string: 最近見到過帝國的信使嗎？

original: Seen any Imperial couriers lately?
string: 最近見到過帝國的信使嗎？

original: What would it take to identify the buyer? (Bribe)
string: 要怎樣才能找出買家呢？（賄賂）

original: Well, now that you mention it, there is something I've been trying to get my hands on.
string: 啊，既然你提到了。我之前確實試著接觸過一些。

original: Great Malacath, we beseech you, aid us in our time of need...
string: 偉大的瑪拉凱斯，我們懇求您在我們危難之際伸手相助。

original: What efforts would they be undermining?
string: 他們想破壞什麼？

original: This! This... Orb. The Eye of Magnus, whatever you want to call it. It's clearly powerful, and no doubt they want it for themselves!
string: 這！這是……瑪格努斯之眼，或者你們有別的什麼叫法。這東西威力無窮，他們肯定想據為己有。

original: I expect to be informed if they make any future attempts to contact you.
string: 如果他們以後跟你有什麼接觸，希望你能來告訴我。

original: Get to the bottom of what?
string: 查明白什麼？

original: Whatever it is those Psijics are up to. They cannot be trusted.
string: 不管這些賽伊克人想做什麼，都不能相信他們。

original: For all we know, he's here to scout out the College. I'm sure they want to undermine our efforts.
string: 據我們所知，他在這裡監視著學院。他們一定是想破壞我們的成果。

original: I'm not sure what just happened but I assure you I will get to the bottom of it.
string: 我還不太確定剛才發生了什麼事，但我保證會追根究底，查個明白。

original: I am not "up to" anything. I apologize if I have offended in any way.
string: 我沒有在「圖謀」任何事。如果無意中冒犯了誰，我道歉。

original: What? What trickery is this? You're not going anywhere until I find out what you're up to!
string: 什麼？這是什麼陰謀詭計？我們查清楚你的圖謀前，你哪兒也去不了。

original: There's been a misunderstanding. Clearly I should not be here. I shall simply take my leave.
string: 這明顯是誤會了。這裡確實不是我該來的地方。我馬上就走。

original: Don't play coy. You asked to see a specific member of the College. Here he is. Now what is it that you want?
string: 別害羞。你讓我從學院裡找一個特殊的人。就是他了。現在你究竟想做什麼呢?

original: Don't play coy. You asked to see a specific member of the College. Here she is. Now what is it that you want?
string: 別害羞。你讓我從學院裡找一個特殊的人。就是她了。現在你究竟想做什麼呢?

original: I'm sorry, I'm afraid I don't understand.
string: 抱歉，我好像不太明白。

original: Well? What is the meaning of this?
string: 什麼？這是什麼意思？

original: None can stand against the Wolf Queen!
string: 狼女王無人可擋！

original: I can see to that. We'll need plenty of fresh corpses to rebuild her army, you see.
string: 交給我吧。你知道，我們需要大量新鮮的屍體來重建一支軍隊。

original: You've come far, mortal. No doubt you seek to enter Potema's Sanctum.
string: 你竟然到得了這裡，凡人。你一定在尋找波特瑪聖所的入口。

original: Did she, now? Well, as it turns out, there are a few lingering contracts we haven't had the chance to complete just yet.
string: 她這樣說的嗎？好吧……的確我們有一些契約進度落後，還沒有機會去完成。

original: And more, dribbling in from time to time. I'll assign them to you as they become available. To be completed at your leisure.
string: 以後陸陸續續還會有更多。來了以後我就會轉交給你。你有空的時候搞定它們就行了。

original: Astrid said you'd have some work for me.
string: 阿斯垂德說你有工作給我做。

original: So what's the plan?
string: 你有什麼計劃？

original: Head to the Riften jail and talk to Sibbi. Get him to tell you where Frost and his Lineage Papers are and bring them to me outside Riften.
string: 潛入裂谷城監獄去見西比。問他寒霜和牠的血統證明在哪。再把它們帶出裂谷城交給我。

original: You'll be well paid for your time.
string: 我會給你個好價錢的。

original: But this is supposed to be your work.
string: 但這是你的工作才對。

original: I really don't have time to deal with you right now. Please just let me get back to my work.
string: 我現在真的沒時間。拜託讓我回去幹自己的事吧。

original: Here's the ring.
string: 指環在這裡。

original: Excellent! Sorry it didn't work out with you and your lady. I know how excited you were for the wedding.
string: 太棒了！真遺憾你和你那位女士沒能用得上它。你我知道你們對婚禮有多期待。

original: You kept saying it would be a huge ceremony at Morvunskar. You said you even had some magic staff there that would handle all the guests.
string: 你一直都說會在莫萬斯卡舉辦盛大的典禮。你還說會召喚出許多魔法僕人們招待賓客。

original: What was that story about my fiancee?
string: 關於我的結婚對象，我都說了些什麼？

original: How could you forget? It was the sweetest story I'd ever heard.
string: 你怎麼會忘呢？那可是我聽過的最甜蜜的故事。

original: You met at the full moon, under the biggest tree in Witchmist Grove, surrounded by fireflies. It was straight out of a storybook.
string: 你們相遇在女巫迷霧樹林最大的樹下，頭頂是皎潔的滿月，周圍有螢火蟲飛舞。簡直像童話書裡的一樣。

original: Yeah, I've been getting that a lot.
string: 是啊…這我最近常聽到。

original: Aw, what's wrong? Did the engagement fall through? Look, how about we call it even, as long as you bring back the wedding ring?
string: 咦，怎麼了？婚約取消了嗎？這樣吧，你把婚戒拿回來，我們就兩不相欠了。

original: That's really a shame - I was so looking forward to the wedding. You said you'd have all the most interesting guests.
string: 那可真是遺憾。我真的很期待那場婚禮。你說過會請到最有趣的客人的。

original: Okay, how much do I owe you?
string: 好吧，我欠妳多少？

original: It's not about the money, really. I wouldn't have given you the wedding ring on credit if you weren't so obviously in love.
string: 說真的，不是錢的問題。如果你們不是如此相愛，我是不會把婚戒交給你的。

original: But if there isn't going to be a wedding, the least you can do is give the ring back. That was one of my best pieces.
string: 但如果婚禮取消了，那你最起碼要把婚戒還回來吧。那可是我最好的寶貝之一。

original: (forcegreet)
string: (forcegreet)

original: So, you're finally back. Look, I've been patient, but you still owe me.
string: 嗯，你還是回來了。看，我一直很有耐心。但你仍然欠我。

original: Here's your goat. Now can you help me retrace my steps?
string: 這是你的羊。現在可以幫我找出我去過哪裡了嗎？

original: Gleda! And not a scratch on her! Happy day!
string: 格麗達！她完好無損地回來了！今天太高興了！

original: I still can't figure out why you stole her. You left a note explaining it, but half of it was gibberish and the rest had mead spilled on it.
string: 我還是搞不懂你為什麼要偷她。你確實留下了一張解釋的紙條。但這上面一半是胡扯，另一半被蜂蜜酒給弄糊了。

original: Only bit I could make out was "repaying Ysolda in Whiterun," and even that's mostly scribbles. Guess you could try there.
string: 我只能勉強辨認出「在償還白漫的伊索爾達之後」這幾個草上飛般的字。那應該算是線索吧。

original: What happened with Gleda again? I'm a little fuzzy on that.
string: 再說一次格麗達出什麼事了？我有點被弄糊塗了。

original: You really don't remember stealing a goat and selling her to a Giant? Are you thick?
string: 你真的不記得偷了羊還把她賣給巨人的事了嗎？你腦子壞了嗎？

original: Go get her! At least she's bound to follow you back - you smell just like the fermented feed she likes.
string: 去把她找回來！起碼她看到你一定會跟著走！你全身聞起來像她喜歡的飼料！

original: That sounds pretty bad...
string: 聽起來真糟糕……

original: You're damned right it does. I'll never breed another prize-winning goat like Gleda!
string: 你說得他媽的對。我再也培育不出像格麗達這樣一隻能得獎的山羊了！

original: And don't you think of coming back to Rorikstead until you get her back from that Giant.
string: 不把她從巨人那邊拿回來，你就別想再回洛利克鎮！

original: I have no idea what you're talking about.
string: 我不知道你在說些什麼？

original: Is that so? Does the name Gleda ring a bell? The star beauty of my farm? Kidnapped by a drunk lout and sold to a Giant?
string: 是這樣嗎？聽到格麗達這名字有沒有印象？我農場裡的明珠？被一個喝醉的蠢貨偷走，拿去賣給一個巨人？

original: You'd better remember her right fast, before I call the guards and have you hauled away.
string: 你最好馬上想起來，要不然我就叫警衛把你抓走，！

original: I'm sorry?
string: 真的很對不住？

original: Sorry's not good enough! Not while my Gleda is still out there, alone and afraid. You kidnapped her and sold her to that Giant.
string: 道歉有什麼用！我的格麗達還在外面，孤獨而恐懼地受著罪！你把她綁架了，還把她賣給了一個巨人。

original: (forcegreet)
string: (forcegreet)

original: You! You've got a lot of nerve showing yourself in this town again. What do you have to say for yourself?
string: 你！你居然還有臉在鎮上露面。你打算怎為你自己辯解？

original: If you had to kill your own brother to be allowed back home, you'd think twice as well.
string: 要是回家的唯一辦法是殺掉自己的親兄弟，你也會再三考慮一番。

original: Don't tell me you, of all people, are afraid of a battle.
string: 我才不相信。你，是你啊，居然會不敢上戰場？

original: I would need to challenge the chief, and take his head, to return home. I'd rather stay here.
string: 我得去會會那個盜賊，取下他項上人頭，然後才能回家。那我寧可待在這裡。

original: I really do apologize. I think I've picked up everything.
string: 我真的很抱歉。我想我都想起來了。

original: I suppose that'll do. Dibella teaches us forgiveness, after all. Even for a drunk like you.
string: 我想那就行了。畢竟蒂貝拉教導我們要寬恕。對於像你這樣的醉漢也是。

original: DialogueGenericSharedInfo
string: DialogueGenericSharedInfo

original: Is someone there?
string: 有人在那裡嗎？

original: What was that?
string: 那是什麼？

original: Huh?
string: 什麼？

original: Where are you?
string: 你在哪兒？

original: You can't hide from me!
string: 你躲不過我的!

original: Over here!
string: 這邊！

original: Be careful!
string: 小心！

original: Hey, watch it!
string: 喂，注意點！

original: Don't do that.
string: 別那麼做。

original: What are you doing that for?
string: 你為什麼那樣做？

original: You could have just asked.
string: 不能好好問嗎？

original: I saw you do that, you know.
string: 我剛才可看見你了。

original: Ha! Found you!
string: 哈！找到你了！

original: What do you think you're doing?
string: 你以為自己在做什麼？

original: You're not supposed to be in here.
string: 你不該在這裡的。

original: Oh no! By the gods! This can't be happening!
string: 哦不！諸神啊！這不可能啊！

original: You dirty thief!
string: 你這骯髒的賊！

original: Stop, thief!
string: 站住，小偷！

original: I understand.
string: 我明白了。

original: Of course.
string: 當然了。

original: How much?
string: 多少？

original: It can't be helped.
string: 幫不了它。

original: Not my problem.
string: 這不是我的問題。

original: It would seem so.
string: 看起來是這樣。

original: It's all in this note.
string: 都記下來了。

original: You've done well.
string: 你幹得很好。

original: Maybe you can help me.
string: 也許你能幫我。

original: Thank you. Here, this is for you.
string: 謝謝。拿著，這是給你的。

original: Just bring it back to me.
string: 把它帶回來給我。

original: I can pay you.
string: 我不會虧待你。

original: Okay. Just this once.
string: 好的。下不為例。

original: How can I argue with that?
string: 我怎能不同意呢？

original: Okay, okay. You've talked me into it.
string: 好吧，好吧。你已經說服我了。

original: No need to get rough!
string: 不要這麼粗魯！

original: Whatever you say!
string: 隨便你說！

original: Don't hurt me! You win.
string: 別傷害我。我認輸。

original: A little coin always greases the wheels.
string: 幾個錢幣就能推動車輪。

original: Gold solves most problems, doesn't it?
string: 有錢好辦事，對吧？

original: For that price? Sure.
string: 那個價格？當然了。

original: You expect me to believe that?
string: 你指望我相信那個？

original: Nah. I don't think so.
string: 不了。我不那麼認為。

original: That doesn't change anything.
string: 那什麼也沒有改變。

original: I'll teach you to talk to me that way!
string: 你居然敢這樣跟我說話！

original: Hope you're willing to back those words up with your fists!
string: 看你的拳頭有沒有比你的嘴巴厲害！

original: I don't have to take that from you!
string: 你竟敢對我這麼放肆！

original: What? Nooo!
string: 什麼？不！

original: We've got an assassin! Check the shadows!
string: 有刺客！檢查暗處！

original: Gods help us!
string: 神啊，救救我們！

original: What in the...?
string: 搞什麼……？

original: What are you staring at, you worthless piece of gutter trash? I simply must start locking the doors again...
string: 你在看什麼東西，你這水溝裡的廢物垃圾。我以後得開始鎖門了……

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

original: Aretino? Why that little bastard! You tell him I'm coming for him! And when I find him, it will be the beating of his miserable life!
string: 艾瑞提諾？那個小王八蛋！你告訴他我會找他！等我找到他，我肯定要把他打死！

original: Aventus Aretino says hello.
string: 阿文圖斯．艾瑞提諾向你問好。

original: The what? Why how dare you! I will not be intimidated in my own orphanage! Get out! Get out this instant!
string: 什麼？你膽子不小啊！我才不會在自己的孤兒院被嚇倒！給我滾！馬上滾！

original: The Dark Brotherhood has come, Grelod.
string: 黑暗兄弟會已經來了，桂羅。

original: I have a family heirloom you can have. Supposed to be sort of valuable. I hope that's all right.
string: 我有個傳家寶可以給你。應該能值些錢。希望你能同意。

original: Assassinations don't come cheap, boy.
string: 雇刺客可不便宜啊，孩子。

original: Finally! My prayers have been answered!
string: 總算來了！我的祈禱有回音了！

original: You've come at last! I knew you would!
string: 你還是來了！我就知道你會來的！

original: Grelod is the headmistress of Honorhall Orphanage. But not for long.
string: 桂羅是榮耀堂孤兒院的院長。不過她幹不長了。

original: It's Honorhall Orphanage, in Riften.
string: 是榮耀堂孤兒院，在裂谷城。

original: Please don't kill Constance Michel. She really is kind.
string: 請不要殺康斯坦斯．米切爾。她真的是個好人。

original: Well? Is it done?
string: 如何？事情辦妥了嗎？

original: Grelod the Kind. Is she... you know?
string: 慈祥桂羅。她……那個了嗎？

original: What do you want? You have no business being in here!
string: 你想做什麼？你快給我出去！

original: Riff-raff! That's all you Riften people are!
string: 一堆垃圾！說的就是你們裂谷人！

original: This is an orphanage, not an inn. Begone from here.
string: 這裡是孤兒院，不是酒館。趕緊從這裡消失。

original: You don't scare me.
string: 你嚇不倒我。

original: You're trying to frighten me, hmm? Do your worst!
string: 想嚇唬我，哈？還差得遠呢！

original: Contract?
string: 契約？

original: My mother, she... she died. I... I'm all alone now. So they sent me to that terrible orphanage in Riften. Honorhall.
string: 我媽媽她……她死了。我……我成了孤兒。他們就把我送到裂谷城的那個可怕的榮耀堂孤兒院。

original: The headmistress is an evil, cruel woman. They call her Grelod the Kind. But she's not kind. She's terrible. To all of us.
string: 院長是個邪惡、殘酷的女人。人們都叫她慈祥桂羅，其實她一點也不慈祥。她非常可怕，對我們每個人都一樣壞。

original: So I ran away, and came home. And performed the Black Sacrament. Now you're here! And you can kill Grelod the Kind!
string: 所以我逃回了家。還進行了黑色聖禮。現在你來了！你可以殺掉桂羅。

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

original: You don't have to say anything. There's no need. You're here, so I know you'll accept my contract.
string: 你什麼也不用說，因為沒有必要。你已經來了，我知道你會接受契約。

original: Yes, of course... The Black Sacrament...
string: 是，當然了……黑色聖禮……

original: It took so long. So very long. But now that you're here, you can accept my contract.
string: 我等了好久，非常久。但現在你來了，你可以接受我的契約。

original: I'm sorry boy, but I'm not who you think I am.
string: 很抱歉，孩子，我不是你想像的那種人。

original: Of course you are! I prayed, and you came, and now you'll accept my contract!
string: 你當然是！我祈禱了，然後你來了，你現在又接受了我的契約！

original: Are you all right?
string: 你還好嗎？

original: It worked! I knew you'd come, I just knew it!
string: 起作用了！我就知道你會來的，我就知道！

original: I did the Black Sacrament, over and over. With the body, and the... the things. And then you came! An assassin from the Dark Brotherhood!
string: 我做了黑色聖禮，一次又一次。和屍體，還有……那些東西。然後你就來了！黑暗兄弟會派來的刺客！

original: Was a man named Sam with me?
string: 有個叫山姆的男人跟我一起來嗎？

original: Dibella teaches love and compassion, but that doesn't mean we're just going to tell you what you want to know and let you walk away from this.
string: 蒂貝拉教給我們愛和憐憫。但這不意味著我們會對你有問必答，還讓你揚長而去。

original: Pick up your mess, then apologize, and if we think you're sincere we'll consider lending you aid.
string: 趕緊收拾一下，然後道個歉。如果你夠真誠我們可以考慮幫你。

original: (forcegreet)
string: (forcegreet)

original: Wake up!
string: 起來！

original: That's right, it's time to wake up, you drunken blasphemer!
string: 那就對了。該起來了，你這醉酒的地痞！

original: Let me think about it.
string: 讓我考慮一下。

original: Thanks, I guess.
string: 那就，謝謝吧。

original: My pleasure. But I think it's time for you to go. No fun keeping you locked up in here with the staff.
string: 不客氣。但我覺得你該走了。把你跟法杖鎖在一起可不好玩。

original: Why did you choose me?
string: 你為什麼選了我？

original: Let's be honest, here. I don't always think my decisions through.  But you... you're going places.
string: 我老實跟你說。我做決定時常想的不夠透徹。但你……你可是見過世面。

original: Maybe a little influence from your old uncle Sanguine could help adjust your course a bit...
string: 也許大叔我，桑吉恩，可以運用我的影響力稍微改變你的人生……

original: So all of this was just a prank?
string: 那所有這些只是場惡作劇？

original: Just a prank? Just a prank? The Daedric Lord of Debauchery does not deal in mere "pranks."
string: 惡作劇？只是惡作劇？ 司掌放蕩之魔侯可不搞「惡作劇」。

original: This may have begun as a minor amusement, but it wasn't long before I realized you'd make a more interesting bearer of my not-quite-holy staff.
string: 這剛開始可能只是一個小玩笑，但我很快意識到你這人很適合拿我這把不是很神聖的法杖。

original: (forcegreet)
string: (forcegreet)

original: I really just needed something to encourage you to go out into the world and spread merriment.
string: 我只是想讓你到世界各地傳播歡樂罷了。

original: And you did just that! I haven't been so entertained in at least a hundred years.
string: 而你確實做到了！我有起碼一百年沒如此開心了。

original: I could sure use a staff like that...
string: 我當然想要這樣一把法杖……

original: So... you were telling me a tale?
string: 那麼……你剛才是跟給我講故事？

original: What did I do? Please, whatever it is, I'm sorry.
string: 我做了什麼？拜託，不管我幹了什麼，我很抱歉。

original: I don't have time for this nonsense. I've got a home to keep and children to feed. Now let me out of here!
string: 我沒有時間浪費在這些沒有意義的事情上。我有一個家要顧，有孩子等我餵。馬上讓我離開這裡！

original: Tell you what. You release me, and I promise my associates won't hunt you down like an animal and butcher you in the street. It's a win-win.
string: 告訴你個好消息。你放了我，我保證我的合夥人不會把你像殺豬一樣宰掉。這是個雙贏的交易。

original: Who are you?
string: 你是誰？

original: My name is Fultheim. I'm a soldier. Well, mercenary, really. You know, a... a sellsword. I've lived in Skyrim all my life.
string: 我叫弗瑟姆，是個士兵。呃…其實是傭兵。你知道的，賣我的身體跟手中的劍。我這輩子都沒離開過天際。

original: That's all! I'm a nobody, really. So can't you just let me go?
string: 就是這樣了！我只是個無名小卒，真的。就不能讓我走嗎？

original: None of your damned business who I am! If you're going to kill me, just do it already!
string: 我是誰跟你狗屁關係都沒有！你要是想殺我，就趕緊動手！

original: As Mara is my witness, if I didn't have this hood on right now I would spit right in your face...
string: 瑪拉作證，要不是戴著這兜帽，我早就吐口水到你臉上了……

original: Ahhh... Vasha, at your service. Obtainer of goods, taker of lives, and defiler of daughters.
string: 啊……瓦沙，願為您效勞。本人專司殺人劫貨、辣手摧花。

original: Have you not heard of me? Perhaps I will have my people carve my name in your corpse, as a reminder.
string: 你沒聽說過我？真該讓手下把我的名字刻在你的屍體上，這樣你就記住了。

original: Would someone pay to have you killed?
string: 有人想付錢殺了你嗎?

original: What? Oh gods, I don't want to die...
string: 什麼？哦、天哪，我可不想死啊……

original: Excuse me? What kind of question is that?
string: 什麼，這是哪門子問題？

original: Me? Ha! Are you serious?
string: 我？哈！你開玩笑吧？

original: Did you ever want to return to your stronghold? Go back to your family?
string: 你就想過回自己的城寨嗎？跟自己的家人在一起？

original: You didn't die. A battle you live through is a great honor.
string: 你沒死。你是個光榮的戰鬥英雄。

original: There you are. Look, I... I just wanted to say thanks for coming to find me. Back in Dawnstar. Crazy jester finally met his match, am I right?
string: 你回來了。那個……我想感謝你遠赴晨星找我。這回瘋狂小丑終於遇到對手了，是吧？

original: The anticipation is killing me. Can you figure out who has the contract? Which one will you choose?
string: 等待真是折騰人啊。你找得出誰才是在我們契約的暗殺對象嗎？你決定選哪個？

original: That twisted jester will pay for what's he's done...
string: 那個瘋狂的小丑會為他的行為付出代價的……

original: I'm afraid I don't have a primary contract for you yet.
string: 我手上目前還沒有契約能夠給你。

original: Why am I not surprised to learn Cicero is alive? I still can't stomach the little clown, but if you've welcomed him here, I won't question it.
string: 為什麼我知道西塞羅還活著一點都不吃驚？我真是受不了這個小丑，不過如果你歡迎他的話，我不會提出質疑的。

original: Maybe I'll make the Potage le Magnifique, hmm? You may have killed the Gourmet, but true artistry never dies.
string: 也許我該做點絕美濃湯，嗯？美食家或許已經被你殺了，但真正的手藝從不會消失。

original: Maybe I'll make the Potage le Magnifique, hmm? But not the way you make it! Ha ha ha. No, certainly not...
string: 也許我該做點絕美濃湯，如何？但和你的做法不同！哈哈哈，必須不同……

original: I've been expecting you.
string: 你終於來了。

original: Should have figured the little lunatic would completely snap.
string: 早該知道那個小瘋子會徹底發瘋。

original: So, what of the old beggar, Narfi? Is it done? Has he groveled for his last septim?
string: 那個老乞丐納菲的情況怎麼樣？搞定了沒？今後不會再看到他乞討了吧？

original: How went your meeting with Ennodius Papius? Did you prove his paranoia legitimate?
string: 你跟恩諾迪尤斯．帕尤斯的會面怎麼樣？你證實了他古板偏執的性格嗎？

original: I see you're back from Dawnstar. Beitild lies dead, I hope?
string: 我知道你從晨星城回來。貝提尤德已經翹辮子了吧？

original: You're alive. Then I guess you haven't paid a visit to the vampire yet, hmm?
string: 你還活著。嗯……我猜你還沒去拜訪那個吸血鬼吧？

original: Please tell me you flayed that horrible bard alive and made a drum from his skin...
string: 請告訴我，你把那個可怕的詩人活活剝下了皮並且做成了一面鼓……

original: Taken care of that layabout Deekus, yet? Or does the idea of killing a fellow Argonian make your scales crawl?
string: 殺死那個小混混蒂庫斯了嗎？還是你看到亞龍人同類就捨不得下手了？

original: No new boots? Does this mean the Argonian is still alive?
string: 沒穿新靴子？這麼說那個亞龍人還活著？

original: You smell like dead cat. Can I assume Ma'randru-jo has been taken care of?
string: 你聞起來就像一隻死貓。我想你是不是已經除掉瑪'蘭德魯-約了？

original: How went your encounter with  Ma'randru-jo? Back in Hammerfell, I always loved watching two cats rip each other to shreds...
string: 你和瑪'蘭德魯-約的會面結果如何？在落錘省的時候，我最喜歡觀看兩隻貓相互搏鬥要把對方撕成碎片了……

original: Hmph. No arrows protruding from your skull... Can I assume Anoriath is dead, then?
string: 嗯。你的頭上沒有箭……我猜阿諾利亞斯已經死了，對吧？

original: Ah, back from Fort Graymoor. The old servant has been put out of her misery, I hope?
string: 啊，從灰色荒原堡壘回來啦。那個老僕人可悲的生命已經終結了，對吧？

original: So, you've returned from Mzinchaleft! A Dwarven ruin... what an exotic place for a kill. Assuming Maluril is actually... dead?
string: 啊，你從津查遺址回來啦！鍛莫遺跡……刺殺的絕佳場所。我猜毛尤利爾是不是已經……死了？

original: Back from your little vacation in Falkreath. So, did you enjoy the sights, sample the food... kill the housecarl?
string: 從佛克瑞斯度假歸來啦。怎麼樣，風景如何，食物可不可口……還有，那個隨從殺了沒有？

original: You haven't faced that pirate captain yet, have you? Safia? I only ask because you're still alive...
string: 你還沒去找那個海盜船長、就是那個叫薩非亞的？我是看你還活著所以才問的啦……

original: So many contracts, so little time...
string: 任務很多，時間卻很有限……

original: Will there ever come a time when the people of Skyrim no longer need our services? I think not.
string: 天際的人們什麼時候才會不需要我們的服務呢？我想這一天永遠也不會到來。

original: Still here? What's the matter, can't handle what I'm throwing your way?
string: 還在呢？怎麼了，我給你的任務你處理不了嗎？

original: I wish I had more contracts to dole out. You handled those jobs like a born killer.
string: 真希望我能有更多契約可以發給你。你幹起活來簡直就像個天生殺人狂。

original: You reek of death, my friend. I salute you.
string: 你簡直是死神的化身啊，我的朋友。我太佩服你了。

original: Remember the passphrase: "Silence, my brother."
string: 記住這句暗語：「靜寂，我的兄弟」。

original: The Sanctuary is in the southern Pine Forest. Close to the road, but away from prying eyes.
string: 聖所就在密松林的南面。離馬路不遠，但是不會有閒人看到。

original: Have you talked to Nazir? He's sure to have some additional contracts for you.
string: 你和納茲爾談過了嗎？他應該有更多的任務要交給你。

original: I don't have anything for you just yet. Please, talk to Nazir, and see what he has available.
string: 我現在沒任務給你。請去和納茲爾談談吧，看他有什麼？

original: I'm still trying to find a suitable contract for you. Continue to work with Nazir on the, um, supplemental assignments.
string: 我還在為你找合適的任務。你先找納茲爾要額外的任務吧。

original: The Keeper will be arriving soon, with the body of the Night Mother. So many preparations to be made...
string: 守護者很快就要帶著夜母的遺體到來了。我們要做很多準備工作……

original: Go, take care of the Muiri contract. There will be plenty more, I promise you.
string: 去完成暮蕊的契約吧。之後還有很多工作等著你，我保證。

original: Why are you still standing there? Hurry, before the meeting begins.
string: 你還在這裡站著做什麼？快去啊，會面就要開始了。

original: Speak with Nazir and see if he has any contracts available. I need time to read Motierre's letter.
string: 去和納茲爾談談，看看他目前有什麼任務。我需要時間來讀一讀莫提雷的信件。

original: What are you waiting for? My husband is out there somewhere with that lunatic. Find them! Do what you've been tasked to do!
string: 你還在等什麼？我的丈夫還和那個瘋子在一起呢。找到他們！快點做你的工作！

original: Shouldn't you be out ruining someone's special day?
string: 差不多該去外面毀掉某個人的特別的一天了吧？

original: Ah, good to see you, brother. Gearing up to kill the Emperor? Exciting times. Exciting times, indeed.
string: 啊，很高興見到你，兄弟。準備好刺殺皇帝了嗎？刺激啊，真是太刺激了。

original: Ah, good to see you, sister. Gearing up to kill the Emperor? Exciting times. Exciting times, indeed.
string: 啊，很高興見到你，姐妹。準備好刺殺皇帝了嗎？刺激啊，真是太刺激了。

original: Cicero is at your service, oh great and powerful Listener!
string: 西塞羅為您效勞，偉大威武的聆聽者！

original: Let's kill someone.
string: 我們去殺人吧。

original: Citizen?
string: 公民？

original: You must be lost. The tavern is down the road a piece.
string: 你迷路了吧。客棧就沿著這條路不遠。

original: I'm fairly certain you wandered into the wrong building, friend...
string: 我想你進錯地方了吧，朋友……

original: Yes, Listener?
string: 是的，聆聽者？

original: I am yours to command.
string: 我聽從你的指揮。

original: How may I serve you, my Listener?
string: 我可以為你效勞嗎，聆聽者？

original: Yes, Listener? How may I serve you?
string: 是的，聆聽者？我可以如何為你效勞？

original: Listener. It is an honor to stand before you.
string: 聆聽者。能見到你真是榮幸。

original: How may I serve you, my Listener?
string: 我可以為你效勞嗎，聆聽者？

original: Please...
What is it you want?
string: 你想要什麼？

original: Just... just stop. And I'll tell you where I've hidden my treasure.
string: 不……不要。我告訴你財寶藏在哪。

original: It's... in a hollowed-out rock. In the tundra. A bit west of Whiterun. Now please... please stop.
string: 在……在一個中空的岩石裡。就在凍土那一帶。白漫西邊。請你……請你不要再……

original: Oh gods, you've taken everything I have. Just kill me and be done with it...
string: 哦天哪，你已經把我的一切都奪走了。給我來個痛快好嗎……

original: Why are you people doing this?
string: 你們為什麼要這麼做？

original: Is it information you want?
string: 你想要資訊嗎？

original: This... this is about the inheritance, isn't it? All right! I'll tell you where I've hidden it.
string: 是……是想要遺產，對嗎？好吧！我告訴你我藏在哪。

original: It's in a hollowed-out tree stump. In the marsh, south of Solitude. Now please, you'll let me go now. Right?
string: 就藏在一個空心的樹樁裡。在沼澤，獨孤城南部。現在，求你了，讓我走。好嗎？

original: Why don't you be a dear and let me go now. All right? I won't say a word to anyone. Our little secret. I promise.
string: 行行好，放我走。好嗎？我不會跟別人說的。我會保守秘密的。我發誓。

original: You... you can't do this to me...
string: 你……你不能這麼對我……

original: Do you have any idea who I am? When my father hears about this, he will gut you.
string: 你知道我是誰嗎？我的父親知道了，他會殺了你的。

original: Ah, now I understand. This is about that my father's hidden cache, isn't it? The dowry for my wedding.
string: 啊我知道了，這與我爸爸的隱藏金庫有關，是吧？我結婚的嫁妝。

original: Ha! Well it's safely hidden away, in a hollowed-out tree stump. Just outside Riften, tucked away nice and secure. You'll never find it.
string: 哈！它藏得很好，在一個中空的樹樁裡。就在裂谷城外面，藏得又安全又隱蔽。你找不到的。

original: Damn it. I gave it away, didn't I?
string: 該死。我說漏嘴了，對吧？

original: I'll tell you anything. Anything! Just please stop... hurting me...
string: 我什麼都告訴你。都告訴你！請你不要再……傷害我……

original: I just...  can't take the pain. Not a second longer.
string: 我……我受不了啦。別來了。

original: I'll give you money. Treasure. I have some things hidden away. Take them all. They're yours. Just please... stop.
string: 我給你錢。財寶。我有藏起來的東西。把它們都拿走吧。它們是你的了。請你……停下。

original: Just north of Windhelm. There's a hollowed-out rock. I have some things hidden in there. Take them! They're yours.
string: 就在風舵城北面。有一個中空的岩石。我在裡面藏了東西。拿走吧！都是你的了。

original: I've told you everything I can. I don't know what else you could want...
string: 我已經把我能說的都告訴你了。我不知道你還想要什麼……

original: So... wait. Cicero is alive? And we're all friends again? I swear, I can hardly keep up...
string: 那麼……等等。西塞羅還活著？我們都成了朋友？這情況演變太快了吧……

original: You know, I can still sell you some potions and such, or train you in alchemy.
string: 你知道，我依然可以賣給你藥水什麼的，或者訓練你的鍊金術。

original: I like it here. We should have moved to Dawnstar ages ago.
string: 我喜歡這裡。我們該早個幾年搬到晨星來的。

original: I can't wait to see what the future brings.
string: 我等不及看將來會發生什麼了。

original: Do you need alchemy components? Or training?
string: 你需要鍊金材料嗎？還是訓練？

original: Hello, Listener.
string: 你好，聆聽者。

original: What do you think? Some more Nirnroot, maybe?
string: 覺得怎麼？再來點奈恩根如何？

original: I learned to cook from my father. Ah, but that was a long time ago. Before, you know... I killed him. But let's not talk about that now.
string: 我從我父親那裡學的廚藝。啊，那是很久以前的事了，在我……殺了他之前。現在別講這事了。

original: I'll follow you till I'm dust in the breeze. You do realize that?
string: 我即使化成灰也會跟隨你。你明白嗎？

original: This place is already starting to feel like home. Must be all the bloodstains.
string: 這個地方已經開始像家了。肯定是血跡的緣故。

original: What do you need, Listener?
string: 你有何吩咐，聆聽者？

original: Listener, please... if Cicero is going to be a part of this Sanctuary I'll accept that. But can't you do something about the... dancing?
string: 聆聽者，我懇求你……如果西塞羅必須成為這聖所的一員，我可以接受。但你不能處理一下那個……舞蹈的事情嗎？

original: Got to admit, I find the Night Mother's presence... comforting.
string: 我必須承認，夜母的存在令人感覺……相當的安詳。

original: The new initiates are working out well. Eager, dedicated, and not afraid to get their hands wet.
string: 新人都很不錯，勤奮、投入，也很大膽。

original: Things proceeding well, Listener?
string: 一切順利吧，聆聽者？

original: Yes, Listener?
string: 是的，聆聽者。

original: The Dark Brotherhood is on the rise again, Listener. I can feel it.
string: 黑暗兄弟會將再次崛起，聆聽者。我能感覺得到。

original: Cicero can talk for a moment. Just a moment. Then Mother must be... tended to.
string: 西塞羅可以聊一會兒。只能一會兒哦。我必須要去……服務夜母。

original: Oh, I do wish to get to know you better. But I must tend to mother. Maybe we can talk for just a moment...
string: 哦，真希望我可以更加瞭解你。可我必須去服務夜母了。或許我們可以談一下下……

original: Yes, Listener? How can Cicero be of service?
string: 是的，聆聽者？西塞羅可以為你服務嗎？

original: Aha! I knew you could do it! I just knew it! I knew the Dark Brotherhood would save me!
string: 啊哈！我就知道你能做到！我就知道！我知道黑暗兄弟會會解救我的！

original: Here, just like I promised. This should fetch you a nice price. And thank you. Thank you again.
string: 拿著，如我所承諾的。這應該可以賣個好價錢了。謝謝你。再次感謝你。

original: Grelod the Kind is dead.
string: 慈祥桂羅死了。

original: Where would I go to join up?
string: 我應該去哪加入？

original: Well I can't just tell that to any skeever that washes up.
string: 嗯，我不能就這樣告訴所有自己跑來的惡鼠。

original: From the look of you, I'm guessing you're more looking to cause some trouble for the Horkers.
string: 從你的樣子看來，我想你是來找我們的麻煩。

original: Haldyn will take my hide for this, but Skyrim's been feeling a bit confining lately.
string: 哈丁知道的話會扒了我的皮，不過天際最近給人感覺有些拘束。

original: We draw council at Japhet's Folly. The fools in Windhelm won't go near it, which is fine by us.
string: 我們在傑非的老巢召開了會議。風舵城的蠢貨們根本不敢接近，這對我們倒有好處。

original: If you'll pardon me now, my crew needs gathering. Should be in Hammerfell before the other Horkers know who let slip their secret.
string: 不好意思，我的人要集合了。我們得在其他成員知道誰洩露了秘密之前趕到落錘省。

original: So where are the Blood Horkers?
string: 血腥長牙在哪呢？

original: You miss them? I don't know how many times I feared for my life.
string: 你居然懷念那些日子？我那時候怕得要死。

original: There were many good battles, friend. I miss those days.
string: 那些光榮的戰鬥啊，朋友。我真想念那些時候。

original: Why not fight back?
string: 為什麼不反擊呢？

original: Our own security forces are limited, and all the mercenaries are tied up in this ridiculous war.
string: 我們的防衛力量有限，而所有的傭兵都已經陷入這場荒謬的戰爭中了。

original: We don't even know their base of operations, and attacking single ships won't really solve the problem.
string: 我們甚至不知道他們的基地在哪，只攻擊一艘船解決不了問題。

original: Do you remember the Legion? Fighting the Thalmor in the Great War?
string: 你還記得軍團嗎？在浩大戰爭中和梭默戰鬥的那些人？

original: I doubt the Forsworn would risk holding this mine a second time. They lost many of their warriors.
string: 我覺得棄誓者不會再回到礦坑。他們損失了大量的戰士。

original: Are you worried the Forsworn might return?
string: 你是不是擔心棄誓者可能回歸呢？

original: It's the rush of good fortune, my friend. It makes you work harder.
string: 這是好運降臨的時刻，我的朋友。更加努力地工作吧。

original: I feel like we're mining even more ore than before.
string: 我覺得我們挖出的礦石比以前更多了。

original: Good to see you again, friend! We've opened the mine back up. If you're here for work, I'll buy any ore you have.
string: 很高興再見到你，朋友！我們的礦井重新開放了。如果你是來工作的，我可以購買你有的礦石。

original: I never thought I'd see Kolskeggr again.
string: 我從沒想到我會再次見到科斯凱格。

original: The mine is just how I remember it.
string: 礦井和我記憶中的一樣。

original: It's good to be mining again.
string: 能再次挖礦真好。

original: I've never seen Pavo so happy. It's good to be back in Kolskeggr.
string: 我沒見過帕沃這麼開心過。能回到科斯凱格真好。

original: There, I cast the spell.
string: 來，我施法了。

original: Well done, indeed.
string: 做得好，真的。

original: Well, you clearly possess the minimum aptitude required. Congratulations. I'll escort you up to the gate.
string: 看來你達到我們的最低要求了。祝賀你，我護送你去大門。

original: You'll want to speak with Mirabelle Ervine right away. And welcome to the College of Winterhold.
string: 你現在去找米拉貝勒．娥文談談吧。歡迎來到冬堡學院。

original: Okay, this is for the spell. (Give 30 gold)
string: 好的，這是法術的錢。（給30金幣）

original: Never mind. I'm not interested.
string: 算了。我沒什麼興趣。

original: No? Very well, it's your choice.
string: 不要？很好，這是你的選擇。

original: I don't know the spell.
string: 我不知道那個法術。

original: I don't know that spell.
string: 我不知道那個法術。

original: I don't know that spell.
string: 我不知道那個法術。

original: I don't know that spell.
string: 我不知道那個法術。

original: I don't know that spell.
string: 我不知道那個法術。

original: I don't know that spell.
string: 我不知道那個法術。

original: Where can I learn more about magic?
string: 我可以在哪裡學習魔法？

original: Nords don't care much for magic. The College in Winterhold is about the only place it's not looked down on.
string: 諾德人不是很關心魔法的事情。可能只有冬堡學院的人才會看得上這類東西吧。

original: Otherwise you could talk to the Jarl's pet wizard in Solitude.
string: 要不然你也可以和獨孤城那邊領主的跟屁蟲法師聊聊。

original: The College of Winterhold is the only place in Skyrim open-minded enough to teach magic.
string: 冬堡學院是全天際唯一一個思維開放到可以教授魔法的地方。

original: Although Ulfric's court wizard has been known to take on apprentices once in a while.
string: 不過聽說烏弗瑞克的宮廷法師偶而也會招收學徒。

original: Magic? Goodness, not here! Nothing dangerous like that! That's all kept to that College up in Winterhold.
string: 法術？天哪，可別在這裡！那真是太危險了！還是讓冬堡的法師去操心比較好。

original: Better that than dealing with Ulfric's wizard like some do.
string: 去那裡總比去找烏弗瑞克的法師要好。

original: Magic is for the weak. Elves, I mean. They keep to that College in Winterhold. They know their place.
string: 法術是弱者的選擇。就是那些精靈。他們總是躲在冬堡的學院裡。他們清楚自己的地位。

original: Of course there is Farengar. He might be the Jarl's wizard, but at least he's a Nord.
string: 當然了還有法仁加。他雖然是領主的法師，但至少他是個諾德人。

original: Pfft, I should've guessed as much. Your kind sticks to that College in Winterhold, as well they should.
string: 哼，果然如我所料。你們這種人最好全都躲進冬堡學院裡。

original: You'd never think to learn from a Nord like the Jarl's wizard.
string: 你不會想從一個諾德人那裡，比如領主的法師身上學到什麼東西的。

original: There's a College in Winterhold that teaches magic. It's very secretive, though, and you know how people hate secrets.
string: 冬堡有一個學院教授法術。那裡一直保持隱秘，而且你知道吧，人們不喜歡隱秘的東西。

original: The Jarl's court wizard was taught there. That one's full of secrets.
string: 領主的宮廷法師就在那裡受訓的。這個傢伙的秘密可多了。

original: Magic? That's dangerous. You want to learn that, go to that College in Winterhold. They teach that stuff there.
string: 法術？很危險啊。你想要學，就去冬堡的學院吧。他們教這類東西。

original: Hey! I know. The Jarl's wizard could teach ya. He's lots closer.
string: 嘿！我知道了。領主的法師可以教你。他就在附近。

original: I've got no interest in magic users. No use for their kind at all. They're way up north in Winterhold, and that's fine with me.
string: 我對法術使用者沒有興趣。他們在這裡派不上用場。所以他們就北上躲到冬堡裡去了，至少對此我挺滿意的。

original: I don't even like our Jarl havin' a  court wizard.
string: 我就連我們的領主養一個宮廷法師都反對。

original: Bit of advice, folks here don't care for magic or those that use it. If you're intent on it, check at the College up in Winterhold.
string: 給你一句建言，這裡的人不喜歡法術，也不喜歡使用法術的人。如果你堅持要學，就去冬堡的學院。

original: Either that or go see the Jarl's court wizard.
string: 不然你就得去找領主的宮廷法師。

original: Looking to blow yourself up? I hear that's what magic does to you. There's a College in Winterhold that teaches magic, unless that blew up too.
string: 想要把自己炸翻啊？法術就是這麼邪門。冬堡有一個學院是教授法術的，如果它還沒被炸翻的話。

original: Be a lot safer just to have the Jarl's wizard teach you a thing or two.
string: 去找領主的法師學東西的時候稍微小心點。

original: Magic is nothing but trouble. If you're set on it, there's that College in Winterhold or Ulfric's court wizard. But don't say I didn't warn you.
string: 魔法除了帶來麻煩以外一無是處。如果你一定要學，那就去冬堡的學院或者找烏弗瑞克的宮廷法師吧。不過可別怪我沒警告你。

original: The people of Skyrim don't like magic much, so about the only place you're likely to find a teacher is the College of Winterhold.
string: 天際人不喜歡魔法，所以你想要給自己找個老師的話，你只能去冬堡的學院。

original: That'd be the College in Winterhold. I suppose you'll be headed there, then. Well, don't let me get in your way.
string: 冬堡有一座學院。我想你可以去那裡。你要去就上路吧。

original: Seen enough magic in my day to know to stay away from it. I'd stay away from the Jarl's wizard in Dawnstar too.
string: 關於魔法我已經見過不少了，多到足以提醒我避開這類東西。當然了晨星城的領主的法師，我也會躲得遠遠的。

original: If you wanna be a damn fool, go to the College in Winterhold instead.
string: 你真這麼相當傻瓜的話，就去冬堡的學院吧。

original: You lookin' for Falion? Why don't you go bother those mages at their College in Winterhold and leave my brother alone?
string: 你在找法利昂？你怎麼不去煩冬堡學院的那群法師，不要打擾我兄弟行嗎？

original: Any aspiring mage would do well to look for the College in Winterhold. Head there, and you'll get what you're after.
string: 稍微有點志向的法師就應該去找冬堡的學院。去那吧，你會找到你想要的東西的。

original: Although our Jarl's humble wizard might be willing to help you too.
string: 儘管我們領主那謙恭的法師也有可能願意給予你幫助。

original: Magic? Got no good use for that here. Mages keep to their College in Winterhold. Go bother them.
string: 魔法？在這裡是派不上用場的，魔法師們都躲在冬堡的學院裡，快去找他們吧。

original: Wish the Jarl's wizard would up and leave with ya.
string: 真希望領主的法師會跟你一起走。

original: Head north to Winterhold. There's a College there, they teach magic. Most Nords don't care for them.
string: 向北前進至冬堡。在那有一所學院，他們傳授魔法。大多諾德人並不關心他們。

original: Else you could go see the Jarl's wizard. Might be able to help you.
string: 另外你可以去拜訪領主的法師。他可能有能力幫助你。

original: Magic? You're on the wrong side of Skyrim. You want Winterhold... that College there. They teach it.
string: 魔法？你現在跑到天際省的另一頭來啦。你要找的是冬堡……那裡的學院。他們傳授魔法。

original: Otherwise you can try the Jarl's wizard. I wouldn't, though.
string: 另外你可以試試去找領主的法師。不過我不會那樣做。

original: Winterhold. You want the College there. They teach quite a bit.
string: 冬堡。你想去那裡的學院。他們教很多東西的。

original: Oh, I think you'll find that magic is rare in Skyrim. Winterhold, though... The College there has it in abundance. Look there if you wish to learn.
string: 噢，我想你會發現在天際魔法是罕見的。不過在冬堡……那裡的學院有大量的魔法。如果你想學就過去看看吧。

original: Not here. Definitely not here. You want to learn, join the College in Winterhold. They'll deal with it.
string: 不是這裡。肯定不是這裡。你想學魔法，就去冬堡的學院。他們才處理那種東西。

original: Magic is... frowned upon in Skyrim. Only the mages at the College of Winterhold teach it freely. If you wish to learn, join them.

string: 你最好先放下其他的事情。真正的挑戰就要來臨了。

original: With Vici's murder, you've started us down a path the Dark Brotherhood hasn't traveled in centuries. The assassination of an Emperor.
string: 從薇齊開始，你已經帶我們走上了一條黑暗兄弟會好幾百年都沒有走過的歷程。你將引領我們刺殺皇帝。

original: And now, your reward. A unique spell to summon a legend of the Dark Brotherhood. His soul serves us now in death, as his body once did in life.
string: 現在，作為獎勵，將傳授一個可以召喚黑暗兄弟會英魂的獨特法術給你。他的靈魂將誓死為我們效命，正如他肉體生前曾做的一樣。

original: Ah, and of course, a bonus, for killing Vici while she addressed her guests, as instructed. Gold... simple and pure. Spend it as you will.
string: 啊，當然還有額外的獎勵，因為你按照要求在薇齊演說時殺死了她。給你的金幣……純粹的金幣獎勵。隨便花吧。

original: Now then. Time to proceed to the next stage of the plan. Go and speak with Gabriella. She's been helping me arrange your next contract.
string: 那麼，是時候去實施我們的下一步計畫了。去和加布裡艾拉談談。她在幫我安排你的下一份契約。

original: With Vici's murder, you've started us down a path the Dark Brotherhood hasn't traveled in centuries. The assassination of an Emperor.
string: 從薇齊開始，你已經帶我們走上了一條黑暗兄弟會好幾百年都沒有走過的歷程。你將率領我們刺殺皇帝。

original: And now, your reward. A unique spell to summon a legend of the Dark Brotherhood. His soul serves us now in death, as his body once did in life.
string: 現在，作為給你的獎勵。一個獨特的可以召喚黑暗兄弟會英魂的法術。他的靈魂將誓死為你效命，正如他的肉體曾經做的一樣。

original: Unfortunately, in your zeal, you failed to eliminate Vici while she addressed her guests, as directed. I'm sorry, but your bonus is forfeit.
string: 抱歉的是，因為你一時心急，你沒能按照要求在薇齊會客的時候殺掉她。很抱歉，但是額外獎勵沒有了。

original: Now then. Time to proceed to the next stage of the plan. Go and speak with Gabriella. She's been helping me arrange your next contract.
string: 那麼，是時候去實施我們的下一步計畫了。去和加布裡艾拉談談。她在幫我安排你的下一份契約。

original: Excellent. Once again, you've proven yourself a born assassin.
string: 很好。你再一次證明了你自己是一名出色的刺客。

original: Tell you what. Why don't you hold onto Shadowmere a while longer? He's a fine steed, and hasn't been ridden nearly as much as he should lately.
string: 對了，你為什麼不繼續帶著微影呢？她是匹好馬，而且近來有一段時間沒人在使用。

original: And now that this Cicero mess has been mopped up, we can get back to the matter at hand, hmm?
string: 既然西塞羅的問題已經解決了，你就可以去處理其他事情了，對吧？

original: You are not worthy.
string: 你沒有這個資格。

original: Go now to Castle Dour in Solitude. Present the Gourmet's Write of Passage to the officer in charge, Commander Maro. I'm sure you remember him.
string: 前往獨孤城的陰鬱堡 。把美食家的通行證帶給負責的指揮官，指揮官馬洛。我想你還記得他吧。

original: Oh yes, it is Cicero! You were a fool to spare me. What, did you think I would be grateful? Cicero should be Listener! Not you! Now you will die!
string: 哦，沒錯，是我西塞羅！你真不該放過我的。怎麼，你以為我會感激嗎？西塞羅才應該是聆聽者！而不是你！現在你去死吧！

original: Ahhh.... gotcha! Oh, Listener, you should see the look on your face! Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
string: 啊……騙到你啦！哦，聆聽者，你應該看看你臉上那副表情！哈哈哈！

original: Oh, Cicero has returned! Not to kill the kind Listener, but to serve, until one of us dies horribly, in service to our Mother! Best friends forever!
string: 哦，西塞羅又回來啦！當然不是來殺死我們親愛的聆聽者的，而是為他效勞的，直到我們當中有一個人為了我們的夜母獻出生命為止！我們永遠都是好朋友哦！

original: In the meantime, I'll make myself at home in the Sanctuary. I'm sure Mother needs... tending.
string: 與此同時，我自己暫時就在聖所安家了。我確信夜母需要……被照顧。

original: You! You're responsible for the siege of Solitude! By Sithis, this undermines all our plans! Fool! Finish that mess, and only then will we speak!
string: 你！你要為獨孤城被包圍負責！西帝斯啊，我們的計畫全部都被打亂了！蠢貨！把這一團糟先給我解決了，我們再討論其他的事情！

original: You! You're responsible for the siege of that... city! By Sithis, this undermines all our plans! Fool! Finish that mess, and only then will we speak!
string: 你！你要為……那個城市被圍攻負責！西帝斯啊，我們的計畫全部都被打亂了！蠢貨！把這一團糟先給我解決了，我們再討論其他的事情！

original: Half of Skyrim knows. Old hag gets butchered in her own orphanage? Things like that tend to get around.
string: 這消息早傳遍半個天際省了。一個老巫婆慘死在她的孤兒院裡？這種事情傳得總是很快。

original: Oh, but don't misunderstand. I'm not criticizing. It was a good kill. Old crone had it coming. And you saved a group of urchins, to boot.
string: 哦，別誤會了。我不是在諷刺你。幹得很不錯。老太婆是罪有應得，而且你還拯救了一群孤兒。

original: Ah, but there is a slight... problem.
string: 啊，不過有一個……小問題。

original: You know about that?
string: 妳怎麼知道的？

original: Who I am really isn't as important as what I am. And what I am is an admirer. Of sorts.
string: 我是誰並不重要，重要的是我是做什麼的。可以說我很敬仰你。

original: Who are you?
string: 你是誰？

original: DBNazirContractSet1ReadyBranchTopic
string: DBNazirContractSet1ReadyBranchTopic

original: Well then, let's get started. I've got three available right now.
string: 好吧，我們開始吧。我目前有三個。

original: Your targets are the beggar Narfi, an ex-miller named Ennodius Papius, and Beitild, a mine boss.
string: 你的目標包括乞丐納菲，前任工廠主恩諾迪尤斯．帕尤斯，還有一個礦坑老闆，貝提尤德。

original: When you've completed all those, we'll see if I might have some more.
string: 等你把這些都完成了，我們再看看有沒有更多的可以給你做。

original: I'm ready for the first set of contracts.
string: 我已經準備好接第一批契約了。

original: It is. These aren't particularly glamorous assassinations, I'll be honest. Don't pay much, either.
string: 是的。這些不算什麼特別困難的刺殺任務，老實說。當然了報酬也不會很多。

original: But they'll keep you busy. Just do them as you're able. There's no real time limit - the targets aren't going anywhere.
string: 但這能讓你練習。盡力去做吧，反正沒有時間限制——目標也不會亂跑。

original: You can turn each one in as it's completed, or wait and turn in the whole group when all the targets have been eliminated. Whichever works for you.
string: 你可以在這些人逐個死掉後向我回報，或是在他們都死後一次性報告。你自己選擇。

original: Sounds simple enough.
string: 聽起來很簡單。

original: The prominent feature here is the Hall of the Elements. It's our primary location for lectures, practice sessions, and general meetings.
string: 這裡最重要的地方就數元素大廳了。那是我們用來舉辦講座、練習和開會的地方。

original: The College of Winterhold has been a fixture in Skyrim for thousands of years.
string: 冬堡的魔法學院在天際已經矗立了上千年的時間了。

original: Sorry, I'm not ready for that just yet.
string: 抱歉，我還沒準備好。

original: I see.
string: 明白了。

original: Well, please let me know when you are.
string: 好的，等你準備好了請告訴我。

original: I'd love to have a look around.
string: 我想到處看看。

original: Wonderful. Please follow me, and don't wander off.
string: 很好。請跟著我，不要四處亂跑。

original: I was told to come see you.
string: 有人叫我來見你。

original: Another new student... I'm surprised at how many of you there are lately.
string: 又一名新的學生……我對你們最近的數量感到驚訝。

original: Well, first you'll need these. While you're not required to wear them, you may find them more to your liking than your current clothes.
string: 首先你需要這些。雖然不強制你穿著它們，但是你會更習慣這些，而不是你的日常衣服的。

original: I'll give you a brief tour, and then we'll get you to your first class. Are you ready to begin?
string: 我先帶你簡單逛逛，然後我們就開始第一課。你準備好開始了嗎？

original: Yes, just a brief overview of our facilities. Are you ready?
string: 是的，只是帶你簡單看看我們的設施而已。你準備好了嗎？

original: You said something about a tour?
string: 你說要帶我參觀？

original: Do you know about Delphine's... activities?
string: 你對戴爾菲娜的……行為有什麼瞭解嗎？

original: That's her business. Not mine. Probably not yours either.
string: 那是她的事情，不是我的。當然，也不關你的事。

original: The dragonstone was some kind of map?
string: 龍石是某種地圖嗎？

original: Yes. A map of ancient dragon burial sites. I've looked at which ones are now empty. The pattern is pretty clear.
string: 是的。一個記錄著先古巨龍埋葬地點的地圖。我檢視過哪些地點現在是空著的。規律很清晰。

original: It seems to be spreading from the southeast, starting in the Jeralls near Riften. The one near Kynesgrove is next if the pattern holds.
string: 看起來是從東南方向的裂谷城附近的傑羅斯山開始的。照這個規律，下一個應該在凱娜之林附近。

original: That's none of your business.
string: 這不關你的事。

original: You're wrong. It is my business. You may be the only one that can stop these dragons.
string: 你錯了。這關我的事情。你可能是唯一一個能夠阻止這些巨龍的人了。

original: But you'll understand that soon enough.
string: 很快你就會瞭解的。

original: I absorb some kind of power from dragons. That's all I can say.
string: 我從龍那裡吸收了某些力量。我只能說這麼多。

original: This is no time to play the reluctant hero. You either are or aren't Dragonborn.
string: 沒時間給你勉強。你到底是龍裔，要嘛就不是龍裔。

original: But I'll see for myself soon enough.
string: 不過我很快就會弄清楚的。

original: Yes, that's how I first learned I was Dragonborn.
string: 是的，這就是我如何知道自己是龍裔的。

original: Good. And you'll have a chance to prove it to me soon enough.
string: 很好。很快你就會有機會證明了。

original: What of it?
string: 怎麼了？

original: Can you do it? Can you devour a dragon's soul?
string: 你能做到嗎？你能吞噬龍的靈魂嗎？

original: Here I am. What do you want?
string: 我來了。你要做什麼？

original: Now we can talk.
string: 現在我們來談談。

original: Close the door.
string: 關上門。

original: Come on, close the door.
string: 來，關上門。

original: You're not afraid of me, are you?
string: 你不怕我，對吧？

original: Just close the door, will you?
string: 關上門，行嗎？

original: Follow me.
string: 跟著我。

original: We should keep moving. Come here. Let me see if I can get those bindings off.
string: 我們應該繼續前進。到這來，看看我們能否把這些繩子弄斷。

original: Looks like we're the only ones who made it. Was that really a dragon? The bringers of the End Times?
string: 看來只有我們逃出來了。那真的是龍嗎？末日的使者？

original: Did you see that?
string: 你看到了嗎？

original: Well would you look at that!
string: 天哪你快看啊！

original: This appears to lead somewhere. Let's see where it goes.
string: 看起來這裡走的通。我們看看到底通向哪兒。

original: I'm not sure. I certainly wasn't expecting this.
string: 我不確定。我也沒想到會這樣。

original: This appears to lead somewhere. Let's see where it goes.
string: 看起來這裡走的通。我們看看到底通向哪兒。

original: What's going on?
string: 發生什麼事了？

original: Someone get that thing out of here and burn it.
string: 來人把那個東西拿開並且燒掉了。

original: Raagh!
string: 啊！

original: Enjoy this while you can. Soon you will all be slaves.
string: 抓緊時間好好享受吧。很快你們都會成為奴隸的。

original: I said, on your knees, Elf!
string: 我叫你跪下來，精靈！

original: Tolfdir is likely already addressing the new Apprentices. Go on in, and if you have any problems, let one of our senior members know.
string: 托夫迪爾已經在招待新來的學徒了。進去吧，如果你有問題的話，就找一下高階成員吧。

original: Initially you'll be learning from Tolfdir, one of our most esteemed Wizards.
string: 一開始你會跟著托夫迪爾學習，他是我們這裡最知名的法師之一。

original: This is where you'll be staying. This bed and desk are yours. Please try and be considerate of others.
string: 這是你住的地方。這張床和桌子是你的。請儘量為別人多著想。

original: Now, let's go back to the Hall of the Elements, where most of the members gather for lectures and study sessions.
string: 現在，我們將回到元素大廳去，那裡是大多數成員舉行講座和學習的地方。

original: Now I'll show you to your quarters. You're going to be sharing space with your fellow Apprentices, who you'll meet shortly.
string: 現在我帶你到你的房間去。你將和你的學徒同學們住在一起，你們很快就會見面了。

original: Our newest members are housed here in the Hall of Attainment.
string: 我們最近加入的成員都住在成就大廳。

original: I'll ask that you please keep your voice down while inside, as others may be working on research or... delicate experiments.
string: 請你在裡面的時候儘量小聲一點，可能有其他人在工作、學習或是……做實驗。

original: Unfortunately, we've had to implement more stringent entry procedures, due to some problems with the local Nords.
string: 很抱歉，由於和本地諾德人之間存在一些問題，我們不得不進行嚴格的入學程序。

original: We don't anticipate any real violence, but it never hurts to be prepared.
string: 我們不允許使用暴力，但是做好準備總不是壞事。

original: On your knees!
string: 跪下！

original: I presume you're talking to me?
string: 你在和我說話嗎？

original: Not so fast Elf!
string: 別這麼快，精靈！

original: Well, yes. Two of them. But you're reaching the end of what I have available.
string: 啊、有的，有兩個。但我這邊能分配的任務已經差不多快要做完了。

original: Your targets are a dark elf wizard named Maluril, in the dwarven ruin of Mzinchaleft. And Helvard, the housecarl of Falkreath.
string: 你的目標是一名叫做毛尤利爾的暗精靈法師，住在津查遺址的鍛莫遺跡裡。還有黑爾沃德，佛克瑞斯城的侍衛。

original: Kill these two, and I'll have one last contract to give you. I'm just finalizing some details now.
string: 殺了這兩個人後，還有最後一個任務等著你。我還在確認一些細節。

original: Are there any more contracts available?
string: 還有什麼任務可以做嗎？

original: Just one right now, actually.
string: 實際上，現在只剩一個了。

original: I need you to eliminate an old woman named Agnis, a servant in Fort Greymoor.
string: 我需要你去解決一個叫阿尼斯的老女人，她在灰色荒原堡壘那裡幫傭。

original: Are there any more contracts, Nazir?
string: 還有其他契約嗎，納茲爾？

original: Well aren't we the eager one? Sorry to disappoint, but there's nothing. Try me again later.
string: 你還真積極啊。但很抱歉暫時沒有了，過一陣子後再來找我吧。

original: Are there any more contracts available?
string: 還有什麼任務可以做嗎？

original: There are indeed. Three, to be exact.
string: 還有。實際上還有三個。

original: There's Deekus, a shipwreck scavenger. Ma'randru-jo, a traveling caravaner. And Anoriath, a hunter.
string: 海難拾荒者、蒂庫斯；旅行家、瑪'蘭德魯-約。還有阿諾利亞斯，一個獵人。

original: Are there any more contracts available?
string: 還有什麼任務可以做嗎？

original: Hmph. How about, instead of giving you another contract, I simply deride you for not finishing the one you still have?
string: 嗯。與其分配新的契約給你，我是不是該教訓你沒把手頭上的做完？

original: Astrid sent me for another contract.
string: 阿斯垂德派我來接下一個契約。

original: So it would appear. Though I'd suspect she'd want you to complete your other contracts first. Do those, then we'll talk about something new.
string: 嗯，似乎是如此。不過我想她會希望你先把你手頭的任務完成了。做完我們再討論新的。

original: Astrid sent me for another contract.
string: 阿斯垂德派我來接下一個契約。

original: As a matter of fact, I do. Two of them. One rather easy assignment, and another that should prove quite a challenge.
string: 實際上我確實有。有兩個。一個比較簡單，另一個可能較有挑戰性。

original: Your first target is an Orc bard named Lurbuk. The other is a vampire by the name of Hern.
string: 你的第一個目標是一名叫做盧布克的獸人詩人。另一個是叫做赫恩的吸血鬼。

original: Happy hunting.
string: 狩獵愉快。

original: Do you have any more contracts?
string: 你還有其他契約嗎？

original: I'm sorry, I don't. Come see me again later.
string: 很抱歉我沒有。過一陣子後再來找我吧。

original: Do you have any more contracts?
string: 你還有其他契約嗎？

original: Well then, your timing couldn't be better.
string: 啊，你來得正好。

original: As it turns out, I've got two new contracts. One rather easy assignment, and another that should prove quite a challenge.
string: 我正好有兩個新的契約。一個比較簡單，另一個應該頗具挑戰性。

original: Your first target is an Orc bard named Lurbuk. The other is a vampire by the name of Hern.
string: 你的第一個目標是一名叫做盧布克的獸人詩人。另一個是叫做赫恩的吸血鬼。

original: Happy hunting.
string: 狩獵愉快。

original: Astrid wanted me to see you about some more work.
string: 阿斯垂德叫我來看有沒有更多的工作可以做。

original: More work? My friend, you still haven't finished the last set of contracts I gave you. Why don't you concentrate on eliminating that final target.
string: 更多的工作？我的朋友，我給你的上一個任務你還沒有完成。你為什麼不專心去解決你之前的目標呢。

original: Astrid wanted me to see you about some more work.
string: 阿斯垂德叫我來看有沒有更多的工作可以做。

original: More work? My friend, you still haven't finished the last two contracts I gave you. Let's get those done, hmm?
string: 更多的工作？我的朋友，你還沒有完成之前我給你的兩個。先做完那些，好嗎？

original: Astrid wanted me to see you about some more work.
string: 阿斯垂德叫我來看有沒有更多的工作可以做。

original: By Sithis, now I am truly impressed!
string: 西帝斯啊，我真是太驚訝了！

original: To kill a pirate captain, on her own ship no less? Simply masterful!
string: 除掉了一個海盜船長，而且還是在她自己的船上？真是太天才了！

original: You've not only earned your payment, but my respect as well. And believe me, friend - that does not come easily.
string: 你不僅贏得了你的獎勵，也贏得了我的尊重。相信我，朋友——這相當不容易。

original: I'm afraid that concludes our business. You have exhausted all available additional contracts.
string: 恐怕我們的工作關係就到此結束。你已經把我所有能給的任務全部做完了。

original: But I'm sure you've got plenty to keep you busy right about now, hmm?
string: 不過我相信你現在一定有自己的事情要做，對嗎？

original: Safia is dead.
string: 薩非亞死了。

original: Hmph. Well, that's sure to throw a branch into Falkreath's well-oiled political machine.
string: 嗯。這顯然會對佛克瑞斯的政治運轉造成不小的打擊。

original: Here's your payment. Well earned, as always.
string: 這是你的報酬。你做的很好。

original: Helvard is dead.
string: 黑爾沃德死了。

original: I hope the elf didn't give you too much trouble. I once got set on fire by a sorcerer. Nasty business, that.

string: 你是怎麼得到的？這種東西已經很多年沒有出現過了。

string: 這是僅有的一個。

string: 掌握了強大魔法的神秘生物，只存在於傳說之中。想像一下他們血管中流動著的力量！

string: 你想要什麼，我的朋友？

string: 那我為什麼要和你說話？

string: 你是我的好朋友，我不會虧待你的。

string: 你啊。你想要什麼？

string: 很高興見到你。

string: 很高興見到你。

string: 你！你又想來傷害我嗎？離我遠點行嗎？

original: It's so good to see you again.
string: 見到你真高興。

original: I don't mean you any trouble. Just leave me alone.
string: 我不想和你惹麻煩。離我遠點。

original: Divines bless you. May the ground you walk quake as you pass.
string: 諸神賜福你。願你的步伐震天撼地。

original: Gods strike you down.
string: 諸神會詛咒你的。

original: My favorite drinking buddy. Let's get some mead.
string: 啊我最愛的酒友啊，我們去弄點喝的吧。

original: Just looking at you makes me upset.
string: 光是看到你就讓我覺得心煩。

original: Good to see Skyrim still has such fine people. You give an old man hope.
string: 真高興天際省還能有你這麼友善的人。我這個老頭覺得有點希望了。

original: You're just rotten. No good.
string: 你真是一塊爛肉。沒用的傢伙。

original: I hope your parents are proud of you. They have a lot of reason to be.
string: 希望你的父母以你為榮。他們一定會的。

original: Leave me alone. Can't an old man have some peace?
string: 離我遠點。就不能讓我這老頭子一個人靜一靜嗎？

original: You're not as dumb as you look.
string: 你沒我想像中那麼笨嘛。

string: 想找我這個老太婆的麻煩嗎？離我遠點。

original: Well, look at you. If only everyone acted like you did.
string: 哦，你真是太棒了。真希望每個人都能像你一樣。

original: You. Every time I look at you my blood boils.
string: 是你。每次看到你我的血液都快要沸騰了。

original: It's a fine day with you around.
string: 見到你真好。

original: You're nothing but trouble.
string: 你只會到處闖禍。

string: 你好啊，朋友！過的好嗎？

string: 真沒用。像你這樣的人存在著一點價值都沒有。

string: 很高興見到你。至少你懂得如何待人接物。

string: 每次看到你，我都想讓一隻劍齒虎在你臉上劃幾道。

original: It's so good to see you again.
string: 見到你真高興。

original: You're mean. I hate you. I hate you forever and ever and ever.
string: 你真小氣。我恨你。我會永遠永遠記恨你的。

original: You're the best! Can you be my father?
string: 你真是太棒了！你能做我的爸爸嗎？

original: You're the best! Can you be my mother?
string: 你真是太棒了！你能做我的媽媽嗎？

original: I hope monsters come and eat you.
string: 真希望你被怪獸吃掉。

original: I bet you could slay one of those mean old dragons. I bet you could do anything.
string: 我打賭你一定能殺掉那些可怕的巨龍。我想你什麼事都能辦得到。

original: The gods know what you've done.
string: 諸神清楚你都做了些什麼？

original: A fine day to you, friend. May you die with a sword in your hands.
string: 你好啊，朋友。願你在戰鬥中光榮地死去。

original: What do you want, milk drinker?
string: 你要做什麼？乳臭未乾的小子？

original: May the gods watch over your battles, friend.
string: 願諸神在你戰鬥時注視著你，朋友。

original: Absolutely no time to deal with lowlifes these days. Go away.
string: 我沒空和你們這些下等人說話。走開。

string: 哦，是你啊。難怪我好像聞到股臭味。

original: So nice to have pleasant company for a change.
string: 難得可以跟人合作得這麼愉快。

original: There are so few pleasures in life as fine as your company.
string: 有你作伴真是人生一大樂事啊。

string: 你要是死了，生活該會變得多麼的美好啊。

string: 你和我，我們是一類人。很高興能認識你。

string: 願阿祖拉的智慧指引你，我的朋友。

string: 賤人。在我發作之前給我消失。

string: 你還想要什麼？你手上的鮮血還不夠多嗎？

original: May your next fight bring you victory, friend.
string: 祝你在下次戰鬥中取得勝利，我的朋友。

string: 願瑪拉凱斯煮沸你的血、刮你的骨以懲罰你的罪刑。

original: May your weapons be sharp and your prey fresh.
string: 願你的兵器永保鋒利，你的敵人無處可逃。

string: 虎人希望你離遠點。你已經給大家造成太多傷害了。

string: 雖然外面很冷，但是有了你的出現，虎人心裡依然覺得很暖和。

string: 它聞起來臭酸、不潔。有害。

string: 說吧。虎人就算全世界的月糖酸掉都會耐心聽你說完的。

original: Ours is to smile at your passing, friend.
string: 你死了會讓我們很高興，朋友。

original: It annoys us. What does it want to take from us now?
string: 真討厭。它又想要做什麼？

original: It is our most favored company.
string: 它是我們最歡迎的朋友。

original: Hmm... Yes, the silence suits you. Gives you an air of mystery.
string: 嗯……是的，沉默挺適合你的。它能給你帶來一種神秘感。

string: 那麼，說正事吧。我正在給你安排一個工作。但是你現在還是先去找納茲爾吧。他有一些小的契約需要你去做。

original: Soon, the Night Mother will arrive. And things around here are sure to get even more interesting.
string: 很快夜母就要到來了。一切都會變得更加有意思的。

string: 啊，最後，入會禮物。黑暗兄弟會的護甲。但願它能在你日後的任務……派上用場。

original: Soon, the Night Mother will arrive. And things around here are sure to get even more interesting.
string: 很快夜母就要到來了。一切都會變得更加有意思的。

string: 我什麼時候可以去殺人呢？

original: But you must be anxious to get to work. I'm arranging a job, but need a bit more time. For now, go see Nazir. He's got several smaller contracts.

original: Soon, the Night Mother will arrive. And things around here are sure to get even more interesting.
string: 很快夜母就要到來了。一切都會變得更加有意思的。

string: 啊，最後，入會禮物。黑暗兄弟會的護甲。但願它能在你日後的任務……派上用場。

string: 我很榮幸能夠加入你的家族，阿斯垂德。

string: 現在你知道我們是誰了吧，下手我們就扯平了。償還你的債務只需要輕輕一刀。

string: 看，我就知道我們可以和平地解決問題的。畢竟你也明白，欠債還錢是天經地義的事情。

string: 那麼，動手吧。選個目標，然後送他到虛無裡去。事成就給你小屋的鑰匙，你就自由了。

string: 好的，我會的。我會殺了他們其中之一的。

original: Now that is a shame.
string: 真丟人。

original: But what you fail to realize is that you involved yourself in this "insanity" when you took Grelod's life. You made your choice.
string: 你還不懂嗎？當你奪走桂羅的性命時，就已經選擇「瘋狂」了。

string: 現在面對後果吧。除非這裡有人死掉，否則你別想離開這個小屋。

string: 你聽到了嗎？蠢貨！這事情沒完！

string: 帝國會反擊的。等著吧。

string: 他是對的。加爾瑪，來吧，我們一起來恢復秩序。

string: 來吧，加爾瑪，我們還有很多事要做。

string: 黑棘領主。我必須承認這念起來很順口。

string: 還請別擔心那暴動，副官。我已經把情況控制住了。

original: We will soon begin publicly executing captured men. That should send a clear message to the people.
string: 我們會於近日開始公開處決俘虜。這樣就足以震懾老百姓了。

original: Indeed. Come, there is much to be done.
string: 是的。來吧，我們還有很多事情要做。

original: Enough! Both of you!
string: 夠了！你們都給我停下！

original: There is a burning city out there that needs a government.
string: 城市都已經亂成一鍋粥了，那裡需要一個政府。

original: Are you two quite done?
string: 你們兩個還沒鬧夠嗎？

string: 你，去收拾你的東西。

original: And you, go sit on that damn chair and start acting like a Jarl.
string: 而你，過去在椅子上坐下，好好當你的領主。

original: If you ladies are finished bickering, there's much to be done.
string: 你們兩位吵完了沒，我們還有很多事情要做呢。

string: 黑棘領主，趕緊重組政府。快點，不然街上要出現暴動了。

original: We must move quickly to prevent further violence.
string: 我們必須趕快行動，防止更多暴力事件的出現。

string: 你們兩個之間親熱完沒有，我們還有一座混亂的城市需要拯救呢。

original: Vignar Gray-Mane! Your family was noticeably absent from the walls. Now I know why. Wouldn't a dagger in the back have sufficed?

original: Thongvor. I should have executed your whole treacherous clan when I had the chance.
string: 松瓦。我應該趁我有機會時把你整個不忠的家族全都處死的。

original: Welcome back. I've left a few surprises for you to discover.
string: 歡迎回來。我給你留了一些驚喜。

original: I think I'll like living here.
string: 我想我會喜歡這裡的生活。

original: Ahhh... It's good to be home.
string: 啊……能回到家感覺真好。

original: Gods. A woman attacked right on the streets.
string: 天哪，一個女人在街上被襲擊了。

original: Are you all right? Did you see what happened?

string: （繼續隱形）（強制結束）攻擊時限到了

original: The attack will be launched imminently. Gather your weaponry and get to the front lines... Now, soldier!
string: 敵人的進攻馬上就要開始了。拔出你的兵器，準備去前線……快，士兵們！

original: Now that our "ghost" has been unmasked, I hope we see more visitors in town than just the occasional pilgrim.
string: 現在既然「幽靈」的真面目被揭穿了，也許我們這裡的訪客數目會多起來。

original: If I were you, I'd keep away from the barrow on the east side of town... it's haunted.
string: 如果我是你的話，我會離城鎮東邊的墓穴遠點……據說那裡鬧鬼。

original: We don't get many visitors through here, unless their headed up to High Hrothgar of course.
string: 我們這裡的訪客並不多，大多數都是前往高吼峰的。

original: Need a room? Maybe a drink? You name it.
string: 要住宿？還是要喝的？請隨便吩咐。

original: Let me know if I can get you anything.
string: 有什麼需要的儘管告訴我。

original: Anything I can help you with? A drink or a room perhaps?
string: 我可以為你服務嗎？你需要喝的還是住宿？

original: Pardon me, milord. Would you care to hear me play my lute?
string: 打擾了，先生。你想要聽我演奏魯特琴嗎？

original: Pardon me, milady. Would you care to hear me play my lute?
string: 打擾了，夫人。你想要聽我演奏魯特琴嗎？

original: If you fancy a bit of music, let me know.
string: 如果你想要來點音樂的話，請告訴我。

original: I can't believe Fastred's gone. I... I should have been nicer to her.
string: 我不敢相信法斯萊德就這麼走了。我……我應該對她好點的。

original: I can't believe Fastred ran off to Riften with that... that bastard.
string: 我不敢相信法斯萊德就這麼和那個……混蛋跑到裂谷城去了。

original: My daughter's driving me crazy, so forgive me if I'm a bit on edge.
string: 我的女兒快要把我逼瘋了，如果我做出什麼失禮行為還請你原諒。

original: If you ever settle down to have children, think twice before you do it.
string: 你如果想要養兒育女的話最好先想清楚。

original: Any idea how I can get my daughter's head out of the clouds?
string: 我怎麼樣才能讓我的女兒回心轉意呢？

original: You a pilgrim or just passing through?
string: 你是朝聖者呢，還只是路過而已？

original: Watch yourself on High Hrothgar, I hear wolves prowl the steps.
string: 在高吼峰的時候小心點，我聽說那裡有狼出沒。

original: I hope Fastred's doing well in Riften. I miss her.
string: 希望法斯萊德在裂谷城過得安好。我很想念她。

original: You must be another pilgrim on the way up to High Hrothgar. No other reason to pass through here.
string: 你一定也是要去高吼峰的朝聖者吧。不然你不會經過這裡的。

original: Pilgrim or not, if I were you, I'd move right through our backwards little town.
string: 管你是不是朝聖者，我是你的話，我會儘快離開這個落後的小鎮。

original: You better not be here to stir up any trouble.
string: 你最好別來這裡惹麻煩。

original: And to think that we've been supplying the Greybeards with our own food supplies. What have they ever done for us?
string: 我們拿我們自己的食物來養活灰鬍子，但他們有為我們做什麼嗎？

original: Oh! You're a traveler! You must have so much to tell about the world outside this boring town!
string: 哦！你是旅行者吧！關於這個沉悶的小鎮之外的生活，你一定有很多故事可以說！

original: Have anything interesting to tell me?
string: 你有什麼有趣的事情可以告訴我嗎？

original: I can't imagine how exciting it must be like to journey from place to place. You're so lucky!
string: 我真是無法想像四處旅行是一件多麼刺激的事情。你真是太幸運了！

original: Narfi's happy now. Maybe Narfi can sleep. Sleep all night. Sleep, sleep, sleep.
string: 納菲現在很開心。也許納菲可以休息了。一覺到天亮。睡覺，睡覺，睡覺。

original: Narfi's sad now. Still wait for Reyda. No more sleep. No, no... no.
string: 納菲現在很不開心。我還在等瑞達。等得睡不著覺。睡不著，睡不著……睡不著。

original: I can't see you, Reyda! I can't find you! Why are you hiding? Hiding, hide, hide, hide! Don't make me sad!
string: 妳在哪裡，瑞達！我找不到妳！妳躲到哪去了！妳總是躲啊，躲啊，躲啊，躲啊！妳不知道我這樣有多傷心嗎！

original: Oh Reyda! Redya! You live among the clouds now, dear Reyda!
string: 哦瑞達！瑞達！我永遠也見不到妳了，親愛的瑞達！

original: I miss Reyda. She was so nice to Narfi. Narfi's sad he can't be with Reyda.
string: 我好想念瑞達，她曾經對納菲那麼好。納菲不能和瑞達在一起真是傷心。

original: You don't look like a pilgrim. Why bother visiting Ivarstead?
string: 你看起來不像是個朝聖者。你到紫杉鎮來做什麼？

original: Hmm? What do you want?
string: 嗯？你想要什麼？

original: Is it absolutely necessary for you to bother me right now?
string: 你非要現在來打擾我嗎？

original: Thanks again for delivering those supplies to the Greybeards.
string: 感謝你幫我把這些補給送給灰鬍子。

original: Ah, good to see you again! How did that delivery go?
string: 啊，很高興見到你！東西送到了嗎？

original: Passing through on your way to High Hrothgar? About to make a delivery up there myself.
string: 你這是要去高吼峰嗎？我正好要把一件東西送過去。

original: I wish I could make my deliveries more often, but the road's getting dangerous.
string: 真希望可以多送幾趟，但是路上越來越危險了。

original: 7,000 Steps indeed... next time they need to build it closer to the ground...
string: 總共有七千級台階啊……下次他們應該把廟蓋離地面近點……

original: I'm going to put those pelts you gave me to good use.
string: 我會好好利用你給我的那些毛皮的。

original: So, have you shown those furry menaces that I mean business?
string: 那麼，你讓那群毛絨絨的野獸們明白我是認真的了嗎？

original: This has to be the worst place in Skyrim to run a mill. How am I supposed to do anything with all those bears running around?
string: 整個天際省就這裡最不適合蓋木材廠了。我該拿那些熊怎麼辦啊？

original: These damn bears are driving me crazy!
string: 這些該死的熊快要把我搞瘋了！

original: Can you believe it? Another pile of logs ruined.
string: 你能相信嗎？我又有一堆原木被毀掉了。

original: I swear, if one more thing goes wrong, I'm going to burn my mill to the ground!
string: 我發誓，要是再出錯，我就把我的木材廠一把火燒了！

original: Hello, my friend? What can I do for you on such a fine day?
string: 你好啊，我的朋友？今天我能為你做些什麼？

original: Miss Temba is much happier now that you took care of those bears. She may not look like she is, but I can tell.
string: 你解決了那些熊，譚巴小姐現在高興多了。雖然看起來不像是那樣，不過我感覺得出來。

original: Those bears are making Miss Temba so angry. I hope you can do something about them.
string: 這些熊把譚巴小姐惹毛了。我希望你可以做些什麼？

original: Such a fine day, smell the air! Isn't it wonderful?
string: 美好的一天啊，聞聞空氣中的味道！這一切不是很美好嗎？

original: I hope life's treating you well, friend.
string: 希望你的生活一切順利，朋友。

original: Oh my, a guest!
string: 哦，天哪，一個客人！

original: Please, make yourself at home!
string: 把這裡當作自己家吧！

original: Lone travelers can find these woods a little treacherous.
string: 落單的旅者可能會覺得這片森林有些危險。

original: We've been looking for someone to join us in a hunt.
string: 我們一直在找人和我們一道去狩獵。

original: Hern and I do so adore guests! These guards are such a bore.
string: 赫恩和我都很喜歡客人！因為那些衛兵們真是太無聊了。

original: A guest, oh my!
string: 一個客人，哦，天哪！

original: Why don't you stay a while?
string: 為何不在這裡待一段時間？

original: The patrols never seem to give us time to be alone, the nosy pests.
string: 巡邏兵總是讓我們不得安寧，這些討厭的蟑螂。

original: Is Hert his sister or his wife? Or both?
string: 赫特是他的妹妹還是妻子呢？還是兩者都是？

original: Hert keeps giving me this look. I don't know if she wants me or if she wants to eat me.
string: 赫特總是這麼看著我。我不知道她是想要我還是想要吃了我。

original: Just my luck, stuck in the sticks with this crazy old woman.
string: 這就是我的命了，和這個瘋老婆子住在這個地方。

original: I grew up hearing songs about Eyldi the Bear! She wrestled a storm out of the sky!
string: 我是聽巨熊埃爾蒂的故事長大的！她甚至可以召喚風暴！

original: If you're looking for a room, you want the Four Shields.
string: 如果你想找住宿的話，你應該去四盾牌。

original: You look like you've seen your share of adventure.
string: 看起來你的冒險經歷也相當豐富了。

original: It's no easy thing to make a living in the wilds of Skyrim.
string: 要在天際省的荒野生存下去可真不容易。

original: Don't see many travelers out this way.
string: 從這裡經過的旅行者不是很多。

original: This land's tough and unforgiving, but beautiful, too.
string: 這片大陸的環境非常惡劣而且嚴酷，但也同樣很美麗。

original: You hear all this talk about a war? I hope it never comes here.
string: 你聽說過戰爭的事情了嗎？希望不要波及到這裡。

original: Seen some mean-spirited folk pass through lately. Thought I was rid of those sorts when I left Markarth.
string: 最近有一些卑鄙的傢伙經過。我還以為離開馬卡斯城就可以遠離這些人了呢。

original: Welcome, traveler. Mind yourself in our town.
string: 歡迎你，旅行者。請不用感到拘束。

original: We aren't a big city like Solitude or Markarth, but we like it this way.
string: 我們的城市雖然不像獨孤城或者馬卡斯城那麼大，但是我們很喜歡。

original: If it weren't for Michel, I'd probably be dead in a Markarth gutter by now.
string: 如果不是米切爾的話，我很可能早死在馬卡斯城的街頭了。

original: Got a loving wife, a healthy son and a patch of land to call my own. What more could a man ask for?
string: 我有一個可愛的妻子，一個健康的孩子和一片屬於自己的土地。我還需要奢求什麼呢？

original: Are you a soldier? One day, I'm going to be a soldier!
string: 你是士兵嗎？總有一天我也會當兵的！

original: Pa says I'm too young to fight in the war, but I can still help by patrolling the town.
string: 爸爸說我太小了，還不能去參加戰鬥，不過我可以幫著巡視城鎮。

original: I wish I was a soldier! They get to travel and stay up late and have fun!
string: 我真希望我能去當兵！他們可以到處旅行，晚上也可以熬夜玩樂！

original: Have you met Lucky? He's my pet goat, and he helps me patrol the town.
string: 你見到來福了嗎？牠是我的寵物山羊，會跟我一同巡邏城市。

original: I'm hoping to run my own inn someday.
string: 我希望有一天我自己也能開一家客棧。

original: Faida's teaching me the innkeeper's trade. She runs the Four Shields.
string: 菲達教我如何當一個客棧老闆。她是四盾牌的老闆。

original: Please stop looking at me like that.
string: 請別這樣看著我。

original: First the war and now there's talk of dragons. What's next?
string: 先是戰爭，然後又是巨龍的傳言。誰知道下一次會是什麼東西？

original: Working hard gives a man reason for drinking hard! Well, that and putting up with a wife like mine.
string: 勞累的工作實在是豪飲的最佳理由了！何況，我家裡還有一個黃臉婆要應付。

original: You're a well-traveled sort, I can tell just looking at you.
string: 你肯定去過不少地方，我從你的外表能夠看出來。

original: You been to Markarth? They've got a tavern called the Silver-Blood Inn. Best ale this side of Skyrim.
string: 你去過馬卡斯城嗎？那裡有一家酒館叫做銀血客棧，裡面有全天際省最棒的麥酒。

original: Money's been tight since the mill burned down. My wife won't let me forget it.
string: 自從木材廠關門以來手頭就一直很緊。我老婆總是不停地嘮叨。

original: They say a strong drink, a sharp axe and a good woman are all a Nord needs to be happy. Two out of three's not bad.
string: 人們常說一個諾德人只需要好酒量、一把鋒利的斧頭和一個好女人就滿足了。我三樣已經占了兩樣了，也不賴。

original: Rest a spell! Can't work every minute of your life.
string: 休息會兒吧！你總不能每時每刻都在工作吧。

original: Where is that lazy man?
string: 那個懶漢跑哪去了？

original: You going to try and sell me something? Well, I ain't interested.
string: 你是不是想找我推銷東西呢？我沒什麼興趣。

original: Did my worthless husband send you?
string: 是我那沒用的丈夫派你來的嗎？

original: Got nothing to say to strange folk.
string: 我和陌生人沒什麼可談的。

original: Keep walking, stranger.
string: 走開，陌生人。

original: Got nothing to spare for travelers nor refugees, here.
string: 我不施捨東西給旅行者和難民。

original: If you're looking for handouts, look somewhere else.
string: 要飯就去別處要去。

original: You want anything in this life, you gotta take it. Just not from me.
string: 如果你的生命中還缺少什麼的話，你就得去努力爭取。當然了，可別從我這裡爭取就行。

original: Faida's the name. I keep the inn.
string: 我是菲達。我是這個客棧的老闆。

original: Something different about you, I can tell. Hope you ain't here to cause trouble.
string: 我能察覺得到你有與眾不同的地方。希望你不是來惹麻煩的。

original: The meals I serve ain't what I'd call a Jarl's feast, but they'll fill your belly.
string: 我這裡的飯菜雖然談不上山珍海味，不過填肚子是絕對沒問題的。

original: Seen a lot of travelers lately. Mostly soldier, nowadays.
string: 最近我見過很多旅客。這些天大多數旅客都是士兵。

original: You met the Lylvieves? Quiet family, but they're the heart of Dragon Bridge.
string: 你見過李維弗斯了嗎？這個家族很低調，不過他們可是龍橋鎮的核心。

original: Poor Horgeir. Everyone in town knows about his wife's affair but him. Probably better if he doesn't know.
string: 可憐的霍格 。鎮裡除了他之外每個人都知道他老婆的事。也許他就這麼蒙在鼓裡最好。

original: I think the dragons are here to test us, and make sure we're still true Nords.
string: 我認為巨龍是來考驗我們的，看看我們還算不算是真正的諾德人。

original: I was a barmaid at the Winking Skeever when I met my husband, rest his soul. Wasn't for him, I'd still be working there!
string: 我遇到我丈夫的時候還在眨眼惡鼠做女侍呢。願他的靈魂安息。要不是他的話我搞不好還在那裡工作呢！

original: Respect the law, and you'll have no trouble in Dragon Bridge.
string: 遵守法律，你在龍橋鎮就不會惹麻煩。

original: Mind you don't cross Tassius. He's in charge around here.
string: 希望你別惹到塔西留斯。他是這一帶的負責人。

original: Don't start any trouble and I think we'll get along just fine.
string: 別惹麻煩，你就沒事。

original: At least, if you're gonna cause trouble, go somewhere else, okay? Please?
string: 如果你想惹麻煩的話請到別處去，好嗎？拜託？

original: Are you a mercenary? You won't find much work here.
string: 你是傭兵嗎？這裡沒你可做的工作。

original: Another quiet day.
string: 真是平靜的一天。

original: Another quiet day... I hope.
string: 真是平靜的一天……希望能維持。

original: Heard there were wolves on the road up north.
string: 聽說北面的路上有狼群出沒。

original: Those rebels better not try coming to Haafingar.
string: 那些叛亂分子最好別到海芬加來。

original: I'll bet a drunk like you sees a lot of strange things.
string: 我打賭像你這種醉鬼肯定見過很多奇異的事物。

original: I give up. What did you see?
string: 我認輸。你看到什麼了？

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

original: Very well. I respect your discretion.
string: 好吧。我尊重你的想法。

original: Now, I need your assistance with a matter of a more... personal nature.
string: 現在，我需要你幫我處理一件較……私人的事情。

original: Oh, very good. Very good indeed. You, my dear, are going to fit in here quite nicely...
string: 哦，太好了。真是太好了。親愛的，你真是太合適這裡了……

original: Now, I need your assistance with a matter of a more... personal nature.
string: 現在，我需要你幫我處理一件較……私人的事情。

original: I live only to serve. Hail Sithis!
string: 遵從您的指令。西帝斯萬歲！

original: Of course, dear. Of course. And, from what my little ravens tell me, you handled yourself quite well.
string: 當然了，親愛的。當然了。另外，我的小烏鴉告訴我，你處理得很好。

original: Now, I need your assistance with a matter of a more... personal nature.
string: 現在，我需要你幫我處理一件更……隱私的事情。

original: I did what had to be done. Nothing more.
string: 我只是奉命行事而已，沒什麼別的。

original: Ah, you're back. So, how went your first real contract? A bit more exciting than what Nazir's been offering, I'd wager.
string: 啊，你回來了。如何？第一次處理真正契約的感覺怎樣？我想應該比納茲爾那邊的好多了吧。

original: That bastard got exactly what he deserved.
string: 那個混蛋是罪有應得。

original: But last I heard, Nilsine is still alive. So I guess you decided not to kill her as well. I have to admit... I'm disappointed.
string: 不過我聽說尼爾欣還活著。所以我想你並不打算一併解決她。我得說我……很失望。

original: Here's the payment for killing Alain. And nothing for letting Nilsine live. Just remember, that was your decision.
string: 這是殺死阿蘭的報酬。尼爾欣既然還活著，就沒有額外的獎勵了。這可怪你自己沒殺她。

original: Alain Dufont now lies dead.
string: 亞蘭．杜鋒特被我搞定了。

original: Thank you. That bastard got exactly what he deserved.
string: 多謝。那傢伙早該死了。

original: And... I heard about Nilsine. You have more than fulfilled your part of the bargain. Please, take this - as payment, and a symbol of my affection.
string: 而且……我聽說了尼爾欣的事了。你做的遠超出我們原本的約定。拿這個作為報酬吧，它代表著我的感激。

original: I'll never forget you.
string: 我不會忘記你的。

original: Alain Dufont now lies dead.
string: 我解決了亞蘭．杜鋒特。

original: Well, what news? Is Alain...
string: 什麼？亞蘭……

original: DB03MuiriAlainWhyBranchTopic
string: DB03MuiriAlainWhyBranchTopic

original: I went to Windhelm to see the Shatter-Shields. They were old and dear friends, and... in mourning. Friga was killed recently. Murdered...
string: 我去風舵城探望碎盾。他們是我的老朋友。但是……他們正處於哀傷之中。弗利嘉最近死了，是被謀殺的……

original: I met Alain in the tavern, while I was... drinking my sadness away. He was handsome, and charming. He said I was the "beautiful lily" of his dreams.
string: 我在酒館見到了亞蘭，當時我……因為悲傷喝得爛醉。他很帥氣，很有魅力。他說我是他的「夢中情人」。

original: Alain made all the pain just... go away. But it was all lies! Alain used me. He ruined my name, destroyed my friendship with the Shatter-Shields...
string: 亞蘭讓我所有的痛苦都……煙消雲散了。但那都是謊言！亞蘭利用了我。他毀掉了我的名聲，毀掉了我和碎盾之間的友誼……

original: Do you know why Alain was in Windhelm? He heard about Friga's murder. He wanted to befriend the family, in their grief... and rob them blind.
string: 你知道亞蘭為什麼會在風舵城嗎？他聽說弗利嘉被謀殺了。他想要趁著他們悲傷的時候接近，然後……掠奪他們的財產。

original: Alain used me to get close to my friends. And now they all think I'm some kind of... monster. Alain Dufont took my life. And now I'm taking his.
string: 亞蘭利用我接近我的朋友們。現在他們都認為我是一個……怪物。亞蘭．杜鋒特毀了我的生活，因此我要他的命。

original: Tell me the full story. Why do you want Alain dead?
string: 告訴我整個由來。你為什麼要殺亞蘭？

original: Excellent. Once Alain is dead, I'll pay you. In gold. I've saved up a bit. I hope that'll do.
string: 很好。只要亞蘭死了我就付給你錢。用金幣付。我存了一些，希望足夠。

original: But, well... There is one more thing. If you're interested?
string: 不過……還有一件事。你有興趣嗎？

original: It will be done.
string: 包在我身上。

original: DB03MuiriContractDetails2a
string: DB03MuiriContractDetails2a

original: I'll need more to go on than that...
string: 我需要知道得更多……

original: What?
string: 什麼？

original: Alain is... is dead?
string: 亞蘭死……死了？

original: I... I'm grateful. It's just this... this isn't at all how I imagined things would play out. There was Alain, but I was considering more, and...
string: 我……我很感激。只是……只是我沒想到事情會發展成這樣。亞蘭的事，我也還在想別的事情，然後……

original: Ah, well. Dead is dead. Right? My thanks to you, assassin. Here's the gold I was going to pay for the job. You earned it, after all.
string: 啊，好吧。反正也死了，對吧？謝謝你，刺客。這是我原本要付你的酬金。無論如何，這是你應得的。

original: Actually, Alain Dufont is already dead. I killed him.
string: 實際上，亞蘭．杜鋒特已經死了。我殺了他。

original: DB03MuiriContractDetails1
string: DB03MuiriContractDetails1

original: What I need? What I need is for Alain Dufont to die! I want him hunted down and murdered like the dog he is!
string: 我想要什麼？我想要亞蘭．杜鋒特去死！我想要他死得像隻畜牲一樣！

original: Obviously. Now tell me what you need.
string: 當然了。跟我說你想要什麼？

original: DB03MuiriKillNilsineTopic
string: DB03MuiriKillNilsineTopic

original: If you can... I want you to kill someone else, as well. You don't have to - not as part of our deal. But if you do... I'll pay you even more.
string: 如果可以的話……我還想要你殺一個人。當然你沒必要——畢竟不是我們交易的一部分。但是如果你做到的話……我可以付給你更多。

original: It's Nilsine Shatter-Shield, in Windhelm. If Nilsine dies, too... I'll make it worth your while.
string: 是尼爾欣．碎盾，住在風舵城。如果尼爾欣也死了……我會報答你的。

original: I'm listening.
string: 我在聽。

original: Isn't there some business you should be tending to?
string: 你不是有正事要做嗎？

original: The Dark Brotherh... Oh. Oh! I... my goodness, you're really here! The Black Sacrament. It actually worked?
string: 是黑暗兄……哦。哦！我……天哪，真的是你們！黑色聖禮真的應驗了？

original: The Dark Brotherhood has come, Muiri.
string: 黑暗兄弟會的人到了，暮蕊。

original: Why are you looking at me like that?
string: 你為什麼那樣看著我？

original: We all are, my dear, but sometimes the Divines reward those who don't seem to deserve it. Call it dumb luck.
string: 我們都不能理解，親愛的，但有時聖靈獎勵那些不該獎勵的人。那純粹就是運氣了。

original: Sometimes I'm surprised he's still the chief.
string: 有時候我都很難理解他為什麼還是酋長。

original: Oh, you've seen your father just trying to chase a skeever from his house. He's a bit soft.
string: 哦，你也看過你爸爸想要趕一隻惡鼠離開的樣子。他有點軟弱。

original: It's a wonderful house, my love. If you don't mind, I'm going to start a small store. Something to do whenever you're on the road.
string: 真是個漂亮的房子啊，親愛的。不介意的話，我想開一家小商店。這樣你走了我還可以有點事情做。

original: You have quite a house. I'm thinking of setting up a small store here. Sell odds and ends.
string: 你的房子真不錯。我想在這裡開一家小商店，賣點雜貨什麼的。

original: Strange house, but strong. Solid. I think I'll open a store. A task to tend to whenever you're away.
string: 古怪的房子，但是很堅固。很耐用。我想我可以開一家商店，你上路的時候我才有事做。

original: This house of yours is wondrous, at least to these eyes. I've thought about starting a store. Something to do here when you're out.
string: 在我看來你的房子真是太漂亮了。我想我可以開一家商店，這樣等你不在的時候我可以有點事情做。

original: This house is huge. I'll be tripping my feet all over this place. Hey, I think I'll start a little business here. Something to do, you know?
string: 房子可真大。我猜會到處摔跤的。嘿，我想在這裡做點小生意。這樣我不至於閒著，你明白嗎？

original: I've seen bigger houses, but it's yours, so I like it. Now, I think I need something to do if you're ever away, so I'll be opening a store.
string: 雖然我見過更大的房子，但是畢竟這間是你的，所以我還是很喜歡。我想等你走了我可能得找點事情做，所以我可以開一家商店。

original: A good house. You chose well. I don't like sitting still, so I've decided to open a store. Buy and sell whatever is needed.
string: 好房子。你選的不錯。我不想就這麼在家待著，所以我打算開一家商店，做點買賣。

original: Hello, my love. Back from some adventure I bet.
string: 你好啊，親愛的。冒險回來啦。

original: It's good to see you again, dear.
string: 很高興見到你，親愛的。

original: It's pleasing to see you again.
string: 很高興再次見到你。

original: Ah, it's my love, come to visit.
string: 哦，親愛的，過來看我了。

original: Hello, dear. I haven't been drinking too much, if that's what you're thinking.
string: 你好啊，親愛的。我有點喝多了，你不就是這麼希望的嗎？

original: You and I, we're the only people in Skyrim worth loving. That's what I think.
string: 你和我，我們是全天際省唯一真心相愛的一對。這就是我心裡所想的。

original: Good to see you, dear.
string: 很高興見到你，親愛的。

original: Yes, my love? What do you need?
string: 嗯，親愛的？你想要什麼？

original: Do you need anything, my love?
string: 你想要什麼，親愛的？

original: Speak. You can ask anything of me, love.
string: 說吧。你可以向我提出任何要求，親愛的。

original: Is there anything you need, dearest?
string: 你需要什麼，我的至愛？

original: I love you. You know that, right?
string: 我愛你。你知道嗎？

original: What do you need, love? Ask anything.
string: 你需要什麼，親愛的？說吧。

original: Yes, love?
string: 嗯，親愛的？

original: What about my father? Was he a good hunter?
string: 我父親呢？他是個好獵人嗎？

original: Oh of course. My mistake.
string: 哦當然了。我錯了。

original: That's what everyone keeps saying. But you didn't kill her. That's what I was asking.
string: 大家都這麼說。但是你沒有殺她。你沒聽懂我的問題。
