original: What? Why? I don't understand... I have done nothing to wrong you. Please, mercy!
string: 什麼？為什麼？我不懂……我做錯了什麼？手下留情！

original: What? You dare challenge Ma'randru-jo? You will suffer for your insolence!
string: 什麼？你敢挑戰瑪'蘭德魯-約？你會為你的傲慢付出代價。

original: I'm sorry, egg brother, but I've been sent to kill you.
string: 抱歉，卵生兄弟，但我奉命取你性命。

original: All right, everyone. Let's be careful, but have fun!
string: 好吧，大家都小心點，但要玩的開心！

original: J'zargo... what shall we have you do... Ah! Why don't you verify that we're the first ones here? Look for any amount of tampering with the tombs.
string: 紮格……該讓你做點什麼呢……啊！你去確認我們是不是第一批找到這裡的。去檢查下墓穴的狀況，看是否被人動過。

original: Onmund, please search that area over there. See if you notice any... residual energies. Alive or undead.
string: 昂蒙德，搜索下那邊。看是否有……殘餘能量，不管是活人或亡靈。

original: Brelyna, my dear, why don't you search for warding magics. Anything designed to keep people out. Don't interact with them, just identify them.
string: 布萊麗娜，親愛的，去檢查看看是否有守衛結界，或任何阻擋人們進來的機關。記得別觸發，只要找到就行。

original: Now, let's see. What shall we have the rest of you do?
string: 好吧，現在，你們剩下的人該做什麼呢？

original: I don't have any more questions. What would you like me to do?
string: 我沒有其他問題了。你想要我做什麼？

original: Ah, yes. Hmm. Well, why don't you see if you can assist Arniel Gane? He's one of our scholars, here working on cataloging our finds.
string: 啊，對。嗯，你可以去協助阿內爾．甘。他是個學者，正在幫我們把找到的東西分類。

original: I expect he'd appreciate some help in locating any additional magical artifacts here in the ruins.
string: 如果你幫他在附近的廢墟裡找些魔法器物的話，他會很感激的。

original: Any enchanted items will do; the usefulness of the enchantment is irrelevant. If you find anything, the class can look it over.
string: 只要是附魔的東西就好，是否有用無所謂。你只負責找，行家會鑒定的。

original: Find Arniel Gane. He's somewhere in the northern section of the ruins. He'll show you what to do.
string: 在廢墟北邊找阿內爾．甘，他會指導你怎樣做。

original: What did you want me to do?
string: 你想要我做什麼？

original: Now what?
string: 接下來呢？

original: Well, are there any questions before we begin?
string: 那麼，在開工之前還有什麼問題嗎？

original: I'm not sure what to expect here. Please be on your guard.
string: 我並不清楚前方的危險，你們小心行事。

original: What... What was that? Everything seemed to shimmer for a moment.
string: 那……那是什麼？剛一瞬間所有東西都在發光。

original: What happened?
string: 發生什麼事了？

original: And here we all are. Shall we step inside?
string: 我們都到齊了。進去嗎？

original: What could this place be?
string: 這是個什麼樣的地方？

original: Be prepared to defend yourself.
string: 時刻戒備。

original: This is simply fascinating.
string: 這真是神奇。

original: Please be careful here. The site isn't entirely secured.
string: 當心點。這地方可能有危險。

original: Please be careful here. The site isn't entirely secured.
string: 當心點。這地方可能有危險。

original: J'zargo finds nothing but dust in these ruins.
string: 紮格在這些廢墟裡一無所獲。

original: Do you think there's treasure here? Something to make J'zargo a powerful wizard?
string: 你覺得這裡會有寶物嗎？能讓紮格成為強大的法師？

original: Who knows what we might find in here.
string: 天知道我們會在這裡發現什麼？

original: You know, there might be gold somewhere in here.
string: 這裡可能會有金幣哦。

original: To think, my ancestors destroyed the homes of Onmund's ancestors. So much bloodshed.
string: 仔細想到，是我的祖先摧毀了昂蒙德祖先的家園。死了那麼多人。

original: I'm not seeing signs of any warding magics at all. Either they're not here, or they were removed long ago.
string: 我在附近並沒發現任何守護結界。可能原來就沒有，或者是被人解除了。

original: This is better than sitting around talking about magic, don't you think?
string: 這比坐著談論魔法有意思多了，不是嗎？

original: This is exciting, isn't it?
string: 這好刺激啊，對不對？

original: I wonder if everyone else would be so happy to rifle through the bones of their ancestors.
string: 搜刮祖先們的屍體可不是什麼讓人開心的事。

original: Can you imagine what it was like, living here so long ago? The first men in Tamriel, here...
string: 你能想像那場景嗎，上古時代的祖先，泰姆瑞爾大陸最早期的人類在這裡生活過。

original: I'm not so sure we should be here.
string: 我覺得我們不該在這裡。

original: I find it hard to believe this excavation was approved.
string: 我不敢相信這挖掘行動竟然被批准了。

original: Don't touch anything!
string: 別碰任何東西！

original: It's going to take forever to sift through all this.
string: 這麼多東西一輩子都檢查不完。

original: I'll be amazed if we find anything useful here.
string: 要是能在這找到有用的東西那我才吃驚呢。

original: Well, certainly none of this will benefit my research...
string: 嗯，這些顯然都對我的研究沒什麼用處……

original: I'm not quite ready to go inside yet.
string: 我還沒準備好進去。

original: No? I daresay we don't have all day.
string: 還沒？我們可沒時間等你。

original: Still? If I have to wait much longer, you may need to just bury me here.
string: 怎麼？你還要我再等的話，乾脆把我埋在這裡好了。

original: Sorry, I'm still not ready to go in there.
string: 抱歉，我還沒準備好進去。

original: Help! Get that beast out of my house!
string: 救命！把那頭野獸趕出我家！

original: It's still here! Get it out!
string: 它還在這！把它弄出去！

original: Get that thing out of here!
string: 把它弄出去！

original: Thank you! I thought that beast would be the end of me!
string: 謝謝你！我以為那頭野獸會殺了我！

original: Me? I like to talk to my targets before the kill. Taunt them, scare them... even challenge them.
string: 我？我動手之前喜歡和我的目標聊聊。嘲弄他們、嚇唬一下……或者是挑戰他們。

original: That can have interesting results. Some victims may flee, others may cower in fear.
string: 這樣會產生很有意思的結果。有些人會逃，有些會嚇得半死。

original: If you can goad a target into attacking you first, you may even find any local guards coming to your aid.
string: 要是你能逼你的目標先對你發動攻擊，你甚至能得到當地衛兵的幫助。

original: What's your preferred method of assassination, Astrid?
string: 你喜歡何種刺殺方式，阿斯垂德？

original: Just be yourself. Eliminate the targets any way you see fit. Quiet, loud, quick, slow - whatever you feel is best.
string: 自己喜歡就行。隨便怎麼殺。快慢皆可，動靜皆宜。

original: Occasionally I'll give you a contract with certain parameters. Stay within them, and you'll earn yourself a bonus.
string: 通常我會給你一份有條件的合約。你只要遵守條件，就能獲得賞金。

original: Can you offer me any advice on the contracts?
string: 你能給我點關於契約的建議嗎？

original: I just cook, and clean, and do whatever it is they ask of me.
string: 我只負責燒飯，掃地，還有被使喚。

original: I can't even keep track of all the people who have been in and out of this fort. They come, they go. I barely notice.
string: 這座堡壘進進出出這麼多人，我怎麼記得住。來來往往，我根本不會去注意。

original: Hard enough to keep up with who owns this fort. One side takes over, the other runs away. I tell them, "I ain't leaving! I come with the place!" Ha!
string: 這堡壘的主人我也記不住，有人接手有人走，我跟他們說，「我不會走！我是堡壘附送的！」哈！

original: I remember one morning, long time ago, I woke up and the place was run by some Orcs. Went to bed that night, it was all vampires. Don't matter to me.
string: 我記得很久以前，有一天早上醒來，這裡已經被一群獸人接管了。晚上我去睡覺，全是吸血鬼。但我根本不在呼。

original: Now, then. I been gabbin' long enough. Too much cleanin' to do.
string: 噢，我聊得太久了。還有一大堆事要做呢。

original: Ha. I'd like to see those arrogant bastards taken down a notch. Always looking down their noses at us lowly footsloggers.
string: 哈，真希望有人可以教訓一下那些自大的雜種。老是看不起我們這些在地上走的人。

original: If a dragon does show up, maybe we'll get lucky and it will eat the mages first. Might give us enough time to kill it.
string: 如果真有龍出現，運氣好的話牠會先吃掉那些法師。這樣我們就有時間殺了牠。

original: Ah, good. I've been wondering how we were supposed to defend this place from a dragon.
string: 啊，好極了，我還在想這地方該怎麼防禦一條龍的進攻呢。

original: No. They're high mages, just in from Alinor. I guess Herself is finally getting worried about all the dragon attacks.
string: 不，他們是高等法師，從阿裡諾爾來。我覺得她老人家也開始擔憂龍的襲擊了。

original: Did you see those robes march in this morning? Who're they with? More of the Emissary's treaty enforcers?
string: 你看到早上那群穿袍子的人了嗎？他們是什麼來頭？密使派來執行條約的人？

original: I'll see you back in Riverwood.
string: 我會在河木鎮和你碰面。

original: Let's get out of here.
string: 我們快走吧。

original: No.... Not again!
string: 不……別再來了！

original: No more.... No more!
string: 不……不要！

original: Don't kill me.... I don't want to die!
string: 別殺我……我不想死！

original: I... won't... surrender!
string: 我……不會……投降！

original: Call... that... a... swing?
string: 你……就……這點……本事？

original: You.... You'll pay for this....
string: 你……你會有報應的……

original: I'll never submit!
string: 我絕不投降。

original: Do your worst, monster!
string: 有什麼就使出來吧，怪物！

original: I won't bend. Never!
string: 我是絕不會屈服的。絕不！

original: You did this didn't you? I'll get you for this!
string: 這是你做的是嗎？我會抓到你的！

original: I haven't heard even a scratch at the door. Have you done it?
string: 我壓根一點聲音也沒聽到。你成功了嗎？

original: What is it now? We have a tasting to attend to!
string: 又怎麼了？我們還得去試飲！

original: Was something we discussed unclear?
string: 還有什麼沒講清楚的嗎？

original: I can't believe that worked.
string: 真不敢相信，這居然成功了。

original: I can't wait to see Sabjorn squirm.
string: 我等不及看撒布喬恩痛苦的表情。

original: You're supposed to be at the meadery.
string: 你應該在酒莊。

original: Can't a man drink in peace?
string: 就不能讓我安靜地喝一杯嗎？

original: I believe Brynjolf wishes to speak with you. We're done here.
string: 我想布林喬夫想和你談談。我們這邊的事辦完了。

original: I trust you have good news for me.
string: 你應該有好消息給我吧。

original: Why aren't you at Honningbrew Meadery?
string: 你為什麼不在蜜之釀酒莊？

original: Shouldn't you be on your way to Whiterun?
string: 你應該要出發去白漫了吧？

original: About time you showed up.
string: 你怎麼現在才出現？

original: Out with it. What happened at the meadery?
string: 說吧。在酒莊發生了什麼事？

original: I'm certain Maven wishes you to be in Whiterun, not wasting time here.
string: 我確定瑪雯希望你出現在白漫，而不是在此浪費時間。

original: Maven wants to see you right away. I suggest you head right over.
string: 瑪雯想馬上見你。我建議你趕快過去。

original: You've made a mess of things and Maven's furious. I told you not to burn more than three of the hives!
string: 你把事情搞得一團糟，瑪雯快要氣炸了。我告訴過你別燒掉三個以上的蜂窩！

original: I've smoothed things over with her for now, but you can forget your cut.
string: 我暫時把事情緩和了，但你也別想要你那一份報酬了。

original: Word on the street is Goldenglow's been hit. Good job, lad.
string: 傳言說金色光輝被砸了。做得好，小夥子。

original: Word on the street is Goldenglow's been hit. Good job, lass.
string: 傳言說金色光輝被砸了。做得好，小姑娘。

original: I heard you ran into trouble at Goldenglow.
string: 我聽說妳與金色光輝有些過節。

original: Hmph, yeah I did. That wood elf s'wit... he's a lot smarter than I expected.
string: 嗯，對。那個木精靈的智慧……他比我想的要聰明的多。

original: Can you believe that fetcher had more than tripled the guard? There must be eight of them in there.
string: 你能想像那混蛋把衛兵數量增加了3倍以上嗎？那裡至少有8個人。

original: It was like he was daring us to come and get him.
string: 好像是他賭我們是否敢去抓他。

original: I need more details about Goldenglow.
string: 我需要知道更多有關金色光輝的細節。

original: Goldenglow Estate brought in a mountain of gold for the Guild. You could almost call it our sweetest deal.
string: 金色光輝莊園為公會賺得了一大筆金幣。算得上是我們最划算的一筆生意了。

original: Then out of the clear blue, Aringoth stops sending us our cut. Mercer was... well, angry to put it kindly.
string: 然後突然有一天，阿林格斯突然不願意支付屬於我們的那一份。墨瑟當時……非常生氣。

original: So we send in Vex and find out he's hired a bunch of mercenaries to guard the place.
string: 所以我們派「小煩」查明他雇傭了一夥傭兵來守衛那地方。

original: How do I destroy the bee hives?
string: 我怎麼毀掉那些蜂窩？

original: They're built like small fortresses to resist the weather, but their one weakness is flame.
string: 它們像小型堡壘一樣能抵禦惡劣天氣，但它們也有弱點，火。

original: Besides, nothing tells the people of Riften we mean business better than a huge column of smoke.
string: 再說，沒什麼比一柱擎天而上的濃煙更能向裂谷城的人表明我們對生意的重視了。

original: Who cares, we're the Thieves Guild.
string: 誰在乎啊，我們是盜賊公會。

original: That's not how things work around here. The Guild depends on an arrangement of influential people to keep things running smoothly.
string: 這裡的規矩可不是這樣。公會需要靠一些有影響力的人打點事務。

original: What's the catch?
string: 有什麼要注意的？

original: The catch is that you can't burn the whole place to the ground.
string: 重點就是你不能把整片地方燒得一乾二淨。

original: That important client Mercer mentioned would be furious if you did.
string: 如果搞砸了，剛剛墨瑟提到的那位重要客戶可是會很火大的。

original: Tell me about the Goldenglow job.
string: 告訴我金色光輝的事。

original: Goldenglow Estate is a bee farm; they raise the wretched little things for honey. It's owned by some smart-mouth wood elf named Aringoth.
string: 金色光輝莊園是個養蜂場。他們豢養可憐的蜜蜂賺錢。運營這個農莊的是一群叫阿林格斯的叢林精靈。

original: We need you to teach him a lesson by burning down three of the estate's hives and clearing out the safe in the main house.
string: 我要你去給他點教訓，燒掉3個蜂巢，然後把主房內保險箱裡的東西搜刮乾淨。

original: I can't kill Grisvar without a shiv.
string: 沒刀我殺不了格利斯瓦。

original: Ah, Borkul muscle one out of you on your way in? Fine. Take this one.
string: 啊，波庫爾在你進來的時候搶走了對吧？好，這拿去。

original: So tell me, did Aringoth enjoy your visit?
string: 告訴我，阿林格斯對你的拜訪滿意嗎？

original: All eyes are on you, lad. Don't disappoint us.
string: 大家都看著你呢，小夥子。別讓我們失望。

original: All eyes are on you, lass. Don't disappoint us.
string: 大家都看著你呢，小姑娘。別讓我們失望。

original: Was there something else?
string: 還有什麼？

original: I suggest you listen to what Mercer has to say... if you want in.
string: 我建議你聽下墨瑟要說的話……如果你想入夥的話。

original: Let me show you the operation, then you can ask your questions.
string: 我先告訴你做法，然後你可以提問。

original: It's just this way. Keep following me.
string: 跟著我就行。

original: Keep following, it isn't far.
string: 跟著我走，不會很遠。

original: Go, leave me in peace.
string: 你走吧，讓我一個人靜一靜。

original: Let's wait until Brynjolf's here before we begin.
string: 我們等布林喬夫來了再開始。

original: How about some skooma instead? (Bribe)
string: 想來點斯庫瑪嗎？（賄賂）

original: Ah, now that's a good idea. Head on in. But don't try anything in there. Madanach is smarter than you think.
string: 啊，好主意。繼續走。但別自作主張，邁德納奇比你們想的要聰明。

original: Good. Then I think it's time we put your expertise to the test.
string: 好。那麼現在可以測試一下你的專業能力了。

original: Yes, I understand.
string: 是，我明白。

original: Before we continue, I want to make one thing perfectly clear. If you play by the rules, you walk away rich.
string: 在我們繼續之前，我想先跟你說清楚。如果你按規矩行事，你能賺到一大筆錢。

original: You break the rules and you lose your share. No debates, no discussions... you do what we say, when we say.
string: 要是你破壞規矩，你一分錢也拿不到。別跟我爭，也沒得商量……就按我們說的做。

original: This better not be another waste of the Guild's resources, Brynjolf.
string: 希望這次不會是白費力氣，布林喬夫。

original: Mercer? This is the one I was talking about... our new recruit.
string: 墨瑟？這就是我說的那人……我們的新成員。

original: Oh? I don't expect anyone to miss my meaning.
string: 哦？我以為沒人會誤解我的本意。

original: Come, Legate. There's much to do.
string: 來吧，副官。我們還有很多事要做。

original: So what can we do now?
string: 我們現在能做什麼？

original: I've been noting a pattern to when the killings happen.
string: 我注意到謀殺的發生時間呈現出一種模式。

original: Now that we know they're tied in to some sort of necromantic ritual, I think I know when the next might occur.
string: 既然我們知道了它和某種死靈儀式有關，我就能猜測下一次謀殺發生的時間。

original: Let's see. From a Loredas of Last Seed until a Middas of Heartfire... it will happen soon. Very soon.
string: 算一下。從末種之月的週六到爐火之月的週三……最近就要發生了。就這幾天。

original: Keep watch in the Stone Quarter tomorrow night. That's almost certainly where the killer will strike next.
string: 明天晚上繼續監視石頭居住區。我敢斷定兇手下次就會在那裡行兇。

original: I guess Calixto was wrong.
string: 我想卡利斯托判斷錯了。

original: Eehh.. Calixto and his books are often confused about such matters. It happens to the best of us.
string: 呃……卡利斯托和他的書在這種問題上常判斷錯誤。但就算是我們有時也會搞錯。

original: Eight-sided. Jade, ringed with ebony. A worn carving.
string: 八個斷面，翡翠質地，以黑檀環飾，上面還有磨損的刻紋。

original: I know it well. Or at least, I've heard of it. I would wager that carving once depicted a skull.
string: 我知道這是什麼。至少，我聽說過。我敢打賭刻紋的樣式原本是一個頭骨。

original: That is the Necromancer's Amulet, of legend.
string: 這是傳說中的死靈術士護符。

original: It appears you were at least half-right. There is necromancy at the heart of this.
string: 看來你至少說對了一半。死靈法術是這一切的源頭。

original: I found your journals and amulet where the Butcher worked.
string: 我在屠夫工作的地方找到了你的日記和護符。

original: My what, now? I've never kept a journal, I can assure you.
string: 我的什麼？我從來都不寫日記的，我可以保證。

original: What exactly did this amulet look like?
string: 那護符看起來到底是什麼樣子？

original: I found one of your journals, all about necromancy.
string: 我找到了一本你的日記，全是有關死靈法術的。

original: Necromancy? I am a member of the College of Winterhold, in good standing!
string: 死靈法術？我是冬堡魔法學院的一員，是貨真價實的！

original: They haven't allowed necromancy for hundreds of years!
string: 死靈法術已被禁絕了幾百年！

original: MS11
string: MS11

original: What made you think I was to blame in the first place? I've actually been after the killer myself.
string: 是什麼讓你覺得應該怪我？我自己也在追蹤殺手。

original: More of those things. Bah. Viola Giordano's been putting them all around the city.
string: 又是這些傳單。呸。維歐拉．喬爾丹諾把這貼滿整座城市。

original: Frankly, whoever keeps taking them down should get a medal.
string: 坦白說，應該頒獎給把它們撕下來的那個人。

original: Oh, Friga Shatter-Shield's old place?
string: 噢，弗利嘉．碎盾的老地方？

original: Well, since she's not using it anymore, Ulfric might just let you have it, if you have the money. And if he likes you.
string: 嗯，反正她再也用不到了，烏弗瑞克可能會把它給你。只要你有錢，而且他對你有好感。

original: Or you could head over to the family and see if they'll let you in. But I wouldn't want to do that myself. Bad luck over there.
string: 或者你可以直接去拜訪他們家，看他們願不願意讓你進去。但我不會這麼做，那裡霉運當頭。

original: Doesn't mean anything to me. Got an unusual shine to it, though.
string: 看不出這東西有什麼用，雖然它發出的光滿特別的。

original: I'd take it to Calixto. He's got a good eye for pieces like that.
string: 我會把它帶給卡利斯托。他是鑒定這類東西的行家。

original: I don't know if I've ever seen any of those before. I've heard about them, though. Sorry, can't help you.
string: 雖然有所耳聞，但我記不清楚是否見過這類東西。抱歉，幫不了你。

original: Sorry, I don't know anything about those kinds of things.
string: 抱歉，我不瞭解這類東西。

original: Not very good quality, is it? Probably came from the Gray Quarter. Have a talk with Revyn Sadri.
string: 品質不怎麼樣，是嗎？可能是從灰民區來的，去和瑞溫．薩德利談談。

original: He usually knows what's going in and out of that place. Thankfully that means I don't have to.
string: 他幾乎對那地方的各種事都一清二楚。感謝老天爺，這樣我就省一事了。

original: Looks like something one of the dark elves would wear. Ask Revyn Sadri, he probably sold whatever it used to be.
string: 看起來像是暗精靈的衣服。去問問瑞溫．薩德利，他就是賣這個的。

original: Nothing anybody I know would wear. Maybe ask one of the Dark Elves, they usually have some kind of rag falling off of them.
string: 我所認識的任何人都不會佩戴這種東西，也許是從哪個暗精靈身上掉下來的。去問問吧。

original: The one who sells things, what's his name. Oh, yes! Revyn Sadri. Maybe he'd know something.
string: 那個賣東西的人，好像是叫瑞溫．薩德利。也許他會知道。

original: Of course, of course. But such things are valuable, and usually falling apart anyway.
string: 當然了，當然。但這種東西都很珍貴，且通常易碎。

original: I don't see why someone would actually use them.
string: 我不明白為什麼有人會使用它們。

original: Although... that court wizard does all manner of experiments. And I know he owns some truly strange things.
string: 雖然說……那個宮廷法師做各種實驗。他還有一堆稀奇古怪的東西。

original: Nobody else would even know which end to hold.
string: 其他人根本對這一無所知。

original: If I were you, I'd go straight to the steward with this information.
string: 換做是我，我會直接把這消息告訴總管。

original: Oh, good, more of those.
string: 噢好極了，又來了。

original: Did you know Viola Giordano wanted to put one of them on my front door?
string: 你知道嗎，維歐拉．喬爾丹諾想把其中一個貼在我家前門上。

original: "Everyone will see it!" she said. Of course! That was my problem with it.
string: 「每個人都能看到！」她說。廢話！那才麻煩呢。

original: If you want to ask her about them, good luck. But I'm not going near her.
string: 你想問她就去吧，祝你好運。但我寧願離她遠點。

original: Are you joking? Even I wouldn't sell something like that.
string: 你開玩笑嗎？這種東西連我都不會賣的。

original: They definitely have some magic in them, I can tell you that much. But it's nothing I know about.
string: 其中肯定被注入了魔法，我只能說這些了。我對這東西也一無所知。

original: How goes the investigation?
string: 調查進展如何？

original: Any luck finding the Butcher?
string: 找到屠夫了嗎？

original: Please, tell me you have good news.
string: 希望你有好消息告訴我。

original: Mmm hmm. Anything else?
string: 嗯，嗯。還有嗎？

original: Now that's interesting. Tell me more.
string: 有點意思。繼續說。

original: Good observation. What else?
string: 觀察得不錯。還有呢？

original: Well, come back when you have some more evidence. I think you're on the trail, though.
string: 好吧，找到更多證據就來告訴我。我覺得你的方向是對的。

original: That's absurd. Come on now.
string: 這太荒唐了。拜託。

original: So what do you think about it all, then?
string: 那麼，你對這一切的看法是什麼？

original: I hate to admit it, but you're probably right.
string: 我不得不承認你可能是對的。

original: I'm sorry. Please help me to find the real killer.
string: 對不起。請幫我找到真凶。

original: You can be resentful or you can help me. Your choice.
string: 你可以滿懷怨恨或者幫我。自己決定。

original: We have evidence of necromancy, and found his amulet.
string: 我們找到了死靈法術的證據，還有他的護符。

original: I don't want to believe it. Wuunferth has been a trusted friend to Ulfric for many years.
string: 我不敢相信。多年來巫恩菲斯一直都是烏弗瑞克信賴的友人。

original: It pains me to see that the whispers had truth to them.
string: 如今謠言居然成真，我感到很心痛。

original: Wuunferth shall be apprehended. I thank you for your diligence in getting to the bottom of this matter.
string: 巫恩菲斯將被通緝。由於你的不懈努力，此事得以水落石出，我深表感激。

original: The streets of Windhelm are now safe.
string: 風舵城的大街小巷終於安全了。

original: It sounds like the court mage has been experimenting.
string: 看起來那個宮廷法師一直在做實驗。

original: Wuunferth. There have been rumors swirling about him for years. As long as I can remember.
string: 就我記憶所及，關於巫恩菲斯的謠言已經流傳了好些年。

original: But he's a dangerous man. It's why they call him "the Unliving." I wouldn't approach him directly.
string: 但他是個危險人物，被人稱作「活死人」。我絕不會接近他的。

original: This information needs to go straight to the steward. He'll listen to you.
string: 把這消息直接告訴總管，他會聽的。

original: I think I'll hold on to it for the time being.
string: 我想我短時間內還不打算割愛。

original: Suit yourself. It's only of value to collectors, though. Good luck finding anyone else who will appraise it that highly!
string: 隨你便吧，這東西只對收藏家有意義。我就不信你能找到一個跟我一樣知道它價值的人！

original: Shouldn't the court mage have it?
string: 不應該交給宮廷法師嗎？

original: Wuunferth? Bah. It's purely ceremonial, and he has no use for it.
string: 巫恩菲斯？不。這只是儀式用品，對他毫無用處。

original: Besides, I wouldn't want to be the one to give it to him. Gives me the creeps. They say he dabbles in necromancy.
string: 而且，我也不想親手交給他。傳言他涉足死靈法術，想到就起雞皮疙瘩。

original: You have yourself a deal, sir.
string: 一言為定，先生。

original: Wonderful. This will be a splendid addition to my private collection.
string: 太棒了，我的私人收藏中又多添了一件珍寶。

original: Ready to check out the house?
string: 準備好去檢查那房子了嗎？

original: Let's go. I'd rather not stay out here alone any longer than I have to.
string: 走吧。我不想一個人待在外面太久。

original: MS11ViolaToHjerimExclamationPoint
string: MS11ViolaToHjerimExclamationPoint

original: Follow me.
string: 跟著我。

original: I'll meet you over there.
string: 我會在那裡跟你碰頭。

original: Do you know anything about this amulet?
string: 關於這護符你知道些什麼？

original: Let me see... ah, yes. This is the Wheelstone. It's an heirloom symbol of the power of Windhelm.
string: 讓我看看……啊。這是輪轉石，風舵城祖傳力量的象徵。

original: Traditionally it's carried by the court mage.
string: 通常由宮廷法師攜帶。

original: I would... eh... be interested in acquiring it. If you're willing to part with it, that is.
string: 其實……我……很要這東西。如果你願意出售的話。

original: For a piece like that, I could pay... 500 gold?
string: 這物品，我願意出到大概……500金幣？

original: The Wheelstone? Have you decided to sell it, yet?
string: 那個輪轉石，你決定要出售嗎？

original: About that amulet...
string: 關於那個護符……

original: Do you know what this amulet is?
string: 你知道這護符的來歷嗎？

original: I've never seen anything like it. I would take this to Calixto at the House of Curiosities. He has a good eye for strange trinkets.
string: 我從沒見過此類東西。我建議拿去給傳奇之屋的卡利斯托看看。他對於稀奇的飾品很內行。

original: Might even give you a bit of gold for it.
string: 也許還能給你出個好價錢。

original: I found this poster in Hjerim.
string: 我在霜齋找到了這傳單。

original: I've been trying to put those up around the city, to warn people. Have them keep their eyes open.
string: 我一直試著在全城張貼這東西，讓人們提高警戒。

original: But someone keeps taking them down.
string: 但是有人一直撕掉我的傳單。

original: You say you found it in Hjerim? Friga's old place. Let's go have a look around there.
string: 你說你在霜齋找到的？弗利嘉的老地方。我們去看看。

original: I've got a feeling about this one.
string: 我對這有好的預感。

original: I found this journal in the killer's lair.
string: 我在兇手的房間裡找到了日記。

original: How can the rest of the people not care?
string: 其餘的人怎麼能無動於衷？

original: Oh, they care all right. Just none of them thinks to do anything about it.
string: 噢，他們當然關心。只是動口不動手。

original: They say I'm just snooping around bothering people, but I'm trying to save lives!
string: 還說我遊手好閒騷擾良民，我可是在救人！

original: Why can't the guards help?
string: 衛兵們不幫忙？

original: They say they're too busy with the war -- I say what good is winning a war if we're still terrorized by one of our own?
string: 他們藉口說要打仗——但是贏了戰爭有什麼用，如果我們還得活在自己人的恐懼之下？

original: I'd like to investigate her house, but I'll need the key.
string: 我想調查她的房子，但我需要鑰匙。

original: Hjerim? Well, I'm not sure what you think you'll find there, but you're welcome to have a look.
string: 霜齋？雖然我不知道你想尋找什麼，但是你要看的話請便。

original: I'm sorry to have troubled you.
string: 很抱歉打擾你。

original: Good day.
string: 祝你今日順心。

original: Do you want to find your daughter's killer or not?
string: 你想找到殺你女兒的兇手嗎？

original: I've had enough troubles recently. What is it that you're after?
string: 我最近麻煩已經夠多了。你想做什麼？

original: I'm trying to find out who did this. I was hoping you'd help.
string: 我想找到真凶。我希望你能幫忙。

original: Well... all right. What exactly do you need to know?
string: 嗯……好吧。你想知道什麼？

original: I have authority in this matter, and need your cooperation.
string: 我奉命處理這事，我需要你的合作。

original: Well... all right. What exactly do you need to know?
string: 嗯……好吧。你想知道什麼？

original: I'm sorry to trouble you, but I have some more questions.
string: 抱歉打擾你，但我還有些問題。

original: I'm sorry -- she was very dear to me, and it's rather painful to think about.
string: 抱歉——我非常愛她，只要想到就心痛。

original: I have some questions about your daughter.
string: 我有些關於你女兒的問題。

original: I'd rather not talk about my daughter, if you'll excuse me.
string: 我不想談我女兒，再會。

original: There might be more to this, if you'll let me help.
string: 如果你讓我幫忙的話，事件或許會有更大進展。

original: Look, friend, if you think you can do better than the legion of guards, be my guest.
string: 嘿，朋友，如果你覺得你能比帝國衛兵做得好的話，別客氣。

original: You'll need to talk to Jorleif, though. We can't just let anyone go around claiming to be on official business.
string: 你得和喬雷福談談。我們不能讓人隨便四處宣稱自己是在幫領主做事。

original: If he's willing, then we'll talk.
string: 如果他答應，我們再來談。

original: Could you use some help?
string: 你需要幫助嗎？

original: If you want to help, ask some of these gawkers if they saw anything useful.
string: 如果你想幫忙，就問問那些旁觀者是否看到了些什麼？

original: I'm going to examine the body before the rats can get to it.
string: 我得在屍體爛掉之前檢查一下。

original: Sounds like the guards aren't doing their job.
string: 看起來衛兵們沒有盡到責任。

original: Look, there's a war going on, if you hadn't heard. We barely have enough soldiers to walk the streets, much less patrol every corner.
string: 聽著，我們現在在打仗，你懂嗎？我們沒有足夠的人手在街上巡邏，更沒有足夠的人手駐守每個街角。

original: How was she killed?
string: 她是怎麼死的？

original: Same as the others. Looks like she was stabbed, and then cut apart.
string: 和其他人一樣。似乎是被刺死，然後分屍。

original: It's like an animal got to her, but these are the wounds of a blade.
string: 看起來像是被動物咬死的，但其實傷口是刀刃造成的。

original: Another? This has happened before?
string: 其他人？這不是第一起？

original: Susanna's the third. It's always the same: young girl, killed at night, body torn up.
string: 蘇珊娜是第三個。案情基本雷同：年輕少女在夜晚遇害，屍體支離破碎。

original: And of course they can't prove he murdered them.
string: 而且他們顯然無法拿出證據說他謀殺。

original: Aye. Our Jarl would sure like to know if he did though. Might even pay to find out.
string: 是啊，但我們的領主很想查明真相，甚至願意付出獎賞。

original: Can't prove it. But I could use your help, being unbiased and all.
string: 無法證明。但你可以幫我，保持客觀那類的。

original: See if you can find anything in the burned out house.
string: 看你是否能在燒毀的房屋裡找到點什麼？

original: I'll pay you to figure it, whether or not he's guilty.
string: 只要你能查明真相，不管他是否有罪，我會付給你酬勞。

original: So why haven't you arrested him?
string: 那你為何還不逮捕他？

original: On rumor and gossip? No. But you, a stranger, might find the truth for us.
string: 就憑流言和臆想？不行。但你作為局外人，也許能查個水落石出。

original: Sift through the ashes that others are too fearful to touch. See what they tell you.
string: 在大家都避而遠之的灰燼裡面找尋線索，看你是否能讀出真相。

original: Should you prove him guilty or innocent, I will reward you.
string: 不管他有罪或清白，只要查明真相，我都會給你獎賞。

original: So why haven't you arrested him?
string: 那你為何還不逮捕他？

original: With his own wife and child inside?
string: 他的妻子和孩子在裡面？

original: That's what they say.
string: 據說是這樣的。

original: See, he's living with Alva now. That started the day after the fire.
string: 他現在和阿爾瓦同居。大火發生隔天就搬進去了。

original: It ain't right, movin' in with a new love the day after your kin die like that.
string: 這樣太不對了，在親人慘死後馬上和新歡同居。

original: They think he did it to get rid of his wife so he could be with Alva.
string: 據說是借此擺脫掉老婆然後和阿爾瓦在一起。

original: He moved in with her the day after the fire. Even I find that suspicious.
string: 他在火災後立刻搬到她家去。連我都覺得可疑。

original: They think he did it to get rid of his wife so he could be with Alva.
string: 據說是借此擺脫掉老婆然後和阿爾瓦在一起。

original: He moved in with her the day after the fire. Even I find that suspicious.
string: 他在火災後立刻搬到她家去。連我都覺得可疑。

original: Why would he do that to his own family?
string: 他幹嘛對自己的家人做出這種事？

original: Lust can make a man do the unthinkable.
string: 男人在慾望的驅使下可以做出異於常人的事。

original: The ashes were still warm when he pledged himself to Alva.
string: 當他向阿爾瓦許下誓言時，他家人的屍骨尚溫。

original: Lust can make a man do the unthinkable.
string: 男人在慾望的驅使下可以做出異於常人的事。

original: The ashes were still warm when he pledged himself to Alva.
string: 當他向阿爾瓦許下誓言時，他家人的屍骨尚溫。

original: Why would he do that to his own family?
string: 他幹嘛對自己的家人做出這種事？

original: How did the fire start?
string: 火災是什麼引起的？

original: Hroggar claims it was a hearth fire. Some folks say Hroggar started it himself.
string: 赫魯加宣稱是由爐火引起。但一些人說是赫魯加親手放的火。

original: Bear fat in the hearth fire, if you believe Hroggar.
string: 他說是因為爐邊的熊脂，你相信嗎？

original: I do, but some folk here think he set the fire himself.
string: 我相信，但有些人說是他親手放的火。

original: What does Hroggar say happened?
string: 赫魯加是怎麼說的？

original: Hroggar blames his wife for spilling bear fat in the fire.
string: 赫魯加怪罪於他的妻子將熊脂撒到爐火上。

original: Many folk think he set the fire himself.
string: 很多人認為是他親手放的火。

original: What does Hroggar say happened?
string: 赫魯加是怎麼說的？

original: Is there a story behind that burned down house?
string: 可以跟我聊聊那棟燒毀的房子嗎？

original: Hroggar's house? It burned down not too long ago.
string: 赫魯加的房子？不久以前才燒毀的。

original: It's a real pity about his wife and kid. The screams woke half the town.
string: 他妻子和孩子的慘叫聲驚醒了半個城鎮。

original: Most folk won't go near it now for fear it's cursed.
string: 大多村民都對那房子敬而遠之，認為它被下了詛咒。

original: Do they? How delightful!
string: 是嗎？真有意思！

original: I'm lucky to have a man that is so devoted to me.
string: 我真幸運能得到如此專一的男人。

original: They say Hroggar burned down his house for you.
string: 聽說赫魯加為了妳燒掉了自己的房子。

original: Hroggar's house? He lost his wife and daughter in the blaze.
string: 赫魯加的房子？他的妻子和女兒被燒死在裡面了。

original: The townsfolk won't go near it. Superstitious lot.
string: 村民們都不敢靠近。一群迷信的傢伙。

original: What happened to that burned down house?
string: 那所被燒毀的房屋是怎麼回事？

original: Hroggar's house fire? Aye. He lost his wife and daughter in the blaze.
string: 赫魯加房子的那場火嗎？他的妻子和女兒被燒死在裡面了。

original: I hear you want someone to look into that house fire.
string: 我聽說妳需要人調查那次火災。

original: Hroggar's house? He lost his wife and daughter in the blaze.
string: 赫魯加的房子？他的妻子和女兒被燒死在裡面了。

original: My people believe it to be cursed now. Who am I to gainsay them?
string: 人們都覺得這房子被詛咒了。我能怎麼反駁呢？

original: What happened to that burned down house?
string: 那棟被燒毀的房屋是怎麼回事？

original: Hroggar's house fire? He lost his wife and daughter in the blaze.
string: 赫魯加房子的那場火嗎？他的妻子和女兒被燒死在裡面了。

original: My people believe it to be cursed now. Who am I to gainsay them?
string: 人們都覺得這房子被詛咒了。我能怎麼反駁呢？

original: I hear you want someone to look into that house fire.
string: 我聽說你需要人調查那次火災。

original: It's bad luck to talk about that place.
string: 就連談論那個地方都會帶來霉運。

original: Jarl's been looking for someone who ain't superstitious though. Be lookin' for a fool if you ask me.
string: 領主想找個不迷信的人，要我說，就是找個笨蛋。

original: What would happen to sailors on the boat?
string: 船上的水手們會怎麼樣？

original: Don't worry about them. We'll make sure they wash up safe. Maybe they'll even pay us for the heroic rescue from their sad crash.
string: 別擔心，我們會保證他們被順利沖上岸的。也許他們還會為我們英勇的營救而付錢。

original: I put out the Lighthouse fire.
string: 我把燈塔的火焰熄滅了。

original: The effects have already been felt. The Icerunner has failed to dock on time.
string: 效果立竿見影。寒冰疾馳者沒能準時靠岸。

original: Without the Lighthouse, the Icerunner will have swung wide of the western shoal and run aground on the eastern coast.
string: 沒有燈塔，寒冰疾馳者就會在西邊的淺灘上亂晃，最後一頭撞上東岸。

original: My sister Deeja will be at the wreck with our Blackblood Marauders. She knows to expect you.
string: 我姐姐蒂亞會跟咱們的黑血掠奪者一起在殘骸那裡。她正等著你過去。

original: Setting up a wreck? I should turn you in to the guards.
string: 製造海難？我去向衛兵舉報你們。

original: Turn me in? For what? What crime's been committed? I'm just making idle talk about what would most undoubtedly be a tragic event...
string: 舉報我？有什麼證據？我犯了什麼罪？我只是在猜想可能會發生何種慘劇而已。

original: A tragic, and very, very profitable event.
string: 慘劇，但是能從中大撈一筆。

original: I'm listening...
string: 說下去。我正在聽……

original: I knew you looked like a clever one...
string: 我知道你是識時務的人……

original: I'm no thief.
string: 我可不是小偷。

original: Of course not! Thieves take what is precious. Thieves steal.
string: 當然不是！偷東西的人才叫小偷。

original: We just take what will not be missed. What no one needs anymore. Maybe we take some weapons and stop a few deaths. Who would call that thievery?
string: 我們只是拿一些沒人會要的東西。也許我們拿走幾件武器，還能恰好阻止幾件謀殺案。這哪算偷竊？

original: Hey! What're you doing in here?
string: 嘿！你們在做什麼？

original: Get out of here or I'll call the guards!
string: 滾開，不然我叫衛兵！

original: That's it! You're leaving, right now.
string: 你快點離開，馬上！

original: You look new. I'm new, too. I think we could be friends.
string: 你看起來像新人，我也是新人。交個朋友吧。

original: If you're looking for opportunities to make some coin, well... I'm your man.
string: 如果你在找發財機會，那麼……你找對人了。

original: Everyone needs work, right? I have good work for you.
string: 大家都要工作對嗎？我就有份工作給你。

original: I believe you know what needs to be done. Something about putting out a fire?
string: 你應該知道怎麼做，滅火會嗎？

original: Looks like you had no trouble.
string: 看來你沒遇什麼問題。

original: Get moving. I'll see if I can't delay any patrols out there.
string: 你快走。我試著拖延巡邏。

original: What did you have in mind?
string: 你在想什麼？

original: It's easy to find things to sell. Things nobody will miss. Things from underground, or just left lying around in someone's house.
string: 要找到東西拿去賣並不難。那些人們不要的東西，被埋在地下，或者丟在家裡生灰塵的。

original: I bet the two of us, we're very alike. So why not take the next step? We can help each other.
string: 我覺得我們英雄所見略同，那麼，加深合作如何？我們能互相幫助。

original: My sister Deeja and I are treasure hunters. We like to collect things.
string: 我姐姐蒂亞和我都是尋寶者。我們喜歡收集寶物。

original: As I said, it's easy to find things nobody will miss. My sister Deeja and I are treasure hunters. You could be too.
string: 正如我說的，我們很容易能找到人們不要的東西。我姐姐蒂亞和我是尋寶者。你也加入吧。

original: So what was your suggestion again?
string: 你剛才的提議能再說一遍嗎？

original: Can you tell me more about what you saw?
string: 關於你剛才看到的東西，可以說多點嗎？

original: Some sort of ghost or apparition appeared. It spoke to me.
string: 類似鬼魂或是幽靈之類的東西，和我交談

original: I'm afraid I didn't see anything...
string: 恐怕我什麼都沒看見……

original: Did you see that?
string: 你看到了嗎？

original: I... I swear I felt something rather strange just then.
string: 我……我發誓我剛才有種怪異的感覺。

original: What just happened?
string: 發生什麼事了？

original: Take great care, and know that the Order is watching.
string: 萬分小心，記住教團一直在看著你。

original: You, mage, and you alone, have the potential to prevent disaster.
string: 法師，你，也只有你，擁有預防災難的潛能。

original: This warning is passed to you because the Psijic Order believes in you.
string: 因為賽伊克教團信任你，才將這警告傳達於你。

original: Judgment will be passed on your actions to come, and how you deal with the dangers ahead of you.
string: 你將來的行動，和你應對未知危險的方式將決定你的判決。

original: Judgment has not been passed, as you had no way of knowing.
string: 你的判決尚未被傳達，因為你無從得知。

original: Know that you have set in motion a chain of events that cannot be stopped.
string: 你已經使一連串的事件開始運作，無法停止。

original: Hold, mage, and listen well...
string: 打住，法師，認真聽……

original: I pulled an amulet off the wall.
string: 我從牆上取下一個護符。

original: Really? Perhaps the amulet is important somehow. Is there some way you can use it?
string: 真的？也許這護符很重要。你知道怎麼使用嗎？

original: I'm trapped in here!
string: 我被困在這裡了！

original: How in the world did that happen?
string: 這到底是怎麼回事？

original: What is this thing?
string: 這是什麼東西？

original: I have no idea! This is amazing. Absolutely amazing. The Arch-Mage needs to be informed immediately. He needs to see this for himself.
string: 我不知道！這太神奇了，太不可思議了。得馬上通知首席法師，他必須親自看看這東西。

original: I don't dare leave this unattended. Can you return to the College and inform Savos Aren of this discovery? Please, hurry.
string: 這東西必須有人看管。你能回學院向薩沃斯．阿冉報告這發現嗎？請快點。

original: The Psijics have no connection to these ruins. And no one's seen any of their order in a long time.
string: 賽伊克跟這些遺跡毫無關係。且他們的人很久沒有出現過了。

original: Perhaps we should take a look inside these coffins...
string: 也許我們該檢查一下這些棺材內部……

original: Now please do be careful. Who knows what we're going to find.
string: 現在請千萬小心。天知道裡面會有什麼？

original: It said something about danger ahead, and the Psijic Order.
string: 說了有關前方的危險，和賽伊克教團。

original: The Psijic Order? Are you quite sure about that? That's very odd.
string: 賽伊克教團？你確定？真是怪異。

original: And danger ahead? Why that doesn't make any sense at all.
string: 前方的危險？一派胡言。

original: You want me to steal it?
string: 你要我去偷？

original: Well let's not put it like that. Wouldn't want the Thieves Guild catching wind of us, eh?
string: 嘿，別這麼說嘛。別讓盜賊公會嗅到我們的存在。

original: Nah, just creep in and have a go at taking it out. I'll be here, and pay you half of what my man in Riften promised for it.
string: 其實也沒什麼，你只要溜進去然後把它帶出來，我會在這等你。事成之後我把我在裂谷城的聯絡人答應給我的酬勞分給你一半。

original: You'll be helping out an old beggar, and the Divines smile on that sort of thing.
string: 這樣你就可以幫上一個老乞丐的忙，而聖靈們很欣賞這種事。

original: Did you say something about money?
string: 你說錢怎樣了？

original: Aye, a whole heap of it. You see that Temple? Way up there?
string: 對，好大一堆的錢。你看見那神殿了嗎？就在那裡。

original: All them women, keeping to themselves. Won't let poor Degaine in, no.
string: 裡面那些女人都是死腦筋，就是不讓可憐的德加因進去。

original: Not even for a look.
string: 連看一眼都不准。

original: But they've got a treasure in there. Gold statue, size of a child. Who knows what they use it for, but I know what I'll use it for.
string: 她們把寶物藏在裡面，一尊黃金塑像，有一個小孩那麼高。不知道她們用來做什麼，但我會讓它物盡其用的。

original: There's no way out that way, you know...
string: 你應該知道，那邊沒路可以出去……

original: Grab what you can, and let's go.
string: 把能帶走的東西統統掠走，然後我們滾蛋。

original: Forget the old man. I'll come with you.
string: 別管那個老頭了。我和你走。

original: Didn't you hear me? I said the keep is under attack!
string: 沒聽到我說的嗎？我說我們的堡壘正受到攻擊！

original: You have no authority over me, boy.
string: 你沒資格命令我、小鬼。

original: Come with us. We need to get out of here.
string: 跟我們走。我們得快點離開這裡。

original: Although, come to think of it, I did hear some odd noises coming from over there.
string: 不過回頭一想，我的確有聽到一些古怪的聲音。

original: A dragon? Please. Don't make up nonsense.
string: 一條龍？拜託，別瞎扯了。

original: Don't you even know what's going on? A dragon is attacking Helgen!
string: 你還不清楚怎麼回事嗎？一條龍在攻擊聖地鎮！

original: You fellows happened along just in time. These boys seemed a bit upset at how I've been entertaining their comrades.
string: 你們來的正是時候。這些人似乎不爽我招待他們同志的方式。

original: Come on!
string: 上啊！

original: Hear that?
string: 聽到了嗎？

original: An old storeroom. See if you can find some potions. Might come in handy.
string: 一間老倉庫啊。你看看能否找到點藥水。也許用得著。

original: An old storeroom. Grab anything you can, but let's keep moving.
string: 一間老倉庫啊。把能拿走的都拿走，然後出發。

original: Damn, that dragon doesn't give up easy.
string: 該死，這條龍看來不會輕易放棄啊。

original: Look out!
string: 小心！

original: Hold on, now, we only want to...
string: 等等，我們只是想要……

original: I've brought your Sybil.
string: 我把先知帶回來了。

original: You... you found her? I can't believe it. Let the girl come with me and we can begin her preparation.
string: 你……你找到她了？真不敢相信。請那孩子過來，我們要開始準備了。

original: I will send word to her family that she is in good hands.
string: 我會通知她家人她現在安然無恙。

original: You've truly earned the Blessing of Dibella, child. Prostrate yourself before her altar, and she will bestow her gift.
string: 你獲得了蒂貝拉的保佑，孩子。虔誠地跪拜於她的祭壇前，她將賜你恩惠。

original: I'm here to bring you to the Temple in Markarth.
string: 我來這是要帶妳去馬卡斯城的神殿。

original: Then it is true what they said? I am touched by the gods?
string: 那他們說的是真的了？我被神選中了 ？

original: I'm looking for a young girl who lives around here.
string: 我在找一個住在附近的年輕女孩。

original: Damn it, man, are you trying to taunt us?
string: 該死的，小夥子，你是想惹事？

original: Damn it, woman, are you trying to taunt us?
string: 該死的，你這女人想惹事？

original: Oh, I... I'm sorry. I just can't... you'll have to speak to my husband.
string: 噢……抱歉。我只是……你最好和我丈夫談。

original: Oh, my. You'll want to talk to Enmon about that.
string: 噢，天哪。你和恩蒙談吧。

original: I thought Enmon and Mean had a little girl, but I haven't seen her in a while.
string: 我記得恩蒙和米恩生了個小女孩，但我很久沒見到她了。

original: I think you might be looking for Enmon.
string: 我覺得你可能在找恩蒙。

original: And what's that have to do with me?
string: 那和我有什麼關係？

original: Yeah, we're all looking for something.
string: 對，我們都在找一些東西。

original: Thank you for bringing this to my attention.
string: 多謝你通知我這事。

original: Tolfdir normally looks after your little group, yes?
string: 一般是由托夫迪爾看照你們，是吧？

original: Since he's apparently occupied, and I will need to see this discovery for myself, I think perhaps you should begin researching the subject.
string: 顯然他忙得抽不開身，我必須親自去看看這個發現。我覺得你該開始研究這東西了。

original: Speak with Urag in the Arcanaeum. See if he is aware of anything that matches your discovery.
string: 和秘藏館的烏拉格談談，看他對於你的發現是否知道些什麼。

original: And... good work. The next time you find yourself exploring Nordic ruins, perhaps this will be helpful.
string: 啊……做得好。也許下一次你去諾德遺跡探索時，這東西或許會派上用場。

original: We found some sort of... orb. Tolfdir wanted you to see it.
string: 我們找到了類似……球體的東西。托夫迪爾想讓你看看。

original: I... see. I trust that Tolfdir will provide a more... specific explanation.
string: 我……明白了。我肯定托夫迪爾會給出更明確的解釋的。

original: We've found something in Saarthal, and Tolfdir thinks it's important.
string: 我們在薩瑟爾城找到了些東西，托夫迪爾覺得很重要。

original: Very well, I trust that you wouldn't be here were it not significant.
string: 很好，我就知道不重要的話你是不會來的。

original: I need to speak to you about Saarthal.
string: 我得和你談談薩瑟爾城。

original: Please don't tell me that another one of the apprentices has been incinerated. I have enough to deal with right now.
string: 別告訴我又有一個學徒被燒成灰了，我現在手上有太多這類事件要處理了。

original: I'll let that comment go because you're new here. Ask things out of turn again, and we have a problem. Now, are we clear on all of this?
string: 鑒於你是個新人，我就當沒聽到你剛才的話。你要是再亂問問題，別怪我發火，懂了？

original: Rules? We're thieves. What's the point of rules?
string: 規矩？我們是賊，管什麼規矩？

original: If you're not sure maybe you don't belong here. I'll ask again, are we clear on all of this?
string: 你如果還不懂，那你可以走了。我再問你一遍，你清楚了沒 ？

original: I'm not sure.
string: 我不確定。

original: It's Grelod!
string: 是桂羅！

original: Aiiiiiiieeeeeeee!!
string: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

original: Both sides respect the Greybeards. They will listen.
string: 雙方都尊重灰鬍子，他們會聽的。

original: Paarthurnax has made the decision to help you. This is the road we have to walk.
string: 帕圖納克斯決定幫你。我們就得跟隨牠。

original: Even the Greybeards must bend to the winds of change, it seems.
string: 看來灰鬍子也要順勢改變了。

original: So be it. Tell Ulfric and General Tullius that the Greybeards wish to speak to them.
string: 就這樣吧。告訴烏弗瑞克和圖留斯將軍，灰鬍子想要和他們談。

original: We will see if they still remember us.
string: 看看他們是否還記得我們。

original: Jarl <Alias.ShortName=Jarl> won't help me while the war rages.
string: <Alias.ShortName=Jarl>領主在戰爭爆發時不會幫我。

original: I see. The dragon will lead you to Alduin, but without the Jarl's help...
string: 我明白了。龍會帶你去見奧杜因，但沒有領主的幫助……

original: I'll worry about capturing a dragon. I need your help to stop the war.
string: 龍交給我來抓，我需要你幫忙停止戰爭。

original: I need your help. I need to capture a dragon.
string: 我需要你的幫助，我必須抓一條龍。

original: We are not warriors. What is overlooked in the Dragonborn is not permitted to any other followers of the Way of the Voice.
string: 我們不是戰士。龍裔被允許做的事，其他龍吼之道的信徒可是不被允許的。

original: Ah! Dragonsreach! There are many difficulties, but I cannot think of a better plan.
string: 啊！龍臨堡！困難重重，但我想不出更好的計劃了。

original: Although I fear the Jarl may not be easy to persuade.
string: 雖然我擔心領主很難被說服。

original: Remember, the Way of the Voice trains you for more than battle. Indeed, we believe that battle is the least of its uses.
string: 記住，龍吼之道不只訓練你的戰鬥技巧。事實上，它的精髓並不在戰鬥上。

original: May the strength and truth of your Voice serve you well. Breath and focus.
string: 願龍吼的力量及真理守護你。集中精力，深呼吸。

original: I'm going to try to capture a dragon, if <Alias.ShortName=Jarl> will help me.
string: 我想要捕獲一條龍，如果<Alias.ShortName=Jarl>幫我的話。

original: I need your help to stop the war.
string: 我需要你幫我停止戰爭。

original: Deliver the message to the warring parties. If they will listen, I will do what I can to bring them to terms.
string: 將消息帶給交戰雙方，要是他們願意聽，我能協助他們達成和解。

original: Are you ready to host the peace council?
string: 你準備好舉行和平會議了嗎？

original: I found what you were looking for.
string: 我找到了你在找的東西。

original: Ah, yes! There it is! Thank you so much.
string: 啊，太好了！就是它！太感謝你了。

original: What did you say you were missing?
string: 你剛才說你遺失了什麼東西？

original: My Alembic. I need it for some research, and can't seem to find it.
string: 我的蒸餾器。我研究要用的，現在找不到了。

original: What was it you were missing?
string: 你遺失了什麼東西？

original: A book of mine. I was at least halfway through, and wanted to finish it, but apparently I put it down somewhere.
string: 我的一本書，我都看到一半了，想結束掉。但我不知道放到哪去了。

original: I need to find where Alduin fled to.
string: 我得查清奧杜因逃往哪裡去了。

original: I can't find my Alembic. I suppose I could use another one, but... well, it sounds silly, but mine has sentimental value.
string: 我找不到我的蒸餾器了，其實可以換一個用。但是，說起來有點可笑，我對我那個有感情了。

original: If you happen to see it, would you mind bringing it to me?
string: 要是你看見了，給我帶過來好嗎？

original: I seem to have misplaced the book I was reading.
string: 我把我在讀的書不知道放到哪去了。

original: You look like you could use a hand.
string: 你看起來需要幫助。

original: Well, yes. This is rather embarrassing, but it seems I've misplaced something.
string: 嗯，是的。這有點尷尬，我好像把某樣東西弄丟了。

original: So if I could lure a dragon into Dragonsreach...
string: 那麼，要是我能把一頭龍引誘到龍臨堡……

original: You might be able to trap him there, exactly.
string: 那你就能使它掉入陷阱。

original: You'd require the Jarl's cooperation, of course. That might not be easy to come by.
string: 當然你還需要領主的協助。這可能就有點難度了。

original: You must trust in the rightness of your cause, and the strength of your Voice.
string: 你必須相信你所行的正義，及你龍吼的力量。

original: But I thought there weren't any dragons until Alduin came back.
string: 我還以為在奧杜因之前，世上根本沒有龍。

original: Oh, this was back in the days of Olaf One-Eye, thousands of years ago.
string: 噢，這得追溯到獨眼奧拉夫的時代，幾千年之前了。

original: In those days, dragons could still be found among the remote mountain peaks.
string: 在那時，龍類依然生存在遙遠群山的峰頂之間。

original: Before the Blades wiped them all out.
string: 之後牠們被刀鋒衛士屠殺殆盡。

original: The Jarl? What are you talking about?
string: 那個領主？你在說什麼？

original: Do you know Dragonsreach? The Jarl of Whiterun's palace?
string: 你知道龍臨堡嗎？白漫城的領主宮殿？

original: Its name is no accident. The palace was originally built to hold a captive dragon.
string: 它並非徒有其名。那宮殿最初就是為牢獄一頭被俘虜的龍而建。

original: One of his dragon allies could tell us...
string: 牠的龍類盟友可能可以告訴我們……

original: Yes, of course! But how to force a dragon to talk to you...
string: 當然了！但如何迫使一頭龍和你交談？

original: There is one possibility. But... no, the Jarl would never agree.
string: 辦法倒是有一個，但是……不行，領主永遠都不會同意。

original: Yes, but he escaped. I need to find out where he went.
string: 是啊，但牠跑了。我得知道牠跑去哪裡了。

original: I feared as much. I thought it was him we saw flying east after your battle.
string: 我也深感憂慮，我就知道在戰鬥後飛向東邊的就是牠。

original: Yes, but he escaped. I need to find his portal to Sovngarde.
string: 是啊，但牠跑了。我得查出牠是如何往來英靈殿。

original: I learned the Dragonrend Shout.
string: 我學會了名為「龍魂撕裂」的龍吼。

original: Alduin... we heard the Dragonrend Shout from here... you defeated him?
string: 奧杜因……我們聽到了龍魂撕裂……你擊敗牠了？

original: I want to know more about the Razor.
string: 我想知道更多關於這把利刃的事。

original: The Razor is Mehrunes Dagon's personal artifact. It has always heralded bloody change and carnage.
string: 利刃是梅魯涅斯．大袞的貼身神器，不詳與屠殺的預兆。

original: It's held many names: Dagger of the Final Wounds, Bane of the Righteous, the Kingslayer.
string: 他有很多名稱：解脫之刃，致命災厄，弒君者。

original: The Mythic Dawn worshipped Dagon as a god. Having his Razor would be invaluable to my collection.
string: 破曉神教如神般供奉大袞，能拿到他的利刃將是我收藏中的無價之寶。

original: Who is Mehrunes Dagon?
string: 梅魯涅斯．大袞是誰？

original: Ah, an excellent question. Mehrunes Dagon is the Daedric Lord of Change, Destruction, and Ambition.
string: 啊，好問題。梅魯涅斯．大袞是掌控變革，毀滅與野心的魔侯。

original: Dagon's Mythic Dawn cult killed the Septim Dynasty and opened the Oblivion Gates into Tamriel. They called it the Oblivion Crisis.
string: 大袞的破曉神教終結了塞普汀王朝並在泰姆瑞爾大陸開啟了湮滅之門。史稱湮滅危機。

original: You caught me. I'll pay off my bounty. (<CrimeGold> gold)
string: 你抓到我了，我願意付懸賞金。（<Crimegold>金幣）

original: You aren't fooling me. Trusted witnesses have seen you commit several murders.
string: 別想耍我。可靠的目擊者看到你犯下多起謀殺案。

original: And there are accounts of your suspicious behavior throughout the city. Now come quietly.
string: 還有你在城中各處的可疑行徑。閉上嘴跟我走。

original: It wasn't me. I've been framed!
string: 不是我幹的，我被陷害了！

original: Smart man. Now come along with us. We'll take any stolen goods, and you'll be free to go. After you pay the fine, of course.
string: 聰明人。那跟我們過來。我們會沒收所有贓物，而你也可以離開。不過當然了，你得先付罰款。

original: Smart woman. Now come along with us. We'll take any stolen goods, and you'll be free to go. After you pay the fine, of course.
string: 聰明的女人。那跟我們過來。我們會沒收所有贓物，而妳也可以離開。不過當然了，你得先付罰款。

original: Good enough. I'll just confiscate any stolen goods you're carrying, then you're free to go.
string: 很好。我要把你偷的東西充公，然後你交了罰金就能走了。

original: I'd rather die than go to prison!
string: 要我進監獄我寧願死！

original: Time to cleanse the Empire of its filth.
string: 該清理帝國內的殘渣了。

original: Then suffer the Emperor's wrath.
string: 那就在君王的怒火下哀嚎吧。

original: Skyrim has no use for your kind.
string: 天際容不下你這種人渣。

original: Then let me speed your passage to Sovngarde!
string: 就讓我立刻送你上英靈殿吧！

original: Then pay with your blood.
string: 就用你的鮮血償還吧。

original: That can be arranged.
string: 這事可以安排。

original: So be it.
string: 那就這樣吧。

original: I submit. Take me to jail.
string: 我投降，送我進監獄吧。

original: Ha, enjoy the Chill.
string: 哈，好好享受寒慄監獄吧。

original: You'll never see the sun again. No one escapes Cidhna Mine. No one.
string: 你可以跟陽光道別了。沒人逃得出希訥礦坑。從沒有。

original: It's off to Cidhna Mine for you.
string: 你將被送到希訥礦坑。

original: You're going to rot in the Dragonsreach Dungeon.
string: 你會在龍臨堡的地牢裡腐爛的。

original: A stretch in the Castle Dour Dungeon will straighten you right out.
string: 在陰鬱堡蹲過後相信你的態度會改善很多。

original: I guess you're smarter than you look.
string: 你還算識相。

original: What's the problem?
string: 出了什麼問題？

original: Halt. You're under arrest for murder and conspiracy against the city of Markarth!
string: 站住，你因謀殺和圖謀破壞馬卡斯城被捕了。

original: The "problem" is your disrespect for the laws of this land. It's time to face the Jarl's justice.
string: 「問題」在於你褻瀆了這片土地的律法，準備面對領主的正義審判吧！

original: By order of the Jarl, stop right there!
string: 根據領主頒布的法令，我命令你站住！

original: You have committed crimes against Skyrim and her people. What say you in your defense?
string: 你已對天際和她的子民犯下大罪。你有什麼想說的嗎？

original: We got everything in hand here. You aren't needed 'round here.
string: 這裡一切都井井有條，不需要你的幫助。

original: We chop trees, we mill the wood. What more would you want to know?
string: 我們就是砍砍樹，磨成粉。你還想知道什麼？

original: It's a hard way to make a living, but we find ways to make ends meet.
string: 靠這吃飯真是艱難，但我們還是能勉強糊口。

original: We don't take kindly to people snooping around our business.
string: 我們不歡迎在附近探頭探腦的人。

original: These axes can chop a lot more than wood, you know.
string: 這些斧頭能砍的可不只是木頭，懂了嗎？

original: Hey, welcome to the mill!
string: 嘿，歡迎來伐木場！

original: My brother and me bought this place when we left the army. Boy, did we lose a bundle, but at least we're not fighting the war!
string: 我和我哥哥離開軍隊後就買下了這地方，雖然花了不少錢，但至少不用再上戰場了！

original: We're making our money back, bit by bit. Every extra bit of work helps...
string: 我們要慢慢地把錢賺回來。多勞多得……

original: We served our time in the Legion. Now we're just trying to make it day to day.
string: 我們曾在軍團服役。現在則是過一天算一天。

original: I used to serve with Trilf and Steirod. Good guys, but don't get on their bad side, you know?
string: 我那時和崔爾夫還有斯特羅德一起服役。他們是好人，但千萬別惹火他們。

original: I once saw Steirod tear a whole tree out the ground with his bare hands. Glad he's on our side!
string: 我曾見過斯特羅德徒手將一棵樹拔起，幸虧他是我們這一邊的！

original: These boys do good work for the Empire!
string: 為了帝國，這些孩子做得不錯！

original: Nice to be here on the home-front. Wouldn't mind being down in Cyrodiil, though.
string: 來到戰爭後方很不錯。當然，我也不介意去賽瑞迪爾。

original: You're a ghost!
string: 你是鬼！

original: I'm worried about my daughter. I'm keeping an eye on her for a little while before I pass on.
string: 我擔心我的女兒。離開前想再多看她一會。

original: I'm worried about my son. I'm keeping an eye on him for a little while before I pass on.
string: 我擔心我的兒子。離開前想再多看他一會。

original: I know my mother would be worried about me. I'm here to let her know everything's all right.
string: 我知道我母親會擔心我。我想告訴她一切都好。

original: I know my father would be worried about me. I'm here to let him know everything's all right.
string: 我知道我父親會擔心我。我想告訴他一切都好。

original: I worry about my sister. This way I can keep an eye on her, make sure she's not getting into trouble.
string: 我擔心我的妹妹。這樣我可以看著她，確保她沒事。

original: I worry about my brother. This way I can keep an eye on him, make sure he's not getting into trouble.
string: 我擔心我的弟弟。這樣我可以看著他，確保他沒事。

string: 我還沒準備好離開我的妻子。

string: 我母親死後一直纏著我。一開始感覺有點奇怪，但現在我很高興她在這裡。

string: 白髮人送黑髮人令人傷心。我兒子的靈魂在此陪伴……就像他從未離開。

string: 我妻子死時，我不確定自己是否能放手。但現在她回來了。

original: I just want her to be safe.
string: 我只想看到她安然無恙。

original: That's... that's good of you. If you were to save her, I would be very grateful. I don't think there's anything I could give you, though...
string: 這……你真好。如果你救她，我會很感激的。雖然我什麼都不能給你。

original: Your daughter is the Sybil of Dibella.
string: 你女兒是蒂貝拉的先知。

original: She... really? That's... I wouldn't have dreamed. Of course, we need her in Markarth, then. I'll come with you.
string: 她……真的？那真是……我從未想過。我想我們必須帶她到馬卡斯城去，我會跟你一起行動的。

original: Where did they take her?
string: 他們把她帶到哪兒去了？

original: It was the Forsworn from Broken Tower. Never been much trouble before. What's it to you?
string: 那些人是破碎塔來的棄誓者，從沒惹過麻煩。怎麼會發生這事？

original: What are you talking about?
string: 你在說什麼啊？

original: Our daughter, Fjotra, was taken from here. The Forsworn descended and... they didn't touch anything else. Just our little girl.
string: 我們的女兒，弗洛特拉，被帶走了。棄誓者突然出現……其他什麼都沒碰，就帶走了我的女兒。

original: Anything else in it for me?
string: 對我還有什麼好處？

original: You, my dear, can earn the Blessing of Dibella. You'll find men to be more pliable in the future... or more vulnerable.
string: 你可以獲得蒂貝拉的賜福。你會發現男人們變得更溫順……或者說更脆弱了。

original: Have you heard of the Blessing of Dibella? It can help you with the wooing of women, if that's your aim.
string: 你聽說過蒂貝拉的賜福嗎？可以幫助你追求女人，如果你有這種打算的話。

original: Or give you strength if you happen to offend one.
string: 或者是在你攻擊她們時給予你力量。

original: Typically we avoid bestowing it upon men, but for the Sybil's escort, we could make an exception.
string: 我們一般不授予男人這種能力，但如果是先知的護衛，我們可以破例。

original: Why is this all such a secret?
string: 為什麼這些都要保密？

original: We prefer not to announce that the Sybil has died until we can introduce the new one. People like to know that we're connected to the goddess.
string: 在繼任者產生之前我們傾向於不公開祭司的死訊。人們比較希望相信我們仍與女神保持聯繫。

original: The girl is just taken from her family?
string: 那女孩就這麼被帶走了？

original: It's considered a great honor for the family. Their daughter will never know hardship, and the goddess blesses them with great bounty.
string: 這對於那家人來說是種榮譽。他們的女兒不會受苦，反而會得到女神的庇佑。

original: What is a Sybil?
string: 先知是什麼？

original: The Sybil of Dibella spends her entire life in direct communion with the goddess.
string: 蒂貝拉的先知用其一生與女神溝通。

original: From the time she's a little girl to the moment she expires, she is a direct connection with the heavenly mother.
string: 從生到死的每一刻，她都在與天母直接交流。

original: From her reverie, we know the mind of our god.
string: 我們從她的夢境中得知神的想法。

original: We have had a vision of the next Sybil, living in a village to the north. She must be brought to the temple for her reverie to begin.
string: 我們收到了有關下一任先知的預言，是一個住在北部鄉村的女孩。她必須被帶到神殿開始她的夢境。

original: I'd like to have a wedding at the temple.
string: 我想在神殿舉行婚禮。

original: You wish to be married? It's good to see love blossoming, even during these difficult times.
string: 你想結婚？能看見愛情綻放真好，即使是在這艱難的年頭。

original: Your wedding will be held tomorrow, from dawn until dusk.
string: 你的婚禮將在明天舉行，從黎明直至黃昏。

original: Don't be late, you don't want to miss your own wedding!
string: 別遲到，你可不想錯過你自己的婚禮吧！

original: You've embarrassed the temple and spat in the face of love. What do you want?
string: 你已使神殿蒙羞，且玷污了愛情。你還想做什麼？

original: Is that an Amulet of Mara? I'm surprised someone like you isn't spoken for.
string: 這是瑪拉的護符？我很驚訝像你這樣的人居然還沒結婚。

original: An Amulet of Mara? You're not married? Surprising.
string: 瑪拉的護符？你尚未結婚？令人吃驚。

original: That amulet. I've seen the Nords wear these when they're looking to marry. With your strength, you should have no trouble.
string: 我見過想要結婚的諾德人佩戴那種護符。你那麼強壯，應該不難找到對象。

original: Is that Lady Mara's amulet? I'm shocked a fine person like you isn't married already.
string: 那是瑪拉女神的護符嗎？我很驚訝像你這樣優秀的人居然還未結婚。

original: You're wearing Mara's amulet? You? I'd marry you. I'd marry you twice.
string: 你戴著瑪拉女神的護符？你這麼優秀的人？和我結婚吧，我都想娶你兩次。

original: Look at you. Wearing an Amulet of Mara. Are you saying you're available?
string: 看看你，戴著瑪拉的護符。看來你依然單身？

original: An Amulet of Mara, you're looking for marriage, then?
string: 你戴著瑪拉的護符，你在找你的另一半，對嗎？

original: You should arrange the ceremony at the Temple of Mara right away. I can't wait.
string: 你應該馬上在瑪拉神殿舉行儀式，我迫不及待了。

original: You go ahead and arrange the wedding ceremony when you're ready.
string: 你準備好了就去安排婚禮。

original: You should speak to the priest in the Temple of Mara to arrange the ceremony. No sense waiting.
string: 你該和瑪拉神殿的祭司談談婚禮的事，別等了。

original: Have you spoken to the Temple of Mara, yet? I'm so excited.
string: 你和瑪拉神殿裡的人講過了吧？我真興奮。

original: Hey, shouldn't you tell the Temple of Mara that we're getting married? Be hard to have a wedding without a priest.
string: 嘿，你不是應該去瑪拉神殿說下我們要結婚了嗎？婚禮一定得有祭司啊。

original: Now shouldn't you be off arranging our wedding day? Don't keep me waiting.
string: 你現在不是應該去安排婚禮了嗎？別讓我等啊。

original: You should tell the priest we're getting married. They'll take things from there.
string: 你該告訴祭司我們要結婚了。他們會著手安排的。

original: I'll see you at our wedding!

original: Our wedding is soon. I'll see you then!
string: 我們的婚禮很快就要舉行了。到時候見！

original: Never thought I'd get married under a Nord god. But with you, it feels right.
string: 我從沒想過會我會在一個諾德神名下結婚。但和你在一起，感覺都對了。

original: Our wedding is soon, under Mara's loving eyes. It'll be perfect.
string: 我們的婚禮很快就要舉行了，在瑪拉之愛的庇護下，一定會很完美。

original: We have our wedding soon, don't we? That's right, we do!
string: 我們快結婚了，不是嗎？是啊，快了！

original: I'm looking forward to our wedding. You and me....

original: The wedding is soon. It'll be a good day.
string: 婚禮將近了。那會是美好的一天。

string: 拿去吧。記住一點，天際的人知恩圖報。如果你行善，更多人會對注意到你的愛。

original: Good luck. Mara bless you.
string: 祝你好運。瑪拉保佑你。

string: 上次那條丟了？好吧，再給你一條。瑪拉保佑你。

original: Silus keeps filling his house with those Mythic Dawn things. Creepy, I tell you.
string: 希魯斯家中不斷累積破曉神教的東西。真是詭異。

original: I can't believe Silus is collecting Mythic Dawn artifacts. Right here in Dawnstar, no less.
string: 我不敢相信希魯斯居然在搜集破曉神教的文物。就在晨星城，你能想像嗎？

original: Did you have any questions about the museum, or would you rather talk business?
string: 關於博物館你有什麼要問的嗎，還是談正事？

original: What is it? Do you have one of the Razor fragments?
string: 怎麼了？你有利刃的碎片嗎？

original: I keep gazing into the pommel gem. Not a single flaw.
string: 我盯著刀柄處的寶石仔細看，沒發現一點瑕疵。

original: I've had to be careful handling those blade shards you found. They're each sharp enough to sever a finger with no effort.
string: 我得非常小心地處理你找到的那些碎片。一不留神可能就少掉一根手指。

original: It's strange holding a hilt that isn't connected to a dagger. Oh well.
string: 拿著把只有刀柄的匕首感覺真是奇怪。唉。

original: My family were in the Mythic Dawn. My museum is our legacy.
string: 我的家族都是破曉神教的人。我的展館是我們的遺產。

original: Wrong or right, the Mythic Dawn changed Tamriel's history. They deserve study.
string: 無論對錯，破曉神教都改變了泰姆瑞爾大陸的歷史。他們值得被研究。

original: Scholars from around the world will come here one day.
string: 終有一天，全世界的學者都會來到此地。

original: Your focal points have been, uh, cleansed.
string: 節點已經被，呃…被淨化過了。

original: Yes, they have. I can feel the difference already. But of course, I'm far more in tune with these sorts of things than most.
string: 是啊，我能感覺到。當然了，我比大部分人對這種東西都要敏感一點。

original: Thank you. I appreciate your assistance.
string: 多謝了，我很感激你的幫助。

original: Maybe some other time.
string: 也許改天吧。

original: I see.
string: 明白了。

original: What did you need me to do?
string: 你想要我做什麼？

original: Use the gloves to clear the focal points. Return to me when you have finished. I thought I made this rather clear.
string: 用手套淨化節點。完成了就來告訴我。我以為我說得很明白了。

original: All right, I'll help.
string: 好的，我會幫忙。

original: Very well. These specially enchanted gloves will allow you to delve directly into the focal points for these energies.
string: 很好。這些特製的附魔手套能讓你直接觸節點內部的能量。

original: Go to each focal point and remove whatever impurities you may find there.
string: 把每個節點處的污染物清理乾淨。

original: Return the gloves to me when you have finished.
string: 完成後回來把手套還我。

original: Please exercise caution. This is not a procedure without possible... consequences.
string: 別告訴我又有一個學徒被燒成灰了，我現在手上有太多這類事件要處理了。

original: Why do these "energies" need to be cleansed?
string: 請謹慎處理，不然的話可能會產生意想不到的後果。

original: As you may be aware, the College has gone to great lengths to purify and enhance the natural energies of the world.
string: 也許你已經注意到了，魔法學院已經竭盡所能地提升並淨化世界上的自然能量。

original: This both enhances our connection to the realm of magic, and eliminates possible interference from outside sources.
string: 這能增進我們與魔法位面的聯繫，同時消除外界可能的干擾。

original: These energies, on occasion, become... polluted. Effort must be made to see that they are kept pure, clean.
string: 這些能量有時候會遭到……污染。必須確保它們的純淨。

original: Do you wish to aid in this cleansing?
string: 你想幫助我們淨化嗎？

original: Is there any College business I can assist with?
string: 有沒有任何學院來的委託是我能幫忙的呢？

original: There may be a matter in which your... skills... could be useful.
string: 也許在某件事情上你的……技能……能派上用場。

original: The various points of focus for magic energies around the College have become polluted, and need cleansing.
string: 魔法學院周圍很多法術能量的節點被污染了，需要淨化。

original: The magical energies underneath the College still require purification. Your assistance would be most useful.
string: 在魔法學院地下的法術能量仍然需要淨化。你的協助會很有用。

original: There have been reports of weird happenings near Wolfskull Cave. Travelers disappearing, odd lights. I suspect wild animals or perhaps bandits.
string: 有報告顯示狼頭骨洞穴附近發生了一些詭異的事，行人失蹤，奇怪的光。我懷疑是野獸或劫匪做的。

original: I don't think it's worth our time with the war going on, but if you want to clear out the cave, I'll make sure you're repaid for your work.
string: 雖然我不覺得這是值得在戰爭快開始前去執行，但如果你能徹查此洞，我保證會給你獎賞。

original: You mean the Dragon Bridge issue? I'll be honest with you, I was planning to let that go. Varnius is a bit jumpy at the best of times.
string: 你是說龍橋鎮的起源？實話實說，我打算放過這件事。瓦紐斯一直都很神經質。

original: I hear you're looking for some help with Wolfskull Cave.
string: 我聽說你需要人解決狼頭骨洞穴的事。

original: The cave has a bad history. Long ago, Potema the Wolf Queen used it for necromantic rituals. That's where it got the name.
string: 這洞穴有個很糟糕的過去。很久以前，狼女王波特瑪在此洞穴裡舉行死靈法術儀式，洞穴也因此來命名。

original: That was over 500 years ago. Nothing much down there now - but everyone's always convinced the cave is haunted.
string: 那是500年前的事了。現在裡面風平浪靜——但所有人都認為它鬧鬼。

original: Why is it called Wolfskull Cave?
string: 為什麼它被稱作狼頭骨洞穴？

original: He he he he he.
string: 嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

original: You just wait. My new pranks are going to the best ever! You'll see! He he he he.
string: 你等著吧。接下來的惡作劇才會是我的傑作！到時候就知道了，嘿嘿嘿嘿。

original: Ha! That ain't nothing. Wait till you see what I got planned for next week.
string: 哈！那還不算什麼？看下個星期會有什麼結果。

original: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! That's my boy!
string: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！好孩子！

original: Ha! I knew it! Had your name written all over it, that one did!
string: 哈！我就知道！那一看就知道是你的手法！

original: See, now that's what I'm talking about. Working hard, making your mark on this world. Good job, son.
string: 看到了嗎，這就是我說的，努力工作，你就能揚名天下。做得好孩子。

original: Sure I did. And I'd do it again.
string: 當然了，而且我還會再來一次。

original: Yeah. So?
string: 嗯。然後？

original: Ha ha ha ha! Yeah, I sure did. It was one of my best pranks yet, father.
string: 哈哈哈哈！耶，是真的。我最棒的惡作劇啊，爸。

original: Hey boy, I heard you nailed a Septim into Lucan's doorstep. Damn near drove him crazy. That true?
string: 嘿，孩子，我聽說你把一枚金幣釘在路坎的門階上，差點把他弄瘋。是真的嗎？

original: Tell me, son. Any truth to these stories I been hearing. About you gluing a cow's udders shut? You really do something like that?
string: 告訴我，孩子。我聽說的那些事情都是真的嗎？聽說你把一頭奶牛的乳房黏了起來？真的是你做的？

original: Heard me a rumor, boy. Something about you putting bugs in the stew over at the Sleeping Giant. You do this?
string: 聽到一些傳聞，說你把蟲子放在沉睡巨人的燉湯裡，是真的？

original: Fine. You play in the mud, or play with your father's forge, or get into sword fights with your little friend. But this is not over.
string: 好吧，你可以去玩泥巴，或者玩你爸的爐子，或者和你的小夥伴玩打仗。但這事沒完。

original: Oh, Dorthe. You're breaking your mother's heart, you know that?
string: 噢，朵西。你讓你母親太傷心了，知道嗎？

original: Well. I can see your father and I are going to have to talk about this. And when we do, things are going to change.
string: 好吧。我會去跟你爸好好談一談，然後做出點改變。

original: Ho, now... Keep me out of this...
string: 噢……我不想管這事……

original: It's just that papa promised I could make something at the forge. So maybe we could do something together, hmmm... next week? Is... that okay?
string: 爸爸答應我能用他的鐵爐做些東西。也許我們可以下次再一起做些什麼，下周如何？

original: Just stop trying to change me, mother! I'm not a baby anymore! I'm almost a woman! I... I can't be who I want to be!
string: 別想著改變我，媽媽！我不再是個孩子了！我都快變成一個女人了！我……我不能違背自己的願望！

original: I'm sorry, mother. I can't help it. All that stuff you like to do, it's just so... boring.
string: 抱歉，母親。我做不到。妳的喜好都……太無趣了。

original: Shor's crown! There are things ladies like us are supposed to do. We've talked about this...
string: 天哪！有些事情是女人們必須做的，我們不是討論過了嗎……

original: Let me guess. You'd rather play "Daedra and Battlemages" with Ordnar. Or go fishing, or catch frogs...
string: 妳的意思是，妳寧願和奧德那玩「魔族和戰鬥法師」，或者釣魚，抓青蛙……

original: Dorthe, listen to me. Your father and your friend may treat you like a boy, but you're not. Do you understand? So please. Be a girl. For me.
string: 朵西，聽我說。你父親和你朋友也許把妳當個男孩一樣對待，但妳並不是啊，懂嗎？像個女孩子，就算為了我，行嗎？

original: Oh. Um. Well... You see...
string: 噢，嗯……這個……

original: Wow. Yeah. That sounds great, mother. Only, um... it's just that...
string: 哇噢，聽起來不錯啊，媽。只是……那個……

original: Oooh. Ahhh... Well... See, the thing is...
string: 噢，啊……這個……這樣說吧，那個……

original: Dorthe, dear, I've been growin' some really lovely vegetables. Maybe tomorrow you could help me plant a new patch? What do you say?
string: 朵西，親愛的，我種了些非常漂亮的蔬菜。也許明天妳能幫我再種一排？

original: Dorthe... I was thinkin' I'd knit a couple of blankets, sell them to Lucan. Would you like to make one? Might be fun, workin' together.
string: 朵西……我在想我可以編幾張毯子，賣給路坎。你想編一張嗎？一起工作也許很有趣。

original: You know, Dorthe, with all those vegetables I've been growing lately, I was thinkin' we could make a right lovely stew. Together. How about it?
string: 嘿，朵西，我種的那些蔬菜可以燉出超美味的湯哦。一起來燒吧，怎麼樣？

original: Don't worry, I am.
string: 別擔心。

original: All right. But I am getting a bit tired of waiting.
string: 可以。但是我等的有點不耐煩了。

original: Yes, sir.
string: 是，先生。

original: Later, little one. I need to finish what I'm working on. But keep watching. Watch, and learn.
string: 以後吧，小傢伙。我得先把手頭的事做完。但你可以看著，邊看邊學。

original: He he. Not just yet, Dorthe. I need to keep forging, and you need to keep watching.
string: 呵呵。還沒好，朵西。我得繼續鍛造，你學著點。

original: Patience, Dorthe. You'll get some time at the forge, I promise you. But not right now. You need to keep watching me. That's how you'll learn.
string: 耐心點，朵西。你以後有機會在鐵匠鋪親手做的，我答應你，但不是現在，你需要不斷地看著我做，這就是你學習的方式。

original: Can I make something now, papa?
string: 我能做東西了嗎，爸爸？

original: Is it time yet? Time for me to make my sword? Or maybe... an axe?
string: 現在是時候了吧？該讓我造一把劍了。或者……斧頭也行。

original: I'm bored standing around, papa. I could take over for you...
string: 我等的好無聊啊，爸爸。我來接手吧。

original: Of course, Lucan. Of course. I was just, well... Never mind.
string: 當然了，路坎。當然。我只是有點……算了。

original: Okay, okay. Just trying make this place a little less... boring.
string: 好吧，好吧。只是希望這個地方沒那麼……無聊。

original: I know, I know. My head's in the clouds again. Just... forget I said anything.
string: 我知道，我知道。我又糊塗了。就當我沒說過吧。

original: That's really not at the top of my list, no. Please, Camilla, I need you to focus.
string: 那可並不是我優先要做的事。凱米拉，請集中注意力。

original: Dear sister, we talked about this sort of thing before. We sell dry goods, nothing more, nothing less.
string: 親愛的姐姐，我們談過這回事。我們賣乾貨，僅此而已。

original: Camilla, really? You don't have better things to do? Because I could certainly find quite a few tasks...
string: 凱米拉，真的嗎？妳沒其他事情好做了？我能找到一堆事情……

original: Hmm. All right. Do you think... maybe we should?
string: 嗯，好吧。你覺得……或許我們應該？

original: Well, I was thinking... we should. We could stock all kinds of specialty items. You know, to cater to some of our more.... "eclectic" customers.
string: 嗯，我在想……我們應該。我們可以儲存各種特別的貨物。然後賣給那些……「特別的」顧客。

original: Hmmm... Well, maybe we could go on a sort of trip. Take the wares on the road. Get some new customers.
string: 嗯……好吧，也許我們可以旅行一趟。上路推銷，結識下新顧客。

original: No, dear sister. We do not.
string: 不，親愛的姐姐。不行。

original: I'm afraid not.
string: 恐怕不行。

original: A sale? To attract new customers? Camilla, everyone in Riverwood already shops here. There are no more customers.
string: 拍賣？吸引新顧客？凱米拉，河木鎮的每個人都來我們這裡買東西，這裡已經沒新顧客了。

original: Lucan, we don't sell silver buckles, do we? One of the customers was asking.
string: 路坎，我們不賣銀扣環是嗎？有個客人剛才在問。

original: We don't sell any imports from Summerset Isle, do we, Lucan?
string: 我們不賣夏暮島進口的貨，是嗎，路坎？

original: Lucan, I was thinking we should have a grand sale. Lower the prices by half, maybe get some jugglers. We could attract lots of new customers.
string: 路坎，我想我們應該搞次大拍賣。降價一半，再找點變戲法的。一定能吸引一大批新顧客。

original: Wonderful. And let's not have this chat again next week. Agreed?
string: 好極了。我們下周可別進行這種談話了，同意嗎？

original: You do realize these simpletons wouldn't know real music if it bit them in the britches, hmm? Very well. Your wish is my command.
string: 你知道這群蠢貨不懂真正的音樂對嗎？好吧，你說什麼就是什麼？

original: It's about your singing. Well, not your singing, your songs. But you know what I'm talking about.
string: 關於你的歌唱。嗯，不是你唱的不好，是你歌的問題。好吧，你知道我想說什麼就好。

original: Here we go...
string: 又來了……

original: Sven, we need to talk...
string: 斯萬，我們得談談……

original: Well. There's something to be said for honesty, I suppose.
string: 好吧，我覺得我們必須互相坦誠。

original: I should have guessed.
string: 我早就知道。

original: No.
string: 不想。

original: I don't suppose I could convince you to take care of it now, could I?
string: 你現在應該不想處理那，對吧？

original: Don't I always?
string: 不是一直都是我在處理嗎？

original: And... you'll take care of it?
string: 那……你會去處理？

original: Wait, let me guess. You'll get to it later.
string: 等等，讓我想想，你會以後再處理這件事。

original: Yep.
string: 對。

original: The corn stores are getting low again, Orgnar.
string: 糧食店狀況不佳，奧格那。

original: You promised me you'd sweep the entranceway.
string: 你答應過我把入口掃一下的。

original: I still need you to make a batch of those fried potatoes. We can serve them with the ale.
string: 我還是需要你做一些炸馬鈴薯。我們可以搭配酒來賣。

original: You are going to brew a new batch of ale, right? Like we talked about? What we have's been sitting in that barrel for over a month.
string: 你要釀一批酒是嗎？就像我們說過的那樣？桶裡的那東西已經放在那邊一個月了。

original: You a fighting man? How about a little bet?
string: 你是個鬥士嗎？要不要來打個賭？

original: You a fighting girl? How about a little bet?
string: 妳是個女鬥士嗎？要不要來打個賭？

original: Think you can go blade to blade with me? You'd be dead in six seconds.
string: 你以為你能和我比劍術？你不到6秒鐘就會掛掉。

original: You. You a Dark Elf lover? Get out of our city, you filthy piece of trash.
string: 你。你是個暗精靈支持者？滾出我們的城市，你這骯髒的傢伙。

original: You damn gray-skin. Go back to Morrowind!
string: 你這骯髒的灰皮膚。滾回晨風去！

original: I'm the best warrior in Morthal, and that's no boast.
string: 我是墨索爾城最好的戰士，不是吹牛。

original: Take my advice. Never gamble. Damn Irnskar has me in debt up to the eyes.
string: 聽我的，別賭博。可惡的艾恩斯卡讓我輸的傾家蕩產。

original: Life's hard enough with all these men propositioning me. But that bard is the worst.
string: 有這些人挑逗我已經夠煩的了，但那個吟遊詩人才是最麻煩的。

original: We're used to getting by on scraps, but the Shatter-Shields want everything for nothing.
string: 我們通常不管小打小鬧，但碎盾們貪得無厭。

original: Poor Roggi. If you're feeling charitable, buy the Nord a mead. He's good for it.
string: 可憐的羅吉。如果你是好心人，給那個諾德人買杯蜜酒吧。他很需要。

original: Ranmir beg a drink from you, yet? That's gold wasted, friend.
string: 蘭米爾向你要酒，是嗎？給他是浪費錢，朋友。

original: No. Never mind.
string: 不，沒事。

original: Okie dokie, Listener.
string: 好吧，聆聽者。

original: All right.
string: 好的。

original: As you will.
string: 如你所願。

original: Very well.
string: 非常好。

original: (bark)
string: （犬吠）

original: Never mind, boy. I don't need you to do anything.
string: 沒事，孩子。我不用你做任何事。

original: All right.
string: 沒問題。

original: As you wish.
string: 如你所願。

original: Very well.
string: 非常好。

original: Fine.
string: 好。

original: Your call.
string: 聽你的。

original: Yes. Let me show you.
string: 對，我來告訴你。

original: I'm on it.
string: 我這就去。

original: Right away.
string: 這就去。

original: With pleasure.
string: 樂意至極。

original: Right.
string: 好的。

original: (woof)
string: （低吠）

original: Here, boy. Let me show you what I need.
string: 這裡，孩子。我告訴你我需要什麼？

original: Let's see it.
string: 說吧。

original: Point the way.
string: 指路。

original: Let us see it, then.
string: 告訴我吧。

original: As you will.
string: 如你所願。

original: Right, then.
string: 那麼好吧。

original: You want me to do something or not?
string: 你到底有沒有事給我做！

original: Do you have any orders?
string: 你有什麼指示嗎？

original: Still something you'd like me to do?
string: 還有要我去做的事嗎？

original: Did you require something of J'zargo?
string: 你還想要紮格做什麼？

original: Did you still need me for something?
string: 你還需要我做什麼？

original: So, did you still need my assistance?
string: 你還需要我的幫助嗎？

original: (panting)
string: （喘氣）

original: Still need me to do something?
string: 還要我做什麼事嗎？

original: Do you still need me to do something?
string: 還要我做什麼？

original: You wanted me to do something, yes?
string: 要我做什麼事？

original: You still wish something of me?
string: 還要我做什麼？

original: Still have something you need?
string: 你還需要什麼？

original: I need you to do something.
string: 我需要你做些事。

original: J'zargo is listening.
string: 說給紮格聽吧。

original: Anything, as long as I get to fight.
string: 都可以，只要我能參與戰鬥就行。

original: Name it.
string: 說吧。

original: What do you need?
string: 你想要什麼？

original: (bark)
string: （犬吠）

original: All right. What is it?
string: 好。什麼事？

original: What do you need?
string: 你想要什麼？

original: Go ahead. What is it?
string: 繼續說，怎麼了？

original: What is it?
string: 什麼？

original: Fine. What?
string: 好。要做什麼？

original: Yes, Thane. What is it?
string: 是的，武衛。怎麼了？

original: I helped the long-dead lovers find each other.
string: 我幫助一對死去已久的戀人找到彼此。

original: Your efforts have helped illuminate the entire province. I trust by now you've achieved a higher comprehension of love.
string: 你的努力給整個省都帶來了光明。我相信現在你已經對愛有了更深層次的理解。

original: Carry the blessings of Mara with you, so the rest of the province may shine with her glories.
string: 願瑪拉的賜福與你同在，以使這省的其他地方也能在她的榮耀下綻放光茫。

original: Now wait a minute, Listener. Even Cicero has his limits! Not many, mind you... but I do have them...
string: 等一等，聆聽者。即使是西塞羅也是有極限的。雖然好像沒有，但是……還是有的。

original: I won't do it. You ask too much.
string: 我不會做的。你的要求太過分了。

original: But Listener... Are you sure? I just can't bring myself to do it...
string: 聆聽者……你確定嗎？我真的做不到啊……

original: (growl)
string: （咆哮）

original: Not for you. Not for anyone.
string: 不能為了你。不能為任何人。

original: Even Khajiit have their limits. No.
string: 就算是虎人也是有極限的。不行。

original: Maybe you want to rethink what you're asking?
string: 可能你想重新考慮你的請求？

original: I will not drag my honor through the mud for you, or anyone.
string: 我不會為了你而使我的榮譽受損，任何人都不行。

original: Forget it. I don't do that kind of work.
string: 算了吧，我不幹那種工作。

original: I'm sorry, but I'm not going to do something like that. Even for you.
string: 我很抱歉，但是我不會去做那種事，就算是為了你也不行。

original: Nothing else? I'm always eager.
string: 沒別的事了？我總是坐不住。

original: That everything?
string: 還有別的事嗎？

original: Is that all?
string: 沒事了嗎？

original: (panting)
string: （喘氣）

original: Anything else?
string: 還有其他事嗎？

original: Is that all?
string: 沒事了嗎？

original: Do you need anything else?
string: 你還需要些什麼？

original: We done?
string: 說完了嗎？

original: That it?
string: 就這樣？

original: Anything else before you go?
string: 你走之前還有什麼事嗎？

original: I helped the forlorn lovers of Markarth.
string: 我幫助了馬卡斯城裡一對孤獨的戀人。

original: The goddess smiles at your efforts, child. The dawn shines bright upon you.
string: 女神看到了你的努力，孩子。黎明將照耀著你。

original: You have seen the young, fickle love of youth, and helped a more seasoned love find its way.
string: 你看到了年輕人那幼稚，變化無常的愛，並幫助一段更成熟的愛情找到它的路。

original: There is one final aspect we wish for you to explore. For a strong love can withstand storms and even survive death.
string: 還有最後一件事我們希望你去探索。因為堅強的愛情可以抵得住風吹雨打甚至可以戰勝死亡。

original: Take this symbol of Mara. She will guide you to the wandering souls of two whose love was so great that their entwinement binds them to this world.
string: 戴上這個瑪拉的護符吧，它會指引你找到那對戀人遊蕩的靈魂，他們的愛如此偉大以至於他們仍廝守在這個世界上。

original: He cares about you.
string: 他關心你。

original: Clearly. I've never even thought of him in that manner. I wish that I was as skilled with words as he.
string: 很明顯。我從未以那種方式想過他。我希望我能和他一樣文采飛揚。

original: Here, take him this letter. I may not be as eloquent as he is, but I hope he understands.
string: 來，把這封信交給他。我的文詞或許沒有他優美，但是我希望他能了解。

original: (Give poem)
string: （交出詩）

original: This is... lovely. Calcelmo wrote this... about me? I never knew he had such feeling in him.
string: 這真是…動人。這是卡塞莫為我寫的？我從不知道他對我有這種感覺。

original: It's from Calcelmo. Please.
string: 這是卡塞莫要給妳的，請收下吧。

original: I'm not sure what this is all about.
string: 我不確定這是什麼意思。

original: So I hear. Come here, you.
string: 那我洗耳恭聽，你，到這裡來。

original: I love you.
string: 我愛妳。

original: Sssh. It's all right. You don't need to say anymore. I had no idea you were so... nuanced.
string: 噓，沒關係的。你不需要再說了。我沒想到你原來這麼的…可愛。

original: Faleen... I...
string: 法琳……我……

original: I'm sorry, I don't know her.
string: 抱歉，我不認識她。

original: Well, suffice to say she is resplendent, but not without resolve. Striking, in all senses.
string: 嗯，她可以稱得上是美豔照人了，真的。她渾身上下都散發光采。

original: Yes, I do.
string: 嗯，我之道。

original: Then you know what a beauty she is.
string: 那麼你知道她是個大美人囉。

original: The trouble is that I can't seem to speak around her.
string: 我遇到的麻煩是，只要在她身邊我就說不出話了。

original: My mouth goes dry, and I start to shake.
string: 我的嘴會變得乾燥，並且我的身體會開始顫抖。

original: I could never hope to approach her.
string: 我從未希望過能接近她。

original: She said that you should elope.
string: 她說你應該和她私奔。

original: I always had a feeling she liked me. More than that brute Jofthor, at least.
