string: 我一直覺得她喜歡我。至少喜歡我比喜歡那個粗魯的約夫托爾多一些。

original: Jofthor... what about him? He'll come after us and... it will be unpleasant.
string: 約夫托爾…那他怎麼辦？他會一直追著我們然後…事情會變得不愉快的。

original: Oh, and to be with you!
string: 哦，然後就可以跟你一起生活了！

original: To Riften, my pet. How you'll adore the city.
string: 到裂谷城去，我的小可愛，妳會愛死那座城的。

original: Where will we go?
string: 我們要去哪兒？

original: We must leave. Your father will never approve of us, and I grow weary of this place.
string: 我們必須走了，你父親永遠不會贊成我們在一起的，而且我已經厭倦了這個地方。

original: Bassianus, sweetie, what is it?
string: 巴夏努斯，甜心，怎麼了？

original: Fastred, we must speak.
string: 法斯萊德，我們必須談談。

original: Oh, Klimmek...
string: 哦，科林麥…

original: What good are fish if you have to eat them alone?
string: 一個人吃魚多苦悶啊？

original: But I thought you only cared about your fishing!
string: 我以為你只關心釣魚！

original: Because... I would miss you.
string: 因為…我會想妳。

original: Why not?
string: 為什麼？

original: I don't want you to leave Ivarstead.
string: 我不希望妳離開紫杉鎮。

original: Klimmek? What is it?
string: 科林麥？怎麼了嗎？

original: Fastred, I have something to say to you.
string: 法斯萊德，我有些話想對妳說。

original: What do you have to lose?
string: 你有什麼好損失的？

original: Ysmir's beard, you're right! No fish was ever caught by staying away from the shore. I'm off to see her!
string: 伊斯米爾的鬍子，你是對的！光站在岸邊可是什麼魚也抓不到的。我要去見她了！

original: She probably appreciates assertive men.
string: 她可能欣賞果斷的男人。

original: What did you call me?
string: 你剛叫我什麼？

original: Your daughter asked me to speak to you.
string: 你的女兒請我跟妳談一談。

original: Oh my. Probably something about the men. We all wish we had her problems.
string: 哦，我的天啊。可能是關於男人的事情吧。我們都希望可以解決她的問題。

original: Now, don't tell my husband, but I don't have any problem with Bassianus.
string: 現在聽好了，不要告訴我丈夫，但是我覺得巴夏努斯並沒有什麼不好的。

original: Even if it means her leaving Ivarstead, I want Fastred to be happy.
string: 即使這意味著她會離開紫杉鎮，我也希望法斯萊德能夠開心。

original: If they just snuck out of town together, I could manage my husband.
string: 如果他們剛好一起溜出城去，我想我可以應付我丈夫。

original: Why do you want her to stay so badly?
string: 為什麼你這麼希望她留下來？

original: Look around here. There's not much left.
string: 瞧瞧這裡吧，這已經沒剩下多少人了。

original: Used to be a good-sized town, but folks have been moving to Riften for a while now.
string: 這裡曾是一個規模不小的城鎮，但是現在本地人一直不斷遷往裂谷城。

original: If all the young people leave, what happens to Ivarstead?
string: 如果所有的年輕人都離開了，紫杉鎮會怎麼樣？

original: You think she'll get over it?
string: 你覺得她是認真的嗎？

original: You know how children are. Her fancies change with the moon.
string: 你知道孩子們的脾氣，她喜歡什麼都是三分鐘熱度。

original: And like always, the boy lacks any kind of spine. He'll need some convincing.
string: 而且和往常一樣，那男孩也還沒拿定主意。需要有人勸勸他。

original: A little push and this would all be simpler.
string: 只要稍微勸勸他，事情就會變得比較單純。

original: I'll talk to your parents about it.
string: 我會跟你父母談談這個的。

original: Oh, thank you so much! It's wonderful to have someone around who understands.
string: 哦，太感謝你了！身邊有個能理解我的人真是太好了。

original: Yes. What's troubling you?
string: 嗯。有什麼在困擾著妳？

original: My parents are being impossible.
string: 我的父母實在太不講理了。

original: Bassianus wants to marry me. And I think I love him. But he wants to move to Riften afterwards, and my father won't allow it.
string: 巴夏努斯想要娶我，而且我也覺得我是愛他的。但是他想搬到裂谷城去，我的父親可不允許這種事發生。

original: He only cares about this stupid town, but Bassianus makes me happier than anyone ever has.
string: 他只關心這座愚蠢的破鎮子，但是巴夏努斯帶給我的歡樂比其他任何人都多。

original: My mother's not any help, either.
string: 我母親也幫不上忙。

original: How did you know I was coming?
string: 你怎麼知道我要來？

original: I prayed to Mara and she spoke to me in a dream. She said a stranger would appear to help me.
string: 我向瑪拉祈禱，而她在夢中與我對話。她說一個陌生人會出現並幫助我。

original: Is that you?
string: 那個人是你嗎？

original: May you carry the warmth of Mara to all corners of the frozen wastes.
string: 願你把瑪拉的溫暖帶給這冰冷廢土上的每一個角落。

original: The dawn surely opens upon you, child. You must bear its light that all may see.
string: 黎明的曙光一定在注視著你，孩子。你一定帶著它那眾生都能看見的光輝。

original: Just tell me what to do.
string: 告訴我該怎麼做就是了。

original: The dawn surely opens upon you, child. You must bear its light that all may see.
string: 黎明的曙光一定在注視著你，孩子。你一定帶著它那眾生都能看見的光輝。

original: Mara has reflected an image to me. At the foot of the throat and young woman... almost a girl... her fickle love must resolve itself.
string: 瑪拉向我昭示了一個畫面。世界咽喉的腳下，有一個年輕的女人……也可以說是一個女孩…她那易變的愛必須被終結。

original: The village of Ivarstead. The woman, Fastred.
string: 一個名叫紫杉鎮的村莊，一個名叫法斯萊德的女人。

original: This is the prayer heard by the goddess and relayed to her servants. Return when she has seen her path.
string: 這是女神聽到了信徒的祈禱而做出的回應。讓她看清她的路之後再回來。

original: I will entreat Mara on your behalf.
string: 我會替你向瑪拉祈福的。

original: May I receive her blessings?
string: 我可以接受她的賜福嗎？

original: Not all can hear the broad echoes of deepest dawn.
string: 不是所有的人都能聽到最深的黎明激起的那廣闊的回音。

original: To receive the touch of Mara, you must first act as her hands in the world.
string: 想要接受瑪拉的觸摸，你必須要先在這個世界中充當她的左膀右臂。

original: Explore the facets of the infinite jewel.
string: 探索無盡珠寶的層面吧。

original: I have a letter from Faleen.
string: 我拿到一封法琳寫的信。

original: This is... more than I could have hoped for. Have you really done this for me?
string: 這…已經超出了我所希望的。你真的為我這麼做了？

original: I have to see her. Please, excuse me.
string: 我必須要見她。抱歉請容我離開。

original: I have a poem I'd like you to read.
string: 我有一首詩想讓妳看看。

original: Pardon me?
string: 什麼？

original: That seems like a lot of money.
string: 那似乎是一大筆錢。

original: Come back when you've got the gold, then.
string: 那麼，等你有了錢再回來吧。

original: I'll buy it. (200 gold)
string: 我買了。（200金幣）

original: Wonderful. I'll write it out so you won't forget it.
string: 太好了。我把它寫下來，這樣你就不會忘記了。

original: Hmmm. I don't think you've got enough to cover my expenses with Silver-Bloods, much less convince me give my words away.
string: 嗯。我不認為你有足夠的錢來支付我與銀血之間的費用，更談不上說服我食言了。

original: About that poem....
string: 關於那首詩…

original: Are you prepared to receive my golden words?
string: 你準備好聽我的金玉良言了嗎？

original: I hear you lost Fastred.
string: 我聽說你失去了法斯萊德。

original: Oh, Fastred. I'm not sure what happened. One moment she's smiling at me, the next I can't even meet her eyes.
string: 哦，法斯萊德。我不確定發生什麼事了？前一秒她還在對我微笑，下一秒她連正眼都不瞧我一下。

original: I'll bet Bassianus would know what's going on. He understands women.
string: 我打賭巴夏努斯會知道這是怎麼一回事的，他很瞭解女人。

original: Boti said to talk to you about Fastred.
string: 伯蒂要我跟你談談法斯萊德。

original: Oh, my love. How I long to take her away from all of this.
string: 哦，我的愛。我多麼渴望帶她遠離這一切。

original: Why did Boti send you to me?
string: 伯蒂為什麼派你過來？

original: Your daughter asked me to speak to you.
string: 你的女兒請我跟你談一談。

original: I'm sure I know what this is about.
string: 我想我知道你要跟我談什麼。

original: She thinks she's in love with Bassianus and wants to leave town. With him.
string: 她覺得她愛上巴夏努斯了並且想離開城鎮。和他一起。

original: Let me tell you how I see it.
string: 讓我告訴你我對這事的看法。

original: Until a few months ago, the girl was head over heels for Klimmek. Wouldn't stop talking about him.
string: 就在幾個月前，我姑娘還在為科林麥神魂顛倒，無時無刻不在談論著他。

original: Now if I thought she was really in love with Bassianus, that would be one thing. But she's a child.
string: 現在就算我認為她真的愛巴夏努斯，也不是理由。她畢竟還是個孩子。

original: It will pass.
string: 那股衝動很快就會消失。

original: Are you the one sent by Mara?
string: 你是瑪拉所派來的人嗎？

original: Which of the Eight Divines do you serve?
string: 妳為八聖靈中的哪一位服務？

original: We are devoted to the Goddess Mara, who gave mortals the gift of love that they might have a hint of eternity.
string: 我們獻身給了女神瑪拉，她贈與凡人愛作為禮物以使他們也能擁有少許的永恆。

original: Her blessings are many. To love is to know the true nature of the gods.
string: 她的賜福有許多。愛就是了解神的本質。

original: I've been sent by Mara to aid you.
string: 我被瑪拉派來幫助你。

original: I was beginning to lose faith that any help would come.
string: 我本來已經不抱期待有任何人能來幫我了。

original: Eh... You see... I've been thinking about Faleen quite a bit. You know Faleen?
string: 呃……你知道……這陣子我一直在想著法琳 。你認識法琳嗎？

original: Oh Listener. Can't you see that's impossible?
string: 聆聽者。你難道看不出來那是不可能的嗎？

original: Sorry, Listener. It can't be done.
string: 對不起，聆聽者。這是不可能的。

original: If only I could, Listener.
string: 要是我能辦到就好了，聆聽者。

original: (whine)
string: （哀嚎）

original: Can't do that. Sorry.
string: 我做不到。對不起。

original: Not possible.
string: 不可能。

original: That can't be done.
string: 辦不到。

original: Can't do it.
string: 我做不到。

original: No. Not possible.
string: 不。不可能。

original: I'm sorry, that can't be done.
string: 我很抱歉。不能那樣做。

original: It shall be done.
string: 沒問題。

original: Of course. Right away.
string: 當然。馬上去。

original: With pleasure, my Listener!
string: 願意效勞，我的聆聽者！

original: (woof!)
string: （低吠聲!）

original: Okay, got it.
string: 好的，知道了。

original: It will be done.
string: 包在我身上。

original: As you say, it will happen.
string: 你吩咐，我照辦。

original: Then that is my task.
string: 我會去處理的。

original: Will do.
string: 沒問題。

original: No problem, I'll handle it.
string: 沒問題，我會去處理。

original: Command me, my Listener.
string: 對我下令吧，聆聽者。

original: Anything you need, Listener.
string: 什麼都行，聆聽者。

original: Oh yes, Listener!
string: 是的，聆聽者！

original: (bark)
string: （犬吠）

original: What do you need?
string: 你想要什麼？

original: What is it?
string: 什麼？

original: What do you want?
string: 你想要什麼？

original: Show me.
string: 讓我看看。

original: What?
string: 什麼？

original: Yes, my Thane?
string: 怎麼了，武衛大人？

original: Did you need something?
string: 需要幫忙嗎？

original: It was like this when I found it.
string: 我找到它時就是這樣了。

original: Figures -- I doubt you have sufficient knowledge to harm the Phial even if you wanted to.
string: 我想——即使你想傷害雪瓶，你也不具備足夠的知識。

original: Either way, this is the end of it.
string: 不管怎樣，這事到此為止。

original: Now if you'll excuse me, I'm not quite in the mood to entertain guests. I trust you can show yourself out.
string: 現在如果你不介意的話，我沒什麼心情去娛樂客人。我相信你自己能走出去。

original: Here's for your trouble.
string: 這是獎勵你的辛勞。

original: Tell me about the Briar Heart.
string: 跟我談談有關荊棘之心的事。

original: The final tempering of the Phial was performed with a type of old magic that's been lost since the Dragon War.
string: 製造雪瓶的最後一步是由一種自巨龍戰爭以來就失傳的古老魔法所完成的。

original: The nearest modern incarnation of it is the strange rituals practiced by the Forsworn.
string: 近代只有棄誓者進行他們奇怪的儀式時才會使用類似的魔法。

original: With the heart of one of their Briar Warriors, I can lock the Phial's magic into its physical form.
string: 我需要一顆荊棘武士的心，就可以將雪瓶的法力封印在它的實體形態裡。

original: It's difficult to explain to the layman -- forgive me if I begin waxing alchemic.
string: 這和外行人很難解釋清楚——請原諒我要開始鍊金了。

original: Tell me about the Mammoth Tusk Powder.
string: 告訴我有關長毛象牙粉末的事。

original: The ivory produced by those beasts is as hard as iron. But the giants have found ways to make it yield.
string: 那些猛獸的長牙如鋼鐵般堅硬。但是巨人們找到了讓它軟化的方法。

original: They're able to grind it down so fine that it can be infused into the lattice of packed snow.
string: 他們可以把那些長牙研磨成非常細小的粉末，象牙粉末甚至可以灌入雪花之間的縫隙。

original: The finished material has the delicate nature of fresh powder snow, but the strength of the hardest steel.
string: 完成後的材料有著雪粉般纖柔的特質，但也擁有著最堅硬的鋼鐵的力量。

original: Tell me about the Unmelting Snow.
string: 告訴我有關不融之雪的事。

original: On top of the Throat of the World is a patch of snow that's never melted.
string: 在世界咽喉的山頂有一塊永不融化的雪。

original: They say the Greybeards taught it to ignore the sun, and heat simply washes over it.
string: 人們說灰鬍子教會它無視陽光，熱量僅僅從它上面流過。

original: The original Phial was made from this snow. We'll only need a small bit for the repairs.
string: 最初的雪瓶就是由這種雪製成。我們只需要一點點來進行修復工作。

original: Looking for my husband Nazeem? Check the Jarl's backside. That's usually where he stuffs himself these days.
string: 要找我丈夫納奇姆？去領主那裡看看吧，這些天他老跟在領主身邊。

original: Are you married? You look the type. Make sure you treat your wife with the respect she deserves.
string: 你結婚了嗎？你看起來像是結婚了。記得要給你妻子她應得的尊重。

original: Here you stand, talking to a married woman. Why? Am I that interesting? Or perhaps there are other things on your mind.
string: 你現在在跟一個結了婚的女人說話。為什麼？我很有趣嗎？或者你正在盤算著其他的事情。

original: Here you stand, talking to a still grieving widow. Why? Am I that interesting? Or perhaps there are other things on your mind.
string: 你現在在跟一個悲傷的寡婦說話。為什麼？我很有趣嗎？或者你正在盤算著其他的事情。

original: Men are all alike, from Skyrim to Hammerfell. They care only for war and politics, and treat their women like cattle.
string: 男人全都一副德性，不管是在天際省還是在落錘省。他們只關心戰爭和政治，對待他們的女人就像對待牲口一樣。

original: I work for Belethor, at the general goods store.
string: 我在雜貨鋪給貝萊托爾打工。

original: Come by Belethor's shop, at the market. I'm sure we've got something you need.
string: 來貝萊托爾的雜貨鋪，在市場裡。我確定我們有你要的東西。

original: Don't mean to be rude, but I'm too busy to talk right now.
string: 我不想無禮，但是我現在太忙了沒時間說話。

original: This war's as stupid as our feud with Clan Gray-Mane.
string: 這場戰爭就像我們與灰鬃家族之間的世仇一樣愚蠢。

original: Need something? Unlike the rest of my family, I've got work to do.
string: 需要什麼？我跟我的家人不同，我還有工作要做。

original: My brother Jon's got the right of it - join the Bards College and avoid this pointless war.
string: 我兄弟喬有這個權利——加入吟遊詩人學院然後避免這場毫無意義的戰爭。

original: My brother Jon had the right of it - join the Bards College and avoid this pointless war. Too bad he died before he had the chance.
string: 我兄弟喬有這個權利——加入吟遊詩人學院學然後避免這場毫無意義的戰爭。很不幸在他抓住這機會之前他就死了。

original: My boy Lars has been getting beat senseless, and by a girl, no less!
string: 我的兒子拉斯被打得不省人事，還是被一個女孩打的，不可思議！

original: The finest cuts, fresh from the wilds!
string: 野外剛獵來的鮮肉，最鮮嫩的部位！

original: Chops and steaks fit for a jarl! Come and see my selection of finest-quality meats!
string: 領主御用的肉排！來瞧瞧吧，我這裡的肉可是上等貨！

original: Tired of bread and stew? Had enough of fish and fowl? Treat yourself and your kin to a choice cut of steak or a tender rack of ribs!
string: 吃膩了麵包與燉肉？吃夠了魚肉和鳥肉？跟家人一起吃一頓上等牛排或者鮮嫩的肋排吧!

original: Need something? Talk to my brother, Elrindir.
string: 你需要什麼？跟我兄弟談談吧，他叫艾倫迪。

original: You should try the venison. It's delicious.
string: 你應該嘗嘗鹿肉。美味極了。

original: Do you hunt? The plains outside Whiterun are ripe with game.
string: 你打獵嗎？白漫城外面的平原可是打獵的個好地方。

original: Shhh. You'll scare the deer.
string: 噓。你會嚇跑鹿的。

original: Oh! You startled me. I wasn't expecting company out here.
string: 哦！你嚇到我了。我沒想到在這也會有人。

original: You look rather pale. Could be Ataxia. It's quite a problem back home in Cyrodiil.
string: 你看起來臉色真蒼白。可能是運動失調症的緣故。如果在賽瑞迪爾的話這可是個大麻煩。

original: These Stormcloaks are ridiculous. They won't shop here because they think I'll sell them poisoned tonics. I should just go back to Cyrodiil.
string: 這些風暴斗篷們腦子進水了。怕我賣給他們有毒的藥水，全都不跟我做生意。真想回賽瑞迪爾去啊。

original: Pardon me, but do I detect a case of the Rattles? I've got something for that.
string: 不好意思，我發現你有點哮喘病的徵兆，我有治這病的藥。

original: I have several elixirs for sale.
string: 我這有些藥水出售。

original: Maybe a hardy Nord like you doesn't need a cure-all. Hmm? What about an invisibility potion?
string: 或許像你這樣的諾德硬漢不需要全面治療藥水。對嗎？來一瓶隱形藥水如何?

original: I'm... Well, who I am isn't important. Let's leave it at that, hmm?
string: 我是……嗯，我是誰不重要。先別管我是誰，好嗎?

original: Forget Solitude or Windhelm. Whiterun was the crown jewel of Skyrim before... Well, before... Never mind.
string: 忘記獨孤城或者風舵城吧。白漫城以前是天際省的明珠……嗯，以前……無所謂了。

original: This was such a glorious city. But then everything had to change. The Empire came... and my brother was lost...
string: 這曾是一個非常宏偉的城市。但是一切都會改變。皇帝來了...我的兄弟卻走了…

original: Ah, but Skyrim! Skyrim is supreme among all nations! Our people, our native people, are unmatched in all Tamriel!
string: 啊，只有天際省！它才是所有省中最棒的！我們的人民，我們本地人，在整個泰姆瑞爾大陸上無人能比！

original: One day the war will end and the true heirs of Skyrim will inherit this great realm.
string: 總有一天戰爭會結束而天際的真正傳人將繼承這片偉大的土地。

original: Imperials, Stormcloaks... I don't care who's in charge around here. I just want to make money!
string: 帝國人，風暴斗篷... 我不管這裡歸誰管。我只想要賺錢！

original: Everything's for sale, my friend. Everything. If I had a sister, I'd sell her in a second.
string: 一切都可以賣，我的朋友。一切。如果我有個妹妹的話，我眼都不眨就會把她給賣了。

original: I'd even buy one of your relatives, if you're looking to sell. Ha ha ha ha. That's a little joke.
string: 我甚至會買你的親人，如果你想賣他們的話。哈哈哈哈。開個玩笑。

original: You just let me know what you need. I am at your beck and call.
string: 讓我知道你需要什麼就成了。我隨時聽你使喚。

original: Welcome to Belethor's General Goods. Welcome, indeed.
string: 歡迎來到貝萊托爾的雜貨鋪。非常歡迎。

original: I know what you're thinking: "This Belethor, how could he part with such magnificent treasures?"
string: 我知道你在想什麼：「這個貝萊托爾，他怎麼捨得和這麼貴重的寶藏分開呢？」

original: I might just be a servant among lords, but don't think for a moment I don't take my duties as seriously as the jarl himself takes his!
string: 我可能只是貴族們的僕人，但是你必須明白，我看待這份工作，和領主看待他的職務一樣盡忠職守！

original: If my cleanin' gets in your way, just say the word an' I'll be off.
string: 如果我打掃時妨礙到你的話，告訴我一聲我就會馬上離開。

original: This here is Dragonsreach, an' it's my task to see it looks fit for a jarl, night an' day.
string: 這是龍臨堡，我的工作就是要讓它隨時隨地的符合領主的身份。

original: Ain't nobody high and mighty in these halls, exceptin' the Jarl. And don't you forget!
string: 在這座廳堂之中沒有人的地位高過領主。你可不要忘了這一點！

original: Don't you go trackin' your dirty boots on my clean floor!
string: 別在我乾淨的地板上留下你骯髒的腳印！

original: Soldiers! They're everywhere these days. And not a one of them knows how to pick up after themselves.
string: 那些臭士兵！這幾天他們到處亂跑，而他們之中沒一個人知道怎麼善後。

original: My poor Fralia thinks Thorald's still alive, but I know better.
string: 我可憐的法利亞認為索拉德還活著，可我知道不是那回事。

original: Whiterun belongs to the true sons of Skyrim now, just as it should.
string: 白漫城現在屬於真正的天際之子們了，它本應如此。

original: We Gray-Manes got just as much to be proud of as them Battle-Borns, but you won't see us with our noses in the air.
string: 我們灰鬃家族和他們戰狂氏族同樣驕傲，但是我們不像他們那樣目中無人。

original: Got of lot of steel to shape.
string: 還有很多打鐵的活等著我去做呢。

original: Hmm?
string: 嗯？

original: I ain't much for talkin'.
string: 我不太想說話。

original: Why you still starin' at me?
string: 你為什麼還盯著我看？

original: Never much cared for that Balgruuf myself. He was in the Empire's pocket, so to speak.
string: 我從不大關心那個巴爾古夫。可以說，他早就是帝國的人了。

original: Bits and baubles for sale, all crafted by the best blacksmith in Skyrim.
string: 賣馬嚼子和小玩意兒，全出自天際省最好的鐵匠之手。

original: Come see my collection of Gray-Mane's finest trinkets! You'll not find their like in all Tamriel!
string: 來看看我收藏的最好的灰鬃小飾品吧！你在整個泰姆瑞爾大陸都找不到第二家了！

original: Shiny trinkets for your good lady! All crafted by the great Eorlund Gray-Mane himself!
string: 漂亮的首飾囉，專為美麗的少女們準備的！這些可都是偉大的厄倫德．灰鬃親手雕琢的！

original: My Eorlund is the finest blacksmith in Skyrim, and that's not just a wife's boasting.
string: 我的厄倫德是天際省最好的鐵匠，我可沒有因為我是他的妻子而吹牛。

original: I can't stand those braggart Battle-Borns. They think they're the gods' gift to Whiterun.
string: 我實在受不了那群自吹自擂的戰狂氏族人，他們以為自己是神賜予白漫城的禮物。

original: Eorlund and I... we both miss our son terribly. Thorald... he went missing, fighting the Imperials.
string: 厄倫德和我……我們都非常想念我們的兒子。索拉德……他在和帝國人戰鬥的時候失蹤了。

original: I...I miss our son terribly, especially since Eorlund died. Thorald... he went missing, fighting the Imperials.
string: 我……我非常想念我的兒子，自從厄倫德死後更是如此。索拉德……他在與帝國人戰鬥的時候失蹤了。

original: Oh, I always knew my Thorald was alive. Ain't a man in Skyrim who can keep a Gray-Mane down.
string: 哦，我一直知道我的索拉德還活著。在天際沒有誰能夠打倒一個灰鬃家的成員。

original: Everyone thinks Thorald is dead. But not me. I know my boy is alive out there. Somewhere...
string: 所有人都認為索拉德死了。除了我。我知道我的兒子還活著。在某個地方……

original: When the Stormcloaks took control of Whiterun, it was a victory for all true Nords.
string: 風暴斗篷佔領白漫城是所有真正諾德人的勝利。

original: I take my duties as Housecarl very seriously. I won't hesitate to shed blood if my uncle Vignar is threatened.
string: 我非常注重我身為侍衛的職責，如果我叔叔溫加爾受到了威脅我絕對會拼命。

original: It's not easy being a woman in Skyrim, I know. But stay strong, and men will come to respect you, and maybe even fear you.
string: 當一個天際省的女人可不容易，我知道。但是只要保持強壯，男人們就會尊敬你，甚至害怕你。

original: What's the matter? You can't stand the sight of a strong Nord woman?
string: 怎麼了？你受不了看到一個強壯的諾德女人嗎？

original: I miss the days when the Gray-Manes and Battle-Borns got along. Ever since the war started, we've been at each others' throats.
string: 我很懷念灰鬃家族和戰狂氏族和平相處的日子。自從戰爭爆發以後，我們就針鋒相對了。

original: There's nothing a man can do that I can't do better, whether it's serving drinks or slaying trolls.
string: 男人能做的事我都能做的更好，不論是端茶倒酒還是放血割喉。

original: The daughters of this land are just as strong and loyal as its men.
string: 這片土地的女兒們和它的男人們一樣堅強與忠誠。

original: You wouldn't know it now, but the Gray-Manes and Battle-Borns were once fast friends.
string: 你現在當然不會知道，但是灰鬃氏族和戰狂氏族曾是經常往來的朋友。

original: I enjoy this work well enough, but I'm ready to retire. I've been thinking of selling the inn to Ysolda. Anyway, what do you need?
string: 我很喜歡這個工作，但是我準備好退休了。我一直在考慮把酒館賣給伊索爾達。算了，你需要什麼？

original: What can I get you?
string: 你想要點什麼？

original: Hungry, tired, or just plain thirsty?
string: 餓了，累了，還是只是有些渴？

original: I'm just out and about, love. The Bannered Mare can do without me for a bit, I suspect.
string: 我要出去走走了，親愛的。敕旗母馬客棧沒有我也很好。應該吧。

original: I don't get much time time off from the tavern, but I enjoy it when I do.
string: 在酒館工作我沒有多少休假時間，但是當我有的時候我很開心。

original: I'll get back to the Bannered Mare soon enough. Just need to stretch my legs a bit...
string: 我會很快回敕旗母馬客棧。我只是想出去透透氣……

original: If it's work you're looking for, Hulda's the one to talk to.
string: 你如果在找工作的話，去找胡爾達談談吧。

original: If you need more food or drink, speak to Hulda.
string: 你如果需要更多吃喝的話，去找胡爾達吧。

original: Mind your manners and pay your bills, and you'll always be welcome.
string: 注意舉止，按時付帳，你就會一直受到歡迎。

original: There was a great battle here in Whiterun. It was quite thrilling! I must compose a song about it someday.
string: 在白漫城發生了一場大戰。挺激動人心的！我有一天要寫一首關於它的歌。

original: If it's a lady you're looking for, you'd best look elsewhere. Once Mikael gets them, they're got.
string: 如果你在找女人的話，你最好去別的地方。一旦被我米凱爾看上了，她就是我的人了。

original: I'm a bard by trade. Perhaps you've heard of me?
string: 我是個吟遊詩人。或許你聽說過我？

original: I don't have much of a reputation in Skyrim yet, but I'm working on that, one sweet lady at a time. Haha!
string: 我在天際省還沒多大名聲，但是我正在為此而努力，一次一個漂亮女人。哈哈！

original: No doubt they still tell tales of Mikael and his sweet songs across Cyrodiil, where last I traveled.
string: 毫無疑問地，在我之前去過的地方，人們還在談論著米凱爾和他在整個賽瑞迪爾省傳唱的美妙歌曲。

original: I enjoy steady patronage in the Bannered Mare. I do hope you'll watch me perform.
string: 我會待在敕旗母馬客棧長期演出。希望你能看我表演。

original: Want to hear a little Nord wisdom? You don't really know a woman 'til you've had a strong drink and a fistfight with her.
string: 想聽聽諾德名言嗎？當你酩酊大醉並與一個女人打得不可開交的時候，你才會真正瞭解她。

original: Keep walkin', softgut. I'm more woman than you can handle.
string: 走去別的地方吧，膽小鬼。我這樣的女人你可消受不了。

original: I got no quarrel with you, but I won't turn one down, neither.
string: 我不責難你，我也不會拒絕別人。

original: Welcome to Warmaiden's. Now you, my girl, have definitely come to the right place.
string: 歡迎來到女豪傑的店。現在，妳、我的女孩，絕對來對了地方。

original: Welcome to Warmaiden's. Now don't let the name worry you - we got plenty o' steel for fightin' men.
string: 歡迎來到女豪傑的店。別被名字搞迷糊了，我們這可有的是給男人打鬥用的傢伙。

original: We've got small weapons as well as big. Maces, daggers, that sort of thing.
string: 我們的兵器有大有小。錘頭，匕首，和其它類似的東西。

original: You look like maybe you need a new weapon. Something big, perhaps? An axe maybe? Or a greatsword?
string: 你看起來好像需要一把新兵器。可能想要個大傢伙？一柄戰斧？或一把巨劍？

original: Most of our weapons were crafted by Adrianne Avenicci. My woman's an artist, is what she is.
string: 店裡絕大多數的兵器都是由阿德理安．阿文尼奇鍛造的。這女人是個藝術家，名副其實。

original: Crush, clobber, slash or slice. We've got a weapon for any occasion.
string: 砸、敲、砍、切，我們有能應付任何場面的兵器。

original: Ah, hello my Nord friend. In the market for some hunting supplies?
string: 啊，你好啊，我的諾德朋友。在市場裡找打獵物資嗎？

original: Ah, hello my Argonian friend. In the market for some hunting supplies?
string: 啊，你好啊，我的亞龍人朋友。在市場裡找打獵物資嗎？

original: Ah, hello my Khajiit friend. In the market for some hunting supplies?
string: 啊，你好啊，我的虎人朋友。在市場裡找打獵物資嗎？

original: Ah, kinsman. How my heart soars to look upon a brother Bosmer. Please, how can I serve your hunting needs?
string: 啊，我的同胞。遇到一個木精靈兄弟讓我很開心。打獵遇到難處了？

original: Ah... How my heart soars to look upon a sister Bosmer. Please, how can I serve your hunting needs?
string: 啊，我的同胞。遇到一個木精靈姐妹讓我很開心。打獵遇到難處了？

original: Hello, friend. In the market for some hunting supplies?
string: 你好，朋友，在市場裡找打獵物資嗎？

original: Hagraven or horker, it matters not. We've got the arrows to fell any game.
string: 烏鴉鬼婆或者是海象，都不成問題。我們的箭將會終結一切敵人。

original: So what can I get you?
string: 那麼我能賣你點什麼？

original: Whiterun once again belongs to its rightful heirs. It's a glorious day for Skyrim.
string: 白漫城再一次歸於它合法的繼承人了。真是天際省輝煌的一天。

original: We Gray-Manes have been feuding with the Battle-Borns for years. There's no more bitter enemy than an old friend.
string: 我們灰鬃家族與戰狂氏族在許多年前就成為世仇。當老朋友變成敵人時最是難纏。

original: When the Empire surrendered to the Aldmeri Dominion, they shamed us all!
string: 當帝國向先祖神洲投降的時候，他們讓我們所有人一起蒙羞！

original: The people saw fit to name me Jarl, and I don't intend to let them down.
string: 人民覺得我做領主很合適，我也不會讓他們失望。

original: You're lookin' at a real warrior! At least I used to be.
string: 你正在看著一位真正的戰士！至少我曾經是。

original: Look at you! Betcha think you're something, huh?
string: 看看你的樣子！你一定認為自己是某號人物，對吧？

original: For thirty years, I served the Legion as a commander. Fought in the Great War.
string: 三十年來，我以指揮官的身份在軍團中服役。參加過浩大戰爭。

original: Vignar and I have our hands full. It's no small task, running an entire hold.
string: 維吉納和我一直很忙。管理一整片領地可不是小事。

original: When I became Steward, I had to give up the bottle. The people of the hold need me at my best.
string: 當我成為總管時，我戒酒了。領地的人民需要我保持在最好狀態。

original: I'd be dead if not for Vignar. He took me in and helped me turn my life around.
string: 如果不是維吉納，我早就死了。他收留我，並幫助我改變了我的生活。

original: I had a bad time a few years back, an' I turned to drink. But Vignar, he wouldn't let me stay weak.
string: 幾年前我過得很不好，於是我借酒消愁。但是維吉納，他不讓我消沉下去。

original: Oh, I'm just a servant, dear. You want to talk to one of the Companions, I'm sure.
string: 哦，我只是一個僕人，親愛的。我想你得去找一位戰友談。

original: I've been tending to the warriors of Jorrvaskr for as long as I can remember.
string: 打從我懂事以來，我就一直伺候勇士之家的戰士們。

original: I see everything, hear everything and know everything.
string: 我看到了所有的一切，聽到了所有的一切，並且也知道所有的一切。

original: Oh, I'm a good keeper of secrets. Have to be, in this hall.
string: 哦，我是個守口如瓶的人。在這個大廳裡，我必須這麼做。

original: I hope the Empire is sending reinforcements to drive these heathens out of Whiterun.
string: 我希望帝國正在派援兵來將這些野蠻人趕出白漫城。

original: Olfrid, patron of the great Clan Battle-Born, a name I'm sure you know well.
string: 奧弗瑞德，偉大的戰狂氏族的族長，我相信你一定很熟悉這個名字。

original: I'm as much a Nord as the next man, but I'm no fool. I don't live in the past, like those Gray-Manes.
string: 我和其他人一樣也是個諾德人，但我不傻。我可不像那些灰鬃家族人一樣生活在昔日的陰影中。

original: Eorlund Gray-Mane's a stubborn fool. Our friendship ended when he turned his back on the Emperor.
string: 厄倫德．灰鬃是個頑固的蠢貨。我們的友誼在他背叛帝國時就結束了。

original: Eorlund Gray-Mane was a stubborn fool. Our friendship ended when he turned his back on the Emperor. Now he's dead.
string: 厄倫德．灰鬃是個頑固的蠢貨。我們的友誼在他背叛帝國時就結束了。現在他死了。

original: Clan Battle-Born's got a proud lineage in Whiterun, but unlike the Gray-Manes, we've also got wealth.
string: 戰狂氏族在白漫有著驕傲的血統，但跟灰鬃家族不同的地方在於，我們有錢。

original: My bloodin' days might be over, but my son Idolaf is out there fightin' for Skyrim! Fightin' for the Empire! Ha!
string: 我的戰鬥生涯可能已經結束了，但是我的兒子伊多拉夫正在外面為了天際而戰鬥！為了帝國而戰鬥！哈！

original: It's a miracle these Stormcloaks haven't robbed us blind yet. I'm sure it's only a matter of time.
string: 這些風暴斗篷們還沒把我們搶個精光真是個奇蹟。不過我確定這只是遲早的事情。

original: There's a rift here in Skyrim, and can't neither magic nor the passin' of time make it right.
string: 在天際省存在著一個「裂痕」，它無法被魔法或者時間的流逝所填平。

original: Evgir Unslaad has come at last. The "Season Unending." War... without end.
string: 艾弗吉．安斯拉德終於來了。那被稱為「不終之季」的戰爭......永無止境。

original: Can you believe those pathetic Gray-Manes still show their face in public?
string: 你能相信灰鬃氏族那些可悲的人們還敢公開露面嗎？

original: There was love between our families. For generations. Now, there is only enmity.
string: 在我們的家人之間曾經有愛。持續了好幾代。現在，卻只剩下敵意。

original: Has the Empire forsaken us? How could Whiterun fall into the hands of these stinking half-wit Nords?
string: 帝國遺忘我們了嗎？白漫城怎麼能落入這些又臭又笨的諾德人手中？

original: Damn those Gray-Manes to Oblivion. They want to back the Stormcloaks, they'll get what's comin' to 'em.
string: 詛咒那些灰鬃人都下湮滅去。他們想要支持風暴斗篷，他們會得到應有的下場。

original: Avulstein Gray-Mane and I were best friends as children. If I see that traitor again, I'll throw him in jail myself!
string: 阿武斯特恩．灰鬃和我曾是兒時的朋友。如果我再看到那個叛徒，我會親手將他送進監獄！

original: The cold, frightening truth is that the Empire represents progress. Anyone who fears progress is a coward.
string: 冰冷駭人的事實是帝國代表著發展。那些畏懼發展的人就是膽小鬼。

original: The Stormcloaks are content to live in the past forever. No wonder the Provincials think we're all baseless savages.
string: 風暴斗篷總執著於過去。難怪其他省分的人都覺得我們是居無定所的野蠻人。

original: Well met, kinsman.
string: 你好，族人。

original: Well met, traveler.
string: 你好，旅行者。

original: You know what's wrong with Skyrim these days? Everyone is obsessed with death.
string: 你知道天際省最近有什麼不對勁嗎？所有人都被死亡的陰影所籠罩著。

original: People have forgotten humor, poetry and romance. I love a good sword fight as much as the next man, but there's more to life.
string: 人們忘記了幽默，詩歌和浪漫。我和其他男人一樣喜歡持劍廝殺，但是生命當中還有其他更美好的事。

original: It's my desire to enter the Bards College. My parents are hesitant, but I pray they let me attend.
string: 加入吟遊詩人學院是我的願望。我父母還在猶豫，但是我祈禱他們讓我參加。

original: All I want it is to escape from this madness. And if Olfina can come with me, all the better. But I've probably said too much.
string: 我只想逃離這一切。如果奧菲娜能和我一起來，就更好了。但是我可能說得太多了。

original: It's no fun getting pushed around all the time...
string: 大家老是欺負我。這可一點也不有趣…

original: I don't know what you did, but Braith won't even look at me now! So thanks!
string: 我不知道你做了什麼，但是布賴絲現在甚至都不敢看我了！謝謝你！

original: My friend Olava? The seer? She says things will get better for me, once I start sticking up for myself.
string: 我的朋友奧拉瓦？那個先知？她說只要我能改變態度，事情會好轉的。

original: I can't fight. Not even a little bit. My family thinks I'm a little milk drinker.
string: 我不會打架。一點也不會。家裡人都說我還沒斷奶呢。

original: By Sithis, but you are a persistent one. Haven't I told you enough?
string: 看在夜母的份上，你可是個執著的人啊。我跟你說過很多次了啊。

original: Maybe some other time I'll reveal your destiny, hmm? Tea leaves, palm reading, crystal scrying... Oooh! Maybe trepanning? Ha ha ha ha.
string: 也許有一天我會揭示你的命運，嗯？茶葉算命，看手相，水晶球占卜什麼的......哦！或者開天眼？哈哈哈哈。

original: Come to Olava for a reading, did you? Sorry, pup, but I'm not quite in the mood.
string: 來找奧拉瓦算命，是嗎？抱歉，年輕人，我現在沒那個心情。

original: Oh, I tell the future, all right. When I feel up to the task, that is. But I'm afraid my energies haven't quite peaked yet today.
string: 哦，好吧，我可以預見未來。但那是當我狀況好的時候。今天恐怕我的能量不夠。

original: Ripe fruit and fresh vegetables for sale! Straight from the fields and orchards of Whiterun to your table!
string: 賣熟透的水果和新鮮的蔬菜！剛從田裡和白漫城的果園摘來的，直接送上你的餐桌！

original: Fresh-baked loaves, still warm from the oven!
string: 剛出爐的麵包，還熱騰騰的呢！

original: I've got a hungry daughter to feed, so selling my produce is really the only thing I care about.
string: 我有個女兒要養，所以我滿腦子只想著做生意的事情。

original: I hope you're looking at me like that because you want to buy something?
string: 我希望你那樣看著我是因為你想買點什麼？

original: I work with my mother, to sell fruits and vegetables. It's fun most days, but hard work.
string: 我和我媽一起工作，賣水果和蔬菜。大部分時間都還蠻有趣的，但工作還是很累。

original: Did you know there are some fruits that actually grow better in the cold weather?
string: 你知道有些水果在寒冷的氣候條件下長得更好嗎？

original: You'd be surprised how much work it is selling things at a stall. It's not all standing around and chatting.
string: 你一定會對在攤上賣東西竟然有這麼多工作要做感到驚訝。可不是光站著閒聊就好呢。

original: Praise Talos and all the Divines! Whiterun has been liberated by the true sons of Skyrim!
string: 讚美塔洛斯和所有的聖靈！白漫被天際省的真正子民解放了！

original: You have come! You have come to hear the word of Talos!
string: 你來了！你來聆聽塔洛斯的真言了！

original: The Imperials silence us because they fear us! They are cowards! Cowards and fools who have forgotten the truth!
string: 帝國軍不讓我們說話因為他們害怕我們！他們是膽小鬼！忘記了真理的膽小鬼和蠢貨！

original: There are those who would silence the Dragon's truth! But not I! Not Heimskr! His word will be known!
string: 肯定很多人會對巨龍的真相保持沉默！但不會是我！不會是海姆斯科！他說的話，會讓人知道的！

original: The truth, child of Talos, is that the Dragon's children have come! To purge the world in fire and righteousness!
string: 塔洛斯的孩子，真相是巨龍的子裔來了！用烈焰與正義來淨化這個世界！

original: He has returned... Oh, how Talos has returned. Helgen has been purged in his light. Will Whiterun be next?
string: 他回來了...哦，塔洛斯回來了。聖地鎮在他的光輝中被淨化了。白漫會是下一個嗎？

original: Once I've made enough money trading with the Khajiit caravans, I'm going to buy the Bannered Mare from Hulda.
string: 我與虎人商隊做生意賺夠錢後，我要立刻把敕旗母馬客棧從胡爾達手上買來。

original: I spend a lot of time at the market stalls so I can learn the merchant's trade.  I need more experience if I'm going to run an inn someday.
string: 我在市場花了很多時間才學到了經商之道。如果哪天要打理客棧的話，我需要更多的經驗。

original: They say there's nothing a Nord woman can't do if she puts her mind to it.
string: 人們說如果一個諾德女人真心去做的話，沒有什麼事她做不成。

original: We Nords are strong, and we're as tough as stone. But I'll bet you didn't know there's some of us with a good head for business, too.
string: 我們諾德人很強壯，而且我們堅如磐石。但是我打賭你一定不知道我們當中也有一些人很有經商頭腦。

original: There's some company I certainly prefer over others. Have you met Mikael? The most amazing bard I've ever heard.
string: 我很喜歡跟某些人做同伴，相較於一般人。你見過米凱爾？他是我所聽說過的最不可思議的吟遊詩人。

original: I just want to go home and read.
string: 我只想回家然後看書。

original: Excuse me, but I'm trying to read.
string: 對不起，我正在看書。

original: Nothing like a good adventure or romance to lose yourself in.
string: 陷入一段傳奇的冒險或者浪漫的愛情故事感覺真是太好了。

original: I import books  whenever I can. Most Nord works are too bawdy and violent for my tastes.
string: 只要我可以的時候我就進口一些書籍。大多數諾德人的作品對我來說都太下流太暴力了。

original: My daughter Braith says I read too much. "Play with me, mother!" Girls need to learn how to take care of themselves.
string: 我女兒布賴絲說我讀書讀太多了。「陪我玩，媽媽！」女孩要學會如何照顧自己。

original: Really, I wish my girl would read more. It would certainly keep her out of all those fights.
string: 說真的，我希望我女兒能多讀一些書。那肯定會使她遠離那些戰鬥。

original: If you'll excuse me, I really just want to get home.
string: 如果你不介意的話，我真的只是想要回家。

original: You tried mercenary work? It might suit you.
string: 你試過當一名傭兵嗎？那可能挺適合你的。

original: Sometimes I miss the soldier's life, but when I hold my daughter in my arms, I know I made the right choice.
string: 有時候我會懷念軍旅生涯，但一看我懷中的女兒，就知道我的決定是正確的。

original: My wife's a good woman. She can be a little hard-headed sometimes, but I love her just the same.
string: 我妻子是個好女人。她有時候會點頑固，但是我還是一樣愛她。

original: My wife was a good woman. She could be a little hard-headed sometimes, but I loved her just the same. Gods I miss her.
string: 我妻子是個好女人。她有時候會點頑固，但是我還是一樣愛她。天啊，我好想念她。

original: What're you lookin' at? I'm not afraid of you, ya know. Even if you are my elder.
string: 你在看什麼？我不怕你，你知道的。就算你是我的長輩也一樣。

original: Boys, girls, dogs, elders - there's nobody I won't fight!
string: 男孩、女孩、狗狗、長輩——沒什麼我不敢打的！

original: I don't fight Lars no more, if that's what you're worried about.
string: 我不和拉斯打架了，如果那是你擔心的事的話。

original: Stupid Lars Battle-Born. I fight him almost every day, but it's not much of a fight, 'cause he don't fight back.
string: 笨蛋拉斯．戰狂。我和他幾乎每天都打架，但其實也不算真正的打架，因為他不還手。

original: I spend so much time among the dead, I sometimes forget how much I miss the company of the living.
string: 我和死人們度過了太長的時間，有時候我會忘記我有多麼懷念有活人陪伴的滋味。

original: With this terrible war, I'm a bit overwhelmed. As are the catacombs.
string: 這場糟糕的戰爭，。我快受不了了。墓穴也容納不了那麼多死人。

original: As Whiterun's priest of Arkay, I spread his word whenever I'm able. In the meantime, most of my hours are spent with the city's dearly departed.
string: 作為白漫城的阿爾凱祭司，只要我可以的話我就會傳播他的真言。平時，我大部分的時間都陪伴著這城市的死者。

original: I ain't done nothin'.
string: 我什麼也沒做。

original: What? Why you lookin' at me?
string: 什麼？你為什麼看著我？

original: That Heimskr's crazy. Him and his talk o' Talos. Wish he'd just shut up.
string: 那個海姆斯科瘋了。他本人還有他關於塔洛斯的言論。真希望他能閉嘴。

original: You're in my home. That's right. This here place, Breezehome, it belongs to old Terek.
string: 你在我家裡。對。就是這個地方，微風閣，它屬於老特理克。

original: Oho! And what do you want, hmm?
string: 哦！你想要什麼，嗯？

original: You can't kick me out of here. You want me gone, you're gonna have to kill me.
string: 你不能把我踢出去。你想要我閃人，那你得要先殺了我。

original: Now I don't care about no deeds, or laws, or other nonsense like that. This house was empty, so I settled in. And now it's mine.
string: 說實在，我不關心什麼房契，或者法律，或者其他那些胡扯蛋。這房子是空的，所以我就住下來了。現在它是我的。

original: I'm a generous man, to those who treat me right. Might be I'll even let you live here with me, if you mind your manners.
string: 誰對我好，我就對誰慷慨。甚至和我住在一起都沒問題，前提是要有教養。

original: Hello, child of Kynareth.
string: 你好，凱娜瑞絲的孩子。

original: Lately it seems I am more nurse than priestess, tending to those who have suffered, both in mind and body, from this terrible war.
string: 最近我變得更像個護士而不是一個女祭司了，一直在幫助那些被戰爭傷害了肉體和精神的人們。

original: These are trying times for us all, I know. Many come to the Temple of Kynareth to pray, and I assist them as best I'm able.
string: 這對我們來說都是一段困難的時期，我知道。很多人來到凱娜瑞絲神殿祈禱，而我盡我最大的可能幫助他們。

original: Come to chat with an old woman, hmm? Do your good deed for the day?
string: 來和一個老女人談話，嗯？為你自己積德呢？

original: Looking for a horse? I own these stables, but Skulvar can help you with a purchase.
string: 在找馬嗎？這間馬廄是我的，但是你要買馬的話去找斯庫瓦。

original: Do you like horses? You  should visit the stables. I own them, you see. And our stock is excellent.
string: 你喜歡馬嗎？你應該去馬廄看看。那都是我的，你知道嗎。我們的馬棒極了。

original: My friend Maven and I - have you met Maven, in Riften? - we know our place in this world. Know the place of others, too.
string: 我的朋友瑪雯和我——你在裂谷城的時候見過瑪雯嗎？我們知道自己算老幾，也知道別人算老幾。

original: Do you get to the Cloud District very often? Oh, what am I saying - of course you don't.
string: 你常去雲頂區嗎？哦，我在說什麼呀——你當然不常去了。

original: Oh, it took years, but I earned my way to the top. I own Chillfurrow Farm, you see. Very successful business. Obviously.
string: 哦，花了我好些年，但我終於掙出了自己的出路。我擁有寒犁農場，正如你所見。生意不錯。

original: I actually advise the Jarl on political matters. My input is invaluable, of course. But this is all probably a bit over your head.
string: 我其實是領主的政治顧問。當然，我的建議很寶貴。但我想和你說了也不會懂。

original: There's a nip in the air. Cold won't be good for my crops. Never is.
string: 空氣中有些寒意。寒冷對我的莊稼可沒好處。從來沒有。

original: I own the Pelagia Farm, just outside the city walls. Nimriel takes good care of things for me.
string: 我擁有佩拉吉奧斯農場，就在城牆外面。尼姆瑞爾替我打理它。

original: I had my years of war and fighting. Senseless, all of it. All I want now is a rake and a patch of good soil.
string: 我也曾征戰沙場。但那些屁也不是。我現在只想要一把耙子和一塊肥沃的地。

original: Come to Dragonsreach to discuss the ongoing hostilities, like the rest of the "great warriors"?
string: 特地跑來龍臨堡討論軍情？就像其他那些「偉大的戰士」一樣？

original: It seems this damnable conflict has claimed everyone's passions of late. Me, I prefer my books, and my spells.
string: 看來這該死的衝突引發了所有人的熱情。至於我嘛，還是喜歡我的書，和我的法術。

original: There's a tranquility in magic, don't you think? It is simply energy, to be harnessed by those with the will and knowledge to do so.
string: 魔法中自有平靜，你不這麼認為嗎？它只是能量，由有意志力與知識的人引導著它。

original: Got some good pieces out here, if you're looking to buy. More inside.
string: 外面有批不錯的貨。如果你想買的話。店裡還有更多。

original: I don't claim to be the best blacksmith in Whiterun. Eorlund Gray-Mane's got that honor. Man's steel is legendary. All I ask is a fair chance.
string: 我不敢自稱白漫最棒的鐵匠。厄倫德．灰鬃才夠格享有那份榮耀。他鑄造的武器只能用傳奇來形容。我只求能公平競爭罷了。

original: I don't claim to be the best blacksmith in Whiterun. Eorlund Gray-Mane was that and more, but now he's dead. All I ask is a fair chance.
string: 我不自稱是白漫最棒的鐵匠。厄倫德．灰鬃才有那份榮耀。但是現在他死了。我要的只是一次公平的機會。

original: Have you met my father? He's the steward, up at Dragonsreach.
string: 你見過我父親了嗎？他是總管，在龍臨堡。

original: Have you met my father? He was the steward, up at Dragonsreach when Balgruuf was Jarl.
string: 你見過我父親了嗎？他是總管，當巴爾古夫還是領主的時候，他在龍臨堡工作。

original: I help my father in more ways than people realize.
string: 我在許多方面提供我父親協助，涵蓋層面遠比人們所知的要廣泛得多。

original: You think all the council my father provides the Jarl is his alone? Hmph. Let's just say I advise the advisor, and leave it at that.
string: 你認為我爸爸為領主提供的意見全是他的主意？哈，讓我們這麼說吧：是我給這位顧問提供建議，剩下的由他去辦。

original: Be warned, the Jarl is in a foul mood since the Stormcloaks overran Whiterun.
string: 當心，自從風暴斗篷開始橫行白漫之後，領主的心情就一直很糟。

original: I serve Jarl Baalgruuf as steward.
string: 我是服侍巴爾古夫領主的總管。

original: The Jarl is, as you can imagine, very busy. Perhaps I can assist you?
string: 如你所能想像的，領主非常的忙。或許我能幫你？

original: The task of Steward is more important than you realize. The Jarl often asks for my invaluable council.
string: 總管的工作比你認為的更加重要。領主經常問我提出一些寶貴的建議。

original: I'm kept so busy, I don't get to see my daughter as often as I'd like. Perhaps you've met her? Adrianne? She owns the shop, Warmaiden's.
string: 我一直非常忙，沒辦法經常去看我女兒。或許你見過她？阿德理安？她經營那間叫做女豪傑的店。

original: After Whiterun is retaken, Ulfric will pay in blood for his insolence.
string: 等到白漫城被解放，烏弗瑞克將為他的傲慢付出代價。

original: You should be talking to my Steward.
string: 你去和我的總管說。

original: I'm the Jarl, not a barkeep. Speak your business.
string: 我是領主，不是個吧台服務生，有什麼事快說。

original: Quickly now, or would you prefer I let Whiterun fall to the Stormcloaks?
string: 快說，還是你希望我讓白漫城落到風暴斗篷手裡？

original: You might be a guest in Dragonsreach, but you're starting to try my patience.
string: 你雖然是龍臨堡的客人，但是你開始讓我感到不耐煩了。

original: What is it that you need?
string: 你想要什麼？

original: You have my attention.
string: 我在聽。

original: Speak your mind.
string: 說出你的想法。

original: It pleases me to see you again.
string: 很高興能再見到你。

original: All this standing around is rubbish. We should be taking the fight to the Stormcloaks.
string: 我周圍站著的都是懦夫。我們應該向風暴斗篷開戰！

original: I'm not a man, I'm a weapon in human form. Just unsheathe me, and point me at the enemy.
string: 我不是血肉之軀，而是鋼鐵之刃。讓我出鞘迎敵吧。

original: My brother takes council from Proventus Avenicci? What a laugh. He takes council from his daughter, and she's a bloody blacksmith.
string: 我的兄長向普羅萬圖斯．阿文尼奇徵詢意見？真好笑。他竟向自己的女兒尋求建議，她只是個該死的鐵匠。

original: I'm the commander of the guard here in Whiterun.
string: 我是白漫的衛兵司令。

original: My boys'll keep you safe. Don't you worry.
string: 我手下的小夥子們會保護你的安全。放心吧。

original: You're not thinking of causing trouble here in this beautiful city, now are you? 'Cause I'd strongly advise against such foolishness.
string: 你不會想在這座美麗的城市裡惹事吧？我勸你快打消這個愚蠢的念頭。

original: I'll always be a commander, even if those Stormcloak dogs have stripped away my power.
string: 即使那群風暴斗篷畜生剝奪了我的權力，我也永遠是一名指揮官。

original: The Legion will regain control of this city. Mark my words.
string: 給我聽好了。軍團會重新奪取這座城市。

original: Yes? What is it?
string: 是？怎麼回事？

original: I'm commander of the guard, now.
string: 現在我是衛兵司令了。

original: The Stormcloaks can keep this city safe better than those Legion lapdogs.
string: 比起那些軍團的馬屁精，風暴斗篷們能更好地守護這座城市。

original: The security in Whiterun is terrible. Shameful, is what it is.
string: 白漫的治安太糟糕了。這真令人羞愧。

original: The guards in this city are all lazy and undisciplined. Things need to change...
string: 城中的衛兵都十分懶散。這情況必須改變……

original: Commander Cauis walks around Dragonsreach like a preening rooster. I could do his job blindfolded....
string: 考伊斯指揮官巡視龍臨堡時就像只驕傲的公雞。他的工作我閉著眼都能做。

original: You are a welcome guest, but you must still respect the rules of the Jarl's household.
string: 歡迎你來此做客，但你依然得遵守領主府中的規矩

original: We can never rest easy, for Balgruuf's enemies will not.
string: 我們永遠也睡不安穩，巴爾古夫的敵人一直在虎視耽耽。

original: Please keep your weapons sheathed in the Jarl's presence.
string: 在領主面前請將刀劍入鞘。

original: It seems our enemies have no end of spies, saboteurs and assassins to send against us.
string: 似乎我們的敵人一直在派遣間諜，內奸還有刺客來對付我們。

original: Think very carefully about your next move...
string: 下步棋你可得仔細想想。

original: Exile or no, my duty to Balgruuf remains. Keep that in mind when you approach him, for I will be watching.
string: 無論是否被放逐，我永遠效忠於巴爾古夫。當你與他會面時，把這番話銘記在心，我會盯著你的。

original: Keep your distance...
string: 給我保持距離……

original: Got the fleetest steeds in all o' Skyrim.
string: 這裡有全天際省最快的千里馬。

original: Make a move toward Balgruuf, and you're dead.
string: 膽敢靠近巴爾古夫一步，你就會成為一具死屍。

original: Gal like you needs a warhorse, I reckon.
string: 我想像你這樣的姑娘需要一匹戰馬。

original: Man like you needs a warhorse, I reckon.
string: 我想像你這樣的漢子需要一匹戰馬。

original: Only thing better than ridin' a swift horse is ridin' a swift horse over the enemy.
string: 沒有什麼比騎一匹快馬更棒了，而身跨快馬踏破敵軍更是件樂事。

original: Lookin' to shatter records or bones? My beasts can do both.
string: 想要破紀錄還是殺敵？我的馬兒們二者都擅長。

original: Need a horse? Talk to my father, Skulvar.
string: 需要匹馬？去跟我父親談，斯庫爾瓦。

original: Old lady Maiden-Loom owns the stables. But my father and me, we run things.
string: 年長的麥登-魯姆女士是這座馬廄的主人。但我父親和我負責打理一切。

original: So I mostly sweep and shovel. You got a problem with that?
string: 我多半做些清掃工作。你有意見？

original: Father says I ain't smart enough to be stablemaster. Some day.
string: 我父親說我不夠聰明，將來無法成為馬廄的主人。

original: My father never thought I was smart enough to be a stablemaster. I just wish he was around to see me now.
string: 我父親一向覺得我不夠聰明，無法當一名馬廄主人。我只希望他現在能來看我。

original: Come to gawk at the dark elf?
string: 來圍觀那暗精靈的？

original: Well look at us. Like two gray specks in the snow.
string: 看看我們，像雪地裡的兩個灰斑點。

original: I mean no offense. I am but a humble farmer, not a great wanderer, like you.
string: 我無意冒犯。我只是一名卑微的農夫，不是你那樣偉大的旅行者。

original: Ah, hello my good friend. Would you do me a kindness? I seem to be down to my last drop of spirits. Let me tell you, sobriety is highly overrated.
string: 你好啊老友。你能幫我個忙嗎？我的酒快喝完了。要我說，戒酒這種事根本沒有一般人想得那麼高尚。

original: Careful if you cross the river to the east. Old Hajvarr Iron-Hand and his brigands are holed up in that cave, White River Watch.
string: 如果你準備向東渡河的話一定要小心，老哈瓦爾．鐵手和他手下的強盜就躲藏在白河監視哨的洞中。

original: The circle of stones to the southwest? That's Secunda's Kiss. The giants hold it sacred, so tread carefully.
string: 西南方的石柱群？那是賽庫達之吻。巨人們視其為聖地，小心行事。

original: You know, I saw something near Shimmermist Cave, to the northeast. Some kind of creature... small and wicked. Never seen its like before.
string: 你知道嗎，我在東北部的光霧洞穴見到了些東西。某種生物……體型不大但性情兇惡。從沒見過這樣的東西。

original: If you're heading east, steer clear of Hillgrund's Tomb. Thing about those old crypts - the dead having trouble staying that way.
string: 如果你向東行，避開潛山之墓。那裡有被困在古老地穴的亡靈棲息。

original: Looking to do some hunting? Avoid Brittleshin Pass. It's southeast of here.
string: 去打獵？別去東南面的布萊特辛山隘。

original: Yesterday, I saw a dragon fly right over the city. Headed northeast. Toward Shearpoint, by the looks of it.
string: 昨天我見到一條龍從城市上空飛過。看起來是飛向東北方的剪角高點。

original: Be glad you're here in the city, and not out in Riverwood. Those poor sods don't even have a wall.
string: 你該感到慶幸你身在城中，而非城外的河木鎮。那片破草地連堵圍牆都沒有。

original: You should talk to the Jarl up in Dragonsreach, lend any aid you can.
string: 你應該和龍臨堡的領主談談。盡可能尋求援助。

original: Fear not. Come dragon or giant, we'll be ready.
string: 不用畏懼。無論來者是惡龍還是巨人，我們時時刻刻準備迎敵。

original: Need a blade? You should talk to Adrianne, at the forge.
string: 需要一把利刃？你該去跟熔爐旁的阿德理安談談。

original: Need supplies? See Belethor at his store. Sleazy little man, but he has good stock.
string: 需要買點補給？去貝萊托爾的雜貨鋪看看吧。那傢伙雖然邋遢，存貨倒是不少。

original: If you need potions, you should try Arcadia's Cauldron.
string: 如果你需要藥水，去阿爾凱迪雅之釜看看吧

original: Stormcloaks, Imperials, dragons. Ain't no matter to me what I kill. Let them come.
string: 風暴斗篷，帝國人，巨龍。要我殺哪個都不是問題。通通放馬過來吧。

original: I worry about the other settlements in the hold. Unwalled, lightly manned - prime targets for those damned dragons.
string: 我擔心領地內的其他聚落。沒有城牆，缺乏人手——是那些龍最好的目標。

original: Rorikstead's a nice enough little hamlet, but a boring posting for a guard. If a dragon attacks, well... then it'll be a different story.
string: 洛利克鎮是個不錯的小村莊，但在那裡當衛兵很無聊。如果飛龍進攻，那麼……就另當別論了。

original: You look tired, friend. The Bannered Mare has beds for rent.
string: 朋友，如果你覺得很累，在敕旗母馬客棧有床位出租。

original: Cause trouble in Whiterun, and I'll haul you into the Dragonsreach dungeon myself.
string: 敢在白漫惹事。我就親自把你拖進龍臨堡的地牢。

original: Where did he go?
string: 他去哪兒了？

original: Somewhere up north, in the ice fields.
string: 北上去冰原了。

original: Said he found some old Dwemer artifact, but... well, that was years ago.
string: 聽說他找到了些古代鍛莫的遺物，但……這是好幾年前的事了。

original: Haven't heard from him since.
string: 從那以後就再沒他的消息了。

original: He's dead?
string: 他死了嗎？

original: Oh no. I hope not. But even I haven't seen him in years, and we were close.
string: 噢不。我希望沒有。但我和他關係那麼好，也好幾年沒見過他了。

original: Became obsessed with the Dwemer. Took off north saying he had found some old artifact. Haven't seen him since.
string: 他對鍛莫文化越來越著迷。他說發現了些古代遺物後就匆匆動身去了北方。從那以後就沒見過他。

original: Somewhere in the ice fields, if you want to try to find him.
string: 冰原上的某處吧，如果你想找他的話。

original: Here you go. Try not to spill anything on them.
string: 拿去吧。希望你別弄髒。

original: What else can you tell me about these pirates?
string: 關於這些海盜你還有什麼能告訴我的嗎？

original: They call themselves the "Blood Horkers."
string: 他們稱自己為「血腥長牙」。

original: They've been around as long as I can remember, but only recently focused on our ships.
string: 就我對他們有印象起他們就在附近遊蕩了，但最近他們才盯上我們的船。

original: A dastardly group, but they're more than simple brigands. Shrewd. Clever. Not to be trifled with.
string: 一群卑鄙小人，但他們不是一般強盜。精明狡猾。不好惹。

original: MS14ShesMine
string: MS14ShesMine

original: If I do, will you tell me who set the fire?
string: 如果我陪妳玩，妳會告訴我是誰點的火嗎？

original: Okay! Let's play hide and seek. You find me and I'll tell you.
string: 好啊！我們玩捉迷藏吧。你找到我我就告訴你。

original: We have to wait for nighttime though. The other one is playing too, and she can't come out until then.
string: 但我們得等到夜幕降臨。還有一個人也要玩，她只有那時能出來。

original: That's cheating. We're playing hide and seek. You have to find me before Laelette does.
string: 你作弊。我們在玩捉迷藏。你得在拉萊特之前找到我。

original: Where did you say I can find you?
string: 妳說我能在哪裡找到妳阿？

original: Is Hroggar your father?
string: 赫魯加是你爸爸嗎？

original: You know him?
string: 你認識他？

original: He made my favorite dolly, but I can't find her.
string: 他替我做的洋娃娃我最喜歡了，但我找不到它了。

original: Are you sure you aren't a stranger?
string: 你確定你不是陌生人嗎？

original: Don't you remember? His name is Hroggar.
string: 你不記得了嗎？他的名字叫赫魯加。

original: No. I'm a friend. Do you know what happened to your house?
string: 不，我是站在你這邊的。你知道你家發生什麼事了嗎？

original: The smoke woke me up. It was hot and I was scared, so I hid.
string: 煙把我嗆醒了。當時很熱，我很害怕，所以我躲了起來。

original: Then it got cold and dark. I'm not scared anymore.
string: 接著變得很陰冷。我也不害怕了。

original: But I'm lonely. Will you play with me?
string: 但我很孤單。你能陪我玩嗎？

original: Like I said. It got hot and smoky. Now it's cold and quiet.
string: 就像我剛剛說的，當時很熱又很多煙。現在變得很陰冷且安靜。

original: I wish someone would find me.
string: 我希望有人能找到我。

original: What happened to you house?
string: 妳家怎麼了？

original: Who are you?
string: 妳是誰？

original: Helgi. But father says I'm not supposed to talk to strangers.
string: 海爾吉。但我爸爸說我不該跟陌生人講話。

original: Are you a stranger?
string: 你是個陌生人嗎？

original: I remember you. You're the stranger. Father says I'm not supposed to talk to strangers.
string: 我記得你。你是那個陌生人。爸爸說我不該跟陌生人講話。

original: Mother's calling me. It's time for me to sleep now. I'm so tired. Thank you for making her feel better.
string: 媽媽在叫我。我該睡覺了。我很累。謝謝你讓她感覺好些了。

original: Who's there? Is that you, father?
string: 誰在那裡？是你嗎，爸爸？

original: <humming>
string: <哼歌>

original: Have you found proof of Alva's treachery?
string: 你找到阿爾瓦叛變的證據了嗎？

original: Is Hroggar innocent or not?
string: 赫魯加是不是無辜的？

original: You better get proof of your accusations against Alva.
string: 你指控阿爾瓦最好要有證據。

original: Any word on that fire?
string: 關於那場火災有什麼話說嗎？

original: I hear the steward asked you to look into the fire.
string: 我聽說總管叫你去調查那場火災。

original: Have you found out anything about Alva?
string: 你查出什麼與阿爾瓦有關的嗎？

original: Have you seen Laelette? Have you seen my wife?
string: 你有看到拉萊特嗎？你有看到我妻子嗎？

original: She's dead. Laelette is dead.
string: 她死了。拉萊特已經死了。

original: I won't let you hurt Alva!
string: 我不會讓你傷害阿爾瓦的！

original: Now I'm going to have to kill you!
string: 我現在必須得殺了你！

original: I hear you put Laelette out of her misery.
string: 我聽說你減輕了拉萊特的痛苦。

original: So no one knows the Staff's location?
string: 這麼說沒人知道法杖在哪？

original: No one here does.
string: 這裡沒人知道。

original: The Synod seemed convinced it was somewhere in Skyrim. They inquired about the ruins of Mzulft, but that's all I remember.
string: 希諾會似乎確信它是在天際省的某地。他們詢問了一些關於樹皮遺址遺跡的事，我就記得這麼多了。

original: It sounded like they were heading there, though they were rather secretive about why.
string: 聽起來他們朝那裡去了，儘管他們對原因三緘其口。

original: I suppose if you're intent on looking for the staff, there's a chance they might be in Mzulft yet. Just don't expect them to be cooperative.
string: 如果你堅持要找法杖，我想他們有可能已經到樹皮遺址了。但別指望他們會跟你合作。

original: Who are the Synod?
string: 希諾會是什麼來歷？

original: Mages based out of Cyrodiil. They fancy themselves the Imperial Authority on magic these last few hundred years.
string: 出身於賽瑞迪爾的法師。他們把自己當成魔法世界的最高權力者。數百年來都是如此。

original: My understanding is that all they really do is make noise in an attempt to curry favor from the Emperor. Lots of politics, little magic.
string: 在我看來他們唯一做的事就是試圖拍皇帝的馬屁。都是些政治手段罷了，跟魔法沒什麼相關。

original: I was quite surprised to find them on our doorstep. They seemed amiable enough, but their line of questioning made me... uneasy.
string: 發現他們就在門前嚇了我一跳。他們看起來很和氣，但他們問問題的方式讓我感到……不自在。

original: It became clear they're trying to hoard powerful artifacts, looking to consolidate power.
string: 很清楚地，他們試圖收集具有強大力量的神器，以此來增強能力。

original: The Augur referred to it as the Eye of Magnus, not me.
string: 占卜師稱之為瑪格努斯之眼，不是我。

original: The Augur?
string: 占卜師？

original: Just what have you gotten yourself involved in?
string: 你惹上了什麼麻煩？

original: Whatever is going on, whatever you're up to... Be very careful.
string: 無論發生了什麼，不論你想做什麼……小心行事。

original: Sorry. So, the Staff of Magnus?
string: 抱歉。那麼，瑪格努斯之杖？

original: Well, it's said to be very powerful. Has the capacity to store an incredible amount of magical power, as the story goes.
string: 據說其非常強力。能貯存驚人的法力。

original: But it's more myth than anything at this point. I've no doubt that it actually exists, but no one has seen it in what, decades? Longer? I'm not sure.
string: 但現在看來這多半是虛構的。我相信它的存在，但數十年來沒人親眼見過，還是更久？我不確定。

original: The only time I've heard it mentioned was when those Synod characters showed up some months ago looking for it.
string: 只有在那幫希諾會成員現身尋找時，我才聽到他們提起它。

original: It may be connected to the Eye of Magnus.
string: 這或許跟瑪格努斯之眼有關。

original: The "Eye of Magnus"?
string: 「瑪格努斯之眼」？

original: I can appreciate that this... thing, this Orb... It's very impressive. Very unique, and definitely worth studying.
string: 我能看出這個……玩意，這個……球體的魅力。它令人印象深刻。十分獨特，極具研究價值。

original: But let's not jump to any conclusions, or assign it importance beyond what we're certain of.
string: 但我們不要急於下定論，也不要賦予其我們還不能肯定的價值。

original: Arch-Mage Aren said you'd mentioned it recently.
string: 首席法師阿冉說你最近提起過它。

original: I see. Well yes, I suppose I did mention it, though I'm not sure what he expects me to tell you.
string: 我明白了。好吧，我大概提過，雖然我不知道他想讓我告訴你些什麼？

original: I only brought it to his attention a few months back when the Synod showed up here looking for it.
string: 直到幾個月前希諾會成員現身搜索時，我才讓他注意到這件事。

original: They were apparently under the impression we were keeping it in a closet somewhere.
string: 顯然在他們的印象裡是認為我們把它放在了某間秘室之中。

original: Do you know anything about the Staff of Magnus?
string: 你知道什麼關於瑪格努斯之杖的消息嗎？

original: Well now that's an odd question. Why in the world would you be asking?
string: 這是個奇怪的問題。你為何這麼問？

original: You mean me, don't you?
string: 你在指我，是嗎？

original: I certainly do.
string: 當然。

original: Since you went so far as seek out the Augur for advice, I thought you'd be more enthusiastic.
string: 既然你為了得到占卜師的建議做了那麼多，我還以為你會更有熱情呢。

original: What should I do next?
string: 我接下來該怎麼做？

original: A most impressive attitude. Keep this up, and you'll do quite well for yourself.
string: 你的態度令人印象深刻。繼續保持，你會做得很好的。

original: You mean me, don't you.
string: 你在指我，是嗎？

original: Something as specific and ancient as the Staff of Magnus... I'm not sure we'd ever find something like that...
string: 像瑪格努斯之杖這麼古老特別的法杖……我不確定我們能否能找到這樣的東西。

original: I seem to recall Mirabelle mentioning the staff somewhat recently. Why don't you see if she can tell you anything?
string: 我記得米拉貝勒最近好像提過法杖什麼的。你何不去找她問問？或許她會告訴你些什麼。

original: I'm quite pleased with your progress, you know. You've certainly proven yourself to be more than a mere Apprentice. Well done.
string: 你要知道我對你的進步感到很欣慰。你已經證明自己不僅僅是一個學徒了。做得好。

original: This circlet once proved invaluable to me. I hope it can be of use to you now.
string: 這個頭環曾是我的無價之寶。希望現在它能對你有所幫助。

original: I spoke with the Augur of Dunlain.
string: 我跟占卜師杜蘭談過了

original: Did you really?
string: 真的嗎？

original: And he specifically mentioned the Staff of Magnus?
string: 他明確地提到過瑪格努斯之杖嗎？

original: I... I'm impressed with your initiative. Of course, someone will need to follow up on this.
string: 你……你的積極給我留下了深刻印象。當然，某人會需要繼續貫徹這一點。

original: It's connected to the orb we found.
string: 這跟我們找到的那個球體有關。

original: And how do you know this?
string: 那麼你是怎麼知道這個的？

original: We need to find the Staff of Magnus.
string: 我們得找到瑪格努斯之杖。

original: I'm sorry, what?
string: 抱歉，你說什麼？

original: Well... I'd certainly love to have such a powerful staff, but I'm not really sure that any of us need it.
string: 嗯……我當然想擁有一根如此強大的法杖，但我不確定我們之中有誰需要它。

original: I have important information for you.
string: 我有重要的消息要告訴你。

original: Really? And what might that be?
string: 真的？是什麼事呢？

original: I think you'll find this payment to be more than fair.
string: 我想你會覺得這筆買賣很划算的。

original: Interested in buying this Honningbrew Decanter?
string: 想要買這蜂蜜酒瓶嗎？

original: Here you go. This should cover it.
string: 拿去吧。這錢應該夠吧。

original: TGLarcenyShared
string: TGLarcenyShared

original: Well, well. I was looking for this little beauty.
string: 啊。我還在找這小美人呢。

original: If you happen across any other unusual trinkets like this, be sure and bring them to me. I promise it'll be worth the effort.
string: 如果你碰巧見到這些不尋常的小玩意兒，千萬要帶給我。我不會虧待你的。

original: Can I sell this Queen Bee Statue to you?
string: 你想買這個蜂后雕像嗎？

original: Of course I'll join you.
string: 我當然會加入。

original: I'll round up what men I can, and meet you outside Northwatch Keep. We'll get in and out as fast as possible.
string: 我會聚集人手，和你在北塔堡壘外碰頭。我們會以迅雷不及掩耳之勢衝進去後撤離。

original: I'll see you there.
string: 我們在那見！

original: There's no time. We've got to get you out of here! Come on, let's go!
string: 沒時間了。我們得把你弄出去！快，我們走！

original: What in the world?
string: 搞什麼？

original: I'm here! I knew I'd find you!
string: 我在這！我就知道能找到你。

original: Brother? Is... Is that you?
string: 兄弟？是……是你嗎？

original: Thorald? Thorald!
string: 索拉德 ？索拉德！

original: Unngh...  Uhhh...
What is this place?
string: 這是什麼地方？

original: That's privileged information. Now move along.
string: 這是機密。快離開。

original: Shall we see what your father thinks of this letter?
string: 想看看你的父親對這封信的看法嗎？

original: Okay, okay!
string: 好吧，好吧！

original: All I know is that Idolaf made some effort to find out what happened to him, but was told to stop asking questions.
string: 我只知道伊多拉夫試圖弄清他發生了什麼，但被勒令停止追問。

original: He got some letter from the Legion and has left it alone since then.
string: 他接到了軍團的一封信，從那以後就再也不過問了。

original: I'll prove it to you, all right? I'll get you the letter. Just... meet me at the statue of Talos, and don't tell anyone about this.
string: 我會證明給你看的，行不行？我會把信帶給你。你只要……在塔洛斯的雕像那等我，別跟任何人提這事。

original: I want to know about Thorald Gray-Mane.
string: 我想談談索拉德．灰鬃。

original: What makes you think I know anything? Everyone knows he's dead and gone!
string: 你怎麼會覺得我知道？人人都知他已經死了！

original: I found your letter to Olfina.
string: 我拿到了你給奧菲娜的信。

original: You what?
string: 什麼？

original: Oh no. No, no, no. This can't be happening.
string: 哦不。不，不，不。這不可能。

original: Please, you can't tell anyone. It must remain a secret! I'll do whatever you want.
string: 求求你，別告訴任何人。保守這個秘密！你要什麼我都照做。

original: If Thorald is alive, where is he?
string: 倘若索拉德還健在，他在哪兒？

original: Last I'd heard, he'd been carted off to Northwatch Keep. Ever heard of it?
string: 我最新收到的風聲，他被帶到北塔堡壘去了。你聽說了嗎？

original: If you go in there, you don't come out. Ever.
string: 一旦你進去，就永遠別想出來。

original: Here, see for yourself. This is the last word I received. I'm telling you, he's gone for good.
string: 來，你自己瞧瞧。這是我接到的最後一則通知。告訴你，他已經跟死了沒兩樣了。

original: How do you know this?
string: 你怎麼知道這個的？

original: I used some contacts in the Legion, asked some questions. Was told I should mind my own business.
string: 我向在軍團裡的連絡人問了些問題。他們叫我別管閒事。

original: What do you know about Thorald Gray-Mane?
string: 關於索拉德．灰鬃你都知道些什麼？

original: What's there to say? You go against the Empire, you wind up dead. Thorald got what was coming to him.
string: 我還能說什麼？敢反抗帝國，你就會沒命。索拉德就是這麼得到了報應。

original: Best not to ask too many questions about it. People might get the wrong idea about you.
string: 這事你最好別問。別人會因此對你產生錯誤的看法。

original: Between the two of us, his family is better off thinking he's dead.
string: 這事我們倆知道就行了，他的家人最好當他已經死了。

original: Thorald and I have history, all right? We used to be friends. So I looked into it when he disappeared.
string: 索拉德和我有交情，好嗎？我們曾是朋友。所以他失蹤後我做過調查。

original: I found out the Thalmor have him. And they don't let anyone go.
string: 我發現是梭默抓了他。他們從不會放任何人回去。

original: So I've kept my mouth shut. Like I said, his family is better off believing he's gone, because he's never coming back.
string: 所以我對此閉口不談。正如我所言，他的家人最好當他已經死了，因為他再也回不來了。

original: I think you know what really happened to Thorald Gray-Mane. (Persuade)
string: 我覺得你知道索拉德．灰鬃到底發生什麼事了？（說服）

original: He fought on the wrong side, and he paid for it. That's all I have to say.
string: 他選錯了邊，也付出了代價。我只能這麼說。

original: I think you know what really happened to Thorald Gray-Mane. (Persuade)
string: 我覺得你清楚索拉德．灰鬃真正發生什麼事了。（說服）

original: Oh come on, leave it alone. He's gone. There's no use in talking about it anymore.
string: 算了吧，別管那麼多。他不在了。多說無益。

original: I wish everyone could just get past that and get on with their lives.
string: 我希望所有人能放下這事，繼續好好生活。

original: It's been a while now. I miss him, but it's clear he's not coming back.
string: 這事距今有一陣子了。我想念他，但很明顯他不會回來的了。

original: He knew what he was getting into. I don't... I don't blame anyone.
string: 他清楚自己的處境。我不……我不怪任何人。

original: Is there anything you can tell me about Thorald?
string: 關於索拉德你有什麼可以跟我說的嗎？

original: Sounds like you need some help.
string: 聽起來你需要點幫助。

original: I can't do this all on my own. Are you... are you offering to help me?
string: 我一個人辦不到。你能……你能幫我一把嗎？

original: I didn't mean to alarm you. Why are you so tense?
string: 我不是存心想嚇你的。為什麼你那麼緊張？

original: Because they've got Thorald locked away somewhere, and if they find me here I'll disappear too!
string: 因為他們把索拉德關起來了，如果他們找到我的話我也會消失！

original: I am not going to let that happen!
string: 我不會讓這發生的！

original: I don't know your brother.
string: 我不認識你的兄弟。

original: Thorald... Thorald Gray-Mane? Fighting for the Stormcloaks, disappeared and believed dead?
string: 索拉德……索拉德．灰鬃？風暴斗篷的人，失蹤後傳言已死的那個人？

original: You really don't know anything about this, do you?
string: 你真的對此一無所知，是吧？

original: Calm down. I'm not working for anyone.
string: 冷靜點。我不是什麼人派來的。

original: No? So you don't know anything about my brother?
string: 嗯？這麼說我兄弟的事你一點也不知道囉？

original: Then what are you doing here?
string: 那你在這裡做什麼？

original: I don't know what you're talking about.
string: 我不知道你在說些什麼？

original: A likely story. They won't even do their own dirty work now, eh? Well, you won't get the better of me!
string: 好一個故事。他們不會弄髒自己手的，不是嗎？你騙不了我！

original: Now tell me where my brother is!
string: 現在告訴我我的兄弟在哪裡！

original: Enough! That's enough. I surrender... I surrender.
string: 夠了！夠了……我投降……我投降。

original: Peace! Everyone stand down. That's an order. Stand down!
string: 冷靜！所有人退下。這是命令，退下！

original: Yield. I yield, Stormcloak! The city of Markarth is yours.
string: 投降。我投降，風暴斗篷！馬卡斯城是你的了。

original: Stop! Enough! Stand down!
string: 住手！夠了！退下！

original: The city is yours.
string: 城市是你的了。

original: It's over! Everyone stop!
string: 結束了！所有人罷手！

original: I surrender... I surrender...
string: 我投降……我投降……

original: Tell me, Vignar. Was all this worth it?
string: 告訴我，維吉納。這一切值得嗎？

original: How many of those corpses lining our streets wear the faces of men who once called you friend? What about their families?
string: 有多少曾把你當作朋友的人曝屍街頭？他們的家人怎麼辦？

original: One day when you can see past your own interests, you will come to see that we were right.
string: 等到你能夠不顧自身利益時，你會明白我們是對的。

original: And this... This is all wrong.
string: 而這……這一切都錯了。

original: If this was my Empire, I'd be able to worship whoever I damned well pleased. You wish to see an Empire without Talos? Without its soul?
string: 要是這是我的帝國，我他媽的喜歡誰就崇拜誰。難道你希望見到一個沒有塔洛斯的帝國？一個沒有靈魂的帝國？

original: We should be fighting those witch-elves, not bending knee to them. The Emperor is nothing more than a puppet of the Thalmor.
string: 我們應該反抗那些精靈巫婆們，而不是屈膝投降。皇帝只是梭默的傀儡罷了。

original: Skyrim needs a High King who will fight for her, and Whiterun needs a Jarl who will do the same.
string: 天際需要一位為她而戰的至高王，而白漫也需要一個同樣的領主。

original: A bit melodramatic, even for you Laila.
string: 就算對妳而言，這也有些誇張了，萊拉。

original: Pack your things and go.
string: 收拾你的東西出發吧。

original: A convenient position to hold now. But mark my words, old man, in the days to come, Ulfric will spread his rebellion thin. And what then?
string: 進可攻退可守，是吧。但記住我的話，老頭，烏弗瑞克的革命遲早會疲於奔命。接下來又會怎樣？

original: We need the Empire, as much as it needs us. We Nords are the Empire! Our blood built it. Our blood sustains it! You of all people should know that.
string: 我們需要帝國，如同它需要我們一般。我們諾德人就是帝國本身！我們的鮮血鑄就了它。我們的鮮血支撐著它！尤其是你怎麼會不懂？

original: We Nords were proud warriors once. And we still could be. Evidenced by the men and women who fought and died bravely today.
string: 我們諾德人曾是光榮的戰士。現在我們依然是。今天英勇戰死的男男女女就是明證。

original: You could see that if you had any faith left in that black heart of yours.
string: 要是你那顆黑心還殘存點信念的話，你也會同意我的。

original: But no, you're content to snatch scraps falling off the Emperor's table. Fine. Take my home. Take my city. May it burn down around you.
string: 但你沒有，你滿足於撿皇帝餐桌上的殘羹剩飯。好啊。拿走我的家園吧。拿走我的城市吧。願你與其俱焚。

original: You think this is personal?
string: 你覺得這是私人恩怨？

original: The Empire has no place in Skyrim... not any more. And you? You have no place in Whiterun anymore.
string: 帝國無以在天際省立足……不可能了。至於你？你在白漫也不再有立錐之地了。

original: Don't worry. We'll take good care of your city when you're gone.
string: 別擔心。你走後我們會好好看管你的城市的。

original: When Ulfric Stormcloak becomes High King, Skyrim will finally be the way my ancestors intended. It's a new day in Markarth.
string: 當烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷成為至高王時，天際終於能實現我祖先的設想。那將是馬卡斯城的新時代。

original: You never were able to see the forest for the trees, were you?
string: 你一直以來目光都很狹隘，對吧？

original: How kind of you. And I've brought an army to give you a going away parade.
string: 你真好啊。我帶了一支軍隊來歡送你。

original: What do I need to know about Potema?
string: 關於波特瑪我需要知道些什麼？

original: Any resident of Solitude can tell you, she was the deadliest person ever to come out of Skyrim.
string: 獨孤城的任何居民都知道，她曾是天際省最致命的人物。

original: Queen of Solitude, granddaughter of Emperor Uriel Septim II, five hundred years ago. Her fight for succession nearly tore the empire apart.
string: 獨孤城女王，皇帝提圖斯．邁德二世的孫女，五百年前。她為了爭奪繼承權，差點導致帝國的毀滅。

original: After twenty years of fighting, she had raised armies of the dead, led by vampire generals. If she returns to power, nobody could stop her.
string: 經過二十年的血雨腥風，她喚醒了由吸血鬼統率的亡靈大軍。如果她東山再起，沒人擋得住她。

original: A curious figure. Unrepentantly evil and nasty, of course, but also astonishingly brilliant, and obviously quite a necromancer at her end.
string: 一個讓人摸不透的人物。毫無疑問她很邪惡陰險，也機敏過人，而且還是一名死靈法師。

original: She was always so close to being Empress, but despite her machinations, it was never to be hers.
string: 她一直離王位很近，但即使他處心積慮想奪權，最終也沒有得逞。

original: Ironically, if she were alive today, she'd be the only living member of the Septim bloodline. By all rights, she would now be Empress.
string: 諷刺的是，如果她今天還活著，她就是塞普汀血脈的僅存成員了。也就是說，她終於可以當女皇了。

original: Some Necromancers were attempting to summon and bind Potema.
string: 一些死靈術士曾試圖召喚並束縛波特瑪。

original: Potema herself? Please tell me you stopped them.
string: 波特瑪本人？ 希望你告訴我你阻止了他們。

original: No! Not again! I shall not be denied again!
string: 不！再也不會！我不想再遭背棄！

original: Ready to get moving?
string: 準備好出發了嗎？

original: So, what's the plan?
string: 計劃是什麼？

original: We heading out?
string: 我們啟程嗎？

original: Whenever you're ready to leave.
string: 隨時都行。

original: You're ready to get going?
string: 你準備好出發了嗎？

original: Shall we get moving?
string: 我們動身嗎？

original: We going?
string: 我們走嗎？

original: Ready to get going?
string: 準備好出發了嗎？

original: You are ready to move, yes?
string: 你準備好了，是嗎？

original: We are leaving?
string: 我們要走了嗎？

original: Waiting.
string: 還在等。

original: Still standing here.
string: 還站著等呢。

original: Mara protect us both.
string: 願瑪拉庇護我們倆。

original: I'm itching for a fight.
string: 不打仗我手都癢了。

original: I'm right behind you.
string: 我緊隨在後。

original: Still here.
string: 還在這裡。

original: I've got your back.
string: 我來殿後。

original: Lead on. I'm behind you.
string: 你帶來。我跟著走。

original: To Oblivion and back, as they say.
string: 正如他們所說，去煙滅走一遭。

original: Ours is to follow, friend.
string: 我們當追隨，朋友。

original: Khajiit guards your back.
string: 虎人替你殿後。

original: If anyone sneaks up on us, I'll smell them coming. Or I might not. We'll see.
string: 如果有人偷偷接近，我會嗅到他們的蹤跡。也或許不會。等著瞧吧。

original: You're taking us somewhere warm, I trust?
string: 我希望，你是要帶我們去個暖和點的地方？

original: An Orc follows to the death.
string: 獸人至死相隨。

original: My blood's calm. I prefer it boiling.
string: 我的鮮血都要凝固了，我寧願它沸騰。

original: You have a grim look.
string: 你看起來好猙獰。

original: We've stopped. What is it?
string: 我們停下來了。怎麼回事？

original: I'm still here.
string: 我還在原地。

original: Let's get going.
string: 我們走吧。

original: I've taken care of Potema.
string: 我擊敗波特瑪了。

original: You've done a great thing, today. It doesn't matter who you support in the war; Potema would have been a blight on the land for both sides.
string: 你今天做了件偉大的事。無論你在戰爭中支持哪方；波特瑪會導致雙方的毀滅。

original: Without you this would have been a disaster. I should have paid more heed to Varnius' warnings.  I won't make that mistake again.
string: 沒有你這將是一場災難。我本該多留心瓦紐斯的警告的。我不會再犯錯了。

original: I had to use your pay to smooth things over with the client. They didn't want to be associated with a criminal. Next time, don't get arrested.
string: 我得用你的報酬來平息客戶的情緒。他們不想與一個罪犯扯上關係。下次別再被抓住。

original: Gettin' pinched and endin' up in jail doesn't cut it with our clients. If you want to get paid next time, stay clean.
string: 我們的客戶可不喜歡看到你被抓到後丟入監獄。你想拿到報酬就別惹禍上身。

original: Yeah, your right. Probably a waste of your time anyway.
string: 對，你說得對。反正可能是在浪費你的時間。

original: Sure, no problem. We'll find someone else to do it.
string: 當然，沒問題。我們會另外找人做的。

original: Don't even give it a second thought. Maybe next time.
string: 想都別想。也許下次吧。

original: Your not winnin' points with me with that attitude.
string: 你這種態度可不會給我留下好印象。

original: When you find your nerves, then we'll talk.
string: 等你控制好自己的情緒我們再談。

original: Fine, but you're not gettin' any wealthier by weaslin' out of everythin' I offer you.
string: 好吧，但是你什麼工作都不願意接，是賺不了錢的。

original: You're not going to get richer with that attitude.
string: 你還是那副態度的話可是賺不了錢的。

original: You need to bloody well get your priorities straight if you want to make it around here.
string: 如果你想在這裡混開，就得搞明白你的首要任務。

original: Too bad, looks like I need to find someone else to take care of business.
string: 真糟糕，看來我得另外找人來打理生意了。

original: If you think you'll make your fortune kickin' around the Flagon all day, that's where your wrong.
string: 如果你覺得整天在漏壺遊手好閒就能賺大錢，那你就錯了。

original: And here I thought you were a master criminal. Guess I was wrong.
string: 我還以為你是個犯罪大師呢。看來我錯了。

original: All-righty. Good luck out there, boss.
string: 好吧。祝你好運，老闆。

original: Here you go, boss. All the details.
string: 就是這樣，老闆。詳情全在這了。

original: Great. Watch yourself out there, boss.
string: 好的。小心行事，老闆。

original: Good... here's your assignment.
string: 很好……這是你的任務內容。

original: Finally, someone with backbone. Here you go.
string: 終於來了個有骨氣的了。拿去吧。

original: Now that's what I like to hear. Off you go.
string: 這才是我愛聽的。你可以出發了。

original: Nice. Here, this is what you'll need to know.
string: 很好。拿去，這是你需要知道的。

original: Keep this up and you'll be rich enough retire before you know it. Good luck.
string: 保持這股衝勁你下半輩子就不用愁了。祝你好運。

original: Just remember the rules... keep it clean and keep it quiet. Here's the details.
string: 記住規矩……行事低調，乾淨俐落。這是任務內容。

original: Here's everythin' you need. You get caught, and we've never heard of you.
string: 你所需要的都在這裡了。一旦你被抓，我們就跟你撇清關係。

original: Just keep your eyes open and your mouth shut and you'll do fine. Let me give you the details.
string: 小心行事，閉緊你的嘴，這樣就能順利辦事。這是任務內容。

original: A pleasure as always, boss. Here's your payment.
string: 合作愉快，老闆。這是你的報酬。

original: Got all your gold ready, boss. You can count every coin, it's all there.
string: 你的錢都準備好了，老闆。你可以親自數數，全在這了。

original: I hardly noticed you were gone. Got your share of the spoils right here, boss.
string: 你速度真是快啊。你這次的錢在我這邊，老闆。

original: Good job. Now here's your part of the deal.
string: 幹得漂亮。這是你的那份。

original: Here's your share. Well done.
string: 這是你的那份。做得好。

original: Nicely done. Here's your share.
string: 幹得漂亮。這是你那一份。

original: And here's the spoils. Plenty more where this came from!
string: 這是戰利品。可謂源源不斷啊！

original: I can pat you on the back all day, but coin's coin, right?
string: 我可以表揚你一整天，但錢才是重點，對吧？

original: This kind of work suits you... and is going to end up makin' you rich.
string: 你很適合做這工作……你會靠此發財的。

original: Couldn't have done it better myself. Here's your coin.
string: 我自己也不能做得更好了。這是你的報酬。

original: If you don't watch it, I may actually start to respect you. Job well done.
string: 如果你不盯著它看，我大概會開始佩服你了。做得好。

original: Sorry, boss. Had to use your share to cover expenses after you done and got messy.
string: 抱歉，老闆。得用你的那份錢來幫你收拾殘局。

original: I'm afraid I had to pay off a few officials to keep you out of jail, boss. Expensive to get murder off the books, know what I mean?
string: 我非得收買些官員才能避免你被抓去關。要開脫謀殺罪可花費不菲，你明白我意思嗎？

original: Now don't get cross with me, but the officials are demanding compensation for the mark you killed. Had to do it... had no choice, boss.
string: 別生我的氣，你殺了那人，官員要求補償。我必須那麼做……別無選擇，老闆。

original: What's the matter with you? We said keep it clean! Well, you can just forget about your payment.
string: 你有什麼問題？我們說好了要乾淨俐落！忘了你的報酬吧。

original: Sure you finished, but you killed someone to do it. Next time listen to the rules if you want to get paid.
string: 你是完成了，但還搭上了條人命。想拿錢你下次就得按規矩辦。

original: You needed to do this clean and quiet, and you failed. Now we need to use your payment to cover your mistake.
string: 你得不動聲色，乾淨俐落地了結這事，但你沒做到。現在我們得用你的報酬來替你善後。

original: I hope you weren't expectin' to get paid for this blundered job. Next time, the mark stays alive... you hear me?
string: 弄成這樣你就別指望拿錢了。下次別殺人……明白嗎？

original: This ain't the Dark Brotherhood. Next time, you keep the job clean and you'll get your coin.
string: 這不是黑暗兄弟會。下次你做得乾淨點就能拿到錢。

original: Consider it forgotten, boss.
string: 忘了它吧，老闆。

original: Are you bloody serious? You're not going to get ahead by quitting around here, that I can promise you.
string: 當真嗎？你老放棄是成不了事的，這點我向你保證。

original: You can't keep quittin' jobs when it strikes your fancy. You're going to make us all look like a bunch of amateurs. Think next time.
string: 你不能一不如意就放棄工作。你讓我們看起來像是一幫門外漢。下次好好想想。

original: Keep droppin' these jobs and I might quit assignin' them to you.
string: 再放棄這些工作我就不會派活給你了。

original: Being connected to a criminal didn't make the client happy... next time, act like a real thief and don't get caught.
string: 客戶不喜歡自己跟一個罪犯扯上關係……下次當個專業的小偷，別被抓到。

original: Good going... you got arrested. Now how do you think that looks for the Guild? Better luck next time.
string: 你還真行……居然被捕了。你覺得公會的顏面該往哪裡擺？下次注意點。

original: Good. Here's what you need to do.
string: 好的。這就是你要做的。

original: Suit yourself. You're the boss.
string: 隨便。你是老闆。

original: All right, whatever you want.
string: 好吧，你想要什麼都行。

original: No problem, I'll find someone else. Don't worry about it.
string: 沒問題，我會去找別人的。別擔心。

original: Hey, you approached me. You want to play coward, that's your problem.
string: 嘿，是你來找我的。你想當縮頭烏龜，那是你的問題。

original: Look, I don't like wasting my time. Come back when you decide to get serious.
string: 聽著，我不喜歡浪費時間。想好了再來。

original: Not interested? Fine. Then let me offer it to someone with a little more backbone.
string: 不感興趣？好吧。我找有點骨氣的人去做。

original: You need to start pulling your own weight around here, otherwise I might "forget" to offer you any more jobs.
string: 你來這裡就得做好自己的本分，不然我可能會「忘記」給你提供工作。

original: Fine. I'll just keep all this coin for myself then.
string: 好的，這些錢我自己留著。

original: Look, if you just want to sit around the Flagon all day getting drunk, that's your business. Just quit wasting my time.
string: 聽著，如果你想整天在漏壺無所事事，喝得酩酊大醉，那是你的事。別來浪費我的時間。

original: The last time I checked, gold coins aren't falling from the heavens. You better take some jobs if you want to earn your share.
string: 據我所知，金幣不會從天上掉下來。想要賺錢的話就去接工作來做。

original: Keep turning down jobs like this and the Guild will begin to lose respect for you.
string: 再拒絕這些工作的話公會就會看不起你了。

original: Fine. Here's everything you need to know.
string: 好吧。你需要知道的全在這了。

original: All right. Take this and get out of here.
string: 好吧。拿了就給我出去。

original: Fine. Just keep it clean. Here you go.
string: 好吧。做得乾淨點。拿去吧。

original: Good, just remember the order: do job first, get drunk second. Now take this and go.
string: 好，記住規矩：工作在先，醉酒在後。現在拿上這個就走吧。

original: Here you go. Hope you don't muck it up.
string: 拿去吧。希望你別搞砸了。

original: Here. Just don't make me look like an ass in front of the Guild and mess it up.
string: 給你。你最好別讓我在公會裡出醜。

original: Whatever, just get it done. Here's the job.
string: 無所謂，搞定就行。這是工作內容。

original: Oh, you're back? I suppose you'll be wanting your pay then.
string: 哦，你回來了？我想你是來要錢的。

original: You did the job and you did it clean; that's all we ever ask. Enjoy the gold.
string: 你把事情辦好了，做得乾淨俐落；我們唯一的要求就是這個。好好享用你的金幣吧。

original: Didn't muck it up I hear. Good. Here's your share.
string: 我聽說幹得不錯。很好。這是你的部分。

original: I suppose you want your share now? Here you go.
string: 我想你是來要你那份的？拿去吧。

original: And with no strings attached. Not bad. Here, got some coin for you.
string: 也沒有附帶條件。不錯。來，這是你的報酬。

original: Amazing what people leave laying around for us to take, isn't it?
string: 人們把好東西放那裡請我們光顧，真棒，對吧？

original: Fine. I guess you'll need your coin then.
string: 好吧。我想你是來要錢的。

original: Here's your gold. Try not to spend it all in one place.
string: 這是你的金幣。別花得太快。

original: I want to pay you, but I had to cover up the murder. Didn't expect you to go on a killing spree.
string: 我原想付你報酬，但我得掩蓋那起謀殺。沒想到你會大開殺戒。

original: Sorry, I don't have a single septim left after paying the town guard to keep quiet about the mark you killed.
string: 抱歉，你殺了人後，你的錢我全花在了城鎮衛兵的封口費上。

original: Look, I told the client you probably had a good reason to kill the mark, but well, they demanded reparations.
string: 聽著，我跟客戶解釋說你不得不殺了那人，但他們還是要求賠款。

original: Are you out of your mind? We said no bloodshed! Well, guess what. You can just forget about your gold.
string: 你瘋了嗎？我們說好不殺人的！你知道嗎，你一枚金幣都拿不到。

original: I thought it was crystal clear... no one dies on these jobs. Remember that next time you want to get paid.
string: 你還搞不清楚嗎……工作不能見血。想要錢下次就給我記住了。

original: You an assassin or a thief? Next time, keep your blade sheathed if you want to make any gold.
string: 你到底是個刺客還是個賊？你想分到錢的話下次就別開殺戒。

original: You drew blood, so you aren't getting paid. That's the rules. You don't like it, take it up with Brynjolf.
string: 你手上沾了血是不會有報酬的。這是規矩。你不高興的話去找布林喬夫。

original: You idiot! We have to cover your mess up and that costs us gold... which means you don't get any.
string: 你這個白癡！幫你收拾殘局是要花錢的……這錢全部用你的酬勞去付。

original: No problem, I'll get someone else to take it.
