string: 沒問題，我找別人接手。

original: Fine. Next time, save me the trouble and pass on it from the beginning.
string: 好吧。下次一開始就別接，省得我麻煩。

original: Make up your mind, will you? You're starting to make us look bad.
string: 下定決心，好嗎？你這樣是在丟我們的臉。

original: First you take the job, now you don't even want it. I wish you'd make up your mind.
string: 你接下工作後，現在又說不想做了。我希望你能下定決心。

original: I'm not really interested in anything dangerous.
string: 我不想冒險。

original: Ah. Some other time, perhaps?
string: 啊。或許下次吧？

original: I'm ready for some adventure.
string: 我準備好去探險了。

original: Well all right. Here, I scribbled down the last place I'd heard about. Check it out, but be careful.
string: 好吧。拿去，我把我聽到的最後一個地點草草記下了。看看吧，但千萬要小心。

original: Is there any College business I can assist with?
string: 學院裡有沒有什麼事情是我能幫上忙的？

original: If you're feeling adventurous, I'm always looking for someone to procure valuable books from some more... dangerous locations.
string: 如果你想冒險，我一直在找人替我從某些……危險的地方取回些珍貴的書籍。

original: There are more books to be recovered and secured here in the Arcanaeum.
string: 秘藏館還有很多書需要修復並妥善保管。

original: Excellent. Thank you, I'll see that this gets put to good use.
string: 棒極了。謝謝你，我會好好利用的。

original: Here's the soul gem you asked for.
string: 這是你要的靈魂石。

original: Yes, a Grand one. Soon, please.
string: 是的，一個特大靈魂石。趕緊，拜託。

original: You needed a soul gem filled?
string: 你要裝滿一顆靈魂石？

original: Here's the item you wanted.
string: 這是你要的東西。

original: Ah, yes. Thank you. I'll get to work on this right away.
string: 啊，就是這個。謝謝你，我馬上去研究。

original: I'll add it to the list of things I need to take care of. Thank you.
string: 我會把這擺在我的第一優先順位。謝謝你。

original: Maybe some other time.
string: 也許改天吧。

original: Some other time? That's not going to help me much, now is it?
string: 改天？這樣子對我一點幫助也沒有，你不覺得嗎？

original: I can take care of that for you.
string: 我能替你保管那個。

original: Here, take this Grand Soul Gem, fill it for me, and bring it right back. I'll be waiting.
string: 給你，拿著這顆特大靈魂石，幫我把它裝滿，然後立刻帶回來。我會等你的。

original: Is there any College business I can help with?
string: 有什麼魔法學院的事務我能幫上忙的嗎？

original: In fact, there is. I need a soul gem filled, if you're up to it.
string: 事實上還真有。我需要裝滿一顆靈魂石，如果你能辦到的話。

original: I've got the gems you asked for.
string: 我拿到你要的靈魂石了。

original: If you can bring me three more, that would be helpful.
string: 如果你能再給我帶三顆，那就再好不過了。

original: I need at least five more, if you can find them.
string: 如果你能找到的話，我至少還需要五顆。

original: Bring me another seven of them, if you can.
string: 如果行的話再帶給我七顆。

original: Ten more would keep me stocked for a bit.
string: 再來十顆我的庫存就比較充足了。

original: What did you say you needed?
string: 你說你需要什麼？

original: I'm running low on Petty Soul Gems.
string: 我的微型靈魂石快用完了。

original: I'm running low on Lesser Soul Gems.
string: 我的小型靈魂石快用完了。

original: I'm running low on Common Soul Gems.
string: 我的普通靈魂石快用完了。

original: I'm running low on Greater Soul Gems.
string: 我的大型靈魂石快用完了。

original: I'm running low on Grand Soul Gems.
string: 我的特大靈魂石快用完了。

original: Is there any College business I can assist with?
string: 有沒有任何學院來的委託是我能幫忙的呢？

original: I need some more supplies. Can you help out with that?
string: 我需要一些補給。你能幫上忙嗎？

original: You wanted something enchanted at the College?
string: 你要拿一些東西去魔法學院附魔嗎?

original: Yes, yes I did. I've already sent instructions, you just need to make sure this arrives in one piece.
string: 對，是的。我已經下達指令了，你只需要確保它完好無損地抵達。

original: Ah, you're from the College? I've been waiting for you.
string: 啊，你是魔法學院的人？我一直在等你。

original: Please make sure this arrives in a timely manner. And don't scratch it up.
string: 請確保這個及時送達。不要刮壞了。

original: Oh, good. I've been waiting for you. Here you go, it's all ready.
string: 哦，很好，我一直在等你。這裡，都準備好了。

original: Now, Sergius knows what I want. I'm hoping he can get it done quickly.
string: 嗯，瑟吉爾斯知道我想要什麼。我希望他能快點辦妥。

original: It's about time someone arrived. Here, make sure this is handled properly.
string: 也該有人來了。拿去，一定要把這個妥善處理好。

original: Oh yes, that. Here you go. I hope this can be ready soon.
string: 哦對，那個。拿去吧。我希望這能快點就緒。

original: Yes, yes. Let's keep our voices down, all right? Just make sure this gets there.
string: 對，對。我們小點聲，行不行？一定得把這個安全送達。

original: Okay, I can do that for you.
string: 好，我能幫忙。

original: All right. Be quick about it, will you? This is a good way for the College to bring in some money.
string: 好的。快點完事，行不行？這是為學院帶來收入的好機會。

original: Here's the name and location of the client.
string: 這是客戶的姓名和位置。

original: Is there any College business I can assist with?
string: 有沒有我能幫忙的學院來的委託？

original: Sure is. I've got another client -- wants me to do some enchanting. You can do the pick-up for me, if you want.
string: 當然。又來了一位客戶——想讓我附魔一些東西。你如果願意的話，可以順便幫我。

original: There's more enchanting to be done. You can acquire whatever it is and bring it back here, and I'll take care of it.
string: 還有更多東西要附魔。無論是什麼都把它帶回來，我會處理的。

original: You must be the one Falk spoke so highly of. Welcome.
string: 你一定是那個佛可讚不絕口的人。歡迎。

original: You've returned! I'm hoping successfully.
string: 你回來了！我正翹首以盼呢。

original: You know what needs to be done. Is there something more you need?
string: 你知道該做什麼？你還需要什麼？

original: The courier must have found you.
string: 信使一定找過你了。

original: Speak to Styrr. He can help.
string: 找斯提爾談談。他能幫上忙。

original: I won't be able to relax until I'm sure Potema is dealt with.
string: 沒有處理好波特瑪的事情之前我是無法放鬆的。

original: DB07AstridPlayerJournalSayTopic
string: DB07AstridPlayerJournalSayTopic

original: I want you to find that miserable little fool and end his life!
string: 去找到那個可憐蟲並且送他一程！

original: But first... find my husband. Make sure he's all right.
string: 但先……先去找我的丈夫。確保他沒事。

original: After the attack, Arnbjorn flew into a rage. When Cicero left... Arnbjorn went after him. They disappeared into the wild.
string: 襲擊結束後，艾恩喬恩勃然大怒。西塞羅逃跑後……他追了上去。一起消失在荒野中。

original: Search Cicero's room. Maybe there's something in there that sheds some light on where he might have gone.
string: 搜一搜西塞羅的房間。也許那裡有什麼東西能告訴我們他去哪兒了。

original: Let me know the minute you find something. I've got to see to Veezara, and calm everyone down.
string: 有什麼發現馬上告訴我。我得照顧維薩拉，並讓大家情緒穩定下來。

original: What do you want me to do?
string: 妳想要我怎麼做？

original: Look, we've got to deal with this situation. You've got to deal with this situation.
string: 瞧，我們得去處理這情況。你得去處理這情況。

original: She's right. I'll be forever in your debt, dearest brother. Now be quiet. Just... just rest.
string: 她說得對。我永遠虧欠你，親愛的兄弟。安靜下來。好好……休息吧。

original: Hush, Veezara. You were very brave. Astrid may well be dead if not for you.
string: 幹得好，維薩拉。你很勇敢。如果不是因為你阿斯垂德很可能已經死了。

original: Bested by a fool. Who's the fool now, hmm?
string: 被傻瓜超過了。現在誰才是傻瓜？

original: I'll admit, even I'm having a hard time disagreeing with you...
string: 我必須承認妳是對的。即使當初我不太願意相信妳的看法……

original: Damn it, this never should have happened! We knew better. We knew better, and still we let our guards down. Agh!
string: 該死，這不應該發生的！我們早該知道事情會如此，但還是疏於防備了。唉！

original: Achh... Thank you, dear. You are most kind. The jester's cut feels as bad as it looks, I'm afraid.
string: 啊……謝謝你，親愛的。感謝妳的親切。恐怕這醜陋的傷口摸起來就跟外表看起來一樣地糟糕吧。

original: Just try to relax, Veezara. Let the elixir do its work. You'll feel better, shortly.

original: In the old tales, Nord heroes would use the power of their Voice to Shout down the gates of cities and strike down their enemies.
string: 古老的傳說中，諾德英雄們會運用他們的聲音來敲破城門，擊垮敵軍。

original: But only the Greybeards study the Way of the Voice any more. If you can Shout... you need to talk to them.
string: 但現在只有灰鬍子還在研究龍吼之道。如果你會龍吼……你得跟他們談談。

original: Old Nord folk tales always talk about Shouting their enemies to pieces. I always thought it was just a myth.
string: 古代諾德的民間傳說總是提到「把他們的敵人吼成碎片」。但我一直以為這只是無稽之談。

original: If you think you might be able to do that kind of thing, the Legion could certainly use your help.
string: 如果你認為自己有那方面的天賦，軍團肯定會重用你。

original: Go talk to the Greybeards, see what they can tell you.
string: 去跟灰鬍子們談談，看看他們能告訴你些什麼？

original: Well, I only know what I've heard in the old tales. Shouting is an ancient form of magic - the use of one's voice to project their power.
string: 呃……我只知道古老傳說中所說的。吐姆是一種古老的魔法形式——用人的聲音來發射他們的力量。

original: If you can Shout, you need to go see the Greybeards. They'll know what to do.
string: 如果你會龍吼，你就該去找灰鬍子。他們知道該怎麼辦。

original: I know more than most. I trained with the Greybeards at High Hrothgar when I was a boy.
string: 這個我可清楚的很。年少時我曾跟灰鬍子一起在高吼峰受訓。

original: The Way of the Voice is an ancient, spiritual form of magic in which you project your vital essence into a "thu'um" or Shout.
string: 龍吼之道是一種古老的精神魔法，你將你的生命精華以「吐姆」或吼叫的形式發射出來。

original: Most people would need to train for years before they could even attempt a single Shout.
string: 大多數的人得要受訓數年，才有辦法試著吼叫一聲。

original: The Dragonborn is different - you have an inborn ability to Shout, the same way dragons are said to.
string: 龍裔不一樣——你有著與生俱來的龍吼能力，據說龍也是這樣。

original: Who are the Greybeards?
string: 灰鬍子是什麼人？

original: They live in seclusion on the slopes of the Throat of the World, the great mountain of Skyrim.
string: 他們與世隔絕，住在那座名叫世界咽喉的大山裡。

original: They're masters of the Way of the Voice. If you really are Dragonborn, they're the ones who can teach you how to use your power.
string: 他們個個精通龍吼之道，如果你真的是龍裔，那只有他們才能教會你運用這種能力。

original: Near as I can tell, a bunch of ancient Nord hermits who live on top of a mountain.
string: 要我說的話，就是一群從很久以前就一直住在某座山山頂的諾德人隱士。

original: Never heard of them talking to anybody before. If they really do want to talk to you, you'd better go find out what they want. You never know.
string: 從沒聽說他們跟其他人有過交流。如果他們真的有話要跟你說，你最好先搞清他們想做什麼，人心叵測呀。

original: They're the Masters of the Way of the Voice - of Shouting. They live up on top of the Throat of the World.
string: 他們個個精通龍吼之道，他們住在世界咽喉之巔。

original: If you're really Dragonborn, they'll want to talk to you. In the old stories, they always summon the Dragonborn for training.
string: 如果你真的是龍裔，他們一定有話要跟你說。在古老的傳說當中，他們總是召喚龍裔，然後訓練他們。

original: Ulfric can tell you more than most anyone. He was studying to be a Greybeard himself, back before the Great War.
string: 烏弗瑞克能告訴你的東西比任何人都多，在浩大戰爭之前，他曾經修習如何成為一個灰鬍子。

original: What's it mean to be Dragonborn?
string: 成為一個龍裔意味著什麼？

original: Well, in the old tales, the Dragonborn heroes would use the power of their Voice to defeat the enemies of Skyrim.
string: 這個嘛，在古老的傳說裡，龍裔會用他們的吼聲來打敗天際省的敵人。

original: Wulfharth was Dragonborn. Talos, too - the founder of the Empire, back in the good old days.
string: 想當年，武夫哈斯曾是一名龍裔，塔洛斯——帝國的創建者——也不例外。

original: In the very oldest tales, back from when there still were dragons in Skyrim, the Dragonborn would slay dragons and steal their power.
string: 在最古老的傳說當中，古老到天際省仍然有龍存在的時候，龍裔會殺死它們、奪取它們的能力。

original: It means you have the Dragon Blood - you have an inborn ability to use your Voice the way dragons do.
string: 這意味著你身體裡流著龍的血液——你生來就有龍吼的能力，跟龍一模一樣。

original: The old tales tell of Dragonborn heroes who slew dragons and took their power.
string: 古老傳說中講述了殺死龍然後奪取牠們力量的龍裔英雄。

original: It seems those tales are true.
string: 看起來，傳說成為了現實。

original: With the dragons returning, and now a Dragonborn appearing... maybe the Greybeards know what it all means.
string: 龍已經回到了這片土地，現在又出現了一位龍裔，希望那些灰鬍子們能瞭解到這背後的深意。

original: It means you can kill dragons and steal their power - even speak with a dragon's voice, they say.
string: 他們說，這意味著你能夠殺掉龍，然後偷取牠們的能力——甚至還能像龍一樣咆哮。

original: There hasn't been a Dragonborn seen in the land for centuries. Not since Talos himself walked the 7,000 Steps to High Hrothgar.
string: 在塔洛斯親自爬了七千台階登上高吼峰之後，這片土地已經好幾個世紀沒出現過龍裔了。

original: I don't know much. Only the old tales about the ancient heroes who would use the Voice to defeat the enemies of Skyrim.
string: 我知道的不多。只知道在某則傳說中，古老的英雄們用龍吼打敗了天際的敵人。

original: They say the Emperors used to be Dragonborn, but that all ended when Martin died during the Oblivion Crisis.
string: 他們說皇帝們曾經都是龍裔，直到馬丁在湮滅危機中喪生為止。

original: The Greybeards can tell you much more than I can. They're the masters of the Way of the Voice and taught Tiber Septim himself.
string: 比起我，灰鬍子能告訴你更多。他們精通龍吼之道，就是他們將此道傳授給泰伯．塞普汀的。

original: The only thing I remember is the old story of Tiber Septim being called Dragonborn by the Nords, before they switched sides and joined the Empire.
string: 我唯一記得的事情就是有關泰伯．塞普汀被諾德人稱為龍裔，直到他們改旗易幟，加入了帝國那一邊。

original: No doubt those Greybeards up at High Hrothgar will talk your ear off about it.
string: 毫無疑問，高吼峰上的灰鬍子們一定會不斷對你提起這件事，直到你耳朵長繭。

original: What do you know about Haldyn?
string: 你對哈丁有什麼瞭解嗎？

original: We used to think the pirates had an army of battlemages at their side.
string: 我們曾以為海盜們有一群戰鬥法師做後盾。

original: As it turns out, it was just one. Haldyn. I've since learned more about him.
string: 結果卻是，只有一個人，就是哈丁。從那以後我就知道了哈丁這麼個人。

original: The most dangerous sort of man -- quick to anger, but patient in exacting vengeance.
string: 最危險的那類人——性情易怒，但是為了復仇又能臥薪嚐膽。

original: He also has a fearsome control of Destruction magic.
string: 他對毀滅系法術的掌控力也讓人毛骨悚然。

original: I wish you the best of luck.
string: 我祝你一路順風。

original: Do you have any proof of that?
string: 那你有證據嗎？

original: Not yet, no. But perhaps an intrepid person such as yourself could help with that.
string: 還沒有，沒有。但是也許像你這樣勇敢的人能夠想想辦法。

original: They have a dark elf who oversees their operations. Suvaris Atheron.
string: 他們有個暗精靈在監督所有行動。蘇瓦利斯．亞瑟榮。

original: She's meticulous to a fault, and keeps a logbook with every transaction she makes.
string: 她做事謹慎，把經手的每一筆交易都記錄在一本航海日記上。

original: If it were to somehow end up in my hands, I wouldn't argue.
string: 如果可以在我手上終結這一切，我不會抱怨什麼的。

original: Who are the Shatter-Shields?
string: 碎盾都是些什麼人？

original: A very powerful family in Windhelm.
string: 風舵城的一個很有勢力的家族。

original: They run a private shipping operation, and would love to have the docks to themselves.
string: 他們私營水上運輸業務，而且喜歡把碼頭據為己有。

original: Wouldn't surprise me if they were in league with the pirates, somehow.
string: 要是他們跟海盜有什麼瓜葛，我一點也不意外。

original: I know this place looks horrible -- please don't hold it against the Company.
string: 我知道這地方看起來很糟糕——但是別因此抱怨商行。

original: MS10Hellos
string: MS10Hellos

original: Please excuse the mess.
string: 這裡一團糟，請勿見怪。

original: If you get me the logbook, I'll have proof of Shatter-Shield's treachery.
string: 如果你幫我弄到了那本航海日記，我就能拿到碎盾反叛的證據。

original: Let me know when you've learned more about the pirates.
string: 你瞭解更多關於海盜的消息之後，告訴我一聲。

original: She's probably the one you ought to talk to.
string: 你該去跟她聊聊。

original: Give those pirates what for!
string: 給海盜們點顏色瞧瞧！

original: We're so grateful for your help.
string: 我們非常感謝你的幫助。

original: What're you looking at?
string: 你盯著什麼看呢？

original: I think they may have met after all.
string: 我想，或許他們早已見過面了。

original: You think Alva...but that means...
string: 你覺得阿爾瓦……但是那就意味著……

original: Ye gods! You think Alva is a vampire?
string: 天啊！你認為阿爾瓦是個吸血鬼？

original: Azura has seen your coming, traveler. It was not curiosity, but fate, that has led you here.
string: 阿祖拉已經預知你的到來了，旅人。引領你來到這裡的，不是你的好奇心，而是命運的安排。

original: You're making a mistake...
string: 你搞錯了……

original: You're the one who conspired with the Forsworn against Markarth! You're coming with me, murderer!
string: 你就是那個跟棄誓者一起對抗馬卡斯的同黨！你被逮捕了，你這個兇手。

original: There's no mistake. You're a wanted man... and it's time to pay for your crimes.
string: 我沒搞錯。你是個通緝犯……現在準備付出代價吧。

original: There's no mistake. You're a wanted woman... and it's time to pay for your crimes.
string: 我沒搞錯。你是個女通緝犯……現在準備付出代價吧。

original: The only mistake was you showing your face. You've committed crimes against Skyrim and her people, and it's time to face the Jarl's justice.
string: 你唯一的錯誤就是還敢出來露面。你已經對天際省和它的人民犯下大罪，準備接受領主的審判吧。

original: The Arch-Mage asked me to see you about class.
string: 首席法師要我負責你的課程。

original: Yes, from what I've heard I expect Tolfdir will be occupied for some time. Hmm, that is a problem, isn't it?
string: 對，就我所聽到的，我想托夫迪爾要忙活一陣子了。嗯，那會成為問題，是嗎？

original: I suppose someone else will need to look after the Apprentices for now.
string: 我想這樣一來，需要其他人來照顧學徒們了。

string: CWSharedInfoStack

original: Good. You've got real fire in you. I like that... Talos guide you.
string: 很好。你滿懷熱情。我很欣賞……塔洛斯指引你。

string: 包在我身上。

string: 我知道我能指望你。

string: 很好，一路保重。

string: 很好。記著——心中念著神，神才眷顧你。

string: 做得好。讓這些狗雜種學會如何敬畏九聖靈。

original: Consider it done.
string: 包在我身上。

original: That's what I wanted to hear. Good luck out there.
string: 正合我意。祝你一路順風。

original: Consider it done.
string: 包在我身上。

string: 戰士，我就知道信得過你。

original: Good luck out there.
string: 祝你好運。

original: Consider it done.
string: 包在我身上。

original: We do this for the good of Skyrim and her people. Never forget that.
string: 我們這麼做都是為了天際和它的子民們。永遠別忘了這一點。

original: Consider it done.
string: 包在我身上。

original: Make me proud.
string: 就看你的了。

original: Consider it done.
string: 包在我身上。

original: May the gods keep you.
string: 願神靈保佑你。

original: Stay sharp out there.
string: 一路小心。

original: Good. Make it it happen, soldier.
string: 很好！弟兄，去搞定它。

original: Show the rebels the futility of their cause.
string: 讓叛徒們知道，負隅頑抗只有死路一條。

original: Consider it done.
string: 包在我身上。

original: As long as the rebels are willing to die fighting the Empire, we must be willing to oblige them.
string: 只要叛軍依舊負隅頑抗，我們就必須時刻準備與之抗衡。

original: Consider it done.
string: 包在我身上。

original: Peace may yet return to Skyrim. But until then, we fight.
string: 和平也許會回到天際省，但是在那之前，我們都不能停止戰鬥。

original: Consider it done.
string: 包在我身上。

original: Don't take too long figuring it out. I've got a war to run here.
string: 別花太長時間。我們這裡的戰鬥可不等人。

original: I see. Well, make it quick, or do you have better things to do than fight for the people of Skyrim?
string: 我明白。好吧，動作快，沒什麼比為了天際省的人民而戰更重要。

original: Well, soldier? Are you up to the task?
string: 戰士？你能完成這個任務嗎？

original: What do you say? Can you do this?
string: 你覺得怎麼樣？你能做到嗎？

original: This won't be easy, but that's why I'm sending you. Think you can handle it?
string: 這事不簡單，這就是為什麼我找你的緣故，能搞定嗎？

original: This won't be easy. But that's why I'm sending you. You got the grit to get this done?
string: 這事不簡單。這就是為什麼我找你的緣故，你有決心搞定它嗎？

original: You gave those mongrels a real whipping, eh? Good work. We'll be sure to send a garrison to reinforce the area and keep the peace.
string: 你給了那些雜種當頭一擊，哈？做得好。我們會多派些人來增援，保持這裡的和平。

original: Excellent! We've hit 'em where it hurts. Repairs will be needed when we take over, but at least the Stormcloaks won't benefit in the meantime.
string: 做得漂亮！給了他們一記迎頭痛擊。我們接管之後還得進行一些維修，但是至少風暴斗篷在這裡再也撈不到半點好處了。

original: We hit 'em where it hurts. As soon as we can, we'll take over - make the needed repairs. In the meantime, the people no longer slave for the Empire.
string: 給了他們一記迎頭痛擊。我們會儘快完成佔領和整修。最起碼，這裡的人們不用再受帝國的奴役了。

original: Well done, indeed. This will be of great service. Understanding the enemy's position makes us all the more equipped to usurp it.
string: 幹得很好。這太有用了。瞭解了敵人據點的部署，我們將它奪回來的勝算又多了幾分。

original: And with the rebels thinking us occupied elsewhere for the time being, we'll be able to take them by surprise.
string: 目前，叛亂軍還以為我們還在別的地方忙，正好有機會可以打他們一個措手不及。

original: Good work. Knowing more about the enemy's position makes it that much easier to take it from him.
string: 做得好。瞭解敵人的部署，我們要想把它奪回來就變得更加容易了。

original: And of course, they'll be caught off guard thinking we're off doing something altogether different.
string: 而且我敢肯定，我們絕對可以殺他們一個措手不及。

string: 你的目標是森加德堡壘。

string: 你的目標就是那些鎮守堡壘的敵人。

original: You're going to the fort.
string: 你要去堡壘那裡。

original: The rebels are keeping some of our men prisoner there. I aim to turn that into an advantage.
string: 叛軍把我們的人都囚禁在那裡。我準備在這一點上做文章，把它變成我們的優勢。

original: I've sent men to scout out the area. You are to meet them, find a way to slip in, free our men, and take over the fort.
string: 我已經派人去勘察了地形。你去和他們碰頭，想辦法打入堡壘內部，解救我們的人，然後佔領那個堡壘。

original: They won't be expecting an attack from the inside.
string: 他們不會想到，我們會從內部偷襲他們。

original: They have some of our boys locked up there. But with a little luck, we can turn that to our advantage.
string: 他們把我們一些人關在那裡。不過要是幸運的話，那可會成為咱們的優勢呢。

original: I've sent some men to scout out the area. Meet them, see if you can't find a way to slip in, free our men, and take over the fort.
string: 我已經派人去勘察了地形。你去和他們碰頭，看是否能找到一條小路鑽進去，解救我們的人，然後佔領那個堡壘。

original: They'll never suspect an attack from the inside.
string: 他們絕對料想不到我們會從內部偷襲。

original: Go in quiet, break our man out, then get out of there. Don't risk combat if you can avoid it. If you can't, then give 'em hell.
string: 悄悄溜進去，救出咱們的人，然後趕緊出來。儘量避免戰鬥、不要冒險。萬一非打不可，就送他們見鬼去吧。

original: Go quiet, break him out, then run. This isn't a suicide mission. Don't risk combat if you can avoid it. If you can't, then give 'em hell.
string: 溜進去，把他救出來，然後就跑。這任務不是派你去自殺，能夠避免戰鬥，就別冒險。萬一戰鬥不可避免，就給他們點顏色瞧瞧。

string: 你能想像得出這背後蘊藏了怎樣的力量嗎？

original: We never should have pulled that thing out of Saarthal.
string: 我們根本就不應該把那東西從薩瑟爾城帶出來。

original: Do you think Ancano knew all along what the Eye was capable of?
string: 你覺得安卡諾會不會一直都知道瑪格努斯之眼的力量？

original: This is going to be terrible for business...
string: 這樣的話做生意可就困難了……

original: You're still alive!
string: 你還活著！

original: Get to the College, before it's too late!
string: 快去學院，不然就來不及了！

original: What are you doing here? You need to get that Staff, or else we don't stand a chance!
string: 你還在這裡做些什麼？ 你得去拿那柄法杖，不然我們一點勝算都沒有！

original: By the gods... what was that?
string: 萬能的聖靈……那是什麼？

original: We need to find out what Ancano's up to.
string: 我們得搞清楚安卡諾要做什麼？

original: I don't know what he's doing, but he won't get away with it.
string: 我不知道他要做什麼，但我知道他絕不可能全身而退。

original: I trust that you'll inform me as soon as the Staff is recovered.
string: 我相信你找到法杖後一定會馬上向我回報的。

original: I hope Mirabelle is helpful in locating the Staff.
string: 希望米拉貝勒能幫你找到法杖。

original: So you're off to find some staff now? I don't see the point of that.
string: 那你現在得去找那個什麼法杖了？我對那毫無頭緒。

original: J'zargo has heard of the Staff of Magnus. Once you are done with it, perhaps you will allow J'zargo to... Borrow it?
string: 紮格聽說過瑪格努斯之杖。你用完之後，能不能讓紮格……借一下？

original: Have you managed to track down the Synod, or the Staff of Magnus?
string: 你有沒有打探到希諾會成員的消息，或者瑪格努斯之杖的消息？

original: Please, tell me you've found the crystal. I've no wish to die in this place.
string: 拜託，告訴我你已經找到水晶了？我不想死在這個地方。

original: Unless you can find that crystal, there's no point in wasting more time with talk.
string: 再繼續說下去就是浪費時間，除非你找到那顆水晶。

original: It's very important you do this correctly.
string: 生死攸關，你不能出錯。

original: Have you managed to track down the Synod, or the Staff of Magnus?
string: 你有沒有打探到希諾會成員或者是瑪格努斯之杖的消息？

original: You got what you came for, didn't you? Go then, back to your college.
string: 你不是得到你要的東西了嗎？走吧，回你的學院去。

original: I hope you have good news for Mirabelle.
string: 希望你為米拉貝勒帶來了好消息。

original: Please, make sure Winterhold is safe!
string: 拜託，一定要保護冬堡的安全！

original: Well? Is everything out there all right?
string: 嗯？一切都還好嗎？

original: Find Savos, and get him back here if you can!
string: 找到薩沃斯，最好能把他帶回來！

original: What's happening? What did you people do?
string: 發生什麼事了？你們在做什麼？

original: You brought this on us! You!
string: 都是因為你！因為你！

original: Please, whatever you did, just make it stop!
string: 拜託了，不管你做了什麼，別再繼續下去了！

original: What's going on out there? What happened?
string: 什麼情況？發生什麼事了？

original: Did you make something bad happen?
string: 你是不是闖禍了？

original: I'm not seeing things again, am I?
string: 這應該不是我的幻覺吧，是嗎？

original: Whatever it is you're up to at the College, you need to fix this at once!
string: 不管你來學院到底所為何事，現在你得馬上解決眼前這件事！

original: What have we gotten ourselves into now?
string: 我們現在又捲入了什麼麻煩？

original: Well, this certainly won't help our image.
string: 嗯，顯然這對我們的形象沒有好處。

original: This is not J'zargo's fault!
string: 這不是紮格的錯！

original: By Azura, what's happening?
string: 阿祖拉保佑，發生什麼事了？

original: Shor's blood, what have they done?
string: 朔爾的血，他們做了什麼？

original: What's going on?!
string: 發生什麼事了？！

original: This can't be happening!
string: 這不可能！

original: The Arch-Mage is dead! Dead!
string: 首席法師死了！死了！

original: Protect yourself! We're under some kind of attack!
string: 保護好自己！我們遭遇了襲擊！

original: We've got to stay focused.
string: 我們得集中精神。

original: We never should have brought that thing here!
string: 我們根本不應該把那東西帶來！

original: I hope this isn't something I did.
string: 雖然這不是我的錯……

original: If this is somehow your fault...
string: 如果這是你的錯的話……

original: Welcome to the Midden.
string: 歡迎來到枯骨地牢。

original: Is it true? One of the Psijics was here in the College?
string: 真的假的？一個賽伊克人現在在學院裡？

original: No one's heard from the Psijic Order in so many years. Hard to believe one would just suddenly show up here.
string: 賽伊克教團已經銷聲匿跡很多年了。他們的人突然造訪實在令人驚異。

original: J'zargo regrets that there was no chance to speak with the Psijic Monk.
string: 紮格沒機會和賽伊克修道士說到話。紮格感到十分遺憾。

original: You must excuse me. I shouldn't be here.
string: 請原諒。我不應該在這裡的。

original: It is good to meet you in person.
string: 很高興能和你見面。

original: How could you just leave me here?
string: 你怎麼能把我丟在這裡不管？

original: Well, everything worked out nicely, didn't it?
string: 嗯，一切順利，不是嗎？

original: I've got to get out of here.
string: 我得出去才行。

original: Why did I ever come here?
string: 我為什麼要來呢？

original: Please! Help me!
string: 拜託！幫幫我！

original: Don't leave me here!
string: 別把我丟在這裡！

original: Urag can be very helpful. Just don't antagonize him.
string: 烏拉格會是個好幫手。不要惹到他就行了。

original: Well, you're certainly making a name for yourself.
string: 嗯，你真是令人刮目相看啊。

original: I understand you're the one that found this... Orb in Saarthal.
string: 我知道是你找到了它……薩瑟爾城的球體。

original: You have what you came for. Now leave.
string: 你已經得到了你要找的東西。離開吧。

original: Take your books and go, before I change my mind.
string: 趁我還沒改變主意，拿你的書快走。

original: Do we have a deal?
string: 我們成交嗎？

original: This thing from Saarthal. What does it do? J'zargo cannot say.
string: 這個來自薩瑟爾城的東西。它是用來做什麼的？紮格不會說的。

original: I hear you found some... thing in Saarthal. You think it could help make me a powerful mage?
string: 聽說你在薩瑟爾城找到了個……東西。你覺得它能讓我變成一個強大的法師嗎？

original: We shouldn't have been disturbing Saarthal, no matter what you found down there.
string: 不管在那找到了什麼，我們都不該去薩瑟爾城為自己找麻煩。

original: At least something good came out of that trip to Saarthal. I didn't find anything but dust.
string: 至少去薩瑟爾城之旅有收穫。我這邊什麼收獲也沒有。

original: What should I do if there's no class?
string: 要是沒課的話我應該做些什麼呢？

original: Well, perhaps it's time for some independent study.
string: 嗯，可能應該抽時間做點獨立研究。

original: Check with Urag gro-Shub in the Arcanaeum. See if he's aware of any references to this... thing that you and Tolfdir found.
string: 去秘藏館找烏拉格．格洛-舒布聊聊。看看他對你和托夫迪爾找到的這個……東西有沒有什麼看法。

original: I'd like to know as much as we can about it.
string: 最好不放過任何蛛絲馬跡。

original: I need to get into the Pelagius Wing.
string: 我要進佩拉吉奧斯側廳。

original: Absolutely not. That wing has been sealed for hundreds of years, and for good reason. They say the ghost of Pelagius the Mad still haunts it.
string: 絕對不行。那處翼廊已經封閉了幾百年，這麼做是有充足的理由的。聽說佩拉吉奧斯瘋子皇帝的鬼魂仍在裡面陰魂不散。

original: Ghost or not, there are reminders of his dark rule that are best left buried away.
string: 不管有沒有鬼，當年他黑暗暴政所留下的遺物最好永遠不要重見天日。

original: Not on your life. It's dangerous in there, and Falk doesn't even like me and Erdi going in every year to clean out the spiders.
string: 不可能。裡面很危險，佛可就連我和艾迪每年去清掃蜘蛛網都不想要我們去。

original: Oh, I'd get in trouble for that. It's not allowed. Besides, it's scary in there!
string: 噢，這會讓我惹上麻煩。那是被禁止的。而且，那個地方很嚇人啊！

original: What's wrong with you?
string: 你是怎麼一回事？

original: You! You'll help me! You help people, right? That's what you do?
string: 你！你會幫我的！你樂善好施，對不對？你一向如此！

original: You have done admirably, little one.
string: 你表現得非常出色，小子。

original: You have helped rid the Orcs of Yamarz in a way that avoids the destruction of their tribe.
string: 你幫助獸人把亞馬茲除掉，避免他們的部族遭受毀滅。

original: They will become stronger for it. And you... You have proven your strength.
string: 他們以後會變強大的。而你……你證明了自己的力量。

original: You have earned my favor for now, mortal, and so I give you a little gift. Use it well.
string: 你暫時獲得了我的恩寵，凡人，所以我要給你一個小禮物。好好利用它。

original: You, place that hammer on the shrine. You're the only one who's proven worthy in all of this...
string: 你，去把那錘子放在聖壇上。到現在為止唯有你是有資格的……

original: You'll have to prove yourselves, but I'm willing to give you a chance. Gularzob's in charge now. Let's hope he's a better chief.
string: 你們需要證明自己，但我打算給你們一次機會。現在由古拉佐伯接管這裡。讓我們期待他會是個好領袖吧。

original: So he has been punished? And what of us? What fate shall we suffer?
string: 也就是說他被處罰了？那我們呢？我們會被如何處置？

original: Yamarz was a coward and a weakling. His deceitful ways have cost you all greatly.
string: 亞馬茲是個懦夫兼廢物。他那些欺騙的手段讓你們付出了慘痛的代價。

original: He fought bravely, but the giant overwhelmed him.
string: 他勇敢地戰鬥，但他完全不是那巨人的對手。

original: Ah, that is good to hear, then.
string: 啊，我很高興聽到這件事。

original: He asked me to kill the giant, then attacked me.
string: 他讓我去殺那頭巨人，事後又攻擊我。

original: What? Why would he do such a thing?
string: 什麼？他怎麼做出這種事？

original: I have returned with Shagrol's Hammer.
string: 我帶回來了煞葛洛的錘子。

original: But... What of Yamarz?
string: 但是……亞馬茲呢？

original: I see. He did not survive. He... He died well?
string: 我知道了。他犧牲了。他……他死的時候不痛苦吧？

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

original: Has the time come? Will I now serve the Night Mother?
string: 時機成熟了嗎？我可以遵從夜母的指示行事了嗎？

original: DB04AstridPlayerProceeResponse1
string: DB04AstridPlayerProceeResponse1

original: Of course, Astrid. What is it?
string: 當然，阿斯垂德。什麼事？

original: Hmm?
string: 嗯？

original: No. No! Listen, I don't know what's going on here, but you take your orders from me. Are we clear on that?
string: 不。不！聽著，我不知道出了什麼事，但你得聽從我的命令。明白了嗎？

original: The Night Mother may have spoken to you, but I am still the leader of this Family. I will not have my authority so easily dismissed.
string: 夜母也許真的召見了你，但我仍然是這個大家庭的首領。我不會因為這種可疑的事交出我所建立的權勢。

original: I... I need time to think about all this. Go see Nazir - do some work for him. I'll find you when I'm ready to discuss the matter further.
string: 我……我需要點時間好好想想。你去找納茲爾吧——幫他幹點活。我準備好的時候自然會找你討論接下來的事。

original: So I should go to Volunruud? I should talk to this man?
string: 所以我應該去沃倫魯德？然後找出這個人談談？

original: Volunruud? Well, that is interesting. I know this place...
string: 沃倫魯德？嗯，這就好玩了。我知道這個地方……

original: He's in some place called Volunruud.
string: 他在一個叫沃倫魯德的地方。

original: Amaund Motierre? I have no idea who that is.
string: 阿蒙德．莫提雷？沒聽說過。

original: But Volunruud... that I have heard of. And I know where it is.
string: 不過沃倫魯德……我聽過這個地名。我知道它的位置。

original: I must speak to someone named Amaund Motierre, in Volunruud.
string: 我必須見一個叫阿蒙德．莫提雷的人，他在沃倫魯德。

original: By Sithis.
string: 西帝斯保佑。

original: And... what did she say?
string: 那……她怎麼說？

original: Yes.
string: 是的。

original: What?
string: 什麼？

original: So Cicero wasn't talking to anyone else. Just... the Night Mother's body?
string: 也就是說西塞羅當時根本不是在和其他任何人說話。而是跟……夜母的聖體？

original: And the Night Mother, who, according to everything we know, will only speak to the person chosen as Listener... just spoke. Right now...
string: 根據我們所掌握的所有知識，夜母只會和被選中成為聆聽者的人開口……而她開口了。就在剛才……

original: ...to you?
string: ……對你？

original: It's true. The Night Mother spoke to me. She said I was "the one."
string: 是真的。夜母昭示了我。她說我就是「被選中的」。

original: AstridConfrontListenerResponse1
string: AstridConfrontListenerResponse1

original: Then what in Sithis' name is going on? Cicero spoke to the Night Mother, but she spoke to you? Is this just more of the fool's rambling?
string: 我的西帝斯啊，這都是怎麼回事？西塞羅和夜母說話，但她卻對你開口了？這該不會又是一個瘋子的瘋話吧？

original: Yes, I'm fine.
string: 是的，我很好。

original: It's true, it's true! The Night Mother has spoken! The silence has been broken! The Listener has been chosen!
string: 是真的，是真的！夜母真的說話了！沉默被打破了！被選中的聆聽者已經出現了！

original: What? The Listener? What are you going on about? What is this lunacy?
string: 什麼？聆聽者？你在說什麼？你瘋了吧？

original: I spoke only to the Night Mother! I spoke to the Night Mother, but she didn't speak to me. Oh no. She spoke only to him! To the Listener!
string: 我只和夜母說話！我和夜母說話，可是她從不向我開口。噢不。她只對那個人說話！對聆聽者！

original: I spoke only to the Night Mother! I spoke to the Night Mother, but she didn't speak to me. Oh no. She spoke only to her! To the Listener!
string: 我只和夜母說話！我和夜母說話，可是她從不向我開口。噢不。她只對那個人說話！對聆聽者！

original: Are you all right? I heard the commotion. Who was Cicero talking to? Where's the accomplice? Reveal yourself, traitor!
string: 你沒事吧？我聽到了騷動。西塞羅在跟誰說話？幫兇在哪裡？現身吧，叛徒！

original: By Sithis, this ends now! Back away, fool! Whatever you've been planning is over!
string: 以西帝斯之名，結束這場鬧劇吧！退下，愚者！你的計劃穿幫了！

original: No! Someone help me! Please!
string: 不！誰來幫幫我！求求你們！

original: I've heard you dabble in necromancy.
string: 我聽說你正開始涉足死靈法術。

original: I beg your pardon?
string: 你說什麼？

original: Why are these mages in Fellglow Keep?
string: 這些法師到光落堡壘來幹什麼？

original: Let's just call it a "difference of opinion" with the College.
string: 姑且把這稱為和學院的「意見相左」吧。

original: They were interested in research that goes outside the bounds of what the College allows, so they were... persuaded to leave.
string: 他們的研究興趣已經超出學院所允許的領域，所以他們……被迫離開。

original: Who is this Orthorn?
string: 這個奧拓恩是什麼人？

original: He was an Apprentice here at the College. Not very skilled, but got involved with a group of mages who took a liking to him.
string: 他是在學院裡學習的一個法師學徒。並沒有相當優秀，但是卻有一些志趣相投的法師把他拉入了他們的小團體。

original: When they left, he took off after them. Stole supplies and books from the College, I suppose as a way to ingratiate himself.
string: 他們離開的時候，他也在不久後步其後塵。他經常回學院偷盜物資和書籍，我覺得那是他為尋求精神愉悅的一種方式。

original: You don't have anything that can help?
string: 你真的沒有可以幫到我們的東西嗎？

original: I said not anymore. Orthorn stole a number of books when he ran off to Fellglow Keep to join those Summoners. Some kind of peace offering.
string: 我說過已經沒有辦法了。奧拓恩偷了很多書逃去光落堡壘，就是為了加入那群召喚師。那些書是給他們作為友好的贈禮。

original: I think one of those volumes may have had some relevant information. If you want them, you'll have to talk to Orthorn.
string: 我想那些書裡面說不定會有一本記載了相關的資訊。要是你想找到它們，得去問奧拓恩。

original: I need to learn about something we found in Saarthal.
string: 我需要知道一些關於在薩瑟爾城發現物體的資訊。

original: I know what you want. Word travels fast around here. Discovered some big mystery, huh?
string: 我知道你想要什麼？在這裡流言傳得很快。你發現了什麼大秘密對吧，嗯？

original: Well you don't even need to ask. No, I don't have anything for you. Not anymore, anyway.
string: 好吧其實你根本不用問我。沒有，我沒什麼能幫你的。總之，已經沒有辦法了。

original: The last of the hunters is dead.
string: 最後一個獵殺者已經死了。

original: Thank you for your help. I will make my home here, away from anyone I might hurt.
string: 謝謝你的幫助。我會在這裡定居，離那些可能會被我傷害的人們遠遠的。

original: I cannot defy Hircine. You have to die.
string: 我不能違背海爾辛的意志。你必須死。

original: I will spare your life.
string: 我會放過你。

original: Thank the gods. Now let's deal with these other hunters. We hunt together!
string: 感謝神明。現在讓我們來解決剩下的獵手們。一起狩獵吧！

original: I've been told to kill you.
string: 有人要我來殺你。

original: And I would deserve it, wouldn't I?
string: 而那是我應得的，對嗎？

original: I can't stop you if that's what you want to do. Hircine is too powerful.
string: 如果你心意已決那我沒法阻止你。海爾辛實在太過強大。

original: But if you spare me, I can be a powerful ally to you. And I would promise to never return to civilized life.
string: 但是如果你放我一條生路，我可以成為你的一個強而有力的幫手。而且我可以保證永遠不回歸人群。

original: I know now that I can't live among people.
string: 我現在明白我不可能在人群中生活。

original: I hear you attacked a little girl.
string: 我聽說你攻擊一個小女孩。

original: A little girl is dead because of me.
string: 有一個小女孩因我而死。

original: Believe me, it wasn't anything I ever intended to do. I just... lost control.
string: 相信我，我絕對不是故意的。我只是……失控了。

original: I tried to tell them, but none of them believe me.
string: 我試圖告訴他們，但沒人相信我。

original: It's all on account of this blasted ring.
string: 都是這該死的指環。

original: Why are you imprisoned here?
string: 你為什麼被關在這裡？

original: Believe me, it wasn't anything I ever intended to do. I just... lost control.
string: 相信我，我絕對不是故意的。我只是……失控了。

original: I tried to tell them, but none of them believe me.
string: 我試圖告訴他們，但沒人相信我。

original: It's all on account of this blasted ring.
string: 都是這該死的指環。

original: Move along.
string: 走啊。

original: Some kind of choir. With chanting.
string: 像是唱詩班在吟誦的那種吧。

original: Screaming?
string: 尖叫？

original: Um... the lute? No, drums!
string: 嗯……是笛子？不，是鼓聲！

original: Welcome home.
string: 歡迎回家。

original: Silence, my brother.
string: 靜寂，我的兄弟。

original: What is the music of life?
string: 人生的音樂是什麼？

original: Oh ho. The whimpering Nord, eh? Yes, yes, I can see how you'd come to that conclusion. Interesting choice.
string: 噢不。哭泣的諾德人，哈？是啊，是啊，我明白你是怎麼得出那個結論的了。真是有趣的選擇。

original: Ah, the feisty goodwife. Quite the mouth on her. Someone must have wanted her dead... right?
string: 啊，暴躁的主婦。她的嘴真是不得了。肯定有人不止一次想弄死她……對吧？

original: The conniving Khajiit. Cat like that was sure to have enemies. It's no wonder you chose him.
string: 陰險的虎人。像這樣的小貓肯定樹敵不少。你選他實在是意料之中。

original: The blubbering barbarian and the tenacious mother. Must have been one of them, right?
string: 愛哭的野蠻人或強橫的母親。你覺得是他們其中之一，對吧？

original: The timid warrior and the sly Khajiit. Must have been one or the other, right?
string: 老是怯場的戰士和油滑的虎人。總有一個是對的，是吧？

original: Hmm. The fearless wife and mother, and the underhanded Khajiit. Had to be one of them, right? Interesting choice.
string: 嗯。無畏的主婦兼母親，還有陰險狡詐的虎人。必定是其中的某一個，對嗎？真是有趣的選擇。

original: Well, well. Aren't we the overachiever. Three possibilities, three victims. Must have been one of them, right? So why take chances...
string: 很好，很好。我們真是賺大了。三種可能性，三個受害者。答案肯定就在他們當中，是吧？那做什麼還費勁去選……

original: Remember, the Sanctuary is in the southern Pine Forest. Just beneath the road, and away from prying eyes.
string: 記好，聖所在密松林的南部。趕路時要儘量避開大道，小心堤防那些密探。

original: Ah, at last! I hope you found the place all right.
string: 啊，終於來了！我希望你一路上是安然無恙的。

original: You. You must take the Lexicon. Free me of my burden.
string: 你。你必須帶上方典。幫我從重擔下解脫出來吧。

original: I'm here to deliver a message.
string: 我是來傳消息的。

original: Reeaaaallllyyyy?
Ooh, ooh, what kind of message? A song? A summons? Wait, I know! A death threat written on the back of an Argonian concubine! Those are my favorite.
string: 噢，噢，什麼樣的消息？一首歌？一張傳票？等等，我知道了！寫在一個亞龍人富翁的情婦的背部的殺人威脅！那是我最喜歡的。

original: Well? Spit it out, mortal. I haven't got an eternity!
string: 怎樣？快說啊，凡人。你當我時間無限多啊！

original: Actually... I do. Little joke.
string: 其實……真的是無限多。開個小玩笑。

original: But seriously. What's the message?
string: 不過說真的。到底什麼消息？

original: Hafrumph! Well then, if you're going to be like that... Perhaps it's best I take my leave. A good day to you sir. I said good day!
string: 呀啊！好吧，你如果堅持用這種態度……我還是走比較好。祝你今天愉快，先生。我說祝你愉快！

original: Yes, yes, as you've said, countless times before...
string: 好，好，就像你說的，從前曾經無數次……

original: You are the best Septim that's ever ruled. Well, except for that Martin fellow, but he turned into a dragon god, and that's hardly sporting...
string: 你是有史以來最卓越的塞普汀。嗯，當然咱們不把馬丁那個老傢伙算進來，他最後居然變成了龍神，那可不是鬧著玩的……

original: You are far too hard on yourself, my dear, sweet, homicidally insane Pelagius. What would the people do without you? Dance? Sing? Smile? Grow old?
string: 你對自己要求太高了，我的親愛的、甜美的、嗜血的小瘋子佩拉吉奧斯。要是失去了你，人們會怎麼辦呢？跳舞？歌唱？開懷大笑？慢慢變老？

original: So many undesirables to contend with. Naysayers. Buffoons. Detractors. Why, my headsman hasn't slept in three days!
string: 太多麻煩人要對付了。老唱反調的、出來耍寶的、還有惡意誹謗的。哎，我的劊子手都已經三天沒睡了！

original: Oh, I couldn't. Goes right through me. Besides, I have so many things to do...
string: 噢，不行啊。我喝了不舒服。而且，我還有很多事要忙……

original: More tea, Pelly my dear?
string: 還要茶嗎，佩利我的親親？

original: How rude! Can't be bothered to host an old friend for a decade or two.
string: 太沒禮貌了！招待老朋友十幾二十年都還要被打擾。

original: I have a saying - I'm not going to feel what you have to like. Or something like that.
string: 我說過——我才不管你喜歡什麼？總之就這個意思。

original: Is it just me or is it getting saner and saner these days?
string: 是只有我越來越正常了，還是最近整個世界都趨向於恢復正常？

original: Pelagius stopped by and mentioned he hated you. Or I mentioned he hated you and he agreed.
string: 佩拉吉奧斯那天拜訪時表達出他對你的厭惡。還是我先說他厭惡你之後他表示了贊同。

original: I hope you're having a good time. Actually, I hope I'm having a good time. I could care less about you.
string: 希望你過得愉快。實際上，我希望我過得很愉快，你怎樣我才不在乎。

original: I see you've been minding your own business. So how is the mind business?
string: 我注意到你一直在悶著頭做自己的事。嗯，頭很悶嗎？

original: Do you mind? I'm busy doing the fishstick. It's a very delicate state of mind!
string: 別打擾我了。我正忙著做魚棒棒。這個需要非常精巧的專注力！

original: Please, take pity on an old madman!
string: 求求你了，可憐可憐我這個老瘋子吧！

original: Who among you can help me?
string: 你們誰可以幫我？

original: Wait, hear my plea! My master, he is lost between worlds and I cannot bring him back!
string: 等等，求你聽我說！我的主人，他在兩個世界的間隙裡迷路了，我沒辦法帶他回來！

original: Why does everyone ignore me? Why do you turn your heads? Why will no one help me?
string: 怎麼沒有一個人回答我？你們為什麼都轉過頭去？沒人肯幫我嗎？

original: The flame of my master burns low. Without him, we are all lost and forever gray... Please, help us!
string: 我的主人的生命之火越來越弱了。沒有他，我們的人生會是黑白沒有意義的……拜託了，幫幫我們！

original: Falk asked me to check it out.
string: 佛可要我去調查一下。

original: I'll make an exception for you, but do not bring anything out when you leave. Too many dark deeds transpired in those halls...
string: 為了你我就破例一回，但是你走的時候不能帶走任何東西。那些殿堂內發生過太多的罪惡了。

original: Falk, you know I'll be careful.
string: 佛可，你知道我會小心的。

original: Well... I suppose in that case, it's okay to let you in. But only briefly. Be careful, and come right back!
string: 好吧……如果這樣的話，那讓你進去應該沒什麼不妥吧。但是只能停留一會。小心點，看完就出來！

original: If you really want to... Just be careful of the ghost! He snuck up on me once and scared me sick. It took a week for me to feel better...
string: 如果你真的想……要小心那個幽靈！他有一次從背後偷襲我嚇掉了我半條命。我休息了一個星期才勉強清醒……

original: Who is your master?
string: 你的主人是誰？

original: He is a great man, but one rarely praised! He rules twin empires that span the length and breadth of our minds! All know him, but few can name him!
string: 他是個偉人，但是不被世人所理解！他同時執掌兩個帝國，它們的疆域和歷史超出了我們想像力的極限！所有人都知道他存在，但幾乎沒人能叫出他的名字！

original: But... he has forbidden me from saying his name. He says it distracts him, and woe to those who draw his ire.
string: 但是……他嚴令禁止我說出他的名字。他說那會讓他分心，讓他生氣可是會有後果的。

original: But you will know him when you see him. He's the one who made me like this!
string: 但是你見到他就知道他是誰了。是他把我塑造成現在的模樣！

original: How can I find your master?
string: 我怎樣才能找到你的主人？

original: Last I saw him, he was visiting a friend in the Blue Palace. But no one as mundane as the Jarl. No, no... such people are below him.
string: 我最後一次見到他的時候，他正在藍宮拜訪一個朋友。不過不是像領主那樣的俗人。不，不……那樣的人根本不配見他。

original: No, he went into the forbidden wing of the palace, to speak with an old friend. Said it had been ages since they had last had tea.
string: 不，他跑到宮殿的禁區去找老朋友說話去了。說他們好久都沒聚過了。

original: Oh and you'll need the hip bone... it's very important. No entering Pelagius' Wing without that.
string: 噢對了你需要那個髖骨……它很重要。只有拿著它才能進入佩拉吉奧斯側廳。

original: What do you need?
string: 你想要什麼？

original: My master has abandoned me! Abandoned his people. And nothing I say can change his mind.
string: 我的主人拋棄了我！他拋棄了他的子民。不管我說什麼他都不會改變心意。

original: Now he refuses to even see me. He says I interrupt his vacation! It's been so many years... Won't you please help?
string: 現在他甚至都不願意見我。他說我打擾了他的休假！這樣已經好幾年了……你真的不肯幫我嗎？

original: Without his guidance, our homeland is falling apart. North wages war against south! The holy flame flickers and dies! We need his return.
string: 沒有他的領導，我們的家鄉正變得支離破碎。南方對北方發動了戰爭！那些可怕的戰火和慘不忍睹屍體！我們需要他的回歸。

original: Oh, but... I'm sure he'll repay you when he comes to his senses! His favor is a powerful, powerful thing. And so very worth any... inconveniences.
string: 噢，但是……我肯定他要是清醒過來的話會付給你報酬的！他的獎賞都是非常、非常強大的東西。所以也值得任何……小小的犧牲。

original: Why do you need him back?
string: 為什麼你想讓他回來？

original: Here are the books that went missing.
string: 這是當時不見了的那些書。

original: Well, well. And you seem to be in one piece!
string: 很好，很好。而且你好像平安無事！

original: Thank you. I'll look these over, and inform Mirabelle if I find anything relevant.
string: 謝謝。我會好好查閱這些資料的，要是找到什麼線索的話我會馬上通知米拉貝勒。

original: "Night of Tears", eh? I remember this one. Well, isn't that interesting.
string: 「淚之夜」嗎？我記得這本書。好吧，這本書其實沒那麼有趣。

original: Did you read it yourself? If I recall it correctly, that has some interesting implications. You should mention that to Tolfdir.
string: 你讀過了嗎？要是我沒記錯，那裡面會有一些很有趣的暗示。你應該跟托夫迪爾說說這件事。

original: And... here. I suppose you've earned these.
string: 還有……給你這個。我想這是你應得的。

original: You needed to know more?
string: 你需要知道更多？

original: You again? We have nothing else to discuss. Now move.
string: 又是你？我們沒什麼好說的。給我滾。

original: You again? We have nothing else to discuss. Now move.
string: 又是你？我們沒什麼好說的。給我滾。

original: Why are you following me? I told you, I don't know anything else!
string: 你跟著我做什麼？我說過了，其他的我什麼都不知道！

original: Look, I've told you everything. Now leave me alone!
string: 我說，我知道的事已經被你套得一乾二淨了。你就別煩我了！

original: Our business has concluded and you're standing in my way.
string: 我們之間的交易已經完成了，現在你是在擋我的路。

original: Ah, I see you have the wine. Hand it over and we'll talk.
string: 啊，你拿到葡萄酒了。把它交給我，然後我們再來聊。

original: No Firebrand Wine yet? How disappointing.
string: 還沒找到火牌葡萄酒？好失望呀。

original: Hmmm, you again. What is it this time?
string: 嗯，你又來了。這次是什麼事？

original: What did you need?
string: 你想要什麼？

original: Aringoth was a fool to think he could get away with this.
string: 阿林格斯還以為他能脫身，真是蠢到家了。

original: No time for idle chatter. Mercer is awaiting your presence.
string: 沒時間閒聊。墨瑟正等著你去見他。

original: Is there anything we can do?
string: 我們能做些什麼嗎？

original: Mercer thinks he knows a way to identify this new thorn in our side. He wants to meet with you right away.
string: 墨瑟說他知道怎麼揪出我們身邊這根新出現的毒刺。他要你馬上去找他。

original: And if I were you I'd hurry. I've never seen him this angry before.
string: 如果我是你的話我絕不會這麼慢吞吞的。我從沒見過他發這麼大脾氣。

original: I warned you not to cross Maven. If I hadn't stepped in and paid amends, you'd be... well, I think you know.
string: 我警告過你不要惹到瑪雯走。要不是我介入，付了賠償金，你就……嗯…你自己知道。

original: At least Sabjorn has found himself in Whiterun's prison. How unfortunate for him.
string: 至少撒布喬恩一覺醒來能發現自己被關在白漫城的監獄。他可真是不幸。

original: Word on the street is that poor Sabjorn has found himself in Whiterun's prison. How unfortunate for him.
string: 坊間傳言說可憐的撒布喬恩一覺醒來發現自己身處白漫城的監獄。他真是不幸啊。

original: What are you gawking at? Can't you see I have problems here?
string: 你他媽的發什麼呆？沒看見我有麻煩了嗎？

original: Maven said you're expecting me.
string: 瑪雯叫我來找你。

original: I'm going to keep this short 'cause we've got a lot to do.
string: 考慮到我們還有很多事要做，我就長話短說吧。

original: Honningbrew's owner, Sabjorn, is about to hold a tasting for Whiterun's Captain of the Guard and we're going to poison the mead.
string: 蜜之釀酒莊的老闆，撒布喬恩，準備為白漫的衛兵隊長舉行一次品酒會，而我們準備在那蜜酒裡投毒。

original: How about we skip the conversation?
string: 你看我們略過這段對話如何？

original: You're a firebrand, aren't you?
string: 你喜歡煽動人心，承認吧。

original: It's about time Brynjolf sent me someone with business sense. I was beginning to think he was running some sort of beggar's guild over there.
string: 布林喬夫早該派一個稍微懂點生意的人跟我談。要不然我會以為他在營運一個丐幫組織。

original: Brynjolf said you wanted to see me.
string: 布林喬夫說你想見我。

original: So you're the one that burned down Goldenglow Estate.
string: 原來是你燒了金色光輝莊園。

original: Do you have any idea what that little stunt you pulled is going to cost me?
string: 你有沒有想過，你那低劣的搞笑行為會給我帶來多大的麻煩？

original: I'm amazed you even bothered to show your face here.
string: 我真驚訝你居然還敢來露面。

original: So, you're the one. Hmm. You don't look so impressive.
string: 那，就是你了。嗯。你看起來很不起眼。

original: You're a madman.
string: 你是個瘋子。

original: Jolly good guess!
string: 猜得不錯！

original: But only half right. I'm a mad god. The Mad God, actually. It's a family title. Gets passed down from me to myself every few thousand years.
string: 但是只對了一半。我是個瘋狂的神。實際上，我就是瘋神。這是個世襲頭銜。每過幾千年就會由我傳給我自己一次。

original: Now you. You can call me Ann Marie.
string: 至於你。你可以叫我安．瑪麗。

original: But only if you're partial to being flayed alive and having an angry immortal skip rope with your entrails.
string: 如果你想要被活剝皮然後讓一個憤怒的神抽出你的內臟跳跳繩的話。

original: If not... Then call me Sheogorath, Daedric Prince of Madness. Charmed.
string: 如果不是……那就叫我謝爾格拉：瘋狂魔侯。很榮幸見到你。

original: All I know is that your people need you to return.
string: 我只知道你的子民盼望你的回歸。

original: Yaaawwwwnn....
string: 呵啊啊啊欠……

original: Oh, pardon me. Were you saying something? I do apologize, it's just that I find myself suddenly and irrevocably...
string: 噢，對不起。你剛才說什麼？真的很抱歉，我剛剛發現自己突然無可救藥地……

original: Bored!
string: 無聊！

original: I mean, really. Here you stand, before Sheogorath himself, Daedric Prince of Madness, and all you deem fit to do is... deliver a message? How sad.
string: 我的意思是，真的。現在你的面前，就是謝爾格拉本人，瘋狂魔侯，而你要做的只是……傳達消息？真是悲慘。

original: I'm afraid I don't know, sir.
string: 我真的不知道，先生。

original: Wrong!
string: 錯！

original: Actually, you do. Sort of.
string: 實際上，你知道。應該知道。

original: I am a part of you, little mortal. I am a shadow in your subconscious, a blemish on your fragile little psyche. You know me. You just don't know it.
string: 我是你的一部分，可愛的凡人。我是你潛意識裡的一片陰霾，我是你脆弱靈魂中的一個斑點。你瞭解我。你只是還沒感覺到。

original: Sheogorath, Daedric Prince of Madness. At your service.
string: 謝爾格拉，瘋狂魔侯。為您服務。

original: So does that mean you'll leave? Or not?
string: 那意思就是你要離開了？還是要留下？

original: Now that's the real question, isn't it? Because honestly, how much time off could a demented Daedra really need?
string: 那才是真正的問題，不是嗎？憑良心說，一個精神錯亂的魔族需要休息多久才夠？

original: So here's what I'm going to do. I'm going to leave. That's right. I'm done. Holiday... complete. Time to return to the hum drum day-to-day.
string: 所以這就是我要做的。我會離開。沒錯。我好了。假期……結束了。是時候回歸庸庸碌碌的平凡生活啦。

original: On one condition.
string: 有一個條件。

original: You have to find the way out first. Good luck with that.
string: 你得先想辦法出去。祝你好運。

original: I think I made a mistake coming here...
string: 我想我來這裡是個錯誤……

original: Oh, no no no! No mistake at all. What you made was a choice. Granted, not a very wise choice, but these things happen. Ah, the folly of youth...
string: 噢，不不不！不是錯誤。你只是做了一個選擇。不是很明智的選擇，但事情有時候就是這樣。啊，年輕就是這樣……

original: You know, you remind me of myself at a young age. All I cared about was riding narwhales and sleeping in honeycombs and drinking babies' tears...
string: 跟你說，你讓我想起了我年輕的時候。那時候我滿腦子只想著去騎一角鯨、去蜂窩裡睡覺還有去喝小嬰兒的淚水……

original: Word of advice if you ride a Narwhale. Mind the pointy end.
string: 騎一角鯨的免費建議。注意尖的那一頭。

original: Ah, but there I go, waxing poetic about my misspent youth. Now where were we? Ah yes. You're the mortal messenger. An I am...?
string: 啊，我居然會為了那浪費掉的青春時代吟著小酸詩。我們剛才說到哪裡了？啊對了。你是來報信的凡人。而我是……？

original: Honestly. Have you any idea?
string: 老實說。你知不知道？

original: So you need me to bring him back?
string: 所以你希望我把他帶回來？

original: Yes, but don't try to use force! He's far too mighty. He'd crush you like a clay doll, or drop you from the sky, or simply eat your brain right up!
string: 是的，但別想要動粗！他實在太強大了。他能把你像個泥娃娃一樣碾碎，或是從天空把你摔下來，又或是把你腦袋直接咬掉！

original: Oh, but he probably won't do those things to you. Probably. Just remind him to come home, and... there'll be no fighting or unpleasantness. Probably.
string: 噢，但是他不一定會這樣子對你。不一定。務必告訴他要回家，還有……不會有人吵架或是鬧得不愉快。應該不會。

original: He's just a little confused at the moment, is all. Knowing my master, he may very well reward you for bringing him to his senses!
string: 他現在只是有點迷茫，沒別的。我瞭解他，你幫他恢復裡智他一定會好好回報你的！

original: Yes, yes, go. Leave me to my ceaseless responsibilities and burdens...
string: 是啊，是啊，走吧。就讓我溺死在無盡的責任和負擔中吧……

original: How can I get to your master?
string: 我怎麼才能見到你的主人？

original: He stays in the Pelagius Wing of the Blue Palace. The doors are locked, and only Falk Firebeard can grant entry.
string: 他在藍宮的佩拉吉奧斯側廳。那裡的門被封了，只有透過佛可．火鬍才能進去。

original: But I hear the maids, Una and Erdi, know how to enter it for cleaning. Surely they can help for such an important matter?
string: 但我聽說有兩個女僕，烏娜和艾迪，可以進去打掃。這麼重要的事情她們肯定會幫忙的吧？

original: Why don't you leave your master?
string: 你為什麼不離開你的主人？

original: Oh, you just don't understand. Without him, I am not free! Without him, I am doomed! All of his empire shall fall into chaos...
string: 噢，你不懂。沒有他，我不自由！沒有他，我就完了！他的帝國將會陷入混亂……

original: I was asked to retrieve you from your vacation.
string: 有人讓我來打斷你的休假。

original: Were you now?
string: 是這樣子的嗎？

original: By whom?
string: 誰？

original: Wait! Don't tell me! I want to guess!
string: 等等！先別說！我要猜一猜！

original: Was it Molag? No, no... Little Tim, the toymaker's son? The ghost of King Lysandus? Or was it... Yes! Stanley, that talking grapefruit from Passwall.
string: 是莫拉格？不，不……玩具匠的兒子，小提姆？利桑杜斯國王的鬼魂？還是……對了！斯坦利，那個帕斯沃爾來的會說話的葡萄柚。

original: Wrong on all accounts, aren't I?
string: 我是不是全錯了？

original: Ha! No matter! Honestly, I don't want to know. Why ruin the surprise?
string: 哈！沒關係！老實說，我一點都不想知道。何必浪費這個驚喜呢？

original: But more to the point. Do you - tiny, puny, expendable little mortal - actually think you can convince me to leave?
string: 不過說正經的吧。像你這樣的凡人——渺小，脆弱，短命——你覺得你真能說服我離開嗎？

original: Because that's... crazy. You do realize who you're dealing with here?
string: 因為那……太瘋狂了。你難道不知道自己在跟誰說話嗎？

original: Okay, what's the catch?
string: 說吧，你有什麼計謀？

original: Ha! I do love it when the mortals know they're being manipulated. Makes things infinitely more interesting.
string: 哈！我最喜歡看到凡人知道自己被操控的表情了。事情會變得無比有趣。

original: Simple.
string: 很簡單。

original: Is it?
string: 是嗎？

original: It's too bad they executed Roggvir before we got here.
string: 要是我們趕到之前羅吉維爾就被他們處死了的話可就不妙了。

original: They say Helgen got hit by a dragon. One of those horrors comes here, we'll be ready.
string: 聽說聖地鎮被龍襲擊了。要是那種怪物來這裡，我們會對付牠的。

original: Brigands I can handle, but this talk of dragons? World's gone mad, I say.
string: 土匪我能對付得了，但你說的是龍？

original: The Greybeards have summoned the Dragonborn to High Hrothgar. Such a thing has not happened for... hundreds of years.
string: 灰鬍子召喚龍裔前去高吼峰了。這種事已經……好幾百年沒發生過了。

original: There was a fight down in the Ratway, but reports are... sketchy. Some say it was Thalmor Agents, others say Thieves Guild. Some say it was both.
string: 在鼠道發生了一場鬥毆，但是回報結果……十分含糊。有人說是梭默特使，另外一些人說是盜賊公會。還有說兩者都有的。

original: Word is Elenwen's furious. Big party at the Thalmor Embassy, and one of the guests went someplace they shouldn't. Caused quite a commotion.
string: 據說愛琳溫最近很暴躁。在梭默大使館舉行的盛大的聚會裡，有一個客人進入了不該進的地方。這事造成了很大的騷動。

original: Have you heard? There's been another dragon attack. Kynesgrove, this time.
string: 你聽說了嗎？又有龍發動攻擊。這次在凱娜之林。

original: What could it mean? The return of the Dragonborn? And who among us could possibly hold that honor? And such power?
string: 這意味著什麼呢？龍裔回來了？我們之中有誰有這麼大的面子？和這麼強的力量？

original: By the gods, it's true, isn't it? A dragon has attacked Whiterun. How could mere men bring down such a beast?
string: 神吶，這是真的，對不對？一隻龍襲擊了白漫。人類怎麼可能打敗這樣一隻神獸呢？

original: By Ysmir, you did it. You killed a dragon.
string: 以伊斯米爾之名，你做到了。你殺死了一隻龍。

original: There's been talk amongst the guards. That you are... Dragonborn. But such a thing... Surely that's not possible...
string: 最近衛兵們經常聊起你。他們說你是……龍裔。但是這種事……怎麼可能嘛。

original: The guards in Dragonsreach say you've aided the Jarl. On behalf of Whiterun, I thank you.
string: 龍臨堡的衛兵說你協助了領主。我代白漫感謝你。

original: I've seen you helping the Jarl. If only all visitors to Whiterun were as noble.
string: 我看到你幫了領主。要是每個來訪白漫的外鄉人都這麼正直勇敢該多好。

original: It was you convinced the Jarl to trap that dragon in the keep. And by Ysmir, it actually worked.
string: 是你說服領主同意把那條龍困在要塞裡的。而且伊斯米爾作證，你的計策很成功。

original: There's a dragon. Here. In Dragonsreach. And I thought it was just a name.
string: 在這裡有隻龍，就在龍臨堡裡。我以為這名字只是個噱頭。

original: We had that beast contained. And you released it! Why? Why would you do such a thing?
string: 我們困住了那頭野獸。你卻把它放了！為什麼？為什麼你要這麼做？

original: Is it true what they say? There was a dragon held captive in Whiterun, and you... you released it? By the gods, man, why?
string: 他們說的是真的嗎？白漫的人抓到了一頭龍，而你……你放走了牠？天哪，拜託，這是為什麼？

original: Is it true what they say? There was a dragon held captive in Whiterun, and you... you released it? By the gods, woman, why?
string: 他們說的是真的嗎？白漫的人抓到了一頭龍，而你……你放走了牠？天哪，拜託，這是為什麼？

original: The Greybeards have arranged a truce between the Stormcloaks and Imperials. How long can such a thing last?
string: 在灰鬍子的斡旋下風暴斗篷和帝國之間達成了停戰協定。這能維持多久？

original: The Greybeards have called a peace council, at High Hrothgar. And can you believe it - both Ulfric Stormcloak and General Tullius have agreed to go.
string: 灰鬍子安排了一個和平會談，在高吼峰。而且你能相信嗎——烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷和圖留斯將軍居然都同意出席。

original: Word is spreading like magefire! The great evil has been vanquished! You have truly saved us all!
string: 消息就像法師的火法術一樣快速蔓延！巨大的邪惡已經被消滅！你救了我們所有人！

original: All hail the Dragonborn!
string: 龍裔萬歲！

original: In the ancient tongue, you are Dovahkiin - Dragonborn!
string: 用古語的叫法，你就是都瓦克因——龍裔！

original: You! You're the one who wiped out the Dark Brotherhood! All the guards are talking about it... You're a hero to us all!
string: 你！你就是那個驅逐了黑暗兄弟會的人！所有的衛兵都在談論這個話題……你是我們公認的英雄！

original: You hear the news? The Emperor has been murdered! Right here, in Skyrim. By the gods, if the Dark Brotherhood can do that, nobody's safe...
string: 你聽說了嗎？皇帝被殺了！就在這裡，在天際省。神啊，要是黑暗兄弟會能做到這種程度，那就沒有他們殺不了的人了……

original: By the gods. The Emperor's been murdered. On his own ship... moored in the inlet. It was... the Dark Brotherhood. There was nothing we could do...
string: 諸神保佑。皇帝被刺殺了。就在港灣裡停泊著的……他自己的私人船隻上。是……黑暗兄弟會做的。我們什麼也做不了。

original: That old woman who runs the orphanage has been murdered. Say, didn't I see you coming out of there...?
string: 經營孤兒院的老太婆被殺了。話說，那天我好像看到你從那裡出來……？

original: Been a murder, over in Riften. Some old lady who runs an orphanage. Those poor children must be heartbroken.
string: 在裂谷城，發生了一起謀殺。被害者是經營孤兒院的一位年老女性。那些可憐的孩子們一定很傷心。

original: Hey! You're the one who killed Alain Dufont, up in Raldbthar. Oh yeah, word about that got around. Man was a piece of bandit trash, is what I hear.
string: 嘿！你不是那個到過拉德巴爾的，殺了亞蘭．杜鋒特的人嗎？噢當然，那種傳聞總是跑得比光快。我聽到的版本裡，你從事山賊這種很垃圾的職業。

original: The Emperor's cousin, killed. Right here in Solitude. I feel nothing but shame...
string: 皇帝的表妹被殺了，就在這個獨孤城裡！羞恥和悲傷佔據了我內心的全部……

original: The cousin of the Emperor was murdered! In Solitude, at her own damn wedding. Not a chance we would have let that happen here.
string: 皇帝的表妹被刺殺了！就死在獨孤城，死於她的婚禮上。我們不該讓這種事在這裡發生啊。

original: You didn't hear this from me, but we've uncovered a plot to kill the Emperor! It gets better. The ringleader? One of the Emperor's own elite guard...
string: 我可能沒跟你說過，但我們確實發現了一個刺殺皇帝的陰謀！主謀？是皇帝本人的精英衛隊裡的一個人！

original: There was some ruckus over by that weird black door. You weren't involved in that craziness, were you?
string: 那邊的怪異的黑色大門處發生了一次瘋狂的騷動。你沒有被捲進去吧，對不對？

original: Been lots of people coming and going through that creepy black door. And noises...  I'd say it sounds like construction, but that's crazy. Right?
string: 有很多人在那黑門裡進進出出。有很多噪音……我覺得很像在施工，但是那也太怪了。你說呢？

original: There are some that say the Dark Brotherhood is back, and stronger than ever. That they've made Dawnstar their home. Tell me - am I wrong?
string: 有人說黑暗兄弟會重出江湖了，而且比以前更強大。還說他們盤踞在晨星城。告訴我——我說的不會是真的吧？

original: The guards have been saying things about you... That you're the one that... Well... They say the Dark Brotherhood... Well. Never mind. Sir.
string: 衛兵們最近經常談論你……他們說你就是那個……呃……他們說黑暗兄弟會……算了。我什麼也沒說。先生。

original: The guards have been saying things about you... That you're the one that... Well... They say the Dark Brotherhood... Well. Never mind. Ma'am.
string: 衛兵們最近經常談論你……他們說你就是那個……呃……他們說黑暗兄弟會……算了。我什麼也沒說。夫人。

original: Wait, I know you. You went into the Emperor's Tower, just before... before his decoy was murdered...
string: 等等，我認識你。你進過皇帝的塔樓，就在……就在他的替身被殺之前……

original: We just received word that somebody tried to kill the Emperor! Turned out to just be his double, but can you imagine if he had succeeded?
string: 我們剛得到線報說有人試圖刺殺皇帝！雖說最終只是殺了個替身，可是你敢想像萬一得逞了會怎麼樣嗎？

original: They're saying the Dark Brotherhood has been destroyed. Wiped off the face off Tamriel. But that's not entirely true... is it?
string: 傳說黑暗兄弟會已經被剿滅了。在泰姆瑞爾大陸的地面上絕跡了。但這不是全部的真相……對嗎？

original: You're the one all the guards are talking about. You went into that Sanctuary... wiped out the Dark Brotherhood! Friend, I owe you a drink.
string: 你就是衛兵們天天在說的那個人吧。你進了那個聖所……然後消滅了黑暗兄弟會！兄弟，我應該請你喝一杯。

original: The city's changed, friend. The Thieves Guild is on the rise... and they've got a firm foothold here in Whiterun.
string: 這座城變了，朋友。盜賊公會日漸壯大……他們在白漫城的勢力逐漸深根。

original: Maybe you haven't heard, but the Thieves Guild is back. Windhelm is their city now, if you catch my meaning...
string: 可能你還沒聽說，盜賊公會復出了。風舵城現在是他們的地盤，你懂我的意思吧……

original: Markarth's a different place, now. Do business here, and you do business with the Thieves Guild.
string: 馬卡斯城跟以前不同了。在這做生意，就得和盜賊公會打交道。

original: A change has swept into Solitude, like a breeze off the ocean - the Thieves Guild has come...
string: 獨孤城面臨了一次改革，就像拂過海面的清風——盜賊公會來了……

original: Ain't no doubt about it. The Thieves Guild is back, and they've got Riften in their grip.
string: 信不信由你。盜賊公會又回來了，他們已經掌控了裂谷城 。

original: Welcome to Riften, home of the Thieves Guild. Or so they'd have you believe. It's all lies. They're just thugs... vermin, creeping around the Ratway.
string: 歡迎來到裂谷城 ，盜賊公會之鄉。其實這名頭不過是他們自己的炒作。全是胡說。他們全是惡棍……害蟲，在鼠道裡爬來爬去。

original: The say the College has been snooping around Saarthal. Mages in a burial crypt. No good can come of that...
string: 他們說學院最近在薩瑟爾城周邊有所動作。有法師在墓穴裡活動。恐怕不會幹出什麼好事……

original: Some are saying the Psijic Monks have been seen in Skyrim. They're an ancient order. I had 'em figured for dead.
string: 傳說最近賽伊克修道士出現在天際省各地。他們是一個古老的組織。我一直以為他們已經消失了。

original: You hear the news? Those damn mages blew up Winterhold! Guess it was just a matter of time...
string: 你還沒有聽說嗎？那些該死的法師炸毀了冬堡！用猜的也知道不過是時間問題而已……

original: Word is the College of Mages is back to normal. If there's such a thing for that lot.
string: 聽說法師學院已經恢復正常了。如果像他們一樣的地方有很多就糟了。

original: Your name's been cleared... by Thonar Silver-Blood. Consider yourself lucky.
string: 托納爾．銀血幫你恢復名聲了……你應該感到慶幸。

original: So Madanach was behind those murders. Gods help us.
string: 也就是說邁德納奇是那幾起殺人事件的幕後主使。願神保佑我們。

original: By Shor, is that... is that Azura's Star? How did you come to possess such a rare treasure?
string: 朔爾神啊，那是……那是阿祖拉之星嗎？你怎麼會有這種稀世珍寶？

original: Who did you have to kill to get that blade?
string: 你是殺了誰才得到那把刀的？

original: That is one... big hammer.
string: 我真是一把……很大的錘子。

original: That mace... get it away from me. Get it away...
string: 那個釘錘……別讓我看見它。把它拿走……

original: Your shield... Dwarf-make, is it not? But yet it seems so much... more.
string: 你的盾……矮人製造，對吧？但是似乎並不是……這麼簡單。

original: That hammer... Why that's Aegisbane, heirloom of Clan Shatter-Shield! Last I heard, it was stolen by a couple of swindlers. Alain and... Muiri. Yeah.
string: 那個錘子……那不是神盾之禍嗎，碎盾氏族的傳家之寶！我最後一次聽到它的消息，是它被兩個騙子偷走了。亞蘭和……莫瑞。對。

original: What a foul and unnatural weapon you wield. Never have I seen its like.
string: 你拿著的兵器真是又邪惡又詭異。我從沒見過這樣的傢伙。

original: Ugh. Your breath is foul. What've you been eating?
string: 呃。你的口臭真嚴重。你吃什麼了？

original: As if Skyrim didn't have enough outsiders. Now we've got mercenaries from Hammerfell struttin' about...
string: 好像天際省的異鄉人還不夠多似的。現在我們又有了來自落錘省的傭兵四處遊蕩……

original: From what I hear, you're the one gave the Thalmor a black eye. Sure know how to pick your enemies, don't you?
string: 我聽說，你就是那個把梭默搞得無地自容的傢伙。你可真會挑敵人。

original: You've come to Dawnstar at a strange time, friend. Seems everyone in the town is having nightmares...
string: 你真是挑了個奇怪的時間來晨星城，我的朋友。最近好像全鎮的人都深陷噩夢……

original: The damned nightmares have finally stopped. Don't suppose you'd know anything about that?
string: 該死的噩夢終於停止了。我想你應該不知道怎麼回事吧？

original: You've been seen in the company of the Companions. That's an honorable path you're on, friend.
string: 有人看見你和戰友團的人在一起。你選擇了一條光明的道路，朋友。

original: I know of your deeds, and am honored to address a member of the Companions.
string: 我聽過你的事蹟，我很榮幸能和一位可敬的戰友團成員談話。

original: Uch. Been tending your hounds? You smell like wet dog.
string: 呃……你剛照顧你的狗嗎？你聞起來像條落水狗。

original: Heard about what you did. Killing those foul witches. Well done, Companion.
string: 我聽過你的壯舉。殺掉了那群令人作嘔的巫婆。做得好，戰友。

original: Kodlak killed, Jorrvaskr attacked. How could this happen, within the walls of Whiterun?
string: 克拉科被殺，勇士之家遭襲。在白漫城城牆之內，怎麼會發生這種事？

original: I heard about the attack on Jorrvaskr, and the killing of your honored leader. You have my sympathies, Companion.
string: 我聽說了勇士之家遭到襲擊，也聽說了你們敬愛的首領遇害。我表示同情，戰友。

original: Kodlak White-Mane has been laid to rest, I know. May his soul live forever in the halls of Sovngarde.
string: 我知道克拉科．白鬃已經走了，但願他的靈魂永駐在英靈殿裡。

original: You... you're the Harbinger. Of the Companions. It is my honor to stand before you.
string: 你……你是先驅。戰友團的先驅。能站在你面前實在是我的榮幸。

original: I hear the East Empire Company has reopened, thanks in no small part to you. Well done. All of Skyrim benefits from their trade.
string: 據說東帝國貿易公司重新開張了，真是多虧了你。你做得太好了。天際所有人民都會從他們的貿易中獲益。

original: You did this city a great service by catching that killer. Well done.
string: 抓住那個兇手是你為這個城市做出的一大貢獻。你做得很好。

original: Good thing you did for Nurelion, retrieving that phial for him before he died. Man was obsessed.
string: 你為努瑞萊昂做了好事，你在他快死的時候為他帶來了那雪瓶。他感激涕零。

original: By Ysmir, you've helped save the Gildergreen. Words can't express what that means to this city.
string: 伊斯米爾神保佑，你幫我們拯救了鍍綠樹。任何言語都無法表達這對這座城有多重要。

original: That sapling you recovered means the Gildergreen will live again. Your deed honors the people of Whiterun.
string: 你找到的那個小樹苗意味著鍍綠樹會繼續存活。你的善舉為白漫人帶來了榮光。

original: You've actually done it. You've found the Sybil of Dibella. You have done Markarth a tremendous service.
string: 你真的做到了。你找到了蒂貝拉的先知。你為馬卡斯城做出了巨大的貢獻。

original: You... you were talking to that murderous savage. And then he escaped. What are you hiding?
string: 你……你和那個野蠻的殺人犯說話。然後他就逃跑了。你是不是隱瞞了什麼？

original: First Torygg and now Elisif. Damn those Stormcloaks. Let's hope that Erikur fares better than they did.
string: 先是托依格然後是艾利西弗。該死的風暴斗篷。希望艾瑞克爾不要步上他們的後塵。

original: Filthy she-hound Elisif got what she deserved. Let her serve as "High Queen" of Oblivion, for all I care.
string: 醜惡的母獵犬艾利西弗得到了應有的懲罰。就讓她去當湮滅的「至高女王」吧。

original: Solitude wouldn't be the same without the Fire Festival. City owes you a debt of gratitude.
string: 沒有火焰節的話獨孤城就不再是獨孤城了。我們欠你一個大人情。

original: It's no secret the Aretino boy is doing some ritual, trying to call the Dark Brotherhood. But who's going to stop him? Me? I'll have no part of that.
string: 眾人皆知艾瑞提諾在進行某種儀式，企圖叫出黑暗兄弟會。但誰會去阻止他呢？你說我？我可不想跟這事有所牽扯。

original: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Watch the magic!
string: 喂！喂！喂！小心你的魔法！

original: Go cast your fancy magic someplace else.
string: 到別處放你那花俏的魔法。

original: Guard might get nervous, a man approaches with his weapon drawn...
string: 衛兵可能會緊張，當一個手持兵器的男人走過來的時候……

original: Guard might get nervous, a woman approaches with her weapon drawn...
string: 當一個手持兵器的女人走過來的時候，衛兵可能會緊張，……

original: Sheathe those claws, Khajiit...
string: 把你的爪子收起來，虎人……

original: You come up to me, fists raised? You looking for a beating?
string: 你來找我，還舉著拳頭？你是來找打的嗎？

original: Releasing a captured dragon. I don't think I'll ever understand that one...
string: 放出一條被捕的龍。我覺得我不可能理解這行為……

original: Whatever you need, Dragonborn. Just say the word.
string: 隨便你要什麼，龍裔。隨你吩咐。

original: Yes, Dovahkiin? How can I help you?
string: 我在，都瓦克因？需要幫忙嗎？

original: You have vanquished a great evil from Skyrim. You have saved this land... and our very souls.
string: 你消滅了盤踞天際省的邪惡勢力。你拯救了這片大陸……和我們的靈魂。

original: No matter what else happens, the guards will always be grateful for everything you've done.
string: 不管還會發生什麼，所有衛兵都感激你所做的一切。

original: Looks like it's really happening. A peace council, attended by both Ulfric and Tullius, up on High Hrothgar. Maybe there's hope for Skyrim yet.
string: 看來真的成功了。一個和平會談，有烏弗瑞克和圖留斯同時出席，在高吼峰舉行。說不定天際省真的還有一線希望。

original: This truce with the Stormcloaks won't last a fortnight. Bloody savages will kill us while we sleep.
string: 跟風暴斗篷達成的停戰協定撐不了兩周。那些殘暴的野蠻人會讓我們在睡夢中喪命。

original: A truce? With the Imperials? They'll murder us all, first chance they get.
string: 停戰協定？和帝國人？只要給他們一絲機會，他們就會殺光我們所有人的。

original: I caught a glimpse of that captured dragon. It's.. beautiful. In its own way.
string: 我瞄了被抓的那隻龍一眼。它……很漂亮。一種很獨特的美。

original: Trapping a dragon in Dragonsreach. Damn clever idea you had, I have to admit.
string: 在龍臨堡設陷阱抓捕一隻龍。我得承認，這真他媽的是個好主意。

original: You have the Jarl's confidence, friend. And so you have mine.
string: 朋友，領主對你信任有加。所以我也信任你。

original: You couldn't possibly be the Dragonborn of legend. Could you?
string: 你不會是傳說中的龍裔吧。真的嗎？

original: If we killed a dragon once, we can do it again. With your help, of course.
string: 如果我們殺死過一隻龍，我們肯定能再殺死一隻。當然，必須有你在。

original: If those Whiterun guards can take down a dragon, so can we.
string: 要是那幫白漫衛兵能打倒一隻龍，我們也能。

original: Got to thinking, maybe I'm the Dragonborn, and I just don't know it yet.
string: 我在想，可能我真是龍裔，只是我還沒發現而已。

original: For a dragon to attack Kynesgrove... Why? Why there? Is no place safe?
string: 一隻龍襲擊了凱娜之林……為什麼？為什麼是那裡？世界上沒有安全的地方了嗎？

original: If I'd been on guard at the Thalmor Embassy, wouldn't nobody be disturbing that party...
string: 如果是我駐守梭默大使館的話，絕對沒人能擾亂那個聚會……

original: Thalmor in the Ratway? What's next, Spriggans in the Bee and Barb?
string: 鼠道裡出現梭默？下一個是什麼？蜂與鉤裡出現樹精？

original: I have to wonder... what does the Dragonborn do once he's summoned by the Greybeards? Can the Thu'um be taught, like any skill?
string: 我很想知道……被灰鬍子召喚的龍裔有多大本事？吐姆可以訓練嗎，像一般的劍術一樣？

original: You know, I could have gone into that Sanctuary. Killed all those Dark Brotherhood types. But I was... sick that day.
string: 你知道，我本來可以進那個聖所的。殺光黑暗兄弟會的人。不過我那天……生病了。

original: Helgen... destroyed by a dragon. Hard to believe, isn't it?
string: 聖地鎮……被一隻龍摧毀了。難以置信，對吧？

original: I know who you are, assassin. I guess the rumors about your kind's "extinction" have been... exaggerated.
string: 我知道你是誰，刺客。那些關於你們這行「絕跡」了的傳言應該是……被誇大了的吧。

original: So the Emperor had a decoy. Poor bastard got murdered, too. But then, I guess that was his job...
string: 原來皇帝有替身。可憐鬼就這樣被殺了。不過我想，那也是他的工作吧……

original: Now, I know who you are. And... and I know your business... Just, please... These are good folk we got here. Mostly...
string: 好了，我知道你是誰了。而且……我知道你的目的……只是，拜託你……這些人都是好人。大部分都是……

original: It ain't true what they say about you and... and the Dark Brotherhood? Is it?
string: 他們說的關於你和……黑暗兄弟會的事不是真的吧？對吧？

original: There are stories about you, and dark tidings in Dawnstar...
string: 關於你的故事有很多，關於你和晨星城的地下勢力……

original: Seems the Emperor's coming to Skyrim... and one of his own protectors was going to have him assassinated. Can't trust anyone these days.
string: 聽說皇上到了天際省……而他的一個保鏢想要刺殺他……這年頭不能輕信任何人了。

original: I heard you were at the wedding of the Emperor's cousin. In Solitude? Gods, that must have been horrible...
string: 我聽說你出席了皇帝的表姐妹的婚宴。是在獨孤城吧？天哪，場面肯定很可怕……

original: I heard you were at the wedding of the Emperor's cousin. In Solitude? Gods, that must have been horrible...
string: 我聽說你出席了皇帝的表姐妹的婚宴。是在獨孤城吧？天哪，場面肯定很可怕……

original: Look, that Vici woman had a bodyguard. I know it's terrible she got murdered at her own wedding, but the city guard is hardly to blame...
string: 你看，那個叫薇齊的女人有一個保鏢。我知道她在自己的婚禮上被殺是件很慘痛的事，但是城衛兵應該是沒有責任的……

original: You ask me, those brats in the orphanage are better off, now that old Grelod is dead.
string: 我倒是覺得啊，老桂羅死了，對孤兒院裡的那幫小鬼不是什麼壞事。

original: The Emperor's cousin Vittoria Vici is getting married soon. The reception will be public - anyone in Solitude can attend.
string: 皇帝的表姐妹維多利亞．薇齊就快要結婚了。婚禮對大眾開放——到時候只要是待在獨孤城的人都可以參加。

original: The Emperor of Skyrim. Dead. These are dark times, my friend. Dark times, indeed...
string: 天際省的皇帝。他死了。這是黑暗的時期，我的朋友。黑暗時期，真的……

original: We may guard Whiterun, but the Thieves Guild guards us. If you know what I mean.
string: 我們可以保衛白漫城，但是盜賊公會保護我們。你知道我的意思吧？

original: Shirking the law in Windhelm ain't what it used to be. Not with the Thieves Guild running things...
string: 在風舵城，弄些偷雞摸狗的事已經不同以往了。自從盜賊公會開始操縱一切之後……

original: Break the law here in Markarth, and maybe we can work something out. Courtesy of the Thieves Guild.
string: 想觸犯馬卡斯城的法律的話，或許我們可以一同合作。盜賊公會敬上。

original: You know, the law here in Solitude can be a bit... "flexible." So long as you've got the gold. That's the way the Thieves Guild likes it.
string: 你知道，在獨孤城這裡，法律是可以稍微……「變通的」。只要你有錢。這就是盜賊公會喜歡的方式。

original: Seeing as how Riften is home to the Thieves Guild, maybe we can work something out if you have trouble with the law. For the right price.
string: 裂谷城畢竟是盜賊公會的老家，當你遇到法律難題的時候可以來和我們一起共度難關。價錢公道喲。

original: The Thieves Guild used to run this city. Now they're nothing but braggarts and bullies, rotting to death down in their Ratway...
string: 盜賊公會以前控制著這座城市。現在他們的人除了愛吹牛之外就是當流氓，每天在他們的鼠道裡混吃等死……

original: What business do College mages have in a place like Saarthal, anyway? It's a place for Nord dead... not your weird experiments.
string: 不管怎樣，魔法學院法師在薩瑟爾城這種地方能有什麼事？這是諾德人的葬屍地……不是你們的實驗室。

original: One of the guards said he saw a mage appear out of thin air. Claimed it was one of those Psijic Monks. Man's been hitting the skooma, I say.
string: 有一個衛兵說看見一個法師憑空出現。據他說那是一個賽伊克修道士。要我的說，這傢伙肯定嗑了斯庫瑪。

original: Imagine, blowing up an entire town. Damn College... Winterhold will never be the same.
string: 想像一下，炸毀一整個鎮的慘況。該死的魔法學院……冬堡永遠無法回到過去了。

original: You're that Mage from the College. Right? Hear things have finally calmed down over there.
string: 你是那個魔法學院來的法師？對吧？聽說你們那的事終於平息了。

original: You put those Forsworn down. Good job.
string: 你擺平了那些棄誓者。做得好。

original: Gods damn those Forsworn. So many dead...
string: 被神詛咒的棄誓者。死了這麼多人……

original: You see those warriors from Hammerfell? They've got curved swords. Curved. Swords.
string: 你看到那些從落錘省來的戰士了嗎？他們有弧形彎劍。弧形的。劍。

original: Wonder what it's like for those Thalmor, now that they've been taken down a notch...
string: 這回那些梭默被狠狠地挫了銳氣，真想知道他們是什麼表情。

original: The people here are still plagued with nightmares. It's... unnatural.
string: 那些人仍然飽受噩夢的折磨。這件事……很蹊蹺。

original: No more nightmares. Thank the gods for that.
string: 沒有噩夢了。感謝諸神保佑。

original: Now I remember - you're that new member of the Companions. So you, what - fetch the mead?
string: 現在我想起來了——你是戰友團新來的成員。那你工作是什麼——幫人倒蜜酒？

original: Honored Companion. How can I assist you?
string: 尊敬的戰友。您需要我怎麼協助您？

original: Is that... fur? Coming out of your ears?
string: 那是……獸毛嗎？從你耳朵裡長出來的？

original: I'm telling you, I heard it. Howling. Those werewolf tales are true.
string: 我告訴你，我聽到過嚎叫。那些狼人傳說是真的。

original: I find your wolfish grin... unsettling.
string: 你那像狼一樣的微笑……我看了很不安。

original: With respect, Companion, I'd ask that you and your friends muzzle that dog of yours. The howling coming from Jorrvaskr has gotten out of hand.
string: 恕我無禮，戰友，希望您和您的友人可以幫狗套上鼻籠。勇士之家傳出的嚎叫聲已經到了難以忍受的地步。

original: If it isn't the slayer of the Glenmoril Witches. How can I assist you, Companion?
string: 這不是格侖摩利女巫的屠殺者嗎？我能幫您做什麼，戰友？

original: Who would dare attack the leader of the Companions? In his own hall? There'll be blood for this, I know it.
string: 是誰膽敢攻擊戰友團的領導人？而且還是在他本人的大殿裡？我知道，這會演變成流血事件的。

original: Kodlak White-Mane is in a better place now. For is there any place better than Sovngarde?
string: 克拉科．白鬃現在在一個更好的地方。你說有什麼地方比英靈殿更美好？

original: Thanks again for helping reopen the East Empire Company. Gonna have them import me some of that aged Breton cheese.
string: 感謝你為東帝國貿易公司重新開業所做的一切。我打算讓他們進口給我一些歷史悠久的布萊頓乳酪。

original: I was this close to catching that killer. I swear it.
string: 我當時差一點抓到那個兇手。我發誓。

original: With Nurelion gone, I suppose Quintus has taken over business in the White Phial.
string: 努瑞萊昂不在了，我想奎因圖斯應該接管了雪瓶的事。

original: The Gildergreen blooms again. All thanks to you.
string: 鍍綠樹再次綻放了花朵。這都是你的功勞。

original: The Gildergreen will bloom again. All thanks to you.
string: 鍍綠樹將會再次綻放花朵。這都是你的功勞。

original: Thanks for clearing out that vampire nest. You saved Morthal.
string: 感謝你掃平了那個吸血鬼巢穴。你拯救了墨索爾城。

original: Wonder what kinds of things they've got the Dibella doing, over in the temple. Mostly praying, I reckon...
string: 不知道他們讓蒂貝拉在那座廟裡做些什麼事。多半是祈禱吧，我猜……

original: I know you had some part in Sinding's escape. Don't deny it...
string: 我知道辛丁的逃脫和你有關。別否認了……

original: We'll protect Erikur as best we're able, but I fear the throne of Solitude is cursed.
string: 我們會盡最大努力保護艾瑞庫爾，但我擔心獨孤城領主的寶座已經被詛咒了。

original: It is whispered that one of the Daedric Princes himself is behind the murder of Elisif. It would seem even the nobility of Oblivion favors our cause.
string: 坊間傳言說一位魔侯親自策畫了艾利西弗的刺殺行動。看樣子連湮滅的王族也站在我們這一邊。

original: Watch the skies, traveler.
string: 小心天上，旅人。

original: Stay out of trouble, Argonian.
string: 別多管閒事，亞龍人。

original: What is it, Argonian?
string: 什麼事，亞龍人？

original: Stay out of trouble, lizard.
string: 別多管閒事，蜥蜴。

original: Staying out of trouble, kinsman?
string: 應該不想惹禍上身吧，我的兄弟？

original: How can I help a brother Nord?
string: 我怎麼才能幫助一個諾德兄弟？

original: Stay out of trouble, Nord.
string: 別多管閒事，諾德人。

original: Don't cross me, Elf.
string: 別惹到我，精靈。

original: Stay out of trouble, Elf.
string: 別多管閒事，精靈。

original: What is it, Elf?
string: 什麼事，精靈？

original: Stay out of trouble, Khajiit.
string: 別多管閒事，虎人。

original: What is it, Khajiit?
string: 什麼事，虎人？

original: What do you want... cat?
string: 你想做什麼……小貓？

original: Stay out of trouble, Redguard.
string: 別多管閒事，紅衛人。

original: What is it, Redguard?
string: 什麼事，紅衛人？

original: Stay out of trouble, Imperial.
string: 別多管閒事，帝國人。

original: What is it, Imperial?
string: 什麼事，帝國人？

original: Stay out of trouble, Orc.
string: 別多管閒事，獸人。

original: What is it, Orc?
string: 什麼事，獸人？

original: Hail, Companion.
string: 喲呵，戰友團的。

original: You're that one from the College. Heard about you.
string: 你是那個從學院來的吧。我聽過你。

original: So you can cast a few spells. Am I supposed to be impressed?
string: 那你應該會用法術嘍。我是不是應該表現出很崇拜的樣子？

original: Try to hide it all you want. I know you're in the Thieves Guild... and so do the other guards.
string: 你想怎麼藏就怎麼藏吧。我知道你是盜賊公會的人……其他衛兵也都知道。

original: Psst. Hey, I know who you are. Hail Sithis.
string: 噓！嘿，我知道你是誰。西帝斯萬歲！

original: Ugh. That armor stinks of death. You been grave robbing?
string: 呃。那副防具散發著死人的味道。你是盜墓者嗎？

original: Ah, now that's a fine shield. And not mere Dwarven... is it?
string: 啊，一個品質上乘的盾牌。而且不僅僅是矮人製造的那麼簡單……對吧？

original: What manner of staff is that? Such a horror...
string: 那是什麼法杖？真是可怕……

original: You wield... Azura's Star? How... how can such a thing be possible?
string: 你拿的是……阿祖拉之星？你怎麼……怎麼可能會有這種東西？

original: Ah, Aegisbane. Sigil of Clan Shatter-Shield. But didn't that get stolen awhile back? Hmph. Must be rememberin' wrong.
string: 哇，神盾之禍。碎盾氏族的象徵。但那東西不是才剛被偷了嗎？嗯，應該是我記錯了。

original: Fine armor you've got there. Dwarven make, am I right?
string: 你這套防具真不錯啊。矮人製造，我說的對嗎？

original: Ebony armor. By Ysmir, 'tis a wondrous sight.
string: 黑檀岩護甲。天吶，看起來太美了。

original: Is your armor made of... dragon bones? By the gods, what I wouldn't do for a set of that.
string: 你的盔甲是……龍骨製成的？我的神靈啊，要是給我一套叫我做什麼都行。

original: Is your armor made of... dragon scales? By the gods, what I wouldn't do for a set of that.
string: 你的盔甲是……龍鱗製成的？我的神靈啊，要是給我一套叫我做什麼都行。

original: Some advice, friend. That armor won't offer much protection in a real fight.
string: 給你一個建議，朋友，那件盔甲在實戰中是沒什麼防禦力的。

original: You come talking to me wearing Imperial armor? You got stew for brains?
string: 你穿著帝國的盔甲來跟我說話？你的腦子是燒壞了嗎？

original: That's some fine Imperial armor you've got there.
string: 你這身帝國盔甲挺神氣的。

original: Judging by your armor, I'd say you're an Imperial scout. If so, well met.
string: 從你的護甲上看，你是個帝國斥候。如果是的話，你好啊！

original: For your sake, I hope your took that armor from a dead Imperial scout...
string: 我倒希望你的護甲是從一個死掉的帝國斥候身上剝下來的……

original: You wear the armor of a mercenary. Now that's the life.
string: 你穿的是傭兵護甲，這才是人生啊。

original: That's good armor you've got there, friend. Iron, solid and true.
string: 你的護甲不錯啊，朋友，實實在在的鋼甲。

original: Hmph. You wear that armor well. Iron may be simple, but it'll stop enough to keep you in the fight.
string: 嗯。你穿的護甲不賴嘛。鋼甲雖然簡樸了點，但在戰鬥中能保住你的小命。

original: Fancy the leather armor, huh? Something to be said for going light.
string: 偏愛皮甲喔？據說十分輕便。

original: That armor... it's like nothing I've ever seen. Like forged midnight...
string: 這副盔甲……我從沒見過這種材質，像是用漆黑的午夜鍛造出來的……

original: Orcish armor, hmm? Had me a set of that once. Ugly and strong, like those that forged it.
string: 獸族護甲？唔，我曾經給人做過一套。這些護甲就像它們的鍛造者一樣，又醜又堅韌。

original: That armor... Are you one of the Emperor's protectors? Can't say I envy you that job.
