original: You have to train a good war dog from a pup. Bite your arm clean off otherwise.
string: 你得從小狗一直訓練，否則可能會把你胳膊咬下來。

original: Ondolemar is the commander of the Thalmor in Markarth.
string: 昂多勒馬是馬卡斯城地區梭默的指揮官。

original: Worship of Talos is strictly forbidden.
string: 嚴禁崇拜塔洛斯。

original: What's that supposed to prove? Get back on patrol!
string: 那又能證明什麼？回去巡邏！

original: But, I've got the key to the Sabre Cage! Look!
string: 但是我有關劍齒虎的籠子鑰匙啊！看！

original: Pfft
string: 呸。

original: Troll's blood was he a tough one!
string: 那傢伙不好對付！

original: Take down that one with your bare hands too?
string: 那次你也是靠空手拿下的？

original: Yeah, why?
string: 對啊，怎麼？

original: Wasn't our last catch a Cave Bear?
string: 上次不是捕了一隻洞穴熊嗎？

original: Why, you don't think I could do it?
string: 怎麼，你覺得我做不到？

original: So, you're saying you brought that cat down alone?
string: 那，你是說你一個人就把那隻大貓給除掉了？

original: You are on the right path, and you will prevail.
string: 你若是走在對的道路上，就會成功。

original: You will be called on to take swift action. Rise to the challenge, and discover what you are capable of.
string: 你會被賦予緊急行動。勇敢接受挑戰吧，發現自己的長處。

original: It is imperative that you return to your College at once.
string: 你必須立即趕回你的學院。

original: You have done well thus far, but trying times are ahead.
string: 你目前為止一直做得不錯。但之後要做的事的會更加艱難。

original: Maybe he's looking for something to eat?
string: 也許他在找東西吃？

original: Maybe she's looking for something to eat?
string: 也許她在找東西吃？

original: He might find something good in there. One man's trash is another's treasure.
string: 他也許會在這找到好東西。各有所好嘛。

original: She might find something good in there. One man's trash is another's treasure.
string: 她也許會在這找到好東西。各有所好嘛。

original: The poor dear must truly be hungry to comb through rubbish like that. Hope he finds something edible.
string: 這可憐的人一定是餓壞了，垃圾桶翻個底朝天。真希望他能找到點吃的。

original: The poor dear must truly be hungry to comb through rubbish like that. Hope she finds something edible.
string: 這可憐的人一定是餓壞了，垃圾桶翻個底朝天。真希望她能找到點吃的。

original: Sometimes it pays to look in every nook and cranny.
string: 到處都仔細找找總是有收穫的。

original: Sometimes it pays to look in every nook and cranny.
string: 到處都仔細找找總是有收穫的。

original: When you're hungry, you'll look anywhere for food. Can't blame him.
string: 人要是餓了就會到處找吃的，不能怪他。

original: When you're hungry, you'll look anywhere for food. Can't blame her.
string: 人要是餓了就會到處找吃的，不能怪她。

original: Desperate times call for desperate measures. Maybe he found what he was looking for in there.
string: 特殊時刻就要用特殊手段。也許他找到要找的東西了。

original: Desperate times call for desperate measures. Maybe she found what she was looking for in there.
string: 特殊時刻就要用特殊手段。也許她找到要找的東西了。

original: How unfortunate he has to dig through refuse like that. Someone should give him a piece of bread.
string: 需要翻垃圾真是可憐。誰給他片麵包吧。

original: How unfortunate she has to dig through refuse like that. Someone should give her a piece of bread.
string: 需要翻垃圾真是可憐。誰給她片麵包吧。

original: You never know what you'll find laying around in a crate or barrel. People toss the darnedest things in them.
string: 你根本不會知道箱子或桶子裡都是些什麼？人們把最骯髒的東西都往裡面扔。

original: You never know what you'll find laying around in a crate or barrel. People toss the darnedest things in them.
string: 你根本不會知道箱子或桶子裡都是些什麼？人們把最骯髒的東西都往裡面扔。

original: What's he doing poking his nose in there?
string: 他到底想找什麼？

original: What's she doing poking her nose in there?
string: 她到底想找什麼？

original: Is he... sifting through trash?
string: 他是在……翻垃圾嗎？

original: Is she... sifting through trash?
string: 她是在……翻垃圾嗎？

original: What's he rummaging around in there for?
string: 他到底在那翻什麼呢？

original: What's she rummaging around in there for?
string: 她到底在那翻什麼呢？

original: Look at him, rummaging through refuse. Wonder what he's lost... besides his mind.
string: 看看他，在這翻垃圾。真好奇除了腦袋之外他到底還丟什麼了……

original: Look at her, rummaging through refuse. Wonder what she's lost... besides her mind.
string: 看看她，在這翻垃圾。真好奇除了腦袋之外她到底還丟什麼了……

original: Tsk. What a man will do for a few coins...
string: 嘖嘖，人為了錢會做出什麼事情呢……

original: Tsk. What a woman will do for a few coins...
string: 嘖嘖，人為了錢會做出什麼事情呢……

original: Picking through garbage. Has he no shame?
string: 撿垃圾。他就沒點羞恥心嗎？

original: Picking through garbage. Has she no shame?
string: 撿垃圾。她就沒點羞恥心嗎？

original: What's he digging around in there for?
string: 他到底在那翻什麼？

original: What's she digging around in there for?
string: 她到底在那翻什麼？

original: What's he doing? Looking for rubies in rubbish? Get a job!
string: 他在做什麼？垃圾堆裡找寶貝嗎？找份工作吧！

original: What's she doing? Looking for rubies in rubbish? Get a job!
string: 她在做什麼？垃圾堆裡找寶貝嗎？找份工作吧！

original: What's this? It thinks it can just throw refuse wherever it likes?
string: 這是什麼？覺得自己可以隨便扔垃圾是吧？

original: Really, the nerve of some people, leaving their trash wherever they please.
string: 真的，這些人真沒品，自己的廢物到處扔。

original: What kind of filthy barbarian just throws their trash on the ground?
string: 什麼樣的野蠻人才到處扔東西啊？

original: Oh, by all means. Just leave your refuse wherever you see fit.
string: 噢，請便。你就到處扔吧。

original: There's a place for trash, and that's not it.
string: 有個地方叫做垃圾場。而這裡並不是。

original: In my day, we knew how to dispose of trash properly.
string: 我那個時候，所有人都知道垃圾要扔到垃圾筒。

original: What's the matter with you? You think you can just go dropping your junk wherever you like?
string: 你有什麼毛病啊？覺得自己可以到處亂丟垃圾？

original: Look at this one. Spoiled as a child, I'll bet. Allowed to leave trash just lying around...
string: 看看這個，我肯定是從小就慣壞了，垃圾都扔地上……

original: I swear, is there no end to these uncouth savages, just throwing their trash wherever they please...
string: 我發誓，粗俗的野蠻人不論到哪裡都會不斷地亂丟垃圾……

original: Hrmmm. Pick up your trash, fetcher.
string: 喂，你這傢伙，快把垃圾撿起來。

original: And they call me a savage. Least I don't leave my trash lying around...
string: 他們說我是個野人。但至少我不把垃圾扔地上……

original: I never did understand the local custom of simply leaving one's trash wherever is convenient...
string: 我永遠無法理解當地的習慣，就這樣隨便把垃圾扔在地上……

original: Who does that? Who just leaves their garbage lying about?
string: 誰做的？誰把垃圾就這麼扔著？

original: Gah! Quit throwing your garbage everywhere.
string: 喂！別到處扔垃圾了。

original: One person's trash is another's treasure. Don't be surprised if you find that gone...
string: 人各有所好，要是看到它消失了也別驚訝……

original: I do the cookin' and cleanin' round the palace.
string: 我在宮裡做飯，打掃房間。

original: Don't need to pay me no mind. I'm the least important person in here.
string: 不用管我，我是個無名小卒。

original: Keepin' the palace clean an' the lords fed ain't easy work, but it's honest work.
string: 打掃宮裡，給大人們做飯可不是什麼簡單的事情，但這是一份正當的工作。

original: Every night, I walk around the Gray Quarter and let them gray-skins know what I think of 'em.
string: 每晚我都在灰民區走走，讓他們知道我有多麼看不起他們。

original: We ought dig a big hole, throw all them dark elves and Argonians in it, and let 'em tear each other to pieces.
string: 我們應該挖一個大坑，把所有的暗精靈和亞龍人都扔進去，看著他們把對方撕成一塊一塊的。

original: Only thing I hate worse than those scale-backs are them filthy gray-skins!
string: 相比那些背上長鱗片的，我更討厭那些灰皮膚的！

original: The Gray Quarter's a disgrace. Them dark elves live like animals.
string: 怎麼會有灰民區這種地方。那裡的暗精靈被當成動物一樣對待。

original: Can't see why we let them dark elves live inside the walls. We should kick 'em out like we did to the scalebacks.
string: 不知道我們為什麼讓暗精靈住在城內。我們應該像對待背上長鱗片的那些人一樣把他們踢出去。

original: Yes? Make it quick, I'm a busy man.
string: 嗯？快點，我很忙。

original: Skyrim isn't very friendly for Argonians, so we mostly just keep out of the way.
string: 天際對亞龍人不怎麼友好，所以我們一般都不到這來。

original: Shahvee knows the dock doesn't look nice, but fresh air is good for the gills.
string: 沙維知道這碼頭不怎麼好看，但是新鮮空氣對身體好。

original: Good honest work staves off the cold.
string: 賣力做工就不冷了。

original: I like to bring Grimvar down here sometimes. It reminds him how lucky he is.
string: 有時候我真想把格瑞姆瓦帶到這。這樣他就知道自己多幸運了。

original: I try to keep Grimvar safe, but these are dangerous times.
string: 我只想讓格瑞姆瓦好好的。但現在世道太亂。

original: When Grimvar asks me why women are being killed around the city. I don't even know what to say to him.
string: 當格瑞姆瓦問我為什麼會有婦女在城裡被殺，我都不知道該怎麼跟他解釋。

original: Ever tried taking care of children? It can be a nightmare.
string: 你照顧過小孩沒有？就跟場噩夢一樣。

original: We can't thank you enough for helping us get this office running.
string: 你幫我們的事業重上軌道了，真不知道怎麼感謝你。

original: Hey, it's our hero! Seen any more of those pirates around here?
string: 咱們的大英雄來了！還有看到其他的海盜出現在這嗎？

original: I appreciate everything you've done for us, but I really am quite busy.
string: 謝謝你為我們做的一切。但我真的很忙。

original: To receive the blessing of Talos, you have only to pray at the altar.
string: 要接受塔洛斯的祝福，只需要去神壇祈禱。

original: Ulfric Stormcloak was a true hero of Skyrim. He stood up to the Thalmor and refused to turn his back on Talos.
string: 烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷是天際的真英雄。他反對梭默，拒絕背叛塔洛斯。

original: The Stormcloaks are gone, but Talos will never be forgotten. I don't care what the Thalmor say!
string: 風暴斗篷離開了，但塔洛斯永遠不會被忘記。我才不管梭默說什麼呢！

original: You know about Talos? He founded the Empire!
string: 你知道塔洛斯嗎？他建立了帝國！

original: We're the only Temple in Skyrim that can openly worship Talos.
string: 我們是天際唯一公開祭拜塔洛斯的神殿。

original: Those awful Thalmor can't touch us, thanks to Ulfric.
string: 多虧了烏弗瑞克，可怕的梭默不敢動我們。

original: I can't believe the Empire would turn its back on Talos.
string: 真不敢相信帝國會背叛塔洛斯。

original: Spare a coin for a poor old woman, milord?
string: 大人，賞我這個窮老太太一點錢吧？

original: Spare a coin for a poor old woman, milady?
string: 夫人，賞我這個窮老太太一點錢吧？

original: Spare a coin? Talos rewards the generous.
string: 賞點錢吧，塔洛斯會保佑慷慨之人的。

original: I hope the wind dies down a bit before tonight. Hard when you've got to sleep outside.
string: 但願今晚風會小點。要睡在外面風大可不好。

original: Nervous being alone at night. Especially these days, with the Butcher prowling the streets.
string: 晚上一個人有點擔心啊。尤其是現在，那個屠夫還在外面遊蕩。

original: Looking for shipping? We'll always offer better service than the East Empire Company.
string: 要運貨嗎？我們的服務比東帝國貿易公司好多了。

original: These lazy Argonians better get their tails moving.
string: 這些懶亞龍人也該動動了。

original: You hear about the Shatter-shield girl? It's a tragedy.
string: 聽說了那個女孩的事情了嗎？真慘。

original: Torbjorn wants the shipping operations to bring in cash, and I make it happen.
string: 托布喬恩想讓船運賺點錢，而我是他的解答。

original: Come see me in the marketplace tomorrow. You won't find better prices in all of Eastmarch.
string: 明天來集市找我。在整個東陲找不到更便宜的了。

original: I don't haggle. If you want a lower price, look elsewhere.
string: 我不接受討價還價。要是想找便宜點的，去別的地方吧。

original: I'd travel more, but who wants to deal with all the soldiers these days?
string: 我想更常出門旅行。但現在誰會想和這些士兵們來往呢？

original: If you're looking to get a drink, Candlehearth Hall's got warm fires and strong ale.
string: 如果想喝一杯的話，燭爐堂客棧那裡可以取暖，還有不錯的麥芽酒。

original: Horses. All day long. Do you have any idea how dull horses are?
string: 整天就知道馬。你知道馬有多無聊嗎？

original: If the guards would listen to Viola, they'd have caught the Butcher by now.
string: 如果那些士兵聽從維歐拉的建議，他們現在就抓到那個屠夫了。

original: I love my husband, but he can be a bit... dull at times.
string: 我愛我丈夫，但他有時候會很無聊。

original: Ugh. I'll need to bathe thoroughly to get this stench off of me.
string: 我得好好洗個澡，把臭氣都洗掉。

original: Looking for something?
string: 在找什麼？

original: Real Nords like to prove their mettle in the pit.
string: 真正的諾德人會在坑裡證明自己的勇氣。

original: Just between you and me, I wouldn't mind if the Empire just up and left for good.
string: 別跟別人說。但我真希望帝國可以永遠離開這裡。

original: I'd love get one of those Imperial weasels under my boot...
string: 我真想踢這些帝國走狗一腳……

original: I've been a bit out of sorts since... since our daughter was taken from us.
string: 自從我們的女兒走了之後……我就有點魂不守舍。

original: Not really sure what to do with myself anymore. I just miss her so much.
string: 我不知道該做什麼了。我很想她。

original: I try not to think of her, but sometimes the simplest thing will remind me.
string: 我試著不去想。但有時候很小的事情都能讓我想起來。

original: No mother should have to bury her daughter.
string: 不應該白髮人送黑髮人啊。

original: This is the Hall of the Dead. Someday you'll end up here.
string: 這是亡者大廳。有一天你也會在這迎接生命的結束。

original: My job's simple enough. The dead don't really complain much.
string: 我的工作很簡單。死人不怎麼抱怨。

original: Luckily Windhelm is cold, so the dead don't rot as quickly. Sometimes the burial has to wait for the ground to thaw, though.
string: 風舵城很寒冷。屍體腐爛的不快。有的時候埋人還得等泥土解凍。

original: Another Dark Elf. Just what Windhelm needs.
string: 又是一個暗精靈。剛好是風舵城需要的。

original: Maybe you should just move along.
string: 也許你應該搬走。

original: This here's Candlehearth Hall. Great room's upstairs, an' there's a bed for rent on the ground floor.
string: 這是燭爐堂客棧。大廳在樓上，而樓下有房間出租。

original: Got some fresh-baked bread an' good cheese, if you're after a bite to eat.
string: 這有剛烤的麵包和新鮮乳酪，要不要嘗一下。

original: Mind you don't get fresh with Susanna. She plays the flirt, but it's just to get good tips.
string: 提醒你，不要跟蘇珊娜混在一起。她賣弄風情不過是想拿多點小費就是了。

original: Those Dark Elf refugees will take over the city if we aren't careful.
string: 如果不注意，暗精靈難民就會掌控這裡了。

original: Be on the lookout. The Butcher could be around any corner!
string: 小心點。那個屠夫隨時可能出現！

original: Captain Lonely-Gale has been avoiding me, I just know it.
string: 孤風船長一直在躲著我。我知道。

original: After what happened to those other women, I'm worried about my own safety.
string: 那些女人出事之後，我也開始擔心自己的安危了。

original: Women murdered time and again, and all the guards care about is the war.
string: 女人經常被殺，衛兵現在只擔心會不會打仗。

original: How can Elda hate the dark elves when she knows so little about them?
string: 艾爾達根本就不瞭解暗精靈，怎麼能恨他們呢？

original: You didn't hear it from me, but if you want a real drink, try the Cornerclub in the Gray Quarter.
string: 別告訴別人是我說的，如果你想喝到真正的酒，去試試灰民區的街角酒吧。

original: Did you know that candle on the mantle hasn't gone out in over a hundred years?
string: 你知不知道那火爐上的蠟燭一百多年都沒熄滅過？

original: Stand away from me, or I'll crack you like an egg.
string: 離我遠一點，不然我會把你像顆雞蛋一樣敲碎。

original: What are you looking at? Scared of strong women?
string: 你在看什麼？沒見過悍婦啊？

original: You look mighty tasty. Better not stick around for supper.
string: 你看起來真可口。最好別留下來吃晚餐。

original: Working in Windhelm is great. I get to see Ulfric up close.
string: 能在風舵城工作真好，我能近距離接觸到烏弗瑞克了。

original: I never expected Ulfric to live up to his legend, but he does.
string: 我從來不覺得烏弗瑞克能延續他的傳奇，但他做到了。

original: Ulfric was a true hero of Skyrim. He will be missed.
string: 烏弗瑞克是天際真正的英雄。大家會想念他的。

original: I just can't believe that Ulfric is gone. Skyrim will never be free now.
string: 我不敢相信烏弗瑞克不在了，天際將永遠無法得到解放。

original: I couldn't ask for a better teacher than Oengul.
string: 我找不到比歐恩古爾更好的老師了。

original: It's a new day in Windhelm. The Stormcloaks are gone, and so is their prejudice.
string: 這是風舵城嶄新的一天，風暴斗篷帶著他們的偏見離開了。

original: I wish the Nords, Argonians and dark elves in Windhelm got along better.
string: 我希望風舵城的諾德人、亞龍人、和暗精靈都能相處得更融洽一些。

original: We Argonians do the work the Nords don't want to do.
string: 我們亞龍人會做諾德人不願意做的工作。

original: The water is cold, but it's a lot better than having to work up in the dry air.
string: 水很冷，不過這可比在乾燥的空氣中工作好多了。

original: Shatter-Shield, East Empire Company... we'll work for any ship that pulls in, as long as they can pay.
string: 碎盾，東帝國貿易公司……我們會為每一艘停在這裡的船工作，只要他們付得起工錢。

original: The Nords don't appreciate us, but so what? I don't appreciate them right back.
string: 諾德人看不起我們，那又怎樣？我也看不起他們。

original: Look, we don't have much love for your kind down here. Probably best if you just left.
string: 聽著，我們對你的種族沒什麼好感，也許你應該離開這裡。

original: Haven't seen you here before, egg brother. Welcome!
string: 從來沒在這見到過你，卵生兄弟。歡迎！

original: Haven't seen you here before, egg sister. Welcome!
string: 從來沒在這見到過你，卵生姐妹。歡迎！

original: The docks can be a dangerous place. Don't expect me to save you if you fall in.
string: 碼頭是個危險的地方，如果你掉到水裡，別指望我去救你。

original: Huh? What's that now? Leave me alone.
string: 啊？現在又怎麼了？離我遠點。

original: Another day, another septim.
string: 新的一天，努力賺錢。

original: The young folks are too happy to break their backs for the Nords. They forget what it was like to swim free.
string: 那幾個年輕人給諾德人幹起活來太賣力啦，都忘了以前自在游水的日子了。

original: Do you know my father? He's really important. He even talks to the Jarl sometimes.
string: 你知道我父親嗎？他真的是個大人物，甚至跟領主說過幾次話。

original: Did you know my father? He was really important. He even talked to the Jarl sometimes.
string: 你聽說過我父親嗎？他曾經是個大人物，甚至跟領主說過幾次話。

original: All the Argonians at the docks are nice to me. Good thing, too, or father would run them off!
string: 碼頭上所有的亞龍人都對我很好，這對他們也有好處，不然父親會把他們都趕走的！

original: They say dragons are coming back. I want to kill one!
string: 他們說龍又回來了，我想要去殺掉一頭！

original: I made my fortune as a sea captain, but now I'm retired.
string: 作為船長，我獲得了許多財富，但現在我退休了。

original: The townsfolk call me "captain" because I used to be a sailor.
string: 鎮上的人叫我「船長」，因為我曾經是個水手。

original: I lost my family years ago. Truth is, I don't really know what keeps me going.
string: 幾年前，我失去了我的家庭。事實上，我不知道是什麼支撐我活到了現在。

original: Did Viola send you to bother me?
string: 是維歐拉派你來給我搗亂的嗎？

original: Serving as Steward to Ulfric Stormcloak was a great honor, but I don't miss his temper.
string: 能夠成為烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷的總管，我感到非常榮幸，但我一點也不懷念他的脾氣。

original: I don't care that we lost, I'm just glad the war is over.
string: 我不在意我們的失利，我只是很高興戰爭結束了。

original: The Stormcloaks are finding victory across the land.
string: 風暴斗篷的戰事四處傳出捷報。

original: I'm not much of a strategist, but Lord Ulfric listens to my counsel all the same.
string: 我雖然不是個軍事家，但烏弗瑞克君主還是會聽取我的建議。

original: If you have any news of the western holds, take it to Ulfric immediately.
string: 如果你有任何關於西方領地的消息，立刻告訴烏弗瑞克。

original: Terrible shame, what happened to those women.
string: 那些女人發生這些事，真是太慘了。

original: I was one of the best soldiers in the Stormcloak army, until I took a sword through the chest.
string: 在被一劍貫穿胸膛之前，我是風暴斗篷軍隊中最好的軍人之一。

original: I'd be out there fighting the Imperials right now if it wasn't for my war-wound.
string: 如果不是這傷勢，我現在還在外面對抗帝國呢。

original: Ever since that Imperial craven ran me through from behind, I've had trouble breathing. Don't have any trouble drinking though.
string: 自從帝國的小人從背後暗算我，我就有了呼吸困難的老毛病，不過不妨礙喝水。

original: What? Were you hoping to claim this house for yourself? Well, the Aretinos always liked me, so I think I'm family enough to take up here.
string: 什麼？你想把這幢房子據為己有？嗯，艾瑞提諾家的人一直很喜歡我，我想我的背景足夠拿下這個地方。

original: The milk drinkers in this town wouldn't last five minutes in a real battle.
string: 一打起仗來，城裡的懦夫們撐不了五分鐘。

original: Rumor holds that the Aretino boy brought an assassin here. Sounds like nonsense to me.
string: 有傳言說艾瑞提諾這小子帶了個刺客回來。我覺得是在胡扯。

original: I once killed six men, single-handed, while rescuing my brothers-in-arms from ambush by an Imperial patrol.
string: 我曾經單槍匹馬連殺六人，那是為了從帝國巡邏隊的偷襲中救出我的戰友。

original: I'm not too proud to admit that I need a bit of help from time to time.
string: 這雖然不大光彩，但我得承認我有時候需要一點幫助。

original: Can't say I mind the sight of all the Imperial guards. It's a change for the better.
string: 說實在的，這一堆帝國衛兵出現在這裡，我還算滿意。這是進步。

original: All my goods are legitimate, which is more than I can say for some.
string: 我所有的貨物都是合法途徑得來的，這是我一再強調的。

original: I like to share my good fortune with those who deserve it.
string: 我願意跟值得的人分享我的財富。

original: Trader dropped by recently with some lovely pieces, if you'd like to have a look.
string: 有商人最近路過這裡，留下了一些好貨，你願意去看看嗎？

original: Pardon the mess. We're really trying to do better around here.
string: 抱歉這太亂了。我們真的想把這裡弄整齊些的。

original: "Windhelm's an easy posting!" they said. Guess they didn't count on Ulfric's little uprising.
string: 「派去風舵城是個涼缺！」 他們說。我想他們沒料到烏弗瑞克會起義。

original: Can you believe the company won't even dock ships here anymore?
string: 你知道嗎，商行居然不在這裡停靠它們的船隻了？

original: The conquering hero returns!
string: 英雄凱旋歸來！

original: I really can't thank you enough for your help.
string: 真的是非常感謝你的幫助。

original: I still can't believe Isabella's gone. She was such a helpful young lass.
string: 我還是不敢相信伊莎貝拉去世了。她是個多麼能幹的小姑娘啊。

original: Now more than ever, the world needs tales of heroism.
string: 現在世界比任何時候都需要英雄傳說。

original: I'll find some way to finish my book.
string: 我會想辦法把書寫完的。

original: Know any tales of nobility and courage? I'm keen to record them.
string: 知道什麼歌頌高貴和勇敢的傳說嗎？我迫切地想記錄它們。

original: Oh splendid, another Nord.
string: 噢太棒了，又一個諾德人。

original: Come slumming to the Gray Quarter, have you?
string: 您是來屈尊拜訪灰民區的嗎？

original: Welcome, brother. Please, enjoy yourself.
string: 歡迎，兄弟。希望您過得愉快。

original: Welcome, sister. Please, enjoy yourself.
string: 歡迎，姐妹。希望您過得愉快。

original: Apparently some Nord women were murdered. Not sure why I should care.
string: 很顯然有些諾德女人被殺了。我不知道自己為什麼要在意。

original: At long last, Windhelm is free. No longer must we suffer persecution at the hands of Ulfric Stormcloak.
string: 最終，風舵城解放了。我們再也不會受到烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷的壓迫了。

original: Things have been a lot worse around here since Ulfric took over.
string: 在烏弗瑞克接管這裡之後，一切變得非常糟糕。

original: It's not the cold of Skyrim that gets to me. It's the stink from the people.
string: 我厭惡的並不是天際寒冷的天氣，而是這裡人們發出的惡臭。

original: When I've made enough money, I'm going to return to Morrowind in high style.
string: 等我賺夠了錢，我一定要衣著光鮮地回晨風去。

original: Both my daughters. Now my wife? How much is one man supposed to take?
string: 先是我的兩個女兒。現在輪到我的妻子？一個人到底該被奪走多少東西呢？

original: Poor Nilsine has been wrecked since her sister was killed.
string: 可憐的尼爾欣，自從她姐姐被殺，精神就變得有點不正常。

original: Seeing a good tavern brawl might be just the thing to lift my spirits.
string: 圍觀一場激烈的酒後幹架剛好能讓我興奮起來。

original: Brond's one of the most savage fighters I've ever seen...
string: 布容德是我見過的最野蠻的戰士之一……

original: What I lack in strength, I make up for with tenacity.
string: 力量上的欠缺，我會用堅韌來彌補。

original: You need anything, come see me. I'm as resourceful as I am discreet.
string: 你有需要的話，來找我。我這裡資源豐富。

original: I have a lot of respect for Ambarys Rendar, but his views are a little extreme.
string: 我非常尊敬安巴利．仁達爾，但他的觀點有點極端。

original: You look like someone who appreciates nice things.
string: 你看起來是識貨的人。

original: Oh, pardon me. Was I in your way?
string: 哦，抱歉。我是不是擋你的路了？

original: I hope someday we'll get to know each other better.
string: 我希望我們能有機會深交。

original: I see why the Nords like Skyrim. This crisp air is wonderful for the lungs!
string: 我明白為什麼諾德人喜歡天際省了。這新鮮空氣對肺有好處！

original: You seem like such a nice person. I'd love to hear more about you.
string: 你看起來是個好人。我想瞭解更多你的事情。

original: Can't believe Ulfric's gone. If not for Hermir, I'd have left the city by now.
string: 真不敢相信烏弗瑞克去世了。如果不是為了赫米爾，我現在就會離開這個城市。

original: Everyone says Eorlund Gray-Mane is the best smith in Skyrim. I plan to change a few minds about that.
string: 人人都說厄倫德．灰鬃是天際省最好的鐵匠。我打算改變大家的這種想法。

original: Need some metal hammered?
string: 需要鍛造金屬嗎？

original: Hermir's become a decent smith. Like to think I had a hand in that.
string: 赫米爾成了一個很棒的鐵匠。我覺得我功不可沒。

original: With my swords in their hands, Ulfric's men will send those legion dogs running.
string: 烏弗瑞克的人將會拿著我的劍驅趕帝國的走狗。

original: I lost my twin sister a while back. Have you ever lost anyone close?
string: 前一陣我失去了我的雙胞胎姐姐。你曾失去過親近的人嗎？

original: My father says we need to just get on with our lives. Like it's that easy.
string: 我父親說我們只要好好生活就行了。就好像這很簡單似的。

original: I've been a lot of things in my life. Pit fighter's the one I'm best at.
string: 我這一生做過好多事，地下格鬥是我最擅長的。

original: We should get a dragon for the Pit. I'd love to fight one.
string: 我們應該弄一頭龍到格鬥場。我挺想跟龍對打。

original: I've been fighting in the Pit for years. That should tell you something.
string: 我在格鬥場格鬥很多年了。這也能證明一些事了。

original: There's two kinds of Pit fighters -- good ones and dead ones.
string: 格鬥選手分兩種——優秀的和死掉的。

original: Ulfric once tried to get me to fight for him, but marching bores me.
string: 烏弗瑞克曾經想找我幫他打仗，但行軍太無聊了。

original: Steel. Barehanded. Armor. Naked. It's all fighting. I can kill you with a weapon or by myself. No difference.
string: 有兵器，沒兵器，有防具，沒防具，這都是戰鬥。我拿不拿兵器都能殺掉你，沒什麼區別。

original: With Ulfric dead and the Stormcloaks gone, who will have the courage to champion the cause of Talos?
string: 烏弗瑞克死了，風暴斗篷撤退了，誰還會有勇氣支持塔洛斯呢？

original: I've spent my life serving Talos. I don't plan to stop now, no matter what the Empire says.
string: 我這一生都追隨著塔洛斯。無論帝國說了什麼，我都不打算放棄這一點。

original: Talos created the Empire. You'd think they'd show him more respect.
string: 塔洛斯造就了帝國。你不覺得他們該表現出更多的尊重嗎？

original: The way I see it, Ulfric's fighting a holy war.
string: 在我看來，烏弗瑞克在進行一場聖戰。

original: Someday all of Skyrim will worship Talos openly, as we do here.
string: 總有一天，天際可以自由的表達對塔洛斯的崇敬，就像我們現在做的一樣。

original: Whatever you've heard I can do is probably true.
string: 你聽別人說我能做的事，多半都是真的。

original: If Ulfric needs a favor, he has it. Anyone else better pay well for the service.
string: 如果烏弗瑞克需要幫助，他會得到幫助。而其他人如果也想要的話，那就得付個不錯的價錢。

original: I'd explain my research, but you'd just be confused.
string: 我會陳述一下我的研究，但你們大概會一頭霧水。

original: Yes, I'm a powerful wizard. No, I won't put on a magic show for you.
string: 對，我是個強大的法師。不，我不會表演魔法給妳看的。

original: My job? Well, I'm the Watcher of the Wheel! Which is... exactly what it sounds like. I watch the Wheel.
string: 我的工作？唔，我是輪子的看守者！那是……就是你聽到的那樣，我負責看守輪子。

original: Watching the wheel isn't as simple as you might think. Have to inspect all the way around the ice, make sure it's not melting.
string: 看守輪子不像你想像的那麼簡單。你必須注意到周圍所有的冰面，確保它沒有融化的跡象。

original: Don't get too many folks up here these days. Sometimes I think they've forgotten about me.
string: 最近沒有多少傢伙來這裡，有時我覺得他們已經把我忘了。

original: My time is limited, so speak quickly.
string: 我趕時間，快點說。

original: It'll take time to rebuild, but the Nords are no strangers to hard work.
string: 重建工作需要花不少時間，不過諾德人對繁重的工作並不陌生。

original: The dark elves and Argonians won't soon forget Ulfric's prejudice, but I'm doing what I can to repair that rift.
string: 暗精靈和亞龍人不會很快忘記烏弗瑞克的偏見，但是我在盡自己所能修補他們之間的裂痕。

original: Being a Jarl isn't something I ever wanted, but if I can help these people, then I will.
string: 我從沒想過要做領主，但如果這樣能幫助這些人，我會做的。

original: Got no time for a Nord who thinks he's better than everyone else. Keep walking.
string: 沒時間理會一個眼高於頂的諾德人，繼續走。

original: I told you, I've got no patience for fools. Keep walking.
string: 我說過，我對白癡沒什麼耐心，繼續走。

original: There's no glory in war. It's just something they tell soldiers so they'll risk their lives.
string: 戰爭沒有榮耀。它只能告訴軍人們他們在拿自己的生命冒險。

original: They call me a war hero. I'm no hero, I'm just a soldier who didn't want to die.
string: 他們叫我戰爭英雄。我不是英雄，我只是一個不想死掉的軍人。

original: If Ulfric had his way, anyone who wasn't a Nord would be shipped right out of Skyrim.
string: 如果烏弗瑞克掌了權，所有非諾德人都會被趕出天際省的。

original: The sooner this war ends, the sooner we can all get on with our lives.
string: 這戰爭越早結束，我們就越早回歸正常生活。

original: Welcome to the House of Curiosities! I offer a brief tour for a few coins, or you can simply browse at your leisure.
string: 歡迎來到傳奇之屋！幾個硬幣就能享受一次對本店的介紹，或者你可以自己隨便看看。

original: If you've got some time, stop by my House of Curiosities. I promise you'll see wonders!
string: 如果你有時間，請在傳奇之屋留住腳步。我保證你會看到好東西的！

original: Welcome, friend, to Calixto's House of Curiosities!
string: 歡迎來到卡利斯托的傳奇之屋，朋友！

original: My sister and I once traveled the world to assemble our collection. Such adventures we had!
string: 我和姐姐曾經為了豐富我們的收藏而周遊各地，真是場冒險！

original: I don't care much for the war one way or the other.
string: 我不怎麼在乎戰爭的勝負。

original: It bothers me that fewer people come to Windhelm these days.
string: 最近來風舵城的人越來越少了，真讓我困擾。

original: Name's Nils. I'm the cook up at Candlehearth Hall.
string: 我叫紐斯。我是燭爐堂客棧的廚師。

original: Can't just throw the big logs on the fire. Got to have the little bits, too.
string: 不能就這麼把大塊木頭扔到火裡，也要扔點小塊的才行。

original: When I'm cutting wood, I pretend there's an Imperial soldier's head on the stump.
string: 我伐木時，會想像帝國士兵的腦袋在那個樹樁上。

original: Hello, hello, hello. Interested in fighting in the Pit? The rules are strict, but if I don't see it, it didn't happen, know what I mean?
string: 你好，你好，你好。有興趣在競技場格鬥嗎？規則很嚴格，不過要是我沒看到違例，那就什麼也沒發生，你懂我的意思吧？

original: It's very important to Huki that all the battles are fair. What's more important to me is that my pay is fair.
string: 對胡基來說，每場戰鬥的公平性非常重要。但對我來說最重要的是我的報酬要夠多。

original: Prove your valor in the Pit! If you haven't got any valor, prove your pocketbook!
string: 在競技場上證明你的勇氣吧！如果你沒有勇氣，證明你有錢吧！

original: When Ulfric was killed, justice was done. That might sound harsh, but it's how I feel.
string: 烏弗瑞克被殺時，正義也隨他而去了。這聽起來很刺耳，不過我就是這麼認為。

original: I thought the the Gray Quarter would be a haven for my kind. I was wrong.
string: 我以為灰民區會是我的天堂。我錯了。

original: The Gray Quarter's not much to look at now, but it wasn't always so bad.
string: 灰民區現在沒有什麼看頭了，但它不是一直這麼差勁的。

original: The cornerclub's been filling up at night lately. I'll bet Elda up at Candlehearth is jealous.
string: 街角吧最近晚上都爆滿。我打賭燭爐堂客棧的艾爾達一定很嫉妒。

original: We might be poor, but is it really any better out there?
string: 我們或許真的很窮，但外面的世界就有那麼好嗎？

original: Not a day passes that I don't wonder if life would be better in Morrowind.
string: 我沒有一天不在想晨風的生活會不會更好些。

original: I don't see why we should live as an underclass to the Nords. If anything, they owe us.
string: 我不知道我們憑什麼活得比諾德人低一等。再說，他們還欠著我們。

original: Alchemy is simple. Unless, of course, you are simple. Then I can't help you.
string: 鍊金術很簡單。除非，你頭腦太簡單。那我就沒辦法了。

original: Must you bother me now? I've almost figured out where it is.
string: 你非得現在打擾我嗎？我就快找到它在哪裡了。

original: My master can be a bit short-tempered, but I've learned so much from him.
string: 我的老師的確脾氣有點壞，但我從他身上學到了很多東西。

original: I'll never have Master Nurelion's skill with potions.
string: 我永遠也達不到努瑞萊昂老師製藥的水準。

original: I have a decent mind for potions, but I've also learned how to craft magical items.
string: 我有一顆渴望製藥的心，但我也去學了製造魔法物品。

original: I'm a sailor on the Northwind. We're laying over in Windhelm for awhile.
string: 我是北風號的水手。我們要在風舵城停留一段時間。

original: It's good to spend some time on solid land.
string: 能腳踏陸地一陣子真不錯。

original: A life on the river makes for weak legs, so I do a lot of walking when we dock.
string: 常年的航行生活會削弱腿部力量，所以我們靠岸的時候我會多走走路。

original: Captain Kjar expects the best, but he's a fair man. He never fails to reward hard work and loyalty.
string: 科亞船長總是精益求精，但他很公正，他從不忘記獎勵努力工作和忠誠的人。

original: Never much cared for Windhelm. The place is depressing.
string: 從沒這麼注意過風舵城。這地方真壓抑。

original: I'm a lot happier out here on the deck than I am wandering around in that ruin of a city.
string: 到甲板上之後，我比在城市的廢墟中閒逛時要高興多了。

original: I heard those Forsworn out west live in caves. Can't be any worse than trying to live in Windhelm.
string: 我聽說西邊的棄誓者住在洞穴裡，那也沒有住在風舵城糟糕。

original: Can't wait until we raise anchor. Anytime the boat's not moving, I start to get impatient.
string: 我們迫不及待地拉起錨。船一旦不動了，我就開始感到焦慮。

original: Sorry, but I'm not looking to hire any more crew right now.
string: 抱歉，但我目前不想召新的船員。

original: You don't know what freedom really means until you've lived on the river.
string: 當你住在水上時，才能真正瞭解自由的含義。

original: Been on the river since I could walk. Wouldn't trade it for the world.
string: 我會走路的時候就在水上生活了。給我全世界我也不換。

original: While you're on my boat, you follow my rules. First rule is, don't touch anything that doesn't belong to you.
string: 你在我船上時，要守我的規矩。第一條是，別碰不屬於你的東西。

original: The best way for us to win the Nords' respect is through hard work.
string: 我們贏得諾德人尊重的最好辦法就是努力工作。

original: Too many dark elves in Windhelm complain about the way we're treated. What good does complaining do?
string: 風舵城有好多暗精靈都抱怨他們所受的待遇。但抱怨又有什麼用呢？

original: I'm proud of my farm. It takes no small effort to grow crops in this part of Skyrim.
string: 我為我的農場感到驕傲，能佔據天際的這麼一片土地來種莊稼可不是什麼小的成就。

original: I own Hollyfrost Farm outside the city. It's honest work, if a bit dull.
string: 我是城外冬青霜農場的主人。這是實實在在的工作，雖說可能有點無趣。

original: The Cruel-Seas have been sailors for generations. In truth, I regret not following in the footsteps of my ancestors.
string: 酷海家族代代都是水手。事實上，我後悔自己沒能走上先人的道路。

original: If I make enough money from the farm, I'll buy myself a longship to sail the rivers of Skyrim.
string: 我的農場賺足了錢，我要給自己買一艘快船，在天際的河流上航行。

original: I understand what potions do, but I don't always understand how they do it.
string: 我知道藥水的效果，但不知道它是如何起作用的。

original: This is Stormcloak territory. If you're one of those craven Imperials, don't expect a warm welcome.
string: 這裡是風暴斗篷的領土，如果你是帝國那邊的懦夫，別指望能受到歡迎。

original: If you're here to join the Stormcloaks, the palace is inside.
string: 如果你是來加入風暴斗篷的，宮殿就在裡面。

original: Loyal Nords are always welcome here. Anyone else better watch their step.
string: 這裡永遠歡迎忠誠的諾德人，其他人最好注意自己的言行了。

original: If you're an Imperial spy, better turn around right now.
string: 如果你是帝國的間諜，最好現在離開。

original: Stay away from the Aretino Residence. The place is cursed.
string: 離艾瑞提諾宅邸遠一點，那地方被詛咒了。

original: You should unload some of that unwanted gear. Head over to Sadri's Used Wares, talk to the Elf.
string: 你該卸下那件沒用的裝備，拿到薩德利舊貨去，找那精靈。

original: If you need an apothecary, the White Phial has respectable stock.
string: 如果你需要藥材，雪瓶有豐富的貨源。

original: By the gods, you're diseased. Get yourself to the White Phial and purchase a remedy, before you infect us all.
string: 天啊，你生病了。在你把我們湊傳染上之前，快去雪瓶接受治療吧。

original: The Dunmer get their drinks at the New Gnisis Cornerclub. Why they can't just call it a tavern is beyond me...
string: 丹莫人一般到新格尼西斯街角吧去喝酒。我真不懂他們為什麼不把那裡叫酒館……

original: If it's bed or board you're after, Candlehearth Hall's got both.
string: 如果你想要床或食物，去燭爐堂客棧吧，那裡兩樣都有。

original: Across the river to the northeast lies Yngol Barrow. Steer clear of that foul place, lest the walking dead claim you as their own.
string: 河對岸的東北方有座英格爾塚。繞開那個邪惡的地方，免得那些不死生物侵襲你。

original: The Eye of Talos was a fine ship, once. Now it lies wrecked, off an island just north of here.
string: 塔洛斯之眼曾經是艘好船。現在它沉了，就在北邊的島嶼附近。

original: Maybe you've seen masts sticking out of the water to the northeast? That would be the wreck of the Winter War. Fine vessel, back in its day.
string: 說不定你看到過東北方向水裡伸出來的桅杆？那應該就是冬戰號留下的殘骸。它應該算是艘瘦型船。

original: South of here, and west of the road, lies Cronvangr Cave. Stay away from that cursed place, and the vampires that call it home.
string: 這裡向南、道路的西邊，是克隆萬格洞穴，離那個詛咒之地遠一點，吸血鬼稱那裡為家。

original: Tell me you've seen them. Those... things. Small and evil, like something out of a nightmare. They come from Stillborn Cave, to the north. I know it.
string: 你應該看過吧。這些……生物。小而邪惡，就像從噩夢裡出來的一樣。它們來自北邊的生還洞穴，我知道。

original: I've no problem with your kind, Orc. But that stronghold you've got in the southeast? Narzulbur? It's an affront to my people.
string: 我對你的種族沒什麼意見，獸人。但你們在東南邊建造的城寨？納祖伯？那可是對我的人民的公然挑釁。

original: I've no problem with Orcs. But that stronghold they've got in the southeast? Narzulbur? It's an affront to my people.
string: 我對獸人沒有意見。但他們在東南邊造的城寨？那可是對我的人民的公然挑釁。

original: You hear the news? There's a dragon roosting up on Mount Anthor, to the northwest.
string: 你聽說了嗎？有一頭龍在西北方向的安索爾山休眠。

original: I... knew Veren and Thorek. They were my friends.
string: 我……我認識維仁和圖雷克，他們是我的朋友。

original: Is this punishment for my past? Is it Mara's will to torment me so?
string: 這是對我過去所作所為的懲罰嗎？是瑪拉想要這麼折磨我的嗎？

original: You must deliver those items to your superior. And I... I must get out of this foul place.
string: 你一定要把這些東西交給你的長官。我……我得離開這個惡心的地方。

original: I don't even know what to think anymore...
string: 我的思考都快停止了……

original: Are you excited? Oh, you should be. Things are finally looking up!
string: 你興奮嗎？噢，你該興奮。一切終於有了起色！

original: Doesn't really matter. Thanks, but no.
string: 是什麼都沒差。我不要，謝謝。

original: I haven't even said what it is.
string: 我還沒說是什麼呢。

original: No, I don't think so. Not today.
string: 不，我不行。今天不行。

original: Malur, I need you to take care of something.
string: 馬魯爾，我需要你保管點東西。

original: As you wish.
string: 如你所願。

original: Well, he's been very busy. Perhaps today he'll have some free time.
string: 這個嘛，他非常忙，說不定他今天會有點閒置時間。

original: Again? Are you sure? He still hasn't answered your last several requests.
string: 還要問？你確定？他還沒回應你之前的請求呢。

original: Why don't you see if Arch-Mage Aren is interested in joining me for a meal?
string: 你為什麼不去問問首席法師阿冉有沒有興趣與我共進晚餐？

original: Will you be needing anything special today?
string: 今天還是老樣子？

original: Yes, that will be fine. Thank you.
string: 好的，那就好，謝謝。

original: I shall inform you the moment something noteworthy happens.
string: 如果有什麼值得注意的事，我會告訴你的。

original: None? Nothing at all? Nothing from the College, even?
string: 沒有？完全沒有？連學院那裡都沒有？

original: There is no news, I'm afraid.
string: 恐怕沒有。

original: So, what's the latest exciting news about goings-on in Winterhold?
string: 那麼，冬堡最近一次讓人興奮的消息是什麼？

original: Oh, you prefer to listen, eh? Of course, of course! The Listener listens! A joke! A funny joke! I get it.
string: 噢，你比較喜歡傾聽？嗯？當然，當然！聆聽者傾聽！真是有趣的笑話！我懂啦！

original: Then listen to this - don't kill me. Let poor Cicero live! I attacked the strumpet Astrid, I did! And I'd do it again! Anything for our mother!
string: 那麼聽著——別殺我。讓可憐的西塞羅活著吧！我的確是襲擊了那婊子、阿斯垂德！而且我還會繼續！為了我們的母親！

original: Return to the pretender, tell her I'm dead! Tell her you strangled me with my own intestines! Ha ha! But lie! Yes, lie! Lie, and let me live!
string: 回去找那冒牌貨，告訴她我已經死了！告訴她你用我的腸子把我勒死了！哈哈！就是撒謊！對，撒謊！撒謊，然後留我一條小命！

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

original: Traitor? Me? Silly assassin. So confused, so confused... and they say I'm mad!
string: 叛徒？哈哈，我？傻刺客，糊塗、真糊塗……他們還說我瘋了！

original: If I'm a traitor, so are you! Have you not heard the maiden's voice? Are you not the Listener?
string: 如果我是個叛徒，那麼你也是！難道你沒聽過夜母的聲音？難道你不是聆聽者？

original: So walk away! Let poor Cicero live! Tell Astrid you did the job! Stabbed, strangled, drowned poor Cicero! A tiny white lie for a dark assassin!
string: 離開吧！讓可憐的西塞羅活下來！告訴阿斯垂德你完成了任務！刺死、勒死、淹死了可憐的西塞羅！撒個小謊說暗殺成功了吧！

original: Time to die, traitor!
string: 該受死了，叛徒！

original: Oh, I like that! Very good, very good! Creative!
string: 哦，我喜歡那樣！很好，很好！有創意！

original: But killing me would be a mistake! Oh yes. You would displease our mother, hmm? For she's your mother too, isn't she... Listener?
string: 但是殺了我絕對是個錯誤！噢是的。你會觸怒我們的母親，嗯？因為她也是你母親，不是嗎……聆聽者?

original: Walk away! Let poor Cicero live! Tell the pretender Astrid you did the job! Stabbed, strangled, drowned poor Cicero! One little itty bitty lie!
string: 離開吧！讓可憐的西塞羅活下來！告訴阿斯垂德你完成了任務！刺死、勒死、淹死了可憐的西塞羅！撒個小謊說暗殺成功了吧！

original: There is only one cure for your madness, Cicero. Me.
string: 瘋狂只有一種治療法，西塞羅。那就是我！

original: DB07AstridCiceroDeadNoChoice
string: DB07AstridCiceroDeadNoChoice

original: Yes, Cicero is dead. (Lie)
string: 是的，西塞羅死了。（撒謊）

original: DB07AstridCiceroDeadYesChoice
string: DB07AstridCiceroDeadYesChoice

original: Yes, Cicero is dead.
string: 是的，西塞羅死了。

original: Arnbjorn is safe, and for that you have my thanks. But what of the fool? Is Cicero dead?
string: 艾恩喬恩安全了，這真要感謝你。但是那個白癡呢？西塞羅死了嗎？

original: DB07CiceroConfrontBranchTopic
string: DB07CiceroConfrontBranchTopic

original: You caught me! I surrender! Ha ha ha ha.
string: 你抓到我了！我投降！哈哈哈哈。

string: 唔……我如果這麼在外面晃，他們會把我鎖起來的。

string: 那個半裸的傻貨想要證明什麼？

original: What a vulgar display.
string: 真是下流。

original: That's not something you see every day...
string: 那可不是每天都能見到的……

original: Gracious! This one is certainly unaccustomed to such sights...

original: Well now! Aren't you putting on quite the show?
string: 好吧！你真是很愛演啊？

original: Oh, dear. Would you look at that? How embarrassing.

original: Look at that fool.
string: 看那個傻貨。

original: Gah! Look over there. I can't believe it.
string: 哈！看那裡。真不敢相信。

original: It takes a lot of confidence to walk around naked. Trust me on that.
string: 裸奔可是非常需要自信的，相信我。

original: Whoa.
string: 哇噢。

original: Crazy person... Something must be wrong with its head, to strut around like that.
string: 瘋子……他的腦袋肯定出毛病了，居然這樣招搖過市。

original: They're half-naked. That ain't right. Somebody's gotta say somethin'...
string: 他們都半裸了。這是不對的。得有人來阻止他們……

original: Look! Look!
string: 看啊！看啊！

original: Somebody get that idiot some armor...
string: 誰來給那個白癡套個盔甲……

original: A bit much, going around like that...
string: 這樣子亂晃有點太過火了……

original: Why the impropriety!
string: 這太不恰當了吧！

original: Never see me strutting around like that!
string: 我永遠不會像那樣大搖大擺走過去！

original: Crazy, naked n'wah...
string: 瘋了，裸體的奴隸……

original: Whoa... Not even I'm that drunk...
string: 哇噢……比我還要醉……

original: Positively vulgar.
string: 真是下流。

original: Somebody get that fool a blanket.
string: 誰給那蠢貨來條毯子。

original: Despite the shame, this one can't help but stare.
string: 拋開羞恥心不談，這真的讓人無法不盯著看。

original: By Ysmir's beard! I didn't know it was gonna be a party!
string: 伊斯米爾的鬍子！我真不知道這裡有個宴會！

original: For shame! You should be locked up for strutting around like that.
string: 真不知羞！你這麼做就該被關起來。

original: Oh my. Been a lot of years since I've seen something like that...
string: 哦，天吶。好多年沒見過這種事了……

original: Got to admire the chops it takes to walk around like that.
string: 能這麼招搖也是需要勇氣的。

original: Not my thing, but who am I to judge...
string: 不是我的風格，但是我沒資格說誰……

original: Wait until the boys hear about this.
string: 等不及跟他們說這事。

original: Now that's something else, right there!
string: 那還真是特別啊，看那裡！

original: I've heard you might know what Faleen likes.
string: 我聽說你可能知道法琳喜歡什麼？

original: What? Why, are you... interested?
string: 什麼？為什麼，你對她……感興趣？

original: You just need to have something to talk about.
string: 你只不過需要點話題。

original: That's the trouble. I know Faleen from the Keep, but I have no idea what sorts of things she likes.
string: 那就是麻煩所在。我在要塞就認識法琳了，但是我完全不知道她喜歡什麼？

original: It's not a simple matter. I could offend her fairly easily by bringing up the wrong subject. I've seen it happen before.
string: 那可不是個簡單的問題。我只要提到不對的話題，就會輕易地冒犯到她。這在以前發生過。

original: Looks like there's not much you can do.
string: 看來你幫不上什麼忙。

original: I guess not.
string: 應該吧。

original: I'm not sure. I hope things work out for you.
string: 我不確定。我希望你能解決這個問題。

original: As do I. It's a puzzling situation.
string: 我也想。這情況真糾結。

original: Boti said she'd handle Jofthor.
string: 伯蒂說她能搞定約夫托爾。

original: She would? If she's willing to deal with him, then everything would be all right.
string: 她會嗎？如果她願意搞定他，那一切都沒問題了。

original: I'll... I'll go speak to Fastred. Post-haste!
string: 我……我馬上去跟法斯萊德談談！

original: Have you spoken to my parents yet? Please, my love depends on it!
string: 你跟我父母談過了嗎？拜託了，我的愛情全靠你了！

original: What would inspire them to leave?
string: 他們怎樣才會離開？

original: Bassianus is still so terrified of Jofthor.
string: 巴夏努斯還是很害怕約夫托爾。

original: If he knew that I'd keep him from hunting the poor boy down, he'd take Fastred to Riften without a second thought.
string: 如果他知道我可以不讓那小子追上他們兩個，他肯定想都不想就把法斯萊德帶去裂谷城。

original: Let him know that I'll watch out for them. I just want my daughter to be happy.
string: 告訴他我會替他們搞定的。我只是想讓我女兒高興。

original: I'll see if I can't get some work done inside, where it's warm.
string: 我試試看回到屋子裡工作，裡面暖和多了。

original: That's nice, son. Just don't stomp on the crop like last time!
string: 那樣挺好，兒子。不過別再像上次一樣踩壞莊稼。

original: I'm gonna go play soldier with a tree!
string: 我要跟樹玩打仗遊戲！

original: It's too cold for my bones, but that never seems to stop you, dear.
string: 我被凍透了，但妳似乎絲毫不受寒冷的影響，親愛的。

original: Another gorgeous gray day, right dear?
string: 又是一個漂亮的陰天，對嗎？親愛的？

original: Guess we can't afford to miss that much work, can we? Oh well...
string: 我想我們無法承擔一天的損失，對嗎？哦好吧……

original: True enough, you cur. Back to work, I suppose...
string: 這倒是真的，你說對了。那還是回去工作吧……

original: Hjorunn, the last time you tried anything, your fist broke on my head!
string: 卓恩，上次你想做什麼的時候，你的拳頭打到我的頭然後斷掉了！

original: Just as long as you don't breathe on me, Hjorunn. I'll be out for hours.
string: 只要你不把氣吐在我身上，卓恩，我會出去待上幾個小時。

original: What did you say? I ought to break off one of those tusks and use it as my drinking horn!
string: 你剛說什麼？我應該挖開一隻銳牙做成我的酒樽！

original: Don't make me to defend the honor of my mead! It's been my friend a lot longer than you have!
string: 別逼我捍衛我的蜂蜜酒的榮耀！它跟我做朋友的時間比你長多了！

original: I have to work twice as hard because you drink up all our profits.
string: 我必須得加倍努力工作，因為你把賺來的錢都喝掉了。

original: Can you pay attention to work for once, instead of your mug?
string: 你能不能把心思放在工作，而不是你的酒杯上？

original: Kharag, take a break and drink with me! Those trees aren't going anywhere!
string: 卡拉德，休息一會陪我喝點酒！這些樹又不會跑！

original: Why so glum, my ugly friend? Did we run out of mead?
string: 為什麼這麼憂鬱，我醜陋的朋友？我們沒有蜂蜜酒了嗎？

original: It's not hopeless, Esbern. I'm Dragonborn.
string: 不是完全沒有希望，伊思本。我是龍裔。

original: You're right, I forget myself. I've lived without hope for so long...
string: 你說得對，我又忘了。我已經太久沒有希望了……

original: The prophecies are clear. Only the Dragonborn can stop Alduin.
string: 預言說得很明確，只有龍裔能阻止奧杜因。

original: What? You're... can it really be true? Dragonborn?
string: 什麼？你是……那是真的嗎？龍裔？

original: Then... there is hope! The gods have not abandoned us! We must... we must...
string: 那麼……還有希望！神還沒有遺棄我們！我們得……我們得……

original: Tell me about Alduin.
string: 告訴我關於奧杜因的事。

original: No, never mind.
string: 不，別在意。

original: You're trying my patience, lad.
string: 你在挑戰我的耐心，小子。

string: 你在挑戰我的耐心，小姑娘。

original: Break the law? Are you kidding?
string: 違反法律？你開玩笑吧？

original: Sorry... I usually have a nose for this kind of thing.
string: 不好意思……我通常對這類事很敏感。

original: Never mind then, lad. If you change your mind, come find me.
string: 那麼別在意，小子。如果你改變主意了，就來找我。

original: Sorry... I usually have a nose for this kind of thing.
string: 不好意思……我通常對這類事很敏感。

string: 沒關係，小姑娘。如果妳改變主意了，就來找我。

string: 我該怎麼做？

string: 拿到指環之後，我要你在布蘭德-謝沒有察覺的情況下把指環放到他的口袋裡。

string: 你想要我做什麼？

string: 當我這行的幫手，報酬很不錯。

string: 你想不想試試？

string: 你想不想試試？

string: 你怎麼會知道那些？

string: 這就是觀察特點的奧秘了，小子。

string: 這就是觀察特點的奧秘了，小姑娘。

string: 他們走路的姿勢，穿衣的喜好，都把自己完全出賣了。

string: 抱歉，你說什麼？

string: 我想說你有銅板，但你不是正當賺來的，我能看出來。

string: 你的口袋……需要一些錢來填滿它。我看得出來。

string: 真高興你終於開竅了。準備好賺錢了嗎？

string: 你這輩子賺的錢都是靠些見不得人的勾當得來的吧，小子？

string: 口袋空虛了，小姑娘？

string: 等我完事了，我會很高興賣給你藥劑的。

string: 哦，抱歉，女士。等我招待完這些人，我很願意賣給你藥劑。

original: What wasn't I clear about?
string: 有什麼我沒說清楚的嗎？

original: Okay lad, ready to make some coin?
string: 好吧小夥子，準備好賺些零用錢了嗎？

original: Okay lass, ready to make some coin?
string: 好吧小姑娘，準備好賺些零用錢了嗎？

original: Changed your mind I hope?
string: 改變主意了？

original: I'm fine, I'm fine. Let's move on.
string: 我很好，我很好。我們繼續。

original: This place has had you shaking in your armor ever since we arrived.
string: 從我們到這地方開始你一直在發抖。

original: Quiet! I think I heard something.
string: 安靜！我覺得我聽到了什麼？

original: Can't say that I have.
string: 我不敢確定。

string: 找到有用的東西了嗎？

string: 不。這麼做是不對的。

string: 真是自大啊？想怎麼做隨你，但聽好了。

string: 我的組織的大本營在裂谷城底下的鼠道裡……一個叫做漏壺的酒館。

original: When you come to your senses, find me there and we'll discuss your future.
string: 你想清楚之後，可以到那去找我，我們再來談談你的將來。

original: The money's nice, but I don't know...
string: 有錢當然好，但我不知道……

original: Look, I'll make this simple for you.
string: 聽著，我會把一切簡單化。

original: The group I represent has its home in the Ratway beneath Riften... a tavern called the Ragged Flagon.
string: 我的組織的大本營在裂谷城底下的鼠道裡……一個叫做漏壺的酒館。

original: When you make up your mind, come find me there and we'll talk about your future.
string: 你想清楚之後，可以到那去找我，我們再來談談你的將來。

original: I can handle it.
string: 我能應付。

original: All right, then. Let's put that to the test.
string: 那麼好吧。我們就來測驗一下。

original: The group I represent has its home in the Ratway beneath Riften... a tavern called the Ragged Flagon.
string: 我所在組織的大本營在裂谷城底下的鼠道裡……一個叫做漏壺的酒館。

original: Get there in one piece and we'll see if you've really got what it takes.
string: 活著到那去，讓我們看看你是不是真的有能力。

original: What's been going on?
string: 出什麼事了？

original: Bah. My organization's been having a run of bad luck, but I suppose that's just how it goes.
string: 呸，我的組織最近運氣很差，但我想世事本無常嘛。

original: But never mind that, even though you fouled up the job I still think you've got that spark I'm looking for.
string: 別在意，即使你搞砸了工作，我仍然覺得你具備我喜歡的特質。

original: There's plenty of gold out there for the taking... if you're up to the challenge.
string: 到處都有金幣隨你取用……只要你能力足夠。

original: Bah. My organization's been having a run of bad luck, but I suppose that's just how it goes.
string: 呸，我的組織最近運氣很差，但我想世事本無常嘛。

original: But never mind that, you did the job and you did it well. Best of all, there's more where that came from... if you think you can handle it.
string: 別在意，你完成了任務，而且完成得很出色。更好的是，我們接到的委託更多了……如果你還有餘力的話。

original: Lorkhan's eyes! Look at that big bastard! Keep your head down, let's see what it does.
string: 洛克汗庇佑！瞧瞧那個大傢伙！別抬頭，我們看看它在做什麼？

original: What should we do?
string: 我們該做什麼？

original: Gods above! Look at that!
string: 老天保佑！看那個！

original: Kill the damn dragon! Unless you have a better idea?!
string: 殺死那頭該死的龍！除非你有更好的主意？！

original: Stay under cover. This is what we came for. We need to see what happens.
string: 保持隱蔽。我們就是為了這個而來的。我們得看清狀況。

original: Steady. Let's see what it does.
string: 穩住。看它在做什麼？

original: Come on. We need to find out what's happening up there!
string: 拜託，我們得弄清楚那邊發生了什麼！

original: You learn a new word like a master... you truly do have the gift.
string: 你學會了一個新的符文，就像大師一樣……你真有天賦。

original: I'm not playing with you, Kayd! You play mean!
string: 我不跟你玩了，凱德！你很壞！

original: Father says I shouldn't play with you anymore.
string: 父親說我不該跟你一起玩了。

original: Can't catch me!
string: 追不上我！

original: Aww, I'm hungry! Can we get some food, instead?
string: 啊啊，我好餓！我們不能找點吃的嗎？

original: Tag! You're it!
string: 嘿！抓住你了！

original: I'm bored! Let's play a game!
string: 我好無聊！我們玩個遊戲吧！

original: Pantea, perhaps you should attend to your students, and leave the politics to me.
string: 潘提亞，去照料學生吧，把政事留給我處理。

original: That is precisely why we remain neutral. Ours is to tell tales of empires, not to make or break them.
string: 這正是我們保持中立的原因。我們該做的是講述帝國的傳說，而不是捏造或者破壞它們。

original: Aia, please be quiet. Viarmo and I are discussing matters of national politics.
string: 艾雅，請安靜。我和維阿墨在討論國家大事。

original: Aia, this is a delicate matter. Why don't you review your lessons and be silent for a while.
string: 艾雅，這是個棘手的問題。妳為什麼不複習一下上課內容，稍微安靜一下呢。

original: But I'm sure those Skyrim dogs would stand down if the keepers of the tales showed their patriotism!
string: 但我敢肯定，如果故事的守護者能夠顯示出他們愛國的決心，那些天際的走狗會退讓的！

original: Maybe if we stopped singing about their silly Nord heroes, the rebels would stop making such a fuss!
string: 說不定我們只要不再歌頌那些傻乎乎的諾德英雄，反叛者就不會搗亂了！

original: Lady Ateia, it is the official position of the college to remain neutral in all political affairs. We cannot risk our history by choosing sides.

original: Now, now, our duty is to record the great tales of history, not to pick sides in them. Best to stay out of the warfare, I feel.
string: 非也，非也，我們的任務是記錄重大的歷史事件，而不是從中選擇陣營。我覺得我們不該涉入戰爭。

original: Viarmo, the college really must take a stand on the war!
string: 維阿墨，學院必須在戰爭中選擇自己的立場了！

original: Viarmo, don't you think it's time that the Bards College officially declared support for the empire?
string: 維阿墨，你不覺得吟遊詩人學院應該正式宣佈支持帝國嗎？

original: You're on! Loser buys the next round!
string: 就賭吧！輸的付帳！

original: That 'incident' in Morthal was just a misunderstanding. No matter what the guards claim.
string: 墨索爾城的那次「事件」只是一場誤會。不管那些衛兵如何宣稱。

original: The people of Skyrim have no appreciation for what we do here. Not that I care.
string: 天際省的人們對我們所做的事情毫無感激之心。不過我也不在乎。

original: Should you ever fall victim to an unfortunate accident, I promise your remains will be put to good use...
string: 如果你遇到什麼不幸的意外，我倒是可以保證你的遺體一定會被好好利用……

original: Restoration is a perfectly valid school of magic, and don't let anyone tell you otherwise!
string: 恢復系法術絕對是學院法術的一項正統學派，別聽其他人胡說八道！

original: Why are my research materials constantly disappearing?
string: 為什麼我的研究材料總是平白無故地消失？

original: Once again, I have found very insulting notes left in my personal effects. Simply barbaric.
string: 又來了，我又在我的隨身物品中找到帶有辱罵的紙條。簡直太野蠻了。

original: Just because I don't fit in here is no reason for others to ridicule me behind my back.
string: 我是不能融入這裡，但別人也沒理由在背後嘲笑我。

original: Ancano is exactly why we're so restrictive about access to the College. We'd all have perished if it weren't for you.
string: 安卡諾讓我們看到了嚴格審核進入魔法學院的人的重要性。要不是你在，我們就都玩完了。

original: I'm sure you've made note of who's been the most helpful during your time here, Arch-Mage.
string: 我相信您一定注意到了您在學院的時候誰幫你最多，首席法師大人。

original: May I just say, it's a pleasure to have you leading the College. Really.
string: 能允許我這樣說嗎，有您領導這個學院真是太好了，真的。

original: If there's ever any way I can assist you, please let me know.
string: 如果有任何地方能夠幫到您的，請告訴我。

original: I think the College is due for a change in leadership.
string: 我想學院是時候換一換領導者了。

original: If you're working on any experiments, please clean up after yourself.
string: 如果你在做什麼實驗的話，做完以後請整理好器具。

original: Just like anywhere else, it's all about who you know. Lucky for you, you know me.
string: 全世界都一樣，重要的是看你認識誰。你很幸運，認識我這麼個人。

original: I hope I can count on you if I ever need a favor.
string: 要是我真需要幫助，我希望我能拜託你。

original: It's a small group of us here at the College. Favors don't go unremembered. Neither do affronts.
string: 在學院我們是一個小團體。誰幫我們我們不會忘。誰侮辱我們也是一樣。

original: The Arch-Mage triumphant! The College... Skyrim... All of Tamriel owes you a great debt!
string: 勝利屬於首席法師！魔法學院……天際省……全泰姆瑞爾都欠您一大筆恩情！

original: I'm quite pleased that we're back to business as usual.
string: 我很高興我們又恢復正常運作了。

original: Certainly nothing illicit going on here, Arch-Mage. You can be quite sure of that.
string: 首席法師大人，這裡肯定沒有什麼非法的勾當。您大可以放心。

original: Even with the College's laid-back attitude, there are still some things that are off-limits.
string: 儘管學院持放任的態度，還是有些東西不能說碰就碰的。

original: There are some experiments the College frowns on. If they're aware of them, of course.
string: 有一些實驗讓學院很不滿。當然，大概你也注意到了。

original: If you ever need something, especially something hard to come by, let me know.
string: 如果你需要什麼東西，尤其是很難買到的東西，告訴我一聲。

original: I've spent a long time building up a list of contacts for goods from all over Tamriel.
string: 我已經花了很長的時間來建立橫跨整個泰姆瑞爾大陸的一套物資交流系統。

original: I am always available should you need me, Arch-Mage.
string: 首席法師大人，只要您需要我，我隨時聽您吩咐。

original: Like it or not, you are a shining example to future generations of College Mages.
string: 也許您不喜歡聽這些，但您就是魔法學院的法師中未來一代的領先者。

original: After all that it's been through, the College still stands. In no small part thanks to you!
string: 經歷這麼多的風霜，魔法學院還是能夠屹立不倒。這全都是你的功勞啊！

original: It's always encouraging to see the younger generations embracing education.
string: 看到年輕一代在這裡擁抱知識，總是令人心裡一陣激動和感慨。

original: The College will be here for you, no matter what. We always look after our own.
string: 不管發生什麼事，學院都會支持你。我們會照顧自己的人。

original: Education is never appreciated until after the fact. Young people never understand this.
string: 在沒看到成果之前大家都輕視教育。年輕人就是學不乖。

original: Have you, by chance, seen my research notes? I seem to have misplaced them.
string: 你有沒有看見我的研究筆記？我好像把它放錯了地方。

original: Another day, another opportunity to learn!
string: 新的一天！有一個可以學習的機會！

original: What you learn here will last you a lifetime. Several, if you're talented.
string: 你在這裡學到的東西夠你用一輩子的。有天分的話，幾輩子。

original: It's no secret that the College's reputation in Skyrim is... tainted.
string: 在天際省，魔法學院名聲掃地已經不是什麼秘密了。

original: Please don't do anything to anger the locals. They don't need additional reasons to hate us.
string: 求你別去激怒這些當地人了。他們已經夠恨我們的了。

original: It is not the place of the College to become involved in local politics.
string: 魔法學院不應該變成一個被捲入地區政治鬥爭當中的地方。

original: Someday the College may be fully accepted by the Nords. I hope that my work as Arch-Mage may help.
string: 總有一天諾德人會完全接受魔法學院，我希望作為首席法師的我能夠對此起到積極作用。

original: Please don't bother the Arch-Mage unless it's absolutely necessary.
string: 如非絕對必要，請別打擾首席法師。

original: If there are any problems, let me know. It's my job to keep things running smoothly.
string: 要是有任何問題，就跟我說。我的職責就是讓一切順利進行。

original: Day-to-day operations are my responsibility, which means if you become a problem, you get sent to me.
string: 日常事務都在我的職責範圍之內，也就是說，如果你出了什麼問題，就會被送到我這裡來。

original: Mine is not a popular position, but someone needs to keep things running smoothly around here.
string: 我的職位不大受人歡迎，不過總得有人來主持局面，好讓一切順利運行。

original: Like it or not, this College is a direct influence on the public's impressions of magic and those that use it.
string: 你喜歡與否我都要說，人們對魔法和施法者的態度直接受到這所學院所左右。

original: It is up to each of us to present ourselves publicly as maturely as possible, and to remain above petty local squabbles.
string: 我們要做到在公眾面前顯得成熟穩重，超然於一些世俗雜事。

original: I still can't believe it. You, the Arch-Mage? Never would have guessed it.
string: 我還是不敢相信。你，成了首席法師？打死我以前也猜不到。

original: You know, this is one of a very few places where you can receive a real education in the schools of magic.
string: 你知道，這是碩果僅存的幾處你能夠學到真正魔法的地方。

original: I think my parents reserved a spot for me here at the College on the day I was born.
string: 我想，我的父母在我出生之時就替我報名學院了。

original: There's a lot of pressure for me to excel in my studies. I hope I can live up to expectations.
string: 我的研習需要克服很大的壓力。希望能夠不負眾望。

original: Thanks to you, the people of Skyrim will continue to have a place to study magic. Even if most of them resent you for it.
string: 真心感謝你，留住了天際這樣一處可以讓人研習魔法的場所。即使大多數人會因此討厭你。

original: I never would have suspected that the Eye could be so dangerous. Tolfdir is right, isn't he? Magic really can overwhelm you.
string: 我絕對想不到這眼睛竟然能夠如此危險。托夫迪爾是對的，不是嗎？魔法真的能讓你走火入魔。

original: I've certainly learned more here than I ever expected to.
string: 在這裡，可以肯定，我學到的東西比我期望到的還要多。

original: I wonder if the College's reptuation will ever recover from our adventures.
string: 我真不知道我們的冒險能否挽回魔法學院的名聲。

original: The College is a bit of an oddity in Skyrim. Magic isn't something that's looked upon fondly here.
string: 魔法學院在整個天際省中顯得很奇特。魔法一直不怎麼受人重視。

original: Nords don't trust magic, or those that use it. Made it difficult for me growing up.
string: 諾德人不相信魔法，更別說它的使用者了。這讓我很難有什麼成長。

original: They won't say much, but most people have very strong opinions about the College and those that study here.
string: 他們不會說什麼，但是大多數人對魔法學院及其中的人都有些抗拒感。

original: Don't expect the local Nords to take kindly to you once they find out you're from the College.
string: 一旦他們發現你是魔法學院的人，這些諾德人就不會給你好臉色看了。

original: J'zargo is pleased, and more than a little jealous, to greet the new Arch-Mage.
string: 見到新首席法師，紮格很高興，也有一點點嫉妒。

original: J'zargo had expected to be named Arch-Mage. But there is still time.
string: 紮格早就想當首席法師。但看來還需要些時間了。

original: Are the Arch-Mage's robes as comfortable as J'zargo believes them to be?
string: 首席法師的長袍穿在身上，有紮格想像中的那麼舒服嗎？

original: Skyrim couldn't be more different from Elsweyr. But magic... Magic's the same no matter where you go.
string: 天際和艾斯維爾可謂天差地別。不過魔法嘛……魔法到哪裡都是一樣的。

original: J'zargo will go wherever he can to learn more. Oblivion itself, if need be.
string: 紮格願意到任何他可以學到更多東西的地方去。只要有需要，就算湮滅也願意去。

original: Khajiit are not known as mages, so J'zargo has much to prove.
string: 虎人不以法師出名，所以紮格還需要證明自己。

original: J'zargo can learn magic from these men and elves, but they cannot learn to be as dashing as he. J'zargo comes out on top.
string: 紮格能夠從這些人類和精靈身上學到魔法，但是他們不能像他如此勤奮學習。紮格總是搶先做到。

original: I think we could blow up half of Eastmarch, and people would still come to us for enchantments.
string: 我看就算我們炸掉半個東陲，人們還是會到我們這裡來附魔。

original: The local Nords may not like us very much, but they don't seem to mind having access to enchanted weapons and armor.
string: 當地的諾德人不是很喜歡我們，但是他們似乎並不介意使用由我們附魔的兵器和護甲。

original: Savos doesn't care for politics. He likes to believe the College is removed from the rest of Skyrim.
string: 薩沃斯不關心政治。他相信魔法學院是游離於其他天際城市之外的地方。

original: If he could, Savos would float the the entire College above Skyrim, for all the Nords to see.
string: 如果他可以，薩沃斯會把整個魔法學院都浮在天際省之上，讓所有諾德人都能看見。

original: Greetings, Arch-Mage.
string: 幸會，首席法師。

original: May I help you, Arch-Mage?
string: 有需要我效勞的嗎，首席法師？

original: Dying breed, eh? Well what do you call that then!
string: 血脈斷絕？好吧，那你管這個叫什麼！

original: It's time to face the truth, old friend. You, Vex, Mercer... you're all part of a dying breed. Things are changing!
string: 老朋友，是時候面對現實了。你，「小煩」，墨瑟……你們都是即將斷絕的血脈。情況要變化了！

original: We've all heard that one before, Bryn! Quit kidding yourself.
string: 布林，我們都已經聽說了那個人！別自己騙自己了。

original: I'm telling you, this one is different...
string: 我告訴你，這一個可不一樣……

original: Give it up, Brynjolf... those days are over.
string: 放棄吧，布林喬夫……過去的日子一去不復返了。

original: When you're ready, I'll keep the rest of your gear safe until you get back.
string: 你準備好了以後，我會幫你保管你的裝備，直到你回來。

original: You'll only have what Malborn smuggled in for you, plus whatever you can pick up inside.
string: 你只能裝備馬伯恩偷帶進去的東西，外加任何在裡面能撿到的東西。

original: Not yet.
string: 還沒有。

original: You need to meet with him and give him whatever you think you can't live without while you're inside the embassy.
string: 你需要跟他見面，然後把你進入使館時會需要的所有東西都交給他。

original: The Thalmor are paranoid and thorough. You won't get in the front door with anything but the clothes on your back.
string: 梭默那群人疑心很重， 帶著兵器的話，你不可能踏入他們的正門

original: Yes, Malborn's all set.
string: 對，馬伯恩已經全部準備好了。

original: Good. I have your invitation to the party.
string: 好，我有你參加宴會的請柬了。

original: But the only way you're going to get past the guards is if they really believe you're an invited guest.
string: 但唯一能通過衛兵檢查的方法，是讓他們確信你是受邀而來的客人。

original: Which means you need to look the part, and not be armed to the teeth. Here, put this on.
string: 也就意味著，你的打扮得要夠逼真，不能全副武裝，來，穿上這個。

original: Hold on a minute.
string: 等等。

original: This is no time for cold feet. I've put everything in your hands here, not least Malborn's life.
string: 沒時間讓你怯場了。我把一切希望都寄託在你身上，包括馬伯恩的命。

original: Now do whatever it is you need to do, and let's get going before we miss our chance!
string: 去做你該做的事情，然後趁著還有機會趕快行動！

original: I'm ready. Keep the rest of my things safe for me.
string: 我準備好了，看好我的其他東西。

original: Don't worry, it will all be waiting for you when you get back.
string: 別擔心，你回來的時候你的東西會原封不動的。

original: Just make sure you get back out of there alive with the information we need.
string: 只要你確保能活著回來，並帶回我們所需要的情報。

original: Good luck.
string: 祝你好運。

original: I'm ready to go.
string: 我準備好了。

original: You can't go to a party at the Thalmor Embassy dressed like that.
string: 你不能就穿著這身衣服去參加梭默大使館的宴會。

original: Have you given Malborn the gear you want to smuggle into the embassy?
string: 你有沒把想偷運進大使館的裝備交給馬伯恩？

original: Hold on, I need to get a few things ready.
string: 稍等，我要去準備一些事情。

original: I'll give you a few more minutes. I can't wait here all day. It's my neck on the line, remember.
string: 我會等多你一會兒，但不能太久。別忘記，我是冒著生命危險的。

original: I'm ready. Here's what I'll need.
string: 我準備好了，這些是我將會需要的東西。

original: Okay. I'll get this inside the Embassy for you. I've got to go. I'll find you at the party, don't worry.
string: 好了，我會幫你把這個送進大使館。我要走了。宴會裡見，別擔心。

original: I'm ready to go.
string: 我準備好了。

original: Your job is to get into the party without being fingered as a spy. I'll take care of the rest.
string: 你的任務是在沒人發現你是間諜的情況下參加宴會。其他的我來搞定。

original: Here's the deal. I can smuggle some equipment into the Embassy for you.
string: 聽著，我能幫你把一些裝備偷運進大使館。

original: Don't plan on bringing anything else in with you. The Thalmor take security very seriously.
string: 別打算帶著其他東西。梭默的安全措施非常嚴格。

original: Give me what you can't live without, and I'll make sure to get it into the Embassy. The rest is up to you.
string: 把你必需的東西給我，我會確保它們能運進大使館。接下來就看你了。

original: You ready yet? I need to get back before I'm missed. Remember, you won't have anything except what I smuggle in for you.
string: 準備好沒？再不回去我就要被人發現了。記住一點，除了我偷運進去的，你千萬不能帶其他東西。

original: Our mutual friend sent me.
string: 我們的共同朋友派我來的。

original: Really? You're who she picked? I hope she knows what she's doing.
string: 真的？你就是她所選的人？但願她清楚自己在做什麼？

original: You should just serve your time. Find an ore vein and start digging.
string: 好好服刑吧，找個礦脈去挖。

original: You're not in here for life, like I am.
string: 你不像我，要被關一輩子。

original: I left behind my daughter Uaile when I was taken.
string: 在我被帶走時，我丟下了我的女兒，烏哀樂。

original: How old is my daughter now, I wonder? In prison, you lose track of time.
string: 我想知道，我女兒多大了？待在監獄裡會忘記時間。

original: I'm just another Forsworn sent to rot here in this mine.
string: 我只是另一個被丟在這裡自生自滅的棄誓者。

original: You need to not bother me.
string: 別打擾我。

original: You're talking to a killer, remember that.
string: 別忘記，你在跟一個殺手說話。

original: You serve your time by digging. So dig.
string: 你是服刑來挖礦的。繼續挖。

original: Prison's not so bad. Less complaints when I kill people.
string: 監獄也不是那麼差。起碼我在這裡殺人時，沒那麼多人抱怨。

original: What?
string: 什麼？

original: Cidhna Mine's for prisoner scum only. Keep out.
string: 希訥礦坑只開放給雜碎犯人，閒人勿近。

original: I'm in charge of the prisoners here.
string: 這裡的犯人歸我管。

original: No funny business. I'm watching you.
string: 別亂來，我在盯著你。

original: You do something out of line, I'll put you down.
string: 你不守規矩，我就讓你倒下。

original: Don't reach for a shiv around me, or we'll both regret it.
string: 別想拿走我身邊的刀，否則你我都會後悔。

original: What do you want? Have digging to do.
string: 你要做什麼？我得繼續挖呢。

original: Other prisoners get suspicious when we talk to each other, so keep it down.
string: 其他犯人對我們的談話起疑心了，小聲點。

original: Whenever I get out of here, I'm going to go kill a Nord.
string: 有朝一日我自由了，我一定會去殺掉一個諾德人。

original: I was sent here because someone said I was a Forsworn.
string: 我被丟在這裡是因為有人說我是棄誓者。

original: I'm innocent. The Nords framed me. I was nowhere near that murder weapon.
string: 我是無辜的。諾德人陷害我。我根本沒碰過那些兇器。

original: I wonder how grandma Bothela is doing. She's probably worried sick about me.
string: 我想知道波塞拉奶奶過得怎麼樣了。她可能很擔心我。

original: What do you want, new blood?
string: 你想要什麼，新人？

original: Jarl decided I was too much of a problem. Threw me in here with the Forsworn.
string: 領主認定我是個大麻煩，就把我扔進這裡跟棄誓者待在一起。

original: I got locked up one too many times. Now I'm in for life.
string: 我進過太多次監獄了，現在我得在這監獄裡待一輩子。

original: I swear, if I ever get out of here, I'm giving up thieving. Really.
string: 我發誓，如果我有幸能離開這裡，我絕不會再偷東西，真的。

original: You mess with the Silver-Blood family, you end up here.
string: 你要是惹了銀血家族，就會到這來。

original: I catch you stealing anything, I'll break your neck.
string: 要是抓到你偷東西，我就把脖子折斷。

original: Now this is real guard duty. Just throw them in the mine and be done with it.
string: 警衛的工作可真簡單。把人扔到礦坑裡就沒事了。

original: Hurry it up. I've got to get back before I'm missed.
string: 快點。我得在他們發現我消失之前回去。

original: Come on. If someone misses me at the party, we're both dead.
string: 來啊。要是有人發現我不在宴會裡，我們都完了。

original: I need to lock the door behind you or the patrols might notice something's wrong.
string: 我要把你身後的門鎖上，否則巡邏兵可能會發現有什麼不對勁。

original: Your gear is in that chest. I'll lock the door behind you. Don't screw this up.
string: 你的東西在那箱子裡。我會把你身後的門鎖上。別搞砸了。

original: I'm ready.
string: 準備好了。

original: Of course. Let me see if we have another bottle of that.
string: 當然。讓我看看還有沒有另一瓶。

original: I'll be waiting by the door for everyone to be distracted.
string: 我會在門邊等著所有人的注意力被轉移。

original: Tss! Get out of here, I saw nothing.
string: 嘖！離開這裡吧，我什麼都沒看見。

original: Perhaps I should ask the Ambassador...
string: 也許我應該去問問大使……

original: Rules, is it, Tsavani? I didn't realize that eating Moon Sugar was permitted.
string: 規矩是嗎，薩瓦尼？我怎麼不知道吃月糖是被許可的。

original: A guest? In the kitchens? You know this is against the rules...
string: 客人？在廚房裡？你明白這樣是違反規矩的。

original: A guest, feeling ill. Leave the poor wretch be.
string: 一個客人，生病了。放過這個可憐人吧。

original: Who comes, Malborn? You know I don't like strange smells in my kitchen.
string: 誰來了，馬伯恩？你知道我不喜歡廚房裡有生人氣味。

original: So far so good. Let's hope nobody saw us slip out.
string: 運氣不錯。希望沒有人看見我們溜出來。

original: We need to pass through the kitchen. Your gear is hidden in the larder.
string: 我們要經過廚房。你的物品就隱藏在食物櫥裡。

original: Just stay close and let me do any talking, got it? Follow me.
string: 跟緊我，別吭聲，懂嗎？跟我來。

original: Tell me about Alduin's Wall.
string: 告訴我些奧杜因之牆的事。

original: Alduin's Wall was created by the ancient Akaviri Dragonguard, the forerunners of the Blades.
string: 奧杜因之牆由上古阿卡維爾神龍衛，也就是刀鋒衛士組織的前身所造，

original: One of the lost secrets of the Blades. Where they recorded all they knew of Alduin and his return. Part history, part prophecy.
string: 刀鋒衛士的其中一個遺失的秘密，記載了他們所有知道關於奧杜因以及他回歸的事情。一部分是史實，一部分是預言。

original: Its location was lost for centuries, but I know where it is: Sky Haven Temple, an ancient Blades sanctuary, hidden within the crags of the Reach.
string: 它的位置在多個世紀以來不為人知，但我知道它在哪裡：天堂廟宇，隱藏於邊塞懸崖中的古代刀鋒衛士避難所，

original: We must go, quickly now. Take me to Delphine. We have much to discuss.
string: 我們該立即上路。帶我去找戴爾菲娜。我們還有很多東西要談。

original: You're talking about... the literal end of the world?
string: 你是說……當真有世界末日？

original: Oh, yes! The prophecies make clear the signs that will precede the end times. One by one, I have seen them fulfilled.
string: 噢，是的！預言明確指出那些會在末日之前發生的事。我已經看見它們一一實現了。

original: I tried to tell them. They wouldn't listen. Fools. It's all come true... all I could do was watch our doom approach...
string: 我試過告訴他們。他們不聽。一群笨蛋。現在全成真了……我只能眼睜睜地看著我們的末日降臨……

original: Doom? You mean the return of the dragons?
string: 末日？你的意思是龍族的回歸？

original: Dragons, pah. They can be killed. The Blades killed many in their early days as dragon-slayers.
string: 龍，呸。他們不是無敵的。刀鋒衛士作為屠龍者，在早些年就殺過很多。

original: No, the dragons are merely the final portent of the End of Days.
string: 不，龍族只是末日前的最後一個預兆。

original: You're talking about... the end of the world?
string: 你說的是……世界末日？

original: That's what everyone keeps telling me.
string: 每個人都跟我說這翻話。

original: Then... there is hope after all. For so long, all I could do was watch our doom approach, helplessly.
string: 總之……我們還有希望。一直以來，我只能絕望的等待著末日的到來。

original: It's a possibility we can't ignore.
string: 這是我們不可忽略的可能性。

original: No! You're wrong. You must be wrong. Laelette may have met her fate out in the marsh.
string: 不！你錯了。你一定搞錯了。拉萊特可能是在沼澤裡看見她的命運。

original: I refuse to believe Alva had anything to do with this. There is no way you can prove it to the Jarl.
string: 我不會相信阿爾瓦跟這件事有任何關聯。你沒有證據可以向領主證明。

original: The other one? What do you mean?
string: 另一個人？什麼意思？

original: I can't tell you. She might hear me. She's so close.
string: 我不能告訴你。她離我們很近，可能會聽見的。

original: If you can find me first, I can tell you.
string: 要是你能先找到我，我就告訴你。

original: Make Laelette go away!
string: 叫拉萊特滾蛋！

original: On threat of what, exactly? This city wouldn't run without me! Now if you'll excuse me, my work awaits.
string: 你說我威脅了什麼阿？這城市沒了我可就完蛋了！現在如果你不介意的話，我還有很多工作等著我。

original: Miss Stentor, watch your tongue in the Jarl's court!
string: 斯丹特小姐，在領主的法庭上請管好妳的嘴！

original: And? I've seen jarls come and go. This one only became Jarl because her husband died. She'll be replaced in a matter of months.
string: 所以？我看過不少領主的起伏興衰。而這個人純粹因為她丈夫死了才成為領主。所以她被取代也只是時間的問題。

original: Very well. But I suspect her grace will not be pleased.
string: 很好。但我覺得夫人不會高興。

original: Yes, and I'm also aware of how necessary my divinations and wards have been in the city's defense. My experiments are all I ask for in return.
string: 是的，同時我也知道我的占卜術和結界對於城市防衛有多麼重要。我只要求以我的實驗作為回報。

original: Miss Stentor, these are quite expensive. I trust you know how limited the hold's funds are at this time?
string: 斯丹特小姐，這些都挺貴的。相信你也知道我們領地目前不太富裕吧？

original: Steward, I will need the following reagents for my studies. Please see to them.
string: 總管。我的研究需要用到這些試劑。請你負責準備好。

original: "Fair" is a word rarely applied to politics, my grace. I'm afraid you must learn to accept this.
string: 「公平」這個詞不太適用在政治上，大人。我想您必須學會接受這個事實。

original: He uses all of Haafingar's resources, and doesn't answer to me in the slightest? This hardly seems fair.
string: 他用了海芬加的全部資源，卻不需要聽從我的指令？這太不公平了。

original: I'm afraid he can. His authority comes from the emperor. Who you also serve, technically.
string: 恐怕他可以這麼做。他是被皇帝直接授權的。確切的說，皇帝也是您的主子。

original: Again? He can't simply cancel an appointment with the Jarl! He serves in my capital city!
string: 又一次？他不能就這樣把領主的會面取消掉！他是在我的首都裡工作！

original: I'm afraid he's had to reschedule, my grace. By all accounts, waging war takes his every moment.
string: 恐怕他已經更改時間了，大人。大家都說，作戰佔據了他全部時間。

original: Steward, when is my appointment to meet with General Tullius? There are some issues we must speak about.
string: 總管，我和圖留斯將軍的會面安排在什麼時候？我們有一些議題必須討論。

original: That may well be our only answer. I will empower my Steward to seek out capable individuals to secure Haafingar. Thank you, my Thanes.
string: 這大概便是我們唯一的答案。我將授權我的總管去找到有能之士來保衛海芬加，謝謝，武衛。

original: Humph. That's only a problem for people who can't afford to hire their own security.
string: 哼。那個問題只是對於沒錢雇傭保鏢的人們而言。

original: Trouble on the roads and cities means less commerce. Less commerce means less money and more starving people. And that means more crime.
string: 道路和城市裡的麻煩意味著貿易的減少。貿易減少意味著沒錢和更多的人挨餓。也就意味著犯罪的增多。

original: My dear Bryling. Barring any... fancy and folly... the good people of Haafingar are surely capable of dealing with the odd highwayman or stray dog.
string: 我親愛的白靈。 撇除那些幻想和荒唐不談……海芬加的人們可以很輕鬆地對付那些小盜賊和流浪狗。

original: The Stormcloaks are far from the only threat to the hold. The roads are beset by bandits and beasts... and now there's even talk of bloody dragons.
string: 風暴斗篷遠不是領地的唯一威脅。領地的道路不斷受到強盜和野獸的滋擾……而現在甚至還有關於該死的巨龍的傳言。

original: I don't see any reason why we'd need them. As long as those dogs stay outside of our borders, we're fine.
string: 我不明白為什麼會需要它們。只要這些狗待在我們邊界之外，我們就不會有事。

original: The news is the same as it's been for the rest of the war, your grace. Our borders are secure, but at the cost of the guards for our towns and roads.
string: 情況一直就跟之前戰爭開打時一樣，大人。我們的邊境是安全的，但是城鎮跟道路卻無人防守。

original: Thane Bryling, what do you have to report about the state of Haafingar's defenses?
string: 白靈武衛，對於海芬加的情況你有什麼要匯報的？

original: That is quite enough. Perhaps I will raise these issues when I have an audience with General Tullius.
string: 夠了。也許我會見圖留斯將軍時會提出這些問題。

original: The Stormcloaks only rebel because the Empire uses Skyrim as its personal larder. The more they take, the more support the rebels gain!
string: 風暴斗篷會反叛只因為帝國隨意榨取天際。帝國拿得越多，反叛就獲得越多的支持！

original: My lady... Surely you're not that naive. Such foolishness would only leave us defenseless. The rebels would storm the palace in an afternoon.
string: 我的小姐……你一定沒有那麼天真。做出那樣愚蠢的事只會讓我們毫無防備。反叛軍只需用一下午的時間就能席捲我們的宮殿。

original: Simple. Let the Empire fight its own war, with its own funds, and without hijacking our supplies and soldiers. Let Haafingar rebuild.
string: 簡單。讓帝國用自己資金打自己的戰爭，也不要讓他們盜用我們的資源和士兵。讓海芬加重建吧。

original: And what would my impetuous Thane Bryling suggest, instead?
string: 而我們衝動的白靈武衛又建議什麼？

original: Listen to you, speaking of sacrifice. You've never gone hungry a day in your life, Erikur!
string: 聽你說的，又談什麼犧牲奉獻。你從來不知道饑餓是什麼滋味，艾瑞庫爾！

original: This is an unfortunate but unavoidable ebb in revenue. But as long as we continue to support the Empire, our sacrifices will be well rewarded.
string: 這些財政上的損失是不幸卻又不可避免的。但是只要我們繼續支持帝國，我們的犧牲就會得到回報。

original: As you know, Solitude's coffers are much depleted by the war efforts. Thane Erikur, you have a strong head for business. What do you suggest?
string: 如你所知，獨孤城的國庫正因為戰爭而枯竭。艾瑞庫爾武衛，你很有商業頭腦，對此有何建議？

original: Hmph. Music tames the most savage beasts. Even Nords.
string: 哼。音樂能馴服大部分野蠻人和猛獸。甚至是諾德人。

original: You'd better hope the war's over by then. The Stormcloaks would eat you alive!
string: 你最好希望那時候戰爭已經結束了。不然風暴斗篷會生吞了你！

original: Lady Ateia has already arranged for me to perform in the court of the Jarl of Falkreath.
string: 阿提亞小姐已經為我安排好在佛克瑞斯主的庭院表演的事宜。

original: What're you going to do after you graduate? I'm thinking of joining the Legion. I hear they're looking for skalds. Just think. Me - a war bard.
string: 畢業以後你準備做什麼？我在考慮加入軍團。聽說他們在尋找吟遊詩人。想像一下，我——戰爭詩人。

original: Try not to play favorites, Lady Ateia. It does a disservice to the whole class.
string: 別特別偏袒誰，阿提亞小姐。這樣對全班都有壞處。

original: Of course not! Complacency is the bane of art. They're in good hands with you, Inge.
string: 當然不要！自滿是藝術的毒藥。你把他們處理得很好，因格。

original: I'm sorry to break it to you, Giraud, but students are an unfortunate necessity of a college. Do try to persevere.
string: 我必須老實跟你說，吉勞德，學生對於學院來說是一個不幸的必需品。堅持下去。

original: Passably. Aia is my star pupil. None of the others can hold a candle to her. Especially not that wretched llldi.
string: 還可以。艾雅是我的模範生。沒有人能和她媲美。特別是那卑鄙的伊爾迪！

original: Some of them have a long way to go, but they're mostly passable. Don't let them hear I said that, though!
string: 他們有些人還有很長的路要走，但他們大部分還很有天資。不過別告訴他們我這麼說過！

original: Bunch of distractions, if you ask me. They just interrupt the rest of my work.
string: 一堆煩人的東西，如果你要問我的話。他們只會打斷我的工作。

original: Yes, headmaster.
string: 是的，校長。

original: How are your students coming along?
string: 你的學生進展如何？

original: Yes, well, see that you keep at it. That is all.
string: 是的，好吧，希望能繼續維持下去。就這樣吧。

original: I'll be the judge of that. Now, back to your practice.
string: 我會自行判斷。現在，回去繼續練習。

original: Patience, Illdi. We study the heroes of the past so we can have better understanding of the heroes of today... and tomorrow.
string: 耐心點，伊爾迪。我們研究過去的英雄，是為了更好地理解現在的英雄……還有將來的。

original: I'm sure it will be fine. Just don't be late.
string: 我相信那會非常棒的。只是記住，別遲到。

original: Yes, Lady Ateia. My voice is strong as a Dragonborn's!
string: 是的，阿提亞小姐。我的聲音像龍裔一樣強而有力！

original: Always! Perfection takes dedication, after all!
string: 永遠是這樣！十年磨一劍！

original: Yes, madam. I know I have a lot to work on.
string: 是的，長官。我知道我有很多地方要加強。

original: I've converted the classic tale of Eyldi the Bear to be performed with drums. I think you'll be impressed!
string: 我嘗試用鼓來表演巨熊埃爾蒂的經典橋段。希望你會喜歡！

original: At this point, I hardly see how your advice would improve it. It's flawless.
string: 在這點上，我看不出你的建議能讓它有什麼改進。它原本就是無可挑剔的。

original: Oh, thank you! I've been working on an original piece. I hope it can stand up to the classics!
string: 噢，謝謝！我一直想做出一個獨特的新作品。希望它能夠比得上那些經典之作！

original: Yes sir, Professor Gemane! It's a war epic about Hoag Merkiller's last stand!
string: 是的，先生，格瑪尼教授！這是一部關於胡奧格．精靈殺手最終之戰的戰爭史詩！

original: Must it be written? Poetry is so dull when it isn't set to music.
string: 一定要用寫的嗎？詩歌如果沒有音樂配合是很無趣的。

original: Why do we always focus on retelling the old stories? There are so many new stories being made, right now...
string: 為什麼我們要抓著老故事不放？有那麼多新故事可以當題材……

original: You there. Have you performed your voice exercises today?
string: 你。你今天有沒去練聲？

original: Your solo performance is about a week away. I expect to hear your early rendition tomorrow, understand?
string: 距你的單獨表演還有大概一星期。我希望明天能先聽到你的試唱，知道嗎？

original: Pardon me, but I trust you've been working on your poem, on the classical heroes of Skyrim, yes?
string: 打擾了，我相信你在準備著你的詩歌，關於天際的古典英雄，對吧？

original: Kynareth has blessed you with tremendous compassion, Silana. You will find a way, I'm sure of it.
string: 凱娜瑞絲憐憫你，賜福於你，西拉娜。你會找到方法的，我確信。

original: I know, and I appreciate it dearly. But I can't help but feel we could be doing more...
string: 我明白，我非常欣賞。但是我幫不上，只是覺得我們應該能做點什麼？

original: We took you in, didn't we? We would be glad to extend our welcome to any other who showed your dedication. What more could we do?
string: 我們接納了你，不是嗎？我們很榮幸有機會歡迎像你這樣具有奉獻精神的人。還有比這更好的嗎？

original: Mistress, the people of Solitude are destitute. Many are starving and desperate for work. We need to be more active, to reach out to them.
string: 夫人，獨孤城的人都很貧窮。大部分人都挨餓並且沒能力工作。我們要主動一些，向他們伸出援手。

original: What could be more important than hearing the prayers of the faithful, and answering the questions of the dedicated?
string: 有什麼能比傾聽虔誠的人們然後對他們作出回應更重要的事情呢？

original: I know you and father Rorlund have many duties to attend to in the temple, but sometimes I feel that there are more important matters to attend to.
string: 我知道你和你的父親洛倫德對神殿負有重大責任，但我覺得有更重要的事情要做。

original: Certainly, acolyte. What troubles you?
string: 當然了，侍祭。有什麼困擾著你的？

original: Mistress, a word?
string: 夫人，方便談一談嗎？

original: I see you have meditated on this subject quite thoroughly. I shall not stop you, but please, try to attend to your temple duties as well.
string: 我知道你在這件事上非常認真。我不會叫你停手，但請你也能同時兼顧神殿的職責。

original: I respectfully disagree, sir. Stendarr and Zenithar may demand strength from them, but Mara and Dibella demand compassion from us.
string: 我抱有敬意地不敢苟同，閣下。斯坦德爾和澤尼薩爾可能需要他們的力量。瑪拉和蒂貝拉卻需要我們的憐憫。

original: Your compassion is admirable, but you see, we cannot help them all. The poor must learn from the examples of the gods and raise themselves up.
string: 你的仁慈受人尊敬，但你知道，我們幫不了所有人。窮人必須學習神的榜樣然後自立。

original: Oh, yes sir. I feel many of Solitude's families are having trouble getting by, and the wealthy do nothing to help them!
string: 噢，是的先生。我感覺到獨孤城裡很多家庭都難以維持生計，而那些闊佬卻袖手旁觀！
