string: 你要去哪……快把我弄下來！

original: Sorry, but I have a treasure to get to...
string: 對不起，我得去找個寶物…

original: So long "friend." Ha ha ha!
string: 永別了「朋友」。哈哈哈！

original: Good luck. Lucan and I will be waiting for you back in the shop.
string: 祝好運。路坎和我會回店裡等你。

original: Yes, we did have a bit of a... break-in. But we still have plenty to sell. Robbers were only after one thing.
string: 是的，我們是發生了起小小的……搶劫案。但我們還是有很多東西賣的。強盜只想要一個東西。

original: An ornament, solid gold. In the shape of a dragon's claw.
string: 一個以黃金製成的飾品，外型像個龍爪。

original: Did something happen?
string: 發生什麼事了？

original: You mean before he died? We had a break in. Thieves didn't touch anything on the shelves, or any coin, just one thing.
string: 你的意思是在他死之前？有人跑到店裡偷東西。竊賊沒有碰架上的任何東西，也沒有拿錢，只拿走了一樣東西。

original: A solid gold ornament, in the shape of a dragon's claw.
string: 一個十足黃金的飾品，像個龍爪。

original: What were you arguing about with Lucan?
string: 你在和路坎爭論什麼？

original: Show those thieves not to steal from Lucan Valerius!
string: 該讓那些賊知道不該從路坎．瓦勒瑞斯這裡偷東西！

original: The sooner you find the claw, the sooner our lives can get back to normal.
string: 你越早找到龍爪，我們就越早能過正常生活。

original: You're back from Bleak Falls. Did you find anything?
string: 你從荒瀑回來了。找到什麼了嗎？

original: Don't let my sister do anything foolish.
string: 別讓我姐做傻事。

original: I don't know what you overheard, but the Riverwood Trader is still open. Feel free to shop.
string: 我不知道你聽到什麼，但河木鎮貿易商行還開著。歡迎光臨。

original: You're not getting that treasure.
string: 你不會得到那寶藏的。

original: I'm too swift for you!
string: 我快過你太多了！

original: Too slow!
string: 太慢了！

original: Lucan over in the Riverwood Trader says thieves broke into his store. Strange, he says they hardly took anything.
string: 河木鎮貿易商行的老闆路坎說有竊賊闖入了他的店。奇怪，他說他們沒拿什麼東西。

original: Did you hear? The Riverwood Trader was robbed! Poor Lucan must be torn to pieces over it.
string: 你聽說了嗎？河木鎮貿易商行被搶了！可憐的路坎一定難過極了。

original: I heard Lucan yelling the other day about a thief breaking into his store. It wasn't me, honest!
string: 我聽到路坎某天在大叫有個小偷闖進他的店裡。那不是我，真的。

original: Maybe you could talk some sense into my pig-headed brother.
string: 也許你能點醒我那豬頭兄弟。

original: Lucan's dead. I guess I'm in charge of the Riverwood Trader now.
string: 路坎死了。我想現在我是河木鎮貿易商行的店長了。

original: I guess Lucan will never see the golden claw again now.
string: 我想路坎再也不會見到那黃金龍爪了。

original: Mara bless you for agreeing to help us.
string: 瑪拉保佑向我們伸出援手的你。

original: If you're going after the claw, you'll need to know the way.
string: 如果你要找黃金龍爪，你得知道路。

original: So, you need a guide out of town after all?
string: 所以，你還是要一個熟悉城外的嚮導？

original: Bleak Falls Barrow is just outside of town. I can show you.
string: 荒瀑古墳就在鎮外。我帶你去。

original: This way.
string: 這邊走。

original: You have the claw. Oh, you have to tell Lucan at once. Hurry!
string: 你拿到龍爪了。哦，你得趕緊告訴路坎。快！

original: Hurry up and tell Lucan you have the claw. He'll be so excited!
string: 快告訴路坎你拿到了龍爪。他會很高興的！

original: For the Empire!

original: Time to show what you're really made of.
string: 考驗你們的時候到了。

original: Things look quiet enough here. Come on. There's my uncle.
string: 四周看起來都很安靜。快，那是我叔叔。

original: How did you know I'd be able to defeat Ancano?
string: 你怎麼知道我能打敗安卡諾？

original: A great many things obscured to you are quite clear to us. We have long believed you would prevail.
string: 我們很清楚許多發生在你身上的事情。我們很早就知道你會成功。

original: What do we do now?

original: The Eye has grown unstable. It cannot remain here, or else it may destroy your College and this world.

original: It must be secured. Ancano's actions prove that the world is not ready for such a thing.

original: We shall safeguard it... for now.
string: 至少現在……我們要保護它。

string: 現在你們有機會可以保有你們的學院，你們應該繼續用生命保護下去。

original: You have our gratitude, Arch-Mage.
string: 我們衷心感謝你，首席法師大人。

original: We knew you would succeed.
string: 我們就知道你會成功的。

original: Your victory here justifies our belief in you. You have proven yourself more than worthy to guide the College of Winterhold.
string: 你果然不負眾望贏得了勝利。你的傑出表現證明你有資格領導冬堡魔法學院，甚至還會遊刃有餘。

original: You dare approach me here? Are you mad? You cannot hope to defeat me!
string: 你竟敢到這來找我？你瘋了吧？你不可能打敗我！

original: Die, worm!
string: 去死，蛆蟲！

original: The College will not fall!
string: 學院絕不會沒落！

original: We will prevail!
string: 我們終將獲勝！

original: I'll not go down without a fight!
string: 我只會在戰鬥中倒下！

original: It is time for us to go.
string: 我們該走了。

original: I have no quarrel with you.
string: 我不想跟你吵。

original: I'm afraid you do.
string: 恐怕這已是既成事實。

original: Get out of my way.
string: 滾一邊去。

original: You fool. You don't stand a chance.
string: 你這笨蛋。你根本沒有勝算。

string: dunHillgrundsTombSharedAuntQuestion

string: 唉……我一點也不覺得自豪。我對那地方充滿恐懼而且阿格娜阿姨很清楚這一點。

original: My Da locked me in there in a drunken rage when he left us... three days in there eating the offerings left for our dead before Aunt Agna found me.
string: 我的老爹酩酊大醉的時候把我關在了這裡然後揚長而去……阿格娜阿姨找到我之前，我吃了三天給死人的供品。

If I can just... stand up...

string: 求你……放過我……

original: No... not like this...
string: 不……不是這樣……

original: You really shouldn't be in here, but I guess since it's you...
string: 你真不應該來這裡，不過我想，正因為是你……

original: I'll let you stay. This time.
string: 我允許你留下。這次允許。

original: If you were anyone else, I'd make you leave.
string: 要是別人的話，我就直接轟走了。

string: 你真的不該……唉，不該在這裡。

string: 你應該知道你現在不應該出現在這裡。

string: 你可以留下，但是你不應該來。

string: 其實我一點都不想要那玩意兒。

original: I suppose that's yours now.
string: 我想那現在是你的了。

original: Oh, what a clever thief you are.
string: 噢，你真是個聰明絕頂的小偷。

original: You could have asked before just taking it.
string: 你在借走它之前其實可以先問我的。

original: I guess I can look the other way, this time.
string: 我想我這次可以把頭轉到另一邊去，就這一次。

original: Guess they deserved it...
string: 他們大概有資格得到它……

original: What's done is done.
string: 該做的都做完了。

original: Well... that was an unpleasant bit of business.
string: 嗯……那是個比較討厭的事情。

original: I didn't know you were so cold-blooded...
string: 我不知道你居然這麼冷血……

original: Remind me not to make you angry.
string: 你得提醒我別惹你生氣。

original: I guess you had your reasons.
string: 我覺得你一定是有理由的。

original: None of my business.
string: 和我有什麼關係。

string: 我覺得那完全沒必要！

original: Was that really necessary?
string: 真的有必要嗎？

original: Why are you doing that?
string: 你為什麼那樣做？

original: Papa told you to do that, not me! Now leave me alone!
string: 是爸爸叫你做的，不是我！別來煩我！

original: I told you to weed the garden by sunset, and you didn't do it. Now you're in big trouble!
string: 我叫你在太陽下山之前把草地修剪完，但你沒有。現在你有大麻煩了！

original: Why? What did I do?
string: 為什麼？我做什麼了？

original: You're going to get it, Sissel!
string: 你馬上就知道了，希塞爾！

original: That sounds lovely. You're very sweet.
string: 聽起來真美妙。你真是個討人喜歡的傢伙。

original: Well that's where I want to build. In the fall forest. Give it an easterly view. The sunrise is almost as pretty as you are.
string: 我就是想蓋在這裡。在秋天的森林裡。目光看向東方。旭日初升的美景和你的臉龐一樣迷人。

original: I've been there before, but I don't know it well.
string: 我去過，但是我不瞭解那個地方。

original: There's a clear spot just west of Riften. You know the area?
string: 緊挨著裂谷城的西邊有一處空地。你知道那地方嗎？

original: Oh? Where?
string: 哦？在哪？

original: I've been thinking about building that cabin we talked about.
string: 我在想怎麼建造我們剛才說的那個小木屋。

original: Perhaps. But not today.
string: 可能吧。但不是最近。

original: One of these days he'll have to learn.
string: 總有一天他會學會的。

original: I just feel like if I'm not here, then something could go wrong. Nils is a hard worker, but I wouldn't trust him to run things.
string: 我只是覺得如果我不在那裡的話，一定會有什麼地方出差錯的。紐斯是一個勤勞的工人，但是我不看好他的經營能力。

original: Just wondering when you'll be ready to give it up and settle down. Seems like you're always working.
string: 我想知道你準備什麼時候放棄，然後過過悠閒日子。你好像總是在工作。

original: Nearly thirty years, now.
string: 到現在……快三十年了。

original: How long have you run this place, again?
string: 再說一次，你經營這家店多久了？

original: Oh! You behave, now!
string: 噢！看你表現了！

original: Hows about we figure out some way to keep warm tonight?
string: 我們想想今晚用什麼辦法保持暖和吧？

original: I'm sorry. What would you like to talk about?
string: 抱歉。你想談什麼？

original: Elda, honey, let's not talk about the war. It's in the past.
string: 艾爾達，親愛的，我們別討論戰爭了。它已經過去了。

original: Tell me about the Great War. I hear you were in the battle of...
string: 告訴我有關浩大戰爭的事。我聽說你曾經在那場戰爭中……

original: Does Mara require more of me?
string: 瑪拉對我沒有別的要求了嗎？

original: I see you are eager to carry the light.
string: 看得出你很想做出更多奉獻。

original: As you venture, Mara fills my mind ever more with visions of love in peril.
string: 你越是深入，瑪拉越是變本加厲地向我的頭腦中輸入愛情破裂的幻象。

original: Embers lie nestled in stone, needing only fuel to bloom to a flame that will warm all around them.
string: 琥珀通常藏在石頭裡，只要有一點燃料就可以熊熊地燃燒起來。

original: Go to Markarth. There you'll find Calcelmo, wise, acid, and reclusive. Help him to emerge and state his intentions.
string: 去馬卡斯城。在那裡你可以找到卡塞莫，他是個睿智但語言尖刻的隱士。想辦法讓他現身並說出他的意圖。

original: This is the prayer heard by the goddess and relayed to her servants.
string: 這是女神聽到了信徒的祈禱而做出的回應。

original: Out of my sight!
string: 給我滾開！

original: No... I was trying to...
string: 不……我是在試著……

original: What? You've been lollygagging in idle reading?
string: 什麼？你居然偷懶看閒書？

original: Erm... no. Not yet. I'm sorry, I was reading up on the effects of distillation.
string: 呃嗯……不。我沒有。我很抱歉，我在研讀有關蒸餾法的作用的資料。

original: Don't be so sure. Now, have you finished grinding the dried snowberries?
string: 別說得這麼肯定。那麼，你把雪漿果乾都研磨完了嗎？

original: I know, master. Don't say such things -- there is always time.
string: 我知道，老師。別說這種話——總會有時間的。

original: I'm sorry to always be so hard on you, boy. I just worry I don't have much time left.
string: 我總是對你這麼嚴厲，我很歉疚，孩子。我只是擔心我的時間所剩不多了。

original: Yes, master. I'm sorry, I'll get back to those notes straight away.
string: 是的，師父。對不起，我待會兒馬上回去繼續找筆記。

original: You can waste your own time, not mine. An apprentice obeys his master. A good one does, at least.
string: 你的時間可以浪費，我的可不能。學徒必須服從導師。至少一個好的學徒是服從的。

original: Yes, master, I know. I just want to keep up my own projects as well.
string: 是的，師父。我知道。我只是想同時做我自己的研究。

original: When I ask you for something, I expect it to get done.
string: 當我叫你做事的時候，我期待這件事情會被完成。

original: Yes, and I'm working on it, but I'm also trying to...
string: 是的，我正在做，但是我同時也在嘗試……

original: Damn it, child, didn't I tell you to gather my notes on sub-material properties?
string: 氣死我了，死孩子，我不是叫你去找我的那個關於副材料性質的筆記嗎？

original: Master, I have a question about infusions of arrowroot.
string: 師父，我想問一個關於如何炮製箭根的問題。

original: Don't waste time apologizing, just find the book!
string: 別把時間浪費在道歉上，趕快去找那本書！

original: I... I apologize, master.
string: 我……我很抱歉，師父。

original: Confound it, boy, I know what I'm doing. It will help me determine the season of his burial, which I can cross-reference.
string: 你拿錯了，小子，我知道我在做什麼。它會幫我考證他的死期，然後我就可以交叉引用這個資料了。

original: Did they really record the star positions from Curalmil's tomb? There's no way it's that precise.
string: 他們真的是從庫拉米爾的墓裡抄來的星相？它不可能這麼精確。

original: Quintus, could you fetch me a copy of The Firmament? I need to compare the old star charts to today's.
string: 奎因圖斯，你能不能幫我取一本星圖副本來？我要拿以前的星圖和現在的做個對比。

original: I'd like a drink.
string: 我想小酌一杯。

original: Here you go, sir. The finest Colovian brandy.
string: 請用，先生。上好的克羅維亞白蘭地。

original: Is there anything else I can get for you?
string: 我還能為你做什麼？

original: Here you go, ma'am. The finest Colovian brandy.
string: 請用，女士。上好的克羅維亞白蘭地。

original: Is there anything else I can get for you?
string: 我還能為你做什麼？

original: We seem to have run out of Colovian brandy. I'll check in the wine cellar for more when I get a moment.
string: 我們的克羅維亞白蘭地好像已經沒了。等我有空的時候會去酒窖檢視是否還有庫存。

original: Here you go, sir. Colovian brandy.
string: 請用，先生。克羅維亞白蘭地。

original: Here you go, miss. Colovian brandy.
string: 請用，女士。克羅維亞白蘭地。

original: I'm sorry, but I think you've had enough for the moment.
string: 對不起，我覺得你已經喝了不少了。

original: Oooh, wonderful! I can't wait!
string: 哦哦，太好了！我已經迫不及待了！

original: Hmph. Most certainly not. But perhaps I can teach you how to put some candles out. We'll start there.
string: 呵。大概不能。不過說不定我可以教你怎樣滅掉蠟燭。我們就從那開始。

original: I understand. I'm sorry. I just get so excited thinking about it. So... can we. Do some fire magic?
string: 我明白。對不起。我只是太激動了。所以……我們能不能。施放一些火魔法？

original: Shh shh. It's fine, child. It's fine. But we must be cautious, hmm? What we do, the things I teach you. The others wouldn't understand.
string: 噓。沒事的，孩子。沒事。不過我們必須小心，嗯？我們平時做的，我教你的那些。其他人是不懂的。

original: Oh! I'm... I'm sorry. I didn't mean to upset you.
string: 噢！真……真抱歉。我不是故意要惹你煩的。

original: By the Eight, keep your voice down! Do you want the entire village to learn our secrets?
string: 以八聖靈之名，你小聲點！你想讓全村人都知道我們的秘密嗎？

original: I was just wondering. The next time we meet, do you think maybe you could teach me some fire magic? Nothing dangerous! Maybe a candle lighting spell?
string: 我只是好奇。下次我們要是再見面，你覺得你會不會教我一些火魔法？不學那些危險的！比如說能點起蠟燭的魔法？

original: Yes, child?
string: 是的，孩子？

original: Jouane?
string: 喬安？

original: TG08BHellos
string: TG08BHellos

original: Let's get out of here before we end up like Mercer!
string: 我們快離開這裡，以免落得和墨瑟一樣的下場！

original: Aye, there will be blood today. I can promise you that.
string: 沒錯，今天一定會見血。我敢肯定。

original: Crime is one thing, murder is another. Mercer will answer for this.
string: 犯罪是一碼事，謀殺又是另一碼事。墨瑟一定會這麼回答。

original: I'd just assume die before I'd let Mercer get those gems.
string: 我覺得在墨瑟拿到那些寶石之前我就會先死掉。

original: Do the Falmer also have no sense of smell? This place reeks!
string: 難道伐莫族也都沒有嗅覺嗎？這地方臭死了！

original: The Eyes would go a long way in helping get the Guild back on its feet.
string: 「伐莫族之眼」一定能夠快速地讓公會回到軌道上。

original: I can't wait to get my hands around that bastard's neck.
string: 我等不及要親手勒死那個雜種了。

original: By Talos, Mercer has a lot to answer for.
string: 我對塔洛斯發誓，墨瑟欠下的債太多了。

original: This place is coming down. Let's get out of here!
string: 這地方快塌了，快離開這裡！

original: With any luck, this will be Mercer's final day alive.
string: 幸運的話，今天就是墨瑟活在世上的最後一天。

original: This place, it's like a maze. How did the dwarves find their way around?
string: 這個地方，好像迷宮一樣。矮人們是怎麼認得這些路的？

original: This is just like old times.
string: 這就像過去的時候一樣。

original: Keep as quiet as you can. The Falmer may be blind, but they can still hear us.
string: 儘量保持安靜。伐莫族雖然眼睛看不見，但是他們耳朵很靈光。

original: If Mercer leaves here with the Eyes, we'll never see him again.
string: 如果墨瑟帶著伐莫族之眼離開這裡，我們就永遠見不到他了。

original: We have to get the Key back.
string: 我們必須把鑰匙拿回來。

original: Mercer's here. I can feel it.
string: 墨瑟在這裡。我能感覺到。

original: Be careful, there's no telling what lurks within these walls.
string: 小心點，沒人知道這牆後面藏著什麼東西。

original: I'm ready. Let's go.
string: 準備好了，走吧。

original: We should tread carefully. I wouldn't be surprised if he's left behind a few surprises for us.
string: 我們應該步步為營。如果他留給我們一些驚喜，我一點也不會驚訝。

original: TG08BKarliahIntroBranchTopic
string: TG08BKarliahIntroBranchTopic

original: Mercer's been here, I hope we aren't too late.
string: 墨瑟來過這裡，希望我們還趕得上。

original: He can't treat me like that. He needs me.
string: 他不能那樣對我。他還需要我。

original: Rulindil, pah! One day, the shoe will be on the other foot.
string: 魯林迪爾，靠！你給我記住，下一次可就會不一樣了。

original: I knew he was telling the truth. I always can tell.
string: 我知道他說的是實話。我總能看出來。

original: They're scared of the dragons, too, aren't they? Paying too well. They don't know anything.
string: 他們也害怕龍，不是嗎？但酬勞太好了。他們什麼都不知道。

original: Etienne must know something related to the dragons... who else might know? Greasy Thom... no, they'd see right through him...
string: 艾逖恩肯定知道一些關於龍的情報……還有誰可能知道呢？格雷西．托姆……不，他不會說瞎話……

original: That would probably be best.
string: 那樣最好。

original: Now get out!
string: 現在滾出去！

original: No, no. I'll... I'll wait outside.
string: 不，不。我……我在外面等著。

original: You'd like to come downstairs with me, is that it, Gissur?
string: 你會陪我下樓的，對嗎，吉蘇爾？

original: Shall we loose his bonds and put you in a cell together? You can ask him anything you like, and see how he answers.
string: 我們該把他鬆綁然後和你關在一間牢房嗎？你可以隨便審問他，看他怎麼回答。

original: Can I... I could help you. He'd talk to me. He trusts me.
string: 我能不能……我可以幫你。他會和我開口的。他信任我。

original: Everyone talks, in the end.
string: 最後，每個人都會開口的。

original: Now, I have work to do. Leave me to it, if you ever want to see the rest of your payment.
string: 現在，我有工作要做。離開這裡，要是你還想拿到剩下的酬金的話。

original: So he has talked! I knew it!
string: 那就是說他開口了！我就知道！

original: You'll get the rest of your money when we confirm his story. As agreed.
string: 我們證實了他的話之後你就可以拿到你全部的報酬了。這是說好的。

original: But no one else has brought you such valuable information, have they?
string: 但是沒有其他人能給你帶來這麼有價值的資訊，對吧？

original: Etienne, he's talked, hasn't he? He knows where that old man is you're looking for, he told me himself.
string: 艾逖恩，他開口了，是不是？他知道你要找的那個老人在哪，他親口對我說過。

original: Do not presume, Gissur. You are most useful, but do not presume. We have other informants who are less... offensive.
string: 別多管閒事，吉蘇爾。你是個可以利用的人，但是你太貪心了。我們手裡有很多比你更……聽話的線人。

original: Silence!
string: 肅靜！

original: I have my own expenses you know...
string: 我要花錢的地方多得是，你懂的……

original: But, I need that money! I earned it.
string: 但是，我需要那筆錢！那是我應得的。

original: Can you tell me more about your missing son?
string: 能多告訴我一些你失蹤的兒子的事嗎？

original: Not here. Let's speak at my home, where we can be alone, unwatched.
string: 在這裡不行。咱們到我家去說吧，那樣就只有我們兩人，沒有別人的耳目。

original: Thorald's disappearance has been hard on all of us, but Avulstein has taken it badly.
string: 索拉德的消失給我們造成了很大的困難，但是對阿武斯特恩來說更嚴重。

original: He's afraid of being taken as well, so he hasn't left the house. All he talks about is Thorald.
string: 他害怕自己也被帶走，所以他沒有離開那房子。他一直念叨著索拉德。

original: Please, help Avulstein if you can. Something has to be done, or we're all going to lose our minds.
string: 拜託，如果可以的話請幫幫阿武斯特恩。得有人做點什麼，不然我們都會瘋掉。

original: Can you tell me anything else about what's going on?
string: 關於發生了什麼事，你還能告訴我一些其他情報嗎？

original: How can you be sure your son is alive?
string: 妳怎麼能肯定兒子還活著？

original: I just... I just know it. I can feel it in my heart. You have to believe me.
string: 我……我就是知道。我的心能感覺到。你要相信我。

original: Please, visit me at my home. I can tell you the whole story.
string: 請你到我家來。我可以把整個故事講給你聽。

original: How do you know they're lying?
string: 妳怎麼知道他們在說謊？

original: It's not wise to discuss it here. Please, if you truly wish to help, meet me at my home. I'll tell you the whole story.
string: 在這裡討論可不怎麼明智。好心人，如果你真的想幫忙，請到我家來找我。我把整個故事講給你聽。

original: All I can think about is my son, my Thorald... they say that he was killed, but I know better. I know my son is alive!
string: 我腦裡想的只有我兒子，我的索拉德……他們說他被殺了，但是我比他們清楚。我知道我兒子還活著！

original: Those Battle-Born... they're in with the Imperials. They know it too, and yet they lie to my very face!
string: 那些戰狂……他們選擇站在帝國人那一邊了。他們也知道這件事，但是他們還是當著我的面撒了謊！

original: You have a job to do.
string: 你有份工作要做。

original: You want to get paid? Do what I hired you for.
string: 你想工作賺錢？完成我交給你的任務吧。

original: Doesn't sound like something I'm interested in.
string: 聽起來不像是我感興趣的事。

original: That's too bad.
string: 那真是太糟了。

original: I don't mind hurting someone for money.
string: 為了錢我不介意打人。

original: No funerals, just some pain. If you get caught, it's not my problem.
string: 別出人命，只是給他們一點痛苦。如果你被抓住了，那可不是我的問題。

original: No killing. I'm not hiring the Dark Brotherhood, here. If you get caught, it's not my problem.
string: 不要殺人。我要雇的不是黑暗兄弟會。如果你被抓，那可跟我沒關係。

original: Just cause some pain. I don't want a death on my conscience. If you get caught, it's not my problem.
string: 教訓他們一下就行。我不想背上一條人命。如果你被抓了，那可跟我沒關係。

original: Hurt him. I mean her. Whichever. No killing though. And I ain't paying your fine if you get caught.
string: 教訓他。我是說她。隨便哪個都行。不過不要殺人。要是你被抓住我可不會保你出獄。

original: I hope I can hear the screams. But don't let on it's from me! And I'm not paying your fine if you get caught.
string: 我希望聽見他們的尖叫。但是千萬別說是我指使的！還有，要是你被抓住的話我是不會保你出獄的。

original: Make it quick, but make it hurt. If you get caught by the guards, I don't know you.
string: 動作要快，但是一定要有效。如果你被衛兵抓住了，我可翻臉不認人。

original: Good. No killing, though. Don't get arrested. I won't help you.
string: 很好。不過，不要殺人。不要被逮住。否則我不會罩著你的。

original: Make it hurt. But not too much. No killing. And don't let the guards catch you.
string: 讓他們痛苦。不過不要太過。不准殺人。還有別被衛兵逮住。

original: It should hurt. A lot. But I'm not paying for murder. Oh, if you're caught, it's not my problem.
string: 要讓他們痛苦。大大地痛苦。但是我不會為謀殺買單。噢，如果你被抓了，那可跟我沒關係。

original: Good. Now remember - pain, and lots of it. But not to the death. If they arrest you, it's not my problem.
string: 很好。記住——痛苦，很刻骨的痛。但是別要了命。要是他們抓住了你，我可什麼都不承認的。

original: You wanted to see me about something?
string: 你見我是要跟我說什麼？

original: I heard you attacked someone in town recently.
string: 我聽說你最近在鎮裡打了人？

original: Thought you might be open to doing it again... for a tidy sum.
string: 我想你還會再做那種事的……為了一筆可觀的報酬。

original: Heard you hit somebody in town not too long ago.
string: 聽說你不久前在鎮裡打了人。

original: I'll pay to do the same, to a certain special someone.
string: 我會付錢讓你再打一次，這次要打我指定的人。

original: So you like to hurt people, huh? The town is still talking about what you did.
string: 所以你很喜歡傷害別人，哈？鎮裡的人們還在談論著你的事。

original: You know, I'll pay you to attack one of my enemies...
string: 你知道，我會出錢讓你去教訓我的敵人……

original: Yeah. You beat people up.
string: 是耶。你很會打人。

original: Got someone I want you to hurt. Don't worry, I can pay.
string: 我有個想讓你去教訓一下的人。別急，我會付錢的。

original: Uh... yeah. I know you don't mind hurting people. Just look what you did to... well, you know.
string: 呃……對。我知道你不介意毆打別人。但是你看看你對……算了，你知道的。

original: I need someone to do that to someone. I'll even pay.
string: 我需要有人幫我做這件事。我會付報酬的。

original: I heard you hurt someone in town not too long ago.
string: 我聽說你前幾天在鎮裡打了人。

original: I'll pay you to hurt someone else. Okay?
string: 我會付錢給你讓你再打一個人。意下如何？

original: I heard about what you did. You hurt someone. Bad.
string: 我聽過你做的事。你打架鬥毆。真壞啊。

original: I got someone who deserves a beating, but I need someone else to do it for me. I can pay.
string: 我知道有個很欠揍的人，但是我需要有人替我去教訓他。我可以給你錢。

original: Yeah. Uh, I know you hurt someone in town recently.
string: 對。呃……我知道你最近在鎮裡打人。

original: I'd like to pay you to hurt somebody else. For me.
string: 我想出錢請你去教訓另一個人。代替我去。

original: Idiot! That wasn't the deal. You were just supposed to teach them a lesson. I am not paying you...
string: 混帳！之前不是這麼說的。你應該只是教訓他們一下。我不會把錢給你的……

original: I ended up killing your enemy.
string: 我最後殺死了你的敵人。

original: They're dead? But now everyone will think I did it!
string: 他們死了？那現在所有人都會以為是我做的！

original: I ended up killing your enemy.
string: 我最後殺死了你的敵人。

original: What have you done? You weren't supposed to murder anyone! Gods...
string: 你幹了什麼？你不應該殺人！天吶……

original: I ended up killing your enemy.
string: 我最後殺死了你的敵人。

original: Good. Wait. Dead? That's not what I asked for. I... uh... you should leave. I need a drink...
string: 很好。等會兒。死了？這不是我要你做的。我……呃……你應該離開。我要喝一杯……

original: I ended up killing your enemy.
string: 我最後殺死了你的敵人。

original: Dead? No, no, no, no, no! This is terrible. I don't know you. Get away from me!
string: 死了？不，不，不，不，不！這太可怕了。我不認識你。你快滾！

original: I ended up killing your enemy.
string: 我最後殺死了你的敵人。

original: Shor's bones! What did you do that for? I would have hired the Dark Brotherhood if I'd wanted that! Get away from me.
string: 朔爾的骨頭啊！你怎麼幹出這種事？要是我想那樣的話我直接雇黑暗兄弟會好了！你給我滾。

original: I ended up killing your enemy.
string: 我最後殺死了你的敵人。

original: Really? What did you go and do that for? You... you need to go away.
string: 真的？你為什麼要做這種事？你……你得趕快離開。

original: I ended up killing your enemy.
string: 我最後殺死了你的敵人。

original: No! Tell me you're joking. Sweet Mara, what have I done? Go away. Just go away.
string: 不！告訴我你是開玩笑的好嗎？我親愛的瑪拉，我幹了什麼？你快走。走吧。

original: I ended up killing your enemy.
string: 我最後殺死了你的敵人。

original: Oh gods, what did you do that for? This is horrible. I'm not paying for murder. Get away from me.
string: 噢神啊，你怎麼會這樣？這真是太可怕了。我不會為謀殺付錢的。你離我遠點。

original: I ended up killing your enemy.
string: 我最後殺死了你的敵人。

original: What have you done? They'll think I did it. Wait, I did do it! I'm not paying you! This is all your fault!
string: 你都做了什麼？他們肯定以為是我做的。等等，不是我！我不給你錢！這都是你一個人做的！

original: I ended up killing your enemy.
string: 我最後殺死了你的敵人。

original: Ha! There's nothing like a few cuts and bruises to drive home a point, huh?
string: 哈！沒有比幾道刀傷幾片淤青更能說明問題的了，嗯？

original: I did what you asked.
string: 我照你說的做了。

original: Good. Maybe things will be different around here from now on.
string: 很好。說不定從現在開始一切會變得好起來的。

original: I did what you asked.
string: 我照你說的做了。

original: Good. Let's hope it's a lesson learned.
string: 很好。希望他們能吸取教訓。

original: I did what you asked.
string: 我照你說的做了。

original: You what? Oh. That. Good. I hope there was a lot of blood.
string: 你說什麼？喔，真是太好了。我希望那裡血濺四方。

original: I did what you asked.
string: 我照你說的做了。

original: It can't be traced back to me, can it? Was there lot's of crying? I hope so.
string: 不會懷疑到我身上吧，你覺得呢？他們有很大聲的哀嚎嗎？我希望是那樣。

original: I did what you asked.
string: 我照你說的做了。

original: Really? I hope it hurt.
string: 真的嗎？希望他們痛不欲生。

original: I did what you asked.
string: 我照你說的做了。

original: Hmph. Good. That'll teach 'em.
string: 呵。很好。他們應該老實了。

original: I did what you asked.
string: 我照你說的做了。

original: Really? Good. Was there a lot of screaming? Never mind. I don't want to know.
string: 真的？很好。是不是有震耳欲聾的尖叫聲？算啦。其實我不想知道。

original: I did what you asked.
string: 我照你說的做了。

original: Were there tears? I hope everyone can see the bruises.
string: 他們有哭嗎？真希望所有人都能看見他們的瘀傷。

original: I did what you asked.
string: 我照你說的做了。

original: Good. I hope it hurt a lot, after all the pain I've been put through.
string: 很好。我希望這會很疼，畢竟我受了那麼多痛苦 。

original: (Invisible Continues Linked to Self)
string: （繼續維持隱形狀態）

original: Let's see here...
string: 讓我來看看……

original: Yeah, got this note.
string: 耶，找到這個筆記了。

original: I have a letter here from Quintus Navale in Windhelm. He said it was urgent.
string: 我這有一封來自風舵城的奎因圖斯．那瓦勒的信。他說有要緊的事。

original: I've got a letter and a lot of gold. Something about it being your inheritance? Oh, and... sorry for your loss.
string: 這裡有一封信和一大筆錢。是你繼承到的遺產之類的？噢，那我真的……對你家的變故深表同情。

original: A letter... not sure who from. He wouldn't say. Just that he was a friend of yours.
string: 一封信……不知道是誰寄來的。他似乎有意隱瞞。只是自稱是你的一個朋友。

original: I have a letter here for you.
string: 我有封信要交給你。

original: A note from someone named Calcelmo, in Markarth.
string: 有一封來自馬卡斯城 的短箋，寄信人是卡塞莫。

original: It's from... Falk Firebeard at the Blue Palace? You've got friends in high places.
string: 這是……藍宮的佛可．火鬍寄來的？你有一個在當官的朋友啊。

original: There's a new museum opening up in Dawnstar. The owner is asking me to hand out invitations to travelers.
string: 晨星城有座博物館最近開業。我在替那裡的老闆向過往遊客派發邀請函。

original: Looks like that's it. Got to go.
string: 信也送到了。我得走了。

original: Do you have anything for me?
string: 你這裡有沒有什麼東西要給我？

original: I've been looking for you. Got something I'm supposed to deliver - your hands only.
string: 我一直在找你。我替人帶東西給你——而且必須親自交予你手。

original: Nope, sorry. Nothing.
string: 沒有，不好意思。什麼都沒有。

original: Then we'd best get started.
string: 那我們最好馬上開始。

original: Brynjolf is needed back at the Thieves Guild to keep order while you're away.
string: 當你不在的時候，會由布林喬夫代為管理公會裡各項事務。

original: And I... I can't bear to face Nocturnal after my failure to protect the Key.
string: 我……自從那次守護鑰匙失敗以來我一直沒法面對諾克圖娜爾。

original: I'm afraid you'll have to face the end of your journey alone.
string: 恐怕你只能獨自面對你旅程的終點了。

original: I take it you never used the Pilgrim's Path.
string: 我猜妳一定從沒走過朝聖者之路。

original: It wasn't created for the Nightingales. It was created to test those who wished to serve Nocturnal in other ways.
string: 那不是為夜鶯而造的。那條路是用來考驗那些想要以其他方式供奉諾克圖娜爾的人們。

original: As a consequence, I have no knowledge of what you'll be facing.
string: 所以呢，我對你要面對的東西一無所知。

original: Sounds like it will be a simple task.
string: 聽起來似乎會是個輕鬆的任務。

original: I'm afraid it's not that simple.
string: 我想這沒有那麼簡單。

original: When the Skeleton Key was stolen from the Twilight Sepulcher, our access to the inner sanctum was removed.
string: 自從放在黃昏墳墓的骷髏鑰匙被偷走後，我們就無法再進入內部聖所了。

original: The only way to bring it back will be through the Pilgrim's Path.
string: 要將它送回去只有一種方法，就是通過朝聖者之路。

original: TG08BKarliahOutroBranchTopic
string: TG08BKarliahOutroBranchTopic

original: I can't believe it's over. Twenty-five years in exile and just like that, it's done.
string: 我不敢相信這都結束了。二十五年來我流離失所四海為家，現在都結束了。

original: All that remains is to ensure the safe return of the Skeleton Key.
string: 現在剩下的是把骷髏鑰匙安全地送回去了。

original: Maybe they're so scared of you they ran away.
string: 可能是他們太害怕你所以都逃跑了。

original: I don't like it. What are they waiting for?
string: 我不喜歡這樣。他們在等什麼？

original: No, but I know they're out there. No other way they can come. Now shut it or you'll ruin our ambush.
string: 不，但我知道他們就在外面。他們只有這條路可以走。現在給我閉嘴，別破壞了這次突襲行動。

original: You hear anything?
string: 你聽到什麼了嗎？

original: Today, they take away your faith. But what of tomorrow? What then? Do the elves take your homes? Your businesses? Your children? Your very lives?
string: 今天，他們奪走的是你的信念。那明天呢？將奪走什麼？精靈們會奪走你的房子？你的生意？你的孩子？還是你的生命？

original: The very idea is inconceivable to our Elven overlords! Sharing the heavens with us? With man? Ha! They can barely tolerate our presence on earth!
string: 那些精靈統治者們才不會接受這樣的想法！和我們分享天堂的生活？和我們人類？哈！他們連我們生活在這世上都不能容忍！

original: And there it is, friends! The ugly truth! We are the children of man! Talos is the true god of man! Ascended from flesh, to rule the realm of spirit!
string: 這就是真相，朋友們！不堪入目的真相！我們是人類的子孫！塔洛斯才是我們的真神！生於血肉，羽化成神！

original: Aye, love. Love! Even as man, great Talos cherished us. For he saw in us, in each of us, the future of Skyrim! The future of Tamriel!
string: 啊，愛！愛！即便身為人子，偉大的塔洛斯仍舊疼惜我們。因為他從我們的身上，我們每個人的身上，可以看到天際省的未來！泰姆瑞爾大陸的未來！

original: "I breathe now, in royalty, and reshape this land which is mine. I do this for you, Red Legions, for I love you."
string: 「我呼吸，以無比的虔誠，我要重塑這片屬於我的土地。這麼做是為了你們，紅色軍團，只因我對你們的愛」。

original: But you were once man! Aye! And as man, you said, "Let me show you the power of Talos Stormcrown, born of the North, where my breath is long winter."
string: 但是你曾經是一個人類！啊！做為人類，你說過：「讓我向你展示塔洛斯．風暴王冠之力，生於北地，我的吐息即是嚴冬」。

original: And deserve our praise you do, for we are one! Ere you ascended and the Eight became Nine, you walked among us, great Talos, not as god, but as man!
string: 你無愧我們的感恩，因為我們本有同靈！早在八聖靈還未變成九聖靈，你漫步於我們之中，偉大的塔洛斯，你的偉大不是源於神性，而是源於人的靈！

original: We are but maggots, writhing in the filth of our own corruption! While you have ascended from the dung of mortality, and now walk among the stars!
string: 我們是卑微的，只能這墮落的凡間掙扎！而你歷盡劫難大徹大悟，現在可以在神界中漫步！

original: Terrible and powerful Talos! We, your unworthy servants, give praise! For only through your grace and benevolence may we truly reach enlightenment!
string: 威嚴而強大的塔洛斯！我們，你卑賤的僕從，感恩於你！因為只有你的雅量與仁慈能帶給我們光明！

original: Talos the mighty! Talos the unerring! Talos the unassailable! To you we give praise!
string: 強大的塔洛斯！賢明的塔洛斯！無可匹敵的塔洛斯！我們感謝你的恩惠！

original: Tomorrow. I'll let you know tomorrow.
string: 明天。明天我就會告訴你。

original: Come on now, we discussed that. I wouldn't be traveling all of Skyrim. It'd just to Whiterun and back, that's it.
string: 不是，我已經說過了。我不打算環遊整個天際。就是到白漫然後回來，就這樣。

original: Oh, I don't know. Yes, we'd make more money, but I don't like the idea of you traveling alone out there with the war and talk of dragons.
string: 噢，我忘了。是的，我們是得多賺錢，但是我總覺得在這戰火紛飛和巨龍出沒的時期出去不大妥當。

original: Have you given my idea any more thought? You said you'd let me know yesterday, and that obviously didn't happen.
string: 你有沒有認真想過我的主意？你昨天說會告訴我你的想法，但是到現在你還是沒有跟我說。

original: That dark elf wants to go on ahead, let him. Better than us risking our necks.
string: 那個暗精靈要先走，那就讓他走。總比我們冒著生命危險好。

original: So we're just supposed to sit here while Arvel runs off with that golden claw?
string: 那我們就坐在這裡，把黃金龍爪拱手讓給阿維爾？

original: No. Not again. Help!
string: 不。別又來了，救命！

original: MS13AlrvelHelp03BranchTopic
string: MS13AlrvelHelp03BranchTopic

original: Hold on. You may know something important.
string: 等等。你可能知道重要的情報。

original: I damn well hope so. If it helps you twist them up, I'm glad to help.
string: 那真是太合我心意了。如果能幫你們修理修理他們，我非常樂意合作。

original: They're after some old guy named Esbern. Something to do with dragons, I gathered it from listening to them talk when they thought I was out.
string: 他們正在追捕一個老年人伊思本。這事和龍有關。我假裝走出去的時候偷聽到了他們的談話。

original: I've seen a guy in Riften who they seem to think is him.
string: 上次我在裂谷城看到有一個人好像是他。

original: Not much to go on -- I don't even know where he lives, or his name. But they seemed pretty excited about it.
string: 接下來就沒了——我都不知道他住在哪裡，也不知道他的名字。但是他們倒是很興奮的樣子。

original: That's it. Now, let's get out of here.
string: 這就對了。現在，我們可以走了。

original: You go ahead. I'm not done here.
string: 你先走。我還沒完。

original: No problem. Thanks for springing me. I owe you. Look me up in Riften if you make it out.
string: 沒問題。謝謝你保我出獄。我欠你一次。你辦完事情之後到裂谷城來找我。

original: I guess you know what you're doing. I've got to find a way out of here.
string: 你應該很清楚自己在做什麼？那我就先找路出去了。

original: Sounds good, I'll follow you.
string: 好主意，我會跟著你。

original: Whatever you want. But let's go, now.
string: 隨便你要什麼？但是現在，我們先走吧。

original: If you like. But we need to find a way to unlock that trap door.
string: 隨便你。但是我們得想辦法解除那門上的陷阱。

original: You've been very cooperative. Thanks.
string: 你是個好夥伴。謝謝你。

original: Why don't you just kill me already.
string: 為什麼你不直接殺了我？

original: No time to explain. Let's get out of here. (Free him)
string: 沒時間解釋。先出去再說。（給他鬆綁）

original: Yeah, sure, okay.
string: 是，當然，好的。

original: Come on, this way. I've seen the guards use it to get rid of bodies. It must lead somewhere.
string: 過來，這邊。我見過衛兵們處理屍體的時候走過這裡。它肯定通往什麼地方。

original: I'd like to hear it all one more time.
string: 我想再重頭聽一遍。

original: Fine. Whatever you want. Can't you just kill me and get it over with?
string: 好。我不管你怎麼想的。你不能直接殺掉我然後讓這一切都結束嗎？

original: There's this old man. I've seen him around Riften. I don't know where he lives. I don't know his name.
string: 這就是那個老人。我在裂谷城見過他。我不知道他住在哪兒。我也不知道他叫什麼名字。

original: Yes, he matches the description of this Esbern guy you're looking for. Maybe it's him. Maybe it isn't.
string: 對，他的樣子很符合你要找的伊思本。可能就是他。也可能不是。

original: That's all I know, okay?
string: 我就知道這麼多，行了嗎？

original: I'm not here to torture you.
string: 我不是來折磨你的。

original: What? Who... what do you want then?
string: 什麼？那你想找誰……你想找什麼？

original: I need to talk to you.
string: 我得跟你談談。

original: I told you, I don't know anything else about it.
string: 我告訴你了，我能說的都說了。

original: You fool, why should I share the treasure with anyone?
string: 你這個傻瓜！我為何要與人分享我的寶貝？

original: The way out is clear. Good luck.
string: 出去的路已經確保安全了。祝你好運。

original: Thank you. When I find my daughter, it will be thanks to you.
string: 謝謝你。我要是找到女兒，絕對不會忘了你的大恩大德。

original: Coven? What do you mean?
string: 女巫團？你是指什麼？

original: Bashnag's circle of mages. We - well "they" live here. They made it pretty clear that I'm no longer welcome.
string: 巴適那的法師之環。我們——呃……「他們」住在那裡。他們已經明確表示我被列入黑名單了。

original: These are no dainty college mages. Bashnag has the skill of a magister and the mind of a warlord. This is a dangerous bunch.
string: 他們和眼高手低的學院法師們完全不同。巴適那擁有大師級的技巧和軍閥一樣的膽略。一群危險的精英人物。

original: They're good company if you want to study necromancy in peace, though.
string: 不過如果你想研習死靈法術的話他們倒是不錯的夥伴。

original: Tell me more about the Coven.
string: 告訴我更多有關女巫團的事。

original: Bashnag is dead.
string: 巴適那死了。

original: He is? I'm not sure how to feel about that.  Perhaps it's for the better.
string: 他死了？我不知道該用什麼樣的表情。可能這是最好的結局。

original: Why were you in Riften?
string: 你來裂谷城幹什麼？

original: My daughter was sent to the orphanage there when I stood accused of illegal necromancy. I had no choice. Run or die.
string: 在我被指控非法使用死靈法術並接受調查的期間，我的女兒被送進了孤兒院。我沒有選擇。只能逃跑或者等著受死。

original: I joined with Bashnag then, but I thought of Savela every day. So I snuck off, hoping to find and steal away with her.
string: 那時我加入了巴適那，但是我每天都在想念薩維拉。所以我偷跑出來，希望能找到她，兩人一起離開這裡。

original: Only, she was gone. Shipped away to another orphanage, or adopted, or... I didn't know what else to do, so I came back, hoping nobody noticed I left.
string: 但是，她不見了。被安排坐船去了另一個孤兒院，或者被收養了，或者……我不知道我還能做什麼，所以我又回來了，想著應該沒有被人發現。

original: Why aren't you part of the coven anymore?
string: 為什麼你不再是女巫團的一員了？

original: I left for a few days in Riften. When I came back Bashnag accused me of trying to sell him out to the Thalmor. I was cursed and chased off.
string: 我在裂谷城逗留了幾天。回來的時候巴適那認定我向梭默出賣了他。我被詛咒和驅逐了。

original: You're a necromancer?
string: 你是個死靈術士？

original: I am, and I don't want to hear your moral judgments about it, either. I wouldn't have had to study in secret in the old days.
string: 對，我不想知道你是怎麼看這個職業的。要是在以前，我根本不用偷偷摸摸地做研究。

original: It isn't safe. Wait here.
string: 外面不安全。你就待在這裡。

original: Please, let me know if it seems safe to leave.
string: 拜託你，如果可以安全離開了請別忘了告訴我。

original: Can you make it out of here?
string: 你能自己出去嗎？

original: Bashnag cursed me. I can't cast a spell to save my life right now. I'll have to wait until the way out is safe.
string: 巴適那對我下了詛咒。我不能施放任何可以自救的魔法。我必須等外面安全了才能走。

original: Why are you down here?
string: 你為什麼在這裡？

original: Thanks for getting me out of that. Bashnag's coven chased me out and left me for dead down here. Nobody lasts too long with the spiders.
string: 感謝你救我出來。巴適那的女巫團驅逐了我，把我扔在這裡等死。沒人能和那些蜘蛛一起待很久的。

original: Please, will you help me get out of here? If the coast is clear, I'll make a break for it.
string: 求求你，能不能幫我逃出去？只要岸邊安全了，我就可以趁機逃走。

original: I'm too weak right now. Between the spiders and the coven, I'd be dead before escaping the cave.
string: 我現在太虛脫了。不是毒蜘蛛就是女巫。我想我無法活著走出洞了。

original: How are you holding up?
string: 你情況怎麼樣？

original: I'm feeling better, but Bashnag's curse won't wear off for weeks.
string: 我感覺好點了，但是巴適那的詛咒需要好幾個星期才會消失。

original: How are you holding up?
string: 你情況怎麼樣？

original: I won't be myself for some time. I just need to get out of here and recover.
string: 這段時間裡我不會是獨自一人了。我只需要離開這裡然後休息一陣子。

original: How are you holding up?
string: 你情況怎麼樣？

original: Of course! I undersand completely. You just put us in a room, and I'll do all the talking. No worries at all.
string: 當然！我非常理解。你只要讓我們碰面就行了，談話的事我會搞定。你放一百個心吧。

original: I'll consider it. Many of the people I deal with are... secretive. You know how it is.
string: 我會考慮的。和我打交道的人都很……神秘。你知道的。

original: Well, I'll want to meet them next time they're around. Maybe you can give an introduction.
string: 好，我想在下次他們出現的時候見見他們。我想你可以做我們的介紹人。

original: Oh, just a matter of finding the right suppliers.
string: 噢，只要找到合適的供應商就萬事順利了。

original: You know. Where do you get your goods? I am always amazed at how you manage to sell things so cheaply.
string: 我是說。你在哪進的貨？我一直很好奇你怎麼能把東西賣得那麼便宜。

original: My... my what, now?
string: 我的……我的什麼，你說？

original: Niranye, I just have to know -- what is your secret?
string: 妮蘭雅，我只是要知道——你的秘密是什麼？

original: Sorry, my scaly friend, you've come to the wrong place. Around here we don't ignore what's happening in the world.
string: 抱歉，我渾身是鱗的朋友，你來錯地方了。在這裡，我們認命。

original: If it's all the same to you, Scouts-Many-Marshes prefers to eat and drink in peace.
string: 如果你覺得無所謂，那麼奴隸也許也會覺得鎖鏈其實很好看。

original: Eight septims for breaking your back, and then you live in squalor. How much is your dignity worth?
string: 八枚金幣就可以讓你卑躬屈膝，過著悲慘的生活。你的尊嚴值多少錢？

original: Eight septims per day, plus lodging.
string: 每天八枚金幣，還包住。

original: How much?
string: 多少？

original: That's really none of your business...
string: 跟你沒關係……

original: How much do they pay you per day?
string: 他們每天給你多少錢？

original: Just you wait and see.
string: 你就等著瞧吧。

original: Oh, I doubt that very much. Who would load their ships, then?
string: 噢，我很懷疑。誰會替他們做事呢？

original: Look around you. Don't you know what their little war is about? They want all non-Nords out of Skyrim. That means you and me.
string: 看看你周圍。你真不知道他們那小小戰爭的目的嗎？他們想把所有非諾德人趕出天際。也就是說要趕走你和我。

original: I think that's just their way. The Nords don't like anybody who's not a Nord, but they're not bad people, deep down.
string: 我想那只是他們的生活方式。諾德人不喜歡任何非諾德人，但是他們本質不壞，真的。

original: Why do you even need to ask? They treat your people as bad as they do mine.
string: 這還用問？他們和對待我的種族一樣惡劣地對待你們。

original: Why do the Nords bother you so much, Ambarys?
string: 為什麼諾德人老是找你麻煩呢，安巴利？

original: Either pour another drink or keep moving, Ambarys.
string: 要嘛再喝一杯要嘛接著滾開，安巴利。

original: Touchy. Maybe some Dunmer lives in you yet.
string: 一碰就著。也許你還有點丹莫人的種。

original: What do you want from me? I work for them ok? We're not friends. They pay me, and I get the job done. That's it.
string: 你想做什麼？我為他們工作不行嗎？我們又不是朋友。他們給我錢，我把工作做完。就這樣。

original: What's new with the Cruel-Seas, Suvaris? Have they given you one of those helmets with the horns on them yet?
string: 酷海有什麼新消息嗎，蘇瓦利斯？他們給你那些上面鑲了角的頭盔了嗎？

original: Here's what's going to happen. I'm going to pretend I didn't hear that, and you're going to leave me alone. Deal?
string: 就知道你會這麼說。我會假裝沒聽到那些話，而你趕快離開我。聽到沒有？

original: Fine, then. I guess some Dunmer are content to be their pets.
string: 那好吧，很好。我想會有些丹莫人就喜歡做他們的看門狗。

original: Look, Ambarys, I just came here for a drink. I don't need any trouble.
string: 你看，安巴利，我是來喝酒的。不是找麻煩來的。

original: Don't you ever find it demeaning, working for that Nord family?
string: 為那個諾德家族工作你不會覺得很沒面子嗎？

original: I... I'm sorry, dear, I've got some other customers. I'll be back around in a minute.
string: 我……對不起，親愛的，我還有幾個客人要接待。我幾分鐘後就回來。

original: What about being loyal to his wife?
string: 那對妻子的忠誠就不重要了？

original: I know, dear. He's a busy man, though, and loyal to the Stormcloaks.
string: 我知道，親愛的。是啊，他很忙，也忠於風暴斗篷。

original: I just don't know what to do anymore. He's hardly ever in the temple. I see him at breakfast, and that's it.
string: 我只是很迷茫不知道要怎麼做。他幾乎再也不去神殿了。我只能在吃早飯的時候見到他，僅此而已。

original: Here, let me get you some mead. This one's on me.
string: 來，請你喝杯蜜酒。說好這次我請。

original: It's been better, I'll be honest with you.
string: 已經好多了，我實話實說。

original: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Is everything all right?
string: 噢，深表同情。一切都還好嗎？

original: Don't bother. I don't have much chance of seeing my husband these days. He's always up in the palace with Ulfric.
string: 不麻煩了。這些日子我很少有機會見到我丈夫。他總是在宮殿裡和烏弗瑞克一起。

original: Oh, Jora. Good to see you. I was wondering if you might ask Lortheim something for me.
string: 喔，喬拉。見到你真高興。我還在想你可能問我一些羅瑟姆的事情呢。

original: Think nothing of it.
string: 還好啦。

original: Oh, thank the gods you're in Windhelm, Calixto!
string: 噢，卡利斯托，幸好有你在風舵城！

original: Bring it to me straight away when you find it. Don't dally. I can keep it safe.
string: 你一找到它馬上送過來。一刻也別耽誤。我能保障它的安全。

original: Oh dear. What should I do?
string: 哦親愛的。我該怎麼做？

original: Be very careful with that. It sounds as if it may be the Death Ring of Dro'farahn. A ring of the most dangerous sort.
string: 小心啊！它有可能是卓．法燃的死亡指環。很危險的指環。

original: Well, I seem to have misplaced it at the moment. But it was white, like alabaster, with three bright rubies set in it.
string: 嗯，我好像把它錯放在什麼別的地方了。不過它是白色的，像雪花石膏的顏色，上面鑲著三顆耀眼的紅寶石。

original: Of course, my dear. It may prove to be quite the curiosity! One must always be alert.
string: 當然，我的心肝。你很會勾起人的好奇心啊！。

original: Calixto, someone left an interesting ring in here a few weeks ago. Would you like a look?
string: 卡利斯托，有人在幾週前留下了這個很有意思的指環。你要看看嘛？

original: Coming right up.
string: 馬上來 。

original: Very much so.
string: 很對。

original: How would you like a drink?
string: 想喝一杯嗎？

original: The dark elves are uneasy. There's a killer on the streets. And Viola Giordano won't leave me alone.
string: 暗精靈都情緒不穩定。大街上有一個殺手，而且維歐拉．喬爾丹諾不會丟下我的。

original: So what's the news on the street, Captain?
string: 最近街上裡有什麼新鮮事嗎，隊長？

original: I'm not seeking advice right now, friend. Just send the message.
string: 我沒有在問你的意見，朋友。快把訊息發出去就是了。

original: Of course. Something that seems to be in short supply these days.
string: 當然。不過這幾天裡我們的物資很短缺。

original: It will work if we can pull Hran's men from the south. And find a bit of luck.
string: 要是我們能把赫然的手下從南邊引出來的話應該就沒問題。不過也需要點運氣。

original: Is that wise, sir?
string: 這樣做對嗎？長官？

original: I'm diverting Gar and Haddring's men to join him.
string: 我正在把噶爾和哈德靈的人分配他那邊去。

original: And the message, sir?
string: 要送什麼訊息，長官？

original: Jorleif, I want you to send a messenger to our western camps.
string: 喬雷福，我要你送個訊息去我們的西營。

original: Of course, my lord.
string: 當然，我的大人。

original: Let me know if you hear anything more substantial?
string: 當你有了更確鑿的消息後再來向我匯報好嗎？

original: They don't seem to be very sympathetic to our cause, sir.
string: 他們好像一點也不在乎，先生。

original: Blasted dark elves. I don't suppose you could tell them that I presently have larger concerns? Such as all of Skyrim?
string: 倒楣的暗精靈。我沒想到你會告訴他們我的遠大計劃？就像解放全天際省？

original: Sir, there continues to be unrest in the Gray Quarter.
string: 長官，灰民區裡的局勢依然動盪不安。

original: As you wish, sir.
string: 如你所願，先生。

original: But you're able to see the whole in the parts, and for that I'm grateful.
string: 但是你能通過細節瞭解大局，在這一點上我非常欣賞你。

original: To be sure, my lord, I am not skilled in the arts of war or military tactics.
string: 我的大人，我可以肯定的是，我對戰爭藝術或是軍事戰術並不擅長。

original: A good point, old friend.
string: 漂亮的觀點，老朋友。

original: Well, sir, the hold of Falkreath is fairly vulnerable, and blocks the only road from Cyrodiil.
string: 嗯，長官，佛克瑞斯的防守相當薄弱，而且它剛好在唯一的那條通往賽瑞迪爾的路上。

original: And you, Jorleif?
string: 你覺得呢，喬雷福？

original: A reasonable strategy.
string: 這戰略很合理。

original: Galmar thinks we should double our men in the Reach.
string: 愛爾瑪認為我們應該在邊塞多加一倍的兵力。

original: Carry on, Lonely-Gale. And loosen yourself a bit.
string: 繼續，孤風。稍微放鬆一點。

original: Um... yes, of course, sir.
string: 嗯……是的，當然，長官。

original: Well that much is good. Let's finish this first war before starting the next one, eh?
string: 好了這就夠了。我們先把這仗打完再開始下一仗，好吧？

original: As restless as ever, sir, but I don't see them taking any kind of incendiary action. Not soon, anyway.
string: 一如既往地不安分，長官，但是也沒有做出過激的舉動。即使如此，大概也快要到極限了。

original: What's the current spirit among the dark elves?
string: 暗精靈中絕大多數人是怎麼想的？

original: See that you do. I will not let Windhelm descend into chaos over a few overactive imaginations.
string: 那樣最好。我不會讓風舵城被一些想像力過剩的人攪亂的。

original: Yes, sir. I'll try to contain her.
string: 是的，先生。我會盡力約束她的。

original: I don't care if she can find a living dwarf -- I can't have her stirring up trouble. We have enough problems as it is.
string: 我不管她是否能再找到一個活著的矮人——我不能任由她到處搗亂。我們現在的麻煩事已經夠多了。

original: Yes, sir. I've been trying to quiet her, but she's insistent. She thinks she can find out who's been killing the women...
string: 是的，先生。我正在努力讓她平靜，但她非常固執。她覺得自己能找到殺掉那些女人的兇手……

original: Captain, I've been receiving complaints about this Giordano woman.
string: 隊長，我最近常收到民眾對於這個叫喬爾丹諾的女人的抱怨。

original: I can ask no more. Thank you, my lord!
string: 這就足夠了。多謝，大人！

original: I'll think on this, but I make no promises.
string: 我會考慮的，但是我不承諾什麼？

original: You need but ask.
string: 你只需開口。

original: And I suppose the Cruel-Seas would be just the clan to provide ships and men?
string: 那酷海就是那個提供船隻和人手的部族？

original: But imagine -- fleets of ships sailing from Windhelm, all bearing the Stormcloak flag! It would be glorious!
string: 但是你想想——浩浩蕩蕩的艦隊從風舵城駛出，所有的船上都飄揚著風暴斗篷的旗幟！那將是無比榮耀的一刻！

original: But most of their supply routes come south, from Cyrodiil.
string: 但是他們的補給多數是從南方運來，從賽瑞迪爾。

original: A navy, my lord. We could stop the influx of Imperial troops to Solitude, and choke their northern lines.
string: 一支海軍，我的大人。我們可以在獨孤城的週邊阻擊帝國軍隊，堵住他們的北路軍。

original: I'm still not sure I understand what you're asking.
string: 我還是不明白你想問什麼？

original: Regardless. It appears Skyrim must stand alone. Again.
string: 無論怎樣。看來天際必須獨自戰鬥。但這也不是第一次了。

original: Those milk drinkers? Might as well be elves. Think they're better than us.
string: 那些喝奶的傢伙？或許還以身為精靈為榮。他們自以為比我們強。

original: I suppose we shouldn't be surprised. They've never had many problems with the Empire.
string: 我想不會有什麼意外的。他們從不和帝國作對。

original: Not a peep. Those prissy Bretons can't be made to lift a finger to help their neighbors.
string: 沒什麼消息。那些謹小慎微的布萊頓人一根指頭也不會幫他們的鄰居們的。

original: Is there any news from High Rock?
string: 高岩有什麼新消息嗎？

original: It's working, Galmar. Our patience has won us friends and allies. And our armies are systematically taking care of the rest.
string: 很成功，加爾瑪。我們的耐心為我們贏得了朋友和同盟。而我們的敵人，正被我們的軍隊有計劃的掃蕩。

original: We need to move faster. Keep them off balance.
string: 我們的速度要再快點。不讓他們有喘息的機會。

original: We can't march on Solitude. Not yet. One thing at a time.
string: 我們不能向獨孤城行軍。暫時不能。事情要一件一件做。

original: Our men are getting massacred out there. Damn Imperials.
string: 我們的人正在被屠殺。可惡的帝國人。

original: Calm yourself, Galmar. Save it for the battlefield.
string: 冷靜，加爾瑪。把你的怒氣留到上戰場的時候。

original: I used to have five good men who worked the mill with me. Then this war started and they all ran off. Idiots with mead in their blood.
string: 我本來有五個能幹的夥計和我一起照料這個工坊。這場戰爭來了，他們就都跑走了。腦袋全是酒精的蠢貨。

original: There's plenty of good wood around here, but I just can't harvest it all by myself. Everyone able-bodied is fighting.
string: 這附近有很多優質的木材，但是我自己沒法去把它們都採伐回來。壯丁們都去打仗了。

original: Of course, without functioning mills, who will make the arrows for our soldiers? Men have no sense of irony.
string: 當然了，沒有工坊，誰給咱們的士兵造箭？你們真是不懂諷刺。

original: Welcome, welcome, welcome! Don't see many strangers out here. Come to get your hands dirty on a real farm?
string: 歡迎，歡迎，歡迎！這裡可不經常有新面孔。準備好投入讓你滿手泥土的真正的農場生活了嗎？

original: Nothing tastes better than food you've grown yourself. Something magic about dirt and sunshine making food.
string: 沒有比自己親手種出來的食物更可口的東西了。用土地和陽光製造食物是個魔法般神奇的過程。

original: The weather's harsh, but I like to think my sunny personality is what helps the grain grow.
string: 天氣很糟，但我想我這開朗又陽光的性格也能幫助穀物成長。

original: Bolfrida is certainly grating, but she pays well. Thankfully nobody from the city can see me out here.
string: 波福瑞達是很讓人不舒服，但是她出價高。還好城裡沒人能看見我在這裡。

original: Farm work is hard work. It's good to relax when I can, but I still have to listen to my brothers harping about "injustices."
string: 務農很累人的。可以放鬆一下是很不錯的，但我還是等聽我兄弟老大抱怨所謂的「不公」呢。

original: Of course working for Bolfrida isn't my first choice. But what else can a Dunmer do out here?
string: 當然我並不是很喜歡為波福瑞達工作。但是一個丹莫人在這裡還能做什麼呢？

original: My sister and I both work for the Nords. Our brother is ashamed of us, but at least we can affort to eat.
string: 我和我的姐妹都為諾德人工作。我們的兄弟對此很不齒，但是至少我們能吃飽飯。

original: Starting to get too old to work all day, but hopefully Master Hlaalu will let me slow down a bit.
string: 我已經老到做不了一整天的工作了，只希望哈拉魯主人能稍微體諒我一下。

original: Every now and then someone from the city comes by. Think they aren't used to seeing a Nord working for a Dark Elf.
string: 偶而會有城裡的人路過這裡。他們好像不太習慣看到一個諾德人為暗精靈工作。

original: Better to work in the cold than in the heat, I say. Though some sun would be nice.
string: 要我說，在冷天中工作比在大熱天工作好一點。雖然曬曬太陽有好處。

original: Master Cruel-Sea comes and works the fields sometimes. I don't think the Mistress likes it, but she won't come out here to catch him.
string: 酷海大人有時候會來農場工作。我想夫人並不喜歡他這麼做，但是她不會來這裡找他

original: Once the sun goes down, it's just me and the dogs. They keep me warm, and don't talk too much.
string: 太陽落山之後，就只剩我和我的狗狗們了。牠們能給我溫暖，而且也不多話。

original: I wonder if I could put the dogs to work somehow. But I don't really have the heart to force them.
string: 我不知道有沒有可能讓狗狗們幫我幹點活。但我不想強迫它們。

original: The great stronghold of Narzulbur welcomes you, outsider.
string: 雄偉的納祖伯城寨歡迎你，外地朋友。

original: Come to purchase ebony? Our Gloombound Mine runs thick with black veins.
string: 來買黑檀岩？我們的昏暗邊界礦場裡到處都是黑色的礦脈。

original: The blessings of the mine have been many, but I have no mate to share them.
string: 礦山的恩賜取之不盡，我卻沒有同伴可以一起分享它。

original: I am proud to have a mate to share in my blessings.
string: 現在我有了可以一起分享這些寶藏的夥伴，我很自豪。

original: Been married many times, but the gods keep taking them from me.
string: 我結過很多次婚，但是神總是把她們從我身邊帶走。

original: I'm hoping this wife can outlast the winter.
string: 我希望這個妻子能活過這個冬天。

original: I've read the entrails many times, but can't fathom why Mauhulakh's wives keep finding tragedy.
string: 我已經詳細研究過很多次了，但還是看不出莫胡拉克的妻子們為什麼都會慘遭不幸。

original: All my auguring never predicted this. A woman for Mauhulakh, eh? We'll see how this goes.
string: 我的占卜從未預測到過這個。莫胡拉克的女人嗎？我們可以看看事情怎麼發展。

original: Urog and Dushnamub were such lovely children. I held them as they watched their mothers die after birth. They know me best, now.
string: 沃戈和杜施納姆真是兩個可愛的孩子。他們剛出生他們的媽媽就死了。現在，他們是最瞭解我的。

original: Mauhulakh was such a darling boy. Until he got older and started having opinions.
string: 莫胡拉克曾是那麼乖巧的一個孩子。直到他長大並有了自己的主見。

original: Yatul and I tend to dote on Mauhulakh. You know how aunts can be with their favorite nephew.
string: 雅圖爾和我對莫胡拉克很是溺愛。你知道姑姑們都是多麼喜愛她們外甥的。

original: Mauhulakh. He wants to be a leader but spends too much time moping over women. Bolar and I should be all he needs.
string: 莫胡拉克。他想成為一個領導者但卻總是在女人身上浪費精力。對他來說有我和波拉應該已經足夠。

original: Well at least now Mauhulakh has nothing to whine about. Until this one dies, too.
string: 好吧至少現在莫胡拉克沒什麼可抱怨的了。除非這個也死掉。

original: Orc chiefs should be strong and stand alone. They need no companions. Progeny is a poor excuse.
string: 獸人酋長應該是強壯和獨立的。他們不需要伴侶。繁衍後代是一種笨拙的藉口。

original: I know I sound abrasive. It's just that I love Mauhulakh so much that I want us to be happy together.
string: 我知道我的話聽起來很刺耳。我只是太愛莫胡拉克了以至於只想和他廝守終生。

original: My brother keeps trying to spin these fantasies to me about my aunts and our father. He's crazy.
string: 我的兄弟一直想對我灌輸他那些關於我爸爸和姑姑們的狂想。他是個瘋子。

original: Uglarz is a great huntress. Perhaps she can teach me something new.
string: 烏戈拉茲是個卓越的獵手。說不定她能教我點新東西。

original: I never would have thought, but Uglarz is an even better hunter than Yatul was. The things I'm learning now...
string: 我從沒想過，烏戈拉茲居然是個比雅圖爾還要優秀的獵人。我正在學習的東西……

original: Yatul's been teaching me to hunt. I'm still learning, but she's the best teacher I could have.
string: 一直以來是雅圖爾教我狩獵。我還在學習，但我覺得她是我能找到的最好的老師。

original: Sometimes I wonder if my aunts are right about my father -- he does seem weak.
string: 有時候我會想可能姑姑們關於我爸的看法是正確的——他的確有點弱。

original: New to Narzulbur? If you're smart, you'll keep moving. There is a wicked shadow over this place.
string: 剛來納祖伯？要是聰明的話，你不該停留。這個地方被一種邪惡的陰影籠罩著。

original: Haven't you seen how my aunts act with my father? It's beyond strange.
string: 你沒看到我姑姑們對我爸做的事嗎？實在是太詭異了。

original: Glad my father seems to have found someone. I just hope she can hold her own against my aunts.
string: 真高興我爸找到了那個她。只要她能對付我的姑姑們我就更滿意了。

original: I never knew my mother, but I doubt even she acted as affectionate with my father as Yatul and Bolar do.
string: 我從不瞭解媽媽，但我覺得她不如雅圖爾和波拉對我爸爸親密。

original: I think I like this new mate of my father's. I mean... nothing like that. I just think she's nice.
string: 我覺得我挺喜歡我爸的新歡。我是說……不是那個意思。我只是覺得她還不錯。

original: My sister is blind. I've told her she shouldn't spend so much time with Yatul, but she won't listen. Thinks she's nice.
string: 我的姐妹已經被迷惑了。我告訴過她不要和雅圖爾走得太近，但她根本不聽。她覺得她是好人。

original: Gadba and me came to work the mine. The plan is to get rich and then go back to Largashbur and take over!
string: 我和加德霸在礦裡打工。我們就是要賺大錢然後回到拉加施布爾想做什麼就做什麼！

original: Mauhulakh brought us in when he found ebony in the mine. Not enough men in town to work it, so here we are.
string: 莫胡拉克找到黑檀岩以後就把我們帶到這裡了。鎮裡願意採礦的人不怎麼多，所以我們就來了。

original: One of these days we need to head back to the Rift. Get some of that good Riften mead.
string: 像這種日子我們就應該回裂谷。喝上幾桶上好的裂谷城蜜酒。

original: Mul is the smart one. I go where he tells me.
string: 莫爾是聰明人。他要我去哪我就去哪。

original: Mining is tough, but Mul says the money is good so we mine.
string: 挖礦雖苦但我們還是願意做，莫爾說這行很賺錢。

original: When we go back to Largashbur we'll be kings. I like Narzulbur, but don't tell Mul.
string: 回拉加施布爾後我們就可以當國王啦。我喜歡納祖伯，但別跟莫爾說。

original: Let Ulfric have his way now. He'll have to give ground later.
string: 暫時先別管烏弗瑞克。他沒多久就得讓步。

original: Hmm. I guess I'll defer to your judgment on this one, but I think it's a mistake.
string: 嗯。我這次就聽你一回，但我還是覺得這不對。

original: We're off to a good start.
string: 我們會有一個很好的開始。

original: I agree. This will set the tone for the whole negotiation. Elenwen should go.
string: 我同意。這次談判必須得有個基調。愛琳溫該離開。

original: Well said.
string: 說得好。

original: I agree. This will set the tone for the whole negotiation. Elenwen should go.
string: 我同意。這次談判口徑必須一致。愛琳溫該離開。

original: I agree. We can't let Ulfric push us around. Elenwen should stay.
string: 我同意。我們不能任由烏弗瑞克擺佈。愛琳溫該留下來。

original: Well said.
string: 說得好。

original: Well said.
string: 說得好。

original: I agree. You shouldn't let Ulfric push you around. Elenwen should stay.
string: 我同意。你不該任由烏弗瑞克擺佈。愛琳溫該留下來。

original: Hmm. It feels like a mistake to me, but I'll bow to your judgment on this.
string: 嗯。雖然這可能是個錯誤，但我此事願意聽你的。

original: Let Tullius have his way on this. He'll have to give ground later.
string: 這事隨圖留斯的便。他沒多久就得讓步。

original: Ulfric has a point. The Thalmor have no business here.
string: 烏弗瑞克也有道理。梭默不該出現在這裡。

original: Maybe so, but we shouldn't be making concessions before negotiations even start. Makes us look weak.
string: 話雖如此，但我們不該在談判開始前就讓步。這讓我們看起來很好欺負。

original: Maybe so, but I can't be making concessions before negotiations even start. It makes the Empire look weak.
string: 話雖如此，但我不能在談判開始前就讓步。這讓帝國看起來很好欺負。

original: I'm glad we agree on this.
string: 很高興我們能就此達成一致。

original: You're right. The Thalmor have no business here.
string: 你說得對。梭默不該出現在這。

original: No, you're right. Elenwen should stay.
string: 不，你是對的。愛琳溫該留下來。

original: I'm glad we see eye to eye on this.
string: 很高興我們對此看法一致。

original: Maybe so, but bringing her here is a deliberate provocation. We need to show Tullius we won't be pushed around.
string: 話雖如此，但把她帶到這裡是蓄意挑釁。我們得讓圖留斯知道我們不會任人擺佈。

original: What's the harm? Besides, Tullius doesn't really want her here either.
string: 有什麼害處呢？再說，圖留斯實際上也不想讓她在這裡。

original: Maybe so, but bringing her here is a deliberate provocation. Tullius needs to know I won't be pushed around.
string: 話雖如此，但把她帶到這裡是蓄意挑釁。圖留斯得知道我不會任人擺佈。

original: What's the harm? Besides, Tullius doesn't really want her here either.
string: 有什麼害處呢？再說，圖留斯實際上也不想讓她在這裡。

original: For we are the children of man! And we shall inherit both heavens and earth! And we, not the Elves or their toadies, will rule Skyrim! Forever!
string: 因為我們同是人類！世間萬物該由我們來繼承！我們不能讓天際省落入精靈或他們的馬屁精手中！永遠不能！

original: Trust in me, Whiterun! Trust in Heimskr! For I am the chosen of Talos! I alone have been anointed by the Ninth to spread his holy word!
string: 相信我，白漫！相信海姆斯科！因為塔洛斯選中了我！只有我蒙恩傳達他神聖的旨意！

original: So rise up! Rise up, children of the Empire! Rise up, Stormcloaks! Embrace the word of mighty Talos, he who is both man and Divine!
string: 起來！起來，帝國的子民們！起來，風暴斗篷！皈依肉身成神的塔洛斯的聖言吧！

original: And what does the Empire do? Nothing! Nay, worse than nothing! The Imperial machine enforces the will of the Thalmor! Against its own people!
string: 而帝國做了什麼？無所作為！不，比無作為還糟糕！帝國機構強制推行梭默的意志！對付它的子民！

original: I need to talk to you.
string: 我得跟你談談。

original: Let me do the talking.
string: 聽我說。

original: Not now.
string: 現在可不行。

original: Shut up, will you?
string: 閉嘴，行嗎？

original: What can I get for you?
string: 我能幫你找什麼呢？

original: You made it in. Good. As soon as you distract the guards, I'll open this door and we can get you on your way.
string: 你成功進入了。很好。只要你引開衛兵，我就打開這扇門，你就可以溜走了。

original: Let's hope we both live through this day.
string: 但願我們都能活過今日。

original: What do we do now?
string: 我們現在怎麼辦？

original: We kill every Thalmor between us and Thorald, and we bring him out alive. Let's go.
string: 除掉每個擋在我們和索拉德之間的梭默精靈，把他救出來。我們走。

original: Let me see if I can bring him back on my own. Without bloodshed.
string: 我去看看能否兵不血刃地把他帶出來。

original: What? You, alone, reasoning with the Thalmor? That's madness, friend.
string: 什麼？你，孤身一人，去和梭默理論？這行不通，朋友。

original: You're serious, aren't you?
string: 你沒在開玩笑，對吧？

original: You're right. We should work together.
string: 你說得對。我們該並肩作戰。

original: Exactly. Together we stand more of a chance of making this work.
string: 沒錯。團結起來更有可能成功。

original: Make your way to Northwatch Keep in Haafingar. I'll meet you near there, and we'll plan our assault.
string: 前往海芬加領的北塔堡壘。我會在附近和你碰頭，再策劃襲擊。

original: I'm sure. I'll bring him back myself.
string: 我成竹在胸。我會親自把他帶回來的。

original: Very well. I'll give you a chance. But if you can't do it, I will.
string: 很好。我先給你一個機會。但如果你失手，我會替你完成。

original: You stay hidden. I'll take care of this.
string: 你躲好，我來處理這件事。

original: Are you sure? I doubt you stand a chance against the Thalmor.
string: 你確定嗎？我懷疑你對付得了梭默嗎？

original: I can have a group of men ready at a moment's notice. Many would be willing to help rescue my brother.
string: 我能在短時間內召集一支人馬。很多人願意協助我營救兄弟。

original: I have proof that Thorald lives.
string: 我有索拉德還活著的證據。

original: I knew it! Let me see, please!
string: 我就知道！請讓我看看！

original: The Thalmor? By the Nine, it's worse than I thought.
string: 梭默？以九聖靈之名，這比我想像得還糟。

original: So... Northwatch Keep. Then we know where to hit them.
string: 如此說來……北塔堡壘。我們知道該上哪兒迎擊他們了。

original: Well, where is it? Forgive me, but I don't dare just trust your word, no matter who you are.
string: 那它在哪兒？請原諒，無論你是誰我都不能輕易相信你的一面之詞啊。

original: I knew he wasn't gone, I just knew it!
string: 我就知道他還沒死，我就知道！

original: Please, get that to Avulstein right away.
string: 請你快把那個帶給阿武斯特恩。

original: What sort of proof do you need?
string: 你需要什麼樣的證據？

original: Anything that confirms that Thorald isn't dead, but is being held captive. I know those Battle-Borns have it.
string: 任何能證明索拉德還沒死，而是被活捉的證據。我知道戰狂氏族手中一定有證據。

original: They'd be hiding it, of course. Wouldn't want it to get out that they've been lying this whole time.
string: 當然，他們會把它藏起來，以防讓外人知道他們一直在說謊。

original: But you might be able to butter them up enough to lower their guard.
string: 但或許你能吹捧他們兩句，好讓他們放鬆警惕。

original: I'm not sure I want to get involved in this.
string: 我不清楚該不該插手此事。

original: Please, I'm desperate. This is my brother's life! I won't let them take it away!
string: 求求你，我沒別的辦法。這可是我兄弟的性命啊！我不會讓他們奪走！

original: I beg of you, look for proof of Thorald's capture. The Battle-Borns have it, I just know it.
string: 我求求你，搜尋索拉德被俘的證據。就在戰狂那裡，我敢肯定。

original: I'll find the proof you need.
string: 我會找到你要的證據的。

original: Anything, anything at all would be a start. Then we can figure out how to get to him.
string: 什麼都好，至少是個開始。接下來我們就能弄清如何找到他了。

original: I'm sorry for doubting you, friend. You have my thanks.
string: 很抱歉我曾懷疑你，朋友。我謝謝你。

original: I'm not even sure what's going on.
string: 我還不大清楚發生什麼事了？

original: My brother, Thorald. He was fighting for the Stormcloaks, and went missing. Everyone assumes he's dead.
string: 我的兄弟索拉德。他為風暴斗篷而戰，但卻失蹤了。大家都認為他死了。

original: But he's not. I just know it. The Imperials captured him, and they're holding him someplace. The Battle-Borns know where.
string: 但他沒有。我很清楚。帝國軍隊俘虜了他，把他關在了某處。戰狂氏族知道在哪。

original: I'd go and search their house for proof, but they want me too. I'd be captured, and then we'll never know what happened to him.
string: 我本想去他們的屋中搜索證據，但他們也想抓我。如果我被捕，我兄弟的下落就永遠無法水落石出了。

original: So I need someone to find that proof for me.
string: 因此我需要有人幫我尋找證據。

original: Yes, absolutely. What can I do?
string: 當然。我能做什麼？

original: I know that Thorald's not dead. I just know it. The Imperials have him, and are keeping him somewhere. But I don't know where.
string: 我知道索拉德沒死。我很清楚。帝國軍隊俘虜了他，把他關在了某處。但我不知道具體位置。

original: Those damned Battle-Borns... they know something. They're hiding it. They practically taunt us with it. They must have some sort of proof!
string: 那些該死的戰狂……他們知道內情，卻隱而不宣。甚至以此奚落我們。他們一定有證據！

original: There's got to be something in that house of theirs. I just know it.
string: 在他們屋裡一定能找到什麼？我敢肯定。

original: I don't dare leave the house myself. So I need your help.
string: 我現在不能離開這幢房子。所以我需要你的幫助。

original: So, you're here to help?
string: 所以，你是來幫忙的？

original: Who are you? What are you doing here?
string: 你是誰？你在這做什麼？

original: Are you working with the Battle-Borns? Speak now before I put you in the ground!
string: 你是不是跟戰狂氏族一夥的？快說，不然我就要打你了！

original: All right, mother.
string: 好吧，母親。

original: I can't take any more of this. No weapons, please. Let's just talk.
string: 我受不了啦。拜託你收起武器。我們只需要談談，不必動手。

original: We can't trust anyone! Who knows what they'll do if they find me here.
string: 我們不能相信任何人！如果他們發現我在這，天知道會幹出什麼事來。

original: How do we know he's not spying for the Battle-Born? This was foolish!
string: 我們怎麼知道他不是戰狂的探子？這是愚蠢之舉！

original: How do we know she's not spying for the Battle-Born? This was foolish!
string: 我們怎麼知道她不是戰狂的探子？這是愚蠢之舉！

original: Avulstein, put that down! He's here to help us find Thorald!
string: 阿武斯特恩，快放下武器！他是來幫我們找索拉德的！

original: Avulstein, put that down! She's here to help us find Thorald!
string: 阿武斯特恩，快放下武器！她是來幫我們找索拉德的！

original: Mother, what's the meaning of this? Who have you brought into our home?
string: 母親，這什麼意思？妳把什麼人帶進了家門？

original: Welcome to our home.
string: 歡迎來我們家做客。

original: You should be safe now.
string: 你現在安全了。

original: I cannot thank you enough for rescuing me from this place. I suspect I'd never again see the light of day otherwise.
string: 我不知道怎麼感謝你的解救之恩。要不是你我很可能就永遠見不到天日了。

original: But why would you risk your life for me, a stranger?
string: 可我們素昧平生，你為什麼冒生命危險來救我？

original: We're here to rescue you.
string: 我們是來救你的。

original: I never thought I'd see another friendly face again.
string: 想不到還能見得到自己人。

original: We need to get to safety as soon as possible. Let's move.
string: 我們得儘快脫離險地。我們走。

original: I never thought I'd see another friendly face again.
string: 想不到還能見得到自己人。

original: We need to get to safety as soon as possible. Let's move.
string: 我們得儘快脫離險地。我們走。

original: I'm here to rescue you.
string: 我來營救你的。

original: So how do we get into the Thalmor Embassy?
string: 我們怎麼進梭默使館呢？

original: I'm not sure yet. I have a few ideas, but I'll need some time to pull things together...
string: 我還不清楚。我有幾個點子，但需要一點時間計劃一下……

original: Meet me back in Riverwood. If I'm not back when you get there, wait for me. I shouldn't be long.
string: 在河木鎮和我碰頭。如果你到時我還沒回來，就等等。不會很久的。

original: Keep an eye on the sky. This is only going to get worse.
string: 注意天空吧。情況只會越來越糟的。

original: What makes you think the Thalmor are bringing dragons back?
string: 你怎麼會認為梭默把龍帶回來了？

original: Nothing solid. Yet. But my gut tells me it can't be anybody else.
string: 沒什麼真憑實據。但直覺告訴我這不可能是別人。

original: The Empire had captured Ulfric. The war was basically over. Then a dragon attacks, Ulfric escapes, and the war is back on.
string: 帝國俘虜了烏弗瑞克。戰爭本來接近尾聲。但一條龍來襲，烏弗瑞克逃跑了，戰火便重燃。

original: And now the dragons are attacking everywhere, indiscriminately. Skyrim is weakened, the Empire is weakened.
string: 現在龍正在四處襲擊，如入無人之境。天際危在旦夕，帝國也是風雨飄搖。

original: Who else gains from that but the Thalmor?
string: 除了梭默還有誰能從中獲益？

original: What's our next move?
string: 我們下一步做什麼？

original: The first thing we need to do is figure out who's behind the dragons.
string: 我們首先要弄清龍的幕後主使是誰？

original: The Thalmor are our best lead. If they aren't involved, they'll know who is.
string: 梭默是我們的最佳線索。就算他們與此無關，也清楚內幕。

original: It was the one that attacked Helgen, when Ulfric escaped from the Imperials.
string: 那是烏弗瑞克從帝國手裡逃脫時，襲擊聖地鎮的那條龍。

original: Interesting. Same dragon...
string: 有意思。同一條龍……

original: Damn it, we're blundering around in the dark here! We need to figure out who's behind it all!
string: 該死，我們根本就在給人牽著鼻子走！我們得弄清幕後主使！

original: I've seen that dragon before, the one that got away.
string: 我以前見過那條剛飛走的龍。

original: Really? Where?
string: 真的？在哪兒？

original: What do you know about the dragons coming back?
string: 你對巨龍的回歸都知道些什麼？

original: Not a damn thing. I was just as surprised as you to find that big black dragon here.
string: 一無所知。看到這裡冒出一條大黑龍，我跟你一樣吃驚。

original: Yes, you do.
string: 不，你知道。

original: Go ahead. Whatever you want to know. Nothing held back.
string: 開口吧。想問什麼就問。我不會有所保留。

original: Who are you and what do you want with me?
string: 你是誰，你要我怎樣？

original: I'm one of the last members of the Blades.
string: 我是刀鋒衛士的最後成員之一。

original: A very long time ago, the Blades were dragonslayers, and we served the Dragonborn, the greatest dragonslayer.
string: 很久以前，刀鋒衛士曾是屠龍者，我們聽命於龍裔，最偉大的屠龍者。

original: For the last two hundred years, since the last Dragonborn emperor, the Blades have been searching for a purpose.
string: 兩百年來，自從最後一位龍裔皇帝駕崩後，刀鋒衛士一直在尋找新目的。

original: Now that dragons are coming back, our purpose is clear again. We need to stop them.
string: 既然龍已歸來，我們的目標又得以明晰。那就是阻止牠們。

original: Can't we talk here?
string: 這裡方便說話嗎？

original: The walls have ears and you're being tested, lad. We'll talk in the Ragged Flagon.
string: 隔牆有耳，而你正在接受考驗，小夥子。我們到漏壺再談。

original: The walls have ears and you're being tested, lass. We'll talk in the Ragged Flagon.
string: 隔牆有耳，而妳正在接受考驗，小姑娘。我們到漏壺再談。

original: How do I find the Ratway?
string: 我怎麼才能找到鼠道？

original: If I have to hold your hand through everything, maybe you aren't cut out for this kind of work.
string: 如果你事事都依賴我，那只能說你或許並不適合這樣的工作。

original: It's under your feet, lad. Just follow the smell.
string: 就在你腳下，小夥子。順著氣味。

original: If I have to hold your hand through everything, maybe you aren't cut out for this kind of work.
string: 如果妳事事都依賴我，那只能說妳或許並不適合這樣的工作。

original: It's under your feet, lass. Just follow the smell.
string: 就在妳腳下，姑娘。順著氣味。

original: I don't believe so. But I'll be able to instruct you further after you've returned from the chamber. It depends on what you learn.
string: 我不這麼認為。但等你從房裡回來後我可以進一步指導你。這要看你聽到了些什麼。

original: And make haste! You must be in place before Cicero and his... ally arrive! They could be planning another meeting at any time!
string: 但得動作快點！你得在西塞羅和他的……盟友到來前就位！他們隨時都有可能策劃另一次會面。

original: Is there anything else I should know?
string: 我還需要知道什麼？

original: Isn't it obvious? As the Night Mother's Keeper, he believes he's entitled to the rule of this Sanctuary.
string: 你還沒看出來？作為夜母的守護者，他認為自己有權統治這間聖所。

original: Cicero will cite our independence as the need to revert to the Old Ways. He'll claim we're undisciplined, unruly. Heretical, even.
string: 西塞羅會批判我們過於獨立，並鼓吹重回舊路。他會指責我們毫無紀律，甚至把我們稱做異端。

original: Ironically, the Night Mother could prove to be just as much a victim. The queen in a fool's twisted game of chess.
string: 諷刺的是，夜母本身可能也會成為受害者之一，就像是全盤覆滅的棋局中的王后一樣。

original: What do you think Cicero is planning?
string: 你覺得西塞羅在計劃些什麼？

original: That's the real question, isn't it? The jester enters, seals the door, and the conversation begins. So someone must be waiting for him inside.
string: 這才是問題的關鍵，不是嗎？弄臣能得以進入，還把門關起來密謀。一定有人從中接應。

original: Any one of us could enter that chamber silently. Unnoticed. But who amongst us would dare conspire against the Sanctuary?
string: 我們任何人都能在不引起注意的情況下進入那間房。但我們之中又有誰會密謀對聖所不利呢？

original: The very thought breaks my heart.
string: 光是想到這我就很傷心。

original: Any idea who would conspire with Cicero?
string: 知道有誰可能會和西塞羅串通連成一氣嗎？

original: It's Cicero. Ever since he arrived, his behavior's been... Well, erratic would be an understatement. I do believe he is truly mad.
string: 是西塞羅。自從他來後，他的行為一直……怎麼說，古怪已不足以形容了。我敢說他是真的瘋了。

original: But it's worse than that. He's taken to locking himself in the Night Mother's chamber, and talking. To someone. In hushed, but frantic tones.
string: 更糟的是，他把自己鎖進了夜母的房間中。對某人說話。語調低沉但言語狂亂。

original: Who is he speaking with? What are they planning? I fear treachery.
string: 他在跟誰說話？他們在計劃什麼？我怕是要謀反。

original: Is something wrong?
string: 有什麼不對勁的嗎？

original: You must help us appease Malacath.
string: 你一定要幫我們取悅瑪拉凱斯。

original: Please hurry. We are counting on you.
string: 請快點。我們都指望著你呢。

original: Don't make a mess of this.
string: 別搞砸了。

original: Let's just get this over with.
string: 我們還是快點解決這事吧。

original: Curses aren't enough, now must I suffer you too? What is it?
string: 對我的詛咒還不夠嗎？我現在還必須忍受你！那是什麼？

original: Why are you here, outsider?
string: 你來做什麼，外人？

original: Please, help Yamarz. Do whatever you can. Our tribe depends on you.
string: 求求你，幫幫亞馬茲。盡你所能。我們部落就指望你了。

original: I must focus now. This ritual is very important.
string: 我必須集中精力。這儀式很重要。

original: I will stay right here and wait for you to bring me what I need.
string: 我會在這等你把我要的東西拿回來。

original: Do you bring word from Malacath?
string: 你帶來了瑪拉凱斯的口信嗎？

original: Do whatever Yamarz asks of you. It cannot make things worse.
string: 聽亞馬茲的話。這有益無害。

original: Speak to Yamarz. Convince him to let you help him.
string: 跟亞馬茲談談。讓他接受你的幫助。

original: You should not be here, outsider.
string: 你不該在這，外人。

original: We have angered Malacath, and so we must be punished.
string: 我們觸怒了瑪拉凱斯，我們得接受懲罰。

original: Our tribe has survived this long without you interfering. We'll be fine.
string: 沒有你的幫助，我們的部落不也延續了這麼久嗎？我們不會有事的。

original: We have sworn loyalty to Yamarz. He will see us through these dark times.
string: 我們已經宣誓效忠亞馬茲。他會幫助我們度過難關。

original: By the Ashpit, we can't go on like this.
string: 以灰燼之界的名義，我們不能再這樣下去了。

original: My husband Leigelf is dead. I... I never thought I would miss that oaf so much.
string: 我的丈夫雷蓋爾夫去世了。我……想不到我會如此思念這個呆子。

original: Iron-Breaker Mine is three times the worth of that Quicksilver Mine and its fat-head owner.
string: 碎鐵者礦坑的價值是水銀礦坑和那蠢蛋礦主的三倍。

original: My miners are as dumb as rocks are grey.
string: 我這邊礦工的腦袋就跟石頭一樣愚蠢。

original: The Mortar and Pestle has cures for every illness, from Ataxia to Witbane.
string: 研缽和杵有辦法治癒一切疾病，包括運動失調症和魔障症。

original: A Stamina Potion maybe? Popular with young men.
string: 要不要來一劑精力藥水？很受年輕人歡迎哦。

original: Frost took my husband years ago. He was a good man.
string: 幾年前我的丈夫死於嚴寒。他是個好人。

original: My children all grew up and left Dawnstar to make their fortune.
string: 我的孩子們都已經長大，離開晨星城自己謀生了。

original: I will serve Dawnstar as I always have.
string: 我會一如既往地為晨星城服務。

original: You should see the grin on Horik's face now that we're in charge. I know he hides it, but I can tell.
string: 你該去瞧瞧霍理克那副小人得志的樣子。他雖然在掩飾，但我看得出來。

original: The Jarl and I have our disagreements. Sorry if you had to overhear one of them.
string: 領主跟我有些意見分歧。如果你無意中聽到了請不要放在心上。

original: I wasn't born in Skyrim, but when I served in the Legion this land became my home.
string: 我不在天際省出生，但從我在軍團中服役起這裡就成為了我的家鄉。

original: Horik and I have lived here ever since I retired. He's a good soldier.
string: 自從我退休後霍理克和我就住在這裡。他是一名優秀的士兵。

original: My duty is to guard Brina Merilis.
string: 我的職責是保護布里那．莫里利斯。

original: Watch your hands around the Legate.
string: 在副官身邊要管好你的手。

original: I've been in the Legion all my life. I'm content to serve.
string: 我把一生都奉獻給了軍團。能在其中服役我很滿足。

original: I'm just one of the miners. I don't want any trouble.
string: 我只是一名普通的礦工。我不想惹麻煩。

original: You should speak to the Jarl if you need something, stranger.
string: 你有需要就去找領主，陌生人。

original: I'm no one special, just a miner who swings a pickaxe for his drinking money.
string: 我只是普通人，一名為了酒錢辛勤工作的礦工。

original: Beitild thinks I drink on the job. Well, what does it matter if I do? Huh?
string: 貝提尤德懷疑我在工作時喝酒。就算是又有什麼關係呢？

original: My wife Beitild is dead. Can't say I miss that old sabre cat.
string: 我的妻子貝提尤德去世了。我真想念那隻老母貓。

original: Quicksilver Mine is the best mine in Dawnstar, and you can tell those Iron-Breaker miners I said so.
string: 水銀礦坑是晨星城最好的礦井，你可以跟那幫碎鐵者礦坑的礦工說這話是我說的。

original: If it's about the mine, I'm all ears.
string: 如果這與礦井有關，我洗耳恭聽。

original: Need a dagger? No? How about a claymore?
string: 要把匕首嗎？不要？來把雙刃寬劍如何？

original: You looking for a shield? Best thing between you and the enemy, friend.
string: 在找盾牌嗎？抵擋敵人可少不了這玩意啊，朋友。

original: Don't forget getting a good pair of gauntlets. Broken hands can't hold a sword.
string: 別忘了拿一副鐵手套。手受傷了可握不住劍。

original: I hear people were spotted using the Black Door. Gods have mercy.
string: 我聽說目擊稱有人在使用黑門。願諸神寬恕他們。

original: I work steel, weapons mostly.
string: 我是個鐵匠，主要製造兵器。

original: Most of the guards in Dawnstar carry swords forged from his very smithy.
string: 晨星城的衛兵佩戴的劍多半是出自他的熔爐。

original: I trained in Hammerfell during my journeyman years. Redguard smiths are second to none.
string: 我在落錘省當過學徒。紅衛人的鍛工舉世無雙。

original: I'll forge you a weapon tomorrow. Right now, I'm closed.
string: 我明天再替你打兵器。我現在關門了。

original: I traveled far and wide when I was younger. Glad to have settled down finally.
string: 我年輕時曾闖蕩江湖。很高興最終能安定下來。

original: I help my husband Rustleif run the forge. He's a marvel with steel.
string: 我替我的丈夫魯斯特雷夫掌管鐵匠鋪。他是個鍛鐵天才。

original: I married Rustleif when he was in Hammerfell, apprenticing under my father.
string: 魯斯特雷夫在落錘省時我嫁給了他，他那時是我父親的學徒。

original: The only thing I dislike about my husband's homeland is the cold. Why is it always so cold?
string: 我對丈夫老家唯一不滿的地方是天氣。為什麼一直這麼冷？

original: We discovered recently that I am with child. I'll need to stop working next season.
string: 最近我發現懷上了孩子。下個季度我就不能做工了。

original: I work in the mine, just like everyone else.
string: 我跟其他人一樣，在礦裡上班。

original: Used to be twice as many miners working here before all this trouble started.
string: 這些災禍發生前在這工作的礦工是現在的兩倍。

original: I mine. Work the smelter. Ain't much else to tell.
string: 我挖礦。此外還打理熔爐。沒什麼好多說的。

original: Been mining all my life. Quicksilver is as much my home as anywhere.
string: 挖了一輩子礦。水銀礦坑就像我的家一樣。

original: Damn Imperials. They won't hold Dawnstar forever.
string: 該死的帝國軍隊。他們不可能一直盤踞晨星城。

original: Why are you speaking to me, Imperial?
string: 你找我做什麼，帝國人？

original: The nightmares in Dawnstar have lifted, and I hear you helped that happen. You have my thanks.
string: 晨星城的噩夢結束了，我聽說是你的功勞。謝謝你。

original: I've been in charge of Dawnstar for over 35 years.
string: 我掌管晨星城超過35年。

original: No Empire is going to take the Jarlship away from this Son of Skyrim.
string: 帝國再也別想從天際之子的手上奪走領地了。

original: The Pale will throw those Imperial backbiters up against the wall when they come for us.
string: 那幫帝國賤人敢來襲擊，蒼原定會讓他們吃些苦頭。

original: Skyrim will not bow to a false king any longer. Ulfric is the true king.
string: 天際省不會再聽從偽君主的命令。烏弗瑞克才是真正的王。

original: Jarl Skald is upset over the loss of Dawnstar. I'll admit, it's less I have to worry about.
string: 斯卡德領主對晨星城的損失感到難過。但我也承認，我不用再操那麼多心了。

original: You should leave. Skald gets upset around Imperials.
string: 你該離開。斯卡德不喜歡帝國人。

original: I'm Skald's housecarl and head of his guard in Dawnstar.
string: 我是斯卡德的侍衛，也是他在晨星城的衛隊長。

original: My only aim is to keep the peace.
string: 我會全力維持和平。

original: Skald is very... vocal about his hatred of the Empire.
string: 斯卡德從不……掩飾他對帝國的不滿。

original: The tenacity of the Imperial Legion is legendary. We need to be ready for them.
string: 帝國軍團出了名的頑強。我們得準備好迎戰。

original: I served in the Great War against the Thalmor. I remember how bravely a Legionnaire can fight.
string: 我曾親歷對抗梭默的浩大戰爭。我對軍團士兵的英勇善戰記憶猶新。

original: Jarl gets booted from Dawnstar, and I'm still stuck cleaning up the dirt.
string: 領主被人從晨星城中趕了出去，我現在還在收拾這爛攤子。

original: What do you want, Imperial? Ain't my life hard enough?
string: 你想做什麼，帝國人？我的日子還不好過嗎？

original: Just a servant of Skald the Elder. Not worthy of time or consideration.
string: 我只是老斯卡德的一名僕人。不勞您浪費時間。

original: There's no honor in being a Jarl's servant. No Sovngarde waits for dust cleaners.
string: 侍奉領主毫無榮譽可言。英靈殿可不會接納骯髒的清潔工。

original: My family has served Skald Felgeif's family for generations.
string: 我的家族世代侍奉斯卡德．菲爾戈夫的家族。

original: Oh, it's just wonderful being Skald's servant. He's not demanding in the least.
string: 哦，當斯卡德的僕人很不錯。他一點也不苛刻。

original: I'm here to lend my magic to the people of Dawnstar.
string: 我在這裡為晨星鎮的人們提供一些魔法服務。

original: I had hoped life would be simpler here, but war seems to find a way of following me.
string: 我本以為這裡的生活會更簡單些，想不到戰爭如影隨形。

original: I served in the Great War as a Legion battlemage. I've no desire to go back.
string: 我參加浩大戰爭時是一名軍團戰鬥法師。我不想再有這種經歷了。

original: I'll work my spells and potions for whoever is willing to leave Dawnstar in peace.
string: 我會替任何願意和平離開晨星城的人施法。

original: The Windpeak Inn features the finest bard in all of Dawnstar. Me.
string: 風岳客棧裡住著全晨星城最好的吟遊詩人。也就是我。

original: Let me know if you need a drink. That's what we're here for.
string: 如果你想喝一杯就跟我說。我們就是為此而來的。

original: Sorry if my father seems a bit distracted. A lot's happened.
string: 很抱歉我父親心不在焉。他總這樣。

original: I'm sorry. My mind was just somewhere else. Did you need a room? Drink?
string: 對不起。我剛才走神了。你是要住宿？還是要喝點什麼？

original: Oh, do you need a room?
string: 哦，你想找個房間住嗎？

original: My daughter Karita sings to the guests when she can. She has her mother's voice.
string: 我的女兒卡利塔很樂意為來賓高歌一曲。她的嗓子和她媽媽一樣好。

original: Everyone thinks I'm too young to be a ship's captain, but I'm going to prove them wrong.
string: 每個人都覺得我年紀太輕當不了船長，我會證明他們是錯的。
