original: I don't buy all that talk about ship captains having to be stern and strict. I want my crewmen to enjoy their work.
string: 我不同意當船長要凶巴巴的那一套，我希望我的船員能享受工作的樂趣。

original: I inherited the ship when my mother passed away. She spent her life on the water, and now I do, too.
string: 母親過世時把這艘船留給了我。她一輩子都在水上度過，現在我也走上了這條路。

original: I'm good with stars and charts, but I admit I've got some things to learn about leading men.
string: 我很善於觀星和看航海圖，但我承認成為一名船長還有很長的路要走。

original: I plan to spend all the days I got left on the water. It's where I belong.
string: 我計劃在水上度過我的餘生。這是我的歸宿。

original: Once sailing gets in your blood, it don't get out.
string: 我身上流淌著航海家的血液，欲罷不能。

original: I been a sailor for so long, I could navigate these rivers an' seas blindfolded.
string: 我是一名老水手了，把眼睛蒙上我都能在這些河海裡航船。

original: Cap'n Wayfinder's as green as seaweed, but he's learnin'.
string: 威凡達船長真是跟海草一樣菜，不過他會學到東西的。

original: I don't like taking orders from a boy, but I need the gold.
string: 我不願聽命於一個毛頭小子，但我手頭有點緊。

original: I could run this ship better than that boy who calls himself a captain. Maybe one day I'll do something about it.
string: 我來當船長會比那小子更合適。也許某天我會取而代之。

original: The captain inherited the Sea Squall from his mother when she died. Maybe I can inherit the ship if he dies...
string: 船長從他媽那繼承了海啼號，也許他死了我也能「繼承」一把……

original: Not a day goes by that I don't think about finding a new ship. I guess it's easier just to stay put.
string: 我天天都在想換一艘船。但人總是安於現狀。

original: You should talk to Rustleif. Get some proper steel.
string: 你該和魯斯特雷夫談談。弄點好兵器。

original: Old lady Frida is a grouch, but she sure can whip up a cure for the Rattles fast.
string: 福瑞達是個老怨婦，但她能很快調製出響尾毒的解藥。

original: Beware of Frostmere Crypt, friend. Heard some bandits are living in the ruins now.
string: 小心冰池地穴。聽說一些土匪盤踞在廢墟中。

original: Giants have been spotted up near Red Road Pass. Best to keep away and avoid it entirely.
string: 紅路山隘附近有巨人出沒。你最好繞道走。

original: Dawnstar is the last port of call before Solitude. Damn rebels aren't taking it.
string: 晨星城是離獨孤城最近的一道港口。該死的叛軍別想攻下它。

original: We won't give up this port to the Imperials without a fight, don't you worry.
string: 我們不會把這座港口拱手讓給帝國軍隊的，你不用擔心。

original: Dangerous post, Dawnstar. If the bandits don't get you, the animals will.
string: 晨星城是個危險的地方。就算你不命喪匪徒手中，也難逃野獸的襲擊

original: Here to dig. That's all.
string: 我在這就只是為了挖礦。如此而已。

original: Dawnstar's got its problems, but as long as the ore is good, I'll stay.
string: 晨星城是出了點問題。但只要這裡能挖出好礦，我就會留下來。

original: Here to mine?
string: 你是來挖礦的嗎？

original: Quicksilver ore is rare. Worth digging.
string: 水銀礦坑礦很稀有。值得一挖。

original: Been working in Iron-Breaker since I was a boy.
string: 我從小在碎鐵者礦坑工作。

original: Iron's a good, stout metal. A fine thing for a Nord to dig.
string: 鐵是一種堅硬的金屬。對諾德礦工來說是個好東西。

original: Plenty of iron to dig.
string: 有很多鐵礦可挖。

original: Mining's an honest trade. No real tricks to it.
string: 礦產交易貨真價實。玩不了什麼花招。

original: I work for the Windpeak Inn. You should head on inside.
string: 我在風岳客棧工作。你該直接進去。

original: Thoring runs the inn. Speak to him.
string: 梭靈是旅館老闆。跟他談談。

original: I'm looking for an old guy, hiding out somewhere in Riften.
string: 我在找一個老頭，他藏身在裂谷城中。

original: Lot of people looking for him. Don't know his name, but he's paid good money for nobody to know he's down here.
string: 很多人都在找他。不知他叫什麼，但是為了不讓外人知道他的行蹤他可花了不少錢。

original: Know of an old guy hiding out in Riften, name of Esbern?
string: 聽說過一個藏身在裂谷城，名叫伊思本的老頭嗎？

original: Well... there is guy like that. He's paid good money for nobody to know he's down here, but I guess I can tell you.
string: 嗯……倒是有一個可疑的人。他為了避免走漏風聲花了不少錢，但我想跟你一說也無妨。

original: I'm looking for an old guy hiding out in Riften, probably in the Ratway.
string: 我在找一個躲在裂谷城中的老頭，大概藏在鼠道。

original: He's holed up in the Ratway Warrens. Be careful. You're not the only one looking for him.
string: 他躲在鼠道窩棚。小心。你不是唯一要找他的人。

original: That old guy hiding out down here... Where does he live?
string: 那老傢伙就藏在這……他住在哪兒？

original: Huh. Lot of old guys around. I don't really know how I can help.
string: 呃。附近有不少老頭。我實在幫不上忙。

original: I'm looking for an old guy, hiding out somewhere in Riften.
string: 我在找一個老頭，他藏身在裂谷城中。

original: Don't know his name, but there is a guy like that hiding out down here. Paid plenty for nobody to know about it.
string: 不知道他的姓名，但是在這裡潛藏了一個和他很像的人。還花了一大筆錢隱藏自己的行蹤。

original: You're not the first person to come in here asking about him, either, so be careful.
string: 你也不是第一個來這裡打聽他的人，小心點。

original: Know of an old guy hiding out in Riften, name of Esbern?
string: 聽說過一個藏身在裂谷城，名叫伊思本的老頭嗎？

original: Yeah, I think I know who you mean. He's paid good money for nobody to know he's down here, but I guess I can tell you.
string: 對，我想我知道你要找誰。為了不讓外人知道他在這，他開了個好價錢，但我想跟你一說也無妨。

original: I'm looking for an old guy hiding out in Riften, probably in the Ratway.
string: 我在找一個躲在裂谷城中的老頭，大概藏在鼠道。

original: Down in the Ratway Warrens. Nice place, if you don't mind the stench, rats, and assorted lowlifes as neighbors.
string: 躲在鼠道窩棚裡。如果你不介意惡臭，老鼠，以及三教九流的話，那倒還算個好地方。

original: That old guy hiding out down here... Where does he live?
string: 那老傢伙就藏在這……他住在哪兒？

original: That's interesting. Why do I care? You want a drink, or maybe just a few broken bones?
string: 這倒有意思。這關我什麼事？你是來喝酒，還是來找打的？

original: Never heard of anybody like that. But if you want to hide out in Riften, the Ratway's where you'd be.
string: 從沒聽說過這樣的人。但如果你想在裂谷城中藏身，鼠道是個好地方。

original: There's a sort of tavern down there, the Ragged Flagon. Where all the lowlifes in Riften get drunk and knife each other.
string: 那裡有一間名叫「漏壺」的酒館。裡面龍蛇雜處，天天都有醉漢滋事。

original: You might try there, if you can get through the Ratway alive.
string: 如果你能從鼠道活著出來，那你倒該去那裡碰碰運氣。

original: I'm looking for an old guy, probably hiding out in the Ratway.
string: 我在找一個老頭，大概藏在鼠道。

original: Yeah. I bet I know your guy. He's hiding out in the Ratway Warrens. Paying us good coin for nobody to know about it.
string: 對。我想我認識你要找的人。他躲在鼠道窩棚。花了好多錢來封我們的口。

original: Looking for the blade? You aren't the first!
string: 為那把刀而來？你不是第一個人啊！

original: You won't take my eye, man-thing!
string: 你奪不走我的眼睛，人類！

original: You're after that damn hilt? Go ahead, try and take it!
string: 你追蹤那柄該死的刀至此？來吧，來拿啊！

original: Finally, you're back.
string: 你終於回來了。

original: ...sweet Night Mother.
string: ……慈愛的夜母。

original: You will talk when you're ready, won't you? Won't you...
string: 您準備好就會開口了，對吧？對不對……

original: And what do you do? Nothing! Not... not that I'm angry! No, never! Cicero understands. Heh. Cicero always understands! And obeys!
string: 而您幹了什麼？什麼也沒有！我不……不生氣！不，絕不！西塞羅會理解的。嗨。西塞羅總能理解！並且遵從！

original: What about you? Have you... have you spoken to anyone? No.... No, of course not. I do the talking, the stalking, the seeing and saying!
string: 您呢？您跟人……說過話嗎？不……當然沒有。一直都是我在講話，是我在追蹤，在觀察，在說話！

original: The others... I've spoken to them. And they're coming around, I know it. The wizard, Festus Krex... perhaps even the Argonian, and the un-child...
string: 其他人……我跟他們談過了。他們都被說動了，我很清楚。法師，菲斯圖斯．克萊克斯……甚至亞龍人，還有那個假小孩……

original: Are we alone? Yes... yes... alone. Sweet solitude. No one will hear us, disturb us. Everything is going according to plan.
string: 就我們嗎？對……對……就我們。甜蜜的孤獨。沒有人會聽到我們，打擾我們。一切都按計劃進行。

original: You, you there! Help me, I'm trapped.
string: 你，就是你！幫幫我，我被困住了。

original: Is anyone out there? Anyone?
string: 外面有人嗎？有人嗎？

original: Help! Can anyone hear me? I'm stuck down here.
string: 救命！有人聽見嗎？我被困在這裡了。

original: You'd better get to Riften. Ask around the Ragged Flagon, in the Ratway. It's at least a good starting point.
string: 你最好快去裂谷城。去鼠道的漏壺裡打聽打聽。這至少是個不錯的切入點。

original: You'd better get to Riften. Talk to Brynjolf. He's... well-connected. A good starting point at least.
string: 你最好去裂谷城找布林喬夫談談。他……他消息很靈通。至少是個不錯的切入點。

original: They seem to think he's hiding out in Riften.
string: 他們似乎認為他藏在裂谷城中。

original: Riften, eh? Probably down in the Ratway, then. It's where I'd go.
string: 裂谷城？那可能藏在鼠道。要是我會躲在那。

original: So the Thalmor think the Blades know about the dragons...
string: 這麼說梭默認為刀鋒衛士知道龍的事嘍？

original: Ironic, right? The old enemies assume that every calamity must be a plot by the other side...
string: 真諷刺，對吧？宿敵們彼此認為每場災難背後都是對方在搗鬼……

original: Even so, we've got to find Esbern before they do. He'll know how to stop the dragons if anybody does.
string: 雖然如此，我們還是得趕在他們前找到伊思本。如果他都不知道如何對付龍，那大概就沒人知道了。

original: Do they know where he is?
string: 他們知道他在哪兒嗎？

original: What would the Thalmor want with Esbern?
string: 梭默想從伊思本那得到什麼？

original: You mean, aside from wanting to kill every Blade they can lay their hands on?
string: 你是說，除了想殺掉每一個落入他們手中的刀鋒衛士以外？

original: Esbern was one of the Blades archivists, back before the Thalmor smashed us during the Great War.
string: 在梭默於浩大戰爭中擊潰我們之前，伊思本是我們刀鋒衛士的檔案管理員。

original: He knew everything about the ancient dragonlore of the Blades.
string: 他知曉關於刀鋒衛士對先古龍的一切知識。

original: Obsessed with it, really. Nobody paid much attention back then. I guess he wasn't as crazy as we all thought.
string: 他沉迷於此，真的。那時還沒人太關注這個。現在看來他並沒有發瘋。

original: I don't know, but the Thalmor are looking for someone named Esbern.
string: 我不知道，但梭默在找一個叫伊思本的人。

original: Yes, I'm sure. They're looking for someone named Esbern.
string: 我敢肯定。他們在找一個叫伊思本的人。

original: Why'd you send me if you weren't going to believe me?
string: 如果你不肯相信我，為什麼要派我去？

original: You're right, you're right. I just... I was sure it must have been them. If not the Thalmor, who? Or... what?
string: 你說得對，說得對。我只是……我當時想一定是他們。如果不是梭默，還有什麼人？或是……其他什麼東西？

original: The Thalmor know nothing about the dragons.
string: 梭默對龍一無所知。

original: Really? That seems hard to believe. You're sure about that?
string: 真的？真是難以置信。你敢肯定？

original: Did you learn anything useful?
string: 你有得知什麼有用的資訊嗎？

original: Esbern? He's alive? I thought the Thalmor must have got him years ago. That crazy old man...
string: 伊思本？他還活著？我以為梭默幾年前就抓到了他。那個瘋老頭……

original: Figures the Thalmor would be on his trail, though, if they were trying to find out what's going on with the dragons.
string: 但是梭默要是想知道龍的動向的話，會追蹤他準沒錯。

original: Let's go, let's go! Before anyone notices us.
string: 我們快走，快！別讓其他人見到。

original: Hmm. I guess that will have to do. You should pass for a real guest, at least until you open your mouth.
string: 嗯。這樣勉強可以。你別開口，別人就會以為你是真的客人。

original: Ready to board the carriage to the embassy?
string: 準備好上車去使館了嗎？

original: You made it out alive, at least. Your gear's safe in my room, as promised.
string: 至少你活著出來了。照我們事先說好的，你的裝備都保管在我的房間裡。

original: I've figured out how we're going to get you into the Thalmor Embassy.
string: 我知道該怎麼讓你混進梭默使館了。

original: He's holed up in the Ratway Warrens. Hardly ever leaves the place - has someone bring him food and such.
string: 他躲在鼠道窩棚。久居不出——定有人給他帶必需品。

original: Crazy old coot, from what I've heard. For that to stand out down here, he must really be off his nut.
string: 如果傳聞屬實，那他就是個瘋老頭。能在那裡堅持那麼久，他一定是瘋的徹底了。

original: He lives somewhere in the Ratway Warrens. Must be crazy or desperate to live down there. Maybe both.
string: 他躲在鼠道的某處。敢住在那不是瘋了就是走投無路。他可能兩者都有。

original: Haven't you figured it out yet? What more needs to happen before you all wake up and see what's going on?
string: 你還不明白嗎？還要發生什麼你才能認清事實的真相？

original: Alduin has returned, just like the prophecy said!
string: 奧杜因回來了，預言應驗了！

original: The Dragon from the dawn of time, who devours the souls of the dead!
string: 來自黎明時代的龍，吞噬逝者的亡靈。

original: No one can escape his hunger, here or in the afterlife! Alduin will devour all things and the world will end. Nothing can stop him!
string: 無論今生還是來世，無人能逃脫被他吞噬的命運！奧杜因將吞噬一切，世界隨之毀滅。無人能阻止他！

original: The Blades knew, once upon a time. Alduin's Wall is the key. Yes, yes!
string: 很久以前，刀鋒衛士曾知曉。奧杜因之牆是關鍵。對，對！

original: Don't move. Don't move. I have it here, somewhere... never thought it would be any use, but now...
string: 別動。別動。我帶在身上，等我找找……沒想到它會派上用場，但如今……

original: And now you pay for meddling in the Thalmor's affairs.
string: 如今你要為干預梭默的事務付出代價。

original: That's him! That's who was asking about Esbern! Kill him!
string: 就是他！打聽伊思本的那個人！殺了他！

original: That's her! That's who was asking about Esbern! Kill her!
string: 就是她！打聽伊思本的那個人！殺了她！

original: Yes! Yes! You see, you know but you refuse to understand!
string: 對！對！你瞧，你根本就知道，但你只是自己不願承認罷了！

original: Who else is looking for Esbern?
string: 還有誰在找伊思本？

original: Dangerous-looking elves who didn't give their names. Draw your own conclusions.
string: 那些相貌兇惡的精靈不肯透露他們的名字。你看著辦吧。

original: Various shady types I've never seen before. I'd watch my back if I was you.
string: 許多我從沒見過的道上人。你最好小心行事。

original: DB04AstridMotierreNazirTopic
string: DB04AstridMotierreNazirTopic

original: I'm thinking we need that amulet appraised. I want to know where it came from, how much it's worth, and if we can actually get away with selling it.
string: 我們該把那護符拿去鑒定一下。我想知道它是從哪來的，值多少錢，還有容不容易脫手。

original: And, there's only one man who can give us what we need - Delvin Mallory. He's a fence, a private operator. Works out of the Ratway, in Riften.
string: 只有一個人能滿足我們的需求——戴爾文．馬洛里。他是一名獨來獨往的銷贓者。他在裂谷城中做生意，卻與鼠道無瓜葛。

original: Give me the letter. Bring Mallory the amulet. Find out everything you can, and sell it if he's willing. He'll offer a letter of credit - that's fine.
string: 把信給我。把護符帶給馬洛里。盡可能查清真相，如果他願意的話就賣給他。他會開一份信用憑證——那樣也行。

original: Delvin Mallory and the Dark Brotherhood have... history. He can be trusted.
string: 戴爾文．馬洛里和黑暗兄弟會有段……淵源。他值得信賴。

original: What are you thinking?
string: 妳在思考什麼？

original: You're damn right we'll accept it. If we pull this off, the Dark Brotherhood will know a fear and respect we haven't seen in centuries.
string: 你說得對，是該答應。如果這事成功，我們就能讓暗黑兄弟在數世紀後重新受到世人的敬畏。

original: You think I'd abandon an opportunity to lead my Family to glory?
string: 你覺得我會放棄一個讓我的家族走向榮耀的機會？

original: But this is all so much to take in. I need time to read the letter, and figure out where we go from here. And this amulet. Hmmm...
string: 但這些事有點複雜。我需要時間仔細研讀這封信，弄清我們接下來該如何做。而這個護符，嗯……

original: So we'll accept the contract?
string: 這麼說我們會接下契約？

original: DB04AstridMotierreNightMotherTopic
string: DB04AstridMotierreNightMotherTopic

original: No, she certainly wouldn't. And... for whatever reason, she chose to relay Motierre's information to you.
string: 不，她肯定不會。況且……無論如何，她把莫提雷的情報轉交給了你。

original: I don't know exactly what's going on here, if you're the Listener, or this is some fluke, or what. But what we now have before us...
string: 我不知道這裡會變得怎樣，或許你真的就是聆聽者，還是這次事件只是純屬巧合，或者另有隱情。但眼下我們面對的是……

original: Surely the Night Mother wouldn't misdirect us...
string: 夜母不會誤導我們……

original: By Sithis, you're not joking.
string: 以西帝斯之名，你不是在開玩笑吧。

original: To kill the Emperor of Tamriel... The Dark Brotherhood hasn't done such a thing since the assassination of Pelagius.
string: 刺殺泰姆瑞爾皇帝……自從行刺佩拉吉奧斯後黑暗兄弟會就沒再幹過這種事了。

original: As a matter of fact, no one has dared assassinate an Emperor of Tamriel since the murder of Uriel Septim, and that was two hundred years ago...
string: 事實上，自從尤利爾．塞普汀死於非命之後就沒人敢行刺泰姆瑞爾皇帝了，而那也是兩百多年前的事了……

original: The letter explains it all. The amulet is for expenses.
string: 信中應該有說明，而護符是為了支付費用。

original: What's this?
string: 這是什麼？

original: (Show Astrid the amulet and sealed letter)
string: （把護符和未拆封的信拿給阿斯垂德看）

original: You're joking.
string: 你一定是在開玩笑。

original: Motierre wants us... to kill the Emperor.
string: 莫提雷要我們……刺殺皇帝。

original: You're back. Good. All right, so? Did you meet this Motierre? What did he want?
string: 你回來了。很好。都還順利嗎？你見到莫提雷了嗎？他想要什麼？

original: The logistics of such an endeavor will be staggering, I know. There will be several minor assassinations necessary. Leading up to the... main target.
string: 我知道此次行動的準備會十分繁雜。我們需要實施數次較小的刺殺行動。在對付……主要目標前。

original: As I mentioned, the amulet I gave you is exceptionally valuable, and will certainly cover the costs of all these other unpleasantries.
string: 我剛說過，我給你的護符異常珍貴，這一定能補償你在處理這件事上的花費。

original: The sealed letter explains everything else, in detail. It should be delivered to your superior. Whomever that may be.
string: 這封信詳細地解釋了剩下的事。該把它轉交給你的上級。無論是誰。

original: This is a complex contract. I need more details.
string: 這份契約很複雜。我需要更多細節。

original: Oh, my furtive friend. When Emperor Titus Mede II lies dead, there will be gold... a fortune in gold. But so much more!
string: 哦，我狡猾的朋友。只要皇帝提圖斯．邁德二世駕崩，就會有金幣……很多金幣。多得數不清！

original: It is said that the Dark Brotherhood, in recent years, has been in decline. That you lack the power, wealth, and respect of days past. Is it not so?
string: 聽說近幾年來，黑暗兄弟會正在衰落。你們再也無法重塑昔日的權利，財富和威望了。不是這樣嗎？

original: If you do this, if you kill the Emperor... Oh, how the masses will fear and respect you.
string: 如果你幹下這種大事，如果你殺了皇帝……想想看人們會多麼敬畏你。

original: We'll require... significant compensation. Can you pay the price?
string: 我們需要……大筆報酬。你能付得起嗎？

original: In the year 3E 41, Emperor Pelagius Septim was murdered in the Temple of the One in the Imperial City. Cut down by a Dark Brotherhood assassin.
string: 3E 41年，佩拉吉奧斯．塞普汀皇帝在帝都的至尊神殿內遭到刺殺。為一名黑暗兄弟會的刺客所殺。

original: His killing ushered in, shall we say, a necessary change in Imperial policy.
string: 我們可以說，他的身亡讓帝國政治走上了正軌。

original: There are those now who wish for a similar change. I am sorry, but that's all I'm at liberty to say.
string: 現在不少人期盼類似的改變。抱歉，但我只能說這麼多。

original: Why do this? Why have the Emperor assassinated?
string: 為什麼要這麼做？為什麼要刺殺皇帝？

original: I performed the Black Sacrament, contacted you people, because I thought you guaranteed discretion.
string: 我舉行了黑色聖禮，與你們接觸，因為我曾以為你們十分謹慎。

original: Is this no longer so?
string: 現在不是了嗎？

original: Who are you, Motierre? Who are you, really?
string: 你是誰，莫提雷？你到底是誰？

original: You think I don't know that? If anyone learned of this meeting, my corpse would swing over Solitude for a decade!
string: 你覺得我會不知道嗎？如果有人知道了此次會面，我的屍首就會被掛在獨孤城外示眾數十年！

original: But what I ask of you... it must be done. There is too much at stake.
string: 但我要你做的事……必須完成。眼下是危急存亡之秋。

original: You do realize this is treason...
string: 你清楚這是叛國罪……

original: It's a shocking request, I know. But it is inside the purview of what you Dark Brotherhood types do. Isn't it? If history is to be believed?
string: 我知道這個請求有點過分。但你們黑暗兄弟會能做這事。不是嗎？歷史就不能重演嗎？

original: You must understand. So much has led to this day. So much planning, and maneuvering. Now you're here, as if the very stars have finally aligned.
string: 你必須明白。這一天是無法避免的。多少計劃，多少排演。而現在你在此，成功就在眼前。

original: But I digress. Here, let me give you these. They are to be delivered to your, um... superior.
string: 我離題了。拿去，這些給你。你必須把他們交給你的，呃……上級。

original: Rexus. The items.
string: 雷薩斯。東西拿來。

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

original: That is correct. What I ask is no small thing, of course. But you represent the Dark Brotherhood. This is... what you do? No?
string: 這就對了。我要你做的自然不是易事。但你代表著黑暗兄弟會。這就是……你該做的。不是嗎？

original: You must understand. So much has led to this day. So much planning, and maneuvering. Now, it's as if the very stars have finally aligned.
string: 你必須明白。這一天是無法避免的。多少計劃，多少排演。現在，成功就在眼前。

original: But I digress. Here, take these. They need to be delivered to your, um... superior.
string: 我離題了。拿去，這些東西必須交給你的……上級。

original: Rexus. The items.
string: 雷薩斯。拿東西來。

original: You want us to kill... the Emperor. Of Tamriel?
string: 你想要我們刺殺……泰姆瑞爾皇帝？

original: Oh, wonderful. You don't know how happy I am to hear you say that.
string: 好極了。你不知道聽到這話我有多高興。

original: So much has led to this day. So much planning, and maneuvering. It's as if the very stars have finally aligned.
string: 這一天是無法避免的。多少計劃，多少排演。現在，成功就在眼前。

original: But I digress. Here, take these to your, um... superior.
string: 我離題了。拿去，這些東西必須交給你的……上級。

original: Rexus. The items.
string: 雷薩斯。拿東西來。

original: Leaders rise and fall. Business is business.
string: 領主的改變更迭。對我而言，只是一樁生意。

original: As I said, I want you to kill several people. You'll find the targets, as well as their manners of elimination, quite varied.
string: 如我所言，我要你殺幾個人。你會發現目標和刺殺方法都不盡相同。

original: I'm sure someone of your disposition will probably even find it enjoyable.
string: 我想像你這樣性格的人可能會覺得這充滿樂趣。

original: But you should know that these killings are but a means to an end. For they pave the way to the most important target.
string: 但你得清楚這些殺戮都是為了最後一擊。它們會為達成最終目標鋪平道路。

original: The real reason I'm speaking with a cutthroat in the bowels of this detestable crypt. For I seek the assassination of...
string: 我在這可憎的地窖裡與一名殺手交談的真正原因，是在尋求刺殺……

original: ...the Emperor.
string: ……皇帝的方法。

original: Go on.
string: 說下去。

original: Right, then. You prefer to listen, is that it? Well, you must represent the Dark Brotherhood. I certainly wasn't expecting anyone else.
string: 那好吧。你不愛說話，對嗎？你必須作為黑暗兄弟會的代表。我明顯指望不了其他人。

original: So I'll cut right to the chase.
string: 我就開門見山地，直接跟你說明暗殺計畫。

original: I would like to arrange a contract. Several, actually. I daresay, the most important work your organization has had in, well... centuries.
string: 我想締結一份契約。事實上，也許是好幾份。我敢保證，這是你們組織這數……世紀以來最重要的行動。

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

original: Oh, I know. I know. But I'm so glad you're here. Please, allow me to state my business. Surely your time is as valuable as my own.
string: 哦，我明白。我明白。但你能來我還是很高興。請讓我把行動的內容說完。你一定跟我一樣是個大忙人。

original: I would like to arrange a contract. Several, actually. I daresay, the most important work your organization has had in, well... centuries.
string: 我想締結一份契約。事實上，也許是好幾份。我敢保證，這是你們組織這數……世紀以來最重要的行動。

original: You have opened the door to darkness, little man.
string: 你開啟了黑暗之門，孩子。

original: Yes, um.... So it would seem. Well, I won't waste your time. I would like to arrange a contract. Several, actually.
string: 是，嗯……看來是的。那好，我就不浪費彼此的時間了。我想締結一份契約。事實上，也許是好幾份。

original: I daresay, the work I'm offering has more significance than anything your organization has experienced in, well, centuries.
string: 我敢說，我給的這份工作，將是你們組織數世紀以來接到的最重要任務。

original: The Night Mother heard your pleas, Motierre.
string: 夜母聽見了你的請求，莫提雷。

original: By the almighty Divines. You've come. You've actually come. This dreadful Black Sacrament thing... it worked.
string: 以全能的神之名義。你來了。你終於來了。這可怕的黑色聖禮……起作用了。

original: Rexus will now give you two items which must be passed along to your superior.
string: 現在雷薩斯會給你兩件物品，你必須把他們交給你的上級。

original: Is there... something else you need?
string: 你……還有什麼事嗎？

original: Reporting for duty.
string: 報告長官。

original: I need you to deliver some false orders to the Stormcloak commander in Dawnstar.
string: 我要你向晨星城的風暴斗篷指揮官傳達假命令。

original: But first we need to get our hands on some rebel orders to make the forgeries.
string: 但首先我們得拿到一些叛軍命令，以便作假。

original: Reporting for duty.
string: 報告長官。

original: Need you to deliver some false orders to the Imperial Legate in Morthal.
string: 你要向墨索爾城的帝國特使傳達假命令。

original: But first we need to get our hands on some Imperial orders to make the forgeries.
string: 但首先我們得拿到一些帝國命令，以便作假。

original: Reporting for duty.
string: 報告長官。

original: Open the door.
string: 開門。

original: The Thalmor have found you. You need to get out of here.
string: 梭默發現你了。你必須離開這裡。

original: Oh, how reassuring! Most likely you're with the Thalmor and this is just a trick to get me to open the door!
string: 哦，這話真令人安心啊！看來你跟梭默是一夥的，想騙我開門！

original: It's okay. Delphine sent me.
string: 別緊張。我是戴爾菲娜派來的。

original: Delphine? How do you... so you've finally found her, and she led you to me. And here I am, caught like a rat in a trap.
string: 戴爾菲娜？你怎麼……這麼說你終於找到她了，是她把你帶到我這的。我就在這，落入了圈套。

original: Open the door.
string: 開門。

original: Go away!
string: 走開！

original: I told you to go away. I'm not opening this door for anybody!
string: 我跟你說了別靠近。我不會為任何人開門！

original: Esbern? Open the door. I'm a friend.
string: 伊思本？把門打開。我是你的朋友。

original: What?! No, that's not me. I'm not Esbern. I don't know what you're talking about.
string: 什麼？！不，我不是。我不是伊思本。我不知道你在說什麼？

original: Yamarz must listen with the ears of the wind.
string: 亞馬茲必須用風之耳傾聽。

original: The ears of the wind?
string: 風之耳？

original: Malacath himself said this to you? But what does it... Ah! Yes! I see! A ritual is necessary!
string: 瑪拉凱斯親自跟你說的？但這是什麼……啊！我明白了！需要舉行一個儀式！

original: This message is for me. I understand now. I have work to do. You, I shall need your help.
string: 這是一條給我的資訊。我現在明白了。我要開始工作了。你過來，我會需要你的幫助。

original: I need a Daedra's heart, at once! Quickly, quickly!
string: 我需要一顆魔族之心，現在！快點，快拿來！

original: How do I contact Malacath?
string: 我怎麼跟瑪拉凱斯交涉？

original: His shrine lies northwest of Largashbur. I am unsure that he will listen, but it cannot hurt.
string: 他的祭壇在拉加施布爾的西北部。我不敢肯定他會聽，但這總沒壞處。

original: He didn't seem to think it would do any good.
string: 他似乎不認為這會有用。

original: Yes, but he offered it as an idea. Perhaps he hopes it will be helpful, but does not wish to risk personal failure.
string: 對，但他提出了這個設想。也許他希望這能幫上忙，但他自己不想冒失敗的風險。

original: You should do as he says. Go to Malacath's shrine, northwest of here, and ask for his help. See what happens.
string: 你該照他說的去做。前往西北邊的瑪拉凱斯祭壇，尋求他的幫助。看看會發生什麼？

original: He was just trying to get rid of me.
string: 他就是想擺脫我。

original: Perhaps. But he spoke of this "curse" to you, which means it has deeply affected him.
string: 也許吧。但他對你提起了這個「詛咒」，也就是說你已經說動他了。

original: It may be worth attempting contact with Malacath after all.
string: 畢竟嘗試與瑪拉凱斯聯繫可能會有用。

original: Go to Malacath's shrine, southeast of Largashbur. See if perhaps he will aid us after all.
string: 前往瑪拉凱斯的祭壇，在拉加施布爾的東南部。看看他最終會不會幫助我們。

original: Yamarz told me to go to Malacath.
string: 亞馬茲要我去找瑪拉凱斯。

original: So, he says to petition Malacath for relief? Interesting.
string: 這麼說他要向瑪拉凱斯請願？有意思。

original: There must be something I can do.
string: 我一定能做些什麼？

original: You? An outsider? I'd sooner slit my own throat than accept help from you.
string: 你？一個外人？我寧可自殺也不接受你的幫助。

original: To even consider it would be such a sign of weakness that I might as well abandon my tribe now.
string: 就算考慮一下也是軟弱的表現，我要是這樣的人早就拋棄我的部落了。

original: What kind of spirits?
string: 什麼樣的幽靈？

original: The kind that curse you, haunt you in the dead of night. There is nothing you can do, nothing anyone can do.
string: 那種施你以詛咒，在夜深人靜時糾纏你的幽靈。你卻無能為力，沒人能幫你。

original: Shagrol, once the leader of this tribe, unhappy with his demise, has dealt with Malacath himself to curse me, curse us all.
string: 部落曾經的首領，煞葛洛，不滿自己的失勢，與瑪拉凱斯作交易，讓他來詛咒我，詛咒我們大家。

original: I'm sorry, what?
string: 抱歉，你說什麼？

original: Spirits! Ghosts! I am cursed, haunted, and I can do nothing. Can you fix that?
string: 幽靈！鬼魂！我被詛咒了，鬼上身了，而我無能為力。你能幫我驅鬼嗎？

original: Of course you cannot. No one can. It is my lot as Chief of this tribe, and so I suffer quietly.
string: 你當然不能。沒人能。作為部落首領這就是我的命運，我只能默默忍受。

original: I understand you need help.
string: 我知道你需要幫助。

original: Atub! Meddlesome woman... You would help us? Help me?
string: 阿土布！愛管閒事的女人……你會幫我們嗎？幫助我？

original: Tell me, outsider. Can you banish spirits? For that is what I need.
string: 告訴我，外人。你能驅走幽靈嗎？我別無他求。

original: What sort of help do you need?
string: 要我幫你什麼忙？

original: Our chief is weakened. He will not rest, will not sleep. He suffers, and so the tribe suffers.
string: 我們的首領日漸虛弱。他無法休息，無法入睡。他倍受折磨，整個部落也是如此。

original: Yamarz is proud, and refuses to see that we need outside help.
string: 亞馬茲很自負，拒絕外界的幫助。

original: He needs someone to confide in. If it will not be one of us, perhaps it will be you. Go to him.
string: 他需要一位值得信任的人。如果我們之中沒有，或許那個人會是你。去找他吧。

original: Forgive Ugor's harsh words. She is merely doing as she has been told.
string: 請原諒烏戈爾的無禮。她只是在服從命令。

original: You have returned. Will you now aid me in contacting Malacath?
string: 你回來了。現在你能助我聯絡瑪拉凱斯嗎？

original: Fine, it's your neck.
string: 好吧，隨便你吧。

original: You were charged with keeping us inside the walls. Have faith, Ugor. I only wish the best for our tribe.
string: 他給你的命令將會把我們鎖在這道牆後面。要有信心，烏戈爾。我是為部落著想。

original: Yamarz charged me with keeping outsiders away from Largashbur. You would have me disobey him?
string: 亞馬茲要我負責將外人擋在拉加施布爾之外。你要讓我違抗他的命令？

original: We cannot carry on this way! You know we are doomed if we do not do something!
string: 我們不能這樣下去了！你很清楚如果我們再無作為就死定了！

original: We need nothing from outsiders! Yamarz will provide for us.
string: 我們不需要外人！亞馬茲會為我們提供一切。

original: Ugor, no! This may be the one we need.
string: 烏戈爾，不！這人或許正是我們的救星。

original: Halt! You have no business here, outsider. Leave at once.
string: 站住！這裡不關你的事，外人。馬上離開。

original: The prophecy says I'm the only one who can defeat Alduin.
string: 預言中說只有我能打敗奧杜因。

original: Ah, the prophecy. Be wary of prophecy. Some are meant as a guide. Some as a warning. Are you sure you can tell one from the other?
string: 啊，預言。當心預言。其中所言部分是指引，部分是警告。你能分辨二者的不同嗎？

original: Does it matter?
string: 這有差嗎？

original: Yes. For matters of such gravity, we need to know where you stand. Or who you stand with.
string: 當然。這很重要，我們得知道你站在那一邊。跟誰是盟友。

original: It was recorded on Alduin's Wall.
string: 這都記錄在奧杜因之牆上。

original: I need to learn the Shout used to defeat Alduin.
string: 我要學會曾經打敗奧杜因的龍吼。

original: Where did you learn of that? Who have you been talking to?
string: 你從哪裡聽來的？你跟誰談過？

original: Where did you learn of a Shout used to defeat Alduin?
string: 你在哪裡得知這個曾擊敗過奧杜因的龍吼？

original: That was the last of the ingredients.
string: 那是最後一種材料了。

original: Yes, Master Elgrim will be pleased I've restored his stock of these rare ingredients.
string: 沒錯，看到這些稀有材料的庫存充足，艾爾格瑞姆大師會很高興的。

original: I feel I owe a bit more than some meaningless coin for all your diligence. Here, this key unlocks my supply chest at Elgrim's Elixirs.
string: 我覺得一點金幣不足以報答你的辛勞。拿去，這把鑰匙可以打開我在艾爾格瑞姆藥水店裡的補給箱。

original: Feel free to take what you need from time to time. I'll be refilling it once every few days or so.
string: 歡迎你不時來取些所需物品。我每隔幾天就會把它重新裝滿。

original: No, not right now.
string: 不，不是時候。

original: Disappointing.
string: 真令人失望。

original: Any clues where I can find these ingredients?
string: 我該上哪兒找這些材料？

original: Nirnroot is the easiest. It grows only by the water and makes a unique chiming noise. The only drawback is it won't regrow after harvesting.
string: 最常見的是奈恩根。它生長於水邊，會發出一種獨特的聲響。唯一的缺點是它被收割後無法重新生長。

original: Nightshade is native to the pine forest and marshy tundra regions of Skyrim and has a distinctive starburst-like violet flower.
string: 龍葵原產於天際省的松林和沼澤苔原地區，其花朵閃耀著獨特的紫色光芒。

original: Last we have deathbell which only grows in marshy tundra terrain. Its inverted bluish-purple flower bunches are unmistakable.
string: 最後是生長在沼澤苔原地形的喪鐘花。它倒長的藍紫色花叢你絕對不會認錯。

original: Why are you so fascinated by alchemy?
string: 妳為何如此癡迷於鍊金術？

original: It's exhilarating to observe the effects of my potions on the body. Watching the heart stop... the eyes go blind.
string: 觀察我的藥水對身體的影響是多麼令人興奮啊。觀察心臟停擺……眼部致盲。

original: We're made up of thousands of parts with thousands of different functions all working in tandem to keep us alive.
string: 我們的身體是由成千上萬個部分所組成，它們功能各異，共同維持著我們的生命。

original: Yet if only a single part of our imperfect machine fails, life fails. It makes one realize how fragile... how flawed we are.
string: 只要我們機體上的任一組織衰竭，生命便隨之消亡。這讓我感受到生命的……脆弱與瑕疵。

original: You ask why I'm so fascinated? The irony... the irony that the same world that gave us life provides us the means to die.
string: 你問我為何如此著迷？多麼諷刺……給予我們生命的世界同樣會導致我們的死亡。

original: Sure, I'll get them for you.
string: 沒問題，我去把它們找來給妳。

original: That means more time for my experiments and less time in the field. Much appreciated.
string: 這意味著我能把更多精力投入到實驗中去，免除在外奔波之苦。非常感謝。

original: What sort of ingredients do you need?
string: 妳需要哪些材料？

original: To restore Master Elgrim's supply I would need 20 deathbell, 20 nightshade and 20 nirnroot.
string: 要補充艾爾格瑞姆大師的材料，我需要20份喪鐘花，20份龍葵和20份奈恩根。

original: Am I sensing that you may be interested in gathering these rare ingredients for me?
string: 你願意替我搜集這些珍貴材料嗎？

original: Are you an alchemist?
string: 妳是一名鍊金術士嗎？

original: I'm aspiring to earn that title, yes. However, the road ahead is paved with loose cobbles and deadly pitfalls.
string: 我渴望贏得這個名號。但前路荊棘遍佈。

original: Master Elgrim says I'm a natural; that I have a unique talent. But I fear his approval masks his intolerance for my mistakes.
string: 艾爾格瑞姆大師說我很有天賦：我擁有一項獨特的才能。但恐怕他對我的贊許可能意味著他不會容忍我犯下的任何錯誤。

original: My errant formulas have cost Master Elgrim a fortune in ingredients; some of which are almost irreplaceable.
string: 我的配方出了差錯，讓艾爾格瑞姆大師白白浪費了不少材料，其中有些甚至是不可替代的。

original: You've done me a great service, my friend. Allow me to compensate you for the information.
string: 你幫了我大忙，我的朋友。請允許我為此報答你。

original: This key opens one of my stashes in the basement of the meadery. Help yourself to any of its contents.
string: 這是我家地下室裡一個儲藏箱的鑰匙。需要什麼請自便。

original: Never mind. I was mistaken.
string: 不用了。我誤會了。

original: You idiot. You came all the way down here for that?
string: 你個白癡。你遠道而來就是為了說這個？

original: I killed her for you.
string: 我替你殺了她。

original: Cut out the middleman, eh? Shrewd, very shrewd. You sure you don't have some Black-Briar blood in you?
string: 排除中間人？精明，真精明。你確定你沒有黑棘的血統嗎？

original: Actually, she's already dead.
string: 事實上，她已經死了。

original: Well, that's just about the best news I've heard all week.
string: 喔，這差不多是我本週來聽到的最好的消息。

original: I was going to give this to whomever killed her for me, but I suppose you've earned it by bringing me this information.
string: 我本打算把這交給替我殺掉她的人，既然如此，這是你應得的。

original: This key opens one of my drop spots in the basement of the meadery. Take anything inside you like.
string: 這是我提煉室地窖中一處交貨點的鑰匙。想要什麼儘管拿。

original: Please, I beg you, don't tell Sibbi where I am. He'll kill me!
string: 求求你，不要告訴西比我在哪。他會殺了我的！

original: Sibbi's been spreading lies about me, you must hear me out.
string: 西比所說有關我的事情都是謊言，你一定要聽解釋。

original: Stop lying or I'll beat it out of you! (Intimidate)
string: 別再撒謊，否則有你好看！（威嚇）

original: I've been hurt worse before.
string: 別以為這樣就能嚇到我。

original: You're serving only eight months for murder?
string: 你殺了人卻只服刑八個月？

original: Mother thought I should be taught a lesson for airing the family's dirty laundry in public.
string: 母親認為該給我一個教訓，因為我損害了家族的名聲。

original: I mean, I've... taken care of many people for her in the past. What in Oblivion did she expect me to do?
string: 我是說，我曾經……幫她處理過那麼多人。她究竟還想要我怎麼做啊？

original: Ah well. At least I have all the comforts of home during my stay. Well, except the touch of a woman of course.
string: 啊，不過至少我在這還是能有點家的感覺。當然，只不過少了女人的陪伴而已。

original: Do you have any information on Svidi?
string: 你有沒有什麼關於斯維迪的情報？

original: She was a young woman... buxom, with long flowing black hair.
string: 她是名年輕女子……很豐滿，有一頭烏黑飄逸的長髮。

original: She used to sing the most lovely songs to me when we were courting. I've never heard a voice so beautiful.
string: 我們獨處的時候，她曾為我演唱了一首最動聽的歌謠。我從未聽過如此美妙的聲音。

original: All that talent will go to waste when I'm finished with her.
string: 但是當我解決掉她之後，那些天賦就無用武之地了

original: Good luck finding her from there.
string: 那祝你早日找到她囉。

original: Amusing.
string: 真好笑。

original: I'll help you find her.
string: 我會幫你找到她的。

original: That's the spirit. Find her and I promise you'll be well compensated.
string: 這才對嘛。幫我找到她，我會好好報答你的。

string: （深呼一口氣）

original: Why shouldn't they trust you?
string: 他們為什麼不該相信你？

original: Dov wahlaan fah rel. We were made to dominate. The will to power is in our blood. You feel it in yourself, do you not?
string: 都 瓦拉 法 瑞爾。我們註定要成為主宰。我們的血液中流淌著對權力的渴望。你也感覺到了，不是嗎？

original: I can be trusted. I know this. But they do not. Onikaan ni ov dovah. It is always wise to mistrust a dovah.
string: 我值得信賴。我很清楚。而牠們則不然。奧尼坎 尼 歐 都瓦克。不相信一名都瓦是明智之舉。

original: I have overcome my nature only through meditation and long study of the Way of the Voice.
string: 通過冥想和對龍吼之道的長期學習，我得以戰勝了我的本性。

original: No day goes by where I am not tempted to return to my inborn nature. Zin krif horvut se suleyk.
string: 我無時無刻不經受著回歸本性的誘惑。辛 克理夫 赫瓦特 西 蘇雷克。

original: What is better - to be born good, or to overcome your evil nature through great effort?
string: 怎樣更好——是生來性善，還是通過不懈努力克服邪惡的本性呢？

original: The Blades say you deserve to die.
string: 刀鋒衛士說你該死。

original: The Blades are wise not to trust me. Onikaan ni ov. I would not trust another dovah.
string: 刀鋒衛士不信任我是明智之選。奧尼坎 尼 歐。是我也不會相信另一名都瓦。

original: Steady now. The Legion has faced down worse than a few dusty old bonewalkers.
string: 沉住氣。相較於這幾個骨頭架子們，軍團還戰勝過更可怕的敵人。

original: We're not leaving here until we get what we came for.
string: 我們不達目的誓不甘休。

original: Is this what killed that Stormcloak over there? Can't be. It looks like it's been dead for a hundred years.
string: 這就是殺死那名風暴斗篷的罪魁禍首嗎？不可能。它看起來已經死了好幾百年了。

original: What in the nine holds is that?
string: 我的天，那是什麼？

original: Be careful men. There's bound to be more up ahead.
string: 小心點夥計。前面一定會有更多。

original: Don't give them a chance to warn the others!
string: 別讓他們有機會給其他人報信！

original: If there's more gold where that came from, I'm in.
string: 如果有錢可拿的話，就算我一個。

original: That's the spirit! Larceny's in your blood... the telltale sign of a practiced thief.
string: 這才像話！你的血液裡流淌著對偷盜的渴望……這是一名老練盜賊的特徵。

original: I think you'll do more than just fit in around here.
string: 我想你可以做些別的事情，而不是在這遊手好閒。

original: Don't know why I bothered. This place is a mess.
string: 不知為何我心煩意亂。這地方真是一團糟。

original: If you were expecting a palace, then maybe you're not cut out for this line of work. Our methods involve secrecy and discretion.
string: 如果你期盼什麼豪宅大院，只能說明你不適合幹這行。我們行事必須隱秘謹慎。

original: Now... if you're done bellyaching like a child, how about handling a few deadbeats for me?
string: 現在……如果你廢話說完了，幫我去修理幾個賴帳的怎麼樣？

original: I almost got killed!
string: 我差點丟了性命！

original: No risk, no reward. That's the way it goes, so you better get used to it.
string: 不入虎穴焉得虎子。我們就是這樣過活的，你最好早點習慣。

original: Now... if you're done bellyaching like a child, how about handling a few deadbeats for me?
string: 現在……如果你廢話說完了，幫我去修理幾個賴帳的怎麼樣？

original: If you're looking for a challenge, you've come to the right place.
string: 如果你是來找刺激的，你來對地方了。

original: A few drinks, a few laughs and a contest. What could be better?
string: 飲酒作樂，一展身手。夫復何求？

original: Maybe you just aren't up to the challenge...
string: 看來這對你而言太過刺激了……

original: What's happening?
string: 怎麼回事？

original: You made it!
string: 你成功了。

original: We need to get inside. Follow me!
string: 我們得進去。跟我來！

original: Come on! We need to get inside before that dragon comes back!
string: 快啊！我們得趕在那些龍回來之前進去！

original: The path to Paarthurnax lies through this gate. I will show you how to open the way.
string: 通往帕圖納克斯的道路就在此扇門後。我會告訴你如何掃清障礙。

original: Enough of your dire predictions! We will talk about this another time.
string: 我聽夠你的預言了！這個我們改日再談。

original: If we win. This war is going to drag on for years. I can feel it. We need to prepare for a long struggle ahead.
string: 如果我們獲勝，戰爭可能還得持續數年。我能預見得到。所以我們得做好打持久戰的準備。

original: You're right. Why dilute the glory with too many souls fighting over it? We'll drive out the Empire and be celebrated as heroes when we win.
string: 你說得對。為何要讓戰爭帶走的生命掩蓋了我們勝利的喜悅呢？我們會把帝國驅逐出去，成為英雄凱旋歸來。

original: With respect, Jarl. You can't ask everyone to throw themselves against trained Legionnaires. Let's leave the fighting to the Stormcloaks.
string: 恕我直言，領主。不是人人都是訓練有素的軍團士兵的對手。還是把戰鬥留給風暴斗篷們吧。

original: We are poised for glory, Jod. The Empire will never take Dawnstar while every last man, woman, and child here draws breathe!
string: 我們已準備好迎接榮耀了，喬德。只要男女老幼們還有一口氣在，帝國就別想拿下晨星城。

original: I don't want to talk about it.
string: 我不想談這個。

original: You don't want to talk about it, or you don't know?
string: 你是不想談，還是不知道？

original: I don't want to talk about it.
string: 我不想談這個。

original: What is this feud you have with your wife? What started this?
string: 你為何與妻子爭吵？起因是什麼？

original: Never. Not until we turn this mine around, drive Beitild out of business, and force her to apologize to me for everything she's done!
string: 絕不。除非我們徹底改變這個礦場，打擊貝提尤德的生意，讓她為她所做過的事向我道歉！

original: If you don't mind me saying, Leigelf. You're working too hard. Go home.
string: 我說你一句你別介意，雷蓋爾夫。你太辛苦了。快回家吧。

original: I'll, uh, just take that as a compliment.
string: 我就，嗯，把這個當成誇獎吧。

original: It's good to hear you say that. I wish my wife was as simple as you.
string: 很高興聽你這麼說。我真希望我的妻子也像你這麼單純。

original: Where else would I go? Dawnstar is my home and working here is my job.
string: 我還能去哪？晨星城是我的家，我在這工作。

original: Thank you for sticking by me.
string: 謝謝你與我共患難。

original: Uh, yes ma'am.
string: 呃……遵命，女士。

original: You'll shut your mouth and get back to work, or you won't be a miner or a soldier by the day's end. Hear me?
string: 閉上你的嘴快給我去工作，否則你一輩子無論礦工士兵都當不成。聽見了嗎？

original: Pride of the what? This isn't the Legion, boss. We're miners, not soldiers.
string: 什麼榮譽？這不是軍團，老闆。我們是礦工，不是士兵。

original: Work hard, now! The pride of Iron-Breaker Mine is on the line.
string: 快努力工作！碎鐵者礦坑的榮譽岌岌可危。

original: Drafted into a war, how could my life get worse?
string: 入伍打仗，還有比這更悽慘的嗎？

original: No he isn't! He's the enemy, and we are going to crush him.
string: 不，他不是！他是敵人，我們要給他點顏色瞧瞧。

original: We're at war with Leigelf? Isn't he your husband?
string: 我們向雷蓋爾夫開戰了？他不是你的丈夫嗎？

original: Keep at it. We need to work twice as hard now that fat-headed Leigelf has declared war!
string: 堅持下去。那個肥頭大耳的雷蓋爾夫挑起了戰爭，我們得加倍努力。

original: I... well, let me think about it.
string: 我……好吧，讓我想想。

original: Your people's war, I mean. The Nords. What kind of life would we be giving our little one if we stayed here?
string: 我的意思是，這是你們的戰爭。諾德人的。如果我們留在這裡，我們的孩子會過著怎樣的生活？

original: War of mine? It's not my war, Seren!
string: 我的戰爭？那不是我的戰爭，賽仁！

original: I'm just worried about raising a child in the middle of this war of yours.
string: 我擔心在你們的戰爭中要怎麼撫養孩子。

original: Hammerfell? I'm not against the idea, but why?
string: 落錘省？不是我反對，不過為什麼？

original: Rustleif, I've been wondering. Maybe after the baby is born, we should move to Hammerfell.
string: 魯斯特雷夫，我在考慮。孩子出生後，也許我們該搬去落錘省。

original: Not hot enough. Does your Skyrim ever get warm, husband?
string: 哪裡算得上熱。天際這邊暖和過嗎，老公？

original: The forge is hot today.
string: 今天鐵匠鋪裡好熱啊。

original: So much for old soldiers settling down to a life of luxury, eh?
string: 老兵歸鄉過安定日子的話題就先談到這，好嗎？

original: Of course. I would have it no other way.
string: 當然。我只會選擇這條道路。

original: With you by my side, is that right Horik?
string: 你會追隨我左右，對吧？霍理克。

original: No. If we must fight, we will, and you will lead us to victory. As you always have.
string: 我不擔心。如果別無選擇，我們會戰鬥，而你會引領我們走向勝利。正如你平常做的那樣。

original: I'm fine, Horik. I just... are you worried about this war?
string: 我很好，霍理克。我只是……你擔心這場戰爭嗎？

original: Are you all right? You seem tired.
string: 你還好嗎？你看起來很疲倦。

original: You weren't. There's just not much to it.
string: 哪裡話。只是我沒什麼好說的。

original: I see. You're a good soldier, Horik. I'm sorry for intruding.
string: 我明白了。你是一名優秀的士兵，霍理克。我不是故意冒犯你的。

original: No. Can't say there was. My parents died when I was young. You and the Legion have been my only family since.
string: 不。談不上有家人。我少時父母雙亡。從此你與軍團就是我僅存的至親。

original: What about your family? There must have been someone waiting for you back at the farm. Wondering if you were ever coming home?
string: 你的家人怎麼了？農場裡肯定有人在期盼你的歸來。在想你究竟會不會回家。

original: What's to say? I was born on a farm, joined the Legion when I came of age, and I've served you ever since.
string: 有什麼好說呢？我出生在一間農場，成年後加入了軍團，從那以後我就一直追隨你。

original: You never talk much about yourself, do you Horik? I swear, these past 30 years you've been at my side, and I think I barely know you.
string: 你很少談你自己，對嗎，霍理克？你我相伴30年，我卻幾乎不瞭解你。

original: Sorry, lass... I've got important things to do. We'll speak another time.
string: 抱歉，姑娘……我有很重要的事要做。我們改天再談。

original: Sorry, lad... I've got important things to do. We'll speak another time.
string: 抱歉，小夥子……我有很重要的事要做。我們改天再談。

original: I'm busy right now, lass. We can talk later.
string: 我現在很忙，姑娘。我們待會兒再談。

original: I'm busy right now, lad. We can talk later.
string: 我現在很忙，小夥子。我們待會兒再談。

original: Always a pleasure, boss. What can I do for you?
string: 樂意之極，老闆。我能為你做什麼？

original: Pull up a seat and have a drink.
string: 拉張凳子來，我們喝一杯。

original: Ah, you're back.
string: 啊，你回來了。

original: Something troublin' ya? I'll listen.
string: 你有什麼煩心事嗎？跟我聊聊吧。

original: So, what can I do for ya today?
string: 我今天能幫你做什麼？

original: Still have quite a good bit of jobs available if you're looking for some extra coin.
string: 如果你想賺外快的話，我這還有許多工作。

original: Need some gold? I may have some work for you.
string: 缺錢嗎？我這還有許多工作。

original: Looking for work?
string: 在找事做嗎？

original: Got lots of jobs available. Interested?
string: 有不少工作。感興趣嗎？

original: So, you're the one Brynjolf's been jabberin' about. Been waitin' to have a word with you.
string: 你就是那個布林喬夫常掛在嘴邊的人。在這等著，我有口信給你。

original: I think you better listen to Mercer and Brynjolf first. We can talk later.
string: 我覺得你最好先去聽聽墨瑟和布林喬夫的話。我們待會再談。

original: Talk to me again if you prove yourself to Brynjolf.
string: 向布林喬夫證明自己後再來找我談。

original: Come back later and I may have some work for you.
string: 待會再來，也許我會有工作給你。

original: I think Brynjolf can give you all the information you need.
string: 我認為布林喬夫能給你所需的一切資訊。

original: Yeah?
string: 什麼事？

original: I'm listenin'.
string: 我在聽。

original: Looking to fix your armor?
string: 在找地方修理盔甲嗎？

original: Can I interest you in anything? Some fine armor perhaps?
string: 你看上了什麼？要不要幾套好盔甲？

original: Be glad to repair any damage to your Guild armor.
string: 很樂意替你修復公會盔甲。

original: So, name your poison! Ha ha ha. Oh, I never get tired of that one!
string: 你要什麼毒藥就說吧！哈哈哈。哦，我樂此不疲！

original: Need some sort of toxin for a special occasion? That's where I come in.
string: 需要什麼特殊毒藥嗎？我就是賣這個的。

original: I sell all sorts of poisons for almost every occasion.
string: 我出售各類毒藥，能滿足各種需求。

original: Looking for the best smith in Skyrim? You found it.
string: 在找天際省首屈一指的鐵匠嗎？我就是。

original: They don't call me the Ember-Master for nothing. What do you need?
string: 人們叫我「熔火大師」是有原因的。你需要什麼？

original: Need your weapon repaired? Or could I interest you in a new one?
string: 需要修理你的兵器嗎？還是要買新的？

original: I've got all sorts of weapons for the discerning marksman. What can I get you?
string: 我為目光銳利的神射手提供各色兵器。你想要買什麼？

original: If you're in the market for the finest bows money can buy, you're talking to the right person.
string: 如果你想要買最棒的弓，那麼你找對人了。

original: Skilled, lethal and good-looking. Yep, it's a curse.
string: 精工細作，致命卻又雅觀。沒錯，這是把奪命利器。

original: Hey, let's talk a second.
string: 嘿，我們談談吧。

original: You're making waves around here. I like that. If you ever want to talk about anything, you let me know.
string: 你在這裡惹了不少事嘛。我喜歡。如果你想找人談談，儘管來找我。

original: Hey, how's it going. Need pickpocket training?
string: 嘿，還順利嗎？想學習竊盜的技巧嗎？

original: If you need pickpocket training, just let me know.
string: 如果你需要學習竊盜的技巧，儘管來找我。

original: If you want to be a master pickpocket like me, I can get you there.
string: 我能把你訓練成為我這樣的竊盜大師。

original: If you wondering why they call me Vipir the Fleet, watch me outrun the town guard sometime.
string: 如果你不知別人為何稱我為「快腿」維皮爾，下次來看我如何擺脫城中的衛兵。

original: I've been a part of this Guild for as long as Mercer has been Guild Master.
string: 墨瑟當上公會會長時我就是會員了。

original: I might not be as big as some of my fellow Nords, but in a fight they can barely lay a hand on me.
string: 可能我的身材不如一些諾德同胞魁梧，但若打起來他們根本碰不到我。

original: My specialty is pickpocketing. All I need is a rich mark, a moon-lit sky and I'm in my element.
string: 我精於竊盜。我只需一個有錢的目標，一輪當空明月，還有一個好狀態。

original: I wouldn't mind teaching the ways of the pickpocket... if the gold was right.
string: 我不介意傳授竊盜技巧……只要價錢公道。

original: I miss the glory days of this place. We had more coin stacked in the vaults than we even knew what to do with.
string: 我真懷念這地方以前繁榮的日子。我們的寶物庫裡堆放的錢幣花都花不完。

original: Come here a second.
string: 來這裡一下。

original: A lot of people are beginning to get impressed with you here. Me included. Just wanted to let you know.
string: 這裡很多人開始注意你了。也包括我。跟你知會一聲。

original: Interest you in some marksman training?
string: 想學習成為神射手嗎？

original: If you need marksman training, and you've got the coin... I'm ready to teach you.
string: 如果你想學習射箭，並且手頭寬裕的話……我願意教你。

original: What's on your mind?
string: 什麼事？

original: Of course you can buy me a drink... you didn't need to say a word, but I heard you loud and clear.
string: 你當然能請我喝一杯……就算不用你說，我也早就心領神會了。

original: Ugh. The wine in Skyrim tastes like urine compared to the fine vintages we had in Valenwood.
string: 呸。與威木省的葡萄美酒相比天際省的就像尿一樣難喝。

original: I don't miss home one bit. I'm glad to leave that life behind me.
string: 我一點也不想家。我很高興能擺脫那樣的生活。

original: I'd much rather earn a living liberating others of their coin this way than spending my days as a carpenter like my father.
string: 我寧願以摸別人的錢包為生，也不願像我父親那樣當一名木匠。

original: It's not hard to fit in and make friends when you have the coin to make it happen.
string: 只要有錢，與人搞好關係並非難事。

original: I don't bother with silly pickpocketing jobs when I can make far more at the gambling table.
string: 既然能在賭桌上贏更多的錢我為何還要偷東西呢？

original: Let's talk for moment.
string: 我們來談談吧。

original: Look, if I was a little harsh before, I just wanted you to know it's because you were new. Know what I mean?
string: 聽著，如果我先前對你有些失禮，那是因為你剛來。明白我的意思嗎？

original: Well, hey there. What can Sapphire do for you?
string: 你好啊。藍寶石能為你做什麼？

original: Back from a job, huh? Hope it went well.
string: 工作歸來？但願還順利。

original: Want to talk? Go ahead.
string: 想談談嗎？請便。

original: They call me Sapphire because I love to steal them.
string: 我愛偷藍寶石，因而人們以此給我冠名藍寶石。

original: Don't get me wrong, I'll steal any gem that isn't nailed down. But there's something about those blue stones that gets my blood boiling.
string: 別誤解了。只要是摸得著的寶石我都會偷。但那些藍色的寶石特別吸引我。

original: When people ask my real name, know what I tell them? Don't ask.
string: 要是有人問我的真名，你知道我會說什麼嗎？別問。

original: Sure I might have some dirt in my past, but that's just ancient history.
string: 我當然有些陳年劣跡，但那是很久以前的事了。

original: I'm a deadeye marksman, lethal with a blade and dangerous in bed. And it only gets better from there.
string: 我是一名頂尖神射手，精於刀法，而且床技也不簡單哦。而且這些年我真是越來越能行了。

original: Last time someone cheated me, I cut off their hand. Still have it actually.
string: 上一次有人想欺騙我，我把他們的手砍了下來。我還保留著呢。

original: Wanted to say something to you.
string: 想跟你說些事。

original: I think you're all right. In fact, I'm kind of impressed how well you're doing around here. Just keep it between us, okay?
string: 我想如果是你的話應該沒問題。事實上，你在此的所作所為讓我印象深刻。別說出去，好嗎？

original: Yeah, you need something?
string: 什麼事，你有什麼需要嗎？

original: What's going on?
string: 發生什麼事了？

original: Sure, we can talk a minute.
string: 當然，我們可以談一會。

original: I've seen a lot of thieves come and go, but I've never seen anyone as good as me.
string: 小偷我見得多了，但沒人比得上我。

original: I could crack the lock on any house blindfolded before you even got your picks out of your pocket.
string: 在你掏出開鎖工具前，我就能蒙著眼打開任何鎖。

original: Been in the Guild a long time... joined right after Brynjolf. Not interested in leadership though, that's more his kind of thing.
string: 我是公會的元老了……緊隨布林喬夫之後加入。但我對當領導沒興趣，那種事更適合他做。

original: I don't care if Vex was chosen as a Guild Third over me, she deserved it.
string: 我不介意「小煩」坐上公會的第三把交椅，地位在我之上，那是她應得的。

original: I kind of like watching things from where I am. Making money is all I care about.
string: 我比較實際。我只在乎賺錢。

original: Hey, I want to talk to you... now.
string: 嘿，我想跟你談談……立刻。

original: You're pretty tough, I respect that. Bringing in a lot of coin for the Guild, making us look good too. Let me know if you need anything, okay?
string: 你蠻厲害的，這點我很尊敬。你為公會帶來了不少收入，也讓我們臉上有光。需要什麼就儘管開口，好嗎？

original: Need something?
string: 需要什麼嗎？

original: You want to talk to me? Okay.
string: 你想跟我談談？沒問題。

original: Yeah, I guess I have a minute. What do you want?
string: 我有時間。你想怎麼樣？

original: I'm the heavy hitter around here. When someone needs pushing around, I'm the one they send in.
string: 我是這附近的頭號打手。如果想教訓什麼人，他們就會派我來。

original: Used to run with a bandit clan in The Pale. Turns out I didn't like them and they didn't like me, so we parted ways.
string: 我曾和蒼原的一個強盜集團有來往。結果我們互相看不順眼，於是就分道揚鑣了。

original: Brynjolf pulled me in a few years ago. Said the Guild was lacking some muscle, so I joined up.
string: 布林喬夫幾年前拉我入夥。他說公會需要些威懾力量，於是我加入了。

original: I've busted heads for Maven Black-Briar when she wants to keep her name out of it. Pays good, so why not?
string: 我曾替瑪雯．黑棘殺人，因為她不想惹禍上身。價錢公道，我何樂而不為呢？

original: I leave all that sneaking around nonsense to everyone else; believe me, when I'm coming for you... you'll know it.
string: 我行事光明磊落；相信我，如果我盯上了你……你會知道的。

original: Got a minute? Wanted to say something.
string: 有空嗎？有事跟你談。

original: I've never seen anyone with skills like yours. I just wanted to let you know that if you need anything, you can talk to me.
string: 我還沒見過什麼人有你這樣的身手。我只想跟你說，如果你有需要，可以來找我。

original: Hey, good to see you!
string: 嘿，很高興見到你！

original: Something I can help with or do you just want to talk?
string: 是來找我幫忙的還是來聊天的？

original: My brother in crime... what'd you need?
string: 我的兄弟犯了事……你需要什麼？

original: My sister in crime. What'd you need?
string: 我的姐妹犯了事……你需要什麼？

original: Name's Rune. Yeah, rune... just like you're thinking.
string: 我叫盧恩。沒錯，盧恩……就是那個原意為「符文」的詞。

original: Have no idea what my birth name really is, and I frankly don't care.
string: 我不知道我的真名叫什麼，老實說我也不關心。

original: Being brought up by a poor family, I had to learn how to steal if I wanted to make ends meet.
string: 我在一個貧困家庭裡長大，要想維持生計我就得學會偷東西。

original: Brynjolf actually caught me trying to pick his pocket in the market. If he was anyone else I would have gotten away with it.
string: 我在市場扒竊布林喬夫時被他抓住。如果換做別人我就得手了。

original: I'm glad Brynjolf decided to let me join. Been trying to make some coin for him ever since.
string: 布林喬夫讓我入夥我很高興。從那時起我就努力為他賺錢。

original: Hmph, so you're the one everyone's falling over.
string: 嗯，你就是那個每次都能得手的人。

original: I don't know, you don't look so impressive to me. I mean, you're no Gray Fox, but you must be doing something right.
string: 我不知道，你看起來不那麼出眾。我是說，你不是灰狐，不過你做的事情卻很有道理。

original: I'm busy, is this important?
string: 我很忙，這事很重要嗎？

original: Are you bothering me for a reason?
string: 你為何打擾我？

original: Oh, this should be good.
string: 哦，這應該不錯。

original: We haven't met.
string: 我們從沒見過面。

original: Name's Garthar. Remember it, because you're going to hear a lot about me.
string: 我叫加塔爾。記住這個名字，將來你會經常聽到。

original: Still learning the ropes, but I'll get the hang of it.
string: 還在摸門道，但我會弄清其中的奧妙的。

original: Been doing a few jobs for Vex... how about you?
string: 正在給「小煩」打工……你呢？

original: Did you want something?
string: 你有什麼需要嗎？

original: Our Guild Master graces me with a visit. What can I do for you?
string: 我們的公會會長大駕光臨。我能替你做什麼？

original: Steal anything worth talking about?
string: 偷到了什麼好東西嗎？

original: Back with good news I trust.
string: 相信你會帶好消息回來的。

original: Well? You done or what?
string: 怎麼？你是做完了還是怎麼？

original: Out with it. Time is money.
string: 快去。時間就是金錢。

original: So, feeling loose? How about you run a job for me.
string: 沒事做嗎？幫我做點事怎麼樣。

original: Need a few spare septims? I got the cure right here.
string: 想要賺外快嗎？我這裡有工作做。

original: I have work if you've got the backbone.
string: 如果你決定做工的話就來找我。

original: Ready for some work or you just going to wander around all day?
string: 你是準備幹點活還是整日在這裡遊手好閒？

original: So, you're the new recruit everyone's been talking about, eh? I guess it's about time we talked.
string: 這麼說你就是那個人人談論的新成員？我想我們該談談了。

original: After you talk to Brynjolf and Mercer, come back and see me.
string: 你跟布林喬夫和墨瑟談過後，再來找我。

original: I have no business with you.
string: 我跟你沒什麼好談。

original: I'm busy. Don't you have something to do?
string: 我很忙。你沒事做嗎？

original: I'm not here to hold your hand. Figure this one out for yourself.
string: 你可不能全靠我。這個你得自己解決。

original: You need advice? Talk to Brynjolf... I got better things to do.
string: 你想要建議？去跟布林喬夫談……我還有更要緊的事。

original: I have no business with you.
string: 我跟你沒什麼好談。

original: Whatever you're selling, I'm not buying.
string: 無論你賣什麼，我都不會買。

original: Don't you have better things to do than disturb me?
string: 你除了來煩我就沒別的事做了嗎？

original: This better be important, I'm quite busy.
string: 來找我最好是有要緊事，我很忙的。

original: I'd had Eorlund forge this for Thorald. It was to be a present for his return. I suppose he can't have it now.
string: 我讓厄倫德為索拉德鍛造了這個。這本是慶祝他歸來的禮物。但他現在用不上。

original: Why don't you take it? We can always make another for the day when this war ends and Thorald can come home.
string: 你就拿去吧？當戰爭結束、索拉德歸鄉時，我們可以為他再做一把。

original: With Eorlund gone, I'm afraid I can't offer you much in the way of thanks. But please, take this. It's the least I can do.
string: 厄倫德不在了，恐怕我也沒什麼能感謝你的。但請你務必收下這個。這是我的一點心意。

original: He said to tell you to "suffer the winter's cold wind."
string: 他要我告訴妳「忍受冬季的寒風」。

original: "...for it bears aloft next summer's seeds." That's my boy.
string: 「……因為在風中有明年夏天即將發芽的種子」。那是我孩子的話。

original: So it's true, then. For now, it's enough to know that he's alive. I can find peace in that.
string: 這麼說是真的。現在能知道他還活著我就很滿足。我安心了。

original: Thank you, dear friend. You've given me back my son.
string: 謝謝你，親愛的朋友。你把我的兒子帶回來了。

original: I'm afraid he's not here. He didn't think it was safe to return.
string: 恐怕他不在這裡。他覺得現在回來不安全。

original: What? After all this, I can't even see him?
string: 什麼？經歷了這麼多，我連他一面都見不著？

original: How... How do I know you're telling me the truth, and not just what I want to hear?
string: 我……我怎麼知道你說的是真的，而不是挑好聽的說？

original: Thorald is safe.
string: 索拉德沒事了。

original: Is he? You've saved him?! I must see him at once!
string: 是他？你救了他？快讓我見見他！

original: Well, it's a winding road up the mountain just ahead. You'll know you're in the right place once you spot the old watchtower.
string: 是前方的一條盤山路。如果你看到一座老哨塔，就證明你走對了路。

original: Once you get to the tower, head north. Bleak Falls Barrow should be just around the corner further up.
string: 到達塔下後，向北走。荒瀑古墳應該就在前方的轉角處。

original: How much farther do I have to walk?
string: 我還要走多遠？

original: This is the bridge out of town. The path up the mountain to the northwest leads to Bleak Falls Barrow.
string: 這就是城外的那座橋。西北方的山路通向荒瀑古墳。

original: I guess I should get back to my brother. He'll throw a fit if I take too long. Such a child....
string: 我該回到我的弟弟身邊。如果我耽擱太久他就會大發脾氣。真是不懂事……

original: Where are we now?
string: 我們到哪兒了？

original: Oh, never mind.
string: 哦，算了。

original: Why would they be looking at me? Are they upset about the service?
string: 她們為什麼要盯著我？她們對服務不滿意嗎？

original: It'll do you good! Maybe you could visit Irgnir or Fruki on your way out? I've seen them looking at you when they come in for drinks....
string: 這對你有好處！你出去時可以順路拜訪伊格涅爾或弗如基。我看到她們來喝酒時一直盯著你……

original: Why would I do that? There's work to be done here.
string: 我為什麼要這麼做？活還沒幹完呢。

original: I was wondering, father. Maybe you should take a day off and head into town. I could watch the inn while you're away.
string: 我在想，爸爸。也許你該休息一天去城裡逛逛。你不在時我能替你看顧旅館。

original: I'm sorry. I just don't feel up to entertaining anyone just now.
string: 對不起。我現在沒有心情去取悅任何人。

original: I'm sure she would want you to be happy, father. Entertaining the guests and drinking and making your lewd jokes like before.
string: 我肯定她希望你開心，爸爸。讓客人高興，邊喝酒邊開些色色的玩笑，就像從前那樣。

original: No, Karita. I don't think I could.
string: 不，卡利塔。我沒有那個心情。

original: Father, do you want to talk? About mother?
string: 爸爸，你想談談嗎？談談媽媽？

original: Thank you, Madena. I appreciate your assistance.
string: 謝謝你，邁德那。感謝你的幫助。

original: I, well, no of course not. I would be glad to help.
string: 我，嗯，當然不介意。很高興我能幫上忙。

original: Actually, I was just wondering if you could make sure people are tended to if they get hurt. I'm sure you wouldn't object to that.
string: 事實上，我在想如果有人受傷你能不能幫忙看看他們。我想你不會介意的。

original: If this is about battle magic, forget it. I've told every Jarl I've served under that I won't....
string: 如果這要用戰鬥魔法，那就免談。我跟侍奉過的每位領主都說過我不會……

original: Madena, I was wondering if you could help me with something. Your magic would be invaluable.
string: 邁德那，你能不能幫我點忙。你的魔法會派上大用場。

original: Still suspicious of me. Well, don't say I never offered.
string: 還在懷疑我。好吧，別怪我沒跟你說過。

original: I said I'm fine, Madena. I won't have some court mage fixing me up like some magical experiment.
string: 我說了我很好，邁德那。我不會讓什麼宮廷法師把我當成實驗品來醫治的。

original: I know old men sometimes have pains in their legs when they rise from bed. I know a few spells that could help.
string: 我知道有時老人起床時會腿疼。我懂一些咒語，或許能幫上忙。

original: I'm fine, Madena.
string: 我很好，邁德那。

original: I've seen you walking with a bit of pain sometimes, Horik.
string: 我看你腿腳有些不方便，霍理克。

original: Well, at the first sign of battle I'll be comfortably sitting in my room, waiting for it to end, so don't you worry.
string: 只要戰爭一有爆發的跡象，我就會躲在舒適的房中，等待它結束，你不必擔心。

original: So you say. We'll see if that's true when the Stormcloaks make their move.
string: 隨你怎麼說。是真是假，風暴斗篷們行動時我們就知道了。

original: I'll tell you the same thing I told Skald. I'm here to help the people of Dawnstar, not play politics. Point your suspicions of treachery elsewhere.
string: 我跟斯卡德一樣這麼說。我是來幫助晨星城人民的，不是玩什麼政治把戲。不需疑心我是叛徒。

original: I want you to know I don't trust you, Madena. And I'll be watching you.
string: 聽好了，我不相信你，邁德那。我會時刻盯著你。

original: Yes, Legate.
string: 是，副官。

original: Oh, don't be such an old stick, Horik. I was joking. I can do that, you know. Redo the battle plans. I'll look over them later.
string: 哦，別那麼古板，霍理克。我開玩笑呢。我能做得到。重新制定作戰方針。我稍後來看。

original: I'm sorry, Legate. I didn't want to imply anything about your ability to lead. You're a hero to the Empire, and I....
string: 對不起，副官。我不是想質疑你的領導能力。你是帝國的英雄，而我……

original: Maybe you're right. I guess the battles I won yesterday won't win today's wars.
string: 你或許是對的。昨日的勝利並不意味著我今天也能打贏。

original: Considering how the Great War ended, I think we need to be cautious about what we rely on.
string: 考慮到浩大戰爭的結果，我想我們還是該小心行事。

original: I don't think that's needed, Horik. It's the same strategy we used for every major defense during the Great War. It'll serve just as well now.
string: 我看沒有必要，霍理克。我們浩大戰爭期間的每場主要防禦戰用的都是這套戰略。如今也會管用。

original: We should go over our strategy again in case the Stormcloaks attack.
string: 我們應該再仔細檢查一遍我們的戰略，以防風暴斗篷發動進攻。

original: Shor's bones, I hope you're right.
string: 以朔爾之骨的名義啊，我希望你是對的。

original: Yes, Legate. No one is getting through us.
string: 是，副官。沒人能突破我們。

original: Keep the guard alert. I want to make sure no townspeople get hurt if there's trouble.
string: 加強警戒。如果出了事我要確保城鎮居民沒人受傷。

original: Brings back memories. Do you have any orders for me, Legate?
string: 讓我想起了過去。您有什麼命令嗎，副官？

original: Just like old times, huh Horik? You and me fighting in a war over some forsaken scrap of land.
string: 一如往昔，對嗎霍理克？我們在荒蕪的土地上並肩作戰。

original: I don't think so, Madena. There will be no deserters in this hold, and that's final.
string: 我不這麼想，邁德那。領地裡不該有逃兵，就這麼定了。

original: Yes, that's exactly what I'm asking. I'm not a Nord, I'm a Breton, and I have no wish to fight this war.
string: 對，這正是我的請求。我不是諾德人，而是布萊頓人，我也無意參戰。

original: You wish to leave now? In Skyrim's moment of triumph, just before we cast off the yoke of Imperial rule?
string: 你現在想離開？在天際省勝利在望之際，在我們就要擺脫帝國統治之際？

original: Skald, I've been meaning to ask you for a leave of absence. I wish to return to High Rock until this war is over.
string: 斯卡德，我想向你請假。我想回高岩生活，直到戰爭結束。

original: Fine, but this isn't over Madena. We'll talk again.
string: 好吧，但這事還沒完，邁德那。我們到時再談。

original: When I came here, my only duties were to cure crop diseases and occasionally light a bonfire on holidays. I didn't sign up to kill.
string: 我剛來這時，我的職責只是給莊稼治病，在節日時生生火。我不是受雇來殺人的。

original: What good is a court mage if she refuses to fight? Where's your sense of duty?
string: 如果一名宮廷法師拒絕參戰那她還有什麼用呢？你的責任感在哪？

original: I told you before, Skald, I have no interest in taking sides in this war. I've no desire to be killed.
string: 我說過了，斯卡德，我無意捲入戰爭。我不願殺戮。

original: Madena, can we count on your spells to assist us in this war? The Empire is bound to bring their battlemages against us.
string: 邁德那，你能不能用咒語協助我們作戰？帝國一定會派戰鬥法師來對付我們。

original: Uh, yes sir. That's me. The oafish servant.
string: 呃…是的閣下。我就是這樣。一個愚蠢的僕人。

original: A servant? Enlisting in the Stormcloaks? Ah, Bulfrek, that's why I like having you about. You're always good for a laugh.
string: 一個僕人？還想加入風暴斗篷？啊，布林弗雷克，這就是我為什麼愛讓你伴隨左右的原因了。你真是太好笑了。

original: Well, I was thinking sir, with the war going on and all. Maybe, I could enlist? Fight the Imperials?
string: 嗯，我在想閣下，既然戰事不斷。也許，我能從軍？對抗帝國？

original: You, have a request of me, Bulfrek? This should be interesting.
string: 你，對我有一個請求，布林弗雷克？這還真有趣。

original: Skald, if you don't mind sir, I have a request.
string: 斯卡德，如果你不介意，閣下，我有一個請求。

original: Exactly, Bulfrek. You always know your place.
string: 沒錯，布林弗雷克。你總是很有自知之明。

original: Yes, my Jarl. We could hardly waste anyone else's precious time on such a tedious task.
string: 是，我的領主。我們不能把其他人的寶貴時間浪費在這個單調的任務上。

original: Bulfrek, I have an order of swords and armor from the local blacksmith coming here. I need every piece polished to a fine shine.
string: 布林弗雷克，我從本地的鐵匠那裡訂了幾把劍和一套盔甲，正在送來。替我把它們都擦亮。

original: I won't have you rob our soldiers of their chance to drive out the Empire. I'm done discussing this, Jod.
string: 我是不會讓你剝奪我們士兵可以趕走帝國的機會。我們沒什麼好談的了，喬德。

original: Glory is meaningless if they have no home to return to. I urge you to lower our commitments to the front until I'm sure we're safe.
string: 如果他們無家可歸那榮譽又有何用？請你在我們安全得到保障前撤回前線的士兵。

original: Nonsense. The best place for our men is driving the Imperials back. I will ensure that men from Dawnstar get every opportunity for glory.
string: 胡說。衛兵們最好的崗位就是去驅趕帝國。我會確保晨星城的每個人都有爭取榮譽的機會。

original: You keep pledging more and more of our guard to the frontlines. The way this is going, we won't be able to defend our own borders.
string: 你答應一直增派我們的衛兵去前線。再這樣下去，我們就無法保衛我們的邊境了。

original: Safety? Don't I have you to handle the town's safety? What is this about, Jod?
string: 安全？我不是讓你去負責城中的安全嗎？怎麼了，喬德？

original: My Jarl, I have concerns about the safety of Dawnstar.
string: 領主，我擔心晨星城的安全。

original: Please, you can't leave me in here! If you let me out I can show you where they hide their best treasure.
string: 求求你，別把我留在那裡面！如果你讓我出來，我就告訴你他們最大寶藏的存放地。

original: One of those things has the key to this cage. If you get me out of here I'll help you slaughter the rest of those crows.
string: 其中一個傢伙身上有這個籠子的鑰匙。如果你放我出來我就幫你殺掉剩下的烏鴉。

original: Please! Help me get out of this cage. I don't know why those things locked me up and I don't want to wait around to find out.
string: 求求你！把我從籠子裡放出來。我不知道為何那些傢伙把我關起來，我也不想待在這裡找答案。

original: Hey! Over here! Get me out of here!
string: 嘿！來這裡！放我出來！

original: Hey you! Let me out! I can help!
string: 嘿，你！放我出來！我能幫上忙！

original: The bastards... somehow they managed to kill Skjor.
string: 那幫雜種……他們竟然殺了斯科約爾。

original: Yours was not an easy transformation. But you're still alive, so congratulations.
string: 你的轉化過程並不輕鬆。但你活了下來，恭喜了。

original: We even have a celebration planned for you.
string: 我們還替你準備了一個慶祝儀式。

original: Actually... on second thought, I'll just kill you!
string: 事實上……考慮再三，我還是決定殺了你！

original: Now that we've got that out of the way, I'll take everything you have... or your life.
string: 既然前方已暢通無阻，我不妨奪走你的財物……取你的性命。

original: I'm glad they didn't find my lucky dagger. It's time to gut these rotten birds. Lead the way!
string: 幸好它們沒找到我的幸運匕首。是時候去除掉那些嘔心的鳥了。帶路！

original: Do you need help?
string: 你需要幫助嗎？

original: Not now! It's time to get back at these crows.
string: 等會再說吧！現在該去找那些烏鴉算帳。

original: (Sharedinfo)
string: (Sharedinfo)

original: No! Don't leave me here! I beg you to let me out!
string: 不！別把我留在這！求求你放我出來！

original: Please! I'll pay you. I'll give you whatever you want. Just don't leave me here!
string: 求你了！我會報答你的。你要什麼我都答應。只要別把我丟在這！

original: Hurry! Get me out of here!
string: 快！放我出去！

original: Use the key to open the door! We have to be quick!
string: 快用鑰匙開門！我們時間不多了！

original: If I wanted to hear a tall tale, I'll read a children's storybook. Get some better stories, Vipir.
string: 想聽童話的話我不如找本故事書來看！你能說些像樣的故事嗎，維皮爾。

original: Well, if you don't want to hear it, that's your loss.
string: 如果你不想聽，那是你的損失。

original: Is this your tale of single-handedly fighting off a pack of trolls or my favorite... where you bedded four women on the same night?
string: 你要講獨自擊退一群巨魔的故事？不如講講我的最愛……與四個女人共度春宵的故事？

original: So, the ending of my tale I began earlier...
string: 我上次講的故事的結局是……

original: You just better hope this one isn't another waste of my coin.
string: 你這次最好別再浪費我的錢。

original: I don't understand it either. They were a sure thing, I swear.
string: 我也不太明白。那些都是已經確定的事，我發誓。

original: I hope this deal goes through. I'm putting quite a bit of coin on the line... and the last two you set up fell through.
string: 我希望這些交易能成功。我已經投了不少錢進去……而你上次弄好的那兩個又泡湯了。

original: All right. I have everything you asked for all ready to go.
string: 好了。你要的我都準備好了。

original: No, and I'm not about to either. I value my life you know... you may want to remember that for yourself.
string: 不，我也不去。要知道我也懂得珍惜自己的性命啊……而且你最好也記住這一點。

original: What about Mercer? Have you asked him?
string: 墨瑟怎樣？你問過他了嗎？

original: If he does, he isn't telling me a thing. I've asked, but all I get from him are more questions.
string: 就算他知道他也什麼都沒透露給我。我問過他，但他的回答讓我更摸不著頭腦。

original: You seem to be a bit closer to Brynjolf than the rest of us. Is he giving you any idea why this place seems to be falling apart?
string: 比起我們你好像跟布林喬夫更親近。他有沒有告訴你為何這裡有些反常？

original: No, but I know that you're going to turn up missing if you keep up this kind of talk.
string: 不知道，但你再敢這樣講話，沒多久你就會消失。

original: You stupid cow. You don't know what you're missing.
string: 你這頭蠢驢。知不知道你錯過了什麼？

original: Vipir "the Fleet." The only man who's foolish enough to name himself after his bedroom prowess.
string: 「快腿」維皮爾。只有他才會蠢到用自己的床技給自己起名。

original: So, Sapphire. Can I do anything for you, or more to the point... to you?
string: 那麼，藍寶石。我有什麼能幫你的，或許我該……更直接點？

original: This place is getting worse and worse.
string: 這地方越來越糟糕了。

original: She said that she barely had enough coin to cover it and I should come back later. Can you imagine that?
string: 她說她沒錢付，我該晚點再來。她居然說得出口？

original: I think I know, but go ahead.
string: 我想我知道，但你繼續。

original: I tried to fence some goods to Tonilia, and you know what she told me?
string: 我本想賣點貨物給托尼利亞，但你知道她對我怎麼說嗎？

original: I'll keep that in mind.
string: 我會記在心上的。

original: Hey, I still have a contact in Valenwood that may have some work for us. You're welcome to join me.
string: 嘿，我跟威木省那邊有接觸，他們好像有活給我們做。你不妨一起來。

original: Yeah, I know what you mean. If things don't start getting better soon, I may look for work elsewhere.
string: 嗯，我知道你的意思。如果事情還沒有好轉，我可能會去別處找事做。

original: What in the name of Oblivion is going on in this place?
string: 這裡究竟發生什麼事了？

original: I think if Brynjolf catches wind of it, he'll boot you right out of here... so drop it already!
string: 我在想如果布林喬夫得知這事，他就會把你從這裡一腳踢出去……所以你最好別再想了！

original: Well, yes! Please!
string: 嗯，好啊！說吧！

original: Your idea to start a brothel, right? Do you want me to tell you exactly what I think?
string: 你想要開一間妓院，對不對？你想不想知道我的看法？

original: Hold a moment, Rune. What did you think about my idea?
string: 等一下，盧恩。你覺得我的主意怎麼樣？

original: Brynjolf, something stinks around here and it's more than just the Ratway. We all know it. The question is, what's Mercer going to do about it?
string: 布林喬夫，你知道這裡惹人生厭的東西不僅僅是鼠道而已。這我們都清楚。問題是，墨瑟對此打算怎麼辦？

original: Well, I see your wounds have healed but your pride still needs some time.
string: 我看你身上的傷口雖已癒合，但重拾自信仍須時日。

original: Pretty angry actually. I can't believe I botched the Goldenglow job. That should have been like stealing a sweetroll from a baby.
string: 實際上我很生氣。真不敢相信我搞砸了金色光輝的任務。這本該是小菜一碟。

original: How are you feeling, Vex?
string: 你感覺如何，「小煩」？

original: Mercer is being Mercer. If he has a plan to get us out of this rut, then he isn't sharing it with me.
string: 墨瑟還是老脾氣。就算他想出解決辦法，那他也沒跟我說過。

original: Well, what the hell is Mercer going to do about this mess? Have you even talked to him?
string: 墨瑟打算怎樣收拾這攤爛攤子？你跟他談過了嗎？

original: Thank you, Vex. You've always been the most reliable one in the Guild.
string: 謝謝你，「小煩」。公會裡就數你最可靠了。

original: I've picked up some new clients and did a few jobs on my own, but I'm not sure if that will cover our expenses.
string: 我結識了幾個新客戶，自己也接了幾個工作，但我不知道這能否負擔我們的開銷。

original: Oh my... umm, you won't let Mercer hear about this will you? Ahem.
string: 哦，我……呃…你不會告訴墨瑟吧？呃哼。

original: You idiot. He said "firs" not "furs." It was a damn logging caravan!
string: 你個白癡。他是說「杉木」，不是「紗布」。那是一支木材運輸隊！

original: That's impossible. I distinctly heard that lout in the tavern say it was a full shipment of furs. They should be worth a fortune.
string: 這不可能。我明明聽到酒館裡的那個笨蛋說那批貨都是紗布。肯定值不少。

original: Delvin, that last shipment we heisted on the Cyrodiil frontier was worthless!
string: 戴爾文，我們在賽瑞迪爾邊境最後劫的一批貨半毛錢不值！

original: When you're in your grave and I'm standing over it. Now get out of my way!
string: 當我站在你的墳墓上時。現在快給我滾！

original: Oh, really? Well then... how can I make that happen?
string: 哦，真的嗎？那麼……我怎樣才能辦到呢？

original: Absolutely.
string: 當然。

original: So, what do you think, my dear? Could a beautiful woman like you ever see yourself with an old codger like me?
string: 那麼，你怎麼看，親愛的？像你這樣美麗的女人有沒有可能看上我這樣的怪老頭？

original: You're an idiot.
string: 你是個白癡。

original: So is it true, bandits get... you know, real friendly with the wildlife?
string: 這麼說是真的，盜賊能與……我是說，能與野獸做朋友？

original: Yeah, what of it?
string: 沒錯，怎麼？

original: So, Thrynn, you were a bandit, huh?
string: 如此說來，希爾英，你曾是個盜賊，對吧？

original: I will, I will...
string: 我會的……我會的……

original: You tell this sorry bunch of thieves that they need to put down their flagons and get to work if they want to keep their status!
string: 你告訴那幫該死的盜賊，如果想保住地位的話，那就別再喝酒快去工作！

original: If I told you that, I'd be lying. We haven't had a bite in weeks. Our clients are starting to get angry.
string: 如果我跟你這麼說，那根本就是在撒謊。我們本週什麼也沒撈到。客戶們都要生氣了。

original: Delvin, please tell me you have good news.
string: 戴爾文，千萬要跟我說有好消息。

original: I'll speak to the Jarl and see what I can do. Just keep them at bay a little longer.
string: 我會跟領主談的，想想辦法。先把他們拖住。

original: Normally I'd agree, but we've already lost so many contacts across Skyrim. If we lose the ones in Riften, we may as well close up shop.
string: 我通常也會這麼想，但我們在天際省已經失去這麼多連絡人。如果我們再失去裂谷城的，可能也就要歇業了。

original: There's no need to be concerned. We've been through more difficult times than this.
string: 不必擔心。大風大浪我們經歷的多了。

original: I think we need to prepare for the worst. The coffers are dwindling and I can barely keep our contacts happy.
string: 我認為該做好最壞的打算。預算在縮減，我很難讓連絡人滿意。

original: Two reasons. He's rich and because we need every sword we can get right now.
string: 兩個原因。他很有錢，而且我們現在急需人手。

original: Remind me why we even bother to allow him to be a part of the Guild.
string: 告訴我，我們為何要考慮讓他入會？

original: Yes, I know. That last job was my fault. I obviously thought Niruin was ready, but I was wrong.
string: 是，我明白。上一次是我的失誤。我原以為尼如因準備好了，但我想錯了。

original: Do we have anyone reliable to send out there? I don't want to look the fool again in front of her, Brynjolf.
string: 我們還有沒有比較靠得住的人啊？我不想要在她面前再看到這個白癡了，布林喬夫。

original: Maven has been nagging us about her request. Any thoughts?
string: 瑪雯一直在跟我們嘮叨她的要求。有辦法嗎？

original: Yes, I'm afraid you're right. Such a shame...
string: 是的，恐怕你說得對。真慚愧……

original: I have. I think we may have to turn this one over to the Dark Brotherhood.
string: 不錯。我想我們可能得把這個移交給黑暗兄弟會。

original: I trust you've applied the appropriate pressure in order to change their mind?
string: 我想你已經給他們施加了適當的壓力，好讓他們回心轉意？

original: Sorry Mercer, they no longer wish to be involved in our operation.
string: 抱歉墨瑟，他們不想再參與我們的事務了。

original: Brynjolf, have you had a chance to speak to our contact in Whiterun?
string: 布林喬夫，你能不能聯繫上我們在白漫的連絡人？

original: Thank you so much for taking care of those thieves. The Riverwood Trader is back to the way it used to be!
string: 多謝你解決了那幫盜賊。河木鎮貿易商行終於可以繼續正常營運了！

original: Thanks for bringing the claw back.
string: 多謝你把龍爪帶回來。

original: It means so much to us to have the claw back where it belongs. Thank you!
string: 龍爪得以回歸對我們意義重大。謝謝你！

original: Thanks for bringing the claw back.
string: 多謝你把龍爪帶回來。

original: Let me guess - you have some "business" to discuss...
string: 讓我猜猜——你有「生意」要談嗎……

original: You do realize there's only one way this can end.
string: 你很清楚要結束這一切只有一個辦法。

original: And how may Ma'randru-jo assist you, hmm?
string: 瑪'蘭德魯-約可以為您服務嗎？

original: Purchase something or leave. Those are your options.
string: 不買東西就走人。你只有這兩個選擇。

original: By the gods! What are you doing here?
string: 以諸神的名義！你在這裡做什麼？

original: The power of Mzinchaleft is mine! Begone from here!
string: 津查遺址的力量屬於我！快滾出去！

original: Gah!
string: 嘎！

original: Nargh!
string: 呃！

original: Unf!
string: 唔嗯！

original: Grrh!
string: 呃！

original: Nnh!
string: 哪！

original: Not quite good enough, are you?
string: 馬馬虎虎吧，你呢？

original: Close...
string: 差不多……

original: You'll need to do better than that.
string: 想打倒我你得再努力！

original: Easily blocked!
string: 很容易堵住！

original: Oho! Not so fast!
string: 啊！慢點！

original: Keep digging! Ugh... If Lu'ah Al-Skaven can raise an army of Draugr, then why do I have to babysit them?
string: 快挖啊！啊……如果盧阿．艾爾-斯卡文能召喚一支諾德亡靈大軍，我還需要這些蠢貨做什麼呢？

original: They burned his body before I could raise him... it should have been returned to me...
string: 他們在我令他復活之前，把他的屍體火化了……那本該屬於我的……

original: Is the line for my next performance starting already? Come on, don't be shy. Plenty of room for everyone.
string: 想看我下一場演出的觀眾已經開始排隊了嗎？來，別害羞。每個人都有位子的。

original: I'm in the mood to ssssiiiiinnnggg! What about you, friend? Care to join me?
string: 我很有高歌一曲的欲望！你呢，朋友？一起來嗎？

original: Well now. What have we here? A lost little lamb?
string: 看看是誰來了？一隻迷途的小羔羊？

original: You really don't want to be loitering here, stranger.
string: 你不該在這閒逛，陌生人。

original: No, I haven't seen him since the dragon showed up.
string: 不，自從龍現身後我就沒見過他了。

original: No, I haven't seen him since the dragon showed up.
string: 不，自從龍現身後我就沒見過他了。

original: I hate those damn things. Too many eyes, you know?
string: 我真討厭那些該死的東西。牠們的眼睛真他媽多，你知道嗎？

original: What next, giant snakes?
string: 接下來是什麼，巨蛇嗎？

original: Yes, yes. What is it? We're all very busy here...
string: 是，是。什麼事？我們現在都很忙……

original: By the love of the Nine, what is it with you sycophants and hangers on? The jarl is busy! And so am I, for that matter.
string: 聖靈保佑，你們這些馬屁精和懶鬼有什麼問題？領主很忙！我也是，真是的。

original: Hrm. You go find your own wreck. This one's mine.
string: 哼。想撿垃圾的話你去找你自己的地盤。這裡是我的。

original: Go away! This is my wreck! Mine!
string: 走開！這裡是我的地盤！我的！

original: You're making me... nervous. Is there something you need?
string: 你讓我感覺很……緊張。你有什麼需要嗎？

original: I find your presence... unnerving. Please depart.
string: 我發現你的出現令人……緊張不安。請你離開。

original: You fighter types are always underfoot. You want me to clean? Then scat!
string: 你們這群戰士還真是礙手礙腳。還叫我怎麼打掃啊，趕緊走開！

original: I really must get back to my duties. This fort isn't going to clean itself.
string: 我得回去工作了。我還要清理整座要塞呢。

original: I'm really not in the mood. State your business, or take your leave.
string: 我現在心情不好。有事就說，沒事就走開。

original: I'm busy, and you're bothering me. So go away.
string: 我很忙，而你打擾到我了。快走開。

original: Who are you? What do you want?
string: 你是誰？你想做什麼？

original: Please, just... just leave me be!
string: 求求你，別……別來煩我！

original: Why are you here? Get away from me!
string: 你來做什麼？別過來！

original: By the gods! Somebody help me!
string: 以神的名義！誰來救救我啊！

original: Oh, I see. Well, I'm sorry to have troubled you about it.
string: 哦，我明白了。好吧，很抱歉帶給你困擾。

original: Just... know that your efforts are appreciated.
string: 只是……多謝你費心。

original: I'm not looking for special treatment, Aval. All I did was talk to Ulfric.
string: 我不是想要特殊待遇，亞沃。我只是去和烏弗瑞克談了談。

original: For all I know, he's already forgotten the conversation. I wouldn't get your hopes up.
string: 據我所知，他已經忘了那次談話。我不想讓你抱太大希望。

original: But I insist. and with good reason.
string: 但我堅持。而且有很好的理由。

original: Malthyr told me that you've been speaking to Ulfric about our situation. He said you're going to help us.
string: 馬提爾告訴我你把我們的處境跟烏弗瑞克說了。他說你會來幫我們的。

original: So few Nords have ever offered to help us, a discount is the least I can do.
string: 諾德人很少會主動幫助我們，我沒什麼能報答你，只能給你打個折了。

original: That's not necessary. I'll pay the same price as anyone else.
string: 不必如此。我會按原價付的。

original: Friend Brunwulf, how good to see you!
string: 布倫武夫，見到你真好！

original: If you see anything you like, just let me know and I'll glad offer you a discount.
string: 如果你有喜歡的，就跟我說，我很樂意給你打折。

original: So serious! (Laughter)
string: 你看那一本正經樣！（大笑）
