original: What is it Ulfric's always saying... "On my honor as a Nord, I swear it." (Laughter).
string: 烏弗瑞克老愛怎麼說來著……「我以諾德人的名譽擔保，我發誓」（大笑）。

original: Just promise me when you get some more in, I'll have the first crack at them.
string: 只要答應我你下次進貨時，能讓我第一個嘗嘗鮮。

original: You know, I'm not sure. My husband's been tending to the vines, so I'll have to ask him.
string: 你要知道，我不敢肯定。我的丈夫可能想先採收葡萄，我得問問他。

original: Is that new batch of tomatoes ready for sale yet, Hillevi?
string: 下一季的番茄要上市了嗎，希勒維？

original: You're such a wet blanket, captain. Can't a girl have a little fun from time to time?
string: 你真掃興，船長。一個女孩就不能偶爾找點樂子嗎？

original: If that business proposition includes smuggling, forget it.
string: 如果那樁生意涉及走私，那就免談。

original: The sailors I know are plenty good at finding trouble without any help from you.
string: 我認識的水手都很能惹麻煩。

original: I was wondering if you still had many associates in the shipping profession.
string: 我想問問你在航運業裡的人脈還在嗎？

original: I have a business proposition for any sailors who might be looking to make a few extra septims.
string: 我有一樁生意，不知有沒有水手願意賺些外快。

original: A pleasure to see you as well, Niranye. What can I do for you?
string: 見到你我也很高興，妮蘭雅。有什麼能幫你的？

original: Captain Lonely-Gale, it's always a pleasure to see you.
string: 孤風船長，很高興見到你。

original: In fact, I'm glad you're here. There's something I'd like to ask you.
string: 事實上，很高興能見到你。我有事要問你。

original: Oh, I see. Yes, yes of course I'll take a look. Just bring them by whenever it's convenient for you.
string: 哦，我明白了。當然，我會考慮看看的。你有空時帶來就好了。

original: I have some things that belonged to my daughter, Friga. She... she won't be needing them any more.
string: 我這裡有一些東西，它們曾經屬於我的女兒弗利嘉。她……不再需要了。

original: Yes, that's right. Whether or not I'm interested depends on what you've got, of course.
string: 沒錯。不過當然要看我對妳帶來的東西有沒有興趣。

original: I understand you purchase used goods, as well as sell them?
string: 我知道你賣二手貨，不知道你買這類東西嗎？

original: The eyes of the law are everywhere these days.
string: 這年頭風聲真的很緊啊。

original: The guards are looking for a killer, but who knows what else they might turn up? Good day.
string: 那些衛兵在找一名殺手，可誰知道他們找到他以後會做些什麼？祝你一日順心啊。

original: Not that I'd know anything about it, of course, but it seems to me that the last thing a thieves' guild would want is to draw attention to itself.
string: 當然，不是說我知道些什麼，但是在我看來盜賊公會最不希望的就是惹禍上身了。

original: It's a bad time to be a criminal, what with these murders going on.
string: 這段時間最好別犯事，因為發生了幾起謀殺案。

original: In fact, thieves have been known to kill, if there's a profit in it. This war's been hard on all of us.
string: 事實上，人們也聽說過盜賊為了利益殺人的事。所以說這場仗對我們來說會很艱難啊。

original: One should never pay too much attention to rumors, Torbjorn.
string: 一個人不該太把謠言當回事，托布喬恩。

original: You have piqued my curiosity, however. Please, do continue.
string: 不過，你激起了我的好奇心。請快繼續。

original: I've been meaning to speak to you, Niranye. Rumor is, you've got ties to the Thieves' Guild.
string: 我本打算跟你說的，妮蘭雅。傳聞說你跟盜賊公會有聯繫。

original: You've done more than enough already. You've been a good friend in a time of need, and we won't forget that.
string: 你做的已經夠多了。你是一名患難之交，我們不會忘記的。

original: I'm sorry I lost myself for a moment there. I just need some time to get over the loss.
string: 抱歉我剛才沒回過神來。我可能是暫時無法抑制自己的悲痛而已。

original: I... I'm so sorry, Torbjorn. You must be suffering terribly. I wish there was some way I could help.
string: 我，我很抱歉，托布喬恩。你一定很難受。我真希望能幫上忙。

original: My little Friga loved to cook, but she was terrible at it. Then one day, out of nowhere, she made the most amazing leek soup.
string: 我的小弗利嘉熱愛烹飪，但技術不好。有一天，不知怎地，她做出了最美味的韭菜湯。

original: She watched while we ate it, and when she saw how much we loved it, she was... so proud...
string: 我們吃時她在一旁看著，看到我們滿意的神情時，她……非常自豪……

original: It was my pleasure, Torbjorn. I enjoy cooking, and after what you and Tova have been through, it was the least I could do.
string: 那是我的榮幸，托布喬恩。我熱愛烹飪，你和托娃蒙受了這些遭遇，這是我能為你們做的最起碼的事情了。

original: I wanted to thank you again for the mince pie you sent over. It was delicious.
string: 再次感謝你送我的肉餡餅。很好吃。

original: We accept the risks that come with our faith, but I'll keep your offer in mind. Thank you, Niranye.
string: 我們願為自己的信仰承擔風險，但我會記著你的建議。謝謝，妮蘭雅。

original: Well, let's just say that I know some people who are experts at helping others disappear when they need to.
string: 這麼說吧，我認識一些人，專門幫有需要的人銷聲匿跡。

original: They are discreet and thorough, though not inexpensive. I hope you'll keep that in mind, should the worst come to pass.
string: 他們行事小心周密，雖然價格不菲。我希望你能記住我的話，最糟糕的日子即將來臨。

original: I doubt Ulfric would let Thalmor into Windhelm without a fight. But please, do continue. How would you help us?
string: 我想烏弗瑞克是不會放任梭默大搖大擺走進風舵城的。但請你繼續說。你能怎樣幫我們？

original: Well, I've heard awful stories about these Thalmor, and how they're rounding up everyone who still worships Talos.
string: 嗯，我聽說過一些關於梭默的可怕故事，講他們如何圍捕仍然崇拜塔洛斯的人。

original: The interrogations are quite merciless, from what I've heard.
string: 就單論我的聽聞，那些刑訊逼供的手段真是慘無人道。

original: I fear for you and your husband, should the Thamlor come here. But perhaps there's a way I can help.
string: 我替你和你的丈夫擔心，梭默很有可能會來。但或許我有辦法幫忙。

original: Is that so? And what were you thinking, exactly?
string: 真的？你具體的意思呢？

original: Hello, Jora. I'm glad to see you. In fact, I was just thinking about you and your husband.
string: 你好，喬拉。很高興見到你。實際上，我剛剛還在想你和你丈夫的事情。

original: I'll be sure to stress your urgency. It seems like every farmer in Skyrim is short on supplies these days.
string: 我一定會強調你的緊急情況。這段日子似乎天際的每個農民都缺乏供給了。

original: Tell him I'll pay double the normal price. We've been getting by with one broken pitchfork, but it's falling apart.
string: 告訴他我會付雙倍價錢。我們只能暫時用把手壞掉的乾草叉應付一下，但它就快斷成兩半了。

original: Revyn put the word out to his suppliers but with the war on, tools are scarce. Both sides have been snapping them up.
string: 瑞溫已經跟供應商提過了，但因為戰爭的關係，工具缺貨。兩邊都開始搶購。

original: Did you have any luck tracking own some more pitchforks?
string: 你有找到任何乾草叉嗎？

original: I'll be sure to tell her.
string: 我一定告訴她。

original: We've got another dozen ripening on the vine. They should be ready in a few days.
string: 我們還有一些葡萄就要熟了。過些天就能上架了。

original: Well enough, I suppose. Nilsine bought up most of the tomatoes, and was asking if we could get more.
string: 我認為很好。尼爾欣買了很多番茄，還問我們能拿到更多貨嗎？

original: How's business today?
string: 今天的生意好嗎？

original: Here's your <Alias=QuestItem>.
string: 這是你的<Alias=QuestItem>。

original: Thank you so much. Here. Let me show you a thing or two about not attracting attention to yourself.
string: 非常感謝。來這裡。我給你看看你自己都沒有注意到的不少東西。

original: This should come in handy. Here. Let me show you a few tricks I've learned about buttering up royalty.
string: 這東西遲早有用。來這裡。我給你展示一下我取悅皇族的新玩意兒。

original: Here's Nelacar's staff.
string: 這是內拉卡的法杖。

original: What's this? Some kind of code? "Need as much iron ore as you can dig up...."
string: 這是什麼？是密碼嗎？「你需要盡可能地多採掘鐵礦石……」

original: He's not spying, but it's clear the Empire is making Lod smith up more swords and armor for them.
string: 他不是間諜，但是很明顯帝國要羅德為他們鍛造更多刀劍護具。

original: Good work. Take this.
string: 做得好。收下吧。

original: Here's Lod's letter.
string: 這是羅德的信。

original: Forget it.
string: 算了吧。

original: Hist spit on you.
string: 希思特神樹唾棄你。

original: Daedra take you, then.
string: 你將成為魔族的俘虜。

original: Milk drinker.
string: 乳臭未乾的小子。

original: I'll get it for you.
string: 我會替你弄到的。

original: Thank you. I'll be waiting for that bottle.
string: 謝謝。我等著。

original: Thanks. I'll be waiting for it.
string: 謝謝。我等著。

original: Good.
string: 很好。

original: It will be done.
string: 包在我身上。

original: Are you all right?
string: 你還好嗎？

original: No. I'm not. I feel like my scales are clawing into me. Maybe you could help an old Argonian out?
string: 不。不好。我感覺我的鱗片都快要倒插進我身體了。你可以幫助一個老亞龍人嗎？

original: I heard some of the sailors talking about how they stashed a bottle of Double-Distilled Skooma in the Gnisis Cornerclub. I just need a taste.
string: 我聽到一些水手說他們怎麼把一瓶蒸餾過二次的斯庫瑪藏在格尼西斯街角吧。我正需要它。

original: Me? Nothing. And I hope to keep it that way. The Jarl is convinced I have some connection with the College, so he goes easy on me.
string: 我？沒什麼。我希望還是能維持現狀。領主認為我和學院有關聯，因此他待我很寬厚。

original: Maybe you'd like to help me keep up appearances? Old Nelacar has a mage's staff in his room in the Frozen Hearth.
string: 或許你得幫我裝個樣子？老內拉卡在凍爐客棧的房間裡有一根法杖。

original: It'd be good to have that staff in case the Jarl starts wondering if I actually have a real connection to the College.
string: 我最好能擁有那根法杖，以免領主會開始懷疑我和學院之間是不是真有關聯。

original: What do you do around here?
string: 你在這幹什麼呢？

original: Not against me. Against all of Falkreath. Those Imperial bastards are spying on every one of us.
string: 不止對我，對佛克瑞斯每個人都如此。這些帝國狗雜種監視我們每一個人。

original: Last night I saw Lod the blacksmith writing a letter. Probably sending word to Solitude and General Tullius.
string: 昨晚我看見鐵匠羅德寫信。可能是通知獨孤城和圖留斯將軍。

original: Are you loyal to Skyrim? Break into Lod's house and get that letter.
string: 你忠於天際省嗎？那就闖進羅德的家拿到那封信。

original: You say there's a plot against you?
string: 你是說有個針對你的陰謀？

original: By the Hist, if I don't get something soon, I don't know how I'll get through the week.
string: 以希思特神樹之名，如果我不能儘快拿到東西，我都不知道怎麼度過這周。

original: This is Markarth, traveler. Safest city in the Reach.
string: 這裡是馬卡斯城，旅人。邊塞最安全的城市。

original: You here to see the Jarl? No sudden moves, understand?
string: 你來這裡會見領主？你可不要亂來，明白嗎？

original: Whole dwarven city underneath the keep. Nchuand-Zel. Best steer clear if you don't want a Steam Centurion carving you up.
string: 整個矮人城市在堡壘的底下。楚安德-澤爾。如果你不想被蒸汽百夫長切成碎片的話最好躲開。

original: Listener. I am your only salvation. Come. Embrace me.
string: 聆聽者。我是你唯一的希望。來吧。皈依我。

original: You've got that right. Only a matter of time before we're roasted alive. Come on!
string: 你說得對。再待一會兒我們可就要被活烤了。來吧！

original: We need to get out of here!
string: 我們得出去！

original: Considering most of us are now dead, I assumed as much.
string: 我也這麼覺得，畢竟我們都已經損失這麼多人了。

original: And before you ask, no - I don't think it was you. Well, maybe I did, but you saving my sorry hide just now sort of erased any doubts.
string: 在你開口之前，不……我不認為這是你做的。好吧，也許我曾經這麼想過，但是你挽救了我的性命，這掃除了我所有的疑慮。

original: So thanks.
string: 非常感謝。

original: The Emperor... it was all a trap. Someone set us up.
string: 皇帝……這個針對我們的陷阱。

original: Watch out for pressure plates here.
string: 小心這裡的壓板。

original: The door up ahead will be locked. Klotha, one of the hagravens, will have the key on her.
string: 這條路前方的門是鎖著的。鑰匙在一名叫克羅莎的烏鴉鬼婆身上。

original: I'll let you live. This time.
string: 這次先放過你。

original: I'll spare you - for now.
string: 我會暫時饒恕你的。

original: All right, you've had enough.
string: 好吧，你也受夠了。

original: You're not worth it.
string: 你還不夠格讓我殺。

original: I didn't think you had the stomach for it.
string: 我不認為你能承擔這個後果。

original: Point that somewhere else!
string: 對著別的地方！

original: Don't do that, it's mean!
string: 別那樣，太無恥了！

original: You have a death wish?
string: 你有求死的欲望？

original: Careful there!
string: 小心那裡！

original: That's a dangerous game you're playing.
string: 你在玩危險遊戲哦。

original: Woah... watch it!
string: 喔……小心！

original: I suggest you aim elsewhere.
string: 我建議你把目標放到別處。

original: Please! Don't shoot!
string: 不要！不要射！

original: Hmm? What're you doing?
string: 嗯？你在做什麼？

original: Now that's just rude.
string: 真粗魯。

original: You're not going to shoot, right?
string: 你不打算射擊，對吧？

original: There's no need for that.
string: 沒必要這樣吧。

original: Don't be a fool.
string: 別傻了。

original: I need to learn the Dragonrend Shout. Can you teach me?
string: 我想學「龍魂撕裂」。你能教我嗎？

original: Drem. Patience. There are formalities which must be observed, at the first meeting of two of the dov.
string: 德萊姆。耐心點。在兩個都瓦第一次會面時，必須遵守禮儀。

original: I think you already know who I am.
string: 我想你早知道我是誰了。

original: Yes. Vahzah. You speak true, Dovahkiin. Forgive me.
string: 是的。瓦紮。你說得對，都瓦克因。原諒我。

original: It has been long since I held tinvaak with a stranger. I gave in to the temptation to prolong our speech.
string: 我上次和陌生人進行汀瓦是很久之前的事情了。我屈從於誘惑延長我們這次談話。

original: You're the master of the Greybeards?
string: 你是灰鬍子的老師？

original: They see me as master. Wuth. Onik. Old and wise. It is true I am old...
string: 他們把我看作大師。烏絲。歐尼。年老而睿智。真的，我老了……

original: I wasn't expecting you to be a dragon.
string: 我沒想到你是龍。

original: I am as my father Akatosh made me. As are you... Dovahkiin.
string: 我父親阿卡托什造就了我。正如你……都瓦克因。

original: So. You have made your way here, to me. No easy task for a joor... mortal. Even for one of Dovah Sos. Dragonblood.
string: 那麼。你來到這裡，見我。對於約爾……凡人……來說不是件容易的事情。甚至對於一位都瓦 索斯……龍之血脈……來說也是如此。

original: What would you ask of me?
string: 你有什麼請求？

original: Not until introductions are complete. Zin. Heyv. Test your Thu'um against mine, Dovahkiin!
string: 除非介紹完。金。海夫。對著我測試你的吐姆，都瓦克因！

original: Drem Yol Lok. Greetings, wunduniik. I am Paarthurnax.
string: 德萊姆 約 洛。你好，翁都尼克。我是帕圖納克斯。

original: Who are you? What brings you to my strunmah... my mountain?
string: 你是誰？你為何來到我的斯特倫馬……我的山脈……？

original: You are bold, wunduniik. You dare enter a Dovah's home without permission.
string: 你很魯莽，翁都尼克。你膽敢未經允許進入都瓦的家。

original: Keep moving, stay focused on your goal, and you will reach the summit.
string: 快走，專注於你的目標，你會到達頂峰。

original: At least the Blades aren't keeping secrets from me.
string: 至少刀鋒衛士沒有隱瞞我什麼。

original: Do not be so sure about that. Beware - the Blades may claim to serve the Dragonborn, but they do not. They never have.
string: 可別太相信。要謹慎……刀鋒衛士或許聲稱自己為龍裔服務，但是他們也許並沒有 ，或者從來也沒有。

original: As for me, I kept from you only what you were not yet ready to know. Are still not ready to know, as your question reveals.
string: 至於我，我保守著你還不需要知道的秘密。你的問題，暫時還不需要讓你知道太多。

original: They have always sought to turn the Dragonborn from the path of wisdom.
string: 他們一直試圖著讓龍裔偏離智慧的道路。

original: Have you learned nothing from us? Would you simply be a tool in the hands of the Blades, to be used for their own purposes?
string: 你什麼都沒從我們身上學到嗎？你只不過是刀鋒衛士為了達到他們目的工具？

original: I have nothing to hide. The Blades helped me find out about it.
string: 我沒有隱藏什麼。刀鋒衛士幫我發現的。

original: Who I stand with is my business.
string: 我站在哪邊是我的事情。

original: If you wish to stand alone, so be it. If you wish for our help, you'll answer my question.
string: 如果你想要孤立無援，就這樣吧。如果你c想要我們的幫助，你得回答我們的問題。

original: The Dragonrend Shout is evil. Would you cure one evil with another?
string: 「龍魂撕裂」很邪惡。你是要以暴制暴嗎？

original: The Blades! Of course. They specialize in meddling in matters they barely understand. Their reckless arrogance knows no bounds.
string: 刀鋒衛士！當然。他們專門插手他們一竅不通的事情。他們蠻橫自大到無以復加的地步。

original: Tell me. Why do you come here, volaan? Why do you intrude on my meditation?
string: 告訴我。你為什麼來這裡，沃蘭。為什麼打擾我冥想。

original: The Blades were born of dragon-hating crusaders. They still carry that legacy although they may not remember from whence it came.
string: 刀鋒衛士源自於仇龍者十字軍。他們仍然保存著這份仇恨，儘管他們不記得來歷。

original: They carried out a genocide of dragons when they first came to Tamriel, and now they will do it again, with your help.
string: 他們第一次來到泰姆瑞爾就來了場龍族大屠殺，現在他們打算在你幫助下再來一次。

original: It was created by those who had lived under the unimaginable cruelty of Alduin's Dragon Cult.
string: 被奧杜因的龍族狂熱崇拜者所迫害的人們發明了龍魂撕裂。

original: Their whole lives were consumed with hatred for dragons, and they poured all their anger and hatred into this Shout.
string: 他們整個生命被對龍的仇恨所吞噬，他們把所有的仇恨和憤怒灌輸進這個龍吼。

original: When you learn a Shout, you take it into your very being. In a sense, you become the Shout.
string: 當你學會龍吼，把它貫穿你全身。從某種意義上，你就是龍吼。

original: In order to learn and use this Shout, you will be taking this evil into yourself.
string: 為了學習和使用龍吼，你要把這邪惡放進你身體。

original: Your kind - joorre - mortals - created it as a weapon against the dov... the dragons.
string: 你的族類……約爾……凡人……把它塑造成對抗都瓦……龍的武器。

original: Our hadrimme, our minds cannot even... comprehend its concepts.
string: 我們的哈德梅，我們的思維……完全無法領會它的原理。

original: Trust your instincts, Dovahkiin. Your blood will show you the way.
string: 相信你的直覺，都瓦克因。你的熱血會指引你的道路。

original: The dragons are terrorizing Skyrim. Don't you think they need to be stopped?
string: 龍族使整個天際省感到恐懼。你不認為得阻止牠們嗎？

original: That may be what you are here for, Dragonborn.
string: 這可能正是你來這裡的目的，龍裔。

original: But stopping Alduin is one thing. Helping you wipe out dragons again is quite another.
string: 但是阻止奧杜因是一回事。幫你再次消滅龍族又是另外一回事了。

original: Dragons are part of the natural order of the world. The Blades thought to change the order to suit themselves, by wiping out the dragons.
string: 龍是自然秩序的一部分。刀鋒衛士想透過消滅龍來改變秩序以達到自己的目的。

original: But again, we see that the natural order will be restored, one way or another.
string: 但是，無論如何，我們再次看到自然秩序恢復。

original: Perhaps we would have dragon allies against Alduin if the ancient Blades had not acted so arrogantly.
string: 或許我們需要龍族盟友來對抗奧杜因，如果刀鋒衛士不那麼自大的話。

original: Why do you hate the Blades?
string: 你為什麼憎恨刀鋒衛士？

original: What do you have against the Blades?
string: 你為什麼如此討厭刀鋒衛士？

original: Not hate. Distrust and fear. The Blades have always sought to turn the Dragonborn away from the path of wisdom.
string: 不是憎恨。是不信任和懼怕。刀鋒衛士一直試圖把龍裔逼到絕路。

original: Is there another way to defeat Alduin?
string: 還有其他方法擊敗奧杜因嗎？

original: Perhaps not. But this Shout was used once before, was it not? And here we are again.
string: 或許沒有。但是這個龍吼以前不是被用過一次嗎？而我們再用一次。

original: Have you considered that Alduin was not meant to be defeated?
string: 你有想過奧杜因不該被打敗的嗎？

original: Those who overthrew him in ancient times only postponed the day of reckoning, they did not stop it.
string: 先古時期推翻牠的人只是延後了清算的日子，並沒有結束它。

original: If the world is meant to end, so be it. Let it end and be reborn.
string: 如果世界注定要結束，就這樣吧。讓它涅磐吧。

original: What's so bad about the Dragonrend Shout?
string: 「龍魂撕裂」有什麼不好呢？

original: Watch it!
string: 小心！

original: Ouch! Hey!
string: 唉唷！嘿！

original: Hey!
string: 嘿！

original: Oh.
string: 噢。

original: What the?
string: 怎麼？

original: Whoops.
string: 呼。

original: Mind yourself.
string: 管好你自己吧。

original: What's the hurry?
string: 急什麼？

original: Oaf.
string: 白癡。

original: Woah!
string: 哇！

original: Excuse me.
string: 不好意思。

original: Uh, sorry.
string: 呃……對不起。

original: Mind the way.
string: 注意腳下。

original: Careful!
string: 小心！

original: Why live alone on a mountain if you love conversation?
string: 如果你喜歡交談的話，為什麼獨自生活在山裡。

original: Evenaar bahlok. There are many hungers it is better to deny than to feed.
string: 伊文那 巴羅。饑餓的人太多了，遺忘他們比餵養他們好。

original: Dreh ni nahkip. Discipline against the lesser aids in qahnaar... denial of the greater.
string: 德萊 尼 納吉。對弱者的處罰有助於……對強者的節制。

original: Hmm. Esbern or Arngeir might have some idea.
string: 嗯。伊思本或者艾恩蓋爾會有辦法的。

original: The Lorekeeper at the College of Winterhold might know.
string: 冬堡學院的知識守護者可能知道。

original: Do you know where I can find an Elder Scroll?
string: 你知道在哪可以找到一個上古卷軸嗎？

original: Krosis. No. I know little of what has passed below in the long years I have lived here.
string: 克洛斯。不。我對山下的事所知不多，我住在這裡已經很多年了。

original: You are likely better informed than I.
string: 似乎你知道的比我多。

original: You mean you were there?
string: 你的意思是你當時在場？

original: Yes. There were a few of us that rebelled against Alduin's thur... his tyranny. We aided the humans in his overthrow.
string: 是的。我們的一些同伴反抗奧杜因的瑟爾……反抗他的暴政。我們幫助人類推翻他。

original: But they did not trust us. Ni ov. Their inner councils were kept hidden from us.
string: 但是他們不相信我們。你 沃。他們的內部議會對我們完全隔離。

original: I was far from here on the day of Alduin's downfall. But all dov felt the... sundering of Time itself.
string: 奧杜因被擊敗的那天我離這裡很遠。但是所有的都瓦都能感到……時間的崩壞。

original: How could an Elder Scroll cast Alduin through time?
string: 上古卷軸怎麼能讓奧杜因穿越時空？

original: Vomindok. I do not know. Perhaps in the very doing they erased the knowing of it from Time itself.
string: 沃明多。我不知道。或許使用後它甚至刪除了時間本身對它的認知。

original: The dov are children of Akatosh. Thus we are specially... attuned to the flow of Time. Perhaps also uniquely vulnerable.
string: 都瓦是阿卡托什的孩子。因此我們對……時間的流動特別敏銳。你也可以說是對此特別敏感。

original: I warned them against such a rash action. Even I could not foresee its consequences. Nust ni hon. They would not listen.
string: 我警告他們不要進行這麼一個魯莽的行動。甚至我都無法預見後果。拉斯特 泥 轟。他們不聽。

original: How does any of this help me?
string: 這對我有什麼好處？

original: Tiid krent. Time was... shattered here because of what the ancient Nords did to Alduin.
string: 提得 克倫特。由於古代諾德人對奧杜因所做的事，在這裡時間是……破碎的。

original: If you brought that Kel, that Elder Scroll back here... to the Tiid-Ahraan, the Time-Wound...
string: 如果你帶那個科爾，上古卷軸回到這裡的話……帶到提得-阿倫，時間傷痕的話……

original: With the Elder Scroll that was used to break Time, you may be able to... cast yourself back. To the other end of the break.
string: 使用上古卷軸來破開時空，你可以……穿梭時空。到達缺口的另一邊。

original: You could learn Dragonrend from those who created it.
string: 你可以從創造「龍魂撕裂」的人們那裡學習「龍魂撕裂」。

original: Using the Dragonrend Shout, right?
string: 使用龍魂撕裂，對嗎？

original: Yes and no. Viik nuz ni kron. Alduin was not truly defeated, either. If he was, you would not be here today, seeking to... defeat him.
string: 是，卻也不儘然。維克 納茲 尼 科隆。奧杜因也沒有被真正擊敗。不然你今天也不會來這裡，找尋……擊敗牠的方法。

original: The Nords of those days used the Dragonrend Shout to cripple Alduin. But this was not enough. Ok mulaag unslaad.
string: 那個時代的諾德人使用「龍魂撕裂」來遏制奧杜因。但是這是不夠的。歐克 馬拉戈 昂斯拉得。

original: It was the Kel - the Elder Scroll. They used it to... cast him adrift on the currents of Time.
string: 是科爾——上古卷軸。他們用來……把牠放逐在時間的洪流之中。

original: You said you were going to answer my question.
string: 你說你會回答我的問題。

original: Drem. Patience. I am answering, in my way.
string: 德萊姆。耐心點。我正在以我的方式回答。

original: I never thought about it.
string: 我從來沒想過。

original: This is the most sacred mountain in Skyrim. Zok revak strunmah. The great mountain of the world.
string: 這是天際省最神聖的山。佐克 雷瓦克 斯狀馬克。世界上的偉大山脈之一。

original: Here the ancient Tongues, the first mortal masters of the Voice, brought Alduin to battle and defeated him.
string: 在這裡，先古的發聲者，第一代操縱龍吼的凡人，和奧杜因戰鬥並擊敗了他。

original: No. Dragons like mountains, right?
string: 不知道。因為龍族喜歡山脈？

original: True. But few now remember that this was the very spot where Alduin was defeated by the ancient Tongues.
string: 真的。但是很少有人記得這裡就是奧杜因被古代發聲者擊敗的地點。

original: Vahrukt unslaad... perhaps none but me now remember how he was defeated.
string: 瓦拉科特 昂斯拉得……或許現在只有我能想起他是怎麼被擊敗的了。

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

original: Ahh, going for the mysterious and brooding thing, hmm?
string: 啊，是為了那神秘而又沉悶的話題來的嗎，嗯？

original: That may work for your targets, but you'll find I'm not so easily impressed.
string: 這也許會對你的目標有效，但你會明白這對我可是一點用也沒有的。

original: You will hear even more, I assure you.
string: 你會聽到更多的，我保證。

original: Ooh, cocky.
string: 呵呵，狂妄自大。

original: I give you three days before you screw up and someone runs a knife across your throat.
string: 我給你三天時間，在你搞砸一切，脖子給別人架上刀子之前滾吧。

original: But who knows? I've been proven wrong before.
string: 但誰知道呢？之前我也被證明是錯的過。

original: It's a pleasure to meet you.
string: 很高興能認識你。

original: Save the niceties for now. I have no intention of getting invested in someone who may be dead tomorrow.
string: 廢話就不多說了。我沒有興趣投資一個可能都活不過明天的人。

original: If you're still breathing in a few weeks, I'm sure we'll be the best of friends.
string: 如果你幾週以後仍然在呼吸，我相信我們會成為最好的朋友。

original: Wind guide you.
string: 願風指引你。

original: Sky guard you.
string: 天空指引你。

original: Breath and focus.
string: 深呼吸集中精力。

original: Go away! Leave me alone!
string: 滾開！離我遠點！

original: Very good.
string: 非常好。

original: That's all, hmm?
string: 就這些，嗯？

original: Goodbye then.
string: 那麼再見了。

original: Su'um ahrk morah.
string: 蘇．烏姆 亞克 莫拉。

original: Lok, Thu'um.
string: 洛克， 蘇．烏姆。

original: You let your aunt go in there by herself?
string: 你讓你的阿姨一個人進去？

original: You let your aunt go in there by herself?
string: 你讓你的阿姨一個人進去？

original: You're tougher than you look. You got me, fair and square.
string: 你比看起來要強悍的多。坦白說，我服了你了。

original: I didn't mean nothing by it! Just... leave me alone! What do you want?
string: 我沒什麼意思！只是……讓我靜一靜！你要做什麼？

original: I need to learn the Shout used to defeat Alduin.
string: 我要學會曾經打敗奧杜因的龍吼。

original: Forgive me. I was... intemperate. I allowed my emotions to cloud my judgment. Master Einarth reminded me of my duty.
string: 原諒我。我反應……太過度了。我的情緒左右了我的判斷。好在愛納斯大師點出我的職責所在。

original: The decision whether or not to help you is not mine to make.
string: 我無權決定是否對你伸出援手。

original: I have given my answer. Go and reconsider your course.
string: 我已經給出我的回答了。現在去解決你自己的問題吧。

original: So the Blades have survived yet another disaster of their own making, and continue to meddle in things they do not understand.
string: 那麼刀鋒衛士又一次從他們自己製造的災難中倖存了下來，並繼續插手他們根本就不瞭解的事情。

original: Don't say that to loud, you don't want it getting back to him.
string: 別這麼大聲，你不想被他聽見吧。

original: Someone should let that cat lose.  That'd shut him up real quick.
string: 該找個人讓那隻大貓嘗到輸掉的滋味，他就能學會閉嘴了。

original: We've got him locked in there now, but he's still challenging anyone that looks crooked at him.
string: 現在我們把他鎖在那裡，但只要有人稍微對他瞥一眼，他仍然會去挑釁人家。

original: He's on one of his drunk rants again. Except this time he's challenging everyone to a duel over in the hole.
string: 他又發酒瘋了。只不過這次他還挑釁每一個人，要求跟他們決鬥。

original: Why? What's he doing now?
string: 為什麼？他在做什麼？

original: Looks like the boss is at it again.
string: 看來老大又來了。

original: What in the world was that racket? Is everything all right?
string: 怎麼這麼吵？一切都還好吧？

original: Try casting a spell at the wall. See what happens!
string: 試試對那堵牆念咒語。看看會發生什麼！

original: How do I get out of here?
string: 我怎麼出去？

original: There must be something about that amulet. Have you tried putting it on?
string: 肯定和護符有關。你有試過戴上它嗎？

original: How do I get out of here?
string: 我怎麼出去？

original: What are we looking for?
string: 我們在找什麼？

original: Anything! Anything at all that might be of interest. That's why I adore this location... we have no idea what we're going to find.
string: 任何東西！任何可能感興趣的東西。這就是為什麼我喜歡這個地方……我們不知道我們要找什麼？

original: And if, along the way, my message about the dangers of magic should happen to sink in for a few students, that would be a happy coincidence.
string: 而且，在這個過程中，如果能有幾個學生理解我之前的魔法危險論的話，這倒是一個很不錯的巧合。

original: What's so important about this place?
string: 這地方有什麼這麼重要？

original: We're particularly interested in the prevalence of magical seals placed on the tombs here. It's rather unlike anything we've encountered.
string: 我們對這些墓穴普遍採用的魔法封印方式特別感興趣。這和我們見過的很不一樣。

original: I think so. Just hold on a moment.
string: 應該可以。給我一點時間。

original: Can you get it open?
string: 你能打開它？

original: Yeeaahh! There.
string: 太好啦！那裡。

original: One more... pull...
string: 用力……拉……

original: I'm not exactly built for manual labor. Now come on, you've almost got it.
string: 我的身體情況不能幹體力活。加油吧，你就快做到了。

original: I'm going... as fast... as I can, you stupid she-devil. I don't see you... helping...
string: 我得……儘快……盡我所能，你這惡毒的女人。我沒看到妳……幫……

original: Hurry, Nazir! I'm telling you, he's in there!
string: 快點，納茲爾！我告訴你，他在那裡！

original: Hurry, Nazir! I'm telling you, she's in there!
string: 快點，納茲爾！我告訴你，她在那裡！

original: You must speak with Astrid. Here, in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
string: 你得和阿斯垂德談談。就在這裡，黑暗兄弟會的聖所。

original: No objections, then? Good. Go now. Before they meet. And report back to me with whatever you learn.
string: 沒有異議？很好。那麼去吧，趕在他們見面前。無論你聽到什麼都向我回報。

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

original: They'll never think to check it. Who in their right mind would hide inside? Now go. Before they meet. And report back to me with whatever you learn.
string: 他們不會想到檢查棺材。他們怎麼會想到有人藏在裡面呢？那麼去吧，趕在他們見面前。無論你聽到什麼都向我回報。

original: Yes, the coffin. It's perfect.
string: 是的，棺材。這計畫很完美。

original: DB04AstridHideResponse1
string: DB04AstridHideResponse1

original: Be that as it may, we have no other choice. You need to remain unseen! Now go! Before they meet. And report back to me with whatever you learn.
string: 即使如此，我們也沒其他更好的選擇。你千萬不能被發現！快去吧！趕在他們見面前。無論你聽到什麼都給我回報。

original: But that seems so... disrespectful.
string: 但，這似乎……很不敬。

original: You must understand. If Cicero is turning the others against me... against us... Our Family would not survive such division.
string: 你得明白。如果西塞羅鼓動其他人反對我……反對我們……我們的家族會分裂而覆滅。

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

original: So you understand my fear. If Cicero's planning something, and conspiring with one of our own, it would be disastrous.
string: 現在你明白我的擔心了吧。如果西塞羅有所圖謀，並和我們當中的一個串通起來，將導致災難性的後果。

original: By Sithis, we must stop them!
string: 以西帝斯之名，我們必須阻止他們！

original: I have a delivery from <Alias.ShortName=QuestGiver>.
string: 我有一樣<Alias.ShortName=QuestGiver>請我送來的東西。

original: What's this? Oh, that's right, the timbers from Anga's Mill.
string: 這是什麼？哦，很好，來自天空磨坊的木材。

original: I swear, that Aeri and her men would make fine Stormcloak recruits. Pity we can't spare the lumber to conscript them.
string: 我發誓，對於風暴斗篷來說，艾莉和她的同伴們一定會是是很好的夥伴，可惜的是我們沒辦法徵召他們而損失木料。

original: Here. Take this. For your time and all that.
string: 拿著。你的酬勞。

original: Oh, thank you. The dogs were getting restless.
string: 哦，謝謝。這些狗開始急躁不安了。

original: Here, this is for you.
string: 拿去，這是給你的。

original: Ah, Berit's ashes. He was a good man. Not many warriors grow to a fine, old age.
string: 啊，貝瑞特的骨灰。他是個好人。沒有多少戰士能健康活到老。

original: Thank you for bringing this to me. I'll make sure he gets his rites. Here, for your trouble.
string: 謝謝你把這東西帶給我。我保證他會有個體面的葬禮。這是你的酬勞。

original: Ah yes, Adonato's new work. Shorter than I expected, but words must be judged on merit, not length.
string: 噢，是的，阿多納托的新作品。比我預想的更短，但是我們得從結果來判斷，而不是長短。

original: I'll look over this later. Why don't you take this, for your trouble?
string: 我晚點會看看的。何不先收下你的酬勞呢？

original: Oh dear. Darkwater Crossing needs medicines for its miners?
string: 噢，我的天。黑水岔口的礦工們需要藥物啊？

original: I'll see about getting this order filled right away. Here, a few septims for you.
string: 我會儘快準備好這些藥物的。拿去，這是幾枚金幣。

original: Joric's sister? Poor child. Magic runs deep in that family's bloodline. It's not always a blessing.
string: 喬利克的妹妹？可憐的孩子。魔法在這個家庭的血脈中根深蒂固。這可不一定是好事。

original: Thank you for this. Something for your trouble.
string: 謝謝你。這是你的酬勞。

original: That's a shame.
string: 真不幸。

original: Fair enough.
string: 有道理。

original: I don't have time.
string: 我沒有時間。

original: Indeed it is.
string: 當然。

original: Yeah, yeah.
string: 是，是。

original: Good luck with that.
string: 祝你好運。

original: Typical.
string: 喔。

original: I don't have time right now.
string: 我現在沒時間。

original: We'll get by.
string: 我們會挺過去的。

original: Very well.
string: 甚好。

original: Don't have time. Sorry.
string: 對不起，沒時間。

original: I could deliver that for you.
string: 我可以幫你送過去。

original: Thanks.
string: 謝謝。

original: Sure. I'd be glad to help.
string: 當然。我很樂意效勞。

original: Thank you.
string: 謝謝。

original: I'd be honored.
string: 我很榮幸。

original: You're sure? When you see Giruad, ask for a tip. I'm sure he'll be in a good mood after reading this.
string: 你確定？見到吉勞德後記得要點小費。我確定他讀了這個之後心情會非常好。

original: I'll deliver the book for you.
string: 我會為你送書的。

original: Well, look at you, thanks. Take it to Voada, she handles all the dogs for the Jarl.
string: 你看你，謝謝。帶給沃達，她負責為領主養狗。

original: I could deliver that for you.
string: 我可以幫你送過去。

original: Thank you. Take it to Quintus, in the White Phial.
string: 謝謝。帶給奎因圖斯，就在雪瓶。

original: I could deliver your message for you.
string: 我可以為你傳遞資訊。

original: Thank you.
string: 謝謝。

original: I'd be glad to help.
string: 樂意效勞。

original: Sorry, I thought Skald the Elder sent you. We've got an order to fill, and he's not known for patience.
string: 抱歉，我以為是老斯卡德派你來的。我們有貨要發給他，而他是出了名的急性子。

original: Look, if you're heading towards Dawnstar anytime soon, can you give the Jarl this note? Let him know he'll get his lumber.
string: 瞧，當你去晨星城的時候，你能把這張字條交給領主嗎？讓他知道他的木頭會到的。

original: "One of the Jarl's men"?
string: 領主的手下？

original: Falkreath is known for its graveyard, traveler. We've buried more dead than you can imagine.
string: 佛克瑞斯以它的墳場聞名，旅人。我們埋葬的死人比你想像的還多。

original: I just finished giving my old war companion, Berit, a proper burial by fire. Old hard head hated the idea of being lost cold in the ground.
string: 我剛給我的老戰友貝瑞特完成火葬。老傢伙可不希望冰冷地躺在土裡。

original: Could you deliver the ashes to Runil, the priest of Arkay? He'll know the right blessings to make for Berit's soul.
string: 你能把這些骨灰交給阿爾凱的祭司魯尼爾嗎？他知道怎麼給貝瑞特的靈魂賜福。

original: You said something about a burial?
string: 你剛剛提到葬禮？

original: I write drama, friend. The legends and history of Skyrim made to excite and inspire.
string: 我在寫劇本，朋友。天際省的歷史和傳奇給我帶來了激情和靈感。

original: Poor Giruad Gemane at the Bards College has been waiting for my latest work, "Olaf and the Dragon," for weeks now. Roads are a mess.
string: 吟遊詩人學院的可憐的吉勞德．格瑪尼等著我的新作，「奧拉夫與龍」。都好幾週了，但我仍舊沒有靈感。

original: What kind of writing do you do?
string: 你寫的是什麼類型？

original: My family has been doing it for years. You need one out in the Reach. Don't want to be alone when some Forsworn comes swinging.
string: 我的家族做這行很多年了。你在邊塞這裡最好也帶著一條，這樣你就不會被棄誓者給抓到了。

original: I personally trained a whole litter for the Jarl. That reminds me, I was going to deliver some dog food to the Keep. Spiced beef. Their favorite.
string: 我親自給領主訓練了一窩。你讓我想起來了，我還得帶些狗糧到堡壘去呢。五香牛肉。牠們的最愛。

original: How long have you been training dogs?
string: 你訓練狗多久了？

original: This mine is only a few years old, but I've been digging up ore for over a century.
string: 這個礦只有幾年而已，但是我已經挖了一個多世紀的礦。

original: We're getting to the point where the tunnels are getting deep into the rock. People complain of bad coughs and foul air.
string: 我們現在正想把礦坑裡的隧道挖得更深。人們抱怨污濁的空氣和隨之而來的咳嗽。

original: I've seen this before. We need some medicines to combat the ore dust. I was about to send a message to Windhelm for aid.
string: 我見過這種情況。我們需要藥物來抵抗礦石粉塵。我打算捎個口信到風舵城尋求幫助。

original: Have you been working in the mines long?
string: 你在這個礦井工作很久了？

original: My brother is... sensitive. He has trouble focusing his attention on things.
string: 我的兄弟……很敏感。他無法集中精力。

original: We were taking him to the Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun, just so the healers could make sure he was in good health, and they say he's fine.
string: 我們把他帶到白漫凱娜瑞絲的神殿，請治療者幫他做檢查，但他們說他沒事。

original: Are you heading to Whiterun? Could you take this letter to the priestess, Danica Pure-Spring? It's a note about Joric's health.
string: 你要去白漫嗎？可以請你把這封信交給女神官丹尼卡．潔春嗎？事關喬利克的健康。

original: What's wrong with Joric?
string: 喬利克怎麼了？

original: If you're one of the Jarl's men, you'll get your lumber. Anga's Mill pays its debts.
string: 如果你是領主的手下，你就能拿到木材。天空磨坊有債必還。

original: I'm a writer by trade. Not that the people of Skyrim do much reading.
string: 就職業而言我是個作家。不過天際人不怎麼喜歡閱讀。

original: Oh, really? So that Dark Elf took my ring. So typical of his kind.
string: 哦，真的？這麼說是暗精靈拿走了我的指環。還真符合他們的個性啊。

original: I think the Jarl should hear about this. Maybe double his taxes. No, triple them. That should teach those people a lesson.
string: 我想我們應該讓領主知道。應該向他們加倍徵稅。不，三倍。這樣才能給那些人一點教訓。

original: You deserve something for sniffing out that thief. Here.
string: 這是你找到小偷應得的報酬。拿著。

original: <Alias.ShortName=QuestGiver> gave me this ring. I think it's yours.
string: <Alias.ShortName=QuestGiver>把這指環給我。我想這是妳的。

original: Thank you. Thank you! Azura's Prophecy always guide you to fortune.
string: 謝謝，謝謝！願阿祖拉的預言一直引導你走向財富。

original: Speaking of fortune. Here. Everything I earned from my last shipment. It's yours.
string: 說到財富。拿著。這是我上一批貨賺的錢。是你的了。

original: I placed <Alias.ShortName=Target>'s ring in her house.
string: 我把<Alias.ShortName=Target>的指環放到她的房子。

original: You're telling me.
string: 我早知道了。

original: Tough luck.
string: 真不幸。

original: It's not that easy. She'd go to the Jarl if she knew I was even remotely involved. You have to get it to her some other way.
string: 沒那麼容易。如果她知道我有間接參與的話，她會告訴領主的。你得用其他辦法把東西給她。

original: Look, it's dangerous, but if you sneak the ring into her house. Put in a dresser or something. I will make it worth your while.
string: 聽著，這很危險，但是如果你能偷偷把指環放進她家，放進櫃子或者其他什麼地方，我會報答你的。

original: I could return the ring for you.
string: 我可以幫你歸還這枚指環。

original: Of course nothing in here is stolen. Only a careless, shameful, idiotic fetcher would do something as stupid as to buy pilfered goods....
string: 當然，這裡沒有什麼東西是偷來的。只有一個粗心，可恥，白癡的收貨人才會購買贓物。

original: Oh by Azura, I've made a terrible mistake. I bought a gold ring, and Viola Giordano has been missing a ring that looks just like it.
string: 噢，以阿祖拉之名，我犯了個嚴重的錯誤。我買了一枚金指環，而維歐拉．喬爾丹諾遺失了和這枚很像的指環。

original: Nothing in here is stolen? Nothing at all?
string: 這裡應該沒有東西是偷來的吧？對吧？

original: Maybe so, but healthy paranoia has saved this Sanctuary before, and my gut's telling me that demented little fool is up to something.
string: 或許吧，但你要知道偏執曾經拯救過這座聖所，而我的直覺告訴我那些瘋狂的小傻瓜正在策劃著什麼！

original: Astrid, you're being a bit... paranoid.
string: 阿斯垂德，妳有點……多疑了。

original: Oh, it's you again. What in blazes do you want?
string: 哦，又是你。你到底要什麼？

original: If you've got the coin, you're welcome here. Otherwise, hit the road.
string: 如果你有金幣，這裡歡迎你。不然，趕緊滾。

original: What can I get you? Mead? Wine?
string: 我可以給你弄點什麼？蜂蜜酒？葡萄酒？

original: Looking for a place to stay?
string: 在找住宿的地方嗎？

original: You have some nerve coming back here after what you did to Keerava.
string: 你對基拉瓦做了那些事之後是不是有點神經過敏了。

original: Welcome to the Bee and Barb, milord. If I can interest you in one of our special drinks, you let me know.
string: 歡迎來到蜂與鉤，先生。如果您對我們的特殊飲品感興趣的話，請告訴我。

original: Welcome to the Bee and Barb, milady. If I can interest you in one of our special drinks, you let me know.
string: 歡迎來到蜂與鉤，夫人。如果您對我們的特色飲料感興趣的話，請告訴我。

original: Is there something I do for you?
string: 我有什麼可以效勞嗎？

original: Be brief Imperial, there's only so long I can stand being downwind of your stench.
string: 快說，帝國人。你的臭氣薰得我沒地方躲了。

original: Ah! A fellow Nord! I trust you're bringing the fight to the Empire.
string: 啊！一位諾德小夥子！我相信你是來給帝國帶來戰爭的吧。

original: If your allegiance lies with the Empire, we haven't much to discuss.
string: 如果你和帝國是站在一邊的，那我們就沒什麼好說的了。

original: Hm. You're not from around here. Imperial spy perhaps?
string: 嗯。你不是本地人。或許是帝國間諜？

original: How can a humble servant of Talos help you today?
string: 塔洛斯卑微的僕人能幫你什麼？

original: Talos bless you, my child.
string: 塔洛斯賜福你，我的孩子。

original: Blessings of Talos upon you.
string: 塔洛斯賜福與你同在。

original: Blessings upon you, traveler.
string: 塔洛斯與你同在，旅人。

original: Sorry, I'm afraid I can't help you much right now... I'm currently in mourning.
string: 對不起，恐怕現在我無法幫到你什麼……我正在服喪。

original: You've caught me at a bad time. I've lost someone dear to me.
string: 現在我不大想說話。我失去了一個對我很重要的人。

original: Yes? What is it?
string: 是？怎麼回事？

original: I'm the brewmaster around here. What did you want?
string: 我是這裡的釀酒專家。你要什麼？

original: I'm quite busy. Need something or can I get back to work?
string: 我很忙。需要什麼，還是我可以回去繼續工作了？

original: Yeah? What do you want? If this is about the meadery, we can talk later.
string: 是嗎？你想要什麼？如果是有關蜂蜜酒，一會我們可以談談。

original: Welcome! Allow me to recommend the Black-Briar Mead... the purest brew in all of Skyrim!
string: 歡迎！請允許我介紹黑棘蜂蜜酒……全天際省最醇的美酒！

original: We serve only the best here... Black-Briar Mead. May I get one for you?
string: 我們只提供最好的……黑棘蜂蜜酒。來一杯嗎？

original: I'm off work at the Black-Briar Meadery. I'll be back there in the morning.
string: 我在黑棘蜂蜜酒廠工作，但已經下班了。我明天早上才會再去上班。

original: Hey, don't look at me that way! Who are you to judge me?
string: 嘿，別那樣看著我！你是誰，有什麼資格對我說三道四？

original: So what if I have a problem? I know how to deal with it!
string: 我怎麼會有問題呢？我知道怎麼處理！

original: Maramal thinks he's so smart; tells me that Mara will cleanse the filth from my blood. Ha! What does he know?
string: 瑪拉莫認為他很聰明；告訴我瑪拉會把我血液中流淌的污穢洗乾淨。哈！他知道什麼？

original: My n'wah of a father thought he could pull my strings... "continue the Hlaalu tradition." Bah! I left all that nonsense behind.
string: 有一個當了父親的奴隸指望能托我的關係「延續哈拉魯家族的傳統」。切！我才管不了那麼許多呢。

original: If Indaryn finds out, he'll have me thrown out of the Meadery for certain. So don't breathe a word of it to him. Not a word!
string: 如果印達林發現了，毫無疑問，他會叫我把蜜酒全都扔了。因此要對他保密。隻字不提！

original: Oh what am I going do? I can barely afford to stay at the Bunkhouse.
string: 哦。我該怎麼辦呢？我勉強能負擔得起工棚。

original: I'm going to stop. That's what I'm going to do! Then everyone will see that I'm not as useless as they think.
string: 我得去阻止。那是我要做的！那樣所有人都會知道我不是他們想像中的沒用。

original: A Dreth never forgets a traitor. You'll pay for this!
string: 德萊瑟人是絕對不會饒恕叛徒的。你會為此付出代價的！

original: Wilhelm was pleased with the delivery, well done.
string: 威爾海姆很高興東西送到了，做得好。

original: I believe you have a delivery to make.
string: 我想你還有東西沒送去吧。

original: You look like you could use a drink. What do you say to some cheap mead?
string: 看來你要喝一杯。來一些便宜的蜂蜜酒怎麼樣？

original: I'm selling the best mead in town for cheap. Interested?
string: 我便宜賣鎮上最好的蜂蜜酒。有興趣嗎？

original: Well met. I don't think they're hiring anyone at the moment, so if you're looking for work, you're out of luck.
string: 幸會。我不認為他們現在打算雇人，如果你要找工作，那就很抱歉了。

original: The trees... they're beautiful here. Reminds me of autumn at home.
string: 那些樹……很漂亮。讓我想了家鄉的秋天。

original: The fall forest makes me miss my childhood; playing among the towering trees in Valenwood and living with my brethren.
string: 秋天的森林讓我想起了兒童時期，我和同胞們生活在威木省，經常在高大樹木之間嬉戲。

original: Seeing the sorry state of this city almost makes me regret my decision to leave my home when my apprenticeship completed.
string: 看到這個城市讓人難過的狀態，讓我後悔做出拿到學位後就離開家的決定。

original: I was fortunate enough to be guided by one of Silvenar's master armorers until he passed.
string: 我很幸運得到希爾維納一名大師指導，直到他去世。

original: On his deathbed, my master urged me to take over his business but I decided against it. I chose to wander Tamriel instead.
string: 在他臨終的時候，我的師父鼓勵我接管他的生意，但是我沒有接受。我選擇浪跡泰姆瑞爾。

original: Now here I am, working for this dreary city's Fishery. I sometimes wonder why I don't just move on.
string: 我現在在這裡，為這個無聊的漁場工作。有時我想我為什麼不一走了之。

original: Hello. Welcome to the Pawned Prawn.
string: 你好。歡迎來到典當小蝦。

original: If there's anything you need, I'd be glad to help you.
string: 如果有你需要的，我很樂意幫忙。

original: My husband Bersi will be the death of me. He spends too much time worrying about Riften and not enough about himself.
string: 我的丈夫波西讓我很擔憂。他花太多時間擔心裂谷城而對自己不太在意。

original: All the crime and corruption in Riften is really getting to him... and now that we hear rumors about the dragons, he's been very depressed.
string: 裂谷城的犯罪和墮落讓他越來越……如今我們還聽到龍的傳言，他變得非常消沉。

original: Bersi's afraid that someone's making a move to take the Pawned Prawn from us. I think he's being paranoid.
string: 波西怕有人從我們手裡奪走典當小蝦。我想他太多心了。

original: We both own the Pawned Prawn together, but he's singlehandedly kept the place running despite all our problems.
string: 我們共同擁有典當小蝦，但是他總是獨力經營，完全不顧及我們的問題。

original: I just care about my husband so much and I hate to see him in this state.
string: 我很關心我的丈夫，所以不願意看到他處於這種狀態。

original: Welcome to the Pawned Prawn. What can I do for you?
string: 歡迎來到典當小蝦。需要什麼？

original: I have all sorts of interesting items for sale. Have you looked around?
string: 我出售各種有趣的物品。請隨便看看。

original: Pickings may be a bit slim today, but if you see anything you like I'll make you a good deal.
string: 今天的貨物或許有點少，但是如果你看上什麼喜歡的，我會以一個好價錢賣給你的。

original: If you're looking for anything to sell for a fair price, I run the Pawned Prawn over by the market.
string: 如果你希望把東西賣個好價錢的話，我在市場附近開了家典當小蝦。

original: I presume you're bothering me for a good reason?
string: 我想你來打擾我，一定有個什麼好理由吧？

original: What in the name of Oblivion do you want?
string: 你他媽到底要做什麼？

original: I don't have time for idle chit-chat. What is it?
string: 我沒時間閒聊。什麼事？

original: The throne suits me, don't you think?
string: 這個王座很適合我，你不這麼認為嗎？

original: My title is just a formality. I've always been in charge around here.
string: 我的頭銜只是個形式。我一直統治著這裡。

original: Jarl Maven Black-Briar. Has a pleasant sound to it, wouldn't you say?
string: 瑪雯．黑棘領主。不是也蠻好聽的嗎，你說呢？

original: Fancy yourself the adventuring type, eh? It's just as well, I doubt your combat prowess would prove valuable in a real battle anyway.
string: 你認為你是個冒險家，嗯？好吧，一場真正的戰鬥就知道你有幾兩重了。

original: I was trained by some of the finest warriors in all Skyrim to wield a blade as if it was an extension of my own arm.
string: 我是由全天際省最好的戰士所訓練出來的，揮舞兵器就像揮舞自己的手臂一樣輕鬆自如。

original: My mother spares no expense where I'm concerned. I'm heir to the family fortune after all.
string: 我母親似乎不像我一樣擔心這些花費。畢竟我將繼承這整個家族。

original: Once I'm in charge I have bigger aspirations than just Skyrim. I plan to bring Black-Briar Mead to all of Tamriel.
string: 一旦我當家我的目標就不是區區天際省，我的目標是把黑棘蜂蜜酒帶到全泰姆瑞爾。

original: My children, Sibbi and Ingun, are being groomed to run the family business one day as well.
string: 我的孩子們，西比和因甘，也開始接受教育準備某天接管這項家族事業。

original: Sibbi will prove to be a fine leader one day, but Ingun... that girl has her mind somewhere other than business.
string: 西比以後肯定會成為一名好領袖的，但是因甘……那孩子志不在此。

original: Maven's disappointed that Ingun's heart isn't in the family business, but she says "Ingun still has her uses." Not sure what that means.
string: 瑪雯對因甘的心思不在家族事業上的事情很失望，但是她說「因甘並非一無是處」。不清楚那是什麼意思。

original: I'm Riften's appointed Steward. How can I help you?
string: 我是裂谷城總管。可以為你效勞嗎？

original: Steward Hemming Black-Briar at your service.
string: 我是總管：海姆英．黑棘，樂意為你效勞。

original: Well, if it isn't my little problem-solver.
string: 這不是我的小智多星嗎？

original: Well, well. Aren't you a sight for sore eyes. I've always got time for lovely ladies.
string: 很好，你是受歡迎的人。我永遠樂意為可愛的女士效勞。

original: Have you come to gawk at me or is this a social call?
string: 你是來耍我的還是來拜訪我的？

original: Ah finally, someone besides the stupid guards to talk to.
string: 啊，終於不用跟那些愚蠢的衛兵交談了。

original: My experiments continue to go well thanks to you. How can I return the favor?
string: 我的實驗進行良好，謝謝你。我怎樣才能報答你呢？

original: Any luck gathering those ingredients?
string: 有找到任何原料嗎？

original: Hm? Sorry, just thinking about my experiments.
string: 嗯？對不起，剛才我滿腦子都是我的實驗。

original: My mind is on my experiments today. What did you need?
string: 今天我的腦子被我的實驗塞滿了。你需要什麼？

original: What was it you wanted?
string: 你要的是什麼？

original: Welcome back to the temple, messenger.
string: 歡迎來到神殿，信使。

original: Blessings of Mara upon you!
string: 瑪拉賜福你！

original: How may I help you, my son?
string: 我怎麼幫你，孩子？

original: How may I help you, my daughter?
string: 我怎麼幫你，姑娘？

original: Lady Mara's messenger returns. What can I help you with, my child?
string: 瑪拉女士的信使回來了。我能幫你什麼，我的孩子？

original: Has the Warmth of Mara been given to Riften?
string: 你將瑪拉的溫暖獻給裂谷城了嗎？

original: Lady Mara bids you welcome to Her Benevolence.
string: 瑪拉女士將會以她的慈愛來擁抱你。

original: What is it you seek, my child?
string: 你在尋求什麼，我的孩子？

original: Visiting Riften? All are welcome at the Temple of Mara.
string: 拜訪裂谷城？瑪拉神殿歡迎你。

original: Please to meet you, I'm a priestess at the Temple of Mara.
string: 很高興見到你，我是瑪拉神殿的女神官。

original: Thanks again for the delivery to Markarth. What can I do for you?
string: 再次感謝你為我送東西去馬卡斯城。我能為你做點什麼？

original: Did you get that purchase agreement to Markarth yet?
string: 你把購買協議送到馬卡斯城了沒有？

original: New in town, eh? Here for the fishing I'd guess.
string: 新來的？我想你是來釣魚的吧。

original: There's nothing like fishing on Lake Honrich, you should try it sometime.
string: 在霍利奇湖釣魚是件美妙的事情，有時間你也應該嘗試一下。

original: If you're hungry, Marise sells fresh fish... caught by yours truly.
string: 如果你餓了，馬利瑟賣新鮮的魚……由鄙人所捕。

original: If you're looking for a handout, you're not going to get one from me.
string: 如果你尋求施捨，我給不了你什麼東西。

original: Can you believe my former husband used to give most of our gold to the poor?
string: 你能相信我的前夫曾經把我們大量的金幣分給窮人嗎？

original: If you're looking for a handout, you'll want to speak with my husband.
string: 如果你尋求施捨，你應該和我丈夫說。

original: If you're looking for a handout, you'll want to speak with my husband. If you're looking for company, I suppose I could do worse.
string: 如果你尋求施捨，你應該和我丈夫說。如果你想找同伴的話，我也沒什麼可以幫你的。

original: Bolli's around somewhere, planning to feed the poor with his nonsense about Mara.
string: 波利在附近某處，計劃跟窮人宣傳他關於瑪拉的廢話。

original: With my husband's new found religion, what I do with our coin and what I do all day seem less important to him. Suits me.
string: 我丈夫有了新的信仰之後，他就不怎麼關心我們的生意和我一天的行為了。那正好。

original: At this rate, he'll give the entire Riften Fishery away to charity. Then how will I live?
string: 照這樣子下去，他會把整個裂谷城漁業都交給慈善事業。那麼我該怎麼生活下去？

original: Such a waste of time preaching to the poor. If they're that hungry, they should just grow some food or something.
string: 對窮人說教真是浪費時間。如果他們餓了，他們不會自己去種點東西嗎？

original: I spend every Friday at the fishery, so I know the meaning of hard work. All those forms to fill out and file; it's exhausting!
string: 我每週五都在漁場，因此我知道努力工作的意義。有這麼多表格和資料要填寫，真是叫人精疲力盡！

original: Mark my words. If Bolli thinks he's giving all of our wealth away to some poor slob, I'll leave him high and dry.
string: 記住我的話。如果波利膽敢把所有的財富都分給窮人，我會把他轟出去的。

original: I'm feeling much better thanks to your efforts.
string: 我感覺好多了，謝謝你的幫助。

original: The pilgrimage is complete, I can feel it.
string: 這次朝聖之旅已然完成了，我能感覺到。

original: Anything else before you make the journey?
string: 在你踏上旅途前還有其他什麼事情嗎？

original: Come to laugh at the grave tender?
string: 你是來嘲笑守墓人的嗎？

original: I can see that disapproving look in your eye.
string: 在你眼裡我看到了不滿，

original: Oh, it's you. Come to extort more from me?
string: 哦，是你。來敲詐我更多的東西？

original: New around Riften? Take my advice. Stay at the Bee and Barb... the Bunkhouse isn't for you.
string: 剛來裂谷城？聽聽我的忠告吧。留在蜂與鉤……工棚不適合你。

original: If you're looking for a bed, this is the wrong place.
string: 如果你想找張床睡覺，你來錯地方了。

original: You looking for something or what?
string: 你在找東西還是在做什麼？

original: Hey! Good to see you again.
string: 嘿！很高興再次見到你。

original: Any luck getting the marks from those men?
string: 你從人們的口中獲得什麼評價了嗎？

original: Sorry about the mess. Keeping this place clean is quite a chore.
string: 很抱歉這裡很亂。要保持這地方的整潔真的很麻煩了。

original: I'd appreciate it if you'd keep your hands to yourself.
string: 你能幫我個忙別再這麼毛手毛腳了嗎？

original: The Bunkhouse isn't an inn. I'd recommend the Bee and Barb.
string: 工棚不是客棧。我建議去蜂與鉤。

original: Who did this to me?
string: 這是誰搞的？

original: This city is corrupt! You're all corrupt!
string: 這座城市墮落了！你們都墮落了！

original: This is unfair! I'm innocent!
string: 這不公平！我是無辜的！

original: Can I interest you in some fine goods from Morrowind?
string: 我有一些來自晨風的商品，不知道你有沒有興趣？

original: Have anything you wish to sell? I pay fair prices for all sorts of goods.
string: 你想賣什麼？我會付出合理的價格收購你所有的東西。

original: If there's anything you wish to purchase, just let me know.
string: 如果你要買什麼東西，告訴我一聲。

original: If you're ever in the market, I deal in specialty goods from Morrowind at one of the stands.
string: 如果你要去市場的話，我在那有個櫃檯經營晨風的特產。

original: Working at the Riften Fishery is tough, but it puts some coin in my pocket.
string: 在裂谷城漁業工作很累，但是能賺錢。

original: I'm beginning to think leaving Mournhold was a mistake.
string: 我開始認為離開哀傷之城是個錯誤了。

original: If Riften is the best Skyrim has to offer, I may as well turn back right now and just head for home.
string: 如果裂谷城這樣也配叫做天際省最棒的地方，我是不是該轉身回家呢。

original: Welcome to Riften, traveler. I hope the road fared well for you.
string: 歡迎來到裂谷城，旅人。祝你路上愉快。

original: What can I do for you?
string: 有什麼可以效勞的？

original: Speak, I wish to hear everything my subjects have to say.
string: 說吧，我希望聽到每一句我的人民想要說的話。

original: I feel so helpless out here. The people of Riften depended on me, and I failed them.
string: 我感到很無助。裂谷城的民眾相信我，而我辜負了他們。

original: Unmid and Anuriel shouldn't blame themselves for Riften's fall, I am the one who's ultimately responsible.
string: 安米德和安努瑞爾無須因為裂谷城的陷落而自責。責任都在我身上。

original: If Riften can be retaken, I will redouble my efforts to ensure the safety of my subjects and the defense of the Rift.
string: 如果我能奪回裂谷城，我會加倍努力保證我的民眾安全，並防禦好裂谷。

original: Out of my way. The son of the Jarl has no time for idle conversation with travelers.
string: 滾開。領主的兒子沒有時間和旅人閒聊。

original: If this isn't about official city business, you're wasting my time.
string: 如果沒什麼公務的話，那你就是在浪費我的時間。

original: I presume you have something important to say?
string: 我猜你有什麼重要的事情要說？

original: Come to gloat, have we? To poke fun at the jarl's youngest son?
string: 你也來幸災樂禍嗎？來取笑領主的小兒子？

original: I can feel you laughing behind my back.
string: 我感覺你在偷笑。

original: Did Harrald send you to taunt me?
string: 哈拉爾德派你來嘲笑我？

original: Welcome to Mistveil Keep. I'm Jarl Laila's steward, Anuriel.
string: 歡迎來到霧隱堡壘。我是萊拉領主的總管，安努瑞爾。

original: As Riften's Steward I'm afraid I can provide only limited assistance, but speak your mind.
string: 作為裂谷城的總管，我恐怕只能提供有限的幫助，先說說你的想法。

original: If you're here to report any instances of corruption, be confident that we're handling these rumors accordingly.
string: 如果你來這裡舉報腐敗案件的話，放心好了，我們會處理相關謠言的。

original: I'm afraid my days as the steward of Riften has come to an end.
string: 恐怕我身為裂谷城總管的日子要結束了。

original: The Imperials now control Riften and have placed Maven Black-Briar on the Jarl's throne.
string: 現在帝國控制了裂谷城，並讓瑪雯．黑棘登上了領主寶座。

original: Perhaps the Stormcloaks might rally to take back Riften one day. Only time will tell.
string: 或許某天風暴斗篷會真正回到裂谷城。只能等時間證明一切了。

original: As Jarl Laila's housecarl, I would ask that you maintain a respectable distance from her at all times.
string: 作為萊拉領主的侍衛，我要告訴你任何時候都要和她保持一個合適的距離。

original: Did you have some sort of official business here?
string: 請問有何貴幹呢？

original: I'd request that when speaking to Jarl Laila, you show the proper respect.
string: 希望在和萊拉領主交談的過程中，你能表現出應有的尊重。

original: Being in exile is the most humiliating thing I've experienced in my life.
string: 在我的一生中，被流放是個恥辱的經歷。

original: I killed scores of the Empire's men before I was forced to surrender.
string: 我在被迫投降前殺死了很多帝國人。

original: The only reason I stopped fighting was a plea from Laila, otherwise I'd would have fought to the death.
string: 我停止戰鬥的唯一理由是萊拉的請求，不然我會戰鬥到死。

original: I know you. Where was it? Hm. Oh! You were getting something for me?
string: 我認識你。不過好像有什麼事？嗯。哦！你有東西要給我嗎？

original: Did we have an appointment? No... it was a delivery? I can't remember.
string: 我們有約嗎？不……還是你來送東西的？我記不清了。

original: Excuse my disorganization, but I'm in the middle of some delicate experiments.
string: 抱歉這裡很亂，我的實驗剛進行到一半。

original: Come to see Balimund perform miracles with steel, eh?
string: 來看巴利穆德表演鋼鐵的奇跡嗎？

original: What brings you to Balimund today? Repair? Purchase?
string: 今天什麼風把你吹到巴利穆德這裡來？修理？購買？

original: Nothing like the smell of a white-hot blade, eh?
string: 沒有什麼比燒紅的刀刃更美麗的了，不是嗎？

original: Looking for some armor? A weapon perhaps?
string: 尋找一些護具？還是要一件兵器？

original: Here to purchase some armor or a weapon?
string: 來這裡購買護具還是兵器？

original: How can I help you today?
string: 有什麼需要嗎？

original: Have you met Balimund? I'm his apprentice. He's teaching me all about being a blacksmith.
string: 你見過巴利穆德了？我是他的學徒。他教我如何成為鐵匠。

original: I used to live at the orphanage here in Riften. Grelod said my ma and da left me there when I was a baby... that they didn't want me.
string: 我以前生活在裂谷城的孤兒院。桂羅說當我還是嬰兒的時候，父母就把我放那裡……說他們不想要我。

original: Balimund took me in and has been so kind to me. I don't know why, but he thinks I can be a great blacksmith like him.
string: 巴利穆德領養我，對我很好。我不知道為什麼，但是他認為我能成為像他一樣偉大的鐵匠。

original: At first I don't know why he picked me. I never even held a hammer in my life! But the first time I picked it up, it just felt right!
string: 首先，我不知道他為什麼選擇我。我甚至連鐵錘都沒碰過！不過我第一次拿上手的時候，還是很有感覺的！

original: Folks in town say that Balimund is the greatest blacksmith in all of Tamriel. I hope I can live up to that some day and make him proud of me.
string: 鎮子裡的人說巴利穆德是全泰姆瑞爾最好的鐵匠。我希望有一天我也能成為像他一樣的鐵匠，讓他為我感到驕傲。

original: Welcome back! Good to see you again.
string: 歡迎回來！很高興再次見到你。

original: Ah, you're back. What have you discovered?
string: 啊，你回來了。發現了什麼？

original: Oh, it's you. Not here to rob me are you?
string: 噢，是你。你不是來搶東西的吧？

original: Well met, friend. How can I help you?
string: 幸會，朋友。有什麼可以為你效勞的？

original: You're a stranger here too, eh?
string: 你也是剛來這裡的，不是嗎？

original: Visitors like us are rare in this part of Skyrim.
string: 在天際省的這些地方，像我們這樣的訪客很少。

original: I've never seen Mjoll this upset about anything. The city really gets to her.
string: 我從沒見過穆月爾抱怨什麼？這座城市確實很適合她。

original: Mjoll told me that it isn't this bad everywhere. Maybe one day I'll venture out and see if she's right.
string: 穆月爾告訴我並非世界的每個角落都這麼糟糕。或許有一天我會出去冒險，看看是否如她所說。

original: Mjoll's brought me nothing but safety and piece of mind... and some lessons with the blade.
string: 穆月爾給我帶來了容身之所和心靈上的避風港……同時也教了我一些使用刀刃的方法。

original: I hope that someday this city will be free from corruption and we can all live in peace.
string: 我希望有一天這座城市能從腐敗中解脫，而我們能和平地生活。

original: You here for lessons like Ingun? Or did you wish to buy something?
string: 你來這裡是為了像因甘一樣學習呢？還是想要買點東西？

original: Do you have any idea how busy I am? My mixture could be burning as we speak!
string: 你知道我有多忙嗎？在我們說話的這時候我早就可以合成許多東西了！

original: Take a look at my supplies if you must, but do hurry... I'm not getting any younger you know!
string: 有需要的話，就看看我的東西吧，但是請快點……要知道，我已經不年輕了！

original: Thanks again for delivering that ore sample.
string: 再次感謝你帶來那份礦石樣本。

original: Have you managed to make it out to Shor's Stone?
string: 你知道怎麼去朔爾之石嗎？

original: This place has seen better days, but it's not my fault.
string: 這個地方曾經有過美好的時光，但現在這樣不是我的錯。

original: Where's my head? I never even greeted you properly.
string: 我真是的糊塗了。我甚至沒有正式向你打過招呼。

original: I apologize in advance for my husband's crankiness; I promise you he means well.
string: 我為我丈夫先前的固執道歉，我向你保證他的初衷是好的。

original: Please, please. I need but a septim. A septim is all I ask. Is that so bad?
string: 可憐可憐我吧。施捨我一枚金幣吧，就一枚，我就這點要求。

original: I can't take this place anymore. The trees... all the colors, but the city, so dark. Why? It makes no sense.
string: 我快受不了這地方了。這些樹……所有的色彩。但這座城市，卻那麼黑暗。為什麼？為什麼會這樣。

original: So cold, so hungry, so tired.
string: 這麼冷，這麼餓，這麼累。

original: No one cares about us! No one! We could die and no one would ever even know! They'd just throw our corpses in the canal!
string: 沒人關心我們！沒有！全世界沒有人知道我們的死！他們只會把我們的屍體扔到河裡。

original: Are you scared of death? I am. I hear everything just stops... forever. It just all goes away, but you don't realize it. I don't want to die.
string: 你害怕死亡嗎？我害怕。我聽說一切都會停止……而且會永遠停止。一切都離你而去，只是你自己不會意識到。我不想死。

original: Sure, sure. I'm a dirty beggar... why would you want to even speak to me.
string: 當然，當然。我是個骯髒的乞丐……為什麼你願意和我說話？

original: To Oblivion with all of you! You rich piles of dung walking by us like we're not there! Pretending we don't exist! How dare you!
string: 你們死定了！你們這些人竟然就這樣旁若無人的走了過去！當我們不存在嗎！真是好大的膽子！

original: You think you know pain? Do you!? Try watching your wife and daughter burn alive after they've been ravaged by brigands! That's pain, my friend.
string: 你認為你瞭解什麼是痛苦，是嗎？看看你的妻女是怎麼被強盜們活活燒死的吧！那才叫痛苦，我的朋友。

original: Edda... she's crazy as a loon, but at least she doesn't have the mind to realize what a horrible world this is. She's the lucky one.
string: 艾達……她瘋了，不過這樣也好，至少她無法再體會到世道的混亂。從某種意義上來說，她才是最幸運的。

original: Just leave Riften. Go far, far away and never return. This place is nothing but a rotten, stinking corpse that's sat in the sun far too long.
string: 離開裂谷城吧。越遠越好，別再回來了。這地方就是一座白日下的枯城，腐朽至極。

original: Greetings, honored friend. Could I interest you in some fine jewelry?
string: 您好，我尊貴的朋友。有興趣看些上好的珠寶嗎？

original: If anything pleases the eye, don't hesitate to make me an offer.
string: 如果您有什麼看得上眼的寶貝，儘管開口出個價。

original: If you have any jewelry to sell, I'd be glad to pay you a fair sum in gold for it.
string: 要是您有什麼珠寶要賣，我倒是很樂意和你做筆買賣，價格包你滿意。

original: Come see me in the market if you're looking for the finest custom jewelry in all of Skyrim.
string: 如果您要買天際最好的穿戴和首飾，就來市場找我。

original: So, you're Brynjolf's new protege, eh? Don't look like much to me.
string: 那麼，你就是布林喬夫的新門徒，嗯？我看不太像啊。

original: It's one thing to say you've got the skills to be a thief. It's another to actually use them.
string: 你說你偷盜本領了得？說是這麼說，不過做起來就是兩碼事了。

original: It's been a long time since anyone joined us. Seems like people are in a rush to leave.
string: 好久沒人加入我們了。人們都急著離開此地。

original: I hear even the simple jobs are becoming difficult. It never used to be like this.
string: 我聽說現在，連往日裡稀鬆平常的工作都變得頗有難度。以前可從未發生過如此狀況。

original: Less coin in everyone's pocket means less coin in mine.
string: 大家口袋裡的錢少了，我能偷的也就少了。

original: Something has to change soon or I may as well pack this place up and leave it for the skeevers.
string: 我不得不改變對策了，否則乾脆不如收拾包袱走人，把這地方留給老鼠算了。

original: You better have coin to pay for your drinks. There's no handouts here.
string: 你最好付得起酒錢。這裡可沒有在布施的。

original: Got a lot of nerve coming down here. People tend to get hurt in the Ratway.
string: 這裡不太妙啊。人們很可能在鼠道遭遇不測。

original: I wouldn't stay here long if I were you.
string: 換做是我，我就不會久留於此。

original: There's a reason the city guard doesn't come down here you know.
string: 城中衛兵不來這裡是有原因的，你知道的。

original: Don't make trouble or else I'll ask Dirge to "walk" you out.
string: 別搗亂，否則我會讓「挽歌」來「趕」你出去。

original: Even if you're one of us, you better not make trouble.
string: 就算你成為了我們中的一員，你也不能肆意妄為。

original: I don't care if you're best buddies with the Guild Master. I'll still smash in your skull if you try anything.
string: 我不管你與公會會長有什麼交情。如果你有所企圖，我就會砸了你的腦門。

original: The last person that made trouble for Vekel ended up floating in the canal... catch my drift?
string: 上一個給威克爾惹麻煩的人，最終成為了運河上的一具浮屍……你明白了嗎？

original: Stay outta trouble, or there's gonna be trouble.
string: 別惹麻煩，否則麻煩就會找上你。

original: Last person who made trouble for Vekel ended up with a smashed head.
string: 上一個給威克爾惹麻煩的人，最後被打碎了腦袋。

original: Vekel doesn't like strangers snooping around the Flagon.
string: 威克爾討厭陌生人在漏壺探頭探腦的。

original: There's two things to do at the Flagon: spend coin and then get out.
string: 在漏壺只有兩件事可做：要嘛花錢要嘛滾蛋。

original: If it isn't the best brawler in Skyrim. Good to see you again!
string: 這不是天際最棒的拳手嗎？很高興再次見到您！

original: You up for another wager?
string: 你還想賭嗎？

original: Back, eh? Ready to brawl?
string: 回來了，嗯？準備好開打了嗎？

original: Too lazy to walk, eh? Well, you've found the right place.
string: 走不動了，嗯？好好，你找對地方了。

original: Got horses that need shoeing, so make it quick.
string: 我有幾匹馬需要安上蹄鐵，快點弄吧。

original: If it's horses you want, you're talking to the right person.
string: 如果你想要馬匹，你就找對人了。

original: If it's horses you want, I'm not sure I can help you. I have too much on my mind as it is.
string: 如果你是要馬匹的話，我不一定能幫到你。我現在要操心的事情太多了。

original: If it's horses you want, you'll want to speak to Hofgrir at the stables.
string: 如果你想要馬匹，去馬廄那裡與霍夫吉爾談談吧。

original: If it's horses you want, you'll want to speak to Hofgrir. I'm afraid I'm in too much trouble to help you.
string: 如果你想要馬匹，去馬廄那裡與霍夫吉爾談談吧。我有些棘手的事情要處理，恐怕幫不了你。

original: Hofgrir is a great teacher. I've learned so much about horses from him.
string: 霍夫吉爾是個好老師。我從他那學了許多關於馬兒的知識。

original: Horses are all I know. I've been riding since I could walk.
string: 我只懂馬術。從我剛學走路時起，就開始騎馬了。

original: If the forest wasn't so dangerous, I'd spend every spare moment riding.
string: 要是森林不那麼危險，我一有空就會去騎馬。

original: When Aventus escaped, Grelod got meaner than ever. I really thought she was going to kill one of us. Guess not!
string: 自從阿文圖斯逃跑之後，桂羅就變得前所未有的殘暴。我當真以為她會殺了我們之中一人。好在沒有！

original: Please, mister. You got to get me out of here. Ever since Aventus left, Grelod's been even meaner than usual. I swear, she's going to kill one of us.
string: 拜託了，先生。你得把我救出去。自從阿文圖斯逃走後，桂羅就變得兇暴異常。我敢肯定，她遲早會殺了我們當中一人。

original: Please, lady. You got to get me out of here. Ever since Aventus left, Grelod's been even meaner than usual. I swear, she's going to kill one of us.
string: 拜託了，女士。妳得把我救出去。自從阿文圖斯逃走後，桂羅就變得兇暴異常。我敢肯定，她遲早會殺了我們當中一人。

original: I used to hate it here, but it's not so bad anymore. Constance is real good to us.
string: 我以前一直很討厭這裡，不過現在沒那麼糟了。康斯坦斯對我們真的很好。

original: It's too bad the orphanage ain't letting us kids get adopted. I'd be the best son ever.
string: 太可惡了，孤兒院竟然不讓人收留我們這些小孩。我會是個好兒子的。

original: I was named after the sound a lion makes. You know: rrroooaaaarr! Really.
string: 我的名字是以雄獅的吼聲命名的。你知道的，就像「吼啊啊啊！」，真的！

original: I can't believe it! Grelod is dead! She's really dead!
string: 簡直不敢相信！桂羅死了！她真的死了！

original: I do hope mummy and father come to get me soon. Ever since that Aventus boy left, Grelod has been so angry.
string: 我非常希望父母快來接我回去。自從阿文圖斯離開後，桂羅從未消過氣。

original: I do hope mummy and father come to get me soon. Ever since that Aventus boy left, this place has gone mad.
string: 我非常希望父母快來接我回去。自從阿文圖斯離開後，這個地方就陷入瘋狂了。

original: My parents dropped me off here a year ago. But they're coming back to get me. They said so.
string: 我的雙親一年前在這裡拋棄了我。不過他們承諾會回來接我的。他們是這麼說的。

original: You look kind of scary. But nobody is scarier than old Grelod.
string: 你看起來很嚇人。不過沒人會比老妖婆桂羅更恐怖的。

original: Constance Michel says we have to be careful of people we don't know.
string: 康斯坦斯．米切爾說過，碰到不熟悉的人，要處處提防著。

original: I'm really afraid of Grelod. When Aventus escaped, she was so mad. I got double the beatings that day.
string: 我真的很怕桂羅。自從阿文圖斯逃走後，她就像發了瘋似的。那天我挨的打是平常的兩倍。

original: Kill one person, and you can solve so many problems. I wonder at the possibilities.
string: 殺人可以解決很多問題。我只想知道可行性。

original: When Aventus escaped, Grelod was so mad. I got double the beatings that day. But that won't happen ever again.
string: 阿文圖斯逃走後，桂羅就像發了瘋似的。那天我挨的打是以前的兩倍。不過那樣的事不會再發生了。

original: I hate it here. Grelod the Kind is the meanest person in all of Skyrim.
string: 我討厭這裡。慈祥桂羅是全天際最狠的人了。

original: Things are much better now that Grelod is dead, but still. I'm sick of this place.
string: 桂羅死了，一切都好多了。不過，我依然討厭這個地方。

original: I'm strong, and quick, and can do any chore you want. Come on, adopt me. Please?
string: 我既強壯又敏捷，還能幫你打點雜事。拜託了，收養我吧。求求你了，好嗎？

original: When Aventus took off, when he said those things, about killing Grelod... I never imagined he was serious...
string: 阿文圖斯逃走後，每當他談起要殺了桂羅時……我從沒想過他是認真的……

original: Come to get yourself a kid? You're out of luck. No way Grelod will let any of us get adopted. Especially not since Aventus took off.
string: 你是來領養小孩的嗎？不大可能了。桂羅是絕不會讓我們被領走的。尤其是阿文圖斯逃走之後。

original: Grelod ain't going to like some stranger just hangin' around. Not that I care.
string: 桂羅是不會喜歡陌生人在她面前閒逛的。我倒不在乎。

original: Constance don't care much for strangers in the orphanage. Afraid someone might hurt one of us kids. Which, I gotta admit, is kind of nice.
string: 康斯坦斯不太關心孤兒院裡的陌生人。他不怕有人會傷害孩子們。我得承認，他這樣倒是挺好的。

original: Why's someone like you want to hang around a place like this?
string: 怎麼會有人像你這樣在這種地方閒蕩呢？

original: Grelod... murdered. Here. I... I need... air... You... you... Get out of here! Get out!
string: 桂羅……被殺了。就在這裡。我……我需要……喘口氣……你……你……給我滾出去！出去！

original: I can't believe Grelod is dead. I had no love for the woman, but to be murdered, in cold blood...
string: 不敢相信桂羅已經死了。雖然我對那個女人沒一點好感，不過她被殘忍的殺害了，倒在血泊之中……

original: You really shouldn't be in here.
string: 你真的不該進來的。

original: I'm sorry, but the children aren't up for adoption right now. You should go.
string: 很抱歉，目前無法領養孩子。你走吧。

original: My only concern is for the children. The poor darlings have no one else.
string: 我唯一擔心的就是孩子們。這些可憐娃兒已經沒有親人了。

original: Welcome to the cozy little family. I'm one of the lookouts for the Guild. I watch Delvin's back.
string: 歡迎來到這個舒服的小家。我是公會的一個觀察兵，我負責支援戴爾文。

original: If you're looking for extra work, talk to Vex or Delvin. They'll fix you up.
string: 如果你在找工作做，去找「小煩」或戴爾文談談。他們會有安排的。

original: Stick to the rules and you'll end up rich. Break them and you're out on your arse. Simple, right?
string: 遵循規則才能富有。否則就會屁都沒有。很簡單的道理，不是嗎？

original: If you're looking for conversation, The Flagon isn't the place.
string: 如果你想要聊天，漏壺可不是你該來的地方。

original: Vekel and me, we have a thing going. So I recommend you keep your hands off the merchandise.
string: 我和威克爾的關係可非同一般。所以我勸你不要打他貨物的主意。

original: Vekel and me, we have a thing going. Try anything with him and it'd be bad for your health.
string: 我和威克爾的關係可非同一般。你要是對他圖謀不軌，就當心你的小命吧。

original: You don't impress me. So don't even try.
string: 你沒能使我眼前一亮。所以還是別試了。

original: You going to buy something or just here for training? Otherwise, move on.
string: 你是來買東西的還是來訓練的？如果都不是，那就走吧。

original: You gonna stare all day or buy some armor?
string: 你是想買護甲呢，還是想看上個一天半載？

original: Come on, come on. The sooner you buy, the sooner I can get drunk.
string: 拜託拜託。你早點買完，我才能早點喝酒啊。

original: Can't you bother me at my armor stand in the market? Or are you that desperate for training?
string: 你就不能來市場的護甲攤位找我嗎？還是你迫切想要接受訓練？

original: My food is the best in all of Skyrim; always as fresh as the day it was collected.
string: 我賣的食物是天際最好的，永遠是那麼的新鮮。

original: Some fresh meat to fill your belly perhaps?
string: 要來點鮮肉填飽您的肚子嗎？

original: The only way to find fresher meats is to hunt it yourself.
string: 除非你親自跑去打獵，否則一定找不到比我這裡更新鮮的肉。

original: I run the meat and produce stand at the market. Come by and see me if you want some of the freshest food you've ever eaten.
string: 我在市場裡賣肉維生。如果你想吃最新鮮的肉，就來找我。

original: I'm feeling much better now thanks to you.
string: 多虧了你，我現在感覺好多了。

original: Did you bring anything? The pain...
string: 你帶來了什麼？只有痛苦……

original: Please help me, I'm going to lose my job at the Riften Fishery.
string: 拜託幫幫我，我就快丟掉裂谷城漁業的工作了。

original: I really need your help! I don't want to lose my job at the fishery! What am I going to do?
string: 我真的很需要你的幫忙！我不想失去漁場的工作！我該怎麼辦？

original: Oh, my aching head. Why do I do this to myself?
string: 噢，真是頭疼。我怎麼會這樣對自己？

original: You have no idea what it's like to have everything, then watch it all disappear.
string: 你既然不知道這一切是怎麼來的，那就看清楚這一切是怎麼消失的。

original: Let me out of here, damn it! I'm not a criminal!
string: 放我出去，該死！我不是犯人！

original: This is what happens to you when you speak your mind in this city.
string: 在這座城裡，你一旦說出了內心的真實想法，就會有這樣的待遇。

original: They threw me in here because I called Ulfric a liar; a deceiver.
string: 我只是說了烏弗瑞克是個騙子，是個大騙子，他們就把我關了進來。

original: Ulfric doesn't care about Talos. He yearns for the throne of Skyrim and he'll say anything to rally people to his side.
string: 烏弗瑞克不在乎塔洛斯。他渴望得到的是天際的寶座，而且他會費盡口舌拉攏人們站到他的一邊。

original: But now, because of Ulfric's greed, countless lives have been lost.
string: 不過現在，由於烏弗瑞克的貪婪之心，無數的人已命喪黃泉。

original: On second thought, maybe I'm better off in here. At least I'll die with a clear conscience.
string: 再三考慮後，我覺得也許待在這裡也未嘗不是件好事。至少我可以問心無愧的死去。

original: Brynjolf sent you to rub it in?
string: 布林喬夫派你來揭我傷疤的？

original: Waste of talent throwing me in here, right?
string: 把我扔到這種地方真是浪費人才，不是嗎？

original: Can't wait to get out of here.
string: 再也待不下去了。

original: What? What are you looking at?
string: 什麼？你在看什麼東西？

original: Piss off. I'm busy.
string: 滾開。我忙著呢。

original: Get away from me.
string: 給我滾開。

original: A pleasure, thane.
string: 我的榮幸，武衛。

original: Is it daylight out? Night? I lose track down here.
string: 現在外面是白天還是夜晚？我沒有時間概念了。

original: The prisoners are in rare form, as usual.
string: 犯人們很安分，和往常一樣。

original: Watch your step in here. The stonework gets slippery.
string: 走路小心點。石板路很容易摔跤。

original: Now that the Empire's arrived in Riften, we've finally established a launching point into Morrowind... just in case.
string: 帝國軍已經抵達裂谷城，我們也開闢了進入晨風的入口……以防萬一。

original: So is it Riften or Rifton? This place has changed its name so many times, I can't even remember.
string: 到底是裂谷城還是斷谷城？這地名換了太多次，我都記不得了。

original: Seems like capturing Riften is turning out to be more of a hassle than a benefit. But what do I know?
string: 似乎佔領裂谷城，弊大於利。不過我不懂什麼大道理。

original: Why we bothered to capture Riften I'll never understand. Just look at this place.
string: 我就是不明白為什麼我們要大費周章的前來攻打裂谷城。看看這個地方吧。

original: This city still reeks with the stench of the Stormcloaks. Makes me sick to my stomach.
string: 這座城市彌漫著風暴斗篷們的臭氣。讓我覺得很反胃。

original: I hope you're finding the city in proper order, thane.
string: 希望您在找尋的城市秩序井然，領主。

original: I trust the day's found you well, thane.
string: 我相信您一切都好，領主。

original: How do you do, thane?
string: 您好嗎，武衛？

original: You could say the Ratway is the city under the city. Dark, dangerous, and no place for decent folk.
string: 你可以說鼠道就是一座地下城。黑暗又危險，惡棍也層出不窮。

original: Riften's under my protection. You watch yourself, now.
string: 裂谷城由我來守護。你自己小心些。

original: Careful. Riften's not the safest place for a nighttime stroll.
string: 別大意。大老晚的在裂谷城閒逛也不一定安全。

original: City's quiet enough now. But when the sun goes down, you best keep on your guard.
string: 現在城裡十分平靜。不過一旦太陽下山後，你最好保護好自己。

original: There's an apothecary in town, yeah. But it's down on the lower walkway, so stay sharp if you go down there.
string: 城裡有位藥劑師，沒錯。不過他家在下城區，你如果要去那裡，保持警惕。

original: There's fine steel at the Scorched Hammer, if you fancy a new blade.
string: 如果你想換把兵器，在滾燙鐵錘那裡有上等的好鐵。

original: Need a drink, you go to the Bee and Barb. Stay out of the Ragged Flagon, stay out of the Ratway.
string: 想要喝酒，就去蜂與鉤。別去漏壺或者鼠道。

original: If it's a bed you need, talk to Keerava in the Bee and Barb. She'll set you right.
string: 如果要住宿，去蜂與鉤找基拉瓦。她會好好安頓你的。

original: There's a foul presence coming from Darklight Tower, southwest of the city. Some say the place is home to necromancers.
string: 城市西南部的黑光塔裡衍生出了邪惡之力。有人說那個地方是法師的發源地。

original: City got attacked once by those damn bandits, come east across the lake, from Faldar's Tooth. They won't be trying that again.
string: 那些該死的強盜們曾經襲擊過城市，從東邊的法爾達之牙，一路越湖襲來。他們不會再來了。

original: Best not go wandering east of the city. Bandits been seen around Broken Helm Hollow.
string: 最好不要去城東。強盜們就在裂盔山谷附近。

original: Talk of strange happenings at Autumnshade Clearing, just north of the lake. My guess? Spriggans.
string: 說說秋影空地發生的怪事吧，就在湖的北邊。我的想法？應該是樹精在作怪。

original: If you journey north, keep well away from Snapleg Cave. Damned Hagravens have infested the place.
string: 如果你要去北邊，離斷腿洞穴遠一點。該死的烏鴉鬼婆佔領了那裡。

original: By the gods, a dragon's been sighted just south of the city, flying around Lost Tongue Overlook.
string: 九聖靈在上，在城的南邊發現了一頭巨龍，在失語眺岩上空盤旋著。

original: Welcome. I don't believe we've met. I am Elenwen, the Thalmor Ambassador to Skyrim.
string: 歡迎。初次見面。我是愛琳溫，是梭默駐天際大使。

original: And you are...?
string: 而您是……？

original: Yes, yes. Now to find myself a drink.
string: 對，是的。現在我要去喝酒了。

original: Everything's in order. Welcome back, sir.
string: 一切正常。歡迎回來，先生。

original: I'm just doing my duty, sir.
string: 我只是在做我的本職工作，長官。

original: Now then. Here's my invitation, I don't have a poisoned dagger strapped to my thigh, et cetera, et cetera.
string: 這裡，拿去。我的邀請函。我的腿上也沒有藏著荼毒匕首之類的暗器。

original: Awful damn cold up here. And only the guests are allowed inside. Damn foreigners and their inhospitable ways.
string: 可惡，這裡真冷啊。而且只有尊客們才允許進去。該死的異邦人，該死的「好客之道」。

original: What are you out here talking to me for? Party's inside.
string: 你在外面和我說話是做什麼？宴會在裡面呢。

original: I'm paid to wait to take you home. Enjoy yourself.
string: 有人付了錢，讓我在這裡等你，然後把你送回家。祝你玩得開心。

original: The lady's already paid the fee. We leave when she gives the word.
string: 那位女士已經付過錢了。她吩咐完之後，我們就走了。

original: Just a minute. I think I left it on the cart.
string: 等等。我好像把它忘在車上了。

original: Of course. Just bring it to me when you find it.
string: 當然。你找到之後就把它給我。

original: Is there a problem?
string: 有什麼問題嗎？

original: Of course not. Purely a formality. Now, I need to see your invitation.
string: 當然沒有。完全只是例行公事。那麼，請給我看看您的邀請函吧。

original: Here you go. (Show invitation)
string: 拿去。（出示邀請函）

original: Thank you, sir. Go right in.
string: 謝謝，先生。請進。

original: Thank you, ma'am. Go right in.
string: 謝謝，女士。請進。

original: Here's my invitation.
string: 這是邀請函。

original: Welcome to the Thalmor Embassy. Your invitation, please.
string: 歡迎來到梭默大使館。請出示您的邀請函。

original: Your invitation, please.
string: 請出示您的邀請函。

original: You must present your invitation to be admitted to the party.
string: 您必須呈上邀請函才能參加派對。

original: Go right on in. The party has already started.
string: 請進吧。宴會已經開始了。

original: I'm sorry, sir, I'm on duty.
string: 很抱歉，先生。這是我的職責。

original: I'm sorry, ma'am, I'm on duty.
string: 很抱歉，女士。這是我的職責。

original: We're not supposed to talk to the guests.
string: 我們不能與客人們交談

original: The Thalmor Embassy welcomes you.
string: 梭默大使館歡迎您的到來。

original: Please proceed into the Embassy.
string: 請前往大使館。

original: Guests are advised to remain inside the Embassy.
string: 客人們最好留在大使館中。

original: I prefer to arrive early. Often the day before the party. So as not to miss out on any of the drinking.
string: 我喜歡早到。最好是宴會開始的前一天就到。這樣才不會少喝到酒。

original: There's not enough drinking in the world today, wouldn't you agree?
string: 大家現在都太少喝酒了，你同意吧？

original: I will just... rest here a moment. Although it is damnably cold out here. I don't look forward to the trip back down...
string: 我只想……在這裡休息一會。儘管這裡非常寒冷。我不想走回頭路……

original: Perhaps we might share a carriage after the party?
string: 或許宴會之後我們可以同坐一輛馬車？

original: I know, I know - we've just met. But think, by the time the party is over we'll no doubt be fast friends. I look forward to it.
string: 我知道，我知道——我們才剛剛見面。不過想想，宴會結束之後，我們毫無疑問會成為好朋友。我很期待。

original: Please. Take your time.
string: 拜託了。慢慢來。

original: Don't mind me. I'm perfectly insensible to the cold.
string: 不用擔心我。我一點也不怕冷。

original: I'll go after you. Although these fellows know me. I never miss one of Elenwen's parties, you see.
string: 我要跟著你。雖然這些傢伙認識我。你瞧，愛琳溫的每一場宴會，我都參加了。

original: My lateness is due more to getting lost on the way up this gods-forsaken mountain than to any desire to actually arrive late.
string: 我遲到全都是因為上山時迷了路，絕非刻意想要遲到。

original: And arriving by carriage, no less! I salute you, sir!
string: 而且還是坐馬車來的！我向您表示敬意，先生！

original: And arriving by carriage, no less! I salute you, my good lady!
string: 而且還是坐馬車來的！我向您表示敬意，尊貴的女士！

original: Ah! A fellow latecomer to Elenwen's little soiree.
string: 啊！我們倆參加愛琳溫的小聚會都晚到了。

original: What kinds of things should I bring?
string: 我應該帶些什麼東西？

original: You're asking me? She promised that she was sending someone who knew what they were doing...
string: 你居然問我？她承諾過她會派來一些思路清晰的人……

original: If you actually want to get out alive, I'd bring whatever you need to move quietly, and kill quickly.
string: 如果你真想活著出去，就帶上任何能令你來去無蹤、殺人無形的物品。

original: I'll see you in Solitude after I meet Malborn.
string: 等我見過馬伯恩之後，就跟妳在獨孤城會合。

original: Sounds good. Be careful.
string: 聽起來不錯。一切小心。

original: Once I'm inside the Embassy, then what?
string: 一旦我進了大使館，之後怎麼做？

original: That's when the fun starts. You'll have to slip away from the party without raising the alarm.
string: 好戲那時候才會開始。你要悄無聲息的逃出宴會，不要引起警覺。

original: Then you'll need to find Elenwen's office and search her files. Malborn should be able to point you in the right direction.
string: 接著你要找到愛琳溫的辦公室，然後搜查她的文檔。馬伯恩應該能幫你指出正確的方向。

original: How am I going to get into this party?
string: 那我怎麼混進派對呢？

original: Let me handle that. You'll have a real invitation, don't worry. As long as you can act the part of a Thalmor toady, you'll get past the guards.
string: 這個我來搞定。我會給你一封真的邀請函，別擔心。只要你能裝成梭默，你就能騙過衛兵。

original: Who's this contact of yours? You're sure I can trust him?
string: 你的內應是誰？他值得信賴嗎？

original: Don't worry about Malborn. He's not a dangerous character like you, but he hates the Thalmor at least as much as I do.
string: 別擔心馬伯恩。他雖說不是像你這樣的狠角色，不過他和我一樣，都痛恨梭默。

original: He's a wood elf - the Thalmor wiped out his family back in Valenwood during one of their purges that we never hear about.
string: 他是個木精靈——梭默暗中執行淨化行動時殺光了他在威木省的家人。

original: Luckily they don't know who he really is, or he wouldn't be serving drinks at the Ambassador's parties.
string: 幸運的是，他們不知道他的身份，否則他是不會正大光明的在大使的宴會上幫客人們倒酒的。

original: Why not just fight our way in?
string: 為什麼不一路殺進去呢？

original: So that's your plan, huh? Even if you could survive, by the time you got inside, whatever documents they had would be long gone.
string: 這就是你的計劃，嗯？就算你活著衝進裡面，那些文件也早就不見了。

original: We're there for information, remember? Trust me, I've been doing this for a long time. My way is better.
string: 我們在那裡打聽消息，記住沒？相信我，我幹這一行已經很久了。我這法子更可靠些。

original: That didn't take long.
string: 妳速度真快啊。

original: I've been doing this a long time, remember? While the Thalmor's been looking for me, I've been watching them.
string: 我幹這一行已經很久了，記住沒？當梭默還在搜尋我的時候，我都已經監視他們很久了。

original: You're not coming?
string: 妳不一起去？

original: That would be a bad idea. I'd be too likely to attract the wrong kind of attention. But they don't know you at all, yet.
string: 那樣不妥當。我會引來不必要的注意。至於你，他們根本不認識。

original: I don't think you were followed. Come on. I have a plan.
string: 你沒被跟蹤。來吧。我有個計劃。

original: So you really are...
string: 那麼，你真的是……

original: Remind me... who are the Thalmor?
string: 告訴我……梭默是什麼組織？

original: Why are the Thalmor after you?
string: 梭默為什麼要追殺你？
