original: Before the Great War, the Blades helped the Empire against the Thalmor.
string: 在浩大戰爭之前，刀鋒衛士曾協助帝國對抗梭默。

original: Our Grand Master saw them as the greatest threat to Tamriel. At the time, that was true. Maybe it still is.
string: 我們的宗師曾把他們視作泰姆瑞爾最大的威脅。以前是，現在可能還是。

original: So we fought them in the shadows, all across Tamriel. We thought we were more than a match for them. We were wrong.
string: 我們在暗地裡一直與他們對抗，衝突遍佈整個泰姆瑞爾大陸。我們本以為他們不是我們的對手。不過，事實並非如此。

original: The Blades? Who are they?
string: 刀鋒衛士？他們是誰？

original: What's our next move?
string: 我們下一步做什麼？

original: We need to find out if the Thalmor are behind the dragons coming back. We need to get into the Thalmor Embassy, somehow...
string: 我們得查一查梭默到底是不是龍族回歸的幕後主使。我們得想辦法潛入梭默大使館……

original: Just the short version.
string: 就說的簡短點吧。

original: They're the high elves that rule the Aldmeri Dominion. Sworn enemies of the Empire and everything it stands for.
string: 他們是統轄先祖神洲的高等精靈。是帝國及其盟友不共戴天的仇敵。

original: Thirty years ago, they invaded the Empire and came close to destroying it. They smashed the Blades in the process.
string: 30年前，他們入侵了帝國，險些將其滅國。同時還擊潰了刀鋒衛士。

original: Since then, they've been working to weaken the Empire any way they can.
string: 從此之後，他們一直試圖削弱帝國的實力，費盡手段。

original: Give me the long version.
string: 說的詳細些吧。

original: They're the rulers of the Aldmeri Dominion - what used to be the Imperial provinces of Summerset Isle and Valenwood.
string: 他們是先祖神洲的執法者——這地方曾經是帝國的省份，夏暮島和威木省。

original: The Thalmor take the arrogance of high elves to the extreme - they believe they are the rightful rulers of all of Tamriel.
string: 梭默將高等精靈的趾高氣昂發揚到了極致——他們堅信自己才是泰姆瑞爾真正的統治者。

original: For a century or more, the Thalmor had been picking away at the Empire. Valenwood was the first, then the province of Elsweyr.
string: 一百多年以前，梭默就開始挖帝國的牆角。威木省是第一個分離出去的，不久艾斯維爾省也步了後塵。

original: But even the Blades didn't see the Great War coming. We underestimated the Thalmor, and they destroyed us.
string: 不過甚至是刀鋒衛士也沒料到浩大戰爭的爆發。我們低估了梭默的實力，以致被他們擊敗了。

original: You'd really risk your life for a stranger's honor? I don't even know what to say. Thank you, my friend. I'll wait here.
string: 你當真願意為一個素未謀面的人赴湯蹈火嗎？我都不知道該說些什麼了。謝謝你，我的朋友。我在這裡等你。

original: Don't be foolish. I'll do it.
string: 別傻了。交給我來處理。

original: You'd do that for a stranger? I don't know what to say. Lead on, I suppose.
string: 你真的願意幫助一個陌生人嗎？我都不知道該說些什麼了。我想，那就出發吧。

original: I understand. Let me help you.
string: 我明白。我來幫你。

original: Thank Kynareth for you, stranger. I'd almost given up hope of walking away from here.
string: 謝謝，願凱娜瑞絲保佑你，陌生人。我都已經不指望能離開這裡了。

original: Greetings.
string: 你好。

original: Please, do you have a potion you can spare?
string: 請問，您可以施捨一瓶藥給我嗎？

original: Please! I'm not sure I'll make it on my own.
string: 求求你！我不知道自己還能不能撐下去。

original: Hello? You! Over here! Please, I need help!
string: 嗨？你好！過來一下！求求你，我需要幫助！

original: That is a lot of blood.
string: 流了很多血。

original: Not sure how much longer I can hold out here.
string: 不知道我還能撐多久。

original: I really got myself into it this time.
string: 這次我真的把自己捲進去了。

original: You seemed upset about something.
string: 你似乎在擔憂著什麼？

original: The world's going mad, and our Jarl does what?
string: 這世上越來越亂了，而我們的領主在做什麼呢？

original: She hides inside with her 'visions'. We need a leader, not some mystic!
string: 她躲在了自己的「幻想」中。我們需要的是領導者，而不是什麼神秘主義者！

original: The world's going mad, and our Jarl doesn't care. She's only in it for herself.
string: 世界越來越亂了，而我們的領主對此毫不關心。她只是沉浸在自己的幻想中。

original: If she's the best Ulfric has to offer, we might've been better off with the Imperials.
string: 如果她就是烏弗瑞克能提供的最好人選，那我們站在帝國一邊的話，境況可能會更有利。

original: How can I?
string: 要我怎麼信任她？

original: She never speaks with us. She's allowed this wizard, Falion, to live in our midst practicing gods-know-what.
string: 她從不與我們交談。她還准許一個叫法利昂的巫師搬進鎮裡，練習不曉得什麼法術。

original: And now there's talk of rebellion, and dragons? What help could Idgrod be against them?
string: 最近好像還有些風聲，是關於叛亂軍和龍族的？艾德格洛德又打算怎麼對付他們？

original: No, we can only rely on ourselves. You'd do well to remember that.
string: 不行，我們只能靠自己。勸你最好也記住這個道理。

original: You don't trust the Jarl?
string: 你不信任領主？

original: What was that argument outside the Hall?
string: 外面是在爭論什麼？

original: Ah, you saw that, did you?
string: 啊，你看到了，是嗎？

original: Life in Morthal has been troubled lately. The people are uncertain, restless. They merely look to the Jarl for leadership.
string: 墨索爾城的百姓們最近頻頻遭到騷擾。人們心神不寧、擔憂萬分。他們只想尋求領主的庇護。

original: There's news of rebellion against the Empire. Strange noises have been heard in the marshes at night.
string: 最近有消息說有人企圖反叛帝國。，沼澤地那到了晚上經常能聽到怪聲。

original: And then, the tragedy with Hroggar's home.
string: 之後，就發生了赫魯加一家的慘劇。

original: The men simply seek wisdom. Everything will be fine.
string: 那些人只是想找出答案。但一切都會好轉的。

original: What's going wrong in Morthal?
string: 墨索爾城出了什麼事？

original: Morthal has enough problems as it is!
string: 墨索爾城的麻煩已經夠多了！

original: We've no need for wizards in our midst!
string: 我們鎮上不需要一個巫師！

original: I have told Idgrod of your concerns. She'll look after you all. Please, go back to your business.
string: 我已經向艾德格洛德匯報過你們所擔心的事了。她會幫你們處理的。請大家都回去各司其職吧。

original: Please, enough already!
string: 拜託，已經夠了！

original: How are we supposed to feel safe in our own homes?
string: 這種狀況叫我們待在自己家裡時怎麼有安全感？

original: What's the Jarl going to do about it?
string: 領主打算怎麼處理這事？

original: What do we do now?
string: 我們現在怎麼辦？

original: I... I don't know. Ancano is gone, but whatever he's done to the Eye doesn't seem to have stopped.
string: 我……我不知道。雖然安卡諾已經死了，不過他利用瑪格努斯之眼所造成的影響仍未消失。

original: I have no idea what to do!
string: 我不知道該怎麼辦！

original: Let's hope we succeed.
string: 但願我們能成功。

original: This is our only chance.
string: 這是我們最後的機會。

original: No way. That sounds illegal.
string: 不行。這聽起來是非法行為。

original: What, did you suddenly grow a conscience? Suit yourself.
string: 什麼，你怎麼又突然找回良知了？你自己看著辦吧。

original: Wait, you want me to go do this alone?
string: 等等，你的意思是要我一個人去做嗎？

original: Yes. I had Falk call you back because you were at the summoning, you have a connection to Potema now. You must deal with her.
string: 沒錯。我要佛克請你回來，是因為施法召喚時你也在場，現在你與波特瑪有了聯繫。必須由你來對付她。

original: I can provide you with help for her minions though.  This should help you deal with the Catacombs themselves.
string: 雖然我幫你對付她的手下。這應該對你進入墓穴有所幫助。

original: All right, I'll do it.
string: 好。交給我。

original: Good. Now get going.
string: 好。現在開始行動。

original: What is skooma?
string: 斯庫瑪是什麼？

original: I'm not sure what it's made from, but I can tell you that once you've had a taste, you'll never crave anything else.
string: 我也不知道它是用什麼做的，不過我敢說你只要嘗過一次，你就再也不想吃其他的東西了。

original: The Dunmer came up with the stuff a long time ago. Very illegal and very hard to come by.
string: 很久以前，是丹莫人把這東西傳進來的。不合法而且貨源極少。

original: I got mine off of a merchant ship in Solitude. Worst mistake I ever made.
string: 我把我的那份留在獨孤城商船上。這是我這輩子最愚蠢的錯誤。

original: I have a potion for you.
string: 我給你帶了一副藥。

original: Thank you. I'd almost given up hope.
string: 謝謝你。我都快絕望了。

original: Here, take this. It's all I can offer for what you've given me.
string: 拿去，請收下吧。我也只能這麼回報你了。

original: I'll get one for you.
string: 我會幫你拿一份過來的。

original: Thank you, my friend.
string: 謝謝你，我的朋友。

original: Go on without me. I think I need to be alone for a while.
string: 離我遠點。我想要一個人靜靜。

original: Don't you want your treasure? Riches, and all that?
string: 你不想要你的寶藏了嗎？這麼多財富，你不要了？

original: Look, I never needed treasure. My father owns land; our family is wealthy. I just wanted adventure. Not this.
string: 聽著，我從來都不缺錢。我家境富裕，只缺冒險，不缺錢。

original: What will you do now?
string: 你接下來會怎麼做？

original: I don't know. Beem-Ja has looked after me since I was knee-high to him. I need to rest, and then I think I'm going back to High Rock.
string: 我不知道。自從我長到畢姆-加的膝蓋那麼高之後，他就開始照顧我了。我想先休養一段時間，接著才打算回高岩。

original: There's just one more thing I need from you. To fully absorb Gathrik's power I require a blood sacrifice.
string: 還有一件事我需要你做的。為了可以完全吸收加斯瑞克的力量，我需要一次血祭。

original: Your blood should be good enough. This will go easier for us both if you don't bother fighting back.
string: 你的鮮血品質應該不錯，如果你乖乖聽話就好辦多了。

original: Fool. I should thank you. I knew the girl wouldn't be strong enough to help me kill Gathrik alone.
string: 愚蠢。我是該感謝你。不過我想這女孩的力量不足以幫我擊敗加斯瑞克。

original: We're in this together. Stay close.
string: 我們一起走。跟緊了。

original: This is no time for idle talk.
string: 沒時間閒聊了。

original: Not now. Stay alert.
string: 現在沒空。保持警惕。

original: Let's clear the place out first. Then we'll gather our loot.
string: 先淨空這裡，然後把我們的贓物儲存到此處。

original: Eyes open. Danger could be anywhere.
string: 這裡危機四伏，最好提高警惕。

original: This place is sure to make us rich!
string: 這地方肯定能讓我們發財！

original: I think I almost got it.
string: 我就快拿到它了。

original: Come on, just open.
string: 來吧，打開它。

original: You've been at it for five minutes. Here, let me try.
string: 你已經弄了五分鐘了。給我，讓我來試試。

original: I can't get it open.
string: 我打不開它。

original: Sorry, can't help you.
string: 抱歉，我沒幫到你。

original: Very well. I suppose I'll just curl up somewhere until this passes as usual.
string: 很好。我想先找個地方躲起來，等鋒頭過了再說。

original: Sure. Here you are.
string: 好。給你。

original: Your kindness will never be forgotten.
string: 您的大恩大德我永生難忘。

original: Here, take this. It's all I can offer for what you've given me.
string: 這個給你。我也只能這麼回報你了。

original: You might lose your job?
string: 你可能會丟了你的工作？

original: My job at the Riften Fishery is in danger. The owner, Bolli, said that if I show up for work in this condition one more time, then I'm out.
string: 我在裂谷城漁業的工作可能有危險了。雇主波利說，要是再發現我在這樣的狀態下工作，就會炒了我。

original: I don't mean to do this to myself, but I can't help it. I tried some skooma a year ago, and ever since then, I can't stop!
string: 我並不是故意這樣對待自己的，不過我實在忍受不住。一年前，我第一次吸了斯庫瑪，可從那之後，我就無法自拔了！

original: If you could give me a healing potion, I could cleanse this poison from my body and get back to my life.
string: 如果你能給我點治療藥水，我就能遠離毒品重獲新生了。

original: Do you like working at the Riften Fishery?
string: 你喜歡裂谷城漁業的工作嗎？

original: Bolli is a good man, he pays us well and watches out for us.
string: 波利是個好人，他付的工錢不少，而且很關心我們。

original: I used to work at the Black-Briar Meadery, but Indaryn and I never saw eye-to-eye. That elf has no patience at all.
string: 我曾在黑棘蜜酒場工作過，不過印達林連看都沒看過我一眼。那個精靈完全沒有耐心。

original: It's probably for the best anyway; I'm far better at fishing than working in a meadery.
string: 不過這樣也好，跟釀蜜酒比起來，我更擅長捕魚。

original: Never mind. My mistake.
string: 沒關係。是我的錯。

original: I should say so.
string: 我也想這麼說的。

original: Next time think before you speak.
string: 下次說話之前，先經大腦過濾一下。

original: You've got some nerve.
string: 你有點動氣了。

original: Give it to me or else! (Intimidate)
string: 把它給我，否則！（威嚇）

original: Or else what? You don't scare me.
string: 否則怎樣？你嚇不了我。

original: You have a death wish or something?
string: 你是想死還是怎麼地？

original: You're threatening me? Oh, that's rich!
string: 你在威脅我嗎？噢，你得意什麼！

original: Hand it over and no one has to know. (Persuade)
string: 把它給我，其他人沒必要知道。（說服）

original: Hand what over? I have no idea what you're talking about.
string: 把什麼東西給你？我不知道你在說什麼？

original: Look, you must have me confused with someone else.
string: 聽著，你一定認錯人了。

original: You aren't making any sense. Hand what over?
string: 你沒講清楚。把什麼東西給你？

original: Look, it was one night, okay? I think she slipped something in my drink. I haven't even been back to the Bunkhouse since.
string: 聽著，就只有一晚而已，好嗎？她可能在我的酒裡下了藥。之後我就甚至就再也沒回過工棚了。

original: Just take this damn thing. I never want to see it again.
string: 把這該死的東西拿走吧。我再也不想看到這玩意兒了。

original: I don't want a bad reputation in Riften, but Haelga's out of control. She wanted to try it in the stables so I said yes.
string: 我不想在裂谷城丟了聲譽，不過哈爾嘉已經失控了。她說想在馬廄試試，於是我就同意了。

original: If you want the mark that badly then go ahead and take it.
string: 如果你真的那麼想要那個印記，就拿去吧。

original: If word gets around that I bedded her, they'll lose all respect for me at the meadery.
string: 如果傳出留言說我睡了她，那我在釀酒廠就沒法混了。

original: Take the mark if you want it. It's not worth all this hassle anyway.
string: 如果你想要就把這個印記拿去吧。就為了這東西，根本不值得爭吵。

original: Haelga gave you a Mark of Dibella. I want it.
string: 哈爾嘉把蒂貝拉的印記給了你。這東西我想要。

original: I have no idea what you're talking about. I'd never sleep with anyone besides my good wife, Drifa.
string: 我完全不知道你在說什麼？除了我的好老婆崔法，我從沒和其他女人上過床。

original: Huh? What are you talking about? I don't even know what that is.
string: 嗯？你在說什麼呢？我根本不知道那是什麼東西。

original: You're crazy! How dare you make such an accusation!
string: 你瘋了！你竟敢肆意誹謗！

original: I gave the marks to Haelga.
string: 我把印記給哈爾嘉了。

original: Oh I know. Isn't it wonderful? I bet she squirmed like a skeever when you pulled them out of your pocket.
string: 噢，我知道。這不是很好嗎？我打賭，當你把它們掏出口袋的時候，她一定不安的像只老鼠。

original: I think things are going to be a lot different around here from now on and I have you to thank for it.
string: 從此以後這裡的局勢將會大大改觀，因此我要好好謝謝你。

original: Here, I want you to have this. It was my father's but I'm certain you'll put it to good use.
string: 拿去，我希望你收下。這是我父親的，不過我相信你一定能好好利用它的。

original: I believe these are yours?
string: 這些是你的嗎？

original: What? How... where did you get these?
string: 什麼？怎麼會……你在哪兒找到的？

original: No, don't tell me. I don't want to know. Look, we need to keep this quiet... between you and me, okay. No one else needs to know about it.
string: 不，別告訴我。我不想知道。聽著，我們得保密……這是你我之間的秘密，對。其他人沒必要知道。

original: If word got out that I'm practicing my Dibellan Arts in Riften, they'll run me out of town.
string: 如果傳出留言說我在裂谷城經營蒂貝拉工藝品，他們肯定會把我趕出鎮子的。

original: Here, take this and don't mention a word of this to anyone, especially Svana!
string: 給你，收下吧，不過不要對任何人說起這事，特別是斯瓦納！

original: Maybe another time.
string: 也許下次吧。

original: Yeah, you're right. Maybe it's not the best idea.
string: 沒錯，你說得對。也許這不是個最好的主意。

original: Sure, I'll help you.
string: 沒問題，我會幫妳的。

original: Oh, this is going to be great!
string: 噢，這實在太棒了！

original: You need to get the Marks of Dibella from Bolli, Hofgrir and Indaryn. Not sure how you're going to do that, but try your best.
string: 你得從波利、霍夫吉爾還有印達林那裡拿回蒂貝拉的印記。雖然不知道到底該怎麼做，不過請你盡力吧。

original: Then just confront Haelga with them and the rest works itself out.
string: 然後就和哈爾嘉攤牌，剩下就任憑發展囉。

original: There must be a way.
string: 一定有辦法。

original: Actually, there is, but I don't think I could get away with doing it. She'd kill me if she found out.
string: 沒錯，一定有辦法，不過我認為我做了那種事情可以全身而退。如果她發現是我做的一定會把我給殺了。

original: You see, I happen to know after she makes love, she gives her partner a token of her affection called a Mark of Dibella.
string: 我偶然得知她在外面偷漢子，她還把蒂貝拉的印記送給了她的情人，以示愛意。

original: If you confront her with three of the Marks, she'd be so embarrassed... well, I don't know what she'd do!
string: 如果你將三枚印記與她當面對質，她一定會很尷尬……哎，不知道她到時候會怎麼做！

original: Why do you hate Haelga so much?
string: 妳為什麼這麼恨哈爾嘉呢？

original: It's not just the work, it's everything about her. She's disgusting. I think she takes her worship of Dibella a bit too seriously.
string: 不只是這份工作，我討厭任何有關她的一切。她真是令人作嘔。她把對蒂貝拉的信仰看得太重了。

original: Do you know she's slept with three different men in the last month alone? What kind of a woman would do such a thing?
string: 僅在上個月她就和三個男人上過床，你知道嗎？什麼樣的女人才會做出這種事情呢？

original: Just for once, I'd like to see her squirm... to rub her nose in it.
string: 一次就行，我想看到她局促不安的樣子……讓她陷入窘境。

original: Do you work here?
string: 你在這裡工作嗎？

original: Work? I suppose you can call it that. I call it slavery. I work my fingers to the bone keeping this disgusting place clean.
string: 工作？你可以這樣這麼說。不過我認為是這是奴役。我每天都拼命打掃才能把這嘔心的地方弄乾淨。

original: Ever since my parents died and Haelga took me in, it's been a nightmare. How was I to know she was such a wretched woman?
string: 自我父母雙亡接著哈爾嘉又帶我入贅她家之後，噩夢就開始了。我當初怎麼會知道她竟是一個如此骯髒的女人？

original: So now I'm stuck living here while those pigs she calls customers grope me and say the most awful things.
string: 於是現在我就倒楣的住在這裡，而她總會叫來一群豬頭——她把他們叫做客人——對我動手動腳，口裡則說著一些骯髒不堪的話語。

original: Any tips on who might accept these?
string: 知不知道誰能勝任此事？

original: Almost anyone in Riften is in dire need of those missives. Speak to them, child. You will know who will listen and who will sin.
string: 幾乎所有裂谷城人都迫切渴望這些書信。和他們說說話，孩子。你會知道哪些人願意傾聽而哪些人會露出嘴臉。

original: A word of advice, keep away from the Keep and the city guards. They follow their own path and have already forsaken Her.
string: 給你個建議，別去惹城堡還有城市的衛兵們。他們特立獨行慣了，而且早就拋棄了對她的信仰。

original: I can't help you with that.
string: 這事我幫不了你。

original: Such a shame. Perhaps another time then.
string: 太遺憾了。那就下一次吧。

original: What can you tell me about Mara?
string: 你有什麼關於瑪拉的消息可以告訴我嗎？

original: Mara is the handmaiden of Kyne, the Goddess of the Storm and the Mother of Men.
string: 瑪拉是風暴女神、凡人之母凱娜的侍女。

original: She is the bearer of love and the patron of marriage.
string: 她是愛情的傳遞者、婚姻的守護神。

original: If you wish to make a donation to her Benevolence, speak to Maramal and ensure your true love will endure for all eternity.
string: 如果你想為女神的仁慈奉上心意的話，去和瑪拉莫談談，還有你必須保證內心的真愛永存不滅。

original: What happened to the shrine of Talos?
string: 塔洛斯祭壇出了什麼事？

original: Now that the Imperial blight has poisoned Riften, the worship of Talos is strictly forbidden by the terms of the White-Gold Concordat.
string: 帝國雜種們玷污了裂谷城之後，他們就以白金協定的名義明令禁止了所有一切關於塔洛斯的信仰。

original: They can defile our shrine, they can arrest our people and they can silence our voices, but the Empire will never destroy our spirit.
string: 他們可以玷污我們的神殿，他們可以捕殺我們的人民，他們也可以鎮壓我們的心聲，但是帝國永遠消磨不掉我們的精神。

original: As long as we keep Talos in our heart, his legacy will never die.
string: 只要我們將塔洛斯緬懷於心，他遺留下來的恩澤就會永存。

original: He helped me escape from prison.
string: 他幫我從監獄裡逃了出來。

original: Did he, now? That doesn't sound like my nephew at all. I doubt he'd be mixed up with the likes of you.
string: 是嗎，怎麼做到的？聽起來不像是我的外甥能做到的。我懷疑他是不是勾搭上你了。

original: He's a friend. He promised you could help.
string: 他是一位朋友。他承諾你能幫上忙。

original: I'd be glad to help a friend of Hadvar. But you didn't answer my question - how do you know him?
string: 只要是哈達瓦的朋友，我都會幫忙。不過你還沒回答我的問題——你怎麼認識他的？

original: No, but I know how to find out. I need an Elder Scroll.
string: 不，不過我知道該怎麼去找。我需要一本上古卷軸。

original: An Elder Scroll? That's not going to be easy to come by.
string: 上古卷軸？這可不是說拿就能拿到的。

original: Esbern's your man for that kind of thing. He may be able to at least point you in the right direction.
string: 伊思本告訴你那東西的線索。至少他能幫你指明方向。

original: I talked to the Greybeards.
string: 我和灰鬍子談過了。

original: Were the Greybeards any help? Did they know this anything about the Shout used against Alduin?
string: 灰鬍子幫上忙了嗎？他們知道怎麼施展專門對付奧杜因的龍吼嗎？

original: Any idea where to find the Elder Scroll?
string: 知道該上哪去找上古卷軸嗎？

original: Ask Esbern. If he doesn't know himself, he'll know where to find it out.
string: 問問伊思本吧。就算他不知道具體地點，他也能指出個大致方向來。

original: Such blasphemies are the calling of mages, not followers of the Way.
string: 這種褻瀆的行為只有法師會知道，而非龍吼之道的追隨者。

original: Take your question to the College of Winterhold. They may be able to help you.
string: 帶著你的疑問去冬堡學院吧。他們應該能幫到你。

original: They die too quickly. Maybe I'll try and hold off on the paralysis next time. Give me more of a moving target. Good practice.
string: 他們太容易死了。或許下次我會試著用麻痺術拖一會。再給我來點移動的靶子。很適合訓練。

original: Ah, the sweet smell of burnt flesh. Nothing better really.
string: 啊，是肉燒焦的味道。真是好得不能再好了。

original: You better quiet down before you end up there. Then I'd have to work the forge.
string: 你最好安靜下來，否則就輪到你被送到下面去了。那樣一來，就得輪到我來管鍛爐了。

original: I work the forge.
string: 我掌管鍛爐。

original: Yeah, I don't know how I feel about what goes on down there.
string: 沒錯，我不知道該對下面發生的事報以什麼想法。

original: You work the forge.
string: 你掌管鍛爐。

original: I bet Naris gets a kick out it. Nasty fella he is.
string: 我打賭納利斯一定樂壞了。他就是這樣一個骯髒的傢伙。

original: I swear they're making me do this for a laugh. At least I'm not dealing with the prisoners down below.
string: 他們讓我這麼做完全是為了取笑我。不過至少我不用再和下面的犯人們打交道了。

original: Why do they need me to do this?  We use magic, not weapons.
string: 他們為什麼要我這麼做呢？我們用的是魔法，又不是武器。

original: They drink all day and night and what do I do?
string: 他們沒日沒夜的喝酒，而我呢？

original: Our vengeance will come.
string: 復仇之日早晚會到的。

original: Remember. It was the Nords who locked you up.
string: 記住了。把你囚禁起來的是諾德人。

original: Our struggle is our people's struggle.
string: 我們的掙扎就等於人民的掙扎。

original: Go on in, already.
string: 早就關進來了。

original: You're a slave. Just like us.
string: 你就是個奴隸。和我們沒什麼區別。

original: Do you remember the sun? Because you'll forget. Soon.
string: 還記得太陽長什麼樣嗎？你很快就會忘記的。很快。

original: You're back. Have you done what I asked?
string: 你回來了。我吩咐的事情你都辦好了嗎？

original: People are having bad dreams?
string: 人民生活在水深火熱之中嗎？

original: Not a single man or woman in Dawnstar has gotten a good night's rest in days. We keep having the same nightmare, over and over.
string: 沒有一個晨星城的百姓能睡上一個安穩覺。我們日復一日遭受著噩夢的困擾。

original: If people aren't tired, they're angry, and if they aren't angry, they're afraid. It's made keeping order a mess.
string: 就算人民沒有疲倦，他們也生氣了，就算他們沒生氣，他們也害怕了。這樣下去，想要維持秩序就成了空談。

original: I hear Mara has sent one of her priests to the inn to try to calm people down, but I don't know how much words will do now.
string: 聽說瑪拉派了一名祭司到這裡的客棧來，想要安撫百姓。不過最近的流言沒多少是可信的。

original: I came at a bad time? What's wrong?
string: 我到的不是時候？發生了什麼事？

original: That's right. Dawnstar. My Dawnstar is plagued with nightmares. I haven't slept properly in days.
string: 沒錯。晨星城出事了。現在我的晨星城全城都陷入了噩夢之中。我都已經好幾天沒能好好睡上一覺了。

original: That priest of Mara who came here before you says the Divines will cure us.
string: 瑪拉的祭司在你說之前就到了，他們會拯救我們的。

original: Well, until they do, I don't have any business to discuss with outsiders.
string: 好吧，在他們成功之前，我也沒必要和外來人說三道四的。

original: Nightmare problem?
string: 噩夢？

original: You haven't heard? All of Dawnstar hasn't had a decent night's rest in days.
string: 你沒聽說嗎？整個晨星城已經好幾天沒能過上一個安穩的夜晚了。

original: People are having nightmares they swear are real. They go to bed, but they wake up more tired than yesterday.
string: 人民遭受著真正的噩夢。人們一覺醒來，卻發現身子比昨日更加疲憊。

original: I've heard that a priest of Mara has come, saying that the Divines will lift this curse somehow, but that remains to be seen.
string: 我聽說瑪拉的祭司已經到了，說是祭司們會驅除這個詛咒的，不過是真是假還尚未可知。

original: What's this about nightmares?
string: 噩夢是怎麼回事？

original: Nightmares. I haven't met a single man or woman who doesn't admit to having them.
string: 是噩夢。所有人都無不承認他們遭受著噩夢的困擾。

original: A bad dream I can handle, but everyone having the same bad dream, every night? It's a curse, I say.
string: 如果是我獨自一人承受噩夢，那說明不了什麼，可是人人都做著同樣的噩夢，每日每夜的？那就應該是詛咒了。

original: I hear there's a priest of Mara visiting the inn. Maybe the Divines will cure us.
string: 我聽說瑪拉的祭司來客棧了。或許祭司們可以拯救我們。

original: No one's getting any rest? Why not?
string: 沒人能好好休息？怎麼會呢？

original: It's these nightmares. Me and every one of my workers can't catch a nod without having one.
string: 是噩夢搗的鬼。我和工人們就連打個瞌睡都會做噩夢。

original: They're almost... real. They say a priest of Mara has arrived in town. We'll see if faith can cure this curse.
string: 這些噩夢非常的……逼真。人們說瑪拉的祭司已經到了小鎮。我們要見證一下我們所信仰的神靈能否拯救我們免於詛咒。

original: Why aren't you getting much sleep?
string: 那你為什麼不好好睡覺呢？

original: New in town? You're lucky. Dreams aren't affecting travelers.
string: 新來的？你太幸運了。噩夢對外來者無效。

original: Everyone else though.... They're horrible. Imagine dying over and over again in your dreams night after night.
string: 其他人就沒那麼幸運了……噩夢非常可怕。想像一下每個夜晚都要在夢中經歷一次又一次的死亡。

original: They say a priest of Mara is visiting the Windpeak Inn. Says the Divines will take care of everything. We'll see about that.
string: 人們說瑪拉的祭司來風岳客棧了。據說祭司們會處理這事的。我們拭目以待。

original: Something for bad dreams?
string: 是因為噩夢嗎？

original: Everyone here is having nightmares. I have miners tripping over their own feet from lack of sleep.
string: 這裡的每一個人都飽受噩夢困擾。由於缺少睡眠，我的礦工們常常自己絆倒自己。

original: I heard there was a Priest of Mara who was supposed to be looking into it. We'll see if anything comes of that.
string: 我聽說瑪拉的祭司會處理這事的。我們拭目以待吧。

original: "No rest in Dawnstar"?
string: 「晨星城不眠夜」？

original: I'll need an Elder Scroll to get any further.
string: 要進一步下去，我需要一本上古卷軸。

original: Ah, indeed? There's a pretty puzzle. Not the kind of thing you'll find in your local bookshop. Let me think...
string: 啊，是嗎？這有點麻煩啊。那可不是隨隨便便就能在書店裡買到的東西。讓我想想……

original: Perhaps the College of Winterhold. What learning there is in Skyrim is gathered there.
string: 也許在冬堡學院會有線索。天際所有的知識與檔案都彙聚在那裡。

original: One of the mages there may be able to put you on the trail of this Elder Scroll.
string: 那裡的法師說不定可以幫你找到上古卷軸的線索。

original: Ah, indeed. Well there's a pretty puzzle. Not the kind of thing you'll find in your local bookshop. I'm sure you'll manage, though.
string: 啊啊，確實。這可是個謎啊。不是那種在書店裡隨便就能找到的東西。但我確定你可以找出來。

original: I'll need an Elder Scroll to get any further. I'm working on locating it.
string: 我需要上古卷軸，才能取得下一步進展。我現在正在找它。

original: I talked to the Greybeards.
string: 我和灰鬍子談過了。

original: Ah, you're back. I hope you've made some progress on tracking down this Shout we need to defeat Alduin?
string: 啊，你回來了。但願你找到了龍吼線索，我們需要利用龍吼才能擊敗奧杜因。

original: He needs to die. He deserves to die. And it falls to you to kill him.
string: 牠必須死。牠該死。殺了牠的重任就交給你了。

original: Until he's dead... well, I'm sorry, but we would dishonor our oaths as Blades if we continued to help you.
string: 直到牠死……呃…很抱歉，如果我們持續幫你的話，我們就會違背刀鋒衛士的誓言。

original: The Blades have been hunting him for centuries, but he was protected by the Greybeards and then the Emperors.
string: 刀鋒衛士已經追捕牠好幾個世紀了，不過牠被灰鬍子和歷代的君王保護。

original: Justice demands that he die for his crimes. Until he is dead, I'm afraid my oath as a Blade prevents me from offering you aid and comfort.
string: 就牠所犯下的惡行，牠理應以死贖罪。除非牠死了，否則以我作為一名刀鋒衛士所發下的誓言，我目前恐怕還不能來幫你。

original: Turns out he's a dragon. But he helped me.
string: 牠是條龍。不過牠幫了我。

original: That's fine. We needed his help. Now we don't, and it's long past time for him to pay for his crimes.
string: 很好。我們以前需要過牠的幫助。不過現在不需要了，牠早就該為牠犯下的罪受罰。

original: And he's not just any dragon. He was the right hand of Alduin.
string: 牠並不是什麼普通的龍。牠可是奧杜因的左右手。

original: He committed atrocities so infamous they are still remembered, thousands of years later.
string: 千年之後，牠曾經臭名昭著的暴行依然為人所知。

original: All well and good. But did you know that he was Alduin's chief lieutenant in ancient times? Responsible for terrible atrocities?
string: 很好很好。不過牠在上古時代，是奧杜因的副手，你知道嗎？牠曾犯下恐怖的暴行。

original: It's true that his crimes are long in the past, but justice does not count the passage of years.
string: 牠犯下的罪確實是很久之前的事了，但是任時間流逝，正義永不滅。

original: You know... what?
string: 你知道……什麼？

original: Paarthurnax. The dragon, that the Greybeards have been protecting for all these years.
string: 帕圖納克斯。那頭受灰鬍子庇護多年的龍。

original: He's a dragon. Not just any dragon, but the right hand of Alduin, responsible for many atrocities during the ancient Dragon War.
string: 牠是條龍。不過並不是普通的龍，而是奧杜因的左右手，牠在上古巨龍戰爭中犯下了種種暴行。

original: You've discovered... what?
string: 你發現了……什麼？

original: What about Paarthurnax?
string: 那帕圖納克斯是誰？

original: There's one more thing. We know about Paarthurnax.
string: 還有另一件事。我們知道帕圖納克斯的事。

original: I'm afraid there's a further problem. A serious one. I've discovered who the Greybeards' leader really is.
string: 恐怕接下來又有一個問題。比較嚴重的問題。我知道了誰是灰鬍子的頭領。

original: I'm afraid there's a problem. A serious one. I've discovered who the Greybeards' leader really is.
string: 恐怕接下來又有一個問題。比較嚴重的問題。我知道了誰是灰鬍子的頭領。

original: It's done. Paarthurnax is dead.
string: 結束了。帕圖納克斯死了。

original: I knew we could count on you! Glad to have you back on our side.
string: 我就知道要指望你！很高興看到你回來。

original: At long last. An ancient evil is avenged. The shades of many Blades salute you this day.
string: 終於。上古惡魔被終結了。刀鋒衛士默默向你致敬。

original: About Paarthurnax...
string: 關於帕圖納克斯……

original: Have you decided to do the right thing, Dragonborn?
string: 你決定去做這件正義之舉了嗎，龍裔？

original: I wish there were another way, Dragonborn, but it falls to you to serve justice upon Paarthurnax.
string: 但願還有其他的辦法，龍裔，不過還是得靠你來給予帕圖納克斯最終的審判。

original: Make your choice, Dragonborn. You're either with us or against us.
string: 做出選擇吧，龍裔。你要站在我們這一邊還是要與我們對立。

original: Justice can be harsh. But it is still justice. Paarthurnax deserves to die.
string: 就算不擇手段，也要替天行道。這仍是正義。帕圖納克斯理應受死。

original: Forget it! It could kill me!
string: 算了吧！它可能會害我送命！

original: No, all my research points in the opposite direction. This is the exact liquid the priests would drink.
string: 不，我所有的調查都顯示相反的答案。而這肯定是當時祭司們喝的東西。

original: The only question in my mind is whether you will be granted The Dreamstride. Otherwise, the worst that could happen is a bad aftertaste.
string: 我唯一的疑問就是你能否被賜予夢中漫步。如果不能，最糟糕的結果不過就是喝起來很難喝而已。

original: I swear upon Lady Mara that I would never let any harm befall you.
string: 我向聖母瑪拉發誓，不會讓你受到任何傷害。

original: Sounds dangerous. How can you be certain?
string: 聽起來很危險。你怎麼能這麼確定？

original: I will not lie to you, there is some risk involved. The last time the Torpor was imbibed could have been decades ago.
string: 我不會對你撒謊，確實有些風險。上一次出現能完全吸收睡眠藥水的人已經是好幾十年以前的事了。

original: But I swear upon Lady Mara that I will do everything within my power to prevent any harm from befalling you.
string: 但我向聖母瑪拉發誓，會竭盡所能讓你不受傷害。

original: I'm going to be your test subject, then?
string: 那麼，你要我來當你的實驗品嗎？

original: As a sworn priest of Mara, the elixir won't work for me. The Torpor will only work for Priests of Vaermina, or the unaffiliated.
string: 作為一名效忠瑪拉的祭司，這種藥水對我是起不了作用的。睡眠藥水只對瓦爾迷納的祭司或沒有信仰的人有效。

original: That's amazing!
string: 太不可思議了！

original: Quite amazing, yes. Alchemy and the blessings of a Divine distilled down into a ingestible liquid.
string: 不可思議，是的。祭司的賜福與鍊金術的奧秘被提取成一種可以吸收的液體。

original: Sadly, I have yet to see it function in person.
string: 可惜的是，我還從沒看到過它在人身上起效。

original: That's impossible.
string: 那不可能。

original: I assure you, the Dreamstride is well known in Vaerminian Lore.
string: 我保證，夢中漫步在瓦爾迷納的相關傳說中很有名。

original: Sadly, I have yet to see it function in person.
string: 可惜的是，我還從沒看到過它在人身上起效。

original: Is that some type of potion?
string: 那是某種藥水？

original: Yes. The Torpor grants an ability the priests of Vaermina called "The Dreamstride"; using dreams to travel distances in the real world.
string: 是的。睡眠藥水賦予瓦爾迷納的祭司一種叫做「夢中漫步」的能力：利用夢境在現實世界內穿行。

original: Why does he need to die?
string: 牠為什麼得死？

original: Here's the big picture. He helped Alduin enslave our ancestors. He may have betrayed Alduin in the end, but that makes him worse, not better.
string: 事情是這樣的。牠幫奧杜因奴役了我們的祖先。雖然最終牠背叛了奧杜因，不過這非但沒有為其洗清罪名，反而更顯露了牠的醜陋。

original: We can't afford to give Paarthurnax the opportunity to betray us in turn, and return to his old master.
string: 我們可不能給帕圖納克斯背叛我們重歸舊主的機會。

original: Paarthurnax was the author of many atrocities during the Dragon War - crimes great enough to be remembered for thousands of years.
string: 帕圖納克斯是巨龍戰爭中多種暴行的罪魁禍首——這些罪行足以遺臭萬年。

original: True, he turned traitor to Alduin and helped overthrow the Dragon Cult, but that does not excuse or expiate his previous deeds.
string: 沒錯，牠背叛了奧杜因並且幫助推翻了拜龍教，但這也無法赦免牠之前所犯下的罪行。

original: Whether or not he has truly repented, or merely acted to save himself, justice demands that he pay with his life.
string: 不管他有沒有懺悔其罪行或是行善贖罪，正義都將取其性命以替天行道。

original: Job's done, Brynjolf.
string: 任務完成了，布林喬夫。

original: You have wax in your ears? I said no one dies. We're not assassins.
string: 你耳朵進水了嗎？我說沒有人死。我們又不是刺客。

original: Well guess what... now you've inherited their debt. Don't come back to me until you have every last coin.
string: 啊，你猜怎麼了……現在你繼承了他們的債務。錢沒湊齊，別來找我。

original: So I've heard. Thanks to you, this should be the last time they forget to pay.
string: 我聽說了。多虧了你，他們再也不敢不還錢了。

original: One small detail though - I need all of the gold they gave you. No one skims around here. Come back when you've got every last coin.
string: 不過還有一個細節——他們給你的金幣，我全都要拿回來。這裡沒人能逃債。等你湊齊了錢，再來找我。

original: You make one move towards my skooma, and I shiv you.
string: 你再敢靠近我的斯庫瑪一步，我就砍了你。

original: Have any skooma? I need to get something from Grisvar.
string: 有斯庫瑪嗎？我要去格利斯瓦那裡拿點貨。

original: Some day, brother. Some day.
string: 改天吧，哥們。改天吧。

original: Nearly broke my back out in the mines today. Damn Nords should bleed for putting us through this!
string: 今天差點在礦坑裡撞斷了腰。該死的諾德人必須為此付出代價！

original: They keep the doors locked when they come down. You kill them, you're trapping us here with no food.
string: 例如他們一下來就把門都鎖死？如果你殺了他們，會讓我們斷了糧食啊。

original: Think maybe we should jump the guards when they come down next?
string: 或許下一次衛兵們來的時候，我們可以來個突襲？

original: Ah, it's not been more than a few days since they came down the last time.
string: 啊，他們上一次來都是好幾天以前的事了。

original: Think the guards will be coming down, soon?
string: 覺得衛兵們快來了嗎？

original: Why keep it a secret?
string: 為什麼要保密？

original: When the orcs invaded the temple, I fled. I left my brothers and sisters here to die.
string: 當獸人入侵神殿的時候，我逃跑了。我把兄弟姐妹們丟在這裡送死。

original: I have all your items for you.
string: 我把妳的東西都找齊了。

original: Items? What items? Let me see those.
string: 哦？什麼東西？給我看看。

original: Hmm. I'm not sure how you managed it, but these are exactly what I need to start my next set of experiments. Wonderful!
string: 恩。雖然我不知道你是怎麼弄到手的，不過這些正是我所需要的，有了這些我就能開始下一步實驗了。好極了！

original: Well, at least allow me to reward you for your uncanny foresight.
string: 好吧，至少讓我獎勵一下你那非凡的遠見吧。

original: Where exactly am I going?
string: 我到底要去哪兒？

original: Let's see. Last time I used the Dwemer Spoon was at my dear friend Boti's house in Ivarstead... Fellstar Farm I believe it's called.
string: 看。我上次用矮人攪拌匙的時候是在紫杉鎮，我好朋友伯蒂的家裡……落星農場吧好像是。

original: The orichalcum ingot should still be in Winterhold at the Frozen Hearth Inn. I don't know why I didn't just take it with me.
string: 那個星隕石錠應該還在冬堡的凍爐客棧裡。我實在不明白我怎麼沒把它帶走。

original: And last is the soul gem. I left that one in Windhelm at the White Phial alchemy shop. It was a good trade too. Ah well.
string: 最後一件是靈魂石。我把它賣給風舵城的雪瓶鍊金店了。倒是賣了個好價錢，啊哈。

original: I suppose I could lend a hand.
string: 我可以幫忙。

original: My services aren't free.
string: 我可不提供免費服務。

original: Sorry, I'm not interested.
string: 抱歉，我不感興趣。

original: Trouble?
string: 有麻煩嗎？

original: What's going on here?
string: 這裡怎麼啦？

original: Maybe some other time.
string: 也許改天吧。

original: A shame. Perhaps another time then.
string: 很遺憾。那就下次吧。

original: Point the way and I'll get them.
string: 給我個方向，我去把它們給找來。

original: Excellent. I can't wait.
string: 好極了。我等不及了。

original: Well... why are you still standing here? Oh, right. You need to know where they are! That would help.
string: 呃……你還站在這裡做什麼？噢，對了。你還不知道他們在哪！這個應該有幫助。

original: What did you need me to get?
string: 妳要我去找什麼？

original: As you can imagine, I tend to forget things often. Leave things around. I really must learn to put these things away.
string: 正如你想的那樣，我常常忘東忘西的，把東西到處亂丟。我真得學會讓自己不再發生類似的事情。

original: What I need is my Dwemer Stirring Spoon, my Orichalcum Ingot and my Grand Soul Gem. In fact, I could use them immediately.
string: 我要找回我的矮人攪拌匙、我的星隕石錠還有我的特大靈魂石。事實上，我馬上就要用到它們了。

original: Bring those items back to me and I'll be happy to experiment on you. No, no... that isn't right. I'd be happy to reward you.
string: 把這幾樣東西帶回來給我，我會很樂意在你身上試驗一下的……不，不……不對。我會很樂意報償你的。

original: Uh... why don't we talk about this later?
string: 呃……我們以後再談這事行嗎？

original: I just think pollinating would be easier if I could do a lot of plants at once.
string: 我只是覺得要是一次性多種點植物，就能有利於傳粉。

original: Half the field? What could need half the field?
string: 整塊地的一半？什麼東西需要這麼大地方？

original: Oh, half the field should do.
string: 噢，整塊地的一半吧。

original: That should be all right. How much space were you planning?
string: 那應該可以。你計劃用多大的地？

original: You know, I was thinking of expanding the herb garden. Make room for some new plants I'm planning.
string: 我正計劃著把花園擴大一點。給一些新植物騰出點地方。

original: I told you I don't like you going there. I've seen scavengers picking at the mammoths. They could be dangerous.
string: 我跟你說過你最好別去那裡。我見過拾荒者在挖長毛象的遺骸。很危險。

original: I had a look at that boneyard the other day, Vantus. The one to the Northwest.
string: 我曾經看過那墓地，萬圖斯。西北邊那個。

original: You appear to need help getting organized.
string: 妳看起來需要幫助。

original: Yes, I could use some help with that. An assistant perhaps? No, no, no. Maybe a familiar. No, too messy.
string: 是啊，我的確需要。來個助手？不，不，還是找個熟人吧。算了，太麻煩了。

original: Well, at any rate, organization is not my strong suit. Not at all. I need as much help as I can get.
string: 嗯，反正整理東西又不是我的長項。我需要有人能夠盡量幫幫我。

original: In fact, if you could retrieve a few things for me, I could start on my next set of experiments.
string: 實際上，如果你能幫我找些東西，我就能繼續我的實驗了。

original: Nope, don't get it at all.
string: 沒，完全不懂。

original: What's not to get? It's as simple as Traven's First Axiom of Magic... or was it Galerion's Law of Casting. Hmm.
string: 有什麼不懂的？這就和特拉文的魔法學第一定理……還有加裡昂的施法守則一樣簡單。

original: I'll tell you what, let me find out where that's from. I'll need to look through my library... and get you an answer.
string: 我這樣說吧，讓我搞清那東西的來龍去脈。我得去圖書館查下資料……然後就能給你個答案。

original: Umm... what were we talking about?
string: 嗯……我們剛才在說什麼呢？

original: You totally lost me.
string: 我徹底被妳搞暈了。

original: I'll tell you why you won't tell me. Because you were absolutely right not to.
string: 我來告訴你為什麼你不肯告訴我。因為你根本就沒這個打算。

original: It's a fundamental rule of magic and it would be ridiculous. You can't draw from harmonic energy without a soul siphon.
string: 這是個很基本的魔法學原理，而且很荒唐。你不用魂路就無法汲取泛能量。

original: Since you're so well informed I'm certain you've solved the problem with thermic drift, right?
string: 既然你如此瞭解，那你肯定已經用熱能流把問題解決了吧，是嗎？

original: I don't understand a word of that.
string: 我一個字都不懂。

original: You don't have to, because it's utter nonsense. It's never going to work.
string: 你不用懂，因為這只是胡扯而已。永遠也實現不了的。

original: No, no, no. What I need to do is to reverse that. Draw the harmonic energy into the reagent and then apply it with the proper incantation.
string: 不、不、不。我只要將這過程倒轉，把泛能量導入藥劑中，然後念出正確的咒語。

original: What was I thinking? It would never work that first way. Why didn't you tell me?
string: 我在想什麼？這一開始就不可能成功。你為什麼不告訴我？

original: What has you so preoccupied?
string: 妳聚精會神在幹什麼呢？

original: Someone actually interested in what I'm doing? Amazing! Well, allow me to explain.
string: 終於有人對我的研究感興趣了嗎？太棒了！讓我來為你解釋一下。

original: My experimentation involves a magical construct and a reagent that will allow the construct to maintain a field of permanent harmonic energy!
string: 我的實驗包括一個魔法裝置和一種藥劑，能用它永久保留泛能量場！

original: I gave the dagger to Andurs.
string: 我把匕首給了安度爾斯。

original: I felt a caress on my cheek some time ago... I thought it to be a trick of the wind, but I think it was a message from my father.
string: 幾天前我感覺臉頰似乎被輕輕拂過……我還以為是風。現在我知道，那是父親傳達給我的訊息。

original: We've made peace with one another without even uttering a single word and I'm content for the first time in my life.
string: 我們之間沒有用語言就和解了，這也是我一生中第一次感到釋然。

original: I thank you. Here, please accept this as a token of my appreciation for your selfless action.
string: 非常感謝。請收下這禮物，就當是我對你無私行為的感激。

original: Good luck with that.
string: 祝妳好運。

original: Yes. Perhaps one day I'll be able to make the journey, but for now I need to tend the dead.
string: 嗯，也許有一天我能踏上旅途，但現在我得照看往生者。

original: I can bring it for you.
string: 我可以幫妳帶過去。

original: I hadn't asked you because I was afraid you'd say no. I appreciate your help.
string: 我怕你拒絕所以就沒問你。多謝你的幫助。

original: Here, I'm entrusting you with the dagger. Bring it to Andurs and he'll take care of the rest.
string: 給你，我把這匕首託付給你了。把它帶給安度爾斯，由他接手。

original: How can you make peace with your father?
string: 你想怎麼和你父親和解？

original: I'd like to make the journey to the Hall of the Dead in Windhelm and give my ceremonial dagger to Andurs, the caretaker.
string: 我想去風舵城的亡者之廳，把儀式匕首帶給看守者安度爾斯。

original: I believe once it's interred with my father's remains I'll be at peace with his memory.
string: 我想只要能把匕首埋在我父親的遺體邊，他就能安然長眠。

original: How's your father to blame for your job?
string: 為什麼你因為這份工作責怪你父親？

original: My father was a Priest of Arkay. All my life was spent around the dead, being forced to learn the proper burial rituals and prayers.
string: 我父親是阿爾凱的祭司。我一輩子都在死者身邊工作，被迫學習正統的葬禮儀式和禱詞。

original: I never had any friends; who'd want to spend time with "the little weird girl who hangs around dead people?"
string: 我從來就沒有朋友，誰願意和一個「老是待在死人身邊」的小女孩玩？

original: So I grew up with a miserable trade. This is all I know how to do... prepare and inter the deceased.
string: 於是我就這樣悲慘地成長。準備和舉行葬禮……這是我唯一會做的事。

original: You tend the graveyard?
string: 妳看管墓地？

original: If you're trying to ask if I tend the hall of the dead alone, then the answer is yes.
string: 如果你是想問我是不是獨自看守亡者之廳，的確是。

original: You think anyone around here is going to lift a shovel to help me? Guess again. "Leave the dirty work to old Alessandra."
string: 你以為這裡會有誰會拿著鏟子來幫我？別作夢了，「把髒活留給老艾利桑德拉。」

original: Look, I didn't ask for this job, I got stuck with it thanks to my father.
string: 我可不是自討苦吃，這可是拜我父親所賜。

original: Oh, Faida. I may travel alone, but you know I carry you always in my heart. I'll see you soon.
string: 噢、菲達。我也許是獨自上路，但請記住，我一直都會想著妳。我們很快就能再相見的。

original: Well, this is it, then. Look after yourself, Gaius. You're doing your duty, and I'm proud of you. But you'd better come back to me. You hear?
string: 嗯，那就這樣吧。照顧好你自己，加留斯。你盡你的職責，我感到很驕傲。但你一定要回到我身邊，知道嗎？

original: Farewell, father. I'll return as soon as I'm able.
string: 再見了，父親。我會儘快回來的。

original: Son, when the Emperor's safety is concerned, anything could go wrong. Off with you, now. And good travels.
string: 孩子，當事關皇帝的安危時，要處處小心。起程吧，一路順風。

original: I understand. But you're being paranoid. I'm inspecting security, not charging off into battle. There's not a lot that can go wrong.
string: 我懂，但你有點過度緊張了。我只負責查驗安全，又不是衝鋒陷陣，哪有多少危險。

original: I know you will. But all the same, remember everything I said. Stay alert, and when you get to the cities, make your observations and move on.
string: 我知道。但你還是要記住我說的一切，保持警惕。在城裡要謹慎行事。

original: Father, you worry too much. I'll be fine.
string: 父親，你擔心過度了。我會平安的。

original: No, so your best plan is to follow him after he leaves Dragon Bridge. However, there is one other option...
string: 不，所以你的最佳選擇就是跟著他離開龍橋鎮。

original: We know there's an actual written travel schedule, somewhere in the Penitus Oculatus outpost. Securing that would, obviously, be most beneficial...
string: 我們知道在洞察之眼哨站有一份行程表，在那裡找看看也許能有所收穫。

original: Do you know Gaius Maro's schedule?
string: 你知道加留斯．馬洛的行程表嗎？

original: Yes. Do not kill Gaius Maro in Dragon Bridge, or on the road. Kill him in one of the other major cities he'll be visiting.
string: 嗯。別在龍橋鎮或半路上殺死加留斯．馬洛，等到他造訪其他城市時再下手。

original: There, the body will be discovered quickly, as will the letter implicating Gaius Maro and the Stormcloaks in the Emperor's assassination.
string: 如此一來屍體和那封信將會很快被發現，大家就會相信加留斯．馬洛和風暴斗篷共同秘謀刺殺皇帝。

original: Do that, and Astrid has authorized me to grant you a rather unique bonus. It is a special token, to be given to Olava the Feeble, in Whiterun.
string: 做到這一點的話，阿斯垂德要我把一個獨特的東西交給你。是一個特殊的物件，本來是要給虛妄的「軟腳蝦」奧拉瓦的。

original: Olava is an old and dear friend, and a powerful seer. The token entitles you to a reading of your future. It's an opportunity one should not pass up.
string: 奧拉瓦是一個上了年紀的好朋友，也是個強大的預言家。這個物件讓你可以預知你的未來，這對每個人來說都是不可錯過的好機會。

original: Is there any way to earn a bonus?
string: 有什麼方法能得到額外獎勵嗎？

original: DB06GabriellaDragonBridgeBranchTopic
string: DB06GabriellaDragonBridgeBranchTopic

original: It's a small town, with one rather unique feature - it houses Skyrim's only Penitus Oculatus outpost.
string: 那是個小鎮，特點在於——它擁有全天際唯一的洞察之眼哨站。

original: It was established by Commander Maro when he first arrived in Skyrim, several months ago. When he began preparing for the Emperor's initial visit.
string: 那是由指揮官馬洛幾個月前第一次到天際時所建，當時他正籌備皇帝的初次訪問。

original: Tell me about Dragon Bridge.
string: 告訴我關於龍橋鎮的事。

original: Yes, the World-Eater is gone... may the spirits have mercy on our souls.
string: 是啊，世界吞噬者已經消失了……但願我們的靈魂得到寬恕。

original: It worked... you did it...
string: 成功了……你辦到了……

original: Hold, Alduin on the Wing! Sister Hawk, grant us your sacred breath to make this contract heard!
string: 堅持住，別讓奧杜因飛走！鷹之姐妹，賜我們力量落實這神契吧！

original: It's no use! Use the Scroll, Felldir! Now!
string: 不行了！用卷軸，費迪爾！快！

original: Skyrim will be free!
string: 天際會得到自由！

original: Let those that watch from Sovngarde envy us this day!
string: 讓那些在英靈殿的人嫉妒我們吧！

original: So be it.
string: 那就這樣吧。

original: We shall see soon enough. Alduin approaches!
string: 很快就會見分曉了，奧杜因正在接近！

original: You do not understand. Alduin cannot be slain like a lesser dragon. He is beyond our strength.
string: 你不懂，奧杜因可不是什麼次級龍類，我們殺不了牠。

original: I never agreed. And if you are right, I will not need it.
string: 我從沒同意過，而且如果你是對的，我就不需要它。

original: No. We will deal with Alduin ourselves, here and now.
string: 不。我們將自己面對奧杜因，就在此時此地。

original: Felldir! We agreed not to use it!
string: 費迪爾！我們說過不要使用它！

original: They did not have Dragonrend. Once we bring him down, I promise I will have his head.
string: 他們沒有「龍魂撕裂」。只要我們把牠抓來地面，我保證會把牠頭砍下來。

original: But none have yet stood against Alduin himself. Galthor, Sorri, Birkir...
string: 但沒人能獨自面對奧杜因。加托爾，索莉，比爾吉爾……

original: We've bloodied him well. Four of his kin have fallen to my blade alone this day.
string: 我們已經狠狠教訓牠了。光是今天牠就有四個同類死於我劍下。

original: He will come. He cannot ignore our defiance. And why should he fear us, even now?
string: 牠會來的，牠無法忽視我們的挑戰。而且牠有什麼理由害怕我們？即便是現在。

original: Why does Alduin hang back? We've staked everything on this plan of yours, old man.
string: 為什麼奧杜因退卻了？我們已經在你的這個計劃上孤注一擲了，老頭。

original: If it does to you, dear, that's all that matters.
string: 只要對你而言有意義就行。

original: No, I'm sorry. I'll just... I'll know it if I find it. Does that make sense?
string: 不，我很抱歉。我會……如果我找到它我會知道的。這有意義嗎？

original: All right, can you describe it to me?
string: 行。你能跟我描述一下嗎？

original: I... I'm not sure. I think perhaps, but I don't know what it is.
string: 我……我不確定。我覺得可能吧，但我不知道那是什麼？

original: Is there something you need, dear?
string: 你需要什麼，親愛的？

original: Who are the Forsworn?
string: 誰是棄誓者？

original: Before the Nords came, we worshipped the old gods, had our own kingdom.
string: 在諾德人來之前，我們信奉舊神，擁有自己的王國。

original: Times have been good and bad since then, but some folks couldn't handle not ruling their own land. Those are the Forsworn.
string: 在那之後幾經曲折，但有些人不能忍受自己的土地受別人控制，他們就是棄誓者。

original: The Forsworn follow the old ways, but some of those were best forgotten. Blood sacrifices, communing with Daedra. It's the road to ruin.
string: 棄誓者有著古老的傳統，不過有些東西真的該忘掉。那些血祭啊，與魔族溝通什麼的，都是自取滅亡啊。

original: What's the Markarth Incident?
string: 什麼是馬卡斯城事件？

original: It's the whole reason Ulfric revolted against the Empire. Well, the first reason anyway.
string: 那是烏弗瑞克掀起針對帝國的叛亂的原因。至少是最主要的原因。

original: Forsworn had taken over Markarth, and Ulfric and his men drove them out. Empire promised they'd be free to worship Talos afterwards.
string: 棄誓者奪取了馬卡斯城，烏弗瑞克帶領手下將他們驅趕出去。帝國承諾會允許他們自由信奉塔洛斯。

original: Pity no one told the Elves. Whole group of those Thalmor came and they demanded Ulfric's arrest.
string: 但是精靈們不知道這一點。梭默的一群精靈隨後到來，要求逮捕烏弗瑞克。

original: Who's in charge of Markarth?
string: 是誰負責馬卡斯城？

original: That would be Jarl Igmund. Young for a ruler of a Hold, especially the Reach.
string: 依格蒙德領主，他當領地的統治者還是太年輕，特別是在邊塞這破地方。

original: Wasn't surprising he stayed loyal to the Empire. His father helped capture Ulfric Stormcloak after the Markarth Incident.
string: 他對帝國的忠誠是意料之中的。他父親在馬卡斯城事件後幫助逮捕了烏弗瑞克。

original: Since the Stormcloaks took over, Jarl Thongvor is in charge.
string: 在風暴斗篷接管後，就由松瓦領主管理。

original: It'll be lean times for the Reach with a Silver-Blood ruling it, that's for certain.
string: 邊塞在銀血的統治下，生活必定會變得很艱困。

original: What can you tell me about Markarth?
string: 關於馬卡斯城你能告訴我什麼？

original: Don't fall.
string: 別摔倒。

original: Sorry, I can't help.
string: 抱歉，我幫不了你。

original: Oh alright.  Well I'll be here for a bit if you change your mind.
string: 好吧。要是你改變主意了就回來。

original: What's in it for me?
string: 那我能得到什麼好處呢？

original: You can have anything except the scroll of course.
string: 你可以隨便要什麼，除了卷軸。

original: I'll help.
string: 我會幫忙的。

original: Great, with the two of us this should be easy.
string: 太棒了，有兩個人就容易得多。

original: What kind of help do you need?
string: 你想要什麼幫助？

original: If Vokun is as powerful as I think, I may need a little help um ... dealing ...with him.
string: 要是沃坤和我想的一樣強大，我就需要幫助來……對付他。

original: Help with what?
string: 怎麼幫？

original: I've finally located Vokun's crypt! The scroll I'm looking for just has to be here.
string: 我終於找到了沃坤的地穴！我要找的卷軸肯定就在這裡。

original: Who are you?
string: 你是誰？

original: I'm Anska.  Are you here to help?
string: 我是安斯卡。你是來幫忙的？

original: "Bent a few folks' arms the wrong way"?
string: 觸怒了一些當地人?

original: That's right. Whole group of the natives called the Forsworn rose up against the Nords. Drove them out.
string: 對。一群自稱棄誓者的當地人起兵反抗諾德人。將他們驅逐。

original: Then Ulfric Stormcloak came with his militia. That must have been a sight to see, him shouting folks to death.
string: 然後烏弗瑞克風暴斗篷帶著軍隊過來了。那場景肯定極為慘烈，一場屠殺。

original: You'd think that'd be the end of it, but those Forsworn are still in the hills, and they're as wild as wolves.
string: 你肯定以為棄誓者們就這樣完了，但他們仍然住在山間，像狼一樣充滿野性。

original: Dwarves built this city?
string: 這城由矮人建造？

original: That's right, at least according to them scholars. Stonework's clearly not Nord, that much is for sure.
string: 對，至少學者是這麼說的，這工藝很明顯不是出自諾德人之手。

original: Old Elven fella named Calcelmo is up in Understone Keep's the one you want to talk to for more about that. Wrote all those books.
string: 一個叫卡塞默的年長精靈精通石下要塞的知識。那些書都是他寫的。

original: What do you know about Markarth?
string: 對於馬卡斯城你瞭解多少？

original: It's an old city. Legends say Dwarves built it first. Then after they vanished, the natives moved in.
string: 是座古城。傳說由矮人建造，他們消失後，當地人搬了進去。

original: Finally, the Nords took over around Tiber Septim's time. That bent a few folks' arms the wrong way.
string: 最後由諾德人在泰伯．塞普汀時代接管。這觸怒了一些當地人。

original: The man doing your job?
string: 為你工作的人？

original: Watch your mouth with me you pup! Who do you think you are?
string: 跟我說話的時候注意你的語氣！你以為你是誰？

original: Oh, I've heard this one before. Watch out Divines, poor Kodrir curses you all for giving him life!
string: 噢，這我聽說過。當心啦！聖靈們，可憐的科迪爾因為你們給了他生命而詛咒你們全部！

original: I swear that woman Aeri doesn't appreciate all the work I do for her damn mill.
string: 我肯定那個叫艾莉的女人一點也不感激我為她那該死的木材廠所做的一切。

original: You're all heart, Kodrir. I bet Lady Mara is weeping a special tear for you right now.
string: 科迪爾，你真是宅心仁厚。我敢說瑪拉女神現在正為你流淚呢。

original: Don't know why you're asking me. But I'm glad that damn Imperial is gone. Something wrong about him.
string: 不知道你為什麼問我。但我很高興看到那個該死的帝國人走掉。他有點不對勁。

original: Whatever happened to Ennodius? He just up and left.
string: 恩諾迪尤斯怎麼了？他直接離開了。

original: I run the mill, so I'm a busy woman. What is it?
string: 我開這個木材廠，所以我是個很忙的女人。有什麼事？

original: Always something going wrong. Mill needs more lumber or the saw needs sharpening.
string: 老是有麻煩，要嘛是木材不夠，要嘛鋸子需要磨了。

original: A good lumberjack is quiet, hard-working, and honest.
string: 一個好的伐木工是安靜，努力，和誠實的。

original: I used to work at Anga's Mill, but I... I had to leave.
string: 我曾經在安佳的木材廠做過事，但現在……我得走了。

original: Someone's after me I tell you. They're watching me. Somewhere.
string: 有人在跟蹤我，他們在某處監視著我。

original: Don't talk to me. You could be one of them.
string: 別跟我講話。你可能是他們一夥的。

original: Strangers are always trouble.
string: 陌生人總是惹麻煩。

original: I don't need to talk to you. Get lost.
string: 我不想和你講話。消失吧。

original: Aeri's the boss. Should talk to her if you want work.
string: 艾莉是老闆。你找工作的話就和她說。

original: I work at the mill. Chop trees, carry logs, saw lumber, you know.
string: 我在木材廠工作，砍樹，搬木頭，鋸木頭，你懂的。

original: I've retrieved the scroll.
string: 我拿到了卷軸。

original: I cannot thank you enough for all of the help.
string: 我對你的幫助感激不盡。

original: Right. Okay, tell me if you change yer mind.
string: 好吧。你改主意了就告訴我。

original: Eat? No, I don't think I'm... hungry. Not now, at least.
string: 吃東西？不，我還……沒餓。現在還沒。

original: Umm... Did you want somethin' to eat?
string: 嗯……你想吃點什麼？

original: What can't you get me, sweetie?
string: 有什麼你不能為我做的嗎，親愛的？

original: What can I getcha, Alva?
string: 我能為你做什麼，阿爾瓦？

original: Let's talk about it some other time.
string: 我們下次再談吧。

original: The longer we wait, the worse it gets.
string: 我們等得越久，狀況就越糟。

original: When the time is right, friend. When we're sure.
string: 等合適的時機，朋友。等我們能確定的時候。

original: Still the same. I tell you, something's got to be done.
string: 還是老樣子。我跟你說吧，必須做點什麼？

original: Not right now. Anything new?
string: 現在不行。有新消息嗎？

original: Buy you a drink?
string: 給你買杯酒？

original: Ho, Gorm.
string: 嘿，葛姆。

original: When I'm known throughout Tamriel, you'll regret this decision.
string: 等我在泰姆瑞爾出名時，妳就會後悔了。

original: No. I mean it.
string: 不。真的不想。

original: No interest in being immortalized in song? Remembered and praised for all eternity?
string: 不想在歌謠中永垂不朽嗎？名垂青史，萬世敬仰？

original: Nah. Just... don't. Leave me outta it.
string: 不，沒興趣。別提了。

original: I'm thinking of composing a song about you, Jonna. Would you prefer that I proclaim your beauty, your strength, your...
string: 我準備為妳寫一首歌，喬娜。想要將描寫重點放在妳的美貌、妳的堅強，還是……

original: Oh, I shouldn't be surprised if they come 'round. And if you're never seen or heard from agin.
string: 噢，我相信他們的確會過來圍觀。特別是像你這種默默無聞的人出現的時候。

original: Yes, but they'll come around eventually. You'll see.
string: 好吧，但是他們總有一天都會圍上來聆聽。我會證明給妳看的。

original: No. They ain't. And they aren't gonna. If you weren't payin' for your room, I'd have thrown you out a long time ago.
string: 不，他們沒有，也不會。要是你沒付你的房錢，我早把你扔出去了。

original: Jonna, do you think the townspeople are warming to my serenades?
string: 喬娜，你覺得鎮裡的人欣賞我的小曲嗎？

original: Oh, look! We have company!
string: 噢，看啊，我們有伴了！

original: Oh Hroggar, you know I'm always hungry. Don't worry, I'll eat when I need to.
string: 噢赫魯加，你知道我一直都會餓。別擔心，我會自己動手。

original: Do you need anything? Are you hungry?
string: 你要什麼？你餓了嗎？

original: I feel wonderful, just like every night.
string: 我感覺棒極了，跟往常一樣。

original: How are you feeling?
string: 你感覺怎樣？

original: Hush now. Think no more of it.
string: 沒事了，別胡思亂想。

original: It was scary. It was like it was real!
string: 很可怕。就像真的一樣！

original: It's just a dream, child. Nothing more.
string: 那只是個夢，孩子。沒什麼？

original: I dreamt that you went away. You made monsters.
string: 我夢見你離開。你變成了怪物。

original: Oh?
string: 噢。

original: I had a bad dream again last night.
string: 我昨晚做了個噩夢。

original: Yes, sir.
string: 是，先生。

original: Have no fear. I believe it is within you to excel in your studies. But you must learn to concentrate!
string: 別怕。我相信你能做的很好。但你必須學會專注！

original: Oh.
string: 噢。

original: Because an unfocused mind will almost certainly be obliterated. Destroyed by the forces you attempt to control and yield.
string: 一個薄弱的意志會很容易被你想控制的力量摧毀。

original: Why?
string: 為什麼？

original: Good. Concentration is paramount when dealing with magical forces.
string: 很好，專注對於施法是至關重要的。

original: Yes sir, I have.
string: 練了。先生。

original: Have you been working on your concentration?
string: 你練習專注力了嗎？

original: That is enough.
string: 夠了。

original: But...
string: 但…

original: I was there only for a short time. Much of what I have learned has been on my own. And I will teach you. You have no reason to go there.
string: 我只待過很短的一段時間，大部分是我自學的。而且我能教你，所以你不用去了。

original: But you went there, didn't you? Isn't that where you learned?
string: 但你去了啊，不是嗎？你不就是在裡面學的嗎？

original: The College is not the only place to learn about magic.
string: 學院又不是唯一能學魔法的地方。

original: But I'm learning about magic, and that's what they do there. Shouldn't I go?
string: 但我在學習魔法，他們又是行家 。我不該去嗎？

original: No, I don't think that will be necessary.
string: 不，我覺得沒必要。

original: When I grow up, will I go to the College in Winterhold?
string: 等我長大了，我會去冬堡的學院嗎？

original: Well dear, you know where to find me if it ever becomes too much for you.
string: 好吧親愛的。要是你改變主意了就回來。

original: Oh no! I couldn't. Mother says they are a burden we must bear for our gift.
string: 噢不！不行。母親說我們受人恩惠就會有負擔。

original: Are you sure you don't want something for them? I may be able to brew you something to help.
string: 你確定不要些什麼東西嗎？我可以給你幫助。

original: Oh, yes. All the time. They come with the visions, as always.
string: 噢，是的。有時候會有幻覺。

original: How are the headaches, dear? You or your mother still having them?
string: 頭痛好些了嗎，親愛的？你和你母親仍然沒好轉？

original: Yes, I'm sure that's true.
string: 對，我敢肯定會實現的。

original: Morthal will be mine to govern someday. I have a great deal to learn.
string: 總有一天我會統治墨索爾城的。我還有很多要學。

original: Oh, of course! I'm sorry, I didn't mean to say that it's not.
string: 噢，那是當然！抱歉，我不是說住裡面不好。

original: Oh, I quite like living in the hall. Mother says it's an honor to live there and serve Morthal.
string: 噢，我住在裡面挺舒服的。母親說服侍墨索爾城是一種榮譽。

original: Thank you, dear. It must be nice to get out of the hall every now and then.
string: 謝謝你，親愛的。不時從大殿裡出來一下，感覺應該不錯。

original: I like your shop, Lami.
string: 我喜歡你的店，拉米。

original: Suleyki mulaag, Paarthurnax. My power has waxed, while yours has waned.
string: 蘇利 穆拉，帕圖納克斯。我的力量在增長，而你的在消失。

original: Dovahkiin! Use Dragonrend, if you know it!
string: 都瓦克因！用龍魂撕裂，如果你會的話！

original: Thank you, thank you! I promise I'll help. And then I'll go back to the College and I'll beg them to let me back in.
string: 謝謝你，太感謝了！我保證會幫忙的。我要回到學院，求他們讓我回去。

original: Oh, you've saved me! Thank you so much. Who knows what they'd have done to me if you hadn't come along.
string: 噢，你救了我！太感謝你了。誰知道他們會做出什麼事。

original: I promise I'll help you get out of here.
string: 我保證我會幫你離開這裡。

original: Where are the books you stole?
string: 你偷的書哪裡去了？

original: I don't have them anymore. She took them... The Caller. She's the one who put me in here!
string: 已經不在我手裡了。她拿走了……召喚者。是她把我關在這裡的！

original: Please, let me out of here!
string: 請幫我出去！

original: I'm just here for the books you took from the College.
string: 我只是來拿回你從學院拿走的那些書。

original: What? The bo... Oh. Oh dear.
string: 什麼？書……噢，哦天哪。

original: I shouldn't have taken them, I know! It was stupid. I was stupid. It won't happen again.
string: 我就知道我不該拿那些書！我真蠢，真蠢。我再也不會這麼做了。

original: Help me get out of here, and I'll help you find them. Please!
string: 幫我離開這裡，我就幫你拿到那些書，求你了！

original: So, you're Orthorn?
string: 那麼，你是奧拓恩？

original: Yes, yes! Did Arch-Mage Aren send you? He sent you to rescue me, didn't he?
string: 對，是的！是首席法師阿冉派你來的？他派你來救我，對嗎？

original: There's a lever, right there in the center. Hurry, before more of them show up!
string: 那裡有個拉杆，就在中間。快點，有人要來了！

original: You have to let me out. They're going to do something awful to me!
string: 你得讓我出去，他們要對我做很恐怖的事！

original: Please, please let me out of here!
string: 請讓我離開這裡！

original: You may have picked up the weapons of my ancient foes, but you are not their equal!
string: 你也許得到了我古代敵人的武器，但你可比不上他們！

original: Unslaad hokoron! Never again!
string: 安斯拉 克榮！不可能！

original: Lost funt. You are too late, Alduin!
string: 洛斯 泛特，太遲了，奧杜因！

original: Bahloki nahkip sillesejoor. My belly is full of the souls of your fellow mortals, Dovahkiin.
string: 巴羅基 吶基 希爾斯月。我肚子裡填滿了凡人的靈魂，都瓦克因。

original: Die now and await your fate in Sovngarde!
string: 現在死吧，等待你在英靈殿的命運吧。

original: Meyz mul, Dovahkiin. You have become strong.
string: 梅 姆，都瓦克因。你變強了。

original: But I am Al-du-in, Firstborn of Akatosh! Mulaagi zok lot! I cannot be slain here, by you or anyone else!
string: 但我是奧-杜-因，阿卡托什的長子！穆拉基 左 洛！我不會在這裡，被你們殺死！

original: That's not funny, Bolli. People are scared.
string: 我要如何到達山頂見他？

original: Oh come now, what's a dragon or two compared to a day full of fishing!
string: 只有強而有力之聲才能找到路。來吧。我們教你怎樣通過龍吼來打開通向帕圖納克斯的道路。

original: I don't know Bolli. It's getting dangerous outside the walls.
string: 為什麼我還沒看到帕圖納克斯？

original: Talen my friend, up for some fishing this week?
string: 他獨居在山頂上。

original: I'll tell you one thing, if you don't make peace with them soon you may get a walkout on your hands. Then we're both in trouble.
string: 他很少和我們說話，更別說外來人。允許去見他本身就是個殊榮。

original: They always try to take advantage of me. Give them an inch and they'll take a mile.
string: 那麼我得和帕圖納克斯好好談談。

original: Maybe they're afraid of you. Maybe it's your breath. How should I know?
string: 也許他們怕你。也許是你太凶了，我怎麼知道？

original: Why don't they listen to me, Keerava? Why won't they do as I say?
string: 他們為什麼不聽我的，基拉瓦？為什麼他們不按我說的做？

original: Damn it, Talen. We still don't have enough this year to get out of Riften.
string: 該死，塔倫。我們今年仍然離不開裂谷城。

original: I hope so. I can't stand this city anymore.
string: 希望是這樣。我受夠這城市了。

original: Don't worry, the time will come when we can walk away from here.
string: 別擔心，我們總有一天會離開這裡的。

original: That isn't an option. Maven sees me serve a competitor's brand here and we may as well dig our own graves.
string: 不行。要是瑪雯知道了，我們就等死吧。

original: We could always look for another brand.
string: 我們可以買別的牌子。

original: If only Maven would stop raising the price on it maybe I could afford to stock more cases.
string: 只要瑪雯別再繼續提高價格，也許我還能多存幾箱。

original: Keerava, we're running low on Black-Briar Mead.
string: 基拉瓦，我們的黑棘蜜酒儲量下降了。

original: Do you work alone?
string: 你一個人工作嗎？

original: Hardly! In fact, I don't know how I get anything done with all of the distractions I have to put up with.
string: 當然不！我都不知道在這麼多東西干擾下我是怎麼完成這些工作的。

original: My wife Hafjorg, well, she's a necessary evil I suppose. Not a lick of talent when it comes to alchemy, but she keeps me fed.
string: 我的妻子哈喬只能算湊合。她在鍊金術方面沒有太大天分，但她至少會做飯。

original: Then there's Ingun Black-Briar. Bright young thing and a worthy apprentice, when she isn't wasting my rare ingredients.
string: 然後因甘．黑棘就出現了。一位年輕，天資聰穎的學徒，知道珍惜我稀有的原料。

original: Tell me about Riften's Thieves Guild.
string: 告訴我有關裂谷城盜賊公會的事。

original: To call it a guild is ridiculous. How can people who would betray one another over a gold coin be considered part of an association?
string: 將它稱為公會真是可笑，成員之間會為了一枚金幣互相背叛，這也能算什麼組織？

original: They're the worst kind. Even the Dark Brotherhood abides by a strict set of rules and tradition. These thieves are just rabble.
string: 他們是最下等的人。就算是黑暗兄弟會也嚴格遵守某些規矩或傳統，但那些賊只是烏合之眾。

original: What do you think?
string: 你覺得呢？

original: Sorry to hear that.
string: 真叫人感到遺憾。

original: Yes, quite a shame. It was a fine weapon.
string: 是啊，太丟臉了。真是把好兵器。

original: I could find it for you.
string: 我可以幫妳找到它。

original: I couldn't ask you to undertake such a trecherous journey, it would be a fool's errand.
string: 我不應該要求你踏上這樣危險的旅途，這會是有去無回。

original: But I see that spark in your eye and I know better than to warn you away.
string: 但我能看到你眼中閃爍著冒險的光芒，我知道不應阻攔你。

original: Grimsever rests with the Dwemer ruin of Mzinchaleft. Tread carefully, friend... those same ruins almost took my life.
string: 無情切割者和津查遺址的鍛莫遺跡一起安息了。小心行事，朋友……這些遺跡曾經差點殺了我。

original: What happened to your blade, Grimsever?
string: 妳的武器無情切割者怎麼了？

original: It was lost years ago in a Dwemer ruin.
string: 幾年以前，它遺落在一個鍛莫遺跡裡。

original: Without it, I feel almost as defenseless as a newborn. I don't think I'll ever be able to find a replacement.
string: 沒了它，我感覺如新生兒一樣無助。我永遠也無法找到替代品了。

original: What happened to you in Mzinchaleft?
string: 妳在津查遺址發生了什麼事？

original: I was adventuring in the depths of the ruins when I was attacked by a massive construct... like nothing I had ever seen.
string: 我當時正前往廢墟深處，突然遭到一個巨型機械的襲擊……那是我從未見過的。

original: When the colossus struck, Grimsever was knocked from my grasp and I was wounded badly.
string: 魔像發動攻擊時，把無情切割者從我手中打掉，我也身受重傷。

original: It was only through blind luck that I was able to crawl away from the Dwemer abomination and make my way to the surface.
string: 僅僅是因為好運，我才能從鍛莫人的殘害中逃脫，回到地面。

original: I must have collapsed, because the next thing I remember is Aerin standing over me tending to my wounds.
string: 我肯定是暈過去了，因為在那以後我只記得艾靈在治療我的傷口。

original: You're Riften's protector?
string: 你是裂谷城的保護者？

original: Its been difficult. I've taken the burdens of this city's problems upon myself and I keep running into impossible obstacles.
string: 很艱難。我一直獨自承擔這城市的所有問題，而且不斷有棘手的事出現。

original: Corruption, lies and deceit are the order of the day here.
string: 腐敗，謊言和欺騙蔓延成風。

original: If it wasn't for Aerin, the young man who saved my life, I think I'd already have given up long ago.
string: 要不是為了艾靈，那個救我一命年輕人，我想我早就放棄了。

original: Why are you here, then?
string: 那妳為何還待在這裡？

original: Many years ago I lost my blade, "Grimsever," within a Dwemer ruin. I took it as a sign that I was wasting my days in search of wealth.
string: 很多年前我在一個鍛莫遺跡裡，搞丟了我的劍，「無情切割者」。那是我尋寶歲月的見證啊。

original: You and I are alike. We seek challenge and great fortune. But for me, that's where the similarities end.
string: 你和我很相像。我們都追求挑戰和財富。但我已經失去了當年的勇氣。

original: You see, Riften is my great beast to be slain and my fortune comes from gratitude and trust.
string: 你看，裂谷城已成為我無法逾越的障礙，而我的財富來自於感激和信任。

original: Heard any rumors lately?
string: 最近有聽到什麼流言嗎？

original: Word is Ulfric Stormcloak escaped from the Imperials. War's only going to get worse, now.
string: 據說烏弗瑞克從帝國人手中逃跑了。戰事現在只會變得更糟。

original: They say a dragon attacked Helgen. Sounds like hogwash to me.
string: 據說一條龍襲擊了聖地鎮。真是一派胡言。

original: Word is Ulfric Stormcloak escaped from the Imperials. War's only going to get worse, now.
string: 據說烏弗瑞克從帝國人手中逃跑了。戰事現在只會變得更糟。

original: They say a dragon attacked Helgen. Sounds like hogwash to me.
string: 據說一條龍襲擊了聖地鎮。有點扯淡。

original: We've got something of a love triangle here in Riverwood. Faendal and Sven, both vying for Camilla's affections.
string: 我們河木鎮這裡有個三角戀情。法恩達爾和斯萬，都想贏得凱米拉的芳心。

original: Ain't used to strangers here in Riverwood.
string: 我對河木鎮的陌生人不熟。

original: I'm spoken for, you know. So don't get any ideas.
string: 我已經有人了，別亂想。

original: You're pretty, I'll give ya that. Just stay away from my husband, Alvor.
string: 我承認妳很漂亮。但離我丈夫阿爾沃遠點。

original: Alvor and I, we got a daughter. Little Dorthe.
string: 阿爾沃和我有一個女兒。小朵西。

original: He would dote on her so much. Let her work the forge and everything. I miss him so.
string: 他十分溺愛她。讓他在鍛鐵爐邊玩，什麼都答應她。我很想念他。

original: My girl likes to work the forge with her papa.
string: 我女兒喜歡和她爸爸在鍛鐵爐邊工作。

original: All of that blacksmithing... It's not good for a little girl. Ain't... ladylike.
string: 那些鐵匠工作……並不適合女孩子。很不……淑女。

original: Dorthe needs to spend more time in the garden. I could use the help.
string: 朵西最好多幹些農活，我需要幫助。

original: It don't matter what I grow - my Alvor, he'll eat anything.
string: 不管我種什麼菜—阿爾沃他什麼都吃。

original: Maybe I'll do turnips next. Hmmm... Or maybe radishes?
string: 也許我該種點大頭菜了。嗯……或者是蘿蔔？

original: New to Riverwood? If you're looking for work, go see Hod at the mill.
string: 初到河木鎮？要是你在找工作，去木材廠找胡德。

original: We're a small village, but we work hard, and take care of our own.
string: 我們是個小村莊，但我們努力工作，自給自足。

original: I own the lumber mill, and pay a fair wage. See my husband Hod if you're looking for work.
string: 我有一家伐木場，工錢不算少。你要是想工作就找我丈夫。

original: Only worry we've got is the war reaching this far.
string: 我們唯一擔心的事戰爭已經很接近了。

original: Years past, the lumber was used for houses or furniture. Now, the soldiers just buy it all.
string: 幾年前，木頭都是用於造房子和傢俱。現在都被士兵買走了。

original: The thought of my wood being used for weapons... Makes me sick.
string: 想到我的木頭被做成了兵器……我感覺惡心。

original: No use thinkin' of things I can't change. Too much work to be done...
string: 想這些也沒用，還有活要幹……

original: You look like a traveler. Someone that has seen far away places and heard new stories.
string: 你看起來像個遊歷四方的人，見過很多地方，知道很多故事。

original: You should come hear me play at the Sleeping Giant Inn. For a small sum you can even pick the song.
string: 你該來沉睡巨人客棧聽我唱一曲。你花點小錢還能點歌。

original: I've been trained as a skald, as was my father, and my father's father before him.
string: 我從小就被當成詩人來培養，和我父親，和我父親的父親一樣。

original: My time at the Bards College was brief. A prodigy has little need for formal education.
string: 我只在吟遊詩人學院待了一小段時間。神童是不需要多少正規教育的。

original: I'm composing a new song. A ballad, for Camilla Valerius.
string: 我在寫一首新歌，獻給凱米拉．瓦勒瑞斯的情歌。

original: Some day Camilla will know of my affections. Some day...
string: 總有一天凱米拉會知道我對她的愛。總有一天……

original: A new face. And a right fair one at that.
string: 新來的啊。而且讓人印象深刻。

original: A new face. And a right ugly one at that. No offence.
string: 新來的啊。長的還挺猥瑣，無意冒犯。

original: Got business here in Riverwood, eh? There are worse villages.
string: 在河木鎮有生意做，是嗎？其他地方情況很糟。

original: At least the damned war hasn't gotten here. Yet.
string: 至少這裡沒受戰火影響，暫時沒。

original: We work hard, try to do right by our families.
string: 我們努力工作，試圖養活家人。

original: Me, I've got my axe, my wife Gerdur and my boy Frodnar. That's all I need.
string: 我有我的斧頭，我妻子歌爾朵和孩子弗洛德納。這就夠了。

original: Woodcutting's my trade. Best log splitter from here to Riften.
string: 我做木材生意，從這裡到裂谷城最好的伐木匠。

original: It's all in the way you hold the axe. Caress it, like any wench, and she'll do ya right.
string: 關鍵就在於你手持斧頭的方式。像個女人一樣輕撫它，她就會聽你的話。

original: You met Camilla yet? Wouldn't mind getting my hands on those trunks. He he he he.
string: 你見過凱米拉嗎？那樹幹（軀幹）摸上去感覺應該不錯。呵呵呵呵。

original: Now you, lass... You've got some beautiful trunks yourself... Hmm?
string: 那麼，小姑娘……你身材也不錯吧……嗯？

original: Well... I'll let you go about your business.
string: 呃……我們還是談你的工作吧。

original: You're new around here, so I'll go easy on ya. But don't get on my bad side.
string: 你是新來的，所以我不苛求你。但別惹我生氣。

original: Get me mad, and I'll prank ya. And not a little. A lot.
string: 我生氣了可就會捉弄你噢。而且不只是稍微捉弄一下而已。

original: Ah, everybody around here's so serious.
string: 啊，這裡的人都這麼嚴肅。

original: So I like to have a little fun, so what?
string: 所以我想開點玩笑，不錯吧？

original: My friend Dorthe doesn't like my pranking. "You're being mean, Frodnar!" So what if I am?
string: 我朋友朵西可不喜歡被我捉弄。她老是說「你真可惡，弗洛德納！」，但要是我真的很可惡呢？

original: Mother wants me to work at the mill. But I ain't nobody's slave.
string: 母親希望我在伐木場工作，但我可不是奴隸。

original: You gotta have better things to do than talk to me all day...
string: 你整天跟我閒聊還不如做事去……

original: Did I see you talking to Sven? Maybe not. Maybe...nevermind. But I would stay away from him if I were you.
string: 我看見你和斯萬講話了嗎？也許沒。也許……算了。總之我建議你離他遠點。

original: Greetings, sister Elf. Good to see a familiar face so far from home.
string: 你好，精靈姐妹。在異鄉見到熟悉的臉真是親切。

original: Greetings, brother Elf. Good to see a familiar face so far from home.
string: 你好，精靈兄弟。在異鄉見到熟悉的臉真是親切。

original: Riverwood's agreeable enough, I suppose. For a Nord village.
string: 以一個諾德村莊來說，河木鎮夠討人喜歡的了。

original: There's beauty here unmatched in all of Skyrim, to be sure.
string: 這裡有全天際都無法比擬的美景。

original: Maybe you've already met Camilla Valerius?
string: 也許你已經見過凱米拉．瓦勒瑞斯了？

original: If only Camilla shared my affections. Or even knew about them.
string: 要是凱米拉和我有相同的感覺……或者至少知道我怎麼想的。

original: Are you a hunter, by chance? The hills surrounding the village are ripe with game.
string: 你曾經做過獵人嗎？附近的山上好玩得很。

original: I work at the lumber mill, but I escape into the forest whenever possible.
string: 我在伐木場工作，但我一有空就逃進森林裡。

original: I miss Valenwood, but the wilds here are... serviceable.
string: 我想念威木省的美景，但這裡的大自然……也還過得去。

original: I don't like to brag, but I once took down a bear at three hundred yards. In a blizzard.
string: 不是我吹牛，有次我在風暴雪中隔著300碼射死了一頭熊。

original: We got rooms and food. Drink, too. I cook. Ain't much else to tell.
string: 我們提供房間和食物，還有酒。我負責做飯，就這些了。

original: Need a room, talk to Delphine.
string: 想要房間，跟戴爾菲娜講。

original: I'm just the cook, lad.
string: 我只是廚師，小子。

original: I'm just the cook, lass.
string: 我只是廚師，女孩。

original: I ain't lookin' to make friends.
string: 我站在這不是要交朋友的。

original: You like Skeever liver. No? Tough luck.
string: 你想要惡鼠肝嗎？不？太遺憾了。

original: Food's hot. Never said it was good.
string: 食物是熱的。但口味不敢恭維。

original: You're that visitor, been pokin' around.
string: 你就是那個四處探頭探腦的人。

original: I'm the innkeeper. It's my business to keep track of strangers.
string: 我是旅館老闆，記住陌生人的行蹤是我的工作。

original: We don't get a lot of travelers here in Riverwood.
string: 沒有多少旅客會經過河木鎮。

original: The war keeps most folks away, these days.
string: 戰爭讓我的顧客減少了。

original: Most of my customers are locals, come to relax after a hard day's toil.
string: 我大多數顧客都是本地人，一天的辛苦工作後來喝一杯。

original: So what's your story? Just here to... relax?
string: 那麼你為什麼來這裡？來……放鬆一下的？

original: You look like you could use an ale.
string: 你看起來得來杯酒。

original: If you're staying the night, I've got a free room.
string: 如果你想住宿，我有空房。

original: Wanderer like you must have quite an appetite. Some food?
string: 像你這樣四處跑路的人肯定餓壞了，不來點吃的？

original: You're a strapping young man. Don't be a stranger.
string: 你還真是個魁梧的年輕人。請常來光顧。

original: The men here like my attention, and I like theirs. Best know your place.
string: 這裡的人喜歡贏得我的注意，我也喜歡他們。想想你的身份地位。

original: You're not from around here. That makes two of us.
string: 你不是這附近的居民，我也不是。

original: I came here from the Imperial Province, to work with my brother Lucan.
string: 我從帝國人的省份來到這裡，和我兄弟路坎一起工作。

original: It got bad back in Cyrodiil. The war with the Thalmor ruined... everything.
string: 賽瑞迪爾省一團糟。和梭默的戰爭毀了……一切。

original: I came to Skyrim looking for a better life. So what did I get? Another war.
string: 我來到天際想開始新生活，但我得到了什麼？另一場戰爭。

original: I just want to find a good husband, and start a family of my own.
string: 我只想找個好丈夫，建立自己的家庭。

original: The Riverwood Trader is everything you need in a general store.
string: 河木鎮的商店有你想要的一切。

original: My sister Camilla or I will be happy to help you.
string: 我姐姐凱米拉和我都願意為你服務。

original: Maybe you're looking for something... particular?
string: 也許你需要某些……特別的貨？

original: We carry just about anything you could need...
string: 我們有你要的一切……

original: I know some of it looks like junk, but everything's a treasure in the right light.
string: 我知道有些看起來不怎麼樣，但是識貨的人都能看出來是寶物。

original: Ain't every day we get visitors in Riverwood.
string: 河木鎮可不是每天都有訪客啊。

original: Whatever you need. By Ysmir, if it's simple and strong, I can forge it.
string: 以伊斯米爾的名義，不管你要什麼，只要是輕便而強韌的，我都能鑄造。

original: You lookin' for a new blade?
string: 你想要一把新的劍？

original: Iron or steel is what you need. Leave that fancy Elven stuff to the Elves.
string: 鐵的或鋼的都行，精靈的東西就算了吧。

original: Iron and steel mostly. I might even have some of your fancy Elven pieces lying around somewhere...
string: 大部分是鋼或鐵的，我甚至還有一些精靈的東西。

original: I could forge you a warhammer that would crush a giant's head like a walnut.
string: 我可以幫你造一把能輕鬆粉碎巨人腦袋的戰錘。

original: You the sneaky type? Got some nice daggers around here somewhere...
string: 你是玩偷襲的？那就挑幾把精緻的匕首吧……

original: Papa says I'm too friendly with strangers, but you seem all right.
string: 爸爸說我對陌生人太友好了，但你看起來是好人。

original: My father is Alvor, the blacksmith. I'm his assistant. I mean, apprentice.
string: 我父親是鐵匠阿爾沃。我是他的助手，呃……我是指學徒。

original: Some day I'm going to forge my own sword!
string: 有一天我會自己造一把劍的！

original: Papa says I'm not ready for weapons. So I make lots of horseshoes and hobnails.
string: 爸爸說我還沒有能力打造武器。所以我做了很多馬蹄鐵和馬刺。

original: Mama doesn't think I'm girlish enough. But that's just stupid girl talk.
string: 媽媽覺得我太不淑女了，但傻姑娘才想做淑女呢。

original: Papa may have wanted a son, but he got me. He's a lucky man.
string: 也許爸爸想要的是兒子，不過他很幸運，有我就夠了。

original: Ain't nothin' a boy can do that I can't do better.
string: 因為任何男孩子能做的事，我都不比他們做得差。

original: Nobody believes me, but I tell you, I saw a dragon!
string: 沒人相信我，但我真的看見了一條龍！

original: By Shor, what do you want?
string: 朔爾在上，你想做什麼？

original: It's my boy Sven you need to listen to. He sings at the inn, most every night.
string: 歡迎去聽我兒子斯萬唱歌。他每晚都在客棧表演呢。

original: Sven has the voice of a snow lark. Only good thing he got from his father.
string: 斯萬有雲雀一樣美妙的聲音，這也是從他父親身上繼承的唯一優點。

original: My boy fancies that Camilla Valerius. She'll come around soon enough.
string: 我兒子迷戀上凱米拉。她應該很快就會被追到了吧。

original: Camilla, I've seen her talking to that Faendal. Filthy elf needs to keep to his own kind...
string: 凱米拉，我見過她和法恩達爾談話。那骯髒的精靈最好守規矩點……

original: What happened to my Skyrim? Everywhere you look, cats, lizards and elves. It's sickening.
string: 我的天際都怎麼了？你看看，到處都是那些貓、蜥蜴和精靈。真讓人嘔心。

original: I raised my Sven to be strong, and proud. A true Nord.
string: 我把我的斯萬養大，讓他強壯而高傲。成為一個真正的諾德人。

original: You're kinda fuzzy. What's wrong with ya?
string: 你有點焦躁啊，怎麼了？

original: Outta my way, stranger.
string: 走開，陌生人。

original: Grrr. Fine, let's get this over with.
string: 嗯。好吧，我們來解決這事。

original: Doing nothing will not grant our tribe relief from this curse. We must try.
string: 袖手旁觀是不會解決問題的。我們得試試。

original: You bring an outsider here, and now insist I call on Malacath for help, when he has clearly forsaken me? You try my patience, Atub.
string: 你把一個外人帶進來，現在還叫我向瑪拉凱斯尋求幫助，但他已經拋棄我了。你在考驗我的耐心，阿土布。

original: It is time, Yamarz.
string: 是時候了，亞馬茲。

original: The Jarl of Whiterun might not think so.
string: 白漫的領主也許會反對。

original: Hmm, yes. But your su'um is strong. I do not doubt that you can convince him of the need.
string: 嗯，對。但你的蘇姆很強。你肯定能說服他的。

original: It wasn't really a victory, since Alduin escaped.
string: 既然奧杜因跑了，那就不能算是真的成功。

original: Ni liivrah hin moro. True, this is not the final krongrah - victory. But not even the heroes of old were able to defeat Alduin in open battle.
string: 尼 力夫拉 辛 摩羅。的確是，這還不是最終克隆格拉—勝利。但即使是上古的戰士也無法正面擊敗奧杜因。

original: Alduin always was pahlok - arrogant in his power. Uznahgar paar. He took domination as his birthright.
string: 奧杜因一直都是帕洛—傲慢。伍茲吶嘎  帕。牠生來即欲稱霸 。

original: This should shake the loyalty of the dov who serve him.
string: 這將動搖牠手下那些都瓦的忠心。

original: I need to find out where Alduin went.
string: 我得知道奧杜因往哪跑了。

original: Yes... one of his allies could tell us. Motmahus... But it will not be so easy to... convince one of them to betray him.
string: 對……牠的某個盟友可以告訴我們。姆馬胡斯……但想說服牠們背叛牠也並非易事。

original: Perhaps the hofkahsejun - the palace in Whiterun... Dragonsreach. It was originally built to house a captive dovah.
string: 也許霍夫卡瑟瓊—白漫城的宮殿……龍臨堡。原本就是建來捕獲都瓦的。

original: A fine place to trap one of Alduin's allies, hmm?
string: 適合把奧杜因的同伴關進去，嗯？

original: I defeated Alduin, but he escaped.
string: 我擊敗了奧杜因，但他逃跑了。

original: Lot krongrah. You truly have the Voice of a dovah. Alduin's allies will think twice after this victory.
string: 洛 克隆格拉。你的確擁有都瓦之吼。奧杜因的盟友會在這次勝利後三思的。

original: Why, why have you done this to us?
string: 為什麼，你為什麼要這麼做？

original: I cannot protect you if you murder us. This is the only warning you will receive.
string: 要是你殺了我們我就不能保護你了。這是我給你的唯一警告。

original: Dragonsreach was built to hold a dragon?
string: 龍臨堡是用來抓龍的？

original: Yes. This was ages ago, you understand. There were more of us then. Before the bruniikke - the Akaviri - came and killed all my zeymah.
string: 那是很久前的事了，那時我族人口眾多。直到布魯尼克-阿卡維爾—殺光我的澤瑪。

original: I used to visit him from time to time. Nearly crazed by loneliness and captivity. Tiiraz sivaas. He did not even remember his own name.
string: 我曾經經常去拜訪牠。牠在孤獨和囚禁中幾乎瘋了。提拉茲 西瓦，牠連自己的名字都忘卻了。

original: I do not know how he came to be caught. But the bronjun... the Jarl... was very proud of his pet. Paak!
string: 我不知道牠是怎麼被抓的，但是布榮瓊……領主對他的寵物非常驕傲。切！

original: The hofkahsejun has been known as Dragonsreach ever since.
string: 霍夫卡瑟瓊因此被又被稱作龍臨堡。

original: According to legend. Although I never thought to put the tale to the test.
string: 根據傳說是這樣沒錯，雖然我不知道真假。

original: Jarl Olaf One-Eye it was, who later became High King.
string: 獨眼奧拉夫領主，後來成為了至高王。

original: They say he Shouted it into submission in single combat atop Mount Anthor and brought it back to Whiterun.
string: 他們說他在安索爾山的一次戰鬥中用龍吼擊敗敵方，把牠帶回白漫。

original: Numinex was the dragon's name. That's his skull decorating the main hall.
string: 那條龍叫怒米奈科斯。牠的頭被掛在主廳中。

original: What if you didn't have to worry about an enemy attack?
string: 要是你用不著擔心敵人進攻呢？

original: Then I would be glad to help you with your mad dragon-trapping scheme.
string: 那我就願意幫你實現你那瘋狂的捕龍計劃。

original: But getting both sides to agree to a truce will be difficult at this point. The bitterness has gone too deep.
string: 但眼下讓雙方握手言和很難。仇恨太深。

original: Maybe... hmm... what of the Greybeards? They are respected by all Nords. High Hrothgar is neutral territory.
string: 但要是……嗯……灰鬍子呢？他們受所有諾德人的尊敬。高吼峰是中立領地。

original: If the Greybeards were willing to host a peace council... then maybe Ulfric and Tullius would have to listen.
string: 如果灰鬍子願意舉行和平會議的話……那烏弗瑞克和圖留斯也許會聽。

original: No. I can't risk weakening the city while we are under the threat of enemy attack. I'm sorry.
string: 不，我不能在受敵人威脅時冒這種風險。我很抱歉。

original: What do you think the Imperials would be doing while this dragon is busy slaughtering my men?
