string: 你可以告訴依格蒙德領主，銀血不會對他的優柔寡斷忍耐太久的。

original: I support the Empire. What of it?
string: 我支持帝國。那又如何？

original: What of it, he says. Your Empire is destroying everything Skyrim stands for. Honor. Pride. Mighty Talos.
string: 你說那又如何，哈。你的帝國正在毀滅一切能承載天際省之魂的東西。榮耀、自尊，以及神聖的塔洛斯。

original: What of it, she says. Your Empire is destroying everything Skyrim stands for. Honor. Pride. Mighty Talos.
string: 妳說那又如何，哈。妳的帝國正在毀滅一切能承載天際省之魂的東西。榮耀、自尊，以及神聖的塔洛斯。

original: You there. You another Imperial puppet? Answer me.
string: 我說你。你也是一個帝國的傀儡嗎？回答我。

original: I'll come back later, then.
string: 那麼，我晚點再來。

original: Arkay keep you and protect you.
string: 阿爾凱寬容和保護你。

original: I'm not afraid of you.
string: 我才不怕你。

original: Is that so? You should be. Though a heart without fear is something I can use... Perhaps you are the one I seek.
string: 是嗎？其實你怕的。雖然不知畏懼的心才可以為我所用……說不定我要找的那個人就是你。

original: We shall soon find out.
string: 我們很快就會知道了。

original: Who are you?
string: 你是誰？

original: I am called Boethiah. Many names have mortals given me. But I am not interested in names. I am interested only in deeds.
string: 我被叫做波耶西亞。人類對我有很多種稱呼。但是我對名字不感興趣。我只對行動感興趣。

original: A god? Assuredly not! When was the last time you saw evidence of Aedra in the world?
string: 一個神？肯定不是！你上次見到神族存在於世間的證據是什麼時候？

original: No, we Daedra are far more powerful than any god. And among my brethren, I am the most feared.
string: 不，我們魔族比神強大得多。而且在我的族群中，我是最受畏懼的一個。

original: Are you some kind of god?
string: 你是某種神嗎？

original: Tell me, why have you slain this one, who trusted you, here upon my shrine?
string: 告訴我，為什麼你要在我的祭壇上，殺了這個信任你的人？

original: Tell me, why have you slain those who profess to follow in my ways?
string: 告訴我，為什麼你殺掉那些信仰我的人？

original: You were weak. Now you are dead. What signs have you left of your passing for us to remember you by?
string: 你是弱者。你死了。你給我們留下了什麼可以用來紀念的標記？

original: A god? Assuredly not! Gods are weak and ineffectual. When was the last time you heard or saw evidence of the Aedra in the world?
string: 一個神？肯定不是！神是弱小和無能的，你上次聽過或者見過神族存在於世間的證據是什麼時候？

original: No, we Daedra are far more powerful than any god. And among my brethren, I am the most feared.
string: 不，我們魔族比神強大得多。而且在我的族群中，我是最受畏懼的一個。

original: My reasons are my own.
string: 我自有理由。

original: Indeed. But I abide only those whose will is aligned to my own. Those who oppose my desires perish in the most dreadful of ways.
string: 確實。但我只與那些和我意志相同的人共處。反對我的人將以最悲慘的方式滅亡。

original: I don't like being ignored. (Intimidate)
string: 我不喜歡被無視。（威嚇）

original: Then my answer is the Hall of the Dead is closed. By order of the Jarl. Understand?
string: 那麼我的回答是亡者之廳已經關閉了。這是遵照領主的命令。明白了嗎？

original: Would some coin help? (<BribeCost> gold)
string: 一把金幣有用嗎？（賄賂<BribeCost>金幣）

original: Well, the Priesthood of Arkay always accepts generous donations.
string: 好吧，阿爾凱祭司團總是歡迎慷慨捐助的。

original: That's not going to work.
string: 那沒用。

original: (Invisible Continue)
string: （保持隱形）

original: We've discovered that some of the dead have been... eaten. Flesh has been chewed off, bones were snapped to get at the marrow inside.
string: 我們發現有一些屍體被……吃掉了。肉被撕咬下去，骨頭被折斷露出了骨髓。

original: We haven't caught anyone or anything yet. It's like it knows when I'm there.
string: 我們還沒有抓到可疑的人或物。就好像犯人對我什麼時候會去那裡瞭若指掌。

original: If you can get to the bottom of this, the Priesthood of Arkay will reward you. Take my key, and be careful.
string: 如果你能調查出真相，阿爾凱祭司團會獎勵你的。拿上我的鑰匙，注意安全。

original: I could help if you tell me. (Persuade)
string: 如果你告訴我的話，我可以幫你。（說服）

original: All right. I was going to suggest the Jarl hire someone to sort this mess out, anyway.
string: 好吧。不管怎樣，我本來就準備建議領主雇人來解決這件事。

original: Who's Arkay?
string: 阿爾凱是誰？

original: Arkay. One of the Eight Divines. God of the Cycle of Birth and Death.
string: 阿爾凱。八聖靈之一。生與死的輪迴之神。

original: It is his shrine people pray to when they visit the Hall. That his divinity will watch over their ancestors on the way to the next life.
string: 人們來廳堂祈禱所跪拜的就是他的祭壇。通常的祈禱內容都是希望祖先的靈魂在前往後世的途上能被他護佑。

original: What's the Hall of the Dead?
string: 亡者之廳是什麼？

original: New to Skyrim? I was confused at first, too. The Nords call their mausoleums the Hall of the Dead.
string: 對天際省不熟吧？我一開始也迷糊。諾德人把他們的公墓叫做亡者之廳。

original: It's where people in the city are buried. Fathers. Forefathers. Mothers. Foremothers.
string: 那是城市裡的人的陵墓。父親、祖父、母親、祖母。

original: That's enough, Thongvor. We're done.
string: 夠了，松瓦。我們就談到這裡吧。

original: I don't have time right now.
string: 我現在沒時間。

original: Very well.
string: 很好。

original: I'll make sure he gets it.
string: 我保證一定會送到他手上的。

original: Thank you. He can be a bit difficult, but I'm sure he'll appreciate your help.
string: 謝謝你。他可能性格有點怪，但我肯定他會對你的幫助表示感激的。

original: What do you know about the Forsworn?
string: 你對棄誓者瞭解多少？

original: Only that they break an old woman's heart. So many friends, so many kin, all lost trying to rebuild a past that was over long ago.
string: 我只知道他們傷了一個老婦人的心。這麼多友人，這麼多親人，想要取回原來的生活卻被殺了。

original: I don't have time. Sorry.
string: 我沒有時間。抱歉。

original: Fair enough.
string: 有道理。

original: I'll bring one if I find it.
string: 如果我找到的話就帶回來給妳。

original: Thanks.
string: 謝謝。

original: What's wrong with your apprentice?
string: 你的學徒怎麼了？

original: Tacitus? Boy's an Imperial. I keep showing him how to treat the iron, but he never gets it.
string: 塔西佗？這個帝國男孩。我一直對教他如何處理鐵，但是他總是學不會。

original: In the Legion, the Imperial smiths used to read books when they couldn't set their hammers straight. Wisdom of the old, I guess.
string: 在軍團裡，帝國的鐵匠在他們不能正確地揮錘的時候會去翻書。老一輩的智慧結晶，我猜啦。

original: If you find a book called "The Last Scabbard of Akrash," could you bring it to me? Tacitus sure isn't learning by example.
string: 要是你找到一本書叫做「阿克拉什的最後劍鞘」，可以把它帶來給我嗎？靠我這樣教，塔西佗看來是學不會的。

original: Here's the book you wanted.
string: 這是妳要找的書。

original: Books. Don't know why the Imperials like these so much. This should help the boy, though, Malacath willing.
string: 書。不知道為什麼帝國人對它們這麼感興趣。不過，這應該對那孩子有所幫助。

original: Here, let me show you how an Orc learns to smith.
string: 過來，我讓你看看獸人是如何學會鐵匠技術的。

original: I served in the Legion. Perhaps I'll show you some of their technique one of these days.
string: 我曾在軍團服役。說不定哪一天我會有興致向你展示一下他們的戰技。

original: I won't be married to some weak-willed Orc chieften. I'd sooner join the Legion.
string: 我才不要和一個意志薄弱的什麼獸人酋長結婚。我很快就要加入帝國軍團了。

original: You'll come of age soon. Time to be married to another chief.
string: 你很快就到適婚年齡了。可以嫁給另一個酋長。

original: Yes, mother.
string: 是的，母親。

original: Imagine the heads of your enemies as you forge. Let your hatred work the steel.
string: 在你鍛造的時候要想著敵人的頭顱。讓你的憎恨之力注入手中的鐵。

original: Sorry, mother. I'll focus on my work.
string: 對不起，媽媽。我會集中精神的。

original: Save your anger for the forge. The steel cannot hear your whining.
string: 把你的憤怒留到鑄造的時候吧。鐵是聽不懂你的哀號的。

original: The metal has been stubborn today. It refuses to bend.
string: 這塊金屬今天很頑固。它不想變彎。

original: No, mother. It's no wonder our enemies fear the sight of an Orc warrior.
string: 不，媽媽。我們的敵人一定會對一個獸人戰士的威風望而卻步的。

original: Ah, is there any weapon finer than an Orc blade?
string: 啊，還有比獸人的刀更出色的武器嗎？

original: On second thought, maybe I'll pass...
string: 另一種想法，或許我不接這工作...

original: I'm in.
string: 我做。

original: Do you have any burglary jobs?
string: 你手上有竊盜的工作嗎？

original: Pretty simple. Break into a house, grab a specific item and get out before they realize what's going on.
string: 很簡單。闖進一戶人家，拿走一個東西，然後在他們做出反應之前趕快離開。

original: The catch is you can't kill anyone who lives there or you forfeit the payment.
string: 最難的一點就是你不能殺掉住在那的任何人否則你就拿不到賞金。

original: You ready for some good old-fashioned burglary?
string: 你準備好進行一次舊式經典作風的竊盜行動了嗎？

original: Tell me about the burglary jobs.
string: 告訴我有關竊盜的工作。

original: We're looking to recover an heirloom for a client. They claim ownership of it, and as long as they're paying we don't really care. You in?
string: 我們要找人替客戶拿回傳家寶物。他們自稱是它的主人，不過只要他們付錢，我不管那麼多。你要不要加入？

original: We've been trying to get this item for a while, but no one with the skills has come along to claim it. Can I count on you to get it?
string: 我們接到這個委託也有段時間了，但一直沒有技術夠高的人去完成它。我能期待你的成功嗎？

original: Have a house with a good bit of valuables inside, but one particular item's caught my eye. You up for it?
string: 有一座房子裡擺滿了值錢貨，但是我看得上的只有一個。你想不想去拿？

original: Got a tip on a desirable item at this location. We want you to break in there and bring it to us. What do you think?
string: 有線索說這裡有一個我們想要的東西。我們想請你闖進去把它拿出來。你覺得怎麼樣？

original: Good, got a buyer in a rush for this item. If you hurry we can turn it around and make a quick profit. Can you get it?
string: 不錯，這東西有個很急的買主。如果你動作快的話我們能操作一下海撈一筆。你能去拿嗎？

original: Sure, sure. We're always looking to get our hands on items from all over Skyrim. How about this one?
string: 當然，當然有。我們一直都在找天際省中可以下手的目標。你看這個怎麼樣？

original: As long as you can keep things quiet and don't get yourself killed in the process, this place has exactly what we're looking for. You in?
string: 只要你能保證悄無聲息地行動而且活著回來的話，我們要找的東西就在這地方等著呢。你要不要做？

original: We've actually stolen this item before and somehow it ended up back in some other mark's house. Guess it's time to reclaim it, eh?
string: 我們曾經偷過這個東西，現在它不知怎麼到了其他人的家裡。我想應該是時候拿回它了，如何？

original: I don't have to take this from the likes of you.
string: 我不是非得從你這種人手裡拿到這個。

original: I cleared the mine of draugr.
string: 我把礦場裡的諾德亡靈都解決掉了。

original: You did? We were waiting for the Jarl to send an entire regiment to clear that mine.
string: 真的？我們還在等領主派部隊來清理礦場呢。

original: Now we can get back to work. Thank you.
string: 現在我們可以回去工作了。謝謝你。

original: The mine isn't safe? Why?
string: 礦場裡不安全？為什麼？

original: We tunneled into an old Nordic crypt. The whole place is crawling with draugr.
string: 我們挖到了一個古老的諾德墓穴。裡面爬滿了諾德亡靈。

original: We're not mining up any ore with those undead around, so I wouldn't go down there if I were you.
string: 只要有那些活死人在，我們就不會繼續採礦，所以我要是你的話就不會下去。

original: Whoa, there. I don't know where you're going, but stay out of that mine. It isn't safe.
string: 喂喂，聽我說。我不知道你要去哪，但是別進那個礦場。那裡不安全。

original: Do you have any shill jobs?
string: 現在有設餌任務嗎？

original: When a client needs us to eliminate another, we don't operate like the Dark Brotherhood. We find alternate means to get them out of the way.
string: 當一個客戶需要我們去殺死另一個客戶的時候，我們的做法和黑暗兄弟會不同。我們選擇其他途徑去平息他們。

original: We send you to plant some phony evidence in the mark's house, and then tip off the town guard... the rest takes care of itself.
string: 我們派你去把一些偽造的證據送到目標的房子裡，然後去向城鎮衛兵舉報……剩下的就任其發展吧。

original: Sound like you can handle it?
string: 你覺得你有辦法勝任嗎？

original: Tell me about the shill jobs.
string: 告訴我有關詐騙的任務。

original: Someone wants to see this mark suffer. They're paying a good bit of coin to have us plant the evidence in their house. You in?
string: 有人想整一下目標人物。他們開高價雇我們去把證據放進目標的家裡。要不要加入？

original: This one should be easy. Get in, plant the goods and get out. Quiet and neat. Sound like your kind of job?
string: 這次的比較簡單。進去，放下貨物，出來。乾淨俐落。不覺得很適合你嗎？

original: The mark must have ticked-off our client badly. He's impatient and keeps asking if the job's done. Can you get him off my back?
string: 這次的客戶一定是被目標氣得要死。他相當焦躁，老是問工作做完了沒有。你能幫我讓他息怒嗎？

original: Got a good one here. Personal score to settle between myself and this mark. You up for it?
string: 我剛好有個好工作。這次是我個人和這個目標的恩怨。你要做嗎？

original: Brynjolf finally got some dirt on the mark and the evidence to back it up. Think you can give him a hand?
string: 布林喬夫總算揪住了目標的狐狸尾巴而且拿到了一些證據。你是不是能去幫他一把？

original: This one angered someone pretty high up in the keep. Can I count on you to get this done for me?
string: 這次的目標得罪的是城塞裡的大人物。你能幫我解決這事嗎？

original: Got another personal score to settle and I'd consider it a favor if you'd take the job. Think you can help me out?
string: 我又有一個私人衝突要解決，要是你接了這份工作，我會報答你的。你能幫我嗎？

original: Sure, sure. Got one that should be pretty easy, as long as you keep your weapon sheathed. Can you handle it?
string: 當然，當然。這有一個很容易完成的任務，你只要記住千萬別讓兵器出鞘就行。你能辦到嗎？

original: Yeah. Someone ticked off Maven and she wants to teach them a lesson... our way. You in?
string: 有人惹瑪雯生氣了，她想教訓他們一頓……太適合我們了。你要接嗎？

original: Maybe some other time.
string: 也許改天吧。

original: Consider it done.
string: 包在我身上。

original: Fine, but don't say I didn't warn you.
string: 非常好，但是可別說我沒警告過你。

original: There's a war on. We need every scrap of ore we can get, so we're going to keep digging. Understand?
string: 戰爭正在進行。就算只挖到一小粒礦石我們也得存著，所以我們要一直挖下去。懂了沒？

original: I don't think it's safe mining a cave on top of that crypt.
string: 我覺得在那個墓穴上方挖礦不是個好主意。

original: Don't be such a coward. We haven't seen any draugr since the mine was cleared. Be grateful.
string: 別這麼沒種。從礦洞被清理後我們就沒再看到諾德亡靈了。你應該心懷感激。

original: Those draugr are going to be back. I can feel it.
string: 那些諾德亡靈會回來的。我有預感。

original: That's comforting. Glad they're keeping watch instead of getting rid of the draugr.
string: 這就讓人安心多了。真高興他們不是屠殺諾德亡靈而是設定守衛。

original: The guards say no draugr have come out of the mine.
string: 衛兵說目前沒再看見過礦裡爬出諾德亡靈了。

original: "We're safe" he says. You'll eat those words when a draugr is tearing into your face.
string: 他說「我們安全了」喲。不過當一個諾德亡靈迎面朝你撲過來的時候你肯定會把這句話咽進肚子裡。

original: They haven't moved out of the caves. I think we're safe.
string: 他們沒有追出洞來。我們大概安全了。

original: Those draugr are going to come up and kill us all.
string: 那些諾德亡靈會上來把我們全殺掉。

original: Steel your nerves. The draugr are gone. Focus on your mining.
string: 控制住你的情緒。諾德亡靈已經走了。集中精力採礦吧。

original: I feel like any moment, a draugr is going to come and chop my head off.
string: 我感覺好像每時每刻都有種危險，會有一個諾德亡靈突然出現擰掉我的腦袋。

original: How can you say that? This mine was filled with draugr not too long ago.
string: 你怎麼能說這種話？這個礦前不久才被諾德亡靈佔領過。

original: Feels good to be mining again.
string: 又能採礦的感覺真不錯呀。

original: Never mind, maybe later.
string: 沒關係，那就下次吧。

original: I'll do it.
string: 我接受。

original: Do you have any numbers jobs?
string: 有哪的帳目需要我改改嗎？

original: Most of the establishments in Skyrim keep their transactions recorded within business ledgers.
string: 天際省的大部分機構都有一本記錄所有交易的總帳。

original: Your job would be to change the numbers in those books so the shortfalls from our other jobs look legit.
string: 你的任務是改動那些帳簿上的數字，使那些由我們的其他工作造成的虧空在帳面上做平。

original: Feel like doing a bit of writin'?
string: 想試試做點文職嗎？

original: Tell me about the numbers jobs.
string: 介紹一下帳目任務吧。

original: This business is a regular target for the Guild. They keep pretty shoddy records, so the job should be a cinch. You in?
string: 這任務是公會的基層業務之一。它們的數量很多價錢很便宜，所以也很容易做。你要做嗎？

original: We want to waylay a shipment on the way from this business without them even noticin' anything went missin'. Want the job?
string: 我們想在商路上偷襲一隻貨船，在他們還沒發現被偷了什麼之前就走人。想做這份工作嗎？

original: Yeah, sure. Got a business on tap that could use a little number rearrangin'. What do you say?
string: 當然有。現在我手上就有個需要做點帳目微調的生意。你覺得如何？

original: Okay, got just the one for you. Ledger's just beggin' to be changed and the Guild could use the coin. How about it?
string: 好啊，正好有一個給你。有人急著要改總帳而公會正缺這筆傭金。你看怎麼樣？

original: Have a client lookin' to have a rival's business ledger changed. Don't know the reason, and don't want to know. Count you in?
string: 有一個客戶想讓他對手的帳目出點差錯。不知道為什麼，也不想知道。交給你吧？

original: Got a personal request from Brynjolf on this numbers job. He says we may hit 'em hard later, and wants to prep their books. Help us out?
string: 這個任務是布林喬夫的私人請求。他說我們可以先對他們手下留情，他想先查一下他們的帳簿。來幫幫我們吧？

original: These marks keep their ledger all neat and tidy, but they're ripe for some change if you know what I mean. Take it?
string: 這些目標把他們的帳做得滴水不漏，但是要是你瞭解我在說什麼的話就知道他們還是嫩了點。要接嗎？

original: All right. Got a simple one. Just get in, change the books and be back in time for last call. So how's about it?
string: 好吧。有個簡單的。就是進去、改帳目、然後在酒吧打烊前回來。你覺得這個怎麼樣？

original: Never mind. I've got other things to do.
string: 不了。我有其他事要做。

original: I'll get it done.
string: 我做。

original: Do you have any fishing jobs?
string: 有釣魚任務嗎？

original: There are all sorts of people wandering around carryin' their valuables on their person... just waitin' for someone like you to pick their pocket.
string: 街上有著各種喜歡把貴重物品隨身攜帶的傢伙……就等著你這樣的人去偷呢。

original: So, you in for a little fishin'?
string: 所以，你想去釣個魚嗎？

original: Tell me about the fishing jobs.
string: 告訴我有關釣魚的工作。

original: Sure, I've got a mark for you. Stole something quite important from a friend of the Guild and we take care of our own. You in?
string: 當然，我正有一個目標給你。從一個公會的老朋友身上偷個十分重要的東西，剩下的我們自己處理。幹不幹？

original: One of our marks seems to have an item of value we want to add to our vault. Get it for us and you'll receive the usual pay. Sound good?
string: 我們的一個目標身上似乎有個我們想納為己有的珍品。替我們拿到它，你會得到應得的報酬。聽起來不錯吧？

original: Got ourselves a freelancer thinks he can muscle in on our territory. How about you teach him some manners, eh?
string: 有一個雲遊武士認為他能用自己的打架功夫衝進我們的領地。嗯，你去給他上一課怎麼樣？

original: Maven wants this mark's most prized possession. The bloody fool carries it on his person all the time. So, think you can handle it?
string: 瑪雯想要從這個目標身上拿走最值錢的收藏品。這個倒霉的笨蛋無時無刻不把那寶物帶在身上。那麼，你覺得有把握嗎？

original: Brynjolf want's this mark's head on a pike, but we'll settle for what the bastard's carryin' instead. Can I count on you?
string: 布林喬夫想讓這個目標的頭被插到尖木樁上，但是我們希望用他帶在身上的東西作交換。能把這事交給你做嗎？

original: Got a mark taxed with carryin' a heavy item. Care to lighten' the load?
string: 有一個目標帶著一個蠻重的東西。介意去幫他減輕一下重量嗎？

original: This brilliant soul decided to pick a fight with a fellow Guild mate. Time for them to pay the piper. Will you help out?
string: 這位睿智的人要和我們公會裡的一個弟兄比武。這種時候就應該讓他們付出點代價。你能幫忙嗎？

original: I've got a mark who just got an item from a relative outside of Skyrim. They probably should have been quieter about it. You in?
string: 有一個目標剛從天際省之外的親戚那收到了一個貴重品。我覺得他們實在應該低調一點的。你說呢？

original: Help us and you may earn a pardon.
string: 幫我們的話你可以得到原諒。

original: Hey, weren't you on the carts with the Stormcloaks?
string: 嘿，你不是那個貨車上跟風暴斗篷一夥的嗎？

original: Ah, well, if Hadvar vouches for you I guess it must be all right.
string: 噢，這個嘛，要是哈達瓦為你作證的話我覺得沒問題。

original: I saw Caius.. that dragon just grabbed him and... I don't know how I made it out of there...
string: 我看到凱尤斯……那隻龍把他抓住然後……我不知道自己怎麼跑出來的……

original: Nothing for it but to keep moving.
string: 只是一直前進，沒別的。

original: Better down here than out there.
string: 這洞裡比外面安全多了。

original: A dragon.... First in a thousand years....
string: 一條龍……千年來首次重現……

original: We need to find a way out of here.
string: 我們得找到出去的路。

original: What?
string: 什麼？

original: Worry about yourself.
string: 擔心你自己吧。

original: Thank Talos you came along... I thought I was going to die down here.
string: 感謝塔洛斯，你來了……我還以為我肯定會死在這裡的。

original: Imperial dogs... there's nothing that's too low for them.
string: 帝國走狗……沒什麼東西比他們更低劣了。

original: You were with us on the carts, weren't you? Not your lucky day, eh?
string: 你當時在貨車上和我們待在一起，不是嗎？今天你挺不幸的，哈？

original: I wonder if there's any more Imperials hiding down here somewhere.
string: 我在想說不定附近還有某些角落埋伏著帝國人。

original: Ralof seems to like you. That's good enough for me.
string: 拉羅夫似乎挺喜歡你的，這對我來說就夠了。

original: What do you make of it... the dragon? What does it mean?
string: 你認為是什麼……是龍嗎？這意味著什麼呢？

original: What next?
string: 接下來會是什麼？

original: I hope someone knows where we're going.
string: 我希望有人知道我們正往哪走。

original: Better down here than out there.
string: 這洞裡比外面安全多了。

original: Just keep putting one foot in front of the other.
string: 你就不停地把一隻腳邁到另一隻前面去就行了。

original: I think we're almost out. Come on!
string: 我想我們馬上就出去了。加油！

original: Take it slow and careful, and I think we can sneak by her.
string: 慢慢地、輕輕地，我想我們能從牠身邊溜過去。

original: We must be near the entrance for that bear to make its den here.
string: 我們肯定是在熊窩的入口附近。

original: I'll follow your lead.
string: 我跟在你後面。

original: I've got your back, don't worry.
string: 我防守你的後方，不要擔心。

original: Not now.
string: 現在可不行。

original: Biggest damn spiders I've ever seen.
string: 媽的，這是我見過最大的蜘蛛。

original: The others'll have to find another way out.
string: 其他人都得找另外的出路了。

original: This is the longest day I can remember.
string: 這是我記憶中最漫長的一天。

original: Let's see if we can find a way out of here.
string: 看看我們能不能找到通往外面的路。

original: We'd better stick together down here.
string: 在這裡我們最好互相照應。

original: I sure hope there's a way out somewhere down here.
string: 我當然希望這裡有路能出去。

original: Here's the noble Empire in all its glory. Pah.
string: 這就是無比輝煌的偉大的帝國。哈。

original: Come on!
string: 上啊！

original: Look around. Grab anything useful.
string: 注意周圍。找些有用的東西。

original: There may be a way out, down this way.
string: 說不定順著這條路走就能出去。

original: We'd better get moving before any more Imperials show up.
string: 我們最好在遇見帝國人之前快點走。

original: Let's see where this goes. Better than going back outside with that dragon.
string: 來看看這條路通往哪裡。這比折回去繼續和那隻龍待在一起好。

original: Get yourself a weapon. I'm going to need your help if we run into any more Imperials.
string: 你得找把兵器。要是再遇上帝國人的話你也得幫忙。

original: We've got to find a way out of here.
string: 我們得找到出去的路。

original: Don't worry. We'll get out of here, somehow.
string: 別擔心。我們能出去的，總有辦法的。

original: I don't think this day is ever going to end.
string: 我開始覺得這一天永遠不會結束了。

original: Better in here than out there.
string: 在這裡比剛才那好多了。

original: I think we're almost out. Come on!
string: 我想我們馬上就出去了。加油！

original: Let's take our time. I think we can sneak by her if we're careful.
string: 我們慢慢來。小心點的話也許能從牠旁邊溜過去。

original: We must be near the entrance for that bear to have made its den here.
string: 我們一定是在熊窩的入口附近。

original: I'll follow your lead.
string: 我跟在你後面。

original: Easy does it.
string: 放輕鬆去做。

original: Not now.
string: 別說話現在！

original: I hate those things. Too many eyes or something.
string: 我討厭那些東西。眼睛什麼的長得太多了。

original: Looks like we're on our own now.
string: 看來我們現在只能靠自己了。

original: Since nobody's trying to kill me just now, maybe we should rest for a minute.
string: 既然現在好像沒人要殺我了，我們也該休息一會兒啦。

original: Let's see if we can find a way out of here.
string: 看看我們能不能找到通往外面的路。

original: We'd better stick together down here.
string: 在這裡我們最好互相照應。

original: I'm glad to be out of that place. I hope this leads somewhere.
string: 能離開那地方我太高興了。希望這條路通往一個好地方。

original: These bastards call themselves Imperial Legionnaires...
string: 這些混蛋傢伙自稱是帝國軍團兵……

original: Come on. Sounds like trouble.
string: 快走。聽起來似乎有人陷入麻煩。

original: Look around. Grab anything that looks useful.
string: 注意周圍。找些有用的東西。

original: There may be a way out, down this way.
string: 說不定能出去，試試順著這條路走。

original: I guess that'll teach me to try to reason with a Stormcloak.
string: 我想這能讓我學會如何跟一個風暴斗篷講道理。

original: Let's see where this goes. We can't be the only survivors.
string: 看看這條路通向哪裡。我們肯定不是唯一的生還者。

original: Find yourself a weapon. You're going to need it.
string: 你得找把武器。要是再遇上帝國人的話你也得幫忙。

original: We'd better get out of here. I don't think this place is going to stand up to much more of this.
string: 我們最好趕快出去。我不覺得這個地方能支撐多久。

original: Don't worry. We'll get out of here, somehow.
string: 別擔心。我們能出去的，總有辦法的。

original: I can't decide if things are about to get worse or better.
string: 我總是不能確定事態是要轉好還是變壞。

original: At least we don't have a dragon to worry about, for the moment.
string: 至少我們不用擔心龍了，暫時。

original: I presume this <Alias=Loot> belongs to you?
string: 這個<Alias=Loot>應該是你的吧？

original: Yes! How'd you get this? Never mind, here. It's not much, but its something.
string: 是的！你怎麼找到的？算了，給你這個。雖然不多，但還能用。

original: I'm going to track down that thief and murder him!
string: 我要追上那個賊然後殺了他！

original: Yeah, he went that way.
string: 是啊，他從那邊跑了。

original: Great! Thanks! Bastard stole from me. I'll catch him though!
string: 太棒了！謝謝！雜種居然偷我東西。不過我會抓住他的！

original: No, didn't see anyone. (Lie)
string: 不，我沒看見。（撒謊）

original: Well, if you do, grab him and yell. Bastard stole from me.
string: 好吧，要是你看見的話，抓住他然後大聲呼叫。那雜種偷我的東西。

original: Slow down. Explain yourself.
string: 喘口氣。把話說清楚。

original: So we're splitting the loot, then?
string: 就是說我們平分戰利品，是嗎？

original: Ha! I'm afraid the loot's already been moved. You've been useful to the Blackbloods, though. You've earned a quick death.
string: 哈！恐怕戰利品早就被挪走了。雖然你和黑血很熟，但你也離死不遠了。

original: So you want me to put out the Lighthouse fire?
string: 你是要我去滅掉燈塔的火？

original: What an interesting idea. I think if someone were to do something like that, there would definitely be a certain amount of loot to be shared...
string: 多麼有趣的想法。我想要是有人做出這種事，一定可以分到相當可觀的戰利品。

original: Yes, if someone were to put out the Lighthouse fire and then meet me on the docks afterwards... I could certainly direct them to that loot.
string: 是啊，要是有人弄滅燈塔的火焰之後來碼頭區見我……我必然會告訴他們到哪裡拿那些戰利品。

original: No time to talk. Snitch or double-cross me and I'll kill you. I mean it!
string: 沒時間多說了，出賣我我就要你的命。記住嘍！

original: Okay, so what's your offer?
string: 好啊，那你能給我什麼？

original: With the war, many more ships come through these docks. Loaded with weapons and pay, but few people. And they pass through dangerous waters.
string: 戰爭期間，還會有更多的船來到這個碼頭。它們滿載著兵器和貨款，但是船員卻很少。而且它們的航線要路過諸多危險水域。

original: We have an interest in one of those boats, the Icerunner.
string: 我們對其中的一艘船感興趣，它叫寒冰疾馳者。

original: The Solitude Lighthouse will be guiding it in... but if its fire were to go out, the Icerunner would run aground.
string: 獨孤城燈塔會把它引導進港……但是要是燈塔不亮的話，寒冰疾馳者肯定會擱淺。

original: You're passing through Solitude? Maybe you're looking to make some easy gold, yes?
string: 你是路經獨孤城的旅人？或許你會想要輕鬆地賺點錢嘍，對吧？

original: Umm...
Hello.
string: 你好。

original: Take this and hold onto it. I'll be back for it later. I'll pay you good. Don't lose it.
string: 拿著這個，看好它。過陣子我會回來拿。我會給你很高的報酬。別弄丟了。

original: Did you see someone run past just now?
string: 你剛才有看到人跑過去嗎？

original: It seems there's no talking you out of this...
string: 好像沒辦法說動你……

original: You should leave. I don't want you scaring off my good death.
string: 你該離開了。我不希望你耽誤我尋求榮耀的死亡。

original: You don't look that old to me. Certainly you're still a strong, capable warrior.
string: 我看你沒有那麼老。毫無疑問，你仍是個強勁有力、以一當百的戰士。

original: Indeed. One should find his death while he can still call himself a proper man.
string: 確實。一個人應該在自己最問心無愧的時候去主動尋求榮耀的死法。

original: We Orc men are not like these Nords and Imperials who carry on until they are grey and feeble and their hair falls out.
string: 我們獸人不像諾德人和帝國人那樣選擇屈從於時間流逝，那樣任憑自己枯萎、虛弱、老死。

original: To cling to something past its usefulness is unseemly, how much more so when that thing is you?
string: 當一個東西已經不再有用的時候還緊抓不放，那實在很難看。如果那個東西是你，又會怎麼樣？

original: On second thought, maybe not.
string: 我想了想，還是不要了。

original: Yes, I am sure. I will give you a good death.
string: 是的，我很肯定。我會讓你痛快地死。

original: Hmm. We shall see.
string: 呵。那就看看吧。

original: Perhaps I could give you the death you seek?
string: 我或許可以給你你所期待的那種死亡？

original: Perhaps...
string: 或許……

original: Are you sure about this?
string: 你確定嗎？

original: Why do you wish to die?
string: 你為什麼想死？

original: My time has come. I am old. Too old to become chief. It would be wrong for me to take wives at this age. So I will die.
string: 我的時間到了。我老了。已經不能再當酋長了。我這種年齡還娶妻是不對的。我應該死去。

original: Malacath has given me a vision of a glorious death. I am to wait here until it finds me.
string: 瑪拉凱斯用幻景告訴我我能死的十分榮耀。我在這裡等待著。

original: As you can see, it has not yet arrived.
string: 你看到了，它還沒來。

original: A good death?
string: 一個榮耀的死亡方式？

original: Yes. Were I to simply lay down and die, it would not please Malacath.
string: 是的。就算我躺下來死了，也不會影響到瑪拉凱斯。

original: Hello.
string: 你好。

original: I am waiting for a good death.
string: 我在等一個榮耀的死亡方式。

original: If you are not here to grant me a good death, then you can leave.
string: 如果你不能讓我死得榮耀，那你還是走吧。

original: Get out of here!
string: 滾出去！

original: This is my treasure!
string: 這是我的財寶！

original: I'm not kidding. I'll hurt you!
string: 我可不是開玩笑。我會對你動手的！

original: It's all in good fun, Tullius.
string: 真好笑啊，圖留斯。

original: If you say so. If this were anyone but you I would lock them up.
string: 好吧。如果是其他人的話我早就把他關起來了。

original: Take it. Take the coat, have your fun. I'll see you at the festival.
string: 拿著它。拿走那外套，好好感受一番吧。我們在節日慶典上見。

original: I'm going to put it on Olaf's Effigy.
string: 我會把它穿在奧拉夫的雕像身上。

original: What?! This is exactly why... don't they understand it's hard enough to fight a war without these juvenile attempts to undermine authority?
string: 什麼？！這是為什麼……他們難道不明白，要是沒有這些誹謗權威的不成熟舉動，想打贏一場戰爭將會非常的難嗎？

original: I need your coat.
string: 我要你的外套。

original: My coat? What do you need my coat for?
string: 我的外套？你要做什麼用？

original: You there! As an officer of the Imperial Legion, I require your assistance to complete my mission.
string: 那邊的！我是帝國軍團軍官，我命令你協助我執行任務。

original: You there, hold! If you are a true friend to Skyrim, you will help me in my mission.
string: 那邊那個，站住！如果你是天際省真正的朋友，你應該協助我執行任務。

original: Are you going to help me with my mission? I need someone very capable.
string: 你要協助我執行任務嗎？我需要有個能力優秀的幫手。

original: Everyone in town knows about the Black Door, and to never go near it.
string: 城鎮裡的每個人都知道黑門，都知道決不能接近它。

original: Whatever you do, stay away from that Black Door. Being near it chills you to the bones.
string: 不管你做什麼，離那個黑門遠遠的。只要靠它近一點，你就會感到透骨的寒意。

original: Did you hear? People have been seen coming in and out of the Black Door. Divines have mercy.
string: 你聽說沒有？有人在那黑門裡進進出出。聖靈們啊寬恕我們。

original: I've heard that shadowy figures are being seen coming in and out of the Black Door. Gods help us.
string: 我聽說有鬼祟的身影在那黑門裡進進出出。神啊救救我們。

original: Excellent work.
string: 幹得漂亮。

original: Now, I trust you're sharp enough to see that the sword doesn't match the description of the Ebony Blade you may know.
string: 現在，我相信你也該敏銳地察覺到，那劍跟你所知的黑檀岩刃的描述不相符。

original: It has languished too long outside the winds of alliance and betrayal.
string: 它已經太久沒有暴露在外面那勾心鬥角的紛爭之風當中了。

original: So how do I open the door?
string: 那我怎麼打開那扇門？

original: I told you, I know everything about this castle.
string: 我告訴過你，這城中大大小小的事我都知道。

original: For some reason that door is special. Only two people can open it, Balgruuf and Farengar, the court wizard.
string: 由於某種原因，那扇門是很特別的。只有兩個人能打開它，巴爾古夫和法仁加，那個宮廷法師。

original: How you get it from them is up to you. Nobody would notice if Farengar went missing, I promise you.
string: 你怎麼辦到那是你的事。我可以向你保證，沒人會關心法仁加是不是失蹤了。

original: Do you know how to open the Whispering Door?
string: 你知道怎麼打開低語之門嗎？

original: I'll take that claw for 50 gold.
string: 我出50金幣買那個龍爪。

original: Fine, here you go.
string: 好吧，拿去。

original: You get killed on account of this thing, it's not my fault. Got it?
string: 你是因為這東西而被殺，和我沒關係。知道了嗎？

original: But, I suppose, if it does actually turn out to be worth something, let me know, will you?
string: 但是，我覺得，要是它確實有價值的話，你會告訴我的，對吧？

original: Oh, I'd gladly sell it to you if you had the money.
string: 噢，要是你出價合理的話我很樂意賣給你。

original: But you don't, do you?
string: 但是你沒有，不是嗎？

original: I could look into it for you.
string: 我可以替你調查一下。

original: I don't even care any more. You want to check it out? Fine. I'll sell you the thing for fifty gold, and then it's your problem.
string: 我也沒什麼興趣了。你想調查一下嗎？好吧。50金幣賣給你，然後就隨你的便了。

original: What was the story?
string: 這當中有什麼故事嗎？

original: Some line about this claw thing and Yngol Barrow. He said it was worth more than its weight in gold if I took it back there.
string: 這當中有一些關於這個爪子和英格爾塚的線索。他說要是我把它帶到那，這東西會更有價值

original: Something about placing it back in Yngol's chamber, I don't know.
string: 可能是要把它放回英格爾的密室吧，我也不清楚。

original: What was I thinking? Even if it were true, I'm not setting foot in some ancient tomb, filled with who knows what.
string: 你問我怎麼想？就算那是真的，我也不會踏進古墓的，誰知道那裡都住著什麼東西。

original: You said something about a bad deal?
string: 你說你做了很糟的交易？

original: Yeah, it was stupid of me.
string: 是啊，我真蠢。

original: I shouldn't have believed the story and just refused the trade. But I didn't, and now I'm stuck with this worthless junk.
string: 我真不該相信那個故事，我應該拒絕那筆交易。但我還是大意了，現在要為這個不值錢的垃圾傷腦筋。

original: I've been burned a few times, made a few bad deals, but mostly I come out on top.
string: 我被耍了好幾次，做了幾筆很糟的交易，不過大多時候我還是占上風的。

original: Do you get much business way up here?
string: 你在這的生意好嗎？

original: Very funny.
string: 你這麼問還真有趣。

original: I'm sure you've noticed that Winterhold isn't exactly overflowing with people.
string: 你肯定注意到了冬堡的人口其實並沒到多到裝不下的程度。

original: So I'll sell whatever I can. If it's worth putting a price on, you can bet I'll do it.
string: 所以我會儘量多賣給你一些東西。要是那東西值得一賣的話，我肯定會賣的。

original: Is there anyone who knows what she likes?
string: 有人知道她喜歡什麼嗎？

original: There is one... Yngvar. He's quite popular with the ladies.
string: 有……英瓦。他很受女性歡迎。

original: Thankfully Faleen is not quite his type, but they've been friends for some time, and he may have some ideas.
string: 幸好法琳不是他喜歡的類型，不過他們現在是朋友，說不定他會知道點什麼？

original: Please, ask him what she likes. It's my only chance.
string: 我求你，幫我問問他法琳喜歡什麼？這是我唯一的希望了。

original: Never mind. I think she wants a more cultured man.
string: 別這麼客氣。我想她想要的是一個更有教養的男人。

original: If that's what she wants, then that's what she'll get.
string: 如果她的願望是這樣，那她會如願以償的。

original: I mean that you should be bold.
string: 我的意思是你應該拿出勇氣來。

original: Wait... you mean I should just... tell her? Tell her how I feel?
string: 等等……你是說我應該……直接告訴她？告訴她我的想法？

original: Who else is in the family?
string: 他們家還有什麼人？

original: Well, there's Ingun Black-Briar, Maven's daughter. Strange girl. She likes to spend time down in Elgrim's Elixirs working on her alchemy.
string: 嗯，有因甘．黑棘，瑪雯的女兒。怪異的女孩兒。她喜歡泡在艾爾格瑞姆的藥水店那裡研究她的鍊金術。

original: Then you have Hemming, Maven's son; spoiled brat and heir to her empire. He follows her word like a loyal dog follows its master.
string: 還有海姆英，瑪雯的兒子；被寵壞的小搗蛋、她的帝國的王位繼承人。他對她順從得就像一隻討好主人的忠狗。

original: And finally, Sibbi; the worst of all of them. He's in Riften Jail for murder.
string: 最後，還有西比；他們中最差勁的一個。他因謀殺被關進裂谷城監獄。

original: Very well.
string: 很好。

original: Of course he wasn't you stupid whore; he's a man. Now I'm not going to warn you again. Is that clear?
string: 他當然不是你們這群沒腦子的應召女中的一個；他是個男人。同樣的話我不會說第二遍。聽明白沒有？

original: He wasn't protesting, Maven.
string: 他不是在反對，瑪雯。

original: Haelga, I like you, so I'm only going to say this one time.
string: 哈爾嘉，我喜歡你，所以我只對你說這一次。

original: If you ever try and "practice the Dibellan arts" with Hemming again, I'll make sure that pretty little face loses its beauty.
string: 如果你試過和海姆英「一同練習某種技巧」，我敢保證你那張花容月貌的小臉會花容失色的。

original: Sigh.
string: 唉。

original: Good, that must be very comfortable for you. I think mine's a bit too small. Perhaps we could trade?
string: 很好，那肯定會讓你很舒服的。我覺得我這個有點太小了。要不我們做個交易吧？

original: Those sellswords won't be a problem now.
string: 那些傭兵不會來煩你們了。

original: That won't be the last we hear from the Silver-Bloods, but at least we can get back to work.
string: 這不會是最後一次聽到銀血家族的名字，但至少我們可以回去正常工作了。

original: Thank you. You've done a good thing for me and my workers. Here. This is for you.
string: 謝謝你。你幫了我和我的工人們一個大忙。拿去，這是送給你的。

original: Who are the Silver-Bloods?
string: 銀血是什麼人？

original: You haven't heard of the Silver-Blood family? They're the most important people in the Reach.
string: 你沒聽過銀血家？他們可是邊塞最聲名顯赫的家族。

original: They practically own the city of Markarth. And we're here on their coin.
string: 他們可算是馬卡斯城的實際掌權者。我們來這裡也是受他們委託。

original: Who are the Silver-Bloods?
string: 銀血是什麼人？

original: A family of thieves. Running their corrupt empire from Markarth.
string: 一個盜賊家族。在馬卡斯城經營著他們的墮落帝國。

original: The Silver-Blood family own half the Reach, and they won't stop until they own all of it.
string: 銀血家族擁有半個邊塞，而且他們還在繼續擴張直到他們擁有一切。

original: I want you and your men to leave.
string: 我想請你和你的人離開。

original: Helping out Ainethach, huh? Give me a reason not to plunge a dagger in your chest.
string: 在幫艾尼塔克，哈？給我一個不一刀刺死你的理由。

original: Why have you shut down the mine?
string: 你為什麼要關掉礦場？

original: Forsworn attacked a while back. Jarl had no men to spare, so the Silver-Bloods generously offered to send us to clean things up.
string: 棄誓者後來又發動一波攻擊。領主沒有多餘的兵力，所以銀血大方地提供兵力把我們送來清理門戶。

original: We just want that old native to hand over his land in payment for our services. Then we'll leave, and everyone can get back to work.
string: 我們想讓那個在地老傢伙交出他的土地來回報我們。拿到以後我們就離開，而大家也都可以正常工作了。

original: I think you should sell the mine.
string: 我覺得你應該賣掉礦場。

original: No. This is my land. You expect me to just hand it over to those Silver-Blood thugs?
string: 不，這是我的土地。你想要我把它白送給銀血那幫混帳？

original: Trouble with the mine?
string: 礦場發生什麼麻煩了？

original: Robbery is what it is. The Silver-Bloods are trying to muscle in on my land.
string: 該說是搶劫嗎。銀血家的人正試圖搶走我的家園。

original: Forsworn attack the mines, and suddenly all these sellswords show up to "help." They won't let anyone work until I sell it off.
string: 棄誓者襲擊了礦場，然後突然出現了一大幫傭兵「幫忙」。我看除非我點頭答應賣掉礦場，否則他們不會讓任何人有辦法工作。

original: The Silver-Bloods have made you a very generous offer for this pile of dirt. I suggest you take it.
string: 銀血家族為了買你這塊小泥地開出了非常有誠意的價碼。我建議你接受這個慷慨的提議。

original: Oh, and when would that be, I wonder? When I sell my land to the Silver-Bloods?
string: 噢，我很好奇那是什麼時候呢？在我把我的領地賣給銀血家族的時候嗎？

original: Watch your tongue, native. We'll leave when we're sure there's no Forsworn here.
string: 注意你的言辭，本地人，我們會在確定這裡沒有棄誓者之後離開。

original: I want you sellswords out of my mine.
string: 我希望你們這種傭兵離我的礦場遠一點。

original: I have plenty of room in my bed.
string: 我床上還有很多空間呢

original: Of course. I rented a bed there. Where else would I sleep?
string: 當然，我在那租了張床，不然我還能睡哪？

original: So, Tythis... you coming by the Bunkhouse later?
string: 那麼，泰迪斯，你等會兒會來工棚嗎？

original: Sigh. Yes, as usual. I'll be there.
string: 唉，好吧，我會像往常一樣在那裡的。

original: Will we be dining together this evening after my work at the fishery?
string: 今晚等我結束在漁場的工作後一起吃個飯怎麼樣？

original: Oh! Bolli... yes, hello.
string: 噢，波利，你好啊。

original: Nivenor, my darling. What a pleasant surprise.
string: 尼維諾爾，親愛的。真是驚喜啊。

original: When I got close, the mercenaries Aringoth hired to protect the estate just waved me off. I don't think he wants visitors anymore.
string: 當我靠近時，那些受雇前來保護莊園的阿林格斯傭兵們把我趕走了。我想他不希望任何訪客來訪。

original: Why didn't you then?
string: 那麼，你為什麼不靠近些呢？

original: Bountiful. Although I would like to have anchored a bit closer to Goldenglow Estate.
string: 夠近了，雖然我想離金色光輝莊園更近一些。

original: Hello Bolli. How's the fishing?
string: 你好啊，波利，今天捕魚如何？

original: Good. You could be our first line of defense since you live outside the city walls, so we're depending on you.
string: 收穫頗豐。說起來自從你住在城牆週邊之後就成了這裡的第一道防線，所以我們都很信賴你呢。

original: Yes, Lady Mjoll. If Riften gets attacked, we'll retreat inside the city gates and bar the door just like you said.
string: 是啊，穆月爾女士，如果裂谷城遭到攻擊，我們會退守回城裡，然後把門閂牢。

original: Have you prepared the stables like I suggested, Shadr?
string: 你照我說的那樣準備好馬匹了嗎？沙德？

original: If I see him, I'll make sure he doesn't do anything brash. Don't worry.
string: 如果我看到他了，我保證不讓他做出什麼無禮的事情的。請別擔心。

original: It's Bersi. He's getting so angry about the corruption in Riften, he said he's going to walk right up to Maven and give her a piece of his mind.
string: 是波西，他對裂谷城內的腐敗感到非常憤怒，他說他要去瑪雯那邊說說他的想法。

original: What is it, Drifa? What's the matter?
string: 怎麼了，崔法？有什麼事嗎？

original: Mjoll! I'm glad I found you.
string: 穆月爾！能找到你太好了！

original: I hope that doesn't mean things are going to get worse around here.
string: 我希望那不意味著有什麼事情變得更糟了。

original: I've heard. Bolli and Keerava were speaking of it just a little while ago.
string: 我聽說了，波利和基拉瓦剛才還在說這件事呢。

original: Marise, I've come to warn you that the Thieves Guild has been harassing shopkeepers again.
string: 馬利瑟，我是來提醒你盜賊公會的人又在騷擾商店店主了。

original: No, no... not at all. Mara believes that the spark of a union comes from inside us, not from our appearance.
string: 不……不全是這樣，瑪拉認為這公會裡有一部分人是來自我們內部，而不是週邊的人。

original: Tell you what... if you still feel unsure, come by the temple sometime and we'll talk about it.
string: 如果你仍然覺得不確定，那你可以挑個時間到神殿來，我們再好好討論一下。

original: Did... did I say you weren't smart? I meant to say that I'm not smart, Lash. I'm just not smart enough to answer your questions.
string: 我有說過你不夠聰明嗎？，我想我是在說我自己不夠聰明，拉什，我還沒有聰明到能夠回答你的問題。

original: Is that so? I'll remember that next time we're in the mine tunnels... alone.
string: 是這樣嗎？下次我們在礦道……獨處的時候，我會記得的。

original: You wouldn't understand, Lash. Your people aren't smart enough for politics.
string: 你還不明白嗎，拉什？你們那幫人沒有聰明到可以搞政治。

original: Why do your people claim the Reach is theirs? The Orcs have been in these lands just as long.
string: 為什麼你們聲稱邊塞是你們的地盤呢？獸人很久以前就在這片土地上了。

original: What I meant to say was... I love having an Orc here in the barracks. They're so... pleasant.
string: 我想說的是，我歡迎獸人在兵營裡。他們很……有趣。

original: If you want me to leave, you could challenge me to a fight. I promise to stop once you've lost an arm.
string: 如果你想要我離開，那就用武力挑戰我吧，我保證會在你丟掉一條手臂後停手的。

original: I don't like bunking with Orcs. It's not... clean.
string: 我討厭和獸人廢話，那一點也不……和樂。

original: I'm warning you. Those people are killers. You'd never last a day with them.
string: 我警告你，這些傢伙都是殺手。你從沒和他們相處過。

original: Maybe I will. What do you think about that?
string: 也許我會的，你怎麼看？

original: You're always talking about the Forsworn. You aren't thinking of joining them, are you?
string: 你總是在討論棄誓者。你該不會是想加入他們吧？

original: I... I'm sorry, Belchimac. I didn't mean that.
string: 我…我很抱歉，貝爾奇邁克，我沒有那個意思。

original: Nothing, Ragnar. Please... don't hurt me.
string: 沒什麼，拉格納。別……傷害我。

original: What did you say? You lazy coward, I'll cut your throat.
string: 你剛才說什麼？你這懶惰的懦夫，我要切開你的喉嚨。

original: Damn Nords. Always getting in the way of us honest folk.
string: 該死的諾德，總是妨礙我們淳樸的鄉民。

original: Oh. I'm sorry. Well, it's good to have you here, anyway.
string: 噢，我很抱歉，不管怎麼說，有你在這裡真好。

original: I asked what you thought of the Orcs, not about me.
string: 我在問你對獸人的看法，而不是我。

original: Cunning warriors and skilled workers. It's good to have you here, Lash.
string: 他們是狡猾的戰士與熟練的工人，

original: Tell me, Ragnar, what do you think of the Orcs?
string: 告訴我，拉格納。你怎麼看待獸人的？

original: I can afford to buy meat now. I prefer working in the mines, anyway.
string: 我現在買得起肉了，總之，我選擇了在礦場工作。

original: I haven't seen you hunting in a while.
string: 我有陣子沒看到你打獵了。

original: I don't know. Whenever those Silver-Blood men decide to leave.
string: 我不知道，那些銀血家族的人什麼時候離開。

original: When will Sanuarach Mine be open?
string: 什麼時候索蘭那馳礦坑才會開放呢？

original: I'd be honored, but I have work to do in the mines.
string: 我很榮幸，但我在礦場還有工作要做呢

original: Your arms and legs are fit for catching strong, agile prey. I could use your help.
string: 你身手不錯，可以對付那些強壯而敏捷的獵物，我需要你的幫助。

original: You want me to hunt with you? I thought you preferred being alone.
string: 你想要我跟你一起打獵嗎？我還以為你更想獨處呢。

original: I've been thinking, would you like to join me in hunting?
string: 我是有想過，那麼你會和我一起狩獵嗎？

original: Of course she will. She's our daughter, after all.
string: 她當然會，她畢竟是我們的女兒呢。

original: You're right. She'll be a great Sybil, won't she?
string: 你說的對，她會成為一個優秀的先知，對吧？

original: No... no, we did the right thing. The temple will take good care of her, and one day she'll be helping all of Skyrim.
string: 不……不，我們做了正確的決定，神殿將會好好照顧她，而有一天她也會幫助整個天際。

original: Enmon, dear, do you have any regrets? About letting her go?
string: 恩蒙，讓她這麼離開了，你感到可惜嗎？

original: So am I. I hope she's happy at the temple.
string: 我也是，我希望她在神殿裡能過的開心。

original: I miss her, too, but I'm glad she's safe.
string: 我也很想她，但我為她能在那裡安然度日而感到開心。

original: Oh, I'm fine, Enmon. I just... I still miss her.
string: 噢，我很好，恩蒙。只不過……很想她。

original: Are you all right, dear? I thought I saw a tear in your eye a moment ago.
string: 你真的沒事嗎？親愛的，我想我剛才看到你流淚了啊。

original: The house is so... empty, Enmon... and quiet.
string: 這房子是那麼的…空蕩幽靜，恩蒙。

original: Are you all right, dear?
string: 你還好嗎，親愛的？

original: You keep saying that. What if she's gone forever? What if they've done something to her?
string: 你繼續說下去吧，如果她永遠地離開了呢？如果他們對她做了什麼呢？

original: I don't know. The guards are out looking for her, now. They'll be back soon.
string: 我不知道，城衛兵現在正在外頭找她呢。他們很快就會回來的。

original: But why did they take her? What could they want with our little girl?
string: 但他們為什麼要帶走她？他們想從我們的女兒這裡得到什麼？

original: Oh, they'll find some way to send us there. It'll be just my luck.
string: 噢，他們會通過某種方式把我們送到那裡去，我可真走運。

original: Only criminals get sent to Cidhna Mine. They're not going to send us there.
string: 只有罪犯才會送到希訥礦坑。他們不會把我們送到那裡去的。

original: We're doomed. The mine is going to stay closed, and we'll up be carted of to Cidhna Mine as slaves.
string: 我們錯了，我們將會被抓到礦場那裡，成為希訥礦坑那些奴隸的一份子。

original: Never. They've shut us down forever, Enmon. The Divines have abandoned us.
string: 這不可能，他們已經幽禁了我們，聖靈神殿已經遺棄了我們。

original: When are those Silver-Blood men going to leave?
string: 這些銀血家族的人什麼時候才會離開呢？

original: Don't say words you don't mean.
string: 別說那些沒有意義的話了。

original: Um... thank you, Lash. You'd... make a fine Nord?
string: 嗯，謝謝你，拉什。你是個優秀的諾德人。

original: You have strong arms. You'd make a good Orc.
string: 你有著強有力的臂膀，你是個不錯的獸人。

original: Razelan. What are you doing?
string: 瑞斯蘭，你在做什麼？

original: I propose a toast to Elenwen! Our mistress!
string: 我要為愛琳溫，我們大家的愛人，敬一杯酒！

original: I speak figuratively, of course. Nothing could be more unlikely than that someone would actually want her in their bed.
string: 我這是胡說的…這裡應該沒有人想在自己的床上看到她。

original: Although... most of you are already in bed with her! But again... I speak figuratively, of course!
string: 雖然說…你們大多數的人已經跟她上過床了！但是…當然，我這也只是胡說的！

original: Attention, everyone! Could I have your attention, please! I have an announcement to make!
string: 所有人注意了！請允許我佔用你們一點兒時間，我有事情要宣佈！

original: Someone bring me a drink, quick!
string: 誰能給我來杯酒嗎？快點！

original: Wouldn't want to offend our Thalmor overlords, would we?
string: 我可不想冒犯我們偉大的梭默主子啊，對嗎？

original: Fine, fine. Get your hands off me. I'll be a good boy now.
string: 好啦，好啦，把你們的手拿開。現在我會做個乖孩子的。

original: There's someone I like very much in Riften. I think I'd like to marry him someday, but... well, he's not of my kind. Would Mara be angry?
string: 在裂谷，我有一位非常心儀的對象。我想某天我會和他結婚，但是……好吧，他不屬於我。瑪拉會生氣嗎？

original: Feel free to ask me anything you like.
string: 你想問我什麼盡管問。

original: Dinya? I was reading that missive you gave me and I was wondering something about marriage.
string: 丁雅?我已經讀了你給我的那封信了，我還在好奇關於結婚的事呢。

original: You know I can't tell you that. As soon as I do, and you have a few meads in you, everyone will know.
string: 你知道我不能告訴你那件事，一旦我這麼做了，所有人都會知道。

original: Of course.
string: 當然了。

original: Say, how are you going to sell all those fish before they spoil?
string: 話說回來，你要怎麼在這些魚變質以前把牠們賣掉？

original: Sounds good. May I owe you for them?
string: 問得好，我該為這些魚感謝你嗎？

original: I have two more bushels for you, Marise. That should keep you well-stocked.
string: 我這裡還多留了兩份魚給你呢，馬利瑟。那會讓你的存貨豐富起來的。

original: Shadr, that's so sweet... I'd love to.
string: 沙德，你真是太好了，我很樂意收下。

original: Naw... he's fine. Look, I wanted to ask if you'll... um, if you'd like to... well, like to have a drink with me at the Bee and Barb sometime?
string: 不……他沒事，你看，我想問問如果你想……好吧，你想挑個時間和我去蜂與鉤酒吧喝上一杯嗎？

original: I'm well. How are things over at the stables? Old Hofgrir giving you a hard time?
string: 好啊，要不在馬廄的工作結束後怎麼樣？老霍夫吉爾會為難你嗎？

original: Hi, Marise. How are you today?
string: 嗨，馬利瑟，今天過得如何？

original: I don't know. All we can do is hope the Eight will favor us and have these creatures stay far away from Riften.
string: 我不知道，我所能做的就只有希望眾神能保佑我們，還有這些怪物能遠離裂谷。

original: Do you... do you think that could happen here? I mean, could a dragon come here and burn the city down?
string: 你認為那件事會發生在這裡嗎？我是說，會有條巨龍把這座城市燒成灰燼嗎？

original: Yes, I heard. I think all of Skyrim knows by know.
string: 是的，我聽說了。我想這事已經傳開了。

original: Brand-Shei, did you hear about Helgen? It's... it's gone! A dragon burned it to the ground!
string: 布蘭德-謝，你聽到聖地鎮的消息了沒？據說它已經……消失了！被一條巨龍燒成了灰燼！

original: I'll see what I can do.
string: 我看看我能做什麼？

original: That's fine. I have a special occasion coming up, and I'd like to have it.
string: 沒關係，不久之後我將會有一個特殊的機會，而我很樂意掌握它。

original: The Argonian sugar-cane wine? It's pretty hard to get around here. Very expensive.
string: 亞龍人甜藤酒？在這裡很難買到這種奢侈品，那太貴了。

original: Brand-Shei, do you think you can find me some theilul?
string: 布蘭德-謝，你覺得你能幫我找到一些酒嗎？

original: Maven, I... please, don't hurt me.
string: 瑪雯，我……請別傷害我。

original: Turning him in to the guards? Have you joined Mjoll as official peacekeepers of Riften? You cost me a lot of coin.
string: 你把他帶到衛兵那裡去了嗎？你曾以裂谷維和部隊官員的身份加入穆月爾是嗎？你這傢伙花了我不少錢啊。

original: Maven, please. I didn't know it was your man. Had I known, I would have looked the other way, I swear.
string: 瑪雯，我不知道那是你的人，要是我知道，我一定會採取別的辦法的，我發誓。

original: I don't like being made a fool of, Brand-Shei. Not one bit.
string: 我不喜歡被人耍，布蘭德-謝，一點也不。

original: Just when you think things couldn't get any worse.
string: 只是在你認為事情不會變的更糟的時候。

original: One of them came in and demanded payment. Bolli tried to tell them no; stood up to them, but...
string: 他們過來這邊要求報酬。波利試著拒絕他們，挺身與他們理論，但是……

original: Did something happen at the Pawned Prawn?
string: 典當小蝦發生什麼事了嗎？

original: I've come to warn you that the Thieves Guild seems to be back to its old tricks again.
string: 我是來警告你盜賊公會又故技重施了。

original: Why in goodness name would you have... oh never mind, just bring them by my house later and I'll see what I can do.
string: 你真是個大好人……喔，算了，待會兒把他們帶到我的房子去，我看看我能做什麼。

original: Horker skin, actually.
string: 實際上是海象的皮。

original: Leather? If they're armored, you should talk to Balimund over at The Scorched Hammer.
string: 皮革？如果是護甲的事情，你該去滾燙鐵錘跟巴利穆德談談。

original: Grelka, can you repair boots?
string: 格瑞卡，你會補靴子嗎？

original: Oh come off it, Niv. We both know you married that fisherman for his gold. You don't need to put on an act for my benefit.
string: 噢，算了吧，尼夫，我們都知道你是貪圖錢財才和那個漁夫結婚的，你不必為了討好我而裝腔作勢。

original: What's that supposed to mean?
string: 你這是什麼意思？

original: If he paid what he owes, I wouldn't have to say anything. Besides, what in Oblivion do you care?
string: 如果他還清了他的債，我絕對會閉嘴的。順便說一句，這關你什麼事？

original: What's this nonsense I've been hearing? How dare you call Bolli a deadbeat!
string: 你在胡說些什麼？你怎麼可以說波利是個無賴！

original: It's a religious thing.
string: 我說的是事實。

original: Try it out? What would you need a leather harness for anyway?
string: 要不要試試？你需要一份皮製馬具做什麼？

original: Oh, good. I wanted to try that out as soon as possible.
string: 噢，好的，我會盡我所能嘗試的。

original: Oh, Haelga... there you are. Your special order from Hammerfell came in off the last Khajiit caravan.
string: 噢，哈爾嘉，從落錘省發給你的特別命令已經由最後一個虎人商隊帶過來了。

original: Oh I get it. "It's missing so Grelka must have it." I wish this town would stop pointing their fingers at me.
string: 噢，我知道了。那不見了，所以一定在格瑞卡手上。我希望這城裡的人不會再對我指指點點了。

original: There is a Thieves Guild in town you know.
string: 你知道城裡有個盜賊公會的。

original: Well, we had one go missing from the Pawned Prawn, and I was just wondering...
string: 好吧，我們有人從典當小蝦那裡走失了，而我只是好奇……

original: Not lately. Why?
string: 那可不是新聞了，怎麼了？

original: Grelka, have you had anyone come by and try to sell you an iron war axe?
string: 格瑞卡，有沒有過人想賣你一把鐵斧頭的？

original: Religion isn't going to save me. So unless Mara is going to start raining coin from the heavens, why don't you mind your own business.
string: 宗教信仰可不會拯救我，所以除非瑪拉會從天堂降下金錢雨，你為什麼不做好你的本職工作呢？

original: You poor thing. You should come by the temple, speak to Maramal.
string: 可憐蟲，你真該去神殿和瑪拉莫談談

original: What's so good about it? I've got deadbeats who don't pay me, the city guard looking over my shoulder and Maven Black-Briar breathing down my neck.
string: 還有比這更好的嗎？某個無賴欠我錢不還，城衛兵提防著我，還有瑪雯．黑棘也緊盯著我。

original: Good day, Grelka.
string: 你好啊，格瑞卡

original: Looking for work?
string: 在找事做嗎？

original: By the gods! The Gourmet has killed the Emperor! Attack!
string: 我的天！美食家殺了皇帝！抓住他！

original: By the gods! The Gourmet and the chef have poisoned the Emperor! Get them!
string: 我的天！美食家和總管毒殺了皇帝，抓住他們！

original: (Laughing.)
string: （笑聲）

original: (Laughing.)
string: （笑聲）

original: (Laughing.)
string: （笑聲）

original: Ah, the Potage le Magnifique. So delicious. My friends, as Emperor, I of course reserve the right of first taste.
string: 啊，絕美濃湯，看起來真是美味。身為皇帝，我當然有第一個品嘗的權利吧？

original: Aha! Here we are. Honored guests, I present to you - the Gourmet!
string: 啊哈，終於來了。在座嘉賓，容我向各位介紹——美食家！

original: Here we are. Gods, I'm nervous. We'll go in in just a moment. Please, I'll serve. You just stand there and... be amazing.
string: 我們走到這裡了。神啊，我真的很緊張。我們只會進去一會兒。拜託了，讓我來服侍吧，你只要站在一旁……吃驚就好。

original: Truth is, we are in no danger whatsoever. Killing an Emperor can be useful, but befriending one? Now that's beneficial - as I'm sure you'd all agree.
string: 事實上，我們現在沒有任何危險，殺掉一個皇帝也許簡單，但幫助一個皇帝呢？那正是利益所在——我確定你會完全贊成這一點。

original: You mean the wedding? My cousin's apparent murder? An unfortunate misunderstanding, no more. Cold mead, hot tempers... these things happen.
string: 妳是指婚禮嗎？我的表親是個顯而易見的殺手？沒有比這更不幸的誤會了。他只是喝了點酒，脾氣有點暴躁而已。

original: Yes, an unfortunate turn of events, that. But an isolated incident. And I have been assured that the fault was with the man's son alone.
string: 是的，發生這樣的事真是一場不幸的劇變。但這畢竟是個例。而且我已經確定這都是他的兒子一手策劃的。

original: Quite. Yet that recent business with the young officer. Maro, was it? How dreadful. The son of your commander, plotting your assassination.
string: 還有，最近那樁案子還牽扯到一位年輕的軍官。是吧，那個馬洛？真可怕啊，你的指揮官的兒子，居然在密謀暗殺。

original: But aren't even you the least bit nervous? After everything that's happened?
string: 但你連一絲緊張感也沒有嗎？在這些事情發生之後？

original: Kill him. And make sure there's nothing left to bury.
string: 殺了他，並且確定已焚毀在場的一切證物。

original: Kill her. And make sure there's nothing left to bury.
string: 殺了她，並且確定已焚毀在場的一切證物。

original: Your Sanctuary's being put to the sword right now. That's what I think of this "deal." You killed my son! All of you! And now you'll pay the price.
string: 你們的神殿就要陷入殺戮之中了，這就是我所認為的「交易」。 你殺了我兒子！你們所有人！現在要為此而付出代價！

original: But you know what? I've changed my mind. How about this? I kill you, and butcher each and every one of your miserable little friends?
string: 但是你知道嗎？我改變主意了，要不這樣吧？我殺掉你，還有你那些可憐的小朋友們。

original: I get you, and the Dark Brotherhood gets to continue its existence.
string: 我得到了你，而黑暗兄弟會也得以長存。

original: Surprised? So was I, when a member of your "Family" came to me with the plan. We worked out a deal, you see. An exchange.
string: 驚訝嗎？我也是。當你們「家族」的一個成員帶著這計劃來找我的時，我們做了一筆交易，如你所見，一個交換條件。

original: You, an assassin for the Dark Brotherhood, have just made an attempt on the Emperor's life. Would have succeeded, had it been the real man.
string: 你，一名為黑暗兄弟會工作的小刺客，你試圖奪取皇帝的性命。如果你成功了，那你就是真正的強者

original: That man was, by far, the most insufferable decoy the Emperor has ever employed. I'm glad he's dead. Ah, but I'm even happier that you killed him.
string: 這個人是皇帝雇用過替身中叫人最難以忍受的騙子。我很高興他死了，更高興的是你殺了他。

original: (Clapping.)
string: （掌聲）

original: Please. You first. I insist.
string: 我堅持你先請。

original: I just need to rest a moment, right here on this lovely rock.
string: 我只是需要休息一會兒。

original: Inside, my friend, inside! Where only the women and drinks are cold.
string: 進去吧，我的朋友，進去！去那只有女人和飲料是冰冷的地方。

original: Stand back and watch a true professional wreck a party.
string: 退後，看看誰才是一個專業的宴會毀滅者吧。

original: My friend! A toast to a beautiful friendship!
string: 我的朋友！為美好的友誼乾杯！

original: The Dawnstar Sanctuary? Whatever for?
string: 晨星聖所？為了什麼？

original: Never mind, it doesn't matter. You need to leave. Now.
string: 沒關係，這不重要。你馬上動身吧。

original: Every moment counts, so I want you to take my horse. His name is Shadowmere. You'll find him outside, by the pool. Let's just say he's... one of us.
string: 分秒必爭，所以我希望你可以用我的馬。她的名字是微影，你可以在外頭找到她的，就在池邊。說她也可以說是……我們當中的一員。

original: Find Arnbjorn. Make sure my husband's all right.
string: 找到艾恩喬恩，確保我丈夫安然無恙。

original: And then, send that jester's twisted little soul to the Void, in as many pieces as possible.
string: 然後，將那小丑瘋狂的靈魂送進虛空，盡可能地將他碎屍萬斷。

original: Yes, an abandoned Sanctuary in Dawnstar. I have the passphrase.
string: 有，可能是晨星城一處廢棄的聖所。我找到了密語。

original: Good, good. Does it say where he may be headed?
string: 好，很好，有提到他可能去哪嗎？

original: Yes, Cicero's journal.
string: 是的，西塞羅的日記。

original: Have you found something?
string: 你找到什麼了嗎？

original: No, nothing. At least nothing I'm aware of.
string: 沒有，並沒有。至少就我所知是如此。

original: Well... If I'm being honest, I haven't exactly been discreet lately in expressing my frustration with this whole situation.
string: 好吧…如果我能虔誠點，也許就不會到今日才在這種情況與挫折中學到什麼叫小心謹慎了。

original: Obeying the Night Mother. You being the Listener. It's ridiculous. No offense.
string: 遵循夜母的意志，你是個聆聽者了。這真荒唐。請勿見怪。

original: Cicero may have overheard me talking to one of the others about the Night Mother. It's possible I was... not entirely respectful.
string: 西塞羅可能偷聽到我與他人討論關於夜母的話題。可能我並沒有完全地表達我的敬意。

original: But to go this far. To attempt to murder the leader of a Sanctuary. Cicero must pay with his life. There is no other option.
string: 但是事情到此，既然西塞羅意圖謀殺聖所的領導者，那他就必須拿性命來贖罪，沒有其它選擇。

original: Did something set Cicero off?
string: 什麼事情刺激到西塞羅了嗎？

original: Ugh... damn thing.
string: 啊……真該死

original: Just... stay back.
string: 總之……退後。

original: Back off.
string: 退回去。

original: Can't trust these things.
string: 真不敢相信。

original: Beem! What are you doing?
string: 畢姆！你在做什麼？

original: No. Sorry.
string: 沒什麼，抱歉。

original: Very well.
string: 很好。

original: Deal.
string: 成交。

original: Good hunting.
string: 狩獵愉快。

original: I'm thinking of buying some armor. Any recommendations?
string: 我在考慮購買護甲的事。可以推薦一下嗎？

original: Depends on what you need. A light armor is good for travel. Less to carry. A heavy armor weighs you down, but no true warrior goes without it.
string: 這取決於你的需求。輕甲便於旅行，方便攜帶。重甲負擔不小，但對戰士而言不可或缺。

original: If you want some heavy armor, I might have a deal we could work out. I need a Daedra's Heart. Jarl wants me to cool his new sword in blood.
string: 如果你想要重甲，我想也許我們可以做一筆交易，我需要一顆魔族之心，領主要我把他的新寶劍用鮮血冷卻。

original: You get me a heart, I get you some armor. Interested?
string: 你幫我把心臟帶來，我給你護甲，有興趣嗎？

original: What kind of weapons do you forge?
string: 你製造哪一類型的武器呢？

original: Anything. Served in the Legion with my sister, Ghorza, for over 10 years. We've seen every piece you can imagine.
string: 任何類型。我和我姐姐果紮為軍團服務已有十年了。我們見過任何你能想得到的兵器。

original: Have you met her? She runs the forge near the smelter. Just don't bother talking to her apprentice. Boy has no talent.
string: 你見過她嗎？她的製造技巧近乎精鍊者了。只是不要跟她的學徒交談以免打擾到他工作。那孩子沒什麼天分。

original: I have your daedra's heart.
string: 我有你要的魔族之心。

original: Good. I'd prefer using water to cool my metal, but it's what the Jarl wants.
string: 很好。我傾向於用水冷卻金屬，但這不是領主想要的。

original: Here. Some of my best armor. Wear it well.
string: 拿去，這是我最好的護甲之一，好好利用它吧。

original: You're not from the Reach?
string: 你不是邊塞領本地人嗎？

original: No. I'm a Breton from High Rock, and I refuse to be mistaken for a filthy native.
string: 不是，我是一位從高岩過來的布萊頓人，而且我拒絕被誤認為本地人。

original: I don't care if we share the same ancestors, these people are savages. Half of them are Forsworn barbarians, and have you seen what they eat?
string: 我不在乎我們可能來自相同的祖先，這些人都是粗魯的人。他們之中有半數是棄誓者野蠻人，你有看到他們吃的是什麼嗎？

original: What have I done for the gods to take me so far from my beloved Daggerfall?
string: 我為了神做了那麼多，就是為了讓我遠離我深愛的匕首雨嗎？

original: Damn Elves! You'll pay for this!
string: 該死的精靈，你會為此付出代價的！

original: Praise Talos!
string: 讚美塔洛斯！

original: What do you mean "saviors of Mer"?
string: 那是什麼意思？「精靈救星」？

original: The Thalmor saved all of Elven-kind during the Oblivion Crisis. We've been watching over our lands for 200 years.
string: 梭默從湮滅危機之中拯救了精靈族，我們守護這片土地已經有200年了。

original: We re-founded the Aldmeri Dominion, an alliance between us and our Bosmer cousins. You might know them from their common name. Wood elves.
string: 我們重新建立了先祖神洲，他們是我們和波茲莫爾近親之間的聯盟。你也許聽說過他們的通稱-木精靈

original: We intend to prove the superiority of Mer over Man, one century at a time.
string: 我們打算每一個世紀就證明一次精靈是優越於人的。

original: Not right now.
string: 現在沒空。

original: Hmph. Fine.
string: 嗯，那好吧。

original: I'm interested. What is it?
string: 我的確有興趣。什麼麻煩？

original: Ogmund the skald. He's old, respected, and I know for a fact that he worships Talos in his home.
string: 吟唱者歐格蒙，他年長且倍受尊敬，而且我知道他常在家膜拜塔洛斯。

original: But the Jarl has been hesitant to call for his arrest. I want you to break in to his home and find evidence.
string: 但是領主對於逮捕他感到有點疑慮。所以我希望你能強行闖入他的家裡找到證據。

original: I found this amulet in Ogmund's house.
string: 我在歐格蒙的房間找到這個護符。

original: Ah, there we have it. This will be all I need to have Ogmund taken care of.
string: 啊，我們有證據了。這將足以讓我好好「招待」歐格蒙了

original: I would like to personally thank you on behalf of myself and the Thalmor for your assistance. Here, for your work.
string: 我個人非常感謝你為我以及梭默而伸出的援手。請收下，這是你應得的酬勞。

original: Why are you after Talos worshippers?
string: 你為什麼要追蹤塔洛斯的信徒呢？

original: It's a religious matter. The Thalmor do not recognize Talos as a god. He was only a man, and does not deserve to a place in our pantheon.
string: 事關宗教信仰，梭默並沒有把塔洛斯看作是一位神明。他只是一個人，而且他不值得被列入萬神殿當中。

original: The Empire has agreed to accept our beliefs, and its citizens have a responsibility to cease their heretical worship.
string: 帝國已經同意接受我們的信仰，而他們的公民也該停止對異端的崇拜。

original: You're awfully inquisitive, aren't you? I like that. Perhaps you'd care to solve a little problem I'm having?
string: 你很愛管閒事對吧？我喜歡那樣，也許你有興趣幫我解決一些麻煩？

original: You're not from Markarth, I take it?
string: 你不是馬卡斯城的人，對嗎？

original: As if this craggy, wretch of a city could give birth to a superiorly bred Mer such as myself. No, I'm not from Markarth.
string: 除非這低賤陡峭的城市能誕生出像我這樣的高貴血統。不，我並非來自馬卡斯城。

original: I was sent here to lead the Thalmor's interests in this corner of Skyrim. It's my mission to root out all Talos worship in this city.
string: 我是被派來這引導天際省中此處的梭默信徒。我的任務是杜絕這個城市裡所有對塔洛斯的崇拜。

original: Who are the Thalmor?
string: 梭默是些什麼人？

original: We're the ruling body of the Aldmeri Dominion. Saviors of Mer. Victors of the Great War.
string: 我們是先祖神洲的管理者，精靈的救星。浩大戰爭的勝利者。

original: The Empire exists because we allow it to exist, and I'm here to make sure the Jarl of Markarth remembers that.
string: 帝國的存在是因我們允許其存在，而我之所以在這裡是為了提醒馬卡斯城的領主記住這一點。

original: You're married to Thonar? What's he like?
string: 你和托納爾結婚了？他怎麼樣？

original: He's the real head of this family. He may not be the eldest, but all the work that keeps us respected is handled by my Thonar.
string: 他是這個家族的棟樑。他也許不是最年長的，但他卻能應對所有的工作。這令我們非常敬佩他。

original: Everything is fine. The shipment will be here soon.
string: 一切順利，貨船一會就到。

original: That's good news. I was starting to fear something had happened.
string: 真是個好消息，之前我還擔心會出什麼狀況呢。

original: You have my thanks.
string: 謝謝你

original: Pactur asked me to deliver a message.
string: 派克托託我送個訊息來。

original: Is everything all right? I've not heard from Sorli or Pactur in some time.
string: 一切都還好吧？我已經有段時間沒從索莉和派克托那裡得到消息了。

original: Maybe some other time.
string: 也許改天吧。

original: Won't be 'some other time' at this rate.
string: 照目前的情形來看，不能改天了。

original: I'll go see Bryling for you.
string: 我會為你去拜訪一下白靈的

original: You're doing me quite a favor. I won't forget it.
string: 你真是幫了我大忙，我不會忘記的。

original: I'm sure she'll be angry. Brace yourself.
string: 我確定她會生氣的，你自己小心點。

original: Can't you reason with her?
string: 你不能跟她解釋一下嗎？

original: Can't do that and keep an eye on things here at the same time.
string: 我現在有的是麻煩沒時間顧及她了。

original: But... You could take word to her in Solitude, let her know it'll be coming soon.
string: 但……你要是去獨孤城的話可以給她捎個話，告訴她貨物馬上送到。

original: I'd make it worth your while. No one would notice a few missing ingots out of the next shipment.
string: 我會給你一些甜頭，比如說沒人會注意下趟貨物少了一些鑄鐵塊。

original: Is there any way I can help?
string: 我能幫上什麼忙嗎？

original: You could take word to her that there'll be a shipment soon. Buy us some time and keep her off our backs.
string: 你可以告訴她等一下會有艘貨船過來。替我們爭取一點時間，把她甩在我們後頭

original: In exchange, I'm willing to let a few ingots go missing. Maybe more than a few.
string: 作為交換，我希望能讓一小部分鑄塊「失蹤」，或許還可以再多一些。

original: Do you get many offers?
string: 你拿到很多工作嗎？

original: Well, no.
string: 呃，沒有。

original: But that's not the point.
string: 但那可不是重點。

original: Bryling owns the mine, and she's not selling. We make her some decent coin running this place. Keeps her living well in Solitude.
string: 白靈擁有這些礦，而且她並不出售，我們讓她獲得可觀的金錢，以便她在獨孤城過舒服的生活。

original: At least, when we can get shipments to her. We're late on the last one. I expect her to start breathin' fire any moment now.
string: 當然，前提是我們可以把貨物運過去。我們上一批貨就遲到了。我想她現在火氣一定不小。

original: I wasn't asking.
string: 我可沒問。

original: I'm just protecting Bryling's investment. She's the owner, even though we're the ones here doing all the work.
string: 我只是在保護白靈的投資。她是擁有者，即使我們一己承包了所有的工作。

original: She's already come down hard on us for missing shipments. Likely to do it again, since we're late.
string: 她已經因遺失貨物而對我們不滿了，在我們誤點之後，這樣的不滿還會出現的。

original: Do you own the mine?
string: 你買下了礦場嗎？

original: No, and before you ask, it's not for sale.
string: 沒有，在你詢問之前，它還是非賣品。

original: Don't let it get you down. Indaryn will eventually tire of picking on you and move on to someone else.
string: 別讓那擊垮你，印達林總有一天會厭倦挑你毛病，繼而轉向別的目標。

original: And do what? Losing a job from the Black-Briar family would make me a marked man. No one would ever take me on anywhere else.
string: 然後呢？丟掉在黑棘的工作會使我成為麻煩人物，不再有人帶我去任何地方了。

original: Maybe it's time you quit then.
string: 也許是你離開的時候了。

original: I can't take it anymore, Tythis. Indaryn keeps pushing me around and I'm not even doing anything wrong.
string: 我受不了啦，泰迪斯。即使我沒犯任何錯，印達林也會繼續欺負我。

original: You're not going to goad me into a fight so I'll get kicked out, Grelka. Eat your food and leave me in peace.
string: 我不會讓刺激我動手，然後害我被驅逐的，格瑞卡。吃你的大餐然後安靜的離開我。

original: Or perhaps you should crawl back into whatever swamp you came from, lizard man.
string: 或者你可以爬回你原本居住的沼澤裡，蜥人。

original: There's no need to be rude, Grelka. If you don't care for Argonians, then perhaps you should take residence somewhere else.
string: 沒必要動粗，格瑞卡，如果你不喜歡亞龍人，那麼你可以住在別的地方。

original: Hey, greenskin... close your mouth. Some of us are trying to eat over here.
string: 嘿，綠皮，閉上你的嘴，我們還得在這裡吃飯呢。

original: You have a kind heart; much too kind for Riften. Don't worry about me, I'll be just fine.
string: 你有著一顆仁慈的心，一顆對裂谷充滿仁慈的心，別為我擔心，我不會有事的。

original: Are you sure that's the real reason? It wouldn't have anything to do with others making an Argonian unwelcome, because if it is...
string: 你確定這是你的真心話嗎？那不會改變其他人對亞龍人的排斥，因為如果那是……

original: The cold stone, the dampness... it suits me, Svana.
string: 冰冷的岩石，潮濕的空氣，這都很適合我，斯瓦納。

original: Madesi, why don't you just take a bed here? There's no need to sleep in Beggar's Row.
string: 瑪德希，你為什麼不弄張床呢？你沒有必要睡在乞丐街。

original: If he wasn't a Black-Briar, I'd march right over to the jail and teach Sibbi some manners... but then I suppose I'd end up like Wulfur.
string: 如果他不是黑棘，那麼我會立刻到監獄去教西比一些規矩……但我想我的下場會像伍爾夫一樣。

original: No, it was Svidi's brother, Wulfur. She's in hiding now. Somewhere far from here I'd suspect.
string: 不，是斯維迪的兄弟，伍爾夫，斯維迪現在正躲著呢，我想她可能躲在離這裡很遠的地方。

original: Come to think of it, I haven't seen Svidi in a while. Wait... he didn't...
string: 說到這個，我有陣子沒看到斯維迪了，他該不會……

original: They say... well, they say he murdered someone. Something to do with Svidi.
string: 他們說……好吧，他們說斯維迪殺了人，或是與此有關。

original: Svana, I heard that Sibbi was put in jail. What happened?
string: 斯瓦納，我聽說那個西比被關進監獄了，這是怎麼回事？

original: I can go back to my life for now.
string: 現在我暫時可以回到我原本的生活了。

original: And I have you to thank for it. I won't forget this.
string: 而我非常感謝你所做的一切，我不會忘記的。

original: I didn't want to risk you not coming.
string: 我不想讓你置身於危險之中。

original: A risky game to play, friend.
string: 這是場危險的遊戲，朋友。

original: But now Kematu's gone, and the rest of his snakes should slither back to their desert.
string: 但現在凱馬圖不在了，而他的殘黨們會設法爬回他們的沙漠的。

original: Relax. Kematu's dead, and now you're safe.
string: 放輕鬆，凱馬圖已經死了，你安全了。

original: You could have warned me you were baiting me into a trap.
string: 之前你該警告我你會把我引進陷阱的。

original: But you're right. This should scatter the rest of them. I can go back to my life for now.
string: 但你是對的，這麼一來可以驅逐他們，我現在可以回到原來的生活了。

original: You have my thanks.
string: 謝謝你

original: There, now you're safe.
string: 那裡，你現在安全了

original: You liar!
string: 你這騙子！

original: How could you do that to me!
string: 你怎能那樣對我！

original: You're out in the middle of nowhere, aren't you?
string: 你現在可是身處荒野之中，對吧？

original: Don't have to tell me twice. But then, I'm not the one that buried iron under these mountains.
string: 不需要再次提醒我，另外，我可不是熔鑄在這群山之下的一塊廢鐵。

original: Why did you summon me here?
string: 你為什麼把我召喚到這裡？

original: Who are you?
string: 你是誰？

original: Dragonborn. It is you. Welcome to High Hrothgar.
string: 龍裔，是你啊，歡迎來到高吼峰。

original: Know anything about the Thieves Guild?
string: 你知道任何關於盜賊公會的消息嗎？

original: You kiddin'? My brother Dirge works in their hideout.
string: 你開玩笑呢？我的兄弟「挽歌」在他們的藏身處工作。

original: I used to run with them myself, but took a job with Maven after they started hittin' a rough patch.
string: 我曾經是他們的支持者，但在他們遭遇打擊之後我接下了瑪雯的工作。

original: If you want to get in on that action, find Brynjolf in the marketplace. I'm sure he could use someone like you.
string: 如果你想加入他們的行動，去市集找布林喬夫，我相信他會僱用像你這樣的人。

original: Tell me more about the Black-Briars.
string: 告訴我更多關於黑棘的事情。

original: Well, you got Maven, she pretty much runs the whole operation. She's got friends in high places if you know what I mean.
string: 好吧，你知道瑪雯，她對這裡的運營方式了若指掌，她在上面有關係，如果你明白我的話。

original: She's also got ties to the Dark Brotherhood and the Thieves Guild, so basically no one can touch her.
string: 她也和黑暗兄弟會以及盜賊公會來往密切，所以基本上沒人能碰她。

original: Just remember, if she tells you to do somethin'... you damn well better do exactly what she says.
string: 只要你記得，如果她要求你做什麼……你最好照她說的辦就是了。

original: Slip up and I'll gut you like a fish.
string: 你搞砸了我就把你像剖魚一樣給宰了。

original: Be seein' you around.
string: 待會見。

original: Dirge told me you made it into the Guild. You need dirt on anything, you talk to me.
string: 「挽歌」告訴我你想加入公會，你得先做點骯髒工作，再跟我商量。

original: What did you want to know?
string: 你想知道什麼？

original: Back again? What is it this time?
string: 又回去嗎？這次是怎麼回事？

original: You want to talk? Finish those jobs for Brynjolf first.
string: 你想跟我談？等你完成布林喬夫的工作後再說吧

original: Get in good with Brynjolf, then we'll talk.
string: 你和布林喬夫打好交道，我們才有得聊。

original: Stay out of the Black-Briars' business and you'll live longer.
string: 別插手黑棘家的事務，你就能活得長命些。

original: You aren't worth my time. Piss off.
string: 你還不值得佔用我的時間，滾開。

original: I'm through with you. Get out of my way.
string: 到此為止吧，給我滾開。

original: What did you want?
string: 你想要什麼？

original: Yeah, walk away like a good doggie. Just stay out of the Black-Briars' business and maybe we'll give you a bone.
string: 對，像隻溫順的小狗那樣走開。別去惹那群人，這樣一來或許我們還會給你一根骨頭。

original: I'll just stay out of your way.
string: 我只會離你遠一些的。

original: Suit yourself.
string: 隨你便。

original: I'll be at the docks if you change your mind.
string: 如果你改變主意了，我會在碼頭等你。

original: How about you tell me for free? (Intimidate)
string: 你覺得免費跟我透露消息怎麼樣？（威嚇）

original: All right, all right, let's not get too hasty now.
string: 好吧，好吧，別激動啊。

original: So what do you want to know?
string: 所以你想知道什麼？

original: Ha ha! Don't make me laugh.
string: 哈哈，別說笑了。

original: Just stay out of the Black-Briars' affairs. You'll live longer.
string: 別插手黑棘家的事務，你就能活得長命些。

original: Here, what can you tell me? (<BribeCost> gold)
string: 拿去，你能透露給我什麼呢？（賄賂<BribeCost>金幣）

original: Pleasure doin' business with you.
string: 與你交易很愉快。

original: So what do you want to know?
string: 所以你想知道什麼？

original: You don't have enough to earn my loyalty.
string: 你還不足以贏得我的忠誠

original: Dirt, huh? I'm not exactly clean myself... (Persuade)
string: 髒，是嗎？我本身也沒那麼乾淨…（說服）

original: Then we're speakin' the same language. Good.
string: 那我們就有共同話題了。很好。

original: So what do you want to know?
string: 所以你想知道什麼？

original: Then you're stupider than you look.
string: 你比看起來還要蠢

original: You better watch your ass around here.
string: 在這裡你最好看好你自己的小命。

original: You can pretend not to hear me all you want... but you better stay out of the Black-Briars' business.
string: 你可以假裝沒聽到我說的話，但是你最好別管黑棘的事。

original: Who are the Black-Briars?
string: 誰是黑棘?

original: The Black-Briars have Riften in their pocket and the Thieves Guild watchin' their back, so keep your nose out of their business.
string: 黑棘家族控制著裂谷城，盜賊公會在為他們做事，所以不要去惹他們的麻煩。

original: Me? I'm Maul. I watch the streets for 'em. If you need dirt on anythin', I'm your guy... but it'll cost you.
string: 我嗎？我是摩爾。我其實就是大街上的小混混，如果你付錢，我就跟著你做事。

original: I'm not scared of you.
string: 我可不怕你。

original: That's the wrong answer.
string: 那是個錯誤的回答。

original: Last thing the Black-Briars need around here is some troublemaker tryin' to steal a piece of the action.
string: 黑棘最不需要的東西是某個麻煩傢伙試著分食大餅。

original: What's it to you?
string: 你這是怎麼了？

original: Don't say something you'll regret.
string: 別說些將來你會後悔的話。

original: Last thing the Black-Briars need is some loudmouth tryin' to meddle in their affairs.
string: 黑棘最不喜歡的事情是某個大嘴巴試圖干涉他們的事務。

original: Just passing through.
string: 只是路過而已。

original: Yeah? Well, I got news for you; there's nothing to see here.
string: 是嗎？好吧，我給你個消息，這裡沒什麼好看的。

original: Last thing the Black-Briars need is some stranger stickin' their nose where it doesn't belong.
string: 黑棘最不喜歡的事情是某個旅行者把他們的鼻子伸到不該伸的地方。

original: I don't know you. You in Riften lookin' for trouble?
string: 我不認識你，你是來裂谷找麻煩的嗎？

original: Hey, you. Get over here, I want to talk to you.
string: 嘿，你，過來這邊，我有話跟你說。

original: This is a shame.
string: 這真是可恥。

original: Always sad when someone has to die.
string: 死亡總是會讓人悲傷！

original: Another one. Terrible.
string: 又一個，真可怕。

original: Large diagonal cut from left shoulder...
string: 左肩有一處斜向的大傷口……

original: Good!
string: 幹得不錯！

original: All right, let's give this a try. Ready your ward...
string: 好吧，試試這個，準備好防守……

original: I'll have to do that some other time.
string: 我得改天才有辦法這麼做。

original: As you wish.
string: 隨你便。

original: It will be my honor.
string: 這將是我的榮幸。

original: As you were, then.
string: 那就這樣了。

original: I'll pass on this one, then.
string: 我想這次就先等等吧。

original: I don't blame you.
string: 我沒有怪你。

original: They live here too, my Jarl. That's what I'm telling you.
string: 他們也住在這裡啊，領主。我才正跟您說呢。

original: It doesn't matter if they're in the city. We fight them where they live, we won't have to fight them here.
string: 他們也在這座城市裡也沒關係。我們就在他們住的地方戰鬥，我們不必和他們在這裡戰鬥。

original: It's not that simple, Igmund. There are reports of Forsworn here in the city.
string: 那並不簡單，依格蒙德，這座城市裡分佈著棄誓者的傳訊人。

original: The only thing we need to discuss is how many men it'll take to flush them out of the hills.
string: 我們唯一需要討論的事情就是要帶多少人把他們趕出這片山崗。

original: My Jarl, we need to discuss the Forsworn.
string: 領主大人，我們得討論一下棄誓者的問題。

original: I'd like to purchase a home in your city.
string: 我想在你的城市買間房子。

original: I don't know you, and I don't sell what precious property we have to outsiders.
string: 我不了解你，而且我們也不賣我們珍貴的房產給外人。

original: But if you're willing to work, and you prove to be reliable, I might deem you worthy to live here. My steward will handle things from there.
string: 但如果你打算在這裡工作，而且證明了你可以信賴，我會承認你夠格居住在這。我的總管將會滿足你的要求的。

original: Nothing to say. Fine, but I'm watching you.
string: 沒什麼要說的了。好吧，但我會注意你的。

original: I was looking to purchase a house in Markarth.
string: 我正想在馬卡斯城買間房子住下呢。

original: I'm looking for work.
string: 我在找工作。

original: I'm a traveler. I have questions.
string: 我是個旅行者，我有些事想問。

original: Very well, you may approach the Mournful Throne, but watch your words.
string: 很好，你可以接近哀傷王座，但要注意你的言辭。

original: You. Who are you to approach the Jarl of Markarth?
string: 你是什麼人，為何要覲見馬卡斯城的領主。

original: So you're from Daggerfall, then?
string: 所以你是從匕首雨來的？

original: Yes. The finest court in all of High Rock. You think politics here are something? Well, we Bretons invented politics.
string: 是的，最好的宮廷是在高岩，你認為這裡的事也叫政治？好吧，別忘了是我們布萊頓人發明了政治。

original: That is where I learned to cook, and where I belong. Not here, with all these dogs.
string: 那是我學會廚藝的地方，是我的歸屬。才不是在這裡，和這些狗在一起。

original: Please, leave me alone. I need to be by myself.
string: 請…離我遠一點，我想一個人待會兒。

original: I... I have some thinking to do. Thank you for this.
string: 我…我有些想法要證實，謝謝你。

original: By the Eight. She's dead, isn't she? And it's all my fault.
string: 神啊，她死了，對嗎？而這一切都是我的錯。

original: Did she really run off and do this? For me?
string: 她逃跑並且所做的這一切，都是為了我？

original: This... This is really from her, isn't it?
string: 這…這真的是她寫的，對吧？

original: It's a letter from Isabelle. You should read it.
string: 這是一封伊莎貝拉的信，你應該看看。

original: A what?
string: 一封什麼？

original: Don't you go pulling my leg. Give it here.
string: 你在開玩笑嗎？把它放在這裡。

original: I have something for you.
string: 我有東西要給你。

original: Unless it's gold for another round of drinks, I don't wanna hear it.
string: 除非那值得我掏錢再喝上一杯，否則我不會聽的。

original: I spoke with Vex about Isabelle.
string: 我和「小煩」談論了伊莎貝拉的事情。

original: Huh?
string: 什麼？

original: Ha. Sure you did. Dagur put you up to this?
string: 哈，你真這麼做了，是達古爾叫你做的嗎？

original: It don't matter now. None of it does. Just leave me be.
string: 那無所謂了，也毫無意義，讓我一個人靜一靜吧。

original: I understand you knew Isabelle Rolaine.
string: 我知道你認識伊莎貝拉．羅萊妮

original: What?
string: 什麼？

original: Don't you... Don't you say that name to me.
string: 不，不要在我面前提起那個名字。

original: Don't you dare. Ever.
string: 別再這麼做了。

original: Where did you say Isabelle Rolaine was?
string: 你之前說過過伊莎貝拉．羅萊妮在哪

original: Like I told you, last time I saw her she was headed for Hobs Fall Cave. No idea what happened to her.
string: 正如我之前告訴你的，上次我看見她朝落灶洞穴去了。我不清楚她出了什麼事。

original: So you do know her.
string: 所以說你認識她。

original: She came through a while ago, wanted to know where she could get her hands on something valuable. Anything, really.
string: 她之前來過，想弄清自己能上哪兒去找點值錢的東西。什麼都好。

original: I told her it was a bad idea, that she wasn't cut out for what'd be necessary, but she wouldn't hear it.
string: 我告訴她那不是個好主意，但她沒有聽進去。

original: So I gave her some advice, pointed her towards Hobs Fall Cave and that was that.
string: 所以我給了她一些建議，並指引她去落灶洞穴。就是那樣。

original: Someone named Ranmir is looking for her.
string: 有個名為蘭米爾的人在找她。

original: Not him again.
string: 不會又是他吧。

original: He came nosing around Riften a while back, making a lot of noise about me. He was... persuaded to leave before he found me.
string: 前陣子他找遍了整個裂谷城，說了一大堆關於我的廢話，後來他…在找到我之前就被人勸走了。

original: Funny, I'd have thought she would've gone back to him by now.
string: 真有趣，我認為時至今日她也該回到他身邊了。

original: I'm just trying to find her.
string: 我只是想試著找到她

original: Well, ain't gonna find her here. Haven't seen her in a while.
string: 好吧，這裡是找不到她的，我們有段時日沒見到她了。

original: Do you know Isabelle Rolaine?
string: 你知道伊莎貝拉．羅萊妮這個人?

original: Who's asking?
string: 誰在問的？

original: Do you know where I could find Isabelle Rolaine?
string: 你知道在哪可以找到伊莎貝拉．羅萊妮嗎？

original: I don't, I'm afraid. Ranmir didn't talk much about her after she'd left.
string: 不知道，蘭米爾很少提到她走後的事情。

original: He seemed convinced that she'd run off with someone named Vex. That's all I remember.
string: 他看起來已確定他心愛的人是和一個叫「小煩」的傢伙走掉了，這是我所記得的。

original: What can be done about it now?
string: 我現在該怎麼做？

original: I'm not sure. I hoped that maybe if she could be found, if he had some sort of explanation, that maybe he could put himself back together.
string: 我也不清楚。但若是能找到她，或許能給他個交代，他也就能振作起來也說不定。

original: I'm in no position to go searching for her, but perhaps you could.
string: 我也沒辦法去找她，你能幫忙嗎？

original: So what happened to him?
string: 所以他後來怎麼了？

original: See, Ranmir was involved with a pretty young woman named Isabelle Rolaine. The two of them were very happy together, I thought.
string: 蘭米爾曾經和一個名為伊莎貝拉．羅萊妮的年輕女子在一起。這小倆口以前過得相當幸福。

original: One day, she just disappeared. Ranmir was convinced she'd run off with someone else, leaving him behind.
string: 但有一天，這個年輕女子消失了，蘭米爾相信她拋棄了自己，與別人私奔了。

original: He turned to drinking, and what's left of him is what you see here every day.
string: 他終日借酒消愁，最終變成了你現在看到的這幅模樣。

original: What's this got to do with me?
string: 這與我有什麼關係嗎？

original: Well, I'm getting to that. Just let me explain.
string: 好吧，我正要說呢，讓我來解釋一下。

original: What did he used to be like?
string: 他以前是個怎樣的人?

original: Oh, he was a different person. Happy, outgoing... Like anyone who's in love.
string: 噢，他是個與眾不同的人，快樂且直率，正如沉浸在愛中的人一樣。

original: Sorry, not interested.
string: 對不起，我沒興趣。

original: Ah. Well, some other time, perhaps.
string: 啊，好吧，也許下次吧。

original: Don't get me wrong, I don't have a problem with him being here all the time. He mostly keeps to himself, and so far he's been able to pay.
string: 別誤會我，我對他沒什麼意見。他總是獨來獨往，而且到目前為止他還付得起錢。

original: I just hate to see what's happened to him. He hasn't always been like this, you know. Drunk, I mean.
