string: 我只是不喜歡他變成這樣。你知道的，我的意思是，他以前並不是這樣一個以酒度日的人。

original: What can I do for you?
string: 有什麼可以效勞的？

original: It's about Ranmir.
string: 是關於蘭米爾的事。

original: Oh, I'm so glad you changed your mind.
string: 噢，我很高興你改變主意了

original: It's about Ranmir.
string: 是關於蘭米爾的事。

original: You said something needing help?
string: 你說你有事情需要幫助？

original: Anything around here that needs doing?
string: 這裡有什麼事需要人幫忙？

original: Well, not exactly.
string: 好吧，不全是這樣。

original: Listen, we're friends, right?
string: 我們是朋友，對吧？

original: I wondered if I could ask a favor of you.
string: 我在想我能否請你幫個忙。

original: Did you reconsider? Will you talk to my father?
string: 你重新考慮過了嗎？你會和我父親談談嗎？

original: You should probably stick to farming.
string: 也許你堅持務農會更好。

original: Well, if you change your mind, I'd still like your help.
string: 好吧，如果你改變主意了，我仍然歡迎你的幫助。

original: You decided to become a mercenary?
string: 你決定當一個傭兵了？

original: Seemed like the best way to see the world and make some coin.
string: 看來這是出去賺錢見世面的最佳選擇了。

original: Sure I'm a little green, but what I lack in experience, I make up for in courage.
string: 雖然我還是有點菜，不過我缺乏的經驗，我會以勇氣來補足。

original: I haven't spoken to him yet.
string: 我還沒跟他談過呢

original: Can't blame you for having better things to do than help some farmer you don't know.
string: 你有比幫助陌生農夫更好的事情要做，這沒什麼好抱怨的。

original: Your father changed his mind.
string: 你父親改變主意了。

original: I can't thank you enough, friend. I'll hope you'll come back to Rorikstead soon and pay me a visit.
string: 感激不盡，朋友。我希望你日後能回到洛利克鎮來看看我。

original: Maybe we can swap stories about our adventures over a mug of ale at the inn!
string: 也許我們可以在酒館裡一起暢飲麥芽酒，一邊交流冒險經歷。

original: Remind me - what am I supposed to do?
string: 提醒我——我該做什麼？

original: Where am I headed again?
string: 我又該去哪裡？

original: Remind me - what am I supposed to do?
string: 提醒我——我該做什麼？

original: Where am I headed again?
string: 我又該去哪裡？

original: Remind me - what am I supposed to do?
string: 提醒我——我該做什麼？

original: I did, and I will. It's just tougher than I thought.
string: 是，我會的，這只比我想像中要難一些而已。

original: You assured me that you could find it, however.
string: 你向我保證你無論如何會找到它的。

original: Not yet. You know you're asking for some pretty strange stuff, don't you? It's not easy to find.
string: 還沒，你知道你在找一些很奇怪的東西，對吧？那可不容易找到。

original: Have you gotten the items I requested from you?
string: 你拿到我要找的東西了嗎？

original: I'm fully aware of the terms of our... arrangement.
string: 我完全清楚我們協商好的……條件。

original: Well, you know the drill. You don't see it here, it's gonna cost you extra for me to get it.
string: 好吧，你知道規矩的，你在這裡是得不到它的，要想拿到手你還得給點額外的好處。

original: Perhaps, perhaps. I'm not quite sure what I need.
string: 也許是吧，我不是很確定我要找什麼。

original: You looking for anything in particular this time?
string: 你這次是在尋找什麼特別的東西嗎？

original: Yeah, well I don't see anything.
string: 是啊，好吧，我什麼也沒看到。

original: I certainly hope so, otherwise I'm wasting my time.
string: 我當然希望如此，否則我就是在浪費時間。

original: You got anything in here worth buying?
string: 你在這裡找到什麼值錢的東西了嗎？

original: Don't sass me, little girl.
string: 別跟我頂嘴，小女孩。

original: Always looking on the bright side, aren't you.
string: 你總是往好的一方面看，對嗎？

original: Same as ever. Trying to keep from freezing to death, trying to keep food on the table.
string: 就跟以前一樣，想辦法別讓自己凍死，也別讓自己餓死

original: How are you today, Thaena?
string: 你近況如何啊，塔伊那。

original: So, only the poor or the sick live here?
string: 所以，這裡只留下了老弱病殘？

original: That's right. Welcome to Markarth, traveler. Thank the Divines you can choose to live somewhere else.
string: 沒錯，歡迎來到馬卡斯,旅行者，你應該感謝聖靈讓你還能選擇自己的住處。

original: So where do you work?
string: 你在哪工作？

original: Arnleif and Sons Trading Company. I'm a porter. Just some muscle hired to move heavy packages.
string: 阿雷夫父子貿易商行，我是個搬運工。工作內容就是用蠻力去搬一些沉重的箱子。

original: But we don't get any shipments in. Forsworn attack every caravan. So all I do is sit here and drink.
string: 但我們收不到任何貨物，棄誓者攻擊了每一個商隊，我所能做的就是坐在這裡喝酒。

original: Come, Rikke. There's still much to be done.
string: 來吧，瑞姬，還有很多事情要做呢。

original: We couldn't have done this without you. The Empire glories in your accomplishments...
string: 我們要成事沒你可不行。帝國的榮耀裡有你的一份功勞。

original: I pray you're right, Legate.
string: 我希望你是對的，副官。

original: In the meantime, we'll continue to root them out and put them to the sword.
string: 在此期間，我們會繼續根除他們並把他們斬於劍下。

original: There's bound to be resistance. There are many Stormcloak camps tucked away in the hills.
string: 他們一定會反抗的，那裡還有很多風暴斗篷隱沒在山中。

original: They'll no doubt strike whenever and wherever they can.
string: 他們隨時隨地都能毫不遲疑的發動攻擊。

original: But without Ulfric to inflame their passions, they'll settle down and return to their homes eventually.
string: 但沒有了烏弗瑞克去燃燒他們的鬥志，他們終將平靜下來並且回到家鄉。

original: I hope we haven't just created a martyr.
string: 我希望我們還沒有創造一個烈士。

original: It wasn't so bad.
string: 還不算太壞。

original: I hate giving speeches.
string: 我討厭演講。

original: I am proud of all of you.
string: 我為你們所有人感到驕傲。

original: All hail the Emperor. All hail his Legionnaires!
string: 為我們的皇帝喝彩吧，為他的將士們喝彩吧！

original: In appreciation for your exemplary service, I am doubling your pay and compensation to the widows of your fallen comrades.
string: 為了讚揚你的模範事蹟，我將給你雙倍報酬，並向你那陣亡夥伴們的家屬給予補償。

original: We are turning the city over to Brunwulf Free-Winter, an honorable and faithful man.
string: 我們會把這座城市移交給布倫武夫．逸冬，一位忠實可靠的人。

original: Many of you will be staying in Windhelm to aid the Jarl in restoring order and stamping out any embers of rebellion that may still smolder here.
string: 你們中的部分人將會留在風舵城幫助領主恢復秩序，並且消滅掉那些垂死掙扎的叛軍餘黨。

original: His head will be sent to Cyrodiil where it will adorn a spike on the walls of the Imperial City.
string: 他的頭顱將被送往賽瑞迪爾掛在帝都的城牆上做裝飾。

original: Let this day be a final warning to all who would still call themselves Stormcloaks.
string: 就把這一天當做是給那些仍自稱為風暴斗篷的人們的最後警告吧。

original: The rebellion is over. Ulfric Stormcloak is dead.
string: 叛亂已經結束了。烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷陣亡了。

original: Attention! General Tullius has an announcement!
string: 注意！圖留斯將軍有事宣告！

original: The Legion will be staying here for quite some time. I don't expect there to be any further violence.
string: 軍團還會在這裡停留一段時間。我不指望這裡還會有更激烈的鬥爭。

original: Brunwulf. Yes, I've sent men to protect him and bring him here.
string: 布倫武夫，是的，我已經派人保護他並把他帶來這裡了。

original: Windhelm will need a government quickly if we are to prevent more violence.
string: 如果我們要阻止更多的暴力事件，那麼就得在風舵城迅速建立起政權。

original: Well, the men will be expecting some kind of speech.
string: 好吧，這傢伙肯定有所耳聞了。

original: And we'll need to hand the city over to that Free-Winter fellow.
string: 而且我們需要做的就是把這座城市移交給逸冬的人。

original: Nothing.
string: 沒什麼。

original: Just saying goodbye.
string: 只是說聲再見而已。

original: What was that, Legate?
string: 怎麼了？副官?

original: Talos be with you...
string: 塔洛斯與你同在。

original: It'll make for a better song.
string: 這將會是一曲更美好的樂章。

original: Let the Dragonborn be the one to do it.
string: 讓龍裔來完成它吧。

original: Right. Well?
string: 好的。嗯？

original: Sovngarde... sir.
string: 英靈殿……先生。

original: Well Ulfric, you can't escape from me this time.
string: 好了烏弗瑞克，這次我絕不會讓你逃掉。

original: Any last requests before I send you to... to wherever you people go when you die.
string: 還有什麼遺言嗎，在我送你去……你族人死後要去的地方之前。

original: Well? What are we waiting for?
string: 好吧？我們還等什麼？

original: Enough!
string: 夠了！

original: You are traitors and will die traitors' deaths. Stand down and face public execution, or advance and face summary execution by my hands.
string: 你們這些叛徒，必將死無葬身之地。你們要嘛就滾開聽候公眾的審判，要嘛就上前馬上讓我親手處決。

original: It matters little to me. Either way I'll be sending your heads back to Cyrodiil.
string: 這對我來說沒什麼區別。不論如何我都會把你們的頭顱送回賽瑞迪爾。

original: No... But I belong to her.
string: 不……但我得聽她的話。

original: Skyrim doesn't belong to you, Ulfric.
string: 天際省並不是屬於你的，烏弗瑞克。

original: I'll never surrender Skyrim into the hands of a corrupt and dying Empire.
string: 我是絕不會把天際省交給一群腐朽衰敗的帝國人的。

original: Step aside Galmar. We're here to accept Ulfric's surrender.
string: 讓開，加爾瑪。我們是來這接受烏弗瑞克投降的。

original: Not while I'm still breathing, it's not.
string: 不行，只要我還活著，你想都不要想。

original: Ulfric Stormcloak!
string: 烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷！

original: You are guilty of insurrection, murder of Imperial citizens, the assassination of King Torygg, and high treason against the Empire.
string: 因為你的叛亂、謀殺、試圖行刺托依格國王、背叛祖國的行為，在此宣佈你有罪。

original: It's over.
string: 已經結束了。

original: Already done, sir.
string: 已經搞定了，先生。

original: Secure the door.
string: 拿下大門。

original: I've purchased Honeyside.
string: 我已經把甜蜜灣買下了。

original: Then allow me to officially welcome you to Riften. You'll make a fine addition to our city.
string: 那麼，請讓我正式地歡迎你來到裂谷城。你絕對會愛上我們這城市的。

original: All that remains now is to bestow the title upon you.
string: 現在最後一步就是要把稱號賜予給你。

original: Hmm? What's this about?
string: 唔？這是怎麼回事？

original: Oh, yes. Of course... the whole thane thing. I'd forgotten. If you're ready then, can we get this out of the way?
string: 噢，是的。當然……武衛那件事嘛。我幾乎都忘了。要是你準備好了，那麼我們就來搞定這事吧？

original: I would be honored to accept.
string: 能夠得到這個稱號讓我倍感榮幸。

original: You've already taken all the necessary steps in becoming eligible for the title.
string: 你完成了所有必要步驟，你已有足夠資格來獲得這個稱號。

original: Therefore all that remains is to bestow it upon you.
string: 因此，最後一步就是要把它賜予給你。

original: You damn well better.
string: 他媽的你最好這樣。

original: I've checked with my court and apparently you're fully eligible... there's nothing standing in the way of presenting you the title.
string: 我和我的上古議會商議過了，很顯然，你完全有資格……沒什麼可以妨礙你獲得這一頭銜。

original: Before I can present you with the title, there's but a single requirement you must fulfill.
string: 在我把稱號授予你之前，還有唯一一個條件你必須滿足。

original: A Thane of Riften is expected to maintain permanent residence within the city walls.
string: 作為一位裂谷城的武衛，他應該在城牆內保證有固定的住處。

original: My steward has such a home available to you for purchase. I think you'll find the accommodations to be most pleasing.
string: 我的侍從剛好有那麼一套房子可以賣給你。我想你肯定會對那住所感到非常滿意的。

original: When the house is yours, return to me and I will present you the title.
string: 等房子屬於你之後，就回來找我，我會把稱號授予你。

original: Not so fast, there's a matter of residence to be discussed.
string: 沒那麼快，居留的問題還得討論討論。

original: In order to have the title bestowed upon you, you need to purchase a house within Riften.
string: 為了能夠被賜予那個頭銜，你必須在裂谷城買棟房子。

original: And by the Eight, aren't you fortunate that my steward has just the place for you to buy.
string: 八聖靈在上，我的侍從剛好有那麼一處地方可以賣給你，你可真夠幸運的。

original: After the place is yours, come back to me and we'll deal with the rest of the nonsense.
string: 等你把那地方買下來就回來找我，我們再去處理其它那亂七八糟的事。

original: What are you doing here? You're supposed to be meeting Malborn in Solitude.
string: 你在這裡做什麼？你應該到獨孤城和馬伯恩見面的。

original: Not here. I told you to meet me in Riverwood.
string: 不是這裡，我叫你到河木鎮找我的。

original: As soon as you distract the guards, I'll open the door.
string: 一旦你把那些衛兵引開，我就打開門。

original: What can I get for you, sir?
string: 有什麼可以幫忙的嗎，先生？

original: What can I get for you, ma'am?
string: 有什麼可以幫忙的嗎，女士？

original: Yes? What do you need?
string: 您好，請問需要什麼？

original: Thank you.
string: 謝謝。

original: I should be the one thanking you. You've solved more problems in the short time you've been here then anyone in my court has their entire careers.
string: 我才應該說謝謝呢。你才來了這麼一陣子，就幫忙解決了那麼多問題，要是換作我的任何手下，肯定搞一輩子都搞不定。

original: You've been a beacon of hope in these dark times for my people and I will never forget it.
string: 在這黑暗的時代裡，你簡直就是我們的希望之光，你的恩情我永遠不會忘記。

original: Therefore, by my authority as Jarl, I pronounce you Thane of Riften and award you all of the benefits befitting your station. Congratulations.
string: 因此，我以領主的身份宣佈，封你為裂谷城武衛，並賜予你一切應得的權益與獎賞。恭喜你。

original: I expect that you'll distance yourself from the affairs of state. In other words, keep your nose out of my business and we'll do just fine.
string: 我希望你能劃清界限，不要插手本土的事務。換句話說，只要你不來干涉我，那大家都能相安無事。

original: Just remember that you're only a part of my court, this doesn't make you one of the family.
string: 要記得你還只是我的一名臣屬，而不是我的家族成員。

original: I guess all that's left is to bestow the title. What were those words again?
string: 我想只剩下稱號賜予的事情了。那該說什麼來著？

original: Doesn't matter... the title is yours. I henceforth name you Thane of Riften. Don't disappoint me.
string: 無所謂……稱號是你的。我從今天開始任命你為裂谷城武衛。別讓我失望了啊。

original: I've purchased Honeyside.
string: 我已經把甜蜜灣買下了。

original: Regarding what, my lady?
string: 是關於什麼的呢，我的女士？

original: Much like Mjoll, you've become champion of our hold; helping people with their difficulties and providing assistance for their needs.
string: 就像是穆月爾一樣，你現在成為了我們領地的勇士 ；不僅幫助人們解決了很多困難，還盡力滿足他們的需要。

original: As the Jarl of Riften, I feel it's my duty to honor your selfless behavior by honoring you with the title Thane of Riften.
string: 作為裂谷城領主，我必須向你那無私的行為致敬，而賦予你裂谷城武衛的稱號。

original: Oh don't pretend to be modest. I'm talking about your new role as champion. Apparently, you've taken my people under your wing.
string: 噢你別太自謙了。我正在討論你勇士的新身份。很顯然，你非常關懷我的人民。

original: If you think you can steal my throne by winning the hearts of the people, that's where you're wrong. Keep that in mind.
string: 你給我聽好了，要是你覺得這樣收買人心就能篡我的位，那你就大錯特錯了。

original: However, since it wouldn't behoove me to make you disappear, I'd rather have you on my side as Thane of Riften.
string: 然而，要我就這樣把放你走也太可惜了，我倒希望你能成為裂谷城武衛，做我的左右手。

original: Is there anything I can help Riften with?
string: 有什麼事情我可以幫到裂谷城的嗎？

original: Ah, there you are. I was wondering when you'd visit us again.
string: 啊，你來了，我剛剛還想著你什麼時候會再來見我們。

original: I've been informed by my steward that you've made quite an impression in the Rift; several of our citizens have expressed their admiration.
string: 我的侍從告訴我，你已經給裂谷的人們留下了深刻的印象；我們有不少居民都對你表示欽佩。

original: So, I've been hearing your name in court quite a bit lately.
string: 嗯，我才在宮廷裡聽說你的大名，有點兒孤陋寡聞了。

original: I've been informed by my steward that you've made quite an impression in the Rift; the people won't stop blathering about you.
string: 我的侍從告訴我，你已經給裂谷的人們留下了深刻的印象；人們都七嘴八舌的討論你。

original: I think I've said enough. Now leave me alone.
string: 我想我說得夠多了。現在讓我靜一靜吧。

original: Be careful, Niluva is a bit... aggressive when she's cornered.
string: 小心點，要是把妮露娃逼急了……她也會咬人的。

original: I told you everything I know. What else did you want?
string: 我知道的一切都告訴你了。你還想怎麼樣？

original: You looking for something?
string: 你在找東西嗎？

original: I thank you for your help, my friend.
string: 朋友，很感謝你的幫忙。

original: The Cragslane operation has been stopped.
string: 斯萊恩峭壁的交易行動已經被終止了。

original: Well done! Your continued efforts have been of great benefit to the people of Riften.
string: 做得好！你的不懈努力可是極大地造福了裂谷城人民啊。

original: Allow me to present you with this compensation for your selfless efforts.
string: 請允許我授予您這些，以作為您那無私奉獻的一點補償吧。

original: I'll send my men to secure any of the remaining goods you left behind. We can't have that substance falling into the wrong hands now, can we?
string: 我會派手下去保護好你留下的貨物。我們不能讓那些東西落在壞人手裡，對吧？

original: Here, this should suffice as your cut of the... or rather, a reward for your actions. Now, if you'll excuse me...
string: 給你，這應該夠你那一份了……或者應該說，這是你行動應得的報酬。那麼，我失陪了……

original: On second thought, maybe we'll fight later.
string: 我想了想，不如我們還是下次再打吧。

original: Suit yourself. I'm always here.
string: 隨你便，反正我一直都會在這裡。

original: Let's fight! (Brawl)
string: 我們來打吧！（打架）

original: Here we go!
string: 放馬過來！

original: How about a rematch?
string: 再比一次怎麼樣？

original: Sure, I don't mind taking some more of your gold.
string: 很好，我也不介意在你身上多贏點錢。

original: Just let me know when you're ready.
string: 你準備好就告訴我一聲。

original: I'll fight you again, but not until you have the gold to back up your bet.
string: 等你有足夠的錢下賭注了，我就和你再打一場。

original: How about another time?
string: 還是下次再來吧？

original: I don't blame you. If I were in your shoes, I'd chicken out too.
string: 這也不怪你，在你那種情況下，換做是我也會臨陣脫逃的。

original: Well, offer still stands if you ever want to have a go.
string: 好吧，要是你什麼時候想來一場的話，我依然隨時歡迎。

original: Sure, I'll match your bet! (Brawl)
string: 好啊，我接受你的賭注！（打架）

original: All right, remember... this is a clean fight. No weapons, no tricks. And none of those fancy magic spells, either.
string: 很好，要記住……這是場公平的戰鬥。禁止使用兵器，禁止作弊。當然所有那些花俏的魔法咒語也一樣禁止。

original: Here we go!
string: 放馬過來！

original: Well come back when you earn some more so I can take it from you!
string: 歡迎再來，等你賺夠了錢再回來輸給我吧！

original: I bet you're wrong.
string: 我敢打賭你錯了。

original: Oh! Sounds like I've got a challenger.
string: 噢！看來有人想要挑戰我呢。

original: Tell you what. How about a friendly wager, just between us. I bet you my entire purse of septims I can beat you in a fistfight.
string: 我跟你說，不如就我們之間，小小地打個賭怎麼樣。我用我整袋錢來賭我一下就能把你打爆。

original: You match the bet and we fight until one of us gives in.
string: 你要是敢跟我賭，我們就打到有人肯認輸為止。

original: Must be dangerous living outside the walls.
string: 住在城牆外一定很危險。

original: Bah, I'm not afraid of anything out here. Walls are just a weakling's hiding spot.
string: 呸，我說這有什麼好怕的。只有懦弱的傢伙才躲在城牆後面。

original: Now me, I'm no weakling. In fact, I bet I've got the strongest arms in all of Skyrim.
string: 你看我，我才不是什麼弱者。實際上，我可是有著天際省最孔武有力的臂膀呢。

original: I'm the Thane of Riften.
string: 我是裂谷城武衛。

original: Forgive me milord, I didn't recognize you! Please proceed.
string: 大人請原諒，我沒認出您來！請您繼續吧。

original: Forgive me milady, I didn't recognize you! Please proceed.
string: 大人請原諒，我沒認出您來！請您繼續吧。

original: Sorry, I'll leave.
string: 對不起，我會離開的。

original: Bloody tourists.
string: 該死的觀光客。

original: Can I pass now? (<BribeCost> gold)
string: 我能過去了嗎？（賄賂<BribeCost>金幣）

original: Sure, that'll do just fine. Go on ahead.
string: 很好，很不錯。去吧。

original: That's just insulting. Not even a proper bribe?
string: 你簡直就在侮辱我。竟然連個像樣的賄賂都沒有？

original: It's fine, I'm allowed to be here. (Persuade)
string: 沒問題的，我是被批准來這裡的。（說服）

original: Oh, my mistake then. Sorry, you can go on ahead.
string: 噢，那一定是我搞錯了。對不起，你可以過去了。

original: Sure, and I'm Queen Barenziah. Now tell me another one.
string: 很好，那我還說我是巴蘭茲雅女王呢。你騙誰啊。

original: Hey, you're not supposed to be down here. Official business only.
string: 嘿，你不可以下來這裡的。這只許公務人員進入。

original: What are you doing down here?
string: 你在這裡做什麼？

original: Ignore me all you want, you still aren't getting in.
string: 聽不聽我的話隨你便，但你還是不能進去。

original: Does this finally mean peace?
string: 終於，這樣就和平了嗎？

original: The fiercest of the remaining rebels will continue to harass us, but by in large, the people here desire peace.
string: 那些最兇殘的殘餘叛亂份子，還會不斷地侵擾我們，但整體來說，這裡的大多數人都期待著和平。

original: What I'm not so sure about is the peace we've made with the Thalmor. But we'll keep that between the two of us, alright?
string: 我不太肯定梭默是否會真的接受我們的和平。這話你我知道就好了，不要亂說出去，好嗎？

original: Now that Ulfric is dead, will there be peace?
string: 現在烏弗瑞克都死了，和平會來嗎？

original: There are those who still call themselves Stormcloaks, who continue to fight us, and bring misery to the people... but they are few in number.
string: 那些自稱為風暴斗篷的人，依然在和我們戰鬥，並把苦難散佈給人民……還好他們已經為數不多了。

original: The ordinary citizen will be happy to get back to life as normal, to have their families return home.
string: 那些普通的居民們會很高興生活能夠恢復正常，並且和家人團聚。

original: And they should enjoy it while they can... I suspect all of Tamriel will again be called to arms in the not too distant future.
string: 他們理當享受自己的生活……不過我懷疑在那不久的將來，戰爭的號角就會再度響徹整個泰姆瑞爾。

original: Now that Ulfric is dead, will there be peace?
string: 現在烏弗瑞克都死了，和平會來嗎？

original: There will be peace for a time, during which we must rebuild Skyrim into the land it once was. Strong. Self-reliant. The center of mankind.
string: 會有一陣子的和平，趁著這段時間我們必須趕緊重建天際省，恢復它曾經的輝煌。使它成為那強大、獨立的、人類文明的中心。

original: Because getting rid of the Empire was only half the problem.
string: 因為擺脫帝國的控制，只是解決了問題的一半。

original: Soon, the elves will again seek to rule the world. We must ready ourselves to fight them.
string: 很快，精靈們就會再次試圖統治世界。我們必須做好準備去對抗他們。

original: For it will be Skyrim that shall lead Tamriel in those dark days, when the fate of the world is finally determined.
string: 當世界的命運終於塵埃落定，那時必將由天際省來引領泰姆瑞爾渡過那黑暗的歲月。

original: Now that we've defeated the Imperials, will there be peace?
string: 現在我們打敗帝國人了，和平會來嗎？

original: Peace? When has any Nord ever known peace? Skyrim breeds warriors. It's who we are, it's in our blood.
string: 和平？諾德人的字典裡有這個詞嗎？天際省是戰士的搖籃。這是我們的宿命，這流淌在我們的血液之中。

original: And that's as it should be. In the darkest days ahead, it'll be us Nords who lead the fight against the elves.
string: 本該如此。那最黑暗的日子即將到來，與精靈們的戰鬥必將由我們諾德人來引領。

original: It's only a matter of time before their pointy ears start itching to rule the world again.
string: 在那些尖耳朵的傢伙們再試圖統治世界之前，這只是時間的問題。

original: It'll be Skyrim that leads the charge. Mark my words. And that time around, mankind will either succeed once and for all or die trying.
string: 天際省將引領我們前進。記住我說的話。到了那時，人類將會再次全面復興，否則必將血流成河。

original: Now that we've defeated the Imperials, will there be peace?
string: 現在我們打敗帝國人了，和平會來嗎？

original: What's next for you?
string: 你以後打算怎麼辦？

original: No, I suspect Skyrim to be my home for many years.
string: 不，這麼多年來我還是很疑惑天際省是不是我的故鄉。

original: Can't say I'll ever get used to the damn cold, or understand these Nords... but, I've come to respect them.
string: 我不擔保能再習慣這麼冷的鬼天氣，也不能說已經很理解這些諾德人……但至少，我開始尊敬他們了。

original: The harshness of Skyrim has a way of carving a man down to his true self.
string: 這種天際省獨有的粗獷味道很能讓人磨練性情，雕琢自我。

original: Will you return to Cyrodiil now?
string: 現在你要回去賽瑞迪爾嗎？

original: The General's put me in charge of assisting the new governments.
string: 將軍要我來負責協助處理新政府的事務。

original: I may understand things here in Skyrim better than the General, but I'm a soldier at heart, not a politician. But I'll do my best.
string: 我也許會比將軍更為瞭解天際省的情況。雖然本質上我依然還是一名士兵，而不是政客，但我也會盡力而為。

original: This is the land of my birth, the land that shaped me. I'm proud to have any part in making it strong again.
string: 是這片土地孕育了我，造就了我。而我能為它的再次興盛作出貢獻，我感到非常驕傲。

original: What's next for the accomplished Legate Rikke?
string: 我們多才多藝的瑞姬副官接下來打算怎麼辦？

original: No, not yet. We'll wait for the Moot to name me High King. It'll be better for all that way.
string: 不，還不是時候。我們要等領地大會代表任命我為至高王，那樣比較妥當。

original: But, that doesn't mean I won't start acting like it. There's much to do. The new Jarls need help building armies, and enforcing their right to rule.
string: 但那並不表示我會就這樣無所事事，有很多事情等著做：得幫助那些新任的領主組建軍隊，還有加強他們的統治權。

original: The Empire may try to reclaim Skyrim, and I need everyone ready for that. Though the biggest threat, of course, is the elves.
string: 帝國想要收復天際省，我要所有人對此格外警覺，雖然我們最大的敵人是精靈族。

original: So, do I call you High King now?
string: 所以，現在我該稱呼你為至高王了？

original: Heh. Ulfric's put me in charge of keeping an eye on the new Jarls. You know, make sure they're generally following orders.
string: 呵。烏弗瑞克要我負責監視那些新任領主。你也知道，得有人確保他們乖乖聽話。

original: Can't say I'm looking forward to that. But, I'll also be training men and women for their new armies.
string: 儘管我不是，但是我也會幫牠們的新軍隊訓練一些人才。

original: The Empire might send over a few Legionnaires to make sure we're serious, and of course, we'll be taking the fight to the elves soon enough.
string: 帝國可能會派些軍團過來惹事，確認我們不是玩玩而已。另外，可想而知的是我們很快也將和精靈交戰了。

original: We'll need trained, disciplined and creative warriors ready for all that.
string: 我們需要大量訓練有素、紀律嚴明並富有創造力的戰士來迎接戰爭。

original: What's next for the mighty Galmar Stone-Fist?
string: 我們無敵的加爾瑪．石拳接下來打算怎麼辦？

original: Is there anything further I can do...?
string: 我還能夠做些什麼……？

original: Ulfric is dead and his army destroyed. There's not much more I could ask of you. The gods, however, I suspect, may have plans for you elsewhere.
string: 烏弗瑞克已死，他的軍隊也覆滅了，你已經幫我夠多了。不過，我想神靈們也許為你準備了其他的計劃。

original: That said, Stormcloak true believers are still operating out of hidden military camps in the hills. If you encounter any on you travels, kill them.
string: 也就是說，那些風暴斗篷的信徒們在山裡還有一些隱秘營地。如果途中遇到他們，殺無赦。

original: With luck, they'll soon lose heart and return to their homes and families. If not, we'll be forced to put them all to the sword.
string: 幸運的話，他們很快就會失去信心，紛紛回到各自的家庭。要不然，我們只好動用武力對付他們了。

original: Is there anything further I can do for the Legion?
string: 我還能夠為軍團做些什麼？

original: The Legion's work is far from finished, but you are free to roam. I suspect you'll be of greater good to Skyrim out there, in the world.
string: 軍團的工作可才剛剛起步呢，不過你可以去自由闖蕩。我想你在外面的世界，會找到更多機會造福天際省。

original: If while you're out there, you stumble into any Stormcloak military camps, I expect you to destroy them. I've reports they are hiding in the hills.
string: 如果你在外面，恰好撞見風暴斗篷的軍事營地，希望你能把他們都除掉。我收到報告說他們躲在山裡。

original: Is there anything further I can do for the Legion?
string: 我還能夠為軍團做些什麼？

original: True sons and daughters of Skyrim reign in every city, we've crippled the Imperial Legion, and cut off its head by killing General Tullius himself.
string: 散落各處的天際省子民，我們擊潰了帝國軍團，並殺死了圖留斯將軍，將他們徹底斬草除根！

original: What more could I ask of you? No, you're free to roam. I suspect the gods have needs for you elsewhere.
string: 我對你別無所求了。去吧，你可以自由去闖蕩。我想在別處，神靈們會更需要你。

original: That said, some of the Legion's staunchest men have organized themselves, and are operating out of hidden military camps in the wilderness.
string: 也就是說，有些軍團的中堅分子自己組織起來，在荒野中建立了一些隱秘的軍事營地。

original: If you come across any Imperials in your travels, I expect you'll know what to do.
string: 要是你在旅途中碰到任何帝國人，我想你知道該怎麼做。

original: Is there anything further I can do for the cause?
string: 為了理想，我還可以做些什麼呢？

original: No. I trust you'll do more good out there in the world, wherever you damn well please to go. You're a true son of Skyrim. You'll know what to do.
string: 沒了。我相信，你在外面的世界，無論去到哪，都能做出更多的貢獻。你可是名副其實的天際之子。你知道該怎麼做的。

original: To begin with, killing any Legionnaire you find out in the wilderness. I've reports they've hidden military camps out there.
string: 首先，在荒野裡殺掉所有你找到的軍團士兵。我收到報告說他們的軍事營地都藏在那裡。

original: Is there anything further I can do for the cause?
string: 為了理想，我還可以做些什麼呢？

original: No. I trust you'll do more good out there in the world, wherever you damn well please to go. You're a true daughter of Skyrim and'll know what to do.
string: 沒了。我相信，妳在外面的世界，無論去到哪，都能做出更多的貢獻。妳可是名副其實的天際之女，妳知道該怎麼做的。

original: To begin with, killing any Legionnaire you find out in the wilderness. I've reports they've hidden military camps out there out there.
string: 首先，殺掉所有你在荒野裡找到的軍團士兵。我收到報告，說他們的軍事營地都藏在那裡。

original: Is there anything further I can do for the cause?
string: 為了理想，我還可以做些什麼呢？

original: I'm ready. I made my peace with the gods long ago.
string: 我已準備就緒。很久以前我就已虔心信奉神靈。

original: What are you waiting for? Do it!
string: 你還在等什麼呢？動手吧！

original: With me, you kill Skyrim's last hope. Mark my words. You'll all be serving elven masters soon. And know then, that I would have stopped them.
string: 與我一起，你扼殺了天際省的最後希望。記住我的話，很快的，你們全都會受精靈奴役，那時你們就知道，原本我會制止他們的。

original: By the gods, stop toying with me and do it!
string: 神靈在上，你別給我嘻嘻哈哈的，快給我動手！

original: Oh my. That...
string: 噢我的天。那……

original: You... you go first.
string: 你……你先。

original: I'm looking for work.
string: 我在找差事。

original: What've you been staring at your feet this whole time? You see that big city up ahead of you? Markarth?
string: 你以為你的腳是拿來做什麼用的？看到眼前這座大城市了嗎？馬卡斯城？知道嗎？

original: Head over there, unless you feel like helping my wife pick crops. And then 50 years later you'll wake up and still be here.
string: 到那邊去吧，除非你想幫我老婆摘玉米，然後等過了50年你清醒之後，你還是在這裡。

original: Have you lived here long?
string: 你在這裡生活很久了？

original: What kind of question is that? Look at me! Is this a young man's face?
string: 這是什麼問題？你看看我！我的樣子像年輕人嗎？

original: I've been here 50 years, and nothing is going to move me off my land.
string: 我在這裡住50年了，什麼都不能把我從我的土地上拉走。

original: As part of your initiation, Master Einarth will allow you to tap into his understanding of "Ro."
string: 作為你入門的一部分，愛納斯大師會與你分享他對於「洛」的認知。

original: Well, that is how the rest of us learn Shouts. As Dragonborn, you can absorb a slain dragon's life force and knowledge directly.
string: 嗯，我們其他人就是這樣學會龍吼的。身為龍裔，你能夠直接吸收被屠戮之龍的生命力量以及所有學識。

original: But learning a Word of Power is only the first step... you must unlock its meaning through constant practice in order to use it in a Shout.
string: 但，學會一個力量之語只是第一步……你必須通過不斷地練習才能逐步解開它的真正含義，如此你才能將它運用到龍吼之上。

original: All Shouts are made up of three Words of Power. As you master each Word, your Shout will become progressively stronger.
string: 所有龍吼都是由三個力量之語組成，隨著你精通每一個符文，你的龍吼威力就會逐漸強大。

original: Ro means "Balance" in the dragon tongue. Combine it with Fus - "Force" - to focus your Thu'um more sharply.
string: 洛其實是龍語中「平衡」的意思。把它和伏斯——「威力」——結合在一起，會使你的吐姆更為精準。

original: What's all this about the Forsworn?
string: 這些棄誓者做了什麼？

original: Seems Kolskeggr Mine got hit by Forsworn. Those madmen get more bold every season.
string: 看來科斯凱格礦坑被棄誓者攻擊了。那些瘋子越來越膽大妄為了。

original: Pavo and Gat are the only survivors. I'll be sending word to the Jarl about this, but I don't know when help will come.
string: 帕沃和賈特是唯一的倖存者。我會把情況上報給領主，但不知道增援何時會來。

original: Was. Forsworn came in the night. Killed everyone. Gat and I are the only ones who escaped.
string: 是的。棄誓者在晚上出現，殺了所有人。就只有我和噶特逃出來了。

original: Hopefully Skaggi will send word to the Jarl and something will be done.
string: 但願斯卡基會把情況告訴領主，快點派人過來處理。

original: You're from Kolskeggr Mine?
string: 你從科斯凱格礦坑來的？

original: Do you own this mine?
string: 這礦坑屬於你？

original: That I do. If you want to grab a pickaxe and dig up some iron, feel free. I'll pay for anything you bring me.
string: 沒錯，是我的。要是你想拿把鎬子挖點鐵礦什麼的，請自便。你挖什麼給我，我都買。

original: Skaggi is in charge, not me.
string: 這個由斯卡基負責，不是我。

original: Is this your mine?
string: 這礦坑是你的嗎？

original: That it is. Good to be home. Let me know if you dig up any ore. We'll pay a fair wage.
string: 沒錯，回家真好。要是你挖到礦物，拿來給我吧，我會給付合理的酬勞。

original: Is this your mine?
string: 這礦坑是你的嗎？

original: Let's just hope that doesn't happen.
string: 讓我們希望那千萬別發生。

original: Do you think the Forsworn will come here? I mean, if they attacked Kolskeggr....
string: 你覺得棄誓者會來這裡嗎？我是說，要是他們攻擊了科斯凱格……

original: Those Forsworn were fierce fighters. Fiercer than I could have imagined.
string: 那些棄誓者都是些兇殘的戰士，兇殘得難以想像。

original: Thank the Divines we survived that.
string: 感謝聖靈，我們活下來了。

original: Well I'm glad you were there. I don't know how I would have gotten past the Forsworn without you.
string: 嗯，很高興你在這裡。要不是有你，我還真不知道該怎麼擺脫那些棄世者。

original: What does she do with the memories?
string: 她要那些記憶幹嘛？

original: Who can say? Perhaps she collects them for display like works of art in a nonsensical art gallery.
string: 誰知道呢？或許她只是把它們當成藝術品，收來展示，就像那些沒意義的藝廊一樣。

original: Whatever the case may be, her intentions are far from benevolent.
string: 不管原因是什麼，反正她沒安好心。

original: Absolutely not! I protest... uh, that is, yes, of course. I still don't understand what just... oh never mind.
string: 當然不是！我抗議……呃……是，是的。我還是不明白到底……噢，算了。

original: That is absolutely untrue! Uh, that is, yes, of course. What... I don't understand why everyone... never mind.
string: 那絕對不是真的！呃……是，是的。什麼……我不明白為何所有人都……算了。

original: I protest! This is an insult to the dignity of my person! This time I'm completely innocent!
string: 抗議！那有辱我的人格！這次我真的是無辜的！

original: This is preposterous. Disrespect... insulting! I am tired of being hounded from all sides!
string: 太荒謬了，這根本是不敬……簡直就是侮辱！我實在受夠這樣的全方位騷擾了！

original: Madame Ambassador, you know that I would never have behaved... that is to say... well I swear I'm innocent this time!
string: 大使夫人，您知道我是絕不會……也就是說……哎，我發誓這次我是無辜的！

original: I don't understand... did you say Ulfric Stormcloak? Fine fellow, although a bit too fond of... I mean, no, of course, I condemn him in the most...
string: 我不明白……你剛剛是說烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷？他是個挺好的傢伙，只是有些太熱衷於……我是說，當然啦，多數情況下我還是譴責他的……

original: Hmm? Did you say snakes? Where? I hate them, always slithering they way they do... what? Are they on me?
string: 嗯？你剛剛是說蛇嗎？在哪裡？我討厭牠們，老是滑來滑去的……什麼？牠們在我身上？

original: What? Of course I know who you are... I didn't mean to suggest, that is, I don't remember even saying that...
string: 什麼？我當然知道你是誰……我不是故意想暗示什麼，我是說，我根本連自己說過什麼都不記得了……

original: What? I didn't... hmm? No, listen, you must have misunderstood... I don't mean to say I wouldn't be interested... what I mean is...
string: 什麼？我沒有……唔？不，聽著，你肯定誤會了……我不是說我沒興趣……我其實是說……

original: What? I didn't... hmm? No, listen, you must have misunderstood... I would never openly insult your... that is to say...
string: 什麼？我沒有……唔？不，聽著，你肯定誤會了……我絕不會當眾侮辱你的……也就是說……

original: Tell your men to stand down. I don't need any help dealing with this kind of fool. He isn't worth the trouble.
string: 叫你的人讓開。對付這種蠢材，我不需要你們幫忙，沒必要為了這種人勞師動眾。

original: I apologize for the disruption to such a festive occasion.
string: 很抱歉打斷了這樣的節日盛會。

original: Dear me. All this trouble over me? I think I was confused. There's no harm in him. Please, let him go.
string: 哎喲，天啊，怎麼那麼多麻煩事？我都被搞糊塗了。他沒有惡意的，真的，放開他吧。

original: Oh... I'm afraid I may have overreacted. Please, I've already forgotten whatever it was he said to me.
string: 噢……恐怕我有些反應過度了。真是的，我都不記得他跟我說過什麼了。

original: I'm sure he's learned his lesson. Let's try to enjoy ourselves.
string: 我相信他已經得到教訓了。我們去放鬆一下吧。

original: I'm sorry, Ambassador. I didn't mean to cause such a commotion. There's no need to have him thrown out on my account.
string: 大使，真是對不起，我不是有意引起這樣的騷動的，您不必為了我而把他扔出去。

original: Oh, Ambassador Elenwen, that won't be necessary. It is just Razelan, after all.
string: 噢，愛琳溫大使，沒必要這樣，畢竟只是瑞斯蘭罷了。

original: I'm sure he'll behave himself for the rest of the evening, won't you dear?
string: 我確信他之後都會安安分分的，是吧？

original: Well, now. There's no need to ruin the party on my account. I don't think he'll be bothering me again.
string: 沒必要因為我而打壞大家的興致，我想他不會再來打擾我了。

original: Forgive me, Ambassador. I allowed this... fool to provoke me. The fault is mine. There is no need for further disruption on my account.
string: 大使，請原諒我，我居然讓這個……蠢貨激怒了我。都是我的錯。請別因為我而壞了大家的興致。

original: Yes, Madame Ambassador.
string: 是的，大使夫人。

original: Remove him. He's disturbing the other guests.
string: 把他帶走。他打擾到其他賓客了。

original: Razelan. And you promised to behave yourself this time.
string: 瑞斯蘭。你保證過這次不再搗亂的。

original: Razelan. What is it this time?
string: 瑞斯蘭。你又要做什麼？

original: You take it back then? You retract your statement? Well?
string: 你說話不算話？嗯？

original: Begone, serpent! Begone from this house and trouble it no more!
string: 滾開，你這個忘恩負義的傢伙！滾出這個房子，別再給我找麻煩了！

original: Beware of the serpent in your midst! Beware, oh people of Skyrim!
string: 當心你們之中有叛徒！當心啊，天際省的子民！

original: There's no excuse for your behavior!
string: 你真是罪無可恕！

original: You behave like you're carousing in a house of ill repute, not the residence of the Thalmor Ambassador!
string: 這可是梭默大使的房子，不是讓你尋歡作樂的隨便地方！

original: I know you're drunk as usual, but that's no excuse for insulting our hostess.
string: 我知道你又喝醉了，但那也不是欺辱賓客的藉口。

original: I don't think anyone deserves that kind of abuse! I've known plenty of elves who were perfectly decent people.
string: 我想任何人都不該承受那樣的咒罵！我認識的很多精靈也是非常端莊得體的。

original: The head office will hear of this, Razelan! You're a disgrace to the East Empire Company, and to the Empire itself!
string: 總部會知道你做的好事，瑞斯蘭！你不但是東帝國貿易公司的恥辱，還是帝國的恥辱！

original: You're a disgrace to the Empire. To think that you're actually the representative of the East Empire Company.
string: 你真是帝國的恥辱！你也不想想，你可是東帝國貿易公司的代表啊。

original: When people talk about the decadent, tottering Empire, it's people like you they have in mind!
string: 每當人們想到那個腐朽不堪、風雨飄搖的帝國，人們腦中浮現的就是你這樣的傢伙！

original: Your insults and provocations have gone far enough!
string: 你的侮辱和挑釁實在太過分了！

original: I'd kill you where you stand if I wasn't bound by my oath as an officer of the Aldmeri Dominion.
string: 要不是我身為先祖神洲的軍官，立下了誓言，我鐵定當場就把你殺了。

original: No harm is meant to you, happy fool.
string: 我對你沒有惡意的，大傻蛋。

original: Right here! I see it in your face! The snakes writhe behind your eyes! Get away, get away from me!
string: 就在這裡！我在你臉上看到了！那些蛇影在你眼神中扭動！滾開，不要靠近我！

original: It's all for a good cause, old chap.
string: 一切都有正當理由的，老朋友。

original: Ulfric Stormcloak? The rightful High King? That's bordering on treason, man! Stand up. Stand up, I say!
string: 烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷？合法的至高王？這是赤裸裸的反叛啊！站起來。我叫你站起來啊！

original: What...! Do you know who I am? I should have you taken up and flogged!
string: 什麼……！你知道我是誰嗎？我真該把你抓起來，抽你一頓！

original: Hey, Razelan, remember when you told me I'd never amount to anything?
string: 嘿，瑞斯蘭，記得你曾說我這輩子都將一事無成嗎？

original: Well, I don't think you should stay things like that about the Ambassador!
string: 呃…我想你不該和那個大使一樣地窩囊。

original: Just play along.
string: 繼續裝吧你。

original: How dare you! You disgusting pig!
string: 好大的膽子！你這隻討厭的蠢豬！

original: You've got a lot of nerve, suggesting something like that, to me of all people! If this was Riften, I'd have you thrown in the dungeon!
string: 你膽子可真大，居然敢跟屬於所有民眾的我，暗示有那樣的事情！如果是在裂谷城，我馬上就把你關進地牢！

original: How dare you speak of the Thalmor in such a disgusting manner!
string: 你竟敢用如此齷齪的口吻形容梭默！

original: I need you to cause a scene. Get everyone's attention for a few minutes.
string: 我要你去製造些事端，引開所有人的注意幾分鐘。

original: Say no more. I was wondering what you were doing here... I'm glad to play my part.
string: 不用多說，只是好奇你剛才在這做什麼……還好我不是負責這部分。

original: I trust you don't presume on our friendship? I am a Jarl, after all. I wouldn't want to appear foolish in front of these people.
string: 我想你知道不該太指望我們的友誼？畢竟我是領主，我可不想在這些人面前丟臉。

original: Nothing would please me more. I'll keep their eyes away while you do what you came here for.
string: 樂意之至！在你行動的時候我會引開他們的注意的。

original: Hmm. I don't want to get involved in anything beneath my dignity as Jarl.
string: 啊，我不想和那些卑賤的事情有任何關聯。

original: Oh... perhaps not, then. I don't think the Jarl of Solitude should be participating in a childish prank.
string: 噢……也許就不要了吧。獨孤城領主實在不適合跟幼稚的惡作劇沾上邊。

original: I don't know... I don't want to do anything that might offend Elenwen. There is a lot of money at stake, after all.
string: 我不知道……我不想冒犯到愛琳溫，畢竟，那關係到一大筆錢呢。

original: I don't even want to know, do I? But for you... all right. I'll do it.
string: 我根本不想知道。不過為了你……好吧，我會做。

original: This is very irregular. I trust that whatever you're doing doesn't compromise my position in any way?
string: 這非常不合常規。無論你在做什麼，都不會連累到我吧？

original: That's it? Sure. Shouldn't be too hard. I usually end up making a fool out of myself without even trying.
string: 就這樣？沒問題，應該不會太困難。通常我不用做什麼就會讓自己出醜。

original: If the parties bore you, why attend them?
string: 要是這宴會這麼讓你厭煩，你幹嘛還要參加？

original: The East Empire Company has interests all across Tamriel, inside and outside the Empire's borders. We try not to get involved in politics.
string: 無論在帝國內還是帝國外，東帝國貿易公司的投資遍佈了整個泰姆瑞爾。我們一般會儘量避免捲入政治紛爭。

original: However, as the head of the company it's my job to make sure we maintain good relationships with prospective partners and investors.
string: 不過，身為公司領袖，我的職責是要確保與有希望的合夥人和投資者維持良好關係。

original: I need your help with something.
string: 我需要你幫忙。

original: Let's hear it.
string: 說來聽聽。

original: Well... let's hear it.
string: 好吧……說來聽聽。

original: My ears are always open to a friend's request.
string: 對朋友，我總是有求必應的。

original: Say on, friend. What do you need?
string: 說吧，朋友，你需要什麼？

original: I'm always glad to help a friend if I can. What do you need?
string: 我總是很樂意盡力幫助朋友的。你需要什麼？

original: Oh? Something interesting, I hope?
string: 噢？應該挺有趣的吧？

original: Do you want to help me with something?
string: 你要來幫幫我嗎？

original: Of course! I mean... assuming you don't want me to kill someone for you. I might have to draw the line there.
string: 好呀。我是說……不是要我幫你殺人就好。那是我的底線。

original: I'm listening.
string: 我在聽。

original: What is it, my friend?
string: 什麼事呢，朋友？

original: What brings you to this party?
string: 什麼風把你吹來的？

original: You must be new around here. Bad manners to ask such a direct question, at one of Elenwen's little soirees.
string: 你一定是新來的。參加愛琳溫的小聚會時問這種問題很沒有禮貌。

original: But I have nothing to hide. I'm in from the south, on business.
string: 但是我沒什麼好隱瞞的。我從南方來的，來做生意。

original: And if you want to do business in Tamriel these days, well, you'd better get used to cozying up to the Thalmor. Like it or not.
string: 這年頭要是你想在泰姆瑞爾做生意，那你最好跟梭默攀點關係。無論你喜歡與否。

original: What does a fellow need to do to get a drink around here?
string: 到底要怎樣才能拿到杯酒？

original: Ah, I see. Very well, my friend. I'll do it.
string: 啊，我知道了。很好，朋友。讓我來吧。

original: Oh... all right. If it's so important to you, I suppose I can help.
string: 噢……好吧，要是你真的很迫切的話，我想我能幫點忙。

original: Very well. I suppose there's nothing wrong with a bit of harmless fun.
string: 非常好。我想開點無害的玩笑也無傷大雅吧。

original: Don't worry. I'll play my part.
string: 別擔心，有我在。

original: I find these parties such a dreadful bore.
string: 我覺得這些宴會實在太煩人了。

original: One thing everyone can agree on. This war is bad for business.
string: 所有人都同意，戰爭有害商業。

original: Ah, pardon me, friend. I didn't see you standing there.
string: 啊，請原諒我，朋友。我沒看到你站在那裡。

original: Allow me to introduce myself: Razelan. Imports and exports, by trade. Observer of human nature, by avocation.
string: 請容我自我介紹：我叫瑞斯蘭。職業是做進出口貿易，嗜好是觀察人性本質。

original: I've decided to help you end the nightmares.
string: 我決定幫你終結這場噩夢。

original: Mara be praised!
string: 讚美瑪拉！

original: Nightcaller Temple is only a short walk from Dawnstar. Come, we must hurry.
string: 喚夜神殿距離晨星城路程很短。走吧，我們得快一點。

original: Sorry, I can't.
string: 抱歉，我辦不到。

original: I understand. If you should change your mind, I'll be here.
string: 我明白。要是你改變主意了就來找我，我會一直在這裡。

original: Then leave. This isn't your problem.
string: 那快點離開吧。那不是你能解決得了的。

original: Turn my back on these people when their lives could be at stake? I should say not.
string: 在這些人面對生命危險的時候，棄他們於不顧？我不能這麼做。

original: Those dreams are not just visions, they're a footprint left by the Daedric Lord Vaermina as she drains these people of their memories!
string: 那些夢不僅是預示，還是魔侯瓦爾迷納吸乾這些人的記憶時，所留下的足跡！

original: Don't be ridiculous. Dreams are harmless.
string: 別傻了，夢境又不會傷人。

original: In any other circumstance, I'd agree with you. However, these aren't normal dreams.
string: 若是別的情況，我會同意你的說法。但是，這些不是一般的夢境。

original: The Daedric Lord Vaermina's voracious hunger for memories is responsible for these visions.
string: 魔侯瓦爾迷納對於記憶的無盡饑渴，正好印證了這些預示。

original: The nightmares are an echo of her presence as she feeds.
string: 那些噩夢正是她吃飽喝足後的體現。

original: Can't you do it for me?
string: 你就不能幫我一把？

original: No. No I can't.
string: 不，我不能這樣做。

original: I have enough to keep me busy. View it as a chance to hone your craft.
string: 我已經夠忙的了，你就把它當成磨練自己的機會吧。

original: Thanks for nothing.
string: 太謝謝你了，簡直一點用都沒有！

original: My pleasure.
string: 榮幸之至。

original: I need something enchanted.
string: 我需要個附魔的物品。

original: I'm sure you can figure it out on your own. If you can't, perhaps Urag has a book you can read.
string: 我確信你一個人就能搞定。要是不行，建議你看看烏拉格的書。

original: I need something enchanted.
string: 我需要個附魔的物品。

original: Well, there's an Imbuer here in the Great Hall.
string: 哦，在大廳這裡有個灌魔器。

original: Well, there's an Imbuer in the Great Hall.
string: 哦，在大廳裡有個灌魔器。

original: No offense, of course.
string: 我真的沒有惡意。

original: New here too, eh? It's good to see another Nord. I feared I'd be the only one.
string: 又是新來的，呃？很高興能看到另一個諾德人，我還怕我是唯一的一個。

original: Almost doesn't feel like Skyrim, being so far away from the rest of the world here.
string: 這裡離世界其他地方那麼遙遠，一點兒都不像是在天際省。

original: New here too, eh? I'd hoped I wouldn't be the only Nord, but I should've known better.
string: 又是新來的，呃？我一直希望能有另一個諾德人呢。

original: Dangerous research must be a problem here.
string: 危險的研究在這裡肯定是個大問題。

original: Not often, no.
string: 不，只是偶爾罷了。

original: Some risks must be taken, to be sure. I am simply trying to avoid untimely deaths.
string: 沒錯，有些風險是不得不冒的。而我純粹是不想暴斃街頭而已。

original: We also must make an effort to avoid worsening what Skyrim thinks of us.
string: 我們也得努力避免我們在天際省的形象繼續惡化。

original: No, sir.
string: 沒有呢，先生。

original: "Sir"? How quaint.
string: 「先生」？真古怪。

original: No, we haven't.
string: 不，我們沒呢。

original: Then allow me to introduce myself.
string: 那請讓我自我介紹一下。

original: No, we haven't.
string: 不，我們沒呢。

original: I am Savos Aren, Arch-Mage of the College of Winterhold.
string: 我是薩沃斯．阿冉，冬堡學院的首席法師。

original: I am quite content to see nearly any aspect of magic explored and investigated here.
string: 魔法的所有面向幾乎都在這裡獲得施展和研究，我對此相當滿意。

original: But I do not and will not approve of any research or experiments that cause purposeful harm to your fellow members of the College.
string: 但無論是現在或者將來，會對你的同儕構成故意傷害的任何試驗和研究我都不會贊成。如有違反，絕不姑息。

original: Are we clear?
string: 清楚了嗎？

original: You are relatively new here, are you not? I have noticed you, but we have not spoken.
string: 相對而言，你還是個新人，不是嗎？我早就注意到你了，只是沒和你說過話而已。

original: You are new here, are you not? We have not spoken.
string: 你是新來的，不是嗎？我們還沒講過話呢。

original: I'm looking for work.
string: 我在找工作。

original: Still eager to please. This is good. Skjor may be right about you.
string: 依然急於討好呀，這是好事。關於你，搞不好斯科約爾還真沒說錯。

original: He has something special planned for you. Better talk to him.
string: 他為你有些特別的計劃，你最好找他談談。

original: Yes. I have something a little different planned this time.
string: 是的，我這次的計劃稍稍有些不同。

original: But it's not for everyone to hear. Meet me in the Underforge tonight.
string: 但不可以讓所有人都知道。今晚和我到地下熔爐碰頭。

original: We will speak more.
string: 我們再詳細討論。

original: You wanted to see me?
string: 你想見我？

original: Yes, I have something special for you.
string: 是的，我準備了點特別的東西給你。

original: But it's not for everyone to hear. Meet me in the Underforge tonight.
string: 但這件事不適合讓所有人都聽見。今晚和我到地下熔爐碰頭。

original: We will speak more.
string: 我們再詳細討論。

original: Skjor was looking for you before. Talk to him before doing anything else.
string: 斯科約爾之前正在找你。先去找他談談，再做其他的事。

original: Sorry, Miss Temba.
string: 抱歉，譚巴小姐。

original: Sigh. Everyone isn't as short as you are... what good are these boards to someone of the proper height!?
string: 唉，不是所有人都跟你一樣矮……這些木板對正常身高的人來說，有什麼作用呢！？

original: I'm so sorry Miss Temba. Perhaps if you would have been more specific...
string: 真的很抱歉，譚巴小姐。或許您可以更明確一點……

original: Gwilin! I told you to cut those boards at twice arm length! My arm's length. Not yours.
string: 格維林！我叫你把那些木板裁成手臂的兩倍長！是我手臂的兩倍長，不是你的。

original: When I want your opinion, I'll ask for it. Otherwise, mind your business.
string: 當我需要你給意見的時候，我就會問你。否則，管好你自己，別多管閒事。

original: I hardly think the bears are clever enough to hold a grudge against you, Miss Temba.
string: 我不認為那些熊有那麼聰明到會記恨哪，譚巴小姐。

original: Another batch of logs completely ruined. I swear, these bears have it out for me.
string: 另一批圓木全毀了。我發誓，一定要跟這些熊一較高下。

original: "Our" business?
string: 「我們」的生意？

original: As I remember things, it was you that showed up at my doorstep looking for a job and a place to live. Try and remember that.
string: 我記得當初是你找上我，想找工作和住處。你最好記清楚。

original: Look, I'm merely suggesting a few things that could expand our business.
string: 我只是為了拓展業務，提出一些小小的建議而已。

original: I'm becoming sick to death of your ideas. Not one of them has paid off since you moved in.
string: 我快受不了你那些鬼點子了。從你進來以後，就沒人給過錢。

original: If you have a moment, I've come up with a few ideas I wanted to share.
string: 要是你有時間，我有些想法希望和你分享一下。

original: That's none of your business and I appreciate if you wouldn't mention it again.
string: 那不關你的事，我拜託你別再提了好不好。

original: Come on, everyone in town knows that you spend more time with Fastred than fishing in the river.
string: 算了吧，城裡所有人都知道，你跟法斯萊德鬼混的時間，遠超過你去河邊釣魚。

original: Blood from a stone, Klimmek. I've been out there every morning. They just aren't biting.
string: 你這是雞蛋裡挑骨頭，科林麥。每天早上我都會外出釣魚，只是那些魚不肯上鉤。

original: We're behind again. I need you to catch another two bushels by week's end if I'm to make another delivery.
string: 我們又落後了。如果我要再多運一趟的話，你週末前就要幫我多拿兩份過來。

original: Yes, mother.
string: 是的，母親。

original: I know your sights are set beyond this town, but for now, while you're under our roof, I need you to pitch in a little more.
string: 我知道你看不上這個小鎮，但現在你是寄人籬下，就麻煩你再努力勤快一點。

original: I help, I do the chores. What else would you have me do?
string: 我有幫忙呀，我有做家務。妳還要我多做什麼？

original: I need you to pitch in a little more around here, dear.
string: 我要你再勤快一些，親愛的。

original: And if she decides to leave Ivarstead, what then? No, no... I can't bear the thought.
string: 要是她決定離開紫杉鎮，那怎麼辦？不，不……我想都不敢想。

original: You're hardly throwing her to the wolves. She just wants to see the world... just like I did when I was her age.
string: 你並不是把她丟出去餵狼啊。她只是想去看看外面的世界而已……想當年我不也一樣。

original: She's our only child, Boti. Am I to throw her to the wolves?
string: 她是咱們唯一的孩子啊，伯蒂。我怎麼可以把她丟給狼群？

original: You have to let Fastred follow her heart. You can't tell her what to do.
string: 你得讓法斯萊德自己決定。你不能事事插手。

original: I know what you said, but I only wanted to speak to him for a moment.
string: 我知道你想說什麼，但我只是想跟他說些話而已。

original: Wilhelm said he saw you speaking to one of the pilgrims on the 7,000 Steps. I told you that I didn't want you to go up there.
string: 威爾海姆說他看到你在七千台階上跟一個朝聖者說話。我說過叫你不要上去那裡。

original: What is it now?
string: 又怎麼了？

original: Fastred, I wanted to talk with you.
string: 法斯萊德，我想跟妳談談。

original: There's much more to worry about in life then a bit of a temper, my friend.
string: 生命中還有很多很多值得在意的東西呢，別那麼意氣用事，朋友。

original: Perhaps, but abuse is abuse. I don't think I could stand it.
string: 或許吧，但侮辱就是侮辱。我真的很難接受。

original: If you'll pardon the expression, she's far more bark than bite.
string: 不如你當沒聽到吧，她也就是說說而已。

original: I heard Temba yelling at you yesterday. Why do you let her treat you like that?
string: 我昨天聽到譚巴對你大喊大叫的，為什麼你讓她這樣吼你？

original: You're sweet. I'm just not ready for that sort of thing right now. I'm sorry.
string: 你真可愛。只是我現在還沒準備好。很抱歉。

original: Perhaps when you're finished here this evening, we could...
string: 或許晚上等妳事情都做完了，我們可以……

original: Thank you Klimmek. That's too kind.
string: 謝謝你，科林麥。你真好。

original: I thought you played wonderfully last night.
string: 我覺得你昨晚的表現很不錯。

original: I know, but I don't want to let them down. I guess I better start thinking about it soon.
string: 我知道，我不想讓他們失望。我想我該開始好好考慮了。

original: Take your time then. It isn't as though the Greybeards are going to complain.
string: 慢慢來。說得好像灰鬍子都要抱怨了似的。

original: I wish I didn't have to. It's quite a difficult climb.
string: 要是可以不去就好了。那真的很難爬呀。

original: You heading up to High Hrothgar soon, Klimmek?
string: 你準備去攀登高吼峰嗎，科林麥？

original: Perhaps one day, but not today.
string: 也許哪天吧，但時候未到。

original: Klimmek is doing just fine. You should follow your heart.
string: 科林麥幹得不錯。其實你很清楚。

original: No. I'll tell you, Wilhelm, if I could sweep her away from here tomorrow I'd do it, but Klimmek still has so much to learn.
string: 不，你聽好了，威爾海姆。要是我明天能把她掃地出門，我一定動手，但科林麥西還有好多要學。

original: Have you spoken to Fastred yet?
string: 你跟法斯萊德說了嗎？

original: See that you don't. I promised to keep you safe and I'm not going to break my word.
string: 看來還沒。我答應過要保護你的安全，我就一定會信守諾言。

original: I'm sorry. I was curious... I didn't believe the stories. I won't go over there ever again.
string: 對不起，我只是好奇……我根本不相信那些故事。我不會再去那裡了。

original: That thing's evil, Lynly! I told you to keep away from there!
string: 它很邪惡啊，林立！我跟妳說過不要靠近那裡！

original: I think I saw it again. That... ghost. It was over by the barrows.
string: 我想我又看到它了。那隻……鬼魂。它彌漫了整個古墳。

original: All right, Wilhlem. I suppose it's the least I can do for you.
string: 好吧，威爾海姆。我想我能為你做的，只有這些了。

original: I think you play beautifully. It would be a shame if you stopped.
string: 我認為你的表現太棒了。要是你不繼續，實在太可惜了。

original: What's the point? I'm not very good, and it's only for the same few people every night.
string: 何必呢？我沒那麼好，而且每晚總是小貓兩三隻。

original: I think you should continue with your performances.
string: 我認為你這麼厲害，應該繼續的。

original: Anything you can tell me about High Hrothgar?
string: 你能告訴我一些關於高吼峰的事嗎？

original: The Greybeards are a solitary lot. I don't think they've ever ventured outside their monastery.
string: 灰鬍子都是些喜歡獨處的人，我想說不定他們根本沒踏出過修道院的門。

original: We get the occasional pilgrim passing through here on their way to the summit, but almost all of them have returned disappointed.
string: 我們偶然才會遇到行經這裡、往山峰而去的朝聖者，但幾乎所有人都是失望而回。

original: I've been to the monastery many times, but I've never even laid eyes on one of the Greybeards. Not that I'd care to.
string: 我去過修道院很多次，但從來沒見過那些灰鬍子一眼。我也不在乎就是了。

original: Being masters of the Thu'um, they could kill you by uttering a single word.
string: 他們都精通吐姆之術，嘴裡吐出一個字就能殺了你。

original: Well, not that they would. They seem peaceful, but I wouldn't want to provoke them.
string: 不過，他們才不會這樣。他們看起來都很愛好和平，不過我也不會沒事去招惹他們。

original: Klimmek brings food supplies up to them once every few weeks when the weather permits it.
string: 每隔幾星期，科林麥都會找個天氣好的日子，把食物補給送上去。

original: Other than that, they seem like a quiet lot. Don't really know too much about them.
string: 除此之外，他們似乎就是安靜的一群人，我對他們也不太了解。

original: It's frightening living below their monastery.
string: 住在他們修道院的下面也夠嚇人的了。

original: Sometimes I swear I can hear strange noises rolling down from up there. It sounds like thunder, but there's never any rain.
string: 真的，有時我能聽到奇怪的聲響從上面傳來，像打雷一樣，但卻從來沒有下過雨。

original: What do you make of that?
string: 是你的話會怎麼辦？

original: The Greybeards stay away from me, and I stay away from them. Suits me just fine.
string: 井水不犯河水，互相保持距離。我就是這麼做的。

original: Always thought it was odd that there's a layer of thick clouds covering the peak of the mountain above the monastery.
string: 我覺得很奇怪，怎麼經常有濃密的雲層籠罩在這修道院的山巔之上。

original: Not sure what's up there, but I bet the Greybeards know.
string: 不知道那是怎麼回事，不過我想那些灰鬍子肯定知道。

original: They call the path to the monastery the 7,000 Steps. Can you imagine?
string: 他們把通往修道院的小路叫做七千台階。你能想像嗎？

original: I'm not certain if I could even make it to the top without collapsing from exhaustion.
string: 我覺得在走到山頂之前，我說不定已經先筋疲力盡，倒地不起啦。

original: The Greybeards are a strange bunch.
string: 那些灰鬍子真是群奇怪的傢伙。

original: I heard they live their entire life without uttering a single word; can you even imagine?
string: 我聽說他們可以一輩子什麼字都不說。你能想像嗎？

original: I've always fancied a journey up the 7,000 Steps to the monastery.
string: 我經常幻想有一天可以爬上七千台階去到修道院。

original: Anything to break the boredom of living in this town. I envy you.
string: 這樣就不用在這沉悶的小鎮裡活受罪了，真羨慕你。

original: Welcome to the Bards College. I am the headmaster here. How may I help you?
string: 歡迎來到吟遊詩人學院，我是校長。有什麼可以為你效勞呢？

original: I have faith that you'll return with King Olaf's Verse.
string: 我堅信你會帶著奧拉夫王之詩回來。

original: Ah, you have returned. How goes the task I gave you?
string: 啊，你回來了。我交給你的任務進行得怎麼樣？

original: I still don't know if rewriting the verse is going to work.
string: 我還是不確定重寫這詩句有沒有用。

original: I do hope the court likes the verse. I think we've done an excellent job of recreating it.
string: 真希望宮裡會喜歡這首詩。我認為我們加工詮釋得非常漂亮。

original: We should have the festival soon.
string: 節慶應該快到了。

original: Good to meet a prospective Bard.
string: 很高興能認識一個未來的吟遊詩人。

original: Get the coat. Then we'll talk.
string: 先去拿大衣再談。

original: Nice to meet the person who went to King Olaf's Tomb.
string: 很高興見到去過奧拉夫王之墓的人。

original: That sounds acceptable.
string: 聽起來還可以。

original: Then I think we're done talking.
string: 那我們就談到這裡吧。

original: You don't own the horse you already sold to Letrush?
string: 你賣給萊特魯什的馬不是你自己的？

original: That is correct. You see, Frost belongs to the Black-Briar estate. Technically everything in the estate is owned by my mother, Maven.
string: 是的，沒錯。這麼說吧，寒霜是黑棘莊園的財產，而理論上莊園裡的所有東西，都屬於我母親瑪雯。

original: My plan was to take the horse from our lodge and deliver it to Letrush at the stables. Obviously, that didn't exactly work out as I'd planned...
string: 我的計劃是從把馬從我們的門房帶到馬廄，交給萊特魯什。但很顯然，計劃趕不上變化……

original: Still, I don't want to cross Letrush. Tell you what. Steal the horse and deliver it, and you can have the second half of the payment.
string: 不過，我還是不想得罪萊特魯什。這樣吧，要是你去把馬偷來，送去給他，我可以分給你一半報酬。

original: I was sent by Louis Letrush.
string: 是路易士．萊特魯什派我來的。

original: Ah, and let me guess. He wants his horse. Well, that's going to be a bit of a problem. You see, I don't really outright "own" Frost...
string: 啊，我猜猜……他想要他的馬。呃，不過現在有個小問題，就是呢，寒霜不完全算是「我的」……

original: Why is Sibbi in jail?
string: 為什麼西比會被關進監獄？

original: No idea, but whatever he did it must have angered Maven. No guard would lock up a Black-Briar without the old lady's permission.
string: 不清楚，不過他肯定做了什麼惹怒瑪雯的事。沒有那位老太太的批准，衛兵是不會隨便把黑棘的人關起來的。

original: Silence, prisoner!
string: 閉嘴，你這個犯人！

original: Gaaaaah!!!
What else do you want from me? I've already told you everything. Listen, if you let me go I can take you to Riften, show you where-
string: 你還想知道什麼？我已經全跟你說了。聽著，如果你放了我，我可以帶你去裂谷城，告訴你哪裡——

original: That will be all for now. I must say I continue to be disappointed in your lack of cooperation. I hope next time you will do better.
string: 暫時到此為止。我得說，你這麼不合作，實在讓我很不滿意，希望下次你會學乖。

original: Like I said, I don't know! I've seen him down in the Ratway. Maybe he lives down there, but I don't know for sure.
string: 我說了，我不知道！我在鼠道看過他。或許他住在那裡面吧，但我不敢確定。

original: And where can we find this nameless old man?
string: 還有，去哪兒可以找到這沒名字的老傢伙？

original: You know the rules. Just answer the questions.
string: 你知道規矩，快點回答問題。

original: Ahhhh!
string: 啊！

original: I don't know his name. Like I've told already a hundred-
string: 我不知道他的名字。我都已經說了一百——

original: And his name is...?
string: 所以，他的名字叫……？

original: There's an old man. He lives in Riften.
string: 好像有個老傢伙，他住在裂谷城。

original: He could be this Esbern you're looking for, but I don't know. He's old and seemed kind of crazy. That's all I know.
string: 他可能就是你要找的這個伊思本，不過我不確定。他很老了，而且有點瘋瘋癲癲的。我只知道這些。

original: No, wait! I was just... catching my breath... why wouldn't I tell you again? I don't even know anything...
string: 不要，等一下！我剛才只是……喘不過氣而已……我不是說過很多次了嗎？我真的什麼都不知道……

original: If you persist in this stubbornness I'll have...
string: 如果你堅持要那麼嘴硬，我就讓……

original: Start at the beginning, as usual.
string: 從頭再來，老樣子。

original: Noooooo!!!
You know the rules.
string: 你知道規矩的。

original: No... for pity's sake... I've already told you everything...
string: 不……請可憐一下我吧……我已經全都告訴你了……

original: Let's begin again.
string: 我們重新開始。

original: Silence. You know the rules. Do not speak unless spoken to. Master Rulindil will ask the questions.
string: 閉嘴，你知道規矩的。沒問你問題，就不要出聲。魯林迪爾大師會親自發問。

original: Stop. Please. I don't know anything else. Don't you think I'd have told you already?
string: 拜託，停手吧。其他的我都不知道。要是我知道，哪會不說呢？

original: I promise. Just a joke I want to play on someone. (Persuade)
string: 我保證。我只是想找個人開開玩笑而已。（說服）

original: Hmm. Very well. I'm putting my reputation on the line for you.
string: 嗯，好吧，我就冒著聲名俱裂的風險，信你一次。

original: This is neither the time nor place for such things. I'm surprised you would ask it of me.
string: 此時此地都不適合，我很驚訝你居然找我說這些。

original: Never mind.
string: 不要緊。

original: Don't presume upon our friendship. My first loyalty is to the Thalmor, as you well know.
string: 別指望我們的友誼能幫你什麼？你也很清楚，我首先要忠於梭默。

original: Yes, that's probably for the best. I really shouldn't risk getting on Elenwen's bad side.
string: 是的，那樣應該是最好的做法了。我真的不該冒險讓愛琳溫討厭。

original: Yes, this probably isn't really the place for your little jokes.
string: 是的，這裡大概也不太適合你那些小把戲。

original: Thank you. I knew you'd understand.
string: 謝謝，我就知道你能諒解。

original: I'll try to forget you ever asked.
string: 我會當你沒有問過。

original: What brings you to this party?
string: 什麼風把你吹來的？

original: There are those in the Empire who would wish to evade their obligations to help root out the Talos heresy.
string: 帝國人都有義務，協助剷除塔洛斯異端，然而有些人卻希望能夠規避這樣的義務。

original: Fortunately, those most opposed to the Emperor's wise policy have now branded themselves traitors as well as heretics.
string: 幸運的是，那些最反對皇帝英明政策的人，都已經被烙上背叛者和異端的罪名。

original: I am here to remind the ruling classes of Skyrim that their loyalty to the Emperor requires cooperation with the Thalmor.
string: 我來這裡，是要提醒天際省的統治階級，要忠於皇帝，就要跟梭默合作。

original: You have asked for my help. I am providing it.
string: 你之前要我幫忙，我現在就在幫你。

original: The degeneracy of the Empire is on display here in this room.
string: 帝國的衰敗在這個房間，顯而易見。

original: It's only a matter of time before your whole rotten Empire collapses of its own decay. No offense.
string: 整個帝國早已腐朽不堪，它的敗亡只是時間的問題。直話直說，您別見怪。

original: None of these people cares a whit about the religious aspects of this war. Another sign of the degeneracy of your Empire.
string: 這裡沒人關心整場戰爭的宗教意義。這是您的帝國衰落的另一個徵兆。

original: At least Ulfric's men are willing to fight for their principles, barbaric as they may be.
string: 就算野蠻，至少烏弗瑞克的人依然挺身為他們的信念而戰，

original: It's a necessary part of my job to mix with the upper classes of Skyrim, such as they are.
string: 我必須在天際省的上層階級之間周旋，這是必要的工作，而他們也一樣。

original: What brings you to this party?
string: 你為什麼來到這個聚會？

original: To maintain relationships.
string: 來維繫關係。

original: By the way, I don't know who you are, but unless you want me to blow your cover, I'd advise that you avoid me for the rest of the party.
string: 順帶一提，我不知道你是誰，但除非你想要我揭穿你，否則請你在之後的宴會中別來打擾我。

original: I'm doing as you asked. Not for nothing, I hope?
string: 如您所願，不過，會有點好處吧？

original: I don't recall seeing you at one of these before. And I know everyone who's anyone in Skyrim.
string: 我沒見過你，而天際省所有的大人物我也認識。

original: That's General Tullius himself. He can't stand Elenwen, but she insists that he attend these parties. Just to piss him off, no doubt.
string: 那位是圖留斯將軍本人。他跟愛琳溫不對盤，但愛琳溫卻堅持要他參加宴會。想必是故意戲弄他吧。

original: See that disgusting drunk over there? A high-ranking official in the East Empire Company, believe it or not.
string: 看到那邊那個討厭的醉鬼了嗎？那是一個東帝國貿易公司的高階長官，信不信由你。

original: But... I rather thought that if I were to help, I might... Well, I might be allowed to return to the College.
string: 但是……我反而在想，要是我聽你說的幫了你，也許我……呃…也許我會再被批准回到學院呢。

original: I can handle this on my own.
string: 我自己能處理好。

original: Are you quite sure? I don't want to get in the way, but...
string: 你真的確定嗎？我不想扯你後腿，但……

original: I thought you wanted to get out of there.
string: 我以為你想要離開那裡。

original: Well yes, I did. And thank you so much for helping me.
string: 噢，我是啊。真謝謝你幫我的忙。

original: But... I rather thought that if I were to help, I might... Well, I might be allowed to return to the College.
string: 但是……我反而在想，要是我聽你說的幫了你，也許我……呃…也許我會再被批准回到學院呢。

original: I'm not sure where else I'd go.
string: 我不知道我還能去哪。

original: All right, you're safe now.
string: 好吧，現在你安全了。

original: Wait, what?
string: 等等，怎麼了？

original: I thought I was going to help you!
string: 我還以為我是去幫你！

original: We need to go upstairs, that's where she is! That's where the books are!
string: 我們得上樓去，她就在那裡！那些書也在那裡！

original: No, no! This is the wrong way!
string: 不，不！不是這條路！

original: Can you make me Blood-Kin?
string: 你能讓我成為血親嗎？

original: Trust like that is not freely given.
string: 那種信賴沒有廉價到可以免費提供。

original: Gladly. By the Code of Malacath, I name you Blood-Brother to the Orcs.
string: 歡呼吧。以瑪拉凱斯法典的名義，我任命你為獸人的血親兄弟。

original: Gladly. By the Code of Malacath, I name you Blood-Sister to the Orcs.
string: 歡呼吧。以瑪拉凱斯法典的名義，我任命你為獸人的血親姐妹。

original: Are all the Orc strongholds guarded?
string: 是不是所有的獸人城寨都有重兵看守？

original: The most well known stronghold is Dushnikh Yal. Here, I'll mark it down for you.
string: 那座最出名的城寨叫做杜什尼克．亞爾。來，我幫你標記一下。

original: Where can I find an Orc stronghold?
string: 哪裡可以找到獸人的城寨？

original: The strongholds keep to themselves. Skyrim hasn't always been kind to the Orcs.
string: 城寨的位置只有他們知道，因為天際省的人對獸人並不太友善。

original: For an outsider like you to be accepted, an Orc would have to make you Blood-Kin, and send word to the chiefs.

original: Hjalti? Who are you talking about?
string: 希雅提？你在說誰啊？

original: You promised me, Hjalti. You promised that when we sacked Hroldan, you would make me your sworn brother.
string: 你答應過我，希雅提。你答應過在洗劫赫洛登之後，咱們就結拜為兄弟。

original: Give me your sword, Hjalti. That we may become brothers as you promised.
string: 給我你的劍，希雅提。這樣我們也許就能像你允諾的成為兄弟了。

original: Hmph.
string: 哼。

original: As I was saying... You'll need to kill the Gourmet, of course. But what's more, you'll need to get his Writ of Passage, so you can take his place.
string: 就像我之前說的……你得除掉美食家，非這樣不可。但是更重要的，你必須拿到他的通行證，這樣你就能接替他的位置了。

original: Oh, and if you can, hide his body. The longer it takes for anyone else to determine his real identity, the better.
string: 哦，當然如果可以的話，把他的屍體藏好。別人越晚發現他被調包，對咱們就越有利。

original: Now off with you!
string: 現在馬上動身吧！

original: Who are you? What do you want?
string: 你是誰？你想做什麼？

original: Hmph. I was wrong about you. I see that now. Maybe we all were.
string: 嗯，我誤解你了，現在我知道了。也許咱們都犯了同樣的錯誤。

original: Here's your payment. And... a little something else, as well. From me. Consider it my way of apologizing. For being so damned curmudgeonly!
string: 這是你的報酬，還有……一些其他的東西，是我一點心意。就當作是我對你的歉意吧，很抱歉之前咱們鬧得不愉快。

original: It's called the Nightweaver's Band. I wore this for years. I want you to have it now. It'll give your magic and sneakiness some much needed "oomph."
string: 這個叫做織夜者指環，我戴好多年了，現在我想把它送給你。它會使你的魔法和潛行變得更加「性感」。

original: Now, you'd better get a move on and see Astrid. It's time! Time for the final stage of this grand and glorious operation.
string: 現在，你該去見阿斯垂德了。是時候了！是時候進入這場壯麗偉業的關鍵階段了。

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

original: Oh, I'm waiting with bated breath...
string: 哦，我屏息靜待……

original: Oh course, Festus. Please continue.
string: 當然，法斯圖斯，請繼續。

original: I believe so. Therefore, you are to obtain that information from Virane - who the Gourmet really is, and where he can be found.
string: 我相信是這樣。所以，你需要從維拉尼那裡獲得情報——誰才是那個真正的美食家，以及他身在何處。

original: Oh, and when you're done with Virane, kill him.
string: 哦，別忘了資訊到手後，做掉維拉尼。

original: Loose ends and all that.
string: 該做的瑣事大概就這樣吧。

original: Next, you'll have to... Are you still paying attention?
string: 之後，你需要……我說你還在認真聽嗎？

original: And this Anton Virane knows the Gourmet's true identity?
string: 這個安東．維拉尼知道美食家真實的身份？

original: You know, maybe I was wrong about you after all. Anyone who's smart enough to shut up and listen can't be all bad.
string: 你知道嗎，或許我之前看錯你了。聰明到懂得不開口的人，通常都不會太差勁。

original: In my, um, investigations, I came upon this. It's a copy of the Gourmet's cookbook. Ah, but not just any copy. It's signed you see!

original: Seems to be a message from the Gourmet to one Anton Virane. I've tracked Virane to the keep in Markarth. It would seem he's the cook.

string: 你連美食家是誰都不知道？好極了。

string: 但是首先你需要知道他是誰。當然啦，前提是假設美食家是一位「他」。就我們目前僅知，也可能是個女人。

string: 我需要殺了他，然後假冒他嗎？

string: 你來啦。跟西塞羅度過了一段甜蜜時光，嗯？現在來說正事吧。阿斯垂德跟你說過美食家的事了，沒錯吧？

original: I need you to take a case of mead to the Frozen Hearth in Winterhold. The delivery fee is yours to keep.
string: 我要你帶一箱蜜酒到冬堡的凍爐客棧去。我會付你跑腿費。

string: 燭爐堂客棧快要沒有咱們這種名貴蜜酒了。你能把這箱送去給他們嗎？像往常一樣，給你跑腿費。

original: I have a case of Frost River Mead for you.
string: 我有一箱寒霜河蜜酒，是給你的。

original: Ah, good. I've been waiting on that.
string: 啊，很好，我一直在等這個哪。

string: 這是你的錢，謝啦。

original: Ah, good. I've been waiting on that.

original: I can certainly help.
string: 當然，我可以幫忙。

original: That'd be great. There's a case of our soon-to-be famous mead that needs to get to Winterhold. Get it there, and you can keep the delivery fee.
string: 那就太好了。那裡有一箱我們出名在望的蜜酒，需要送到冬堡去。把它送去，我會付你跑腿費。

original: How's the meadery working out?
string: 酒裝的生意怎麼樣？

original: It's tough, with just the two of us.
string: 很艱苦，就我們兩個忙進忙出。

original: There's hardly ever time to make the occasional delivery to the taverns of Skyrim.
string: 這裡很少有機會把貨送到天際省的酒館去。

original: We could use a pair of hands and a strong back. There'd be a little coin in it for you.
string: 勤奮的雙手和堅實的脊背，是我們需要的。或許只有一點點錢，可以支付你。

original: Indeed I do.
string: 我確實是。

original: Need me to deliver any more mead?
string: 需要我送更多的蜜酒嗎？

original: I've brought the fragment.
string: 我帶了碎片過來。

original: I'll speak with Aela about how you handled yourself. Come back later.
string: 我會和艾拉說說你是怎麼做的。待會再來吧。

string: 我會和法卡斯說說你是怎麼做的。待會再來吧。

original: The Festival is back on.
string: 節慶又恢復了。

original: Great. Looks like you'll be one of us soon.  We'll gather outside the College for the Burning of King Olaf.
string: 太棒了。看來你很快就能成為我們的一員了。我們會在學院外面集合，慶祝火燒奧拉夫節。

original: I'll tell everyone we're ready but we'll start the festival at dusk.

original: Come talk to me after dark, we'll get the festival started when you do.
string: 天黑後來找我，我們談完後再開始慶祝。

original: Best batch of Spiced Wine I ever had.
string: 這是我喝過最棒的一批香料酒。

original: I thought the festival wasn't happening this year.
string: 我以為今年不會過這個節了耶。

original: Thanks for convincing Elisif to put this on again.
string: 感謝你說服艾利西弗重新恢復這個節日。

original: Come on! Light the fire!
string: 快點！點火啊！

original: Jorn is the best of the bunch, you should hear him sing.
string: 喬恩是所有人中最厲害的，你應該聽聽他的歌喉。

original: I heard you're the reason we get to have this.  Thank you.
string: 我聽說是因為你，我們才能享受到這一切。謝謝你。

original: I believe Sanguine would be pleased with this festival.
string: 我相信桑吉恩會很喜歡節慶活動的。

original: I like the pretty lights.
string: 我喜歡那些漂亮的火光。

original: Burn the king!
string: 燒掉國王！

original: You've done well by restoring our Festival.
string: 你恢復了我們的節日，做得好。

original: Thank you so much. The festival has really increased my sales.
string: 非常感謝你。慶典真的讓我的生意變好了。

original: There's the man himself!
string: 那是他本人！

original: There's the woman herself!
string: 那是她本人！

original: Burn the King!
string: 燒掉國王！

original: Congratulations on getting the festival restored.
string: 慶賀節日得以恢復。

original: Get your festival meat pie. Specially made.
string: 拿一個節日肉派吧，特製的呢。

original: Try our meats made here at the Festival. They're the best.
string: 試試我們的節日肉品。它們是最美味的。

original: So nice to get this break from my cleaning duties.
string: 能從清潔工作中脫身真好。

original: You might as well have some sweets. I made them for the festival after all.
string: 也來一些糖果吧。畢竟可是我為節日特別做的。

original: I wish you luck in finding the verse.
string: 祝你能順利寫出動人的詩歌。

original: We should really get to court.
string: 我們真的應該動身前往宮裡去了。

original: We should present the verse soon.
string: 我們應該馬上呈上那份詩文。

original: Don't forget to speak to Jorn when you're ready for the festival.
string: 等你準備好慶祝節日，別忘了去找喬恩。

string: 小心，在亡者之棲找到的，可能不只有奧拉夫王之詩啊。

original: Good luck. You're on your own now.
string: 祝你好運。現在你得靠自己了。

original: Never mind, I'm dead already-
string: 無所謂，反正我橫豎都是死人了-

string: 聽著，密探！你被困在這裡了，我們抓到你的同謀了。

string: 所以……話說完了？

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

original: No. Oh, please no...
string: 不。哦，請別……

original: I'm afraid not. Loose ends, and all that.
string: 恐怕不會，我需要把瑣碎的事情一起解決。

original: Okay. All right. Wonderful. You're welcome! I'll just be on my way, then...
string: 好吧，太棒了。別客氣！我這就離開，然後……

original: Of course, Anton. Thank you. (Lie)
string: 當然，安東。謝謝你。（撒謊）

original: The Dark Brotherhood?
string: 黑暗兄弟會？

original: Now... now wait a minute. Let's not get hasty. I mean, surely my friend wouldn't want me to endanger my own life. Right?
string: 現在……先等一下，稍安勿躁。我是說，我的朋友肯定不會讓我陷入危險的，對吧？

original: Look, his name is Balagog gro-Nolob. He's an Orc! The Gourmet's an Orc! He's staying at the Nightgate Inn. That's all I know!
string: 聽著，他的名字叫巴拉葛戈．格洛-諾洛波。是個獸人！那個美食家是獸人！他待在夜扉客棧。我只知道這些！

original: Now... now you'll let me go. Right?
string: 現在……你會讓我走的，對嗎？

original: For the Dark Brotherhood, that can be easily arranged. (Intimidate)
string: 對黑暗兄弟會來說，把你處理掉可是小事一樁。（威嚇）

original: The... the Gourmet?
string: 那個……那個美食家？

original: Never! I don't know what led you here, but nothing will betray my trust. I'll take the secret of the Gourmet's identity to my grave.
string: 休想！我不知道你是怎麼找到這裡的，但無論發生什麼事我都不會出賣自己的信譽。美食家的身份，到死我都會守口如瓶。

string: 那個美食家。他是誰？他在哪裡？

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

string: 啊，沒錯，高岩省，布萊頓人精緻菜肴的故鄉……

string: 我知道你是誰，安東，也知道你來自哪裡。

string: 求求你，求你放過我吧……

original: Mara have mercy that gave me a fright.
string: 承蒙瑪拉憐憫，嚇了我一大跳。

original: Do you think the ghost is one of... Tiber Septim's dead men?
string: 你覺得那個幽靈是……泰伯．塞普汀哪個死掉的手下嗎？

original: All of a sudden, the ghost disappeared. What happened to it?
string: 那個幽靈突然消失了，怎麼回事？

original: Do you think that ghost is coming back? It seems to have vanished.
string: 你覺得那個幽靈會回來嗎？它好像已經消失了。

original: I was just getting used to that ghost being here, and poof, now he's gone.
string: 我好不容易才適應有個幽靈在這裡的事實，結果它突然又不見了。

original: Hjalti? Is that you? I've been waiting.
string: 是你嗎，希雅提？我一直在等你。

original: I've been waiting for you. Hjalti.
string: 我等你好一陣子了，希雅提。

string: 我曾經與你並肩作戰，從蠻族手中奪回邊塞。

string: 想起我是誰了嗎，希雅提？

original: I have Hjalti's sword.
string: 我拿到希雅提的劍了。

original: It's been an honor to serve you, brother.
string: 能為你服務令我倍感榮幸，兄弟。

original: Remembers our lessons from the sword masters of Alcaire? Let me show you a few things you may have forgotten before we leave Hroldan.
string: 還記得咱們從阿爾凱瑞的劍術大師那兒學來的東西嗎？在離開赫洛登之前，讓我露幾手你可能已經忘了的招式給你瞧瞧。

original: The ghost is looking for his sword.
string: 那個幽靈正在找他的劍。

original: A sword? I remember a legend that Tiber Septim had attacked one of the enemy camps before he came to Old Hroldan. It could be there.
string: 一把劍？我想起了一個故事，傳說泰伯．塞普汀在來到古赫洛登之前，曾攻打一處敵營。那把劍可能就在那裡。

original: I'll mark it down on your map.
string: 我把它標記在你的地圖上。

string: 那個幽靈提到了一個叫「希雅提」的人。

string: 我聽到尖叫聲。

original: You said you saw a ghost?
string: 妳說妳看見一個幽靈？

original: (screams)
string: （尖叫）

string: 聽著，我跟你簽約，你負責執行，成果差強人意。現在聽好，你令人難以忍受，我呢，就只是……我。

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

original: You would expect any less from the Listener?
string: 難道你對聆聽者不報期待？

original: You've got the Writ of Passage too, I see. Splendid, splendid...
string: 並且同時拿到了通行證。不錯，真不錯……
