string: 啊，來自馬卡斯城的消息宣稱，要塞的廚師突然暴斃了。

original: You performed your duties to the letter.
string: 你照實履行了約定的任務。

original: Dead.
string: 死了。

original: Right, which we had already established. And you managed to hide the body as well? Good.
string: 好，我們已經搞定他了。而且你也把他的屍體藏起來了？很好。

original: You've got the Writ of Passage too, I see. So there's that. And Anton Virane has suffered an untimely fate, as well. Good.
string: 同時還拿到了通行證，嗯，很好，而且安東．維拉尼也身亡了。不錯。

original: Well, looks like you completed the contract as directed. Finally. A little sloppy, but, well... done is done.
string: 嗯，看來你最後確實有按照指示完成了任務，儘管有點馬虎，但……畢竟還是完成了。

original: Here's your gold, with a little extra for hiding the body. Now go see Astrid. The final stage of the contract has come. The Emperor must fall.
string: 這是你的賞金，你藏好屍體，所以有加賞。現在去見阿斯垂德吧。契約的最後部分需要你去完成，我們一定要取下皇帝。

original: Dead.
string: 死了。

original: Good. And his Writ of Passage?
string: 很好。他的通行證呢？

original: Oh wait, let me guess - you don't have them.
string: 哦，等等，讓我猜猜——你沒拿到。

original: Fool! Amateur! Without those papers you'll never be able to present yourself as the Gourmet! Off with you! Back to the body to retrieve them!
string: 蠢貨！真不專業！沒有那些文件你永遠都沒法化身美食家！快滾！回屍體那裡把通行證拿回來！

original: Dead.
string: 死了。

original: Good, good. And you've got the Writ of Passage too, I see, so that's done.
string: 不錯，不錯。而且你也拿到了通行證，任務完成了。

original: But why? Why, pray tell, have I received word that Anton Virane is still walking around Markarth, hale and healthy as the day he was born?
string: 但為什麼？你告訴我，為什麼我聽說安東．維拉尼依然活蹦亂跳地在馬卡斯城四處活動？而且精神抖擻、健健康康地像剛出生似地！

original: Back to Markarth with you! Virane must be silenced! He's a potential witness, you witless dagger jabber!
string: 快給我趕回馬卡斯城！必須讓維拉尼閉嘴！他是可能的目擊者，你這沒腦的傢伙！

original: Dead.
string: 死了。

original: Good, good. And you've got the Writ of Passage, too, I see. So there's that.
string: 很好，很好。而且你也拿到了通行證，嗯，做得好。

original: I've also received word from Markarth. It would seem Anton Virane has suffered an untimely fate, as well. Good.
string: 馬卡斯城也有消息傳來，安東．維拉尼似乎已經身亡了。不錯。

original: But unfortunately, that inn is abuzz with the news of somebody killing one of their guests! What, hiding the body was too much for you to handle?
string: 但不幸的是，那家客棧現在流言四起，說有人殺了他們一個房客！藏個屍體對你來講，有那麼難嗎？

original: Bah! Useless. Here's your gold. Now go see Astrid. The time to move against the Emperor has finally come. Sithis help us all.
string: 呸！真沒用，這是你的賞錢。現在去阿斯垂德那裡吧。和皇帝的對抗已經進入最後階段。願西帝斯祝所有人一臂之力。

original: Dead.
string: 死了。

original: Remember, the Markarth Keep. That's where you'll find Anton Virane. Probably cooking up all of the Gourmet's recipes, passing them off as his own.
string: 記住，你可以在馬卡斯堡壘找到安東．維拉尼。他很可能正照著美食家的食譜在烹製食物，並當成自己發明的。

original: All you've got to do is find and kill one lousy chef. The clock is ticking...
string: 你只需要找到並除掉一個討人厭的廚師。時間可不等你啊……

original: So, the prodigal murderer returns. And the Gourmet?
string: 噢，流浪殺手回來了。那個美食家怎麼樣了？

original: Ah, you're back. Ready to try again, are we? Let's start from the top. You were sent to kill the Gourmet. And he is...
string: 啊，你回來了。準備好再做一次了嗎？讓咱們從頭再來。你被派去殺那個美食家。而他……

original: On second thought, I'll walk.
string: 我想，我還是用走的好。

original: Suit yourself.
string: 隨你便。

original: Don't blame me if your feet get sore.
string: 你要是走到腳痠，可別怪我啊。

original: Then stop wastin' my time.
string: 那就別再浪費我的時間。

original: Off with ya then. I've got work to do.
string: 你走吧。我還有事要做。

original: Didn't think you had the coin for it anyway.
string: 反正我也不覺得你會有錢做這個。

original: Then off with ya. I've got better things to do.
string: 你走吧。我還有更好的事情可以做。

original: Should have known you'd be a cheap one.
string: 還真不知道你還挺俗氣。

original: Then what are you wasting my time for?
string: 那你為何還在這裡浪費我的時間？

original: Walkin' never hurt nobody. If you change your mind, I'll be here.
string: 想用走的就走吧。要是你改變主意了，我都在這裡。

original: Oh. Was it something I said? I can't afford to lower the price, but come back if you change your mind.
string: 哦，是因為我說了什麼嗎？我沒法再降價了，但要是你改變了主意，就來這裡找我。

original: Here's my offer... (<Global=Horsecost> gold)
string: 這是我出的價……（<Global=Horsecost>金幣）

original: You've got a deal. It's the one with the saddle.
string: 成交。這匹馬已經配好馬鞍了。

original: Then come back when you've got that much.
string: 等你有這些錢了，再回來找我吧。

original: That'll do. She's all saddled up for you.
string: 成交。牠已經整裝待發了。

original: When you get it, she's yours.
string: 錢要是夠的話，牠就是你的了。

original: Sounds fair. She's yours. Like I said, she's all saddled.
string: 聽起來不錯。牠是你的了。正如我所說，牠已經整裝待發了。

original: When you got that much, we'll talk.
string: 你有足夠的錢以後，咱們再談。

original: Fair enough. You can have her. She's the one with the saddle.
string: 好吧。牠是你的了，鞍馬齊備的那一匹就是。

original: Didn't think you had the coin.
string: 你身上的錢不夠吧？

original: That's your best offer? I suppose so. She's the one with the saddle.
string: 你就給這麼多？好吧好吧，鞍馬齊備的那一匹就是。

original: If you had it, you'd be riding and we wouldn't be talking.
string: 你要是錢夠多，早就騎馬上路了，我們也不會在這裡多費唇舌。

original: That much? I mean, of course. If that's all you've got.
string: 就這樣？我是說，好吧，假如你就只有這些錢。

original: I'd sell her for that, but you ain't got it.
string: 我是要賣牠沒錯，但不會賣給你。

original: Sold. She's all yours. She's already saddled up.
string: 牠是你的了。好馬配好鞍。

original: That would work, except you ain't got.
string: 也可以，除非你沒帶夠錢。

original: Wish everyone haggled like you. She's all yours.
string: 真希望所有買家都像你這樣。牠是你的了。

original: Too bad you don't have that much. Guess you'll have to walk.
string: 可惜你的錢不夠，看來你只能用走的了。

original: Good enough for me. It's the one with the saddle.
string: 我對你的開價滿意。鞍馬齊備的那一匹就是。

original: That would be a fair price. When you've got it, come see me.
string: 我開價可是很公道合理的。你要是籌夠錢了，就來找我。

original: Wow! Didn't think I could get that for her. I mean, sure!
string: 哇哦！沒想到牠能賣出這個價。我是說，當然好！

original: Looks like you're a little short on coin though. Sorry.
string: 看起來你好像有點資金短缺啊。抱歉了。

original: Can I buy a horse?
string: 我能買匹馬嗎？

original: Suppose so. Got one all saddled if you've got the coin.
string: 可以。你要是錢夠多，就連鞍帶馬都賣給你。

original: Not today. Sold my last one. Pretty sure I sold it to you.
string: 今天不行。最後一匹賣掉了。記得是賣給你了。

original: Yeah, I got one for sale.
string: 行，有一匹能賣。

original: You could if I had one. Sold my last available horse to someone that looked an awful lot like you.
string: 要是我還有的話，當然沒問題。不過我已經把最後一匹馬賣了，是一個長得跟你非常非常像的人。

original: Got one all saddled and ready to go. What are you willing to pay?
string: 我這裡有一匹鞍馬齊備的好馬整裝待發。你開個價吧。

original: If I had one. Sold my last one to you a bit ago.
string: 我沒馬了。最後一匹馬不久前剛賣給你了。

original: Reckon you can. How much you willing to pay?
string: 可以吧。打算開個什麼價？

original: Nope. Sold my last one to some stranger.
string: 沒辦法囉。最後一匹馬已經賣了。

original: It's for sale, if you've got the coin.
string: 你要是有錢，牠就賣給你。

original: Not right now. You bought my last one.
string: 現在沒有馬，你買了最後一匹。

original: That one with the saddle? How much are you offering?
string: 那匹鞍馬齊備的？你打算給多少？

original: Can't help you. They're all spoken for.
string: 幫不了你。現在供不應求。

original: Don't mind if you do. What's your price?
string: 別介意。開個價吧。

original: If I had one you could. They're all spoken for.
string: 我要是還有就賣你，但現在供不應求。

original: I've got one all saddled up for you! What do you figure she's worth?
string: 我有一匹整鞍待發的馬！你準備出多少？

original: Wish I did, but some outlander bought my last one.
string: 我也希望能賣你，但是最後一匹被某個外鄉人買走了。

original: That's what I'm here for. What are you offering?
string: 這就是我來這裡的原因。你願意出多少？

original: Don't have any that are for sale right now.
string: 現在什麼都沒有。

original: Yes! Yes, you can. She's all saddled up and everything.
string: 當然！你當然可以。牠的裝備很齊全。

original: Not today. You should have come by earlier. Wait, didn't I sell me last one to you?
string: 今天不行。要是早點來就好了。等一下，我最後一匹馬不就賣給你了嗎？

original: I have your frost salts.
string: 我有你要的寒霜鹽。

original: Well, well, you actually did what you said you were going to do. I'm impressed.
string: 唉呀，你確實完成了允諾的事情。我很佩服。

original: Here, let me teach you a thing or two about Alteration magic. It's the least I can do.
string: 過來，讓我教你一些變換系法術的知識。這是我力所能及的。

original: Sorry to hear that.
string: 真遺憾。

original: It's not any of your bother, so I don't see what you're apologizing for.
string: 又不是你的兄弟，你有什麼好遺憾的。

original: I could find those frost salts for you.
string: 我能幫你找到那些寒霜鹽。

original: If you want to go to the trouble, feel free. I suppose I could offer you a bit of free Alteration training when you get back.
string: 要是你想淌渾水的話，隨你便。等你回來，我或許能免費替你做些變換系的訓練吧。

original: What do you do in Kynesgrove?
string: 你在凱娜之林做什麼？

original: Nosy one, huh? I was a mage back in Morrowind. I lend my talents to the mines here, helping them keep the tunnels safe.
string: 你挺愛管閒事的嘛，嗯？我是從晨風省來的法師，我把天賦用在附近的礦場，幫忙確保礦坑的安全。

original: By Azura, it gets hot in there. I use Frost Salts for a potion to keep the heat bearable, but I'm out.
string: 阿祖拉在上，這裡越來越熱了。我用寒霜鹽製作了一種藥水掌控溫度，但現在已經用完了。

original: Yes. I'm sure he's doing well there.
string: 是的。我確信他在那兒很好。

original: Last time you said he was fighting for the Empire.
string: 上次你說他正為帝國而戰。

original: He's off fighting the war, dear. For the Stormcloaks.
string: 他出去打仗了，為風暴斗篷而戰。

original: Mama, where did papa go?
string: 媽媽，爸爸去哪裡了？

original: I did. Those mead stains are always tricky.
string: 洗了。那些蜜酒的污點總是很棘手。

original: Did you clean the linens, yet?
string: 那些麻布，你洗了嗎？

original: I'd like to collect my earnings.
string: 我想要我的工錢。

original: Here's your pay. It's never enough for what we do, but war gives us warriors its own kind of benefits, doesn't it?
string: 這是你的報酬。這點小錢實在不足以支付我們的付出，不過戰爭卻帶給我們戰士特有的好處，不是嗎？

original: Are you sure? It's rightfully yours, but this money could go to getting better weapons and armor, and making repairs to the settlements we control.
string: 你確定？這錢理當是你的，不過這筆錢本來可以拿去買更好的兵器和盔甲，還能用來修復我們控制的居留地。

original: Are you all right?
string: 你還好嗎？

original: I saw guards dragging bodies over here. Might be a way out.
string: 我看過衛兵從這裡拽運屍體，也許可以從這裡出去。

original: We've got to get out of here.
string: 咱們必須離開這裡。

original: You saved my life. I won't forget it. Look me up if you're ever in Riften.
string: 你救了我，我不會忘記的。如果你到了裂谷城，就來找我吧。

original: You didn't have to help me, so... thanks.
string: 你根本不必幫我的，所以……謝謝你。

original: Are you all right?
string: 你還好嗎？

original: Now the Thalmor will be hunting me for the rest of my life. I hope it was worth it.
string: 現在我下半輩子都會被梭默追殺了，希望這值得我這麼做。

original: I should have known this would end badly. I can't believe I let Delphine talk me into this.
string: 我早該料到這件事不會有好的結果。真不敢相信戴爾菲娜居然說服我去做這個。

original: Let's get out of here, for pity's sake!
string: 行行好，咱們快離開這裡吧！

original: Trust me, we have nothing to say to one another.
string: 相信我，咱們之間沒什麼好說的。

original: Use your Unrelenting Force shout to strike the targets as they appear.
string: 目標出現的時候，使用你的冷酷之力龍吼打擊他們。

original: Please, sir, leave me alone!
string: 先生，請不要靠近我！

original: Don't you dare walk away from me, you slut! Do you know who I am?
string: 好大的膽子，竟敢離開我，妳這個蕩婦！妳知道我是誰嗎？

original: No, I'm sorry, but I can't go anywhere with you. I won't. Please, I must get back to my duties.
string: 不，很抱歉，但我不能跟你走。我不會跟你走的。請讓我繼續我的工作吧。

original: Oh, I don't think so. I think I understand perfectly. Don't worry, my dear, I will make any necessary excuses to your employer.
string: 哦，我不這樣認為。我想我非常明白。別擔心，親愛的，我可以對妳的雇主說出任何理由。

original: Oh, don't worry. I'll let you make it up to me. Now, where can we go for a little privacy, hmm?
string: 哦，別擔心嘛。我會讓妳補償我的。現在，我們去哪個比較有隱私的地方好呢，嗯？

original: What? I'm sorry, sir, but you must have misunderstood. I'm not permitted to leave the party.
string: 什麼？對不起，先生，你一定是誤會了。我是不能離開這個聚會的。

original: I'm sorry, sir. I didn't mean to give you the wrong impression earlier. I meant no disrespect.
string: 抱歉，先生，我並不想讓你誤會，我不是故意那樣無禮的。

original: Hello, my dear. I got your message. Where shall we go?
string: 哈囉，親愛的。我收到妳的訊息了。咱們要去哪裡？

original: So. You think you can toy with me, is that it? No, my dear. I have my heart set on you, and I always get what I want.
string: 妳以為妳能玩弄我，是嗎？不，親愛的，我可是一心牽繫著妳，而且我總能得到我想要的。

original: Yes. She said she can sneak you up to her quarters right now.
string: 是的，她說現在她能夠把你悄悄帶進她的房間。

original: Haha. I knew it! No woman yet born has been able to resist my charms for long. Thank you, my friend. I owe you one.
string: 哈哈，我就知道！能抵抗我魅力的女人還沒出生呢。謝謝你，朋友，我欠你一次。

original: Not yet. These things can't be rushed.
string: 時候未到。這些事不能操之過急。

original: Ha. Don't toy with me. I may just have to seize my opportunity with both hands, ha ha ha. But we'll play it your way for now.
string: 哈，別耍我。我也許不得不抓住我的機會，哈哈哈，但是現在咱們就先照妳的規則玩吧。

original: Don't worry. She's all yours.
string: 別擔心。她是你的了。

original: Ha. We'll see. I do have my eye on her, but she seemed a bit cold when I spoke to her earlier. Maybe just playing hard to get, eh?
string: 哈，走著瞧吧。我確實注意到她了，不過之前我跟她說話的時候，她顯得有些冷漠。也許只是欲擒故縱吧？

original: Maybe I can talk to her for you. See if she's interested.
string: 也許我能幫你探探口風，看她是否感興趣。

original: Really? Yes, maybe that would be just the thing. She seemed to be playing hard to get when I spoke to her earlier.
string: 真的？好啊，也許那樣行得通。之前和她說話時，她似乎刻意保持矜持。

original: Go on. See what she says. Now you've gone and gotten my hopes up again.
string: 去吧，看看她怎麼說。現在你可又燃起我的希望啦。

original: I saw you eyeing that serving girl.
string: 我看到你跟那個女僕眉來眼去。

original: Mmm, yes... Brelas, is that the one? I hope you're not thinking of cutting me out, are you? Haha.
string: 嗯，沒錯……布萊拉絲，你說的是她嗎？希望你不是想自己獨吞吧？哈哈。

original: I'm warning you, when I get my heart set on something I'm not easily put off.
string: 我警告你，要是我對什麼心動了，可不是說放棄就放棄的。

original: What brings you to this party?
string: 什麼風把你吹來的？

original: You must be new to Skyrim, or you'd already know who I am. I have a stake in most anything of importance in Solitude.
string: 你一定才來到天際省，不然你一定知道我是誰。幾乎所有獨孤城的重要事項，都和我有關。

original: I feel that it's time to put aside the grievances of the past, and let peace and prosperity flourish between the Empire and the Aldmeri Dominion.
string: 我想是時候摒棄前嫌了，讓咱們共同營造帝國和先祖神洲的和平與昌盛吧。

original: I try to do my little part. Besides, just between you and me, it's making me pots of money, hahaha.
string: 我只是盡點小心力。而且，就你知我知，我可因此賺了不少錢哪，哈哈哈。

original: Have you talked to Brelas yet? I'm not a patient man, you know.
string: 你跟布萊拉絲談過了嗎？我可沒多少耐心，你知道。

original: Did you see that serving girl? I hear elf women are insatiable...
string: 看到那個女僕了嗎？我聽說精靈裔女人都如狼似虎的……

original: For the man who knows how to make money, war can be a most profitable venture.
string: 對懂得賺錢的人來說，戰爭可算是最有利潤的投資。

original: The Great War is long past. It's time the Empire and the Aldmeri Dominion put aside their differences. Prosperity is good for everyone.
string: 浩大戰爭是很久以前的事了，帝國和先祖神洲的人民也該摒棄歧見了，繁榮昌盛是每個人的願望。

original: Elenwen always throws quite a party. I never miss one if I can help it.
string: 愛琳溫舉辦的宴會總是很棒，有機會我一定都去。

original: Yes, sir.
string: 是，先生。

original: Oh... not at the moment. Maybe later. Don't go far.
string: 哦……現在不行。也許待會吧。別走太遠。

original: Um, thank you. Sir. Was there anything else I can do for you?
string: 嗯，謝謝您，先生。還有什麼我能效勞的嗎？

original: No, no, that's not what I'm interested in right now.
string: 不不，我現在對這個不感興趣。

original: I just wanted to get a better look at you. I like what I see, my dear.
string: 我就想好好看看妳，妳好美，親愛的。

original: And believe me, I don't say that to everyone. I'm very discriminating when it comes to the female form.
string: 相信我，我可不隨便這樣說的。說到女性的外貌，我的眼光很高的。

original: Uh, Brelas, sir. Did you need a drink? Something to eat?
string: 呃……我叫布萊拉絲，先生。您要喝點什麼？要吃的嗎？

original: You there! Serving girl! What's your name, dear?
string: 小女僕！就是妳！妳叫什麼名字，親愛的？

original: There's a likely-looking filly. Even if she is an elf.
string: 雖然是精靈，但那小姑娘相貌可人哪！

original: That fellow over there asked me to talk to you...
string: 那邊那個傢伙要我跟妳說說話……

original: Ugh. Erikur, right? He was talking to me earlier. I could tell what he was after.
string: 呃，艾瑞庫爾，對吧？他剛才跟我說過話。我知道他想要幹嘛。

original: I hate working these parties. Some of the guests are nice, but there's always a few like Erikur.
string: 我討厭在這些宴會工作。有些客人很友善，但總是有一些像艾瑞庫爾這樣的人。

original: Please tell him to leave me alone. Politely. I'm sure you'll have better luck getting through to him than I would.
string: 請你要他保持距離，禮貌一點。我相信你比我更有說服力。

original: I hope you're enjoying yourself, sir.
string: 希望您過得愉快，先生。

original: I hope you're enjoying yourself, ma'am.
string: 希望您過得愉快，女士。

original: What can I get for you?
string: 您需要什麼？

original: I trust that this is just the begining of a long and mutually beneficial relationship.
string: 我相信這只是一段漫長互利關係的開始。

original: I'm so glad you could attend today.
string: 我很高興今天你能來。

original: I hope you're enjoying yourself.
string: 希望你過得愉快。

original: Please, help yourself to more wine.
string: 別客氣，盡情享用美酒吧。

original: The hospitality of the Thalmor Embassy is at your service.
string: 好客的梭默大使館全體人員願為您效勞。

original: Well, I'm glad that little unpleasantness is over.
string: 嗯，我很高興那個小小的不愉快過去了。

original: Yes, Madame Ambassador.
string: 是的，大使夫人。

original: Sir, you must tell her! You don't know what they'll do to me! Please!
string: 先生，您必須告訴她！您不知道他們會怎麼對我！拜託您！

original: Mistress Elenwen, it's not true! I did nothing!
string: 愛琳溫夫人，那不是真的！我什麼都沒有做！

original: No!
string: 不！

original: Well. Whatever the truth of it, I'm sure a few words with Master Rulindil will have a salutary effect. Take her downstairs.
string: 好吧，不管真相為何，我相信跟魯林迪爾大師聊聊有益無害。把她帶到樓下去。

original: Is that so, Erikur? And you with such delicate sensibilities. It must have been most upsetting.
string: 是這樣嗎，艾瑞庫爾？你這麼敏感纖細，這一定讓你很受傷吧。

original: I demand that you have this wench removed from my presence at once!
string: 我要求你立刻把這個村婦從我面前帶走！

original: Elenwen! This servant girl has been throwing herself at me in a most disgusting manner.
string: 愛琳溫！妳的女僕對我投懷送抱，一點也不害羞。

original: Now you're going to be sorry you crossed me.
string: 現在妳該後悔遇到我了。

original: Any suggestions as to how I find them?
string: 有沒有什麼建議，能幫我找到他們？

original: I heard one of them was just arrested trying to sneak into the city. If he's locked up in the jail, perhaps you can get it out of him.
string: 我聽說他們其中一個在試圖潛入城的時候被逮捕了。如果他被關進監獄了，也許你能從他身上得知。

original: Please, I know I'm asking you to do something difficult, maybe even dangerous. I just don't know who else I can trust.
string: 拜託你，我知道我要求你做的事情很困難，甚至可能很危險，但我不知道還能相信誰。

original: You've seen them? Then waste no time, head there at once!
string: 看見他們了嗎？那就別浪費時間，趕快過去那裡吧！

original: The longer they're around, the more danger I'm in! Please, kill Kematu and end this nightmare for me!
string: 他們在這附近越久，我就越危險！拜託你，殺掉凱馬圖，幫我了結這場噩夢吧！

original: I've run across these Alik'r before. I know where they're hiding.
string: 我曾經偶遇過這些阿利克爾人，我知道他們藏在哪裡。

original: If you're getting involved in this, that'd be where you start looking.
string: 如果你要淌這渾水，可以從那裡下手。

original: Why is this suddenly so important, anyway?
string: 這件事怎麼會突然變得這麼重要？

original: Last I heard he intended to pass through Eastmarch on his way here.
string: 上次我有他的消息，是他打算穿越東陲來這裡。

original: Last I'd heard, he was crossing the border from Morrowind into The Rift.
string: 上次我有他的消息，是他正穿過邊境，從晨風進入裂谷。

original: Where's the courier?
string: 信使呢？

original: I don't know. Are you not listening at all?
string: 我不知道。你根本沒在聽我說話？

original: It was a simple task, so I didn't keep close tabs on it like I do with the dangerous stuff.
string: 對於危險的任務我總是密切關注，但因為這個任務很簡單，我就沒有太密切地注意了。

original: What is it Arniel wanted you to get?
string: 阿內爾要你把什麼拿到手？

original: I don't know. He never told me.
string: 我不知道，他從沒告訴過我。

original: He made most of the arrangements himself, he just needed it transported from Morrowind. That's what I agreed to help with.
string: 大都是他自己安排的，他只是需要有人把它從晨風運來。我同意幫他送這個東西。

original: If I'd known it was so important to him, I'd have charged him more.
string: 要是我早知道這個東西對他那麼重要，我就多收他一點。

original: Didn't you tell Enthir this was valuable?
string: 你沒告訴恩希爾這很貴重嗎？

original: Have you lost your mind?
string: 你瘋了嗎？

original: Think, please, just for a moment, about what he would do if he knew its true value.
string: 想想吧，動一下腦袋，要是他知道這個東西的真實價值，他會怎麼做。

original: Do you really believe he would honor our agreement, or go running off to the highest bidder?
string: 你真覺得他會信守咱們的諾言嗎，或者會投奔出價最高的買家？

original: Please, you must set this right. I'm begging you.
string: 求求你，你一定要讓一切恢復正常。我拜託你了。

original: What is this thing that's so important?
string: 這是什麼東西呀，這麼重要？

original: It... It's very valuable. Critical to my work, and one-of-a-kind. That's all I care to say for now.
string: 它……它很貴重。對我的工作非常重要，是獨一無二的。我現在只能說這麼多。

original: It can't be lost. It just can't! It's irreplaceable, do you understand?
string: 它絕對不能弄丟，無論如何都不能！它無可取代，你明白嗎？

original: Without it, I cannot finish my work. All these years, so much time, so much energy...
string: 沒有它，我的心血就付之一炬了。這些年來，所有的時間，所有的精力……

original: You must find it! It cannot end this way! Not after I've worked so hard!
string: 你一定要找到它！不能就這樣結束！我的努力絕不能白費！

original: The courier never arrived with it.
string: 信差來的時候，根本沒有帶著它。

original: He has some simple-minded courier delivering it?
string: 難道他讓某個頭腦簡單的傢伙負責運送？

original: It left Morrowind, but never arrived here.
string: 它被送出晨風了，但並未送達這裡。

original: No, no no no. This can't be happening.
string: 不不不不不。不會吧！

original: Enthir really doesn't have whatever it is you asked him for.
string: 不管你到底想拿到什麼，恩希爾確實沒有。

original: What?
string: 什麼？

original: I... I don't understand. Where is it?
string: 我……我不明白。東西呢？

original: You're not listening to me. I don't have it.
string: 你沒聽我說嗎？我沒有。

original: I set up the whole deal. A courier was supposed to be bringing it from Morrowind. He never arrived.
string: 我都安排好了呀。一名送貨人應該要帶著它從晨風過來的，但他卻從未出現。

original: Okay? The deal was already done, the thing just never showed up. I can't help that!
string: 懂了嗎？交易已經完成了，但那東西就是沒有出現，我也不能怎樣啊！

original: I'm not running any more errands for you.
string: 我不會再為你跑腿了。

original: Did I ask you to? Did you hear me say that?
string: 我有叫你做嗎？你哪隻耳朵聽到我那樣說了？

original: What sort of "payment" do you expect this time?
string: 這次你想要什麼樣的「報酬」？

original: Nothing, nothing at all! Arniel already overpaid for... whatever it is.
string: 不要，什麼都不要！阿內爾已經付得夠多了……不管那是什麼東西。

original: You're holding out on Arniel again.
string: 你又在隱瞞阿內爾了。

original: Oh, by the Divines, you too?
string: 哦，看在聖靈的份上，你也是嗎？

original: I've already told him. I don't have it!
string: 我已經跟他說了，那東西不在我手上。

original: What do you want me to say to Enthir?
string: 你要我跟恩希爾說什麼？

original: I don't know, I don't know!
string: 我不知道，我不知道！

original: I've already agreed to pay him quite handsomely for the... well, the item in question.
string: 我已經同意付給他一筆慷慨的酬金，為我運送……呃……那個東西。

original: Just... Do whatever it takes to get him to stop lording this over me.
string: 只要……只要能阻止他隨意擺佈我，你怎麼做都行。

original: Have you unraveled the mystery of the dwarves yet?
string: 你解開矮人的謎團了嗎？

original: No, and at this rate, I never shall!
string: 還沒，而且照這樣下去，我永遠也解不開！

original: Enthir is once again holding out on me. He refuses to deliver yet another item absolutely essential to my work!
string: 恩希爾又扯我的後腿，再一次！他拒絕運送另一件對我的工作非常重要的東西！

original: I am close, so close! You must force him to see reason!
string: 我快成功了，就快了！你一定要讓他明白這個道理！

original: Teach me your spell, and I'll see what I can do.
string: 教我你的法術，我再看看我能做什麼。

original: Wonderful, just wonderful! I knew I could count on you!
string: 太棒了，真是太棒了！我就知道我能指望你！

original: Now this spell is not for defending yourself, but it's just right for heating the Convector. At least three seconds' burn is necessary.
string: 這個法術不是用來自我保護，而是用來加熱環流器的。加熱時間至少要三秒鐘。

original: Just place the soul gem inside, and heat the Convector. At least three seconds. You'll almost certainly need to find multiple Convectors.
string: 把靈魂石放進去，並加熱環流器。最少等三秒鐘。我看你肯定需要多找幾個環流器。

original: I suspect it may be due to the nature of the soul gem versus the crystals this was intended for. Destroys the equipment in the process.
string: 我想這可能是因為靈魂石的自然性質與水晶相剋，所以這個就設計成這樣了。在這個過程中是會損壞儀器的。

original: But, ahh... It's effective. Three times, and the crystal should be ready for the next step. Isn't this exciting?
string: 但是，啊……會有效的。重複進行三次的話，水晶應該就可以進到下一階段的狀態了了。這不是很令人興奮嗎？

original: What's in this for me?
string: 這對我有什麼好處？

original: Well, I... Don't you see?
string: 啊，我……你沒看到嗎？

original: Unlocking this mystery... The story alone is worth more riches than you can even imagine.
string: 解開這個謎團……會發現單單這故事就比你想像中的更有價值。

original: And perhaps... well, I don't wish to speculate, but... What if we could contact the dwarves? What if they're still out there? Imagine!
string: 說不定……雖然我不喜歡預測，但是……如果我們能聯繫上矮人呢？如果他們還在那裡呢？想想看！

original: What do you want me to do?
string: 你想要我怎麼做？

original: Well, yes. The designs for my Convector were based on real dwarven machines, so there may still be some in existence.
string: 沒錯。我的環流器是根據真正的矮人族機器設計的，所以搞不好這些機器還能在某處找到。

original: I'd go looking myself, but uhh... Yes, there are calculations to double- and triple-check. Many calculations.
string: 我本來想要自己去找，但是，呃……我還有些算式需要檢查個兩三遍。數量很多。

original: Perhaps you could seek out these Convectors in Skyrim ruins? I can even teach you the spell to heat them.
string: 也許你能在天際省的遺跡中幫我找找這些環流器？我可以教你加熱它們的法術。

original: It's very particular, and very important.
string: 它非常特別，而且非常重要。

original: Can you build another?
string: 你能再造一個嗎？

original: Hmm? No, no. No! I'm too close now. Can't take the time.
string: 嗯？不不不！馬上就要成功了，我不能浪費那個時間。

original: Though... Perhaps there's another option. I, umm, I may require further assistance from you.
string: 儘管……也許還有其他選項。我，嗯，可能還需要你進一步的協助。

original: And that won't work?
string: 那個沒辦法用嗎？

original: Well, yes. I mean, no. That is, it might, but I'm not completely sure. I'm no tonal architect, I've only read their writings. Scraps, really.
string: 可以啊。我是說，不行。換言之，也許可以吧，但是我不能完全確定。我不是設計人，只是讀過他們寫的東西，片片段段而已。

original: The soul gem by itself isn't enough, you see. It needs to be altered, purified. The dwarves had machines for this sort of thing.
string: 只有靈魂石本體還不夠。它需要被轉化、被淨化。矮人族有專門的機器來做這件事。

original: I attempted to build my own, based on designs and using parts you helped to provide. My very own Dwarven Convector.
string: 我打算用你幫忙找到的設計和零件，打造屬於自己的機器。全部屬於我的矮人環流器。

original: It worked, but not fully. And the uhh... The device was destroyed in the process.
string: 成功了，但功能還不完全。而且呃……設備在使用過程中受損了。

original: What went wrong?
string: 什麼出錯了？

original: Without boring you with the, ahh, details, I am attempting to re-create the circumstances of the event.
string: 太多……呃……細節可能會讓你覺得心煩，我打算重現事件發生時的環境。

original: The dwarves were very clever, tapping into and drawing power from the Heart of Lorkhan itself.
string: 矮人很聰明，知道從洛克汗之心汲取能量。

original: Lacking the heart of a dead god myself, I was attempting to substitute a rather specific soul gem. The ahh, the one you helped me acquire.
string: 不過我沒有死去之神的心臟，所以我打算用特殊的靈魂石取代，就是你找來的這塊。

original: Haven't they been gone a long time?
string: 他們不是消失很久了嗎？

original: Precisely!
string: 沒錯！

original: What could be worth studying about a long-lost civilization?
string: 研究一個失落已久的文明有什麼價值？

original: And what mystery is that?
string: 其中的謎團到底是什麼？

original: Their disappearance, of course!
string: 當然就是他們的消失絕跡啊！

original: Instant, unexplainable. The stories have fascinated me... Ever since I was young, I wanted to know what really happened.
string: 這些故事立刻毫無理由地令我著迷……從我還年輕的時候，就想知道究竟發生了什麼事。

original: After years and years of work, I'm closing in on a way to investigate what happened through experimentation.
string: 經過年復一年的努力，透過實驗，我終於越來越接近真相了。

original: Only now... Well, it's simply a disaster.
string: 只是現在……唉，簡直一團糟。

original: Did you account for the, uh, extra coefficient introduced by... umm...
string: 你有沒有把，嗯……那個哪來的額外係數，呃……納入計算？

original: Don't patronize me!
string: 別對我一副盛氣凌人的樣子！

original: I have no idea what you're talking about.
string: 我不知道你在說什麼。

original: Look, it's all very simple.
string: 看，這很簡單。

original: The Dwemer, they were uhh, masters of magic in a way we can't even begin to conceive of.
string: 鍛莫，他們曾經都是我們無法想像的魔法大師。

original: Their greatest achievement, however, has also been their greatest, shall we say... Mystery.
string: 他們最偉大的成就，也是他們最偉大的……這麼說好了……秘密。

original: How is your project coming along?
string: 你的計劃進行得怎麼樣了？

original: Terrible, just terrible. I vastly underestimated the heat transfer necessary, and have destroyed my only working model. I'm at a loss.
string: 糟糕，很糟糕。我嚴重低估了熱量傳遞的必要性，因此毀了唯一能用的模型。我很茫然。

original: I've got the Soul Gem you were after.
string: 我找到了你想要的靈魂石。

original: Do you?
string: 你找到了？

original: Wonderful. I was afraid I'd have to give up, and when I'm so close...
string: 太好了。我還擔心必須被迫放棄，都快要成功了……

original: Thank you for this. I have a great deal of work ahead of me.
string: 謝謝你。我還有好多工作等著。

original: Here's the staff you wanted.
string: 這是你要的法杖。

original: Well, well.
string: 好，好。

original: All right, you delivered on your end, so I'll deliver on mine. Here's the gem Arniel was after.
string: 好吧，你履行了諾言，所以我也要完成我的承諾。這是阿內爾在找的石頭。

original: Can't imagine what he expects to do with that... it's warped beyond any ability to capture a soul.
string: 不知道他想要那個做什麼……它能抵抗任何捕捉靈魂的能力。

original: What is it that you want?
string: 你想要的是什麼？

original: I have a... friend, let's say, who's interested in a staff. A particular one.
string: 我有個……朋友，這麼說吧，他對一根法杖很感興趣。一根特殊的法杖。

original: It's nothing dangerous, so don't worry. I'm not even sure why he wants it, but then that's not really my concern. He's willing to pay for it.
string: 一點都不危險，所以別擔心。我甚至搞不懂他為何想要這個東西，不過那其實也不關我的事。反正他願意為之付錢。

original: The problem is that it'll be a little difficult to acquire, seeing as how it's in the hands of someone who isn't exactly friendly.
string: 不過有個問題，要得到它有些困難，因為掌握這東西的人並不是那麼友善。

original: So, you bring that staff back here, and I'll consider it payment for the item Arniel was after.
string: 你把法杖帶回來給我，我就給你阿內爾在尋找的東西。

original: With all due respect, Arch-Mage, I'm not in a position to just give this away.
string: 恕我直言，首席法師，我不能夠把這個東西給別人。

original: I told Arniel what I wanted in exchange for it, and he was unwilling to come up with it.
string: 我跟阿內爾說過我的交換條件，不過他不願意。

original: Now, if you're here on his behalf, I'm afraid I'm going to have to insist on my original payment.
string: 現在，如果你是代表他，恐怕我依然會堅持我原先的報酬。

original: You think you can do what he can't, and I'll sell it to you. Then you're free to run off to him with it, if you like.
string: 你覺得你能做到他做不到的事情，而我就會把這個賣給你。然後如果你想，你可以帶著這個去找他。

original: I understand you have something of Arniel's.
string: 我知道你有某樣阿內爾要的東西。

original: Oh dear.
string: 我的天。

original: He's so afraid to talk to me he's sending you to do it? I should've expected as much.
string: 他不敢和我說話就派你來？不出所料。

original: I'm afraid you've been a little mis-informed. I have something of mine, that I was going to sell to Arniel.
string: 你搞錯了。我手上的東西是我的，我要賣給阿內爾。

original: I had retained Enthir's services in, uhh, acquiring something specific.
string: 我雇用了恩希爾，替我找一些特殊的東西。

original: But now he's refusing to deliver. Could you perhaps speak with him, and see if we can come to some sort of arrangement?
string: 但是現在他不想交出來。也許你能和他談談，看看能否達成個什麼協定？

original: Did you need any more help with your project?
string: 你的計劃還需要其他幫助嗎？

original: As a matter of fact, there is something you can do for me.
string: 其實，你確實可以幫忙。

original: What? Oh, no. No, no. I need more time to research the dwarven machinery. Thank you for offering, though.
string: 什麼？不不不。我需要更多時間來研究矮人機械，但還是謝謝你。

original: What did you need me to do for you?
string: 你需要我為你做什麼？

original: Ah, that's excellent news. This will be most helpful in furthering my research.
string: 啊，這真是大好的消息，對我的研究進行將會非常非常有幫助。

original: I'm afraid I can't offer you much right now, but please take this. And perhaps, if this is all successful...
string: 恐怕我現在無法給你什麼，但是請收下這個。如果一切都能成功……

original: Well, let's not get ahead of ourselves. It's too early to be getting excited. Still, this is most encouraging.
string: 我們不能自滿，現在高興還太早，不過，這確實很振奮人心。

original: Thank you again. If I require anything else, I shall be sure and let you know.
string: 再一次謝謝你！要是我還需要什麼，我會告訴你的。

original: I've got the cogs you asked for.
string: 我拿到了你要的齒輪。

original: I simply need more pieces of Dwemer equipment to study. It's nothing dangerous... At least, not necessarily.
string: 我需要更多的鍛莫設備零件，好用來研究。這一點都不危險……至少，不一定危險。

original: And please, let's just... Let's keep this between us.
string: 拜託你……別讓其他人知道這件事。

original: Just... Just bring me some Dwemer cogs. I need to examine them for the methods used in forging them.
string: 就……給我一些鍛莫齒輪。我需要它們來檢驗鍛造方法。

original: Ten of them should be enough for me to get a better understanding of how they were crafted. That's all I need, all right?
string: 十個應該就夠我搞清楚它們是如何打造出來的。我就需要這麼多，好嗎？

original: Can you tell me more about this project of yours?
string: 你告訴我更多有關你計畫的內容嗎？

original: Ah, yes. Umm, no. No, I don't think so. Not at this point.
string: 啊，好的。嗯，不不，我不能。現在不行。

original: It's just that, well I'm not even really sure it's going to amount to anything just yet. All theoretical right now, you understand.
string: 就是這樣，我現在也不敢確定究竟會有什麼結果。你知道，目前這些都只是理論。

original: But the implications are quite intriguing, I think. I simply need some experimental results to confirm my suspicions.
string: 不過，我覺得這其中的含義相當有趣。我只需用一些實驗資料來證實我的猜測。

original: Are you involved in something dangerous?
string: 你捲入了什麼危險的事情嗎？

original: What?
string: 什麼？

original: No, no. Goodness, no!
string: 沒有，沒有。天啊，沒有！

original: At least, I don't think so. No, it's just... It's just something I'd prefer to keep to myself.
string: 至少，我覺得沒有。只不過……只不過有些事我想還是自己知道就好。

original: But... I can't help but notice that you're doing quite well for yourself, rising through the ranks and all.
string: 但是……我不禁注意到你頗為成功，白手起家。

original: It may not be "official", but there is a, uhh, project I've been working on.
string: 這也許不夠「官方」，不過我有個……呃…正在進行的計劃。

original: I wonder if perhaps you could assist with it.
string: 我想知道你是否能夠幫忙。

original: Is there any College business I can assist with?
string: 有沒有我能幫忙的學院事務？

original: You mean the official sort of business? Hmm, well... no. No, not really.
string: 你是說官方的任務？嗯，沒有，不算有。

original: What happens now?
string: 現在呢？

original: Now? I announce to all of Markarth that I have returned. Don't worry about your name. They'll know who to blame and fear after today.
string: 現在？我要向全體馬卡斯城公民宣佈我回來了。別擔心你的名譽，今天之後，世人會知道該去責怪或恐懼的究竟是誰。

original: It'll take years, but I'll organize the Forsworn again. We'll reclaim our land, and then, when power is ours, we'll have peace. A kingdom.
string: 這得耗費數年，但我會再次讓棄誓者團結起來。我們將開拓自己的土地，之後，當我們的力量重新恢復，我們會贏得和平。新的王國於焉誕生。

original: Until then, let me offer you a warning. Beware the Forsworn. No place in the Reach is safe from us now.
string: 到那時，讓我給你們一個忠告：當心我們棄誓者。此後，每一寸邊塞的土地能逃不過我們的掌心。

original: Do you surrender?
string: 你們屈服嗎？

original: I surrender! Give me a few hours to gather my household, and I'll depart. You have my word.
string: 我投降！給我幾個小時召集家人，之後我就離開。我向你保證。

original: I'll donate my earnings to the cause.
string: 我會捐出我的收入。

original: I wish more had the dedication and strength of character that you demonstrate. I'll be sure this gets put to good use.
string: 我希望能有更多人擁有你所展現的奉獻精神和骨氣。我相信這是有好處的。

original: I'll take my pay.
string: 我要我的酬勞。

original: Here you go. Your continued assistance to the cause is appreciated.
string: 拿去吧。感謝你的持續協助。

original: I assume you saw the Gildergreen? Big tree, all burnt up, in the middle of the Wind District.
string: 我猜你看到鍍綠樹了吧？在和風區中央，那棵被焚燒殆盡的大樹。

original: It's part of the Temple of Kynareth. People want Danica to do something about it, but I don't know what they expect.
string: 它是凱娜瑞絲神殿的一部分。人們期望丹尼卡能想想辦法，但我不知道他們究竟期望什麼。

original: Don't forget the ranting and raving. About the Night Mother, how she was the true leader of the Dark Brotherhood, and Astrid was just a "pretender."
string: 別忘了他一再高聲呼喊夜母的傳奇，並稱她才是黑暗兄弟會的真正領袖，而阿斯垂德只不過是個「冒牌貨」。

original: It's true, I'm afraid. Cicero was a little whirlwind, slashing this way and that. It would have been funny, if he weren't trying to murder us all.
string: 恐怕是真的。西塞羅是個小旋風，到處打打殺殺。要不是他試圖殺光我們，其實還挺有趣的。

original: This is not the time to keep Astrid waiting.
string: 現在沒有時間讓阿斯垂德等待。

original: Thank you. It's nice to know someone admires me for more than just my appearance.
string: 謝謝。很高興有人不只是因為我的相貌而稱讚我。

original: Well, it shows. Your skill rivals some of the greatest miners I've known.
string: 哎呀，妳的技藝可以和最棒的礦工相提並論了。

original: I owe it all to my father who started me swinging the pickaxe when I was a barefoot little girl.
string: 這都歸功於我的父親。在我還是打赤腳亂跑的小姑娘時，就教我如何使用鶴嘴鋤。

original: I've been watching the way you mine and I have to say, I'm very impressed.
string: 我注意妳挖礦好一陣子了，我必須說，我很佩服妳。

original: I need someone that cares about me more than they care about themselves. That person isn't you.
string: 我需要一個關心我勝過他自己的人。這個人不是你。

original: And why not? I'm handsome, strong and smart. What else could you possibly need?
string: 為什麼不？我英俊、強壯又聰明。妳還會需要什麼？

original: Odfel, I've told you time and time again. I'm not interested in a relationship with you.
string: 奧德菲爾，我告訴過你好多次了。我不想和你交往。

original: Grelka, do you fancy a walk tomorrow?
string: 格瑞卡，明天妳想出去散步嗎？

original: You have yourself a bet.
string: 你在和你自己打賭。

original: You think so, huh? Maybe you'd like to put some septims behind that boast.
string: 妳那樣想嗎？也許妳替自己誇下的海口下賭注。

original: I'll have you know I can haul up just as much iron as you in a day and still manage to clean up my messes.
string: 我會讓你明白，我一天可以挖到和你一樣多的鐵礦，之後還能收拾乾淨。

original: I'd rather spend more time in the mine hauling up iron then doing woman's work keeping the house clean.
string: 我寧願在礦坑挖鐵礦也不願在家做家務。

original: All I'm asking is that you clean up once in a while. How you can find anything in your half of the place is beyond me.
string: 我只是要求你偶爾清理一下，我不能想像你能在這麼凌亂的地方找到東西。

original: That's what scares me. I'm afraid I'll travel to Darkwater Crossing and find it burned to the ground.
string: 這正是讓我恐懼的地方。我怕等我到達黑水岔口的時候，發現它已經被燒毀了。

original: This civil war is taking its toll on all of us. Miners are some of the hardest hit.
string: 內戰已使我們遭受了慘重的損失。礦工受害尤為嚴重。

original: It's no feast in their neck of the woods either. Last time I was up there, father said they were barely scraping by.
string: 他們附近的那一帶也不好過。上次我去那裡的時候，父親說他們僅勉強維持生計。

original: How are your parents faring, Grelka? Doing better than we are I would guess.
string: 妳的父母過得如何，格瑞卡？我想比咱們這邊好。

original: I know there's ore still in there, I can smell it. If you think you're right then you can pack up and leave any time you like.
string: 我知道那裡面一定還有礦石，我能感覺到。如果你覺得你是對的，那你隨時都可以打包走人。

original: What makes you so sure? What if I'm right?
string: 你怎能那麼確定？要是我對了怎麼辦？

original: And I'm telling you, you're wrong.
string: 那現在我告訴你，你是錯的。

original: I've been cracking rock ever since I was able to hold a pickaxe and I'm telling you, this mine is drying up.
string: 我從會拿鶴嘴鋤的那天起，就在採礦了。我告訴你，這個礦坑快枯竭了。

original: Quit your bellyaching. We've all got our problems.
string: 別發牢騷了，咱們都有自己的問題。

original: At this rate that'll never happen.
string: 照這機率，永遠都不可能。

original: You two will just have to learn to get along until we can build you another house.
string: 在我們建好另一棟房子之前，你們就學學如何好好相處吧。

original: You think living with Grogmar is easy? Did you see how he lives?
string: 你覺得跟格洛格瑪生活容易嗎？你知道他是怎麼生活的嗎？

original: Oh, don't worry about me. I relish the challenge.
string: 哦，別擔心我。我喜歡挑戰。

original: Don't worry, Orthus. I'm doing my best to get you reassigned to Solitude.
string: 別擔心，奧蘇斯。我會盡力讓你再次分配到獨孤城的。

original: It's very nice to meet you. You'll have to excuse Orthus here. He so rarely gets back to civilization. Stuck in Windhelm, poor fellow.
string: 很高興認識你。請原諒奧蘇斯，他很少回到文明社會。可憐的傢伙，被困在風舵城啦。

original: Vittoria! There's someone I'd like you to meet.
string: 維多利亞！我希望妳能見見這個人。

original: Go ahead and play your joke.
string: 繼續開你的玩笑吧。

original: Just between us, I've got more important things to do than attend these meaningless parties.
string: 私下說說，比起參加這些無聊的宴會，我還有更重要的事情。

original: I should be back in Windhelm. I've got work to do.
string: 我應該待在風舵城。我有事要做。

original: Did you know Vittoria is the Emperor's cousin? Best stay on her good side.
string: 你知道維多利亞是皇帝的表妹嗎？最好和她同一陣線。

original: Did you know Vittoria's getting married? They say the Emperor might even come to Skyrim for the wedding!
string: 你知道維多利亞快結婚了嗎？他們說皇帝很可能會來天際參加婚禮！

original: I'm ready for this party to be over.
string: 天下沒有不散的宴席。

original: I wasn't expecting to see you here! I assume you have your reasons. Everyone does.
string: 沒想到會在這裡見到你！我想你有自己出席的理由。每個人都是如此。

original: Look around the room and you'll see what we're up against. Just between you and me, a lot of what Ulfric says about the Empire is true.
string: 看看四周，你就知道我們在和什麼對抗了。你知我知，很多烏弗瑞克所說關於帝國的事情都是真的。

original: I swear Elenwen holds these parties just to make the Empire look bad. Almost makes me want to join the Stormcloaks.
string: 我發誓愛琳溫舉行這些宴會是想讓帝國難堪。搞得我都想參加風暴斗篷了。

original: The only reason I'm here is because my refusal to attend would cause a diplomatic incident.
string: 我會來，只是因為拒絕出席，就會出現外交危機。

original: I need another drink.
string: 我需要再來一杯。

original: I don't remember seeing you at one of these before.
string: 我不記得在這樣的宴會上見過你。

original: Do I know you? I didn't think so.
string: 我認識你嗎？不認識吧。

original: The Empire is fortunate to have the support of the Thalmor during this difficult time, don't you think?
string: 在這困難的時候，帝國還能得到梭默的幫助真的很幸運，你不覺得嗎？

original: Mark my words, the war will be over in a matter of months. Once Ulfric sees the full might of the Empire, I'm sure he'll come to his senses.
string: 聽好了，這場戰爭幾個月就會結束。等烏弗瑞克見識到帝國的真正實力，我想他會恢復理智的。

original: I don't understand why General Tullius hasn't been recalled. The man is clearly incompetent. I have half a mind to tell him so myself.
string: 我不明白為什麼圖留斯將軍還沒有被撤回。這人明顯很無能。我都想自己跟他說。

original: Trust me, there's no place better to forge relationships with the movers and shakers of Skyrim.
string: 相信我，要和天際省有影響力的人建立關係，沒有比這裡更好的地方了。

original: Yes. She wants you to leave her alone.
string: 是的，她要你別靠近她。

original: What? That little tease! Leading me on and turning cold at the last minute. I don't think so.
string: 什麼？她捉弄人嘛！把我騙過來又在最後關頭翻臉。我不會甘休。

original: Not right now.
string: 等會兒。

original: As you wish.
string: 隨你便。

original: I'll make sure she gets it.
string: 我會確保她收到的。

original: Thank you.
string: 謝謝。

original: I don't have time for that.
string: 我沒那個閒時間。

original: Then leave.
string: 那你走吧

original: I'll find those gauntlets.
string: 我會找到那些護手的。

original: We will see.
string: 我們等著瞧吧。

original: Who are these "natives" you mentioned?
string: 你說的這些「原住民」是誰 ？

original: They just call themselves the people of the Reach. Lot of common blood with the Bretons, by the looks of them.
string: 他們自稱為邊塞人。看他們的長相，和布萊頓人應該有血緣關係。

original: Used to have their own kingdom, till the Nords came, now they're at the bottom of the hay pile.
string: 他們曾經有自己的國家，直到諾德人到來，現在他們是社會最底層。

original: I'll stay out, then.
string: 那我退出。

original: Good to hear.
string: 很高興你這麼說。

original: I'll handle those draugr for you.
string: 我會幫你對付那些諾德亡靈。

original: You're joking, right? Those bone-walkers will tear you limb from limb.
string: 你開玩笑吧？那些行屍走肉會把你碎屍萬段。

original: But if you want to get yourself killed, go ahead.
string: 但如果你想找死的話，請便。

original: I go where I please.
string: 我想去哪兒就去哪兒。

original: Fine, but there's a whole crypt of draugr underneath the mine.
string: 好吧，但礦坑裡有整個地穴的諾德亡靈等著你。

original: We're not going in there until the Jarl's men come to clear them out, so I wouldn't go down there.
string: 在領主的人把它們趕走之前，我們不進去，所以我現在不會下去。

original: We're going to need an army to clear out that crypt.
string: 我們需要一支軍隊來清剿地穴。

original: That's too bad.
string: 那真是太糟了。

original: Aye.
string: 好啦。

original: You're telling me.
string: 我早知道了。

original: What if I took care of the Forsworn?
string: 如果我搞定那些棄誓者呢？

original: I'm sure Pavo would be grateful, and we'd all rest a little easier.
string: 我相信帕沃會很感激你的，而且我們會更安心。

original: But that's nonsense. You can't handle a group of Forsworn by yourself. If their axes don't get you, their magic will.
string: 但這是空話，你不可能一人對抗一幫棄誓者。就算他們的斧頭打不到你，魔法也能。

original: I'd be grateful. Kolskeggr is my home.
string: 我會很感激你。科斯凱格是我的家。

original: But, I wouldn't go there if I were you. There's a whole group of them with axes and magic on their side. You'd never stand a chance.
string: 但如果我是你，我不會去那裡。有一整群棄誓者在那，拿著斧頭、使著魔法，你不會有機會的。

original: For Kynareth!
string: 為了凱娜瑞絲！

original: Scourge of nature!
string: 自然之災！

original: May Kynareth's winds blow you to fortune.
string: 希望凱娜瑞絲的風為你帶來好運。

original: It's time for you to go.
string: 你該走了。

original: Hey, get out of here!
string: 喂，滾開！

original: Leave or be removed.
string: 走開，不然殺了你。

original: You need to leave now.
string: 你現在就得走。

original: Go, you're not wanted here.
string: 滾，這裡不歡迎你。

original: I don't think you belong here.
string: 我不認為你屬於這裡。

original: Leave now or suffer dire consequences.
string: 現在就滾，不然後果嚴重。

original: Get out of here before I call the guards!
string: 現在就滾，不然我叫衛兵了！

original: Both of you... out, out!
string: 你們兩個……出去，出去！

original: I think it's time for you to get going.
string: 我想你該離開了。

original: Could you please leave now?
string: 請你可以現在離開，好嗎？

original: You must leave immediately.
string: 你必須立刻離開。

original: You're not welcome here. Go.
string: 你在這裡不受歡迎。滾。

original: You need to leave.
string: 你得離開。

original: What is my destiny?
string: 我的命運是什麼？

original: That is for you to discover. We can show you the Way, but not your destination.
string: 你要自己找尋。我們可以給你指引，但不能告訴你終點。

original: You mean I'm not the only Dragonborn?
string: 你是說，我不是唯一的龍裔？

original: You are not the first. There have been many of the Dragon Blood since Akatosh first bestowed that gift upon mortalkind.
string: 你不是最早的龍裔。自從阿卡托什給予凡人這一恩賜以後，出現過很多龍裔。

original: Whether you are the only Dragonborn of this age... that is not ours to know.
string: 至於你是不是這時代僅存的龍裔…我們就不得而知了。

original: You are the only one that has been revealed thus far. That is all I can say.
string: 不過你是目前唯一被人所知的龍裔。我只能說這些。

original: I'm ready to learn.
string: 我準備好學習了。

original: You have shown that you are Dragonborn. You have the inborn gift.
string: 你證明了你是龍裔。你有與生俱來的天賦。

original: But do you have the discipline and temperament to follow the path laid out for you? That remains to be seen.
string: 但你是否擁有紀律和性情，讓你得以遵循你的命運之路？這要以後才知道了。

original: I'm answering your summons, Master.
string: 我在回應您的召喚，大師。

original: We are honored to welcome a Dragonborn to High Hrothgar.
string: 我們很榮幸，迎接一位龍裔來到高吼峰。

original: We will do our best to teach you how to use your gift in fulfillment of your destiny.
string: 我們會盡全力教導你，如何運用天賦來實現你的命運。

original: I want to find out what it means to be Dragonborn.
string: 我想找到身為龍裔的意義。

original: We are here to guide you in that pursuit, just as the Greybeards have sought to guide those of the Dragon Blood that came before you.
string: 我們就是來引導你的，正如灰鬍子一直尋找機會引導那些你之前的龍裔一樣。

original: Who are you? What is this place?
string: 你是誰？這是哪兒？

original: We are the Greybeards, followers of the Way of the Voice.
string: 我們是灰鬍子，龍吼之道的追隨者。

original: You stand in High Hrothgar, on the slopes of Kynareth's sacred mountain.
string: 你站在高吼峰，凱娜瑞絲聖山的山坡上。

original: Here we commune with the voice of the sky, and strive to achieve balance between our inner and outer selves.
string: 我們在這裡和天語交流，努力平衡內我和外我。

original: Aw, quit your bellyaching.
string: 唉呀，別再發牢騷了。

original: Yeah, I know what you mean.
string: 嗯，我懂你的意思。

original: It's not that bad.
string: 沒那麼糟。

original: You'd rather be plowing a field? Not me.
string: 你寧願耕地？我才不要。

original: Go tell the commander. I'm sure the boot in your arse will take your mind off your troubles.
string: 去跟指揮官說。我確定屁股上挨一腳肯定會讓你的煩惱煙消雲散。

original: You must be all right if you've got time to complain.
string: 如果你還有時間抱怨，你鐵定沒事。

original: I'm still sore where I took that arrow. I hate archers.
string: 我被箭射傷的地方還很酸痛。我討厭弓箭手。

original: This imperial armor is damn heavy.
string: 帝國的盔甲真他媽的重。

original: I'm sick of waiting. When are we going to see some action?
string: 我不想等了。我們什麼時候能看到一些動靜？

original: Hope I don't draw guard duty.
string: 希望我不要抽到站衛兵。

original: I bet we have rabbit again. I'm getting sick of rabbit.
string: 我打賭又是兔子，都膩了。

original: We're running out of bread. I hope the supplies get here soon.
string: 我們快沒麵包了。希望補給快點兒到。

original: Why aren't you at your post, Justiciar?
string: 為什麼你不在你的崗位，審判者？

original: Who are you? Intruder!
string: 你是誰？入侵者！

original: What? Raise the alarm!
string: 什麼？拉警報！

original: Raise the alarm! We've been infiltrated!
string: 拉警報！我們被侵襲了！

original: You there. I don't think I've seen you around before.
string: 你。我不覺得我在這一帶見過你。

original: Haven't seen her around before.
string: 在這一帶沒見過她。

original: Haven't seen him around before.
string: 在這一帶沒見過他。

original: Come here. Let me see your face.
string: 過來，讓我看看你的臉。

original: Seems a bit short to me.
string: 看起來有點兒矮。

original: Wait, is that a tail?
string: 等等，那是尾巴嗎？

original: Must be new around here.
string: 一定是新來的吧。

original: If Maven already threw you in jail, why steal her horse?
string: 如果瑪雯已經把你扔進監獄了，為什麼還要偷她的馬？

original: I'm not stealing anything. Besides, some jail time isn't going to make me roll over and play dead.
string: 我什麼都沒偷。再說，蹲一會兒牢不至於讓我改變主意而且假裝我已經死了。

original: Letrush already agreed to pay me.
string: 萊特魯什已經答應付我錢了。

original: Well then, if you don't want the extra gold, you can certainly let Letrush keep it as a gesture of goodwill.
string: 那好，如果你不想要外快，你可以讓萊特魯什留著錢作為友好象徵。

original: What? No! No, you don't understand! There's been some kind of mistake! I... Aggghhh!
string: 什麼？不，不，你不明白！其中有誤會！我……啊啊啊！

original: I've killed the leader of <Alias=BanditCamp>.
string: 我殺了<Alias=BanditCamp>的領袖。

original: Teach them to stop paying me.
string: 告訴他們別再付我錢了。

original: Here. You deserve a reward for your service.
string: 拿著。你的付出值得有所回報。

original: Oh, you wanted the attic room? Why didn't you say so the first time?
string: 哦，你想要閣樓房？你怎麼一開始不說？

original: The thing is... we don't actually have an attic room. But I think I know what you mean. Go ahead and make yourself at home.
string: 其實呢……我們沒有閣樓房，但我應該知道你的意思。請隨意吧。

original: I'd like to rent the attic room. (<Global=RoomCost> gold)
string: 我想要租閣樓房。（<Global=RoomCost>金幣）

original: Attic room, eh? Well... we don't have an attic room, but you can have the one on the left. Make yourself at home.
string: 閣樓房，是嗎？呃……我們沒有閣樓房，不過可以給你左邊那間，請隨意。

original: I'd like to rent the attic room. (<Global=RoomCost> gold)
string: 我想要租閣樓房。（<Global=RoomCost>金幣）

original: Next to the door, the room on the left.
string: 在門邊，左邊那間。

original: Where was my room again?
string: 我的房間在哪兒來著？

original: Move along. Nothing to see here.
string: 繼續走。這裡沒什麼好看的。

original: Well, this is a nice mess you've gotten me into.
string: 好吧，你真是讓我陷入了大麻煩。

original: That could have turned out better.
string: 事情不該是這樣子的。

original: I can't believe I got caught.
string: 真不敢相信我竟然被抓了。

original: Let's go. Let me worry about the guards.
string: 走吧。衛兵交給我。

original: Well... if you say so.
string: 好吧……既然你這麼說的話。

original: Not just yet.
string: 還沒。

original: Well, hurry it up!
string: 快點！

original: Let's go.
string: 走吧。

original: All aboard!
string: 全部登船！

original: You're the one who's coming to Japhet's Folly with us, right? You ready to go?
string: 你就是那個要和我們一起去傑非的老巢的人，對吧？你準備出發了嗎？

original: Before you even ask, yes I have an ancestry steeped in magic, and no I don't want to talk about it.
string: 在你開口問之前，是的，我有祖先研究過魔法，但我不想說這些。

original: Yes, I know Winterhold used to be full of my kind, and no I don't care that they're all gone now.
string: 是的，我知道冬堡曾經都是我族的人，但我不在乎，因為他們現在都死了。

original: Does that cover everything?
string: 這樣有說明一切了嗎？

original: No coin right now.
string: 現在沒錢。

original: Well then you'd better have something I really want to buy.
string: 那你最好有些值錢的東西是我想要的。

original: I do. The question is, what have you got?
string: 我有。問題是，你有些什麼？

original: Let's just take a look then.
string: 讓我們來看看吧。

original: Can we do business?
string: 我們能做交易嗎？

original: I hope you've got some coin.
string: 我希望你有點錢。

original: I understand you're an elf who knows how to get things.
string: 據我所知你是很有手段的精靈。

original: All right, let's not overdo it.
string: 好吧，我們別做過頭了。

original: Meet me at my quarters.
string: 到我住的地方見吧。

original: Let me give you a bit of advice.
string: 讓我給你個建議。

original: You want to work on something that's not officially allowed? Don't tell anyone you're doing it.
string: 你想做點超出規則所允許的事？別讓別人知道。

original: You need something you're not officially supposed to have, you come see me.
string: 如果你想要點正規管道弄不到的東西，來找我。

original: You tell anyone that I told you, and I'll fry you from the inside out. Got it? Good.
string: 你要是告訴別人我跟你說的，我會把你燒得外焦內脆。懂嗎？很好。

original: He becomes a full-fledged member of the Bards College. Please welcome our newest Bard!
string: 他成為了吟遊詩人學院的正式成員。請熱烈歡迎我們的新詩人！

original: We remember all those Solitude soldiers out fighting the good fight in this thankless war.
string: 讓我們銘記正在戰場上為了這吃力不討好的戰爭奮戰的獨孤城戰士們。

original: With the lighting of the effigy...
string: 借著肖像的火光……

original: The festival would not have been possible without the dedication and hard work of our latest applicant.
string: 沒有這位新申請者的辛勞和奉獻，這個節日就辦不成。

original: The festival would not have been possible without the dedication and hard work of our most recent inductee.
string: 沒有這位新入學員的辛勞和奉獻，這個節日就辦不成。

original: Welcome, people of Solitude! We of the Bards College are pleased to be here to celebrate the Burning of King Olaf.
string: 歡迎各位獨孤城的人民！我們吟遊詩人學院很高興能夠在這裡與各位一起慶祝火燒奧拉夫節。

original: What are your thoughts on Cicero and the Night Mother?
string: 你對西塞羅和夜母，有什麼看法？

original: Two hundred years ago, I would have lain down my life for the Unholy Matron. But that is an age long since passed. Astrid is my matron now.
string: 200年前我可能還會為這不潔之母去死。但那年代早過去了。現在阿斯垂德是我的女主人。

original: Without the Night Mother, there is no Dark Brotherhood. The Matron deserves our unwavering support and respect.
string: 沒有夜母就沒有黑暗兄弟會。這位女主人值得我們忠貞的擁護和愛戴。

original: Though I admit, I find her Keeper a bit too exuberant for my liking.
string: 雖然我得承認她的那個看守讓我覺得有點太瘋狂讓我不太喜歡。

original: The witless fool and his pet corpse? Take a guess.
string: 那個無知的蠢貨和他那副屍體？你猜猜阿。

original: Their arrival is the best thing that's happened to this Sanctuary in years. Astrid is an effective leader, but we've been rudderless for too long.
string: 他們的到來是聖所這些年來所發生的最好的事。阿斯垂德是個得力的領袖，但我們已經群龍無首太久了。

original: Scrounging for contracts, abandoning the Tenets. The Dark Brotherhood has been reduced to a group of common cutthroats. Frankly, it's embarrassing.
string: 四處找事做，背棄教義。黑暗兄弟會已經是一群劊子手了。老實說，很丟臉。

original: Truthfully? I'm not entirely sure. It's not that I don't have the utmost respect for Sithis, and the Night Mother, and the ancient ways. I do.
string: 要聽真話？我不太確定。我並非不對西帝斯、對夜母和古法深懷敬意。我相當尊敬這些。

original: But I've never been much for religion. I kill because it's what I've been trained to do. It's all I know. So long as Astrid is happy, I'm happy.
string: 但我從來不是很虔誠的人。我殺人，因為這是我所受的訓練，我就知道這些。只要阿斯垂德高興，我就高興。

original: I don't like mimes, minstrels, thespians, acrobats, jugglers, troubadours or tumblers. Flutists give me a headache. I particularly hate jesters.
string: 我不喜歡小丑，滑稽戲子，雜耍的，拋球的，唱民謠的或耍雜技的。吹笛子的讓我頭疼。我尤其討厭小丑。

original: As a rule, I'm also not crazy about the corpses of old women. For the Night Mother, I'll make an exception. But Astrid is the only mistress I serve.
string: 一般來說，我對老女人的屍體也不熱衷，不過夜母的例外。但阿斯垂德是我唯一侍奉的女主人。

original: What can you tell me about yourself?
string: 你能說說自己嗎？

original: Look. If you're trying to get to know me - don't. I don't like you, and I never will. It's nothing personal. But...
string: 聽著，如果你是想瞭解我，省省力氣吧。我不喜歡你，現在以後都不會。不是因為你做了什麼，但……

original: My wife trusts you, and I trust her judgment. So you can't be all bad.
string: 我妻子信任你，我也相信她的判斷力，所以你不可能太差勁。

original: Here's all you need to know: I'm a werewolf. I like killing things. I love Astrid. I hate annoying people. And the color blue gives me a headache.
string: 你只需要知道：我是狼人。我喜歡屠殺。我愛阿斯垂德。我討厭煩人的人。藍色讓我頭疼。

original: What can you tell me about yourself?
string: 你能說說自己嗎？

original: I might ask the same of you. For you are more than mortal. You are moon-born. You are wolf.
string: 我也想這麼問你，因為你並非凡人。你是月裔。你是狼。

original: So you're a Companion, then? I can't imagine you got your gift anywhere else. I hope you have better luck with them than I did.
string: 你是戰友團的一員，是吧？我想不出你還能在其他地方得到你的才能。希望你和他們相處和睦，別像我一樣。

original: Oh yes, I was once brother to the Companions. Let's just say they found my methods "unsettling." The Dark Brotherhood, obviously, feels differently.
string: 哦，是的，我也曾是戰友團的兄弟。這麼說吧，他們覺得我的手段「讓他們不安」。 不過黑暗兄弟會顯然不這麼想。

original: What can you tell me about yourself?
string: 你能說說自己嗎？

original: What a curious question. Well, I enjoy moonlit nights, taking long walks on the beach, knitting and unicorns.
string: 真有趣的問題。嗯，我喜歡月夜，喜歡沿著海邊漫步，喜歡針織和獨角獸。

original: In fact, I once took a seaside stroll, on a moonlit night, and discovered a unicorn... which I proceeded to stab in the throat with a crochet needle.
string: 有一次月夜，我在海邊漫步，發現一頭獨角獸……然後我把鉤針插入牠的喉嚨。

original: I'm a woman of refined, yet simple tastes.
string: 我是個品味優雅卻單純的女人。

original: What can you tell me about yourself?
string: 妳能說說自己嗎？

original: I'm just a little girl! The Dark Brotherhood killed my mama and papa, and then they took me captive! Please, please help me!
string: 我只是個小女孩！黑暗兄弟會的人殺了我的父母，把我抓了起來！求求你，求求你幫我！

original: Rather convincing, don't you think?
string: 我裝得挺像，你不覺得嗎？

original: In truth, I'm no more a little girl than you are. I was once, of course. Three hundred years ago. Vampirism tends to keep one remarkably... fresh.
string: 說真的，我跟你一樣都不是小女孩。當然，我曾經是。大概三百年前吧。成了吸血鬼顯然讓人……青春永駐。

original: What can you tell me about yourself?
string: 你能說說自己嗎？

original: Hmph. I like to say I was born with a wand in my hand. Well, not literally - you can see how painful that would have been for mother.
string: 唔，我喜歡說我帶著魔杖出生。當然，不是字面上的意思，要是真的那樣，你可以想像母親會多痛苦。

original: But I was a prodigy! Casting simple spells by one, completing complex incantations by three. Resurrecting corpses by seven! Ha!
string: 但我是個天才！一歲就會簡單法術，三歲可以施展複雜的咒語，七歲就能讓屍體起死回生！哈！

original: When I was thirteen I accidentally burned down the family home. A bit of lightning gone awry. Ah, but soon after I mastered my gifts. Completely.
string: 十三歲的時候，我不小心把家燒了。用火出了點差錯。啊，但很快我就精通這些能力，完全運用自如。

original: I went on to teach at the College - left after two years. Too simple. Too safe. None of them truly understood the glory of the Destruction school...
string: 後來，我去學院教書，只待了兩年。太簡單也太安穩了。沒人真正明瞭毀滅學派的榮耀……

original: What can you tell me about yourself?
string: 你能說說自己嗎？

original: Once, I was a Shadowscale. An assassin in service to the King of Black Marsh. Trained by the Dark Brotherhood since the day of my hatching.
string: 我曾經是個影鱗，是黑沼澤之王的一名刺客，從小由黑暗兄弟會訓練培養。

original: Ah, but that was a lifetime ago. Today, I am the last of my kind. My order is extinct. Now, I happily serve Astrid, and this Sanctuary.
string: 啊，但那簡直是上輩子的事情了。如今，我是我族僅存的一位。我的組織已經不復存在。現在，我則樂於侍奉阿斯垂德和聖所。

original: I am a trained killer, and once again have been given purpose. Life is good.
string: 我是訓練有素的殺手，而且再度被賦予使命。生活很美好。

original: What can you tell me about yourself?
string: 你能說說自己嗎？

original: This Sanctuary has been my entire life since I was a young woman. That's when I first discovered my, shall we call it "aptitude," for elimination.
string: 這個聖所早在我年輕時，就是我生命的全部。就是在那時，我第一次發現了——或許能稱之為消除的「才能」。

original: I had an uncle, you see. He made certain... unwanted advances. So I killed him. And liked it. Then I killed again. And liked it even more. And so on.
string: 我本來有個叔叔，他給了我一些……不怎麼中聽的建議，所以我殺了他，而且很享受其中。之後我再次動手，並且更加享受，事情就是這樣。

original: I was recruited by the Dark Brotherhood, and have been here ever since. I met my husband Arnbjorn, rose to leadership. And now here we are.
string: 我被黑暗兄弟會招募進來，直到現在。在這裡，我認識我的丈夫艾恩伯約恩，升到領導階層。這就是現在的我們。

original: Ah, well, I'm Redguard, as I'm sure you've noticed. Though not like most of my kind you'll find in Skyrim, that's for damned sure.
string: 啊，我是紅衛人，我相信你已經注意到了。但我跟天際省大部分的同族人不一樣，我非常確信。

original: I am a child of Hammerfell, born of the sands of the mighty Alik'r. In that great desert, blood is a shade of crimson I can scarce describe.
string: 我是落錘省之子，生於偉大阿利克爾的沙土。在那片廣大沙漠，血是我無法描述的深紅。

original: My past is long and storied, and not altogether proud. But the Dark Brotherhood saved me from myself. And I have never looked back.
string: 我的過去漫長曲折，並不全是值得驕傲的事。但黑暗兄弟會給我了自我救贖的機會，我也從此沒再回頭。

original: Ah, well, I'm Redguard, as I'm sure you've noticed. Though not like you. Hmph. No, definitely not like you.
string: 啊，我是紅衛人，我相信你已經注意到了。但我跟天際省大部分的同族人不一樣，我非常確信。

original: I am a child of Hammerfell, born of the sands of the mighty Alik'r. In that great desert, blood is a shade of crimson I can scarce describe.
string: 我是落錘省之子，生於偉大阿利克爾的沙土。在那片廣大沙漠，血是我無法描述的深紅。

original: My past is long and storied, and not altogether proud. But the Dark Brotherhood saved me from myself. And I have never looked back.
string: 我的過去漫長曲折，並不全是值得驕傲的事。但黑暗兄弟會給我了自我救贖的機會，我也從此沒再回頭。

original: Me? Oh, Cicero is just the Keeper! I... keep! I look after our matron, you see. The Night Mother. I keep her clean, and protected, and happy...
string: 我？哦，西塞羅只是個守護者！我……守護！你瞧，我守護我們的女主人「夜母」，我幫她保持清潔，保護她，讓她開心……

original: But I am not the Listener. Oh no. There is no Listener. Not yet! But some day, some day, some day I pray, that one will come to hear her say...
string: 但我不是聆聽者。哦不，這裡沒有聆聽者，還沒有。但某一天，某一天，我祈禱某一天，會有這樣一個人來聆聽她的……

original: The words.
string: 那些話。

original: Me? Oh, Cicero is just the Keeper! I... keep! I look after our matron, you see. The Night Mother. I keep her clean, and protected, and happy...
string: 我？哦，西塞羅只是個守護者！我……守護！你瞧，我守護我們的女主人「夜母」，我幫她保持清潔，保護她，讓她開心……

original: But I am not the Listener. Oh no. You are the Listener! You heard the words! And everything will soon be put right.
string: 但我不是聆聽者。哦不。你就是聆聽者！你聽到了那些話！很快的，一切都會邁向正途。

original: Any advice on my current contract?
string: 對我現在的任務有什麼建議？

original: Yeah. Follow my wife's orders, and don't do anything stupid.
string: 有。聽從我妻子的命令，別幹傻事。

original: You must speak to that Muiri woman, correct? I have heard rumors in Windhelm. She was recently implicated in a thievery, along with her lover.
string: 你得和那個叫暮蕊的女人談話，是嗎？我在風舵城聽到謠言，她最近和她的情人一起捲入一件偷竊案。

original: The lover will likely be your target. If memory serves me correctly, he leads a group of bandits. So this may be rather interesting for you.
string: 那個情人應該會是你的目標。如果我沒記錯的話，他帶領一群土匪。你應該會感興趣的。

original: The contracts I dole out are fairly simple - go to a location, and kill the target. But this is different.
string: 我發出的契約都很簡單，無非是到指定地點，殺指定目標。可是，這次不一樣。

original: The jobs Astrid gives you will be more important, and usually more complex. Just keep your wits about you. And for Sithis' sake, don't get killed.
string: 阿斯垂德給你的任務會更重要，通常也更複雜。放機靈點兒。看在西帝斯的份上，別丟了性命。

original: You're headed to The Hag's Cure, right? It's a good shop. You should examine their wares. Never pass up the chance to buy a good potion... or poison.
string: 你要去「鬼婆妙方」是吧？是間好店。你應該好好看看他們的貨，絕對不要錯過好藥水……或毒藥。

original: And one more thing. Have fun. You'll be committing a dark deed, but there's no reason you shouldn't enjoy yourself.
string: 最後一件事。玩得愉快！你將履行一個黑暗契約，但你也該學會享受過程。

original: You're only young once. Trust me, I know.
string: 青春一逝不再來。相信我，我很瞭解。

original: Yes. Just because you're now a professional assassin, don't think you have to skulk around in the dark like a skeever and stab people.
string: 是的，別因為你是職業刺客，就覺得一定得像惡鼠，在暗處徘徊，從背後刺人。

original: Do what I do. Walk up to your target, introduce yourself, melt their skin off, and then run like the wind. Works every time.
string: 學學我。走上前去，和你的目標打招呼，燒死他，然後飛快逃匿。每次都成功。

original: You're being sent to meet with the contact directly, is that correct? What a most unusual occurrence. Astrid usually performs this duty herself.
string: 你被派去直接和聯絡人見面，是嗎？真不尋常。這種事，阿斯垂德通常都自己來。

original: I can only assume she wants to test the full breadth of your abilities. So. Be polite, and professional, and represent us well.
string: 我只能猜，她是想測試你的全部實力。那麼，禮貌點、專業點，做個好榜樣。

original: She said that? If I find anyone working against my wife, or this Sanctuary, I'll beat them to death with their own severed head.
string: 她這麼說的？若讓我知道有人敢在我妻子或聖所後面搞鬼，我會拔下他的頭砸爛他的身體。

original: Of course, they'd probably already be dead...
string: 當然，頭拔下來大概就已經死了……

original: But you know what I mean!
string: 但你懂我的意思！

original: Astrid thinks a Family member may be conspiring with Cicero.
string: 阿斯垂德認為可能有個家族成員，正與西塞羅一起密謀不軌。

original: You're joking. While I can understand if some family members wish to honor the Old Ways once more, surely no one would oppose Astrid's rule.
string: 你開玩笑吧。我可以理解一些成員希望重振舊法，但絕對沒有人會反對阿斯垂德的領導的。

original: Astrid thinks a Family member may be conspiring with Cicero.
string: 阿斯垂德認為可能有個家族成員，正與西塞羅一起密謀不軌。

original: Does she? Listen, brother... Astrid is my mistress, and I worship the ground she walks on. But this Cicero business has her a bit... paranoid.
string: 她這麼想嗎？聽著，兄弟……阿斯垂德是我的女主人，我甚至膜拜她走過的路。但西塞羅這件事，她有點……多疑了。

original: Astrid thinks a Family member may be conspiring with Cicero.
string: 阿斯垂德認為可能有個家族成員，正與西塞羅一起密謀不軌。

original: Does she? Listen, sister... Astrid is my mistress, and I worship the ground she walks on. But this Cicero business has her a bit... paranoid.
string: 她這麼想嗎？聽著，姐妹……阿斯垂德是我的女主人，我甚至膜拜她走過的路。但西塞羅這件事，她有點……多疑了。

original: Astrid thinks a Family member may be conspiring with Cicero.
string: 阿斯垂德認為可能有個家族成員，正與西塞羅一起密謀不軌。

original: Oh! Well, I hope she doesn't suspect me. I mean, I've spoken with Cicero a bit, and he's quite charming. But I'd never go against Astrid. Never.
string: 哦！那，希望她別懷疑我。我的意思是，我和西塞羅說過話，他也挺迷人的，但我絕對不會背叛阿斯垂德，絕不可能。

original: Astrid thinks a Family member may be conspiring with Cicero.
string: 阿斯垂德認為可能有個家族成員，正與西塞羅一起密謀不軌。

original: Ha! And would that surprise anyone? This Sanctuary's a mess. Wouldn't surprise me if somebody's talking to the fool on the sly. Making deals.
string: 哈！誰又會感到驚訝？聖所已經一團亂。如果有人和那蠢貨密謀，做交易我也不會奇怪。

original: And no, before you ask, it's not me. I know which side my bread is buttered on.
string: 但先說好，那絕不是我。我知道應該跟著誰。

original: Astrid thinks a Family member may be conspiring with Cicero.
string: 阿斯垂德認為可能有個家族成員，正與西塞羅一起密謀不軌。

original: To what end? Usurping Astrid's authority as leader of the Sanctuary? Hmmm... Yes, I can see her concern. Thank you for bringing this to my attention.
string: 密謀什麼？篡奪阿斯垂德聖所領袖的位子？嗯……是的，我瞭解她的擔心所在。謝謝你讓我知道。

original: Astrid thinks a Family member may be conspiring with Cicero.
string: 阿斯垂德認為可能有個家族成員，正與西塞羅一起密謀不軌。

original: Oho! The Listener wants my counsel! I thought you were above the opinions of mere mortals, now that you commune with dead old women.
string: 哼！聆聽者需要我的建議？你現在既然可以和已死的老女人交流了，怎還會需要會聽凡人的意見。

original: Just remember Astrid's commitment to her Sanctuary, to her Family. A Family that now counts you as one of its own. Honor Astrid above all others.
string: 別忘記阿斯垂德對聖所和家族的奉獻。你也是家族的一份子。阿斯垂德比其他人更值得榮耀。

original: You may be the Listener, or you may just be a lunatic who's started hearing voices. Either way, Astrid is still your mistress. Not the Night Mother.
string: 你可能是聆聽者，也或許只是能聽到說話聲的瘋子。不管怎樣，阿斯垂德始終是你的女主人，不是夜母。

original: The man you need to speak with, his name is Motierre? That's a very old and powerful Breton family, firmly established in Cyrodiil. Most curious...
string: 你要交談的人，名字叫莫提雷？那可是個古老而強大的布萊頓家族，在賽瑞迪爾很有威望。真有意思……

original: So you're the Listener, hmm? Well that hardly seems fair. You just got here. The Night Mother should have spoken to me. Any idiot could see that.
string: 你就是聆聽者？那太不公平了。你才來不久。傻子都知道夜母應該先跟我談談。

original: But, I will serve gladly, as that's my lot in life. Now let's see. Ah yes, Volunruud. It's an old crypt, infested with Draugr. So plan accordingly.
string: 不過我還是會樂意侍奉的，畢竟這是我的職責。讓我們瞧瞧，啊，沃倫魯德，滿是諾德亡靈的古地穴，好好擬定計劃吧。

original: If the Night Mother truly spoke to you, if you really are the Listener... your destiny was written in the Void. Astrid is right to fear your power.
string: 如果夜母真的跟你說過話，如果你真的是聆聽者……那你的命運已經寫於虛無。難怪阿斯垂德會懼怕你的力量。

original: You've got to kill a soft little woman on her wedding day. What's next? Murdering a crippled orphan in his sleep?
string: 你要在一個溫柔小女人的婚禮上送她去死。再來呢？殺害一個熟睡中的殘廢孤兒？

original: Your contract sounds simple, which means it certainly will not be. Getting into that reception will be easy, but have you thought about getting out?
string: 你的任務聽起來很簡單，這表示它一定沒那麼容易。進入婚禮會場不難，但你想過怎麼出來嗎？

original: Slaughtering the Emperor's cousin? At her wedding? Those guards will be out for blood. Wouldn't surprise me if the crowd jumped in too.
string: 謀殺皇帝的表妹？在她的婚禮上？那些衛兵可都是嗜血之徒，而群眾摻進來攪和也是可能的事。

original: It's no fair. I love weddings. Astrid should have given this contract to me. Instead, she's got me visiting cities, assessing security. How boring.
string: 這不公平。我喜歡婚禮。阿斯垂德應該把那工作交給我的。結果她卻要我去逛各個城市，刺殺衛兵。真無聊。

original: But listen, I think I can help you. The wedding reception is outside the Temple of the Divines, right? In Solitude?
string: 但聽著，我想我能幫你。婚禮招待會是在聖靈神殿外面對吧？在獨孤城？

original: If so, the bride will probably address the crowd from the balcony. It overlooks the courtyard.
string: 如果是這樣，那新娘應該會在陽臺上對群眾致詞，從庭院可以看得一清二楚。

original: Well, there's an old statue there. I've seen it. Hanging right over where she'll be standing. Old means weak. Weak means it could fall. Hmmm?
string: 陽台那裡有尊舊雕像，我見過，就掛在她將站之處的上方。老舊意味不牢，不牢就表示可能會掉落。對吧？

original: Ah, killing her will be easy. She'll be so happy, she'll never see it coming. I should know, I killed a bride once.
string: 啊，殺她何其容易。她那時會欣喜若狂，根本不會意識到即將發生的事。我當然知道，我之前殺過一個新娘。

original: It was our honeymoon. Tepid, I said! The bathwater should be tepid! Lukewarm is not tepid! Close, maybe, but there's is a difference! Stupid cow.
string: 那是我們的蜜月。溫熱，我是這麼說的！洗澡水應該是溫熱的！微溫不是溫熱！也許很接近，但有差別！蠢女人。

original: I hope you don't mind, but I took the liberty of surveying the site of the reception.
string: 希望你別介意，但我擅自勘察了一下招待會的地形。

original: There's a small parapet, just opposite the balcony, that would prove an excellent spot for a long-range kill.
string: 在陽臺對面有道矮護牆，那會是進行遠端射殺的好地方。

original: I left something there for you. If you're inclined to take that approach.
string: 我在那裡留了東西給你。如果你想試試這手段就用吧。

original: What's the matter, Listener? Night Mother not feeling very chatty these days? You need help from your flesh and blood lessers?
string: 怎麼了，聆聽者？夜母最近不想說話嗎？你需要活生生的小惡靈幫助嗎？

original: You've got to track a man, kill him, and then frame him for a crime. This contract's perfect... for me. Clearly, my lovely wife made a mistake.
string: 你得跟蹤一個人，宰了他，再替他安上罪名。這個契約對我來說……確實完美。很顯然，我可愛的妻子犯了個錯誤。

original: Astrid had me investigate the Penitus Oculatus. Their members are highly trained, effective warriors. Be on your guard, brother.
string: 阿斯垂德要我調查洞察之眼。他們的成員都是訓練有素的戰士。小心提防，兄弟。

original: Astrid had me investigate the Penitus Oculatus. Their members are highly trained, effective warriors. Be on your guard, sister.
string: 阿斯垂德要我調查洞察之眼。他們的成員都是訓練有素的戰士。小心提防，姐妹。

original: Killing Gaius Maro in a city will be challenging because of all the guards, but fights, even murder, are fairly common.
string: 在城裡殺加留斯．馬洛會挺困難，因為護衛眾多，但打架，甚至謀殺，都是很常見的。

original: Killing him secretly will certainly make things easier on you, but if there are witnesses, so be it.
string: 若能暗地理解決他肯定會讓事情變簡單一些，但如果被人看到了，也不會有什麼大問題。

original: Normally I talk to a victim before I end his life, but I wouldn't recommend it this time. Maro will be alert to danger. Talking may spook him.
string: 通常我會在殺死目標前和他交談，但這次我不建議你這麼做。馬洛對危險的警覺性很高，和他講話可能會打草驚蛇。

original: I've taken the liberty of visiting the cities, and spreading some nasty rumors about Gaius Maro. To make his treachery that much more believable.
string: 我這邊也會去造訪一些城市，散佈關於加留斯．馬洛的惡毒流言，提高他的叛變的可信度。

original: Remember, your target is Gaius Maro, the son. Not Commander Maro, the father! We need him alive. But the son... Ha! Scorch his face off!
string: 記住，你的目標是加留斯．馬洛，那個兒子；不是指揮官馬洛，那個父親！我們要父親好好活著，至於兒子嘛……哈！燒焦他的臉！

original: Yes, do not underestimate Cicero. A man like that, small and foolish, is easy to mock. To underestimate. Don't make the same mistake I did.
string: 是的，別小看西塞羅。像那樣的人，矮小愚蠢，很容易嘲弄，容易輕視。別犯和我一樣的錯誤。

original: Any thoughts on the current situation?
string: 對目前狀況有什麼想法？

original: Going after Cicero now would be a fool's errand. That little jester is currently being digested in Arnbjorn's stomach, mark my words.
string: 追殺西塞羅只會是傻瓜的小差事。你聽著，那小丑現在肯定在艾恩喬恩的肚子裡被消化著呢。

original: Any thoughts on the current situation?
string: 對目前狀況有什麼想法？

original: Cicero destroyed any sympathy I may have had for him when he wounded Veezara. Kill the fool and be done with it.
string: 當西塞羅弄傷維薩拉的時候，我對他僅有的一點同情也消失殆盡了。殺了那蠢貨結束這一切吧。

original: Any thoughts on the current situation?
string: 對目前狀況有什麼想法？

original: All right, so maybe I was wrong. Maybe Cicero coming here wasn't the best thing that could have happened. But even I didn't anticipate this.
string: 好吧，說不定我錯了。說不定西塞羅的到來根本不是好事，不過就連我也沒預料到他會搞出這種大事。

original: Well, you know the old saying. When life gives you lemons...
string: 你懂的，俗話說得好，當生命給你檸檬的時候……

original: ...go murder a clown.
string: ……去殺個小丑。

original: Any thoughts on the current situation?
string: 對目前狀況有什麼想法？

original: I feel only pity for Cicero. He must die, of course, but can any of us truly blame him for his actions? We mocked him, disrespected the Old Ways.
string: 對西塞羅，我只感到遺憾。他一定得死，這是當然的，但我們之中，誰又真的可以責怪他的行為？我們只知道嘲笑他，我們侮辱了古法。

original: Our actions were shameful. Surely, the Night Mother weeps this day.
string: 我們的行為讓人羞愧，夜母今天肯定落淚了。

original: Any thoughts on the current situation?
string: 對目前狀況有什麼想法？

original: The last thing you need is my help. Listener or not, you've proven yourself time and again. To Astrid, to the Family... and to me.
string: 你最不需要的就是我的幫助。無論你是不是聆聽者，你已經多次證實了你的實力——對阿斯垂德、對家族，還有……對我。

original: Hmm... Well, assuming this Gourmet is just a cook, it will probably be an easy kill. Just be discreet - alerting others will be the real threat.
string: 嗯……如果這個美食家只是個廚子，那殺他應該不難。只要記得小心謹慎就好，驚動他人就麻煩了。

original: Hmph. I wouldn't worry too much about this Virane giving you the information you need. Give him a good scare, and he'll squawk like a Hagraven.
string: 哼，我不擔心這個維拉尼，他一定會給你情報。好好嚇嚇他，他準像個烏鴉鬼婆一樣嘰嘰喳喳全盤吐出。

original: That said... If your attack on Virane is witnessed, those Markarth guards are going to be none too happy...
string: 不過話說回來……如果你傷害維拉尼被人看到了，那些馬卡斯衛兵也不會太高興的……

original: Yes - don't kill the Gourmet!
string: 是的，別殺美食家！

original: Oh, I know you have to, but it makes me sad all the same. I love the Gourmet's recipes. The world will soon be a blander, less flavorful place.
string: 哦，我知道你必須這麼做，只是我有點感傷。我愛吃美食家的菜，這世界很快要變成平淡無味之地了。

original: You've been directed to dispose of the Gourmet's body, is that correct? I often find water to be a suitable hiding place. A lake, a pool... the sea.
string: 你授命處理掉美食家的屍體，對嗎？我一直覺得有水的地方不錯。湖泊啦，池塘啦……或者海洋。

original: Believe it or not, Festus likes you. He senses your power, your potential. Follow his instructions to the letter, and you may even earn his respect.
string: 信不信由你，菲斯圖斯欣賞你。他感受到你的力量、你的潛力。嚴格聽從他的指揮，你或許能得到他的敬重。

original: You get to kill the Emperor. The bloody Emperor. You'd better enjoy this one. You owe us all that much. So make it bloody, painful, and spectacular.
string: 你要殺了皇帝，那個天殺的皇帝。你最好享受這次殺戮。你欠我們很多，所以務必讓那個皇帝死得痛苦、壯觀、血腥。

original: Yes. You're killing the Emperor himself. The Dark Brotherhood will get one shot at this, and you've been given the honors. So don't screw up.
string: 是的，你要確實殺皇帝本人。黑暗兄弟會難得有這一次機會，而你被授予這個榮耀。別搞砸了。

original: Don't take any chances with this one. Use the Jarrin Root to poison the Emperor's food. You're disguising yourself as a chef - it only makes sense.
string: 別想靠運氣。確實地用加林根在皇帝的食物下毒吧。你要偽裝成廚師，這樣才合情理。

original: Well... While it's true I prefer sorcery's more destructive nuances, we mustn't forget the many spells with simpler, more practical applications.
string: 好吧……沒錯，我確實比較喜歡魔法，因為它更具破壞性，但我們不能忘了還是有很多簡單實用的咒語。

original: Sure, you poison the Emperor, but what then? Why not summon an Atronach to cause some chaos? Or turn invisible and slip away. Use your imagination!
string: 是啦，給皇帝下毒，然後呢？為什麼不召喚某個元素搞破壞？或者變隱形遁逃？發揮你的想像力！

original: What an honor, the assassination of an Emperor. And all because you are the Listener, favored by the Night Mother, anointed by Sithis.
string: 多麼高的榮耀，被指派去暗殺皇帝。因為你是聆聽者，所以受夜母偏愛，被西帝斯欽點。

original: I am so very happy for you. If not a bit... envious.
string: 我真為你高興，但或許也有點……忌妒。

original: Astrid has arranged for your escape, no? Then you have nothing to worry about. Get in, kill the Emperor, and get out. Then, we celebrate.
string: 阿斯垂德已經幫你安排好撤退對策了，不是嗎？那你就沒什麼好怕的啦。潛入，殺了皇帝，逃出。然後，大肆慶祝。

original: It took all the favors, bribes, and blackmails I could muster, but I've secured your exit out of the keep.
string: 特權、賄賂、恐嚇信，能用的手段都用了，終於替你找到逃出城堡的退路。

original: Just follow my instructions, and the Dark Brotherhood will be back on top. All thanks to you... Listener.
string: 只要聽從我的指示，黑暗兄弟會一定能再度崛起。這一切都是你的功勞……聆聽者。

original: Anything else before I set off?
string: 在我離開之前還有什麼事嗎？

original: The leader of <Alias=Dungeon> is dead.
string: <Alias=Dungeon>的領袖死了。

original: I'm impressed. Forsworn usually make short work of mercenaries, but you took care of them. Here is your reward.
string: 我很驚訝。棄誓者通常都會除掉傭兵的，但你搞定了他們。這是你的獎勵。

original: I can't do that right now.
string: 我現在不能那樣做。

original: Then leave.
string: 那走吧。

original: It will be done.
string: 如您所願。

original: We will see.
string: 我們拭目以待。

original: You're the Jarl? I'm looking for work.
string: 你是領主？我需要工作。

original: Are you a sellsword? I don't like your kind. No honor. No loyalty. Unreliable.
string: 你是個傭兵？我不喜歡你們。沒有榮譽感，不忠誠，不可信賴。

original: But I can't turn away a potential ally in these times. Let's see if you're better than a common mercenary.
string: 但在這種時期，我不能趕走可能的盟友。讓我們看看你是否比一般傭兵出色。

original: My scouts have tracked down one of the Forsworn leaders, hiding out in their blood-soaked camps. Deal with them.
string: 我的偵察兵已經找到其中一位棄誓者領袖的行蹤，他藏在他們沾滿鮮血的營帳裡。除掉他們。

original: You're the chief?
string: 你是酋長？

original: Yes. I earned the right by slaying my father in single combat.
string: 是的。我一擊擊斃我的父親，贏得這個權位。
