string: 你應該好好磨練你的龍吼，很快你眼前的路就會清晰了。

original: The Voice was a gift of the goddess Kynareth, at the dawn of time. She gave mortals the ability to speak as dragons do.
string: 龍吼是先古時期凱娜瑞絲女神的禮物。她給予了凡人像龍一樣說話的能力。

original: Although this gift has often been misused, the only true use of the Voice is for the worship and glory of the gods.
string: 雖然這個能力經常被濫用，但是它唯一的真正用途，是崇拜和榮耀諸神。

original: True mastery of the Voice can only be achieved when your inner spirit is in harmony with your outward actions.
string: 只有內外兼修，你才能發揮龍吼的真正實力。

original: In the contemplation of the sky, Kynareth's domain, and the practice of the Voice, we strive to achieve this balance.
string: 我們凝視天空，也就是凱娜瑞絲的領域，並練習龍吼，努力在兩者之間取得平衡。

original: We study the Way of the Voice, according to the teachings of our founder, Jurgen Windcaller.
string: 我們遵循創始人約根．喚風的教導，學習龍吼之道。

original: Very few are permitted to study with us here at High Hrothgar.
string: 只有少數人可以在高吼峰，和我們一起學習。

original: But in your case, Dragonborn, it is a privilege to guide you towards mastery of your Voice.
string: 但對於你，龍裔，引領你精通龍吼是種榮幸。

original: Sky above, Voice within.
string: 蒼天在上，龍吼在心。

original: Exactly. Nobody even remembers our name these days.
string: 正是。現在根本沒人記得我們叫什麼了。

original: We used to be known across Tamriel as the protectors of the Septim Emperors. Those days are long gone, though.
string: 我們曾是塞普汀歷任皇帝的保護者，在泰姆瑞爾廣為人知。然而那些日子，早已一去不復返。

original: For the last two hundred years, we've been searching for the next Dragonborn to guide and guard, as we are sworn to do.
string: 兩百年來，我們一直在找尋下一代龍裔，予以引導和保護，這是我們的誓言。

original: But we never found one. Until now.
string: 但我們一直沒找到。直到現在。

original: The faction that rules the Aldmeri Dominion. The ones who almost destroyed the Empire during the Great War, thirty years back.
string: 統治先祖神洲的那幫人；在三十年前的浩大戰爭中，差點毀滅帝國的那群人。

original: There's no worse enemy to humankind in Tamriel. The Empire barely survived the last war. The Thalmor don't intend to lose the next one.
string: 他們是人類在泰姆瑞爾所遭遇最可怖的敵人，帝國差點在上次的戰爭中滅亡，梭默可不打算再輸一次。

original: I'm very dangerous! Don't make me come out there and hurt you!
string: 我很危險！別逼我出去傷害你！

original: I'm not opening this door, so you might as well leave me alone.
string: 我不會開門的，你還是別理我的好。

original: If my friends find out you've been bothering me, you'll be very sorry!
string: 如果我的朋友發現你打擾過我，你不會有好下場的！

original: Go away!
string: 走開！

original: This one's mine.
string: 這是我的。

original: Wind guide you.
string: 願風指引你。

original: Sky guard you.
string: 天空指引你。

original: Hush, Salma. We aren't alone.
string: 安靜，薩爾瑪。有人。

original: Treasure, that's what! Get off your scaly rump and let's go.
string: 寶藏，一定是寶藏！挪挪你那該死的屁股，我們走。

original: We must gather our strength. Who knows what's inside?
string: 我們必須同心協力。誰知道裡面有什麼？

original: How can you just sit here and wait? We should be in there!
string: 你怎能呆呆等在這裡呢？我們應該要進去！

original: When can I meet your leader, Paarthurnax?
string: 我何時才能見你們的首領——帕圖納克斯？

original: As I said, you will know you are ready when your Voice can open the path to him.
string: 我說過，當你的龍吼能打開通往他的道路時，代表你準備好了。

original: There are only four of you?
string: 只有你們四個？

original: Five. Our leader, Paarthurnax, lives alone on the peak of the Throat of the World.
string: 五個。我們的首領，帕圖納克斯，獨自居住在世界咽喉的山峰上。

original: When your Voice can open the path, you will know you are ready to speak to him.
string: 當你的龍吼可以打開道路，你就準備好與他對話了。

original: Why don't the others talk?
string: 其他人怎麼不說話？

original: Their Voices are too powerful for anyone not trained in the Way to withstand. Even a whisper could kill you.
string: 他們的龍吼對那些沒有學過龍吼之道的人來說太過強大了。即使是低語也能要你的命。

original: Approach Master Borri and he will gift you his knowledge of "Wuld."
string: 到博瑞大師身邊去吧，他會教授你「戊」的知識。

original: Approach Master Borri and he will gift you his knowledge of "Nah."
string: 到博瑞大師身邊去吧，他會教授你「吶」的知識。

original: Approach Master Borri and he will gift you his knowledge of "Kest."
string: 到博瑞大師身邊去吧，他會教授你「凱斯」的知識。

original: Why are Shouts in the dragon language?
string: 為何龍吼用的是龍語？

original: Dragons have always been able to Shout. Language is intrinsic to their very being.
string: 龍一向有吼叫的本領，而語言是他們的本質。

original: There is no difference in the dragon tongue between debating and fighting. Shouting comes as naturally to a dragon as breathing, or speaking.
string: 龍爭論與搏鬥時的發聲方法並無二致。對於龍來說，吼叫跟呼吸講話一般平常。

original: In mythic times, when mortalkind was in great need, the goddess Kynareth granted us the ability to speak as dragons do.
string: 神話時期，在人類的緊要關頭之際，凱娜瑞絲女神許以我們說龍語的能力。

original: For most people, long years of training are required to learn even the simplest Shout.
string: 對大多數人來說，就算要發出最簡單的龍吼也需常年訓練。

original: But for you, the dragon speech is in your blood, and you learn it almost without effort.
string: 但就你而言，你的能力與生俱來，學習它不費吹灰之力。

original: When you Shout, you speak in the language of dragons. Thus, your Dragon Blood gives you an inborn ability to learn Words of Power.
string: 當你吼叫時，你發出的就是龍語。你的龍族血脈給了你學習力量之語的先天能力。

original: You've planned this from the beginning.
string: 你一開始就計劃好了。

original: If we want to stay on top in Skyrim, the Guild needs that paragon back.
string: 如果我們想保住在天際省的領導地位，公會就必須拿回典藏品。

original: Without it, we're just a bunch of petty thieves.
string: 若非如此，我們就只是一群不成氣候的小毛賊。

original: You mean wealth?
string: 你是指財富？

original: Not exactly. The crown is what the Guild calls a paragon; an object that enhances our thieving abilities.
string: 不全是。公會將那頂王冠稱為典藏品；一個能夠增強我們偷盜能力的東西。

original: At least, that's what I'm told it does... there hasn't been a paragon in this Guild for hundreds of years.
string: 至少，我是這麼聽說的……數百年以來，我們的公會一直沒有任何典藏品。

original: Tell me what this gem's worth.
string: 告訴我這寶石值多少。

original: Do I look like a merchant to you? You're going to have to take that up with Vex in the Thieves Guild.
string: 我看起來像商人嗎？你得去問盜賊公會的「小煩」。

original: Get in good with them and you'll find her.
string: 跟他們打好關係，你就能找到她。

original: The name's Maul; I watch the streets for the Black-Briars. If you need dirt on anything, I'm your guy.
string: 我叫摩爾，替黑棘看守街道。如果你需要倒賣物品，找我就對了。

original: Got any dirt on this? (Show unusual gem)
string: 這東西值多少？（展示不尋常的寶石）

original: Only way you could have found one of those is by stealin' it. Guess you'll fit in around here better than I thought.
string: 要弄到這玩意兒，你只能用偷的。看來你混得比我想像的要好。

original: So what do you want to know?
string: 所以你想知道什麼？

original: Walk always in the shadow of Sithis.
string: 願永行於西帝斯的陰影。

original: May the shroud of death embrace you.
string: 願死亡之幕擁抱你。

original: Darkness guide you.
string: 願黑暗指引你。

original: Burn that little jester alive.
string: 燒死這個小丑。

original: Remember, fireballs. You can never go wrong.
string: 記住，用火球。只要用了火球一切沒問題。

original: Go, incinerate some poor bastard for me.
string: 去吧，替我燒了那些可憐蟲。

original: Yeah, yeah. Goodbye, kill lots of people, Hail Sithis, and all that.
string: 好啊，好啊。再見，多殺點人，西帝斯萬歲。

original: Go. Do what has to be done.
string: 去吧。該做什麼就做吧。

original: Have fun!
string: 玩得開心！

original: Can't wait to hear all about the next person you murder.
string: 等不及聽到你再殺一人的消息。

original: Have a good contract.
string: 工作愉快。

original: Kill well, and often.
string: 殺個痛快。

original: Just come back alive, and I'll be happy.
string: 只要活著回來，我就很高興了。

original: Go on now. Time to get your hands bloody.
string: 去吧，讓鮮血染紅你的雙手吧。

original: Take care of yourself, beef roast.
string: 照顧好你自己，烤牛排。

original: Later, ham hock.
string: 後會有期，火腿。

original: Yeah, good luck.
string: 祝你好運。

original: Represent us well, brother.
string: 好好代表我們，兄弟。

original: Represent us well, sister.
string: 好好代表我們，姐妹。

original: Remember, when you kill - we all wield the blade.
string: 記住，你殺人——就是我們在殺人。

original: Watch yourself out there.
string: 在那裡小心點。

original: Cicero bids you... farewell.
string: 西塞羅向你……道別。

original: Oh, yes. Goodbye, goodbye.
string: 哦，好。再見，再見。

original: Farewell, farewell!
string: 再會，再會！

original: Until next time, brother.
string: 後會有期，兄弟。

original: Until next time, sister.
string: 後會有期，姐妹。

original: Kill well. And often.
string: 殺個痛快。

original: Right, then.
string: 那麼好吧。

original: Stay safe.
string: 注意安全。

original: Can you tell me more about Wards?
string: 你能再多告訴我一些有關結界的事嗎？

original: The key to wards is that they take time to charge.
string: 結界的關鍵是它們需要準備時間。

original: Not long, but you can't start casting with a fireball coming at you.
string: 不用很久，但你不能等到火球朝你飛過來才施放。

original: Also, if your ward isn't negated by an incoming spell, it will recharge itself after a moment or two.
string: 另外，即使你的結界沒有被敵人的咒語擊破，一段時間後也會重新充能。

original: Just be careful. Casting wards requires constant concentration, and you can easily find yourself drained of your magicka reserves.
string: 總之，務必小心。施放結界需要持續專注，你不難發現法力儲備很快就會被耗盡。

original: Please, follow me. I'll escort you inside the College.
string: 請跟我來，讓我護送你進入學院。

original: You do indeed have the power. I'm impressed.
string: 你的確擁有那種能力，我印象深刻。

original: I am Dragonborn. Now let me pass!
string: 我是龍裔。快讓我過去！

original: So you have the Voice, then? I would be quite impressed to see that.
string: 這麼說你擁有龍吼的力量？何不讓我開開眼界？

original: It does, and I can prove it.
string: 是的，而且我能證明。

original: Can you? You have the power of the Voice? Now I'm interested.
string: 你能嗎？你擁有龍吼的力量？我很感興趣。

original: By all means, show me.
string: 請務必讓我開開眼界。

original: This is important. It's about the dragons.
string: 這很重要。和龍有關。

original: Dragons, is it? Does that make you the fabled "Dragonborn" we've heard mention of?
string: 龍？那能證明你是傳說中的「龍裔」嗎？

original: You were just going to prove that you're Dragonborn.
string: 你得證明自己是龍裔。

original: Please, allow me access.
string: 請讓我過去。

original: You must first prove your worth, and then I shall lead you across.
string: 你先得證明自己，我才能領你過去。

original: You risk death by doing so, and you shall not gain entry.
string: 你這麼做有可能害自己送命。而且你也進不去。

original: Do not cross the bridge unaided!
string: 不准獨自過橋！

original: Summoning undead isn't frowned upon?
string: 召喚亡靈在這裡沒問題嗎？

original: By Sheor, no. Those archaic policies died out with the Mages Guild, and were never enforced here.
string: 以舒奧爾的名義，沒問題。那些古老的政策隨著法師公會一起逐漸消失了，我們這裡也沒有執行過。

original: Necromancy, as any other type of magic, is a tool to be used.
string: 死靈法術，就像其他任何魔法一樣，是一種工具。

original: Of course, non-mages may not see it that way, so we don't go around flaunting it.
string: 當然，不是法師的人可能不這麼認為，所以我們不會去四處宣揚。

original: If you require assistance with summoning techniques, please let me know.
string: 如果你在召喚術方面需要幫助，請通知我。

original: If you would, please also contain your summons to the College grounds. The locals do not need to be agitated further by Atronachs roaming their town.
string: 如果你打算召喚，請在學院中進行就好。不要讓精靈在城中出現，引起當地人的不安。

original: The summoning of undead is even less advisable outside of the College.
string: 在學院外召喚亡靈不是明智之舉。

original: This is quite an impressive library.
string: 這圖書館真壯觀。

original: A mage is only as good as what he knows. I try and make sure as much knowledge is available as possible.
string: 一名法師只擅長他所知的領域。我盡力確保人們在這裡能得到更多的知識。

original: We've been keeping this collection since the Second Era. Books have come and gone during that time, but it's mostly intact.
string: 自從第二紀元以來我們就存有這些收藏。很多書在那段時期來來去去，但好在大部分都沒有受損。

original: You take your work very seriously.
string: 你對你的工作相當嚴謹。

original: Of course I do. If I didn't, most of these books would've been burned to ashes or dissolved to nothing before the Third Era.
string: 當然。若非如此，這些書籍大多在第三紀元前就化為灰燼了。

original: Mages need to be reminded to be careful around research materials.
string: 法師必須時時刻刻重視研究材料。

original: You are now in the Arcanaeum, of which I am in charge. It might as well be my own little plane of Oblivion.
string: 你現在身處秘藏館，這裡由我掌管。你可以把這裡視為是屬於我個人的湮滅之境。

original: Disrupt my Arcanaeum, and I will have you torn apart by angry Atronachs.
string: 如果你膽敢破壞我的秘藏館，我會讓憤怒的元素把你撕成碎片。

original: Now, do you require assistance?
string: 所以，你需要幫助嗎？

original: So you're treated badly because of your work?
string: 這麼說你因工作遭到惡劣對待？

original: Well... No. Not really. Not directly, I mean.
string: 嗯……不。不能完全這麼說。我是說，這不是直接原因。

original: But I know things are said behind my back. Conversations cease when I enter rooms.
string: 但我知道有人在我背後說一些事。我一進房間議論就停止了。

original: I'm quite aware of what's going on here, and I will not stand for it!
string: 我很清楚這裡發生了什麼，我絕不會容忍！

original: I don't understand.
string: 我不明白。

original: It's quite simple really. There are some who shall not be dignified by being named, who have implied that it is not.
string: 其實很簡單。有些人——就不說名字了——不覺得如此。

original: That is to say, it's been suggested that resources used for my study of Restoration could be put to better use. Any other use, in fact.
string: 也就是說，有人在背後建議將我用以研究恢復系的資源重新分配。做什麼都可以，只要不是用在恢復系上就行。

original: It's not just healing cuts and bruises, you know. The undead are a very real, very dangerous threat and Restoration magics can keep them at bay.
string: 恢復系不僅僅是用來癒合傷口那麼簡單。不死生物是實實在在的威脅，而恢復系法術能把他們困住。

original: Not to mention the benefit of wards! How can they continually overlook wards! It's baffling!
string: 更不用說結界術的好處了！他們怎能長期輕視結界術的作用！真令人喪氣！

original: Not really.
string: 那倒未必。

original: I... I see.
string: 我……我明白了。

original: Well, I'm glad we've established this early, rather than me hearing about it years or decades later when the whispers behind my back are loud enough.
string: 嗯，很高興我們及早把話講明。總比我繼續任憑人在背後指指點點，之後發現從交頭接耳變成公開談論來得好。

original: Of course it's valid.
string: 那當然。

original: Good, good.
string: 好，很好。

original: Not that I require validation, of course. There are just some - and I shan't name names - who would disagree.
string: 當然，我不是在尋求認可。只是，確實有人不同意我的看法——我就不說名字了。

original: It can make life difficult when one's colleagues fail to recognize the research one engages in.
string: 當你的同事不能意識到你的研究有什麼重要性時，日子就難過了。

original: You consider Restoration a valid school of magic, worthy of study, don't you? Don't you?
string: 你認為恢復系是一個正式的魔法學派，值得研究，不是嗎？不是嗎？

original: Winterhold used to be full of dark elves?
string: 暗精靈們曾在冬堡裡隨處可見？

original: Didn't you know?
string: 你不知道嗎？

original: Before the Oblivion Crisis, many elves called Winterhold their home. More visited the College from Morrowind every year.
string: 在湮滅危機前，許多精靈把冬堡視為他們的家。每年學院來自晨風的訪客比如今多得多。

original: After, growing distrust of magic made life difficult for many. Some left rather than endure the growing hatred from the local Nords.
string: 後來，人們對於魔法的懷疑與日俱增，讓許多精靈難以謀生。有些因為無法承受本地諾德人的怨恨日益高漲，於是選擇離開。

original: Others returned home after the Red Year, when Vvardenfell erupted and caused much destruction.
string: 其他的則在紅色之年後回到了各自的家鄉。那一年瓦登費爾火山爆發，造成了很大的破壞。

original: Winterhold itself died in the years between then and now. What's left out there is a husk. Only the College really remains.
string: 事到如今冬堡已成了一座死城。徒有其表。只有學院還在。

original: We haven't really been introduced.
string: 我們還沒被正式引薦給彼此呢。

original: No, I suppose we haven't. Brelyna Maryon, of House Telvanni. First of my family to leave Morrowind in a long time.
string: 對，我想是的。我是泰爾瓦尼家族的布萊麗娜．瑪約。是多年來我們家族第一個離開晨風的成員。

original: Now I'm here to study Conjuration. That's what's important.
string: 眼下我在這裡學習召喚系法術。這才是正經事。

original: I'm sorry, what?
string: 抱歉，你說什麼？

original: I've just been asked enough questions. I'm here to learn, not to explain myself over and over.
string: 我已經被問了夠多問題了。我是來學習的，不是來講自己的故事的。

original: Forgive me, I didn't mean to assume.
string: 請原諒，我不是刻意在裝模作樣的。

original: The research I've done seems to indicate that Skorm Snow-Strider left part of his journal here after laying siege.
string: 我的研究有跡象表明，圍攻後斯科姆．雪步將他的一部分日記留在了這裡。

original: I believe it should indicate how to enter the blocked off sections of the stronghold.
string: 我認為其中記載了進入城寨封閉區域的方法。

original: I should warn you, Forelhost is quite haunted, but I'm sure you can handle it. Return to me here once you've obtained the staff.
string: 我得警告你，皮紙主人鬧鬼很嚴重，但我相信你能對付。拿到法杖後就立即回我這來。

original: Me? No, I'm too important to the war effort to risk life and limb in there... Besides, that's what I'm paying you for.
string: 我？不，我對戰爭工作十分重要，不能冒生命危險去那裡……再說，是我付你錢。

original: It seems that after the strength of the Cult was broken in the Dragon War a last contingent came here to create a stronghold and regroup.

original: And for their bloody sacrifices, the Dragons gifted their priests with terrible power.

string: 好，好。來了一塊生肉。哦，我美麗的妻子把你的一切都跟我說了。

string: 畢竟我還需要點時間接受「或許我們還有希望」這個想法。

string: 為何梭默這麼想找到你？

string: 我找到伊思本了。他躲在鼠道中。

string: 墨索爾城這有什麼麻煩嗎？

string: 人們對自己不瞭解的東西會不安，甚至恐懼。這個在預料之中。

string: 一些人害怕我們新來的法師。隨著他們對他的瞭解逐步加深，就會接納他了。

string: 我找到你的頭盔了。

original: Sorry to hear that.
string: 真叫人感到遺憾。

original: Well, I never claimed otherwise.
string: 否則我就不會這麼說了。

original: That's a terrible story.
string: 真是個悲慘的故事。

original: Pfft. Ungrateful milk drinker.
string: 呸，忘恩負義的小鬼。

original: Watch your words next time.
string: 下次說話注意點。

original: Well, aren't you sweet? I'd be happy to give you some alchemy training in exchange for the ring, if you bring it to me.
string: 啊，你真好。只要你把指環帶回來，我很樂意提供一些鍊金術訓練作為交換。

original: I could find that ring for you.
string: 我能替你找回指環。

original: Blessing of Arkay to you for your help.
string: 願阿爾凱保佑你，感謝你的幫助。

original: I'll do it.
string: 我做。

original: Oh, you could? I sure would love to have it again. Could show you some of my old scouting tricks.
string: 哦，真的？若能失而復得我當然高興。我會教你幾招偵查技巧。

original: What if I could find that helmet for you?
string: 如果我替你把頭盔找回來呢？

original: According to my grandfather at least. He swore that version of the legend was true, even found the cave old Lenne stumbled into.
string: 至少我爺爺是這麼說的。他發誓那個傳說是真的，甚至還找到了老萊內無意中發現的洞穴。

original: Hey, if you find it, I could show you some of the clan's favorite fighting moves. They're all shield techniques.
string: 嘿，如果你找到了，我就教你幾種我們氏族最愛用的招式。都是使盾的技巧。

original: Your ancestral shield is lost in a cave?
string: 你祖傳的盾牌失落在一個洞穴當中？

original: Jarl wants it to look like an ancient blade. High Queen Freydis ruled over Windhelm in the Second Era, and her sword was legendary.
string: 領主想讓它看起來像一把古劍。至高女王芙瑞迪絲在第二紀元期間統治風舵城，她有一把傳奇之劍。

original: Getting the real sword would be even better than making a copy, but no one wants to risk getting it from its resting place.
string: 如果能拿到原物自然要比重製一把好，但沒人有膽子去將其取回。

original: If you find that sword, traveler, I'd be grateful.
string: 如果你能找到那把劍，旅行者，我會感激不盡。

original: What's special about this sword?
string: 這把劍有什麼特別之處？

original: My husband. We used to go out in the wilds and collect ingredients together. He used to call me his "pretty Juniper."
string: 是因為我的丈夫。我們以前經常一道去野外收集材料。他從前都叫我「美麗的刺柏」。

original: It's quite romantic, if you're an alchemist. Frost took the old fool a few seasons back, while he was looking for the Ring of Pure Mixtures.
string: 如果你是一位鍊金術士，自能領會其中的浪漫。幾個季節前，當我的老伴外出找尋純淨混合物指環時，寒冷的天氣奪走了他的性命。

original: I found the ring's resting place after he died, but I'm far too old to go exploring some cave, now.
string: 他死後，我查到了指環的下落，但我現在上了年紀，沒法去探索洞穴了。

original: How'd you pick up the herb trade?
string: 你怎麼會選擇做藥草生意？

original: I am. I came into Arkay's light after the Great War. So many died by my hands, my magics.
string: 是的是的。浩大戰爭之時我就開始追隨阿爾凱，我已經殺死了很多人，用我的魔法。

original: I'm fortunate that Kust and the people of Falkreath have come to accept me as one of their own.
string: 很幸運卡斯特和佛克瑞斯的人民接納我成為了他們的一員。

original: Could you do an old elf a favor? I misplaced my journal in a cave I was exploring. I'll pay for its return.
string: 你能幫老精靈一個忙嗎？我探險時把一本日記掉在洞中了。把它帶回來，我會報答你的。

original: You're a priest of Arkay?
string: 你是阿爾凱的祭司？

original: I was the finest scout in the Legion, once. Tracked down all the places in the wilds that were causing people trouble.
string: 我曾是軍團裡最出色的斥候。足跡遍佈所有帶給人麻煩的荒郊野嶺。

original: Lost my helmet in one of the old caves. My pretty, pretty helmet. Life just got worse after that. Kept losing things. So many things....
string: 我在一個古老的洞穴裡遺失了頭盔。它很漂亮。從此生活越來越不順。我開始一直失去。失去了很多東西……

original: What's your story, old man?
string: 你有什麼故事，老先生？

original: Yes. I've wandered a bit, but I always come back to Kynesgrove. My clan was one of the first to settle here.
string: 對。我曾去過一些地方，但最終還是回到了凱娜之林。這裡的第一批定居者中，也包括了我的族人。

original: Legend says that my forefather Lenne discovered the mines after he stumbled into a dark cave to relieve himself. Too much mead.
string: 傳說我的祖先萊內有天喝了太多蜂蜜酒，跌跌撞撞地進到一個山洞中醒酒，於是無意間找到了這座礦山。

original: Of course, there's another story of Lenne losing the family shield in a different cave, so it depends on who you believe.
string: 當然，另一個版本的故事說萊內在別的洞穴中遺失了祖傳的盔甲，這就要看你相信誰了。

original: Are you from Kynesgrove?
string: 你是從凱娜之林過來的嗎？

original: Of course I am. What do I look like, a tavern wench?
string: 當然。不然你看我像什麼，酒館的蕩婦嗎？

original: Ah, don't let my words cut you too deep. I've just been working the forge too hard. Trying to set this sword right.
string: 啊，別太在意我的話。我打鐵太辛苦了。正努力把這把劍鍛好。

original: You're the castle blacksmith?
string: 你是城堡的鐵匠嗎？

original: <Alias=Dungeon> is free of bandits.
string: <Alias=Dungeon>已從盜賊手中解放。

original: That's a load off my mind. Here's your pay.
string: 我心裡的大石頭落地了。這是你的報酬。

original: You remind me of myself a few years ago. Let me show you a little bit about wearing light armor. It's helped me out whenever I was scouting.
string: 你讓我想起了幾年前的自己。讓我來教你穿輕甲的訣竅。我以前當斥候時這對我很有幫助。

original: Now I've got the itch to travel again. If you're leaving town, I wouldn't mind coming with for a while.
string: 現在我又想去旅行了。如果你要出城，我願與你一塊行動。

original: Now that's good work. Everyone will be a lot safer with them gone, Dark Elf and Nord alike.
string: 做得不錯。趕跑了他們，每個人的安全都更有保障了，無論是暗精靈還是諾德人。

original: Here, some gold as promised, and let me show you a bit about wearing heavy armor. Save you some aches on a long march.
string: 拿去，這是說好的金幣，讓我來教你如何穿重甲。這能減輕你長途跋涉的痛苦。

original: Forget it.
string: 算了吧。

original: Suit yourself.
string: 隨你便。

original: Fair enough.
string: 有道理。

original: I don't have time right now.
string: 我現在沒時間。

original: Yes. It is.
string: 是。的確。

original: That's too bad.
string: 那真是太糟了。

original: I'll do it.
string: 我會的。

original: Good. I'll have a sack of coin waiting for you when you get back.
string: 很好。事情辦完後來找我，有一大袋錢等著你。

original: This brings back memories. Come back when you're done and maybe I'll be up to showing you a few tricks.
string: 這勾起了我的回憶。你完事後來找我，我會教你幾招。

original: That's a brave offer. I'd be happy to throw in my coin behind that.
string: 這是一個大膽的提議。我很樂意在事後奉上報酬。

original: You deal with them, I'll make sure you get paid. Maybe this old soldier will throw in some lessons as well.
string: 你修理了他們，我不會虧待你的。讓我這個老兵再教你幾課如何？

original: What if I took care of these bandits?
string: 如果我替你處理那幫盜賊呢？

original: I may have accidentally let a prisoner escape. The leader of one of those bandit groups.
string: 我或許不慎讓那個犯人逃走了。他是一個盜賊團夥的首領。

original: I told everyone he died during questioning, and I need you to track him down and make sure he doesn't show up to disprove that.
string: 我跟所有人說他在審訊時身亡了，我要你去追捕他，保證他不會出現，讓事情敗露。

original: What's this problem you have?
string: 你遇到什麼麻煩了？

original: That's right. Used to explore all over. I'm the one who originally found the mine Darkwater Crossing was built around.
string: 沒錯。我的足跡遍佈各處。我就是那個發現黑水岔口附近礦山的人

original: I was actually scouting a bit the other day, old times sake. Spied a brigand heading back to his camp.
string: 其實我之前有跑去附近偵察了一番，老習慣改不掉。我去監視一名返回營地的盜賊首領。

original: Up for a little hunting? My husband is being a sad stick, so I can't go myself.
string: 要不要去狩獵一下呢？我的丈夫性情古怪，不讓我一個人去。

original: You were an adventurer?
string: 妳是一個冒險家？

original: Whenever a group of marauders attack a Nord village, Ulfric is the first to sound the horn and send the men.
string: 只要有諾德村莊遭到掠奪者的襲擊，烏弗瑞克必定是第一個吹響號角派人趕來的。

original: But a group of Dark Elf refugees gets ambushed? A group of Argonians, or a Khajiit caravan? No troops. No investigation. Nothing.
string: 但若是一群暗精靈難民遭到伏擊呢？一群亞龍人、或是虎人商隊？不會有士兵、不會有調查、什麼也不會有。

original: There's a group of cutthroats out there right now that Ulfric doesn't lift a finger to bring to justice, as long as they don't threaten Nord land.
string: 現在這外面有一夥亡命之徒，但只要他們不襲擾諾德人的土地，烏弗瑞克就懶得將他們繩之以法，即使這輕而易舉。

original: Ulfric doesn't care about outsiders?
string: 烏弗瑞克不在乎外鄉人？

original: You wouldn't be a sellsword, would you? I have a little problem you could solve.
string: 你不會剛好是個傭兵吧？我需要你幫忙解決點問題。

original: I used to be an adventurer in my day, then I settled down. Got married.
string: 我年輕時曾是一名冒險家，後來我安頓了下來。結了婚。

original: Fine, then.
string: 那樣啊，好吧。

original: Thank you for asking.
string: 多謝你詢問。

original: You're weak. (Intimidate)
string: 你很弱。（威嚇）

original: I am not weak. Very well, outlander, I will go with you whenever you are ready.
string: 我才不弱。好吧，外地人，你準備好我就跟你一道去。

original: You dare challenge a child of Malacath?
string: 你膽敢挑釁一位瑪拉凱斯之子？

original: You're weak. (Brawl)
string: 你很弱。（打架）

original: What if I pay off your dowry? (<BribeCost> gold)
string: 如果我幫你付嫁妝呢？（賄賂<BribeCost>金幣）

original: That is a fine idea. The stronghold would need the gold when I left to marry, anyway. I am ready when you are.
string: 這主意不錯。不管怎麼說，我出嫁後寨裡總會用得上金幣的。我準備好了。

original: No. That won't be enough.
string: 不。這還不夠。

original: Enough of this! Fight me!
string: 夠了！來跟我決一死戰！

original: So, you reveal yourself!
string: 你露出了馬腳！

original: You can't hide from me!
string: 你躲不過我的!

original: Now you die!
string: 受死吧！

original: There you are!
string: 你在這啊！

original: Ha, found you!
string: 哈，找到你了！

original: No one here now.
string: 這裡沒人。

original: Must've scared 'em off.
string: 定是把他們嚇跑了。

original: Oh come now, resorting to petty tricks are we?
string: 哦拜託，別玩那種小把戲了。

original: A bold but foolish move.
string: 一次有勇無謀的行動。

original: Coward.
string: 懦夫。

original: You cannot escape!
string: 你無處可逃！

original: Where'd you go?
string: 你去哪？

original: Come back here!
string: 回來！

original: Where are you?
string: 你在哪？

original: You can't hide forever!
string: 你躲不了一輩子！

original: You can't get away from me!
string: 你逃不出我的掌心！

original: Show yourself!
string: 快現身！

original: They picked on the wrong old man.
string: 他們惹錯人了。

original: Haven't fought like that in years.
string: 好幾年沒大展身手了。

original: That was fun.
string: 真有趣。

original: Waste of time.
string: 浪費時間。

original: Didn't even work up a sweat.
string: 汗都沒流呢。

original: Pathetic.
string: 可悲。

original: That's what happens when you cross the Guild.
string: 這就是你與公會為敵的後果。

original: I think they got the message.
string: 我想他們收到了風聲。

original: Damn, just as I was getting warmed up.
string: 該死，我才剛剛熱身呢。

original: I hardly felt a thing.
string: 我毫無感覺。

original: And that's why I'm the best.
string: 這就是我最出色的原因。

original: The afterlife will bring you darkness.
string: 死後將只有無邊無際的黑暗等著你。

original: Bless you, Lady of Shadows... I live another day.
string: 讚美妳，暗影女士……我又活過了一天。

original: I send you to your rest.
string: 我會讓你安息。

original: You were no match for a Nightingale.
string: 你不配做夜鶯的對手。

original: Shadows consume you.
string: 暗影會吞噬你。

original: That wasn't a fight, it was an execution.
string: 這算不上對抗，而是場屠殺。

original: So ends the lesson.
string: 做個了斷吧。

original: That was hardly worth my time.
string: 真是浪費我的時間。

original: How disappointing.
string: 真讓人失望。

original: Hmph. Hardly a challenge.
string: 哼。一點挑戰性都沒有。

original: That'll teach you to cross me.
string: 讓你學學如何迎敵。

original: That's the end of that.
string: 結束了。

original: Guess it was nothing after all.
string: 也許沒什麼動靜。

original: I must've been hearing things.
string: 我一定聽到了什麼？

original: You've got moments to live.
string: 你活不了多久了。

original: I'm endin' you right now!
string: 我現在就來了結你！

original: Sure, pick on the old guy!
string: 當然，大家都想先挑老傢伙下手！

original: Come on, I won't bite.
string: 拜託，我又不會咬人。

original: Let's get this party started.
string: 開始狂歡吧。

original: Been itching for a fight.
string: 不戰鬥我手都癢了。

original: I promise a swift but painful end!
string: 我會給你個痛快！

original: No mercy for the weak!
string: 對弱者絕不留情！

original: I'll give no quarter!
string: 我不會留情的！

original: So, it's to the pain then!
string: 這下會夠你受的！

original: Ah good, I could use some practice!
string: 好啊，我有機會練習一下了！

original: I'll tear you apart!
string: 我會把你大卸八塊！

original: The burden of death approaches!
string: 死亡的腳步臨近了！

original: Come, taste darkness's embrace!
string: 來吧，嘗嘗被黑暗擁抱的滋味

original: Your life is forfeit!
string: 你不會活下去了。

original: I bring death from the shadows!
string: 我是暗影中的死神。

original: By Nocturnal's grace, I will defeat you!
string: 借助諾克圖娜爾之力，我會擊敗你。

original: I'll bury my blade in your heart!
string: 我會將利刃插入你的心臟。

original: Your death will be my triumph!
string: 你死亡之日就是我勝利之時。

original: You're not a threat... merely an annoyance.
string: 你毫無威脅……只是一隻惱人的蒼蠅。

original: You've just written your own epitaph.
string: 你這下自掘墳墓了。

original: Your blood will adorn my blade!
string: 你的鮮血會讓我的利刃增色。

original: This shouldn't take long.
string: 這不會太久的。

original: So, it begins.
string: 開始了。

original: Where'd you come from?
string: 你從哪來？

original: Hey!
string: 嘿！

original: Talos smite you!
string: 塔洛斯詛咒你！

original: Sovngarde awaits!
string: 英靈殿在召喚我！

original: This should be fun!
string: 這會很有趣的！

original: For the Emperor!
string: 為了皇帝！

original: Die villain!
string: 死吧，惡賊！

original: I'll enjoy killing you!
string: 我會享受殺你的過程的。

original: Time to fight!
string: 戰鬥的時候到了！

original: Finally! Let's end this.
string: 終於！我們來做個了結吧。

original: There you are!
string: 你在這裡啊！

original: Your feeble attempt to hide is insulting!
string: 你東躲西藏是對我的侮辱!

original: You can't hide from me!
string: 你躲不過我的!

original: Enough games, let's end this!
string: 夠了，我們來做個了結吧！

original: Come coward, now we fight!
string: 來啊懦夫，我們決鬥吧！

original: I knew I heard something!
string: 我就知道聽到了什麼！

original: Now you're mine!
string: 你的命是我的了！

original: Hm? Something's near...
string: 嗯？有東西在靠近……

original: Wait, I hear something...
string: 等等，我聽見了什麼……

original: I heard something.
string: 我聽到有動靜。

original: Who's there?
string: 誰在那裡？

original: What was that?
string: 搞什麼？

original: I'll find you... it's only a matter of time.
string: 我會找到你……這只是時間問題。

original: Coward. Come out and fight me!
string: 懦夫。出來應戰！

original: Come on, show yourself!
string: 來吧，快現身！

original: I'm going to find you...
string: 我會找到你的……

original: I don't have time for this.
string: 我沒時間玩遊戲。

original: There's no need to hide. I won't hurt you.
string: 不用躲。我不會傷害你。

original: Come out and face me, you coward!
string: 出來面對我，你這懦夫！

original: I can smell your fear.
string: 我能嗅到你的恐懼。

original: I can hear your heart beating.
string: 我能聽見你的心跳。

original: Hiding? The shadows are my domain!
string: 躲？暗影之中可是我的地盤！

original: Hiding only prolongs the inevitable.
string: 躲避不是長久之計。

original: I know you're here. Show yourself.
string: 我知道你在這裡。快現身。

original: Noooo....

original: Commander Maro. Where is he?
string: 馬洛指揮官，他在哪？

original: You mean... there's still a chance? But how? Our plan has gone to ruin, everyone is dead, the Family...
string: 你是說……還有機會？但是怎麼做？我們的計劃已經失敗，所有人都死了，家族……

original: The contract is still on. The true Emperor must be assassinated.
string: 契約依然有效。真正的皇帝必須死。

original: You found it? I've been looking for that blade for months. You took on all those bandits yourself?
string: 你找到它了？這把劍我找了好幾個月了。你一個人除掉了所有的強盜？

original: Thank you. Here, my father had a favorite sword and shield technique. Let me teach it to you, in honor of his memory.
string: 謝謝你。對了，在劍術和盾術中有一招我老爹最喜歡用。我教給你吧，就算是紀念他留給我的一切。

original: I have your sword.
string: 我拿到了你的劍。

original: Bless you, friend. You have renewed my hope.
string: 祝福你，朋友。你重新賦予我希望。

original: Before I came into Zenithar's calling, I confess I was a thief. But I learned a few things in my time that might help you survive. Let me show you.
string: 在我聽到澤尼薩爾的感召之前，我承認我是個賊。但那些日子裡我學到了一些可能對你有幫助的生存技巧。讓我示範給你看看。

original: I have your amulet.
string: 我找到你的護符了。

original: If I cared for your opinion on our affairs, I'd ask. Now, if you'll excuse me.
string: 如果我想知道你對我們之間的事有什麼意見的話，我會問的。好了，恕不奉陪。

original: Nivenor! How can you say that? He gives you everything you ask for.
string: 尼維諾爾！你怎麼能那樣說？你要什麼他都給你了。

original: How do you think? He's a pig. All I am to him is a warm body to lay with.
string: 你覺得呢？他是頭豬。我對他來說只是個暖被窩的肉塊而已。

original: So how are things with you and Bolli?
string: 我想問你和波利最近怎麼樣？

original: No, no... please, I'm just tired is all. Thank you.
string: 不，不……拜託你了，我現在只想休息。謝謝。

original: Look, if you're in some sort of trouble, I could talk to Haelga.
string: 看，要是你遇到什麼麻煩了，我可以去跟哈爾嘉說。

original: Don't worry about it, Svana. It's my problem... no need for you to get involved.
string: 別擔心了，斯瓦納。這是我一個人的事……你沒必要捲進來。

original: Wujeeta, you're worrying me. You look so... well, so sad.
string: 巫傑塔，你在擔心我。你看起來真……唉，真悲傷。

original: If there was any justice in the world, I'd just get this over with and die peacefully.
string: 要是這世上還存在公正的話，我寧願不惜一切擺脫這玩意，然後平靜地死去。

original: It's an evil substance. Whoever's selling it to you should be brought to justice.
string: 這是個邪惡的事物。不管是誰賣給你的，他都應該受到法律的審判。

original: I can't, Valindor. It won't let me go. It's taking over my life.
string: 我不能，瓦林多。它不會放過我的。它在一點一滴地佔據我的生命。

original: Wujeeta, you really need to stop using that skooma. It's very bad for your health and I wouldn't want to see anything happen to you.
string: 巫傑塔，你真的應該戒掉斯庫瑪。他對你的身體非常有害，而我不想看到你有任何不幸。

original: Not to worry, dear Svana. I promise you I can handle it, but your concern is quite flattering.
string: 別擔心，親愛的斯瓦納。我可以應付得來的。不過你的關心真叫我窩心呢。

original: Relaxing? They must be working you to the bone! You should rest before you do yourself in.
string: 輕鬆？他們絕對會操到你死為止！在你累垮自己之前，你必須休息。

original: Oh, it's not so terrible. I actually find the work quite relaxing.
string: 噢，沒那麼糟。其實我覺得這工作做起來很輕鬆的。

original: How do you do it, Valindor? How do you work at Black-Briar Meadery and the Fishery without getting exhausted?
string: 你怎麼做到的，瓦林多？你是如何在黑棘酒莊和漁場同時做兩份工作而沒被累垮的？

original: Sorry, Tythis. I'll get it to you somehow.
string: 抱歉，泰迪斯。我會想辦法弄到錢給你的。

original: If you'd stop wasting your coin on that skooma, you'd have enough gold to live on.
string: 如果你不再把錢浪費在那什麼斯庫瑪上的話，你足以讓自己過上小康生活。

original: Just give me a few more days and I promise I'll come up with it.
string: 再給我幾天時間，我保證還你。

original: Niluva, you promised me you'd pay me back yesterday. So what's the story?
string: 尼路瓦，你上次答應過昨天要還錢。那麼這次你準備編什麼藉口？

original: I'll make sure it's sent right away.
string: 我保證它馬上會被送出。

original: I'll draft a letter to Rythe. If you could have it sent to Cheydinhal for me, that would make up for your blunder.
string: 我會抓緊時間擬一封給瑞瑟的信。如果你能替我送去香丁赫爾，我就不再追究你犯的錯誤。

original: I'm sure my mother can compensate you for it.
string: 我媽媽肯定能賠償你的。

original: Ingun, you clumsy fool! You've tainted our entire supply of Painted Troll Fat. You have no idea how hard that was to get.
string: 因甘，你這個蠢到家的笨蛋！你弄髒了我們剛進的所有彩色巨魔脂肪。你根本不懂弄到那批貨有多難。

original: Very well, I'll keep practicing them.
string: 好，我會繼續練習的。

original: Ingun! If you want to remain in my shop as an apprentice I expect you to act like one. No exceptions!
string: 因甘！要是妳還想繼續在我店裡當學徒的話就必須表現得專業點。不要心存僥倖！

original: This is an utter waste of time.
string: 這真他媽的浪費時間。

original: Until you can do those formulas with your eyes shut, you'll never be ready to master the more difficult ones.
string: 直到你閉著眼都能配得和配方上一樣，你才能繼續學習更高難度的。

original: I don't understand, Elgrim. The formulas you're giving me are for novices but I've advanced well passed that point.
string: 我不明白，艾爾格瑞姆。你給我的配方都是新手級的，但我的水準已經遠遠超過了那個級別。

original: And a hefty cut for yourself too I'm sure. Just see to it the items are secured and the rest disposed of properly this time.
string: 我敢肯定，你在其中也佔了很大的一分。這次一定要保護好有用的貨，並且正確處理掉沒用的。

original: The coin isn't just for the men, there's a lot of people that need to be compensated in order to make this happen.
string: 這錢可不是只有這些人的份，為了這件事的成功，還有很多默默奉獻的人需要被補償。

original: For what it's costing me, I should be handed the merchandise on a silver platter.
string: 我付出這麼多，應該有人把那些貨裝在銀色的大圓碟子上呈給我才對。

original: My agents are telling me that we've appropriated the caravan from Hammerfell... with minimal losses.
string: 我手下的特務說，我們捕獲了那輛從落錘省來的大篷車……用最小的代價。

original: Anything you can do to keep his filthy hands off of me would be a welcome change.
string: 不管你用什麼辦法讓他那骯髒的手遠離我我都會很高興的。

original: I'll talk to him, but he's stubborn. He's like his mother; he sees what he wants and he won't quit until he has it.
string: 我會跟他談的，但他是個固執的人。他和他母親一樣；他很清楚自己的欲望而且不達目的決不甘休。

original: It's Hemming. He's making advances and I can't bear the man's presence. Is there anything you can do?
string: 是海姆英。他不斷得寸進尺，以至於我不能再容忍他了。你能幫我做點什麼？

original: Well that depends on what the favor is, now doesn't it.
string: 這個要取決於我能得到的酬勞，你說是不是。

original: Maul, can I ask a personal favor of you?
string: 摩爾，我能請你私下幫我個忙嗎？

original: Just stay away from me and maybe I won't weave a spell to shrink something that matters to you.
string: 要是你不想希望我施法縮小你身上某個重要部位的話你最好離我遠點。

original: You listen to me. I'd be careful wagging that pretty little tongue at me like that otherwise I may just have it cut off.
string: 你聽我說。我通常會很小心謹慎地使用嘴裡那小巧靈活的吐字器官，因為我很怕它一不留神被人切掉。

original: I find the concept of sleeping with you not only repulsive, but morally unsettling. Does that answer your question?
string: 我發現和你一起睡覺的念頭不僅很惡心，而且讓人很不舒服。這能回答你的問題了嗎？

original: So, have you thought about what I said?
string: 那麼，你考慮我說的事了嗎？

original: Let's just say my mother knows which pockets to line and keep it at that.
string: 我想她很懂得要怎麼樣才能撈到最多好處。

original: It's surprising the Council is allowing a Nord rule Riften under the Imperial flag. That can't be their first choice.
string: 議會居然讓一個臣服於帝國的諾德人治理裂谷城，太令人驚訝了。那肯定是他們的權宜之計。

original: Yes, she's been grooming herself for this for quite a long time.
string: 是啊，她為了這件事，有好長一段時間天天打扮得花枝招展的。

original: Your mother seems to have taken to her seat quite well.
string: 你媽媽適應得很快啊。

original: I'll let him know.
string: 我會讓他知道的。

original: Next time you speak to him, tell him to clean up his own messes. I'm not about to jeopardize this position for a bunch of low-life thugs.
string: 下次你見他的時候，叫他自己收拾自己的爛攤子。我不打算為了一群混混威脅到自己的位子。

original: I've spoken to Brynjolf and he assures me it'll be taken care of.
string: 我跟布林喬夫談過了，他信誓旦旦說事情會解決的。

original: Any word about our little problem in the Ratway?
string: 我們在鼠道的小問題有什麼進展嗎？

original: I'm almost certain he'll reach the Imperial City tomorrow, so we should have an answer by the end of the week.
string: 我很確定他明天會到達帝都，所以我們這週末必會得到一個答案。

original: Good. If I need to light a few fires in order to get what we need to defend this place from the Stormcloaks, so be it.
string: 很好。如果我需要點幾把火才能為我們爭取到對抗風暴斗篷所需的東西，我很樂意照辦。

original: Yes, and I sent it with our fastest courier and under the cover of night, exactly as you specified.
string: 是，我差遣手下最快的信差在夜幕的掩護下把它送去，完全按照你的指示。

original: Hemming, have you dispatched that letter I gave you yesterday?
string: 海姆英，我昨天交給你的那封信你送出了嗎？

original: No, mother. The execution will proceed as planned.
string: 不，媽媽。死刑將按原計劃執行。

original: Are you going soft on me, Hemming? Perhaps I made the wrong choice installing you as steward.
string: 你這是在對我關說嗎，海姆英？看來我把你培養成總管或許是個錯誤的決定。

original: But, mother... this is quite a sizable contribution and the crime doesn't befit such a harsh punishment.
string: 但是，媽媽……這筆捐款數目龐大，而且他的罪行並不至於被判這麼重的刑罰。

original: The execution will proceed as planned.
string: 死刑將按原計劃執行。

original: There's still the matter of the prisoner to discuss. Now, his family is willing to contribute handsomely if we release him.
string: 關於犯人仍有一些問題要討論。現在，他的家人想捐獻一大筆錢以換取他的自由。

original: Yes, milady. Sorry, milday. They will be completed.
string: 是的，女士。抱歉，女士。它們會被完成的。

original: Excuses are not acceptable in my court. When I ask for something I expect results, and I expect them immediately.
string: 我的宮廷當中不接受任何藉口。當我開口，我就要有成果，而且要馬上得到。

original: I'm sorry, milady. The components for those elixirs are quite volatile and in some cases, very dangerous to handle. I must take care.
string: 對不起，女士。那些靈藥所需的材料都是很不穩定的，而且有時候極具危險性。我必須得謹慎。

original: Why are the potions I requested not completed?
string: 為什麼我要的藥水沒有完成？

original: You sent me a letter, didn't you? Thanking me for killing your rival?
string: 你寄給我一封信，是吧？因為我殺了你的對手，所以你向我道謝？

original: You wanted to thank me for killing <Alias=Victim>?
string: 你想感謝我殺了<Alias=Victim>？

original: What if I don't want to be a werewolf?
string: 要是我不想成為一個狼人呢？

original: That is your choice. We will not force you. But to join the Circle, your blood must be as ours.
string: 那是你的選擇。我們不能強迫你。但想要加入圓環，你體內必須流著和我們一樣的血。

original: Meet us here when you're ready.
string: 你準備好的時候來這裡見我們。

original: No. Now shove off.
string: 不。現在，滾吧。

original: Snilf, it's me. I don't have a roof over my head either, remember?
string: 斯尼爾福，是我。我也沒有一個遮風避雨的窩，還記得嗎？

original: Oh if only I could provide more than this coin. I hope it'll do.
string: 噢，要是我能拿出比這更多的錢就好了。我希望這些錢還夠。

original: Again? Buy some food this time will you?
string: 又來？你這次好歹也買點食物行嗎？

original: Yes, I hope this helps.
string: 是的，我希望這有用。

original: Another uncounted causality of this war. Here you are, you poor man.
string: 這場戰爭又帶來一筆無法統計的死亡數目。給你，可憐的人。

original: Certainly, my good man. Here.
string: 當然了，我的好夥計。給你。

original: You're disgusting, stay away from me.
string: 你真惡心，離我遠點。

original: If I had even a pot to piss in, I'd gladly share. Sorry.
string: 就算我只有一個夜壺，我也會很高興共用的。真抱歉。

original: Yes, I hope this helps you.
string: 是的，我希望這能幫上你的忙。

original: Absolutely. Here you are. Be well.
string: 必須的。給你吧。保重。

original: Ugh, you smell horrible. Get yourself cleaned up.
string: 呃……你發出的氣味真可怕。趕緊去洗一洗吧。

original: Very well, here.
string: 很好，拿去。

original: Oh you poor thing, you must be starving. Come to the temple later and let us feed you.
string: 噢可憐的傢伙，你肯定餓壞了。等等來神殿吧，我們給你準備點吃的。

original: Snilf, I told you begging isn't the answer. I expect to see you at the temple later.
string: 斯尼爾福，我告訴過你乞討不是辦法。我希望待會能在神殿看到你。

original: Sorry, no time. I'm late.
string: 對不起，沒時間。我遲到了。

original: If you want to awaken from your next slumber, I suggest you leave me be.
string: 要是你想在下次睡著後能還醒過來，我建議你別煩我。

original: What? No. Get away from me.
string: 什麼？不。快從我面前消失。

original: I suppose. Just get something to eat and stay away from the Bee and Barb for a change.
string: 應該是。要不你就遠離蜂與鉤，找點別的食物來換換口味。

original: Very well, please use it for food.
string: 很好，請把它用在食物上。

original: Never. Now move aside.
string: 想都別想。快讓開。

original: Spare a coin?
string: 給我枚金幣好嗎？

original: If you could spare a septim, I'd be grateful.
string: 如果你施捨我一枚金幣，我會感謝你一輩子。

original: Help out an old man here with some coin, would you?
string: 花點小錢救救我這可憐的老人好嗎，好心人？

original: Hey, can I get a gold or two?
string: 嘿，能分一兩枚金幣給我嗎？

original: I could sure use some coin.
string: 我需要一點錢。

original: Go away.
string: 走開。

original: Edda, you know well I barely have any coin to call my own. I'm sorry.
string: 艾達，你知道我是個窮光蛋。我心有餘而力不足。

original: You must be starving. Here, spend it well.
string: 你肯定餓壞了。來，拿去買點好東西。

original: All right, all right. Here.
string: 好吧，好吧。給你。

original: Yes, I hope this helps.
string: 是的，我希望這有用。

original: Yes, of course. This war is causing your woes, it's hardly your fault.
string: 是的，當然。是這場戰爭使你不得不唉聲嘆氣，這是人之常情。

original: Certainly, good lady. Here.
string: 當然，可愛的女士。來。

original: Are you joking? Go earn a living and stop loafing!
string: 你開玩笑嗎？去工作賺錢，別遊手好閒！

original: I would if I could, but I can barely make ends meet.
string: 要是行的話我早就去幹了，事實證明我很難養活自己。

original: Here, this should help.
string: 拿著，這個應該幫得上忙。

original: Of course, here. Be well.
string: 當然，拿去。好好照顧自己。

original: Maybe you should look for work instead of begging for coin.
string: 也許你該去找工作，而不是沿街討錢。

original: Here you are.
string: 這給你。

original: Oh you poor thing! Come by the temple and my husband and I will keep you fed.
string: 噢，可憐的傢伙！你來神殿吧，我和我丈夫可以養活你的。

original: Edda, Edda. There's no need for this. Just come by the temple and we'll care for you.
string: 艾達，艾達。你沒必要這樣子。你直接來神殿吧，我們會照顧你的。

original: Sorry, all out of coin.
string: 不好意思，錢剛好用光了。

original: I've told you before, and I'll tell you again. Leave me alone.
string: 我之前就跟你說過，現在再說一遍。別管我。

original: Ugh, you reek. Get out of my way.
string: 呃……臭乞丐。別擋我的路。

original: Here you go, dear.
string: 給你，親愛的。

original: Oh, very well. Just try and clean yourself up.
string: 噢，非常好。你趕緊清洗一下你自己吧。

original: Get away from me, you filthy woman.
string: 離我遠點，你這骯髒的女人。

original: Please milady, can you spare a gold coin for an old woman?
string: 親愛的女士，你能給我這可憐的老婆子一點錢嗎？

original: Please my lord, can you spare a gold coin for an old woman?
string: 求求你，大人，你能給我這可憐的老婆子一點錢嗎？

original: Please help me, I'm starving.
string: 救救我吧，我快餓死了。

original: Please, I don't have anything to eat.
string: 求求你，我好幾天沒吃東西了。

original: Can you spare any coin?
string: 你能施捨給我一些錢嗎？

original: Spare a septim?
string: 施捨枚金幣好嗎？

original: Gladly. He won't bother you anymore, I promise.
string: 樂意之至。他不會再煩你了，我可以保證。

original: There's a new guard nosing around the meadery. Can you do something about it?
string: 有個新來的衛兵老是在酒莊問東問西的。你能解決一下這問題嗎？

original: Sure, Ton. You know I'm good for it.
string: 當然，冬恩。你知道我很擅長的。

original: I need you to do me a favor, Dirge.
string: 我需要你幫我個忙，「挽歌」。

original: That's all they are... rumors. So quit worrying.
string: 那就是它們全是……謠言。所以不用擔心了。

original: Look, I need to know. What's going on between you and Brynjolf?
string: 等等，我必需瞭解一下。你和布林喬夫怎麼了？

original: How dare you! After all we've been through together? How can you do this to me!
string: 你怎麼敢這麼說！我們一起經歷了這麼多事，你怎麼能這樣對我！

original: I can take care of myself.
string: 我能照顧好自己。

original: Come on, Ton. Marry me. Let me take care of you.
string: 求你啦，冬恩。和我結婚吧。讓我照顧你吧。

original: I don't want to settle. I like things the way they are.
string: 我不想安定。我喜歡自由和隨性。

original: Why can't you just settle down and run the Flagon with me?
string: 為什麼你不能安定下來和我一起經營漏壺呢？

original: Vekel, you have no shame. I'll get you the rest like I said. I want that hammer.
string: 威克爾，你真不要臉。我會守信把剩下的那些都找來給你。我想要那個錘子。

original: Yeah, funny thing about that. The price was a hundred higher than I expected.
string: 是啊，告訴你一件有趣的事。那價格比我預計的高了一百金幣。

original: You did? Thanks. I get you the rest of your coin by tomorrow.
string: 是嗎？謝謝。我明天就把剩下的錢都拿來給你。

original: Good news. I found that dwarven hammer you were looking for.
string: 好消息。我找到了你要找的那個矮人錘子。

original: I'll pass it along.
string: 我會繼續進行的。

original: You know what I mean. Tell your boss that rough is rough, but when someone pulls a dagger fun time is over.
string: 你懂的。去告訴你的老大，平時管理寬鬆無傷大雅，但是當有人被逼得要亮刀出來時，就沒那麼好玩了。

original: They aren't my boys. Do I look like the leadin' type?
string: 他們不是我的小弟。你看我像個大哥的樣子嗎？

original: You need to tell your boys to place nice, Delvin. Almost threw two of them into the well last night.
string: 你應該告訴你的小弟們放老實點，戴爾文。我昨晚差點把他們倆都扔進井裡去。

original: Well if it turns up, I'll be willing to buy.
string: 如果有貨，我很樂意買下來。

original: Maybe. That stuff's gettin' tough to bring across the border with all the Argonian patrols.
string: 可能會有。現在有了亞龍人巡邏隊，想運那東西過境比以前難多了。

original: Well, if some Moon Sugar should fall into your lap...
string: 呃…要是你能找些月糖來的話……

original: Puttin' together another shipment from Morrowind, Vekel. Lookin' for anythin' special?
string: 晨風那邊又過來了一船貨，威克爾。你有什麼特別需要嗎？

original: Am I responsible if the vintage was off on that case? Sorry, you know the rules Vekel. No refunds.
string: 難道在過了保存期限也要我來負責嗎？抱歉，威克爾，你懂規矩的。我不退款。

original: Sure, it tastes great. Only one problem. You said it can make the darkness as clear as day when you drink it. Guess what? It doesn't.
string: 當然，它味道很好。只有一個問題。你說喝下它之後在黑夜看東西會和白天一樣清晰。你猜怎麼著？完全無效。

original: What do you mean? That wine tastes finer than anythin' Surilie Brothers ever made.
string: 什麼意思？那酒比蘇瑞利兄弟做的任何一款都香醇。

original: All right, Delvin. What gives with that case of Shadowbanish you sold me?
string: 好吧，戴爾文。你賣給我的那箱影散酒是做什麼的？

original: She's in the Bannered Mare. She knows you're out here.
string: 她在敕旗母馬客棧那裡。她知道你會來這裡。

original: We cannot go after her, not without drawing attention.
string: 我們不能跟蹤她，一定會被察覺的。

original: You must bring her to us.
string: 你必須把她帶來給我們。

original: Lead her to the Whiterun stables, outside of the city. We will wait for you there.
string: 帶她去白漫城外的馬廄。我們在那裡等你。

original: What do I get for telling you?
string: 我告訴你有什麼好處？

original: Money, if that is what you wish.
string: 錢，如果你喜歡的話。

original: Now tell me where she is!
string: 告訴我她在哪！

original: I've seen the woman you're looking for.
string: 我看見了你要找的那個女人。

original: You have? Where? Tell me now!
string: 真的？在哪？馬上告訴我！

original: Why are you after Saadia?
string: 你為什麼要追捕薩蒂亞？

original: She sold the city out to the Aldmeri Dominion. Were it not for her betrayal, Taneth could have held its ground in the war.
string: 她向先祖神洲出賣了我們的城市。如果不是她叛變，譚思家族便不需要因為打敗仗而將城市拱手讓出。

original: The other noble houses discovered her betrayal and she fled. They want her brought back alive.
string: 其他貴族勢力發現了她的叛變行為，於是她逃跑了。他們想找人把她活捉回來。

original: The resistance against the Dominion is alive and well in Hammerfell, and they want justice.
string: 反抗神洲的風潮在落錘省如火如荼地蔓延，他們要求此事有個公正的裁決。

original: Amazing... you can see how the Akaviri craftsmen were beginning to embrace the more flowing Nordic style...
string: 真神奇……你可以看出那些阿卡維爾工匠如何開始傾向於那更平滑的諾德風格……

original: We're here for Alduin's Wall, right, Esbern?
string: 我們是為奧杜因之牆而來，對吧，伊思本？

original: Yes, of course. We'll have more time to look around later, I suppose. Let's see what's up ahead.
string: 是啊，當然啦。待會我們想必會有充足的時間探索這裡。我們先去看看前面有些什麼吧。

original: Fascinating! Original Akaviri bas-reliefs... almost entirely intact!
string: 美妙絕倫！原版的阿卡維爾浮雕……幾乎完全沒有被碰觸過！

original: The Companions are werewolves?
string: 戰友團裡全是狼人？

original: Not everyone, but all the Circle are. It's a secret to everybody.
string: 不是全團，但圓環裡的都是。這是一個不被外人知道的秘密。

original: Not all of us, just the members of the Circle. We shouldn't be talking about this anyway.
string: 不是所有人，只有圓環的成員才是。但無論如何我們不應該討論這個問題。

original: Who are the Silver Hand?
string: 白銀之手是誰？

original: Bad people who don't like werewolves.
string: 不喜歡狼人的壞人。

original: So they don't like us either.
string: 所以他們也不喜歡我們。

original: A group of werewolf hunters who have gotten wise to our little secret.
string: 有一小撮狼人獵手知道了我們的秘密。

original: They've made it their mission to hunt us down, but we are hunters ourselves.
string: 他們把獵殺我們當成他們的使命，但其實我們也是獵手。

original: Why did Skjor call this my Trial?
string: 為什麼斯科約爾說這是我的試鍊？

original: I watch you to make sure you are honorable.
string: 為了保證你的行為正直，我得監視你。

original: If you are honorable and strong, then I can call you brother.
string: 如果你正直而且強大，我就會把你當作我的兄弟。

original: I watch you to make sure you are honorable.
string: 為了保證你的行為正直，我要監視你。

original: If you are honorable and strong, then I can call you sister.
string: 如果你正直而且夠強大，我就願意把你當作我的姐妹。

original: I would hope that's obvious.
string: 我希望你的表現將會是顯而易見的。

original: Do well here, and you'll be a full member of the Companions.
string: 好好幹，你會成為一個優秀的戰友團團員。

original: Fail, and it won't matter anyway.
string: 失敗的話，也不會有什麼損失。

original: What is Wuuthrad?
string: 精靈屠戮者是什麼？

original: Ysgramor was the hero who started the Companions. Wuuthrad was his weapon.
string: 伊斯格拉謨是創立戰友團的英雄。精靈屠戮者是他的武器。

original: He came from the ancient homeland and killed all the elves.
string: 他從先祖的家園來，殺掉了所有的精靈。

original: But not all of them, because some of them are still here.
string: 但他並沒有趕盡殺絕，因為現在還是有精靈住在這片土地上。

original: It was the blade hefted by Ysgramor when he returned to drive the elves out of the old Skyrim.
string: 那是伊斯格拉謨當年回天際省將精靈族驅逐出去的時候揮舞的兵器。

original: Without that axe, this whole land would be overrun still.
string: 沒有那把斧頭，這片土地今天一定仍被佔領著的。

original: Wuuthrad is a relic of Ysgramor. Through that weapon, we trace our line straight to the first harbinger of makind in this land.
string: 精靈屠戮者是伊斯格拉謨留下的神器。透過那把武器，可以證明我們是第一批來到這片土地上的人類先驅的直系後代。

original: What fragments we have are displayed in honor, but we always seek more.
string: 我們尊敬地對待現有的殘存碎片，但我們一直在設法找到更多。

original: He'll answer any questions you have.
string: 他會回答你的所有問題。

original: Try not to disappoint. Or to get him killed.
string: 別讓他失望，或讓他掛了。

original: She'll answer any questions you have.
string: 她會回答你心中的所有問題。

original: Try not to disappoint. Or to get her killed.
string: 別讓她失望，或讓她掛了。

original: Where is everyone?
string: 大家都到哪去了？

original: We've been awaiting your return.
string: 我們一直在等你回來。

original: Leave this place... Leave this place...
string: 離開這裡……離開這裡……

original: That door up ahead... looks perfect for hiding an ambush. Be ready.
string: 前面那扇門……看起來是埋伏的最佳地點。做好準備。

original: Why is your cemetery so large?
string: 為什麼你們的公墓這麼大？

original: Many battles have been fought here over the centuries. Graves were dug and monuments built, and the town grew around these.
string: 幾個世紀以來這裡上演了很多場戰爭。人們挖出一個個墓穴、建起一座座紀念碑，久而久之就圍繞這些發展成了城鎮。

original: In time, Falkreath came to be known as the heroes' graveyard. Many noble Jarls and renowned warriors asked to be buried here.
string: 那時候，佛克瑞斯以英雄的陵墓聞名於世。很多貴族領主和著名的英雄都要求被埋在這裡。

original: Falkreath's reputation has faded somewhat, but the graves remain, reminding us of the one inevitable truth of life.
string: 佛克瑞斯的名氣現在已經不那麼大了，但這些墓碑不會消失，總是提醒著我們那個生命不可避免之真理。

original: How long have you been a Steward?
string: 你做總管多久了？

original: It was Dengeir who made me a steward, long ago when he was young.
string: 丹格爾把我培養成一個總管，從他很年輕的時候就開始了。

original: When Dengeir's health began to fail, young Sidgeir was appointed Jarl in his stead. It was simpler just to keep me as steward.
string: 當丹格爾的健康狀況開始惡化時，年輕的西德蓋爾被指定為他的繼位者。讓我繼續做總管顯然更方便一些。

original: Sidgeir has no interest in running his hold, and so leaves such matters to me. As for my part, I do my best to see that folk are treated fairly.
string: 西德蓋爾對統治他的領地並無興趣，所以他把政務都交給我處理。至於我，就竭盡所能讓民眾們得到公正合理的對待。

original: Does your inexperience make your job difficult?
string: 你會不會因為經驗不足而感到這份工作很困難？

original: Difficult? I am a Jarl. I eat the most succulent meat, drink the finest ale and hunt with the best hounds in the hold.
string: 困難？我是個領主。我吃最優質的嫩肉，喝最上乘的美酒，坐著全領地內最極品的座駕在狩獵。

original: Meanwhile, my very capable steward sees to the needs of the smallfolk and ensures that my hold runs smoothly.
string: 而且，我那精明能幹的總管替我應付那幫老百姓讓我高枕無憂。

original: Being a Jarl could hardly be simpler. You should try it sometime.
string: 做一個領主可不簡單。你真應該試試。

original: We're on the right track. She's been through here as well.
string: 我們走的路是對的。她也經過了這裡。

original: Karliah always was a nimble minx... slipping passed these draugr must be child's play for her.
string: 卡莉亞這個小美人兒一直身手敏捷……悄聲穿過這些諾德亡靈對她來說簡直是小兒科。

original: Bone chimes... clever. Rigged to wake the draugr I'd bet. Don't blunder into any of them.
string: 骨製編鐘……聰明。我敢打賭這是為了叫醒諾德亡靈們而做的。千萬別不小心碰到它們。

original: There's two more of them ahead.
string: 前面還有兩個。

original: Pull the chain over there, and watch out for the spikes. Looks like Karliah reset all of the traps.
string: 去拉那裡的鎖鏈，同時小心迸出來的火花。看來卡莉亞把所有的陷阱復原並重新開啟了。

original: The stench in here... this place smells of death. Be on your guard.
string: 這股惡臭……這裡充滿了死亡的氣息。準備好你的武器。

original: Karliah's been through here. What does she expect to find?
string: 卡莉亞來過這裡。她到底想找什麼？

original: How did you become a Jarl while so young?
string: 你這麼年輕怎麼當上領主的？

original: My uncle Dengeir was Jarl until a short time ago. His old age and failing health caught up with him, and he stepped down.
string: 不久前領主的位置上坐的還是我叔叔丹格爾呢。但是他年老體衰，不得不退位。

original: He now serves us honorably as Thane, and to the great benefit of the hold, I now serve as Jarl.
string: 現在他作為武衛盡心盡力為我們效忠，而且為了領地的福祉，我被指定為領主。

original: And, once more, I prove Commander Maro the fool. I told him you can't stop the Dark Brotherhood. Never could.
string: 所以，又一次。我再度證明了指揮官馬洛是個傻瓜。我告訴他你不可能阻止得了黑暗兄弟會。永遠不能。

original: Yes sir.
string: 是的大人。

original: The honor has been mine. You should be proud of what we've accomplished here. The Dark Brotherhood is no more. And the Emperor, finally, is safe.
string: 榮譽是我的。你應該為我們在這裡完成的成就感到驕傲。黑暗兄弟會再也不能囂張了。而且，終於，我們的皇帝也安全了。

original: Oh... I see. Well then, let me be just say that it's been an honor serving under you Commander Maro.
string: 哦……我知道了。那好吧，我只想說我對在指揮官馬洛您的麾下作戰感到十分光榮。

original: Hmph. Now there's an excellent question. An excellent question, indeed. Truth is, as soon as the Emperor sets sail,  I'm resigning my position.
string: 哼。這是個很有水準的問題。很有水準，真的。其實，我打算等皇帝一啟程，就提交辭呈。

original: Very good. And you'll be returning to... Well, if you don't mind me asking, where exactly will you be going now, sir?
string: 很好。你將回到……呃…如果你不介意我問的話，告訴我你要去哪裡好嗎，大人？

original: It'll be shuttered by the end of the month.
string: 這個月結束前它會被撤掉。

original: And the outpost at Dragon Bridge?
string: 那龍橋鎮的前哨呢？

original: The library is just through here. We're getting close now.
string: 再往前就是圖書館了。我們已經很接近它了。

original: The undercroft is ahead... ugh, Necromancers. Be careful.
string: 地下室就在前面……呃…死靈術士們。小心點。

original: Yes, you certainly do.
string: 是，你當然是了。

original: You'll be going back to the College, then? I, uhh... I think perhaps I'll wait a bit before venturing there myself.
string: 你要回學院去，對吧？我，呃……我想再等一陣子之後再回去那裡。

original: Let this whole thing blow over, you know. Give certain parties a chance to forget what I may have done.
string: 讓這件事平息吧，你懂的。讓某些人士能遺忘我的所作所為吧。

original: Still, you've gotten me out of that cage, and I won't forget it. Thank you again, and good luck to you.
string: 即便如此，是你把我從籠子裡放出來的，我不會忘記的。再次感謝你，並祝你好運。

original: I've got what I came for.
string: 我拿到了我想拿的東西。

original: Have the books, do you? I mean, I'm very glad. That's wonderful.
string: 找到那些書了，是不是？我是說，我很高興。真是太好了。

original: You could, you know, let me out of this cage now.
string: 你可以，那個，把我從籠子裡放出去。

original: I've got what I came for.
string: 我拿到了我想拿的東西。

original: How long have you been here?
string: 你來這裡多久了？

original: First it was 6 months, then a year, then 2 years. Now I'm in for life.
string: 一開始是6個月，然後是1年，後來又變成2年。現在是一輩子了。

original: What are you in for?
string: 你是怎麼進來的？

original: The first time? Thieving. The second time? Thieving. The third time? Thieving. It kind of keeps going like that.
string: 一開始嗎？是偷竊。第二次？偷竊。第三次？偷竊。就像是一種迴圈一樣。

original: How long have you been here?
string: 你來這裡多久了？

original: Long enough.
string: 夠久了。

original: What are you in for?
string: 你是怎麼進來的？

original: Don't want to talk about it.
string: 我不想說。

original: How long have you been here?
string: 你來這裡多久了？

original: A couple of years? I wasn't a Forsworn when I came, but I joined up when I got in. Easier that way.
string: 有幾年了吧？我剛來的時候不是棄誓者，但是不久後我就加入了。那樣會使日子好過得多。

original: What are you in for?
string: 你是怎麼進來的？

original: Guards say I murdered someone. I was just sleeping off some mead in my aunt's house, but that didn't stop them from arresting me.
string: 衛兵說我謀殺了某人。我當時喝多了蜜酒正在我姑媽家裡睡覺，但他們還是抓了我。

original: I don't even know who they said I killed.
string: 我根本不認識他們所說的那個受害者。

original: How long have you been here?
string: 你來這裡多久了？

original: Guards brought me in about 12 years ago. Was running a good group of bandits up until then.
string: 12年前我被衛兵帶到這裡。那時候我管理一個很有前途的強盜團體。

original: But these Forsworn. They're nothing like the men I cobbled together. They're real killers.
string: 但是這些棄誓者們吶。他們和我東拼西湊的雜牌軍不同，他們是真正的殺手。

original: How long have you been here?
string: 你來這裡多久了？

original: Year seven, I think? Surprised I haven't cut my own throat out by now, but something keeps me going.
string: 七年了吧，我覺得？我自己都很驚訝我居然沒有割喉自殺，但我確實有著活下去的信念。

original: What are you in for?
string: 你是怎麼進來的？

original: Murder. Banditry. Assault. Theft. And lollygagging.
string: 殺人。搶劫。強姦。偷竊。跟其他有的沒有的。

original: What are you in for?
string: 你是怎麼進來的？

original: I'm a Forsworn. One of our raids went bad, and I got captured.
string: 我是個棄誓者。我們有一次打劫行動失敗了，我就被抓了。

original: Would've been fine dying for the Reach with my kinsmen, but the Silver-Bloods want their ore mined, so they threw me in here.
string: 當時要是和我的兄弟們一起死在邊塞就好了，但是因為銀血要這些礦石，所以他們就把我扔到這裡來做苦力。

original: Valmir, you rat. You're not a soldier at all! Must be one of the Thalmor!
string: 瓦爾米爾，你這隻死老鼠。你根本不像個戰士！你一定是梭默的一份子！

original: Oh! Um, he he... Hold on... I... I can explain...
string: 噢！呃…他、他……等等……我……我能解釋清楚……

original: Wait... who in blazes is this?
string: 等等……這傢伙到底是誰？

original: Hmm....
Why don't you go in there and get it?
string: 為什麼你不進去拿走它呢？

original: Wait, it's haunted? I don't like ghosts... let me think about this for a minute...
string: 什麼，那裡鬧鬼？我不喜歡鬼魂……讓我思考一下……

original: My men? What did you do? You'll die for this.
string: 我的人？你做了什麼？你要拿命來賠。

original: We're close now. I can see the camp.
string: 我們現在很接近了。我能看到帳篷了。

original: It's just across the bridge and up that hill.
string: 就在過了橋後的山上。

original: I'll make it worth your while. (Bribe)
string: 我不會讓你白費時間的。（賄賂）

original: I can't believe it! How did ya' talk her into this?
string: 我不信！你怎麼說服她這樣做的？

original: Never mind, I don't care. I'm just glad I don't gotta' work for Maven anymore.
string: 沒關係，我不在乎。不用再為瑪雯工作已經夠讓我高興的了。

original: Here, ya' did me a favor, I guess I owe you one.
string: 嘿，你幫了我一個大忙，看來我欠你一次了。

original: Here, it's your debt with Maven. You're free.
string: 看這個，你欠瑪雯的欠款條。現在你們兩不相欠了。

original: You ain't got enough coin to make my problems go away unless ya' can talk Maven Black-Briar into letting me outta' my debt.
string: 你不可能有那麼多錢幫我解決問題的，除非你能說服瑪雯．黑棘一筆勾銷我的債。

original: You try and set one foot in this yard, and I'll cut it off.
string: 你敢踏進這院子裡一步試試，看我把你的腳剁下來。

original: I need to get inside Mercer's house.
string: 我需要進入墨瑟的房子裡。

original: Of mine? What is it?
string: 我的？是什麼？

original: I have something of yours.
string: 我這裡有一些你的東西。

original: No visitors. No way. Now piss off, before ya' make me mad.
string: 不見客。打死也不見。你快滾出去，別非要惹我發火。

original: So, buy him off?
string: 那，收買他？

original: Sure, but he'll ask for a whole lot. I mean, you are asking him to betray Mercer Frey.
string: 當然可行，不過他一定會喊出很高的價碼。畢竟，你是要他背叛墨瑟．弗雷。

original: Your best bet would be to erase his debt with Maven Black-Briar. If you talk to her, she might be able to give you the details.
string: 你最好把賭注押在幫他清理欠瑪雯．黑棘的債上面。如果你去找她，她也許能向你透露一些詳細情報。

original: Of course, you could just run him through and take what you need off of his corpse... I could care less.
string: 當然了，你也可以解決他然後從他的屍體上搜刮出你要的東西……但這我就不干涉了。

original: I want to get on his good side.
string: 我想讓他走上正道。

original: Vald? Good side? I think you have the wrong person.
string: 沃德？正道？你可選錯人了。

original: The only thing Vald understands is gold. A man after my own heart.
string: 金幣是沃德的字典裡的唯一的一個字。我太理解我的同類了。

original: Brynjolf said you have info on Vald.
string: 布林喬夫說妳知道沃德的事情。

original: That pig? Oh, I have info on him. More than you care to know.
string: 那頭豬？哦，我知道的比你想像得到的還多得多。

original: You mentioned a watchdog?
string: 你剛才說有個看門狗？

original: That'd be Vald. A real piece of work, that one.
string: 那一定是沃德。那件事做得真是好得沒話說。

original: Mercer's holding something over his head, keeping him loyal.
string: 墨瑟抓到他的把柄，牢牢地綁住他。

original: Talk to Vex. She used to know him very well... if you catch my meaning.
string: 去找「小煩」聊聊。她以前對他瞭解得透徹……我想你應該聽得懂吧。

original: I don't suppose the ramp is easy to access.
string: 我感肯定那樓梯沒那麼簡單走。

original: No. It's some sort of crazy contraption Mercer commissioned for quick escapes.
string: 是啊。它是墨瑟造出來用於快速逃跑的新發明什麼的。

original: I'd wager a well-placed shot at the ramp's mechanism would lower it in a hurry.
string: 我敢跟你打賭這個機關一定是能迅速把樓梯放下來的那種。

original: What's the best way to get into Riftweald Manor?
string: 進裂谷曠野莊園最好的方法是什麼？

original: Good question. I've only set foot inside a few times myself and that was in Mercer's company.
string: 問得好。我自己也只親自進去過那麼幾次，而且是和墨瑟一起。

original: If you can get past his trained watchdog, I think your best bet might be the ramp to the second floor balcony in his backyard.
string: 如果你能通過他訓練有素的看門狗，我想你最好的選擇是後花園裡通往二樓露臺的樓梯。

original: Because war is good for business, of course.
string: 當然是因為戰爭能讓生意更好做啊。

original: And what makes you think that?
string: 你為什麼這樣想？

original: The war? That is not a reason to leave, it is a reason to stay.
string: 戰爭？那不是逃走的理由，而是留下的理由。

original: That may be, but what of the war? That is not so easy to escape from.
string: 可能是吧，但是戰爭呢？戰爭可不是說躲就能躲的。

original: I admit, the dragons are a concern, but we can avoid them if we do not stay in one place for too long.
string: 我承認，龍確實是個讓人擔心的問題，但是我們可以用四處遊走的方式來躲開牠們。

original: Between the war and the return of the dragons, I wonder if we should not leave Skyrim and ply our trade elsewhere.
string: 今天戰火硝煙，明天巨龍襲擊，我在想我們是不是該離開天際省區別的地方做生意。

original: Hm. I had not thought of it that way.
string: 呵。我不這麼想。

original: Hah, you have the foresight of a Khajiit in a sandstorm. If we offer a discount to both sides, the winners will persecute us for helping the losers.
string: 哈，你的眼光就和沙暴中的虎人一樣短淺。如果我們對雙方都提供折扣，將來贏的一方會因為我們幫助他們的敵人而迫害我們。

original: Both. One or the other is bound to win the war eventually. Why not curry favor now, so that the victor will look upon us kindly?
string: 都是。兩邊總有一方會贏得最終勝利。為什麼不現在開始巴結他們，讓勝利者對我們有好感呢？

original: The soldiers? From which side, the Stormcloaks, or the Imperials?
string: 士兵？哪一邊的，風暴斗篷，還是帝國軍？

original: I wonder if we should offer discounts to the soldiers.
string: 我在想我們要不要對士兵提供折扣。

original: And we will lose customers. Let us hope that if there are dragons, there are only a few and they are not too foul-tempered.
string: 而且我們的客戶也會減少的。還是祈禱即使有龍，也只有少數幾隻，而且脾氣也不要特別暴躁。

original: I feel pity for these Nords. When the dragons attack cities and towns, they will lose everything.
string: 我真可憐那些諾德人。當龍襲擊都市和城鎮的時候，他們會失去一切。

original: We are fortunate. We travel lightly, and can escape at a moment's notice. We have no home that a dragon can burn to the ground.
string: 我們是幸運的。我們輕裝上路，而且要逃跑的話很容易。我們也沒有房產什麼的會被龍燒掉。

original: S'rendarr be merciful! What ill fortune that this should happen now, while we are trying to make a living.
string: 斯仁達爾慈悲！雖然現在遭遇不幸，但我們還活著。

original: I wish I could say that I did not, but in every part of Skyrim, there is talk of dragon sightings. It is no coincidence.
string: 我真希望我可以不信，但是在天際省的每個地方，關於目擊了龍的流言到處都有。這絕不是巧合。

original: Do you believe all this talk of dragons? Can the ancient ones truly have returned?
string: 你相信這些關於龍的傳聞嗎？這些上古生物真的回歸了嗎？

original: As the saying goes, you do not need to be faster than the dragon; you need only be faster than your friends.
string: 就像那句老話說的，你不用跑得比龍快；只要比你的朋友快就行了。

original: I suppose if we do, we will find out just how fast each of us can run.
string: 我想如果真的碰上了，我們就能知道自己跑得多快了。

original: Moons protect us! I hope we do not encounter one of them on the road.
string: 月亮保佑我們！我希望我們不會在路上遇到牠們。

original: All this talk of dragons returning to the world makes me more than a little nervous.
string: 到處都有巨龍出現的消息，聽得我好心慌啊。

original: That is true. Perhaps I should be more grateful for this opportunity. Not many Khajiit can say that they have visited Skyrim.
string: 那倒是真的。也許我該感謝這次機會，畢竟沒多少虎人有幸拜訪過天際。

original: In truth, I do not. I have always dreamed of seeing new lands, and it does not hurt that we are making a good profit.
string: 事實上，我沒有。我夢想著能夠看到新大陸，而且我們也可從中賺上一筆。

original: Do you ever find that you regret making this journey?
string: 你為踏上這趟旅程而後悔過嗎？

original: Yes, I know just what you mean. My toes are numb from the cold more often than not.
string: 是啊，我明白你的意思。我的腳趾總是被凍麻。

original: We have been in this land for so long, I have forgotten what it feels like to walk on warm sand.
string: 我們在這片土地上待得太久了，我都忘了踩在溫暖的沙子上是什麼感覺。

original: Hah! I wish that I had your optimism.
string: 哈！我真希望能像你一樣樂觀。

original: It is a pity, but it cannot be helped. Perhaps if we continue to show that we can be trusted, they will open their cities to our caravans.
string: 雖然很遺憾，但是沒辦法。如果我們能表現得再可信一點，也許他們就會放我們的小車進入城市了。

original: Not only that, but these Nords have no love for us. They look upon us and see only thieves and smugglers.
string: 不止是這樣，這些諾德人不喜歡我們這種人，在他們眼裡我們就是小偷跟走私者。

original: I feel the same. I do not think Khajiit were made for the cold.
string: 我也這麼覺得。我不認為虎人是為了寒冷而生的。

original: It has been a profitable journey, and yet I long for the warm sands of Elsweyr more and more each day.
string: 這是趟很賺錢的旅行，但我還是越來越想念艾斯維爾溫暖的沙子。

original: Put the thought out of your mind, and do not speak of it again.
string: 快忘掉這個想法，也別再提起它了。

original: Yes, of course you are right. Still, I would give much for even a few grains of moonsugar.
string: 嗯，我覺得你是對的。但我還是願意花大錢，哪怕只能買到幾顆月糖。

original: Control yourself! Do not frighten away our customers with your fits.
string: 克制點！別讓你那身打扮嚇跑了顧客。

original: My ears hear the truth in your words, and yet my body shakes with the need.
string: 我聽到了你言語裡的真理，但我的身體因為欲望而動搖。

original: You know that our supply is limited. It could be a season or more before we get a new shipment from the south.
string: 你知道我們的供給很有限，我們可能得再撐一季或者更久，才能得到南方運來的貨物。

original: My bones ache for the moonsugar. It has been too long since I tasted it.
string: 對月糖的渴望讓我渾身疼痛，我太久沒嘗到它了。

original: If the river is not frozen to ice, perhaps.
string: 如果河面還沒有結冰，或許吧。

original: The road takes us past many cold rivers. We can fill our skins there.
string: 這一路我們會經過很多冰冷的河流，我們可以在那清洗身體。

original: Soon it will be time to replenish our supply of water.
string: 很快我們就可以獲得水分補給了。

original: I welcome you, friend. How may I serve you?
string: 歡迎你，我的朋友。有什麼我能幫忙的嗎？

original: So many refuse to talk to us. They call us thieves and smugglers. I am glad to see that you are not such a one.
string: 好多人都不願意跟我們說話，他們說我們是盜賊和走私者。真高興你不是其中一個。

original: Welcome. If I cannot serve you, I am sure that one of my other traders can do so.
string: 歡迎。就算我不能服務你，我其他的營業員會幫助你的。

original: I have traveled far across Tamriel to serve you.
string: 我跑了大半個大陸只為了服務你。

original: Perhaps you have encountered Ma'dran or Akhari? Both are sworn to me, and both have worthy goods to offer.
string: 也許你已經遇到過麥德蘭或者阿克哈裡？他們都對我發過誓，會提供有價值的貨物。

original: The road makes this one weary.
string: 這路讓人厭倦。

original: The wind blows bitter cold in this place.
string: 這地方寒風凜冽。

original: The longer we travel the roads of Skyrim, the more empty this land seems.
string: 我們在這裡走得越遠，就越覺得這片大陸很空曠。

original: The warm sand of Elsweyr is far away from here.
string: 艾斯維爾溫暖的沙子離這裡太遠了。

original: The roads of Skyrim lead to many dangers.
string: 天際的路上真不太平。

original: We are creatures of the desert. The north wind chills us to the bones.
string: 我們是沙漠的孩子，北風對我們來說太冷了些。

original: There is much beauty in this place.
string: 這地方美女真多。

original: How high the mountains of Skyrim rise!
string: 天際的山真高啊！

original: A peaceful greeting to you.
string: 向您問好。

original: It is a strange sight, the white flakes that sometimes fall from the sky.
string: 真是前所未見，白色的碎片從天上落下來。

original: The air is so clear in Skyrim, one can see forever.
string: 天際的天空真乾淨，讓人永遠看不厭。

original: A welcome to you, fellow traveler.
string: 歡迎，旅行者們。

original: Khajiit welcomes you, and also your coin.
string: 虎人歡迎你，和你的錢。

original: Do you seek to make a purchase?
string: 你想買點什麼？

original: Khajiit has wares, if you have coin.
string: 虎人有貨，你有錢。

original: Fortune smiles upon this meeting.
string: 財富在對我們微笑。

original: Welcome to you.
string: 歡迎你。

original: Warm sands, friend. How may this one serve you?
string: 溫暖的沙子，朋友，你喜歡這個嗎？

original: Please, come and browse our goods.
string: 拜託，過來看看貨吧。

original: May your bed be warm and your food sweet.
string: 願你能吃飽穿暖。

original: You honor Khajiit with your presence.
string: 你忠實的虎人與你同在。

original: Many fine things are here for you, friend.
string: 這裡有很多東西適合你，朋友。

original: Come and see what is for sale, traveler.
string: 來看看有什麼好買嗎？旅行者。

original: May the sun warm your path, friend.
string: 願您的一路上陽光普照。

original: Speak to one of the others if you wish to buy something.
string: 你想買東西的話，請找其他人。

original: This Khajiit guards the others.
string: 這個虎人正在保護同伴。

original: Bring your coins, but do not bring trouble.
string: 帶著錢來，但是別帶麻煩。

original: Khajiit is always watching for thieves and pickpockets.
string: 虎人總是對盜賊和扒手很警惕。

original: Khajiit is ready for any troublemakers.
string: 虎人不畏懼任何找麻煩的人。

original: If you have come to see our wares, speak to the others.
string: 如果你是來看貨的，找其他人。

original: Welcome to Khajiit's humble camp.
string: 歡迎來到虎人的營地。

original: Khajiit is just a guard, and has no wares to sell.
string: 虎人只不過是個保鏢，沒什麼可賣的。

original: Blessings of the moons upon you, traveler.
string: 月亮保佑你，旅行者。

original: Some come to buy, but others come to steal. Khajiit shows no mercy to thieves.
string: 有些人來買東西，但也有些人是來偷的。虎人對小偷絕不留情。

original: Khajiit are not welcome in the cities, so we make our camps outside the walls.
string: 虎人在很多城市裡都不受歡迎，所以我們在城牆外搭起了營地。

original: There is no trust for Khajiit in this place.
string: 虎人在這裡不被信任。

original: You'd prefer your son to grow bitter and resent you? (Persuade)
string: 你想讓你的兒子繼續痛苦下去，然後開始恨你？（說服）

original: I... I cannot deny the truth of what you say. Erik is all the family that I have left, but it's wrong to hold him back as I have.
string: 我……我承認你說得對。艾瑞克是我唯一的家人了，我這樣攔著他是不對的。

original: Go and tell Erik that I've changed my mind. I'll see about borrowing some money in Whiterun for his armor.
string: 去告訴艾瑞克我改變主意了。我會試著從白漫借錢來給他買裝備。

original: Perhaps you should let a father decide what is best for his own son.
string: 或許你該讓父親來決定什麼對他的兒子最好。

original: Find the money, or you'll have me to deal with. (Intimidate)
string: 想辦法找點錢出來，否則我不客氣了。（威嚇）

original: Ah, I see. I've just remembered that I saved a few septims in case of an emergency. This is starting to feel like one.
string: 啊，我剛想起來我留了點錢應付緊急狀況。這好像就是緊急狀況了。

original: Tell Erik that I've changed my mind, and we'll visit Whiterun soon to fit him for armor. And please don't hurt me!
string: 告訴艾瑞克我改變主意了，我們馬上去白漫看看有沒有合適的裝備。求你別傷我！

original: Go ahead, hit me as often as you want. It's not going to change anything, other than to make me and the town guard angry.
string: 來吧，想怎麼打我就怎麼打我。不過這除了激怒我和城鎮衛兵以外，改變不了任何事情。

original: Here, use this to buy some armor. (<bribecost> gold)
string: 拿去，用這些去買點裝備。（賄賂<BribeCost>金幣）

original: You would give your own coin to help my son? I'm moved by your compassion.
string: 你要自掏腰包來幫我兒子？你的同情心真令我感動。

original: Your kind deed will not go unrewarded, my friend. Tell Erik I've changed my mind, and we'll visit Whiterun soon to fit him for armor.
string: 你的善舉會得到回報的，朋友。告訴艾瑞克我改主意了，我們馬上去白漫幫他挑裝備。

original: I appreciate the gesture, but I'd rather not be in debt to a stranger.
string: 非常感謝您的慷慨，但我不想欠陌生人的人情。

original: You should let your son choose the life he wants.
string: 你該讓你兒子自己選擇他想要的生活。

original: But the world is a dangerous place. Erik has no idea what he's getting himself into.
string: 但世間險惡，艾瑞克根本不知道他得面對什麼。

original: What's more, he's got no armor. I'll have to save up the money for it.
string: 更重要的是，他沒有裝備。我得為此存不少錢。

original: My son? Erik? What about him? Did something happen? Is he alright?
string: 我兒子？艾瑞克？他怎麼了？出什麼事了嗎？他還好嗎？

original: I'd like to talk to you about your son.
string: 我得跟你談談你兒子的事。

original: Mirabelle will be waiting for you.
string: 米拉貝勒會等著你。

original: Well, boy, you're one of us now. I trust you won't disappoint.
string: 好吧，小子，你是我們的一員了。我相信你不會讓我們失望的。

original: Well, girl, you're one of us now. I trust you won't disappoint.
string: 好吧，姑娘，妳是我們的一員了。我相信妳不會讓我們失望的。

original: It shall be so.
string: 理當如此。

original: It shall be so.
string: 理當如此。

original: It shall be so.
string: 理當如此。

original: It shall be so.
string: 理當如此。

original: Let it beat with ours, that the mountains may echo and our enemies may tremble at the call.
string: 讓他的心跳聲加入我們的吧。當群山為之迴響，我們的敵人也將顫抖懼怕。

original: His heart beats with fury and courage that have united the Companions since the days of the distant green summers.
string: 從很久以前便團結著戰友團的憤怒與勇氣，也存在於他的心跳之中。

original: Her heart beats with fury and courage that have united the Companions since the days of the distant green summers.
string: 從很久以前便團結著戰友團的憤怒與勇氣，也存在於她的心跳之中。

original: Then the judgment of this Circle is complete.
string: 那麼，圓環的裁決到此結束。

original: I would lead the song of triumph as our mead hall reveled in his stories.
string: 我要讓凱旋之歌像蜂蜜酒一樣在他的故事中令人著迷。

original: I would lead the song of triumph as our mead hall reveled in her stories.
string: 我要讓凱旋之歌像蜂蜜酒一樣在她的故事中令人著迷。

original: And would you raise a mug in his name?
string: 你願意為他舉杯嗎？

original: And would you raise a mug in her name?
string: 你願意為她舉杯嗎？

original: It stands ready to meet the blood of his foes.
string: 它時刻準備著飲下他敵人的血。

original: It stands ready to meet the blood of her foes.
string: 它時刻準備著飲下她敵人的血。

original: And would you raise your sword in his honor?
string: 你願意為他的榮耀揮劍嗎？

original: And would you raise your sword in her honor?
string: 你願意為她的榮耀揮劍嗎？

original: I would stand at his back, that the world might never overtake us.
string: 我會永遠站在他身後，讓這世界永遠沒機會擊倒我們。

original: I would stand at her back, that the world might never overtake us.
