original: Yes. I'm your friend, and I've invited you to dinner.
string: 對。我是你的朋友，我也邀請過你。

original: Never mind, then.
string: 哦，那算了。

original: Arkay watch over you.
string: 阿爾凱注視著你。

original: What do you want with me?
string: 你想要我做什麼？

original: I said let's go. Now.
string: 我們走吧。現在。

original: He... He gave me something just a little while ago.
string: 他……他之前給了我一些東西。

original: He told me it was from Labyrinthian, and that I would know what to do with it when the time came.
string: 他跟我說是從「迷城」帶過來的，還說只要時機一到，我就自然會知道怎麼處理。

original: I think... I think he meant this for you, then. I'm not sure why, but there was something very personal about it for him.
string: 我想……他是想要我把這交給你。雖然我不知道為什麼，但這東西對他有特殊意義。

original: Also, I think you should take this amulet. It belonged to Savos, but I think would do you the most good now.
string: 你收下吧，雖然它是屬於薩沃斯的，但現在對你更有用。

original: Take it, and get out of here. Bring back that staff before Ancano brings the whole College down around us.
string: 帶著它吧，然後離開這裡。在安卡諾把整個學院都整垮之前把法杖帶回來。

original: I don't understand. What coincidence?
string: 我不明白。什麼巧合？

original: Savos. Before... before he died.
string: 薩沃斯。在……在他死之前。

original: You really think the Staff will help?
string: 你覺得那法杖真的有幫助？

original: You were told to find it, weren't you?
string: 你被告知需要找到它，對吧？

original: If the stories about the staff are true, if it really can absorb a tremendous amount of power, maybe we can break through Ancano's magic.
string: 如果那些傳說屬實，如果它真的能吸取極大的能量，也許我們就能打破安卡諾的魔法。

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

original: What in the name of Sithis...
string: 西帝斯在上，那究竟是……

original: Cicero! It's good to see you again, old friend.
string: 西塞羅！很高興能再見到你，老朋友。

original: Listener!
string: 聆聽者！

original: Home again, home again! I'll return to the Night Mother straightaway!
string: 回家了，可以回家了！我會馬上回去找夜母的！

original: You're dismissed. Return home.
string: 你可以走了，回家吧。

original: Oh, of course. Mother needs me, after all.
string: 噢，行。畢竟夜母還需要我。

original: You're dismissed. Stay in the Sanctuary.
string: 你可以走了，請待在聖所裡。

original: I will return to the Dawnstar Sanctuary immediately, Listener.
string: 我會馬上回到晨星聖所的，聆聽者。

original: You're dismissed. Return home.
string: 你被解雇了，回家吧。

original: Yes, Listener. I'll be here if you need me.
string: 是，聆聽者。有需要時請來找我。

original: You're dismissed. Stay in the Sanctuary.
string: 你被解雇了，待在聖所裡。

original: Yes, Listener. I'll return to the Dawnstar Sanctuary without delay.
string: 是，聆聽者。我會立即回到晨星聖所的。

original: You're dismissed. Return home.
string: 妳被解雇了，回家吧。

original: Of course. But if you need me, just give the order.
string: 是的。但只要有需要，請儘管開口。

original: You're dismissed. Stay in the Sanctuary.
string: 妳被解雇了，待在聖所裡。

original: Yes, Listener! I will remain in this very spot until you tell me otherwise. Spiders could eat my face off and faithful Cicero would not move an inch!
string: 是的！聆聽者！我就待在這裡，直到你有下一步指示。就算蜘蛛爬過來要咬爛我的臉，忠心的西塞羅也不會走動一步的！

original: Wait here.
string: 在這裡等著。

original: Yes, Listener. I won't move unless you give the word.
string: 是，聆聽者！我會原地待命。

original: Wait here.
string: 在這裡等著。

original: I'll remain in this location until ordered otherwise.
string: 是，聆聽者！我會原地待命。

original: Wait here.
string: 在這裡等著。

original: Oh yes, Cicero and the Listener! On the hunt!
string: 遵命，西塞羅和聆聽者！整裝待發！

original: I command you to accompany me.
string: 我命令你與我結伴同行。

original: Off we go.
string: 我們走吧。

original: Follow me.
string: 跟著我。

original: Oh, but the Listener jests with poor Cicero. You already have company. You don't need my help at all.
string: 噢，聆聽者真會跟可憐的西塞羅開玩笑。你已經有同伴了。你根本不需要我的幫助。

original: Follow me.
string: 跟著我。

original: I am honored to be chosen.
string: 我很榮幸我能被選中。

original: I command you to accompany me.
string: 我命令你與我結伴同行。

original: Lead on, Listener.
string: 帶路吧，聆聽者。

original: Follow me.
string: 跟著我。

original: But you already have a traveling companion. I fear I would just get in the way.
string: 但你已經有同伴同行了。恐怕我不該打擾你們。

original: Follow me.
string: 跟著我。

original: I am yours, Listener.
string: 為您服務，聆聽者。

original: I command you to accompany me.
string: 我命令妳與我結伴同行。

original: Yes, Listener.
string: 是的，聆聽者。

original: Follow me.
string: 跟著我。

original: Oh, well... You seem to already have assistance. Surely you mean to remain inconspicuous...
string: 噢，好吧……看來您已經有幫手了。你肯定不想太引人注目吧……

original: Follow me.
string: 跟著我。

original: As for myself, you've proven your mastery twice over. Thuri, Dovahkiin. I gladly acknowledge the power of your Thu'um.
string: 對於我來說，你已經兩次證明了你的才能。圖維，都瓦克因。我很高興能承認你那吐姆的力量。

original: And so Alduin's lordship passes to you. Thuri, Dovahkiin. I gladly submit to your mastery of the Thu'um.
string: 那麼奧杜因的統治權就移交了你的手上。圖維，都瓦克因。我很高興能夠為你服務。

original: Zu'u Odahviing. Call me when you have need, and I will come if I can.
string: 祖．傲達威英。你要是有需要就叫我，我會盡力趕來的。

original: The world is a better place without Alduin.
string: 沒有奧杜因，這個世界更完美了。

original: Perhaps. At least it will continue to exist. Grik los lein.
string: 也許吧。至少它會繼續存在。格理克 羅斯 雷恩。

original: And, as you told me once, the next world will have to take care of itself. Ful nii los. Even I cannot see past Time's ending.
string: 而且，正如你曾說過的那樣，下個時代的人民只能自求多福了，福爾 尼 羅斯。連我也看不透時空的終結。

original: I am glad you believe that. At least it will continue to exist. Grik los lein.
string: 我很高興你能夠相信。至少它會繼續存在。格理克 羅斯 雷恩。

original: Even I cannot see past Time's ending to what comes next. Niid koraav zeim dinoksetiid. We must do the best we can with this world.
string: 連我也看不透時空終結以後，將會迎來些什麼？尼埃德 克拉夫 澤埃姆 蒂諾可賽迪埃德。我們必須盡力去幫助世界。

original: But I forget myself. Krosis. So los mid fahdon. Melancholy is an easy trap for a dovah to fall into.
string: 我失態了，克洛西斯。索 羅斯 米得 法爾頓。都瓦很容易陷入憂鬱的陷阱之中。

original: You have won a mighty victory. Sahrot krongrah - one that will echo through all the ages of this world for those who have eyes to see.
string: 你獲得了一個偉大的勝利。薩羅特 克羅格拉——那將會在這世界的文明裡永遠流傳下去。

original: Savor your triumph, Dovahkiin. This is not the last of what you will write upon the currents of Time.
string: 享受你的勝利吧，都瓦克因。這並不是你在時間洪流所寫下的最後篇章。

original: Perhaps now you have some insight into the forces that shape the vennesetiid... the currents of Time.
string: 也許你已深刻領悟了塑造這維納賽迪埃德的……時間洪流。

original: Perhaps you begin to see the world as a dovah.
string: 也許你開始以都瓦的眼光看世界了。

original: I was just fulfilling my destiny as Dragonborn.
string: 我只是在履行我作為龍裔的使命。

original: You once told me you did not believe in destiny.
string: 你曾告訴過我你不相信命運。

original: Indeed, you saw more clearly than I - certainly more clearly than Alduin. Rok funta koraav.
string: 確實，你看得比我更清楚——當然也比奧杜因更清楚。洛克 方塔 克拉夫。

original: I told you I'd stop him, and I did.
string: 我說過我會阻止他的，而我也做到了。

original: And so you fulfilled your destiny, which you once said you did not believe in.
string: 你曾說過你不信宿命，但還是難逃預定的結局。

original: But I cannot celebrate his fall. Zu'u tiiraaz ahst ok mah. He was my brother once. This world will never be the same.
string: 但我無法慶祝牠的死。祖 烏 提艾拉茲 阿斯 烏克 瑪。好歹牠曾是我的兄弟，一切都已經變了。

original: Alduin brought this on himself.
string: 這是奧杜因牠自找的。

original: Indeed.  Alduin wahlaan daanii.
string: 確實。奧杜因瓦藍 達尼埃。

original: His doom was written when he claimed for himself the lordship that properly belongs to Bormahu - our father Akatosh.
string: 當牠宣佈自己擁有統治權的時候，牠的滅亡便已註定。因為那本是屬於博瑪胡——我們的父親阿卡托什的。

original: It was necessary.
string: 這是必須的。

original: You did what was necessary. Alduin had flown far from the path of right action in his pahlok - the arrogance of his power.
string: 你做了你該做的事。奧杜因已經在錯誤的路途上飛得太遠——牠對自己的力量過於自負。

original: I have no regrets. Alduin had to be destroyed.
string: 我一點都不後悔。奧杜因必須被毀滅。

original: Of course. Alduin wahlaan daanii. I would not have helped you if I thought otherwise.
string: 確實。奧杜因瓦藍 達尼埃。要非我想法跟你一致，我不會幫你的。

original: You don't sound very happy about it.
string: 聽你的語氣似乎不太高興。

original: Happy? No, I am not happy. Zeymahi lost ont du'ul Bormahu. Alduin was once the crown of our father Akatosh's creation.
string: 高興？不，我一點都不高興。澤瑪西 洛斯特 奧 杜烏 博瑪胡。奧杜因曾是我們父親手下最優秀的存在。

original: So, it is done. Alduin dilon. The Eldest is no more, he who came before all others, and has always been.
string: 劃下句點了吧，奧杜因狄龍。最年長者已逝，前無來者，永恆存在 。

original: I was actually looking to buy something.
string: 我其實是準備買些東西。

original: Didn't you just see that woman getting attacked in front of us? We're closed.
string: 你剛沒看到那個女人在我們面前受到襲擊嗎？我們打烊了。

original: Who was he? Who are the Forsworn?
string: 他是誰？棄誓者是幹嘛的？

original: Think he worked down at the smelter. Lot of the laborers there are sympathetic to the Forsworn.
string: 也許他是在鍛造廠裡工作，那裡很多勞工都同情那些棄誓者

original: They promise people they'll kill off all the Nords that rule over the Reach. Nothing but murderers and saboteurs.
string: 他們承諾會殺掉所有統治著邊塞的諾德人。他們純粹就是一幫殺人犯和內奸。

original: Did you see that madman? A Forsworn agent. Here in the city.
string: 你看見那個瘋子沒有？那個棄誓者的間諜。就在這座城市裡。

original: I was actually looking to buy something.
string: 我其實是準備買些東西。

original: I'm sorry. I don't think I can bare to sell anything right now.
string: 很抱歉，我現在沒心情賣任何東西。

original: Did you know her? Who was she?
string: 你認識她嗎？她是誰？

original: She's a traveler, from the Imperial City. Came by every day looking for jewelry for her relatives back home.
string: 她是從帝都來的旅客，每天都過來看看，想買些珠寶回去給親戚。

original: Why would anyone want to kill her? It doesn't make any sense.
string: 為什麼會有人想要殺她？這沒道理啊。

original: No. She's such a nice woman. Comes by every day looking for jewelry for her family in Cyrodiil. Is it because she's a noble?
string: 的確。她是個好女人。她每天都來給賽瑞迪爾的家人買珠寶，也許她是個貴族？

original: Why would anyone want to kill her? It doesn't make any sense.
string: 為什麼會有人想要殺她？這沒有意義啊。

original: Do you know why he was after her?
string: 你知道他為什麼跟蹤她嗎？

original: Margret. He... he killed her. Right in front of me.
string: 瑪格麗特。他……把她殺了，就在我面前。

original: He... he tried to kill Margret. Right in front of me.
string: 他……他就在我面前，企圖殺害瑪格麗特。

original: None of my business, anyway.
string: 無論如何，這與我無關。

original: That's right. It isn't.
string: 沒錯，不關你的事。

original: That man shouted something about the "Forsworn."
string: 那男人在大聲喊「棄誓者」什麼什麼的。

original: I said move along. The Forsworn are just a bunch of madmen. We have everything under control. Stay out of it.
string: 我重覆一次，你快走吧。棄誓者不過只是一群瘋子而已，我們已經控制住局面了，別來礙事。

original: We'll handle things from here. Move along.
string: 現在由我們接手處理，請離開吧。

original: The Forsworn. Here inside the city.
string: 棄誓者。就在這城市裡面。

original: He was after Margret. Why?
string: 他為什麼尾隨著瑪格麗特呢？

original: Damn. Another body to get rid of.
string: 該死。又一具屍體要處理。

original: Betrid. No! We had a deal you Forsworn bastards!
string: 貝垂德！不！你們這些棄誓者混蛋，我們可是說好了的！

original: Why? We had a deal Madanach. A deal!
string: 為什麼？邁德納奇，說好的協議呢。協議呢！

original: Traitors. Traitors all of you!
string: 叛徒。你們都是叛徒！

original: The Reach belongs to the Forsworn!
string: 邊塞是屬於棄誓者的！

original: Biding his time until what? Until another person is lying dead in the streets? Don't be naive.
string: 他還想等到什麼時候？等到再有人橫屍街頭嗎？別那麼天真了。

original: Please. Those savages are no match for us. The Jarl is just biding his time.
string: 拜託。那些野蠻人怎麼可能是我們的對手。領主只是在等待時機。

original: The Jarl is refusing to dispatch men to the front lines. Do you think it's because of the Forsworn threat?
string: 領主一直不肯派人上前線。你覺得這和棄誓者的威脅有關嗎？

original: You're being paranoid. We're in control of Markarth. Not the Forsworn.
string: 你別胡思亂想了，我們已經控制了馬卡斯城。兇手不可能是棄誓者。

original: Yeah, but she was a Nord. And a noble. Perfect Forsworn target.
string: 對，但她是諾德人。而且還是貴族。對棄誓者來說確是個完美的目標。

original: I think it was Margret. Poor woman, she was just visiting the city from Cyrodiil.
string: 我想那是瑪格麗特吧。可憐的女人，她才剛從賽瑞迪爾來到這裡旅遊。

original: Someone was attacked in the market. Do you know who it was?
string: 有人在市場裡被襲擊了。你知道那是誰嗎？

original: Now you're being ridiculous. This is our city. Not theirs.
string: 你可真是莫名其妙，這城市是我們的，不是他們的。

original: This was their city once. They won't stop until we're all dead.
string: 但這曾經是他們的城市，他們想殺光我們。

original: The Jarl has things under control. Don't you worry.
string: 領主會掌控局面的，你別擔心。

original: A Forsworn agent. Running loose in the city. The Jarl is going to hear about this.
string: 一個棄誓者的間諜在城市裡四處活動，應該將此事報告領主。

original: dunMiddenShared
string: dunMiddenShared

original: I'd like to rent a room. (<Global=RoomCost> gold)
string: 我想要租個房間。（<Global=RoomCost>金幣）

original: Are you joking? You just rented a room from me.
string: 你在開玩笑嗎？你已經租下一間了。

original: Have a good rest. It's the big room with the double bed.
string: 好好休息吧。那可是間有雙人床的大房間。

original: I'll rent Tiber Septim's room. (<Global=RoomCost> gold)
string: 我想租泰伯．塞普汀的房間。（<Global=RoomCost>金幣）

original: Sure thing. It's yours for a day.
string: 當然可以，這房間今天是屬於你的。

original: What does this look like, the Temple of Mara? No gold, no bed.
string: 你當我這裡是什麼，瑪拉的神殿嗎？沒錢，就別想住在這裡。

original: I'd like to rent a room.  (<Global=RoomCost> gold)
string: 我想要租個房間。（<Global=RoomCost>金幣）

original: Are you joking? You just rented a room from me.
string: 你在開玩笑嗎？你已經租下一間了。

original: Sure thing. It's yours for a day.
string: 當然可以，這房間今天是屬於你的。

original: What does this look like, the Temple of Mara? No gold, no bed.
string: 你當我這裡是什麼，瑪拉的神殿嗎？沒錢，就別想住在這裡。

original: Sorry, love, but I'm not a charity.
string: 抱歉，親愛的，我可不是在經營慈善事業呢。

original: Oh, very well. But my energies are low. I warn you - I won't be able to see much. Give me... five gold, and I'll do what I can.
string: 噢，非常好。但我的法力不多了。所以我們先說好——我無法預知太多東西。給我……五枚金幣吧，我盡力而為。

original: I want you to read my fortune.
string: 我想讓你幫我算算命。

original: No... no, that is all. Now... now please. I find myself very weary all of sudden.
string: 不……不，就這麼多了。現在……現在我，突然感覺非常累。

original: Is there anything else?
string: 還有什麼其他的嗎？

original: There's a cave. No, not a cave. A... home? A place you feel secure. You will find safety there... sanctuary. I see snow, lit by the star of dawn.
string: 那有個洞穴。不，不是洞穴。是個……家？一個讓你感到可靠的地方……看來是星光下的聖所，你在那會很安全……

original: And you are not alone. There are others. A child of night... a stalker of the sands? Oh, but before you are family, there will be blood. Such blood.
string: 不是只有你一個，還有其他的人。一名夜之子……一名沙土潛行者？噢，但在你們團結一致之前，也許得先流點血。流很多的血。

original: Wait! There's something else... A potential for adventure, and wealth. It is a ruin, ripe for the plunder. Deepwood Redoubt. Far to the northwest...
string: 等等！還有其他……也許能去冒險，甚至發財呢。有個廢墟值得探索。它叫做深木據點。在這遙遠的西北方……

original: Through there is... Hag's End. The last resting place of an assassin of old. A Dark Brother, who bequeaths his ancient earthly possessions... to you.
string: 穿過那裡將到達……巫婆之終。那長眠著一名古代的刺客。他是黑暗兄弟會的人，他將把他的世俗財產遺贈……給你。

original: What do you see?
string: 你看到了什麼？

original: Your destiny is dark. Oh yes, so dark. But much of it has been fulfilled. You have found sanctuary, and the comforting words of a mother's love.
string: 你的命運暗淡無光。噢是的，非常暗淡。不過多數命運已經被決定。你找到了聖所，還有母愛的安慰。

original: And you have companionship. A child of night, and a stalker of the sands. Together, you are a family.
string: 你還有同伴。一名夜之子，一名沙漠潛行者。你們就像一家人，團結在一起。

original: Wait! There's something else... A potential for adventure, and wealth. It is a ruin, ripe for the plunder. Deepwood Redoubt. Far to the northwest...
string: 等等！還有其他的……一個關於冒險，還有財富的可能性。有個廢墟值得探索。它叫做深木據點。在這遙遠的西北方……

original: It is the last resting place of an assassin of old. A Dark Brother, who bequeaths his ancient earthly possessions... to you.
string: 那裡長眠著一名古代的刺客。他是黑暗兄弟會的人，他將把他留在世間的財產轉贈……給你。

original: What do you see?
string: 妳看到了什麼？

original: WhiterunOlavaReadingTopic1
string: WhiterunOlavaReadingTopic1

original: Hmph. Yes. Yes, I surely can. It's not something I do lightly, mind you, and it's not as specific as you might want. But yes. I will do this for you.
string: 嗯。是的。是的，當然可以。但先說好，這不是什麼輕而易舉的事，也許沒你期待得那麼詳盡。但是可以，我能幫你。

original: Please, relax. Free your mind. Yes, that's it...
string: 請你放鬆，放開你的心靈。是的，就是那樣……

original: I was told you could see my future.
string: 我聽說妳能預知未來。

original: Token, you say? Let me see.
string: 你說是，信物？給我看看

original: Oh, goodness me. You're a friend of Gabriella's, then. Well, I guess we both know why you're here.
string: 噢，天哪！你是加布裡艾拉的朋友啊，原來。好吧，那我知道你為什麼到這裡來了。

original: I have this token for you.
string: 這個信物給你。

original: Why, this is utterly unique.
string: 這實在太特殊了。

original: I'm not the only one seeing this, am I?
string: 不是只有我看到，對吧？

original: Not much further. Come, little thing. Serve me in death.
string: 夠了。來吧，小東西。給我死吧。

original: I took care of that group of Silver Hand.
string: 我處理掉了那幫白銀之手的人。

original: Excellent. Looks like you've really driven them into hiding. Keep this up. We'll wipe them out, yet.
string: 太棒了，看來你真的把他們趕跑了，繼續努力。總有一天，我們會把他們趕盡殺絕。

original: I've got the plans.
string: 我拿到了那些計劃。

original: Perfect. Hopefully this will let us know more about their movement. I think we've got them on the run!

string: 半個天際都已落入我們手中，錢財也開始滾滾而來了。

string: 呃…看來你的行動已經在外面引起了不少反響。人們也再次議論起公會了。

original: The Guild's at full strength and we have you to thank for it. We've had our share of dark times, and now they seem like a distant memory.

string: 你應該發現了，公會正在成長。漏壺外面的空地上又多了一個商家。

string: 能卸下負擔重新上路的感覺真好，繼續努力吧，我能看到賞金就在前方。

string: 要是我的敵人當中有一個不想買兇殺我，我都覺得是一種侮辱。

original: Answer me, or I'll paint this room with your blood! (Intimidate)
string: 回答我，不然我就給你放血爽一下！（威嚇）

original: DB02Captive2Intimidate
string: DB02Captive2Intimidate

original: I'm kneeling here with my hands bound and a sack over my head, and you have the gall to ask me that?
string: 我雙手被捆綁著頭上套著麻袋跪在這裡，你居然還厚顏無恥這樣問我？

original: What do you think, genius?
string: 你在想什麼？天才？

original: One last time: Would. Someone. Pay. To. Have. You. Killed? (Intimidate)
string: 最後問你一次：有、人、要、買、凶、殺、你、嗎？（威嚇）

original: DB02Captive1Intimidate
string: DB02Captive1Intimidate

original: Please! I don't know! I mean, I'm a soldier. I've killed people. When I was ordered to. Maybe there were some times... some times I got carried away?
string: 拜託！我不知道！我是當兵的，我殺過人，但都是服從命令而已。也許有時候……有時候我會殺紅了眼？

original: But war is war. Right? Nobody could blame me for that. Could they?
string: 但是戰爭嘛，難免會死人的，對吧？這不能怪我，對吧？

original: Answer me, or die! (Intimidate)
string: 回答我，不然就下地獄吧！（威嚇）

original: DB02Captive3Persuade
string: DB02Captive3Persuade

original: He he he he he he he. The real question is, "Would someone pay to have me killed... again."
string: 嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。真正應該問的是：「會有人想買凶再殺我一次嗎」。

original: A day goes by without someone trying to gut me in the street, I get disappointed.
string: 今天又沒有人在街上刺我一刀，我有些失望。

original: Come on, you can tell me. We're all friends here. (Persuade)
string: 拜託，你可以告訴我的。我們是朋友。（說服）

original: DB02Captive2Persuade
string: DB02Captive2Persuade

original: I'm a woman living in Skyrim with six children and no husband. I don't have the time or patience to be "nice."
string: 我是個住在天際省、沒有丈夫、一個人帶六個孩子的女人。我沒有時間和耐心「扮好人」。

original: Do some people look down on me? Have I made some enemies? You're damn right.
string: 有人鄙視我？我樹敵了？好吧，你說的太對了。

original: It's all right. Just tell me what I need to know. (Persuade)
string: 沒關係。把我想知道的告訴我就行了。（說服）

original: DB02Captive1Persuade
string: DB02Captive1Persuade

original: Okay, well... I guess it's possible. I've been selling my sword arm for years now. Killed a lot of people. Could be someone wanted revenge.
string: 好吧，嗯……我想可以吧。我當了這麼多年傭兵，殺了很多人。有人找我報仇也不奇怪。

original: But... But you're not going to kill me. Right?
string: 但……但你不會殺我的，對吧？

original: Shhh... Don't be afraid. You can tell me. (Persuade)
string: 噓……別怕。全都告訴我吧。（說服）

original: I'll need to lock up the store. Thank you so much for agreeing to help us.
string: 我得把店關了。非常感謝你願意幫助我們。

original: I should lock up the store now. Thank you again.
string: 我現在應該把店關了。再次謝謝你。

original: Mara, I forgot how late it was. We'll need to lock up the shop.
string: 瑪拉，我忘了已經這麼晚了。我們得把店關了。

original: Mara, I forgot how late it was. Need to lock up the shop.
string: 瑪拉，我忘了已經這麼晚了。得把店關了。

original: Many used to come to these caves. The forgotten. The wretched.
string: 很多人都曾經來過這些山洞。被遺忘的。窮困潦倒的。

original: I've found the Crown of Barenziah.
string: 我找到了巴蘭茲雅王冠。

original: I knew you had it in you. After all, finding the Stones was no easy feat.
string: 我就知道你辦得到。畢竟，尋找那些石頭並不是件容易的事。

original: Well, I'm not one to welch on a deal, so here's your reward. I hope you put it to good use. I know I have.
string: 我是說話算話的人，這是給你的報酬。我希望你能善用它。是我的話就會。

original: Does the crown still exist?
string: 王冠還存在嗎？

original: I have it on good authority that the crown is within Tolvald's Cave; dropped by a Dunmer caravan leaving Morrowind long ago.
string: 據可靠消息，王冠還藏在托沃德洞穴裡呢。是在很久以前一個鍛莫在離開晨風省時不小心遺落的。

original: If you can bring it back, we could restore the paragon... and reap its benefits.
string: 如果你把它找回來，我們就可以恢復這個昔日的皇家象徵……並且享受它帶來的好處。

original: Now is it worth something?
string: 現在這東西可值錢了吧？

original: When I told you the set had to be complete, I left out a small detail... I honestly didn't think you'd ever get this far.
string: 在我告訴你要找齊一整套的時候，我漏了一些小細節……說真的我並沒有想到你能做到這一步。

original: If the stones were remounted on the crown, it would be of great benefit to the Thieves Guild.
string: 如果那些寶石能夠被重新鑲嵌在王冠上，對於盜賊公會將有莫大的幫助。

original: I've found all of the Stones of Barenziah.
string: 我找到了所有的巴蘭茲雅寶石。

original: I've found all the Stones of Barenziah.
string: 我找到了所有的巴蘭茲雅寶石。

original: Unbelievable! You must be the first person to set eyes on all twenty-four of them in... well, the last two eras.
string: 難以置信！你肯定是最近兩個紀元以來第一個找齊全部二十四個的人。

original: You sure you won't buy it?
string: 妳確定妳不買？

original: Look, I only buy things I can turn around quickly for a profit. And no one wants those stones unless they have the whole set.
string: 聽著，我只買倒貨快、能賺錢的東西。沒有一整套的話沒人想買這些石頭的。

original: Tell you what, if you find the rest of them, talk to me again. Otherwise, keep it and maybe it'll bring you luck.
string: 這麼說好了，如果你找到了剩下的再來找我。不然，就自己留著，說不定會給你帶來好運。

original: How many of these are there?
string: 這總共有多少個？

original: I think there were twenty-four in all. Most people keep them as a curiosity.
string: 我想應該是有24個。很多人基本上只是出於好奇心而收藏它。

original: Some of the Guild members have tried to locate them over the years, but they haven't been successful... well, until now.
string: 這些年來公會的一些人一直在找它們，都無功而返……好吧，直到現在。

original: Is it worth anything?
string: 這東西有價值嗎？

original: Not like that it isn't.
string: 並不如它看起來的那樣。

original: The stone was pried off of Barenziah's ceremonial crown by a thief in order to cover his tracks.
string: 這石頭是一個小偷從巴蘭茲雅在加冠儀式時所戴的王冠上偷取的，他這麼做是為了掩蓋行蹤。

original: Is this unusual gem worth anything?
string: 這種不尋常的寶石有什麼價值嗎？

original: Been a while since I've seen one of those. What you've got there is a Stone of Barenziah.
string: 我很久沒見到過這種寶石了。你手頭的這個是巴蘭茲雅寶石。

original: In case Falk doesn't make it clear - Solitude owes you a debt of gratitude.
string: 為了避免佛可沒有跟你說清楚 - 獨孤城欠你一個人情。

original: I hope Falk made it clear that Solitude owes you a debt of gratitude.
string: 我希望佛可跟你說了獨孤城欠你一個人情這件事。

original: I have Potema's remains.
string: 我把波特瑪的遺體拿來了。

original: Excellent! These things do have a way of working out when people take action. I'll sanctify the remains.
string: 很好！這種事情只要有人付諸行動，還是會有結果的。我會淨化這具遺體的。

original: Take this payment - the Jarl would thank you but she very much wants to keep Potema's return quiet.
string: 收下這個謝禮 - 領主本當親自謝你，但她更希望讓波特瑪回歸這件事情低調一點。

original: Make no mistake we consider you a protector of Solitude.
string: 不要誤會，我們可是把你當作獨孤城的保衛者的。

original: Take this payment - the Jarl would thank you but she very much wants to keep Potema's return quiet.
string: 收下這個謝禮 - 領主本當親自謝你，但她更希望讓波特瑪回歸這件事情低調一點。

original: Make no mistake we consider you a protector of Solitude.
string: 不要誤會，我們可是把你當作獨孤城的保衛者的。

original: Falk sent me to talk to you about Potema.
string: 佛可派我來跟你談談波特瑪的事情。

original: Ah Potema. Former queen of Solitude and one of the most dangerous necromancers in recorded history.
string: 啊，波特瑪。獨孤城的前任皇后，史上最危險的死靈法師之一。

original: She was responsible for the Empire's near collapse almost five hundred years ago. I believe I have a book about her...
string: 她是五百多年前讓帝國遭遇到危機的罪魁禍首。我有一本關於她的書。

original: As to Potema herself, find what's left of her body, likely a skeleton. Remove it from the Catacombs and bring it back to be sanctified by Arkay.
string: 至於波特瑪，你去找到她的遺骸，可能已經變成一具屍骨。把她從地下墓穴中取出並帶回來，然後讓阿爾凱進行淨化。

original: I can do that.
string: 沒問題。

original: Good. Being at the summoning created a connection to Potema, you are the one to do this.
string: 很好。你參與了招魂儀式，已經與波特瑪有了某種程度上的聯繫，因此你是這項任務的不二人選。

original: I can provide you with some help with her minions.
string: 如果屆時要對付她的爪牙什麼的，我可以提供一些幫助。

original: And now that Potema has returned?
string: 現在波特瑪已經回歸了？

original: Summoned in spirit form is not raised from the dead. She'll need help before she can return to the living.
string: 招魂不是起死回生。讓她復活的話還需要一些幫助。

original: For the moment, the Wolf Queen has retreated to a place filled with dead eager to serve her. She has gone to her old Catacombs.
string: 目前，狼女王已經退到一個滿是她忠實追隨者的地方 - 她那座古代地下墓穴。

original: A few days ago, one of her servants busted through a wall into the Temple of Divines. We'll need you to go into the Catacombs themselves.
string: 幾天前，她的一個僕人鑽牆進了聖靈神殿。我們想請你親自進地下墓穴一趟。

original: I'll talk to Styrr. We'll figure something out.
string: 我會找斯提爾談談。我們會想出辦法的。

original: I wish you well friend. Be careful.
string: 祝你好運，朋友，多保重。

original: You've returned. Good. What did you find at Wolfskull Cave?
string: 你回來了。很好。你在狼頭骨洞穴裡有什麼發現嗎？

original: Pruzah wundunne wah Wuth Gein. I wish the old one luck in his... quest.
string: 普魯紮 烏獨內 瓦爾 烏斯 蓋因。希望那老傢伙一切順利吧。

original: But I doubt many will wish to exchange Alduin's lordship for the tyranny of Paarthurnax's "Way of the Voice".
string: 但我很懷疑有多少人願意用奧杜因的統治來換取帕圖納克斯「龍吼之道」的暴政。

original: If Alduin himself could not stand against your Thu'um, I feel no shame in my own defeat.
string: 如果奧杜因無法對抗你的吐姆，那我失敗了也沒什麼好羞愧的。

original: Goraan! I feel younger than I have in many an age.
string: 戈拉恩！我覺得自己比以前年輕多了。

original: Many of the dovahhe are now scattered across Keizaal. Without Alduin's lordship, they may yet bow to the vahzen... rightness of my Thu'um.
string: 現在很多都瓦都散落在凱紮。沒有奧杜因的統治，牠們尚未臣服於瓦紮恩……我的吐姆。

original: But willing or no, they will hear it! Fare thee well, Dovahkiin!
string: 但不管如何，牠們都會聽到的！永別了，都瓦克因！

original: I'll put it plainly. You can claim your sword, or you can keep your wife. If you set foot outside the gate, I won't be here when you return.
string: 我把話說明白，你要嘛拿回你的劍，或是保住你的妻子。如果你出了這道門，我可不會在這裡等你回來。

original: I just need to hire one, maybe two good men. You won't starve.
string: 我只是要雇一、兩個能幹的人。妳不會因此餓著的。

original: So you're willing to starve your wife and daughter to reclaim some rusty old sword?
string: 這麼說你願意為了一把鏽跡斑斑的古董劍而讓你的妻女挨餓？

original: It took me weeks to find that thieves' den. I can't stop now, and I can't get the sword on my own.
string: 我花了好幾個星期才找到那夥盜賊的窩。我現在不能半途而廢，但靠我一個人也拿不回那把劍。

original: I know your family's honor is important to you, but we can't afford it!
string: 我知道家族榮譽對你來說很重要，但我們冒不起這個險！

original: Wait... I....
string: 等等……我……

original: Saffir!
string: 莎弗兒！

original: I want to stop at Karthwasten. (<Global=CarriageCost> gold)
string: 我想去西卡斯鎮。（<Global=CarriageCost>金幣）

string: 晨星城。（<Global=CarriageCostSmall>金幣）

string: 佛克瑞斯。（<Global=CarriageCostSmall>金幣）

original: I want to stop at Kynesgrove. (<Global=CarriageCost> gold)
string: 我想去凱娜之林。（<Global=CarriageCost>金幣）

original: I want to stop at Shor's Stone. (<Global=CarriageCost> gold)
string: 我想去朔爾之石。（<Global=CarriageCost>金幣）

string: 我想去黑水岔口。（<Global=CarriageCost>金幣）

string: 我想去紫杉鎮。（<Global=CarriageCost>金幣）

string: 我想去石山。（<Global=CarriageCost>金幣）

original: I want to stop at Old Hroldan. (<Global=CarriageCost> gold)
string: 我想去古赫洛登。（<Global=CarriageCost>金幣）

original: Just pay me when the job's done.
string: 搞定了付我錢就行。

original: My only demand is that these vermin are permanently eliminated before my reputation is completely destroyed.
string: 我唯一的要求是在我的名聲被完全毀掉之前永久剷除那些害蟲。

original: You'd better, or I yell "skeever." (Intimidate)
string: 你最好快點兒，不然我叫「惡鼠」出來了。（威嚇）

original: Okay, okay. No need to make rash decisions.
string: 好吧，好吧。別這麼急嘛。

original: Here's half. You get the rest when the job's done.
string: 這是一半報酬。事成之後再給剩下的。

original: Yell all you want. It's not going to change my mind.
string: 你儘管叫吧。我不會改變主意的。

original: I might be able to help.
string: 我可以幫忙。

original: Oh really? And I don't suppose you'd just do it out of the kindness of your heart, would you?
string: 哦，是嗎？你應該不是出於好心的吧？

original: I hope you're not expecting to get paid until the job's done.
string: 我希望你在工作完成之前別老想著報酬。

original: That's the only way I operate. (Persuade)
string: 這是我的行事原則。（說服）

original: Oh, very well. Here's half. You get the rest when the job's done.
string: 哦，很好。這是一半報酬。事成之後再給剩下的。

original: Well that's not how I operate, so forget it.
string: 但那不是我的行事原則，免談了。

original: You've got a deal.
string: 就這麼定了。

original: Don't come back until every one of those things are dead.
string: 殺光那些東西之前別給我回來。

original: How do I "permanently" clear the vermin?
string: 我要如何「永久地」除掉那些害蟲？

original: I bought some poison. I was going to have my lazy, good-for-nothing assistant Mallus handle it, but he seems to have vanished.
string: 我買了些毒藥。本來想叫我那懶惰而又一無是處的助手莫魯斯來處理的，但他好像消失了。

original: If you plant this in the vermin's nest, it should stop them from ever coming back.
string: 如果你把這毒藥放在害蟲的巢穴裡，就能阻止它們回來。

original: My apologies, Lady Maven.
string: 對不起，瑪雯女士。

original: The only reason we're having this conversation is due to Brynjolf's assurance you won't botch another assignment.
string: 我們會在這說話的唯一原因是布林喬夫保證過你不會搞砸另一項任務。

original: He claims you possess some sort of uncanny aptitude for your line of work. Quite frankly I find that hard to believe.
string: 他說你在你這行當中擁有不可思議的能力。老實說，我不怎麼相信。

original: Where do I begin?
string: 我該從哪開始？

original: Head to the Bannered Mare in Whiterun and look for Mallus Maccius. He'll fill you in on all the details.
string: 去白漫城的「敕旗母馬客棧」找莫魯斯．馬修斯，他會告訴你詳細內容的。

original: You won't have that problem with me.
string: 你跟我合作不會有那種問題。

original: I hope not. This is an important job.
string: 希望不會。這可是個重要的任務。

original: I have a competitor called Honningbrew Meadery that I want to put out of business.
string: 我有個競爭對手叫做蜜之釀酒莊，我想讓它倒閉。

original: I also want to know how they managed to get the place up and running so quickly.
string: 我也想知道他們是怎麼這麼快建立並經營起來的。

original: You have no faith in the Guild?
string: 你不相信公會嗎？

original: Faith? I don't have faith in anyone.
string: 相信？我誰都不相信。

original: All I care about is cause and effect. Did the job get done and was it done correctly. There's no gray area.
string: 我只關心過程與結果。任務有沒有完成、以及完成的狀況之類的。沒有折衷可言。

original: You seem to know an awful lot about this place.
string: 你好像對這地方十分熟悉。

original: I suppose there's no point in concealing the truth any longer.
string: 我想沒必要再隱瞞事實了。

original: My knowledge of this temple comes from personal experience. I was a priest of Vaermina.
string: 我對這神殿的認識來自於個人經歷。我曾是個瓦爾迷納的祭司。

original: Let's just hope they got it right this time.
string: 希望它們這次能夠順利進行。

original: It was my idea to replace one of the key elements with our focusing crystal. Months of enchantments went into it.
string: 把其中一個關鍵元素替換成我們的聚焦水晶是我的主意。我們花了好幾個月將法力注入其中。

original: This machinery, all of it, was designed to collect starlight, and then... I'm not sure. Split it, somehow?
string: 這整個機械，就是被設計用來採集星光的，接下來嘛……我不知道要怎麼做，是不是用某種方法分離它？

original: From all our research, it seems they were intent on discerning the nature of the divine.
string: 從我們的研究來看，他們好像很熱切地想參透神明的本質。

original: I was the one who thought of using this... this Oculory. I don't know what the dwarves called it. Something unpronounceable, I'm sure.
string: 我就是那個想要用這個……這個匯光之睛的人。我不知道矮人們是怎麼稱呼它的。不過絕對會非常拗口，絕對。

original: No matter what Gavros said, this was my idea first. The Council is going to know that when I get back.
string: 不管加弗羅斯怎麼說，這最早是我的主意。等我回去議會就會知道了。

original: I found your crystal.
string: 我找到了你的水晶。

original: Ha! So you did.
string: 哈！你還真找到了。

original: I was almost beginning to think Gavros had gone and gotten himself killed just to spite me.
string: 我都開始懷疑加弗羅斯是因為冒犯我而送命的了。

original: Well, with the Falmer skulking around I can't very well do this on my own. I guess you'll have to come with me.
string: 因為周圍潛伏著伐莫族，我自己是沒法搞定這事的。你得跟著我。

original: I'll explain on the way.
string: 我會在路上解釋的。

original: I'm with the College of Winterhold.
string: 我是冬堡學院的人。

original: You are, are you?
string: 你當然是，怎麼了？

original: Savos wouldn't even grant us an audience when we came to you, but now you come here expecting something from me?
string: 當我們來找你的時候，薩沃斯甚至沒有理睬我們。現在你還想來有求於我們？

original: I don't much like this, I'll tell you. But you've saved my skin, so maybe I can overlook the past for now.
string: 我得說，我不大喜歡這樣。不過你幫過我大忙，因此我可以暫時不計前嫌。

original: Come on, I'll explain on the way.
string: 走吧，我會在路上解釋的。

original: I happen to have found a focusing Crystal. Is this what you were looking for?
string: 我找到了一個聚焦水晶。你是在找它嗎？

original: You found... how in the world...
string: 你找到了……怎麼可能……

original: That's it. That's it! I don't know who you are, but you may have just saved this little project...
string: 是的，就是它！我不知道你是誰，不過你可能挽救了我這個計劃……

original: In fact, who are you, anyway?
string: 對了，你到底是誰？

original: I don't know what sort of help you expect from me, but if you can actually find the crystal I'd certainly be grateful.
string: 我不知道你想要我幫什麼忙，但如果你能找到那水晶，我肯定會感謝你的。

original: If I find this crystal you're looking for. Will you help me?
string: 如果我幫你找到那個水晶。你會幫我嗎？

original: What's the crystal for?
string: 這水晶是做什麼用的？

original: It was a brilliant idea, really. Mostly mine, though Gavros took the credit.
string: 這可是個絕妙的點子，真的，基本上是我想到的，但加弗羅斯卻得到了稱讚。

original: Secret, though. Official Synod business. Can't talk about it.
string: 不過這是個秘密。因為這是個正式的希諾會事務，不能透露。

original: Go on, get out of here!
string: 走啊，快點滾！

original: Get out of my face!
string: 給我滾！

original: <Global=WE17GoldAmount> gold? You can have it, if you can take it from me.
string: <Global=WE17GoldAmount>金幣？沒問題啊，有本事就放馬過來拿。

original: If you insist. Come on boys. This'll be fun.
string: 如果你堅持的話。來吧，夥計們。這會很有意思的。

original: I'm afraid I don't have any gold to spare.
string: 恐怕我可沒有錢給你。

original: Fine. If you can't pay with coin, you'll pay with your life!
string: 沒關係。沒錢就償命吧！

original: Here, take it. (Pay <Global=WE17GoldAmount> gold)
string: 拿去吧。（支付<Global=WE17GoldAmount>金幣）

original: The, um, Emperor thanks you... Now shove off!
string: 那個誰，呃……皇帝會感謝你的……現在給我滾吧！

original: Er, rather, have a nice day, citizen.
string: 呃……那祝你愉快，公民。

original: Hello.
string: 你好。

original: You there! Ah... citizen. This area is off limits.
string: 喂，你！嗯……公民。此地閒人勿進。

original: You are interfering in Imperial business. Yeah, so you'll have to pay us a fine... of say, 100 gold. Pay up, citizen.
string: 你干涉了帝國公務。嗯，我們要罰你……讓我想想，100金幣。快拿出來，公民。

original: Grant me the power to break through this barrier and to send the Skull to the depths of Oblivion!
string: 賜予我力量，穿破這層障礙，把頭骨送到湮滅深處吧！

original: The Skull hungers. It yearns for memories and leaves nightmares in its wake.
string: 頭骨正感到飢餓不已。它急欲吞食記憶，所到之處只留下噩夢。

original: I call upon you, Lady Mara!
string: 我懇求你，瑪拉女士！

original: We can discuss it later. We need to proceed.
string: 我們過會兒再談。現在得前進。

original: Indeed. My reverence for Vaermina's machinations should not take precedence over our mission. My apologies.
string: 的確。我對瓦爾迷納詭計的敬畏之心不該阻礙了我們的任務。對不起。

original: The inner sanctum lies ahead. We must reach the Skull and put an end to Dawnstar's troubles. Lead on, my friend.
string: 內部聖所就在前面。我們必須趕到頭骨那裡，結束晨星城的麻煩。帶路吧，朋友。

original: Here? Now?
string: 在這裡？現在？

original: Dawnstar's fate rests in that tiny bottle. The longer we wait, the more damage Vaermina could be doing to those poor people.
string: 晨星城的命運就在那小瓶子裡了。耽擱越久，瓦爾迷納就會對那些可憐的人們造成更多傷害。

original: I understand your hesitation, but I promise you that it works.
string: 我明白你在猶豫什麼，但我保證那樣做是行得通的。

original: I found the Torpor.
string: 我找到了睡眠藥水。

original: I'm relieved you discovered a bottle intact; this place looks as though it was ransacked by the orcs.
string: 你發現了一瓶完整的藥水，那我就放心了。這地方看來已經被獸人徹底洗劫過。

original: So... I've taken us this far, but you need to guide us the rest of the way. Drink.
string: 那麼……我已經把咱們帶到這一步了，接下來要由你來帶路了。喝吧。

original: How will I know what it looks like?
string: 我怎知道是什麼樣子？

original: It should be in a small bottle, very similar to a potion.
string: 它應該在一個小瓶裡，和藥水很像。

original: I'll begin searching up here.
string: 我會從這裡開始找。

original: Now that they've been dealt with, we need to find the Torpor.
string: 既然已經搞定他們了，現在得去找睡眠藥水了。

original: What am I looking for?
string: 我要找什麼？

original: We're looking for a book of alchemical recipes called "The Dreamstride."
string: 我們在找一本名叫《夢中漫步》的鍊金配方書籍。

original: The tome bears the likeness of Vaermina on the cover. It should be here somewhere.
string: 那本書的外面有著瓦爾迷納的肖像。它應該就在這附近。

original: Barring any more interruptions, perhaps we can locate the information I need.
string: 倘若不會再有阻礙的話，我們就可以找到我要的資訊了。

original: Don't wait around for me. I bet I'll beat you to Korvanjund even though you start first.
string: 別等我。我打賭就算你先出發，我也會比你先到科萬瓊德。

original: We're not leaving until we get what we came for.
string: 沒得到我們要的東西，絕不能離開。

original: No. And I'm not sure I'm better off for it now neither.
string: 不。而且我也不確定現在要不要去找它。

original: Hail, Galmar.
string: 加爾瑪萬歲。

original: Hail, Ilfhild.
string: 伊菲爾德萬歲。

original: Cold as the inside of an ice wraith. That and some Imperials are camped out around the entrance, staying nice and warm around their fires.
string: 這裡冷得像冰怨靈的肚子。那些帝國士兵居然在入口處紮營，舒服地待在火堆前取暖。

original: Imperials? Well, if they're keeping themselves comfortable, let's slip in and send them to their graves that way.
string: 帝國士兵？好吧，如果他們這麼舒服的話，我們就潛進去讓他們舒舒服服地死去。

original: What's the situation?
string: 情況如何？

original: Well, that's something at least.
string: 嗯，至少有點價值。

original: Stormcloaks were already camped out around the entrance when we got here. They don't know we're here yet, though.
string: 我們到這裡的時候風暴斗篷已經在入口處紮營了。不過他們還不知道我們來了。

original: What's the situation?
string: 情況如何？

original: I feel sick.
string: 我覺得不舒服。

original: There, there. It will pass. Going too long without a proper meal can make the stomach weak.
string: 沒關係。會好的。很久都沒有吃頓飽飯的話，肚子肯定受不了。

original: Feel free to stay and mingle with your new coven, if you have the strength.
string: 不用客氣，待在這裡和你的新同好們交流一下吧，如果你有那力氣的話。

original: Thank you, Eola. For everything.
string: 感謝你所做的一切，愛歐拉。

original: It's an honor, champion. Feel free to stay and mingle with your new coven.
string: 這是我的榮幸，勇士。不用客氣，待在這裡和你的新同好們交流一下吧。

original: Enough talk. Let's go kill some Imperials.
string: 話不多說了。我們去教訓那些帝國士兵吧。

original: We had the advantage of surprise this time, but things won't be so easy from here on out.
string: 這次我們有出其不意的優勢。但在這之後就不會那麼簡單了。

original: That's the way I like it. Short and bloody. They never knew what hit them.
string: 我就喜歡這樣，迅捷而血腥。這些傢伙都在不知不覺中死去。

original: I knew when you walked into the Hall of the Dead that you were special.
string: 當你一踏進亡者之廳時，我就看出你的不同凡響了。

original: And here you are. Champion of Namira. Keeper of her ring. You're everything I hoped you would be.
string: 而現在你來到了這裡，娜米拉的勇士和指環的守護者。你沒有辜負我的重望。

original: Praise to Namira!
string: 讚美娜米拉！

original: The feast has begun!
string: 盛宴開始了！

original: I can smell the blood. Good and sour.
string: 我聞到血的味道了，酸甜美味。

original: Good.
string: 很好。

original: Is dinner ready?
string: 晚飯準備好了嗎？

original: I love this part of the meal.
string: 我喜歡這道菜。

original: Namira grants us victory.
string: 娜米拉給我們帶來了勝利。

original: Do you know the way out of here?
string: 你知道出去的路嗎？

original: Yes, yes. We should proceed cautiously.
string: 好，好。我們得謹慎行動。

original: "End of Days"? I don't think things are quite that bad.
string: 「世界末日」？我不覺得事情有那麼糟糕。

original: Alduin... The dragon who's raising the others?
string: 奧杜因……那頭復活牠同類的龍？

original: We'll stick around here for a while and see if we can find anything else useful.
string: 我們會在這裡多待一會兒，看看能否再找到其他有用的東西。

original: The crown must be around here somewhere. Spread out, and keep your eyes open.
string: 王冠肯定就在附近。分頭行動，睜大眼睛來找。

original: Too bad we can't read these carvings. Who knows what secrets we'd uncover?
string: 可惜我們看不懂這些刻字。否則天知道我們會發現什麼秘密？

original: Oh... I've heard of this. They say these walls show the history of the ancients who built this place.
string: 哦……我聽說過。有人說這些牆上記載的是建造這裡的古人的歷史。

original: Let's hope that's the last of them. Come on, let's see what's down this way.
string: 希望不會再有這種東西出現了。走吧，讓我們看看這條路下去會有什麼？

original: Steady now! They may be uglier than Imperials but they'll go down just the same.
string: 鎮定點！也許他們長得比帝國人還醜，但他們一樣都得死。

original: That's done it! Alright, boys, let's get moving. We've got more...
string: 結束了！好了，夥計們，繼續前進。前面還多著呢……

original: How's it going, Unblooded? You find anything yet?
string: 怎麼樣，菜鳥？有沒什麼發現？

original: Keep looking, Unblooded. There's got to be some way to get that thing open.
string: 繼續尋找，菜鳥。總有個辦法把那個東西打開。

original: You see a lever anywhere?
string: 你有看到拉桿嗎？

original: Unblooded, do what you do best. See if you can find some way to get that gate open.
string: 菜鳥，盡你所能吧。看看能否找到開門的方法。

original: Come on, boys. Let's spread out and see what we've got.
string: 來吧，夥計們。分頭好好找一下。

original: Alright everyone! Keep your guard up. No telling what we'll find down here.
string: 大家聽著！保持警惕。誰也不知道下面會遇到什麼？

original: Good job!
string: 幹得漂亮！

original: Is there anything on the claw that might show how to open this door?
string: 龍爪上有沒有留下打開門的線索？

original: Looks like the door will open if we turn these rings the right way.
string: 看來如果我們把這些圓環轉對方向的話，門就會打開。

original: I wouldn't do that again unless you know for sure it's going to open.
string: 我不會再做一次，除非你確定它能打開。

original: Look out!
string: 小心！

original: Hmm... that looks like some kind of claw from a statue. I wonder what it's used for.
string: 嗯……這看起來像是某尊雕像上的爪子。不知道有什麼作用。

original: See what you can figure out, Unblooded. I'm going to check out these carvings over here. Let me know if you find something.
string: 看你能否有所發現了，菜鳥。我打算在這檢查一下這些雕刻品，你有什麼發現就告訴我吧。

original: Even if one of these pictures tells us where the Crown is, I'm betting we're going to have to find a way through that door.
string: 就算這些畫裡頭有關於王冠下落的線索，我們肯定還得想辦法通過那扇門。

original: Hmm, looks like this is as far as the Imperials got.
string: 嗯，看起來帝國士兵只能走到這裡。

original: One thing at a time. We're here for the Crown. Any of these carvings show a crown?
string: 一樣一樣來。我們是來找王冠的。這些雕刻上有沒有畫上王冠？

original: Ah! The Hall of Stories... we must be getting close now.
string: 啊！故事大廳……我們肯定離它不遠了。

original: Draugr. Ain't you ever seen one before?
string: 諾德亡靈。難道你之前沒見過嗎？

original: What in the nine holds is that?
string: 我的天，那是什麼？

original: Now let's keep moving.
string: 我們繼續前進。

original: Steady. A few dusty bonewalkers aren't going to stop us anymore than the Imperials could.
string: 穩住。幾個灰頭土臉的骷髏和帝國士兵一樣，都阻止不了我們前進。

original: Don't give them a chance to warn the others!
string: 別讓他們有機會警告其他人！

original: Careful, boys. There's bound to be more up ahead.
string: 小心了，夥計們。前面肯定有更多。

original: Maybe they're so scared of you they ran away.
string: 可能是他們太怕你，所以都逃跑了。

original: I don't like it. What are they waiting for?
string: 我不喜歡這樣。他們在等什麼？

original: No, but I know they're out there. No other way they can come. Now shut up or you'll blow our ambush.
string: 不，但我知道他們在那裡。他們沒別的路可以過來。現在閉上嘴，別暴露了我們的位置。

original: There may be some way to get through on the level above. Hurry!
string: 應該有路可以上去的。快點！

original: Maybe you can find a way through somewhere above us.
string: 說不定你能找到通往上面的路。

original: You have your orders. Get moving.
string: 你們聽到命令了。趕快行動。

original: You there, Unblooded, see if you can find another way through. We'll charge in to help as soon as we hear fighting.
string: 你，菜鳥，看看你能不能找到另一條通路。一開打我們就衝進去幫忙。

original: Not so sure? Oh, then perhaps we should take a moment to look around a little, eh?
string: 不太確定？哦，所以你覺得我們也許應該停下來，然後四周看看？

original: You sure about that? Then please, be my guest and go strolling on in there. We'll stay here and watch your back...
string: 你確定嗎？那好吧，那你進去吧。我們留在這裡掩護你後方……

original: But there isn't any other way through.
string: 但是沒有別的路了。

original: I don't like the look of this. Perfect spot for an ambush. Ten to one they're just waiting for us on the other side.
string: 我覺得不妙。這裡是最佳的埋伏地點。敵人很有可能就在另一邊等著我們。

original: For Skyrim!
string: 為了天際省！

original: Time to show what you're really made of.
string: 考驗你們的時候到了。

original: Pick a man and put him down. We attack on my signal.
string: 挑個人把他打倒。聽我號令進攻。

original: Sold. Here you go. (Gain <Global=WIAddItem07PayB> gold)
string: 成交。給你。（得到<Global=WIAddItem07PayB>金幣）

original: I'm glad we could come to an agreement.
string: 很高興我們能成交。

original: Not good enough. I'll hold onto this. You'll need to find another one.
string: 不行。我只能接受這個價錢。你找別人吧。

original: Oh... well... I can see you have no appreciation for scholarship.
string: 哦……好吧……我看出來了，你對學習研究不感興趣。

original: Not good enough. I'll shake the extra coin out of you if I must. (Intimidate)
string: 還不夠。如果必要的話我會把錢從你身上抖出來。（威嚇）

original: Hold on, there. I suppose, in the uh, interest of research... I can spare a few more coins. Double and a half its value. That's all I can muster.
string: 你等等。呃……為了研究的話……我可以再付點錢。我會出比這東西價值兩倍半的錢。只能這樣了。

original: Ha! I'll see to it the Jarl hears of your abuse of a court scholar. Shame on you.
string: 哈！我一定要把你戲弄宮廷學者的事情報告領主。真不要臉。

original: I think you can do better than that. (Persuade)
string: 我想你還能付更多。（說服）

original: Well... I suppose important research is worth every coin. All right. You have yourself a deal. How's double and a half its value in trade?
string: 好吧……我想重要的研究花再多的錢也是值得的。行，成交了。我付多兩倍半的價錢怎麼樣？

original: With this the world could have a better understanding of the Dwemer!
string: 有了這個，世界將更加瞭解鍛莫！

original: Come now, where's your sense of propriety? Extorting an old man like this.
string: 拜託。像這樣敲詐一個老人，你的禮節何在？

original: Sounds fair. Here you go. (Gain <Global=WIAddItem07PayA> gold)
string: 聽起來不錯。拿去吧。(得到<Global=WIAddItem07PayA>金幣）

original: Wonderful. You've just made an important contribution to the advancement of a Dwemer scholarship.
string: 太棒了。你剛剛為鍛莫研究的進步作出了重要貢獻。

original: Sure. Take a look.
string: 沒問題。看一下吧。

original: Excellent. Very good. This is exactly what I need to complete a series of studies I'm doing on Dwemer craftsmanship and magical resonance.
string: 太棒了。很好。我目前正在進行鍛其工藝和魔法共鳴的一系列研究，它正好可以幫我完成這些研究。

original: I simply must have this! I'll pay you double what it's worth.
string: 我一定要得到它！我付雙倍價錢！

original: Actually, I'm not sure I have it anymore.
string: 其實，這東西好像不在我身上了。

original: Oh... what a terrible shame. Well, if you think you know where you left it and can retrieve it, I'll be here.
string: 哦……真是太遺憾了。好吧，等你拿回來之後可以到這來找我。

original: I'm here about the <Alias=Item>.
string: 我是為了<Alias=Item>而來的。

original: You are? Very good.... may I see it?
string: 是嗎？太好了……能給我看看嗎？

original: There have been murders in Windhelm?
string: 最近風舵城發生了好幾起謀殺案？

original: None of that matters to me. Until someone takes a Dunmer, I let Windhelm deal with its own problems.
string: 那些都不關我的事。風舵城會自己解決這些問題，除非有人殺了丹莫。

original: I've got what I came for, I better get back to Dragon Bridge.
string: 我來這裡的目的已經達到，該回龍橋鎮了。

original: Did you find anything at Wolfskull Cave?
string: 你在狼頭骨洞穴裡找到什麼了嗎？

original: How are the dark elves treated in Windhelm?
string: 風舵城裡暗精靈的待遇如何？

original: Well you see where we have to live. This forgotten alley. All the filth from the upper quarters flows downhill, like they say.
string: 你自己看看我們住的地方吧。這個被遺忘的巷子。就像他們說的，上方城區什麼污穢都往山下流。

original: Good luck getting one of the guards to help with anything.
string: 你想讓某個衛兵幫你忙？祝你好運吧。

original: I tried to get Ulfric to even come down here to see the squalor, but the High Lord of His Mightiness couldn't find the time.
string: 我甚至試過請烏弗瑞克親自下來看看這骯髒的地方，但這位偉大的陛下抽不開身。

original: Why are there so many dark elves here?
string: 為什麼這裡有這麼多暗精靈？

original: Where else would we be?
string: 我們還能去哪兒？

original: When the Red Mountain burned, you could scarcely breathe in Morrowind. So we came west.
string: 紅山爆發之時，在晨風省居住的話連呼吸都有困難。所以我們向西遷移。

original: Windhelm is the first city on that road, and here we are.
string: 風舵城是途中遇到的第一個城市，因此我們就安頓下來了。

original: If we had known the Nords would be so unwelcoming, we may have kept walking.
string: 如果當時知道諾德人會這麼不友善的話，我們就不會停留了。

original: Are the people of Windhelm devout?
string: 風舵城的居民虔誠嗎？

original: Like anyone, a crisis will push them towards devotion. I've been seeing a lot of the Shatter-Shields, since they lost their daughter.
string: 危機會促使他們變得虔誠，就像任何人一樣。自從他們失去了女兒以後，我已經看到很多碎盾的成員了。

original: Hillevi Cruel-Sea comes in a lot, but I haven't seen her husband here in years.
string: 希勒維．酷海經常過來，但我好幾年沒見過她的丈夫了。

original: Ulfric prays for strength. I speak to Captain Lonely-Gale, but he doesn't spend much time here. Too busy.
string: 烏弗瑞克始終渴望力量。我和孤風船長談過，但他沒辦法花太多心思在這。太忙了。

original: What does Talos have to do with the war?
string: 塔洛斯和這場戰爭有什麼關係？

original: The Empire's elven puppetmasters never cared much for the idea of a human becoming a divine. So the worship of Talos is outlawed.
string: 帝國的幕後主使——精靈從來都不喜歡一個凡人被尊為神。所以他們宣告禁止崇拜塔洛斯。

original: Skyrim doesn't take kindly to being told what to do. And to try and forget Talos, well... they may as well ordered us all to cut off our ears.
string: 天際省的百姓不喜歡聽命於他人，也不喜歡被強迫忘掉塔洛斯，這麼說吧……他們還不如下令我們全部把自己耳朵割掉呢。

original: Tell me about Talos.
string: 告訴我有關塔洛斯的事吧。

original: Talos, who in life was known as Tiber Septim, united Tamriel and founded the Empire.
string: 塔洛斯，凡人時期名叫泰伯．塞普汀。他統一了泰姆瑞爾並創建了帝國。

original: He was rewarded for his deeds by being joined with the Divines in eternal glory. The only mortal to do so.
string: 因為他對於聖靈們在「永恆光輝」時期做出的貢獻，他得到了獎勵。他是唯一一個做到的凡人。

original: We worship him that we might follow in his path. We can't literally join him in the heavens, but we may do our best to know them here on Nirn.
string: 我們朝拜他，希望有朝一日能夠追隨他的光輝歷程。當然不能真的與他在天堂相會，但至少我們在奈恩能夠竭盡所能地瞭解天堂的情況。

original: What's there to do in the city?
string: 在城市裡能幹些什麼？

original: If you're looking to pass the time, you can give Calixto a few septims and gawk at whater oddity he's come across lately.
string: 如果你想消磨時間的話，可以付些錢給卡利斯托，聽點他的最近遇到的奇聞異事。

original: If you're need of goods, there's a market. If it's a soft bed and a hot meal you're after, there's Candlehearth Hall.
string: 如果你想買東西，這裡有一個市集。如果你想要吃頓熱騰騰的飯菜、睡個好覺，可以去燭爐堂客棧。

original: Who are the prominent citizens in Windhelm?
string: 誰是風舵城裡的名人？

original: There's an author named Adonato staying at the inn. He's published a few works of historical fiction.
string: 酒館裡住著一位作家，名叫阿多納托。他寫過一些歷史小說。

original: The clans Shatter-Shield and Cruel-Sea see most of the gold that passes through the city.
string: 碎盾幫和酷海幫掌管著這座城市大部分的金錢流通。

original: And obviously you have Ulfric, the Jarl and future High King.
string: 當然還有領主和未來的至高王烏弗瑞克。

original: Oh, and that busybody Viola Giordano. She's got her nose in everyone's business, which I guess is one way of being prominent.
string: 哦，還有那位好事者維歐拉．喬爾丹諾。她誰的閒事都愛管，這也是出名的一個方法吧。

original: Folk are talking about murders.
string: 人們都在談論兇殺案。

original: Terrible shame, that. Seems we have a killer on the loose here in Windhelm.
string: 這事可真是丟臉。看來我們風舵城裡藏有一個連環殺手。

original: He's claimed three victims that I know of, though maybe there's more that haven't been found yet.
string: 他已經殺了三個我認識的人了，也許還有更多受害者沒被發現。

original: All lovely young ladies, too. Let's hope the guards find that demon soon, and introduce him to the headsman's axe.
string: 而且死的都是年輕漂亮的女性。希望那些衛兵能夠快點逮到這個惡魔，送他上斷頭臺。

original: What kind of captain are you?
string: 為什麼別人叫你船長？

original: Well, nothing. At least not any more. Folk just call me that because of what I used to do.
string: 咳，沒什麼。至少現在不是了。人們只是因為我以前是船長才這麼稱呼我的。

original: I was a sailor for many a year. I made my coin as a trader and in time, I bought my own ship.
string: 我當了很多年的水手。靠做買賣賺錢，過了好一陣子才買了屬於我自己的船。

original: When I retired here in Windhelm, most folk already knew me as Captain Lonely-Gale, and the name just stuck.
string: 我退休後在風舵城安頓下來時，大家都知道我叫孤風船長了，所以就一直這麼叫了下來。

original: Watch that tongue, Rendar, or your whole lot could be down with the Argonians hauling ballast by tomorrow.
string: 說話小心點，仁達爾，不然你那幫人明天就會被亞龍人扔到海裡去。

original: Typical Nord. Beard for brains.
string: 典型的諾德人。鬚長無腦。

original: My men have their orders. But it's a big city, and there's a war on. Plus these murders.
string: 我的人手絕對奉命行事。但這是座大城市，外面又在打仗，還發生了謀殺案。

original: A few dark elves getting shoved around doesn't really amount to much.
string: 幾個暗精靈被推來喚去算不了什麼？

original: If the guards in the Gray Quarter weren't a bunch of n'wahs, I wouldn't be here talking to you.
string: 如果灰民區的衛兵不是一群混蛋的話，我就不會在這裡和你說話了。

original: If anything actually happens, call a guard.
string: 如果真的發生什麼事，就叫衛兵。

original: I have the items you requested.
string: 我有你要的東西。

original: Ah, have you? Let Kesh have them.
string: 啊，真的？快給凱石。

original: That should do. Now - Inhale deeply.
string: 那樣應該行了。現在……深呼吸。

original: Yes, yes. This will create a fine fume.
string: 是的，是的。這些可以做出一份很棒的薰香。

original: Remind me - what am I supposed to do?
string: 提醒我——我該做什麼？

original: Remind me again about the attack on the fort...
string: 再跟我說一次關於攻擊要塞的事情……

original: That fort is as good as ours.
string: 那座要塞等於已經是我們的了。

original: That fort is as good as ours.
string: 那座要塞等於已經是我們的了。

original: I'm not sure. I need to think about it.
string: 我還不確定，我需要想一想。

original: Tell me about the attack on the fort.
string: 告訴我有關攻擊要塞的事情。

original: Reporting for duty.
string: 報告長官。

original: Reporting for duty.
string: 報告長官。

original: Reporting for duty.
string: 報告長官。

original: Reporting for duty.
string: 報告長官。

original: Reporting for duty.
string: 報告長官。

original: Reporting for duty.
string: 報告長官。

original: Reporting for duty.
string: 報告長官。

original: Reporting for duty.
string: 報告長官。

original: Reporting in.
string: 報到。

original: Reporting in.
string: 報到。

original: Reporting in.
string: 報到。

original: Reporting in.
string: 報到。

original: Reporting in.
string: 報到。

original: Reporting in.
string: 報到。

original: Reporting in.
string: 報到。

original: Reporting in.
string: 報到。

original: What? Get over with the rest of the men at Korvanjund.
string: 什麼？去把科萬瓊德剩下的人都除掉。

original: Korvanjund. Remember?
string: 科萬瓊德。記得嗎？

original: Good work! Lucky we had you with us today.
string: 做得好！有你在真是太好了。

original: That crown must be here somewhere. Keep looking.
string: 王冠就在附近。繼續找。

original: My pa always warned me not to mess with places like this.
string: 我老爹總是警告我別亂闖這種地方。

original: Careful. No telling what will happen the next time you mess with that door.
string: 小心。誰知道下次你再碰那門會發生什麼事。

original: Maybe that claw has a clue on it? You know, how to turn the rings so the door will open.
string: 說不定那爪子上有線索？比如提示如何轉動那些圓環來開門之類的。

original: Keep a sharp eye out. There's no telling what we might run into in here.
string: 保持警惕。天曉得我們會在這裡碰到什麼？

original: All for an old crown, huh?
string: 一切就是為了一頂老舊的王冠，對吧？

original: The Imperials will be sorry they got in our way.
string: 帝國士兵想擋路的話簡直就是送死。

original: So far, so good.
string: 到現在為止都還不錯。

original: Ulfric Stormcloak is counting on us to bring him back that crown, and that's exactly what we're going to do.
string: 烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷正指望著我們為他找回那頂王冠，而這也是我們正在做的事情。

original: Keep your wits about you and watch your shield brother's back.
string: 注意保持警惕，掩護你的盾友。

original: I know some of you are ex-legion and may know men on the other side. But remember this. They are the enemy now and they will not hesitate to kill you.
string: 我知道你們當中的一些人以前也是軍團的，而且認識那邊的人。但請記住，他們現在已經是敵人了，而且他們不會對你手下留情的。

original: Their spies must've found out we know about the Crown, and they don't want us to have it. But they won't stand in our way.
string: 他們的間諜一定發現我們知道王冠這件事了，也一定不想讓我們得到的。不過他們無法阻止我們。

original: Listen up. Those Imperials aren't here by coincidence.
string: 大家聽好了，那些帝國士兵到這來並非偶然。

original: General Tullius is counting on us to bring back the Jagged Crown, and that's exactly what we're going to do.
string: 圖留斯將軍正指望我們取回鋸齒王冠，這正是我們正在做的事情。

original: I realize some of you may know men on the other side. But remember this. They are the enemy now and will not hesitate to end your lives either.
string: 我知道也許對方有些是你們的朋友。但要記住，他們現在是敵人，同樣也不會對你們手下留情。

original: Ulfric the Pretender wants that crown, but we're not going to let him have it.
string: 烏弗瑞克這個覬覦王位的傢伙想要王冠，我們不能讓他得逞。

original: Listen up, legionnaires. Those Stormcloaks are here for the same reason we are.
string: 聽著，軍團士兵們。那些風暴斗篷和我們是對著同一個東西來的。

original: No... No! You must be the one who took my skooma!
string: 不……不！你肯定是拿走我的斯庫瑪的人！

original: No! There's got to be more Skooma... Shut up! Shut up!  Don't lie to me J'zhar! You hid it! You always try to steal it from me!
string: 不！肯定還有更多的斯庫瑪……閉嘴！閉嘴！別騙我傑扎爾！你藏起來了！你一直想從我這裡偷走它！

original: Where is it? I know you were trying to keep it for yourself J'zhar... You always try to keep it for yourself!
string: 在哪兒？我知道你藏起來了混球……嘰扎爾……你一直想占為己有！

original: Kynareth save us, here he comes again...
string: 凱娜瑞絲保佑我們，牠又來了……

original: I don't know!
string: 我不知道！

original: Guardsman! What happened here? Where's this dragon? Quickly now!
string: 衛兵！這裡發生什麼事了？龍在哪兒？快說！

original: No! Get back! It's still here somewhere! Hroki and Tor just got grabbed when they tried to make a run for it!
string: 不！回來！牠還在附近！若基和圖爾剛剛在逃跑的時候被牠抓住了！

original: I envy you the chance to see this dragon up close!
string: 你能如此近距離地看見這條龍，真羨慕你！

original: This is all just too much, too fast. Go get some work from Nazir. I need time to... to think...
string: 這一切都太迅速太難以接受了。去找納茲爾接工作吧。我需要時間……好好想想……

original: Maybe, but they wouldn't taste as good as a loaf of fresh-baked pumpernickel.
string: 也許吧，但是它們不會像新鮮出爐的一條黑麵包那樣好吃。

original: Exactly. Road patrols were cut in half because the Jarl needed soldiers. Now the bandits are bolder than ever.
string: 完全正確。因為領主急需人手，巡邏的衛兵被削減了一半，所以強盜們現在越來越猖獗了。

original: They've been raiding the farms for food, and supplies are scarcer than ever. Maybe I should sell swords and armor, instead.
string: 他們洗劫農場，掠奪食物，資源比從前都少了。也許我應該改賣兵器和防具。

original: Let me guess, they're saying it's because of this trouble with the Stormcloaks?
string: 讓我猜猜，他們說這是因為與風暴斗篷之間的矛盾造成的？

original: I had to. The farmers are charging me double for the produce I sell.
string: 我必須得這麼做。我從農民那裡進貨，他們收我雙倍的價錢。

original: Did you raise your prices, Carlotta?
string: 你是不是漲價了，卡蘿塔？

original: You're right. I'll have to remember that the next time I get a shipment in.
string: 你說得對。我的下一批貨到的時候就這麼做。

original: I'm sure you could charge double for those and still sell them all within a week.
string: 我相信就算你開出雙倍的價錢，仍然可以在一週之內賣掉它們。

original: Aren't they? I always set some aside for myself when the traders bring them up from the south.
string: 是吧？每次商人從南邊運過來的時候我都會留一些給自己吃。

original: Those green apples you sold me the other day were delicious.
string: 之前你賣給我的那些綠蘋果很好吃。

original: The gods smile on them who show charity. Best you remember that.
string: 眾神眷顧那些有善心的人。你最好記住這一點。

original: Make it quick, then. I don't want your stink driving my customers away.
string: 那就快點。我可不想你的臭氣薰走我的客人。

original: That's right, mock the town beggar like everyone else. But I've got a right to browse, don't I? I ain't hurtin' anyone.
string: 很好，和別人一樣嘲笑城裡的乞丐吧。但我有權利討錢，不是嗎？我又不傷害誰。

original: How goes the begging today, Brenuin?
string: 今天討到錢了嗎，布瑞紐恩？

original: Best you forget whatever you think you saw, elf. Such idle talk can prove hazardous to one's health.
string: 精靈，最好忘了你剛剛看到的事。這種閒話可是會惹禍上身的。

original: Would your good friend be named Jon, by any chance? I've spied the two of you talking quite intimately.
string: 你的好朋友會不會是喬？我曾經看見你們兩個聊得挺開心的。

original: Glad to see you're making new friends. I know Jon's death was hard on you.
string: 很高興看到你交了新朋友。我知道喬的死對你打擊很大。

original: Got any sausages? I'm cooking a special breakfast for a friend, and they're his favorite.
string: 有香腸嗎？我在為一個朋友做早餐，他很喜歡香腸。

original: Ah, Olfina. How may I help you?
string: 啊，奧菲娜。需要我幫忙嗎？

original: Make it quick, and there might be a bowl of hot stew in it for you.
string: 那就快一點，或許你還能喝上一碗熱湯。

original: Certainly. I'll be sure to bring some back for you the next time I go hunting.
string: 沒問題。我下次打獵的時候一定幫你帶點兒回來。

original: I've got a recipe for venison stew that I want to try out. Will you have venison anytime soon?
string: 我有一份鹿肉湯的食譜想試試。你最近會進鹿肉嗎？

original: By Ysmir, I will. Gods know it's been too long since I tasted real meat.
string: 向伊斯米爾發誓，我當然會。我都好久沒有吃上真正的肉了。

original: If they do, promise you'll actually purchase something for once.
string: 如果他們給你的話，發誓你會至少真的去買一次東西。

original: Just browsin' today. If the gods be kind, someone will take mercy on me and spare a few septims.
string: 看看今天運氣如何。要是天有眼的話，就找個人可憐可憐我，施捨幾個錢吧。

original: Here's what they owed us.
string: 這是他們欠我們的。

original: I suppose it's not a total loss then.
string: 那我想還不算全盤皆輸吧。

original: Let me give you a piece of advice. If you want to make some serious coin in this business you need to listen to rules.
string: 讓我給你個忠告。如果真的想在這一行賺錢你必須循規蹈矩。

original: Now, on to other things.
string: 現在來說說別的事情。

original: Yeah, it's all here.
string: 是的，都在這裡了。

original: Well done. And it would seem I owe you something in return.
string: 很好。看來我該報答一下你。

original: Here you go, I think you'll find these quite useful.

string: 我賜予你這件兵器，作為你府邸的徽章。
