original: The people of Skyrim are more open minded about certain things than people in other places.
string: 天際省的人對某些事情的看法比其他地方的人更寬大。

original: Some like taking friends on adventures. M'aiq thinks being alone is better. Less arguing about splitting treasure.
string: 有些人喜歡帶著朋友去冒險。麥奎覺得獨自上路更好些。省得分財寶時動不動就打起來。

original: Don't try blocking if you have two weapons. You will only get confused.  Much better to hit twice anyway.
string: 如果你雙持武器的話不要試圖格擋。你只會使自己暈頭轉向。總之，打對方兩次比格擋要好得多。

original: M'aiq knows many things, no?
string: 麥奎知道很多事情，是吧？

original: M'aiq is tired now. Go bother somebody else.
string: 麥奎已經累了，你鬧別人去。

original: M'aiq is done talking.
string: 麥奎的話已經說完了。

original: Your own fate will be your own choice. Just as always.
string: 你的命運由你自己選擇。和平常一樣。

original: Now be gone.
string: 現在你走吧。

original: Run for it!
string: 快逃啊！

original: The museum is doing well. I haven't told anyone about the... incident with the Razor.
string: 博物館狀況很好。我沒有告訴任何人那個……和利刃有關的事件。

original: Good to see you in my museum again. I owe you my life.
string: 能看到你再來博物館真是太好了。我欠你一條命。

original: I never thought all I would want is peace and quiet, but I think our little adventure scared me straight.
string: 我從不認為我想要的是平靜和安寧，但我現在覺得我們的小冒險把我嚇壞了。

original: Fine. Get out of here.
string: 很好。滾離這裡。

original: Thank you. Here's your gold. I'll make a run for it back to Dawnstar.
string: 謝謝你。這裡是你的報酬。我會飛奔回晨星城的。

original: Dagon has spoken.
string: 大袞已經下令了。

original: Fine. I'm not dying without a fight!
string: 很好。我不會不戰鬥就心甘情願去死的！

original: Wait. Wait. Don't kill me. There's another way.
string: 等一下。等一下。別殺我。還有別的辦法。

original: I can take the pieces back to my museum. Seal them in a display case.
string: 我可以帶這些碎片回我的博物館。把它們密封在一個陳列櫃裡。

original: You get a generous amount of gold, I get to complete my collection, and nobody has to die.
string: 你拿到一大筆錢，我完成我的收藏，大家都不用死。

original: Before you go, mortal. One final challenge. Ha ha ha.
string: 留步片刻，人類。接受最後一個挑戰吧。哈哈哈。

original: You think to betray Mehrunes Dagon? Suffer!
string: 你想背叛梅魯涅斯．大袞？受苦吧！

original: It's not working. Why don't you give it a try? Just put your hands on the altar.
string: 它沒動靜。不如你試試看吧？只要把你的手放在祭壇上就行。

original: Mehrunes Dagon, the Lord of Change, we have brought your Razor to you. We beg you, please bring the blade's full glory to Tamriel again!
string: 變革之主梅魯涅斯．大袞，我們帶來了你的利刃。我們祈求你，請你讓刀鋒的榮光重回泰姆瑞爾！

original: Good. You're here. I'll place the pieces on the altar, and Dagon should speak to us.
string: 很好。你來了。我把碎片放在祭壇上，然後大袞應該會對我們說話。

original: I'll meet you at the shrine.
string: 我會去祭壇和你見面。

original: Let me put the pieces on the altar. We'll see if Mehrunes Dagon can still be reached.
string: 讓我來把碎片放在聖壇上。我們看看梅魯涅斯．大袞是否還能感知到我們。

original: Try putting your hands on the altar. Maybe Mehrunes Dagon will speak to you.
string: 試試把你的手放在聖壇上。可能梅魯涅斯．大袞會和你說話。

original: This sounds like a terrible idea...
string: 這聽起來像是個糟透了的主意…

original: You don't want to be part of history? Fine. I'll be at the shrine if you change your mind.
string: 你不想青史留名嗎？那好吧。如果你改變主意就來祭壇找我。

original: You think Dagon will repair the Razor?
string: 你認為大袞會修復利刃？

original: Ever since I was a boy, I felt this strange sense of destiny surrounding the Mythic Dawn cult, and now I know what it is.
string: 當我還是個小孩時，我就感覺破曉神教組織散發著一種奇異的天命將臨的氣場，現在我知道它是什麼了。

original: Don't you see? Fate has led you to me and to the pieces. Dagon has to answer our call. We're so close.
string: 你看不到嗎？命運指引你遇到了我和這些碎片。大袞回應了我們的召喚。我們已經如此接近。

original: I'll meet you at the shrine.
string: 我會去祭壇和你見面。

original: Can you teach me about Speechcraft?
string: 你能教我口才技巧嗎？

original: Ah. Well. After a little incident with a roguish lad and the daughter of a prominent Thane... Well, let's just say, best not.
string: 啊。這個嘛，我剛跟一個流氓小夥子和一個顯貴武衛的女兒起了點衝突……嗯，我覺得應該說，最好不要。

original: Afraid not. But if you're serious about sharpening that tongue, you might try the Bard's College in Solitude.
string: 恐怕不是。但如果你真的想練一下嗓子，你可以去獨孤城的吟遊詩人學院去看看。

original: You have it! The blessed Wabbajack! You must use it on me. You must.
string: 你拿到了！被賜福的瓦巴傑克！你一定要對我使用它。你一定要。

original: You're the one who returned blessed Sheogorath. I would be honored to be Wabbajacked by you, your grace.
string: 你就是拿回被賜福的謝爾格拉的人。能被你施以瓦巴傑克的我感到萬分榮幸，大人。

original: Wabbajack Wabbajack Wabbajack Wabbajack.
string: 瓦巴傑克瓦巴傑克瓦巴傑克瓦巴傑克！！！

original: Don't go to the Blue Palace. The master is on vacation. Don't listen to Dervenin. Don't do it.
string: 別去藍宮。主人正在度假中。別聽德文英的。別做那件事。

original: The master has gone but Dervenin will find him. Dervenin should not have gone.
string: 主人走了但是德文英會找到他的。德文英不會離開。

original: Vacation is where the head is. That is what Dervenin told us about our master. He's cozy in his Solitude.
string: 去度假是主人的行程。這是德文英跟我們說的。他在他的獨孤城過得很安逸。

original: If you wish to learn more about them, you're welcome to my tome on the subject. Should be on my table.
string: 如果你想瞭解更多有關它們的事，歡迎你來讀讀我那本論述這個主題的書。應該就放在我的桌子上。

original: Then I'll make it a point to hunt them down.
string: 那我會不遺餘力追捕他們。

original: Good. I lost more than a few acquaintances to the Falmer and I wish to see them avenged.
string: 很好。我有好幾個熟人都命喪伐莫族之手了，我很希望看到它們得到報應。

original: You appear to despise them.
string: 你好像很鄙夷它們。

original: Why shouldn't I? The Falmer have killed more than a fair share of my acquaintances. They're animals... they show absolutely no pity or remorse.
string: 為什麼不呢？伐莫族殺了我太多熟人了。它們是動物…毫不懂得憐憫和悔過。

original: They sound more like victims to me.
string: 我倒是覺得它們比較像是受害者。

original: Yes, I suppose you're right. Forgive me. I've lost several close friends to the Falmer and it tends to distort my view.
string: 是的，我想你說得對。原諒我。因為伐莫族的肆虐我失去了好幾個密友，這好像讓我變得偏激了些。

original: What drove them underground?
string: 是什麼將它們趕到地底下的？

original: The Nords went to war with the Falmer in the First Era. Killed them by the thousands to drive them from their snowy homeland.
string: 諾德人在第一紀元中和伐莫族展開過一場大戰，殺害了它們成百上千的族民，把它們趕出了白雪皚皚的家園。

original: The Falmer retreated underground and forged an uneasy alliance with the dwarves who ended up betraying them.
string: 伐莫族撤退到了地下，與那裡的一個種族建立了頗為坎坷的同盟關係，也就是最終背叛了它們的矮人族。

original: This betrayal made them what they are now... horrible blind monstrosities with a burning hatred of any but their own kind.
string: 那次背叛讓它們變成了現在的樣子…懷著對一切異族的憎恨，燃燒著怨怒的可怕盲眼怪物。

original: So they were like your kind?
string: 這麼說它們和你們很像？

original: Like the Altmer? Yes, I would say their culture quite possibly rivaled our own.
string: 像傲爾特莫族？是的，我可以說它們的文化極有可能與我們的不相上下。

original: What exactly is a Falmer?
string: 伐莫族到底是什麼？

original: In the time before man, they were known as the snow elves. They lived in the sunlight and had a very prosperous society.
string: 在人類還沒誕生時，它們被叫做冰雪的精靈。它們生活在陽光下而且建立了富饒的社會。

original: Azura's Star is ours. Ours!
string: 阿祖拉之星是我們的。我們的！

original: You will pay for Malyn's death, Azura worshipper!
string: 你要為馬林的死付出代價，阿祖拉的信徒！

original: Don't look at me. I didn't kill her. I was just... making sure the body got buried.
string: 別看我。我沒殺她。我只是…確認一下遺體是不是埋好了。

original: What are you doing?
string: 你在做什麼？

original: Fine, you little swindler. Here's a septim. Now where's this bridge?
string: 幹得不錯，小騙子。給你一塊錢。快說橋在哪？

original: Thank you! You'll find the ruins right here.
string: 謝謝！那個廢墟就在這個地方。

original: Where did you find this, boy?
string: 你從哪兒找到這個的，小朋友？

original: I found them near the old Dwemer bridge in the far west. I'll mark it down for you on your map for a small fee.
string: 我在很遠的西邊的鍛莫橋那裡找到的。我可以把它標在你的地圖上，價格公道。

original: Hey there! Check out what my friend and I found. I'll sell some of it to you, if you want!
string: 喂，過來！看看我和我的朋友找到的好東西。如果你想要，我可以限量出售給你！

original: Why? Why do you pursue me?
string: 為什麼？你為什麼追我？

original: It is done. I won't go back to Avanchnzel. I won't.
string: 不用再說了。我不會回阿旺晨澤爾。不會回。

original: I could have left it behind. I could have put it back where it came from.
string: 我終於可以擺脫它了。我終於可以把它放回它原本的地方去了。

original: As the sun ends the night, end the darkness of this soul, return life to the creature you see before you!
string: 像太陽結束黑夜般，結束這具靈魂的沉睡，將生命重新召回你眼前這生物的軀體吧！

original: We won't return empty handed.
string: 我們不會空手而歸的。

original: There will be a feast in our honor when we return.
string: 我們回去時會有一場盛大的接風宴會。

original: It will be a good day. I can feel it in my gut.
string: 一定會是美好的一天。我有這種直覺。

original: The scent of victory is on the wind.
string: 勝利的芬芳從風中吹來。

original: Aye.
string: 同意。

original: It will be so.
string: 一定會的。

original: Shhh.
string: 噓。

original: You're right. We're not alone.
string: 你是對的。我們不孤獨。

original: Do you feel that?
string: 你感覺到了嗎？

original: Dibella's blessing to you.
string: 願蒂貝拉賜福你。

original: Be careful not to fall on your way out.
string: 小心點，出去的時候別摔倒。

original: I have silver to bend.
string: 我要去鍊銀了。

original: Farewell.
string: 再會。

original: Come back if you need a new ring or necklace.
string: 需要新的指環或者項鍊時就再來找我。

original: Stop by my stall in the market sometime.
string: 常來我的小攤看看啊。

original: Bye now, mister.
string: 慢走，先生。

original: Bye now, miss.
string: 慢走，小姐。

original: Come back when you need more meat. Bring gold.
string: 還需要肉的話就再來。帶著錢。

original: Need to get back to chopping.
string: 得繼續剁肉去啦。

original: Stay out of trouble in my city.
string: 在我的城市裡別鬧事。

original: Stay clear of the Forsworn. Bloodthirsty savages.
string: 別和棄誓者扯上關係。那群嗜血的野蠻人。

original: I should get back to work. Money doesn't count itself.
string: 我該繼續工作了。錢不會自己數自己的。

original: Time to prepare some more records on the silver trade.
string: 該為白銀交易準備些新的檔案簿了。

original: Yeah, yeah.
string: 是，是。

original: Get going, then.
string: 那趕緊動身啊。

original: The blood of Markarth is silver.
string: 馬卡斯的血都是白銀。

original: I have work to do.
string: 我有工作要做。

original: Yes, I was bored talking to you anyway.
string: 嗯，反正我覺得跟你說話無聊得很。

original: Take care.
string: 多保重。

original: I have records I need to tend to.
string: 我有要處理的檔案。

original: What? Oh. Bye.
string: 什麼？噢。拜拜。

original: Bye now, dearie.
string: 下次見，寶貝兒。

original: Take care, dearie.
string: 慢點走，寶貝兒。

original: Come back whenever you need something.
string: 需要什麼就再過來啊。

original: If you need anything else, just ask.
string: 需要什麼別的東西的話，儘管開口。

original: I better get back to sorting the dry goods.
string: 我該回去整理和分類那些紡織品了。

original: Now where did I put that shipment of forks...
string: 現在我該把這一批叉子放在哪…

original: I think I'm going to get another drink.
string: 我想我要再喝一杯。

original: Bye.
string: 再見。

original: Remember. Ale is cheaper than blood in Markarth.
string: 記住。在馬卡斯城，麥芽酒可比血還要便宜啊。

original: Guards are free to search your room. Uh, just keep that in mind.
string: 衛兵可以隨意地搜你的房間。呃…牢牢記住這點就對了。

original: I should remind Kleppr to clean this place up.
string: 我應該提醒克萊珀打掃這個地方。

original: Bye, now.
string: 下回見。

original: May the crags fail to trip your feet.
string: 願你的腳步免受懸崖峭壁的阻礙。

original: Safe travels to you.
string: 祝一路順風。

original: Good fighting to you.
string: 祝無往不勝。

original: Live a life worth telling about.
string: 要過一個有故事可講的人生。

original: I have a prison to run.
string: 我還有一所監獄要經營。

original: Don't cause any trouble.
string: 給我老老實實的。

original: I have work to do.
string: 我有工作要做。

original: Goodbye.
string: 再見。

original: Now you let me know if you need a cure... or anything else.
string: 請儘管來找我，當你需要解藥…或者其他什麼東西的時候。

original: I have herbs to mix.
string: 我得去混合草藥。

original: I should get back to memorizing recipes.
string: 我該繼續去背配方了。

original: Now, is lavender an herb or a poison? Hmm....
string: 現在想想，薰衣草是良藥還是毒藥？嗯…

original: Bring more gold next time.
string: 下次多帶點錢來。

original: Tell everyone you see to bring me some septims.
string: 跟別人宣傳一下你看到的，讓我多賺點錢。

original: If you'll excuse me, I have a city to run.
string: 如果你不介意，我要去管理我的城市了。

original: I have letters to read.
string: 我有信件要讀。

original: Keep your eyes open for Forsworn when you're on the roads.
string: 在路上行走的時候要注意棄誓者。

original: Let me know if you need something forged.
string: 要是需要打造什麼的話儘管來找我。

original: Back to making weapons.
string: 得繼續打造兵器去啦。

original: I should heat up the forge. Why does it have to be so hot?
string: 我應該加熱熔爐。為什麼它必須要這麼熱呢？

original: Oh, goodbye then.
string: 噢，那再見啦。

original: What? Oh, goodbye.
string: 什麼？噢，再見。

original: Yes, yes. I have a lot of research to do.
string: 是的，是的。我有很多研究工作要做。

original: Back to my studies, then.
string: 那我回去繼續做研究了。

original: Goodbye. Be careful if you head into the ruins.
string: 再見。你要是去廢墟的話要注意安全。

original: Arkay protect you.
string: 阿爾凱保護你。

original: How can Mercer open up a vault that needs two keys? It's impossible. Could he pick his way in?
string: 墨瑟怎麼能打開一個需要兩把鑰匙才能打開的寶物庫呢？不可能。會是他把鎖給撬開了嗎？

original: Stop yammering and keep your eyes peeled. They could be here at any moment. If I were them I'd come straight here, sword swingin'!
string: 別廢話了，警覺點。他們隨時都有可能出現。如果我是他們的話我會直接來這裡，揮著劍就砍過來！

original: Can you believe one person came in here and took out this whole camp?
string: 你能相信有個人單槍匹馬闖進這裡然後拔掉了整個營地嗎？

original: What can you tell me about Riverwood?
string: 關於河木鎮，你能告訴我些什麼？

original: Gerdur's family first settled here as wood cutters a few generations ago.
string: 最開始是幾代之前，歌爾朵的家庭在這裡安頓下來並伐木為生。

original: She and Hod run the mill. I make a decent living sharpening axes and fixing the sawmill.
string: 她和胡德經營木材廠。我的工作是把鈍斧頭磨快以及修理鋸木廠的器具。這份工作讓我過得還不錯。

original: It's my mill. Some folks think it's my town too, but it ain't. The Jarl in Whiterun owns the land and the town. I just pay the taxes.
string: 那是我的木材廠。有些人覺得這裡也算是我的一個小鎮，但它不是。白漫城裡的領主擁有這裡的土地和城鎮。我只是個納稅的。

original: Looks like we've got ourselves another fool.
string: 看樣子我們又讓一個傻瓜上勾了。

original: Are they gone?
string: 他們走了嗎？

original: Please help. I can pay you.
string: 請幫幫我。我可以給你報酬。

original: And I've got better things to do than listen to more of your fantasies.
string: 我除了繼續聽你的幻想之外還有更有意義的事可以做。

original: Do you sell spells?
string: 你有法術書賣嗎？

original: I think I have a few old spell books laying about. If you want more, you'll have to go to the College of Winterhold.
string: 我想我有一些用不上的舊法術書。要是覺得不夠的話，你得去冬堡學院找。

original: Do you know any old ballads about dragons?
string: 你有沒有聽過關於龍的老民謠什麼的？

original: There's the one about Tiber Septim and the dragon Nafaalilargus. I never bothered to learn it.
string: 有一個講泰伯．塞普汀和納法利拉古斯龍的事情的。我從來沒想過去學它。

original: The Blades killed them all centuries ago. Nobody asks to hear that lay anymore.
string: 刀鋒衛士們好幾個世紀前把他們滅族了。沒人會去聽那些個陳腔濫調。

original: Outlanders should mind their own business.
string: 外來者們應該先管好自己的事。

original: Don't come back.
string: 別回來。

original: Damn outsiders.
string: 該死的外地人。

original: And stay out.
string: 在外面待著。

original: Are there other strongholds out there?
string: 那裡還有別的城寨嗎？

original: There are a few great strongholds worthy to talk about. Dushnikh Yal, Mor Khazgur, Narzulbur, and Largashbur.
string: 有幾個大型的要塞值得一說。杜什尼克．亞爾、莫卡茲古爾、納祖伯，還有拉加施布爾。

original: Who is Malacath?
string: 瑪拉凱斯是誰？

original: You do not remember the Daedric Lord of the Orcs? The keeper of the Sworn Oath and the Bloody Curse?
string: 你不記得統御獸人的魔侯了嗎？誓言和血腥詛咒的掌管者？

original: We live by his code and follow his teachings. Spend some time with the wise woman and you'll remember.
string: 我們恪守著他的法典，遵循著他的教導。和族裡的女智者一起相處一些時間吧，你會記住的。

original: He is the Daedric Lord of the Orcs. The keeper of the Sworn Oath and the Bloody Curse.
string: 他是獸人們崇拜的魔侯。誓言和血腥詛咒的掌管者。

original: We live by his code and follow his teachings. An outlander like you wouldn't understand.
string: 我們恪守著他的法典，遵循著他的教導。和睿智的女性一起相處一些時間吧，你會想起來的。

original: How can I convince you to let me in?
string: 我怎麼才能說服你放我進去？

original: Hmm... we've heard whispers of an enchanted pair of gauntlets, hidden and protected by dangerous men, beasts, or worse.
string: 嗯…我們聽到了一副附魔的護手在低語，它正被危險的人、獸或者更難對付的東西收藏和保護著。

original: They are called the Forgemaster's Fingers. Bring them to our chief, and he will decide if you're worthy to be Blood-Kin to the Orcs.
string: 它們被稱作熔爐大師的手指。把它們帶給我們的酋長，他會決定你是否有資格成為獸人的血親。

original: I go where I please, Orc.
string: 我想去哪就去哪，獸人。

original: Ha. We admire your fighting spirit, Orc-Kin. You'll fit right in here. Come inside.
string: 哈。我們讚賞你的好戰精神，獸人血親。你加入這裡實在是再適合不過了。進來。

original: You're no kin of mine, pig-face.
string: 你絕對不是我的血親，豬頭。

original: We won't kill you, outlander, but we don't want you here. Remember that.
string: 我們不會殺你，外來者，但是我們這裡不歡迎你。你要記住這一點。

original: I'm just a traveler. What is this place?
string: 我只是個旅行者。這是什麼地方？

original: This is our stronghold. Here, we are free to live as Malacath intended, away from the prying eyes of the Nords.
string: 這裡是我們的要塞。在這裡，我們在瑪拉凱斯的庇護下自由地生活，遠離諾德人窺探的視線。

original: You must have been away from your kind for a long time to forget. Come, speak to the chief and the wise woman and remember.
string: 你一定是離開你的族群太遠了才會忘記。過來，跟酋長和睿智女性談一談，然後記起來吧。

original: I don't understand. What is this place?
string: 我不明白。這是什麼地方？

original: This is our stronghold. Here, we are free to live as Malacath intended, away from the prying eyes of the Nords.
string: 這裡是我們的要塞。在這裡，我們在瑪拉凱斯的庇護下自由地生活，遠離諾德人窺探的視線。

original: You're not an Orc, or Blood-Kin, so stay out. We only help our own.
string: 你不是獸人，也不是血親，所以你不能進來。我們只幫助自己人。

original: Welcome, child of Malacath. Your kin bid you welcome to our stronghold.
string: 歡迎，瑪拉凱斯的兒女。你的血親歡迎你來到我們的要塞。

original: Halt, outlander. By the Code of Malacath, this stronghold belongs to the Orcs. Your kind are unwelcome.
string: 站住，外地人。根據瑪拉凱斯法典，這個城寨屬於獸人。你等族類不受歡迎。

original: I promise you, I'll never let this happen again! I'll seal this whole place away...
string: 我向你保證，我絕不會讓這種事再次發生！我要把這個地方封印起來…

original: I had no choice! It was the only way to make sure that monster never escaped!
string: 我沒有選擇！這是確保那頭怪獸逃不出來的唯一辦法！

original: ...I'm sorry, friends. I'm so sorry!
string: ……對不起，我的友人們。真的很對不起！

original: Agreed. We all stay together.
string: 贊成。我們全都一起行動。

original: I'll be right with you.
string: 我會和你並肩同行。

original: We stay together, no matter what. Agreed?
string: 我們要一起行動，不管做什麼？贊成嗎？

original: We're not going to make it, are we?
string: 我們不會成功的，是嗎？

original: This is it, you know. Through this door. Can you feel it?
string: 就是它了，你知道的。跨過這道門。你能感覺到嗎？

original: What else could we do? Stay there and die with her? She refused to go on, we didn't have a choice!
string: 我們還能做什麼？也在那裡等死給她陪葬嗎？是她不想繼續走，我們沒有選擇！

original: We shouldn't have left her there to die!
string: 我們不能把她留在那裡等死！

original: Come on, you can make it. Let's go.
string: 加把勁兒，你能做到的。我們走吧。

original: Going back would be the end of all of us. We keep pushing forward, and we'll make it. We will!
string: 回頭就是死路一條。我們要繼續前進，我們能成功。我們一定能！

original: I don't think going back is a good idea.
string: 我覺得回頭不是個好主意。

original: You're right. This is all my fault. Should we turn around, head back?
string: 你是對的。這都是我的錯。我們是不是該轉身回去？

original: This is insanity. We never should've come here.
string: 這是精神錯亂。我們根本不應該來這裡。

original: Dead. Something grabbed her from behind. Gone before I could do anything.
string: 死了。有東西從後面抓住了她。我反應過來之前她就死了。

original: Where's Elvali? She was right behind me.
string: 艾爾瓦利哪去了？她剛才還在我後面。

original: Come on, we can't stop now. We have to keep moving!
string: 起來啊，我們現在不能停。我們必須繼續走！

original: Just another minute, please.
string: 等一下就好，拜託。

original: Forget it. Maybe I'll come back later.
string: 當我沒說。也許我應該晚點再來。

original: Very well. Perhaps when my research is complete, I'll feel more comfortable discussing my findings with you.
string: 非常好。可能等到我的研究完成，我會比較有閒情逸致跟你討論我的發現。

original: You ok?
string: 你還好嗎！？

original: Thanks for the help. The Reach has been crawling with Forsworn lately.
string: 多謝幫忙。邊塞最近到處都有棄誓者在活動。

original: It's a wonder people can get anywhere around here. Maybe I'll avoid this entire hold for awhile. That said... I do have a few things to sell.
string: 神奇的是，在這片土地上人們可以去任何地方。可能我應該暫時徹底離開這個領地。其實…我確實有一些東西可以賣。

original: I don't remember any of that. Be reasonable. (Persuade)
string: 我都不記得是那樣。你要講道理。（說服）

original: Well... all right. Just because we are friends. Give me, say... 750 gold and we can call it even.
string: 呃……好吧。看在咱們朋友一場的份上。給我，差不多……750金幣，我們就互不虧欠。

original: Nice try, but those bandits almost killed me. Now pay up.
string: 想得真美，我可是差點死在那些強盜手裡。現在快給錢。

original: See you, friend. And take it easy on the wine.
string: 再會，朋友。別把那葡萄酒看得太重要啦。

original: I don't have 10,000 gold.
string: 我沒有10000金幣。

original: So you're telling me you and Sam just sent me in there to die, then? I want my money, you bastard.
string: 你是想告訴我你和山姆就是把我騙到那裡去送死的，嗯？我要我的錢，你們這些雜種。

original: If there's one thing I hate more than a mean-spirited drunk, it's one who can't settle their debts.
string: 如果有什麼東西比心胸狹窄的醉鬼更讓我痛恨的話，那就是還不起債的懦弱小人。

original: Sorry, I don't even have 750 gold.
string: 不好意思，我連750金幣也沒有。

original: Here's your gold. (10,000 gold)
string: 給你錢。（給予10000金幣）

original: Thanks. You and Sam drink too hard for me. Think I'll take my gold and go buy a nice bit of swamp in Black Marsh.
string: 謝謝。你和山姆喝太猛了，我可不敢陪你們。我還不如拿走我的錢去黑沼澤買上一小杯夠味的臭水呢。

original: Thanks. You and Sam drink too hard for me. Think I'll take my gold and go buy something for this headache.
string: 謝謝。你和山姆喝太猛了，我可不敢陪你們。我還是拿著我的錢去買點能解頭痛的東西吧。

original: Here's your gold. (750 gold)
string: 給你錢。（給予750金幣）

original: Who are you?
string: 你是誰？

original: We caroused together with Sam Guevenne, remember? We broke into the Temple of Dibella? How much did you end up drinking?
string: 我們和山姆．圭文一起痛飲，記得嗎？我們還闖進了蒂貝拉神殿？最後你到底喝了多少？

original: Hey, where do you think you're going? Come back here.
string: 嘿，你以為你要去哪？回來。

original: Hey! There you are, you drunken bastard. I did it, so pay up.
string: 嘿！你在這裡啊，你這沒品的酒桶。我做完了，快給錢。

original: Whoa, not so fast there, friend. You owe me money.
string: 哇，別這麼急，朋友。你還欠我錢呢。

original: You and Sam dared me to go into that bandit camp. Well I did and brought back his stupid hat like you said, so give me the 10,000 gold you promised.
string: 你和山姆慫恿我進那個強盜營地。我就進去了，而且按你說的把他的蠢帽子拿回來了，所以你得把答應我的10000金幣給我。

original: We agreed to 750 gold. I want my money.
string: 我們談好了是750金幣。一毛都不能少。

original: So endeth the lesson.
string: 那麼上課到此為止。

original: Back from whence you came, heathen!
string: 從哪來回哪去，異教徒！

original: To Oblivion with you.
string: 你去死吧。

original: Forgive me, my brother.
string: 原諒我，我的兄弟。

original: Mara forgives you, my child.
string: 瑪拉會原諒你，我的孩子。

original: Rest well and sleep deeply, my brother.
string: 睡熟些，好好休息，我的兄弟。

original: For Lady Mara!
string: 為了瑪拉女士！

original: For Dawnstar!
string: 為了晨星城！

original: By Her Benevolence, you shall not stop us!
string: 以她的恩惠之名，你不能阻擋我們！

original: Take heed! They've awakened!
string: 小心！他們醒了！

original: Time for your final rest!
string: 你該迎接你的死亡長眠了！

original: They mustn't stop us!
string: 他們不能阻止我們！

original: We fight till the last!
string: 我們要戰鬥到最後！

original: ...w...what happened? Wait! We're still under attack!
string: ……怎……怎麼了？等等！我們仍在遭受攻擊！

original: ...the Miasma... They're still here! Stop them!
string: ……毒氣……這裡還有毒氣！快擋住！

original: ...dreaming... Defilers! Kill the defilers!
string: ……做夢……污染者！殺掉那些污染者！

original: ..wha?... where?... D-destroy this place! Tear it apart!
string: ……什……在哪？……毀、毀掉這個地方！把它炸成碎片！

original: ...s-sleeping? No! Burn the temple! Kill the priests!
string: ……睡、睡覺？不！去燒掉神殿！殺死祭司！

original: ...not dead? Kill them, kill them all!
string: ……沒死？殺了他們，殺光他們！

original: Lady Mara... preserve me...
string: 瑪拉女士……寬恕我……

original: I've failed you... forgive me...
string: 我讓妳失望了……請原諒我……

original: Too much... can't...
string: 太多了……不能……

original: Lady Mara... I await your embrace...
string: 瑪拉女士……我等待著妳的擁抱……

original: No... not when we're so close...
string: 不……在我們離得這麼近的時候不能……

original: Can't fail now... must hang on...
string: 現在不能失敗……必須堅持……

original: How could you, Erandur...
string: 你怎麼能這樣，依蘭杜爾……

original: Vaermina forgive me...
string: 瓦爾迷納請原諒我……

original: How dare you defile this temple, orc!
string: 你竟敢褻瀆神殿，獸人！

original: Begone, invader!
string: 消失吧，入侵者！

original: Die, foul orc!
string: 去死吧，愚蠢的獸人！

original: You'll pay for your blasphemy!
string: 你將為你的不敬付出代價！

original: Awaken, and perish!
string: 醒來，然後死去！

original: Feel the Benevolence of Mara!
string: 感受瑪拉的恩惠吧！

original: I'll send you to Oblivion!
string: 我要把你送到湮滅裡去！

original: This is your final hour!
string: 你的大限到了！

original: We must end the nightmares!
string: 你必須結束這些噩夢！

original: Is this the correct book?
string: 是這本書嗎？

original: Thank Her Benevolence it wasn't burned like the other tomes.
string: 感謝她的恩惠，它沒有像其他書卷一樣被燒掉。

original: Actually, I've already found it.
string: 實際上，我已經找到它了。

original: Well done. I wasn't certain you'd even know what to look for.
string: 做得好。我曾經一度懷疑你連自己要找什麼都不知道。

original: Show me where it is, before I take you over my knee.
string: 告訴我它在哪，別讓我用膝蓋頂碎你的脊椎。

original: Fine, I'll show you, you big bully.
string: 很好，我會告訴你的，你這個大惡霸。

original: You meditate on the Words? How?
string: 你冥想那些符文？怎麼做？

original: Knowing a Word of Power is to take its meaning into yourself.
string: 認知一個力量之語就是把它的涵義變成你的精神的一部分。

original: Contemplate the meaning of a Rotmulaag. You will become closer to that Word, as it fills your inner self.
string: 集中精神思考一個魯姆拉格的涵義。你會更加接近那個符文，接著，它會緩緩流入你的本我意識。

original: Will I teach you, Dovahkiin? What Word calls you to deeper understanding? There are three to master: Fus, Feim, and Yol.
string: 需要我教你嗎，都瓦克因？哪一系符文能喚起你更深的認同感？有三種可以學習：伏斯，費姆，尤。

original: Are you saying the ancient Nords sent Alduin forward in time?
string: 你是說古諾德人把奧杜因送入了未來的時間？

original: Not intentionally. Some hoped he would be gone forever, forever lost. Meyye.
string: 但不是有意為之。有一些人希望他永遠離開，永遠消失。梅伊。

original: I knew better. Tiid bo amativ. Time flows ever onward. One day he would surface.
string: 我當時就知道了。提德 波 阿瑪拉夫。時間之河總是向前流動。總有一天牠會浮上水面。

original: Which is why I have lived here. For thousands of mortal years I have waited. I knew where he would emerge but not when.
string: 這正是我住在這裡的目的。人類歷史的幾千年過去了，我一直等待。我知道牠會在哪裡出現，但不知道何時。

original: An Elder Scroll? What's that?
string: 上古卷軸？那是什麼？

original: Hmm. How to explain in your tongue? The dov have words for such things that joorre do not.
string: 嗯。用你們的語言怎麼描述？都瓦人的語言裡有表達這類事物的詞彙而你們的語言裡沒有。

original: It is an... artifact from outside time. It does not exist, but it has always existed. Rah wahlaan. They are...hmm... fragments of creation.
string: 它是一個…來自時間之外的神器。它不存在，但它總是已經存在。拉爾 瓦蘭。它們是……嗯……造物留下的餘料。

original: The Kelle... Elder Scrolls, as you name them, they have often been used for prophecy. Yes, your prophecy comes from an Elder Scroll.
string: 凱勒…就是你們稱為上古卷軸的物件，它們經常被用於書寫預言。是的，你們的預言來自一個上古卷軸。

original: But this is only a small part of their power. Zofaas suleyk.
string: 但這只是它們的力量的一小部分。佐法斯 蘇牙。

original: Did you hear the Greybeards call "Dovahkiin"?
string: 你聽見灰鬍子召喚「都瓦克因」了嗎？

original: I was just outside Ivarstead when it happened. It's an exciting moment. Nothing like this has happened in centuries.
string: 事情發生的時候我在紫杉鎮。那是個激動人心的時刻。這樣的事情好幾個世紀都沒有發生過了。

original: I did. Strange days when the monks will do that. I wonder what it means.
string: 是的。僧侶會這樣做確實很奇怪。不知道是怎麼回事。

original: Who are you?
string: 你是誰？

original: Just a pilgrim. I'd prefer to leave it at that, if you don't mind.
string: 只是一個朝聖者。我還是喜歡靜靜冥想，如果你不介意的話。

original: What are you doing?
string: 你在做什麼？

original: Walking the Steps. Meditating on the emblems. I make this trip every few years.
string: 徒步朝聖。冥想那神符。我每過幾年就要做一次這樣的旅行。

original: What are you doing?
string: 你在做什麼？

original: I'm walking the 7,000 Steps to honor the Greybeards and reflect on my own life. It's a tradition among the Nords of Skyrim.
string: 我在走七千台階的朝聖之路，為了紀念灰鬍子和反思我的人生。這是天際省諾德人的一項傳統。

original: I like to spend time up here. Walk the Steps, meditate on the emblems. Doesn't hurt when I bag some game along the way.
string: 我喜歡在這裡度過我的時光。數著朝聖之步，冥想著聖符。打些野味回家也未嘗不可嘛。

original: Enjoying the hospitalities of the inn. Suggest you do the same.
string: 享受酒館裡人們的熱情好客。你也是這麼做的吧。

original: Do you visit the Greybeards?
string: 你會拜訪灰鬍子嗎？

original: They're not the sort to take visitors, but I never go that high up the path anyway.
string: 他們不太喜歡招待客人，但其實我從沒有在那條路上走到海拔那麼高的地方過。

original: Some folk who make the trip leave them food or other essentials, but not to make conversation.
string: 有些來朝聖的人會留給他們食物或者其他必需品，但不和他們談話。

original: Here's the book you were looking for.
string: 這就是你要找的書了。

original: Looks like you're still in one piece. And more importantly, so is the book. Thank you.
string: 看起來你完好無缺。而且更重要的是，書找來了。謝謝你。

original: I'm not really interested in dangerous.
string: 我不太想冒險。

original: Some other time, then.
string: 那，就下次再說吧。

original: I'm ready for some adventure.
string: 我準備好去探險了。

original: All right. I wrote down the last place I'd heard about. Don't get killed.
string: 很好。我寫下了我打聽到的最新地點。別把命弄沒了。

original: Is there any College business I can assist with?
string: 有沒有任何學院來的委託是我能幫忙的呢？

original: There are more books to be recovered and secured in the Arcanaeum.
string: 還有更多應該被秘藏館收藏的書需要找回來。

original: I just try to keep out of the way when they start roughhousing.
string: 他們開始彼此大打出手的時候我只能努力不擋著他們。

original: Don't mind them. Just working out some issues, in the old way.
string: 別管他們。只是解決一些不同意見，以較傳統的方式。

original: Little blood to clear the air. Hope you have the stomach for it, outsider.
string: 一絲血腥味能讓空氣清新起來。希望你也喜歡這種味道，外來者。

original: What is it?
string: 什麼？

original: Not now, I'm trying to watch this!
string: 現在不行，我要全神貫注地觀看這個！

original: Pay attention, you could learn something.
string: 注意點，你可以學到有用的東西。

original: Are you going to let me watch, or not?
string: 你是要讓我繼續看呢，還是不讓？

original: Look at the young ones scrap!
string: 看看那群年輕的廢物！

original: Twelve septims on the girl! Look at that speed.
string: 12塊錢賭女孩贏！看她那速度！

original: Out of the way!
string: 讓開！

original: Could you move? You're in the way.
string: 你能挪一下嗎？你擋著我了。

original: Hope they don't get carried away here.
string: 希望他們在這裡打不會被帶走。

original: Good fight going, here.
string: 有場好看的搏鬥，在這裡。

original: With any luck, a worthy hero will step forward and solve our problems, just like in the tales of old.
string: 運氣好的話，一個傑出的英雄將從天而降並幫我們解決難題，就像古老的故事裡那樣。

original: We must keep faith in ourselves and the Divines.
string: 我們該對自己、對聖靈都抱有信心。

original: These are troubling times, indeed.
string: 這是亂世，真的。

original: These are troubling times, indeed.
string: 這是亂世，真的。

original: We've had the same troubles.
string: 我們也有同樣的麻煩。

original: I've spent many hours in council meetings lately grappling with that problem.
string: 我最近為解決這個棘手的問題花了很多時間召開理事會會議。

original: I've spent many hours in council meetings lately grappling with that problem.
string: 我最近為解決這個棘手的問題花了很多時間召開理事會會議。

original: I've spent many hours in council meetings lately grappling with that problem.
string: 我最近為解決這個棘手的問題花了很多時間召開理事會會議。

original: We've got our hands full dealing with the Stormcloaks. What about you?
string: 我們最近和風暴斗篷做生意賺飽了荷包。你怎麼樣？

original: Are the dragons frightening your people as much as they're frightening mine?
string: 我的人民所畏懼的龍是不是也以同樣的力量驚嚇著你的人民？

original: Have you found it difficult to get provisions lately? I can scarcely feed the staff in my palace.
string: 你有沒有發現最近糧食越來越難買到了？我快養不起我宮殿裡的臣僕們了。

original: Between the dragons and the Stormcloaks, my coffers are running dry.
string: 夾在龍和風暴斗篷之間，我的錢包要空了。

original: Splendid. Call if you have need of me.
string: 很棒。要是需要我就來找我。

original: It pleases me to hear you say so.
string: 你這麼說真令我感到高興。

original: Excellent. I'll leave you to it, then.
string: 很好。那麼，我就不打擾你了。

original: As much as can be expected, yes.
string: 是的，和期待的一樣好。

original: I have no complaints.
string: 我毫無怨言。

original: I suppose so, yes.
string: 我想是的。

original: Everything is splendid, thank you.
string: 做的都很好，謝謝。

original: Very much so, and thank you for asking.
string: 正是如此，謝謝你的邀請。

original: Very much so, and thank you for asking.
string: 正是如此，謝謝你的邀請。

original: Are you enjoying the party?
string: 你喜歡這個宴會嗎？

original: Is the food and drink to your liking?
string: 食物和美酒還合你胃口嗎？

original: Is my staff seeing to your needs?
string: 我的人服務還周到嗎？

original: Can the Thalmor be trusted?
string: 梭默值得信賴嗎？

original: For now, perhaps. But I've heard disturbing rumors that they're marshalling their strength.
string: 就現在來看，還信得過。但是我聽說了令人不安的謠言說他們正在集結力量。

original: I suspect the treaty that ended the war was just a tactic to buy time so the Thalmor can rebuild their armies.
string: 我懷疑這項休戰條約是梭默用以爭取時間重建軍隊的策略。

original: I hope I'm wrong. I'm not sure the Empire can afford another war.
string: 我希望我是錯的。我不確定帝國是否能同時應付兩場戰爭。

original: How are you enjoying the party?
string: 你喜歡這個宴會嗎？

original: Well enough, I suppose.
string: 很好，我覺得。

original: Elenwen puts a great deal of effort into these parties, and it shows.
string: 看得出來啦，愛琳溫在這次宴會中投入了很多。

original: I just wonder what her real motivations are. That woman is inscrutable.
string: 我在想她的真正意圖是什麼？那個女人真是深不可測。

original: I'm doing as you asked. This is for some good purpose, yes?
string: 我按你說的去做了。這麼做的意圖是好的，對吧？

original: A Jarl has many duties. Attending parties isn't the most important one, but neither is it unpleasant.
string: 一位領主具有很多職責。出席宴會不是最重要的一項，但是也不會令我反感。

original: Take advantage of the fine food and drink. Such things have been scarce since the war began.
string: 好好享受這些佳餚和美食吧。自從戰爭開始以後這些東西就變得很稀少了。

original: I came here hoping to learn that more Imperial reinforcements were on their way to Skyrim, but so far I've been disappointed.
string: 我來這裡希望得知帝國會向天際省派出更多的增援，但到目前為止我很失望。

original: I admit, I've never felt entirely at ease in the Thalmor embassy.
string: 我承認，我在梭默大使館從沒感到過一絲放鬆。

original: Do you visit the embassy often?
string: 你常去大使館嗎？

original: There are words spoken, and words unspoken. Beware these Thalmor, for they are adept in both languages.
string: 有些話是明說的，而有些話是不言而喻的。小心這些梭默，他們可都是口是心非的啊。

original: For this reason, I avoid them when I can.
string: 就因為這個，我儘量避免接觸他們。

original: Having a good time?
string: 玩得開心嗎？

original: Fair faces and fine food are well and good, but honesty is rarely so pleasing.
string: 美人配佳餚人人喜歡，但是實話卻鮮少動人。

original: Be about your business, while I'm about mine.
string: 你管好你自己的事，我管好我的事。

original: Now here is a face I did not expect to see. Be mindful, for you walk among adders.
string: 現在這裡有個我不想看到的人。蛇群中徘徊，要當心。

original: It is not eyes that reveal another's true nature. It is the heart.
string: 眼睛不能揭露別人真實的一面，要靠心去發現。

original: If your eyes and your ears are open and your mind is free of judgement and expectation, you might learn much in this chamber.
string: 如果你耳聰目明而且沒有先入為主的觀念的話，那麼你會在這個屋子中學到很多。

original: There are words spoken, and words unspoken. Beware these Thalmor, for they are adept in both languages.
string: 有些話是明說的，而有些話是不言而喻的。小心這些梭默，他們可都是口是心非的啊。

original: Some Jarls resent the Thalmor. How about you?
string: 有些領主討厭梭默。你呢？

original: Yes, I know what you mean. Most Nords struggle to accept change.
string: 是的，我知道你什麼意思。多數諾德人都在努力接受改變。

original: Those who fought the Thalmor in the Great War still see an enemy. But that war is over, and a new day has dawned.
string: 那些從在浩大戰爭中和梭默戰鬥過的人依然視他們為敵人。但是戰爭已經結束了，新的一天已經開始。

original: Besides, the Thalmor reward their friends richly. Anyone who doesn't take advantage of that is a stubborn fool.
string: 另外，梭默對他們的朋友很厚道。任何不會利用這一點的人都是呆瓜。

original: Have you known Elenwen long?
string: 你認識愛琳溫很久了嗎？

original: I've known her long enough to appreciate her excellent taste in food and wine.
string: 我對她的瞭解，足以讓我對她關於美酒佳餚的良好品味讚美有加。

original: And also long enough to respect her importance to Skyrim. She plays a vital role in rooting out the forbidden worship of Talos.
string: 也足以讓我對她之於天際省的重要性感到尊敬。她在根除塔洛斯崇拜的過程中扮演了重要的角色。

original: As far as I'm concerned, those Talos-worshippers get what they deserve. All they do is cause problems for me and the other Jarls.
string: 正如我擔心的，那些塔洛斯的崇拜者得到了他們應得的下場。他們只會給我和其他領主惹麻煩。

original: You asked for my help. Not for nothing, I hope?
string: 你請求我的幫助。我覺得，不會沒什麼好處吧？

original: These Thalmor know how to treat a guest.
string: 這些梭默知道怎麼款待客人。

original: A ruler is entitled to luxury, don't you think? The Thalmor understand that.
string: 一位統治者有權奢侈，你不覺得嗎？梭默懂得這點。

original: Why would anyone join the Stormcloaks? They have a fraction of the Empire's wealth and power.
string: 怎麼還有人加入風暴斗篷？他們只不過占了帝國財富與權力的一小部分。

original: If I had my way, I'd spend all my time at parties like this, and none of it dealing with the common rabble.
string: 如果要我選擇，我會花掉我所有的時間來參加這樣的宴會，而不是對付那些暴民。

original: Are you enjoying the party?
string: 你喜歡這個宴會嗎？

original: I am not. I have no more taste for Thalmor wine than I do for Thalmor company.
string: 不喜歡。跟梭默的美酒相比，我對梭默的商行更感興趣。

original: What is more, I'm away from the hold at a time when there are dragons and Stormcloaks on the loose.
string: 此外，當出現巨龍和風暴斗篷暴動時，我就離開了領地。

original: There's every chance I'll return to find a pile of smoking ash where Whiterun once stood.
string: 只要有一線希望我就會回去找尋白漫曾經所在地的廢墟。

original: How well do you know Elenwen?
string: 你跟愛琳溫熟嗎？

original: Not well at all, and I'm happy to keep it that way.
string: 一點都不熟，而且我很高興保持這個狀態。

original: That woman and her Thalmor Justiciars have caused nothing but problems for the people of Skyrim.
string: 那個女人和她的梭默審判者只會給天際省的百姓帶來麻煩。

original: I've got this. Do what you need to do.
string: 我知道了。去做你該做的吧。

original: This gathering is nothing more than a boast. The Thalmor are reminding us that we're at their beck and call.
string: 這個聚會只是為了炫耀。梭默在暗示說我們只能聽他們的擺佈。

original: We've got troubles enough without the Thalmor and their witch-hunts.
string: 就算沒有梭默和他們的那些獵殺行動，我們的麻煩也已經夠多了。

original: I'd rather be back at Whiterun, but while I'm here I might as well get some real news from the other parts of Skyrim.
string: 我寧可回白漫去，但是既然我來了我也許能從天際省的其他地方得到些有價值的新聞

original: These Thalmor might not like to admit it, but as long as the Empire has Skyrim, the Empire has strength.
string: 這些梭默不會承認的，但是只要帝國還控制著天際省，帝國就掌控著力量。

original: Jarl Elisif, it's a pleasure to see you again.
string: 艾利西弗領主，很高興再見到你。

original: Why, thank you. You are most courteous.
string: 為什麼，謝謝你。你很客氣。

original: I admit, I'm surprised to see you here. Normally these parties are reserved for  the Jarls and business leaders of Skyrim.
string: 我承認，你來這我很驚訝。一般這些宴會都是專門為天際省的領主或商界領袖準備的。

original: Elenwen must be very fond of you.
string: 愛琳溫一定很喜歡你。

original: Are you here with one of the Jarls?
string: 你是跟領主一起來的嗎？

original: I beg your pardon?
string: 你說什麼？

original: You must have me mistaken for someone else. I am Elisif, widow of High King Torygg and Jarl of Solitude.
string: 你一定把我跟別人搞混了。我是艾利西弗，至高王托依格的遺孀，獨孤城的領主。

original: Lucky for you, I possess a forgiving nature and I'm not easily insulted.
string: 你很幸運，我天性寬容而且不易被激怒。

original: Enjoying the party?
string: 喜歡這個宴會嗎？

original: Very much so, yes.
string: 是的，很喜歡。

original: Elewen's parties are always so elegant. She really has impeccable taste.
string: 愛琳溫舉辦的宴會總是那麼高雅。她的品味真是完美無瑕。

original: My only regret is that she doesn't host them more often.
string: 我唯一感到遺憾的是這樣的宴會舉辦的太少了。

original: Go ahead and play your little joke.
string: 繼續說你的小笑話。

original: When I married Torygg, he promised we'd go to lavish parties just like this. I wish he were here now.
string: 當我和托依格結婚以後，他答應我會舉辦一個像這樣豪華的宴會。我真希望他也能來。

original: Isn't this something? Elenwen really knows how to host a party!
string: 這難道重要嗎？愛琳溫真的很會舉辦宴會。

original: I could learn a lot from the people in this room.
string: 我能從這間屋子了的人中間學到很多。

original: Have you tried the wine?  It's better than anything in the Blue Palace.
string: 你喝這裡的酒了嗎？它比藍宮裡的酒要好喝。

original: Enjoying the party, Proventus?
string: 喜歡這宴會嗎，普羅萬圖斯？

original: Oh, hello there. I didn't expect to see you here.
string: 哦，您好。我沒料到您會來。

original: Yes, I am indeed. Elenwen always serves the best wine at her parties. The food is excellent as well.
string: 是的，我確實來了。愛琳溫總是在她的宴會上供應最上等的美酒。食物也很美味。

original: Though I confess, being surrounded by so many wealthy and important people makes me feel more than a little nervous.
string: 但是我承認，被那麼多富人和政要圍在中間，可不是普通的緊張。

original: What do you do for a living?
string: 你是做什麼工作的？

original: I'm the Steward of Whiterun. I serve Jarl Balgruuf in Dragonsreach.
string: 我是白漫的管家。為龍臨堡的巴爾古夫領主服務。

original: Truth be told, I'd be more comfortable if I were back there. I get nervous in the company of so many worthies.
string: 實話實說，要是回那裡去我會更舒服些。和那麼多有錢人混在一起讓我覺得緊張。

original: Quite a gathering, wouldn't you say?
string: 你是說，你想退出這個宴會？

original: Oh, yes! Quite! So many important people from all across Skyrim.
string: 哦，是！退出！那麼多來自天際省的要人都在這裡。

original: You don't look happy to be here.
string: 在這你看起來不怎麼高興。

original: Is it that obvious? I should take pains to seem more happy. I wouldn't want to upset our host.
string: 那麼明顯嗎？我應該忍忍表現的高興點。我不想讓主人感到沮喪。

original: But the truth of it is, I have a mountain of paperwork back in Windhelm and it's not getting any smaller.
string: 但事實是，我在風舵城還有堆積如山的文書工作要去做，那可不是輕鬆的工作。

original: I just hope this party doesn't drag on all night.
string: 我只是不希望這個宴會會通宵進行。

original: What brings you to this party?
string: 你為什麼來到這個聚會？

original: Ill luck. I'm a busy man and I don't have time for this sort of frivolity.
string: 倒楣啦。我很忙我可沒時間參加這種輕浮的聚會。

original: But at the same time, I don't dare refuse an invitation from Elenwen.
string: 但同時，我又不敢拒絕愛琳溫的邀請。

original: What do you know of our host?
string: 你對咱們的宴會主人知道些什麼？

original: Elenwen is a formidable woman. She lacks for neither cunning nor ambition.
string: 愛琳溫是一個令人敬畏的女人。她毫不缺乏狡詐和野心。

original: Now that I think of it, she would have made a fine Imperial general.
string: 現在我覺得，她會成為一位出色的帝國將軍的。

original: This must be awkward for you.
string: 這一定會令你感到尷尬。

original: That's putting it mildly.
string: 說得委婉些。

original: The Thalmor invite me here to remind everyone that they can tell the Empire what to do.
string: 梭默邀請我來這裡是想提醒所有人，帝國在他們的掌控之下。

original: I would refuse, but I don't want to jeopardize the peace between us.
string: 我會拒絕，但是我不想危害我們之間的和平。

original: Can there truly be peace between the Thalmor and the Empire?
string: 梭默和帝國之間真的存在和平嗎？

original: There is peace now, and that peace will continue for as long as it suits our needs.
string: 現在是和平的，而且只要它符合雙方的利益這種和平會一直持續下去。

original: But make no mistake, this is not a peace forged out of necessity between rival nations of equal strength.
string: 但是別搞錯了，在勢均力敵、相互競爭的國家之間是無法停戰談和的。

original: It is more like the calm between storms. And the next storm, I think, will be far deadlier than the last.
string: 這更像是風暴之前的平靜。下次風暴到來的時候，我想，會比上次更猛烈的。

original: What are your duties here in Skyrim?
string: 你在天際省的職責是什麼？

original: I lead the Justiciars. We are charged with enforcing the ban on Talos worship.
string: 我領導著審判者。我們負責執行對塔洛斯崇拜的禁令。

original: Nords can be quite stubborn. They're slow to change their ways, and we find more heretics every day.
string: 諾德人真的相當頑固。他們不肯改變他們生活的方式，我們每天都能發現更多的異教徒。

original: But mark me well -- I will purge the heresy from this land as surely as the flame burns the flesh from the bone.
string: 但請好好記住我的話 — 我會淨化這片土地上的異端，就像把骨頭上的血肉焚燒殆盡一樣。

original: I didn't know you had dealings with the Thalmor.
string: 我不知道你和梭默還有來往。

original: Have you learned nothing about me? I have dealings with everyone.
string: 你對我不瞭解嗎？我跟所有人都有來往。

original: Now, leave me. I don't want to arouse suspicion by talking to someone that clearly doesn't belong here.
string: 現在從我身邊走開。我不想因為和一個外地人交談而被他人懷疑。

original: Are you here on guild business?
string: 你來這裡是為了公會任務嗎？

original: Don't mention the Guild. In fact, it's better if you don't speak to me at all. This is not the place.
string: 別提公會了。事實上，你要是不跟我說話會更好。這裡說話不方便。

original: What's your relationship with the Thalmor?
string: 你跟梭默是什麼關係？

original: We have a relationship of mutual respect.
string: 我們彼此尊重。

original: I care little about the politics and rivalries between the Thalmor and the Empire.
string: 我不關心梭默和帝國之間的政治和競爭。

original: But I do respect power, and the Thalmor have that. They leave me alone, and I leave them alone.
string: 但是我確實相信權利，而且梭默也有權利。他們不管我，我也不管他們。

original: Does your company do business with the Thalmor?
string: 你的商行和梭默做生意嗎？

original: A delicate question, to be sure. I'm the Emperor's cousin, and the Empire has little love for the Thalmor.
string: 問題提的很微妙。我是皇帝的堂兄，帝國對梭默沒什麼好感。

original: On the other hand, the Thalmor have considerable funds and are looking to expand their shipping.
string: 再說另一方面，梭默擁有雄厚的資金而且正在打算擴張他們的船運業務。

original: I haven't signed any deals yet, but I'm sure my cousin will want a cut if I do. What better way to soothe his wounded pride?
string: 我還沒有進行任何交易，但是我確信我的堂兄會想要個折扣的。有什麼能撫平他受傷的自尊心嗎？

original: Do you trust the Thalmor?
string: 你信任梭默嗎？

original: I trust them completely, because I understand them.
string: 我完全相信他們，因為我瞭解他們。

original: When the Thalmor want something, they tell you straight. In my experience, they have no interest in subtleties and innuendo.
string: 當梭默想要什麼，他們會跟你直說。在我的印象裡，他們對來陰的和來暗的都沒有興趣。

original: So if one of them says they're going to do something, I believe them. When you can just take what you want, there's no need to lie.
string: 所以如果他們某人說要做某件事，我就會相信。當你能想要什麼就得到什麼，就沒有撒謊的必要了。

original: How did you make your fortune?
string: 你是怎麼發達致富的？

original: I've spent most of my life as a trader. I've got a stake in several shipping ventures across Tamriel, mostly imports and exports.
string: 我人生中的大部分時間都是商人。我在泰姆瑞爾大陸的若干船運買賣上都有投資，多數都是進出口生意。

original: I made a lot of friends in a lot of ports, and the Thalmor approached me with a generous offer.
string: 我在很多港口交了很多朋友，梭默總是對我很慷慨。

original: I give them access to my business associates, and they keep my coffers full.
string: 我讓他們成為了我的交易夥伴，同時他們也讓我的錢包鼓鼓的。

original: Do you host these parties often?
string: 你經常舉辦這種宴會嗎？

original: Quite often, yes. The only thing I enjoy more than luxury is sharing that luxury with those who can appreciate it.
string: 是的，經常舉辦。唯一比奢侈品更令我享受的事情，就是和有鑒賞力的人一同享受奢侈品。

original: But I also enjoy learning the latest gossip and hear the most intriguing rumors.
string: 但是我也很喜歡瞭解最新的小道傳聞和最有趣的謠言。

original: I can see you spared no expense.
string: 我能看出你不惜工本。

original: Of course not. One does not gather the most important men and women of Skyrim and then serve them cheap ale and stale bread.
string: 當然不是這樣。要是一個沒有天際省重要人物參加的宴會，就只會供應廉價麥芽酒和硬麵包了。

original: This is only a taste of the benefits that accrue to those that align themselves with Thalmor interests.
string: 這只不過是讓那些和梭默利益相關的人來嘗嘗我們的好處罷了。

original: You sound like quite the businessman.
string: 你聽起來是個徹頭徹尾的商人。

original: Not every Nord is obsessed with strength, honor and skill at arms.
string: 不是所有諾德人都對力量、榮譽和戰鬥技巧著迷。

original: A rare few are born with a gift for making money. My investments are my strength and my wealth is my weapon.
string: 很少的一部分人生來就具有賺錢的天賦。我的資產就是我的力量，我的財富就是我的兵器。

original: As for honor, well, there are some luxuries even I can't afford.
string: 至於榮耀，好吧，即使是我也有一些奢侈品是買不起的。

original: Have you lived here all your life?
string: 你這輩子都住在這嗎？

original: Born and raised right here in Rorikstead.
string: 我在洛利克鎮土生土長。

original: My father was a soldier. He fought in the great war and when it was over, he retired here to raise a family.
string: 我父親是名士兵。他曾參加過浩大戰爭，戰爭結束後，他退役到這裡組建了自己的家庭。

original: My mother passed away when I was just a babe, so he did his best to raise me on his own.
string: 我還是嬰兒的時候母親就辭世了，所以他就盡全力靠自己把我養大了。

original: It's not the most exciting place in the world, but the people here work hard and don't cause trouble for anyone.
string: 這裡不是世界上最令人興奮的地方，但是這裡的人民安居樂業，不給任何人添麻煩。

original: Your crops seem to be thriving
string: 你們的作物看起來欣欣向榮。

original: It's true. For as long as I can remember our crops have always done well.
string: 沒錯。在我的記憶中，我們的作物總是長得很好。

original: I'm not sure whether it's the soil, the climate or the favor of the Divines, but we've never had a poor harvest.
string: 我不知道是土壤、天氣還是聖靈庇佑的原因，總之我們從未有過歉收。

original: Yarr!
string: 呀啊！

original: Avast, dog!
string: 住手，蠢豬！

original: Die, ya cowardly lubber!
string: 去死，你這懦弱的傻大個。

original: Horkers' revenge!
string: 血腥長牙的復仇！

original: WERJ05PowerAttackBark
string: WERJ05PowerAttackBark

original: This is for Haldyn!
string: 這是為了哈丁！

original: I guess you don't have potatoes in your ears after all. Just make sure we get a fresh batch in soon.
string: 看來你耳朵沒被塞住。儘快給我們弄一批新鮮的來吧。

original: Yep. Ale's going bad.
string: 是。麥芽酒壞掉了。

original: Did you hear me?
string: 你聽見我說什麼了嗎？

original: The ale is going bad. We need to get a new batch.
string: 麥芽酒壞掉了。咱們需要一批新的。

original: Hard not to.
string: 很難沒聽見。

original: Wait, where did you get this? This piece was thought to be lost forever, please take this with my utmost thanks!
string: 等下，你從哪拿到這個的？這塊被認為再也找不到了，拿著這個我萬分感謝你。

original: I've found a lost verse of the Poetic Edda.
string: 我收集了詩歌集的很多片段。

original: Orgnar.
string: 奧格那。

original: Orgnar!
string: 奧格那！

original: Are you listening?
string: 你在聽嗎？

original: Is there somewhere I can buy fresh supplies?
string: 這裡有什麼地方能買到補給嗎？

original: Lucan's got a little bit of everything at the Riverwood Trader.
string: 路坎在河木鎮商人那裡幾乎能得到任何東西。

original: If you need weapons or armor, see Alvor, the blacksmith.
string: 如果你需要兵器或盔甲，去找那個鐵匠阿爾沃。

original: And by "supplies" I suppose you mean weapons and armor.
string: 你說「補給」我想是指兵器和盔甲。

original: Alvor can help you out. He's our blacksmith.
string: 阿爾沃能幫你。他是我們的鐵匠。

original: Can I use your forge?
string: 我能看看你的鍛鐵爐嗎？

original: I see no harm in it, if you have the skill.
string: 沒什麼不行的，只要你有鍛鐵技巧。

original: The grindstone will improve your weapons. Use the table to improve your armor.
string: 磨刀石能磨利你的武器。你也可以使用那張工作台來強化你的護甲。

original: If you've got the raw materials, you can use the forge to make something new.
string: 要是有原料，你還可以用鍛爐打造新的裝備。

original: I saw a dragon in Helgen.
string: 我看到聖地鎮有條龍。

original: Truly? So maybe my mother isn't crazy after all.
string: 真的？那麼我媽也許還沒瘋。

original: You had best tell the Jarl in Whiterun. He needs to know about this.
string: 你最好告訴白漫的領主。他需要知道這些。

original: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
string: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

original: Like to see him laugh his way out that.
string: 就喜歡看到他這樣笑。

original: Careful, huh? Thanks, Skulvar. I'll remember that. Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
string: 小心，嗯？謝啦，斯庫瓦。我會記著的。哈哈哈哈哈哈！

original: Consider yourself hired. (<global=hirelinggold>)
string: 我考慮僱用你。（<global=hirelinggold>金幣）

original: You seem to be a little short on coin. Come back and see me when you've got the gold.
string: 你的錢似乎有點不太夠。存夠錢之後再來這裡找我。

original: Looks like you've got some help already. I'll join you, but you'll have to let your comrade go. What do you say?
string: 看來好像已經有人在幫助你了。我可以加入你，但是你的同志必須離開。如何？

original: With a master of magic at your side, you'll have nothing to fear.
string: 有一個魔法大師在你身邊，你就無可畏懼了。

original: That's a fair price. My blade is yours.
string: 價格公道。我的劍歸你了。

original: My blade is sharp and I thirst for battle. Onward, then!
string: 我的劍鋒利無比，我渴望戰鬥。那麼，走吧！

original: You have chosen wisely. Lead on, and I shall follow.
string: 你的選擇很明智。帶路，我跟著你。

original: What dangers and wonders shall we discover in the frozen wastes? I can hardly wait to find out!
string: 在冰荒曠野能發現什麼樣的危險和奇觀？我等不及去發現了。

original: Lead the way!
string: 帶路！

original: Oh, a customer. Sorry you had to hear that.
string: 哦，一個顧客。讓你聽到了真是抱歉。

original: Why are you asking?
string: 你為何這麼問？

original: I'm with the Vigil of Stendarr. We believe this house might have been used for Daedra worship. Evil rites and so forth.
string: 我是斯坦德爾警戒者的一員。我們相信這座房子被用於魔族崇拜、進行邪惡的儀式，諸如此類。

original: You'll stay that way for now.
string: 你暫時保持那樣。

original: Coward. You're nothing. Nothing!
string: 懦夫。你一無是處！廢物！

original: I need a moment. I'll be back later.
string: 我需要點時間。我很快就回來。

original: I understand. Speaking to a goddess is overwhelming for many. Return when you're prepared.
string: 我懂。對許多人來說，跟女神談話的壓力太大了，難以負荷。等你準備好後回來找我。

original: What is this place? Who's Azura?
string: 這是什麼地方？誰是阿祖拉？

original: This shrine was built by the Dunmer. As our land was scorched by fire and brimstone, Azura's prophecies led us to safety.
string: 這座神殿由丹莫族所建造。當我們的土地被火山之焰化為焦土時，阿祖拉的預言指引我們逃到了安全之所。

original: She is a Daedra, a powerful being who watches from beyond our mortal plane. She has chosen you to be her champion.
string: 她是個魔族，是一個俯覽我們凡人世界的強大存在。她現在挑選了你作為她的勇士。

original: Stop right there. I'm not interested.
string: 別再說下去了，我不感興趣。

original: Fine. I can't force you to help me, but the offer is open.
string: 好吧。我不能強迫你幫我，但是你隨時都可來找我。

original: Your cannibal has been taken care of.
string: 你的食人族已經收拾掉了。

original: I don't need to know the details. Blessings of Arkay to you for your help.
string: 我不想知道細節。願阿爾凱的賜福與你同在。

original: Here. Take my amulet as a reward.
string: 給你，收下我的項鍊當作獎勵吧。

original: Why not?
string: 為什麼不呢？

original: I can't talk about it. Rest assured, the Jarl hears everyone's concerns. You will be able to visit the dead again soon.
string: 我不能說。放心，領主會傾聽所有人的擔憂的。你將很快就能再次探訪那些死者了。

original: You... must be Dragonborn!
string: 你……一定是龍裔！

original: Keep firing!
string: 繼續打！

original: That's it! We'll bring that bastard down!
string: 就是這樣！咱們會打垮那個畜生的！

original: Is that all you've got?
string: 你就只有這些嗎？

original: For Whiterun and Skyrim!
string: 為了白漫城和天際省！

original: Come down here and fight, you coward!
string: 下來決一死戰，你這個懦夫！

original: I can't get a bead on him!
string: 我沒法瞄準他！

original: Does anyone see him?
string: 有人看到他了嗎？

original: We don't stand a chance!
string: 咱們打不過他！

original: Stay under cover!
string: 躲在掩體後！

original: Now you're going to pay!
string: 是時候付出代價了！

original: Take him down! It's our best chance!
string: 除掉他！這是咱們最好的機會！

original: Is it dead?
string: 死了嗎？

original: Hold it there! Keep your distance.
string: 站住！和她保持距離。

original: I don't know where we're going, but Sovngarde awaits.
string: 我不知道我們要去哪，但是我感覺英靈殿正在等待著我慷慨就義。

original: Ulfric? The Jarl of Windhelm? You're the leader of the rebellion.
string: 烏弗瑞克？風舵城的領主？你就是那群叛軍的領袖？

original: But if they've captured you.... Oh gods, where are they taking us?
string: 可是，連你也被他們逮住了……噢，天哪，他們要把我們帶到哪裡去？

original: Watch your tongue. You're speaking to Ulfric Stormcloak, the true High King.
string: 你嘴巴放尊重點。你現在正和烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷說話呢，他可是真正的至高王殿下。

original: And what's wrong with him, huh?
string: 這傢伙是怎麼回事，嗯？

original: Hakon, Gormlaith, Felldir? Who are they?
string: 哈孔、葛拉斯、費迪爾？他們是誰？

original: The first mortals that I taught the Thu'um - the first Tongues. The leaders of the rebellion against Alduin.
string: 我傳授吐姆的第一批凡人 - 首批發聲者們。他們是對抗奧杜因的叛軍領導者。

original: They were mighty, in their day. Even to attempt to defeat Alduin...  sahrot hunne. The Nords have had many heroes since, but none greater.
string: 在他們那個時代，他們個個都是絕頂高手。他們甚至去挑戰巨龍奧杜因……沙哈洛特 哈尼。諾德人從那個時代以後出過很多偉大的英雄，但是始終沒有一個人能超過他們。

original: What do I do with the Elder Scroll when I find it?
string: 當我發現了上古卷軸之後我該怎麼做？

original: Return it here, to the Tiid-Ahraan. Then... Kelle vomindok. Nothing is certain with such things...
string: 帶到這裡……提德-阿蘭……來。然後……凱勒 沃明多克。事情會如何演變誰也不知…

original: But I believe the Scroll's bond with the Tiid-Ahraan will allow you a... a seeing, a vision of the moment of its creation.
string: 但是我相信卷軸與提德-阿蘭的聯繫將使你獲得……一種視覺，一種感知它創造之初情景的能力。

original: Then you will feel - know - Dragonrend, in the power of its first expression.
string: 之後你將感知——瞭解——龍魂撕裂，它最為原始的力量。

original: You will see them... wuth fadonne... my friends - Hakon, Gormlaith, Felldir.
string: 你將會看到他們……烏斯 法多恩……我的朋友 - 哈孔、葛拉斯、費迪爾。

original: Do you know the College of Winterhold? They have a deep interest in such arcana.
string: 你知道冬堡學院嗎？他們對那些神秘的東西興趣頗深。

original: I can use it to learn Dragonrend from the ancient Nords who defeated Alduin.
string: 我能從那些擊敗奧杜因的古諾德人那裡學習龍魂撕裂。

original: Hmm. Well, if that's what the Greybeards told you, I confess I don't have a better plan.
string: 嗯。好吧，如果灰鬍子跟你這麼說了的話，老實說我也沒有更好的計劃。

original: So little is known about the Elder Scrolls, almost anything is possible where they're concerned. Artifacts of truly inconceivable power.
string: 對上古卷軸知之甚少，和他們相關任何事情都是有可能的。真正具有超凡力量的神器。

original: I don't really know. Paarthurnax told me it would work.
string: 我不是很瞭解。但帕圖納克斯告訴我這行得通。

original: Paarthurnax? That name is familiar... the legendary leader of the Greybeards?
string: 帕圖納克斯？那個名字很熟…灰鬍子傳奇領導人？

original: I would not have expected a scholar of such an esoteric turn of mind among their ranks.
string: 我不認為他們當中會出現一個擁有如此令人難以理解思維的學者。

original: Turns out the ancient Nords used it to send Alduin forward through time.
string: 證明古諾德人使用它將奧杜因送入了未來。

original: Fascinating! So the ancients were more daring... or foolhardy... similar to the Dragon Break itself, although less far-reaching...
string: 真不錯！所以古人更有膽量……或者說有勇無謀……就好像「龍破」本身一樣，儘管沒那麼深遠……

original: This Elder Scroll might be able to show you the past in some way, then... yes, yes, it could work.
string: 這個上古卷軸也許能用某種方式將過去展現給你，之後……是的，是的，它可以。

original: What does the Dragonrend Shout actually do?
string: 龍魂撕裂到底能做什麼？

original: I cannot tell you in detail. I never heard it used. Kogaan. It was the first Thu'um created solely by mortals.
string: 我沒法跟你說得很細。我從未聽過有人使用它。克甘。第一個由凡人創造的吐姆。

original: It was said to force a dragon to experience the concept of Mortality. A truly vonmindoraan... incomprehensible idea to the immortal dov.
string: 據說是強迫一條龍體驗死亡的意象。一個真正的沃明多蘭……對於不朽的都瓦來說是不可理解的。

original: The giant at <Alias=BountyLocation> is dead. I'm here for the bounty.
string: <Alias=BountyLocation>的巨人死了。我來領懸賞金。

original: Hey, a fight!
string: 嘿，一場戰鬥！

original: Are those two at it again?
string: 那兩個又在忙了嗎？

original: What is it?
string: 什麼？

original: I've been working on a shield for Aela.
string: 我正在為艾拉做一面盾牌。

original: My wife is in mourning and I need to get back to her soon. I'd be much obliged if you could take this to Aela for me.
string: 我妻子正在服喪，我得趕回她身邊。你要是能幫我把這個帶給艾拉，我會感激不盡的。

original: Wait, before you go...
string: 等下在你走之前……

original: Vilkas will see if you're worth our trouble.
string: 威爾卡斯想知道你是否值得給我們惹這麼多麻煩。

original: I hear you have spirit. This is good. You may yet join our numbers.
string: 我聽說你有志氣。這很好。你也許能加入我們。

original: Keep up the effort, boy. Eyes on the horizon, always.
string: 繼續努力，孩子。所有人都看著你呢。

original: Keep up the effort, young one. Eyes on the horizon, always.
string: 繼續努力，年輕人。所有人都看著你呢。

original: Aye.
string: 好的。

original: Vilkas, take him out to the yard and see what he can do.
string: 威爾卡斯，把他帶到院子裡去，看看他能做什麼？

original: Vilkas, take her out to the yard and see what she can do.
string: 威爾卡斯，把她帶到院子裡去，看看她能做什麼？

original: Great, back to the fight.
string: 很好，繼續戰鬥。

original: Always good to see 'em go.
string: 總是很願意看到他們打架。

original: So who's winning now?
string: 那麼現在誰贏了？

original: Keep a sharp eye about you and maybe I'll teach you to fight some day.
string: 我會密切注意你的，也許某一天我能好好教教你如何戰鬥。

original: Watch the blades.
string: 注意你的刀子。

original: What are you waiting for?
string: 你在等什麼？

original: Just keep swinging!
string: 持續揮擊！

original: Pull him back!
string: 把他逼退！

original: Nice!
string: 不錯！

original: Come on!
string: 上啊！

original: Get him!
string: 抓住他！

original: Chop chop!
string: 砍啊！

original: Get in there and push!
string: 就是那！使勁！

original: All right!
string: 好吧！

original: Come on now, watch the footwork. Keep your balance.
string: 現在快點，看準腳法。保持平衡。

original: Strike when the shoulder turns. He's giving you openings!
string: 當肩膀轉過來的時候再擊打。他正在留給你空擋！

original: Watch the eyes!
string: 看著眼睛！

original: Just keep moving, you'll wear him out!
string: 保持移動，你將耗盡他的耐力！

original: I'm looking for work. Got any leads?
string: 我是來找工作的。有什麼可以介紹的嗎？

original: The Jarl has put out a bounty to slay a giant. Here, take a look at this decree for details.
string: 領主已經為殺死巨人發布了懸賞令。拿去，好好看一下懸賞令的細節吧。

original: The leader of <Alias=BountyLocation> is dead. I'm here for the bounty.
string: <Alias=BountyLocation>的首領已經死了。我是來拿賞金的。

original: I'm looking for work. Got any leads?
string: 我是來找工作的。有什麼可以介紹的嗎？

original: The Jarl has put out a bounty on Forsworn. Here, take a look at this decree for details.
string: 領主已經為殺死棄誓者發布了懸賞令。拿去，好好看一下懸賞令的細節吧。

original: So you work in the Winking Skeever?
string: 你在眨眼惡鼠工作嘍？

original: Work in it? I own it.
string: 在那工作？我擁有那裡。

original: You could say that. I own the place.
string: 可以那麼說吧。我擁有那個地方。

original: So you work here?
string: 你在這工作嘍？

original: That seems rather harsh.
string: 你似乎相當無情。

original: Listen, Roggvir and I grew up together. It was us, a few others and Vivienne. Vivienne Onis.
string: 聽著，我和羅吉維爾一起長大。我們是一掛的，還有一些其他人和維威恩尼。維威恩尼．奧尼斯。

original: I have no idea why, but one day, I told Roggvir I liked her. It was a stupid thing to do... He mocked me incessantly after that.
string: 我不知道為什麼，但有一天，我告訴羅吉維爾我喜歡她。那可真是個愚蠢的舉動…從那以後他就總嘲笑我。

original: From that point forward, every time Vivienne and I were anywhere close to each other, he made sure to humiliate me.
string: 從那時起，每次維威恩尼和我在一起的時候，他總會羞辱我。

original: He'd beat me up, dump mead on my head, anything he could get away with. Once he even slipped a beehive into my bed.
string: 他會打我一頓，把蜜酒倒在我頭上，做盡任何他想得到的壞事。有一次他甚至把一個馬蜂窩塞到了我的床上。

original: We were children, sure. But Roggvir never outgrew that immaturity, or his cruelty. So any talk about him being an "honorable" Nord? Pure folly.
string: 我們曾是孩子，沒錯。但是羅吉維爾並沒有從他的不成熟或是殘酷中有所成長。所以有任何人說他是一名「可敬的」諾德人？一派胡言。

original: That doesn't seem like a good attitude.
string: 你接待客人的態度似乎不怎麼好。

original: If you're looking for a good attitude go see the Bards. They'll fake it for you if nothing else.
string: 想要有人和顏悅色的對待你，勸你去找那些吟遊詩人。沒意外的話，他們會裝出來給你看的。

original: What do you mean?
string: 你是什麼意思？

original: Let's just say the headsman's axe may not be the worst way for a Solitude Jail prisoner to die.
string: 對於獨孤城監獄裡的犯人來講，死在劊子手的砍頭斧下或許不是最壞的選擇。

original: Look at that. I've told you to watch your tongue and mine is waggling. I've said enough.
string: 看看那個。我早就叫你小心說話，不知道說過多少次了。我現在也不想再說了。

original: Are you the court wizard?
string: 你是宮廷法師嗎？

original: No. That honor is Sybille Stentor's. A smart man steers clear of Stentor.
string: 不是。希比利．斯丹特才是。聰明人會避開斯丹特的。

original: And keeps himself out of the dungeon when she's having a bad day...
string: 而且當她心情不好的時候遠離她免得坐牢……

original: No. That honor is Sybille Stentor's. A smart woman steers clear of Stentor.
string: 不是。希比利．斯丹特才是。聰明人會避開斯丹特的。

original: And keeps herself out of the dungeon when she's having a bad day...
string: 而且當她心情不好的時候遠離她免得坐牢……

original: Now that Sybille Stentor is out of the picture, I am indeed. And the court is, well... free of her... eccentricities.
string: 現在希比利．斯丹特已經不成氣候了，我才是老大。而且朝廷已經，呃……從她的……怪癖中解放出來了。

original: Moving into her quarters was an interesting process.
string: 搬到她的住所裡去是個有趣的事情。

original: The rumors are all true.
string: 所有的謠言都是真的。

original: Then we should soon be selling arrows by the bushel. A sword is no good against a dragon.
string: 那我們應該快點去做弓箭生意。刀劍什麼的打不過一頭龍。

original: I've been traveling all over. Even been to Helgen...
string: 我經常旅行。甚至去過聖地鎮…

original: Where the Dragon attacked?
string: 那個被龍襲擊的地方？

original: We've heard rumors of death and... and fire from the skies. But no real news.
string: 據謠言說有人傷亡……還有從天而降的火焰。但是還沒有確切的消息。

original: So he did what he thought was right.
string: 所以他做了他認為正確的事情。

original: Then like Roggvir, you have a Nord's heart. It's hard for many of the people here to understand.
string: 就像羅吉維爾，你有一顆諾德人的心靈。這對這裡的大多數人來說太難理解了。

original: I think Aldis understands. I don't think I could have stayed here if anyone else had...
string: 我覺得艾迪斯理解。我覺得我不能待在這，要是什麼人…

original: I... I think I need to be done talking for the moment.
string: 我…我想我得暫時結束談話了。

original: Sounds like your brother was a traitor.
string: 聽起來你兄弟是個叛徒。

original: Then you didn't know Roggvir, and you have no idea what it means to be a Nord of Skyrim!
string: 看來你不瞭解羅吉維爾，你不知道這對天際的諾德意味著什麼！

original: He did the honorable thing, even when he knew it would cost him everything.
string: 他做了件值得尊敬的事情，即使他知道那會讓他一無所有。

original: My brother was the best man in Solitude.
string: 我兄弟是獨孤城最好的人了。

original: Who was your brother?
string: 誰是你的兄弟？

original: Roggvir. He opened a gate and they executed him for it.
string: 羅吉維爾。開了一扇城門，他們因此處決了他。

original: He opened a gate and the wrong man rode out of it. If that man hadn't been Ulfric Stormcloak. If Ulfric hadn't killed High King Torygg...
string: 他開了一扇城門，之後一個不該出現的人從這扇門中衝出。如果這個人不是烏弗瑞克風暴斗篷。如果烏弗瑞克沒有殺死至高王托依格…

original: But it was Ulfric. And he did kill the High King, in honorable combat. My brother refused to allow the the Imperials to take revenge for the deed.
string: 但是他確實是烏弗瑞克。而且他確實在一場光榮的戰鬥中，殺死了至高王。我的兄弟拒絕允許帝國採取報復行動。

original: So now he's dead.
string: 所以現在他死了。

original: No, I think he was an honorable man.
string: 不，我認為他是個令人尊敬的人。

original: Then like Roggvir, you're a Nord at heart. It's hard for many of the people here to understand.
string: 就像羅吉維爾，你有一顆諾德人的心靈。這對這裡的大多數人來說太難理解了。

original: I think Aldis understands. I don't think I could have stayed here if anyone else had...
string: 我覺得艾迪斯理解。我覺得我不能待在這，要是這些話被什麼人……

original: I... I think I need to stop talking now...
string: 我…我想我得暫時結束談話了。

original: Yes, yes, and yes. Oh my goodness, yes.
string: 是，是，是的。哦我的老天爺，是的。

original: Oh, wow. I knew it. I knew they were real! I have to remember to tell papa.
string: 哦，哇哦。我就知道。我就知道牠們是真的！我得記得告訴爸爸。

original: I was in Helgen when the dragon attacked.
string: 我在聖地鎮時曾遭遇過龍的襲擊。

original: Really? Was it big? Did it breath fire?
string: 真的？牠很大嗎？牠會噴火嗎？

original: Okay, if you don't want to hear about the dragon...
string: 好吧，如果你不想聽點關於龍的消息的話……

original: Dragon?
string: 龍！

original: Even if that battle is with a dragon?
string: 即使是和一條龍戰鬥？

original: Can any man hope to be ready for a dragon?
string: 誰會希望準備好去迎戰一條龍？

original: I can but hone their skills and harden their hearts. The rest is up to the gods.
string: 我只能磨練他們的技巧、堅實他們的內心。除此之外就只能聽天由命了。

original: You're the Dragonborn aren't you?
string: 你是龍裔對吧？

original: I'm sort of hoping you're going to fight the dragons for us. A normal man is no match for a dragon.
string: 我有點想要你幫我們和那些龍戰鬥。一個普通人可是戰勝不了龍的。

original: When's your next execution?
string: 下一個死刑是什麼時候？

original: Ain't got one. But I'd fancy a chance at that Jaree-Ra's scrawny neck.
string: 還沒有呢。但我已經在想像戰斧砍向加雷-拉瘦細脖子的感覺了。

original: Filthy Argonian never would have set foot in this city, if High King Torygg was still alive. I can tell you that.
string: 如果至高王托依格還活著，那些卑鄙的亞龍人永遠都別想涉足這座城市。我可以跟你說。

original: Do they keep you busy?
string: 他們讓你很忙嗎？

original: Depends on what you mean by "busy." I'm also the head jailor in the dungeon here. Quiet job, usually.
string: 取決於你對「忙」的定義。我同時也是地牢的獄卒頭頭，這基本上是個清閒的工作。

original: Is the man who was executed buried here?
string: 那位被處決的人埋在這裡嗎？

original: You mean Roggvir. Yes. I made an appeal to Captain Aldis. He allowed Roggvir to have a proper Nord burial, as is the custom in Solitude.
string: 你是說羅吉維爾。是的。我向艾迪斯隊長提了建議。請他允許羅吉維爾以諾德人的方式入葬，就像獨孤城的風俗那樣。

original: What darkness pervades Solitude?
string: 獨孤城彌漫著怎樣的黑暗？

original: This city has a long history of madness and murder. The Wolf Queen... Pelagius... The death of High King Torygg... And now, public executions.
string: 這座城市擁有一段漫長、黑暗、充滿殺戮的歷史。狼女王……佩拉吉奧斯……至高王托依格之死……然後是現在，公開行刑。

original: My books tell the stories. Have no doubt - as pretty as its streets are, as jovial as the bards may be... darkness is drawn to Solitude.
string: 我的書記述了這段歷史。毫無疑問 - 像他們的街道一樣美麗，像遊吟詩人一樣活躍…黑暗正逼近獨孤城。

original: How could you execute a fine and honorable man?
string: 你怎麼能處決一個善良而值得尊敬的人？

original: Sometimes you just do what needs to be done. You don't have to hate a man to kill him.
string: 有時候你只能做你應該做的。你不必痛恨任何人殺了他。

original: Though, admittedly... it helps.
string: 但，無可否認的…這有用。

original: So you think what he did was right?
string: 你覺得他做的是對的？

original: No. I think he was entirely wrong. Roggvir's execution was justified and necessary.
string: 不。我認為他完全錯了。羅吉維爾的處決是正當且必要的。

original: Being honorable might make you a good man, but it doesn't make you right. Be a better world if it did.
string: 品德高尚可以使人成為一個好人，但絕不可能讓人事事正確。否則，世界就不會像現在這樣了。

original: You were the one presiding over the execution.
string: 你是主持行刑的人。

original: Not my finest hour. Roggvir was a fine and honorable man.
string: 那段時間真不好過。羅吉維爾是一個善良而令人尊敬的人。

original: Why were they executing him?
string: 為什麼他們處決了他？

original: You really don't know?
string: 你真的不知道？

original: He let Ulfric Stormcloak escape Solitude. Ulfric rides in, murders the High King and Roggvir lets him ride right back out.
string: 他讓烏弗瑞克風暴斗篷逃出了獨孤城。烏弗瑞克乘馬而來，謀殺了至高王，羅吉維爾讓他乘馬離開了。

original: You really don't know?
string: 你真的不知道？

original: He opened the gate for Ulfric Stormcloak. Ulfric rides in, defeats the High King and Roggvir was the one that let him ride right back out.
string: 他為烏弗瑞克風暴斗篷打開了大門。烏弗瑞克乘馬而來，擊敗了至高王，羅吉維爾正是讓他騎馬離開的人。

original: And now the Stormcloaks have claimed the entire city. I guess we have Roggvir to thank for that as well.
string: 現在風暴斗篷佔領整個城市了，我想這也得謝謝羅吉維爾。

original: Don't forget me next time you need herbs and potions.
string: 你需要草藥和藥水的時候別忘了來找我。

original: Thanks again for finding out about my daughter.
string: 為找到我的女兒，再次感謝你。

original: Come by the Winking Skeever any time you want to hear a tune.
string: 下次你還想聽小曲，就再來光顧眨眼惡鼠吧。

original: You should think about staying the night. Corpulus keeps a clean inn.
string: 你應該考慮在這過夜。科普盧斯把旅館收拾的很乾淨。

original: Stick around! Still plenty of songs to sing and mead to drink.
string: 多待會！還有好多歌沒有唱完，好多酒沒有喝光呢。

original: Come back if you want to play tag.
string: 如果你想玩捉迷藏，就回來找我吧。

original: Papa doesn't like when I talk to customers, anyway.
string: 總之，爸爸不喜歡我和顧客聊天。

original: Remember the Winking Skeever next time you're footsore.
string: 下次你想歇腳時，一定要再來光顧「眨眼惡鼠」旅館。

original: Need anything, you just say the word.
string: 需要什麼，儘管說話。

original: I was done talking anyway.
string: 我不想再說了。

original: Yeah. Next time.
string: 是的。下次吧。

original: May song speed you along.
string: 願歌聲祝福你一路順風。

original: May the words of poets keep you warm.
string: 願詩歌給予你溫暖。

original: May all your adventures be worthy of telling.
string: 希望你所有的歷險都值得記誦。

original: Now you can say you've met the most talented bard in all of Skyrim.
string: 你可以說是遇見了全天際最有才華的吟遊詩人。

original: Don't forget my name. Someday, everyone will be saying it.
string: 別忘了我的名字。有一天，我將家喻戶曉。

original: Glad that distraction's over...
string: 麻煩事結束真是太好了……

original: We're done then? Good.
string: 說完了？好。

original: I suppose I should return to my papers...
string: 我想我得繼續寫作了……

original: Always good to talk to a fellow bard.
string: 總是很喜歡和詩人朋友聊天。

original: Farewell, stranger.
string: 告辭，陌生人。

original: Stop by again, sometime. I'll sing for you.
string: 下次吧。我會為你演唱一曲的。

original: Anytime, friend.
string: 隨時歡迎，朋友。

original: Always time for a fellow bard.
string: 永遠歡迎吟遊詩人朋友。

original: Oh, if you haven't heard Dean Pantea sing, you should.
string: 哦，如果你沒聽過潘提亞院長的歌，推薦你聽聽。

original: We should talk again sometime.
string: 咱們應該找時間再聊聊。

original: Always glad to talk to a bard.
string: 總是很高興能和吟遊詩人聊天。

original: Thanks for taking the time. People never want to talk to me.
string: 謝謝你費了這麼多時間和我聊天。很少有人願意和我說話。

original: Okay, I'll go now.
string: 好吧，我現在走。

original: I'm glad I could help.
string: 很高興能幫到你。

original: Anything I can do.
string: 願盡力而為。

original: Always glad to talk to the bard who returned part of the Poetic Edda.
string: 能與懂得部分詩歌集的吟遊詩人聊天，真是非常榮幸。

original: It's been an honor.
string: 我的榮幸。

original: I'll get back to court business, then.
string: 那麼，我要回去處理宮廷事務了。

original: Keep your sword arm strong.
string: 強壯的右臂才能使得一手好劍。

original: Always have your shield at the ready.
string: 盾牌要時刻準備好。

original: Take care of your armor, and it'll take care of you.
string: 照料好你的盔甲，它就能照料好你。

original: I must return to the court. They simply can't make do without me.
string: 我必須回宮廷去。他們不能沒有我。

original: Good, we've wasted enough time here.
string: 好，咱們已經浪費夠多時間了。

original: We'll speak again later. If we must...
string: 我們下次再聊。如果有需要的話……

original: I'll be sure to check "Talk to random stranger" off my list of today's tasks...
string: 今天我的任務清單上應該沒有「與路人甲聊天」這一項……

original: You are free to leave.
string: 你可以走了。

original: You are excused.
string: 你可以走了。

original: I am done with you. You may go.
string: 沒事了。可以走了。

original: Be well. Pray for Solitude and my husband.
string: 保重。為獨孤城和我丈夫祈禱吧。

original: Keep the faith. General Tullius will win this war.
string: 要有信心。圖留斯將軍會贏的這場戰爭的。

original: We have the utmost confidence in you and Ulfric's guiding hands.
string: 我們對你和烏弗瑞克的指引充滿信心。

original: May the blessings of the Eight be with you.
string: 願八聖靈與你同在。

original: May the blessings of the Nine be with you.
string: 願九聖靈與你同在。

original: Feel free to return to me with questions. The Blue Palace is an open forum.
string: 別介意向我提問題。藍宮是一個言論開放的場所。

original: Please feel welcome in the court of Solitude.
string: 在獨孤城的宮廷裡，請不要拘束。

original: I won't forget what you've done for Solitude.
string: 我不會忘記你為獨孤城所作的一切。

original: Anyone with a stout heart like yours is welcome here.
string: 這裡永遠歡迎像你這樣的勇士。

original: I'm proud to call a man like you friend.
string: 能與您這樣的男子結交，實乃三生有幸。

original: I'm proud to call a woman like you friend.
string: 能與您這樣的女子結交，實乃三生有幸。

original: Do not dishonor or attempt to harm Elisif in any way. Adhere to that rule, and you'll be fine.
string: 不要以任何方式去羞辱或傷害艾利西弗。守著這條規矩，你就不會有麻煩。

original: I must return my attention to Elisif. If were were to lose another Jarl while I was... distracted...
string: 我必須把注意力放回艾利西弗身上。可能一不留神……又會失去一個領主……

original: Take care of yourself, and always remember: the world is ripe with people looking to spill your blood...
string: 照顧好自己，然後牢記：想榨乾你的人，世上有的是。

original: Stay guarded. You never know what could be out there.
string: 保持警戒。你永遠都不知道下一刻會發生什麼。

original: All right. Back to slicing, dicing and baking.
string: 好吧。繼續切片、切丁、烘烤。

original: Back to my errands.
string: 我繼續做事。

original: Don't mess anything up while you're here...
string: 你可別一來就把東西弄亂了…

original: Good talking to you. Not many care to chat with the help.
string: 很高興和你談話。要我幫忙的話，直接找我就是。

original: Okay. I need to get back to the palace soon, anyway.
string: 好吧。不過，我要即刻回宮了。

original: You can catch me at the Blue Palace later, if you want to talk again.
string: 如果你還想找我，今後可以到藍宮找我。

original: If Erdi caught me chatting, I'd never hear the end of it...
string: 要是艾迪逮到我聊天，我就不得安寧了……

original: I guess I should be getting back to work. It was more fun talking, though.
string: 我想我得回去工作了。雖然，聊天很有樂趣。

original: May Arkay bless you with a long life.
string: 願阿爾凱保佑你福大命大。

original: May the light of truth keep the darkness at bay.
string: 願真理之光能黑暗中為我們指出一條明路。

original: It's best you leave me be.
string: 你最好別來煩我。

original: Sure, you make your retreat and I'll make mine.
string: 當然，你撤我就撤。

original: Keep your head about you.
string: 去想你自己的事吧。

original: Just watch yourself. You don't want to meet me on the job.
string: 自己小心點。你不會想在工作中見到我的。

original: Tell these Horkers to set me free.
string: 讓這些海象放我走。

original: Leave me be. I'm no harm here.
string: 別管我。我在這沒事。

original: Keep my men in your prayers. They'll need them if they don't shape up.
string: 祝福他們吧。保佑他們凡事都能化險為夷。

original: Stay strong. The Eight willing, we'll win this war.
string: 堅強點。八聖靈在上，我們必能贏得這場戰爭。

original: Sure, whatever you say. Bye.
string: 好吧，既然你這麼說。再見。

original: You should speak to my daughter, Evette. She's the brains of the family.
string: 你應該和我女兒談談，愛芙緹。她是我們家的智多星。

original: Always good talking to you... friend.
string: 很高興和你談話…朋友。

original: Thanks for talking to me.
string: 謝謝和我聊天。

original: For a stranger, you're not so bad.
string: 就一個陌生人來說，你不算壞。

original: Blessed are those who worship, for they know true grace.
string: 祝福只賜予信仰神靈之人，只有他們真正懂得感恩。

original: Keep the faith.
string: 維護你的信仰。

original: The strong and honorable always carry the blessing of the Eight.
string: 八聖靈賦予你力量與榮耀。

original: The strong and honorable always carry the blessing of the Nine.
string: 九聖靈賦予你力量與榮耀。

original: Your rewards in life will match the strength of your faith.
string: 你對神的信仰越是虔誠，神對你的眷顧也就越多。

original: The Temple of Divines is always open for worshipers.
string: 聖靈神殿的大門永遠向信仰者敞開。

original: Take care, and go with the blessings of the Eight.
string: 保重，願八聖靈的賜福與你同在。

original: Take care, and go with the blessings of the Nine.
string: 保重，願九聖靈的賜福與你同在。

original: I really need to get back to planning my wedding..
string: 我真得回去準備我的婚禮了。

original: Now if you'll excuse me. The East Empire Company has several accounts, and it's up to me to balance them.
string: 恕您原諒，東帝國貿易公司還有一些帳戶需要我去結算。

original: Perhaps I'll be seeing more of you.
string: 也許我們還能相見。

original: Please come back if you're ever in need of fletching supplies.
string: 你如果要買箭，就回來找我吧。

original: Good to talk to a fellow traveler.
string: 很高興能跟同是旅人的人聊天。

original: Stop back anytime.
string: 隨時歡迎你回來。

original: Thank you for helping my Aunt, earlier. I'll see you around.
string: 謝謝你幫了我姑媽。下回見。

original: People to see and places to go, huh? Later, then.
string: 還要去見幾個人、去一些地方，對吧？待會見。

original: I understand, you're an important person. I'll catch up with you later.
string: 我知道，你是個重要人物。待會我去找你。

original: I should make sure Svari is okay.
string: 我要確保斯瓦瑞沒事。

original: Addvar won't sell anything if I don't go and check up on him.
string: 要是不過去盯著他，艾達瓦什麼都不會賣的。

original: Come back to Bits and Pieces anytime.
string: 歡迎下次再來光臨零珠碎玉。

original: Make sure to recommend us to your associates.
string: 一定要向你的同伴推薦我們哦。

original: Return anytime you need arms or armor. My forge never rests.
string: 要買武器盔甲就來找我。我從不歇工。

original: Keep safe. And always wear your armor.
string: 保重。時刻穿著你的盔甲。

original: Finally...
string: 終於……

original: Thank the gods for the end of yet another pointless conversation...
string: 我的神啊，一場毫無意義的談話終於結束了……

original: Thank you for your patronage.
string: 謝謝惠顧。

original: I do hope you'll remain in Solitude. This city could do with some new blood.
string: 我真希望你能留在獨孤城。城裡需要些新面孔。

original: Remember Radiant Raiment when you need a change of attire.
string: 當你需要換身衣裳的時候，記得來錦衣服飾店。

original: May you sword feast on Stormcloak flesh.
string: 痛宰風暴斗篷吧。

original: Good hunting. Go kill some bandits for me.
string: 祝你一切順利。幫我除這些強盜。

original: If you're off to fight, talk to Beirand before you go. His armor is well forged and dependable.
string: 如果準備去戰鬥了，走之前去見見貝爾蘭德吧。他的盔甲工藝精良，非常可靠。

original: These are troubled times. Be on your guard out there.
string: 現在時局動盪。在外要多加小心。

original: May the gods speed your journeys... and steady your sword arm.
string: 神保佑你一路順風…有如神助。

original: Come back when you figure out how to spend money.
string: 等你想明白了到底該怎麼花錢，再回來找我吧。

original: I'll always have fruit to buy. Until it goes rotten. Then... I won't.
string: 我一直要買水果。除非都爛掉了，那才……不買了。

original: Good luck out there. It seems like a tough time to be wandering Skyrim.
string: 祝你好運。現在似乎不是漫遊天際的好時機。

original: Stay warm and keep sober. It's the two things I know for sure will make life better.
string: 充滿熱情、保持冷靜。據我所知，做到這兩點，才能過好日子。

original: If you're heading up to Solitude you should stop to check out the view on your way. It's a good one.
string: 如果你要去獨孤城，多留意路上的風景吧。很美的。

original: Carriages to all the cities in Skyrim. Don't forget us.
string: 這車能送你去天際的任何地方。要上路就來找我們。

original: A man like you should own a horse. Go speak with my husband.
string: 像你這樣的男子漢應該有匹馬啊。去跟我丈夫談談。

original: A woman like you should own a horse. Go speak with my husband.
string: 像你這樣的女子應該有匹馬啊。去跟我丈夫談談。

original: Plenty of chores to do...
string: 有好多零活要做…

original: Pa always says good men need few words.
string: 老爸總是說，真正的好人話不多。

original: I want to check on Grani, one of our horses. Goodbye, stranger.
string: 我要去看看我的愛馬格拉尼。下回見，陌生人。

original: I don't want the Lexicon.
string: 我不想要方典。

original: I won't be the one to go back there. I won't return to Avanchnzel. You can't make me do it.
string: 我不想回那裡。我不回阿旺晨澤爾。你別強迫我。

original: It's okay. I'll take the Lexicon.
string: 好吧，我會收下方典。

original: You must bring it to Avanchnzel, in the west. Return it to them. It must go back.
string: 你必須把它帶到西方的阿旺晨澤爾。把它還給他們。必須如此。

original: Are you... all right?
string: 你…還好嗎？

original: Oh, I am well. I will be well. Well to be within the will inside the walls.
string: 噢，我很好。我會沒事的。能理解牆上的意志真的很好。

original: My patron appears once more. Have you need of my blade?
string: 我的老主顧又出現了，有什麼要我效勞的？

original: It pleases me to see you again, my patron.
string: 再次見到你真好，老主顧。

original: Didn't think I'd be seeing you again so soon.
string: 沒想到我能這麼快又見到你。

original: You're looking hale and healthy. It's good to see you again.
string: 你看起來精神不錯，很高興能又見面了。

original: You're back! Great! Are we going on another adventure?
string: 你回來了！太棒了！我們又要去冒險了嗎？

original: It's great to see you again! It's been too quiet without you around.
string: 很高興見到你！你不在我太寂寞了！

original: Well, look what the horker dragged in. Still wandering all over Skyrim and causing trouble?
string: 喂，看看這混蛋又在搞什麼鬼，還在天際到處惹是生非？

original: I knew you couldn't stay away. Admit it, you were lost without me.
string: 我就知道你走不遠的，承認吧，沒我你都找不到路。

original: Well, look who it is. Been keeping out of trouble much? I hope not!
