string: 如果你歸還護身符，對大家都有好處。（說服）

original: Oh, I suppose. But you keep this to yourself; I don't want it being known that I go back on my trades. Understand?
string: 噢，我同意。但是你自己留著這東西，我可不想讓人知道我在生意上反悔了。懂嗎？

original: Yes, you see, the thing is... I'm not concerned with "everyone's best interest." I find I'm only concerned with my own.
string: 是的，你看，問題是……我不在意是否「所有人都有最大得益」，我在意的只是自己那一份。

original: I understand you have something of Onmund's. He wants it back.
string: 我知道你有昂蒙德的一些東西。他想拿回去。

original: Oh my. How precious.
string: 哦天哪。真是難得。

original: Onmund is too afraid to deal with me himself, and so he's sent you.
string: 昂蒙德害怕和我做交易，所以他派你過來。

original: I'll make this very simple for you. All my trades are final. Onmund knew this ahead of time, and went through with it anyway.
string: 我直接告訴你吧。我的生意是不會撤銷的。昂蒙德早知道這一點，清楚得很。

original: So there's nothing more to be said.
string: 所以沒什麼好說的了。

original: I've already made it very clear that all of my trades are final.
string: 我早說過我不會撤銷交易的。

original: Why is this amulet so important to you?
string: 這護身符對你有何重要之處？

original: I told you, it's from my family.
string: 我告訴過你，這是我家人給我的。

original: I don't... I know they always disapproved of what I wanted in life, to learn magic instead becoming a farmer, or a hunter.
string: 我…… 我知道他們從未贊成過我的想法，去學習魔法而不是做個農夫或獵人。

original: But no matter how poorly they may have treated me, they're still my family. I didn't consider that until after I'd made the trade.
string: 但不管他們對我有多不好，他們還是我的家人。我做了那筆交易後才發現這一點。

original: What did you need from Enthir?
string: 你想從恩希爾那裡得到什麼？

original: It doesn't matter. It's also none of your concern.
string: 不重要了。也不關你的事。

original: Just talk to him; see if you can convince him to give my amulet back.
string: 和他談談，看是否能勸他歸還我的護身符。

original: You have an odd name for a dark elf.
string: 對於一個暗精靈來講你的名字挺奇怪的。

original: I may be dark elf by birth, but I was raised Argonian.
string: 我雖然有暗精靈的血統，但我是被亞龍扶養長大的。

original: Through reasons I'm still trying to discover, I ended up orphaned then taken in by a kindly Argonian family in Black Marsh.
string: 我是個孤兒，被黑沼澤一個友善的亞龍人家庭收養了。直到現在我都還在找原因。

original: I hope one day to find out what happened to me... how I ended up like that.
string: 我希望有一天能查明我的身世……為什麼我會有這種遭遇。

original: What's the Ratway?
string: 鼠道是什麼？

original: It's Riften's name for the sewers beneath our feet. Absolutely disgusting!
string: 那是裂谷人對於下水道的稱呼。真令人反感！

original: If you fancy keeping your purse filled with gold and your head on your shoulders, I'd stay out of those awful tunnels.
string: 要是你想平安無事就遠離那地方。

original: Disgusting. Ruined sewers filled with goodness knows what.
string: 令人反感、不知充滿了何物的破敗的下水道。

original: There's an entrance down by the canal, but I'd highly advise you stay out of there... its the Thieves Guild's territory.
string: 運河附近有個入口，但我建議你別靠近……那是盜賊公會的領地。

original: Everyone knows the Thieves Guild uses the old sewer system beneath Riften as their hideout.
string: 盜賊公會用下水道系統作為藏身地點的事是人所共知的。

original: I'd go down there myself, but that would leave Jarl Laila unprotected.
string: 我可以自己下去那裡，但那樣萊拉領主就沒人保護了。

original: There are ruined sewer tunnels beneath the city. The only way I know how to get in there is through a door off of the canal.
string: 城市地下有廢棄的下水道。我知道的唯一能進去的方法是穿過河道裡的一扇門。

original: If I were you, I'd keep my feet dry and stay up here.
string: 如果我是你，我會遠離那地方的。

original: It's our name for the old sewers that run under the city.
string: 那是我們對舊下水道的稱呼。

original: It used to be a huge system hundreds of years ago but it fell into decay just like the rest of Riften.
string: 幾百年前它曾經是一個巨大的系統，但和裂谷的其他地方一樣，現在已經衰敗不堪。

original: The Guild stocks the place full of thugs that aren't good enough to join, so watch yourself if you venture down there.
string: 公會在裡面安置了很多暴徒，如果你要進去就當心點。

original: Tell me about the Thieves Guild.
string: 告訴我盜賊公會的事。

original: They live below the streets in the Ratway like dirty animals. And trust me, they're no better than the vermin that slink out of there for scraps.
string: 他們像骯髒的動物一樣在大街下的鼠道中生活。他們也不比垃圾堆裡的那些害蟲好多少。

original: They make it difficult for decent people to earn a living. Of course, not many decent people live here in the first place.
string: 他們讓正直的人無法順利生活。當然了，這裡也沒多少正直的人。

original: I'd hardly call them a Guild. More like unorganized rabble.
string: 他們算不上什麼公會，更像是烏合之眾。

original: In fact, I wouldn't say they were a threat at all. No, our resources should be spent on preparations for invasion.
string: 事實上，我不覺得他們是什麼威脅。我們的資源應該花在抵禦入侵的準備工作上。

original: We're all eager to see them brought to justice. Maven Black-Briar has assured me that they're being dealt with appropriately.
string: 我們都希望將他們繩之以法。瑪雯．黑棘向我保證過已經著手處理他們了。

original: As one of our city's most influential citizens, she's has taken it upon herself to oversee their incarceration.
string: 作為我們城裡最有影響力的公民，她以將他們抓捕歸案為己任。

original: Sadly, they're proving elusive but I have confidence that Maven won't give up until this city has been rid of them all.
string: 可惜的是，他們十分狡猾。但我有信心，瑪雯一定會將他們通通抓起來的。

original: Liars and bastards. Every one of them. I'd have their heads on a pike if it wasn't for the war effort.
string: 他們是一群騙子和雜種。要不是現在忙於戰事，我會把他們的頭擰下來。

original: All I need is a dozen men and we could march into the Ratway and burn them out like rodents.
string: 我只需要一群人往鼠道長驅直入，把他們像老鼠一樣燒死。

original: Stormcloaks won't have it though. Too busy keeping the Imperial forces at bay.
string: 但風暴斗篷沒空做這事。他們忙著抵抗帝國軍隊。

original: They're vermin... garbage. They're exactly what makes this city such a horrible place to live.
string: 他們是害蟲……垃圾。就是他們把這城市搞得烏煙瘴氣。

original: How appropriate they should live in the Ratway with the rest of the trash.
string: 他們就是應該在鼠道和那些垃圾住在一起。

original: They'd stop at nothing to take your last bit of food if that's all you had.
string: 他們會毫不猶豫拿走你最後一口食物。

original: The Ratway's too good of a place for that scum.
string: 那些人渣連鼠道這種地方都不配住。

original: They used to be pretty feared around here. I mean, you'd whisper the name and it'd send chills down your spine.
string: 他們曾經是人人懼怕的對象。只要說出他們的名字都會打個冷顫。

original: Now, they're nothing more than ruffians and thugs trying to pry a few extra coin from honest people.
string: 現在他們只是一群流氓無賴，只會從善良的人那裡拿走幾個硬幣。

original: All it would take is a small force of guard to go into the Ratway and flush them out.
string: 只需一小部分衛兵進入鼠道就可以將他們趕走。

original: Maybe some gold will help? (<BribeCost> gold)
string: 也許幾枚金幣能有所幫助？（賄賂<BribeCost>金幣）

original: Well, if you insist...
string: 如果你堅持的話……

original: Seems your purse is lighter than you thought.
string: 你的錢包似乎比你想的要輕一些。

original: Dragonborn? What do you mean?
string: 龍裔？你在說什麼？

original: In the very oldest tales, back from when there still were dragons in Skyrim, the Dragonborn would slay dragons and steal their power.
string: 在最古老的傳說當中，古老到天際省仍然有龍存在的時候，龍裔會殺死牠們、奪取牠們的能力。

original: That's what you did, isn't it? Absorbed that dragon's power?
string: 你就是那樣做的是嗎？吸取龍的力量？

original: Did you kill all this game yourself?
string: 這麼多都是你獵來的？

original: Oh, yes. Hunting is my great passion.
string: 噢是啊，打獵是我熱衷的興趣。

original: That's why my brother and I opened a shop to sell hunting supplies. It's the Drunken Huntsman, down by the main gate.
string: 這就是為什麼我兄弟和我開了家打獵用具店。店名叫醉獵戶，就在城門附近。

original: He tends the store, and I've got this stall.
string: 他看管店面，而我則是顧攤位。

original: Why the name "Drunken Huntsman"?
string: 為什麼叫「醉獵戶」？

original: Yes, I hear that question often.
string: 很多人問這個問題。

original: My brother Anoriath and I came up with it one night after consuming... rather too much mead.
string: 我和我兄弟阿諾利亞斯想出來的，有天晚上我們喝了……太多蜜酒。

original: After our drinks, we went out for a moonlight hunt. We got separated, and in his drunken state my brother mistook me for a deer.
string: 喝完之後，我們打算出門來場月光下狩獵。我們走散了，而我兄弟在喝醉的狀態下誤把我當成了一隻鹿。

original: He shot an arrow that pierced my... well, my rump. After such a memorable adventure, we knew we had the name for our shop.
string: 他射了一支箭穿透了我的……呃……臀部。在那次難忘的經歷後，我們就決定了我們店的名字。

original: So you're a healer?
string: 那麼妳是個治療者？

original: Of a sort. I don't have formal training in the Restoration school, but... something just as good.
string: 算是吧。我沒有受過正式的恢復系法術訓練……但會一些。

original: Within these walls, I have all that I need to brew a potion for nearly any ailment.
string: 在這裡，我能給幾乎任何輕微病症調製出相應的藥水。

original: If I had a Septim for every case of Rockjoint or Witbane I've cured since I opened this shop, I'd be a rich woman indeed.
string: 要是我向每個治好石化關節或腦損的病人都收一金幣，我早就成富婆了。

original: So you're a healer?
string: 那麼妳是個治療者？

original: Who forges your arms and armor?
string: 誰為你製造武器和護甲？

original: Adrianne. At her forge, just outside.
string: 阿德理安。她的熔爐就在外面。

original: Place is named after her. "Warmaiden's." It's a childhood nickname, given by her father. What I hear, she was playing with swords even back then.
string: 這地方就是根據她命名的。「女豪傑」這是小時候她父親幫她取的小名。就我聽說，她從那時起就開始玩劍了。

original: Anyway, our wares are strong and the prices fair. What else matters?
string: 不管怎樣，我們的商品物美價廉。除此之外還要奢求什麼？

original: Since Adrianne's death, I've had to buy them from the Khajiit caravans.
string: 自從阿德理安死後，我就必須從虎人商隊那裡買了。

original: Tried making some myself, but I'm no good with the forge and anvil.
string: 我也試過自己做一些裝備，但我並不擅長此事。

original: Anyway, our wares are strong and the prices fair. What else matters?
string: 不管怎樣，我們的商品物美價廉。還需要什麼？

original: What's the next target?
string: 下一個目標是什麼？

original: Good that you're so eager.
string: 你這麼積極很好。

original: What's our first target?
string: 我們的第一個目標是什麼？

original: Good that you're so eager.
string: 你這麼積極很好。

original: This looks like the guardian chamber. The key to that door has to be around here somewhere.
string: 這看起來像是守護者的房間，鑰匙應該在附近。

original: "Every door has a key," says Vilkas. Sometimes he is wrong, but look around anyway.
string: 「有門必有鑰匙」，威爾卡斯總是這麼說。雖然不一定對，但就四處找找看吧。

original: We should keep moving. Still the draugr to worry about.
string: 我們得繼續前進，小心諾德亡靈。

original: Now let's move. I think that was the last of the Silver Hand, but still plenty of draugr for the both of us.
string: 走吧。我想那就是白銀之手的最後結局了。

original: I will take you down too. I am not splitting this horde with anyone.
string: 我會把你也帶走的，我不會丟下任何一個人。

original: You will pay for stealing from me you eyeless freak!
string: 你會為偷我東西而付出代價的，不長眼的怪物！

original: I better stay back and see to the old man. Good luck you two.
string: 我還是離遠點，去照看下老人家好了。祝你們倆好運。

original: All right, let's see if we can find a way out.
string: 好吧，看看是否能找到出去的路。

original: I'll keep watch in case Ulfric comes through here. Talos guide the both of you.
string: 我要守在這裡看烏弗瑞克是否會過來。願塔洛斯指引你們。

original: Let's go on ahead. See if the way is clear.
string: 繼續往前吧。看前面的路是否暢通。

original: Still you persist? Very well.
string: 你還是堅持？很好。

original: Enough!
string: 夠了！

original: The staff! Use it on the Eye!
string: 用法杖！朝著眼睛打！

original: I am beyond your pathetic attempts at magic. You cannot touch me.
string: 你魔法水準遠不及我，想都別想碰到我。

original: Spells have no effect!
string: 法術沒效！

original: Let's get in there.
string: 我們進去吧。

original: I'll be right behind you!
string: 我跟著你！

original: Never mind.
string: 不要緊。

original: Hmph.
string: 哼。

original: I don't have time for this... I can get rough with you if I have to.
string: 時間緊急……別把我惹毛了。

original: Now, now! That won't be necessary.
string: 嘿，嘿！沒必要。

original: I don't have time for this. I can get rough with you if I have to. (Intimidate)
string: 時間緊急……別把我惹毛了。（威嚇）

original: I don't have time for this. I can get rough with you if I have to. (Brawl)
string: 時間緊急……別把我惹毛了。（打架）

original: I don't know what happened to me.
string: 我不知道我怎麼了。

original: Well, you can Shout now. You couldn't before, right? That can only mean one thing. You must be Dragonborn.
string: 啊，你現在能發出龍吼了，原先不能，對嗎？那就意味著，你是龍裔。

original: There's one way to find out. Try to Shout... that would prove it.
string: 有一個辦法可以查明。試著發出龍吼……就知道了。

original: According to the old legends, only the Dragonborn can Shout without training, the way the dragons do.
string: 根據古老傳說，只有龍裔能天生就發出龍吼，像真正的龍那樣。

original: I think you may be right.
string: 也許你說的是對的。

original: Yes. I think I am. You can Shout now. That can only mean one thing. You must be Dragonborn.
string: 是啊，你現在能發出龍吼了。那就意味著，你是龍裔。

original: There's one way to find out. Try to Shout...
string: 有一種辦法能弄清楚。看你能否發出龍吼……

original: According to the old legends, only the Dragonborn can Shout without training, the way the dragons do.
string: 根據古老傳說，只有龍裔能天生就發出龍吼，像真正的龍那樣。

original: Now let us see how quickly you can master your new Thu'um.
string: 那就看看你能多快學會新的吐姆吧。

original: Jump! Come on!
string: 跳啊！快點！

original: Get going!
string: 快走！

original: Through the inn! Now!
string: 穿過酒館！現在！快！

original: You still here? Go!
string: 你還在那裡？上啊！

original: Go! Now!
string: 走！現在！

original: Get moving!
string: 衝啊！！！

original: Go!
string: 開始！

original: What will become of the Afflicted?
string: 感染者從何而來？

original: Did you leave any alive? The Afflicted are mere vessels for my Blessing. It will spread to others through their touch and my own.
string: 你見到過他們？感染者只是我詛咒的載體，通過接觸傳染給其他人。

original: Another Overseer will replace Orchendor, when the time comes. For now all is cleansed and ordered.
string: 等時機到來時，另一個監督者會替代奧塵多。現在一切都井然有序。

original: Very well. Goodbye.
string: 很好，再見。

original: Embrace order and hard truth, mortal. Good bye.
string: 擁抱秩序與真理吧，凡人。再見。

original: I don't relish being a Daedra's puppet.
string: 我不想成為魔族的傀儡。

original: And yet you have done my bidding. Why, I wonder?
string: 但你還是執行了我的命令，為什麼？

original: What happens now?
string: 現在怎麼辦？

original: Go, seek your fate. I will be watching, and perhaps we will meet again - afterwards.
string: 去面對你的命運吧。我會注視著你的，也許日後我們能有機會再見。

original: Well done, mortal. All things are in their order, and Orchendor roams the Pits. His betrayal will be punished, and your obedience is rewarded.
string: 很好，凡人。一切都回歸秩序，奧塵多也已墜入深淵。他的背叛會遭到懲罰，而你的遵從將得到獎賞。

original: May I commune with Peryite again?
string: 我能和魄伊特再度交流嗎？

original: The vapors are waning, but not yet gone. Take a breath. Peryite will speak if He sees fit.
string: 煙霧漸弱，但尚未消失。深呼吸，看魄伊特是否決定見你。

original: Where can I find the items you want?
string: 我該在哪裡找你要的東西？

original: This one would try a shop. You might prefer the direct route, hm?
string: 在商店裡試試，你應該會喜歡直接一點，是嗎？

original: Deathbell grow in the frozen tundra. You might nip into a mine for the ruby and silver. Vampire Dust is tricky. Vampires, you know.
string: 喪鐘花生長在冰封草原，紅寶石和銀可以在礦洞找到，吸血鬼灰燼就有點麻煩了，找吸血鬼要吧，你懂的。

original: Ro...
So what is the Poetic Edda?
string: 詩歌集是什麼？

original: I think Giraud here would give you the best explanation of both it and the history of King Olaf's Verse. You should speak to him about it.
string: 我想吉勞德能為你詳盡地解釋這東西，還有奧拉夫王之詩。你該和他談談。

original: So King Olaf's Verse is a lost part of the Edda?
string: 看來奧拉夫王之詩是詩歌集中遺失的一部分？

original: And a very ancient one.
string: 而且還很古老。

original: The verse criticized the reigning King Olaf. He was so incensed the bard was put to death and all the copies burned.
string: 詩歌批判了奧拉夫王的統治，奧拉夫王十分震怒，將該詩人處死並燒毀了所有副本。

original: At least, that's what we thought until I translated some ancient texts a year or so ago. We now believe King Olaf buried the truth with the bard.
string: 我們以前是這樣想的，直到我譯完了一些古代文獻。現在我們相信奧拉夫王將詩人和真相一起埋入了土裡。

original: If I'm right Svaknir and King Olaf's Verse lie in Dead Men's Respite, along with the burial chamber of King Olaf himself.
string: 如果我是對的話，斯瓦科尼爾和奧拉夫王之詩一起被埋在了亡者之棲，就在奧拉夫王的墓室旁。

original: Viarmo said you could tell me about the Poetic Edda.
string: 維阿墨說你能告訴我關於詩歌集的事。

original: He's sending you after King Olaf's Verse then? That's good, we shouldn't leave it lying around now that I've figured out where it is.
string: 看來是他派你去找奧拉夫王之詩？很好，既然我已經找到了它在哪兒，就最好把它挖出來。

original: The Verse was Svaknir's contribution to the Poetic Edda, the living history of Skyrim. Each bard adds to the Edda in his or her time.
string: 那首詩詞是斯瓦科尼爾對詩歌集的貢獻，天際的活歷史。每個時代的詩人都在詩歌集中加入自己的部分。

original: Now, that's it. One free outfit per soldier. You lose that, or get it banged up, you'll need to pay like everyone else.
string: 就這樣吧，每個士兵一件免費的外套。要是丟了或壞了，就得出錢再買一套。

original: Heavy.
string: 重型護甲。

original: They don't make finer steel anywhere else. If this doesn't keep you from dying, nothing will.
string: 這種鐵是最優質的了，抵禦死亡的最佳助手。

original: Medium.
string: 中型護甲。

original: Alright. This here's enough to keep your insides from spilling out, except from the fiercest of blows, and shouldn't weigh you down too much.
string: 行了，這件已經足以保護你的軀幹了，而且不太笨重。

original: Light.
string: 輕型護甲。

original: Alright... here you go. Should keep you light on your feet, and hold up decent enough if you wind up trading blows with the enemy.
string: 好的……給你。這護甲很輕，而且能抵擋輕微的傷害。

original: What?
string: 什麼？

original: Light armor for scouting detail, heavy armor for full on combat, or something in between?
string: 輕甲適合偵查，重甲適合戰鬥，還是說你想要介於兩者中間的？

original: General Tullius said you'd get me outfitted.
string: 圖留斯將軍說你會給我裝備。

original: Yep. I have just one question for you.
string: 對。我只想問你一個問題。

original: Light, medium, or heavy?
string: 輕型，中型，還是重型？

original: And you think Ulfric will let me just walk in there, no trouble?
string: 你覺得烏弗瑞克會任由我走進去？

original: True, he's a dangerous and blood thirsty man, but he's also a Nord that honors our traditions.
string: 的確，他是個危險又嗜血的人，但他也是個尊崇我們傳統的諾德人。

original: Keep your wits about you and you won't be harmed.
string: 你聰明點就不會有麻煩。

original: And then get back here. Because if Ulfric isn't bluffing, I'll need every able body to defend Whiterun.
string: 完事就回來。如果烏弗瑞克沒有誇大其詞，那我們就得全力防守白漫。

original: That's not why I'm here.
string: 我可不是為此而來。

original: I'm sorry to hear that. If you change your mind, speak with Galmar. What does bring you to me?
string: 我很遺憾。要是你改變主意了，就和加爾瑪談。

original: Yes, sir.
string: 是，先生。

original: Good.
string: 很好。

original: That's not why I'm here.
string: 我可不是為此而來。

original: I see. Then there's nothing further to discuss. If you change your mind, speak with the Legate.
string: 我明白了。那沒什麼好說的了。如果你改變主意，你就去找副官談談吧。

original: Yes, sir.
string: 是，先生。

original: Good.
string: 很好。

original: Are you saying you sent me out there to die?
string: 你這樣是說要派我去送死？

original: Not at all. That was as much a test of your abilities as it was your resolve.
string: 並不是。只是對你的信心和能力進行測試而已。

original: I wasn't sure your heart was in it. But you've proven me wrong. And I respect that.
string: 我本來懷疑你的誠意，但你證明了我是錯的。你得到了我的尊重。

original: Now, if were done being sentimental, it's time for you to take the Oath.
string: 現在別婆婆媽媽了，到你宣誓的時候了。

original: Does every recruit have to do this?
string: 每個新成員都要這麼做？

original: Only the ones I'm not sure about. This will prove your abilities, but more importantly, it will prove your commitment.
string: 只有那些我不太信任的人。這種考驗能證明你的能力，更重要的是，證明你的忠誠。

original: How did you become the Jarl of Eastmarch?
string: 你是如何成為東陲領的領主的？

original: My father, the great Bear of Eastmarch, died during my imprisonment after the Markarth Incident.
string: 我的父親，東陲之巨熊，當我在馬卡斯城事件後被囚禁期間去世了。

original: I, his only son, forced to deliver his eulogy via a letter I had smuggled out of prison. Such is the love of Titus Mede for his subjects.
string: 我作為他的獨子，只能從獄中將他的悼詞偷運出去。這是提圖斯．邁德對他子民的愛。

original: When finally set free, I returned to Windhelm, and was greeted by a city in mourning, at one with my own grief and anger.
string: 當我最終獲得自由，回到風舵城之時，迎接我的是一座沉浸在悲傷中的城市，還有我自己的悲痛與憤怒。

original: Clamoring in angry voices, calling out for justice, for war, they sat me on the throne.
string: 人們懷著滿腔怒火要求為正義而戰，他們將我推上王位。

original: The Throne of Ysgramor! The throne of my father...  I only hope I can prove worthy of the honor.
string: 伊斯格拉謨的王位！我父親的王位……我只希望我不會辜負他。

original: And what of his widow? Doesn't she claim the throne?
string: 他的遺孀呢？她沒有宣稱繼位？

original: Indeed, Elisif has become Jarl of Solitude, historically and conveniently home of the High King, backed by Imperial interests.
string: 當然有了，艾利西弗成為了獨孤城領主，歷史上和傳統上的至高王所在地。背後是帝國勢力的支持。

original: But the Moot has not yet met to name her High Queen. And they won't. Not as long as I have any say in it.
string: 但領地代表大會還未任命她為至高女王。而只要我沒有表示任何意見，他們也不會這麼做。

original: Do you desire to be the High King?
string: 你想做至高王嗎？

original: There hasn't been a true High King in Skyrim for generations.
string: 天際已經好幾代沒有真正的至高王了。

original: For too long he's been hand-picked by the Emperor, and given emphatic nods by milk-drinking Jarls addicted to Imperial coin.
string: 有很長一段時間都是皇帝精心挑選出來的人當至高王，然後被一些卑鄙短視貪財的領主們阿諛奉承。

original: It's time we had a real king. One of our own making.
string: 是時候我們該選出自己的至高王了。

original: Some call you a murderer.
string: 有人說你是謀殺犯。

original: I challenged him in the traditional way, and he accepted. There were many witnesses. No "murder" was committed.
string: 我按照傳統規矩和他決鬥，他同意了。很多目擊者在場，沒有「謀殺」這一說。

original: True, he didn't stand a chance against me.
string: 雖然他的確是毫無勝算。

original: But that was precisely the point! He was a puppet-king of the Empire , not a High King of Skyrim.
string: 但那就是關鍵！他是帝國的傀儡王，而非天際省至高王。

original: His father before him perhaps, but not Torygg.
string: 也許他的父親曾經是，但托依格並不是。

original: He was too privileged and too foolish, more interested in entertaining his queen than ruling his country.
string: 他肆意專權，愚蠢狂妄，討好老婆勝於治理國家。

original: Why did you kill the High King?
string: 你為什麼殺死至高王？

original: I killed Torygg to prove our wretched condition. How is the High King supposed to be the defender of Skyrim, if he can't even defend himself?
string: 我殺他是為了證明我們可悲的處境，一個連自己都無法保護的至高王如何能做天際的守護者？

original: What will it take to end the war?
string: 如何才能結束這場戰爭？

original: Ulfric Stromcloak's head rolling away from his lifeless body.
string: 只需烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷人頭落地。

original: I hope Ulfric will come to his senses. But I fear he's in too far to stop now.
string: 我希望烏弗瑞克能回歸理智，但恐怕他已經無法回頭了。

original: Likely only Ulfric's death, or the overthrow of the Jarls supporting him will end this. Either way, much blood will be spilt.
string: 看來只有烏弗瑞克的死，或是他背後勢力的倒臺才能結束這一切。但不管何種方式都會流血遍地。

original: First we'll kick the Thalmor and their bloody Imperial puppets out of the country. Then we'll rebuild Skyrim into the land she once was.
string: 我們先要把梭默和他們該死的帝國傀儡趕出這個國家，然後重建天際，恢復往昔榮耀。

original: When we are done with that, we will take our army to the Dominion, and show those pointy-eared bastards not every man is fit to be their slave.
string: 做完那件事，我們就把隊伍拉到先祖神洲，告訴那裡的混蛋精靈們不是誰都適合當他們的奴隸。

original: What is the aim of this war?
string: 這場戰爭目的何在？

original: We're fighting because we're done bleeding for an Empire that won't bleed for us.
string: 因為我們已經受夠了一個拋棄自己人民的帝國。

original: Untold numbers of Nords died defending the Empire against the Dominion. And for what?
string: 不計其數的諾德人因抵禦先祖神洲對帝國的入侵而死，為了什麼？

original: Skyrim being sold to the Thalmor so the Emperor could keep his throne!
string: 只因皇帝想保住王位就把天際出賣給了梭默！

original: We're fighting because our own Jarls, once strong, wise men, have become fearful and blind to their people's suffering.
string: 我們戰鬥是因為我們曾經強大、睿智的領主們已經變得膽小如鼠，對人民的苦難視而不見。

original: We're fighting because Skyrim needs heroes, and there's no one else but us.
string: 因為天際需要英雄，而除了我們已經沒有別人。

original: Why are you fighting this war?
string: 你們為何進行這場戰爭？

original: Have you always lived in Skyrim?
string: 你一直住在天際？

original: I'm originally from Cyrodiil, sent here at the request of the Emperor himself. I'm often ordered to places with problems that need fixing.
string: 我是賽瑞迪爾人，應皇帝的要求來到此處，經常被派往動亂之地。

original: Now, while I'm certain this is all terribly interesting to you, I have important matters to attend.
string: 現在，雖然我知道你對這些很感興趣，但我還有要事在身。

original: What's the Imperial Legion doing in Skyrim?
string: 帝國軍團在天際省幹什麼？

original: The Legion's always been here. Without us to keep order, the provinces would fall into barbarism and lawlessness. Especially Skyrim.
string: 軍團一直在這裡，沒有我們維持秩序，這些省份都會陷入混亂和暴行之中。特別是天際。

original: Take for example, Ulfric Stormcloak and his little "rebellion." But rest assured, his days are numbered.
string: 比如說，烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷和他小小的「叛亂」。但大可放心，他氣數已盡。

original: Of course.
string: 當然了。

original: Sure.
string: 當然。

original: Properly controlled, it has knowledge enough to turn paupers into kings.
string: 只要控制得當，它能使貧民成為國王。

original: Besides, you're not scared of a few sleeping metal men. Are you, Drennen?
string: 再說，你也不怕那些沉睡的鐵人，對嗎，德恩南？

original: Not to mention our pay.
string: 更別說我們的報酬了。

original: General Tullius never mentioned you...
string: 圖留斯將軍從沒提起過你……

original: Galmar never mentioned a mission here...
string: 加爾瑪從未提起過這裡有任務……

original: What can you tell me about the Dragon Cult?
string: 關於拜龍教你知道些什麼？

original: What can you tell me about Forelhost?
string: 關於皮紙主人你知道些什麼？

original: What can you tell me about the Dragon Cult?
string: 關於拜龍教你知道些什麼？

original: Can you tell me more about this place?
string: 關於此地你還瞭解多少？

original: I haven't found the mask yet.
string: 我還沒找到面具。

original: Well then, what are you waiting for? Get in there and earn your pay.
string: 哈，那你還等什麼？去找啊。

original: Why aren't you going in there?
string: 你為什麼不進去？

original: I've found the journal of Skorm Snow-Strider.
string: 我找到了斯科姆．雪步的日記。

original: And what? You couldn't read it yourself? Fine, give it here a moment.
string: 然後呢？你看不懂？好，讓我看看。

original: What are you waiting for? Get in there and find that mask.
string: 你還等什麼呢？去找面具啊。

original: Any progress on finding the mask?
string: 找到面具了沒？

original: Don't bother me if you haven't found anything about the mask.
string: 要是沒找到面具就別來煩我。

original: Do you worry about raising a family in these dangerous times?
string: 在這種危險的時候你擔心家人嗎？

original: Of course. Every night I pray that we don't get a visit from a dragon, or that two armies don't show up to fight over the bridge.
string: 當然了，我每晚都祈禱別遇上龍，或者是兩軍在龍橋鎮打起來。

original: You ask if I'm worried? I'm terrified, if you want to truth of it. But I have to stay strong for my wife and children.
string: 你問我是否擔心？老實說，我都嚇死了。為了我的老婆跟孩子我必須堅強點。

original: You mentioned mean folk passing through town?
string: 你說有惡意的人經過此鎮？

original: Both the Imperials and Stormcloaks have sent riders this way, scouting the bridge and the lands nearby.
string: 帝國和風暴斗篷都派騎兵來過，偵查橋和附近區域。

original: They stayed at the inn, but didn't pay. They said soldiers don't need to pay because they're risking their lives to protect us.
string: 他們待在酒館裡還不給錢。他們說士兵們不用付錢，因為他們拼死保護了我們。

original: And that's not all. They took a heap of our lumber, and one tried to have his way with my daughter. They think they can do whatever they want.
string: 還有，他們拿走我一堆木頭，還有人對我女兒動手動腳，他們真是肆意妄為。

original: Did you say you came here from Markarth?
string: 你是說你從馬卡斯城來？

original: I grew up an orphan on the streets of Markarth. I'd have died there, too, but for the kindness of an old warrior named Logrolf the Bent.
string: 我小時候是馬卡斯城街頭的孤兒，要不是一個叫羅格洛夫的戰士我早死了。

original: Logrolf rescued me and gave me enough money to get out of the city. I followed the Karth river north, and came here.
string: 羅格洛夫救了我，給我足夠的錢離開馬卡斯。我沿著卡斯河向北走，來到此地。

original: When I met Michel, I knew this was where I belonged. I suppose that's it, really.
string: 當我遇到米切爾時，我認定那就是我的歸宿。我真的那麼想。

original: How old is that stone bridge near the town?
string: 鎮子邊的石橋建了幾年了？

original: Hard to say. It's ancient, that much we know for sure. It was here long before the town itself.
string: 很難說。肯定很古老，在鎮子之前就存在了。

original: I just hope the bridge survives the war. It's the only place you can cross the Karth river for a long way in either direction.
string: 我只希望石橋能從戰火中倖存，想過卡斯河就靠它了。

original: Could be if one side wants to keep the other from coming across, they might try to knock it down.
string: 要是一方想阻止另一方過河，可能石橋就要遭殃。

original: Sounds like you're having some trouble with your wife.
string: 你和你老婆之間似乎有點狀況。

original: Her name's Olda. If you've met her, then you probably already know what I'm talking about.
string: 她叫奧爾達。如果你已經見過她，你可能就知道我在講什麼了。

original: I swear that woman is the most spiteful shrew in all Skyrim. I think there's a chunk of ice where her heart ought to be.
string: 我敢說那女人是全天際最惡毒的潑婦了，她的心肯定是冰做的。

original: What brings a Breton to Skyrim?
string: 一個布萊頓人為何來到天際省？

original: Isn't it obvious? Why, the wonderful weather and hospitable people, of course!
string: 答案不是很明顯嗎？當然是美景和好客的居民了！

original: Not to mention my great fondness for dragons and petty political power struggles.
string: 再加上我對龍類和政治事件的愛好。

original: Ah, but without a doubt, the most compelling feature of this frozen wasteland is the volley of inane questions leveled at me on a regular basis.
string: 啊，但毫無疑問的，這片冰封荒地上最吸引人的，莫過於經常有人問我一連串無聊的問題了。

original: How's business?
string: 生意如何？

original: Interesting, to say the least. What with all that's been going on.
string: 就目前這種狀況來說，還蠻有意思的。

original: On the one hand, supplies are harder to come by, since fewer traders are traveling the roads these days.
string: 一方面，貨物供應越來越少了，因為路過此地的貿易商日益減少。

original: But on the other, the scarcity of supplies has led to some, well, "elevated" prices.
string: 另一方面，貨物短缺也導致了，呃……物價上漲。

original: All that matters is that I have what you need. And it's worth every septim.
string: 唯一重要的是我有你想要的，而且一分錢一分貨。

original: Who's in charge of Whiterun?
string: 誰在管理白漫？

original: That'll be the Jarl, Balgruuf the Greater. He's an honorable enough man. Never done wrong by me or my kin.
string: 就是領主大人，強者巴爾古夫。他是個可敬的人物，在我和我的家族眼中，他從來沒有做過錯誤的決定。

original: Things are tough for him now, I'd wager. What with the fighting, and the dragons. But Balgruuf's a tough old Nord. He can handle it.
string: 現在狀況很艱難，戰爭和龍都是棘手的問題。但巴爾古夫是個堅強的老諾德人，他能解決的。

original: Hrongar became the Jarl when his brother Balgruuf, who had the job before him, was murdered.
string: 前任巴爾古夫被剷除以後，他的兄弟霍隆格納成為領主。

original: Balgruuf was an even-tempered man, but his brother's a hot-blooded war-monger who wants to settle everything with a blade.
string: 巴爾古夫是個性情平和的人，但他弟弟是個脾氣暴躁，喜歡用武力解決所有問題。

original: If you've got some business with Hrongar, mind you stay on his good side. The palace dungeon's filled with folk who roused his temper.
string: 如果你有事和霍隆格納商量，千萬別惹毛他。地牢裡關著的全是觸怒他的人。

original: Vignar the Revered is the Jarl in Whiterun. I guess he was a great hero once, because the Companions all call him "Vignar the Revered."
string: 維吉納是白漫的領主。我想他曾是個大英雄，因為勇士們都叫他「尊貴的維吉納」。

original: Is Vignar too old to be Jarl? It's a fair question. If he's grown infirm and is losing his wits, where does that leave the people of Whiterun?
string: 維吉納太老而不能當領主？確實也言之有理。要是他這麼削弱又腦袋不靈光，那算置白漫百姓於何地呢？

original: You ever think of returning to Cyrodiil?
string: 你想過要回賽瑞迪爾嗎？

original: Why, because I'm a proud citizen of the Empire? Because the Stormcloaks only want Nords in Skyrim?
string: 為什麼，因為我是一名自豪的帝國人？因為風暴斗篷只接納天際本地的諾德人？

original: The Stormcloaks can rot in Oblivion for all I care. I've lived in this city for twenty years. Twenty!
string: 我只在乎風暴斗篷可以都在湮滅中腐爛。我在這城裡已經住了20年，20年之久！

original: Who should I talk to for work?
string: 要是我想工作該找誰？

original: Try Hulda, the innkeeper at the Bannered Mare. It's just up the road, near the market.
string: 試試胡爾達，敕旗母馬客棧的客棧老闆。就在前面，市場旁邊。

original: You should check in at Dragonsreach, too. There's so much going on these days, the Jarl or his Steward might have need of help.
string: 你也應該去龍臨堡看看。這些天發生了許多事情，領主和他的總管可能需要幫助。

original: Try Olfina, the new innkeeper at the Bannered Mare. It's just up the road, near the market.
string: 試試奧菲娜，敕旗母馬客棧的新老闆。就在前面，市場旁邊。

original: You should check in at Dragonsreach, too. There's so much going on these days, the Jarl or his Steward might have need of help.
string: 你也應該去龍臨堡看看。這陣子發生了許多事情，領主和他的總管可能需要幫助。

original: Who's the best blacksmith in Skyrim?
string: 誰是天際之中手藝最巧的鐵匠？

original: I can tell you're new around here, askin' a question like that.
string: 我看，你是新來的吧，這個問題還用問嗎？

original: My husband Eorlund tends the Skyforge up at Jorrvaskr, the Companions mead hall. There's no finer smith in the nine holds.
string: 我的丈夫厄倫德掌管天空熔爐。那在勇士之家，也就是戰友團的蜜酒大廳上方。九大領地之內的鐵匠中沒人比他更出色。

original: You should ask him about his work. It's the only subject that'll get him talking.
string: 只要問到有關鍛造的事情，他就一定和你滔滔不絕。

original: Well, that and maybe those stuck-up, dung-sniffing Battle-Borns.
string: 呃…除了那個話題，還有那些自大而又狂妄的戰狂氏族！

original: Curse you for bringing up that bitter memory.
string: 詛咒你勾起了那一段慘痛的記憶。

original: Not long ago it was my husband Eorlund. There was no finer smith in the nine holds.
string: 不久之前是我的丈夫-厄倫德，九大領地之內的鐵匠中沒人比他更出色。

original: Now he's dead and gone and the Skyforge of Jorrvaskr lies cold.
string: 現在他死了，勇士之家的天空熔爐一直空缺著。

original: You get a lot of attention from men?
string: 妳很吸引男士們的注意嗎？

original: You've got no idea. Half the men in Whiterun have proposed to me. Some were even single.
string: 你有所不知。白漫裡過半的男人都曾向我求過婚，其中一些是單身漢。

original: They'll never understand. No amount of flowers or honeyed words are going to change my mind.
string: 他們永遠不會明白。再多的鮮花和甜言蜜語都不能改變我的心意。

original: Right now, all that matters is my daughter Mila. No man's going to get between me and my little girl.
string: 現在，我只關心我的小女兒米拉。沒人能介入我和她之間。

original: Now it is your turn.
string: 現在輪到你了。

original: Master Borri.
string: 博瑞大師。

original: Master Wulfgar will demonstrate Whirlwind Sprint. Then it will be your turn.
string: 沃夫加大師將展示旋風衝刺。然後就輪到你了。

original: You must hear the Word within yourself before you can project it into a Thu'um.
string: 你必須先聽到你內心深處的符文，然後再以吐姆的形式釋放出去。

original: Wuld...
Nah...
Kest...
string: 凱斯……

original: Tell me about the Black-Briar family.
string: 告訴我關於黑棘家族的事。

original: Maven Black-Briar is the owner of the largest and most profitable business in all Skyrim, the Black-Briar Meadery.
string: 瑪雯．黑棘；是天際之城內最大最賺錢的黑棘蜜酒窖業主經銷商。

original: We're pleased to have her in Riften. She brings stability, opportunities for employment and strategic value to our city.
string: 我們很高興她在裂谷城。她帶來了穩定的工作和機遇，而且這對我們的城市來說是一筆戰略資源。

original: Maven Black-Briar, the matriarch of the family, represents everything that's wrong with this city.
string: 瑪雯．黑棘，家族的女負責人，代表著這座城市裡一切是非的起源。

original: She's bribed countless officials, has friends back in the Imperial City and freely associates with the Thieves Guild.
string: 她賄賂了無數的官員，在帝都都有她的朋友並且與盜賊公會有自由的聯繫。

original: I've tried everything I can to protect Riften's citizens from her family, but to no avail.
string: 我已經試過了所有方法保護裂谷城的公民免受她的家族的危害，但是毫無幫助。

original: The Black-Briars have been instrumental in keeping Riften on the map.
string: 是黑棘家族的幫助讓裂谷城還存在於地圖上。

original: Before the meadery was opened almost fifty years ago, this town was nothing... a simple waypoint for those journeying on to Morrowind.
string: 在大約五十年前酒莊開張之前，這座城市什麼都沒有……只是一個簡單的路標，告訴旅行者去晨風的路。

original: Now, thanks to my mother's generosity, this city is making its mark.
string: 現在，由於我母親的慷慨行為，這座城市正在形成它的標誌。

original: Tell me about your family.
string: 跟我聊聊你的家庭。

original: When speaking of the Black-Briars, only one thought should spring to mind. We are not to be trifled with.
string: 當提到黑棘的時候，你只需要知道一件事：別看扁我們。

original: Help us, you end up rich. Cross us and you'll end up a memory. Is that enough information for you?
string: 協助於我；你將收穫榮耀，與我們對立；你將身首異處，請問這樣夠了嗎？

original: Tell me about your family.
string: 跟我聊聊你的家庭。

original: Hmph. My family. All that wealth and they squander it on foolish ventures and political schemes.
string: 嗯。我的家庭。所有那些財富都被他們浪費在愚蠢的投資和政治陰謀上了。

original: I was meant for so much more than all of this... I wish to pledge my life and ply my talents in darker circles.
string: 我註定要終結這一切……願盡我所能、哪怕是在更黑暗的時期裡去賭上自己的性命。

original: If only my mother would let me, I would make her proud.
string: 只要我母親允許我，我將讓她無比自豪。

original: Tell me about your family.
string: 跟我聊聊你的家庭。

original: What are the rumors of corruption you mentioned?
string: 妳提到的那些腐敗的謠言是什麼？

original: There are those that believe the Jarl does nothing for this city... that it's corrupt and run by the Black-Briar family.
string: 就是有些人相信領主對這座城市毫無作為……是腐敗的，並且是被黑棘家族所控制。

original: I can assure you that this is entirely false. We are fully in control of everything.
string: 我可以向你保證這完全是錯的。我們完全控制著一切。

original: Why would you want to leave Skyrim?
string: 你為什麼要離開天際？

original: Are you serious? The war is tearing the land apart, the dragons have returned seeking who knows what... Skyrim is going nowhere fast.
string: 你是認真的嗎？戰爭踐踏著這片大陸，龍也回來了…天際很快將變成廢墟。

original: If I were you, I'd pack up and get out of here before you end up in one of those burial cairns.
string: 如果我是你，我會在你死在墳堆裡之前收拾包裹逃出這裡。

original: You treat all your customers like this?
string: 你對所有的顧客都是這個態度嗎？

original: Look, I've moved all over Skyrim selling these bits of junk and I'm barely scraping by.
string: 聽著，我走遍了天際來賣這點垃圾而且我只能勉強維持生活。

original: I'm not out to win friends and I could care less if you're happy about your purchase or not. I just need the coin.
string: 我不是來外面交朋友的，而且我也不在乎你對你的買賣滿不滿意。我只想多賺點錢。

original: The sooner I get out of Skyrim the better.
string: 我能越快離開天際越好。

original: By the Eight... you actually got your hands on it! This alone is worth more than some thieves earn in a lifetime.
string: 我的天啊……你的身手真得很不錯！就算那些小賊們做了一輩子，還抵不過你這一件來得值錢。

original: I managed to recover an Eye of the Falmer.
string: 我設法找到了一顆伐莫族之眼。

original: Must have come from Mercer's place. He'd admired the Gray Fox for some time. Sure, I'll buy it from you... here you are.
string: 你一定是從墨瑟那找到的對吧。他已經崇拜灰狐好一段時間了。當然，我會付錢的……拿去。

original: Found this bust of the Gray Fox. Worth anything?
string: 我找到了這個灰狐半身像。值錢嗎？

original: It's worth quite a bit actually. Quite a catch! Here you go, this should make you smile.
string: 其實這還值那麼幾個錢。非常不錯！拿去，這應該能讓你感到高興。

original: Can I sell this Dwarven Puzzle Box to you?
string: 我能把這個矮人魔方賣給你嗎？

original: What a delightful find! This should cover it.
string: 這是個可愛的發現！我想應該值這些吧。

original: Would this ship model be worth anything?
string: 這個船隻模型值錢嗎？

original: This should compensate you for your find.
string: 這應該能補償你的發現。

original: I found this map at the EETC. Interested?
string: 我在東帝國貿易公司找到了這張地圖。有興趣嗎？

original: I can't do this. We shouldn't be here. I'm sorry.
string: 我不能這麼做。我們不應該在這裡。對不起。

original: A few hours sleep and we should be ready to continue through.
string: 睡幾個小時後我們應該就能繼續前進了。

original: Wait!
string: 等等！

original: Best get rid of the ones we see. Just in case.
string: 最好解決掉我們看到的那些。以防萬一。

original: If you wish to talk, I'll be here for a bit.
string: 如果你想談談，我會在這裡。

original: Proceed down the hall to the gate when you're ready.
string: 你準備好後就沿著大廳向下前進直到大門那。

original: This way, please.
string: 請往這邊走。

original: Please hurry, we need to catch Mercer before he leaves Skyrim.
string: 請趕快，我們得在墨瑟離開天際之前抓住他。

original: Until next we meet, lad.
string: 下次有機會再見吧，小夥子。

original: Until next we meet, lass.
string: 下次有機會再見吧，小姑娘。

original: Revenge? How interesting...
string: 復仇？這還真有趣……

original: Very well, the conditions are acceptable. You may proceed.
string: 非常好，這樣很令我滿意。繼續說下去。

original: My appetite for Mercer's demise exceeds my craving for wealth, Your Grace.
string: 我想讓墨瑟讓位的願望超過了我對財富的渴望，大人。

original: Very well. I name your initiates Nightingale and I restore your status to the same, Karliah.
string: 非常好。我封妳為夜鶯新兵並且恢復妳原有的能力，卡莉亞。

original: And in the future, I'd suggest you refrain from disappointing me again.
string: 而且我建議妳，最好別再讓我失望了。

original: You surprise me, Karliah. This offer is definitely weighted in my favor.
string: 妳真讓我吃驚，卡莉亞。這個提案肯定是看準了我的喜好吧。

original: You're already mine, Karliah. Your terms were struck long ago. What could you possibly offer me now?
string: 你早就是屬於我的了，卡莉亞。妳的契約在很早以前就已經訂定了。妳現在還能給我什麼呢？

original: Ah, Karliah. I was wondering when I'd hear from you again. Lose something did we?
string: 啊，卡莉亞。我還在想什麼時候能再聽到妳的聲音呢。看來我們失去了什麼對吧？

original: Let's go.
string: 走吧。

original: Before we depart, Brynjolf has some business to discuss. I suggest you listen to him.
string: 在我們分開前，布林喬夫有件事情想討論。我建議你聽一聽。

original: If the Key isn't returned to its lock in the Twilight Sepulcher, things will never be the same for the Guild.
string: 如果鑰匙沒有被放回在黃昏墳墓的那把鎖裡，對公會的影響將無法挽回。

original: As time passed, our luck would diminish to the point of non-existence. And whether you know it or not, our uncanny luck defines our trade.
string: 隨著時間流逝，我們的運氣會逐漸削弱直至不存在。並且不管你知不知道，我們那神奇的運氣決定了我們的交易。

original: First time I ever set out to return something...
string: 這是我第一次為了「歸還」物品而行動……

original: Very true. In our line of work, it's quite rare we set out to return a stolen item to its rightful owner.
string: 完全正確。在我們工作的歷史中，幾乎不會為了把東西還給它的真正主人而行動。

original: You have returned with the gauntlets! Enter. Speak to our chief right away.
string: 你帶著那雙護手回來了！進來。趕快和我們的首領談談。

original: Return with the gauntlets, or not at all.
string: 帶著那雙護手回來，否則就不用回來了。

original: You cannot take this away from me!
string: 你不能搶走這個！

original: No! The Eye is mine!
string: 不！眼睛是我的！

original: No! You will not deny me this!
string: 不！你必須聽我的！

original: Erik the Slayer, huh? Sounds fearsome.
string: 嗜殺者艾瑞克，哈？聽起來很可怕。

original: Father says I should pick a name that describes what I really am,  but nobody's going to hire Erik Greenthumb or Erik Hoe-pusher.
string: 父親說我應該取個能形容我的名字，但是沒人會想雇一個叫「園丁」艾瑞克或「鋤地者」艾瑞克的傢伙吧。

original: No, I need a name that will put some fear in the hearts of my enemies. When I have some enemies, that is.
string: 不，我需要一個能讓我的敵人恐懼的名字。當我有敵人的時候，就該這樣。

original: On second thought, let's talk about this another time.
string: 仔細考慮之後，我們還是以後再談吧。

original: Another time, or not at all. It's really none of your business, after all.
string: 以後，或者永遠不用。畢竟，這真的不關你的事。

original: How old are your horses?
string: 你的馬都幾歲了？

original: None of 'em's older than nine, and the youngest is six.
string: 他們都不超過九歲，最小的六歲。

original: Now, the horse I got for sale is seven years old, but in fine health. She's got a lot of spirit, that one.
string: 現在，我出售的馬是七歲大，但是很健康。就是看起來精力充沛的那一隻。

original: We've taken to calling her Queen Alfsigr, or just Allie for short. I expect you can name her anything you like once she's yours.
string: 我們已經決定叫她艾爾弗西嘉女皇，或者小名艾利。一旦她成為你的之後，還請隨意為她取名字。

original: Your days of exploiting your son are over.
string: 利用你兒子的日子已經結束了。

original: Exploiting? What's that supposed to mean? Erik works the farm because he's a good lad!
string: 利用？那是什麼意思？艾瑞克之所以在農場工作，是因為他是個好孩子！

original: I'm not forcing him to stay here. I know that he wants a life of adventure, but I've told him before that I can't afford to buy him armor.
string: 我沒有逼他留在這裡。我知道他想讓生活充滿冒險，但是我以前就告訴過他我買不起他的盔甲。

original: Tell me about Riften.
string: 告訴我關於裂谷城的事。

original: You can get a room at the Bee and Barb, but mind your coin purse -- it's no secret the Thieves' Guild makes its home here.
string: 你可以在「蜂與鉤」旅社找一個住處，但是要保管好貴重財物，那裡是個賊窩。

original: Oh, and if you meet Maven Black-Briar, stay on her good side. This is her city, and nobody else's.
string: 噢，如果你碰到了瑪雯．黑棘，不要惹怒了她。這座城是她的，而不屬於任何其他人。

original: What do you know about Solitude?
string: 關於獨孤城，你能告訴我些什麼？

original: Solitude's been the capital of Skyrim as long as I can remember. Most of the High Kings of Skyrim were Jarls of Solitude first.
string: 獨孤城自從我有記憶以來就一直是天際的首都。天際的至高王們大部分都曾是獨孤城的領主。

original: Ah, let's see, what else... The Bards College is here, and the main office of the East Empire Company.
string: 啊，讓我想想，還有什麼……吟遊詩人學院在這裡，東帝國貿易公司的總部也是。

original: If you need it, you can get a room for a fair price at the Winking Skeever, just inside the main gate.
string: 如果你需要的話，你能在眨眼惡鼠那弄到一個價錢合理的房間，它就在走進大門不遠處。

original: What can you tell me about Windhelm?
string: 關於風舵城，你能告訴我些什麼？

original: It's an old city, I can tell you that. The Palace of the Kings is ancient.
string: 那是一座古老的城市，這個我很肯定。眾王之殿的歷史非常悠久。

original: It's not the friendliest place for outsiders. The Dark Elves were all forced to live in a slum called the Gray Quarter.
string: 那對外來人來說不是最友善的地方。暗精靈全部被迫生活在一個叫做灰民區的貧民窟裡。

original: The Argonians can't even live inside the walls. They're all stuck out on the docks.
string: 亞龍人甚至不能居住在城牆裡。他們全部擠在碼頭那。

original: Still, Candlehearth Hall's got decent food and cheap bunks. You could do worse.
string: 但是，燭爐堂客棧有不錯的食物和便宜的住處。你也可以選擇差一點的地方。

original: What do you know about Whiterun?
string: 關於白漫城，你知道些什麼？

original: Well, I know the Companions make their home here. Their mead hall, Jorrvaskr, is the oldest building in the city.
string: 嗯，我知道戰友團在那定居。他們的蜂蜜酒大廳，勇士之家，是城裡歷史最悠久的建築。

original: Oh, and there's a nasty feud between two families called the Gray-Manes and Battle-Borns. You'll want to be careful there.
string: 噢，灰鬃氏族和戰狂氏族之間世代結仇。你在那時得小心點。

original: The rest you can find out by asking the townsfolk. I'd start with the barkeep at the Bannered Mare, or the castle steward.
string: 其他的你可以問城裡的居民。我想我會先去問敕旗母馬客棧的老闆，或者是城堡的總管。

original: I don't care about the ring! Tell me what else I said! (Intimidate)
string: 我不管什麼指環！告訴我我還說了什麼！（威嚇）

original: All right, all right. You're mean when you're sober.
string: 好啦好啦。你清醒的時候還挺嚇人的嘛。

original: You said you the ceremony was going to be in Morvunskar. You said your friend Sam was going to be your best man.
string: 你說過你的婚禮將在莫萬斯卡舉行，你說你的朋友山姆將成為你的伴郎。

original: You think you can bully me. I grew up with five brothers. Go... get...my...ring.
string: 你覺得你能嚇倒我嗎？我和五個兄弟一起長大的。去、找、到、我、的、指、環。

original: I just need to get to the wedding. Please. (Persuade)
string: 我必須準備好婚禮！拜託。（說服）

original: You must have had a wild night if you can't remember that.
string: 如果你這都記不住的話，你肯定過了一個瘋狂的夜晚。

original: But I suppose everyone gets the jitters before their wedding. And I did say you could take a bit of time paying me back.
string: 但是我想每個人在婚禮前都會神經過敏。而且我的確說過你可以花點時間來向我償還。

original: You said the ceremony was going to be at Morvunskar. Don't forget you still owe me!
string: 你說婚禮將在莫萬斯卡舉行。別忘了你仍然欠我錢！

original: I'm sure your bride-to-be will tell you when you where the ceremony will be.
string: 我很確定要跟妳結婚的人會告訴你婚禮將什麼時候在哪裡舉行的。

original: If she still wants to marry you when you tell her you can't afford the ring.
string: 當然，那是假設如果你沒法弄到指環但對方還是願意跟你結婚的話。

original: Seriously, let me pay you for the ring. (2000 gold)
string: 說真的，讓我付錢買下這枚指環吧。（2000金幣）

original: Decided to go through with it then? I knew you couldn't have forgotten about your fiance. You spoke of her so glowingly.
string: 已經想通了？我就知道你不可能忘掉你的未婚妻。你說起她的時候那麼激動。

original: I don't know much about Morvunskar but it sounded like a lovely place for the ceremony. Congratulations.
string: 關於莫萬斯卡我知道的不多，但是那聽起來像是個舉辦婚禮的好地方。祝賀你們。

original: I think I would prefer my ring back. I put a lot of time into making it and you just gave is away as a joke.
string: 我想我更想要回我的指環。我花了很長時間才做好它，你就這樣開玩笑的送出去了。

original: Tell me everything and you won't end up like your goat. (Intimidate)
string: 告訴我一切，否則你的結局會和你的山羊一樣。（威嚇）

original: Okay, okay. Most of what you said didn't make sense but you left a note. The only bit that I could read said "after repaying Ysolda in Whiterun."
string: 好，好。你說的大部分話都毫無意義，但是你留下了一張便條。我能讀懂的只有「在償還白漫的伊索爾達之後」。

original: That's all I know.
string: 我就知道這麼多。

original: Do what you have to do, I'm not giving up on Gleda.
string: 做你該做的事吧，我可不會放棄格麗達的。

original: Help me retrace my steps and I'll pay you for the goat. (1000 gold)
string: 幫我找出我去過那些地方，我會為山羊付錢的。（1000金幣）

original: Fine, but I'll still be missing my Gleda. Doubt I'll ever have a prize winning goat again.
string: 好吧，但是我還是會想念我的格麗達的。或許我再也無法擁有一隻能獲獎的山羊了。

original: Most of what you said was gibberish but you left a note. The only bit I could read was "after repaying Ysolda in Whiterun."
string: 除了你留下的那張便條以外，你說的大多都是廢話。我唯一能讀懂的那些字是「先償還給白漫城的伊索爾達」。

original: There's not enough money in the world to replace Gleda.
string: 世界上的所有錢都不足以替代格麗達。

original: Now, what did I say about that staff?
string: 現在，我說了什麼關於法杖的事？

original: You said a whole lot of nonsense about selling Gleda to hire a priestess for some big event.
string: 你說了很多關於出售格麗達來為一個重要場合雇傭一個女祭司的廢話。

original: There was a bit of talk about some staff you had in safe keeping. Never said where, but you sure didn't have it with you!
string: 還說了些你妥善保管的什麼法杖。但沒說過是在哪，你肯定沒有帶著它！

original: I need to find Sam and the staff, in order to get Gleda back. (Persuade)
string: 我得找到山姆和法杖，這樣才能找回格麗達。（說服）

original: I suppose that makes sense. You didn't mention a Sam and nothing you said about the staff made sense.
string: 我想那行得通。你沒提過山姆這個人而且你說的關於法杖的事完全沒意義。

original: You left a note but it was mostly gibberish, the only bit I could make out was "after repaying Ysolda in Whiterun."
string: 你留下了一張便條但是上面都是些隻言片語，我唯一能看得懂的就是「在回敬白漫的伊索爾達之後」。

original: You didn't seem to need either to sell Gleda to the Giant in the first place. I think you'll figure it out.
string: 那你之前又何必把格麗達賣給巨人？我想你會設法搞定這件事的。

original: Tell me how I got here and I'll pay for the damages. (<BribeCost> gold)
string: 告訴我我怎麼來這的，我將為損失負出賠償。（賄賂<BribeCost>金幣）

original: Well, we can always use contributions.
string: 好吧，我們總能用得上捐贈的。

original: You were ranting when you got here  but most of it was slurred. You did say something about Rorikstead . Maybe you should take a look there.
string: 你來這時一直在胡言亂語，但是大部分都含糊不清。但你的確說了關於洛利克鎮的事，或許你應該去那看看。

original: Oh you must be nobility of some sort. Running around partying and paying others to clean it up.
string: 噢，你肯定是某個貴族。到處開宴會然後付錢讓別人清理。

original: I don't think so. Clean up your own mess.
string: 我不這麼認為。清理好你自己造成的麻煩。

original: I'm sorry, I don't even remember how I got here. (Persuade)
string: 對不起，我完全不記得我怎麼來這的了。（說服）

original: Well, you were deep in your cups when you got here.
string: 嗯，你來這的時候已經喝太多了。

original: You were ranting but most of it was slurred. You said something about Rorikstead.
string: 你當時在胡言亂語但是大部分都含糊不清。不過你說了關於洛利克鎮的事。

original: Oh, I'd love to help you figure it out, but I'm so busy cleaning up the mess you made of our temple...
string: 噢，我很樂意幫助你弄清楚，但是我在忙著清理你對我們神殿造成的麻煩。

original: Now if you were to help tidy up and perhaps apologize afterwards... I might be able to help you.
string: 現在如果你來幫忙收拾然後再道歉……我或許願意幫你。

original: You're going to assault Northwatch Keep?
string: 你打算襲擊北塔堡壘？

original: I'll do anything if it means saving my brother. You'll join us, won't you?
string: 如果能救我的兄弟，我願意做任何事。你會跟我們來的，是嗎？

original: Thorald can't be left to those... monsters.
string: 索拉德不能被留在那些……怪物手中。

original: Lingrah krosis saraan Strundu'ul, voth nid balaan klov praan nau.
string: 靈嘎 克羅西斯 撒然 斯特朗度．烏爾，沃斯 聶德 巴蘭 克羅夫 普蘭 惱。

original: Stand between us, and prepare yourself. Few can withstand the unbridled Voice of the Greybeards. But you are ready.
string: 站在我們之間，靜下心來。幾乎沒人能禁得起灰鬍子的全力龍吼。但是你準備好了。

original: You have completed your training, Dragonborn. We would Speak to you.
string: 你已經完成了你的訓練，龍裔。我們要和你談談。

original: Dah...
Meyz nu Ysmir, Dovahsebrom. Dahmaan daar rok.
string: 梅 怒 伊斯米爾，都瓦瑟布羅姆。達曼 達爾 洛克。

string: 梅 怒 伊斯米爾，都瓦瑟布羅姆。達曼 達爾 洛克。

string: 吶爾 吐姆，姆 歐法 尼 努，都瓦克因，吶爾 蘇牙 都 坎，吶爾 蘇牙 都 朔爾，阿克 吶爾 蘇牙 都 阿莫拉斯巫。

original: There you are.
string: 你在這裡！

original: Not just yet.
string: 還沒。

original: Let me know. We shouldn't stay here all day. My men want their mead.
string: 讓我知道！我們不該整天待在這，我的人想喝蜂蜜酒。

original: Let's go.
string: 走吧。

original: All aboard!
string: 全部登船！

original: Are you ready to go?
string: 你準備好走了嗎？

original: Do I have to beat it out of you? (Brawl)
string: 我必須得用拳頭來解決嗎？（打架）

original: It would be my pleasure.
string: 這是我的榮幸。

original: So, what's the word around the Guild?
string: 那麼，公會的狀況如何？

original: I haven't seen so much celebrating in years. Mercer's dead, we have a new Guild Master and things are finally looking up.
string: 我幾年來都沒看到過這麼多的慶祝了。墨瑟死了，我們有了一個新的公會會長，事情終於漸漸好轉了。

original: Business is booming, coin is flowing and everyone seems content as things keep going our way.
string: 生意蒸蒸日上，金幣源源不斷，事情朝著我們的方向發展，每個人看起來都很滿足。

original: A new chapter in the Thieves Guild is being written this day and we all owe it to you. Many thanks.
string: 盜賊公會的新篇章已經被改寫了，這都多虧了你。非常感謝。

original: I haven't seen so much celebrating in years. Mercer's dead, we have a new Guild Master and things are finally looking up.
string: 我幾年來都沒看到過這麼多可喜可賀的事。墨瑟死了，我們有了一個新的公會會長，事情終於有好轉了。

original: I only hope we can restore the Guild to its former glory after all the damage that's been done.
string: 我只希望我們能重建公會使其恢復往日的榮耀，在經受所有這些損失之後。

original: So, word has it you and Brynjolf know where Mercer's hiding. Good.
string: 那麼，我聽說你和布林喬夫知道墨瑟藏在哪。很好。

original: Make sure you make him pay for what he did to Gallus... heck, for what he did to all of us.
string: 你一定要讓為他對加盧斯做的事……可惡，和對我們所有人做的事付出代價。

original: We're all behind you, friend. Do your best.
string: 我們都在你身後，朋友。盡你的全力。

original: The word is that Mercer Frey is a dead man. The Guild wants his blood.
string: 有人說墨瑟．弗雷死定了。公會想殺了他。

original: I can't say I blame them. Murder is not our way. Gallus was before my time, but I still can't believe it.
string: 我不能說我怪他們。謀殺不是我們的方法。加盧斯是在我之前的，但是我仍然無法相信。

original: You need to teach him a lesson... show him the penalty for betrayal around here.
string: 你得教訓他們一下……告訴他這裡對背叛的懲罰。

original: Look, I like you, so I'll tell it to you straight. Brynjolf and the rest are in the Guild, and they're ready to cut you down.
string: 聽著，我喜歡你，所以我直接跟你說。布林喬夫和其他人在公會裡，而且他們準備好砍倒你了。

original: I know you have a damn good reason for siding with Karliah, so I hope you can give it to them.
string: 我知道你有支持卡莉亞的好理由，所以我希望你能把它給他們。

original: Everyone's been worried since you and Mercer haven't shown up in a while. Brynjolf even went out to find you.
string: 自從你和墨瑟失蹤一段時間後每個人都著急了。布林喬夫甚至出去找你了。

original: Delvin and Vex have been running things for now.
string: 戴爾文和「小煩」現在在負責。

original: I hope this all gets straightened out soon or I'm headed on the first caravan out of Riften.
string: 我希望這全部都將很快被擺平否則我就跟著下一個離開裂谷城的車隊出發了。

original: Glad to hear Gulum-Ei got what he deserved. That lizard owes me big for a bad shipment of Shadowbanish Wine he tried to pass off on me.
string: 很高興聽到古魯姆-埃得到他應得的了。那個蜥蜴想把一次影散酒的事故損失歸結到我頭上，可欠了我不少。

original: Mercer's been storming around waiting for you to come back. I think he's finally figured out who's been messing with the Guild.
string: 我想他終於弄清楚是誰在找公會的麻煩了。

original: Never seen the guy so angry. Better help him out any way you can.
string: 從沒看到過那傢伙這麼生氣。最好用你知道的任何方法幫助他。

original: Maven was down here right before you got back and she was all smiles. Haven't seen her like that in a long time.
string: 在你回來前剛好下來了，她笑的很開心。很久沒看到她像那樣了。

original: Whatever you did at Honningbrew, you're now on her good side. Best of all, if she's happy, Mercer's happy.
string: 不管你在蜜之釀酒莊做了什麼，你已經討得她的歡心了。最重要的是，如果她高興，墨瑟就高興。

original: Keep it up and you'll go places.
string: 繼續努力，你會獲得成功的。

original: Well, you did something Vex couldn't do at Goldenglow, so you're looking pretty damn good.
string: 嗯，你做了「小煩」在金色光輝無法做到的事情，所以你現在看起來真不錯。

original: Word is that you found something while you were out there though... something that could be a problem for the Guild.
string: 有人說你在外面的時候找到了什麼東西但是……可能是一個對公會有麻煩的東西。

original: Just watch your back and do what Mercer says... he'll sort it out.
string: 當心你自己並且做好墨瑟說的……他會整理好的。

original: I don't know about the others, but I sure am glad to see a fresh face down here.
string: 我不知道其他人怎麼樣，但是我倒是很高興能在這看到一個嶄新的面孔。

original: The Flagon used to be packed every night with the boys from the Guild but now look at it.
string: 漏壺以前每天晚上都是被公會的小夥子們塞得滿滿的，但是現在你看。

original: Last few years have been pretty bad. I've almost closed this place up.
string: 最近幾年情況很糟。我幾乎都要把這地方給關了。

original: Can you share anything about the Thieves Guild?
string: 你知道關於盜賊公會的事嗎？

original: I don't know you so we've got nothing to talk about. How about you finish the job Brynjolf gave you, then we can talk.
string: 我不認識你所以我們沒什麼好談的。你去完成布林喬夫給你的任務怎麼樣，然後我們再談。

original: Can you share anything about the Thieves Guild?
string: 你知道關於盜賊公會的事嗎？

original: Sure. How about you mind your own business about it, and I won't have to get Dirge to toss you into the cistern?
string: 好啊。你處理好你自己的事情怎麼樣？那我就不會讓「輓歌」把你扔進蓄水池裡。

original: Can you share anything about the Thieves Guild?
string: 你知道關於盜賊公會的事嗎？

original: You're not from Riften?
string: 妳不是裂谷本地人？

original: I've been adventuring across Tamriel since I was a fresh-faced young woman barely able to swing a blade.
string: 自從我還是一個稚氣未脫的小女孩，甚至很難揮舞一把劍的時候我就開始在泰姆瑞爾冒險了。

original: My travels have taken me from High Rock to Valenwood, Elsweyr to Morrowind and all points in between.
string: 我的旅程途徑高岩和威木省，艾斯維爾和晨風之間的所有地方。

original: Why is your shop down here in the canal?
string: 你的商店怎麼在這運河旁邊？

original: The moisture in the air is better for the ingredients. It isn't every day that you get your hands on fresh nirnroot or painted troll fat.
string: 空氣中的水分對原料來說是好的。不是每一天你都得去碰新鮮的奈恩根和鮮豔的巨魔脂肪的。

original: It also makes it easier to gather water when the canal is right out the front door.
string: 這也讓取水更加容易因為運河就在大門旁邊。

original: Besides, I also prefer the quiet. I didn't open this business for browsing. Come in, buy what you need and get out.
string: 而且，我偏好寧靜。我做生意不是讓人來參觀的。進來吧，買完你需要的東西然後就出去。

original: How did you come to be known as Horse-Crusher?
string: 你怎麼得到碾馬者這個稱呼的？

original: Been stuck with the name for years.
string: 這個名字困擾了我好幾年。

original: I've been ridin' horses since I was a lad... nothin' I liked more. But as I got bigger, so did my mounts.
string: 我從我還是一個男孩的時候就開始騎馬了……沒有什麼比這更好玩。當我長大後，我的馬也變大了。

original: Then one day, I was drunker than I've ever been and mounted a poor colt. Broke his back in two. Haven't ridden since.
string: 然而有一天，我喝的爛醉如泥，然後騎在一頭可憐的小馬身上。將它的背碾壓成兩段，從那以後我就再也沒有騎馬了。

original: I imagine current events are keeping you busy.
string: 我想最近的戰事讓你很忙。

original: People say I'm making gold off of other people's misery, but what else would I do? Smithing is all I know.
string: 人們說我是透過其他人的痛苦來賺錢，但是我還能做什麼呢？我就只會鍛造而已。

original: Next time one of my shields deflects a killing blow, they'll change their tune.
string: 等我做的盾擋住了一次致命的猛擊之後，他們就會改觀的。

original: I'll donate some other time.
string: 我下次再捐款。

original: As you wish. Whatever you can afford will certainly be put to good use.
string: 沒有問題。任何金額的捐款都會給予我們很大的幫助。

original: I'd like to donate. (5 gold)
string: 我想捐款。（5金幣）

original: Thank you! I can promise you that this will be put to good use.
string: 謝謝你！我能向你保證這會被用在正確的地方的。

original: Do you accept charity?
string: 你們接受捐贈嗎？

original: Of course! I'd be more than happy to add a donation to our charity box.
string: 當然！如果你為我們的募捐箱增加一些捐款會讓我非常高興的。

original: Right now, the best you could provide is coin. We need all the help we can get.
string: 現在，建議你可以捐獻一點錢。我們需要我們能獲取的一切幫助。

original: You sound quite charitable.
string: 你聽起來很仁慈。

original: Yes, I suppose someone has to be around here. Have you seen the condition of this sorry excuse for a city?
string: 是的，我想總得有人做點什麼？你看到了這座城市的掩蓋在拙劣藉口下的情況了嗎？

original: Beggars roam the streets, crime runs rampant and the threat of war is driving away business.
string: 乞丐充斥著街道，罪犯猖獗而且戰爭的威脅都在破壞這裡的經濟。

original: The paltry amount of coin that I place in the charity box at the temple is the least I can do to help.
string: 我放在神殿募捐箱裡的一些微不足道的金幣是我唯一能做的了。

original: Tell me about Maven Black-Briar.
string: 告訴我關於瑪雯．黑棘的事。

original: Lady Maven could buy or sell anyone in Skyrim. I wouldn't be surprised if she's the one pulling the strings around this city.
string: 瑪雯女士能買通或者出賣任何天際的人。我可不會覺得奇怪如果她是真正控制這座城市的人。

original: She's always welcome in Mistveil Keep and between you and me, I'm pretty sure she even has some pretty influential friends within the Empire.
string: 她在霧隱堡壘永遠是受歡迎的，而且這話只限於我們之間，我很確定她甚至在帝國裡也有一些很有影響力的朋友。

original: I'd also warn you not to cross her. She employs quite a few... troubleshooters  to take care of messy problems.
string: 我也要警告你不要讓她發脾氣。她雇傭了很多……糾紛解決者來處理棘手的問題。

original: You run the Black-Briar Meadery?
string: 你經營黑棘蜜酒莊？

original: Maven Black-Briar wants me to keep the mead flowing and that's what I aim to do despite all these lazy good-for-nothings that work for us.
string: 瑪雯．黑棘想讓蜂蜜酒源源不斷的流著，那就是我打算做的事，雖然有這些為我們工作的懶漢一無是處，只是在幫倒忙。

original: Ever since I took over as the foreman the production of our mead has never been more profitable.
string: 自從我擔任工頭後，我們的蜂蜜酒從沒這麼有利可圖過。

original: And if the meadery is profitable, I get rich. Get the picture?
string: 如果酒莊有利潤賺，我就會變的富有。懂了嗎？

original: What can you tell me about Talos?
string: 你能告訴我有關塔洛斯的事嗎？

original: He's the protector of Man, the Dragon of the North, the patron of all Nords.
string: 他是人類的保護者，北方巨龍，所有諾德人的庇護者。

original: And despite the Imperials and their treaty, he will always be one of the Nine Divines.
string: 儘管有帝國和他們的狗屁協定，但他一直都是九聖靈之一。

original: A devout Nord would rather fall in battle and have his blood spill upon the earth than allow the Empire to strike his name from the divinity.
string: 一個虔誠的諾德人即使是戰死沙場也不會放棄他的宗教信仰。

original: How's business?
string: 生意如何？

original: Not well I'm afraid. That Brynjolf... he keeps draining the people's pockets with his ridiculous miracle cures.
string: 恐怕不太好。那個布林喬夫……他一直在用他那荒謬的神蹟藥水賺人們的錢。

original: A few months ago it was troll fat salve and now he's got something new.
string: 幾個月前是巨魔脂肪藥膏，現在他又有了新東西。

original: Not that there's anything that can be done about it. He's in good with the Thieves Guild.
string: 在這種狀況下做什麼都是於事無補。他在盜賊公會混的很好。

original: I take it you protect the Jarl?
string: 我可以認為你的工作是保護領主嗎？

original: Indeed. There have been multiple attempts on the Jarl's life. We're not certain if it's the Dark Brotherhood or simply Imperial sympathizers.
string: 沒錯。目前已經發現了很多次謀害領主的計畫。我們不知道是黑暗兄弟會還是帝國的支持者搞的鬼。

original: We've also had run-ins with spies attempting to probe our security for weaknesses. I work with the city guard to make certain they fail.
string: 我們還逮捕了一些打算找出我們安全性漏洞的間諜。我和衛兵們一起瓦解了他們的計畫。

original: At the end of the day, I'm the last line of defense for the Jarl. I will not allow her to fall.
string: 即使是世界末日，我也是領主的最後防線。我不會讓她倒下的。

original: As long as she continues to keep me at her side, she can count on my blade to protect her.
string: 只要她還讓我待在她身邊，她就不用懷疑我的劍能不能保護她。

original: To be honest, I doubt someone would be stupid enough to make an attempt on Maven... sorry, Jarl Maven's life.
string: 說實話，我真不相信有人會愚蠢到企圖謀害……對不起，領主的生命。

original: But just in case, I'll be ready for them.
string: 但是以防萬一，我會為他們而有所準備的。

original: What is the White-Gold Concordat?
string: 白金協定是什麼？

original: Surely you're aware of the Great War between the Imperials and the Elves who called themselves the Aldmeri Dominion?
string: 想必你一定知道帝國和自稱先祖神洲的精靈的浩大戰爭吧？

original: When the smoke cleared, the White-Gold Concordat was signed... it was supposedly a treaty aimed at establishing peace within the Empire.
string: 當戰火消散後，簽署了白金協定……它旨在維持帝國的和平。

original: One of the terms of the treaty was the outlawing of worship to Talos.
string: 協定中的一個條目規定崇拜塔洛斯是非法的。

original: To the Stormcloaks, this was viewed as the moment when the Empire became unworthy of the allegiance of any true Nord.
string: 對風暴斗篷來說，從這一刻起就意味著帝國已經不值得諾德人效忠了。

original: What of Ulfric himself?
string: 烏弗瑞克他這個人如何呢？

original: With the Stormcloaks at his back, Ulfric's poised to rid Skyrim of the Empire's forces and invalidate our involvement with the White-Gold Concordat.
string: 有風暴斗篷當他的靠山，烏弗瑞克已經準備好抹除在天際的所有帝國力量，並且用白金協定使我們無法介入。

original: Between you and I, I think his motivations are a bit more self-serving. He uses this holy war as leverage in order to pursue the throne.
string: 這只有你我知道，我覺得他的動機有一點太過自私。他用這場聖戰作為坐上王座的手段。

original: If he were to be crowned High King, I'm not so certain it would be the golden age his followers expect.
string: 如果他被冠以至高王的王冠，恐怕將不會有他的追隨者所期望的黃金年代。

original: With the Stormcloaks at his back, Ulfric's poised to rid Skyrim of the Empire's forces and invalidate our involvement with the White-Gold Concordat.
string: 有風暴斗篷當他的靠山，烏弗瑞克已經準備好抹除在天際的所有帝國力量，並且用白金協定使我們無法介入。

original: Many have died taking up arms for this cause. I fear that the land will be stained with blood for years to come.
string: 很多人在起義爭取理想的過程中倒下了。我害怕在幾年內這片土地都將被血給染紅。

original: What's your stance on the war?
string: 你對戰爭中抱持什麼態度？

original: While I feel Ulfric's cause is just, my concern is for the people of The Rift.
string: 我是覺得烏弗瑞克的理想沒錯，但我擔憂的是裂谷的人民。

original: How can they continue to lead their already meager lives with dark clouds looming overhead?
string: 當烏雲還籠罩在頭上時，他們怎麼還能夠繼續領導那些面黃肌瘦的人民呢？

original: My heart goes out to them. If only our coffers were deeper, I could protect them as they were my own family.
string: 我的心跟隨他們。如果我們的金庫更充實些，我能像保護我自己的家人一樣保護他們。

original: You seem to be well acquainted with wealth.
string: 你看起來很瞭解財富。

original: Wealth is my business. Help me out and I can add to yours. Would you like a taste?
string: 財富是我的事業。幫幫我，我會給你好處的。有沒有興趣？

original: Maybe I should visit that farm in Morrowind.
string: 或許我應該拜訪一下那個在晨風省的農場。

original: How could you possibly know about...
string: 你怎麼可能知道……

original: Please. My family means too much to me. Don't hurt them.
string: 拜託。我的家人對我意義重大。不要傷害他們。

original: Don't say I didn't warn you. (Brawl)
string: 不要說我沒警告過你。（打架）

original: Come on, give it your best shot!
string: 來吧，盡你的全力吧！

original: I think you need to shut your mouth. (Brawl)
string: 我想你需要閉上你的嘴。（打架）

original: I'm going to make you sorry for this!
string: 我會讓你後悔的！

original: I can't thank you enough for what you did.
string: 我真是無法感謝你的所作所為。

original: The East Empire Company is in your debt.
string: 東帝國貿易公司欠你一個人情。

original: Glad Orthus was able to find someone competent to help out.
string: 很高興奧蘇斯能找到一個有用的人來幫忙。

original: You handled yourself pretty well back at Japhet's Folly. We'll remember that.
string: 你在傑非的老巢表現的很不錯。我們會記住的。

original: Do you like it out here, away from everything?
string: 妳喜歡遠離一切，待在這偏僻山野裡嗎？

original: Other people just make things complex. Out here, Hern and I can get everything we need from the occasional traveler.
string: 其他人只是讓事情更複雜。在這山野裡，赫恩和我能從偶爾路過的旅行者身上弄到我們需要的一切東西。

original: What locations does this mill supply?
string: 這個木材廠供給哪些地方？

original: We supply Falkreath to the south. Until recently we supplied Helgen.
string: 我們供給南邊的佛克瑞斯。直到最近我們供給了聖地鎮。

original: Falkreath trades with the surrounding holds and without our wood they would have trouble keeping their prices low.
string: 佛克瑞斯和附近的領地做生意，沒有我們的木頭他們會有點難保持低廉價格。

original: Do you get many guests?
string: 客人多嗎？

original: We have guests as often as we can but there aren't a lot of travellers these days. The war keeps people off the roads.
string: 客人跟平常一樣多，但是這些天旅行者變少了，因為戰爭讓人們不敢出遠門。

original: Hey! It's the bard-to-be.
string: 嘿！這是未來的吟遊詩人。

original: We will see about this...
string: 我們會知道的……

original: I'm sorry, were you about to say something?
string: 對不起，你打算說什麼？

original: Ayleid, Dwemer, Daedric... Not even Falmer. None of them are a match. Quite curious indeed.
string: 亞曆德族，鍛莫，魔族人……甚至還有伐莫族。他們都不是對手。確實很奇怪。

original: Surely there's more you can tell me.
string: 你肯定還有更多可以告訴我的。

original: There is indeed much that we know that you do not. That does not mean that you are ready to understand it.
string: 確實有許多事我們知道而你不知道。那並不意味著你已經準備好理解他們了。

original: Do not let your easy mastery of the Voice tempt you into the arrogance of power that has been the downfall of many Dragonborn before you.
string: 不要自恃能輕易掌控龍吼而產生對力量的傲慢，這就是在你之前許多龍裔滅亡的原因。

original: Thank you, Master. I will continue my training.
string: 謝謝你，大師。我將繼續我的訓練。

original: Good. Then you will be ready for whatever lies ahead.
string: 好的。那麼你將能準備好應對任何會發生的事。

original: I will try to follow the Way of the Voice.
string: 我會嘗試遵從龍吼之道的。

original: That is commendable. But remember, the Dragon Blood is itself a gift of Akatosh. Do not try to deny that gift.
string: 這是值得讚賞的。但是記住，龍血自身就是阿卡托什的恩賜。不要嘗試否認那種恩賜。

original: Your destiny requires you to use your Voice - why else would Akatosh have bestowed this power upon you?
string: 你的命運要求你使用你的龍吼——除此之外阿卡托什還會有什麼原因將這種力量賜給你？

original: If you remember to use your Voice in service to the purpose of Akatosh, you will remain true to the Way.
string: 如果你能在使用龍吼時，記住這是為阿卡托什的意圖服務，那麼你將保持在這條道路上的虔誠。

original: But I don't follow your philosophy. Why help me learn the Voice?
string: 但是我不遵從你們的宗旨，為什麼幫助我學習龍吼？

original: The Dragonborn is an exception to all the rules - the Dragon Blood itself is a gift of the gods.
string: 龍裔是所有規則的例外——龍血自身就是眾神的恩賜。

original: If we accept one gift, how can we deny the other? As Dragonborn, you have received the ability to Shout directly from Akatosh.
string: 如果我們接受了一個禮物，我們如何拒絕其它的？作為龍裔，你已被賜予了直接來自阿卡托什的龍吼。

original: We therefore seek to guide you on the proper use of your gift, which transcends the restrictions which bind other mortals.
string: 我們因此爭取引導你正確使用你的天賦，這種天賦能超越束縛在其他凡人身上的限制。

original: Who was Jurgen Windcaller?
string: 約根．喚風是誰？

original: He was a great war leader of the ancient Nords, a master of the Voice, or Tongue.
string: 他曾是古諾德人的一個偉大的戰爭領導者，是龍吼和龍語的大師，

original: After the disaster at Red Mountain, where the Nord army was annihilated, he spent many years pondering the meaning of that terrible defeat.
string: 在紅山的災難，諾德軍隊被殲滅之後，他花了許多年沉思那場可怕失敗的意義。

original: He finally came to realize that the gods had punished the Nords for their arrogant and blasphemous misuse of the Voice.
string: 他最終意識到眾神已經因為對龍吼的傲慢和褻瀆懲罰了諾德人。

original: He was the first to understand that the Voice should be used solely for the glory and worship of the gods, not the glory of men.
string: 龍吼代表對眾神的榮耀與崇拜，而不是對人，他是第一個瞭解這點的人。

original: Jurgen Windcaller's mastery of the Voice eventually overcame all opposition, and the Way of the Voice was born.
string: 約根．喚風對龍吼的掌握最終克服了所有阻礙，因此龍吼之道誕生了。

original: What did you actually say?
string: 你們到底說了什麼？

original: Ah. I sometimes forget you are not versed in the dragon tongue as we are. This is a rough translation:
string: 啊，有時候我會忘了你不像我們一樣精通龍語，這是粗略的翻譯：

original: "Long has the Stormcrown languished, with no worthy brow to sit upon."
string: 風暴王冠已經凋零很久了，很久以來， 一直沒有值得佩戴它的人出現。

original: "By our breath we bestow it now to you in the name of Kyne, in the name of Shor, and in the name of Atmora of Old."
string: 以凱娜、朔爾、先古阿特莫拉大陸的名義借由氣息我們把它贈與你。

original: "You are Ysmir now, the Dragon of the North, hearken to it."
string: 你現在是伊斯米爾了，北方巨龍，傾聽吧。

original: What was that ceremony all about? Were you Shouting at me?
string: 那個儀式是什麼意思？你們在對我吼叫嗎？

original: We spoke the traditional words of greeting to a Dragonborn who has accepted our guidance.
string: 我們對接受了我們引導的龍裔使用傳統的歡迎語言。

original: The same words were used to greet the young Talos, when he came to High Hrothgar, before he became the Emperor Tiber Septim.
string: 相同的話曾被用來歡迎年輕的塔洛斯，在他成為皇帝泰伯．塞普汀之前，來到高吼峰的時候。

original: Goodbye, my love.
string: 再見，我的寶貝。

original: Bye, love.
string: 再見，寶貝。

original: Conquer your enemies, my love.
string: 征服你的敵人，我的寶貝。

original: I'll be here if you need me, love.
string: 如果你需要我我會在這的，寶貝。

original: You're going? I'll miss you, dear.
string: 你要走了？我會想你的，親愛的。

original: Leaving? Take the world by storm, dearest.
string: 離開？要名震四海哦，親愛的。

original: I'll be here, my dear.
string: 我都會在這裡，親愛的。

original: Living with you would be perfect.
string: 和你一起生活將會很完美。

original: We could live in my house in Whiterun.
string: 我們可以住在我在白漫的房子裡。

original: I have a house in Riften.
string: 我在裂谷城有棟房子。

original: My house in Markarth would be perfect.
string: 我在馬卡斯城的房子將會很完美。

original: How about my house in Windhelm?
string: 我在風舵城的房子怎麼樣？

original: Let's live in my house in Solitude.
string: 讓我們住在我在獨孤城的房子裡吧。

original: Your old place would suit us just fine.
string: 你的老地方會很適合我們的。

original: Breezehome, my house in Whiterun.
string: 微風閣，我在白漫的房子。

original: Honeyside, my house in Riften.
string: 甜蜜灣，我在裂谷城的房子。

original: Vlindrel Hall, my house in Markarth.
string: 林德爾會堂，我在馬卡斯城的房子。

original: Hjerim, my house in Windhelm.
string: 霜齋，我在風舵城的房子。

original: I'll get everything ready and meet you there.
string: 我會把一切準備好並在那和你碰面。

original: I'll meet you there.
string: 我們在那裡再見。

original: I'll see you there, then.
string: 那麼我們在那見。

original: Very well. I'll meet you there.
string: 很好。我們在那見。

original: All right. I'll see you there.
string: 好吧。我們在那見。

original: If that's what you want. I'll see you there, soon.
string: 如果那是你想要的。我們就在那見吧，我很快就會到的。

original: I'll see you there.
string: 我們在那見！

original: Our new home. I'll see you there!
string: 我們的新家。我們在那見！

original: Then I'll see you at home!
string: 那麼我們回家見！

original: A home for the two of us. I'll meet you there.
string: 一個我們倆的家。我們在那見。

original: It will be our little nest. I'll be waiting for you there.
string: 那將是我們的小安樂窩。我會在那等你的。

original: The two of us, living together. I'll see you at home!
string: 我們兩個，生活在一起。我回家等你！

original: I'll see you at home, then. Don't keep me waiting!
string: 那麼我會在家裡等你。不要讓我一直等！

original: I'll be waiting for you at home, then.
string: 那麼我會在家裡等你。

original: Proudspire Manor, my house in Solitude.
string: 豪塔別墅，我在獨孤城的家。

original: I'd like us to move somewhere else.
string: 我想我們得去別的什麼地方。

original: Oh? Where?
string: 哦？哪裡？

original: Where are you thinking?
string: 你想去哪？

original: Where?
string: 哪？

original: You want to move? Where?
string: 你想去別的地方？哪？

original: I was just getting settled in. Where are we going?
string: 我剛剛安頓下來。我們要去哪？

original: Oh really? And where were you thinking?
string: 噢真的嗎？你想去哪？

original: And where would that be?
string: 是哪裡？

original: Who runs the show at Honningbrew Meadery?
string: 是誰在負責蜜之釀酒莊？

original: Some layabout named Sabjorn.
string: 一個叫作撒布喬恩的無所事事的人。

original: Been a thorn in my side for the last few years now.
string: 最近幾年都是我腰上的一根刺。

original: You might want to rethink that. You're missing out on some wonderful opportunities, working in that bar.
string: 你可能會想重新考慮的。在那間酒吧裡工作，你會錯過一些大好機會的。

original: I'm not interested, Jaree. It doesn't matter how many times you ask.
string: 我不感興趣，加雷。不管你問多少次。

original: Degaine the beggar got himself kicked out the Temple of Dibella. Caused quite the ruckus.
string: 乞丐德加因讓他自己被趕出了蒂貝拉神殿。造成了很大的騷動。

original: I'm looking for work.
string: 我在找工作。

original: Skjor was looking for you, earlier.
string: 剛才，斯科約爾在找你。

original: I'm looking for the Staff of Magnus.
string: 我在找瑪格努斯之杖。

original: Are you?
string: 是嗎？

original: Well. I'm afraid I can't help you with that. I need the crystal to do anything useful, and I don't have it.
string: 嗯。恐怕我不能幫你。我需要水晶才能作一些重要的事，但是我手上沒有。

original: *Sigh*... and that's the last one. All right, enough of this.
string: 哎……那是最後一個了。好了，夠了。

original: C'mon, let's get something to eat.
string: 來吧，讓我們吃點什麼？

original: Would you mind cooking something for me?
string: 你介意幫我煮點吃的嗎？

original: Here, this is fresh. I'll have another meal ready tomorrow.
string: 拿去，這是新鮮的。明天我會再準備一餐的。

original: Here. Wouldn't want you going into a fight on an empty stomach. I'll have another meal ready tomorrow.
string: 拿去，我可不想讓你空著肚子去打仗。明天我會再準備一餐的。

original: A warrior marches on the gut. Here. This should give you strength. I'll cook another tomorrow.
string: 一個戰士因勇氣而前行。拿去，這能給你力量。我明天會再做一個。

original: Here. This is from a recipe my people have passed on to me. I can cook another tomorrow.
string: 拿去，這是根據流傳在我們那裡的食譜做出來的。我明天可以再做一個。

original: Here you are. I added a little mead into the recipe. I think it tastes better. Let me know what you think tomorrow, I'll make another one.
string: 給你。我在食譜中加了點蜂蜜酒。我想它嚐起來會更美味。明天讓我知道你的感想，我會再做一次的。

original: I should be asking you the same question, but all right. I'll cook. Here, try this, and don't you dare ask for another one before tomorrow.
string: 我應該問你同樣的問題，但是沒關係。我會做的。來，試試這個，然後你在明天前不准再吃這個了。

original: I can. Here. This is fresh. I'll have another one made tomorrow.
string: 可以啊。拿去，剛做好的。我明天會為你再做一個。

original: I have the Elder Scroll.
string: 我拿到上古卷軸了。

original: You have it. The Kel - the Elder Scroll. Tiid kreh... qalos. Time shudders at its touch.
string: 你拿到它了，克爾——上古卷軸。提德 克雷……伽羅斯。時間在它的觸摸下也會顫抖。

original: There is no question. You are doom-driven. Kogaan Akatosh. The very bones of the earth are at your disposal.
string: 毫無疑問。你是毀滅驅策者。克甘．阿卡托什。大地之骨任你處置。

original: Go then. Fulfill your destiny. Take the Scroll to the Time-Wound.
string: 那麼走吧。完成你的使命。將卷軸帶去時間傷痕。

original: Do not delay. Alduin will be coming. He cannot miss the signs.
string: 不要遲疑。奧杜因會過來的。牠不可能錯過徵兆。

original: Do not delay. Alduin must feel the tremors in Time by the Scroll's presence here. He will know what it means.
string: 不要遲疑。奧杜因透過時間的震動肯定知道卷軸出現在這裡。牠會知道這意味著什麼的。

original: Use Dragonrend! It is the only chance to defeat him!
string: 用龍魂撕裂！這是打敗他的唯一機會！

original: He is too strong on the wing! Bring him to gol with Dragonrend!
string: 他的翅膀太強壯了！用龍魂撕裂將牠逼下來！

original: Use Dragonrend, Dovahkiin!
string: 使用龍魂撕裂，都瓦克因！

original: Dovahkiin, vosaraan! Use Dragonrend before Alduin consumes you!
string: 都瓦克因，沃薩蘭！在奧杜因吞噬你之前使用龍魂撕裂！

original: Now, Dovahkiin! Now he is vulnerable!
string: 現在，都瓦克因！現在牠很脆弱！

original: This is your chance, Dovahkiin! Strike with all your force!
string: 這是你的機會，都瓦克因！用盡全力進攻！

original: Hurt him while he is grounded!
string: 當他落下時全力攻擊牠！

original: Use Dragonrend! It is the only chance to defeat him!
string: 用龍魂撕裂！這是打敗牠的唯一機會！

original: He is too strong on the wing! Bring him to gol with Dragonrend!
string: 牠的翅膀太強壯了！用龍魂撕裂將牠逼下來！

original: Use Dragonrend, Dovahkiin!
string: 使用龍魂撕裂，都瓦克因！

original: Dovahkiin, vosaraan! Use Dragonrend before Alduin consumes you!
string: 都瓦克因，沃薩蘭！在奧杜因吞噬你之前使用龍魂撕裂！

original: Ruth wah nivahriin joor!
string: 如斯、破甘、那拉斯、沃瑞、瓦迥！

original: Aav uv dir. Join me or perish with your mortal friends.
string: 奧 烏 德爾。加入我，否則就和你的凡人朋友們一起死。

original: Someday I'm going to kill a dragon all by myself.
string: 有一天我將親自殺死一頭龍。

original: I'm eleven years old, and I could take you.
string: 我十一歲了，我可不怕你。

original: Kynesgrove is this way. We can travel together or split up and meet there, your choice.
string: 凱娜之林是這條路。我們可以一起去，或者分頭行動然後在那碰面，你說了算。

original: That's better. Let's get on the road to Kynesgrove.
string: 舒服多了，讓我們啟程去凱娜之林吧。

original: What of it?
string: 怎麼了？

original: I think you're looking for this.
string: 我想你在找這個。

original: We need to talk.
string: 我們得談談。

original: When he shows up here and vouches for you, then I'll see what I can do for you.
string: 當他在這露面並且為你作證，而我將看看我能為你做什麼？

original: Closest town from here is Riverwood. My uncle's the blacksmith there. I'm sure he'd help you out.
string: 離這最近的城鎮是河木鎮。我叔叔是那的鐵匠。他肯定會樂意幫你的。

original: It's probably best if we split up. Good luck. I wouldn't have made it without your help today.
string: 我們最好還是分頭行動吧。祝好運。沒有你，我是不可能逃出來的。

original: Listen, you should go to Solitude and join up with the Imperial Legion. We could really use someone like you.
string: 聽著，你應該去獨孤城並且加入帝國軍團。我們肯定可以用得上你這樣的人。

original: And if the rebels have themselves a dragon, General Tullius is the only one who can stop them.
string: 如果反叛軍有一頭龍，圖留斯將軍是唯一能阻止他們的人。

original: Place the crystal in the central apparatus, and we can start the process for focusing it.
string: 將水晶放在儀器中間，然後我們可以開始調焦的過程了。

original: Took an incredible amount of work to get it running again. Now I'm hoping it'll all be worth it.
string: 我們花費了很多功夫來讓它重新運作。現在我希望它值得我們這樣做。

original: Here it is. Magnificent, isn't it?
string: 在這裡。很壯觀，不是嗎？

original: No one seems to know. Perhaps the return of the Dwemer. Perhaps the end of the world.
string: 沒人知道。或許是鍛莫的回歸。或許是世界末日。

original: Waiting for what?
string: 等什麼？

original: I'd like to decorate my home.
string: 我想裝修一下我的家。

original: I'd like to decorate my home.
string: 我想裝修一下我的家。

original: I'll be glad to help you. There are many ways to improve your home, provided you have the coin.
string: 我很樂意幫助你。有很多方法可以裝飾你的家，只要你有錢的話。

original: And of course, don't forget to consult your Home Decorating Guide for descriptions of the decorations you can buy.
string: 當然，不要忘了查詢居家裝修指南，看看你能購買的裝飾品資訊。

original: Now, what would you like to purchase?
string: 現在，你想購買什麼？

original: I'd like to decorate my home.
string: 我想裝修一下我的家。

original: You've already purchased every available improvement. I'm afraid I have nothing else to offer you.
string: 你已經購買了所有可裝飾的傢具。恐怕我沒有其他東西可以給你了。

original: I'd like to decorate my home.
string: 我想裝修一下我的家。

original: Splendid! There's a house available right now.
string: 棒極了！現在就有一棟房子正在出售。

original: The house I mentioned earlier is still available, if you want to buy it.
string: 如果你想買的話，我之前說過的房子還在出售。

original: I'd like to purchase a house in the city. (10,000 gold)
string: 我想在城裡買一棟房子。（10000金幣）

original: Wonderful! Here is the key to your new home.
string: 太好了！這是你新家的鑰匙。

original: Very well, just let me know when you're ready to purchase the house.
string: 非常好，你準備好置購房子了就告訴我。

original: Very well, just let me know when you have the necessary funds.
string: 非常好，當你有足夠的資金的時候告訴我。

original: Is there anything else you'd like to purchase?
string: 你還想買什麼東西嗎？

original: As you wish. Speak to me again if you decide to purchase some decorations for your home.
string: 如你所願。如果你決定為你的家買一些裝飾品就再和我談談。

original: Never mind, I don't want to purchase decorations right now.
string: 沒關係，我現在不想購買裝飾品。

original: I'm sorry, but you don't seem to have enough gold to pay for that.
string: 對不起，但是你好像沒有足夠的錢購買這個。

original: Floor decorations. (400 gold)
string: 地板裝飾。（400金幣）
