string: 例如像是酒？我不要本地這些兌了水的，我要裂谷城產的黑棘蜜酒。

original: You're the Jarl? I'm looking for work.
string: 你是領主？我需要工作。

original: Before my ma and da passed, I told them that one day, I'd become the best trader in Skyrim.
string: 我爸媽在世時，我就跟他們說，有朝一日我一定會成為全天際最偉大的商人。

original: I met one of the caravan leaders, Ma'dran. He said he'd help get me started if I could bring him a mammoth's tusk. Easier said than done.
string: 後來我遇見一個商隊老闆，名叫馬德蘭。他說如果我能給他搞來一隻長毛象的長牙，就帶我入行。他說得倒輕鬆。

original: You're looking to become a merchant?
string: 你想當商人？

original: I picked up the trade when I was a girl. One of the temple healers staying here on a pilgrimage showed me the basics.
string: 我還是小姑娘時就開始研究這些了。有位來朝聖的神殿治療者教了我一些基礎知識。

original: She had a book with her, "Song of the Alchemists," that I used to read over and over. I miss having a copy.
string: 她有本書，叫做《鍊金術士之歌》，我讀了很多遍。可惜我手頭沒有抄本。

original: How long have you studied alchemy?
string: 你學習鍊金術多久了？

original: That I am. Train the recruits. Turn boys into men. That sort of thing.
string: 是啊。我訓練新兵，把他們培養成真正的男人。就這些。

original: Thinking of asking the General for some training books. Give the soldiers something to do while they're on rest. Something besides drinking.
string: 我在想是不是該找將軍要份訓練手冊來，這樣士兵們休息的時候也有點事做，不至於整天酗酒。

original: Ever seen a book called "The Mirror"? We used to hand it out to boys looking to learn basic shield work.
string: 你有見過一本名叫《鏡》的書嗎？我們曾經拿它來教這群小子們持盾的基本技巧。

original: Are you with the Legion?
string: 你是軍團的人？

original: Our little girl died recently. I've been shouldering my days with strong mead, but nothing gives my Tova peace.
string: 我們的小女兒最近死了。我每天都借酒澆愁，可是卻沒有任何事物可以安慰我的托娃。

original: I've been looking for an Amulet of Arkay to remind my wife that our child is with the gods now, but I can't find one.
string: 我想找個阿爾凱護符來，好提醒我的妻子，我們的孩子已經歸於眾神了，可是我找不到。

original: Your wife is in mourning?
string: 你妻子似乎心情不大好？

original: Tell me now or I'll kill you where you stand!
string: 告訴我，不然我馬上就殺了你！

original: No, please! There's no need for that! I'll tell you everything.
string: 不，別！別這樣！我什麼都告訴你。

original: It's Karliah... her name is Karliah.
string: 是卡莉亞……她的名字是卡莉亞。

original: He's going to owe us for this betrayal.
string: 他會為背叛我們付出代價。

original: Aye, he does indeed... and with his fingers in the East Empire Company's pie, we'll make good use of that debt.
string: 贊同，他確實做到了……因為他在東帝國貿易公司內有內線，我們要好好利用這一資源。

original: If I'm not being clear enough, that means we don't want him killed.
string: 如果你覺得我說的還不夠明白，那我明講了吧，我們不希望他死。

original: For now, just keep on his tail and he's bound to step into something he can't scrape off his boot.
string: 現在只要繼續跟著他就行，他註定會踩上髒東西的，到時候他想甩也甩不掉了。

original: I don't need to prove anything to you. I'm done here.
string: 我不需要向你證明什麼。再會了。

original: I know that mound - high on the hill east of Kynesgrove.
string: 我知道那個龍塚——就在凱娜之林東邊的山上。

original: Why didn't you say so earlier? At least now we don't have to waste time searching the area.
string: 你怎麼不早說？至少我們不必再費心去搜索整片地區了。

original: We should get moving. There's no time to waste.
string: 我們出發吧，別再浪費時間了。

original: Hold on. I'm not ready to go yet.
string: 等等，我還沒準備好。

original: I can't wait around for you to make up your mind. I'll meet you at Kynesgrove. Don't waste time getting there.
string: 我沒時間再跟你婆婆媽媽了。我們凱娜之林見吧。路上別耽擱太久。

original: Let's go kill a dragon.
string: 我們去殺一頭龍吧。

original: I need to get into my traveling gear. Give me a minute and I'll be ready.
string: 我得先著裝。等我一會兒，馬上就好。

original: I know that mound - high on the hill east of Kynesgrove.
string: 我知道那個龍塚——就在凱娜之林東邊的山上。

original: Good. Good. Now we won't have to spend time searching for it.
string: 好，好。這樣我們就不必花時間去找了。

original: We should get moving. There's no time to waste.
string: 我們出發吧，別再浪費時間了。

original: The Greybeards are right. I am Dragonborn.
string: 灰鬍子說的對，我是龍裔。

original: I hope so. But you'll forgive me if I don't assume that something's true just because the Greybeards say so.
string: 但願如此。不過你可得原諒我，灰鬍子說的話我不會全當真。

original: I just handed you the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller. Does that make me Dragonborn, too?
string: 剛才是我把約根．喚風的號角交給你的，那是不是意味著我也是龍裔了呢？

original: Take that thing down!
string: 把那個打下來！

original: We've got to bring it down!
string: 把那個打下來！

original: Don't let it get too close!
string: 別讓那東西靠近！

original: We've got to ground that bastard!
string: 我們得讓那個混蛋落下來！

original: Come on! This is our best chance!
string: 來啊！現在正是好機會！

original: Attack while it's landed!
string: 對方一降落就攻擊！

original: Now it's my turn, you son of a bitch.
string: 該我出招了，你這狗娘養的。

original: For the Blades!
string: 為了刀鋒衛士！

original: I am Sahloknir! Hear my Voice and despair!
string: 我是撒洛克尼爾！聆聽我的怒吼，消失吧！

original: It's to be a real fight, then. Good!
string: 認真了嗎。好呀！

original: My lord Alduin requires your death. I am glad to oblige him.
string: 我的主人奧杜因想取你的性命。我願聽從他的旨意。

original: I see that mortals have become arrogant while I slept.
string: 看來我沉睡的這段時間裡，凡人已經越來越放肆了。

original: My Voice has been silent for too long!
string: 我的怒吼已經沉寂太久了！

original: Hiding will not save you!
string: 想要躲是沒用的！

original: Dohaviin, your Voice is no match for mine!
string: 龍裔，你的龍吼敵不過我！

original: Your Voice is strong... for a mortal.
string: 你的龍吼很強大……可惜你終究只是個凡人。

original: Come and face me, then!
string: 來與我決一死戰吧！

original: I do not fear you, Dovahkiin!
string: 我並不畏懼你，都瓦克因！

original: Go. Tell your commanders you have won. I, my family, and my men will be gone before they arrive.
string: 去吧。告訴你的指揮官，你贏了。我和我的家人，還有我的人會在他們到來之前離開的。

original: There is no point in further talk. Go now!
string: 多說無益。走吧！

original: We surrender. The capital is yours. If you pledge no harm will come of my people, I turn over the seat of power to you.
string: 我們投降。首都是你的了。只要你願意放過城中百姓，我願意將王位讓與你。

original: It's over. No more violence.
string: 都結束了。別再打了。

original: Sir...
string: 掌管……

original: Enough! Stop!
string: 夠了！停下！

original: Cease fighting. It's over.
string: 停火。都結束了。

original: (Sharedinfo)
string: (Sharedinfo)

original: Well, let me know if you ever want to practice.
string: 好吧，你想練習的話就告訴我一聲。

original: You chose the wrong girl to mess with.
string: 你惹錯姑娘了。

original: Nice shot! Right on target.
string: 射得好！正中靶心。

original: Now hit it again.
string: 再來一次吧。

original: Let me know if you want to practice some more. Next time we'll make it a little more challenging.
string: 還想練習就來找我。下一次難度會更有挑戰性。

original: You need to stay inside the boundaries.
string: 你得站在邊線以內。

original: Only use the practice arrows.
string: 只能用練習箭。

original: Stay within the boundaries and only use the practice arrows.
string: 站在邊線裡，使用練習箭。

original: Shoot the right target.
string: 射擊右邊的靶子。

original: Shoot the left target.
string: 射擊左邊的靶子。

original: Shoot the middle target.
string: 射擊中間的靶子。

original: Two Imperial drunks who thought they were above the law.
string: 兩個喝醉了，自以為凌駕於法律之上的帝國人。

original: Don't be like them. Don't feel sorry for me.
string: 別跟他們一樣，沒什麼好抱歉的。

original: Nice job hitting those targets.
string: 射得好。

original: Excellent. Follow me to the targets and we'll begin.
string: 很好，跟我去靶場，我們開始練習。

original: One, two, three...
string: 一，二，三……

original: Go!
string: 開始！

original: Time's up! Better luck next time.
string: 時間到！下次再說吧。

original: Here, take these. Looks like you're running low.
string: 拿著。你的好像不夠了。

original: Listen to me and you might learn something.
string: 好好聽我說，你會受益匪淺的。

original: Sure.
string: 當然。

original: Let's see if I can teach you a few things about using a bow.
string: 讓我來教你一些用弓的常識吧。

original: Remember, composure and speed. You don't need to see your arrow hit before moving onto your next target. Trust your shot is true.
string: 記住，要沉著，果斷。不必等你的箭擊中目標了才去想第二箭。要相信你的箭術。

original: Take care, stranger. Be careful out there.
string: 小心，陌生人。在外要多保重。

original: Shoot the far target.
string: 射擊遠處的靶子。

original: It was nice to spend time with someone who enjoys archery as much as I do.
string: 能跟一個同樣喜歡射箭的傢伙在一起可真叫我開心。

original: Lost, stranger?
string: 迷路了嗎，陌生人？

original: Looking to practice, stranger?
string: 想要練習嗎，陌生人？

original: Try and hit the middle target.
string: 試著射中中間的靶子。

original: Ready to practice some more?
string: 想再多練習幾次嗎？

original: Let me know if you want to try again.
string: 如果你還想再試一次，就告訴我。

original: Try and hit the left target.
string: 試著射中左邊的靶子。

original: Try and hit the right target.
string: 試著射中右邊的靶子。

original: Great job hitting those targets. You definitely surprised me with your speed and composure.
string: 真是百步穿楊。你的沉著和果斷令我訝異。

original: It's not often I get visitors out here. You lost, stranger?
string: 很少有人來拜訪我。你是迷路了嗎，陌生人？

original: Try and hit the far target.
string: 試著射中遠處的靶子。

original: You're a mercenary?
string: 你是傭兵嗎？

original: I am an artisan, painting in strokes of blood red upon the canvas of life. But yes, I will take coin to fight at your side.
string: 我是個工匠，在生命的畫布上用鮮血繪製我的傑作。不過，你要是肯出錢，我願意替你出力。

original: After all, where is the value in creating art if there is nobody left alive to see it?
string: 畢竟，沒有活人欣賞的藝術又有何價值呢？

original: Why'd the Companions reject you?
string: 為什麼戰友團拒妳於門外？

original: It wasn't my fault! I told them over and over that it was an accident!
string: 那不是我的錯！我跟他們說過無數次了，那是個意外！

original: They wanted me to prove my worth, so they threw me up against a young whelp of a lad, hardly old enough to grow his first chin-hairs.
string: 他們要我證明自己的價值，就讓我和一個毛頭小子決鬥，那小子可能連下巴的鬍子都沒長齊。

original: I guess they thought a woman wasn't strong enough to hurt him. I didn't mean for him to die! Why would I want that? I just... lost control.
string: 我猜他們是覺得一個女人根本不可能傷得了他。我不是故意要殺了他啊！我怎麼可能那樣想呢？我只是……一時失控罷了。

original: Sounds like you've got a grudge.
string: 看來有人對你很不滿。

original: You been talking to those Companions?
string: 你和戰友團那群人談過了？

original: "Too hot-headed," they cried. Weak, pathetic cowards, the lot of them!
string: 他們說我太衝動了。真是一群可憐又軟弱的懦夫！

original: You must really love to fight.
string: 你一定很喜歡戰鬥。

original: The heat of battle is the fire that forges the strongest blades. It's an old Nord proverb.
string: 史上最鋒利的劍刃正是用戰鬥中的怒火鑄造而成。這可是一句諾德古諺。

original: That, and a true Nord never misses a chance to test her worth.
string: 一位真正的諾德人，是絕不會放棄任何可以證明自己的機會的。

original: What do you know of the Khajiit?
string: 你對虎人瞭解多少？

original: About the same as everyone else. They're the cat-folk of Elsweyr. Great warriors, good traders.
string: 和別人差不多吧。艾斯維爾來的貓族嘛。優秀的戰士，也是精明的商人。

original: Way I hear it, Elsweyr ain't nothing like Skyrim. It's got tropical forests and dusty badlands. It sounds awful!
string: 我聽說艾斯維爾和天際省完全不同。那裡居然有熱帶叢林，還有一望無際的荒野。太可怕了！

original: You mentioned trading caravans?
string: 你剛才說商隊？

original: Yeah, these Khajiit make a living traveling the roads and selling their wares.
string: 是啊，那些虎人四海漂泊，就靠沿路兜售他們的貨物維生。

original: It's got to be tough. Skyrim's a hard enough land when you've got a roof over your head.
string: 那一定很辛苦。要知道，就算勉強有個遮風蔽雨的地方，天際省的環境還是很惡劣的。

original: Worst thing is, nobody wants them in the cities. Nobody trusts them.
string: 最糟糕的是，大家都不想讓虎人進城。沒人相信他們。

original: What can you tell me about Whiterun?
string: 關於白漫，你有什麼可以告訴我的？

original: Hmph. Plenty.
string: 嗯。很多。

original: I'd say we're prosperous enough. Most folk don't go hungry, if they're willing to work hard.
string: 我們這裡的生活很富足。只要肯努力工作，大多數人是不會餓肚子的。

original: The city's ruled by the Jarl up in Dragonsreach. That's the fortress, there, up on the tall hill.
string: 城市的統治者是領主，住在龍臨堡裡。就是那個地方，瞧，山上那座要塞便是。

original: But you're probably more interested in Jorrvaskr, mead hall of the Companions. Their deeds of war and valor are... legendary.
string: 不過你也許會對勇士之家更感興趣，那裡是戰友團的蜜酒之廳。他們是一群充滿傳奇色彩的勇士，個個功勳卓絕，英勇無畏。

original: Arise! Arise and defend us!
string: 來吧！來保衛我們！

original: Porch. (<Global=HDRiftenPorch> gold)
string: 門廊。（<Global=HDRiftenPorch>金幣）

original: Garden. (<Global=HDRiftenGarden> gold)
string: 花園。（<Global=HDRiftenGarden>金幣）

original: (sigh)
string: （嘆氣）

original: No. Not really.
string: 不，不是的。

original: This isn't over. I catch you sending one letter to General Tullius, I'll have you both executed.
string: 還沒完呢！要是我抓到你送信給圖留斯將軍，我會把你倆統統處決。

original: You mentioned the Great War.
string: 你剛剛提到了浩大戰爭的事情。

original: About 30 years ago, the Aldmeri Dominion invaded the Empire. It was a surprise attack, caught everyone off guard.
string: 三十年前，先祖神洲入侵了帝國。那是一場突襲，所有人都措手不及。

original: They ended up sacking the Imperial City. I was there, blasting apart young Elven men and women with Fireballs and Lightning Bolts.
string: 最後，他們攻陷了帝都。當時我也在那裡，朝著那些年輕的精靈男女們施展火球和閃電箭，把他們一個個擊斃。

original: By Akatosh, all the blood. The smell of flesh burned and pulled apart by magic. I never want to do that to another soul ever again.
string: 阿卡托什啊，那可真是血流成河。空氣中彌漫著皮肉被魔法燒焦和撕爛的氣味。我不想要再做那種事了。

original: Another time, maybe.
string: 下次再說吧。

original: Very well then.
string: 很好。

original: I'll do it.
string: 我做。

original: Thanks.
string: 謝謝。

original: You cannot prevail against me. I will outlast you... mortal!
string: 你贏不了我的。我會活到最後……凡人！

original: I knew it... Mercer sent you to kill me! Guards, there's an intruder!
string: 我就知道……是墨瑟派你來殺我的！衛兵！入侵者！

original: In honor of your service in battle, I am hereby granting you permission to purchase property in Whiterun. Talk to my steward if you're interested.
string: 為了表彰你的卓越貢獻，我特此授予你白漫城內的居住權。如果你感興趣，可以去找我的總管。

original: In honor of your service in battle, I am hereby granting you permission to purchase property in Markarth. Talk to my steward if you're interested.
string: 為了表彰你的卓越貢獻，我特此授予你馬卡斯城內的居住權。如果你感興趣，可以去找我的總管。

original: In honor of your service in battle, I am hereby granting you permission to purchase property in Riften. Talk to my steward if you're interested.
string: 為了表彰你的卓越貢獻，我特此授予你裂谷城內的居住權。如果你感興趣，可以去找我的總管。

original: In honor of your service in battle, I am hereby granting you permission to purchase property in Windhelm. Talk to my steward if you're interested.
string: 為了表彰你的卓越貢獻，我特此授予你風舵城內的居住權。如果你感興趣，可以去找我的總管。

original: Just... leave here! Leave us alone!
string: 離……離開這裡！離我們遠點！

original: Begone from here! Get out of this orphanage! Help!Somebody help me!
string: 走開！滾出孤兒院！天哪！有人救救我們嗎？

original: Oh, thank Arkay. Please, take this gold for your troubles.
string: 哦，感謝阿爾凱。請你收下這些錢吧。

original: I found your amulet.
string: 我找到了你的護身符。

original: Well, would you look at that! Argonian Ale! My thanks, friend. Here, take this here healing potion. I, er, "found" it in the temple.
string: 哦，瞧啊！亞龍人麥芽酒！謝謝你，朋友。來，收下這瓶治療藥水。這是我在神殿裡……呃……「找到」的。

original: Here's that special ale you wanted.
string: 這就是你要的特殊麥酒了。

original: A bit of jewelry for your journey home?
string: 要不要賞你點珠寶好做回家的盤纏？

original: The dragon at <Alias=BountyLocation> is dead. I'm here for the bounty.
string: <Alias=BountyLocation>的巨龍已經死了。我是來拿賞金的。

original: I'm looking for work. Got any leads?
string: 我是來找工作的。有什麼可以介紹的嗎？

original: The Jarl has put out a bounty on the dragon that's been terrorizing the countryside. Here, take a look at this decree for details.
string: 領主正在懸賞捕殺滋擾鄉鄰的巨龍。來，這張紙上寫得更詳細。

original: The Battle-Borns?
string: 戰狂？

original: Don't even get me started on that lot.
string: 別跟我提起那個詞。

original: They put on airs like they're somethin' special. Sure, they've got money, but they ain't got a shred of honor between 'em.
string: 他們整天趾高氣昂，好像自己有多威風似的。是啊，他們是有錢，可一個個都寡廉鮮恥，毫無榮譽感。

original: Gray-Mane. Now that's a name fills you with pride. We've got roots in Whiterun. We've got history.
string: 灰鬃。這才是讓你感到自豪的名字。我們在白漫可謂是根基深厚，歷史悠久。

original: Where's Jorrvaskr?
string: 勇士之家在哪？

original: Head up the steps from the market an' look to your right. Can't miss it.
string: 從市場沿著樓梯往上走，然後右轉。很好找。

original: Do you trust them?
string: 妳相信他們嗎？

original: Matter of fact, I do. They've been fair enough with me, far as I can tell.
string: 當然了。至少在我看來，他們還挺討人喜歡的。

original: And a Nord knows a liar when she sees one.
string: 諾德人一眼就能看出誰在撒謊。

original: Why not?
string: 為什麼不呢？

original: Reputation, mostly. A lot of Khajiit turn to smuggling and thievery to get by.
string: 多半是因為名聲不佳吧。不少虎人都幹過走私和偷竊的勾當。

original: A few bad apples spoil the bunch. You know how it is.
string: 結果就是一粒屎攪臭了一鍋湯。這道理你肯定清楚。

original: Thanks for sticking around and keeping me company.
string: 謝謝你能願意和我作伴。

original: It was nice to finally meet someone out here who doesn't want to rob you or take off your head.
string: 終於能碰上不是來搶劫或是取我首級的傢伙，真是太好了。

original: I know it isn't much, but here, take this bow. It was given to me by my family. It's special to me, but brings back too many painful memories.
string: 收下這把弓吧，我知道這點薄禮不算什麼？但這是我家祖傳下來的，對我而言無比珍貴，可它實在蘊藏了太多不堪回首的往事。

original: Looks like you're no longer needed. Time to die.
string: 看起來我不再需要你了。去死吧。

original: Very funny.
string: 這麼問很有意思是吧？

original: Maybe I can teach you thing or two about using a bow.
string: 也許我可以教你一些關於使弓的知識。

original: It was my pleasure. It's not often I get visitors out here. Let alone friendly ones.
string: 這是我的榮幸。本來我這裡也沒多少人來，更別提朋友了。

original: Thanks for helping me out.
string: 謝謝你的幫助。

original: I think I've taught you everything I know. You might even be as good as me now.
string: 我想我已經把知道的都教給你了。你現在甚至比我還要強了。

original: Kind of scary if I think about it.
string: 想想看還真是恐怖啊。

original: I'm ready for some more practice.
string: 我想繼續練習。

original: Shoot the middle target.
string: 射擊中間的靶子。

original: Shoot the right target.
string: 射擊右邊的靶子。

original: Shoot the left target.
string: 射擊左邊的靶子。

original: Great shot. Now hit the target to the right.
string: 射得好。現在瞄準右邊的靶子。

original: Here, take these. Looks like you're running low.
string: 拿著。你的好像不夠了。

original: I want to try again.
string: 我想要再試一次。

original: You did it! All three targets in eight seconds. Nice job.
string: 棒極了！八秒內射中三個靶子。真漂亮。

original: I'll count to three and then say "go." You have eight seconds to hit each of the three targets. Draw string and get ready.
string: 我數到三，然後我喊「開始」。你有八秒鐘時間擊中所有的靶子。準備拉弓上弦吧。

original: When I tell you to, try and hit each of the three closest targets in eight seconds.
string: 我喊開始後，你要儘量在八秒內射中附近的三個靶子。

original: If you can learn to keep your composure and trust that each shot is true, then you should be able to quickly handle multiple targets.
string: 如果你真的夠沉著，對自己的箭術充滿信心，你就應該一次對付多個目標。

original: So whenever we came across more than one deer in a single location, it was imperative we kill as many as we could.
string: 萬一我們發現某個地方同時聚集著好多鹿，我們就得在短時間內把它們統統殺掉。

original: At the time, it was difficult to keep food on the table, let alone have enough left over to sell at the market.
string: 現在連我們餐桌上吃的都成問題了，更別說拿到市場上去賣了。

original: My older brother took me out hunting a lot when I was little.
string: 小時候哥哥經常帶我出去打獵。

original: I'm ready for some more practice.
string: 我想繼續練習。

original: Now hit the target to the left.
string: 射擊左邊的靶子。

original: It's easy - stay inside the boundaries and only use the practice arrows.
string: 很簡單——站在線內，只準用練習用箭。

original: What are the rules again?
string: 規則是什麼？

original: Here you go.
string: 給你。

original: I need some practice arrows.
string: 我需要一些練習用箭。

original: OK, let's see what you can do.
string: 好的。看看你行不行。

original: Remember to stay within the boundaries and only use the practice arrows. I have some if you don't have any.
string: 記住，一定要站在線內，只能使用練習用箭。萬一你那裡沒了，可以找我要。

original: Aim for the middle target.
string: 瞄準中間的目標。

original: If you can remain calm, even in the midst of chaos, your arrow will most likely find its target.
string: 只要你足夠冷靜，哪怕周圍再混亂，你的箭依然能夠擊中目標。

original: She always said composure was the key to a successful archer.
string: 她總說沉著是通向優秀弓箭手的鑰匙。

original: My father was rarely home, so it was my mother who actually taught me how to use a bow.
string: 我父親很少在家，是母親教我怎麼使弓的。

original: Sahloknir! Ziil gro dovah ulse!
string: 撒洛克尼爾！澤爾 葛洛 都瓦克 奧斯！

original: I was just curious.
string: 我只是好奇而已。

original: Well aren't you a strange one.
string: 你真是個怪人。

original: You're right. I was probably mistaken.
string: 你說得對。我也許弄錯了。

original: Of course you were. Now stop wasting my time.
string: 當然了。別浪費我的時間了。

original: It's true. He told me.
string: 是真的，他告訴我的。

original: Please, stop wasting my time. You're embarrassing yourself.
string: 拜託，別浪費我時間了。你這是自討沒趣。

original: What do you think of him?
string: 妳是怎麼看他的？

original: Think of him? He's an odd little man. Always poking around the ruins and wasting time in his museum.
string: 怎麼看？他是個怪人，要嘛整天在廢墟裡晃蕩，要嘛就是窩在博物館裡。

original: Seems friendly enough. Obviously intelligent. Why do you ask?
string: 看起來還挺和善的，知識應當還算淵博。你問這個做什麼？

original: He has feelings for you.
string: 他對你有感覺。

original: What? You're out of your mind. That old coot's more interested in dead dwarves than anybody around here.
string: 什麼？你瘋了吧。那個老頭子對矮人古屍有感覺還差不多。

original: Don't talk such rot.
string: 別胡說。

original: I want to talk to you about Calcelmo.
string: 我想跟妳談談有關卡塞莫的事。

original: Calcelmo? What about him?
string: 卡塞莫？他怎麼了？

original: You're probably overthinking this.
string: 你想太多了。

original: That may be the case.
string: 也許是吧。

original: But she is as volatile as a sabre cat. One wrong word, and I've seen her turn on a man so quickly...
string: 可她就像頭劍齒貓似的讓人捉摸不定。我見過她眨眼間就翻臉……

original: You sound a little confused.
string: 你聽起來很困惑。

original: I don't want to choose! They're both so amazing.
string: 我也不想選啊！我都很愛他們。

original: Are you prepared, then, to help bring the light across this land?
string: 那麼，你準備好給這片土地帶來光明了嗎？

original: Is it still possible to aid the temple?
string: 我還能給神殿做貢獻嗎？

original: Always, child. Mara's mercy is ever-flowing.
string: 當然，孩子，瑪拉的恩惠永遠照耀著你。

original: I don't think I can help you.
string: 我覺得我幫不了你。

original: Do not forsake your heart, child, for it may one day come to surprise you.
string: 別太放縱自己的心智了，孩子。那樣總有一天你會得到教訓的。

original: Mara will always accept into her arms should you seek return to her fold.
string: 瑪拉將永遠向那些回頭浪子敞開懷抱。

original: Have it your way. I'll take the job, but don't expect a miracle.
string: 就照你說的吧。我會盡力而為，但別指望會有什麼奇跡出現。

original: Ha! I'd sooner bend my knee to Ulfric Stormcloak.
string: 哈！我寧可向烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷下跪乞討。

original: Besides, Gray-Mane would never make steel for the Legion.
string: 另外，灰鬃是絕對不會替軍團打造武器的。

original: I just can't fill an order that size on my own.
string: 我一個人無法應付這麼大的訂單。

original: Why don't you swallow that stubborn pride of yours and ask Eorlund Gray-Mane for help?
string: 你就不能暫時放下你的自尊，去找厄倫德．灰鬃幫忙嗎？

original: We'll pay whatever it takes. But we must have more swords for the Imperial soldiers.
string: 錢不是問題。可帝國的士兵們需要更多的劍。

original: What's dangerous about daedra?
string: 魔族有什麼危險的？

original: They are profane creatures with no hope of redemption. They lure innocents to their deaths and corrupt the souls of all they touch.
string: 它們是一群不得救贖的骯髒生物。專門濫殺無辜，腐蝕所觸及的一切生靈。

original: And their heretical artifacts grant powers to mortals that wreak havoc across Tamriel. They must be destroyed or guarded to prevent temptation.
string: 那些異端神器讓凡人獲得力量導致泰姆瑞爾禍亂四起。他們必須被毀掉或者監護起來，以免意外發生。

original: Who's Stendarr?
string: 斯坦德爾是誰？

original: He is the God of Mercy. The patron of order and justice for all of Tamriel.
string: 他是仁慈之神，是泰姆瑞爾秩序和正義的化身。

original: We bring his compassion where none can be found, by cleansing all those who would offend his children.
string: 我們要將他的恩賜傳遍世間每個角落，凡是冒犯他子民的人，都要予以消滅。

original: You're bloated with disease. The Vigilant of Stendarr can help you, as long as you promise to never assist the Daedra.
string: 你已經病入膏肓了。斯坦德爾的守備人們能幫助你，但你要承諾今後不可再與魔族相勾結。

original: I am Keeper of the Vigil here in Skyrim. We bring Stendarr's Mercy to the innocent and His Justice to the Daedra.
string: 我是天際省的守夜人。我們將斯坦德爾的仁慈帶給世間純潔的人們，用他的正義去教訓那些兇殘的魔族。

original: You speak to a Vigilant of Stendarr. Cavort with any Daedra, and we will hunt you down.
string: 你正在和一位斯坦德爾的守備人說話。只要你膽敢與魔族為伍，我們就要消滅你。

original: Wherever the Daedra hide, the Vigil of Stendarr will cast them into the light.
string: 無論魔族躲藏在何處，我們都會把它們揪出來。

original: Stendarr's Mercy be upon you, for the Vigil has none to spare.
string: 願斯坦德爾憐憫你吧，守夜人是絕不姑息一切罪惡的。

original: Walk always in the light, or we will drag you to it.
string: 你須行走於光明之下，否則我們必讓你受光明的制裁。

original: The suffering the Daedra cause will not go unpunished.
string: 魔族會為他們親手造成的苦難付出代價。

original: The Mercy of Stendarr does not extend to Daedra worshippers.
string: 斯坦德爾的憐憫是絕不會降臨到魔族崇拜者的身上的。

original: You're a Vigilant of Stendarr?
string: 你是斯坦德爾的守備人？

original: Yes. Our order was founded after the Oblivion Crisis. We dedicate our lives to facing the threat of Daedra wherever they appear.
string: 是的，我們教派在湮滅危機過後就成立了。我們畢生致力於對抗魔族的威脅，無論何時何處。

original: Stendarr be with you.
string: 斯坦德爾與你同在。

original: The Vigil will be watching you.
string: 守夜人會注視著你的。

original: None escape the Vigil. All come into the light.
string: 無人能逃避守夜人的審判。一切將昭示於光明之下。

original: Please cure me.
string: 請治癒我吧。

original: Stendarr's Light purify you of your ills.
string: 斯坦德爾的光芒將淨化你的疾病。

original: Fine. Take all the artifacts I have.
string: 好吧，把這些神器都拿走吧。

original: Wise decision. The vaults in the Hall of the Vigilant will guard this against future temptation.
string: 真是個明智的決定。我們會將這些神器存入守備大廳的寶庫中，以防更多的人被誘惑。

original: You hunt daedra?
string: 你們狩獵魔族？

original: And any other abominations that prey on mortals. Vampires. Werewolves. Witches.
string: 還有其他侵擾凡人的不潔生物。比如吸血鬼，狼人，女巫。

original: But the Daedra are the worst. Their callous disregard for our lives is abhorrent in the eyes of the God of Mercy.
string: 但這之中魔族最為可怖。他們肆意踐踏生命，仁慈之神是不會容忍這一行徑的。

original: Thank you for your role in all of this.
string: 謝謝你的所作所為。

original: It'd be my honor should you decide to make Whiterun your home. Speak with Proventus. He'll make the necessary arrangements.
string: 如果你能在白漫城安家，那我真是榮幸之至。去和普羅萬圖斯談談吧，他會給你安排必要的手續的。

original: For Whiterun! For the Empire!
string: 為了白漫！為了帝國！

original: Carry on men, my gratitude and blessings go with you!
string: 加油吧，夥計們，我的感激與祝福將永遠與你們相伴！

original: Lest our honor be lessened should we allow these bloodthirsty beasts to prowl our lands!
string: 只要我們的尊嚴還在，就絕不允許這群嗜血的野獸蹂躪我們的土地！

original: Ha! The most important question of all, that one.
string: 哈！這是最重要的問題，不是嗎？

original: You'll want the Bannered Mare. See old Hulda, she'll keep you swimmin' in mead.
string: 建議你去敕旗母馬客棧。找老胡爾達吧，她絕對會讓你暢遊在蜜酒的海洋裡的。

original: But mind he bard, Mikael. Poncy little milk drinker, that one.
string: 不過小心詩人米凱爾。那傢伙陰陽怪氣的，還是個娘娘腔。

original: Where can I get a drink?
string: 我要喝酒的話，該去哪兒？

original: Ha! The most important question of all, that one.
string: 哈！這是最重要的問題，不是嗎？

original: You'll want the Bannered Mare. See old Hulda, she'll keep you swimmin' in mead.
string: 建議你去敕旗母馬客棧。找老胡爾達吧，她絕對會讓你暢遊在蜜酒的海洋裡的。

original: Where can I get a drink?
string: 我要喝酒的話，該去哪兒？

original: Ha! The most important question of all, that one.
string: 哈！這是最重要的問題，不是嗎？

original: You'll want the Bannered Mare. See Olfina, she'll keep you swimmin' in mead.
string: 建議你去敕旗母馬客棧。找奧菲娜，她的蜜酒多到都能把你淹死。

original: Where can I get a drink?
string: 我要喝酒的話，該去哪兒？

original: Ain't sure if they're takin' on new members, but you should talk to the Companions. They're over in their hall, Jorrvaskr.
string: 你可以去找戰友團，可是不知道他們還收不收人。他們通常都待在蜜酒大廳裡，那裡名叫勇士之家。

original: If by "work" you mean "testing your steel in bloody battle."
string: 如果你所謂的「工作」指的是「浴血奮戰」的話。

original: Any place I can find work?
string: 我上哪能找到工作？

original: Aye, that I do. Have all my life. We Battle-Borns have been here since the beginning. Along with the Gray-Manes.
string: 是的。住了一輩子了。我們戰狂氏族和灰鬃氏族從建城以來就一直居住在這裡。

original: Our families been close as kin for generations.
string: 我們兩家世代團結，親如兄弟。

original: But Ulfric Stormcloak's uprising has divided us. Now seems we can scarce look at each other without comin' to blows. Petty and foolish, that.
string: 可烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷的叛亂卻令我們兩家反目成仇。現在我們居然要兵戎相見，真是太狹隘，太愚蠢了。

original: They're sayin' dragons have returned to Skyrim. Now that there, that's a real problem.
string: 聽說現在巨龍又在天際現身了。這才是真正的大麻煩啊。

original: You live here?
string: 你住在這裡？

original: A pity. And words I hear too often.
string: 可惜。這樣的話我聽過太多次了。

original: But there's no shame in it. One of them dragons comes callin' in Whiterun, the place'll go up like tinder.
string: 不過這也無可厚非。要是真有條巨龍飛進白漫城，那這裡立刻就會變成一片火海。

original: Just passing through.
string: 只是路過而已。

original: Truly?
string: 真的嗎？

original: Ha! By Shor, this city could use more like you.
string: 哈！看在朔爾的份上，這座城市真的需要更多像你這樣的人。

original: Best head up to Dragonsreach, then, and see the Jarl. He's lord of Whiterun, and can set you on the path.
string: 那麼你不妨去龍臨堡拜見領主吧。他是白漫城的統治者，會告訴你該怎麼做的。

original: I'm here to help, in any way I can.
string: 我是來盡我所能提供幫助的。

original: Ah, so it's gold you're after, then?
string: 啊，這麼說你是為錢才來嗎？

original: You need only ask about. Plenty o' folk in Whiterun with too much fat and gold to be bothered doing anything for themselves.
string: 你算來對地方。白漫城有一堆腦滿腸肥的有錢人，渾身都是金幣，他們想做什麼只要動動手指就行。

original: I seek my fortune.
string: 我是來追求財富的。

original: Well met, kinsman. What brings you to Whiterun?
string: 你好啊，老鄉。什麼風把你給吹來了？

original: Well met, traveler. What brings you to Whiterun?
string: 你好啊，旅行者。什麼風把你給吹來了？

original: And so, we must each one of us, continue to fight this insurrection, lest our fallen brothers have died for naught!
string: 所以，我們必須團結一致，鎮壓這場叛亂，不要讓我們兄弟們白白犧牲！

original: ...You! Why?
string: ……你！為什麼？

original: But Ulfric will not stop here. No, he will continue to strike out against any true Nord who remains faithful to the Empire.
string: 但烏弗瑞克不會就此甘休。不，他會繼續打擊每個對帝國效忠的諾德人。

original: He will continue to sow discord and chaos wherever he can.
string: 只要他還有一口氣，就會四處散播衝突和混亂。

original: The citizens of Whiterun are forever in your debt!
string: 白漫城的居民永遠感謝你！

original: In defeating these Stormcloak traitors, you have proven the hollowness of their cause and the fullness of your hearts.
string: 在擊敗風暴斗篷叛徒的過程中，你已經證明了他們事業的虛假和你心靈的完滿。

original: They already sing of your valor and skill! The halls of Sovngarde are no doubt ringing with your praises!
string: 他們正在歌唱你們的勇敢與威猛！你們的頌歌已經響徹了英靈殿的大廳！

original: Revel in your victory here today, even as the gods revel in your honor!
string: 為你們的勝利歡呼吧，連諸神都將讚嘆你們的功績！

original: Everyone, on me! The Jarl wishes to speak!
string: 大家注意了！領主有話說！

original: You don't look like a guard.
string: 你看起來不像衛兵。

original: We're not. The Silver-Bloods pay our wage. Every man here is a trained mercenary.
string: 我們不是衛兵。是銀血花錢雇的。這裡的每個人都是受過訓練的傭兵。

original: Keep out? Why?
string: 不准進入？為什麼

original: This is a jail, owned by the Silver-Blood family. We use the prisoners to mine for ore.
string: 這裡是監獄，歸銀血家族所有。在這裡關押的犯人都在為我們挖礦。

original: It's the most secure prison in Skyrim. Throw scum in, close the gates. No one gets out.
string: 這裡是全天際最安全的監獄。只要把人丟進去，門一關，誰也別想出去。

original: So unless you're here to dig, you don't belong here.
string: 你若不是來挖礦的，就別在這裡晃蕩了。

original: Now, you. Get down there.
string: 嘿，你，給我下去。
