original: What do you want now? You still hurling baseless accusations?
string: 你現在想怎麼樣？你還在到處搬弄這些無理控訴？

original: I'm not going to kill you. That's not our way.
string: 我不會殺妳。這不是我們的行事風格。

original: Linwe is holed up at a place called Uttering Hills Cave. He's got his entire Guild there, so be careful.
string: 林維躲在一個名叫出言山洞穴的地方。他叫整個公會的成員都聚集在那，你要小心點。

original: After you're done with all this, come back anytime, and I'll make good on my end of the bargain.
string: 事成之後，隨時可以回來找我，我會兌現之前的承諾。

original: Tell me where Linwe's hiding.
string: 告訴我林維躲在哪。

original: If I tell you, you need to promise not to kill me.
string: 如果我告訴了你，你得答應不殺我。

original: I'd prove to be quite an asset to the Thieves Guild... I'm one of the best fences in Skyrim.
string: 我對於盜賊公會來說是一個有用之人……因為我是天際省最優秀的銷贓者之一。

original: How'd you get involved?
string: 妳是怎麼被牽扯進來的？

original: I used to fence for the Thieves Guild in Skyrim a long time ago.
string: 很久以前我為天際省的盜賊公會處理贓物。

original: When Linwe moved into the area, he contacted me and said if I didn't fence for them, he'd kill me.
string: 當林維來到這塊地方時，他找到我，對我說如果不幫他們銷贓，就殺了我。

original: Who's crazy?
string: 誰是瘋子？

original: It's a guild of Altmer thieves, they call themselves the Summerset Shadows.
string: 那是傲爾特莫盜賊的公會，他們自稱為夏暮暗影。

original: Their leader, Linwe, he's the worst of the lot. He steals valuables from the dead.
string: 他們的頭目是林維。他偷竊死人身上的財物，是這群人中最壞的傢伙。

original: I'm listening.
string: 我在聽。

original: Look, I had no choice. They're crazy... I could be killed!
string: 聽著，我也是不得已的。他們是一群瘋子……我有可能會被殺掉！

original: My mistake.
string: 不好意思，我錯了。

original: Next time you wish to accuse someone of a crime, I suggest you obtain proof!
string: 下次你指控一個人有罪時，最好有真憑實據！

original: I don't have time for this!
string: 我沒時間管這事！

original: Think I'm defenseless? Well you're wrong!
string: 你以為我是病貓？你過來試試！

original: Tell me everything or end up like Fjotli! (Intimidate)
string: 一切從實招來，否則下場就會像芙優蒂一樣！（威嚇）

original: Now, just a moment. Let's think about this... you know, discuss it like two rational people.
string: 等一下。我們冷靜點……兩個人理性地討論一下。

original: Now you're threatening me? What in the name of the Divines is wrong with you?
string: 你在威脅我？你他媽的到底吃錯什麼藥了？

original: You might be a decent thief, but you're an awful actor. (Persuade)
string: 你也許是個出色的小偷，不過你是個拙劣的演員。（說服）

original: Now, just a moment. Let's think about this... you know, discuss it like two rational people.
string: 等一下。我們冷靜點……兩個人理性地討論一下。

original: I'm afraid I have absolutely no idea what you're speaking of.
string: 我完全不知道你在說什麼？

original: Drop the act. I know you're involved in her death.
string: 別演戲了。我知道妳跟她的死有關。

original: How dare you!
string: 你竟敢這麼說！

original: You're accusing me of taking part such a... such a... heinous act? I should have you arrested for even suggesting such a thing!
string: 你指控我參與了如此……如此……卑劣的犯罪行為？憑你這句話，我就可以叫衛兵逮捕你！

original: I'm here about Fjotli.
string: 我是為芙優蒂的事情而來的。

original: Fjotli...  Fjotli... Where have I heard that name?
string: 芙優蒂……芙優蒂……這名字聽起來怎麼這麼耳熟？

original: Oh, of course, the poor girl who was murdered. Such a beautiful young thing... a tragedy to be certain.
string: 哦，對了，是一個被殺害的可憐女孩。多麼年輕漂亮的孩子……真是個悲劇。

original: Yes, can I help you with something?
string: 我能幫你什麼呢？

original: I must return to Markarth.
string: 我必須回到馬卡斯城。

original: What happened to Fjotli?
string: 芙優蒂出什麼事了？

original: I don't know. Rumor has it that she was murdered... butchered by a madman. I really try and stay out of such things.
string: 我不知道，有謠言說她是被謀殺的……兇手是一個瘋子了。我真的不想管這種事情。

original: Torsten might think Linwe or myself are responsible for Fjotli's death, but I can assure you nothing could be further from the truth.
string: 托斯滕．酷海可能認為林維或者我應該對芙優蒂的死負責，但我保證群眾的眼睛是雪亮的。

original: I'm sorry I mislead you. Return when this is over, and we'll talk about my involvement in the Thieves Guild.
string: 對不起，我誤導了你。等這事結束之後再回來，我會把我在盜賊公會中扮演的角色一五十一地告訴你。

original: You mean he murders his marks.
string: 妳的意思是他謀殺了他的目標？

original: No! Linwe prefers stealing from the deceased. Digs up the corpses, breaks into the Hall of the Dead...
string: 不！林維比較喜歡做像是從死人身上偷東西、盜墓、闖入亡者之廳之類的事情……

original: He even stole that locket right off that poor murdered girl's body... or what was left of it.
string: 他甚至偷走了那個被殺小女孩身上的墜子……還有一些其他剩下的東西。

original: I said, next prisoner!
string: 我說了，把下一個犯人帶上來！

original: There it is again. Did you hear that?
string: 又來了，你們都聽見了嗎？

original: What was that?
string: 那是什麼？

original: I want to pay that prisoner's fine.
string: 我要付清這個犯人的罰款。

original: Done. Convince him to stay out of the city while you're at it.
string: 行了。可以請你順便要他離這座城遠點嗎？

original: Takes coin to pay a fine. And you don't have enough.
string: 罰款需要錢。你還不夠呢。

original: Ah, yes! There it is! Thank you so much.
string: 啊，太好了！就在這裡！太感謝你了。

original: I think the Bards College might be looking for recruits. You should speak to the head of the college, Viarmo, if you're interested.
string: 詩人學院好像在招收新人。如果你感興趣，可以去找校長維阿墨。

original: Varnius Junius stopped by here on his way to court. He was worried about something. I'm sure Falk Firebeard could tell you what.
string: 瓦紐斯．尤尼斯在去庭院途中路過這裡。他看似為了什麼事情很著急。你可以去找佛可．火鬍問清楚情況。

original: People say there's a man wandering the streets near the Blue Palace. He seems distressed but he's not making any sense.
string: 有人說有個男人在藍宮附近的街上徘徊。他看起來不知為什麼事情很難過。

original: Speaking of my pay...
string: 提到我的報酬……

original: Yes, yes. Here it is. I think I'd best be off now.
string: 對對，給你吧。我現在該走了。

original: Ha! You've done it! Got to admit, I wasn't sure you could pull it off. But you've definitely earned your pay.
string: 哈！你成功了！說老實的，我本來還有點懷疑，不過你確實很可靠。

original: Let's make the exchange.
string: 我們來做個交易吧。

original: I see you but I don't see Frost. Come back when you have the horse with you.
string: 我看到你，但沒看到「寒霜」。等拿到了馬再來見我。

original: I could be convinced to catch him. (Persuade)
string: 你得先說抓到狗之後有什麼報酬。（說服）

original: It's a smart man that demands something up front for his work. Some gold now and some when I have my dog. Here's the meat.
string: 聰明人在接受工作之前都會提一些條件。這些金幣你先拿去，找回我的狗之後再給你一些。肉在這裡。

original: You know that dog on the road you asked me to get?
string: 你知道那條你要我去抓的狗嗎？

original: No, sorry. I didn't see a dog.
string: 不，對不起。我沒看到過任何一隻狗。

original: There's one out on the road. I can't afford to chase him down but I could use a fierce, loyal beast to keep me company.
string: 外面路上有一隻。我沒辦法抓到牠，但我很想要一隻兇猛而又忠誠的動物陪著我。

original: Tell me, do you believe in mighty Arkay, god of life and death?
string: 告訴我，你相信偉大的生命和死亡之神阿爾凱嗎？

original: This is your last warning, outsider. We keep the peace, here. Stay out of our business.
string: 這是最後的警告，外來者。我們這裡的生活安靜詳和。不要來騷擾我們。

original: Let's not jump to conclusions. We'll do all the research we need to figure out what we're dealing with.
string: 不要急於得出結論。我們會進行一切必要的研究，弄清楚對手是什麼樣的。

original: Something arcane. Very old, very powerful. Do you think...?
string: 某種既古老又強大的神秘之物。你認為是……？

original: He proposed that the real reason Saarthal was fought over by the Elves and the Nords was because something was unearthed there.
string: 他提出精靈和諾德人爭奪薩瑟爾城的原因是那裡出土了某種東西。

original: I don't see the relevance.
string: 我沒看出有什麼關聯。

original: "Night of Tears", by Dranor Seleth. Old book, one I'd forgotten about. This thing here... it might be what the book was about.
string: 有一本由德拉納．塞勒斯所寫的老書「淚之夜」，我都快忘記了。這裡的東西……很可能就是書中提到的。

original: Here's something to consider, Mirabelle.
string: 這些東西要認真對待，米拉貝勒。

original: I feel better already.
string: 我感覺好多了。

original: Gods bless you, healer.
string: 眾神保佑你，治療者。

original: Thank you. The pain is already easing.
string: 謝謝你。疼痛減輕很多了。

original: Sounds like no one should possess it.
string: 聽起來這東西不能落入凡人之手。

original: Good, then you understand why this is about more than just Mercer's lust for power.
string: 很好，你終於明白這事情不僅僅只限於墨瑟對於力量的渴望了。

original: The three of us could keep it.
string: 我們三個可以保存它。

original: I'm afraid that's impossible.
string: 恐怕不可能。

original: The Guild should possess this item.
string: 這件物品應該交給公會保管。

original: Although it would benefit the Guild more than you can imagine, in the end, it would do more harm than good.
string: 儘管這東西會給公會帶來難以想像的利益，但是它終究會帶來更大的危害。

original: Gunnar, take care of the boy. I have to find General Tullius and join the defense.
string: 甘那，照顧好小男孩。我要去找圖留斯將軍，參加戰鬥。

original: I wish Elgrim had spent more time tutoring me then that Ingun girl.
string: 我真希望艾爾格瑞姆指導我的時間比指導那個因甘女孩的時間更長一點。

original: Your skin's as pale as the snow. You scared of sunlight, or something?
string: 你的皮膚像雪一樣蒼白。你是害怕陽光什麼的嗎？

original: Don't like those eyes you got. There's a bad hunger to them.
string: 不喜歡你的眼睛，流露出饑渴的光芒。

original: Vampire! Burn it!
string: 吸血鬼！燒死牠！

original: Vampire! To arms!
string: 有吸血鬼！快拿起武器！

original: Burn it! Burn the vampire!
string: 燒死它！燒死這個吸血鬼！

original: Vampire!
string: 吸血鬼！

original: Has the war made your travels difficult?
string: 戰亂是不是讓你們的旅程更加困難了？

original: Quite the opposite, in fact.
string: 事實上正好相反。

original: The soldiers are some of our best customers, for we offer supplies and wares they cannot obtain by other means.
string: 士兵是我們最好的顧客。因為我們為他們提供了從別處無法獲得的補給和貨物。

original: It was Ri'saad's idea to come here now, while the land is in turmoil. Where others saw only danger, he saw opportunity.
string: 眼下這片土地一片混亂，瑞撒德極力主張來到這裡。多數人看到的是危險，而他看到的是機會。

original: Who owns the trading caravans?
string: 這些貿易商隊是誰的？

original: It is Ri'saad who owns the three trading caravans that travel the roads of Skyrim.
string: 在天際省道路上旅行的三支貿易商隊都是瑞．撒德的。

original: Long ago, I was an orphan on the streets of Corinthe. I stowed away aboard a trade ship that brought me here. It was Ri'saad who found me.
string: 很久以前，我是寇林瑟街頭的一個孤兒。我偷偷上了一條貨船來到這裡。後來瑞．撒德找到了我。

original: He provided the funds to start this caravan, and put me in charge of it. I owe him more than I could ever hope to repay.
string: 他提供了成立這支商隊的資金，讓我負責。他對我的知遇之恩，我怎麼報答都不夠。

original: Do you work for Risaad?
string: 你為瑞撒德打工嗎？

original: He hired the others and paid for my goods. I am allowed to run the caravan, but I pay Ri'saad a percentage of my profits.
string: 其他人都是他雇請的，還出錢幫我進貨。由我來經營商隊，抽出一定的利潤給瑞．撒德。

original: I say this without bitterness, for it was Ri'saad who saved me from a life of servitude aboard a trading ship.
string: 這些事情說起來毫無苦難之感，因為是瑞．撒德把我從商船的奴役生活中救出來。

original: I am grateful to have the life that I do now. It is a far cry from my days as an orphan on the streets of Corinthe.
string: 對於現在的生活我滿懷感激。比我在寇林瑟街頭流浪的日子好多了。

original: How long have you been in Skyrim?
string: 你來天際省多久了？

original: Not long, in truth. I came to Skyrim after I found myself unwelcome in both Elsweyr and Cyrodiil.
string: 事實上並不久。我發現艾斯維爾和賽瑞迪爾都不歡迎我，於是才來到這裡。

original: I seem to have an unfortunate talent for getting myself involved in misunderstandings with the law.
string: 我似乎有種不幸的天賦，人們總是會誤會我。

original: Ri'saad was able to look past that, and it was he who helped to set me up with a trade caravan. Now I work for him.
string: 瑞．撒德沒有棄我於不顧，他幫我建立起了商隊。現在我為他工作。

original: Have you had trouble with the locals?
string: 你跟當地人相處有發生過問題嗎？

original: Mostly it is the Nords. They do not like outsiders in their land, and so we are forbidden to enter the cities.
string: 大多數是跟諾德人。他們不喜歡外地人出現在他們的土地上，因此他們禁止我們進城。

original: When they look upon us, they see only pickpockets and skooma dealers. It is most unfair, but we do our best to ignore them.
string: 在他們眼裡我們只是扒手和斯庫瑪販子。這很不公平，不過我們也儘量無視他們。

original: Why sell your goods in Skyrim?
string: 為什麼你會在天際省出售貨物？

original: An astute question, for we are far from home and this is a cold, hard land.
string: 這個問題不大好回答。因為我們遠離家鄉來到這片寒冷艱苦的土地，確實不合情理。

original: The wise trader finds the best opportunities, even if he must travel far to find them. Skyrim is a ripe opportunity indeed.
string: 明智的商人總會找到最佳的商機，即使需要跋山涉水才能找到也無所謂。而天際省確實是一個成熟的商機。

original: The dragons and the war have scared many other traders away, but for those with courage, there is much profit to be made.
string: 龍族和戰亂讓很多商人望而卻步，但對於有勇氣的人來說，這樣反而能賺的更多。

original: I'm curious about your homeland.
string: 我對你的故鄉很好奇。

original: The Khajiit hail from a distant land called Elsweyr, bordered on the north by Cyrodiil and the south by the glistening blue waters of the sea.
string: 虎人來自於一個名叫艾斯維爾的遙遠大陸，北邊與賽瑞迪爾相接，南邊與藍色閃耀的大海相鄰。

original: Elsweyr is an arid land of deserts and rocky canyons, where the sun shines warmly, always.
string: 艾斯維爾是一個到處都是沙漠和岩石峽谷的不毛之地，那裡總是充滿著陽光。

original: There are cities so ancient, the sands have swallowed them whole. But now I will say no more, for I miss my home greatly.
string: 那裡還有一些被沙子吞沒的先古城市。但我不想再說下去了，這會讓我變得好想念家鄉。

original: Tools, wares and weapons, all for sale at fair prices.
string: 工具、雜貨和兵器，價格公道，童叟無欺。

original: Goods and wares of all kinds, and all can be yours!
string: 各式各樣的商品雜貨，應有盡有！

original: Come! Come and see what goods I offer.
string: 瞧一瞧看一看啦。

original: Far have I traveled to bring you these fine goods. Come and see what I offer.
string: 我遠道而來帶來這些上好貨物，走過路過不要錯過！

original: May your road lead you to warm sands.
string: 願你的前路是溫暖的沙地。

original: I hope that you will come to do business with us again.
string: 衷心希望你再次惠顧。

original: May the sun keep you warm even in this land of bitter cold.
string: 即便在這片嚴酷寒冷的土地上，也願太陽為你帶來溫暖。

original: Until our next meeting, if such is fated.
string: 如果命運如此安排，那我們後會有期了。

original: I hope you will find a warmer welcome in your travels than we have found in ours.
string: 我希望你在旅途中能比我們那時受到更熱烈的歡迎。

original: The roads of Skyrim can be treacherous. If you must walk them, be wary.
string: 天際省的道路非常艱險。如果你一定得在天際省旅行，請多加小心。

original: I don't know how I do it. It just happens.
string: 我不知道我是怎麼辦到的。一切都很自然。

original: You were given this gift by the gods for a reason. It is up to you to figure out how best to use it.
string: 上天賦予你這種天賦不是偶然的。你也有責任弄清楚如何充分利用這種天賦。

original: Turns out, we fatally underestimated the Thalmor. They smashed us with ease during the Great War.
string: 結果表明，我們錯誤地低估了梭默的實力。他們在浩大戰爭中輕而易舉地擊潰了我們。

original: I was one of the few who escaped. For a long time, all I cared about was staying alive, and taking revenge on the Thalmor when I could.
string: 我就是少數倖存者之一。在很長一段時間裡，我一直盤算著如何生存下去並向梭默復仇。

original: But then the dragons returned. And I remembered that the Blades used to be dragonslayers.
string: 不過後來發生了龍族回歸事件，我想起刀鋒衛士從前就是屠龍者。

original: And that we were sworn to protect the Dragonborn, the greatest dragonslayer of all.
string: 我還想起，我們曾經發誓要保護最偉大的屠龍者 - 龍裔。

original: Put that down before you get hurt.
string: 放下武器，否則休怪我不客氣了。

original: I'm sorry, just... Just don't hurt me. I know you're not one of them, but you just can't help them. You can't let them know I'm here.
string: 很對不起，只是……只是別傷害我。我知道你和他們不是一夥的，但你也別幫他們。別讓他們知道我在這。

original: Please, will you help me? There's no one here I can trust.
string: 能幫幫我嗎？我信不過這裡的人。

original: I mean it! I'll... I'll cut you in half!
string: 我是認真的！我要……我要把你劈成兩半！

original: So, are you working with them? You think you can take me? You so much as touch me, and you're going to lose fingers.
string: 那麼，你跟他們是一夥的？你以為能打得過我嗎？要是你敢碰我一根汗毛，我就把你的手指頭砍下來。

original: I've found this expedition journal.
string: 我找到了這本探險日記。

original: Let's see. Ah, so that's what happened to Staubin. Tragic, but I warned him he was leading those people on a fool's errand.
string: 我看看。啊，這就是斯陶賓的遭遇了。真是悲劇，我當初警告過他這一趟簡直是把那幫人送入火坑的。

original: Unfortunately, sometimes the stone of scholarship is built on the foundation of death. I'll inform the kin.
string: 不幸的是，有時通往學識的路總是用屍骨來鋪就的。我會轉告他們的家人。

original: Here, I usually pay researchers for their work when they emerge from the ruins, but they won't be needing it anymore.
string: 這個給你吧，本來是要在研究者們從廢墟回來時付給他們的報酬，現在看來他們也無福消受了。

original: Oh really? Hmm... this looks like someone from Staubin's little group. A brave scholar, but not very wise....
string: 哦，是嗎？嗯……這看起來像是個斯陶賓小隊的成員。他是個勇敢的學者，但腦袋不怎麼靈光……

original: If you find Staubin, it would be good to see any notes he may have collected. I doubt you'll find him alive, though.
string: 如果你找到斯陶賓，最好能找到他收集到的一些筆記。但我想他可能已經遇難了。

original: You know, I was there for that whole sordid affair. Marvelous time! Butterflies, blood, a Fox, a severed head... Oh, and the cheese! To die for.
string: 你知道嗎，那件骯髒的事情發生時我在場。真是光輝的時刻啊！蝴蝶，鮮血，一隻狐狸，一顆砍下來的頭顱……哦！還有那非常可口的乳酪！

original: Why would anyone think you're a spy?
string: 為什麼有人會覺得妳是密探？

original: Some of these Nords will come up with any excuse to despise us.
string: 欲加之罪，何患無辭。這些諾德人總有理由來貶低我們。

original: And it isn't just the dark elves they hate -- they make a target of the Argonians as well.
string: 他們仇視的不僅僅是暗精靈，還有亞龍人。

original: In fact, just about anyone who isn't a Nord is fair game for their bullying.
string: 實際上，只要不是諾德人，他們都會去欺侮一番。

original: Curse you!
string: 詛咒你！

original: You just sit tight. I'll get around to it eventually.
string: 你就慢慢等著吧。我會想辦法搞定的。

original: Right, right... Oh, look at that. I seem to have lost my keys. Might take me a while to find them.
string: 好吧，好吧……哦，你瞧瞧。我好像把鑰匙弄丟了，可能要費一番功夫才找得著。

original: I said my fine has been paid! Now let me out!
string: 我說我的罰金已經付清了！現在，放我出去！

original: Sorry, my ears aren't so good. You say somethin'?
string: 很抱歉，我的耳朵不怎麼靈光。你剛才說什麼來著？

original: Guard! My fine's been paid, now set me free!
string: 衛兵！我的罰金已經付清了。快放我出去！

original: I'm not much for sneaking.
string: 偷偷摸摸的事我做不來。

original: I have faith in you.
string: 我相信你。

original: But, if you find more trouble than you can handle, run out to the courtyard. We'll come as soon as we hear fighting.
string: 但是，如果你發現麻煩大到你解決不了的時候，就跑到院子裡去吧。我們聽到打鬥聲時會儘快趕來的。

original: I'm on it.
string: 我這就去。

original: You should wait until night fall before trying to sneak in. Talos preserve you.
string: 你應該等到夜幕降臨再溜進去，願塔洛斯保佑你。

original: Talos preserve you.
string: 塔洛斯會保佑你的。

original: What's the plan?
string: 計劃是什麼？

original: We found a cave under the lake. With luck, it'll lead into the prison.
string: 我們在湖底下發現了一個洞穴。幸運的是，它通往監獄裡頭。

original: I need you to sneak in there, and free our men, killing anyone inside as you go. Once you've rescued the prisoners, head out to the courtyard.
string: 我要你潛入進去，解救我們的人，順便把所有衛兵都除掉。一旦你救出了我們的人，就出到庭院裡來。

original: We'll stand guard out here and rush in as soon as we hear fighting.
string: 我們會守在這裡，一旦聽見裡面傳來打鬥聲，我們就衝進去。

original: Should be fun.
string: 應該挺有意思的。

original: There's a grate outside the wall. Looks like it used to be buried in snow. I don't think they know it's there.
string: 牆外有個壁爐。看起來它原來是被埋在雪裡的。好像他們不知道有個爐子在那裡。

original: From the look of it, I'd bet it leads straight into the prison.
string: 看起來它是通向監獄裡頭的。

original: I need you to sneak in there, and free our men, killing anyone inside as you go. Once you've rescued the prisoners, head out to the courtyard.
string: 我要你潛入進去，解救我們的人，順便把所有衛兵都除掉。一旦你救出了我們的人，就出到庭院裡來。

original: We'll stand guard out here and rush in as soon as we hear fighting.
string: 我們會守在這裡，一旦聽見裡面傳來打鬥聲，我們就衝進去。

original: How's business?
string: 生意如何？

original: Working with the Guild again is the best decision I've ever made. Protection, respect and a constant flow of coin... it couldn't get any better.
string: 再次和公會合作是我做出過的最正確的決定。受人保護，被人尊敬，還有花不完的錢……好得不能再好了。

original: Best of all, there's no need to smuggle things quietly anymore. With the influence we have in Solitude, I can march it right out the front door.
string: 最重要的是，我們不用再偷偷摸摸的搞走私了。借助公會在獨孤城的影響力，我可以大搖大擺地從正門出入。

original: How could I complain when I went from Sabjorn's lackey to one of the wealthiest merchants in Whiterun in no time at all?
string: 以前在撒布喬恩夾著尾巴做人，一夜之間變成白漫城最富有的商人，我還有什麼好抱怨的？

original: Plus, the meadery's doing so well, I'm almost having trouble keeping up with the demand.
string: 此外，蜂蜜酒廠經營得很不錯，我都有點供不應求了。

original: I'd say things couldn't be any better.
string: 我得說，眼下這種情況好得不能再好了。

original: Business? Business is actually inconsequential to me. I share little of your lust for coin.
string: 生意？生意對我來說不重要，我不像你那麼貪財。

original: However, as promised, I'll still be more than happy to take any stolen merchandise off your hands.
string: 不過就像我之前承諾過的，我仍然很樂意從你手中收回被你偷走的貨物。

original: I've been setting up some open trading with Tonilia back at the Guild in Riften, and it's proven to be quite profitable.
string: 最近我一直忙於安排跟裂谷城公會的托尼利亞進行一些交易，事實證明我從中收益不少。

original: There's been no word from the remnants of the Summerset Shadows, so I'm assuming you either eliminated all of them or they've fled Skyrim.
string: 還沒有夏暮暗影餘孽的消息，因此我認為他們要嘛都被你消滅了，要嘛都逃離了天際省。

original: Everything seems to be working out nicely, wouldn't you agree?
string: 一切看起來都一帆風順的，你覺得呢？

original: Business is absolutely booming, my friend.
string: 生意發展的形勢讓人開心啊，朋友。

original: I've taken to hiring a few extra men of my own just to keep up with all the shipments.
string: 我又多雇了一些人手來加快裝貨的進度。

original: Old Delvin certainly takes care of his own, doesn't he.
string: 老戴爾文只關心他自己。

original: Just remember me if you get your hands on anything else.
string: 如果你想要其他東西的時候，記得來找我。

original: Do me a favor. If you speak to Maven, tell her everything's well at hand down here, okay?
string: 幫個忙，如果你見到瑪雯，告訴她這裡的一切都好，行嗎？

original: Give my regards to Karliah if you see her.
string: 如果你見到卡莉亞，代我向她問好。

original: Hurry back... and bring more merchandise.
string: 請快點帶著更多的貨物回來………

original: When you get back to Riften, tell Delvin this new arrangement's working out quite well.
string: 如果你回到裂谷城，請告訴戴爾文說新協議狀況很不錯。

original: Crossing the Guild was a bad idea. I'll buy goods from you after you settle your accounts.
string: 背著公會搞小動作可不大明智。等你跟公會搞清楚帳目後，我再來買你的貨物吧。

original: Ah, you're just in time. I got in a shipment of fine wares courtesy of the East Empire Company.
string: 啊，你來得真剛好。承蒙東帝國貿易公司的好意，我得到了一批上好的器具。

original: Come to sell me something special, or did you just want to look through my merchandise?
string: 你是來賣給我特別物品，還是來看我的貨物的？

original: Ah, you're back. I'm hearing good things about the Guild through the grapevine.
string: 啊，你回來了。我通過一些秘密途徑得知了一些關於公會的好消息。

original: Brought me more than some Firebrand Wine I trust?
string: 是不是給我帶來了一些火牌葡萄酒？

original: I heard about what you did at the Guild all the way out here. Sorry, can't buy or sell anything from you.
string: 我聽說了你在公會的所作所為。對不起，我不能和你做買賣。

original: Been a while since I've seen you at the meadery. Bring me anything interesting?
string: 自從上次在蜂蜜酒廠見到你到現在已經有一段時間了。有沒有帶什麼有趣的東西來？

original: What brings you to Whiterun? Got some juicy goods to sell?
string: 什麼風把你吹到白漫城來了？帶來了一些好東西要賣的嗎？

original: What have you got for me today? Nothing illegal I hope!
string: 今天你給我帶了些什麼來？希望不會來路不明吧！

original: I've got plenty of good merchandise for you. Take a look.
string: 我準備了很多很棒的貨物，來看看吧。

original: Rumor has it you couldn't follow the Guild's rules, so we can't do any business until it's been worked out.
string: 聽說你不遵守公會的規矩，因此我們不能和你做生意，直到你解決這個問題為止。

original: Taking me up on my offer, eh? Good.
string: 接受我的提議嗎？很好。

original: I'm assuming you're here for more than a social call. Down to business, eh?
string: 我想你不是來聊天的吧。開門見山做生意吧？

original: I'm always on the lookout for all sorts of goods. Bring me whatever you... well, "find" and I'll see what I can do.
string: 我一向都在找尋各式各樣的商品。不管你「找到」什麼樣的東西都可以帶來給我，我會幫你處理。

original: So, did Delvin send you again or you here on your own this time?
string: 那麼，這次又是戴爾文派你來的，還是你自己來的？

original: In trouble with the Guild, eh? Well, looks like we won't be trading merchandise until you smooth it over.
string: 你跟公會有點矛盾吧？看來我們現在不能跟你做生意，等你先把問題解決了再說。

original: So, you've come to see me to sell or to buy? Hm?
string: 那麼，你來找我是想出售貨物還是來購買東西？

original: I've got all sorts of interesting things for you to buy, and I assure you they're of the finest quality.
string: 我這裡的東西你肯定感興趣，而且我保證都是品質上乘的。

original: If you've got the time to sell, I've got the time to buy.
string: 你有時間賣，我就有時間買。

original: Let's see what you have for me today. Something simple to turn around for a profit I trust.
string: 我來看看你今天都有些什麼？相信一定是那種一轉手就能賺錢的東西吧。

original: I've been forbidden to deal with you until amends are made with the Guild. Sorry.
string: 等你賠償公會的損失後，我才能和你做生意。對不起。

original: Glad your here, I've been looking for some more merchandise to buy. Have lots of orders to fill and my clients don't like to wait.
string: 很高興你在這，我一直在尋找貨源，有大把訂單等著我發貨，而且我的客戶急著要呢。

original: Now I know you've come by for more than just a visit. What did you bring?
string: 我知道你來不是為了聊天的。你帶了什麼東西？

original: I promise you, I buy much more than simple silver trinkets.
string: 我向你保證，我一定不會只買點小小的銀飾品而已的。

original: I've made a lot of new contacts thanks to you, and more contacts means more coin for everyone.
string: 多虧了你，我得到了很多新合約，更多的合約代表大家可以賺得更多。

original: Thank you, Enthir.
string: 謝謝你，恩希爾。

original: If trying to rid yourself of stolen goods becomes a burden, and you find yourself in Winterhold, visit me at the College.
string: 如果銷贓對你來說是個負擔，那就到冬堡的學院來見我。

original: I've been known to handle items of questionable interest from time to time and I'll see what I can do.
string: 通常我會幫人銷贓，讓我看看我能幫到你什麼？

original: If you ever manage to gain entry to the College, and you find trying to rid yourself of stolen goods becoming a burden, come visit me.
string: 如果你有機會到學院來，而且銷贓對你來說是個負擔，那就來找我。

original: I've been known to handle items of questionable interest from time to time and I'll see what I can do.
string: 我知道該如何幫人處理贓物，到時看看我能幫你什麼忙。

original: Listen, all I want is the truth to be revealed to the Guild. They respected Karliah, and she deserves better.
string: 聽著，我只想讓公會知道真相。他們尊敬卡莉亞，她也應該受到更好的待遇。

original: Do whatever you can and I'd consider it a personal favor.
string: 請儘量幫忙，我會記得還你一個人情的。

original: Thanks!
string: 謝啦！

original: Let's teach these bastards a lesson.
string: 我們來好好教訓一下這些混蛋！

original: All right!
string: 好吧！

original: Last but not least. Let's go!
string: 這是最後但並不是最不重要的。走吧！

original: Hey!
string: 嘿！

original: Get me out of here!
string: 快帶我出去！

original: Hurry!
string: 快點！

original: The guard has the key.
string: 鑰匙在衛兵身上。

original: As you command.
string: 謹遵號令。

original: No. I can't afford to risk both of you. I need you here working on ways to defend the city against these dragons.
string: 不。我不能讓你們倆去冒險。我需要你留在這裡研究從巨龍手中保護城市的方法。

original: I should come along. I would very much like to see this dragon.
string: 我得一起去。我很想見識一下這頭龍。

original: Don't worry, my lord. I'm the very soul of caution.
string: 別擔心，大人。我是個謹慎的人。

original: Tell him what you told me. About the dragon.
string: 把你告訴我有關巨龍的事情都跟領主報告。

original: So, Irileth tells me you came from the western watchtower?
string: 嗯，伊瑞萊斯告訴我說你是從西邊的哨塔過來的。

original: I'd take this a bit more seriously if I were you. If a dragon decides to attack Whiterun I don't know if we can stop it.
string: 我建議你認真對待此事。如果一頭龍要來襲擊白漫城，我們都不知道能否抵擋得住。

original: A dragon! How exciting! Where was it seen? What was it doing?
string: 一頭龍！太令人激動了！牠在什麼地方？牠在做什麼？

original: You should come, too.
string: 你也應該一起來。

original: Farengar, you need to come at once. A dragon's been sighted nearby.
string: 法仁加，你得馬上過來。附近發現了一頭龍。

original: Farengar!
string: 法仁加！

original: I have the stone tablet you wanted.
string: 我找到了你要的石片。

original: Ah! The Dragonstone of Bleak Falls Barrow! Seems you are a cut above the usual brutes the Jarl sends my way.
string: 啊！荒瀑古墳的龍石！看來你不像是領主之前派給我的那種四肢發達、頭腦簡單的傢伙。

original: Time is running, Farengar, don't forget. This isn't some theoretical question. Dragons have come back.
string: 時間寶貴，法仁加，別忘了。這不是假設性的問題。巨龍回歸了。

original: Yes, yes. Don't worry. Although the chance to see a living dragon up close would be tremendously valuable...
string: 是的，是的。別擔心。不過近距離跟一頭活龍接觸是個很有價值的良機……

original: Oh, have no fear. The Jarl himself has finally taken an interest, so I'm now able to devote most of my time to this research.
string: 哦，別擔心。領主終於感興趣了，因此我現在可以把大部分時間投入到這項研究中去了。

original: Good. I'm glad you're making progress. My employers are anxious to have some tangible answers.
string: 好。很高興你取得了進展。我的雇主很想看到一些實質性的成果。

original: Perhaps dating to just after the Dragon War. If so, I could use this to cross-reference the names with other later texts.
string: 也許可以追溯到巨龍戰爭結束之後。如果是的話，我可以拿來比對裡面出現的名字和其他後期的文獻。

original: You see? The terminology is clearly First Era or even earlier. I'm convinced this is a copy of a much older text.
string: 你看到了嗎？這些術語明顯是第一紀元甚至更早期的。我確信這是一份某個更古老文獻的副本。

original: What did it do? Is it attacking the watchtower?
string: 牠做了什麼？是不是正在襲擊哨塔？

original: Uh... that's right. We saw it coming from the south. It was fast... faster than anything I've ever seen.
string: 呃……沒錯。我們看見牠從南方出現。速度很快……比我以前見過的任何東西都要快。

original: Let's go.
string: 走吧。

original: The pain's a little less than before, but it still hurts bad enough.
string: 疼痛比以前減輕了，但仍然讓人受不了。

original: It's not as bad as before, but I still can't get a good night's sleep.
string: 雖然情況比以前有所好轉，但在晚上還是睡不安穩。

original: I ain't going to lie, it's still pretty bad.
string: 老實跟你講，還是很糟糕。

original: The fever's down a bit, an' I can almost see straight.
string: 高燒退了點，看東西比較清晰了。

original: I still can't hold nothin' down, but it's better than yesterday.
string: 我還是全身無力，但比昨天好多了。

original: My joints ache, I can't eat nothin' and my head feels like a furnace. I've seen better days.
string: 我的全身關節很痛，吃不下東西，頭痛欲裂。看來要完蛋了。

original: I feel better already.
string: 我感覺好多了。

original: Gods bless you, healer.
string: 眾神保佑你，治療者。

original: Thank you. The pain is already easing.
string: 謝謝你。疼痛減輕很多了。

original: I have things I should see to, but go ahead.
string: 我現在有事在身，不過你有什麼事就說吧。

original: Goodbye.
string: 再見。

original: Thanks again for your help.
string: 感謝你的幫助。

original: Where is this secret door?
string: 這扇秘門在哪裡？

original: I'll tell you more about it when we are nearby.
string: 等我們到了之後就告訴你。

original: It's somewhere around here, Agna said to look to the Bear to find the way.
string: 就在這附近，阿格娜說尋找熊的標記就能找到路。

original: We should get after Vals Veran before he does more damage here.
string: 我們要去追上瓦爾斯．威冉，別讓他繼續搞破壞。

original: The glory of killing it is ours, if you're with me!
string: 如果你跟著我，可以盡享殺戮的榮耀！

original: Could you call yourselves Nords if you ran from this monster? Are you going to let me face this thing alone?
string: 如果你們在這隻怪物面前落荒而逃，還敢自稱是諾德人？你們要我獨自一人去面對牠？

original: But it's more than our honor at stake here. Think of it - the first dragon seen in Skyrim since the last age.
string: 但這不僅僅是關於我們榮譽的問題。想想看——這是自上一紀元以來天際省首次出現巨龍。

original: Quickly, follow me!
string: 快點，跟我來！

original: Give my regards to Tonilia. Tell her I'll contact her soon.
string: 請代我問候托尼利亞。告訴她我很快會跟她聯繫的。

original: You'll find Ri'saad with his caravan group. Just don't do anything stupid when you get there.
string: 你會找到瑞．撒德和他的商隊。屆時請別做出什麼傻事。

original: Was there anything else, or is our transaction complete?
string: 還有其他事情嗎，還是我們的交易完成了？

original: Did Ri'saad accept our offer?
string: 瑞．撒德接受我們的提議了嗎？

original: I've struck a deal with Ri'saad.
string: 我跟瑞撒德達成協議了。

original: Good, I'll contact some of my people and have them prepare some shipments right away.
string: 好，我會去聯繫幾個人，叫他們馬上把貨準備好。

original: Good job. Here, let me give you something for all the leg work.
string: 做得好。辛苦你了，這是給你的報酬。

original: Perhaps this will sweeten the deal? (Give satchel)
string: 也許這個對交易有幫助吧？（給予包裹）

original: Ah, Moon Sugar. I could smell it on you. I'm pleased with this offer, and accept.
string: 啊，月糖。我聞到了。我很樂意接受這份工作。

original: Take my word to the leaders of your guild and tell them we look forward to a prosperous and profitable future.
string: 請幫我捎個口信給你們公會的頭兒，告訴他我們對雙方之間的「錢」景充滿期待。

original: If you happen upon any of our caravans in your travels, we'd also be more than willing to pay you a fair sum for any of your stolen goods.
string: 如果你在旅途中有機會遇到我們的其中一支商隊，我們很樂意用不錯的價錢買下你偷來的貨物。

original: I bring an offer from the Thieves Guild.
string: 我帶來了一個來自盜賊公會的提議。

original: Yes, I've heard the Guild is rising back to power. An alliance would be most beneficial to both parties.
string: 嗯，我聽說盜賊公會的勢力漸漸變大了。如果我們雙方結盟的話會是個互惠互利的結果。

original: I'll consider the offer, but I'll have to discuss it with the other caravans.
string: 我會考慮這個提議的，但我要與其他商隊討論一下。

original: You approach as if you know us, stranger. Who are you and what do you want?
string: 你找上門來好像很瞭解我們似的，陌生人。你是誰、有什麼事？

original: Tell me more about these caravans.
string: 告訴我更多有關商隊的事情。

original: Ri'saad is the head of a small syndicate of independent merchant families.
string: 瑞．撒德是獨立商人家族小團體的領袖。

original: Each caravan is obliged to pay dues, but in return a small portion of the profits are shared between them and the leader parcels out the routes.
string: 每支商隊必須支付會費，但相對的商隊與領袖可以獲得貨物所代表利益的一小部分。

original: If we could make contact with them, they could provide an excellent way to inconspicuously transport goods for us.
string: 如果我們與他們取得聯繫，他們可以幫我們秘密地運送貨物。

original: What's Moon Sugar?
string: 什麼是月糖？

original: It's an illegal substance highly favored by the Khajiit. Very difficult to come by.
string: 這是虎人非常喜歡的一種違禁物質。很難找到。

original: If Moon Sugar is refined properly, it can be used to make skooma, another substance that will knock you over after a single draught.
string: 如果把月糖以合適的方式精鍊，它就可以用來合成斯庫瑪，另一種可以一小口就致你於死的物質。

original: You want me to go talk to Ri'saad?
string: 你要我去找瑞．撒德？

original: Actually, I want you to bring him something. You see, the caravans are notorious for transporting illegal substances.
string: 其實，我是要你帶東西給他。你也知道，商隊經常運送違禁物品。

original: Present Ri'saad with this satchel of Moon Sugar, and I bet my last septim he'll make a deal.
string: 把這包月糖拿給瑞．撒德，我敢打賭他會接受這筆交易的。

original: How can I help?
string: 我能做什麼？

original: I'm not sure if you've noticed, but there are several Khajiit Caravans that travel across the realm.
string: 不知道你注意到沒有，有幾支虎人商隊在位面之中穿行。

original: They're shrewd traders and don't mind getting their hands dirty. I've bartered with their leader, Ri'saad, on more than one occasion.
string: 他們這些狡猾的商人，才不介意玷污自己的手腳。我跟他們的首領，瑞．撒德，做過好幾次交易了。

original: Sure, what do you need?
string: 沒問題，什麼事？

original: Well, as you know, the Guild's growing and things are looking up around here.
string: 呃…你也知道，公會正在全面發展，運作也越來越順利。

original: The only thing we're lacking is a reliable way to transport our merchandise across Skyrim.
string: 我們唯一缺少的是把我們的商品流通到天際省各處的可靠手段。

original: Before we get down to business, I've got something I need you to do.
string: 在我們辦正經事之前，我有件事情要你去做。

original: Call upon me if I can be of any service.
string: 有需要我效勞的請儘管開口。

original: Browse as much as you like, please.
string: 請隨便看。

original: Look around all you want, but don't try anything funny.
string: 請隨便看，但不要做傻事。

original: Hey! You planning to steal something? Don't even think about it.
string: 喂！你想偷東西嗎？門都沒有。

original: Why does the town have such a large cemetery?
string: 這鎮上怎麼有一處這麼大的公墓？

original: The cemetery is ancient. It's been here longer than the town.
string: 這是一座古代公墓。它的歷史比小鎮還要久遠。

original: I'm no scholar, but I know that a lot of battles have been fought here over the course of history.
string: 我不是學者，但我知道在歷史上這個地方發生過很多場戰役。

original: After each battle, more dead were buried, and the graveyard got bigger. I've heard it's now the biggest graveyard in Skyrim.
string: 每打一仗，就要掩埋很多死者，墓地就越來越大。我聽說它現在是天際省中最大的墓地。

original: Is this place always so gloomy?
string: 這地方一直都是這麼陰鬱的嗎？

original: Yes, and I couldn't tell you why.
string: 是的，我也說不清楚是為什麼。

original: My wife and I think there's some dark magic at work. Or perhaps Arkay's influence is strong here, and he likes to keep it this way.
string: 我和我妻子都認為有某種黑暗魔法在此運作。又或者是阿爾凱在這裡的影響力很強，而他喜歡這種陰鬱的樣子。

original: Do you tend this graveyard alone?
string: 你一個人維護這個墓地嗎？

original: Oh, merciful Arkay, no! I am too old and frail, and this graveyard is too large.
string: 哦，仁慈的主啊，才不是！我一個老骨頭，怎能自己維護這麼大的一座墓地呢。

original: Kust is my assistant. He helps me tend the headstones and keep our cemetery clean, as befits a place of rest.
string: 卡斯特是我的助手。他幫我打掃墓碑、保持墓地清潔，這樣才會像個逝者安息之地的樣子。

original: Steal anything from my shop, and you'll regret it.
string: 要是敢從我店裡頭偷東西，我讓你吃不了兜著走。

original: Be seein' you, stranger.
string: 後會有期，陌生人。

original: You hear any juicy gossip in town, be sure to share it with me!
string: 如果聽到鎮上有什麼好消息，一定要告訴我！

original: I'll be right here if you need anything else.
string: 如果你需要其他東西，儘管來這裡找我。

original: See me at my forge if you need arms or armor.
string: 如果你需要兵器和盔甲就到我的鐵匠鋪來。

original: Good steel's worth every septim. Remember that.
string: 記住，一分錢一分貨。

original: Life is far too short, my friend. Don't waste it!
string: 朋友，人生苦短，何不及時行樂！

original: We'll all meet Arkay sooner or later. Best to enjoy the time we've got.
string: 我們遲早要上天堂的。須得今朝有酒今朝醉。

original: Good to talk to you.
string: 很高興與你聊天。

original: You'll meet a lot of tongue-wagging gossips in this town. Try not to take them too seriously.
string: 在這個鎮上會聽到各種誇大不實的謠言，不要太當一回事。

original: Mind what you say! The Empire has ears all over this town.
string: 注意你說的話！這個鎮上到處是帝國的耳目。

original: Mark my words, I'll be Jarl again someday!
string: 記住我的話，終有一天我會再次成為領主的！

original: May wisdom forever light your path.
string: 願智慧之光永遠照亮你的前路。

original: Be safe, traveler.
string: 一路保重，旅行者。

original: Don't judge Dengeir too harshly. He is old, but he means well.
string: 別光憑外表就判斷丹格爾的為人。他雖然年紀大，但心地很善良。

original: May your time in Falkreath be pleasant.
string: 祝你在佛克瑞斯過得愉快。

original: Come and see me again sometime. I might have some use for you.
string: 有空再來看看我。我也許能幫得上你的。

original: We're done here, I think.
string: 看來我們在這裡的事情已了。

original: Keep in song in your heart to ward off the gloom.
string: 心中保持樂觀，陰鬱自然消除。

original: Perhaps one day, I'll write a song about you!
string: 也許有一天我會寫一首關於你的歌曲！

original: Aren't you worried about Wolfskull Cave?
string: 你不擔心狼頭骨洞穴嗎？

original: I've done my part, Dragon Bridge will have extra guards. Falk Firebeard will find a way to take care of the cave.
string: 我的事情已經完成了，龍橋鎮會有更多衛兵的。佛可．火鬍會想辦法搞定洞穴的事情。

original: Are you worried about what that petitioner said about Wolfskull Cave?
string: 你在擔心那個請願者提到的有關狼頭骨洞穴的事情嗎？

original: Not really. Varnius Junius is a fool. I'm sure nothing will come of it.
string: 沒有。瓦紐斯．尤尼斯是個蠢貨。我敢肯定不會有什麼事的。

original: I suppose if you're truly interested you could talk to Falk. He's the better-safe-than-sorry type.
string: 如果你真的有興趣，可以去跟佛可談談，他是那種「小心駛得萬年船」類型的人。

original: Please don't interrupt the court.
string: 請不要干擾問政。

original: Court is in session.
string: 法庭正在進行審理。

original: I'm trying to speak to the Jarl.
string: 我想晉見領主。

original: Do you need someone to check out Wolfskull Cave?
string: 你要派人去檢視一下狼頭骨洞穴嗎？

original: Oh, I thought that matter was handled. I think Falk is taking care of that.
string: 哦，我以為那事已經處理好了。佛可正在跟進這事。

original: Good luck. I'm counting on you.
string: 祝你好運。我就指望你了。

original: Taking on Potema won't be easy. But you are the one to do it.
string: 波特瑪這件事不大好處理。但你是最佳人選。

original: Why me?
string: 為什麼是我？

original: I'm not really sure. Styrr thinks you have some sort of link to Potema.
string: 我也不大清楚。斯提爾認為你跟波特瑪有某種聯繫。

original: I trust his judgment on this. As a priest of Arkay he's had to deal with necromancy before. Nothing as dangerous as Potema though.
string: 這件事上我相信他的判斷。作為阿爾凱的祭司他不得不處理有關死靈法術的事情，雖然沒有其他的什麼比波特瑪更危險了。

original: Who is Styrr?
string: 斯提爾是誰？

original: He's Solitude's priest of Arkay. He's the one who figured out Potema was still around. He'll help as much as he can.
string: 他是獨孤城的阿爾凱祭司。正是他發現波特瑪還遊蕩在這個世上。他會儘量幫助你的。

original: I've reconsidered your offer. I'll do it.
string: 我重新考慮了你的提議。我答應你。

original: Excellent.
string: 太好了。

original: Now you die!
string: 受死吧！

original: You should never have come here!
string: 你不該在這裡的！

original: I have your amulet.
string: 我找到你的護身符了。

original: There it is. Ah.... Home....
string: 就是它了。啊……我的家鄉……

original: If you ever need the skills of a Khajiit warrior by your side, I would be honored to travel with you.
string: 如果你需要一個虎人戰士在身邊，我很榮幸能陪伴在你左右。

original: Until then, here. This is for you, in thanks.
string: 那先道別了。這個給你，代表我的謝意。

original: Sorry to hear that.
string: 真叫人感到遺憾。

original: We are used to the cycle of gain and loss. It is no trouble.
string: 人生無常。無所謂了。

original: I could get your amulet back.
string: 我可以找回你的護身符。

original: You are kind to offer. We believe the bandits are a part of a group headquartered here.
string: 你真是太親切了。我們相信那幫強盜就盤踞在這附近。

original: Be careful. I miss my amulet, but a life cannot be replaced as easily.
string: 請小心行事。我失去了護身符，不希望你拿生命來交換。

original: Bandits giving you trouble?
string: 強盜來找你麻煩？

original: A few days ago, we were ambushed. A nuisance, really, but many of the marauders had quick fingers.
string: 幾天前，我們遭到了伏擊。這些人很容易打發，不過他們的手腳很快，見什麼就搶什麼。

original: One of them stole my Moon Amulet, given to me by my mother when I was just a cub. It is my only memory of home in this cold land.
string: 其中一個搶走了我的月亮護身符，那是我母親在我小時候給我的。它是我在這片寒冷的土地上僅存的家鄉回憶。

original: Bandits harass the caravans at every step, but Khajiit usually scare them off.
string: 商隊經常受到強盜的騷擾，但虎人大部分時候都能讓他們打退堂鼓。

original: I have Rjorn's Drum.
string: 我找到了榮恩的戰鼓。

original: At last! I have searched for this drum for 20 years.
string: 終於找到了！我找這面戰鼓都找20年了。

original: The college treasury is a bit thin right now. But I can show you some tricks I learned from my days with the army.
string: 現在學院的經費吃緊，但我可以教你一下以前在軍隊中學到的技巧。

original: Who's Rjorn and why do you want his Drum?
string: 榮恩是誰，為什麼你想要他的戰鼓？

original: You're joking, right? Rjorn? Only the most famous battle drummer of the second age. Well, famous among bards at least.
string: 你在開玩笑嗎？榮恩？他是第二紀元時代最有名的戰鼓手。好吧，至少在吟遊詩人當中非常有名。

original: That drum has been in half a dozen famous battles. It's a priceless artifact.
string: 那面戰鼓曾經在多場著名戰役中出現過。它是一件無價之寶。

original: Rjorn was always looking for new stories to tell. It seems he was writing a lay about Halldir when he vanished. That was the missing clue.
string: 榮恩總是在挖掘新故事。聽說在他失蹤時，他正在撰寫一篇關於霍迪爾的詩歌。那就是消失的線索。

original: What did they find?
string: 他們找到什麼了？

original: Rjorn's drum! Nobody knows where he died, and therefore where his drum might be.
string: 榮恩的戰鼓！沒人知道榮恩死在什麼地方，也不知道他的戰鼓現在位於何方。

original: Halldir was the missing link. Rjorn entered Halldir's Cairn in secret, and presumably died there.
string: 霍迪爾就是消失的線索。榮恩進入了霍迪爾的秘密石塚，因此大家推測他就死在那裡頭。

original: Now all I need to do is find someone to get it. Wait. You. You could do it. I need you to get me that drum.
string: 現在我要做的是找人進到那裡面去。等一下，你，你可以辦到。我希望你去幫我把那面戰鼓找回來。

original: BardsCollegeDrumHello
string: BardsCollegeDrumHello

original: They found it! They actually found it!
string: 他們找到它了！真的找到了！

original: Why would a necromancer want your flute?
string: 為什麼一個死靈術士會要你的長笛？

original: Apparently Larina told him some story about the flute being able to make the dead dance.
string: 顯然勒琳娜告訴了他某種關於長笛可以控制死者的故事。

original: It's just a flute. A really old and valuable flute, but just a flute.
string: 那只是一隻長笛。雖然它既古老又昂貴，但它就只不過是隻長笛而已。

original: I recovered your flute.
string: 我找到了你的長笛。

original: That's it! Wonderful! I knew I could count on you.
string: 就是這個！太好了！我就知道可以相信你。

original: I don't have any money to give you. but I can show you a few tricks I learned playing for the Winterhold wizards.
string: 我沒有錢可以給你，但我可以教你一些我在為冬堡法師演奏時學到的技巧。

original: Who's neck is that?
string: 你在發誰的脾氣？

original: Larina. That fool student of mine stole my flute and sold it to some necromancer.
string: 勒琳娜。那個沒腦子的學生偷了我的長笛，賣給了某個死靈術士。

original: I just got a ransom note for it. That flute has been handed down for seventeen generations!
string: 我為這個長笛懸賞了一筆報酬。那支長笛已經流傳17代了！

original: Well don't just stand there. Go get my flute!
string: 別傻站在這裡啊。去把我的長笛找回來！

original: That damn fool! I should ring her neck!
string: 那個該死的蠢貨！我應該扭斷她的脖子！

original: I've found Finn's Lute.
string: 我找到了芬恩的魯特琴。

original: What? You did? Oh sweet Divines! You did!
string: 什麼？真的？哦，老天爺！你找到了！

original: There is no way I can pay you what this Lute is worth. But I can teach you a few tricks I've learned over the years.
string: 我沒法給你相當於這把琴價值的獎勵，但我可以教你一些多年來我學到的技巧。

original: It makes me sad whenever I think about it.
string: 一想到它我就覺得很難過。

original: What's so important about Finn's Lute?
string: 芬恩的魯特琴很重要嗎？

original: Finn was the bard who invented the eight course lute that is commonplace today.
string: 當代最流行的八弦魯特琴就是吟遊詩人芬恩發明的。

original: Until he found a way to string the extra courses, bards only had six course lutes.
string: 在他成功給魯特琴加上額外的琴弦前，吟遊詩人只能使用六弦的魯特琴。

original: The lute they stole is Finn's original eight course lute. I doubt they even realize its true value.
string: 他們偷的那把魯特琴，是芬恩原裝的八弦魯特琴。我懷疑他們根本不懂這琴的真實價值。

original: Why are you sad?
string: 你為什麼這麼難過？

original: Hmm? Oh, sorry. My mind wanders sometimes. I was just thinking about Finn's Lute.
string: 嗯？哦，不好意思。我有點走神了。我剛才在想著芬恩的魯特琴。

original: Over a year ago, thieves broke into the college and made off with a lot of valuable things. Mostly gold and silver.
string: 一年多以前，一群毛賊闖進了學院，偷走了很多貴重東西，大部分是金銀製品。

original: But they also stole Finn's Lute. We just learned where the bandits fled to, and I very much want that lute back.
string: 但他們也偷走了芬恩的魯特琴。我們剛剛得知那夥毛賊的下落，我很想拿回那把魯特琴。

original: Peace, Galmar.
string: 心平氣和，加爾瑪。

original: You are weak. Sooner you realize it, the sooner we can see the back of you.
string: 你太軟弱了。你越快意識到這一點，我們就能越早擺脫你。

original: Perhaps this would be a good time to get the Dragonborn's input on this matter.
string: 也許現在該讓龍裔發表對於此事的看法。

original: Please. If we have to negotiate the terms of the negotiation, we will never get anywhere.
string: 拜託。如果我們需要談判如何談判，肯定會陷入僵局。

original: She's part of the Imperial delegation. You can't dictate who I bring to this council.
string: 她是帝國代表團的成員。而且我帶誰來參加會議，你管不著。

original: I have every right to be at this negotiation. I need to ensure that nothing is agreed to here that violates the terms of the White-Gold Concordat.
string: 我有權參與這次談判。我要確保這裡達成的協議不會違反白金協定的條款。

original: Diplomatic as usual.
string: 跟以往一樣，又是外交事務。

original: Yes!
string: 是！

original: Hear, hear!
string: 我同意！

original: That didn't take long.
string: 看來沒有用多長時間。

original: Your chief Talos-hunter?
string: 你的首席塔洛斯獵人？

original: No. You insult us by bringing her to this negotiation?
string: 不。你把她帶進這次談判，就為了羞辱我們？

original: I hope that we have all come here in the spirit of...
string: 我希望我們本著……

original: Now that everyone is here, please take your seats so we can begin.
string: 既然大家都在，請就座，然後就可以開始。

original: Yes, my lord.
string: 是的，大人。

original: Besides, Jarl Laila will never agree to...
string: 此外，萊拉領主不會同意……

original: Ulfric, you can't be taking this demand seriously? We can hold Riften against anything the Empire can throw at it.
string: 烏弗瑞克，你不會真的以為我們能滿足這個要求吧？我們守住裂谷城就能抵擋任何來自帝國的攻擊。

original: By Talos, the stones on this one! You're in no position to dictate terms to us, Tullius!
string: 塔洛斯在上！你沒有資格強加條款於我們，圖留斯！

original: This is how the Empire repays us for our loyalty?
string: 這就是帝國報答我們的忠心嗎？

original: How could bears run you out of business?
string: 野熊怎麼會害妳的生意沒得做？

original: Have you ever seen what a bear does to the trees? They jump up on their hind legs and scratch them to bits... marking their territory or something.
string: 你見過一頭熊是怎麼對付樹木的嗎？牠們會跳上去，用後腿把樹皮撕成碎片……給牠們的領地做記號什麼的。

original: It's getting to the point where I have to scour Skyrim for untouched trees at the right size. Costs me too much time and money.
string: 因此我得走遍天際省，尋找沒有被熊碰過、尺寸又合適的樹木。花了我很多時間和金錢。

original: I brought ten bear pelts, just like you asked.
string: 我照妳的要求帶來了10張熊皮。

original: Nice to finally meet someone who can follow simple instructions.
string: 終於見到能按指示辦事的人了。

original: Here's your reward, as promised. Now if you'll excuse me, I have to get back to work.
string: 這是我答應過的報酬。現在我要失陪了，得回去工作。

original: You having a bear problem?
string: 妳遇到熊來找麻煩嗎？

original: Are you kidding? Those damn things will drive me right out of business!
string: 你在說笑嗎？那些該死的熊快要害得我連生意都沒得做了！

original: Tell you what. Bring me ten of their pelts from anywhere in Skyrim I'll gladly pay you for thinning out the herd.
string: 這樣吧，你給我帶來10張熊皮，隨便你從天際省的哪個地方搞來，只要減少這些雜種的數量就行，我會付報酬給你的。

original: She said she'll be home soon.
string: 她說她很快就會回家的。

original: You've made Narfi so happy! Narfi now waits for his sister until she comes home.
string: 你讓納菲很高興！現在納菲要等他的姐姐回家了。

original: At least Narfi has Reyda's Necklace... reminds Narfi of his sister. Thank you for giving this to Narfi.
string: 至少納菲得到了瑞達的項鍊……這樣可以讓納菲想起他的姐姐。謝謝你把這個交給納菲。

original: Sorry Narfi, she's dead.
string: 對不起，納菲，她死了。

original: Oh no! No, no, no. Narfi never got to say goodbye! Now Narfi's all alone.
string: 哦不！不不不。納菲還沒有機會跟他說再見呢！現在納菲只剩自己一個人了。

original: At least Narfi has Reyda's Necklace... reminds Narfi of his sister. Thank you for giving this to Narfi.
string: 至少納菲得到了瑞達的項鍊……這樣可以讓納菲想起他的姐姐。謝謝你把這個交給納菲。

original: Is this her necklace? (Give necklace)
string: 這是她的項鍊嗎？（給予項鍊）

original: Reyda! You saw Reyda? Did you tell her Narfi cries? Did you tell her Narfi never said goodbye like mother and father?
string: 瑞達！你見過瑞達了？有沒有告訴她納菲很孤單？有沒有告訴她納菲沒有機會像爸媽那樣跟她告別？

original: I found Reyda's necklace.
string: 我找到了瑞達的項鍊。

original: Reyda! You saw Reyda? Did you tell her Narfi cries? Did you tell her Narfi never said goodbye like mother and father?
string: 瑞達！你見到瑞達了？有沒有告訴她納菲很孤單？有沒有告訴她納菲從來沒有像爸媽那樣跟她說再見？

original: Anything dangerous on that small island to the east?
string: 東邊那座小島有什麼危險嗎？

original: I've seen some sort of a cave entrance over there. Folks call it "Geirmund's Hall," but I don't know why.
string: 我在那裡看到了像是某個洞穴的入口。當地人都叫它格爾蒙德大廳，但我不知道為什麼。

original: Probably best if you avoid it for now... it didn't seem to do Reyda any good.
string: 或許你還是別去的好……瑞達的下場就是一個很明顯的例子。

original: You told Narfi she's coming back?
string: 你告訴納菲說她姐姐要回來了？

original: I just said that to make the poor guy feel better. I'm pretty sure she's dead.
string: 我這麼說是為了讓那可憐的傢伙好過一點。我很肯定他姐姐已經死了。

original: Reyda would gather ingredients from the small island in the river east of here. Then one day, she just vanished.
string: 瑞達之前經常去那條河東方的小島上採集藥材。突然有一天，她莫名其妙地失蹤了。

original: I tried to look for her, but she never turned up.
string: 我去找過她，但一無所獲。

original: What's the story with Narfi?
string: 能告訴我納菲的事嗎？

original: He's harmless. He's been in a state ever since his sister Reyda disappeared over a year ago.
string: 放心，他不會傷害你的。自從他姐姐瑞達一年多以前失蹤後，他就一直這個樣子了。

original: He just keeps to himself in what's left of his folk's farmhouse across the river.
string: 他一直待在河的對岸，他父母留下的農場裡，很少與外人來往。

original: What's wrong with you?
string: 你怎麼了？

original: With father I said goodbye... with mother I said goodbye. Reyda leaves and Narfi can't say goodbye.
string: 爸爸媽媽出門時我跟他們說再見。但瑞達出門時，我卻沒有跟她說再見。

original: Makes Narfi very, very sad. Narfi needs Reyda to say goodbye.
string: 納菲非常非常傷心。納菲要跟瑞達說再見。

original: Are you okay?
string: 你還好嗎？

original: Reyda was here, then gone. Went to gather plants and never came home... nope, nope.
string: 瑞達以前在我身邊的，後來她走了，去採草藥就沒有再回來……不要，不要。

original: Everyone looked and no one could find her. Wilhelm said she'll be back... told Narfi not to worry... Reyda will come back.
string: 大家都在找她，卻找不到。威爾海姆說她會回來的……叫納菲不要擔心……瑞達會回來的。

original: Well, least I can do is give you something for taking care of him. If you won't accept it as a payment, consider it a gift.
string: 呃……我能做的是給你一些東西，以表示對你幫助他的謝意。如果你認為不想接受報酬，那就把它當作是一件禮物吧。

original: I found this in Shroud Hearth Barrow. (Give journal)
string: 我在覆爐古墳找到了這個。（給予日記）

original: Let me see that!
string: 讓我看看！

original: ...I can't believe this...
string: ……難以置信……

original: It was all just a fabrication of this Wyndelius character? I can't believe we were so stupid.
string: 韋德留斯這個人物完全是捏造出來的？不敢相信，我們以前真是太蠢了。

original: Actually, you need to take a look at this. (Give journal)
string: 其實，你要看看這個。（給予日記）

original: Let me see that!
string: 讓我看看！

original: ...I can't believe this...
string: ……難以置信……

original: It was all just a fabrication of this Wyndelius character? I can't believe we were so stupid.
string: 韋德留斯這個人物完全是捏造出來的？不敢相信，我們以前真是太蠢了。

original: Has anyone ever explored the barrow?
string: 有人探索過覆爐古墳嗎？

original: About a year or two ago, some fella named Wyndelius came through; said he was some kind of a treasure hunter.
string: 一、兩年前，有個名叫韋德留斯的人來過，說他是什麼寶藏獵人。

original: I warned him not to go in there, just like I warned you. The very next night we heard screams from the barrow, and that was it.
string: 我警告他不要去覆爐古墳，就跟我警告你的一樣。第二天晚上我們聽見古墳傳來尖叫聲，就這樣了。

original: We never saw him again.
string: 之後我們再也沒見過他。

original: Sorry, I can't help you.
string: 對不起，幫不了你。

original: Don't blame you one bit.
string: 一點也不怪你。

original: I could investigate for you.
string: 我可以幫你調查。

original: If you think there's anything you can do, be my guest.
string: 如果你認為可以幫忙，請自便。

original: Do the spirits haunt your town as well?
string: 那些鬼魂經常騷擾你們小鎮？

original: Fortunately, they seem to be sticking to the barrow. I think they're guarding it.
string: 好在它們只會在覆爐古墳一帶出沒。我認為它們是在守護那座古墳。

original: Certainly isn't helping my business any; who'd want to rent a room anywhere near a haunted barrow?
string: 當然這對於我的生意沒好處，誰會在一個鬧鬼的古墳附近租個房間來住呢，你說對吧？

original: Tell me more about the barrow.
string: 多跟我說些關於這座古墳的事吧。

original: There ain't much more to tell... they're haunted and you should stay away.
string: 沒什麼好說的……就是鬧鬼而已，你最好不要踏足那個地方。

original: Look, I've seen one of the spirits with my very own eyes. When it glared at me, I swear it burned right through my soul.
string: 我親眼見過其中一個鬼魂。當它的雙眼盯著我的時候，我發誓這種感覺就像全身的靈魂都在灼燒一樣。

original: Malacath has heard my pleas! He speaks to us!
string: 瑪拉凱斯聽到了我的祈禱！他正在回應我們！

original: How long has this been going on?
string: 這個情況持續多久了？

original: Weeks? Longer? It feels like an age has gone by. I haven't slept in so long.
string: 好像有幾周甚至更久時間了吧。我都感覺像是過了一個世紀。好久沒有睡個好覺了。

original: He is quick to anger, and slow to forgive. One who wrongs Malacath is one who will endure great torment in return.
string: 他是個容易發怒、不肯輕易原諒別人的人。誰要是冒犯了瑪拉凱斯，就會惹來無窮無盡的折磨。

original: He demands loyalty and strength from his orcs. We have tried to please him, but he is now angry with us, and so we suffer.
string: 他要求獸人為強壯並且忠誠。我們試圖榮耀他，但現在他對我們只有憤怒，因此我們才會受苦。

original: Who is Malacath?
string: 瑪拉凱斯是誰？

original: You do not know of Malacath? He is the keeper of oaths, the master of curses.
string: 你不知道瑪拉凱斯？他是誓言的守護者、詛咒的主人。

original: You are an Orc, but do not know of Malacath, our master and yours?
string: 你是個獸人，卻不知道我們的主人，同時也是你的主人瑪拉凱斯？

original: Deal with your own curses.
string: 你們自己去解決你們的詛咒吧。

original: We have been on our own for some time now. I fear we will not survive.
string: 我們這段時間一直在努力著。但恐怕我們活不了多久了。

original: I would be honored. Beyond honored to have such a thing here at the College.
string: 這是我的榮幸。在學院這裡擁有這種東西真是太榮幸了。

original: This opens up entire new realms of research for us. Oh, if only Septimus were here to see this!
string: 這個可以為我們打開研究的全新層面。哦，要是塞普汀默斯在這裡見證的話就好了！

original: Thank you. Please, take this. It can't quite compare to an Elder Scroll, but still. You will be remembered for generations for this.
string: 謝謝你。請收下這個。它雖然比不上上古卷軸，但你值得擁有它。你的貢獻將為後世所銘記。

original: Okay, if you don't want it, I'll find someone who does.
string: 好，如果你不要這個，我會給其他想要的人。

original: Wait. Are you... Are you serious?
string: 等一下。你……你不開玩笑？

original: You have an Elder Scroll? You?
string: 你有一份上古卷軸？不會吧？

original: I am serious. It's yours if you want it.
string: 我不開玩笑。是認真的。如果你要就拿去。

original: You... Really? An Elder Scroll?
string: 你……真的嗎？一份上古卷軸？

original: Would you be interested in an Elder Scroll?
string: 你對上古卷軸有興趣嗎？

original: Very funny. Did Enthir put you up to this?
string: 真好笑。是恩希爾叫你這麼做的？

original: Ulfric means war.
string: 烏弗瑞克只想要戰爭。

original: You've returned with my axe. I knew that would be his response.
string: 你帶著我的斧頭回來了。我就知道他會以這種方式回應的。

original: As soon as you left I sent word to General Tullius, who's been kind enough to lend us some of his troops and Legate Cipius here.
string: 你一走，我就帶話給圖留斯將軍，他大方地派了他的一些部隊和塞皮爾斯副官到這裡來。

original: Let Ulfric try to make it past our combined forces.
string: 讓烏弗瑞克會一會我們兩軍聯合。

original: I'll turn you back over to your Legion. Legate Cipius will have use for you. Gods be with us all.
string: 我放你回你的帝國軍去。塞皮爾斯副官還有用得著你的地方。眾神保佑我們。

original: You will be stopped.
string: 會有人阻止你的。

original: Oh? True, I may meet my end in a dark alley with a dagger in my back. But the people have seen the truth, and they will not back down.
string: 什麼？我倒是可能在一個漆黑的小巷子裡被人背後一刀刺死。但人民已經看到了真相，他們不會退縮的。

original: You've killed the High King. Why make war on your own people?
string: 你殺了至高王。為什麼要把你自己的同胞扯進戰爭旋渦？

original: I have shown the people that when our Jarls drink the Empire's milk, it makes us weak.
string: 我已經讓大家明白，當我們的領主接受帝國的小恩小惠時，我們就已經懦弱不堪了。

original: I must now show them the path that will lead us back to our strength.
string: 我現在要指給他們一條路，一條重回富強之路。

original: There is no progress without sacrifice. No wheat without threshing the chaff.
string: 沒有犧牲，何來進步。凡是麥子無不有殼。

original: The Empire and the Jarls who back them must be swept away. The people demand it. I demand it.
string: 必須驅除支持他們的帝國和領主們。這是大家的要求，也是我的要求。

original: We'll be seeing you soon.
string: 我們很快會再見面的。

original: Sooner than you think.
string: 比你想的還要快。

original: (Hand him the axe)
string: （把斧頭交給他）

original: Oh. What's this?
string: 哦。這是什麼？

original: Ahhh... You're quite brave to carry such a message. It's a pity you've chosen the wrong side...
string: 啊……你帶來這個資訊，勇氣可嘉。可惜的是你站錯了陣營……

original: You can return this axe to the man who sent it. And tell him he should prepare to entertain... visitors.
string: 你可以把這把斧頭送回原來的主人。告訴他作好準備招呼……客人們吧。

original: I expect a great deal of excitement in the city of Whiterun in the near future...
string: 我期待不久的將來在白漫城中會在一大堆激動人心的事情發生……

original: I've brought a message from the Jarl of Whiterun.
string: 我帶來了白漫城領主的訊息。

original: Is that so? I've been wondering when he'd come around.
string: 是這樣嗎？我一直在猜測他什麼時候會出面。

original: Then I was wrong about him.
string: 那我看錯他了。

original: The Jarl of Whiterun returns your axe.
string: 白漫城領主歸還了你的斧頭。

original: It's time to decide.
string: 現在該作出決定了。

original: Yes, to General Tullius.
string: 對，寫給圖留斯將軍。

original: I need to make a few things clear before I accept these Legionnaires of his.
string: 在我接受他的這些帝國士兵之前，得搞清楚幾件事情。

original: Are we writing a letter, Lord?
string: 我們要寫一封信嗎，大人？

original: Proventus. Bring me my pen. And the good parchment.
string: 普羅萬圖斯。把我的筆拿來，還有上好的羊皮紙。

original: Understood.
string: 瞭解了。

original: Good.
string: 很好。

original: Good...
Should I say anything to him?
string: 我要對他說什麼？

original: Men who understand one another need not waste words.
string: 互相理解的兩個人之間不需要言語來溝通。

original: There are but a few simple truths behind one warrior giving another his axe.
string: 一個戰士把他的斧頭交給另一個人，其背後只有一些簡單的原因。

original: Ulfric will know my meaning.
string: 烏弗瑞克會明白我的意思的。

original: An axe?
string: 一把斧頭？

original: How long have you been in Skyrim? Yes. Give the man my axe.
string: 你來天際省多久了？沒錯，正是把我的斧頭交給那個人。

original: If he returns it to you it means we have business to settle. If he keeps it, then we are at peace.
string: 如果他把斧頭送回來，表示我們有恩怨要解決。如果他收下，表示我們相安無事。

original: You have a task for me?
string: 你有一個任務要給我？

original: One moment. But don't go far. I expect I'll need you.
string: 請稍等。但不要走遠。我需要你。

original: I've made up my mind, even if my advisors are still squabbling. I'm sending you to Windhelm.
string: 我決定了，即使我的顧問們還在爭吵不休，我還是打算派你去風舵城。

original: Deliver this axe to Ulfric Stormcloak.
string: 把這把斧頭送去給烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷。

original: You can return this axe to our friend. The esteemed Jarl of Windhelm has my answer. Make sure he gets it.
string: 你可以把這把斧頭送回給我們的朋友，作為對尊敬的風舵城領主的回答。一定要送到他手上。

original: You there.
string: 喂，至於你。

original: I have a message for you to deliver to our friend, the esteemed Jarl of Windhelm.
string: 我要你幫我送一個資訊給我們的朋友 - 尊敬的風舵城領主。

original: So about this axe...
string: 那麼這把斧頭……

original: Finally.
string: 終於。

original: Oh, he's serious. But so am I.
string: 哦，他是認真的，我也是。

original: Lord, wait. Let us see if Ulfric is serious.
string: 大人，等一下。我們要看看烏弗瑞克是不是認真的。

original: Damnit! This isn't about gold!
string: 該死！這不是金錢的問題！

original: The chests of gold didn't hurt.
string: 收到幾箱金幣肯定沒壞處。

original: This again?! That was different. Was I given a chance to object to the terms of the treaty? No.
string: 又是這個？！那情況不一樣。我有機會反對協議的條款嗎？沒有。

original: The Jarls weren't asked. We were told. And we had to like it.
string: 領主們收到的不是請求，而是命令。我們被迫接受。

original: This again?! That was different. Was Balgruuf given a chance to object? No. The Jarls weren't asked. He was told. And he had to like it.
string: 又是這個？！那情況不一樣。巴爾古夫有機會反對協議的條款嗎？沒有。領主們收到的不是請求，而是命令。他被迫接受。

original: Was it cowardly then to accept the White-Gold Concordat?
string: 接受白金協定是懦夫的行為嗎？

original: It seems cowardly.
string: 看起來是懦夫的行為。

original: And what harm is there in letting a few legionnaires die in place of your own men?
string: 那麼讓幾個軍團士兵代你自己的手下去送死，有什麼損失？

original: But, Proventus has a point. Ulfric has made it clear. In his mind, to refuse his claim is to side with the Empire.
string: 但是，普羅萬圖斯說的對。烏弗瑞克表達得很清楚，在他看來，拒絕服從於他就是與帝國為伍。

original: Ulfric is the one who has offended.
string: 侵犯他人者正是烏弗瑞克。

original: Then might I urge you to consider General Tullius's request? I mean, if you are bent on offending Jarl Ulfric...
string: 那麼能否請你考慮一下圖留斯將軍的請求？我是說，如果你決意要得罪烏弗瑞克領主的話……

original: True. He's already proven his personal strength. Now he seeks to prove his army's.
string: 對。他已經證明了自己的個人力量。現在他想證明他軍隊的力量。

original: I'm not the High King, but neither am I a boy.
string: 我不是至高王，但我也不是個小孩子。

original: If Ulfric wants to challenge my rule in the old way, let him.
string: 如果烏弗瑞克要以傳統方式來挑戰我的統治地位，叫他放馬過來。

original: Though I suspect he'll prefer to send his "Stormcloaks" to do it for him.
string: 不過我懷疑他更願意派他的「風暴斗篷」來做這件事情。

original: That "boy" was High King of Skyrim.
string: 那個「男孩」曾經是天際省至高王。

original: Torygg? He simply walked up to the boy and murdered him!
string: 托依格？他只是簡單地從背後殺了那個男孩而已！

original: He was rather straight forward with Torygg.
string: 他處理托依格可是相當直接了當。

original: He'll do no such thing!
string: 他不會做這種事情的！

original: He'll do no such thing! A dagger in the back is all you could expect!
string: 他不會做這種事情的！只有你才會從背後攻擊！

original: It's time to act.
string: 現在該行動了。

original: I'm not a fool, Proventus. I mean it's time to challenge Ulfric to face me as a man, or to declare his intentions.
string: 我不是傻瓜，普羅萬圖斯。我的意思是現在該讓烏弗瑞克像個男人一樣接受我的挑戰，或者至少他必須公開自己的意圖了。

original: I'm not a fool, Proventus. I mean it's time to challenge Ulfric to face me as a man, or march his Stormcloaks up to the gates.
string: 我不是傻瓜，普羅萬圖斯。我的意思是現在該讓烏弗瑞克像個男人一樣接受我的挑戰，或者讓他的風暴斗篷作好攻城拔寨的準備了。

original: You plan to march on Windhelm?
string: 你打算進軍風舵城？

original: I'm of a mind with Irileth.
string: 我與伊瑞萊斯的意見一致。

original: Prey waits.
string: 獵物才會等。

original: As in all things, Lord, caution... I urge us to wait and see.
string: 大人，萬事須得謹慎……我建議你靜觀其變。

original: Proventus, what do you make of all this? If Ulfric were to attack Whiterun...
string: 普羅萬圖斯，你怎麼看這局勢？如果烏弗瑞克要進攻白漫……

original: Now, I believe you have some business to conclude with my court wizard?
string: 現在，相信你有什麼事情要找我的宮廷法師吧？

original: Now get out of here and to the outpost! I need to know what's happening out there.
string: 現在動身去前哨站吧！我想瞭解那裡發生的事情。

original: Hmm... these are interesting reports...
string: 嗯……這些報告很有意思……

original: I was given strict instructions. For the Jarl's eyes only.
string: 我有嚴令在身，只能給領主一個人過目。

original: Don't be daft. Proventus is my eyes.
string: 別傻了，普羅萬圖斯是我的代表。

original: Just give me the letter. I presume once I have it, I can do as I please with it? Good.
string: 把信給我。我想一旦拿到這封信，怎麼處理它都可以吧？好。

original: Ulfric plans to attack Whiterun. The General wants to lend Legion troops.
string: 烏弗瑞克打算進攻白漫城。將軍想借你軍團部隊。

original: Until that dragon's dealt with, I don't care what Tullius wants.
string: 沒有搞定那頭龍，我才沒空管你圖留斯的事情。

original: For now, give the papers to my Steward.
string: 先把文書交給我的總管吧。

original: I see... Give the papers to my Steward.
string: 我明白了……把文書交給我的總管吧。

original: But until that dragon's dealt with, Ulfric's just going to have to wait.
string: 但我得先搞定那頭龍的問題，烏弗瑞克的事情得放在一邊了。

original: For now, I'll hold onto this axe. But it's a tenuous peace at best.
string: 我暫時先收下這把斧頭吧。但這只代表雙方暫時的和平。

original: I suppose it's time I give him an answer...
string: 我想現在該給他一個答覆了……

original: I have an important message for you.
string: 我有一個重要口信給你。

original: No doubt requesting to garrison his men in my castle. How many times must I deny him?
string: 一定又是請求在我的城堡裡駐紮他的手下。這傢伙到底要我拒絕多少次？

original: Well? Out with it.
string: 怎樣？快說啊。

original: I have an important message from General Tullius.
string: 我有一份來自圖留斯將軍的重要密件給你。

original: We can talk about that once this dragon is dealt with.
string: 等我們處理了這頭龍的問題再說吧。

original: About that message from the General...
string: 關於那個來自將軍的口信……

original: Ah yes. I've studied those documents... Very interesting...
string: 啊，對了。我一直在研究那些文件……很有意思……

original: About that message from the General...
string: 關於那個來自將軍的口信……

original: Did he now? The man is persistent, I'll give him that.
string: 又是他？只能說，這傢伙太有毅力了。

original: Jarl Ulfric Stormcloak asked me to deliver this axe to you.
string: 烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷領主要我把這個斧頭給你。

original: We can talk about that once this dragon is dealt with.
string: 等我們處理了這頭龍的問題再說吧。

original: About that message from Ulfric...
string: 關於那個來自烏弗瑞克的口信……

original: Ah yes.
string: 啊，是了。

original: I suppose it's time I gave him an answer...
string: 我想現在該給他一個答覆了……

original: About that message from the Jarl...
string: 關於那個來自領主的口信……

original: Well he don't like company, I can tell you that much. Just wants to be left alone. But no... that's not really it.
string: 我告訴你，他不喜歡有人陪伴，只想一個人獨處。不過不是……不是這樣的。

original: It's like... he wants to talk. Likes people and all. But he stays separate, because he's supposed to.
string: 就像是……他想與人交流。跟其他人一樣。但他總是獨處，因為他必須這樣。

original: Kind of sad, really.
string: 聽起來有點悲傷。

original: What do you know about the Orc?
string: 你對獸人的事情瞭解多少？

original: You see any other inns around here? Where else would I go to drink?
string: 你看到這附近有其他酒館嗎？我還能去哪裡喝酒？

original: Do you come here a lot?
string: 你經常來這裡嗎？

original: Anything you need, just holler.
string: 你要什麼儘管吩咐。

original: Sure, walk away. I wasn't talking or anything...
string: 當然，走開吧。我不想跟人聊天……

original: Him? Oh... Ah, name's Balablob or Malaclob, one of them funny Orc names. Talks real good, though. Not a savage at all.
string: 他？哦……啊，叫什麼巴拉布羅或者馬拉柯洛什麼的，跟其他搞笑的獸人族名字一樣。不過他談吐很得體，根本不像是個野蠻人。

original: Said he's a writer. Don't know what kind of job that is, but it must earn him some pretty coin. He's paid up for the next few months.
string: 他自稱是個作家。不知道這是哪門子工作，但肯定靠這個賺了很多錢。他還付了接下來幾個月的租金。

original: He mostly just hangs about. Goes down to the lake, sometimes samples the stores of wine in the cellar. Man can do whatever he pleases, far as I care.
string: 大部分時間他都在閒逛，去小湖那裡，有時會去取一些地窖裡的啤酒樣品。像他那種人，逍遙自在的，想做什麼就做什麼。

original: Tell me about the Orc.
string: 告訴我關於那個獸人的事情。

original: This old place? Been here forever. Built by my great grandda. Run by him, then all the way up the line to me.
string: 你說這個老地方嗎？一直就在這裡的。由我的曾祖父建造和經營，然後一直傳到我手裡。

original: What can you tell me about the inn?
string: 你可以告訴我有關這間酒館的事嗎？

original: NightgateHadringBusinessBranchTopic
string: NightgateHadringBusinessBranchTopic

original: Nah, not so much. The odd traveler on the road. But mostly just old Fultheim, come to drink away a lifetime of bad memories, I'd wager.
string: 不，沒多少客人。一般是路過的旅人。常客只有借酒消愁的老弗瑟姆。

original: Course there's the Orc. Long-term tenant, that one. For what he pays, I could afford to shut this place down.
string: 還有那個獸人。他是長期租客，付的錢足夠我關門回家養老了。

original: Do you get a lot of business?
string: 你的生意很不錯吧？

original: Keep your eyes open in the barrow... that's how they get you!
string: 到了覆爐古墳時要打醒十二分精神……一不小心就會丟了性命！

original: If you're headed up to the monastery, watch your step... it's a long way down.
string: 如果你要去修道院，路上要小心……這一趟遠著呢。

original: If you pass through again, stop by for a drink.
string: 下次路過的話順便來喝杯酒。

original: A pleasant journey, milord.
string: 一路順風，先生。

original: A pleasant journey, milady.
string: 一路順風，女士。

original: Just get out of town as fast as you can. Nothing for anyone here.
string: 儘快出城去吧，這裡沒什麼好待的。

original: Sure, leave. Everyone else does.
string: 當然，離開吧。誰也不想待在這裡。

original: I wish I could go with you...
string: 我想能和你一起走……

original: Narfi so happy! So happy! So happy!
string: 納菲很高興！很高興！很高興！

original: The mountain will eat you! Watch the mountain!
string: 那座山會吞沒你的！千萬要小心！

original: If you see Reyda, tell her that Narfi misses her and to come home soon... very soon. Soon... soon, like the moon!
string: 如果你看見瑞達，跟她說納菲很想念她，快點回來……常回家看看，常回家看看！

original: Reyda! Reyyyyda!
string: 瑞達！瑞～達！

original: Hmph. What a boring conversation.
string: 哼。真是場乏味的對話。

original: Thanks again for the legwork.
string: 再次感謝你幫我跑腿。

original: Be careful up there.
string: 路上小心。

original: Welp, time to gather more supplies I guess.
string: 那麼，該去準備好充分的補給了。

original: If you get a chance, kill a few more bears for me, will you?
string: 有機會幫我多殺幾頭野熊，可以嗎？

original: Now go give those stupid bears what's coming to them!
string: 現在去收拾那些可惡的野熊吧！

original: Just get out of my way, I've got work to do.
string: 別妨礙我，我有工作要做。

original: Have yourself a great day!
string: 祝你今天過得愉快！

original: Anything I should watch out for during the climb?
string: 在攀爬時我該注意什麼？

original: Well, there's the occasional wolf pack or stray, but that's all I've ever had to deal with. Shouldn't be a problem for the likes of you.
string: 呃…偶爾會有野狼出現，不過我都能應付，更不用說你了。

original: Other than that, watch your footing. In these wintry conditions, the stairs can be treacherous.
string: 除此之外，注意腳下。在這種冬天，臺階會打滑。

original: I delivered the supplies to High Hrothgar.
string: 我把補給送到高吼峰了。

original: Quite a climb, wasn't it?
string: 這一趟爬得夠嗆吧？

original: Anyway, much appreciated. Here, take this for your troubles.
string: 不管怎麼說，非常感謝。這是你的酬勞。

original: Sorry, I can't help you with that.
string: 對不起，我不能幫你。

original: Maybe I'll hold off and go another day. Get some rest first.
string: 那我改天再去吧。先休息一下。

original: I could do it for you.
string: 我可以幫你。

original: Really? That would be kind of you.
string: 真的？你真是太好了。

original: Here, take this bag of supplies. At the top of the steps you'll see the offering chest. Just leave the bag inside and you're done.
string: 拿著這袋補給品。爬到頂上後有個捐贈箱，把東西放進去就行了。

original: And in return?
string: 那他們以什麼作為回報？

original: Well, it's kind of an understanding between us. I mean, it just wouldn't feel right to charge them for a bit of preserved food.
string: 呃……這算是我們之間的某種默契。我的意思是，送給他們一點備用食物就收錢的話，總感覺不大好。

original: Trouble is, my legs aren't what they used to be and climbing the 7,000 Steps takes its toll.
string: 問題是，我的腿已經大不如以前。長久以來爬那七千台階，如今它們開始吃不消了。

original: What types of deliveries do you make to High Hrothgar?
string: 你都往高吼峰送什麼東西？

original: Mostly food supplies like dried fish and salted meats; you know, things that keep fresh for a long time.
string: 大部分是食物，比如魚乾和醃肉。就是那種可以長期保存的東西。

original: The Greybeards tend not to get out much, if you catch my meaning.
string: 灰鬍子不怎麼出來見人，你懂的。

original: What does it mean to be a Companion?
string: 加入戰友團意味著什麼？

original: It means living such that your Shield-Siblings would proudly say they fought at your side.
string: 那意味著你的盾友們可以自豪地說他們和你並肩戰鬥。

original: Glory in battle, honor in life.
string: 戰鬥的榮譽，生命的尊嚴。

original: Deal with problems head on. Leave whispers and sneaking to the gutter rats who can't fight for themselves.
string: 處理好眼前的問題。不用去管那些膽小如鼠、無法自保的傢伙們。

original: I wish more of our ranks asked such questions.
string: 真希望我們的人可以多問這樣的問題。

original: I've started seeing the Companions as a kind of family.
string: 我已經開始把戰友團的人視為家人了。

original: I've battled next to every man and woman here, and the bonds of sweat are stronger than those of blood.
string: 我和這裡的兄弟姐妹們並肩作戰，這種關係比血緣關係更緊密。

original: I would trust anyone here with my life, which is more than I'd say for the milk drinkers who raised me.
string: 我會全心全意信任這裡每一位戰友，超過那些生我養我的懦夫們。

original: It means resting your haunches in Whiterun more than I'd care to, for one.
string: 就是說我不介意你跑到白漫城去找樂子。

original: But when it's time to draw blood, there's no one in Skyrim I'd rather have at my back.
string: 但是踏上戰場時，我希望我們能夠一起灑熱血。

original: It means waking up every day knowing that you could die, and having to earn your life by clawing for every breath.
string: 這也意味著當你每天醒來時都知道自己可能會死，必須竭盡所能地活下去。

original: I don't know how those cozy lords manage to drag themselves out of bed every day. Why bother if you're not living?
string: 我不知道那些安逸的領主們每天是怎麼從舒適的床上爬起來的。那樣活著有什麼意思？

original: I've never been a smart one. But the Companions welcome anyone with the heart of a warrior.
string: 我不是什麼聰明人。但是戰友團歡迎內心渴望成為戰士的人。

original: When we step into battle, we fight for our own name, and the name of the Companions.
string: 當我們踏入戰場之時，我們為自己和戰友團的榮譽而戰。

original: There's been a group called the Companions for over 4000 years. It's been many different things in that time.
string: 管它外面怎麼天翻地覆，戰友團已經屹立了四千年了。

original: A conquering army. Ruthless mercenaries. A band of drunken louts. And the esteemed company you see before you.
string: 這是一支常勝之軍，一隊冷酷無情的傭兵，一群酒鬼。這就是你面前的這個受人尊敬的組織。

original: But there's always been a kind of honor to it. We don't deal in politics or underhanded sneaking.
string: 但總是有一種榮耀伴隨其中。因為我們不搞齷齪的政治或者卑鄙的小手段。

original: We try to uphold the legacy of Ysgramor. To bear his good name such that it never be forgotten, and always be spoken with reverence.
string: 我們努力維護伊斯格拉謨的名譽，繼承他的遺志，使之不會被人遺忘，在人們提起他時總會心存敬畏。

original: It means signing on for the Nord ideas of how to live your life. Honor, battle, glory, all that.
string: 這意味著接受諾德人的生活原則，包括尊嚴、戰鬥和榮譽。

original: "Even an elf can be born with the heart of a Nord," Skjor said when I joined. I think he meant it as a compliment.
string: 在我加入時，斯科約爾說：「連一個精靈也可以生來就具有諾德之心」。我認為這是對我的讚揚。

original: To me, it means not having to answer foolish questions a second time.
string: 對於我，那意味著遇到蠢問題時不必再回答第二次了。

original: Just because you've been accepted here so quickly, don't think I'm going to help you rise any faster.
string: 就算你很快地就被接受，但不表示我會幫你繼續往上爬。

original: Fight well, don't be a lout, and you'll be fine. You don't need my help.
string: 好好戰鬥，不魯莽行事，你就能混得不錯。你不需要我的幫助。

original: So much.
string: 意義可多了。

original: This group... this family... this band... this is the best thing I've ever been a part of.
string: 這樣一個組織……這樣一個大家庭……這樣一個團體……是我參與過的最好的。

original: The oldest fighting group in Skyrim, and nothing but glory from Ysgramor's day to our own.
string: 天際省最古老的戰鬥組織，從伊斯格拉謨時代至今，除了榮耀，別無其他。

original: To be counted in that line is a bit of immortality. Even if I never see Sovngarde, I'll have that much.
string: 成為其中一員就是一種無上的榮譽。即使我無緣英靈殿，這已經足夠了。

original: It means when I have troubles, I always have someone on my side.
string: 意思是當我身陷危險之時，總有人陪伴在我左右。

original: We have Shield-Siblings to keep our backs as dangerous as our fronts.
string: 我們有盾友一同出生入死、共渡艱難險阻。

original: I think.
string: 我認為是這樣的。

original: My advice? Don't overthink it. Fight well and the rest takes care of itself.
string: 我建議你別想太多。好好戰鬥，其他的就順其自然。

original: What's it like being a werewolf?
string: 變成狼人是什麼感覺？

original: How did you... you reach beyond your station, new blood. Let's wait and see how we judge your Trial before speaking further.
string: 你怎麼……這不是你該討論的話題，新人。等我們看看你的試鍊結果後再說吧。

original: You shouldn't even know about that. Remember you're not a full Companion yet, whelp. Know your place.
string: 你不該知道這個事情。記住，你還不是一個正式的戰友團成員，新人。要有自知之明。

original: What did I tell you? Keep quiet about that.
string: 我是怎麼跟你說的？不要提起這個。

original: I think there are some things that... oh, wait. Are you trying to trick me? You are not a full-blood yet. We can't talk about that.
string: 我想有些事情……哦，等等。你想耍我嗎？你還不是正式成員，我們不能討論這個話題。

original: We should not be talking about that.
string: 我們不能談論這個。

original: I don't know what you're talking about. But if I were you, I'd hold my tongue.
string: 我不知道你在說什麼？建議你不要亂說話。

original: I don't know who you've been talking to, but they were clearly mistaken.
string: 我不知道你和誰談過，但是他們說的明顯搞錯了。

original: Especially for a new whelp, you should choose your words more carefully.
string: 尤其是你這樣一個新人，更應該注意一下措辭。

original: For me, a heavy burden.
string: 對我來說是一副重擔。

original: The beastblood has given me prowess, but my soul is now forfeit to Hircine upon my death.
string: 野獸之血給了我力量，但現在我的靈魂喪失了死後去到海爾辛身邊的資格。

original: I keep searching for some hope of Sovngarde, but to no avail.
string: 我一直在尋找英靈殿，但是一無所獲。

original: A sensitive question. You may want to be careful broaching that subject with some.
string: 這是個敏感的問題。你跟別人提起這個話題的時候不可以亂說。

original: The old man and I have our differences when it comes to this. It's a blessing, given by Hircine.
string: 提到這件事情的時候，老頭子和我的意見不同。這是海爾辛賦予的一個賜福。

original: To worry about the hereafter means losing sight of the now.
string: 擔心將來意味著忽視現在。

original: What do I care about Sovngarde? Give me the power to tear my foes as a beast of the wild, and I will savor it.
string: 我要英靈殿做什麼？因為它可以給我力量，像野獸一樣撕碎我的仇敵，而我將會享受這種快感。

original: I was raised in the woods. Hunting every animal I could see, with my father. I know them all as well as I know my own mind.
string: 我是森林中長大的。與我父親一道狩獵各種動物。我對它們瞭若指掌，就像對自己的想法瞭若指掌一樣。

original: And when I feel myself filling with the blood of the wolf... it's like I'm bringing all the strength of all the beasts inside me.
string: 而當我感覺自己體內狼血沸騰之時……就像是獲得了所有野獸的力量一樣。

original: But my mind and soul remain my own. I become more than either human or beast.
string: 但是我的意識和靈魂仍然是自己的。我成了超越人類或者野獸的人。

original: It's like being born. Every time.
string: 每次都像是獲得了新生一樣。

original: I've enjoyed the boons that come with beastblood. Just like every member of the Circle.
string: 我很享受野獸之血帶來的好處，就像圓環的其他成員一樣。

original: Kodlak is right, though. We've given a piece of our souls for this power. I know my mythic histories. Bargains like that lead to ruin.
string: 不過克拉科對於這方面的看法是對的。我們在得到這份力量的同時，也失去了一部分自己的靈魂。我知道我的神話歷史。這樣的「靈魂交易」只會帶來毀滅。

original: This is a curse that was laid upon us. That much is clear.
string: 這顯然是對我們的一個詛咒。

original: I like being stronger when I become the wolf. But Kodlak says it is bad for the soul, and I trust him.
string: 我喜歡變成狼人時的強大力量。但是克拉科說這樣有損我們的靈魂，我相信他。

original: Family and honor. That's what it means to be one of us, boy.
string: 成為我們的一員就意味著加入這個大家庭，共同分享榮譽，小子。

original: Family and honor. That's what it means to be one of us, girl.
string: 成為我們的一員就意味著加入這個大家庭，共同分享榮譽，姑娘。

original: Why did you join the Companions?
string: 你為什麼加入戰友團？

original: I learned the ways of the blade in the Great War. Nearly lost my life outside the Imperial City.
string: 我在浩大戰爭中學會了劍術。但還是在帝都外差點送了命。

original: I came home to Skyrim when it was all over. But I wasn't much good at anything other than fighting.
string: 當一切結束之時我回到天際省的家。但我發現自己不適合戰鬥以外的生活。

original: Wandered around as a blade for hire. Was a damned good one, too.
string: 於是當傭兵四處跑，也混得相當不錯。

original: The money was good, and the women were good, and the drinks were good. But I was losing myself. My heart.
string: 錢是好東西，女人是好東西，酒也是好東西。但在紙醉金迷之中，我迷失了自己，迷失了我的心。

original: I was lucky the Companions found me. Now there's a reason to be fighting. The honor of my brothers and sisters is worth more than coin.
string: 很幸運戰友團找到了我。現在我有了戰鬥的理由。戰友團兄弟姐妹們的榮譽更勝過金錢。

original: Of course, the money is still good. And the drinks!
string: 當然，錢和酒仍然是好東西！

original: My mother was a Companion. And her mother. And all the women in my family, back to Hrotti Blackblade.
string: 我的母親也是一名戰友團成員，她母親也是。甚至我家族從霍蒂．黑刃時代至今的所有女性都是。

original: I stayed with my father in the woods until I was old enough for my Trial. We hunted everything there was to hunt.
string: 我和父親一起在森林中狩獵，直到我的年齡達到試練要求。我們獵遍了所有可能的獵物。

original: Good training.
string: 那是很有用的訓練。

original: Ma didn't live long enough to see me join, but I fight to honor her and all my Shield-Sisters through time.
string: 我母親沒能活到我加入戰友團的那一天，但是我為她的榮譽，以及所有盾友的榮譽而戰。

original: Vilkas and I have been here since we were little whelps.
string: 威爾卡斯和我從小時候就在這裡了。

original: Our father, Jergen, raised us here.
string: 我們的父親傑根在這裡把我們撫養長大。

original: Even Vignar couldn't remember Companions younger than us!
string: 甚至維吉納對戰友團的記憶都沒有我們那麼早！

original: To hear Farkas tell it, our father raised us here as happy pups, running around biting knees.
string: 聽法卡斯說，父親在我們很小的時候就把我們帶到這裡來，我們倆就像小乳狗一樣在大人的膝蓋間亂跑。

original: I love my brother, but his brains are not his strong suit.
string: 我愛我的兄弟，但是他頭腦不大靈光。

original: We were brought here by Jergen. Whether he was our father or not, I don't care.
string: 傑根把我們帶到這裡。不管他是不是我們的親生父親都無所謂。

original: He left to fight in the Great War and never came back. So he's not my problem anymore.
string: 他離開去參加浩大戰爭，再也沒有回來。因此他已經完全從我的生命中消失了。

original: We've been here as long as either of us can remember, though. So try to show some respect.
string: 不過我們從懂事時起就在這裡了。因此請放尊重一點。

original: Like most of our band, I found this family after losing my own.
