original: The Empire will pay appropriate compensation for the massacre at Barleydark Farm.
string: 帝國會為黑麥農場的屠殺支付適當的補償。

original: The Empire will pay appropriate compensation for the massacre at Riverwood.
string: 帝國會為河木鎮的屠殺支付適當的補償。

original: The Empire will pay appropriate compensation for the massacre at Rorikstead.
string: 帝國會為洛利克鎮的屠殺支付適當的賠償。

original: The Empire will pay appropriate compensation for the massacre at Karthwasten.
string: 帝國會為西卡斯鎮的屠殺支付適當的賠償。

original: The Empire will pay appropriate compensation for the massacre at Old Hroldan.
string: 帝國會為古赫洛登的屠殺支付適當的賠償。

original: The Empire will pay appropriate compensation for the massacre at Kolskeggr Mine.
string: 帝國會為科斯凱格礦坑的屠殺支付適當的賠償。

original: The Empire will pay appropriate compensation for the massacre at Stonehills.
string: 帝國會為石山的屠殺支付適當的賠償。

original: The Empire will pay appropriate compensation for the massacre at Frost River Farm.
string: 帝國會為霜河農場的屠殺支付適當的賠償。

original: The Empire will pay appropriate compensation for the massacre at Granite Hill.
string: 帝國會為格蘭尼特山的屠殺支付適當的賠償。

original: It seems we may have an agreement.
string: 看來達成共識了。

original: This here's Rorikstead. Quiet place. Good people, though. You can get a room and a mug at the Frostfruit Inn if you care to stay.
string: 這裡是洛利克鎮。安靜詳和，民風淳樸。要是想待一陣子，可以到霜果客棧落腳，喝上一杯。

original: That's the Honningbrew Meadery. Supposed to be a big rivalry between them and the Black-Briars of Riften.
string: 那是蜜之釀酒莊。他們好像和裂谷城的黑棘有著激烈的競爭關係。

original: Remember when that used to be the Honningbrew Meadery? Didn't stand a chance against those Black-Briars of Riften.
string: 還記得那裡曾經是蜜之釀酒莊嗎？在與黑棘的競爭中一敗塗地，就這麼垮了。

original: This is Karthwasten. Mining town. I hear they've had a lot of trouble with the Forsworn.
string: 這是礦業之城西卡斯鎮。聽說他們飽受棄誓者的騷擾。

original: This here's the Darkwater. Comes down from Lake Honrich into the White River, a few miles downstream. Good fishing, I hear.
string: 這裡是黑水河，源自霍利奇湖，下游幾英里處匯入白河。聽說是個垂釣聖地。

original: Morthal, capital of Hjaalmarch hold. Not quite in the same league as Solitude or Whiterun, but a nice enough place if you like swamps.
string: 墨索爾城，希雅陲領的首都。跟獨孤城或白漫城相比不在同一檔次，但如果你喜歡沼澤的話，它還算是一塊寶地。

original: Here we are. Dawnstar. Capital of the Pale. Don't get up this way much. Beautiful country though.
string: 這是晨星城，蒼原的首府。別抱太多的期望。儘管它是個美麗的城市。

original: I can't say I've been to Winterhold more than a handful of times. Can't see much reason most honest folk would want to come up here.
string: 我到過冬堡的次數屈指可數。搞不明白為什麼很多老實人會想來這裡。

original: Well, this is Falkreath. Not much to look at if you're used to the bigger cities, but the folk here are friendly enough if you give them a chance.
string: 啊，這就是佛克瑞斯了。你要是住慣了大城市的話這裡就沒什麼可看的了，但是你稍微一接觸，就會發現這裡的百姓很友善。

original: The Braidwood Inn's up that way. I know the innkeeper - Iddra. Nice lady.
string: 辮枝客棧在路的盡頭。我認識店老闆，伊德拉。她人很不錯。

original: Shor's Stone - pissant little town, not even an inn. Just a bunch of miners scratching in the dirt.
string: 朔爾之石，沒落的小鎮，甚至連個旅館都沒有。就有一大幫礦工在塵土中亂刨。

original: I'm a Thane? What does that mean?
string: 我是個武衛？什麼意思？

original: The Jarl has recognized you as a person of great importance in the hold. A hero.
string: 領主視你為領地中的重要人物。一個英雄。

original: The title of Thane is an honor, a gift for your service. Guards will know to look the other way, if you tell them who you are.
string: 武衛的稱號是種榮耀，對你所作貢獻的嘉獎。衛兵要是得知你是武衛，他們對你都會睜一眼閉一眼的。

original: Kolskeggr Mine is clear of Forsworn.
string: 科斯凱格礦坑不會再有棄誓者來騷擾了。

original: You drove them off? By yourself?
string: 你把他們趕走了？就你自己？

original: Thank you! We'll head back to work, right away. Take this, it's the least I can do.
string: 多謝！我們現在能回去工作了。這個拿去，算是我的一點兒心意。

original: Go. Your very presence sickens me.
string: 滾。你讓我嘔心。

original: Be warned. You have been marked by the Thalmor.
string: 小心，你被梭默盯上了。

original: Now remove yourself from my presence, while you still draw breath.
string: 趁你還有口氣，從我這裡消失吧。

original: Go now. Return to your pathetic pursuits.
string: 現在走吧。繼續你那無聊的追求吧。

original: Filthy Nord. In time, your entire race will be eradicated.
string: 骯髒的諾德人。用不了不久你們會被連根鏟平。

original: The Justiciars know your face. And we elves have long memories...
string: 審判者認識你這張臉。我們精靈的記性可好得很吶……

original: Back to the swamp with you, Argonian. Lest I carve you into boots.
string: 從哪兒來的回哪兒去吧，亞龍人。免得我把你踩在靴子底下。

original: Crawl back into whatever pit spawned you, Orc.
string: 從哪個坑裡爬出來就滾回哪個坑去，獸人。

original: Slink away now, little Khajiit, with your tail between your legs.
string: 快溜吧，小虎人，帶著你屁股上的尾巴一起溜。

original: Flee from my sight, Dunmer, or I'll have you shipped back to Vvardenfell in a crate.
string: 從我眼前滾開，丹莫。不然我就把你塞進板條箱運回瓦登費爾。

original: Pathetic excuse for an elf...
string: 對一個精靈而言真是個悲哀的藉口……

original: You are a disgrace to the Altmer. I should kill you on general principle.
string: 你真是高等精靈的恥辱。要是平時我會殺了你。

original: That isn't a very good reason.
string: 這不是個很好的理由。

original: Reason, reason, reason. Your kind and their reasons.
string: 理由，理由，理由。你有你的理由，他們有他們的。

original: Boethiah has sent me. (Persuade)
string: 波耶西亞派我來的。（說服）

original: The Dark Mistress? She sent you? Wait. Molag Bal's altar. Of course.
string: 是黑暗女王派你來的？等一下。莫拉格巴爾的神壇。當然了。

original: I have to get to Markarth at once. Cut me loose.
string: 我要馬上趕往馬卡斯城。放開我。

original: The Dark Mistress? Sent you? Ha. Now tell me the one about the Troll who gives gifts to good little boys and girls.
string: 是黑暗女士派你來的？哈。你不如跟我說說那個送小孩子們禮物的巨魔的故事吧。

original: Does it matter? Here. (<BribeCost> gold)
string: 有關係嗎？收下這個。（賄賂<BribeCost>金幣）

original: Fine. I won't ask questions. Cut me loose.
string: 好吧。我不問問題。放了我吧。

original: You think it's money I need? I'm a prisoner, not a beggar.
string: 你看我需要錢嗎？我是個犯人，不是乞丐。

original: Molag Bal. (Intimidate)
string: 莫拉格巴爾。（威嚇）

original: So. The King of Corruption sends his messenger to challenge me. Very well.
string: 這麼說，墮落之王派了一個信使來挑戰我。不錯嘛。

original: I will meet with Molag Bal, and I will venerate his altar in Boethiah's name, as I did before.
string: 我將會見莫拉格巴爾，之後我將以波耶西亞之名在他的祭壇祈禱，就像我以前做的那樣。

original: Cut me loose, minion of the Hated One. I need to get to Markarth.
string: 放了我，被憎恨者的僕人。我要去馬卡斯城。

original: You? A servant of the King of Corruption? Has the beast's standards fallen so far? Tell me another one.
string: 你是墮落之王的僕人？那畜生的標準變得如此低落？勸你換個把戲吧。

original: Never mind. Stay here.
string: 算了。待在這裡。

original: I have a choice?
string: 我有得選擇嗎？

original: Here. Let me untie these binds.
string: 來，讓我解開這些繩索。

original: Ah, freedom. Now get out of my way. I have a task to attend to.
string: 啊，自由真好。現在滾開。我有要事在身。

original: Wait here a moment.
string: 在這等一會兒。

original: That's all I can do, you idiot. What are you waiting for?
string: 我也只能這麼做啊，笨蛋。你還在等什麼？

original: Ah ha ha! You mortals and your frail, limp, pathetic bodies. Try it again.
string: 哈哈哈！你這個凡人，柔弱的四肢，可憐的肉體。再試一次吧。

original: You bend to me?
string: 你屈服於我？

original: Yes!
string: 是！

original: You pledge your soul to me?
string: 你將靈魂交予我？

original: Yes!
string: 是！

original: You forsake the weak and pitiful Boethiah?
string: 你會摒棄軟弱和可憐的波耶西亞嗎？

original: Yes!
string: 是！

original: You're mine now, Logrolf.
string: 你現在是我的了，羅格洛夫。

original: Kill him.
string: 殺了他。

original: No problem.
string: 沒問題。

original: Keep your scales on.
string: 保持你的公正。

original: Too lazy to give him a drink yourself? Oaf.
string: 你連給他一杯酒都懶嗎？呆子。

original: Yes, mum!
string: 遵命！

original: Yessir!
string: 遵命！

original: Lynly, would you mind taking care of the customer please?
string: 林立，你能招呼一下那些客人嗎？

original: Hey, Talen... get off your lazy tail and take care of the customer!
string: 喂，塔倫……別偷懶了，招呼下客人！

original: Frabbi, a customer needs a drink!
string: 弗拉碧，有位客人想要杯酒！

original: Saadia, wake up dear!
string: 薩蒂亞，親愛的醒醒！

original: Look alive, will you!
string: 拜託你利索點！

original: You want a drink?
string: 想喝點什麼？

original: Welcome to the Vilemyr Inn. If there's anything I can get you, just let me know.
string: 歡迎來到維爾米爾客棧。想要什麼儘管開口。

original: Finally, someone comes in. Kick off your boots, stay awhile. Let me know if there's anything I can help you with. I got nothing but time these days.
string: 終於終於，來客人了。把靴子脫掉吧，稍坐片刻。有什麼需要的就告訴我。我有的是時間。

original: Come on in. The Silver-Blood Inn has plenty of strong drink and clean rooms.
string: 快請進。銀血客棧有上好的烈酒以及乾淨的房間。

original: Ah, a visitor. Old Hroldan Inn has hundreds of years of history, friend.
string: 啊，一個顧客。朋友，歡迎來到百年老店古赫洛登旅館。

original: If you've got the coin, you've come to the right place. Pull up a seat.
string: 這裡歡迎有錢的客人。請隨便坐吧。

original: Come on in. Let me know if you need anything, or take a seat by the fire and I'll send someone over.
string: 快請進。需要什麼儘管開口，或者到火爐旁坐下，我會叫人過去招呼您。

original: Come on in. Just stoked the fire. Take a seat and get the cold out.
string: 快請進。到火爐邊坐吧，驅散身上的寒氣。

original: Welcome. Let me know if you want anything... think I got a clean mug around here somewhere.
string: 歡迎。想要什麼就跟我說……我那個乾淨杯子哪裡去了。

original: Come on in. We got warm food, warm drinks, and warm beds.
string: 快請進。我們這裡有溫暖的食物，美酒及床鋪。

original: I'll put it to good use.
string: 我會好好利用它的。

original: If the Guild isn't willing to listen to reason, you might have to.
string: 如果公會不明事理，你最好不要學他們。

original: Is there something else?
string: 還有什麼事嗎？

original: There's something you could do for me. For all of us here.
string: 我需要你為我做一件事。為我們這裡的所有人。

original: The Jarl needs to know if there's a dragon on the loose. Riverwood is defenseless...
string: 如果真有一條龍在這附近遊盪，那就必須讓領主知道。因為河木鎮是毫無防衛力量的……

original: We need to get word to Jarl Balgruuf in Whiterun to send whatever troops he can. If you'll do that for me, I'll be in your debt.
string: 我們要向白漫城的巴爾古夫領主稟告，請求他派出軍隊。如果你肯幫我，日後定有報答。

original: That dragon flew off this way. You must have seen it.
string: 那條龍從這裡飛過。你一定看到了。

original: You're right, I saw it. But... how's that possible? Dragons don't exist... they're just stories from long ago...
string: 你說的對，我看到了。但是……那怎麼可能？龍根本不存在……只不過是先古的傳說而已……

original: It was a dragon. Ralof will tell you the same thing.
string: 它的確是一頭龍。拉羅夫也會這麼說的。

original: I don't know why... but I actually believe you. You've got the look of someone who's just seen a dragon.
string: 我不知道為什麼……但是我確實相信你。看你的表情，就知道你確實見過一頭龍。

original: Things just go from bad to worse. First the war, now dragons... what's this world coming to?
string: 事情越來越糟了。首先是戰亂，現在半路又殺出一堆龍……這世界怎麼了？

original: Never mind.
string: 不要緊。

original: I'm sorry to turn you away. I hope you understand.
string: 我很抱歉要讓你走。希望你能理解。

original: But look... if you need work, Hod can always use help at the mill.
string: 不過……要是你找活做，可以去找木材廠的胡德，他一直在找幫手。

original: A dragon attacked Helgen and destroyed it. Ralof and I escaped together.
string: 一頭龍襲擊並摧毀了聖地鎮。拉羅夫和我一同逃了出來。

original: A dragon? In Helgen? It can't be... although...
string: 一條龍？在聖地鎮？不可能……只不過……

original: It would explain what I saw earlier... flying down the valley from the south... I thought I must have just been seeing things...
string: 怪不得我先前看見……它從南面俯衝進入峽谷……我肯定不是眼花……

original: What if I do?
string: 如果我是對的呢？

original: No, why would I?
string: 不，為什麼是我？

original: What's not allowed here?
string: 這裡不能做什麼事情？

original: Purposely killing your fellow College members is a bad idea. I'd advise against it. Theft and assault can get you into trouble as well.
string: 企圖殺害學院的學員可不是好主意，我建議你不要這麼做。偷竊和攻擊他人同樣會讓你惹上麻煩。

original: As for research... Well, a sufficient explanation will cover almost anything.
string: 至於研究……呃……只要能舉出個妥善的說明，便幾乎能搞定一切事情。

original: If you're going to need live test subjects for your experiments, it's easier to do that off of College grounds.
string: 如果你的實驗需要活的實驗體，那麼到院外去做會比較容易。

original: What's the purpose of the College?
string: 學院的宗旨是什麼？

original: Purpose? I should think it's self-evident.
string: 宗旨？我想那是不言而喻的。

original: Magic is a true power, not something to be shunned by commoners or treated as an amusing diversion by politicians.
string: 魔法是真正的力量，不應被民眾所避諱，也不應作為政客們拿來消遣的玩物。

original: It shapes worlds, creates and destroys life... It deserves proper respect and study.
string: 是它構築了世界，創造和毀滅了生命……它理應得到正當的尊重和研習。

original: The College is a place where we can focus on that, without the pressures of the world weighing down on us.
string: 學院是一處讓我們能集中精神於魔法的地方，免除了外界壓力對我們的干擾。

original: Tell me more about the Great Collapse.
string: 告訴我更多關於大塌陷的事。

original: The Sea of Ghosts practically came alive. No one was expecting it. Monstrous waves battered the shore for weeks on end.
string: 鬼魂之海來襲。沒人會期望如此。巨浪拍打岸邊數週之久。

original: Winterhold was ancient and weathered, but it couldn't withstand the sea's fury. Entire districts of the city were lost overnight.
string: 飽經歲月侵蝕的冬堡抵擋不住海的侵襲。整個城區在一夜間就消失了。

original: The waves receded in time, but the damage was irreversible. Most residents of Winterhold abandoned what was left of the city.
string: 海浪終究是消退了，但是損毀是無法恢復的。大多數冬堡居民離開了這座城市。

original: The College survived, and so here we remain.
string: 學院倖存了下來，因此我們還留在這裡。

original: What are you doing out here?
string: 你在外面是做什麼的？

original: I'm here to assist anyone interested in joining the College. Also, my presence tends to frighten the locals and keep them away.
string: 我在這裡引導那些有心加入學院的人。同時，我也會嚇跑那些無聊的當地人，不讓他們滋擾學院。

original: What were the glory days like?
string: 可以形容一下當年的輝煌嗎？

original: The Flagon was once a city beneath a city. We had our own smith, our own alchemist... you name it.
string: 漏壺曾經位於城市下方的另一個城市。我們曾擁有自己的鐵匠、鍊金術士……你能想到的都有。

original: If we can make a name for ourselves in Skyrim once again, I can almost promise you those merchants would return.
string: 要是我們能再次揚名天際省，我敢保證那些商人會回來的。

original: Best of all, we'd have enough gold to throw around so we can start living in the lap of luxury again.
string: 最棒的是，我們能夠擁有足夠的金錢來揮霍，我們能再次過上奢侈的生活。

original: Take a city back? What's that mean?
string: 奪回一座城市？此話怎講？

original: Thanks to Maven Black-Briar, we still have some pull in Riften. But get arrested in Whiterun and you'll be tossed right into the prisons.
string: 多虧了瑪雯．黑棘，我們還在裂谷城有些影響力。但你要是在白漫城被捕，那肯定會被丟進監獄裡的。

original: If we can gain the confidence of someone very influential who lives there by doing a unique job for them, we'd be able to have some leverage there too.
string: 要是我們能贏得某個人的信任，此人又為他們做著特殊的工作，那麼我們在那也將獲得一定的影響力。

original: The only way to get that special job is by doin' smaller ones in those cities until we catch their ear... then they'll contact me and we're off.
string: 唯一能獲得特殊工作的辦法就是做好小事並引起他們的注意……之後他們會聯繫我，那樣我們就能離開了。

original: How will doing extra jobs help the Guild?
string: 做額外工作如何對公會有幫助？

original: Years ago, the Guild used to have a foothold in every major city in Skyrim. You wouldn't dare even lift an apple without checkin' with us.
string: 多年前，公會曾在天際省的各大城市擁有立足點。生活中的一切都和我們息息相關。

original: When things started goin' downhill around here, it became difficult to keep it all together. We lost fences, influential contacts and coin.
string: 但當我們的運勢走下坡之後，保持公會團結就變得困難了。我們失去了地位、影響力和資金。

original: It wasn't long before we lost what we depend on to survive... respect.
string: 不久後我們就遺失了我們曾賴以生存的根基……就是尊重。

original: By doin' these extra jobs and puttin' some fear into the people, we can take back the cities and start bein' taken seriously once again.
string: 多做些工作，在人們心中積累恐懼的陰影，我們就可以收服那些城市並再一次得到重視。

original: Are you kidding me? Ever since the Guild's luck turned sour, we haven't had a coin to our name.
string: 你開什麼玩笑？自從公會的運氣惡化以來，我們名下就再沒有什麼錢了。

original: And when the coin dried up, that's when people started to leave.
string: 當資金消耗殆盡之時，人們就會開始離開公會。

original: We had the best of everything down here... the Ratway was a damn palace.
string: 我們最好的東西都在這了……這鼠道真是個該死的地方。

original: The only way this place will ever return to its glory days is if we can finish these extra jobs and start the gold flowing again.
string: 唯一能讓這地方回歸它光輝歲月的辦法就是完成這些額外工作，讓財源再度滾滾而來。

original: May I ever return to Nightingale Hall?
string: 我能再回到夜鶯大廳嗎？

original: Yes. Now that you're a Nightingale, you may consider this your home.
string: 可以。現在你已經是夜鶯了，你可以把這當成是你的家。

original: You'll find that this place offers many things that will help you in your endeavors as well as a wealth of information for you to learn.
string: 你將會發現這地方有許多東西可以協助你，而且也有很多可供學習的知識。

original: Once the Skeleton Key has been restored to the Twilight Sepulcher, I'll make this place my home as well.
string: 等到骷髏鑰匙回到了黃昏墳墓裡，我也會把這裡當成家的。

original: Then Nocturnal's angry at us?
string: 那麼諾克圖娜爾是對我們生氣囉？

original: If Nocturnal was truly displeased with me... with any of us, she wouldn't have answered my call.
string: 如果諾克圖娜爾真的是對我……或是對我們任何人不滿，她就不會回應我的呼喚了。

original: I have no doubt that we still hold her favor and I believe it gives us enough of an edge to defeat Mercer Frey.
string: 我堅信我們仍受到她的恩寵，而且我相信這給了我們足夠的力量去擊敗墨瑟．弗雷。

original: But she spoke to us.
string: 但是她親口說了。

original: You merely transacted the Oath; signed the unwritten contract with Nocturnal.
string: 你只不過執行了那個誓言；跟諾克圖娜爾簽訂了口頭的契約。

original: In order for us to receive our abilities... our end of the bargain, I'm afraid the Key must be returned.
string: 如果我們想要得到能力……完成這筆交易，恐怕需要先還回那把鑰匙。

original: I don't feel stronger.
string: 我沒感到更強壯。

original: With the Skeleton Key missing from the Twilight Sepulcher, I'm afraid Mercer's seen to it that none of us can benefit from Nocturnal's gifts.
string: 由於骷髏鑰匙離開了黃昏墳墓，恐怕墨瑟是故意讓我們沒辦法因為諾克圖娜爾的禮物而取得優勢。

original: Do you think we stand a chance against Mercer?
string: 你覺得我們有可能擊敗墨瑟嗎？

original: If you would have asked me that yesterday, I'd have said no. But now I think our chances have improved.
string: 要是你昨天問這個問題，我會說不可能。但現在我想我們的勝算變高了。

original: Look, call me crazy if you like, but I trust Karliah. I don't think she'd lead us down a suicidal path.
string: 你可以認為我瘋了，但是我信任卡莉亞。我不覺得她會把我們引向絕路。

original: Besides, I'd rather die with some of Mercer's blood on my blade than spend the rest of my life regretting that I ran the other way.
string: 而且，我寧願在與墨瑟的戰鬥中陣亡，也不願意懷著對錯誤選擇的悔恨而苟且偷生。

original: I guess we're Nightingales now.
string: 我想我們現在就是夜鶯了。

original: Aye, and some of what Karliah said is starting to make sense.
string: 同意，卡莉亞說的一些事講得通了。

original: Mercer may have damaged our reputation and raided our coffers, but this goes well beyond even his twisted form of larceny.
string: 墨瑟也許傷害到我們的聲望，奪走我們的錢財，但是和他扭曲了偷竊的本質相比就顯得微不足道了。

original: Old Delvin kept calling it a curse and we all laughed at him. Looks like the joke's on us.
string: 老戴爾文堅稱我們被詛咒了，而我們都在笑他。現在看來其實錯的是我們。

original: I'll pay the toll later.
string: 我待會再付過路費。

original: That's right. Turn around and leave.
string: 就是這樣。轉過去，離開。

original: Let me through, pig-face. (Intimidate)
string: 讓我過去，豬頭。（威嚇）

original: Those eyes. All right, killer, go on through. But don't try anything. Madanach knows more than you think.
string: 那些眼睛。好吧，殺手，過去吧。但是別做傻事。邁德納奇知道的比你想像得還多。

original: That's what I was hoping you'd say.
string: 我就等著你這麼說。

original: How about I fight you for it? (Brawl)
string: 我揍你一頓怎樣？（打架）

original: Here's your shiv.
string: 拿去，一把小刀。

original: All right, head on in. But don't try anything in there. Madanach is smarter than you think.
string: 很好，過去吧。但是別做傻事。邁德納奇比你想像的要聰明。

original: Then find one. That dung heap Grisvar's been known to make a few.
string: 那就去找一把。那個倒楣蛋格利斯瓦做了好幾把。

original: I don't have a shiv.
string: 我沒有小刀。

original: Madanach is expecting me. (Persuade)
string: 邁德納奇在等我。（說服）

original: Hmph. Fine. Go on in. But don't try anything in there. Madanach knows more than you think.
string: 啊嗯，好吧。進去吧。但是別做傻事，邁德納奇可是無所不知的。

original: The only thing Madanach expects is a bottle of Skooma in tribute every so often. You're not getting through.
string: 邁德納奇唯一想要的就是時不時地送他一瓶斯庫瑪。你不能過去。

original: I need to see Madanach.
string: 我需要見邁德納奇。

original: You want to talk to the King in Rags? Fine. But first you got to pay the toll.
string: 你想和襤褸國王談話？好吧，但是你需要先交過路費。

original: How about you get me a shiv? Not that I need one, but it's nice to have in case I need to do some "shaving." Ha ha.
string: 幫我弄來一把小刀如何？我不是真的很需要，不過當我需要「刮」點東西的時候，就很有用了。哈哈。

original: You ready to pay the toll? One shiv.
string: 準備好要付過路費了嗎？一把利刃。

original: What did you do to Eltrys?
string: 你對艾翠斯做什麼了？

original: Same thing we do with all the other natives who want to change things around here.
string: 我們對任何想改變這裡的人都做一樣的事。

original: We had a nice little deal going between Thonar and Madanach until you and Eltrys started snooping around.
string: 在你和艾翠斯四處打探之前，我們在托納爾和邁德納奇之間有很好的生意往來。

original: Well, you wanted to find the man responsible for those killings? You'll have plenty of time with the King in Rags when you're in Cidhna mine.
string: 好吧，你想找該為那些殺戮負責的人嗎？等你到了希訥礦坑之後就有時間慢慢的跟邁德納奇談談了。

original: Madanach is behind these killings!
string: 邁德納奇謀劃了這些殺戮！

original: You think you're the only one who knows that? We had a nice little deal going between Thonar and Madanach until you showed up.
string: 你以為就你知道真相？你出現之前，我們在托納爾和邁德納奇之間有很好的生意往來。

original: You'll have plenty of time to take it up with the King in Rags while you're serving a life sentence in Cidhna Mine.
string: 當你在希訥礦坑服無期徒刑期間，你就有足夠的時間跟他聊這些了。

original: You're corrupt. Thonar is paying you.
string: 你真墮落。是托納爾收買你的。

original: We have a nice arrangement in this city, and we're not letting you get in the way.
string: 我們的城市井然有序，而且我們不會讓你破壞這些規矩的。

original: You have a problem wth that? Take it up with Madanach. I'm sure the King in Rags and his Forsworn would love to meet you.
string: 不爽嗎？跟邁德納奇說吧。襤褸國王和他的棄誓者肯定想見見你。

original: Now you're coming with us. It's a life sentence in Cidhna Mine for you.
string: 現在我們要把你帶走。你的餘生都得在希訥礦坑度過了。

original: I'm not a murderer.
string: 我沒殺人。

original: Liar.
string: 我不信。

original: Horrible. My soul is heavy with guilt.
string: 可怕。我的靈魂因內疚而沉重。

original: Pah. The gods have a place for killers. You can't carry the burden? You're weak.
string: 呸。眾神特意為殺手們預留了位置。你忍受不了？真是軟弱啊。

original: Exciting. I felt the rush of blood... and smiled.
string: 很令人興奮。我感受到了血的流動……血的氣味。

original: A true killer, like me. The gods put us here to fill their halls with souls. You'll fit in fine down here.
string: 像我一樣，一名真正的殺手。眾神將我們下放到這，好用靈魂填滿他們的殿堂。你很快就會習慣這裡的。

original: The new meat. So soft. Tender.
string: 是鮮肉啊。又軟又嫩的鮮肉。

original: What was it like killing your first one, huh?
string: 第一次殺人是種什麼感覺？

original: Skooma? What's that?
string: 斯庫瑪？那是什麼？

original: Bottles of Moon Sugar. Khajiit use it as a... pick me up. Good way to pass the time.
string: 一整瓶月糖。虎人用它來……誘惑我。真是個打發時光的好辦法。

original: Prisoners smuggle the stuff in. Only currency we have down here.
string: 犯人們把這些東西走私進來。用來榨取我們的工資。

original: What about my reward?
string: 我的報酬呢？

original: But I haven't forgotten the service you did for me in retrieving the Dragonstone for Farengar.
string: 但我並沒有忘記你為了我幫法仁加取回了龍石。

original: As a token of my esteem, I have instructed Avenicci that you are now permitted to purchase property in the city.
string: 為表達對你的敬意，我向阿文尼奇下了指示，允許你在這城市裡購買房產。

original: And please accept this gift from my personal armory.
string: 還有請你接受這從我私人軍械中選出的贈禮。

original: So there's no High King now?
string: 所以現在沒有至高王了？

original: No, not until the Moot meets to choose another. And it won't meet until one side or the other wins the war.
string: 沒有，直到領地代表大會開會選出新的至高王。而在一方或者另一方勝出之前這個大會是不會召開的。

original: Don't worry, though. Ulfric is our rightful High King. He'll drive out the Empire and Skyrim will have peace at last.
string: 不過，別太擔心。烏弗瑞克是我們公正的至高王。他會把帝國驅逐出去，讓天際省獲得最終的和平。

original: Ulfric killed the High King?
string: 烏弗瑞克殺了至高王？

original: Some say murdered, but it was a lawful challenge in the old way.
string: 有人說是謀殺，但這其實是以一種傳統方式進行的合法挑戰。

original: Ulfric called him out as a traitor to Skyrim, and killed him in single combat.
string: 烏弗瑞克對外宣稱他是個背叛天際省的叛徒，隨後在一對一格鬥中殺死了他。

original: If Torygg couldn't defend his throne, he had no business being High King.
string: 如果托依格不能保住他的王位，他就不應該成為至高王。

original: Who's Elisif?
string: 艾利西弗是什麼人？

original: I suppose she's Jarl Elisif now. She married High King Torygg just before Ulfric killed him. The Empire supports her claim to be High Queen.
string: 我想現在應該稱她為艾利西弗領主了。她在至高王托依格被烏弗瑞克殺死之前嫁給了他。帝國支持她成為至高女王。

original: I don't really have anything against her - not her fault that her husband Torygg was bought and paid for by the Empire.
string: 我對她倒是沒有什麼意見——她的丈夫托依格被帝國花錢收買並不是她的錯。

original: But she's nothing but a puppet for the Empire now, with her husband Torygg dead. Ulfric will make sure she never takes the throne as High Queen.
string: 但現在她丈夫托依格死了，她只不過是帝國的傀儡。烏弗瑞克會確保她永遠沒機會問鼎至高女王的寶座。

original: You support the Stormcloaks, then?
string: 所以，你支持風暴斗篷？

original: Of course. Ulfric's cause is just. It's time for Skyrim to rid itself of the Empire.
string: 當然。烏弗瑞克是正義的。天際省到了該擺脫帝國的時候了。

original: Why? Is he loyal to the Empire?
string: 為什麼？他對帝國忠誠嗎？

original: I wouldn't say that. But he and Ulfric have been at odds for years, and I'm afraid Balgruuf will end up siding with the Empire because of it.
string: 不能那麼說。但是他和烏弗瑞克之間的嫌隙已經持續多年，我看巴爾古夫恐怕要因此倒向帝國一邊了。

original: But it's hard to believe that even Balgruuf would choose Elisif over Ulfric.
string: 但是一般人都很難相信連巴爾古夫都會選擇艾利西弗而放棄烏弗瑞克。

original: What can you tell me about the Jarl?
string: 你對領主有什麼瞭解？

original: Jarl Balgruuf? I don't mean to be disrespectful, as he's ruled Whiterun Hold well for years, but he seems in over his head now.
string: 巴爾古夫？我不想對他不敬，畢竟他也是這幾年來把白漫城治理得井井有條的人，但他最近似乎遇上了非常棘手的問題。

original: He's been trying to stay out of the war, but it can't last. He's going to have to pick a side. I'm afraid he's going to make the wrong choice.
string: 他試圖用各種手段避免被捲入戰爭中，但這不是長久之計。他最後必須要明確立場。我看他是要做出錯誤的選擇了。

original: Come on. Give me your hand, I'm getting you out of here.
string: 快點。把手給我，我帶你出去。

original: It's too late for that. Leave me. Save yourself.
string: 太晚了。你走吧。自己逃生要緊。

original: The wounds are deep, Vilod! I can't stop the blood.
string: 傷口太深了，維羅德！我止不住血啊。

original: Tell my family I fought bravely.
string: 告訴我的家人我英勇地戰鬥過。

original: Torolf!
string: 托羅爾夫！

original: Gods... Everyone get back!
string: 神啊……所有人後退！

original: See the inn on the other side? Jump through the roof and keep going!
string: 看到另一頭的那間旅館了嗎？從屋頂上跳過去，一直往前走！

original: So the Eyes of the Falmer are gems?
string: 所以伐莫族之眼是寶石？

original: Not just ordinary gems. They're said to be flawlessly cut and as big as a man's head. Can you imagine how much they're worth?
string: 不是普通的寶石，而是精工雕琢，而且有人頭那麼大。你能想像那值多少錢嗎？

original: Gallus and Mercer spent the better part of a month infiltrating Irkngthand, but the dwarves had protected the place far too well.
string: 加盧斯和墨瑟把一個月中比較好的時段用於潛入苦悶之牙廢墟，但矮人們對那地方防備太過森嚴。

original: There were just too many obstacles blocking the way. The plans were shelved and the rest is history.
string: 路上遇到的障礙太多了，所以這計畫就被放棄，也不再提起。

original: A snow elf?
string: 冰妖精？

original: Aye, that's what the Falmer were known as long ago... before they became the blind monstrosities they are today.
string: 是啊，那是是伐莫族族很久以前的名字……在他們還沒有變成盲眼的兇神惡煞之前。

original: When Gallus took one look at this statue, he knew it was something special. He took it right up to Enthir at the College of Winterhold.
string: 當時加盧斯看了一眼這雕像，就知道它不是普通的東西。他立即把它帶去給了冬堡學院的恩希爾看。

original: Didn't take long for Enthir to find a book in the college's library that told of Irkngthand and a great statue with gemmed eyes within.
string: 恩希爾沒花多少就在學院的圖書館找到了一本有關苦悶之牙廢墟的書，書上寫道廢墟裡有一個雕像的眼睛是用寶石做的。

original: What are the Eyes of the Falmer?
string: 伐莫族之眼是什麼？

original: A few years before Mercer murdered Gallus, the Guild took in a thief who specialized in dwarven antiquities.
string: 就在墨瑟殺掉加盧斯的幾年前，公會抓到了一個精通矮人古代歷史的賊。

original: The thief had broken into a nobleman's home somewhere in Windhelm and made off with a small figurine of a snow elf with crystalline eyes.
string: 那個盜賊闖入過風舵城的一個貴族家裡，成功偷出了一個鑲著水晶眼睛的冰妖精小雕像。

original: Do you think Mercer knows we're here?
string: 你覺得墨瑟知道我們在這裡嗎？

original: Mercer's been careful so far. I don't think he'd just leave those plans behind unless he had his reasons.
string: 迄今為止墨瑟一直很謹慎。我不覺得他會輕率地把計劃書留在家裡，除非有特殊原因。

original: For someone in possession of the Skeleton Key, stealing the Eyes of the Falmer would be child's play.
string: 對於一個持有骷髏鑰匙的人來說偷走伐莫族之眼易如反掌。

original: No, he means to ambush us down here, I'm almost certain of it.
string: 不，他計劃要在這下面伏擊我們，我可以肯定。

original: The lass seems to think old Mercer is pulling a fast one on us... leading us here and letting the dwarven constructs wear us down.
string: 那個姑娘好像以為老墨瑟在設計騙我們……把我們帶到這裡來然後讓那些矮人機關把我們折騰到筋疲力盡。

original: I've learned to trust her lead at this point. After all, we Nightingales need to stick together, eh?
string: 現在我已經學會要相信她的領導了。畢竟，我們夜鶯們要團結一心才行，對吧？

original: No! Noooooo!
*cough*
string: （咳嗽）

original: *cough*
string: （咳嗽）

original: *gasp*
string: （喘氣）

original: *Gasp* Finally, someone came!... I...
string: 啊……終於，有人來了！……我……

original: *coughs* The cat... *gasp* Ra'jiir... ambushed me. He's trying to take the sword back! I... can't... *gasp*
string: 咳……那隻貓…… 啊 ……拉·吉爾……埋伏了我。他要拿回那把劍！我……沒法…… 啊

original: TG09NDAttacks
string: TG09NDAttacks

original: Shadows take you!
string: 讓暗影吞噬你！

original: Darkness destroy you!
string: 讓黑暗毀滅你！

original: Glory to Nocturnal!
string: 為了諾克圖娜爾的榮耀！

original: Shadows fall!
string: 暗影降臨吧！

original: Submit to Her will!
string: 服從她的意志吧！

original: Your end is near!
string: 你的死期到了！

original: I'll bury you in darkness!
string: 我要把你埋葬在黑暗的深淵！

original: Yeargh!
string: 呀呃！

original: Rargh!
string: 嘎啊！

original: Hyargh!
string: 嘿呀！

original: Hunh!
string: 喝！

original: The Stormcloaks will pay appropriate compensation for the massacre at Barleydark Farm.
string: 風暴斗篷得為發生在黑麥農場的屠殺付出適當的撫慰金。

string: 風暴斗篷得為發生在河木鎮的屠殺付出適當的撫慰金。

string: 風暴斗篷得為發生在霜河農場的屠殺付出適當的撫慰金。

original: The existence of so-called "Doomstones" throughout Skyrim has been repeatedly verified. The meaning of these stones has not.

original: References to similar stones appear in lore throughout the various Tamrielic cultures.

original: At present, there is no confirmation of any of the various theories surrounding the nature of these stones.

original: Nonetheless, many are drawn to these stones based on the local stories describing them as a source of significant power.

original: The College will continue to research these intriguing objects, and of course any findings will be relayed with all possible haste.

original: It is no secret that both the Synod and the College of Whispers have recently made inquiries as to the status of our College here in Winterhold.
string: 大家都知道，希諾會和低語學院兩方最近都很關注我們冬堡學院的那座雕像。

original: At this time, there is no indication that either group is aware of the other's correspondence.
string: 在此期間，他們任何一方都沒有表示出在此事上與另一方互通有無的意向。

original: The College of Winterhold has thus far declined requests for direct meetings. This has been at the specific request of Arch-Mage Aren.
string: 所以冬堡學院一直拒絕直接會面。這是應首席法師阿冉的特別要求而採取的政策。

original: Aren believed that although the initial communications were innocent enough, they were sent with a particular motive in mind.
string: 阿冉認為雖然最初的溝通是十分單純的，但難免都懷有自己的利益、動機。

original: The Synod's harsh rules and draconian structure are maintained only by suppressing any opposition to their Council's policies.
string: 希諾會的嚴厲規定以及亞龍人的等級結構這兩樣東西的穩固都是靠鎮壓所有反對他們理事會政策的聲音來維持。

original: It is entirely possible that they look to our College here in Winterhold in order to find supporters for their organization.
string: 他們想來我們冬堡學院裡尋覓和拉攏支援其組織的人是完全有可能的。

original: Likewise, the College of Whispers has long been driven by its desire to directly oppose the Synod.
string: 同理，低語學院想正面和希諾會對抗的情緒由來已久，這是他們的一次機會。

original: They focus on research banned by the Synod, such as Conjuration and Necromancy.
string: 他們專注於研究希諾會禁止的學術，例如召喚和死靈法術。

original: The College of Whispers hopes to learn that our College also supports these avenues of research.
string: 低語學院希望能在我們學院尋找同樣支持這類研究的同僚。

original: Thus they may claim that the Synod is indeed a political minority in the Empire and should be treated as such.
string: 所以他們可能會宣稱希諾會是帝國內的政治少數派而且理應被如此對待。

original: Our actual position and policies are irrelevant. No matter the facts of the response, it will certainly be twisted to suit the whims of either group.
string: 我們的實際立場和我們的政策無關。不管我們作出何種回應，它定會被曲解成符合其中某一方的幻想的意見。

original: Indeed, it has been jokingly suggested that we send the exact same response to both, which each will warp into support for their side.
string: 確實，有人建議我們對兩方給予完全相同的回應，這會被每一方都理解成對他們的支持。

original: At present, these two groups do little beyond attempting to gain the attention and favor of the Emperor.
string: 現在，這兩派勢力除了努力吸引皇帝的注意力和偏袒之外，其他所做的事甚少。

original: They appear to have little interest in real study and research for the sake of gaining knowledge.
string: 他們似乎沒有多大興趣真正去做可以積累知識的研究和試驗。

original: Arch-Mage Aren believes that their conflict poses a significant threat to the autonomy of our College, and I concur.
string: 首席法師阿冉相信他們的衝突對我們學院的自治權造成了嚴重威脅，這一點我很贊成。

original: Arch-Mage Aren believed that their conflict poses a significant threat to the autonomy of our College, and I concur.
string: 首席法師阿冉相信他們的衝突對我們學院的自治權造成了嚴重威脅，這一點我很贊成。

original: Falling in with either would threaten to draw much unwanted attention to our College.
string: 對任何一方示好都會給我們的學院帶來很多無益的關注。

original: If either group goes through less official channels and attempt to contact you directly, please refer them to the College's Master Wizard.

original: Say as little as possible so as to avoid compromising our neutral position.

original: It is absolutely worthy of research, despite many of the notes I've had left in my bed. And my desk. And on occasion, my meals.
string: 它絕對值得研究，儘管有很多筆記被我忘在床上。還有我的桌子上。還有，有時候忘在我的餐盤裡。

original: Anyone suggesting that Restoration is better left to the priests of the Temples, I think, is forgetting a few things.
string: 有人會說恢復系最好留給神殿裡的祭祀去做，但我想，他們忘記了一些東西。

original: Firstly, the ability to repel the undead cannot be ignored.
string: 首先，它抵禦亡靈生物的能力不可忽視。

original: Skyrim is well known to be full of these... Draugr, ancient Nord warriors who cannot find peace.
string: 天際省的這種族類數目之多可謂聲名遠播……就是諾德亡靈，死去但不能得到平靜的古代諾德戰士。

original: I submit that everyone in this College has, at one time or another, relied on one of the Restoration spells that can keep them at bay.
string: 我推測這所學院的每個人，至少一次，依靠恢復系法術中的一個來保護自己的安全。

original: Secondly, how can anyone forget wards? They have become essential to any mage working in dangerous situations.
string: 其次，我們怎麼能忘記結界呢？它們對任何一個工作在危險環境中的法師來說都是不可或缺的。

original: They are counted upon every bit as much as Candlelight, or Invisibility.
string: 它們經常成為施法者們的精神支柱，比如燭光術或隱身術。

original: But more importantly, wards have saved lives. This is a simple fact.
string: 但是更重要的是，衛兵可以救別人的命。這是個簡單的事實。

original: Every mage in this College regularly uses wards for practice, so as to avoid physical harm.
string: 這所學院的每個法師都經常使用結界來練習，這是為了避免遭受物理傷害。

original: I truly hope that these points actually sink in, and that more care and thought is given to this subject in the future. Thank you.
string: 我發自內心地希望這些觀點被各位所聆聽和理解，以及將來會有更多的關注和思考被投入到這個課題中。謝謝。

original: As many know, there is an ongoing effort to research the work of the Archmagus Shalidor.
string: 眾所周知，有一個研究大法師沙利多的著作的項目正在進行。

original: He is most remembered for his great maze of Labyrinthian, said to hold "Glamoril", or the secret of life.
string: 他最值得紀念的成就是他的巨大迷宮建筑，「迷城」據說那裡守護著「格拉莫瑞」，或者說生命的秘密。

original: While stories have persisted since the First Era, none have ever confirmed the existence of this "Glamoril" or its purpose or function.
string: 但傳言說自第一紀元以來，沒有人證實過「格拉莫瑞」的存在、意義及功能。

original: The College has developed some theories, however.
string: 不過，學院建立了一些理論。

original: We know that Shalidor had an understanding of magic that surpassed almost any of either his age or ours.
string: 我們知道沙利多對魔法的理解力超越了他的年代和我們的年代所有人。

original: The few works of his that have been recovered suggest that he had an understanding of magic and the world that few have ever achieved.
string: 根據他的已知作品來看，他對於魔法與這個世界的深厚認知，可是沒幾個人能比得上。

original: What is interesting is that it appears he was also incredibly prolific, writing on a diverse array of subjects.
string: 有趣的是，他似乎也很博學，寫了一批其他領域的研究論文。

original: An array so great, in fact, that it remains a source of curiosity.
string: 這些領域包羅萬象，實際上，到底有多少個領域目前仍是未知數。

original: What, then, of this Glamoril? It means "secret of life" in elvish. Could this be an explanation for Shalidor's works?
string: 那麼，這個格拉莫瑞是怎麼回事？它在精靈語裡面是「生命的秘密」之意。這有沒有可能是沙利多的所有著作的最終解釋呢？

original: Is it possible that it somehow contributed to his work? Perhaps allowed him to life multiple lifetimes in a short span of time?
string: 有沒有可能這個東西以某種方式對他的研究作出了貢獻？讓他能在短時間內經歷數次生命？

original: Increased his intelligence and knowledge in ways unfathomable to us? We may never know for certain.
string: 用我們不能理解的方法增長了他的智力和知識？我們永遠無法考證。

original: The College is always searching for more of Shalidor's writings in an attempt to understand both our knowledge of the man, and of magic in general.
string: 學院一直在搜尋沙利多更多的文字作品，為了從宏觀上理解我們對於人類和魔法的知識。

original: At this time, I would like to make a few statements regarding policy here at the College.
string: 在這裡，我想做一些聲明以表明我對學院政策的尊重。

original: Please refrain from practicing Conjuration spells in view of the town of Winterhold.
string: 考慮到我們就要到冬堡了，請遏制住練習召喚系法術的衝動。

original: Atronachs have a tendency to frighten the locals. Undead.... well, I don't even think it needs to be said.
string: 元素很大機率會使當地人受到驚嚇。亡靈……這個，我想我不用說大家也知道。

original: Urag has asked me to remind everyone to please return materials borrowed from the Arcanaeum in the same condition as you received them.
string: 烏拉格要求我提醒大家，請在歸還秘藏館的材料時確保它是處於和借出時相同的數量和狀態。

original: If this is impossible due to misuse or accident, Urag recommends finding a replacement copy to deliver to the Arcanaeum.
string: 如果因為誤用或者意外造成無法原樣歸還，烏拉格建議找一個可替代的相同材料送還秘藏館。

original: Failure to do so will result in paying, in Urag's words, "a blood price." I did not ask him to elaborate on that point.
string: 如果無法做到的話將需要付出罰金，用烏拉格的原話，是「血債血償」。我沒有要求他對這一點做詳細說明。

original: Once again, I must ask that everyone please clean up any materials used in the common areas.
string: 重申一次，我必須請每個人務必把在公共區域使用的材料清理乾淨。

original: We've had yet another sprained ankle due to soul gems being left on the floor. Let's please try and keep injuries to a minimum.
string: 我們這裡又有一人因遺落在地板上的靈魂石而扭傷腳踝。讓我們一同努力讓傷殘減到最少吧。

original: The Midden remains off-limits at this time; while the initial outbreak has been cleaned up, the area is still considered hazardous.
string: 現階段枯骨地牢仍然是禁入區域；雖然最初的暴動已經被掃清，但這個地區仍被認為是高危險地帶。

original: No more experiments are to be carried out there, and mages are advised that you enter the Midden at your own risk.
string: 那裡不允許進行實驗，我們仍必須對法師們建議如果要進入枯骨地牢的話請自負後果。

original: While Drevis appreciates the spellcasting skill that went into somehow cramming several hundred apples into his pillow...
string: 雖然德萊維斯贊許枕頭裡有好幾百個蘋果的朋友的施法技術……

original: He would ask that it please not happen again.
string: 然而他會請求不要再讓這種事發生了。

original: He has suggested that, should he find out who is responsible, he is well versed in making things disappear permanently.
string: 他暗示了，如果他找出了對此事件負責的人，他對讓任何東西永久消失都是很在行的。

original: There have been unconfirmed reports that someone has been sneaking into the town of Winterhold while invisible, and causing... issues.
string: 有未確認的報告指出有人用隱身潛入了冬堡鎮內，而且造成了……一些麻煩。

original: This goes quite against College policy, and the party responsible is advised to cease these actions at once.
string: 這嚴重違背了學院的政策，建議對此事件負責的派系立即停止此種行為。

original: Any information as to the whereabouts of the previous group of Apprentices would be greatly appreciated.
string: 如能提供任何有關前一組學徒下落的情報，我們會感激不盡。

original: As of yet, there has been no sign of them.
string: 到目前為止，他們杳無音信。

original: Projects are underway to discern the origin and nature of the College's recent find in Saarthal.
string: 為了辨明學院對薩瑟爾城最新發現的屬性和來源而成立的研究項目正在進行中。

original: Work continues on the Eye of Magnus, as it has been commonly referred to.
string: 我們在繼續研究瑪格努斯之眼，這是它的通常叫法。

original: Any and all theories are currently being considered. Those with ideas should please speak with Mirabelle.
string: 目前我們接受一切可能的理論。對此有設想的同僚請與米拉貝勒會談。

original: At this time, there is no indication that, as has been rumored, the object is in fact a physical part of Magnus, the god of magic.
string: 現階段，沒有證據證明這個物體如傳言中那樣是瑪格努斯，也即魔法之神的肉體的一部分，

original: It has been suggested that the object is a gateway to the realm of Aetherius, but nothing has proven that idea one way or the other.
string: 曾有人猜想它可能是通往艾瑟瑞斯領域的大門，但這一猜想未能通過任何一種方法被證明。

original: It has been proposed that the object is in fact the entirety of Aurbis in one physical space.
string: 有人提議這物體可能是奧比斯在一個物理空間內的完全體。

original: This would of course mean that Tamriel, indeed all of Mundus, is actually contained within the sphere.
string: 這當然就意味著泰姆瑞爾，實際上直至整個夢達思都是被包含在那球體中的。

original: It further suggests that we are somehow then outside our own existence while looking in at it.
string: 該猜測進一步提出，從某種角度來說當我們從裡面觀察它時，我們是超出了我們自身的存在。

original: While the idea seems dubious at best, it has not, at present, been entirely ruled out.
string: 雖說這個猜測最多只能說是值得懷疑的，但目前，它還沒有完全出局。

original: I really do need you to stay in place, please. I don't want to risk hurting any of the other Apprentices.
string: 我真的需要你站在在原地，拜託了。我不想傷害到任何一個學徒。

original: Over there, please. Just opposite me. Wouldn't want anyone else in the way.
string: 請去那邊。就在我的正對面。我不想讓別人擋在中間。

original: Suddenly I don't feel like fighting.
string: 我突然不想打了。

original: Why am I fighting?
string: 我為什麼要戰鬥？

original: I really don't want to fight.
string: 我真的不想打架。

original: I see no reason to keep fighting.
string: 我看不到繼續打下去的理由。

original: This fight makes no sense.
string: 這場戰鬥完全沒有道理。

original: I'm not interested in fighting anymore.
string: 我不想再打了。

original: I see no reason to fight.
string: 我看不到戰鬥的理由。

original: There's no reason to fight.
string: 沒有理由戰鬥。

original: I'm staying out of this.
string: 我不參與這事。

original: This fight is pointless.
string: 這場戰鬥毫無意義。

original: Work, damn you!
string: 快點動啊，去你的！

original: I don't understand. This should produce some notable effect.
string: 我不明白。這應該能產生顯著的效果呀。

original: Perhaps a little harder?
string: 也許是力道太小了？

original: Hmm. That... That didn't really do anything, did it?
string: 嗯。這……這好像沒什麼變化，有嗎？

original: Right, then...
string: 好吧，那……

original: But please, don't leave. You've been instrumental in this process. I'd like you to see the results first-hand.
string: 但是拜託了，別走。你對這件事的進展有很大的幫助。我想讓你第一時間看到結果。

original: Well, I suppose it's time, isn't it? Let's see what happens. You, uhh... You may want to stand back a step or two.
string: 好吧，我想應該是時候了，對不對？我們來看看會發生什麼事？你，呃……你可能會想後退一兩步。

original: I certainly don't expect it to have quite the same results. I'm no tonal architect, of course!
string: 我當然不敢期望它會產生相同的結果。我可不是他們那種設計師！

original: I also lack Sunder, the counterpart to the dagger Keening. I am reasonably, confident, however, that this will still work.
string: 我也缺少「薩恩德」，那把與哀慟配對的匕首。但是就理論上我有自信實驗能順利進行。

original: Lacking the heart of a dead god, I am substituting the crystal you helped craft in its place.
string: 我缺少一顆死去的神明心臟，我要用你幫忙製作的水晶代替它的位置。

original: This little experiment is a first step in recreating the events of their disappearance in an effort to unravel that mystery.
string: 這個小實驗是重現他們的失蹤事件、解開謎團的第一步。

original: Everyone knows the dwarves disappeared. No one knows why.
string: 所有人都知道矮人消失了。沒有人知道為什麼？

original: I apologize if I have not been clear about my work. I didn't want to discuss it for fear this moment might never come.
string: 如果我沒有講清楚我的研究，我向你道歉。我不想討論它是因為我怕這個時刻永遠不會到來。

original: So what's next?
string: 接下來呢？

original: Now... Now we see whether my theories are correct.
string: 現在……來看看我們的理論是否正確。

original: Have you made any progress translating Shalidor's work?
string: 你翻譯沙利多的著作有什麼進展了嗎？

original: I only just got my hands on it. I can only work so quickly.
string: 我才剛剛開始呢。我的工作速度最快也就如此了。

original: It's coming along slowly. I expect there will be some results soon.
string: 這進度有點慢。希望能很快看到一些結果。

original: We were able to figure out the last text you brought in. I thought the least I could do is pass the knowledge along.
string: 我們弄清楚了你最近一次帶來的文字。我想我至少要把這些知識傳遞下去。

original: You see, my name is Barbas. And I have a problem I think you can help sort out.
string: 你知道嗎，我叫巴巴斯。我有個小麻煩，我覺得你能幫我解決。

original: I guess I'll stay on the lookout. Keep your nose clean while you're here outsider.
string: 我想我會一直待在瞭望台那。你在這裡可別鬧事啊，外地人。

original: If you were willing to retrieve him for me I'd give you some fresh meat to attract him out on the road.
string: 要是你願意幫我把牠弄來，我可以給你一些新鮮肉塊作為把牠引來的誘餌。

original: I've seen whole packs of dogs.
string: 我見過一整群的狗呢。

original: No, no, this one's alone on the road outside of town. I can't afford to chase him down but I could use a fierce, loyal beast to keep me company.
string: 不，這隻獨自一個走在城鎮外面的路上。我沒錢雇人尋找牠，但我實在希望能有隻兇猛、忠誠的野獸陪伴我。

original: Sure, I can catch him.
string: 當然，我可以抓住牠。

original: Good! There's some gold in it for you if you succeed. Here's the meat - check the road just outside of town.
string: 好！如果成功的話，我會給你一些金幣。這是鮮肉——去城外的那條路上看看吧。

original: The guard at the gate mentioned a dog.
string: 大門那的衛兵有提到一隻狗。

original: I asked the gate guards to look for him. I can't afford to chase him down but could use a fierce, loyal beast to keep me company.
string: 我曾經請求門衛去找他。我沒錢雇人把他找回來但我可以找一個兇猛的、忠誠的野獸陪伴我。

original: What sort of dog?
string: 什麼種類的狗？

original: I don't know really.  The blacksmith is offering a reward for a dog he saw on the road. I was hoping you'd seen it.
string: 我還真不知道。鐵匠正在懸賞請人找一條他在路上見過的狗。我還希望你有看見牠呢。

original: I've seen whole packs of dogs.
string: 我有看到很多狗。

original: No, this was a specific one. The blacksmith is offering a reward for a dog he saw on the road. I was hoping you'd seen it.
string: 不，這是條特別的狗。鐵匠正在懸賞請人找一條他在路上見過的狗。我還希望你有看見牠呢。

original: No. Some wolves, but no dogs.
string: 不。有一些狼，但沒有狗。

original: Ah, well. The blacksmith is offering a reward for a dog he saw on the road. I was hoping you'd seen it.
string: 啊，好吧。鐵匠正在懸賞請人找一條他在路上見過的狗。我還希望你有看見牠呢。

original: Did you see a Dog out there?
string: 你在外面有看到一條狗嗎？

original: Owning a farm does have its advantages.
string: 擁有一個農場確實有好處。

original: I'm here to buy food, Nazeem. I suppose you don't need to worry about that.
string: 我來買食物，納奇姆。你應該不需要擔心這個。

original: Ah, Ysolda was it? What brings you to the market?
string: 啊，這不是伊索爾達嗎？什麼風把你吹到市場來了？

original: I didn't mean... I'm sorry I asked.
string: 我不是故意……我不該隨便問的，對不起。

original: And why shouldn't I? Just because I'm a Gray-Mane doesn't mean I can't earn my own keep.
string: 我為什麼不能？我是個灰鬃並不能代表我不可以賺錢買自己的要塞。

original: Are you still working at the Bannered Mare in the evenings, Olfina?
string: 你晚上還在敕旗母馬客棧工作嗎，奧菲娜？

original: Plenty of people here that need Eorlund's craftsmanship, my dear. We've never had any reason to deal with those caravans of theirs.
string: 這裡有很多人需要厄倫德的技藝，親愛的。我們從來沒有理由和他們那些商隊做交易。

original: Fralia, do you ever deal with the Khajiit at all? I'm sure they would love to trade in your husband's steel.
string: 法利亞，你有沒有和虎人做過交易？我肯定他們會很喜歡買進你丈夫的鐵器的。

original: I want my freedom.
string: 我想要我的自由。

original: Your freedom? Yes. But even if you were to escape Cidhna Mine, your name would still be stained with all that blood.
string: 你的自由？對。但是就算你能逃出希訥礦坑，你的名字也還是沾滿鮮血。

original: (Invisible Continue)
string: （保持隱形）

original: So, my fellow beast, what do you want? Answers about the Forsworn? Revenge for trying to have you killed?
string: 那麼，我的野獸夥伴，你想要什麼？關於棄誓者的答案？報復想置你於死地的人？

original: Well, well. Look at you. Your kinsmen have turned you into an animal, Nord. A wild beast caged up and left to go mad.
string: 好啦，好啦。看看你。你的親戚把你變成了一隻動物，諾德人。一隻被關在籠子裡的，只能在孤獨中發瘋的野獸。

original: Well, well. Look at you. The Nords have turned you into an animal. A wild beast caged up and left to go mad.
string: 好啦，好啦。看看你。諾德人把你變成了一隻動物。一隻被關在籠子裡的，只能在孤獨中發瘋的野獸。

original: What do you mean, I'm not skilled enough?
string: 你是什麼意思，我的技能還不夠高嗎？

original: Just that, I'm afraid. You lack the ability, in any school of magic, to contribute meaningfully to the College's research.
string: 恐怕，就是那樣。你缺乏能力，對任何一個系別的魔法都不夠熟練，不能對學院的研究工作做任何貢獻。

original: I suggest you learn more on your own. Come back once you've attained some measure of success.
string: 我建議你先自己提高知識水準。當你有了成功的例證後再來吧。

original: Your target's name is Vittoria Vici. She oversees the East Empire Company's business holdings in Solitude.
string: 你的目標的名字是維多利亞．薇齊。她控制著東帝國貿易公司在獨孤城的生意。

original: The wedding is being held in that city, at the Temple of the Divines. Her death will cause an uproar, which is exactly what we want.
string: 婚禮就是在那個獨孤城舉行，在九聖靈的神殿裡。她的死將會造成騷亂，而那正是我們想要的。

original: Vici is likely to address her guests frequently, as is the wedding custom. Kill her when she does that, and I promise you a significant bonus.
string: 薇齊經常向她的客人演講，婚禮賓客也不例外。當她這麼做的時候，殺了她，我向你保證，會有特別的額外報酬。

original: Now go. And give the city of Solitude a celebration they're not likely to forget.
string: 現在去吧。贈給獨孤城一個難以忘懷的慶典吧。

original: (Remain silent)
string: （保持沉默）

original: Very well.
string: 甚好。

original: The target's name is Vittoria Vici. She oversees the East Empire Company's business holdings in Solitude.
string: 你的目標的名字是維多利亞．薇齊。她控制著東帝國貿易公司在獨孤城的生意。

original: The wedding is being held in that city, at the Temple of the Divines. Her death will cause an uproar, which is exactly what we want.
string: 婚禮就是在那個獨孤城舉行，在九聖靈的神殿裡。她的死將會造成騷亂，而那正是我們想要的。

original: Remember, we want people to notice. Kill Vici while she's addressing her guests, as is the custom, and I can promise a bonus.
string: 記住，我們的目的是想吸引人們的注意。在薇齊依照習俗向賓客致辭時殺死她，我可以許諾給你一筆追加酬金。

original: Now go. And give the bride a special kiss, from me.
string: 現在去吧。要記得，幫我給新娘送上一個特別的吻。

original: Enough talk. Just tell me who to kill.
string: 不需要多說。告訴我要殺誰就行了。

original: Oh, do you mean this old stone? (Give Dragonstone to Farengar)
string: 噢，你是說這個古老的石頭嗎？（把龍石給法仁加）

original: Ah! The Dragonstone of Bleak Falls Barrow! You already found it! You are cut from a different cloth than the usual brutes the Jarl foists on me.
string: 啊！荒瀑古墳的龍石！你已經找到它了！你和領主派來欺騙我的那些畜生完全不是同一種材料做的！

original: I, ah, learned of a certain stone tablet said to be housed in Bleak Falls Barrow - a "Dragonstone," said to contain a map of dragon burial sites.
string: 我，啊，聽說了有一塊石板擺放在荒瀑古墳——那是一塊「龍石」。據說上頭刻著一張龍之古塚的地圖。

original: Go to Bleak Falls Barrow, find this tablet - no doubt interred in the main chamber - and bring it to me. Simplicity itself.
string: 去荒瀑古墳，找到這塊石板……它肯定是葬在主墓室——然後帶回來給我。就這麼簡單。

original: By my right as Jarl, I name you Thane of Whiterun. It's the greatest honor that's within my power to grant.
string: 以我領主的權利，授予你白漫城武衛之名。這是我的權利所能授予的最高榮譽。

original: I assign you Lydia as a personal Housecarl, and this weapon from my armory to serve as your badge of office.
string: 我任命萊迪亞作為你的私人侍衛，同時將這把從我的兵器庫中取出的兵器賜予你，作為你的身份象徵。

original: I'll also notify my guards of your new title. Wouldn't want them to think you're part of the common rabble, now would we?
string: 我也會把你的新頭銜告知我的衛兵。我們不想讓他們以為你是普通的下層民眾，對嗎？

original: We are honored to have you as Thane of our city, Dragonborn.
string: 我們很榮幸迎來了你成為我們的武衛，龍裔。

original: Why is it so empty here?
string: 這地方為什麼這麼空蕩蕩的？

original: You mean the inn, or Winterhold?
string: 你是說這個酒館，還是冬堡？

original: Suppose it's the same answer, either way. Winterhold's fallen on hard times, to say the least. Most folk packed up and left years ago.
string: 不管是哪個，答案其實都一樣。簡單說，冬堡正處於艱難時期。很多人都在好幾年前收拾行李遷徙到別處去了。

original: A few of us are either too stubborn or too crazy to go, so we do our best to make a living.
string: 我們當中有些異常頑固或者異常瘋狂的人拒絕離開，所以我們盡自己所能維持生活。

original: Nice place you have here.
string: 你這裡是個好地方。

original: It's not much, but we get by.
string: 賺得不多，但能糊口。

original: Very little money passes through Winterhold anymore, but if there's one thing you can count on, it's folks needing a drink now and then.
string: 冬堡很難吸引外來資金了，但如果還有一件事可以指望，那就是滿足那些需要不時來一杯的朋友們。

original: Why set up shop here?
string: 為什麼在這裡開店？

original: Wasn't by choice, I can tell you that.
string: 我可以告訴你，是因為別無選擇。

original: Options were in short supply. Ranmir and I grew up here, and nearly any money I make, he drinks away.
string: 那時候我的選擇不多。我和蘭米爾從小在這長大，而且只要是我賺的錢，都會被他喝進肚子。

original: Without the coin to pack up and leave, I decided to take to trading.
string: 因為沒錢可以收拾行李搬遷，所以我決定做生意。

original: Wasn't by choice, I can tell you that.
string: 我可以告訴你，是因為別無選擇。

original: Options were in short supply. Ranmir and I grew up here, and his drinking soaked up whatever coin we had.
string: 那時候我的選擇都已被別人搶光啦。我和蘭米爾從小在這長大，而且我只要賺來點錢，都會被他喝進肚子。

original: So I opened a shop to try and get by. Now, though...
string: 所以我就開了一家店勉強過活。但是，現在……

original: Have to admit, I'm attached to the place. Suppose that makes me crazy, doesn't it?
string: 我得承認，我離不開這個地方了。也許這讓我變得瘋狂了，有沒有？

original: What is it you do here in town?
string: 你在城鎮裡做什麼？

original: Oh, well. You know. A bit of this, a bit of that.
string: 噢，這個嘛。你知道的。一會兒忙這，一會兒忙那的。

original: They haven't made me a guard, even though I've been asking. So I'll take odd jobs, anything that comes along for now.
string: 雖然我誠懇地請求了，但他們沒錄用我成為一個衛兵。所以我做各種零工，有什麼做什麼。

original: What isn't the Jarl dealing with?
string: 領主有什麼事沒有處理？

original: Trust you saw the house that burned down. Peculiar bit of business, that was.
string: 你一定看到了那間被燒毀的房子。夠詭異的吧。

original: And that's on top of noises from the marsh in the night, tales of monsters, and now this wizard in our midst.
string: 黑夜沼澤裡的怪音、恐怖怪物的傳說，我們已經受夠了，現在這個法師又到我們鎮裡來了。

original: What's a man to do if he can't look to his Jarl for help?
string: 如果我們不能指望領主幫忙，那要領主做什麼？

original: Bah, it's no use. Let's get back to it, then.
string: 該死的，根本沒用。看來，我們還是回去吧。

original: Tell me about the conduit inside the Sepulcher.
string: 告訴我有關墳墓裡聖泉的事。

original: The conduit to Nocturnal's realm, the realm of Evergloam, has been in Skyrim... well, longer than recorded history.
string: 那聖泉通往諾克圖娜爾的位面，也就是無盡黃昏的位面，早已經存在於天際省……嗯，比目前有記載的歷史年代還要早。

original: The Twilight Sepulcher was constructed around it by man and mer in order to shield it from those who would exploit its power.
string: 人類和精靈在它的週邊建造了黃昏墳墓，這為了保護它不受來奪取力量的外人所侵襲。

original: It's through this conduit that we're given Nocturnal's greatest gift, our luck. What she gains in return is a complete mystery.
string: 就是因為這個聖泉，讓我們能接受諾克圖娜爾最仁厚的恩賜，這是我們的福氣。而她收取的回報是什麼，則不被我們所知。

original: This didn't interfere with the Nightingales?
string: 這不會和夜鶯有衝突嗎？

original: These priests weren't threat to the Skeleton Key or the conduit to Nocturnal's realm, so they were tolerated.
string: 這些祭司對骷髏鑰匙和諾克圖娜爾位面的聖泉不造成威脅，所以我們容忍他們。

original: One of their ceremonies involved the Pilgrim's Path, a so called "test of worthiness."
string: 他們有一種儀式牽涉到朝聖者之路，那儀式被稱為「虔誠之試鍊」。

original: If a pilgrim was able to complete the path, it was said that they would become one with the shadows. What that means is anyone's guess.
string: 據說如果一個朝聖者能按規定走完那條路，他將成為一個與暗影同在的人。沒有人猜得出那意味著什麼？

original: What's the story with the Pilgrim's Path?
string: 朝聖者之路到底是什麼？

original: Even though Nocturnal doesn't desire worship in the traditional sense, the Twilight Sepulcher propagated a small group of priests.
string: 雖然諾克圖娜爾不需要傳統意義上的禮拜儀式，黃昏墳墓仍然出現了一小群祭司。

original: Of course, they'd never come into direct contact with Nocturnal but they insisted they had her favor.
string: 當然，他們從不和諾克圖娜爾直接聯繫，但他們堅持認為自己受到她的眷顧。

original: As part of their "duties," the priests created all sorts of baseless rituals and ceremonies all on Nocturnal's behalf.
string: 作為他們「使命」的一部分，這些祭司自創了各式各樣沒有依據的儀式和祭祀，全都冠以諾克圖娜爾之名。

original: I can't think of anyone better suited to return the Key. Just remember to keep your eyes open and walk true with the shadows.
string: 我想不出還有誰更適合去還回鑰匙了。你要記住時刻保持警覺並隱藏在暗影中行走。

original: Listen, lad. I have faith in you. I know that sounds strange coming from a thief, but these recent events have changed my perspective.
string: 聽著，小夥子。我相信你。我知道這對一個盜賊來說有點奇怪，但最近發生的事情讓我改變了看法。

original: Listen, lass. I have faith in you. I know that sounds strange coming from a thief, but these recent events have changed my perspective.
string: 聽著，姑娘。我相信你。我知道這對一個盜賊來說有點奇怪，但最近發生的事情讓我改變了看法。

original: I don't understand why you won't come with me.
string: 我不明白妳為什麼不和我一起去。

original: I've been a Nightingale for a very long time. I sold my allegiance to Nocturnal in exchange for many profitable years of thieving.
string: 我成為夜鶯已經很長一段時間了。我發誓對諾克圖娜爾忠誠，換取了好幾年回報豐厚的盜竊生活。

original: Falling in love with Gallus was wrong. It was a distraction that allowed the Sepulcher to be desecrated and it likely cost him his life.
string: 和加盧斯產生墜入愛河是個錯誤的決定。那分散了他的注意力，使墳墓的秘密失守，而且我幾乎可以肯定，就是因為這樣而害他喪命。

original: Until the Key is returned, I will never set foot inside that place again.
string: 除非鑰匙被歸還回去，否則我不會再踏進那個地方一步。

original: Right now, the Guild needs someone to maintain order. Everyone is awaiting the news of Mercer's demise; it couldn't be a more precarious time.
string: 現在，公會需要有人維持秩序。每個人都在等待墨瑟的死訊，這是個極度缺乏穩定的時期。

original: I also need to reassure Maven that it's business as usual without Mercer... and that a new Guild Master will soon be taking over.
string: 我也需要再次向瑪雯保證沒有墨瑟一切都會照常進行……並且，一個新的公會會長會很快即位。

original: Where has Alduin gone?
string: 奧杜因去了哪裡？

original: Haven't you been listening to me? All the old tales agree that he has some means to travel to Sovngarde itself.
string: 你剛才都沒聽我說嗎？所有的古老傳說都說他有辦法直接到達英靈殿裡面。

original: There he devours the souls of the heroic dead to feed his power. You must find his portal to Sovngarde before he returns, stronger than ever.
string: 在那裡他吃掉英雄的靈魂來增長他自己的力量。你必須在他變得無比強大回到人間之前找到他通往英靈殿的傳送門。

original: The old tales say that he can travel into Sovngarde to devour the souls of the dead.
string: 古老傳說裡說他能去英靈殿吞食死者的靈魂。

original: You must find out how he does this, before he regains his strength and returns.
string: 你必須找出他如何做到這件事的，而且要趕在他重新吸滿力量回到人間之前。

original: And with that, the tour is over. I thank you for your patronage, and I hope to see you again soon!
string: 這樣一來，旅途就結束了。感謝你經常光顧，希望能快點再見到你！

original: Don't let this innocent-looking flute fool you, for this is the Dancer's Pipe.
string: 別被這根長笛的純潔外表蒙蔽了，因為它是「舞者之笛」。

original: Legend holds that the Dancer's Pipe has won wars, toppled empires and changed the very course of history.
string: 傳奇故事中都說「舞者之笛」贏得過戰爭，顛覆過王朝，改變了歷史的軌跡。

original: None know its origins, but the stories say that men who hear its music are compelled to dance uncontrollably, no matter the peril.
string: 沒人知道它的來源，但故事中說人一旦聽到它吹奏出的樂曲，就會甘冒任何危險都要不停跳舞，難以自制。

original: To activate this strange power, one must only speak the magic words, which are...
string: 啟動那些奇怪的能力，你必須述說那些魔法咒語，比如說……

original: Oh my, I very nearly got us both into a nasty predicament, didn't I?
string: 噢天吶，我差點讓咱們兩個都陷入危險，是不是？

original: Ah, now here is an item out of legend. This is Ysgramor's Soup Spoon.
string: 啊，現在我要拿出一個傳奇物品。這是伊斯格拉謨的湯匙。

original: Now, I know what you're thinking - this is no spoon, it's a fork! Nobody can eat soup with a fork!
string: 現在，我知道你在想什麼——這根本不是勺子，這是叉子！沒人能用叉子喝湯！

original: Well, my friend, you did not know Ysgramor.
string: 好吧，我的朋友，你根本不懂伊斯格拉謨。

original: Here is the Book of Fate, discovered in a secret room in the Arcane University.
string: 這是奧術大學的命運之書。

original: The writing in the book describes the destiny of its reader, so the words change from one person to the next.
string: 書裡記載著閱讀者的命運，所以每個人讀它的時候內容都不同。

original: Some see only blank pages, and nobody knows why. Perhaps some of us are born with no destiny, or maybe the blank pages signify an imminent death.
string: 有些人只能看到空白的頁面，沒人知道為什麼？可能我們有些人生下來就沒有命運，或者空白的書頁預示著即將到來的死亡。

original: These tools were found in a crypt outside Windhelm. They belonged to the ancient Nords who dwelt in Skyrim before the days of the First Empire.
string: 這些工具是在風舵城外的一個地穴找到的。它們屬於第一帝國之前的一個曾在天際省逗留的古代諾德人。

original: Most scholars believe that the Nords of old used these implements to prepare their dead for burial.
string: 大部分學者都認為以前的諾德人用這些器具為他們的死者準備墓葬。

original: What macabre mysteries would these tools reveal if they could but speak?
string: 如果這些工具能說話的話它們會講出什麼樣的可怕秘密？

original: Another time, maybe.
string: 下次再說吧。

original: Very well. If you change your mind, you can usually find me here. In the meantime, feel free to look around.
string: 沒問題。如果你改變主意了，你隨時可以來這裡找我。還有不要拘謹，隨便四處看看吧。

original: Come on! We need to get inside!
string: 加把勁！我們得趕快躲進去！

original: Where are you going? The barracks is through here!
string: 你要去哪？從這裡就能通過兵營！

original: Quick, I can cut you loose inside the keep.
string: 快點，進了要塞我就可以幫你鬆綁。

original: We've got to get inside. Now!
string: 我們得進去。馬上！

original: It's you and me, prisoner. Stay close!
string: 只有我們兩人，犯人。跟緊點！

original: I'll take the tour. (2 gold)
string: 我要參加觀光。（2金幣）

original: Splendid! If you'll just follow me, I'll tell you tales and show you wonders such as you've never seen.
string: 太美好啦！你只要跟著我，我就會給你講很多傳說故事而且讓你帶著完全的新鮮感參觀那些奇跡。

original: You mentioned a tour?
string: 你剛才說觀光？

original: Indeed I did! For a few septims, I'll tell you about some of the most interesting curiosities in my collection.
string: 我確是做到了！給我幾枚金幣，我會告訴你我的故事中最令人好奇的部分。

original: How did you assemble this collection?
string: 你是怎麼收集到這些藏品的？

original: My sister and I inherited a modest sum of money. We decided to travel and seek out whatever adventures we could find.
string: 我和我的姐妹繼承了一筆相當數目的遺產。我們決定去旅行並參加任何能遇到的冒險。

original: As we journeyed across Tamriel, we encountered tales of exotic and wondrous artifacts. We decided to collect as many as we could.
string: 我們穿行泰姆瑞爾的時候，聽到關於一些詭異而奇妙的神器傳說。我們決定要盡力收集這類傳說，越多越好。

original: My sister passed away some years ago, so I settled down here and opened the House of Curiosities.
string: 我的姐妹幾年前去世了，於是我來這裡安頓下來並開了這家傳奇之屋。

original: I think she would be happy to know that our collection has brought smiles to faces both young and old.
string: 我想她如果知道我們的收藏能讓無論年輕或年老的面龐都現出笑容的話一定很高興。

original: Have the Stormcloaks caused you any trouble?
string: 風暴斗篷給你添麻煩了嗎？

original: No more than I was already getting.
string: 我的麻煩已經夠多了。

original: Four of the guards have already decided they're in love with me. Two of the guards got into a fight over me at the tavern.
string: 四個衛兵說他們已經確定自己愛上我了。兩個衛兵在酒館為了我決鬥。

original: At least Balgruuf's men bathed regularly. These Stormcloaks always smell of ale and sweat, and their breath reeks.
string: 至少巴爾古夫的人會經常洗澡。這些風暴斗篷身上總是帶著酒味和汗味，而且有嚴重口臭。

original: How's life under Stormcloak rule?
string: 風暴斗篷統治下的生活怎麼樣？

original: Well, the Stormcloak guards drink a lot more than the Imperials did, so I've been making more money lately.
string: 這個嘛，風暴斗篷衛兵喝的酒比帝國的衛兵多得多，所以我最近賺得多了。

original: On the other hand, they're a violent bunch. Every night a fight breaks out and I end up with a smashed chair or a broken table.
string: 但另一方面，他們是具有暴力傾向的一群人。每天晚上都會發生鬥毆而最終我總是要面對一張壞桌子或一把壞椅子。

original: So, not much has changed, really.
string: 所以，實際上，沒什麼大的變化。

original: The siege must have been hard on the city's merchants.
string: 城池被圍困一定讓城裡的商人們很不好過。

original: Oh no, not at all.
string: 噢沒有，完全沒有。

original: I simply locked the doors, hid beneath my counter and prayed to the Divines that my life would be spared and my shop wouldn't burn to the ground.
string: 我就是關了大門躲在櫃檯下面，向聖靈祈禱我能活命，我的商店不會被燒成廢墟。

original: But other than that, everything was business as usual. Now, do you have any other painfully obvious things to say?
string: 但除此之外，一切商業行動都照常進行。現在，你還有什麼人盡皆知的真知灼見要講嗎？

original: Have things changed much with the Stormcloaks in charge?
string: 風暴斗篷掌權後有很大的改變嗎？

original: Well, not a great deal, no.
string: 嗯，不，不是很大。

original: But I do less business than I used to. The Stormcloaks don't like buying from anyone that isn't a Nord.
string: 但我比以前做生意做得少了。風暴斗篷不喜歡從非諾德人手裡買東西。

original: If I wasn't married to Ulfberth, I'd be out of business.
string: 要不是和烏爾夫貝斯結了婚，我一定不做生意了。

original: You guard the caravan?
string: 你負責保護商隊？

original: Yes, I was hired to protect the others as we walk the roads of Skyrim.
string: 是的，我被雇來保護那些行走在天際省上道路的旅客。

original: It is a thankless task and I would rather be back home in Elsweyr, but I have little choice.
string: 這是個吃力不討好的工作所以我想回艾斯維爾的家去，但我沒有太多選擇。

original: Ahkari freed me from a prison in Cyrodiil, and now I must repay my debt to him.
string: 阿卡利把我從賽瑞迪爾的一個監獄裡放出來，但現在我必須還他錢。

original: A word of advice, my friend --  do not mix gambling and drink. Taken together, they will empty your pockets of every septim.
string: 朋友，給你個建議——不要既喝酒又賭博。如果你兩者皆有的話，你的口袋很快就空了。

original: What dangers does the caravan face?
string: 商隊會遇到什麼危險？

original: Skyrim is filled with all manner of dangerous beasts.
string: 天際省到處都有危險的野獸。

original: Wolves, trolls, mammoths and giants would all like to make a meal of us.
string: 狼，巨魔，長毛象，還有巨人都喜歡把我們當成美味餐點。

original: But the dragons are the most fearsome. Lucky for us, they don't seem to hunt along the roads.
string: 但龍是最可怕的。幸運的是，牠們似乎不會在道路上捕獵。

original: Troll's blood! It's a torture room.
string: 巨魔的血！這是個審訊室。

original: The torture room. Gods, I wish we didn't need these....
string: 審訊室。神啊，我希望我們不用進這房間……

original: We'll get him when he comes back around. Hold your fire.
string: 我們要在他回來的時候抓住他。你們先暫時停火。

original: Release the Miasma! Release it now! Hurry, Casimir, hurry!
string: 放出毒氣！現在就放！快點，凱西米爾，快！

original: We can't hold them! Go, Casimir! Run!
string: 我們拖不住他們了！快去，凱西米爾！跑啊！

original: We can't hold them back! Go! Get to the Barrier! Release the Miasma!
string: 我們頂不住他們了！快去！去柵欄那裡！快放毒氣！

original: Keep going, Casimir! Release the Miasma!
string: 繼續前進啊，凱西米爾！放毒氣！

original: Prepare yourself.
string: 準備好吧。

original: Beyond these doors is the inner sanctum and the Skull of Corruption.
string: 在這些門後面是內部聖所和墮落頭骨。

original: Quickly! Kill him now. Kill him and claim the Skull for your own! Vaermina commands you!
string: 快點！快殺了他。殺死他然後讓墮落頭骨歸你所有！瓦爾迷納命令你！

original: When the ritual's complete, the Skull will be free and then Erandur will turn on you.
string: 當儀式完成，頭骨將得到自由，然後依蘭杜爾便會轉頭對付你。

original: He's deceiving you.
string: 他在騙你。

original: It feels good to finally have a chance to help these people. Helplessly watching them suffer's been difficult.
string: 終於有機會幫助這些人們的感覺真好。眼看著他們受苦卻無能為力實在是很難過的。

original: Follow me, it's this way.
string: 跟我來，走這邊。

original: Perhaps my prayers were answered and your reason for stumbling across Dawnstar is more than a mere coincidence.
string: 也許我的祈禱得到了回應，你偶然來到晨星城一定不僅僅是因為巧合。

original: There's a small shrine to Mara I established inside the tower's entry hall. I was hoping to seek spiritual guidance from Her.
string: 在塔的門廳裡有一座我建造的瑪拉的小型祭壇。我希望能得到她的精神引導。

original: The temple's been abandoned for decades now. Ironic isn't it... a ruin within a ruin?
string: 神殿已經廢棄好幾十年了。很諷刺吧……一個廢墟中的廢墟？

original: When the temple was active the priests would rarely be seen in Dawnstar. They preferred to live a solitary existence.
string: 當神殿香火旺時晨星城裡很少見到祭司。他們當時更喜歡過隱居的生活。

original: I'm not familiar with the tower's history, but it was deserted for quite a long time before Nightcaller Temple was established inside.
string: 我對塔的歷史不熟，但在喚夜神殿在裡面建成之前它已經荒廢很長時間了。

original: The tower on that hill is our destination. People around here call it the Tower of the Dawn.
string: 那座山上的塔就是我們要去的地方。這裡的人們把它叫做黎明之塔。

original: None that I care to talk about.
string: 沒有，所以我沒什麼可告訴你的。

original: I have friends. Only family I need.
string: 我有很多朋友。但我需要的是家人。

original: I had a daughter, once. She'd be 23 this year. Married to some hot-headed silver worker or maybe on her own learning the herb trade.
string: 我曾經有個女兒。她還在的話今年應該23歲了。可能和一個急脾氣的銀匠結婚或者自己一個人學習草藥交易。

original: The Nords didn't care who was and who wasn't involved in the Forsworn Uprising. I had spoken to Madanach once, that was enough.
string: 諾德人不關心誰參與了棄誓者的暴動而誰沒參與。我曾經和邁德納奇說過一次話，而這就足夠了。

original: But my little Aethra didn't want to see her papa leave her. She pleaded to the Jarl to take her instead.
string: 但我的小艾斯拉不想看到爸爸離開她。她求領主讓自己代替我受刑。

original: And after they made me watch as her head rolled off the block, they threw me in here anyway, to dig up their silver.
string: 他們強迫我看著她的頭顱滾下斷頭台，而且還是把我扔進了這裡，要我替他們挖銀礦。

original: Yes, but they're far from Skyrim.
string: 是的，但他們在離天際省很遠的地方。

original: (Invisible Continue)
string: （保持隱形）

original: Do you have any family? Anyone waiting for you on the outside?
string: 你有家人嗎？有人在外面等你回家嗎？

original: None of your business.
string: 跟你沒關係。

original: Fine. Don't tell me. But I know that look in your eyes. Someone who's faced death at the hands of the law.
string: 好吧。那就別說。但我知道你那眼神。那是曾經面對過法律制裁，面臨過死亡的眼神。

original: Young. I've always been known to get into trouble.
string: 年輕人。我陷入麻煩的話總會有很多人知道。

original: Then you know the hard looks as judgment gets set upon you. The sneers of people who never had to face sentence.
string: 於是你知道你的判決被下達時臉上的痛苦表情。你能聽到那些從來不用接受判決的人在譏笑。

original: It was in Helgen. I was being sent to the executioner.
string: 那是在聖地鎮。我正被送到行刑者那裡去。

original: So you know what it's like to have your life in someone else's hands. Why should they get to decide? Isn't judgment for the gods?
string: 那麼你應該知道自己的性命掌握在別人手裡是什麼感覺。為什麼由他們來決定？為什麼不是由神來審判？

original: Madanach asked me to hear your story.
string: 邁德納奇要我來聽你的故事。

original: My story, huh? Everyone in Cidhna Mine has a tale. Let's hear yours first. When was the first time you felt chains around your wrists?
string: 我的故事，哈？希訥礦坑的每個人都有故事。我們先來聽聽你的吧。你手腕上第一次帶上鐵鍊是什麼時候？

original: I want to know about Thonar.
string: 我想瞭解托納爾的事。

original: I had Markarth. My men and I drove the Nords out. We had won, or so we thought.
string: 我曾打下了馬卡斯城。我和我的臣民趕走了諾德人。我們贏了，或者說我們認為如此。

original: Retribution was swift. I was captured, quickly tried, and sentenced to death. But my execution never came.
string: 報應來得很快。我被抓捕了，迅速被審訊，並被判為死刑。但對我的刑罰沒能實行。

original: Thonar Silver-Blood stopped it. He wanted the Forsworn at his call, that I would point their rage at his enemies and spare his allies.
string: 托納爾·銀血阻止了它。他想讓棄誓者聽命於他，讓我必須集中火力對抗他的敵人而放過他的盟友。

original: And I have. Humiliating at first, but I knew he would let his guard down eventually. That he would come to trust I was under control.
string: 我照做了。一開始我覺得被他羞辱了，但我知道他終究會放鬆戒備的。總有一天他會相信我完全受他控制。

original: I had questions about the Forsworn.
string: 我想問幾個關於棄誓者的問題。

original: This was our land. We were here first. Then the Nords came and put chains on us. Forbid us from worshipping our gods.
string: 這曾我們的土地。是我們先定居在這裡的。然後諾德人來了，用鐵鍊奴役我們，也禁止我們信奉自己的神。

original: Some of us refused to bow. We knew the old ways would lead us back to having a kingdom of our own.
string: 我們中有一些人拒絕屈服。我們知道那些能讓我們重新建立自己的王國的古老方法。

original: That is who we are. The Forsworn. Criminals in our own lands. And we will cut a bloody hole into the Reach until we are free.
string: 那就是成為棄誓者。一群我們自己土地上的罪犯。我們會持續用鮮血來染紅邊塞的土地，直到我們重獲自由。

original: I don't need, or want, your help.
string: 我不需要，也不想要你的幫助。

original: So many say that, at first, until they realize the truth.
string: 一開始，很多人都這麼說，直到他們知道了真相。

original: If you change your mind, speak to Braig. Tell him I sent you. I want you to know how widespread the injustice of Markarth is.
string: 如果你改變主意的話，就跟布萊吉說。告訴他是我叫你去的。我想讓你知道在馬卡斯城肆虐的罪惡有多麼倡狂。

original: Understand? How?
string: 理解？怎麼理解？

original: There's a man named Braig inside these mines. Besides me, he's been here the longest.
string: 這礦場裡有一個叫布萊吉的男人。除了我之外，他是在這裡待最久的。

original: Tell him I sent you. Ask him why he's here. I want you to know how widespread the injustice of Markarth is.
string: 告訴他是我叫你去的。問問他為什麼會到這裡來。我想讓你知道在馬卡斯城肆虐的罪惡有多麼倡狂。

original: Let's start with revenge!
string: 讓我們開始復仇吧！

original: Then come for me, "son of Skyrim." Come for me!
string: 那就來啊，「天際之子」。來啊！

original: Then come for me, "daughter of Skyrim." Come for me!
string: 那就來啊，「天際省的姐妹」。來啊！

original: Very well. Come for me, then. Come and let's end this!
string: 很好。那就來啊。來作個了斷！

original: (Invisible Continue)
string: （保持隱形）

original: You're one of us now, you see? A slave. The boot of your kinsmen stepping on your throat. Maybe if you understood that, I could help you.
string: 你現在是我們中的一員了，明白了嗎？你是一個奴隸了。你的同胞已經一腳踩在你的喉嚨上了。等你明白這一點時，我才能幫你。

original: You're one of us now, you see? A slave. The boot of the Nord stepping on your throat. Maybe if you understood that, I could help you.
string: 你現在是我們中的一員了，明白了嗎？你是一個奴隸了。諾德人已經一腳踩在你的喉嚨上了。等你明白這一點時，我才能幫你。

original: You have a lot to answer for.
string: 你要為很多事情負責。

original: Do I? And what about you? What right did you have to meddle in my affairs? Kill my people? Was it worth it? Your truth?
string: 是嗎？那你呢？你有什麼權利干涉我的事情、殺我的人？難道你這麼做就是為了尋求所謂的真相？

original: Yes, I have.
string: 是的，我能。

original: You will release me - ro laan - if in return I promise to take you to Skuldafn and stop helping Alduin?
string: 你放了我 - 洛 蘭恩 - 作為回報，我答應帶你去斯庫達芬，並且不再幫助奧杜因。

original: What's your position on the civil war?
string: 你在內戰中扮演什麼樣的角色？

original: As long as the Empire continues to uphold its treaty obligations, my government does not concern itself with the internal politics of Skyrim.
string: 只要帝國繼續履行它的條款義務，我的政府就不去干涉天際省的內政。

original: I've never quite understood exactly what the Justiciars do.
string: 我一直不大明白審判者是做什麼的。

original: The Thalmor Justiciars are so often misunderstood. Our primary goal is to preserve the peace between the Empire and the Aldmeri Dominion.
string: 梭默審判者經常被人誤會。我們的主要目標是維護帝國和先祖神洲之間的和平。

original: The worship of the false god Talos contributed to the unfortunate friction that led to the Great War.
string: 對於虛假之神塔洛斯的崇拜，導致了雙方的爭端，最終導致了浩大戰爭的發生。

original: Following the Great War, the White-Gold Concordat set out the terms for peaceful coexistence between the two powers.
string: 在浩大戰爭之後，雙方簽訂了白金協定，規劃了雙方和平共存的條款。

original: The Empire and the Dominion agreed that the worship of Talos was a relic of the past, and must be eliminated in the interests of peace.
string: 帝國和神洲同意為了雙方的和平，必須取締崇拜塔洛斯這個過時的習俗。

original: But I'm sure you didn't come here for a lecture on high politics.
string: 但我敢肯定你不是來聽我講一堆關於政治的長篇大論的吧。

original: What does your position as Thalmor Ambassador involve?
string: 請問您身為梭默大使有什麼職責？

original: One of my main duties is to foster a better understanding between the Aldmeri Dominion and the people of Skyrim.
string: 我的其中一項主要職責是促進先祖神洲與天際省人民之間的相互理解。

original: I also oversee the activities of the Thalmor Justiciars throughout Skyrim, although this has been unfortunately disrupted by the war.
string: 我也擔負著監督天際省各處梭默審判者的活動的職責，不過這一職責不幸地被戰爭打斷了。

original: Father won't let me go see the dragon.
string: 父親肯定不許我去看龍的。

original: Is it true? Did you really capture a dragon on the Great Porch?
string: 真的嗎？你真的在大門廊抓到一頭龍？

original: A dragon in Dragonsreach. That's something I never saw coming.
string: 一頭龍在龍臨堡中。這個我從來沒有料到啊。

original: So my brother really did it. Whiterun will be the toast of Skyrim for this!
string: 看來我的兄弟真的成功了。這樣一來白漫城會贏得全天際省的尊重！

original: I'll be glad when that beast is gone from Dragonsreach. I never understood what the point of all this was.
string: 很高興那頭野獸離開龍臨堡了。我一直不明白這麼折騰到底是為什麼？

original: Capturing that dragon was a mighty deed. In my younger days, I'd have been the first to join in the attempt.
string: 抓到那頭龍是件大好事。在我年輕的時候，這種事情我肯定會第一個參加。

original: A captive dragon, just think of the possibilities!
string: 抓到一頭龍，簡直令人難以置信啊！

string: 斯庫達芬 芬 科斯 迪諾。

string: 奧杜因 薩蘭 辛 希爾 科 松文迦德！

original: Het siiv nunon dinok.
string: 海特 西弗 儂昂 迪諾。

original: Boziik, Dovahkiin. Nuz mey.
string: 波茲，都瓦克因。怒 梅。

original: It doesn't matter.
string: 沒關係。

original: Oh, fine. Keep your secrets. I see how it is.
string: 哦，好吧。留住你的秘密吧。我理解。

original: That wagon recently had a little accident. They're stranded now, just up the road.
string: 那輛貨車最近出了一場事故。它現在被擱置了，就在路邊上。

original: We're outnumbered, but I have a plan.
string: 我們寡不敵眾，但我有個主意。

original: You got here just in time.
string: 你來的正及時。

original: I blackmailed <Alias=Steward> for the information.
string: 我通過勒索<Alias=Steward>弄到了情報。

original: That was crafty. I'm sure having a steward in the pocket will come in handy.
string: 真聰明。身邊有個管家真是省事很多。

original: Lucky for us, that the wagon recently had a little accident. They're stranded now. Just up the road!
string: 我們運氣好，那輛貨車最近出了一場事故。它現在被擱置了，就在路邊上！

original: We're outnumbered, but I have a plan.
string: 我們寡不敵眾，但我有個主意。

original: You got here just in time.
string: 你來的正及時。

original: If you hadn't killed them, they would have killed you.
string: 如果你不殺他們，他們就會殺了你。

original: Only a beast kills without feeling.
string: 只有野獸才會殺人不眨眼。

original: There's an enemy wagon loaded with coin and weapons. We need to capture it.
string: 有一輛載滿了金幣和武器的敵人貨車。我們得把它搶過來。

original: Really? It just so happens we've been tracking a wagon! For about a day now.
string: 真的？我們就在追蹤這樣一輛貨車呢，已經追了有一天了。

original: So that's what's in there? Coins and weapons? How do you know that?
string: 那車裡裝有金幣和兵器？你是怎麼知道的？

original: I've been better. And you?
string: 我不是很好，你呢？

original: I'm all right, I guess. How are you?
string: 我想我應該沒事，你怎麼樣？

original: If you hadn't killed them, they would have killed you.
string: 如果你不殺他們，他們就會殺了你。

original: Only a beast kills without feeling.
string: 只有野獸才會殺人不眨眼。

original: So what's the plan?
string: 你有什麼計劃？

original: I've been better. And you?
string: 我不是很好，你呢？

original: I'm all right, I guess. How are you?
string: 我想我應該沒事，你怎麼樣？

original: Grisvar is dead.
string: 格利斯瓦死了。

original: You've finally become one of us. Come with me. I think it's time I announced my plans to you and your new brothers.
string: 你終於成為我們的一份子了。跟我來。現在是時候把我的計劃告訴你和你的新弟兄們了。

original: (Invisible Continue)
string: （保持隱形）

original: Have you met Grisvar the Unlucky? He's rightly named, and he's also a thief and a snitch.
string: 你見過「倒楣蛋」格利斯瓦了嗎？他確實人如其名，而且他還是個盜賊和告密者。

original: He's outlived his minor usefulness. Take care of him, and then we can leave Cidhna Mine for good.
string: 他這人簡直一無是處。搞定他，然後我們就可以永遠離開希訥礦坑了。

original: Spare me from your speeches.
string: 少跟我說教了。

original: You know, I'm almost beginning to like you, but you haven't earned your place out of here yet.
string: 你知道嗎？我差點就開始喜歡你了，但你還沒有贏得在這裡的地位。

original: Let me out. They're going to kill me!
string: 放我出去。他們要殺了我！

original: Madanach says hello.
string: 邁德納奇向你問好。

original: What? No. No don't kill me. Please!
string: 什麼？不不，別殺我。求你了！

original: You'll help me escape then?
string: 那你要幫我逃出去嗎？

original: Yes, but I need a show of loyalty from you. I don't need a shiv in the back while we break out.
string: 是的，但你得拿出點誠意來。我可不想在逃出去之前被你從背後刺一刀。

original: I talked to Braig.
string: 我跟布萊吉談過了。

original: Imagine hearing a story like that, over and over. Each time a different family Each time a different injustice.
string: 想像一下一遍又一遍地聽聞那樣的故事。每次都是不同的家庭遭遇不同的不公正。

original: Your meddling above ground reminded me of how removed I've been from the struggle. My men and I should be in the hills, fighting.
string: 你在地面上的所作所為讓我想起自己離這場鬥爭有多遙遠了。我的手下和我應該加入這場鬥爭。

original: You think your story justifies the murders the Forsworn have committed?
string: 你以為你的故事可以證明棄誓者犯下的殺人罪行是正當的嗎？

original: I'm not Madanach. I was never a leader of the Forsworn. The only anger I can justify is my own.
string: 我不是邁德納奇，也從來不是棄誓者的首領。這是我唯一能夠為自己辯解的事情。

original: But every family in the Reach has a story like mine. There are no innocent onlookers in this struggle. Just the guilty, and the dead.
string: 但是在邊塞的每一個家庭裡都有一個跟我一樣的故事。這場鬥爭中沒有無辜的旁觀者。只有有罪之人和死人。

original: I'm sorry to hear what happened to you.
string: 聽到你的遭遇我深表遺憾。

original: My daughter is the one who needs your pity. I'm just a poor Forsworn whose only regret is not killing more Nords before I was locked up.
string: 需要你的憐憫的是我的女兒。我只是個可憐兮兮的棄誓者，唯一的遺憾是在被關起來之前沒有殺夠諾德人。

original: All I've got.
string: 就這樣了。

original: Just one, for now.
string: 暫時只有一個。

original: I have some Sleeping Tree Sap to sell.
string: 我有一些沉睡之樹的汁液要出售。

original: Ah, of course! How much have you got?
string: 啊，沒問題！你有多少呢？

original: I found this note on Ulag's body.
string: 我在烏萊格的屍體上找到這個字條。

original: Did you? So Ulag didn't make it passed those giants then? More's the pity.
string: 是嗎？看來烏萊格沒能躲過那些巨人囉？真遺憾。

original: If you found any of the sap, I'd be willing to pay you the same cut I offered him. Better price than you are likely to find otherwise.
string: 如果你找到汁液的話，我會付你跟他一樣的價錢。這個價錢比任何地方都要好。

original: That's why I'm here. I want to join.
string: 那就是我在這裡的原因。我要加入。

string: 好吧。在讓你加入之前，我得瞭解一下你的能耐。先給你來個小小的考驗。

original: I want to fight the Empire. I'll bleed for the chance to do so.
string: 我要與帝國抗爭。我渴望有這個機會。

original: Can't fault anyone for that! As long as you hate the Empire as much as I do, that I can work with.
string: 不能因為這個責怪別人！只要你跟我一樣憎恨帝國，就可以加入我。

string: 天際省就是我的家園。
