string: 把這個當作是你存在於你的蘇姆之中，在你的呼吸之中。蘇姆 阿克 莫拉。你會燃燒什麼，會放過什麼？

original: Feim.
string: 費姆。

original: "Fade" in your tongue. Mortals have greater affinity for this Word than the dov. Everything mortal fades away in time, but the spirit remains.
string: 用你們的話來說就是「枯萎」。凡人與這個符文的關係比都瓦來得緊密。凡人的一切都會隨著時間流逝而消失，但靈魂是永存的。

original: Ponder the meaning of spirit. Unslaad zii. Where mortal flesh may wither and die, the spirit endures.
string: 思考一下靈魂的含義。安斯拉 茲。在凡人血肉枯萎和死去的地方，靈魂永存。

original: That is "Feim." Let that meaning fill you. Su'um ahrk morah. You will find that your spirit will give you more strength.
string: 是「費姆」。讓它的奧義填滿你。蘇姆 阿克 莫拉。你會發現你的靈魂會給予你更多的力量。

original: Fus.
string: 伏斯。

original: It is called "Force" in your tongue. But as you push the world, so does the world push back.
string: 用你們的話來說就是「力量」。但當你向外界施加壓力時，外界也會對你產生反作用力。

original: Think of the way force may be applied effortlessly. Imagine but a whisper pushing aside all in its path.
string: 想像一下無窮的力量在你的胸中湧動。想像一下只需隻字片語就可排山倒海的力量。

original: That is "Fus." Let its meaning fill you. Su'um ahrk morah. You will push the world harder than it pushes back.
string: 是「伏斯」。讓它的奧義填滿你。蘇姆 阿克 莫拉。你要向外界施加比其更強大的力量。

original: I wish to meditate on a Word of Power.
string: 我想要冥想一個力量之語。

original: Which calls to you, Dovahkiin? Fus, Feim, or Yol?
string: 都瓦克因，你要學什麼？伏斯、費姆，還是約？

original: You're the Master of the Greybeards. Do others come here to train?
string: 你是灰鬍子的老師。還有別人來這裡受訓嗎？

original: I have taught the Way of the Voice for centuries and the Thu'um since long before that.
string: 我教導「龍吼之道」有幾百年時間了，在此之前我一直在教導吐姆。

original: But no, Dovahkiin. Others do not come here to train anymore. Saraan. You are the first in over a hundred years.
string: 不是的，都瓦克因。不會有其他人來這裡受訓了。撒然。你是近百年來第一個進來的人。

original: I meditate on the Rotmulaag - the Words of Power. I counsel in their use. It is enough for me.
string: 我在冥想力量之語魯姆拉格。我對它們的使用提出建議。這就足夠了。

original: I've found the ice wraith teeth.
string: 我已經找到一些冰怨靈的牙齒。

original: Any idea where I can find some ice wraiths?
string: 我要去哪裡找冰怨靈？

original: Well, I'd be careful if I were you. I hear the Nords hunt them for some kind of initiation rite and not all of them end up victorious.
string: 建議你多加小心。我聽說諾德人為了搞什麼入教儀式而獵殺它們，但很少有人能成功。

original: The last traveler that traded me some said he found them at a place called Ancient's Ascent.
string: 上一個賣給我這東西的旅行者說，他是在一個名叫遠古坡道的地方找到的。

original: Careful though, rumor has it a dragon makes its home there.
string: 不過要小心，有謠言說那裡住著一頭龍。

original: Perfect, just perfect! These should help keep my stock fresh for quite a while.
string: 太好了，真是太好了！這些東西可以讓我的存貨保持新鮮一段時間了。

original: And, as promised, here's my trade. Hope you like it.
string: 對了，作為之前承諾過的，這些給你，希望你喜歡。

original: Would these do?
string: 這些可以嗎？

original: Not really interested.
string: 不怎麼感興趣。

original: Oh! Well if you change your mind, come back and see me.
string: 哦！好吧，如果你改變主意一定要回來找我。

original: Okay, I'll find some.
string: 好，我會去找一些來。

original: Thanks, I was actually worried I'd run out.
string: 謝謝，其實我還蠻擔心會用完的。

original: How do you keep this food so fresh?
string: 你是如何讓這些食物保持得如此新鮮的？

original: I picked up a trick from a butcher in Elinhir, a small town over the border in Hammerfell.
string: 我在愛林希爾的一個屠夫那裡學到一記絕活。愛林希爾是個小鎮，位於落錘省邊境上。

original: He showed me a way to grind up ice wraith teeth and use it as a preservative. Keeps everything cold and fresh, but only for a limited time.
string: 他教了我如何磨碎冰怨靈的牙齒，製作成一種防腐劑，可以用來冷藏物品、保持新鮮，但只有在一定時間內有效。

original: I'm always looking to replenish my supply, so if you ever come across five of them, I'd be more than happy to take them off your hands.
string: 我一直都想多準備些備用的材料，因此如果你找到了5份的話，我很樂意付錢買下來。

original: I found a book that might help your search.
string: 我找到了一本書，也許對你有幫助。

original: Let me see that!
string: 讓我看看！

original: Yes... yes. This is it! I don't know how you found this stranger, but you've obviously succeeded where I had failed.
string: 是的... 是的。正是這個！我不知道你是怎麼找到這個的，但你顯然辦到了我之前無法辦到的事情。

original: Please, let me offer you this key. It unlocks my strongbox under my stand in the marketplace. Help yourself to anything inside.
string: 請收下這個鑰匙。它可以打開我在市場中貨攤下面的保險箱。裡面的東西你要什麼就拿什麼？

original: I think this book may answer your questions.
string: 這本書也許能回答你的疑問。

original: Why were you searching in Skyrim?
string: 那你怎麼會在天際省中尋找線索呢？

original: I learned that a matron who had served for House Telvanni had escaped Morrowind during the Accession War.
string: 我查到了曾在泰爾瓦尼家族中工作過的一名女子在權力戰爭期間逃離了晨風省。

original: Records showed her buying passage aboard a sailing vessel named "The Pride of Tel Vos," but that's where the trail ran cold.
string: 記錄顯示她購買了一艘名叫「泰爾沃斯榮耀號」船隻的船票，但之後便沒有消息了。

original: I spent years looking for what became of the ship, but I ended up empty-handed.
string: 我花了數年時間想找出那艘船的下落，但一無所獲。

original: I'll keep an eye open.
string: 我會多加留意的。

original: Thank you.
string: 謝謝。

original: Do you have any clues about your past?
string: 你有沒有關於自己過去的線索？

original: Just one. I know when I was found by my Argonian father, I was wrapped in a blanket bearing the symbol of House Telvanni.
string: 只有一個：在我被我的亞龍人養父發現之時，我被放在一個帶有泰爾瓦尼家族標誌的籃子裡。

original: It was one of the great houses in Morrowind long ago. Whether that means I was one of them or not, I'm uncertain.
string: 那是很久以前在晨風省的幾大家族之一。我不知道自己是不是其中的一個成員。

original: If you come across anything in your travels that might provide me with the answers I'm looking for, I'd be grateful.
string: 如果你在旅途中，找到我一直尋求的答案，我會很感激你的。

original: Werewolf!
string: 狼人來了！

original: By the gods! It... it can't be!
string: 我的神啊！不……不可能！

original: It's a werewolf! To arms! To arms!
string: 那是個狼人！拿起武器，準備戰鬥！

original: I'll be glad when this beast is gone from here. Do whatever it is you need to do with it, Dragonborn.
string: 要是能把這隻野獸除掉就太好了。放手去幹吧，龍裔。

original: Farengar, very bad idea. Even for you.
string: 法仁加，你這樣做很不妥當啊。

original: Farengar! Enough, fool!
string: 法仁加！夠了，蠢貨！

original: Joor mey! What are you doing back there?
string: 約爾 梅！你在後面做什麼？

original: Surely you wouldn't miss a few scales... or a small amount of blood...
string: 你應該不在乎少掉幾塊鱗片或是流幾滴血吧……

original: I assure you, you will not even notice me. Most of them are hardly painful at all to a large dragon such as yourself.
string: 我向你保證，完全不會有什麼影響的。大部分實驗對於你這樣一頭巨龍來說是一點痛楚也沒有的。

original: I would be most appreciative if you would permit me to perform some, ah, tests on you. Purely in the interests of the advancement of knowledge.
string: 如果你允許我…呃…在你身上進行一些實驗，我會非常感激你的。這些實驗完全是出於鑽研知識的興趣。

original: Incredible! Uh... sir, you have no idea how long I have waited for such an opportunity!
string: 難以置信！呃……先生，你不知道我等這個大好機會等了多久的時間！

original: Begone, mage. Do not test my promise to the Dovahkiin.
string: 走吧，法師。不要考驗我對都瓦克因許下的承諾。

original: You're either the bravest person I've ever met, or the biggest fool.
string: 你要嘛是我遇到過最勇敢的人，要嘛就是最愚蠢的。

original: Faas nu, zini dein ruthi ahst vaal.
string: 法斯 怒，基尼 德恩魯斯 阿斯 瓦。

original: By all the gods...
string: 以眾神之名……

original: May Kynareth guard you while you pass through her realm!
string: 當你穿過凱娜瑞絲的領域時，願她守護你！

original: Carry on, soldier. This is all part of the Dragonborn's plan.
string: 照做吧，士兵。這一切都在龍裔的計劃之內。

original: I admit, I doubted you, but no more. You've made a dragon submit to your will. A feat to rival the legendary Olaf One-Eye! What glory!
string: 我承認以前懷疑過你，但再也不會了。你讓一頭龍屈服於你。這是一項能與傳說中的獨眼奧拉夫媲美的成就！簡直是無上的榮耀啊！

original: This is a local favorite and one of the first songs I ever learned. Ragnar the Red.
string: 這是本地人最喜愛、也是我學會的第一首歌：「紅衣拉格納」。

original: This one's a favorite of mine. A legend we all know and love...
string: 這是我的最愛之一，一個我們所熟知和摯愛的傳說……

original: This is an ode to Skyrim's truest sons and daughters... the Stormcloaks.
string: 這首頌詞獻給天際省最真誠的兒女們 - 風暴斗篷。

original: This is an ode to Skyrim's staunch protectors... the Imperials.
string: 這首頌詞獻給天際省最可靠的保護者——帝國。

original: This next song goes out to the Dragonborn. The savior of Skyrim.
string: 下一首歌獻給龍裔，天際省的救星。

original: Just checking on our take. How are we doing?
string: 只是來檢查一下我們的收入。情況怎麼樣？

original: It's as if the merchandise and coin are simply falling from the sky.
string: 就好像財富從天下掉下來一樣。

original: Vex and Delvin are having to turn clients away at this point, it's almost impossible to keep up.
string: 把這樣下去，「小煩」和戴爾文得把客戶打發走了，實在沒辦法維持下去。

original: Don't forget to check your tribute chest once in a while. As Guild Master you're getting a significant cut of the spoils.
string: 別忘了隔一段時間就去檢查一下你的上納箱。作為公會會長，你能分到不少。

original: How's the Guild doing?
string: 公會的狀況如何？

original: Take a good look around you! Have you ever see the Guild in such a prosperous state?
string: 看看你周圍！你有看過公會如此繁榮的樣子嗎？

original: With Mercer Frey gone and our influence present in all of Skyrim's cities, the Guild's accumulating wealth faster than we can spend it.
string: 墨瑟．弗雷不在了，我們的影響力也遍及天際省各個城市，公會獲得的財富讓我們花都花不完。

original: I couldn't be more proud to be a part of the Thieves Guild, or its new Guild Master.
string: 能成為盜賊公會的一分子，或者成為新的公會會長，這是無上的榮幸。

original: Take a good look around you! Have you ever see the Guild in such a prosperous state?
string: 看看你周圍！公會如此繁榮的狀況你有沒有見過？

original: With Mercer Frey gone and our influence spreading across Skyrim, the Guild's earned a new level of respect it hasn't seen in decades.
string: 墨瑟．弗雷不在了，我們的影響力也遍及天際省各處，公會受到的尊敬達到了數十年來從未有過的高峰。

original: I couldn't be more proud to be a part of the Thieves Guild, or its new Guild Master.
string: 能成為盜賊公會的一分子，或者是遇見新的公會會長，這是無上的榮幸。

original: About the secrecy of the Nightingales...
string: 關於夜鶯的秘密……

original: I think by now, most within the Guild are well aware of what transpired between Mercer Frey and ourselves.
string: 我想，到現在為止，公會裡大部分的人都清楚墨瑟．弗雷和我們之間發生什麼事了？

original: The notion that the Nightingales are a fictive group has long since passed.
string: 現在人們早已沒有「夜鶯只是個虛構的團體」這個觀念了。

original: If you wish to wear your Nightingale Armor within the Guild, I'm certain that no one would give it a second thought.
string: 如果你想在公會裡穿著你的夜鶯護甲，我想一定不會有人懷疑的。

original: How have things been now that Mercer's gone?
string: 墨瑟已經不在了，妳的狀況如何？

original: I'm feeling a sense of inner peace... something I haven't felt in a very long time.
string: 我感覺到內心平靜安詳……我已經很久沒有這種感覺了。

original: Instead of being clouded with thoughts of revenge and retribution, I feel only serenity and fulfillment.
string: 我不再被被復仇和報應的想法給蒙蔽，而感到平靜與滿足。

original: Of course, I've been also dabbling in my old pastimes as well. Take a look around, and feel free to share the fruits of my labor.
string: 當然，我還是很享受過去的一切。現在看看四周吧，別太拘泥，也跟大家分享成果吧。

original: It was good speaking with you again.
string: 很高興能再次與你說話。

original: May the shadows guide your journey.
string: 願暗影指引你的前路。

original: Eyes open and walk with the shadows.
string: 保持警惕，與暗影同行。

original: Eyes open and walk with the shadows.
string: 保持警惕，與暗影同行。

original: Now go and make us some coin, lad!
string: 現在去幫我們賺幾個錢吧，小夥子！

original: Now go and make us some coin, lass!
string: 現在去幫我們賺幾個錢吧，小姑娘！

original: Done? Let's get moving.
string: 搞定了？我們走吧。

original: Done, then? This way!
string: 搞定了？往這邊！

original: Get ready to open the trap!
string: 準備好打開陷阱！

original: If you were dead, I could keep the horse... (Intimidate)
string: 如果你死了，我就可以留住那匹馬……（威嚇）

original: Now wait a minute... No need to do anything drastic. Look, Keep the horse, all right? Then we all walk away happy...
string: 等一下……沒必要動粗嘛。這樣吧，你留著馬兒，行了吧？大家好聚好散……

original: Well ain't that the truth of it. All right, then. Let's see what you've got!
string: 那倒是實話。那好吧，來看看你有什麼！

original: If you were dead I could keep the horse.
string: 如果你死了，我就可以留住那匹馬。

original: I'm going to Maven unless I leave here with Frost. (Persuade)
string: 除非我帶著「寒霜」離開，否則我就去找瑪雯。（說服）

original: You're playing a dangerous game, my friend.
string: 你在玩火，朋友。

original: Fine, you win. Take the horse and leave.
string: 好吧，你贏了。牽著馬走吧。

original: And telling her what? That you stole her horse? I don't think so.
string: 你想告訴她什麼？說你偷了她的馬？不可能吧。

original: You know, I bet Maven would pay me even more for this info... (Persuade)
string: 你知道嗎，為了這個情報瑪雯會付我更多的錢……（說服）

original: Sure - take advantage of the guy in jail. Okay, fine. I can make the deal sweeter.
string: 很厲害嘛，佔一個待在監獄裡的人便宜。好吧，我可以讓這個交易更划算一些。

original: I obviously don't have anything here, but... there's a hidden stash in the Lodge. And I did manage to hold on to the key...
string: 顯然我這裡什麼也沒有，但是……在小屋那裡有一個隱藏的箱子。而且我手上也有那把鑰匙……

original: Take it.
string: 拿去。

original: Nice try, but my mother's already got me in jail. Maybe you should try that one on Letrush.
string: 不可能，我母親已經進監獄了。也許你要找的那個人在萊特魯什。

original: You mentioned something about Whiterun before?
string: 你以前提到過白漫城？

original: My daughter, Fura, was assigned to Whiterun after she joined the Imperial Army.  I was hoping you might have met her.
string: 我女兒弗拉加入帝國軍隊後，被派駐到白漫城。我原來希望你可能遇到過她。

original: I haven't heard from her lately. I've tried talking to Captain Aldis but he hasn't been any help.
string: 我有一段時間沒聽到她的消息了。我試圖向艾迪斯隊長請求幫助，但他沒幫上任何忙。

original: Actually, yes.
string: 去過。

original: Wonderful. I hadn't really hoped to run in to someone who had been there.
string: 太好了。真沒想到能遇到去過那裡的人。

original: You're a traveller, correct? Have you been to Whiterun?
string: 你是個旅行者吧？有沒有去過白漫城？

original: I'm sorry, I've never met her before.
string: 對不起，我以前沒見過她。

original: Ah, well I guess it was unlikely. I'm sorry to waste your time.
string: 喔，我想確實不太可能。很抱歉浪費你的時間了。

original: I haven't met her, but I could try to get more information.
string: 我沒見過她，不過我會想辦法打聽消息的。

original: Oh that's very sweet of you. Anything you can find out from Captain Aldis would be welcome news.
string: 哦，你真是太好了。只要你從艾迪斯隊長那裡帶回消息，我都很高興。

original: No, sorry. I haven't been to Whiterun before.
string: 不，對不起。我以前沒去過白漫城。

original: Ah well, it was a long shot.
string: 啊，這下希望不大了。

original: Have it your way. Let's get that crown men!
string: 隨便你。我們快拿上那頂王冠，夥計們！

original: Alright, get the crown off that draugr!
string: 好吧，快把王冠從那個諾德亡靈身上拿下來！

original: If you don't mind king, we'll just be taking that crown of yours and be on our way.
string: 要是你不介意做國王的話，我們就用我們的方法，來談談你那頂王冠的問題。

original: By the nine!
string: 以九聖靈之名！

original: Ralof... get away from there, fool!
string: 拉羅夫……快離開那裡，笨蛋！

original: Hey, I found a crown over here on this corpse. Is this the one we're looking for?
string: 喂，我在這具屍體上找到了一個王冠。是不是我們要找的東西？

original: Alright, get the crown off that draugr!
string: 好吧，快把王冠從那個諾德亡靈身上拿下來！

original: Have it your way. Let's get that crown men!
string: 隨便你。我們快拿那頂王冠走，夥計們！

original: Well, King... If you don't mind, we'll just take that crown of yours and be on our way.
string: 呃……陛下……如果您老人家不介意的話，我們就拿下這頂王冠走人了。

original: By the nine!
string: 以九聖靈之名！

original: Hey, I found a crown over here on this corpse. Is this the one we're looking for?
string: 喂，我在這具屍體上找到了一個王冠。是不是我們要找的東西？

original: Tell me about Markarth.
string: 告訴我關於馬卡斯城的事情。

original: Markarth is... different from the rest of Skyrim, there's no doubt about that.
string: 馬卡斯城跟天際省的其他城市不一樣，這是毫無疑問的。

original: The Reach has been part of Skyrim for a thousand years, but the Reachmen still haven't accepted it.
string: 邊塞曾經有一千年的時間作為天際省的一部分，但邊塞人仍然沒有接受這個事實。

original: It was only 20 years back that the Reachmen rebelled. Even took control of Markarth itself for a time.
string: 邊塞人叛亂事件只不過是20年前的事，當時他們曾一度控制了馬卡斯城。

original: They were crushed, of course, but the survivors - the Forsworn - still lurk in the wilds and make the Reach dangerous for honest folk.
string: 他們確實被打垮了，但那些被稱為「棄誓者」的倖存者們仍然潛伏在荒野中，威脅著人們不敢前往邊塞。

original: Die, you dog!
string: 死吧，你這條狗！

original: Death to the beastblood!
string: 你這野獸去死吧！

original: I'll rip you apart, Companion!
string: 我要把你撕個粉碎，戰友團的傢伙！

original: Ysgramor would be ashamed of you!
string: 伊斯格拉謨都會為你感到羞恥！

original: I can smell your shame!
string: 我可以察覺到你的恥辱！

original: Which one is that?
string: 那傢伙是誰？

original: We knew you'd be coming here.
string: 我們早就知道你會來這裡。

original: Well, look what we have here.
string: 啊，看看是誰來了。

original: It's time to die, dog.
string: 死期到了，狗。

original: Your mistake, Companion.
string: 這是你的錯，戰友。

original: It doesn't matter. She wears that armor, she dies.
string: 沒差。只要穿著那件盔甲就得死。

original: It doesn't matter. He wears that armor, he dies.
string: 沒差。只要穿著那件盔甲就得死。

original: Killing you will make for an excellent story.
string: 殺了你，回去我就能說一則精彩的故事了。

original: None of you will be alive to tell it.
string: 你們不會有命去說那則故事的。

original: You're going to regret this.
string: 你會為此後悔的。

original: I don't know the Firebolt spell.
string: 我不瞭解火焰箭魔法。

original: I don't know the spell for summoning a Flame Atronach.
string: 我不會召喚火焰元素的法術。

original: I don't know the Magelight spell.
string: 我不瞭解魔光術。

original: I don't know the Fear spell.
string: 我不瞭解威懼術。

original: I don't know the Heal Other spell.
string: 我不瞭解治癒他人法術。

original: No? Well, if you think you're capable of it, then I'd be happy to provide it to you for a mere 30 gold.
string: 不行？如果你認為自己有能力，那我很樂意以30金幣的低價賣給你。

original: Or you can try your luck with one of the court wizards around Skyrim. They also sell spells.
string: 或者你可以去天際省找宮廷法師，他們也會出售法術。

original: Here you are. Now I'm anxious to see you cast it.
string: 給你。現在我很想看到你使用它。

original: It's this place. It feels like home. It's just nice to finally have something going right in my life.
string: 就是這個地方。感覺就像家鄉一樣。我的人生中終於遇到一件好事了，真是太開心了。

original: So I'm finally seeing you with a smile on your face.
string: 我終於在你臉上看到笑容了。

original: Let's just hope it stays this way for a long time.
string: 希望這種好事可以長久下去。

original: Couldn't be busier.
string: 我忙得要死。

original: Better than ever. With the Guild back on its feet, there's more coin to throw around. How about you?
string: 比以前更好了。公會又再振興起來，也有更多錢可以花了。你覺得呢？

original: How's the training going?
string: 訓練情況怎麼樣了？

original: Never. This is the best the Guild's done since I've been a part of it.
string: 從來沒有吧。這是自從我加入公會以來最繁榮的景象。

original: Take a look around. Have you ever laid eyes on such wealth?
string: 看看周圍。你以前見過這樣的富足情景嗎？

original: I agree. It'll be nice to get back the respect we lost in the last few years.
string: 我同意。能夠重拾過去幾年失去的尊嚴，真是大快人心。

original: At this rate, the Guild won't be such a laughingstock anymore.
string: 照這樣下去，公會不會再成為別人的笑柄了。

original: Yeah, it's really something else, isn't it?
string: 嗯，確實如此啊。

original: You know, things are really starting to move around here. I mean, look at the place. I've never seen so much merchandise.
string: 你知道嗎，這裡開始出現蓬勃生機了。我是說，看看這個地方，如此繁榮的商貿狀況是以前從未有過的。

original: Yes, your head hurts and you don't remember where you are.
string: 是的，你頭痛記不住你在哪裡。

original: Unh, my head.
string: 呃……我的頭。

original: I see. So you don't remember fondling the statuary, then?
string: 我明白了。這麼說你不記得曾經撫摸過雕像的事？

original: Blasphemer?
string: 褻瀆者？

original: So do you remember anything I said when I got here?
string: 這麼說妳還記得我來這裡時說的話？

original: You were ranting when you got here  but most of it was slurred. You did say something about Rorikstead . Maybe you should take a look there.
string: 你來這時一直在胡言亂語；但是大部分都含糊不清，但你的確說過關於洛利克鎮的事，或許你應該去那看看。

original: You watch yourself on that island. Those mercenaries don't take prisoners.
string: 到了那個島上後，你要多加小心。那些傭兵一般都不留活口的。

original: There! Now attack it!
string: 行了！現在快攻擊它！

original: Keep it busy. I'll try to drain some of its power!
string: 纏住它。我來想辦法吸引它的力量！

original: Nothing seems to work!
string: 什麼東西都沒用！

original: We were supposed to be learning about something?
string: 是不是有什麼我們必須先瞭解的？

original: Yes, well. After the unfortunate incident that occurred, I think it's best if we just move on.
string: 是的。在那件不幸的意外發生後，我們最好忘掉它，繼續生活。

original: Noooo!
string: 不！

original: Gaaaah!
Aaaaah!
I'm ready to return to Tamriel.
string: 我已經準備好返回泰姆瑞爾了。

original: Return now to Nirn, with this rich boon from Shor, my lord: a Shout to bring a hero from Sovngarde in your hour of need.
string: 回到奈恩吧。帶著我主人，朔爾，的禮物回去。一記「龍吼」讓你在危急之時召喚一位英靈殿的英雄與你一同奮戰。

original: Not yet.
string: 還沒有。

original: Tarry not too long - the land of the dead is not meant for mortals to linger.
string: 別耽擱太久——死亡之地可不是凡人可以逗留的。

original: If it is our lot to end, we'll live in song if not in soul.
string: 如果這是我們的末日，我們將會活在頌歌中，而不是虛空之中。

original: At Sovngarde's gates I'll meet my fate with mirthful heart, and know I fell in noblest cause.
string: 在英靈殿之門，我會滿懷喜悅地迎接自己的命運，因為我將死在最高貴的事業中。

original: Now ends this tale, my eternity be damned!
string: 現在結束這個故事，讓我的永恆見鬼去吧！

original: Through fire and time, the terror has lived. No more, I say! I've set my heart on terrible deeds, death's grim art.
string: 過去，恐懼一直與戰火和時光並存。我說到此為止了！我決心要做出可怕的事情來，我要成為死神的代言人。

original: To battle, my friends! The fields will echo with the clamor of war, our wills undaunted.
string: 戰鬥吧，我的朋友們！我們英勇不屈的戰歌將在大地之間回歸！

original: We must drive away his mist, Shouting together, and then unsheathe our blades in desperate battle with our black-winged foe.
string: 我們必須驅除他的迷霧，一起吼叫，然後拔出我們的刀劍，與那個長著黑色翅膀的敵人一決死戰吧。

original: Felldir speaks wisdom - the World-Eater, coward, fears you, Dragonborn.
string: 費迪爾說得對：世界吞噬者是懦夫，他害怕你，龍裔。

original: But with four Voices joined, our valor combined, we can blast the mist and bring him to battle.
string: 但有了四個龍吼加入，再加上我們的英勇，我們可以轟開迷霧，引牠出來戰鬥。

original: Alduin's mist is more than a snare - its shadowy gloom is his shield and cloak.
string: 奧杜因的迷霧不單是個陷阱 - 霧中的陰暗就是牠最好的掩護。

original: By Shor's command we sheathed our blades and ventured not the vale's dark mist.
string: 按照朔爾的旨意，我們收好自己的刀劍，不會冒險進入山谷的迷霧中。

original: But three await your word to loose their fury upon the perilous foe.
string: 但這三人在等著你一聲令下，對著窮兇惡極的敵人釋放他們的狂暴。

original: Gormlaith the fearless, glad-hearted in battle; Hakon the valiant, heavy-handed warrior; Felldir the Old, far-seeing and grim.
string: 英勇無畏的葛拉斯，在戰場上總是歡欣鼓舞；驍勇善戰的哈孔，力大無比的戰士；老人費迪爾，遠見卓識而又嚴苛冷酷。

original: Daal...Vus!
string: 達……烏斯！

original: Nahl...
string: 吶爾……

original: The mist is gone, my mind is clear.
string: 濃霧消失了，我的神志也清晰了。

original: For Skyrim! For Shor! For Sovngarde's freedom!
string: 為了天際省！為了朔爾！為了英靈殿的自由！

original: Down with you, damned worm!
string: 去死吧，該死的蛆蟲！

original: I'll fight and die, if such fate is mine.
string: 如果這是我的命運，我會戰鬥到最後一口氣。

original: Better to die with blade in hand than feed his hunger, hopeless in the mist.
string: 戰鬥到最後一口氣，好過被他吞噬、死在絕望中。

original: No higher fate than fall in battle at Sovngarde's gates, a glorious end!
string: 能死在英靈殿大門口的戰鬥中是無比輝煌的事情，再也沒有比這更榮耀的了！

original: Before I fall, you'll feel the bite of my sharp blade, as Shor's my witness.
string: 在我斷氣之前，我會讓你好好嘗嘗這把劍的利害，大神朔爾作證！

original: Zu'u unslaad! Zu'u nis oblaan!
string: 祖 安斯拉德！祖 尼斯 傲布蘭！

original: I may fall to your malice, but your fate is already written.
string: 我可能會死在你手裡，但你的命運是無法改寫的。

original: You may strike me down, but your doom is near.
string: 我可能會被你打倒，但你的末日就要來臨了。

original: You cannot defeat us! The Dragonborn still stands!
string: 你是打不過我們的！龍裔還活著呢！

original: Your doom has come, damned worm!
string: 你的末日到了，該死的蛆蟲！

original: Stand fast! The fell worm's death is ours at last, the light returns!
string: 給我頂住！那隻蛆蟲終於要被我們殺了，光明就要回歸了！

original: Nowhere to hide! Hunter becomes our prey!
string: 你無處可躲了！獵人變成了我們的獵物！

original: Use Dragonrend, to drag him down!
string: 快用「龍魂撕裂」，把牠拖下來！

original: Die, World-Eater, in despair and fear!
string: 世界吞噬者，在絕望和恐懼之中死去吧！

original: Today you die, your doom has come.
string: 今天就是你的死期。

original: Use Dragonrend, brothers! Bring him to swords-reach!
string: 快用「龍魂撕裂」，兄弟們！把牠拉近一點！

original: Down with you, damned worm!
string: 去死吧，該死的蛆蟲！

original: For Skyrim! For Shor! For Sovngarde's freedom!
string: 為了天際省！為了朔爾！為了英靈殿的自由！

original: I've waited long for such a worthy opponent.
string: 我一直在等待著像你這樣勢均力敵的對手。

original: The joy of battle burns in your heart!
string: 你的內心燃燒著戰鬥的歡樂之火！

original: The path is closed, till your courage is tested.
string: 當你的勇氣通過考驗之後，道路才會開啟。

original: Shor's Hall awaits, if worthy you prove.
string: 朔爾的大廳在等著，如果你證明自己的話。

original: Prove worthy by warrior's test, and cross the bridge to the blessed hall.
string: 通過戰士的考驗證明你自己，然後穿過橋樑去聖廳。

original: Honest pay for honest work.
string: 實實在在的必有收穫。

original: I have nirnroot to sell.
string: 我有奈恩根要出售。

original: I have cabbage to sell.
string: 我有捲心菜要出售。

original: I have gourds to sell.
string: 我有葫蘆要出售。

original: I have leeks to sell.
string: 我有韭蔥要出售。

original: I have potatoes to sell.
string: 我有馬鈴薯要出售。

original: Ease your heart, our honor is unstained - it's by Shor's command we curb our onslaught.
string: 你要心平氣和，我們的榮耀是純潔無瑕的 - 是朔爾的旨意要我們非攻兼愛。

original: It is by Shor's command that we curb our wrath - so let's feast and sing 'til our fate calls us.
string: 我們抑制自己的怒氣是朔爾的旨意 - 那麼在命運到來之前，讓我們對酒當歌，及時行樂吧。

original: Let us not spurn our lord's bounty - this hall is his gift, for glory well-earned.
string: 我們不要拒絕主上的施捨 - 這個大廳是他的禮物，這是我們應得的榮耀。

original: I long to fight that foul worm.
string: 我很想與那個垃圾一決高下。

original: Shall Alduin remain so long unchallenged?
string: 怎麼這麼長的時間都沒人去挑戰奧杜因？

original: Agh!
string: 啊！

original: Oof!
Nargh!
string: 呃！

original: Argh!
string: 啊！

original: Weergh!
string: 噢！

original: Yeagh!
string: 耶！

original: Yearrgh!
string: 耶啊啊！

original: Hyargh!
string: 嘿呀！

original: Rrarggh!
string: 啊啊！

original: Grrargh!
string: 啊啊！

original: Aggghh!
string: 啊啊啊！

original: Nyyarrggh!
string: 嗯呀啦啦！

original: Hear that? Stormcloaks. Maybe we can reason with them.
string: 聽到了嗎？風暴斗篷。也許我們可以跟他們講道理。

original: Just give me a minute... I'm out of breath...
string: 等一下……讓我喘口氣……

original: We need to get moving! That dragon is tearing up the whole keep!
string: 我們得繼續趕路！那頭龍要把整個城堡夷為平地了！

original: Not many wood elves would choose to come alone to Skyrim.
string: 很少有森林精靈會選擇獨自一人前往天際省。

original: What're you doing here, Redguard? You a sellsword? A sailor from Stros M'kai?
string: 你在這做什麼，紅衛人？你是個傭兵，還是來自斯圖爾斯．邁凱的水手？

original: You from one of the strongholds, Orc? How did you end up here?
string: 你是從城寨中跑出來的吧，獸人？怎麼會出現在這裡？

original: You're a long way from the Imperial City. What're you doing in Skyrim?
string: 你從帝都大老遠跑到天際省，有何貴幹啊？

original: You're not with the Thalmor Embassy, are you high elf? No, that can't be right....
string: 你不是梭默大使館的人吧，高等精靈？嗯，大概你不是……

original: Another refugee? Gods really have abandoned your people, dark elf.
string: 你也是難民嗎？眾神真的拋棄了你的族人，暗精靈。

original: You from Daggerfall, Breton? Fleeing from some court intrigue?
string: 你是從匕首雨那來的吧，布萊頓人？是想躲開那裡的宮廷糾紛嗎？

original: You with one of the trade caravans, Khajiit? Your kind always seems to find trouble.
string: 你是跟貿易商隊一起來的吧，虎人？你這種人總是惹麻煩。

original: Are you a relative of one of the Riften dock workers, Argonian?
string: 裂谷城那些碼頭工人是你的親戚嗎，亞龍人？

original: You picked a bad time to come home to Skyrim, kinsman.
string: 你現在回到家鄉，真不是時候，夥計。

original: With mead and fellowship let's mend our wounds.
string: 有蜜酒跟好友的陪伴可忘卻身上的傷痛。

original: Shor's favor found me today. Let's lift a mug of mead together, our wounds to salve and weariness cure.
string: 今天幸運之神眷顧了我。我們來共同舉杯，治好身上的傷痛，消除所有的疲勞吧。

original: By a bold stroke, you bested me, friend.
string: 你這一記蓋過我了，朋友。

original: Well fought, friend. Your fury is unmatched.
string: 打得好，朋友。你的勇猛無人可敵。

original: Aye. Let us forget our sorrow in the fury of battle.
string: 對。我們來忘記戰鬥中的傷痛吧。

original: Meat and mead must ever make way for the clash of steel - the song of battle.
string: 蜜酒跟肉排一向要給金戈鐵馬的戰鬥之歌讓路。

original: Hail, comrade! Shall we by clash of steel ease the gloom of the encompassing mist?
string: 來呀，朋友！我們要不要來痛快地戰一場，消除這重重霧氣帶來的陰鬱？

original: My blade is restless, unblooded too long.
string: 我的刀刃像個急躁的小子，已經好久沒有嗜血了。

original: Listen well, friend, and lighten your mood while words I'll spin of warriors bold, whose deeds of valor brought undying fame.
string: 聽好了，朋友，我要講的是英勇戰士們建功立業的故事，聽了之後你的心情一定會振奮起來的。

original: I crave a tale of tall ships and fearless heroes, for heart's ease.
string: 我渴望聽到一個包含有高桅帆船和無畏英雄的故事，這種故事聽起來很安逸。

original: A cup I'll gladly raise in company with you. None have yet bested me in boasting or drinking.
string: 我很高興與你一同舉杯。說到吹牛皮和喝酒，還沒有人能比得過我呢。

original: Come, let us share a cup of mead, and trade tales of our time on Mundus, reliving the glory of our remembered deeds.
string: 來，讓我們乾了這杯蜂蜜酒，共同分享我們在夢達斯的故事，重現之前的輝煌時光吧。

original: I ran out of scrolls.
string: 我的卷軸用光了。

original: You what? How could you run out? J'zargo gave you more than enough. Bah, just forget J'zargo ever asked for your help.
string: 你什麼？怎麼能用光？紮格給你的已經夠多了。呸，忘掉紮格曾經請求過你的幫助吧。

original: I'm afraid she's right. I'm deeply sorry that this has to come between us.
string: 恐怕她是對的。我們之間要走到這一步，我深表遺憾。

original: But just as Paarthurnax's later deeds do not expiate his crimes, your deeds do not allow us to ignore our duty.
string: 但正如帕圖納克斯後來的行為不能抵銷他的罪過一樣，你的付出也不允許我們無視自己的職責。

original: I hope you will return to us soon with the news that justice has finally been done.
string: 我希望你儘快帶著已經伸張正義的消息回來。

original: With both Alduin and Paarthurnax dead, a dark chapter in history will finally be closed.
string: 奧杜因和帕圖納克斯都死了，歷史上黑暗的一章終於要結束了。

original: There's still the matter of Paarthurnax. I'm not ungrateful for what you've done. Esbern speaks for both of us.
string: 現在還有帕圖納克斯的問題。你付出了這麼多努力，我也不是忘恩負義的人。伊思本需要咱們兩個。

original: But our oath as Blades binds us. Paarthurnax must die. There's no excuse now that Alduin is dead.
string: 不過我們的誓言仍要遵行。帕圖納克斯必須死。既然奧杜因已經死了，那現在就沒有理由留著帕圖納克斯的小命了。

original: Thank you. Thank you, Dragonborn. You've done a great service for us all.
string: 謝謝你。謝謝，龍裔。你拯救了我們所有人。

original: I knew you could do it... I believed in you, and yet... I still didn't think I'd live to see this day.
string: 我就知道你能行的……我相信你的能力，不過……我沒想到自己能活著看到這一天。

original: You've done it... just as the prophecy said...

string: 那一天當你走進我的旅館時，我沒想過事情會發展成這樣……傳說中的巨龍出現……還有英靈殿……

original: We are all in your debt, Dragonborn.
string: 我們所有人都欠你一個人情，龍裔。

original: Since you're still alive, I assume you have good news to report?
string: 既然你還活著，那麼你應該有什麼好消息要報告吧？

string: 我們聽說了白漫城的消息 - 你居然騎著一頭龍離開了白漫城！

original: Please... Delphine has been very worried about you.

original: Perhaps, perhaps not. Dragons are not like normal mortal creatures, and Alduin is unique even among dragonkind.
string: 也許會，也許不會。龍族不像普通的凡間生物，而奧杜因在龍族中也是獨一無二的。

original: He may be permitted to return at the end of time to fulfill his destiny as the World-Eater.
string: 等到末日來臨之際，他可能會被允許回歸，以完成他作為世界吞噬者的宿命。

original: But that is for the gods to decide. You have done your part.
string: 但那就要讓眾神去定奪吧。你已經完成了你的任務。

original: Is Alduin really dead? I didn't absorb his soul when he died.
string: 奧杜因真的死了？他死的時候我沒有吸收他的靈魂。

original: You've shown yourself mighty, both in Voice and deed. In order to defeat Alduin, you've gained mastery of dreadful weapons.

original: Now it is up to you to decide what to do with your power and skill.
string: 現在該由你來決定如何利用你的力量和技能。

original: Will you be a hero whose name is remembered in song throughout the ages?
string: 你會成為一個英雄、你的名字永遠為世人所傳頌？

original: Something must've gone wrong, and he ended up in the state he's in now, fused to the energies that flow through the College.
string: 肯定是哪裡出了錯，然後他就變成現在這種狀態，跟在學院中流動的能量融合在一起。

original: I've never felt it appropriate to ask him about it, about how that must feel. Or, I suppose, if he can feel at all.
string: 我一直想問他有什麼感覺，但總是說不出口。不過，那也得要他還有知覺才行呢。

original: Let's see here....
string: 我們來看看……

original: Come on, soldier. Keep moving!
string: 快點，士兵。繼續走！

original: All right, get that armor on and give that axe a few swings.
string: 好了，穿上那套盔甲。拿那斧頭，看順不順手。

original: Grab anything useful and let's go.
string: 拿起所有有用的東西，然後就走吧。

original: It's locked. See if you can get it open with some picks. We might need that gold once we get out.
string: 它上鎖了。看你能否撬開它。等我們出去了可能要用到那些金幣。

original: Sure, take all my things. Please.
string: 當然了，我的東西你盡量難去用吧。

original: You better get that armor on. Give that sword a few swings, too.
string: 你最好穿上那套盔甲，並揮揮看那把劍。

original: What did the Psijic want?
string: 那個賽伊克人有什麼事？

original: Beyond asking for you, he never said. Very strange indeed.
string: 除了問起你的事情之外，他什麼也沒說。真是奇怪。

original: I'm... I'm not sure what happened.
string: 我... 我不確定發生了什麼事。

original: A monk from the Psijic Order, here, after all these years, and then he just leaves.
string: 一個來自賽伊克教團的修道士，已經有好多年沒來拜訪了，卻什麼也沒做就離開了。

original: I hope we didn't offend him somehow.
string: 希望我們沒有冒犯到他。

original: You sent for me?
string: 是你派人來找我的？

original: You've been a worthy patron. Shall I join you once more, free of charge?
string: 你一直是一個有價值的顧客。我是不是應該再次加入你的隊伍，還不要錢？

original: I could really use some more experience in the field. I'd be happy to join you again, and it won't cost a thing.
string: 我需要更多實戰經驗，我很想加入你，對你也沒什麼壞處。

original: Back for more? Since we had so much fun the last time, I'll join you free of charge.
string: 還想再來？既然我們上次玩的這麼開心，這次我就免費加入你。

original: If you still need my blade, I'll join you. I want to make sure you get your money's worth.
string: 如果你還需要我，我可以加入。絕對不會讓你失望的。

original: Since you paid my fee recently, I suppose it's only fair that I join you once more.
string: 既然最近幾次你都付過錢了，我應該再幫你一次才算公平。

original: I'm bored. What do you say we go smash a few heads in? This one's on me.
string: 我現在無所事事，要不我們去殺幾個人吧？這件事就交給我好了。

original: Very well, let's go. (0 gold)
string: 很好，我們走吧。（0金幣）

original: Looks like you've got some help already. I'll join you, but you'll have to let your comrade go. What do you say?
string: 看來你已經有個幫手了。我可以加入你，但你的同伴必須要離開。你的決定是？

original: Lead the way.
string: 帶路。

original: Once more into danger!
string: 我們又陷入危險了！

original: I'm ready to go!
string: 我要出發了！

original: My blade is yours once more.
string: 再一次，我的力量屬於你。

original: Good, I can use the exercise. Haha!
string: 好吧，我可以使用這個儀式。哈哈！

original: Alright, then. Let's go.
string: 那好吧，我們走。

original: Or if you're feeling lucky, you can take this bow. Might take her by surprise.
string: 如果你感覺運氣夠好的話，可以拿這把弓，也許能讓牠吃一驚。

original: Or if you're feeling lucky, you can take this bow. Might take her by surprise.
string: 如果你感覺運氣夠好的話，可以拿這把弓，也許能讓牠吃一驚。

original: I've tempered the Hide Helmet.
string: 我已經精製好皮製頭盔了。

original: You have talent. Keep working at your craft, and you'll be a fine smith one day.
string: 你天賦異稟，繼續努力吧，肯定能成為一個優秀的鐵匠。

original: Why don't you keep that dagger and helmet? Maybe you'll remember me when you're making Skyforge Steel, huh?
string: 你為什麼不留著匕首和頭盔呢？也許你能在鑄造天空熔爐之鋼的時候想起我，不是嗎？

original: Here's a Hide Helmet.
string: 這是頂皮製頭盔。

original: I should hire you to be my assistant at this rate.
string: 這樣下去我最好雇你做我的助手。

original: Let's improve the fit. Take this leather to the workbench over there.
string: 我們來搞定這件工作，把皮革拿到那邊的製作台。

original: Here's that Leather you wanted.
string: 這是你要的皮革。

original: Ah, good. A lot of weapons and armor need leather for straps, fittings, that kind of thing.
string: 啊，很好。很多兵器和裝甲需要裝上皮帶和小配件什麼的。

original: Let's see if you can make a hide helmet. Here's the rest of what you need.
string: 看你是否能做一個革製頭盔，這是其他需要的東西。

original: I've sharpened the Iron Dagger.
string: 我已經打磨過鐵匕首了。

original: This looks good. You put time into your blades, they'll serve you well when you need them.
string: 這把劍看起來不錯。你花在打磨寶劍上的時間越長，寶劍就會在你需要的時候發揮出應有的作用。

original: You want to keep helping? How about you make some armor? Let's start by tanning some leather on the rack.
string: 你想幫到底？那我們來製作盔甲吧！首先是在架子上削皮革。

original: Here's an Iron Dagger.
string: 這是把鐵匕首。

original: Not bad, but it's a little dull. How about you sharpen it up? Just need a bit of metal and the grindstone over there.
string: 還不賴，只是有點鈍了，把它磨一下吧？只需要一些金屬和磨刀石就行了。

original: Need any help around the forge?
string: 使用鍛爐需要指導嗎？

original: Yes, actually. How about you smith me an iron dagger? Here's everything you need to make one. Go ahead.
string: 沒錯。不然，你幫我打造一把鐵匕首吧？這裡是所有會用到的原料。開始吧。

original: Can I use the alchemy lab?
string: 我能使用鍊金設備嗎？

original: Long as you clean up. You know how to use it right? Mix a couple of ingredients together, see what happens.
string: 只要你用完之後把它擦乾淨。你知道怎麼用嗎？把幾種原料混在一起，看會發生些什麼？

original: A little Wheat and Blisterwort makes a healing potion, if you didn't know.
string: 告訴你吧，一些小麥和氣泡草就能做成治療藥水。

original: We have plenty of ingredients for sale, too.
string: 我們有充足的原料供銷售。

original: How do you enchant weapons and armor?
string: 你怎麼給武器和盔甲附魔？

original: Ah, a student of the craft. You'll need to start by learning an enchantment.
string: 啊哈，你想學習這門技術嗎？你得先從學會附魔配方開始。

original: Take an enchanted weapon or piece of armor, then use the Arcane Enchanter to learn its secrets. The item is destroyed in the process, so be wary.
string: 拿來一件附過魔的武器或護甲，然後用附魔台來研究其中的奧妙。要小心，這件物品在這個過程中會被摧毀。

original: Once you know an enchantment, you'll need a filled soul gem, and something to enchant. You'll use the Arcane Enchanter for that, too.
string: 學會附魔效果之後，你需要一塊充滿的靈魂石和一件物品來進行附魔。你得在附魔台上執行這些操作。

original: Of course, I have everything you need for sale, if you have the coin.
string: 當然！只要你有錢，你需要的材料我這裡都有。

original: I think we're done here.
string: 沒事了。

original: Listen, I don't want any trouble. (Persuade)
string: 聽著，我不想惹麻煩。（說服）

original: Who said anything about trouble? Now get out of my face.
string: 誰說了什麼麻煩啊？現在滾開點。

original: Gods, you're boring!
string: 天哪，你真是無聊！

original: Back off. Now. (Intimidate)
string: 馬上退後。（威嚇）

original: What's a milk drinker like you doing out here? Go home to your mother.
string: 你這個乳臭未乾的小子在這裡做什麼？回去找你媽去！

original: Get out of my face.
string: 滾開。

original: You shouldn't talk to me like that.
string: 你不該這麼跟我說話的。

original: Why? What are you gonna do, cry?
string: 為什麼？你要怎麼樣？哭嗎？

original: Can you play "The Dragonborn Comes"?
string: 你會演奏「龍裔之歌」嗎？

original: Just make sure to take care of whatever's going on there. It's my name on the line.
string: 只是想保證把那些事都解決掉，我現在自己都有麻煩。

original: Whatever you're getting paid, I'll double it. (<BribeCost> gold)
string: 你拿多少錢我都給你雙倍。（賄賂<BribeCost>金幣）

original: You want to pay me to do my job? Fine. I'll mark the location on your map.
string: 你給我錢，幫我做事？好吧，我把那個地點在地圖上標識出來。

original: Tell me where you're going before someone gets hurt. (Intimidate)
string: 我不想揍你，告訴我你要去哪。（威嚇）

original: All right, all right! No need to get violent. We're on the same side.
string: 好吧好吧！不用動手動腳！我們是站在同一邊的！

original: I'll mark it on your map. This one's on you.
string: 我會在地圖上標識出來的。看你的了！

original: Someone's going to get hurt, all right.
string: 有人要倒楣了，這點毋庸置疑。

original: I could save you a lot of trouble... (Persuade)
string: 我可以給你省下很多麻煩……（說服）

original: If you really want to do my job for me... Here, I'll mark the location on your map.
string: 如果你真想把我的工作包過去……這裡，我把任務地點標在你的地圖上。

original: No, I think I've got this one. Thanks, though.
string: 不用了，我瞭解了。多謝。

original: Where are you headed?
string: 你去哪？

original: I probably shouldn't tell everyone who asks. This is important business, you know.
string: 或許我不應該告訴其他人是誰在問。這是很重要的，我想你應該懂。

original: There's been word of some trouble nearby. I'm on my way to investigate.
string: 聽說附近有情況，我去看看。

original: Now I have some time to kill...
string: 現在我有的是時間打發……

original: Greetings, brother. You look weary. I have something to help you relax, if you're interested.
string: 兄弟，你好。你看起來很疲倦，如不介意，我這有些可以讓你放鬆的東西。

original: Greetings, sister. You look weary. I have something to help you relax, if you're interested.
string: 你好，小姐。你看起來很疲憊。如果你有興趣，我這裡有幫助你放鬆的東西。

original: Nice doing business with you, friend.
string: 朋友，合作愉快。

original: This one has something sweet for the fellow traveler, if it entices.
string: 這東西對往來的路人有極大的吸引力……

original: Important deliveries to make! No time for chatting!
string: 有重要貨物需要運送！沒時間閒聊了！

original: Instead of projecting the sky, we project all of Tamriel, and then harness the latent energies to overlay the positions of...
string: 不只是天空，我們也計畫投影整個泰姆瑞爾，然後利用潛在的力量壓倒……

original: Have you ever seen the Orrery in the Imperial City? It was the inspiration for this idea.
string: 你見過帝都的天象儀嗎？這儀器的靈感就來自於它。

original: This projection should be lit up like the night sky...
string: 這個方法應該被推廣……

original: I have nothing to say to you. Now move along, or I'll order my guards to attack.
string: 我沒什麼和你說的了。現在快走開，不然我叫人來攆你。

original: Keep away. If I am harmed, people will come looking.
string: 別過來。如果我受傷了，會有人過來察看的。

original: What's the paint on the cow for, again?
string: 奶牛身上的畫是做什麼用的？

original: And the paint on the cow?
string: 牛身上的圖案呢？

original: Thanks. You take care of yourself, now.
string: 謝謝。現在你自己多保重吧。

original: Good luck.
string: 祝你好運。

original: The cow, of course. Others do it differently, but I've found that an annual offering usually keeps the giants away from our livestock.
string: 奶牛嘛，確實。其他人不這麼做，但是我發現每年進貢可以防止巨人來騷擾我的家畜。

original: Some think it's superstition, but I believe it works. I've yet to have a giant kill any of my livestock.
string: 有些人認為是迷信，但是我相信這是有用的。到現在為止還沒有巨人來屠殺我的牲畜。

original: What are you offering to the giants?
string: 你能給巨人提供什麼？

original: I have everything under control. Thanks for offering.
string: 一切都在我掌控之下。感謝你的幫助。

original: Need any help?
string: 需要幫忙嗎？

original: I'm headed to the inn.
string: 我去旅館了。

original: It's tradition. We mark the animal as a way to let the giants know we're giving it to them willingly. Sort of a peace offering.
string: 這是一個傳統。我們在動物身上做標記，這樣巨人們以為我們是誠心給他們進貢。一種和平解決問題的方式。

original: My wife's going to kill me when I tell her we'll need to bring another cow.
string: 如果我對我妻子說我們得再弄一頭牛，她肯定會殺了我。

original: Either way this ends up, I'm headed to the inn.
string: 無論此事如何了結，我都要去酒館。

original: I'm on my way to a giant camp and I can't guarantee those beasts won't think you're part of the offering.
string: 我正在去一個巨人營地的路上，我不敢說那些蠻獸不會把你也當成貢品。

original: Keep your distance and you shouldn't have anything to worry about.
string: 保持距離就好了，你無需擔心。

original: Why?
string: 為什麼？

original: I'd stay away if I were you.
string: 我要是你我就躲得遠遠的。

original: No. I was too afraid to look. I don't know what we're going to do now. We have nothing left.
string: 不，我都不敢看了。我不知道我們應該做什麼，我們已經一無所有了。

original: Did you see where the dragon went?
string: 你看到龍去哪邊了嗎？

original: Then you've seen them, too. We lost our home, our livestock... We barely have enough gold to get by.
string: 你也已經看到過他們了。我們失去了我們的家，我們的牲畜……連生活費都沒有。

original: I know. I was at Helgen.
string: 我知道。我當時就在聖地鎮。

original: It's true about the dragons returning. Saw it with my own eyes.
string: 巨龍回歸的事情是真的。我親眼所見。

original: Thank you for your kindness.
string: 謝謝你的好意。

original: Thank you for the gold, traveler.
string: 謝謝你的金幣，旅行者。

original: That's okay. We'll find a way to get by. Safe travels.
string: 那也行。我們會想辦法度日的。旅途小心。

original: Ready now! Everyone, with me! For the Empire! For the Legion!
string: 準備！跟著我！為了帝國！為了軍團！

original: Rrrrrraaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!!
string: 啊啊啊啊啊！！！！

original: But make no mistake. What we do here today, we do for Skyrim and her people.
string: 但別搞錯。我們今天的所作所為，是為了天際省和她的子民。

original: By cutting out the disease of this rebellion, we will make this country whole again!
string: 根除這個叛亂的惡疾，我們可以使這個國家再次統一起來！

original: This is the day we send a message to Ulfric Stormcloak and the rebel Jarls who support him.
string: 今天我們要向烏弗瑞克．風暴斗篷領主和支持他的叛軍領主傳達一個訊息。

original: This is an important day for the Empire and for the Legion. And for all of Skyrim.
string: 對於帝國和軍團，乃至整個天際省，今天是一個重要的日子。

original: This is it men!
string: 是時候了！

original: Understandable. Be on your way.
string: 明白了。你走吧。

original: Thanks for wasting my time.
string: 多謝你浪費了我的時間。

original: That's right.
string: 正解。

original: Sorry, I'll be leaving now.
string: 抱歉，我得走了。

original: I need you to do something.
string: 我需要你做些事。

original: Does it involve sneaking and stabbing? Ooh, please say yes!
string: 這項工作包括潛入暗殺嗎？哦，最好是有！

original: Just name it.
string: 講出來。

original: Of course, Listener. What is it?
string: 當然，聆聽者。怎麼了？

original: This way!
string: 這邊！

original: Funny, when I was a boy, Imperial walls and towers used to make me feel so safe.
string: 想來真有趣。在我小的時候，一直覺得帝國的城牆和塔樓是那麼有安全感。

original: Rorikstead. I'm... I'm from Rorikstead.
string: 洛利克鎮。我是洛利克鎮的人。

original: A Nord's last thoughts should be of home.
string: 諾德人的遺願應該是葉落歸根。

original: Why do you care?
string: 這和你有什麼關係？

original: Hey, what village are you from horse thief?
string: 喂，你是哪個鎮的人，偷馬賊？

original: Give them their last rites.
string: 讓他們受死吧！

original: Yes, General Tullius.
string: 是，圖留斯將軍。

original: As you wish.
string: 隨你便。

original: Ditched it for this. Easier to sneak past the enemy.
string: 別管了。這樣比較容易混過去。

original: I suppose it would be. Good thinking.
string: 我覺得就是那樣。想得好！

original: I'll say what I like to him.
string: 我想跟他說什麼就跟他說什麼。

original: Of course. That's your choice. I just wanted to let you know.
string: 當然。那是你的選擇。我只是告訴你而已。

original: Thanks for the warning.
string: 多謝提醒。

original: You're welcome.
string: 歡迎。

original: Is there a problem?
string: 有什麼問題嗎？

original: No, no. Well, I don't think so.
string: 不，不。嗯，我不這麼認為。

original: What does it matter what I say to him?
string: 我跟他說什麼會有什麼關係嗎？

original: Between the two of us, there are rumors about him. That this "advisor" position he has is a sham, an excuse.
string: 這是我們之間的秘密。這有許多傳言關於他的傳言。據說他的這個顧問頭銜是個藉口、偽裝。

original: That what he's really doing is spying for the Thalmor, trying to feed them information. Whether it's true, I can't say.
string: 他真正的身份可能是梭默間諜，幫他們套取情報。是真是假，我不能斷定是真是假就是了。

original: But it never hurts to be a little suspicious, does it?
string: 但是多疑一點也沒壞處，對吧？

original: Why would Ancano be looking for me?
string: 為什麼安卡諾要找我？

original: I'm not sure. Just... Well, mind what you tell him, all right?
string: 我不太清楚。我只是……很在意你告訴了他什麼？

original: There you are. I've been trying to find you.
string: 你在這啊。我一直在找你。

original: I just wanted to let you know that Ancano's been asking about you. I think he's looking for you.
string: 我只是想說安卡諾剛才問了有關你的事，我想他在找你。

original: Has everyone here forgotten their training? Kill that thing!
string: 你們這些傢伙都忘了之前做過的訓練嗎？快殺了那東西！

original: Damn you mages! Aren't you good for anything?
string: 你們這些該死的法師！這麼一無是處？

original: I want every arrow in the sky!
string: 弓箭手都瞄準天上的目標！

original: Keep firing!
string: 繼續射！

original: Lead with those arrows, dammit!
string: 見鬼，這些箭給我中啊！

original: Up through the tower, let's go!
string: 衝過高塔，我們上！

original: Jarl Ulfric! What is that thing? Could the legends be true?
string: 烏弗瑞克領主！那是什麼？難道說傳說是真的？

original: What do you know about Ancano?
string: 你對安卡諾有什麼瞭解？

original: Don't trust that one. He's up to something.
string: 別相信那個人。他私底下在忙一些事情。

original: Most here are up to something, of course, but in his case, it's not good.
string: 這裡的大多數人當然都在忙自己的事，但是以他來說，應該不是什麼好事。

original: I haven't figured it out yet, but I will.
string: 我還沒弄明白是什麼事，但那只是遲早的問題。

original: He is rather handsome though, isn't he?
string: 他倒是挺帥的，對吧？

original: What do you know about Ancano?
string: 你對安卡諾有什麼瞭解？

original: He's asked far, far too many questions about my research.
string: 他老是在問我研究的問題，問得太多了。

original: I think the Thalmor are trying to steal my work!
string: 我懷疑梭默正試圖偷取我的研究成果！

original: I haven't told him anything, of course. What I'm doing is far too important. Can't breathe a word of it.
string: 我當然沒有告訴他任何東西。我正在進行的研究太重要了，一個字都不可洩露。

original: What do you know about Ancano?
string: 你對安卡諾有什麼瞭解？

original: I know I don't like the way he looks at me.
string: 我不喜歡他看我的眼神。

original: I can't tell if he expects me to blow myself up, or to try and murder him. But he clearly doesn't trust any of us.
string: 我不知道他是不是以為我會把自己給炸了，或者認為我會去謀殺他。但是他肯定不相信這裡每個人。

original: I know he's from the Thalmor, and that he claims to be here simply as an advisor.
string: 我知道他來自梭默，自稱是過來做顧問的。

original: I also know that no one really believes that. I've been trying to avoid him, honestly.
string: 我覺這沒人會相信這件事。老實說，我最近一直在躲著他。

original: There's a rumor that you're spying for the Thalmor.
string: 有傳言說你是梭默的間諜。

original: What?
string: 什麼？

original: Preposterous, and just the sort of thing I would expect from mages who have nothing better to do with their time.
string: 荒謬。我想只有那些無所事事的法師才做得出來這種事。

original: I have made it quite clear that my only role here is as an advisor to the Arch-Mage.
string: 我說的很清楚，我在這的唯一身份就是首席法師的顧問。

original: I would suggest that you not further spread this rumor.
string: 我建議你不要再散佈這個謠言了。

original: Thank you for your help. You may go now.
string: 謝謝你的幫助。你現在可以走了。

original: Why does this matter to you?
string: 這跟你有什麼關係？

original: Something was discovered in Saarthal that was significant enough that Tolfdir sent a new member of the College, alone, to deliver word.
string: 在薩瑟爾城有了一個重大的發現，托夫迪爾派了一名新學院成員回去傳話。

original: That sounds precisely like the sort of thing that should matter to everyone. Especially me.
string: 那很明顯的聽起來像是與每個人都息息相關的事情。特別是我。

original: How do you know anything about this?
string: 你是怎麼知道這些事情的？

original: It is my job to know these things.
string: 我的職責就是了解這些東西。

original: My role as advisor to the Arch-Mage is aided by knowing everything that transpires here.
string: 作為首席法師的顧問，我有責任瞭解這裡發生的一切。

original: Yes, we did. I just informed the Arch-Mage.
string: 是的。我已經通知首席法師了。

original: I am well aware. Tolfdir is still in Saarthal, is he? I shall be expecting a full report from him when he returns.
string: 我很清楚。托夫迪爾還在薩瑟爾城，是不是？他回來的時候我要他的完整報告！

original: Maybe...
string: 大概是吧……

original: I know full well that you have. Please do not insult my intelligence.
string: 這種事我當然清楚。請不要侮辱我的智商。

original: Tolfdir is still there now, is he? I shall expect a full report when he returns.
string: 托夫迪爾現在還在那裡，是不是？他回來的時候我要他的完整報告！

original: You there. I have questions for you.
string: 你在這。我有話要問你。

original: You were in Saarthal, yes? It has come to my attention that something was found there.
string: 你之前在薩瑟爾城，是吧？那裡的一些東西引起了我的注意。

original: Let's cut you loose.
string: 我來為你鬆綁吧。

original: Come on, you need your hands free.
string: 快，你得把綁著手的繩子弄掉。

original: Those binds aren't going to cut themselves.
string: 那些繩子可不會自己斷掉。

original: Let's cut you loose.
string: 我來為你鬆綁吧。

original: Come on, you need your hands free.
string: 快，你得把綁著手的繩子弄掉。

original: Those binds aren't going to cut themselves.
string: 那些繩子可不會自己斷掉。

original: Hooray for the Arch-Mage!
string: 首席法師萬歲！

original: Glory to the Arch-Mage!
string: 榮譽歸於首席法師！

original: Well done, well done indeed!
string: 做得好，幹得太好了！

original: Congratulations!
string: 祝賀你！

original: Long live the Arch-Mage!
string: 首席大法師萬歲！

original: Members of the College -- your new Arch-Mage!
string: 學院各位學員們 - 這位是你們的新任首席法師！

original: You've done it! The College is safe again, thanks to your work.
string: 你成功了！學院恢復了安全，謝謝你的努力！

original: I knew you had it in you. I daresay the Psijics are right. There's no one more deserving to be Arch-Mage, in my opinion.
string: 我就知道你有這個能耐。我敢說賽伊克人是對的。在我看來，沒有其他人比你更適合成為首席法師。

original: Here, consider these yours. And the Arch-Mage's quarters as well. I shall be here for advice, should you need me.
string: 這些都屬於你了，同時首席法師的住處也歸你。我會在這裡提供建議給你，隨叫隨到。

original: And speak to Eorlund if you want a better weapon than... whatever that is.
string: 想要比這破銅爛鐵更好的兵器？去和厄倫德談談。

original: At Helgen, they said you shouted the King to death?
string: 在聖地鎮，有人說你用龍吼把至高王給殺死了？

original: Not entirely true, though not entirely false either.
string: 不全對，也不全錯。

original: Any Nord can learn the Way of the Voice by studying with the Greybeards, given enough ambition and dedication.
string: 只要付出一定的熱情和精力，所有的諾德人都可以跟著灰鬍子學會龍吼之道。

original: My shouting Torygg to the ground proved he had neither.
string: 我把托依格吼倒在地。徹底證明了他的無能。

original: However, it was my sword piercing his heart that killed him.
string: 但是，我用我的劍刺穿他的心臟殺了他。

original: I'm out of missives, but I need some more.
string: 我的信紙用完了，我需要更多。

original: Certainly! Glad to see you have the task well at hand.
string: 當然！很高興看到你的工作做的不錯。

original: Get going!
string: 快走！

original: Move!
string: 快走！

original: What are you waiting for? Go!
string: 你在等什麼？快走！

original: They're hurt, but they'll live.
string: 他們受傷了，但是還死不了。

original: We'll have to carry this one on our backs....
string: 我們必須自已搞定這個了……

original: Another second out there with the dragon, and they'd both be dead....
string: 只要再和龍待多那麼一秒鐘，他們就會全死……

original: You Imperial bastards!
string: 你們這群帝國雜種！

original: Death to the Stormcloaks!
string: 風暴斗篷必死！

original: Justice!
string: 正義！

original: This was all I could find.
string: 我找到的就有這些了。

original: I see. It probably doesn't even matter now, what with the mess that's been made in here.
string: 我懂了。這裡一團糟，現在都無所謂了。

original: I'll add this to the rest of the items. I don't think there's anything further I need from you.
string: 我會把它和其餘的物品放在一起，你的任務已經完成了。

original: You're in luck. I happen to already have the mold.
string: 你運氣真好。我剛好拿到模具。

original: You've more than proven that the Thieves Guild is back on its feet in our city and earned every bit of your reward.
string: 你不僅證明了盜賊公會已在我們的城市重新崛起，而且你的付出也得到了回報。

original: Tell Delvin that he can count on me to provide the influence around here with the right people when he needs it.
string: 告訴戴爾文，如果需要，我有合適的人可以提供影響力。

original: If you're ever looking to sell any illegally obtained merchandise, I'd also provide my services as a fence. It's the least I can do.
string: 如果你打算賣一些非法貨物，我也可以提供一些服務。那是我能夠做到的。

original: Oh, Beem-Ja. I never meant for this. What have I done?
string: 噢，畢姆-加，我不是有意的。我都做了什麼？

original: Beem-Ja!
string: 畢姆-加！

original: What are you doing? Get off the road!
string: 你在做什麼？到屋裡來！

original: Get off the road, boy!
string: 不要站在外面，孩子！

original: Haming, get over here!
string: 哈明，過來！

original: Just walk towards me, come on!
string: 到我這邊來，快點！

original: Don't look up. Just focus on me. You can do it!
string: 不要向上看。跟緊我就行，你能行的！

original: Legends don't burn down villages.
string: 「傳說」可不會把村莊夷為平地。

original: By bringing down my other Hunters, you turned the chase inside out.
string: 你除掉了我其他幾個獵手，徹底扭轉了這場追逐遊戲的形勢。

original: And they were no base prey.
string: 他們絕非等閒之輩。

original: You continue to amuse and impress. Go forth, with my blessing.
string: 你還是一如往常般地讓我愉悅、讓我印象深刻。去吧，我會為你祈禱的。

original: I failed to bring down Sinding.
string: 我沒能打倒辛丁。

original: Not a failure, my servant.
string: 這不算是失敗，我的僕人。

original: I defy you and your vile tasks.
string: 我鄙視你和你那卑劣的任務。

original: So you may think.
string: 也許你是這麼想的。

original: Well met again, Hunter.
string: 很高興又見面了，獵人。

original: Come on, this way!
string: 快點，這邊！

original: Through here. Let's go!
string: 從這裡進去，快！

original: I can cut you loose inside. Come on!
string: 我可以幫你切斷繩子，快過來！

original: You! Come on, into the keep!
string: 你！快到要塞裡去！

original: Fine. I hope that dragon takes you all to Sovngarde.
string: 很好，希望你們都被那條龍送上英靈殿。

original: We're escaping, Hadvar. You're not stopping us this time.
string: 我們要跑了，哈達瓦，這次你別想攔我們。

original: Ralof! You damned traitor. Out of my way!
string: 拉羅夫！你這該死的叛徒。閃一邊去！

original: You never mentioned that lunatic living in the tunnels.
string: 你從沒說過有些瘋狂的東西住在通道裡。

original: I thought it would be better to leave some of the details out of our previous discussion. Didn't want to risk you walking away from the job.
string: 在上次我們談話中，我覺得還是忽略某些細節比較好，我可不想讓你在工作時分神。

original: Besides, you've done Maven a favor getting rid of him and saved me from wasting coin hiring someone else to do it later.
string: 還有，你把他除掉也算是幫了瑪雯一個大忙，也省得我花錢去雇其他人。

original: Any chance I could talk you into overlooking this? (Persuade)
string: 我怎樣才能說服你幫我調查此事呢？（說服）

original: You're not sweet-talking your way out of this. Not after what you did. You're headed to Cidhna Mine, and that's that.
string: 你別以為甜言蜜語幾句就能讓我網開一面，你自作自受，等著去希訥礦坑吧，別廢話了。

original: All right, but you just watch yourself. Next time, I might not be so lenient.
string: 好吧，但你注意點，下次我可不會這麼寬宏大量了。

original: Don't bother with that. Lost the key ages ago. Poor fellow screamed for weeks.
string: 放著別管。鑰匙幾年前就丟了，那可憐的傢伙哀嚎了幾星期。

original: Wait a second. Looks like there's something in this cage.
string: 稍等會兒。這籠子裡好像有東西。

original: See if you can get it open with some picks. We'll need everything we can get.
string: 看你是否能用開鎖器把它打開，我們需要利用身邊的所有東西。

original: With me, prisoner. Let's go!
string: 跟著我，囚犯，快！

original: Mage, eh? Well, to each his own. It's not for me to judge.
string: 你是法師？人各有志，我不做評論。

original: Thief, eh? It's never too late to take charge of your own fate, you know.
string: 你是盜賊？好吧，每個人都有權選擇自己的命運。

original: Warrior, good! Those stars will guide you to honor and glory.
string: 你是戰士，很好！那些星座將指引你通往名譽與榮耀。

original: Go ahead, see for yourself.
string: 你自己去看一下。

original: These are the Guardian Stones, three of the thirteen ancient standing stones that dot Skyrim's landscape.
string: 這些是守護石，天際之中一共分佈著十三個，這是其中三個。

original: Mage, eh? Well, to each his own. It's not for me to judge.
string: 你是法師？人各有志，我不做評論。

original: Thief, eh? It's never too late to take charge of your own fate, you know.
string: 你是盜賊？好吧，每個人都有權選擇自己的命運。

original: Warrior, good! I knew you shouldn't have been on that cart the minute I laid eyes on you.
string: 你是戰士，好極了！我一看到你就知道你絕非等閒之輩。

original: Go ahead, see for yourself.
string: 你自己去看一下。

original: These are the Guardian Stones, three of the thirteen ancient standing stones that dot Skyrim's landscape.
string: 這些是守護石，天際之中一共分佈著十三個立石，這是其中三個。

original: Hey now, don't take all the good stuff!
string: 喂，別把好東西都拿走了！

original: Oh, Beem...
string: 噢，畢姆……

original: Father never trusted Beem. I always thought he was just being overprotective.
string: 父親從來都不信任畢姆，我以為他只是過分謹慎而已。

original: Beem! What are you doing? Stop it!
string: 畢姆！你在做什麼？住手！

original: No Thanks
string: 不用了

original: Each has their own way.
string: 人各有志。

original: This doesn't seem legal.
string: 這看起來不怎麼合法。

original: Ah, a snitch, eh? Can't have you running to any guards now, can I?
string: 啊，你這個偷聽者，不怕我叫衛兵過來嗎？

original: Just give me what you have and we both walk away from this. (Intimidate)
string: 把所有的東西都給我，大家都可以平安離開。（威嚇）

original: No need to get so... hostile. Just take it. Sounds like you need it more than I do.
string: 用不著這麼……殺氣騰騰的。拿去吧。看來你比我更需要它。

original: Yeah... That's not going to happen.
string: 嗯……那不可能。

original: What are you talking about?
string: 你在說什麼啊？

original: The finest skooma, the sweetest moon sugar. At a fair price, of course.
string: 最好的斯庫瑪，最甜的月糖。當然，價錢公道。

original: It's in the clouds!
string: 牠在雲裡！

original: As fearless in death as he was in life.
string: 生時他無所畏懼，死後他勇魂永存。

original: Halt!
string: 停！

original: It has been an honor, Jarl Ulfric!
string: 這是我的榮幸，烏弗瑞克領主！

original: Shut up back there!
string: 後面的都給我閉嘴！

original: Good. Let's get this over with.
string: 很好，我們快點開始辦事吧。

original: What have you got for sale?
string: 你有什麼東西可以賣給我？

original: Assorted books, scrolls... I'm sure you'll find something useful.
string: 這裡有分門別類的書籍、卷軸……你肯定能找到有用的東西。

original: I have a few things laying around that weren't worth adding to the collection. You may look through them.
string: 這附近也擺了一些不值得加入收藏的書籍，你也可以看看。

original: Please make sure your hands are clean before touching anything, all right?
string: 在你摸任何東西前一定要確保你的手乾淨，了解了嗎？

original: Hadvar! Into the keep, soldier, we're leaving!
string: 哈達瓦！進要塞，士兵們，我們要走了！

original: We just need to move some of these rocks to clear the way!
string: 我們得把石頭搬開，清出一條道路！

original: Let's go!
string: 來吧！

original: With me, up the tower!
string: 跟我一起到塔上去！

original: This way, friend! Move!
string: 這邊，朋友！快跑！

original: You know, since Kodlak's funeral the Skyforge feels more... awake.
string: 在克拉科的葬禮過後，天空熔爐似乎……正在甦醒。

original: It's always been said that the souls of the heroes of old are what give Skyforge steel its strength.
string: 據說是古代勇士之魂賦予了天空熔爐之鋼如此強大的力量。

original: But I think the forge knows the greatness of Kodlak's soul. I can't really explain, but it feels like it's... young.
string: 熔爐似乎能分辨出偉大的克拉科的靈魂，不知何故，它讓人感覺到……年輕了不少。

original: I'll wager it could now forge metal the likes of which hasn't been seen since eras long forgotten.
string: 我敢說，現在它能鑄造幾個紀元前的古老鐵器了。

original: I'm eager to try.
string: 我真的很想試試。

original: That one right there, walking out the door. He was one of them asking about that old man you're looking for.
string: 那邊那個，走出門的那個。他知道你要找的老人的情況。

original: I don't want to help you.
string: 我不想幫你。

original: Suit yourself. But those who listen at doors always wonder what is beyond them.
string: 隨你的便吧。只是，聆聽過門的低語之人，總是會猜想門的另一頭到底有什麼。

original: Eventually your curiosity will drive you back to me.
string: 你最終會因好奇心回來找我。

original: I'm not so easily molded.
string: 我沒那麼容易受人影響。

original: You may think so. But in the end, you mortals will always flit like fire with the winds of your desires and conveniences.
string: 也許你是這麼想的。但你們凡人的生命只是一掠而過的火光，伴隨著欲望和貪念，如風般消散。

original: And those winds issue from my whispers.
string: 那些風也是由我吐息而成。

original: Who are you to expect anything?
string: 妳以為妳是誰啊？妳以為妳能要求什麼？

original: I forgive your not knowing my name. Few can hear my whispers anymore.
string: 你不知道我的名字，但我寬恕你。幾乎沒人能再聽到我的低語了。

original: I am Mephala, the Lady of Whispers.
string: 我是梅法拉，低語女神。

original: I tug at the web of connections between mortals. Love, hatred, loyalty, betrayal.
string: 我將凡人編織在網中。用愛與恨，忠誠與背叛。

original: What could the boy not do?
string: 那孩子有什麼不能做的？

original: The boy is good at sussing out secrets, but the corruptibility of children is ultimately too limited for my purposes.
string: 那男孩擅於挖掘秘密，但孩童有限的能力無法滿足我的需求。

original: You, though, I expect will prove far more malleable.
string: 然而你，對我來說想必會是塊可塑之材。

original: Excellent work, child.
string: 幹得太好了，孩子。

original: I can feel their heartbreak swelling in my blade.
string: 我能感受到他們在我劍尖下破碎的心。

original: Their tears shine the ebony to a sharpest gleam.
string: 黑檀岩在他們的淚光下反射出最鋒利的光芒。

original: Ah, the blood of deceit is a nourishing flow.
string: 啊，欺騙之血相當滋養啊。

original: At last, my blade is returned to its full glory.
string: 我的刀終於完全恢復了它的榮耀。

original: Now go forth, child. Continue your tiny subversions against the orders of trust and intimacy.
string: 繼續吧，孩子。繼續用你卑微的力量去破壞信任和親密。

original: The blade will feed on the ire of Tamriel. Bathe in your infamy. Feel the weight of their loathing, and my power will course through it once more.
string: 這把刀浸透了泰姆瑞爾的怒火。你們這些臭名昭著的人渣，感受它的憎惡吧，我將把我的力量將再次融入其中。

original: Seek out those closest to you. The final pluck of their misguided heartstrings will accompany my blade in the song of your grandeur.

original: In Reachwater Rock, I found a cryptic message that said the tomb here had been sealed, and should be forgotten forever. What is the story of this place?
string: 我在觸水岩找到了一條神秘的訊息，聲稱這個墓穴已經被封印了，應該被人們永久地遺忘。這裡面有什麼秘密嗎？

original: In Folgunthur, I found a cryptic message on the body of a powerful Draugr, condemning him for his ancient crimes. What was his story? Why was he entombed with a broken amulet?
string: 在佛古恩瑟，我在一個強大的諾德亡靈的屍體身上發現了一條神秘的訊息，譴責了它所犯下的先古的罪孽。它到底做了什麼事？為什麼它會被和一條破碎的項鍊埋葬在一起？

original: In Geirmund's Hall, I found a cryptic message on the body of a powerful Draugr, condemning him for his ancient crimes. What was his story? Why was he entombed with a broken amulet?
string: 在格爾蒙德大廳，我在一個強大的諾德亡靈的屍體身上發現了一條神秘的訊息，譴責了它所犯下的先古的罪孽。它到底做了什麼事？為什麼它會和一條破碎的項鍊被埋葬在一起？

original: In Saarthal, I found a cryptic message on the body of a powerful Draugr, condemning him for his ancient crimes. What was his story? Why was he entombed with a broken amulet?
string: 在薩瑟爾城，我在一個強大的諾德亡靈的屍體身上發現了一條神秘的訊息，譴責了他所犯下的先古的罪孽。他到底做了什麼事？為什麼他會和一條破碎的項鍊被埋葬在一起？

original: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered, and his three sons were hunted down by King Harald's personal battlemage. The entire incident was covered up, their names struck from every record. But the legend survived. Perhaps someone still knows the truth of this ancient tale.
string: 很久以前，大法師高爾多遭到謀殺，他的三個兒子也分別被哈拉爾德國王的御用戰鬥法師們獵殺。然而，這整起事件都被掩蓋，他們的名字被從每一條記錄上抹消。但是，傳說依舊延續著。也許總有一天，某個人能夠揭開這則古老傳說的真相。

original: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered, and his three sons were hunted down by King Harald's personal battlemage. The mage Daynas Valen spent his life searching for the truth of this tale, and came to Folgunthur with the key needed to unlock its secret.
string: 很久以前，大法師高爾多被他的三個兒子謀殺了，他的項鍊也被偷走了並且被三個兒子平分。我打敗了三兄弟並且找回了項鍊的碎片。也許高爾多的墓穴裡埋藏著如何將這些碎片還原的秘密。

original: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered by his three sons, who stole his amulet of power and divided it among themselves. The brothers were hunted down in secret and sealed in tombs across Skyrim. To reclaim the amulet, I will need to seek out their final resting places.
string: 很久以前，大法師高爾多被他的三個兒子謀殺了，他的項鍊也被偷走了並且被三個兒子平分。這三兄弟均被秘密地獵殺了，並且封鎖在了天際省各地的墓穴裡。為了找回項鍊，我必須找到他們的長眠之地。

original: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered by his three sons, who stole his amulet of power and divided it among themselves. I defeated the brothers and reclaimed the fragments of the amulet. Perhaps Gauldur's tomb holds the secret to restoring it to its original form.
string: 很久以前，大法師高爾多被他的三個兒子謀殺了，他的項鍊也被偷走了並且被三個兒子平分。我打敗了三兄弟的不死身軀，找到了項鍊的碎片，並在高爾多的墓穴裡重鑄了項鍊。

original: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered by his three sons, who stole his amulet of power and divided it among themselves. I collected the fragments of the shattered amulet and brought them to Gauldur's tomb, where the ghosts of the three brothers ambushed me.
string: 很久以前，大法師高爾多被他的三個兒子謀殺了，他的項鍊也被偷走了並且被三個兒子平分。我找回了項鍊的碎片並且帶到了高爾多的墓穴，而在那裡我遭到了三兄弟的幽靈埋伏。

original: Long ago, the Archmage Gauldur was murdered by his three sons, who stole his amulet of power and divided it among themselves. I defeated the undead brothers, located the fragments of the shattered amulet, and forged it anew in Gauldur's tomb.
string: 很久以前，大法師高爾多被他的三個兒子謀殺了，他的項鍊也被偷走了並且被三個兒子平分。我打敗了三兄弟的不死身軀，找到了項鍊的碎片，並在高爾多的墓穴裡重鑄了項鍊。

original: The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller
string: 約根．喚風號角

original: After demonstrating my ability to learn Words of Power and to Shout, the Greybeard Arngeir has sent me on a final trial - retrieving the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from his tomb in Ustengrav, a burial mound in the marshes of Hjaalmarch.
string: 在展示了我學習力量之語和龍吼的能力之後，灰鬍子艾恩蓋爾給了我最後一個試鍊——從埋葬約根．喚風的炙燃墓，一個希雅陲領沼澤裡的古墓中拿到他的號角。

original: After demonstrating my ability to learn Words of Power and to Shout, the Greybeard Arngeir sent me on a final trial - retrieving the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from his tomb in Ustengrav. Unfortunately, when I reached the tomb, I found that someone had replaced the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller with a note asking me to meet them in the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood.
string: 在展示了我學習力量之語和龍吼的能力之後，灰鬍子艾恩蓋爾給了我最後一個試鍊——從埋葬約根．喚風的炙燃墓取回他的號角。不幸的是，當我到達墓穴時，我發現某人已經把約根．喚風的號角換成了一張紙條，叫我在河木鎮的沉睡巨人客棧見他。

original: After demonstrating my ability to learn Words of Power and to Shout, the Greybeard Arngeir sent me on a final trial - retrieving the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from his tomb in Ustengrav. When I arrived, the horn was missing, and in its place was a note from Delphine asking me to meet her in Riverwood. Delphine has given me the horn, so I can now return to Arngeir and complete my training.
string: 在展示了我學習力量之語和龍吼的能力之後，灰鬍子艾恩蓋爾給了我最後一個試鍊——從埋葬約根．喚風的炙燃墓中取回他的號角。在我到達之後，號角已經不見了，那裡只有一張戴爾菲娜丟下的紙條叫我在河木鎮見她。戴爾菲娜已經把號角給我了，我可以回去找艾恩蓋爾繼續訓練了。

original: After demonstrating my ability to learn Words of Power and to Shout, the Greybeard Arngeir sent me on a final trial - retrieving the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from his tomb in Ustengrav. When I arrived, the Horn was missing, and in its place was a note from Delphine asking me to meet her in Riverwood. Delphine gave me the Horn, and I returned it to Arngeir to complete my trial. The Greybeards then greeted me formally as Dragonborn, and High Hrothgar is now open to me.
string: 在展示了我學習力量之語和龍吼的能力之後，灰鬍子艾恩蓋爾給了我最後一個試鍊——從埋葬約根．喚風的炙燃墓中取回他的號角。在我到達之後，號角已經不見了，那裡只有一張戴爾菲娜丟下的紙條叫我在河木鎮見她。戴爾菲娜已經把號角給我了，我可以回去找艾恩蓋爾繼續訓練了。灰鬍子正式尊稱我為龍裔，同時高吼峰也對我敞開了。

original: Arniel has once again asked me to speak to Enthir, who was supposed to deliver something else relating to Arniel's project.

original: Arniel was convinced that Enthir was refusing to complete the trade the two of them had arranged, but it turns out that this time Enthir never received the item in question. The courier bringing the item never arrived. If I want to help Arniel finish his work, I'll need to find the courier myself.
string: 阿內爾認為恩希爾拒絕完成他們已經安排好的交易，不過實際上恩希爾並沒有收到東西。信使根本就沒有送到。如果我想要幫助阿內爾完成他的工作的話，我需要親自找到信使。

original: Arniel was distraught over being unable to finish his project, believing that Enthir was refusing to complete a trade the two of them had agreed upon. Instead, the courier that was supposed to deliver the item never arrived. I've tracked him down (sadly he did not survive) and have the package Arniel wanted. I should make sure it gets to Arniel as soon as possible.
string: 阿內爾在為自己的計畫無法完成而煩惱，他認為恩希爾拒絕完成他們兩個早商量好的交易。實際上，是信使沒有送到。我追蹤到了他（可惜的是他沒能活下來）並且拿到了阿內爾想要的包裹。我應該確保儘快把東西送到阿內爾手裡。

original: I've helped Arniel with the final piece of his project, by tracking down a missing courier who was supposed to be delivering an item from Morrowind. That item is Keening, a dwarven dagger that Arniel claims is very important. With it, he says he's able to finish his experiment and has asked that I observe what happens.
string: 我幫助阿內爾完成了他計畫最後一個部分，追蹤到了一個從晨風送貨來的信使。送來的東西叫做哀慟，這是一把矮人匕首，阿內爾認為它非常重要。有了它，他就可以完成他實驗的最後一部分，並且他也邀請我觀看接下來發生的事情。

original: Arniel's experiment is over, but I'm not entirely sure what has happened. He has vanished, leaving behind the dagger Keening. I may never know whether he succeeded in his work.
string: 阿內爾的實驗結束了，但是我完全不清楚發生了什麼事。他消失了，只留下那把匕首哀慟。我也許無從知道他的實驗到底有沒有成功了。

original: Arniel has finally revealed to me that his secret project deals with the disappearance of the dwarves, though he hasn't been clear about how his work relates to it. He's given me a warped soul gem, and asked me to find several Dwarven Convectors in the various ruins around Skyrim. I'm supposed to place the gem inside a convector, and then heat it using a spell Arniel has taught me. When I've done this several times, I should return the gem to Arniel.

string: 在世界咽喉之巔我打敗了奧杜因之後，牠逃走了。牠的一個巨龍夥伴也許能告訴我牠逃到了哪裡。白漫領主答應幫我在龍臨堡捕獲一隻龍，我學會了一個新的以奧杜因同夥為名的龍吼，可以把一隻龍召喚到龍臨堡的庭院裡以便我設陷阱捕獲牠，然後就可以審問那隻龍以便獲悉奧杜因的巢穴然後一勞永逸地解決牠。

string: 在世界咽喉之巔我打敗了奧杜因之後，牠逃走了。牠的一個巨龍夥伴也許能告訴我牠逃到了哪裡。在白漫領主的幫助下，我在龍臨堡捕獲了巨龍傲達威英。傲達威英揭示了奧杜因的巢穴位於斯庫達芬的先古神殿，並且只能從空中到達。為了換取牠的自由，牠願意載著我去。

original: Waking Nightmare
string: 惡夢甦醒

original: I've overheard two citizens of Dawnstar complaining about horrible nightmares. They seem to be relying on a priest of Mara named Erandur for assistance.
string: 我偶然聽到晨星的兩位市民在抱怨恐怖的夢魘。他們似乎在尋求一名叫做依蘭杜爾的瑪拉祭司的幫助。

original: Erandur has assured me he can end the nightmares, the source of which seems to be within Nightcaller Temple, a place of worship for Vaermina. I have agreed to assist him in this endeavor and we are now on our way.
string: 依蘭杜爾向我保證可以結束夢魘，它的源頭似乎是喚夜神殿，一個用來崇拜瓦爾迷納的地方。我答應幫助他並且一同上路了。

original: Erandur has revealed that Nightcaller Temple contains the legendary Skull of Corruption, an artifact of great power. In order to end the nightmares, we must breach the inner sanctum and allow Erandur to perform a ritual on the Skull which will render it inert.
string: 依蘭杜爾發現喚夜神殿裡存放著傳說中的墮落頭骨，一件擁有強大力量的神器。要想終結夢魘，我們需要進入內部聖所，好讓依蘭杜爾在墮落頭骨上進行一個儀式使之無效化。

original: From a tome obtained in the temple's library, Erandur has discovered a way to breach the inner sanctum. By obtaining a special liquid, we'll be able to perform a Dreamstride... travel a distance using another subject's dreams.
string: 從神殿圖書館的一本書上，依蘭杜爾找到了進入內部聖所的方法。靠著一種特殊的液體我們可以進行夢中漫步——在其他人的夢中行走。

original: With Vaermina's Torpor in hand, I am ready to undergo the Dreamstride. I must drink the liquid which will enable me to enter the dreams of those who still slumber within these walls and use them to breach the inner sanctum.
string: 靠著手中的瓦爾迷納的睡眠藥水，我已準備好進行夢中漫步。我必須喝下這種藥水，好讓我進入這神殿內仍在睡眠的人夢中，然後靠著他們進入內部聖所。

original: I've found myself within the dreams of a priest of Vaermina. I am experiencing the Orc invasion of the temple over a decade ago. In the guise of the priest, I've been tasked with releasing the Miasma and placing everyone inside the temple in a deep sleep.
string: 我發現我自己進入了一個瓦爾迷納祭司的夢中。我體驗到了十數年前獸人進攻這座神殿的時刻。我在夢境中看見的這位祭司，被命令釋放毒氣以便讓神殿內所有人進入深深的睡眠。

original: After awakening from the Dreamstride, I was able to remove the barrier to the inner sanctum. I must now follow Erandur to the Skull of Corruption so it can be rendered inert.
string: 從「夢中漫步」中醒來，我已經可以移走內部聖所的屏障了。我必須跟著依蘭杜爾去把墮落頭骨無效化。

original: I've heard the words of the goddess Vaermina, who claims that Erandur will kill me after the ritual to destroy the Skull of Corruption is complete. I must make a choice; either allow Erandur to complete the ritual and destroy the Skull, or kill Erandur and wield the Skull of Corruption as my own.
string: 我聽到了瓦爾迷納女神的話語，她宣稱依蘭杜爾在舉行儀式毀掉墮落頭骨後會殺死我。我必須做一個選擇：允許依蘭杜爾舉行儀式毀掉頭骨，或者殺死他後將墮落頭骨據為己有。

original: I've made my decision, and allowed Erandur to live. The Skull of Corruption has been destroyed and Erandur has offered his services as a companion if I should ever need his assistance.
string: 我做出決定，讓依蘭杜爾活著。墮落頭骨已經被摧毀，如果我需要他的幫助，依蘭杜爾將與我同行。

original: I've made my decision and Erandur has died by my hands. Unfortunately, the Skull of Corruption was destroyed before I could take his life. Such moments are the misfortunes of the indecisive.
string: 我做出決定，親手殺了依蘭杜爾。不幸的是，在我殺了他之前，墮落頭骨已經被摧毀了。真是禍不單行。

original: I've made my decision and Erandur has died by my hands. I now possess the Skull of Corruption and look forward to performing my duties for Lady Vaermina.
string: 我做出決定，親手殺了依蘭杜爾。現在我擁有墮落頭骨，希望能為瓦爾迷納女士服務。

original: The Silence Has Been Broken
string: 打破靜寂

original: I returned to Nazir, but he directed me to speak with Astrid immediately. Perhaps she's made up her mind about me seeing Amaund Motierre in Volundruud.
string: 我回到了納茲爾身邊，他叫我直接去找阿斯垂德，也許她會跟我談談關於我在沃倫魯德看到阿蒙德．莫提雷的事情。

original: Astrid has agreed to let me see Amaund Motierre in the dungeon known as Volunruud, as commanded by the Night Mother. I'm to speak with Motierre, and find out what he wants.
string: 憑著夜母的命令，阿斯垂德同意讓我在叫做沃倫魯德的地下城與阿蒙德．莫提雷碰面。我要去見莫提雷，看看他想做什麼？

original: Amaund Motierre has commissioned the Dark Brotherhood to kill several people, all of which will lead to the assassination of a primary target - the Emperor of Tamriel himself. I am to report this information back to Astrid.
string: 阿蒙德．莫提雷想讓黑暗兄弟會幫他殺多個目標，目的是為了達成最終目標「刺殺泰姆瑞爾大陸的皇帝本人」。我必須把這個消息帶回給阿斯垂德。

original: I've given Astrid the amulet and sealed letter provided to me by Amaund Motierre. I'm to take the amulet to a fence named Delvin Mallory, in the Riften Ratway - to gain any information I can, and sell it if Mallory is willing to buy.
string: 我將阿蒙德．莫提雷給我的護符與密封信件交給了阿斯垂德。接著我要帶著這個護符去裂谷城鼠道找一個名叫戴爾文．馬洛里的銷贓者，盡可能地搜集護符的情報並想辦法賣掉它。

original: Delvin Mallory has informed me that the amulet provided by Amaund Motierre indicates he is a member of the Emperor's Elder Council. Mallory was willing to purchase the amulet in exchange for a letter of credit, which I must now deliver to Astrid.
string: 戴爾文．馬洛里告訴我，透過阿蒙德．莫提雷給的護符，可得知他是一名上古議會的成員。戴爾文願意用信用憑證來購買護符，現在我必須將這信用憑證帶回去並交給阿斯垂德。

original: After meeting with Amaund Motierre, I learned he is a member of the Elder Council, and wants the Dark Brotherhood to kill several people, all of whom lead to a primary target - the Emperor himself.
string: 與阿蒙德·莫提雷碰面後，我得知他是一名上古議會的成員，且他希望黑暗兄弟會能幫他殺死一系列目標，最終目的是為了殺死殺死皇帝本人。

string: 我成功攔截了<Alias=Courier>並且把假文件送給了<Alias=EnemyCapital>的敵軍指揮官。

original: The Cursed Tribe
string: 受詛咒的部落

original: I've heard rumors there's some kind of problem in the Orc settlement of Largashbur, southwest of Riften.
string: 我聽說裂谷城西南的獸人據點拉加施布爾遇到了一些麻煩。

original: The orcs of Largashbur are besieged by giants, and have been forbidden to leave their stronghold. Atub, the wise woman of the tribe, has asked me to find her Troll Fat and a Daedra Heart so that she may contact Malacath for guidance.
string: 拉加施布爾的獸人正受到巨人們攻擊，並被禁止離開他們的要塞。阿土布，部落的女智者請求我幫她找到巨魔脂肪和一顆魔族之心，以便她聯繫瑪拉凱斯尋求指引。

original: Malacath has spoken to his followers and expressed disappointment in them. He is angry they allowed his shrine to be desecrated, and has commanded the chieftain of Largashbur, Yamarz, to return to the shrine and reclaim it.
string: 瑪拉凱斯對他的追隨者表達了不滿。他很生氣他的祭壇被玷污了。他指示拉加施布爾的部落酋長亞馬茲奪回它。

original: Despite being specifically instructed by Malacath to see to it himself, Yamarz wants my help in defeating the giants that have overrun Fallowstone Cave and the shrine of Malacath. He's promised to pay me in exchange for making sure he arrives there safely.
string: 儘管被瑪拉凱斯明言下令，亞馬茲還是希望我幫他打敗巨人並奪回法羅石洞穴和瑪拉凱斯祭壇。他答應只要我保證他安全到達祭壇，就給我報酬。

original: After Malacath ordered him to retake the shrine in Fallowstone Cave, Yamarz insisted that I escort him there to make sure he arrived safely. Now he has offered to pay me even more in exchange for killing the giant myself, to which I have agreed.
string: 在被瑪拉凱斯命令奪回法羅石洞穴裡的祭壇後，亞馬茲堅持要我護送他安全抵達。現在他提議只要我能親手殺死巨人，他願意付額外的報酬。而我答應了。

original: After escorting Yamarz to Fallowstone Cave and proving myself more worthy, Malacath has commanded me to return to Largashbur and deliver Shagrol's Hammer there.

string: 事情比戴爾菲娜想的要嚴重。龍族不僅是回歸了，而且還在不斷的被其他龍復活著。戴爾菲娜懷疑這是梭默為某些陰險的目的而選擇把龍族帶回世間的。她準備和她的聯絡人聯繫讓我們滲透進梭默大使館。

She's going to help me infiltrate the Thalmor ambassador's manor and find out what they know about the dragons. I should meet with her contact, Malborn, in the Winking Skeever Inn in Solitude.
string: 事情比戴爾菲娜想的要嚴重。龍族不僅是回歸了，而且還在不斷的被其他龍復活著。戴爾菲娜懷疑這是梭默為某些陰險的目的而選擇把龍族帶回世間的。她準備幫我滲透進入梭默大使官邸看看他們對龍知道些什麼？我要去獨孤城眨眼惡鼠旅館和她的聯絡人馬伯恩碰面。

original: It seems that things are worse than even Delphine thought. Dragons aren't just coming back to life, they're being resurrected by other dragons. Delphine suspects that the Thalmor might be bringing dragons back for some sinister purpose. I met with her contact, Malborn, who is going to smuggle some of my equipment into the Thalmor ambassador's manor. I'm going to infiltrate the manor posing as a guest at the ambassador's party. Once inside, I need to meet up with Malborn and figure out a way to slip away from the party without being caught.
string: 事情比戴爾菲娜想的要嚴重。龍族不僅是回歸了，而且還在不斷的被其他龍復活著。戴爾菲娜懷疑這是梭默為某些陰險的目的而選擇把龍族帶回世間的。我見到了她的聯絡人馬伯恩，他可以把我的裝備偷運進大使官邸。我將會裝成大使的客人參加宴會。在裡面我和馬伯恩再想溜出來的辦法。

original: It seems that things are worse than even Delphine thought. Dragons aren't just coming back to life, they're being resurrected by other dragons. Delphine suspects that the Thalmor might be bringing dragons back for some sinister purpose. Her contact, Malborn, smuggled some of my equipment into the Thalmor ambassador's manor. I infiltrated the manor posing as a guest at the ambassador's party. Now I need to search the ambassador's office to find out what the Thalmor know about the dragons.
string: 事情比戴爾菲娜想的要嚴重。龍族不僅是回歸了，而且還在不斷的被其他龍復活著。戴爾菲娜懷疑這是梭默為某些陰險的目的而選擇把龍族帶回世間的。我見到了她的聯絡人馬伯恩，他把我的裝備偷運進大使官邸。我裝成大使的客人參加宴會。現在我要搜索大使的辦公室看看有沒有什麼有關龍族的資訊。

original: It seems that things are worse than even Delphine thought. Dragons aren't just coming back to life, they're being resurrected by other dragons. string: 事情比戴爾菲娜想的要嚴重。龍族不僅是回歸了，而且還在不斷的被其他龍復活著。戴爾菲娜懷疑這是梭默為某些陰險的目的而選擇把龍族帶回世間的。在馬伯恩的幫助下，我滲透進入了大使官邸。我搜索了大使的辦公室，得知梭默跟我們一樣對龍的回歸一無所知——但是他們正在裂谷城找一個叫做伊思本的刀鋒衛士，梭默認為他也許知曉龍族回歸的意義。

original: Delphine, the innkeeper in Riverwood, is more than she seems. She was the one that left me the note in Ustengrav. She gave me back the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller. She went to a lot of trouble to get my attention. I should find out what she wants.
string: 戴爾菲娜，河木鎮的旅館主人，遠比她看起來複雜。她就是在炙燃墓給我留紙條的人，也是她還給了我約根．喚風的號角。我要找出她到底想要做什麼？

original: Delphine believes that dragons are coming back to life and that the next one will resurrect near the town of Kynesgrove. Once I've convinced her that I'm Dragonborn by killing the dragon, she promises to fully explain who she is and what she wants with me.
string: 戴爾菲娜相信巨龍們活了過來並且下一隻將會在凱娜之林小鎮附近復活。只要我能殺死一隻龍就足以說服她我是龍裔，她就會告訴我她的目的。

original: Delphine believes that dragons are coming back to life and that only the Dragonborn can stop them. Near Kynesgrove, we saw a dragon Shouting another one back to life. That dragon is dead, and now it's time for Delphine to give me some answers.
string: 戴爾菲娜相信巨龍們活了過來並且只有龍裔能阻止牠們。在凱娜之林附近，我們看到一隻龍用吼叫復活了另外一隻龍。龍死了，我想戴爾菲娜該給我一些答案了。

original: Delphine believes that dragons are coming back to life and that only the Dragonborn can stop them. It turns out that she was right. Near Kynesgrove, we saw a dragon Shouting another one back to life. After we killed the dragon and I absorbed its power, Delphine accepted that I was Dragonborn as she had hoped, and revealed that she is one of the last members of the Blades, an organization dedicated to protecting the Dragonborn and stopping the dragons.
string: 戴爾菲娜相信巨龍們活了過來並且只有龍裔能阻止牠們。在凱娜之林附近，我們看到一隻龍用吼叫復活了另外一隻龍。在我們殺死了那隻龍而我吸收了牠的靈魂後，戴爾菲娜相信我就是龍裔並且告訴我她其實是最後的刀鋒衛士中的一員，這個組織致力於保護龍裔並且阻止巨龍。
